entries.translated:
Memaksimalkan Serangan
setelah serangan kritis.

entries.original: "Senses super effective moves."
entries.translation_source: Senses super effective moves.
entries.translated:
Mendeteksi gerakan
superefektif.

entries.original: "Warns of the foe’s strongest move."
entries.translation_source: Warns of the foe’s strongest move.
entries.translated:
Memperingatkan tentang
gerakan terkuat lawan.

entries.original: "Reveals the foe’s held item."
entries.translation_source: Reveals the foe’s held item.
entries.translated:
Mengungkap item yang
dibawa lawan.

entries.original: "Reverses stat changes."
entries.translation_source: Reverses stat changes.
entries.translated:
Membalikkan perubahan
statistik.

entries.original: "Stops the foe from eating Berries."
entries.translation_source: Stops the foe from eating Berries.
entries.translated:
Menghentikan lawan dari
memakan Beri.

entries.original: "Hits up Speed but drop Defense."
entries.translation_source: Hits up Speed but drop Defense.
entries.translated:
Meningkatkan Kecepatan
tapi menurunkan
Pertahanan.

entries.original: "Doubles weight."
entries.translation_source: Doubles weight.
entries.translated: Menggandakan berat.

entries.original: "Halves weight."
entries.translation_source: Halves weight.
entries.translated:
Mengurangi setengah
berat.

entries.original: "Flinching raises Speed."
entries.translation_source: Flinching raises Speed.
entries.translated:
Menggentarkan
meningkatkan Kecepatan.

entries.original: "Transforms upon entering battle."
entries.translation_source: Transforms upon entering battle.
entries.translated:
Berubah bentuk saat
memasuki pertempuran.

entries.original: "Dark-type hits raise Attack."
entries.translation_source: Dark-type hits raise Attack.
entries.translated:
Serangan tipe Gelap
meningkatkan Serangan.

entries.original: "Scary move types raise Speed."
entries.translation_source: Scary move types raise Speed.
entries.translated:
Jenis gerakan menakutkan
meningkatkan Kecepatan.

entries.original: "Critically hits poisoned foes."
entries.translation_source: Critically hits poisoned foes.
entries.translated:
Serangan kritis pada
lawan yang terkena
racun.

entries.original: "Protects against mental problems."
entries.translation_source: Protects against mental problems.
entries.translated:
Melindungi dari gangguan
mental.

entries.original: "Protects Grass-types from status."
entries.translation_source: Protects Grass-types from status.
entries.translated:
Melindungi Pokémon tipe
Rumput dari status.

entries.original: "Protects from status when sunny."
entries.translation_source: Protects from status when sunny.
entries.translated:
Melindungi dari status
saat cuaca cerah.

entries.original: "Can’t use items."
entries.translation_source: Can’t use items.
entries.translated:
Tidak bisa menggunakan
item.

entries.original: "Powers up team when sunny."
entries.translation_source: Powers up team when sunny.
entries.translated:
Meningkatkan kekuatan
tim saat cuaca cerah.

entries.original: "Hurts sleeping foes."
entries.translation_source: Hurts sleeping foes.
entries.translated:
Menyakiti lawan yang
tidur.

entries.original: "Steals foe’s item when hit."
entries.translation_source: Steals foe’s item when hit.
entries.translated:
Mencuri item lawan saat
terkena serangan.

entries.original: "Weakens non-contact moves."
entries.translation_source: Weakens non-contact moves.
entries.translated:
Melemahkan gerakan
non-kontak.

entries.original: "Can poison foe on contact."
entries.translation_source: Can poison foe on contact.
entries.translated:
Dapat meracuni lawan
saat kontak.

entries.original: "Can steal foe’s item after attack."
entries.translation_source: Can steal foe’s item after attack.
entries.translated:
Dapat mencuri item lawan
setelah menyerang.

entries.original: "Switches form when attacking."
entries.translation_source: Switches form when attacking.
entries.translated:
Berganti bentuk saat
menyerang.

entries.original: "Summons a heavy rainstorm."
entries.translation_source: Summons a heavy rainstorm.
entries.translated: Memanggil hujan deras.

entries.original: "Summons extremely harsh sunlight."
entries.translation_source: Summons extremely harsh sunlight.
entries.translated:
Memanggil sengatan sinar
matahari yang sangat
terik.

entries.original: "Summons a mysterious air current."
entries.translation_source: Summons a mysterious air current.
entries.translated:
Memanggil arus udara
misterius.

entries.original: "Ups Attack, but allows one move."
entries.translation_source: Ups Attack, but allows one move.
entries.translated:
Meningkatkan Attack,
tetapi hanya bisa
menggunakan satu
gerakan.

entries.original: "Ups Sp. Atk below half HP."
entries.translation_source: Ups Sp. Atk below half HP.
entries.translated:
Meningkatkan Sp. Atk
saat HP di bawah
setengah.

entries.original: "Never makes contact."
entries.translation_source: Never makes contact.
entries.translated:
Tidak pernah melakukan
kontak.

entries.original: "Sound moves become Water-type."
entries.translation_source: Sound moves become Water-type.
entries.translated:
Gerakan Suara menjadi
tipe Air.

entries.original: "Sometimes moves quicker."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes moves quicker.
entries.translated:
Kadang bergerak lebih
cepat.

entries.original: "Fainting damages the foe."
entries.translation_source: Fainting damages the foe.
entries.translated: Pingsan merusak lawan.

entries.original: "Blocks priority moves."
entries.translation_source: Blocks priority moves.
entries.translated:
Memblokir gerakan
prioritas.

entries.original: "Eats Berries early."
entries.translation_source: Eats Berries early.
entries.translated:
Memakan Berry lebih
awal.

entries.original: "Picks up Honey after battle."
entries.translation_source: Picks up Honey after battle.
entries.translated:
Mengambil Madu setelah
pertempuran.

entries.original: "Reduces damage done to allies."
entries.translation_source: Reduces damage done to allies.
entries.translated:
Mengurangi kerusakan
yang diterima sekutu.

entries.original: "Can regain consumed Berries."
entries.translation_source: Can regain consumed Berries.
entries.translated:
Dapat mendapatkan
kembali Berry yang sudah
dimakan.

entries.original: "Protects from allies’ moves."
entries.translation_source: Protects from allies’ moves.
entries.translated:
Melindungi dari gerakan
sekutu.

entries.original: "Enters battle disguised."
entries.translation_source: Enters battle disguised.
entries.translated:
Memasuki pertempuran
dengan menyamar.

entries.original: "Eating Berries restores HP."
entries.translation_source: Eating Berries restores HP.
entries.translated:
Memakan Berry memulihkan
HP.

entries.original: "Gives item to ally after use."
entries.translation_source: Gives item to ally after use.
entries.translated:
Memberikan item kepada
sekutu setelah
digunakan.

entries.original: "Doubles damage on replacements."
entries.translation_source: Doubles damage on replacements.
entries.translated:
Menggandakan kerusakan
pada penggantian.

entries.original: "Acts as if asleep."
entries.translation_source: Acts as if asleep.
entries.translated:
Bertindak seolah-olah
tertidur.

entries.original: "Copies dance moves."
entries.translation_source: Copies dance moves.
entries.translated: Meniru gerakan tarian.

entries.original: "Powers up allies."
entries.translation_source: Powers up allies.
entries.translated:
Meningkatkan kekuatan
sekutu.

entries.original: "Takes over a KOed ally’s Ability."
entries.translation_source: Takes over a KOed ally’s Ability.
entries.translated:
Mengambil alih Ability
sekutu yang KO.

entries.original: "Resets ally’s stat changes."
entries.translation_source: Resets ally’s stat changes.
entries.translated:
Mengatur ulang perubahan
stat sekutu.

entries.original: "Powers up super effective hits."
entries.translation_source: Powers up super effective hits.
entries.translated:
Meningkatkan kekuatan
serangan yang sangat
efektif.

entries.original: "Normal moves become Electric."
entries.translation_source: Normal moves become Electric.
entries.translated:
Gerakan Normal menjadi
Listrik.

entries.original: "Ups Attack on entry."
entries.translation_source: Ups Attack on entry.
entries.translated:
Meningkatkan Attack saat
masuk.

entries.original: "Ups Defense on entry."
entries.translation_source: Ups Defense on entry.
entries.translated:
Meningkatkan Defense
saat masuk.

entries.original: "Fetches first failed Poké Ball."
entries.translation_source: Fetches first failed Poké Ball.
entries.translated:
Mengambil Poké Ball
pertama yang gagal.

entries.original: "Lowers everyone’s Speed when hit."
entries.translation_source: Lowers everyone’s Speed when hit.
entries.translated:
Menurunkan Kecepatan
semua saat terkena
serangan.

entries.original: "Bounces back stat decreases."
entries.translation_source: Bounces back stat decreases.
entries.translated:
Memantulkan kembali
penurunan stat.

entries.original: "Spits prey if hit after a swim."
entries.translation_source: Spits prey if hit after a swim.
entries.translated:
Memuntahkan mangsa jika
terkena serangan setelah
berenang.

entries.original: "Moves ignore redirection."
entries.translation_source: Moves ignore redirection.
entries.translated:
Gerakan mengabaikan
pengalihan.

entries.original: "Fire and Water hits boost Speed."
entries.translation_source: Fire and Water hits boost Speed.
entries.translated:
Serangan Api dan Air
meningkatkan Kecepatan.

entries.original: "Ups and resists sound moves."
entries.translation_source: Ups and resists sound moves.
entries.translated:
Meningkatkan dan menahan
gerakan suara.

entries.original: "Creates a sandstorm when hit."
entries.translation_source: Creates a sandstorm when hit.
entries.translated:
Menciptakan badai pasir
saat terkena serangan.

entries.original: "Halves special damage."
entries.translation_source: Halves special damage.
entries.translated:
Mengurangi setengah
kerusakan spesial.

entries.original: "Doubles Berry effects."
entries.translation_source: Doubles Berry effects.
entries.translated: Menggandakan efek Berry.

entries.original: "Free physical hit. Hail renews."
entries.translation_source: Free physical hit. Hail renews.
entries.translated:
Serangan fisik gratis.
Hujan es memperbarui.

entries.original: "Powers up ally moves."
entries.translation_source: Powers up ally moves.
entries.translated:
Menguatkan gerakan
sekutu.

entries.original: "Changes type with terrain."
entries.translation_source: Changes type with terrain.
entries.translated:
Mengubah tipe sesuai
medan.

entries.original: "Screens are removed on entry."
entries.translation_source: Screens are removed on entry.
entries.translated:
Layar dihilangkan saat
masuk.

entries.original: "Protects team from poison."
entries.translation_source: Protects team from poison.
entries.translated:
Melindungi tim dari
racun.

entries.original:
"A physical attack
delivered with a
long tail or a
foreleg, etc."
entries.translation_source: A physical attack delivered with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
entries.translated:
Serangan fisik yang
dilancarkan dengan ekor
panjang atau kaki depan,
dll.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with a sharp chop.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
tebasan tajam. Memiliki
rasio serangan kritis
yang tinggi.

entries.original:
"The foe is slapped
repeatedly, back
and forth, two to
five times."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times.
entries.translated:
Lawan ditampar berulang
kali, bolak-balik, dua
hingga lima kali.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a flurry of punches
that strike two to
five times."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena rentetan
pukulan yang mengenai
dua hingga lima kali.

entries.original:
"The foe is slugged
by a punch thrown
with muscle-packed
power."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan
tinju bertenaga penuh
otot.

entries.original:
"Numerous coins are
hurled at the foe.
Money is earned
after battle."
entries.translation_source: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe. Money is earned after battle.
entries.translated:
Banyak koin dilemparkan
ke lawan. Uang
didapatkan setelah
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"The foe is punched
with a fiery fist.
It may leave the
foe with a burn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the foe with a burn.
entries.translated:
Musuh dipukul dengan
kepalan api. Dapat
membuat musuh terbakar.

entries.original:
"The foe is punched
with an icy fist.
It may leave the
foe with frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the foe with frostbite.
entries.translated:
Musuh dipukul dengan
kepalan es. Dapat
membuat musuh beku.

entries.original:
"The foe is punched
with an electrified
fist. It may leave
the foe paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Musuh dipukul dengan
kepalan listrik. Dapat
membuat musuh lumpuh.

entries.original:
"Hard, pointed, and
sharp claws rake
the foe."
entries.translation_source: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.
entries.translated:
Cakar yang keras,
runcing, dan tajam
menggores musuh.

entries.original:
"Huge, impressive
pincers grip and
squeeze the foe."
entries.translation_source: Huge, impressive pincers grip and squeeze the foe.
entries.translated:
Penjepit besar dan
mengesankan mencengkeram
dan meremas musuh.

entries.original:
"A vicious tearing
attack with pincers.
The foe will faint
if it hits."
entries.translation_source: A vicious tearing attack with pincers. The foe will faint if it hits.
entries.translated:
Serangan robek ganas
dengan penjepit. Musuh
akan pingsan jika
terkena.

entries.original:
"Blades of wind hit
the foe on the 2nd
turn. It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: Blades of wind hit the foe on the 2nd turn. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Bilah angin mengenai
musuh pada giliran ke-2.
Memiliki rasio pukulan
kritis yang tinggi.

entries.original:
"A frenetic dance of
fighting. It sharply
raises the Attack
stat."
entries.translation_source: A frenetic dance of fighting. It sharply raises the Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Tarian pertempuran yang
hiruk pikuk.
Meningkatkan stat
Serangan secara tajam.

entries.original:
"A basic attack.
It can be used to
cut down thin trees
and grass."
entries.translation_source: A basic attack. It can be used to cut down thin trees and grass.
entries.translated:
Serangan dasar. Dapat
digunakan untuk menebang
pohon tipis dan rumput.

entries.original:
"Strikes the foe
with a gust of wind
whipped up by
wings."
entries.translation_source: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.
entries.translated:
Menyerang musuh dengan
hembusan angin yang
dihasilkan oleh sayap.

entries.original:
"The foe is struck
with large, imposing
wings spread wide."
entries.translation_source: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide.
entries.translated:
Musuh diserang dengan
sayap besar yang
mengesankan yang
direntangkan lebar.

entries.original:
"The foe is made to
switch out with an
ally. In the wild,
the battle ends."
entries.translation_source: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.
entries.translated:
Musuh dipaksa berganti
dengan sekutu. Di alam
liar, pertempuran
berakhir.

entries.original:
"A 2-turn move that
hits on the 2nd
turn. Use it to fly
to any known town."
entries.translation_source: A 2-turn move that hits on the 2nd turn. Use it to fly to any known town.
entries.translated:
Gerakan 2 giliran yang
mengenai pada giliran
ke-2. Gunakan untuk
terbang ke kota yang
dikenal.

entries.original:
"A long body or
tentacles are used
to bind the foe for
two to five turns."
entries.translation_source: A long body or tentacles are used to bind the foe for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Tubuh panjang atau
tentakel digunakan untuk
mengikat musuh selama
dua hingga lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The foe is struck
with a long tail,
vines, etc."
entries.translation_source: The foe is struck with a long tail, vines, etc.
entries.translated:
Musuh dipukul dengan
ekor panjang, tanaman
merambat, dll.

entries.original:
"The foe is struck
with slender, whip-
like vines."
entries.translation_source: The foe is struck with slender, whip- like vines.
entries.translated:
Musuh diserang dengan
tanaman merambat tipis
seperti cambuk.

entries.original:
"The foe is stomped
with a big foot.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Musuh diinjak dengan
kaki besar. Dapat
membuat musuh mundur.

entries.original:
"Two legs are used
to quickly kick the
foe twice in one
turn."
entries.translation_source: Two legs are used to quickly kick the foe twice in one turn.
entries.translated:
Dua kaki digunakan untuk
menendang musuh dengan
cepat dua kali dalam
satu giliran.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
by a kick fired
with muscle-packed
power."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked by a kick fired with muscle-packed power.
entries.translated:
Musuh diserang dengan
tendangan yang
dilontarkan dengan
kekuatan penuh otot.

entries.original:
"The user jumps up
high, then kicks.
If it misses, the
user hurts itself."
entries.translation_source: The user jumps up high, then kicks. If it misses, the user hurts itself.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melompat
tinggi, lalu menendang.
Jika meleset, pengguna
melukai dirinya sendiri.

entries.original:
"A quick kick from a
rolling spin.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: A quick kick from a rolling spin. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Tendangan cepat dari
putaran berguling. Ini
mungkin membuat lawan
menggigil.

entries.original:
"A lot of sand is
hurled in the foe’s
face, reducing its
accuracy."
entries.translation_source: A lot of sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.
entries.translated:
Banyak pasir dilemparkan
ke wajah lawan,
mengurangi akurasinya.

entries.original:
"The user sticks its
head out and rams.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user sticks its head out and rams. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menjulurkan
kepalanya dan
menyeruduk. Ini mungkin
membuat lawan menggigil.

entries.original:
"The foe is jabbed
with a sharply
pointed horn to
inflict damage."
entries.translation_source: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
entries.translated:
Lawan ditusuk dengan
tanduk yang sangat
runcing untuk memberikan
kerusakan.

entries.original:
"The foe is jabbed
repeatedly with a
horn or beak two to
five times."

entries.translated:
Lawan ditusuk berulang
kali dengan tanduk atau
paruh dua hingga lima
kali.

entries.original:
"The horn is rotated

The foe will faint
if it hits."
entries.translation_source: The horn is rotated like a drill to ram. The foe will faint if it hits.
entries.translated:
Tanduk diputar seperti
bor untuk menyeruduk.
Lawan akan pingsan jika
terkena.

entries.original:
"A physical attack
in which the user
charges, full body,
into the foe."
entries.translation_source: A physical attack in which the user charges, full body, into the foe.
entries.translated:
Serangan fisik di mana
pengguna menyerbu,
seluruh tubuh, ke lawan.

entries.original:
"The user drops its
full body on the
foe. It may leave
the foe paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menjatuhkan
seluruh tubuhnya ke
lawan. Ini mungkin
membuat lawan lumpuh.

entries.original:
"A long body or
vines are used to
wrap the foe for
two to five turns."

entries.translated:
Tubuh panjang atau
tanaman merambat
digunakan untuk melilit
lawan selama dua hingga
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"A reckless, full-
body charge attack

user a little."

Serangan menyerbu
seluruh tubuh yang
ceroboh yang juga
sedikit melukai
pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user rampages
about for two to
three turns, then
becomes confused."

entries.translated:
Pengguna mengamuk selama
dua hingga tiga giliran,

entries.original:
"A reckless, life-
risking tackle that
also hurts the user
a little."

entries.translated:
Sebuah tebasan ceroboh

nyawa yang juga sedikit
melukai pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user wags its
tail cutely, making
the foe lower its
Defense stat."

Pengguna menggoyangkan

stat Pertahanannya.

entries.original:
"The foe is stabbed

etc. It may poison
the foe."

Lawan ditusuk dengan
duri beracun, dll. Ini
mungkin meracuni lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is stabbed
twice with foreleg
stingers. It may
poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is stabbed twice with foreleg stingers. It may poison the foe.

Lawan ditusuk dua kali

depan. Ini mungkin
meracuni lawan.

entries.original:

two to five times

Jarum tajam ditembakkan

dua hingga lima kali
sekaligus.

entries.original:
"The foe is given an
intimidating look

Defense stat."

Lawan diberikan tatapan

menurunkan stat
Pertahanannya.

entries.original:
"The user bites with
vicious fangs.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user bites with vicious fangs. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggigit

mungkin membuat lawan
menggigil.

entries.original:
"The user growls in
a cute way, making
the foe lower its
Attack stat."

Pengguna menggeram

stat Serangannya.

entries.original:
"The foe is made to
switch out with an
ally. In the wild,
the battle ends."

entries.translated:
Lawan dipaksa untuk
bertukar dengan sekutu.
Di alam liar,
pertarungan berakhir.

entries.original:
"A soothing song
in a calming voice
lulls the foe into
a deep slumber."
entries.translation_source: A soothing song in a calming voice lulls the foe into a deep slumber.
entries.translated:
Nyanyian menenangkan
dengan suara yang
menenangkan membuat
lawan tertidur lelap.

entries.original:
"The user generates
odd sound waves.

tentakel panjang atau

menurunkan Kecepatan.

entries.original:
"Forgets about
something and
sharply raises
Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: Forgets about something and sharply raises Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Melupakan sesuatu dan
meningkatkan Pertahanan
Spesial secara drastis.

entries.original:
"The user distracts
the foe by bending
a spoon. It may
lower accuracy."
entries.translation_source: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower accuracy.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengalihkan
perhatian lawan dengan
membengkokkan sendok.
Dapat menurunkan
akurasi.

entries.original:
"Heals the user by
up to half its full
HP. It can be used
to heal an ally."
entries.translation_source: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.
entries.translated:
Menyembuhkan pengguna
hingga setengah HP
penuhnya. Dapat
digunakan untuk
menyembuhkan sekutu.

entries.original:
"A strong jumping
knee kick. If it
misses, the user is
hurt."
entries.translation_source: A strong jumping knee kick. If it misses, the user is hurt.
entries.translated:
Tendangan lutut melompat
yang kuat. Jika meleset,
pengguna terluka.

entries.original:
"The user intimidates
the foe with the
design on its belly
to cause paralysis."
entries.translation_source: The user intimidates the foe with the design on its belly to cause paralysis.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengintimidasi
lawan dengan pola di
perutnya untuk
menyebabkan kelumpuhan.

entries.original:
"Absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
on a sleeping foe
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Menyerap setengah dari
kerusakan yang
ditimbulkan pada lawan
yang tidur untuk
memulihkan HP.

entries.original:
"The foe is sprayed
with a cloud of
toxic gas that may
poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is sprayed with a cloud of toxic gas that may poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Lawan disemprot dengan
awan gas beracun yang
dapat meracuni lawan.

entries.original:
"Round objects are
hurled at the foe
to strike two to
five times."
entries.translation_source: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.
entries.translated:
Benda bundar dilemparkan
ke lawan untuk menyerang
dua hingga lima kali.

entries.original:
"An attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang menyerap
setengah dari kerusakan
yang ditimbulkan untuk
memulihkan HP.

entries.original:
"The user forces a
kiss on the foe
with a scary face
that induces sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user forces a kiss on the foe with a scary face that induces sleep.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memaksa ciuman
pada lawan dengan wajah
menakutkan yang
menyebabkan tidur.

entries.original:
"A 2nd-turn attack
move with a high
critical-hit ratio.
The foe may flinch."
entries.translation_source: A 2nd-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. The foe may flinch.
entries.translated:
Gerakan serangan giliran
kedua dengan rasio
pukulan kritis tinggi.
Lawan mungkin gentar.

entries.original:
"The user transforms
into a copy of the
foe with even the
same move set."
entries.translation_source: The user transforms into a copy of the foe with even the same move set.
entries.translated:
Pengguna berubah menjadi
salinan lawan dengan set
gerakan yang sama.

entries.original:
"A spray of bubbles
hits the foe.
It may lower the
foe’s Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: A spray of bubbles hits the foe. It may lower the foe’s Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Semprotan gelembung
mengenai lawan. Dapat
menurunkan stat
Kecepatan lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a rhythmic punch
that may leave it
confused."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a rhythmic punch that may leave it confused.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan
pukulan berirama yang
dapat membuatnya
bingung.

entries.original:
"The user scatters
bursts of fine
spores that induce
sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user scatters bursts of fine spores that induce sleep.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyebarkan
semburan spora halus
yang menyebabkan tidur.

entries.original:
"A blast of light
that cuts the foe’s
accuracy. It also
illuminates caves."
entries.translation_source: A blast of light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It also illuminates caves.
entries.translated:
Semburan cahaya yang
menurunkan akurasi
lawan. Juga menerangi
gua.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with an odd, hot
energy wave that
varies in intensity."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with an odd, hot energy wave that varies in intensity.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
gelombang energi panas
aneh yang intensitasnya
bervariasi.

entries.original:
"The user just flops
and splashes around
without having any
effect."
entries.translation_source: The user just flops and splashes around without having any effect.
entries.translated:
Pengguna hanya menciprat
dan memercik tanpa efek
apapun.

entries.original:
"The user alters its
cells to liquefy
itself and sharply
raise Defense."
entries.translation_source: The user alters its cells to liquefy itself and sharply raise Defense.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengubah selnya
untuk mencairkan diri
dan meningkatkan
Pertahanan secara
drastis.

entries.original:
"A large pincer is
used to hammer the
foe. It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: A large pincer is used to hammer the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Penjepit besar digunakan
untuk memukul lawan.
Memiliki rasio serangan
kritis tinggi.

entries.original:
"The user explodes
to inflict terrible
damage even while
fainting itself."
entries.translation_source: The user explodes to inflict terrible damage even while fainting itself.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meledak untuk
menimbulkan kerusakan
besar meskipun
membuatnya pingsan.

entries.original:
"The foe is raked
with sharp claws or
scythes two to five
times."
entries.translation_source: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.
entries.translated:
Lawan diraih dengan
cakar tajam atau sabit
dua hingga lima kali.

entries.original:
"The user throws a
bone that hits the
foe once, then once
again on return."
entries.translation_source: The user throws a bone that hits the foe once, then once again on return.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melempar tulang
yang mengenai lawan
sekali, lalu sekali lagi
saat kembali.

entries.original:
"The user sleeps for
two turns to fully
restore HP and heal
any status problem."
entries.translation_source: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.
entries.translated:
Pengguna tidur selama
dua giliran untuk
memulihkan HP dan
menyembuhkan semua
masalah status.

entries.original:
"Large boulders are
hurled at the foe.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: Large boulders are hurled at the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Batu besar dilemparkan
ke lawan. Dapat membuat
lawan gentar.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with sharp fangs.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with sharp fangs. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
taring tajam. Dapat
membuat lawan gentar.

entries.original:
"The user reduces
its polygon count
to sharpen edges
and raise Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user reduces its polygon count to sharpen edges and raise Attack.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengurangi
jumlah poligonnya untuk
menajamkan ujung dan
meningkatkan Serangan.

entries.original:
"The user changes
its type to match
the type of one of
its moves."
entries.translation_source: The user changes its type to match the type of one of its moves.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengubah
tipenya agar sesuai
dengan tipe salah satu
jurusnya.

entries.original:
"A simultaneous
3-beam attack that
may paralyze, burn,
or frostbite the foe."
entries.translation_source: A simultaneous 3-beam attack that may paralyze, burn, or frostbite the foe.
entries.translated:
Serangan 3 sinar
simultan yang dapat
membuat lawan lumpuh,
terbakar, atau beku.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with sharp fangs
and halves the
foe’s HP."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with sharp fangs and halves the foe’s HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan taring tajam dan
mengurangi setengah HP
lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is slashed
with claws, etc.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Lawan ditebas dengan
cakar, dll. Memiliki
rasio serangan kritis
tinggi.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
decoy using one-
quarter of its full
HP."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membuat umpan
menggunakan seperempat
dari HP penuhnya.

entries.original:
"An attack that is
used only if there
is no PP. It also
hurts the user."
entries.translation_source: An attack that is used only if there is no PP. It also hurts the user.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang digunakan
hanya jika tidak ada PP.
Juga melukai pengguna.

entries.original:
"This move copies
the move last used
by the foe, then
disappears."
entries.translation_source: This move copies the move last used by the foe, then disappears.
entries.translated:
Jurus ini meniru jurus
terakhir yang digunakan
lawan, lalu menghilang.

entries.original:
"A 3-kick attack
that becomes more
powerful with each
successive hit."
entries.translation_source: A 3-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
entries.translated:
Serangan 3 tendangan
yang semakin kuat setiap
pukulan berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"An attack that may
take the foe’s held
item if the user
isn’t holding one."
entries.translation_source: An attack that may take the foe’s held item if the user isn’t holding one.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang dapat
mengambil item lawan
jika pengguna tidak
memegang item.

entries.original:
"Ensnares the foe 
with sticky string
so it doesn’t flee
or switch out."
entries.translation_source: Ensnares the foe with sticky string so it doesn’t flee or switch out.
entries.translated:
Menjerat lawan dengan
benang lengket sehingga
tidak bisa melarikan
diri atau bertukar.

entries.original:
"The user predicts
the foe’s action to
ensure its next
attack hits."
entries.translation_source: The user predicts the foe’s action to ensure its next attack hits.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memprediksi
gerakan lawan untuk
memastikan serangan
berikutnya mengenai.

entries.original:
"A sleeping foe is
shown a nightmare
that inflicts some
damage every turn."
entries.translation_source: A sleeping foe is shown a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
entries.translated:
Lawan yang tidur
diperlihatkan mimpi
buruk yang memberikan
kerusakan setiap
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user makes a
fiery charge at the
foe. It may cause
a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user makes a fiery charge at the foe. It may cause a burn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melakukan
serangan api kepada
lawan. Mungkin
menyebabkan luka bakar.

entries.original:
"An attack that can
be used only while
asleep. It may
cause flinching."
entries.translation_source: An attack that can be used only while asleep. It may cause flinching.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang hanya bisa
digunakan saat tidur.
Mungkin menyebabkan
lawan gentar.

entries.original:
"A move that works
differently for the
Ghost-type and all
the other types."
entries.translation_source: A move that works differently for the Ghost-type and all the other types.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang bekerja
berbeda untuk tipe Hantu
dan semua tipe lainnya.

entries.original:
"A desperate attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has."
entries.translation_source: A desperate attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
entries.translated:
Serangan putus asa yang
semakin kuat semakin
sedikit HP pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user changes
type to make itself
resistant to the
last attack it took."
entries.translation_source: The user changes type to make itself resistant to the last attack it took.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengubah tipe
untuk membuatnya tahan
terhadap serangan
terakhir yang diterima.

entries.original:
"A vortex of air is
shot at the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: A vortex of air is shot at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Pusaran udara
ditembakkan ke lawan.
Rasio serangan kritis
tinggi.

entries.original:
"Cotton-like spores
cling to the foe,
sharply reducing
its Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: Cotton-like spores cling to the foe, sharply reducing its Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Spora seperti kapas
menempel pada lawan,
sangat mengurangi
Kecepatannya.

entries.original:
"An all-out attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has."
entries.translation_source: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
entries.translated:
Serangan habis-habisan
yang semakin kuat
semakin sedikit HP
pengguna.

entries.original:
"A move that cuts
2 to 5 PP from the
move last used by
the foe."
entries.translation_source: A move that cuts 2 to 5 PP from the move last used by the foe.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang mengurangi
2 hingga 5 PP dari
gerakan terakhir yang
digunakan lawan.

entries.original:
"The opposing team is
hit with powdery snow
that may leave them
with frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The opposing team is hit with powdery snow that may leave them with frostbite.
entries.translated:
Tim lawan terkena salju
bubuk yang mungkin
menyebabkan radang
dingin.

entries.original:
"Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession."
entries.translation_source: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Memungkinkan pengguna
menghindari semua
serangan. Mungkin gagal
jika digunakan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"A punch thrown at
blinding speed.
It is certain to
strike first."
entries.translation_source: A punch thrown at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.
entries.translated:
Pukulan yang dilempar
dengan kecepatan
membutakan. Pasti
menyerang lebih dulu.

entries.original:
"Frightens the foe
with a scary face
to sharply reduce
its Speed."
entries.translation_source: Frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its Speed.
entries.translated:
Menakuti lawan dengan
wajah menakutkan untuk
sangat mengurangi
Kecepatannya.

entries.original:
"The user draws up
close to the foe
disarmingly, then
hits without fail."
entries.translation_source: The user draws up close to the foe disarmingly, then hits without fail.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mendekati lawan
dengan sikap tidak
mengancam, lalu
menyerang tanpa gagal.

entries.original:
"The user kisses
the foe with sweet
cuteness that
causes confusion."
entries.translation_source: The user kisses the foe with sweet cuteness that causes confusion.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mencium lawan
dengan manisnya yang
menyebabkan kebingungan.

entries.original:
"The user maximizes
its Attack stat at
the cost of half
its full HP."
entries.translation_source: The user maximizes its Attack stat at the cost of half its full HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memaksimalkan
stat Attack-nya dengan
mengorbankan setengah
dari HP penuhnya.

entries.original:
"Filthy sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may poison the
target."
entries.translation_source: Filthy sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.
entries.translated:
Lumpur kotor dilemparkan
ke lawan. Mungkin
meracuni target.

entries.original:
"Mud is hurled in
the foe’s face to
inflict damage and
lower its accuracy."
entries.translation_source: Mud is hurled in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
entries.translated:
Lumpur dilemparkan ke
wajah lawan untuk
memberikan kerusakan dan
menurunkan akurasinya.

entries.original:
"Ink is blasted in
the foe’s face or
eyes to damage and
lower accuracy."
entries.translation_source: Ink is blasted in the foe’s face or eyes to damage and lower accuracy.
entries.translated:
Tinta disemburkan ke
wajah atau mata lawan
untuk merusak dan
menurunkan akurasi.

entries.original:
"A trap of spikes is
laid around the
foe’s party to hurt
foes switching in."
entries.translation_source: A trap of spikes is laid around the foe’s party to hurt foes switching in.
entries.translated:
Jebakan paku dipasang di
sekitar tim lawan untuk
melukai lawan yang masuk
bertukar.

entries.original:
"An electric blast is
fired like a cannon
to inflict damage
and paralyze."
entries.translation_source: An electric blast is fired like a cannon to inflict damage and paralyze.
entries.translated:
Ledakan listrik
ditembakkan seperti
meriam untuk memberikan
kerusakan dan
melumpuhkan.

entries.original:
"Completely negates
the foe’s efforts to
heighten its ability
to evade."
entries.translation_source: Completely negates the foe’s efforts to heighten its ability to evade.
entries.translated:
Sepenuhnya meniadakan
upaya lawan untuk
meningkatkan
kemampuannya menghindar.

entries.original:
"If the user faints,
the foe delivering
the final hit also
faints."
entries.translation_source: If the user faints, the foe delivering the final hit also faints.
entries.translated:
Jika pengguna pingsan,
lawan yang memberikan
serangan terakhir juga
pingsan.

entries.original:
"Any battler that
hears this faints
in three turns
unless it switches."
entries.translation_source: Any battler that hears this faints in three turns unless it switches.
entries.translated:
Setiap petarung yang
mendengar ini akan
pingsan dalam tiga
giliran kecuali ia
bertukar.

entries.original:
"A chilling wind is
used to attack.
It also lowers the
Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: A chilling wind is used to attack. It also lowers the Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Angin dingin digunakan
untuk menyerang. Juga
menurunkan stat
Kecepatan.

entries.original:
"Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession."
entries.translation_source: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Memungkinkan pengguna
menghindari semua
serangan. Mungkin gagal
jika digunakan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The user strikes
the foe with a bone
in hand two to five
times."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes the foe with a bone in hand two to five times.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memukul lawan
dengan tulang di tangan
sebanyak dua hingga lima
kali.

entries.original:
"The user locks on
to the foe, making
the next move sure
to hit."
entries.translation_source: The user locks on to the foe, making the next move sure to hit.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengunci lawan,
membuat gerakan
berikutnya pasti
mengenai.

entries.original:
"The user thrashes
about for two to
three turns, then
becomes confused."
entries.translation_source: The user thrashes about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengamuk selama
dua hingga tiga giliran,
lalu menjadi bingung.

entries.original:
"A 5-turn sandstorm
that damages all
types except Rock,
Ground, and Steel."
entries.translation_source: A 5-turn sandstorm that damages all types except Rock, Ground, and Steel.
entries.translated:
Badai pasir selama 5
giliran yang merusak
semua tipe kecuali Batu,
Tanah, dan Baja.

entries.original:
"A harsh attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Serangan keras yang
menyerap setengah dari
kerusakan yang
ditimbulkan untuk
memulihkan HP.

entries.original:
"The user endures
any hit with 1 HP
left. It may fail if
used in succession."
entries.translation_source: The user endures any hit with 1 HP left. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bertahan dari
serangan apa pun dengan
1 HP tersisa. Mungkin
gagal jika digunakan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The foe is charmed
by the user’s cute
appeals, sharply
cutting its Attack."
entries.translation_source: The foe is charmed by the user’s cute appeals, sharply cutting its Attack.
entries.translated:
Lawan terpesona oleh
daya tarik imut
pengguna, yang sangat
menurunkan Attack-nya.

entries.original:
"A 5-turn rolling
attack that becomes
stronger each time
it hits."
entries.translation_source: A 5-turn rolling attack that becomes stronger each time it hits.
entries.translated:
Serangan bergulung
selama 5 giliran yang
menjadi lebih kuat
setiap kali mengenai.

entries.original:
"A restrained attack
that always leaves
the foe with at
least 1 HP."
entries.translation_source: A restrained attack that always leaves the foe with at least 1 HP.
entries.translated:
Serangan terkendali yang
selalu membuat lawan
setidaknya memiliki 1
HP.

entries.original:
"A move that makes
the foe confused,
but also sharply
raises its Attack."
entries.translation_source: A move that makes the foe confused, but also sharply raises its Attack.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang membuat
lawan bingung, tetapi
juga meningkatkan
Attack-nya secara
drastis.

entries.original:
"Heals the user by
up to half its full
HP. It can be used
to heal an ally."
entries.translation_source: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.
entries.translated:
Menyembuhkan pengguna
hingga setengah HP
penuhnya. Dapat
digunakan untuk
menyembuhkan sekutu.

entries.original:
"An electrically
charged tackle that
may also paralyze
the foe."
entries.translation_source: An electrically charged tackle that may also paralyze the foe.
entries.translated:
Tackle bermuatan listrik
yang juga dapat
melumpuhkan lawan.

entries.original:
"An attack that
grows stronger on
each successive
hit."
entries.translation_source: An attack that grows stronger on each successive hit.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang semakin
kuat setiap pukulan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
wings of steel.
It may also raise
the user’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan
sayap baja. Ini juga
dapat meningkatkan
Defense pengguna.

entries.original:
"The foe is fixed
with a mean look
that prevents it
from escaping."
entries.translation_source: The foe is fixed with a mean look that prevents it from escaping.
entries.translated:
Lawan diikat dengan
tatapan jahat yang
mencegahnya melarikan
diri.

entries.original:
"If it is the other
gender, the foe is
made infatuated and
unlikely to attack."
entries.translation_source: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.
entries.translated:
Jika lawan berbeda jenis
kelamin, lawan akan
jatuh cinta dan kecil
kemungkinan untuk
menyerang.

entries.original:
"While asleep, the
user randomly uses
one of the moves it
knows."
entries.translation_source: While asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
entries.translated:
Saat tidur, pengguna
secara acak menggunakan
salah satu gerakan yang
diketahuinya.

entries.original:
"A soothing bell
chimes to heal the
status problems of
all allies."
entries.translation_source: A soothing bell chimes to heal the status problems of all allies.
entries.translated:
Lonceng yang menenangkan
berbunyi untuk
menyembuhkan masalah
status semua sekutu.

entries.original:
"This attack move
grows more powerful
the more the user
likes its Trainer."
entries.translation_source: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
entries.translated:
Serangan ini semakin
kuat semakin besar kasih
sayang pengguna terhadap
Trainernya.

entries.original:
"The foe is given a
booby-trapped gift.
It restores HP
sometimes, however."
entries.translation_source: The foe is given a booby-trapped gift. It restores HP sometimes, however.
entries.translated:
Lawan diberi hadiah yang
menjebak. Namun,
terkadang hadiah itu
memulihkan HP.

entries.original:
"This attack move
grows more powerful
the less the user
likes its Trainer."
entries.translation_source: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
entries.translated:
Serangan ini semakin
kuat semakin kecil kasih
sayang pengguna terhadap
Trainernya.

entries.original:
"It protects the
user’s party from
all status problems
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: It protects the user’s party from all status problems for five turns.
entries.translated:
Melindungi tim pengguna
dari semua masalah
status selama lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user adds its
HP to the foe’s HP,
then equally shares
the total HP."
entries.translation_source: The user adds its HP to the foe’s HP, then equally shares the total HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menambahkan
HP-nya ke HP lawan, lalu
membagi total HP secara
merata.

entries.original:
"A mystical and
powerful fire
attack that may
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: A mystical and powerful fire attack that may inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
Serangan api mistis dan
kuat yang dapat
memberikan luka bakar.

entries.original:
"A ground-shaking
attack against all
standing Pokémon.
Its power varies."
entries.translation_source: A ground-shaking attack against all standing Pokémon. Its power varies.
entries.translated:
Serangan pengguncang
tanah terhadap semua
Pokémon yang berdiri.
Kekuatannya bervariasi.

entries.original:
"The foe is punched
with the user’s full
power. It confuses
the foe if it hits."
entries.translation_source: The foe is punched with the user’s full power. It confuses the foe if it hits.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan
kekuatan penuh pengguna.
Jika mengenai, lawan
menjadi bingung.

entries.original:
"A brutal ramming
attack delivered
with a tough and
impressive horn."
entries.translation_source: A brutal ramming attack delivered with a tough and impressive horn.
entries.translated:
Serangan tabrak brutal
yang dilakukan dengan
tanduk yang kuat dan
mengesankan.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
an incredible blast
of breath that may
also paralyze."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with an incredible blast of breath that may also paralyze.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan
hembusan napas luar
biasa yang juga dapat
melumpuhkan.

entries.original:
"The user switches
out, passing along
any stat changes
to the new battler."
entries.translation_source: The user switches out, passing along any stat changes to the new battler.
entries.translated:
Pengguna berganti,
mewariskan perubahan
stat apa pun kepada
petarung baru.

entries.original:
"Makes the foe use
the move it last
used repeatedly for
two to six turns."
entries.translation_source: Makes the foe use the move it last used repeatedly for two to six turns.
entries.translated:
Membuat lawan
menggunakan gerakan yang
terakhir digunakan
secara berulang selama
dua hingga enam giliran.

entries.original:
"An attack move that
works especially
well on a foe that
is switching out."
entries.translation_source: An attack move that works especially well on a foe that is switching out.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang bekerja
sangat baik terhadap
lawan yang sedang
berganti.

entries.original:
"An attack that frees
the user from traps
and hazards. Also
raises Speed."
entries.translation_source: An attack that frees the user from traps and hazards. Also raises Speed.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang
membebaskan pengguna
dari jebakan dan
rintangan. Juga
meningkatkan Kecepatan.

entries.original:
"Allures the foe to
reduce evasiveness.
It also attracts
wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Allures the foe to reduce evasiveness. It also attracts wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Memikat lawan untuk
mengurangi Evasiveness.
Juga menarik Pokémon
liar.

entries.original:
"An attack with a
steel-hard tail.
It may lower the
foe’s Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: An attack with a steel-hard tail. It may lower the foe’s Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Serangan dengan ekor
sekeras baja. Dapat
menurunkan Pertahanan
lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with steel claws.
It may also raise
the user’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
cakar baja. Dapat juga
meningkatkan Serangan
pengguna.

entries.original:
"Makes the user
attack after the
foe. In return,
it will not miss."
entries.translation_source: Makes the user attack after the foe. In return, it will not miss.
entries.translated:
Membuat pengguna
menyerang setelah lawan.
Sebagai imbalannya,
tidak akan meleset.

entries.original:
"Restores the user’s
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather."
entries.translation_source: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
entries.translated:
Memulihkan HP pengguna.
Jumlah HP yang
dipulihkan bervariasi
tergantung cuaca.

entries.original:
"Restores the user’s
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather."
entries.translation_source: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
entries.translated:
Memulihkan HP pengguna.
Jumlah HP yang
dipulihkan bervariasi
tergantung cuaca.

entries.original:
"Restores the user’s
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather."
entries.translation_source: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
entries.translated:
Memulihkan HP pengguna.
Jumlah HP yang
dipulihkan bervariasi
tergantung cuaca.

entries.original:
"A unique attack 
that varies in type
depending on the
user.       "
entries.translation_source: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the user.
entries.translated:
Serangan unik yang
tipe-nya bervariasi
tergantung pengguna.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
double chops.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with double chops. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena tebasan
ganda. Memiliki rasio
critical-hit yang
tinggi.

entries.original:
"A vicious twister
attacks the foe.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: A vicious twister attacks the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Angin puting beliung
yang ganas menyerang
lawan. Dapat membuat
lawan mundur.

entries.original:
"A heavy rain falls
for five turns,
powering up Water-
type moves."
entries.translation_source: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.
entries.translated:
Hujan deras turun selama
lima giliran, memperkuat
gerakan tipe Air.

entries.original:
"The sun blazes for
five turns, powering
up Fire-type
moves."
entries.translation_source: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.
entries.translated:
Matahari bersinar terik
selama lima giliran,
memperkuat gerakan tipe
Api.

entries.original:
"The foe is crunched
with sharp fangs.
It may lower the
foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is crunched with sharp fangs. It may lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Lawan digigit dengan
taring tajam. Dapat
menurunkan Pertahanan
lawan.

entries.original:
"A retaliation move
that pays back the
foe’s special attack
double."
entries.translation_source: A retaliation move that pays back the foe’s special attack double.
entries.translated:
Serangan balasan yang
membalas serangan
spesial lawan dua kali
lipat.

entries.original:
"The user hypnotizes
itself into copying
any stat change
made by the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menghipnotis
dirinya sendiri untuk
meniru perubahan stat
yang dilakukan lawan.

entries.original:
"A blindingly speedy
charge attack that
always goes before
any other."
entries.translation_source: A blindingly speedy charge attack that always goes before any other.
entries.translated:
Serangan kilat yang
sangat cepat yang selalu
bergerak sebelum gerakan
lainnya.

entries.original:
"An ancient power is
used to attack. It
may also raise all
the user’s stats."
entries.translation_source: An ancient power is used to attack. It may also raise all the user’s stats.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan kuno digunakan
untuk menyerang. Dapat
juga meningkatkan semua
stat pengguna.

entries.original:
"A shadowy blob is
hurled at the foe.
May also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May also lower the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Gumpalan bayangan
dilemparkan ke lawan.
Juga dapat menurunkan
Sp. Def lawan.

entries.original:
"Two turns after
this move is used,
the foe is attacked
psychically."
entries.translation_source: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked psychically.
entries.translated:
Dua giliran setelah
jurus ini digunakan,
lawan diserang secara
psikis.

entries.original:
"An attack that
lowers Defense.
It can also smash
cracked boulders.      "
entries.translation_source: An attack that lowers Defense. It can also smash cracked boulders.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang menurunkan
Pertahanan. Juga dapat
menghancurkan batu
retak.

entries.original:
"The foe is trapped
in a fast, vicious
whirlpool for two
to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The foe is trapped in a fast, vicious whirlpool for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Lawan terperangkap dalam
pusaran air yang cepat
dan ganas selama dua
hingga lima giliran.

entries.original:
"All party Pokémon
join in the attack.
The more allies,
the more damage."
entries.translation_source: All party Pokémon join in the attack. The more allies, the more damage.
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon dalam tim
ikut serta dalam
serangan. Semakin banyak
sekutu, semakin besar
kerusakan.

entries.original:
"An attack that hits
first and causes
flinching. Usable
only on 1st turn."
entries.translation_source: An attack that hits first and causes flinching. Usable only on 1st turn.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang menyerang
lebih dulu dan
menyebabkan gentar.
Hanya dapat digunakan
pada giliran pertama.

entries.original:
"The user attacks in
an uproar that
prevents sleep for
two to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks in an uproar that prevents sleep for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan keributan yang
mencegah tidur selama
dua hingga lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user charges
up power for use
later. It can be
used three times."
entries.translation_source: The user charges up power for use later. It can be used three times.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengisi daya
untuk digunakan nanti.
Dapat digunakan tiga
kali.

entries.original:
"The power built
using Stockpile is
released at once
for attack."
entries.translation_source: The power built using Stockpile is released at once for attack.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan yang dibangun
menggunakan Stockpile
dilepaskan sekaligus
untuk menyerang.

entries.original:
"The energy it built
using Stockpile is
absorbed to restore
HP."
entries.translation_source: The energy it built using Stockpile is absorbed to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Energi yang dibangun
menggunakan Stockpile
diserap untuk memulihkan
HP.

entries.original:
"The user exhales a
heated breath to
attack. It may also
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user exhales a heated breath to attack. It may also inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menghembuskan
napas panas untuk
menyerang. Juga dapat
menyebabkan luka bakar.

entries.original:
"A hailstorm lasting
five turns damages
all Pokémon except
the Ice-type."
entries.translation_source: A hailstorm lasting five turns damages all Pokémon except the Ice-type.
entries.translated:
Badai es yang
berlangsung lima giliran
merusak semua Pokémon
kecuali tipe Es.

entries.original:
"It enrages the foe,
making it incapable
of using the same
move successively."
entries.translation_source: It enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move successively.
entries.translated:
Ini membuat lawan marah,
sehingga tidak dapat
menggunakan jurus yang
sama secara
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"Flattery is used to
confuse the foe,
but its Sp. Atk
also rises."
entries.translation_source: Flattery is used to confuse the foe, but its Sp. Atk also rises.
entries.translated:
Sanjungan digunakan
untuk membingungkan
lawan, namun Sp. Atk-nya
juga naik.

entries.original:
"A sinister, bluish
white flame is shot
at the foe to
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: A sinister, bluish white flame is shot at the foe to inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
Api kebiruan yang
menyeramkan ditembakkan
ke lawan untuk
menyebabkan luka bakar.

entries.original:
"The user faints,
but sharply lowers
the foe’s Attack
and Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: The user faints, but sharply lowers the foe’s Attack and Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Pengguna pingsan, namun
sangat menurunkan
Serangan dan Sp. Atk
lawan.

entries.original:
"An attack that is
boosted if user is
burned, poisoned,
or paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang
ditingkatkan jika
pengguna terbakar,
keracunan, atau lumpuh.

entries.original:
"An attack that is
executed last.
The user flinches
if hit beforehand."
entries.translation_source: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang dilakukan
terakhir. Pengguna
gentar jika terkena
serangan sebelumnya.

entries.original:
"Doubly effective on
a paralyzed foe,
but it also cures
the foe’s paralysis."
entries.translation_source: Doubly effective on a paralyzed foe, but it also cures the foe’s paralysis.
entries.translated:
Efektif ganda pada lawan
yang lumpuh, namun juga
menyembuhkan kelumpuhan
lawan.

entries.original:
"The user draws
attention to itself,
making foes attack
only the user."
entries.translation_source: The user draws attention to itself, making foes attack only the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menarik
perhatian pada dirinya
sendiri, membuat lawan
hanya menyerang
pengguna.

entries.original:
"An attack that
changes type
depending on the
user’s location."
entries.translation_source: An attack that changes type depending on the user’s location.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang berubah
tipe tergantung pada
lokasi pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user charges
power to boost the
Electric move it
uses next."
entries.translation_source: The user charges power to boost the Electric move it uses next.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengisi daya
untuk meningkatkan
serangan Listrik yang
digunakan selanjutnya.

entries.original:
"The foe is taunted
into a rage that
allows it to use
only attack moves."
entries.translation_source: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.
entries.translated:
Musuh diejek hingga
marah sehingga hanya
bisa menggunakan
serangan.

entries.original:
"A move that boosts
the power of the
ally’s attack in a
battle."
entries.translation_source: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a battle.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang
meningkatkan kekuatan
serangan rekan dalam
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"A move that tricks
the foe into
trading held items
with the user."
entries.translation_source: A move that tricks the foe into trading held items with the user.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang menipu
musuh untuk menukar item
yang dibawa dengan
pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user mimics the
foe completely and
copies the foe’s
ability."
entries.translation_source: The user mimics the foe completely and copies the foe’s ability.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meniru musuh
sepenuhnya dan menyalin
kemampuan musuh.

entries.original:
"A self-healing move
that restores half
the full HP on the
next turn."
entries.translation_source: A self-healing move that restores half the full HP on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Gerakan penyembuhan diri
yang memulihkan setengah
HP penuh pada giliran
berikutnya.

entries.original:
"The user randomly
picks and uses a
move of an allied
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The user randomly picks and uses a move of an allied Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Pengguna secara acak
memilih dan menggunakan
gerakan Pokémon rekan.

entries.original:
"The user lays roots
that restore HP on
every turn.
It can’t switch out."
entries.translation_source: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. It can’t switch out.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menanam akar
yang memulihkan HP
setiap giliran. Tidak
bisa berganti.

entries.original:
"A powerful attack,
but it also lowers
the user’s Attack
and Defense stats."
entries.translation_source: A powerful attack, but it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.
entries.translated:
Serangan kuat, tetapi
juga menurunkan
statistik Serangan dan
Pertahanan pengguna.

entries.original:
"Reflects back the
foe’s Leech Seed
and any status-
damaging move."
entries.translation_source: Reflects back the foe’s Leech Seed and any status- damaging move.
entries.translated:
Memantulkan kembali
Bibit Pengisap musuh dan
gerakan status yang
merusak.

entries.original:
"A move that
recycles a used
item for use once
more."
entries.translation_source: A move that recycles a used item for use once more.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang mendaur
ulang item bekas untuk
digunakan sekali lagi.

entries.original:
"An attack move that
gains in intensity
if the target has
hurt the user."
entries.translation_source: An attack move that gains in intensity if the target has hurt the user.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang meningkat
intensitasnya jika
target telah melukai
pengguna.

entries.original:
"An attack that also
breaks any barrier
like Light Screen
and Reflect."
entries.translation_source: An attack that also breaks any barrier like Light Screen and Reflect.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang juga
menghancurkan penghalang
seperti Layar Cahaya dan
Refleks.

entries.original:
"A huge yawn lulls
the foe into falling
asleep on the next
turn."
entries.translation_source: A huge yawn lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Kuap besar membuat musuh
tertidur pada giliran
berikutnya.

entries.original:
"Knocks down the
foe’s held item to
prevent its use
during the battle."
entries.translation_source: Knocks down the foe’s held item to prevent its use during the battle.
entries.translated:
Menjatuhkan item yang
dibawa musuh untuk
mencegah penggunaannya
selama pertempuran.

entries.original:
"Gains power the
fewer HP the user
has compared with
the foe."
entries.translation_source: Gains power the fewer HP the user has compared with the foe.
entries.translated:
Mendapat kekuatan
semakin sedikit HP
pengguna dibandingkan
dengan musuh.

entries.original:
"The higher the
user’s HP, the more
powerful this
attack becomes."
entries.translation_source: The higher the user’s HP, the more powerful this attack becomes.
entries.translated:
Semakin tinggi HP
pengguna, semakin kuat
serangan ini.

entries.original:
"The user employs
its psychic power
to swap abilities
with the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to swap abilities with the foe.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
menukar kemampuan dengan
musuh.

entries.original:
"Prevents foes from
using any move
that is also known
by the user."
entries.translation_source: Prevents foes from using any move that is also known by the user.
entries.translated:
Mencegah musuh
menggunakan gerakan apa
pun yang juga diketahui
oleh pengguna.

entries.original:
"A self-healing move
that cures the user
of a poisoning,
burn, or paralysis."
entries.translation_source: A self-healing move that cures the user of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.
entries.translated:
Gerakan penyembuhan diri
yang menyembuhkan
pengguna dari keracunan,
luka bakar, atau
kelumpuhan.

entries.original:
"If the user faints,
this move deletes
the PP of the move
that finished it."
entries.translation_source: If the user faints, this move deletes the PP of the move that finished it.
entries.translated:
Jika pengguna pingsan,
gerakan ini menghapus PP
dari gerakan yang
menjatuhkannya.

entries.original:
"Steals the effects
of the foe’s
healing or status-
changing move."
entries.translation_source: Steals the effects of the foe’s healing or status- changing move.
entries.translated:
Mencuri efek dari
gerakan penyembuhan atau
perubahan status lawan.

entries.original:
"An attack that may
have an additional
effect that varies
with the terrain."
entries.translation_source: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang mungkin
memiliki efek tambahan
yang bervariasi
tergantung medan.

entries.original:
"The user dives
underwater on the
first turn and
strikes next turn."
entries.translation_source: The user dives underwater on the first turn and strikes next turn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyelam di
bawah air pada giliran
pertama dan menyerang
pada giliran berikutnya.

entries.original:
"A quick flurry of
straight-arm
punches that hit
two to five times."
entries.translation_source: A quick flurry of straight-arm punches that hit two to five times.
entries.translated:
Serangan cepat pukulan
lengan lurus yang
mengenai dua hingga lima
kali.

entries.original:
"Alters the user’s
type depending on
the location’s
terrain."
entries.translation_source: Alters the user’s type depending on the location’s terrain.
entries.translated:
Mengubah tipe pengguna
tergantung medan lokasi.

entries.original:
"The user flashes a
light that sharply
raises its Sp. Atk
stat."
entries.translation_source: The user flashes a light that sharply raises its Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memancarkan
cahaya yang meningkatkan
Sp. Atk secara tajam.

entries.original:
"A burst of light
injures the foe. It
may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: A burst of light injures the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Ledakan cahaya melukai
lawan. Mungkin juga
menurunkan Sp. Def
lawan.

entries.original:
"A flurry of down
hits the foe. It
may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: A flurry of down hits the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Serangan bulu halus
mengenai lawan. Mungkin
juga menurunkan Sp. Atk
lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is covered
with a mass of down
that sharply cuts
the Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The foe is covered with a mass of down that sharply cuts the Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Lawan ditutupi dengan
massa bulu halus yang
secara tajam memotong
stat Attack.

entries.original:
"A wobbly dance
that confuses all
the Pokémon in
battle."
entries.translation_source: A wobbly dance that confuses all the Pokémon in battle.
entries.translated:
Tarian goyang yang
membingungkan semua
Pokémon dalam
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"A fiery kick with a
high critical-hit

entries.original:
