shell trap. If the
user is hit by a
physical move, the
trap will explode."
entries.translation_source: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memasang
perangkap cangkang. Jika
pengguna terkena gerakan
fisik, perangkap akan
meledak.

entries.original:
"The user regains up
to half of its max
HP. It restores
more HP in a
sandstorm."
entries.translation_source: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memulihkan
hingga setengah dari HP
maksimumnya. HP yang
dipulihkan lebih banyak
saat badai pasir.

entries.original:
"The user stabs the
target with a sharp
horn. This attack
never misses."
entries.translation_source: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menusuk target
dengan tanduk tajam.
Serangan ini tidak
pernah meleset.

entries.original:
"In this two-turn move,
the user gathers
light and fills a
blade with light’s
energy to attack."
entries.translation_source: In this two-turn move, the user gathers light and fills a blade with light’s energy to attack.
entries.translated:
Dalam gerakan dua
giliran ini, pengguna
mengumpulkan cahaya dan
mengisi pedang dengan
energi cahaya untuk
menyerang.

entries.original:
"The user bursts into
song, emitting
bubbles. Any burnt
Pokémon will be
healed."
entries.translation_source: The user bursts into song, emitting bubbles. Any burnt Pokémon will be healed.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bernyanyi
sambil mengeluarkan
gelembung. Pokémon yang
terbakar akan sembuh.

entries.original:
"The user hides in
the target’s shadow,
steals the target’s
stat boosts, and
then attacks."
entries.translation_source: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bersembunyi di
bayangan target, mencuri
peningkatan stat target,
lalu menyerang.

entries.original:
"The user exchanges
Speed stats with
the target."
entries.translation_source: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menukar stat
Kecepatan dengan target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
while stitching the
target’s shadow to
the ground to
prevent escape."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks while stitching the target’s shadow to the ground to prevent escape.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
sambil menjahit bayangan
target ke tanah untuk
mencegahnya melarikan
diri.

entries.original:
"The user shines a
spotlight on the
target so that only
the target will be
attacked."
entries.translation_source: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyorotkan
sorotan pada target
sehingga hanya target
yang akan diserang.

entries.original:
"If the previous move
failed, frustration
doubles the power of
this move."
entries.translation_source: If the previous move failed, frustration doubles the power of this move.
entries.translated:
Jika gerakan sebelumnya
gagal, frustrasi
menggandakan kekuatan
gerakan ini.

entries.original:
"The user drains HP
equal to the foe’s
Attack stat. It
also lowers the
foe’s Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The user drains HP equal to the foe’s Attack stat. It also lowers the foe’s Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyedot HP
sebesar stat Serangan
lawan. Gerakan ini juga
menurunkan stat Serangan
lawan.

entries.original:
"The user slams the
target with a meteor
force. This move
disregards the
target’s Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user slams the target with a meteor force. This move disregards the target’s Ability.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menghantam
target dengan kekuatan
meteor. Gerakan ini
mengabaikan Ability
target.

entries.original:
"The user gets teary
eyed to look pitiful.
This lowers the
target’s Attack and
Sp. Atk stats."
entries.translation_source: The user gets teary eyed to look pitiful. This lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bermata
berkaca-kaca agar
terlihat memelas. Ini
menurunkan stat Serangan
dan Sp. Atk target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
foe’s throat to
prevent it from
using moves that emit
sound for two turns."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the foe’s throat to prevent it from using moves that emit sound for two turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
tenggorokan lawan untuk
mencegahnya menggunakan
gerakan yang
mengeluarkan suara
selama dua giliran.

entries.original:
"The user shoots
poisonous threads to
poison the target
and lower the
target’s Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target’s Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
benang beracun untuk
meracuni target dan
menurunkan stat
Kecepatan target.

entries.original:
"The user lands a
tropical kick on the
foe. It also lowers
the foe’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user lands a tropical kick on the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Attack.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melakukan
tendangan tropis pada
lawan. Ini juga
menurunkan Serangan
lawan.

entries.original:
"A strong electric
blast crashes down
on the target. This
may make the target
flinch."
entries.translation_source: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may make the target flinch.
entries.translated:
Ledakan listrik kuat
jatuh menimpa target.
Ini dapat membuat target
gentar.

entries.original:
"The user electrifies
the ground for five
turns, powering up
Electric moves and
eluding sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user electrifies the ground for five turns, powering up Electric moves and eluding sleep.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengaliri
listrik tanah selama
lima giliran, menguatkan
gerakan Listrik dan
menghindari tidur.

entries.original:
"The user turns the
ground to grass for
five turns, powering
up Grass moves and
restoring HP."
entries.translation_source: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns, powering up Grass moves and restoring HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengubah tanah
menjadi rumput selama
lima giliran, menguatkan
gerakan Rumput dan
memulihkan HP.

entries.original:
"The user covers the
ground in mist for
five turns, halving
Dragon moves and
preventing status."
entries.translation_source: The user covers the ground in mist for five turns, halving Dragon moves and preventing status.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menutupi tanah
dengan kabut selama lima
giliran, membagi dua
serangan Naga dan
mencegah status.

entries.original:
"The user makes the
ground weird for
five turns, boosting
Psychic moves and
blocking priority."
entries.translation_source: The user makes the ground weird for five turns, boosting Psychic moves and blocking priority.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membuat tanah
menjadi aneh selama lima
giliran, meningkatkan
serangan Psikis dan
memblokir prioritas.

entries.original:
"When combined with
Water Pledge, its
power increases and
a vast swamp appears."
entries.translation_source: When combined with Water Pledge, its power increases and a vast swamp appears.
entries.translated:
Saat dikombinasikan
dengan Sumpah Air,
kekuatannya meningkat
dan rawa yang luas
muncul.

entries.original:
"When combined with
Grass Pledge, its
power increases and a
sea of fire appears."
entries.translation_source: When combined with Grass Pledge, its power increases and a sea of fire appears.
entries.translated:
Saat dikombinasikan
dengan Sumpah Rumput,
kekuatannya meningkat
dan lautan api muncul.

entries.original:
"When combined with
Fire Pledge, its
power increases and
a rainbow appears."
entries.translation_source: When combined with Fire Pledge, its power increases and a rainbow appears.
entries.translated:
Saat dikombinasikan
dengan Sumpah Api,
kekuatannya meningkat
dan pelangi muncul.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
bizarre area in
which slower Pokémon
get to move first
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menciptakan
area aneh di mana
Pokémon yang lebih
lambat bisa bergerak
lebih dulu selama lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
bizarre area in
which Pokémon’s held
items lose effect
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose effect for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menciptakan
area aneh di mana item
yang dibawa Pokémon
kehilangan efeknya
selama lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
bizarre area where
Pokémon’s Defense
and Sp. Def swap
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a bizarre area where Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def swap for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menciptakan
area aneh di mana
Pertahanan dan
Pertahanan Spesial
Pokémon bertukar selama
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself and its
allies from status
moves with a
mysterious power."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melindungi
dirinya dan sekutunya
dari serangan status
dengan kekuatan
misterius.

entries.original:
"Using a pulled-up
mat as a shield,
the user protects
itself and its allies
from damaging moves."
entries.translation_source: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan tikar yang
ditarik sebagai perisai,
pengguna melindungi
dirinya dan sekutunya
dari serangan yang
merusak.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself and its
allies from priority
moves."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melindungi
dirinya dan sekutunya
dari serangan prioritas.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself and its
allies from wide-
ranged attacks."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself and its allies from wide- ranged attacks.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melindungi
dirinya dan sekutunya
dari serangan dengan
jangkauan luas.

entries.original:
"The user envelops
itself in a veil
made of water. It
regains some HP
every turn."
entries.translation_source: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyelimuti
dirinya dengan kerudung
yang terbuat dari air.
Ia memulihkan sebagian
HP setiap giliran.

entries.original:
"The user raises the
Sp. Def stat of an
ally Pokémon by
using a mysterious
aroma."
entries.translation_source: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meningkatkan
stat Pertahanan Spesial
Pokémon sekutu dengan
menggunakan aroma
misterius.

entries.original:
"The user lets out a
damaging belch at
the target. The user
must eat a held
Berry to use this."
entries.translation_source: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengeluarkan
sendawa yang merusak
pada target. Pengguna
harus memakan Buah Beri
yang dibawa untuk
menggunakan ini.

entries.original:
"The user passes its
held item to the
target when the
target isn’t
holding an item."
entries.translation_source: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memberikan item
yang dibawanya kepada
target saat target tidak
membawa item.

entries.original:
"The user flings its
held item at the
target to attack.
Its power and effect
depend on the item."
entries.translation_source: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effect depend on the item.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melemparkan
item yang dibawanya ke
target untuk menyerang.
Kekuatan dan efeknya
tergantung pada item
tersebut.

entries.original:
"The user dives down
onto the target from
the sky. This move
is both Fighting
and Flying type."
entries.translation_source: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is both Fighting and Flying type.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyelam ke
bawah menuju target dari
langit. Serangan ini
bertipe Pertarungan dan
Terbang.

entries.original:
"Gravity intensifies
for five turns,
preventing moves
that use flight and
negating Levitate."
entries.translation_source: Gravity intensifies for five turns, preventing moves that use flight and negating Levitate.
entries.translated:
Gravitasi menguat selama
lima giliran, mencegah
serangan yang
menggunakan terbang dan
meniadakan Melayang.

entries.original:
"The user employs its
psychic power to
average its Defense
and Sp. Def stats
with the target."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
meratakan stat
Pertahanan dan
Pertahanan Spesialnya
dengan target.

entries.original:
"The user prevents
the opposing team
from using any HP
recovery for five
turns."
entries.translation_source: The user prevents the opposing team from using any HP recovery for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mencegah tim
lawan menggunakan
pemulihan HP apa pun
selama lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user disperses
electrically charged
particles, changing
Normal- to Electric-
type moves."
entries.translation_source: The user disperses electrically charged particles, changing Normal- to Electric- type moves.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyebarkan
partikel bermuatan
listrik, mengubah
gerakan tipe Normal
menjadi tipe Listrik.

entries.original:
"The user chants an
incantation that
prevents foes from
landing critical
hits for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user chants an incantation that prevents foes from landing critical hits for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melantunkan
mantra yang mencegah
lawan memberikan pukulan
kritis selama lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user levitates
using electrically
generated magnetism
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melayang
menggunakan magnet yang
dihasilkan listrik
selama lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user manipulates
magnets to up Def
and Sp. Def stats of
allies with Plus or
Minus Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user manipulates magnets to up Def and Sp. Def stats of allies with Plus or Minus Ability.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memanipulasi
magnet untuk
meningkatkan statistik
Pertahanan dan
Pertahanan Khusus sekutu
dengan Kemampuan Plus
atau Minus.

entries.original:
"The user covers the
target in a powder
that explodes if it
uses a Fire-type
move."
entries.translation_source: The user covers the target in a powder that explodes if it uses a Fire-type move.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menutupi target
dengan bubuk yang
meledak jika target
menggunakan gerakan tipe
Api.

entries.original:
"The user employs its
psychic power to
average its Attack
and Sp. Atk stats
with the target."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
meratakan statistik
Serangan dan Serangan
Khusus dengan target.

entries.original:
"The user reflects
the target’s type,
making it the same
type as the target."
entries.translation_source: The user reflects the target’s type, making it the same type as the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memantulkan
tipe target,
menjadikannya tipe yang
sama dengan target.

entries.original:
"The user’s
mysterious psychic
wave changes the
target’s Ability to
Simple."
entries.translation_source: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.
entries.translated:
Gelombang psikis
misterius pengguna
mengubah Kemampuan
target menjadi Simple.

entries.original:
"The user shoots a
torrent of water at
the target and
changes the target’s
type to Water."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target’s type to Water.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
semburan air ke target
dan mengubah tipe target
menjadi Air.

entries.original:
"The user makes the
target float with
psychic power. The
target is easier to
hit for three turns."
entries.translation_source: The user makes the target float with psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membuat target
melayang dengan kekuatan
psikis. Target lebih
mudah terkena serangan
selama tiga giliran.

entries.original:
"The foe is brought
trick-or-treating.
This adds Ghost type
to the target’s type."
entries.translation_source: The foe is brought trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.
entries.translated:
Lawan diajak
trick-or-treating. Ini
menambahkan tipe Hantu
ke tipe target.

entries.original:
"The user sprays a
poisonous liquid
that lowers Attack,
Sp. Atk, and Speed
of poisoned foes."
entries.translation_source: The user sprays a poisonous liquid that lowers Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed of poisoned foes.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyemprotkan
cairan beracun yang
menurunkan Serangan,
Serangan Khusus, dan
Kecepatan lawan yang
diracuni.

entries.original:
"The user puts a
forest curse on the
target. The target
is now Grass type
as well."
entries.translation_source: The user puts a forest curse on the target. The target is now Grass type as well.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memberikan
kutukan hutan pada
target. Target sekarang
juga menjadi tipe
Rumput.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
everything around it
by making its head
explode. This also
damages the user."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks everything around it by making its head explode. This also damages the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
segala sesuatu di
sekitarnya dengan
meledakkan kepalanya.
Ini juga melukai
pengguna.

entries.original:
"A pillar of light
that deals physical
or special damage
based on the user’s
better stat."
entries.translation_source: A pillar of light that deals physical or special damage based on the user’s better stat.
entries.translated:
Pilar cahaya yang
memberikan kerusakan
fisik atau khusus
berdasarkan statistik
terbaik pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with electrically
charged fists. This
makes Normal-type
moves Electric-type."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This makes Normal-type moves Electric-type.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan tinju bermuatan
listrik. Ini membuat
gerakan tipe Normal
menjadi tipe Listrik.

entries.original:
"If the target is
electrified before
its move in the turn,
the target’s move
becomes Electric."
entries.translation_source: If the target is electrified before its move in the turn, the target’s move becomes Electric.
entries.translated:
Jika target dialiri
listrik sebelum
gerakannya dalam
giliran, gerakan target
menjadi Listrik.

entries.original:
"It prevents the
target from using
items. Its Trainer
also can’t use
items on it."
entries.translation_source: It prevents the target from using items. Its Trainer also can’t use items on it.
entries.translated:
Ini mencegah target
menggunakan item.
Pelatihnya juga tidak
bisa menggunakan item
padanya.

entries.original:
"By locking down the
battlefield, the
user keeps all
Pokémon from fleeing
during the next turn."
entries.translation_source: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
entries.translated:
Dengan mengunci medan
pertempuran, pengguna
mencegah semua Pokémon
melarikan diri selama
giliran berikutnya.

entries.original:
"The user fires a
powerful beam of
light from the
Eternal Flower. This
damages the user."
entries.translation_source: The user fires a powerful beam of light from the Eternal Flower. This damages the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
sinar cahaya yang kuat
dari Eternal Flower. Ini
melukai pengguna.

entries.original:
"The fewer PP this
move has, the
greater its power."
entries.translation_source: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its power.
entries.translated:
Semakin sedikit PP yang
dimiliki gerakan ini,
semakin besar
kekuatannya.

entries.original:
"The user helps the
target and makes it
use its move right
after the user."
entries.translation_source: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membantu target
dan membuatnya
menggunakan gerakannya
tepat setelah pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user instructs
the target to use
the target’s last
move again."
entries.translation_source: The user instructs the target to use the target’s last move again.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memerintahkan
target untuk menggunakan
gerakan terakhir target
lagi.

entries.original:
"The user suppresses
the target and makes
its move go last."
entries.translation_source: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menekan target
dan membuat gerakannya
menjadi yang terakhir.

entries.original:
"Using Happy Hour
doubles the amount
of prize money
received after
battle."
entries.translation_source: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan Happy Hour
melipatgandakan jumlah
uang hadiah yang
diterima setelah
pertarungan.

entries.original:
"The user centers
its hex nut and
strikes twice with
its arms. It may
cause flinching."
entries.translation_source: The user centers its hex nut and strikes twice with its arms. It may cause flinching.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memusatkan mur
heksagonalnya dan
menyerang dua kali
dengan lengannya. Ini
dapat menyebabkan
flinch.

entries.original:
"It can only be
used after the
user has exhausted
all other moves it
knows in battle."
entries.translation_source: It can only be used after the user has exhausted all other moves it knows in battle.
entries.translated:
Hanya dapat digunakan
setelah pengguna
menghabiskan semua
gerakan lain yang
diketahuinya dalam
pertarungan.

entries.original:
"It takes the enemy
into the sky,
where it can’t
attack. It is
dropped next turn."
entries.translation_source: It takes the enemy into the sky, where it can’t attack. It is dropped next turn.
entries.translated:
Membawa musuh ke langit,
di mana ia tidak dapat
menyerang. Ia dijatuhkan
pada giliran berikutnya.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon
congratulates you
on your special
day!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
entries.translated:
Pokémon mengucapkan
selamat atas hari
spesialmu!

entries.original:
"The user and an
ally hold hands.
This makes them
very happy."
entries.translation_source: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.
entries.translated:
Pengguna dan sekutu
bergandengan tangan. Ini
membuat mereka sangat
bahagia.

entries.original:
"The user unleashes
a strong beam that
deals double damage
to Dynamaxed targets."
entries.translation_source: The user unleashes a strong beam that deals double damage to Dynamaxed targets.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melepaskan
sinar kuat yang
memberikan damage ganda
pada target yang
Dynamax.

entries.original:
"The user ignores
the effects of moves
and Abilities that
draw in moves."
entries.translation_source: The user ignores the effects of moves and Abilities that draw in moves.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengabaikan
efek dari gerakan dan
Ability yang menarik
gerakan.

entries.original:
"The user bites down,
preventing itself
and the target from
switching out."
entries.translation_source: The user bites down, preventing itself and the target from switching out.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggigit,
mencegah dirinya sendiri
dan target untuk
berganti.

entries.original:
"The user consumes
its held Berry,
then raises its
Defense sharply."
entries.translation_source: The user consumes its held Berry, then raises its Defense sharply.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengkonsumsi
Beri yang dipegangnya,
lalu meningkatkan
Pertahanannya secara
tajam.

Mmm\. Taman di tengah kota gurun
sangat menenangkan. Dehara City\lbenar-benar surga oasis yang indah!

entries.original: "Valley Cave"
entries.translation_source: Valley Cave
entries.translated: Valley Cave

entries.original:
"I pride myself on how much I know
about bugs."
entries.translation_source: I pride myself on how much I know about bugs.
entries.translated:
Aku bangga dengan seberapa banyak
yang aku ketahui tentang serangga.

entries.original:
"Are you using a Pokémon Centre’s
PC for storing your Pokémon?

Each Box can hold up to
30 Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Are you using a Pokémon Centre’s PC for storing your Pokémon? Each Box can hold up to 30 Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu menggunakan PC di
Pokémon Centre untuk menyimpan\lPokémon-mu? Setiap Box dapat

menampung hingga 30 Pokémon.

entries.original: "Please don’t stare at me."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t stare at me.
entries.translated: Tolong jangan menatapku.

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon Box on the PC gets
full, just switch to another Box."
entries.translation_source: If a Pokémon Box on the PC gets full, just switch to another Box.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon Box di PC sudah penuh,
ganti saja ke Box lain.

entries.original:
"You can avoid battles by not
letting Trainers see you."
entries.translation_source: You can avoid battles by not letting Trainers see you.
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa menghindari pertempuran
dengan tidak membiarkan Pelatih\lmelihatmu.

entries.original: "And I thought I could catch anyone."
entries.translation_source: And I thought I could catch anyone.
entries.translated:
Dan kupikir aku bisa menangkap
siapa pun.

entries.original:
"Trained Pokémon are stronger than
wild ones."
entries.translation_source: Trained Pokémon are stronger than wild ones.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang terlatih lebih kuat
daripada yang liar.

entries.original:
"Hang on!
My line’s snagged!"
entries.translation_source: Hang on! My line’s snagged!
entries.translated: Tunggu! Pancingku tersangkut!

entries.original:
"With a better rod, I could catch
better Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: With a better rod, I could catch better Pokémon\.
entries.translated:
Dengan pancing yang lebih baik, aku
bisa menangkap Pokémon yang lebih\lbaik\.

entries.original:
"I guess you get to be good at
what you like.

Well, you beat me at Pokémon,
but you can’t top me at fishing."
entries.translation_source: I guess you get to be good at what you like. Well, you beat me at Pokémon, but you can’t top me at fishing.
entries.translated:
Kurasa kamu menjadi ahli dalam hal
yang kamu sukai. Yah, kamu\lmengalahkanku di Pokémon, tapi kamu

tidak bisa mengalahkanku dalam
memancing.

entries.original:
"It’s all right.
Losing doesn’t bug me anymore."
entries.translation_source: It’s all right. Losing doesn’t bug me anymore.
entries.translated:
Tidak apa-apa. Kekalahan tidak lagi
menggangguku.

entries.original:
"You got those Badges from Gym
Leaders. I know!"
entries.translation_source: You got those Badges from Gym Leaders. I know!
entries.translated:
Kamu mendapatkan Lencana-Lencana
itu dari Pemimpin Gym. Aku tahu!

entries.original:
"A beautiful trainer like me, losing
her way?

Impossible!

I know exactly where I’m going\."
entries.translation_source: A beautiful trainer like me, losing her way? Impossible! I know exactly where I’m going\.
entries.translated:
Pelatih cantik sepertiku, tersesat?
Mustahil! Aku tahu persis ke mana\laku pergi\.

entries.original:
"You can’t see it from up top, but
there’s a passage that goes under\lthe bridge!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t see it from up top, but there’s a passage that goes under the bridge!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak bisa melihatnya dari
atas, tapi ada lorong yang melewati\lbawah jembatan!

entries.original:
"The warmer the weather, the
stronger I get!"
entries.translation_source: The warmer the weather, the stronger I get!
entries.translated:
Semakin hangat cuacanya, semakin
kuat aku!

entries.original:
"I must hone my psychic senses
further.

Next time, I will not be wrong."
entries.translation_source: I must hone my psychic senses further. Next time, I will not be wrong.
entries.translated:
Aku harus mengasah indra psikisku
lebih jauh. Lain kali, aku tidak\lakan salah.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn someone was just
pushed into the ocean\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn someone was just pushed into the ocean\.
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah seseorang baru saja
didorong ke laut\.

entries.original: "I love showing off my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I love showing off my Pokémon!
entries.translated: Aku suka memamerkan Pokémon-ku!

entries.original:
"I collect sea Pokémon on weekends
because the sea is so close."
entries.translation_source: I collect sea Pokémon on weekends because the sea is so close.
entries.translated:
Aku mengumpulkan Pokémon laut di
akhir pekan karena lautnya sangat\ldekat.

entries.original:
"I can beat even marine Pokémon
at swimming."
entries.translation_source: I can beat even marine Pokémon at swimming.
entries.translated:
Aku bisa mengalahkan bahkan Pokémon
laut dalam berenang.

entries.original:
"I see The Ruins of Void over
yonder!"
entries.translation_source: I see The Ruins of Void over yonder!
entries.translated:
Aku melihat The Ruins of Void di
sana!

entries.original:
"You can only dive where the sea is
dark."
entries.translation_source: You can only dive where the sea is dark.
entries.translated:
Kamu hanya bisa menyelam di mana
lautnya gelap.

entries.original:
"I’m looking at the sea to forget
the bad thing that happened!"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking at the sea to forget the bad thing that happened!
entries.translated:
Aku melihat laut untuk melupakan
hal buruk yang terjadi!

entries.original:
"It’s still a long way to
The Ruins of Void.

I want to go back to Dresco Town."
entries.translation_source: It’s still a long way to The Ruins of Void. I want to go back to Dresco Town.
entries.translated:
Masih jauh menuju The Ruins of
Void. Aku ingin kembali ke Dresco\lTown.

entries.original:
"My friend wanted to swim to
The Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: My friend wanted to swim to The Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
Temanku ingin berenang ke The Ruins
of Void.

entries.original:
"M-my legs! They cramped up!
Glub, glub\."
entries.translation_source: M-my legs! They cramped up! Glub, glub\.
entries.translated: K-kakiku! Kram! Glub, glub\.

entries.original:
"If I were to ride a Pokémon on
the sea, I’d like a Lapras.

Lapras is so big, I bet it
would keep me dry on water."
entries.translation_source: If I were to ride a Pokémon on the sea, I’d like a Lapras. Lapras is so big, I bet it would keep me dry on water.
entries.translated:
Jika aku bisa menaiki Pokémon di
laut, aku ingin Lapras. Lapras\lsangat besar, aku yakin itu akan

membuatku tetap kering di air.

entries.original:
"I wish I could ride my Pokémon.
I bet you’re not tired."
entries.translation_source: I wish I could ride my Pokémon. I bet you’re not tired.
entries.translated:
Aku berharap bisa menaiki
Pokémon-ku. Aku yakin kamu tidak\llelah.

entries.original:
"I should’ve been buffing up my
Pokémon, not me!"
entries.translation_source: I should’ve been buffing up my Pokémon, not me!
entries.translated:
Seharusnya aku memperkuat
Pokémon-ku, bukan diriku sendiri!

entries.original: "Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!"
entries.translation_source: Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!
entries.translated:
Menunggangi Pokémon pasti terlihat
menyenangkan!

entries.original:
"Will my pearls grow bigger inside
Cloyster?"
entries.translation_source: Will my pearls grow bigger inside Cloyster?
entries.translated:
Apakah mutiaraku akan tumbuh lebih
besar di dalam Cloyster?

entries.original:
"I’m beat! But, I still have the
bike race and marathon left!"
entries.translation_source: I’m beat! But, I still have the bike race and marathon left!
entries.translated:
Aku kelelahan! Tapi, aku masih
harus ikut balap sepeda dan\lmaraton!

entries.original: "I did my best. I have no regrets!"
entries.translation_source: I did my best. I have no regrets!
entries.translated:
Aku sudah berusaha maksimal. Aku
tidak menyesal!

entries.original: "I did my best, so I’ve no regrets!"
entries.translation_source: I did my best, so I’ve no regrets!
entries.translated:
Aku sudah berusaha maksimal, jadi
aku tidak menyesal!

entries.original: "This air is beautiful!"
entries.translation_source: This air is beautiful!
entries.translated: Udara ini indah!

entries.original:
"All Pokémon have weaknesses.
Even the strongest ones.

That’s why it’s best to raise
Pokémon of different types."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon have weaknesses. Even the strongest ones. That’s why it’s best to raise Pokémon of different types.
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon memiliki kelemahan.
Bahkan yang terkuat sekalipun.\lItulah mengapa sebaiknya kamu

merawat Pokémon dari berbagai tipe.

entries.original: "Isn’t the view great?"
entries.translation_source: Isn’t the view great?
entries.translated: Pemandangannya bagus, bukan?

entries.original:
"I wish I was as good
as you."
entries.translation_source: I wish I was as good as you.
entries.translated: Aku berharap bisa sehebat kamu.

entries.original:
"If your Pokémon gets confused,
switch it out.

That’s a good tactic."
entries.translation_source: If your Pokémon gets confused, switch it out. That’s a good tactic.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon-mu terkena kondisi
Bingung, ganti saja. Itu taktik\lyang bagus.

entries.original: "You worked hard!"
entries.translation_source: You worked hard!
entries.translated: Kamu bekerja keras!

entries.original:
"I really should stop attacking
trainers and blaming them\."
entries.translation_source: I really should stop attacking trainers and blaming them\.
entries.translated:
Aku benar-benar harus berhenti
menyerang pelatih dan menyalahkan\lmereka\.

entries.original:
"Please don’t splash my face!
You’ll ruin the makeup."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t splash my face! You’ll ruin the makeup.
entries.translated:
Tolong jangan percikkan wajahku!
Kamu akan merusak riasanku.

entries.original:
"Perhaps that reek is your sweaty
Pokémon’s body odor\."
entries.translation_source: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty Pokémon’s body odor\.
entries.translated:
Mungkin bau tidak sedap itu adalah
bau badan Pokémon-mu yang\lberkeringat\.

entries.original:
"This year, I’m going to finally
learn how to swim!"
entries.translation_source: This year, I’m going to finally learn how to swim!
entries.translated:
Tahun ini, aku akhirnya akan
belajar berenang!

entries.original:
"Did I just win?
Or did I lose?"
entries.translation_source: Did I just win? Or did I lose?
entries.translated:
Apakah aku baru saja menang? Atau
kalah?

entries.original:
"When I can’t be with my boyfriend,
I spend time with the Pokémon he\lgave me."
entries.translation_source: When I can’t be with my boyfriend, I spend time with the Pokémon he gave me.
entries.translated:
Saat aku tidak bisa bersama
pacarku, aku menghabiskan waktu\lbersama Pokémon yang dia berikan

padaku.

entries.original:
"In your future, I sense that you
will meet many others.

I think you will be linked to each
other by a strange power."
entries.translation_source: In your future, I sense that you will meet many others. I think you will be linked to each other by a strange power.
entries.translated:
Di masa depanmu, aku merasakan
bahwa kamu akan bertemu banyak\lorang lain. Aku pikir kamu akan

terhubung satu sama lain oleh
kekuatan aneh.

entries.original:
"From far out among the stars, our
planet is just a drop of water.

But we want to protect that drop
of water for everyone."
entries.translation_source: From far out among the stars, our planet is just a drop of water. But we want to protect that drop of water for everyone.
entries.translated:
Dari jauh di antara
bintang-bintang, planet kita\lhanyalah setetes air. Tapi kita

ingin melindungi tetesan air itu
untuk semua orang.

entries.original:
"Your mom bought those snazzy
Running Shoes for you?

She must adore you."
entries.translation_source: Your mom bought those snazzy Running Shoes for you? She must adore you.
entries.translated:
Ibumu membelikan Sepatu Lari yang
keren itu untukmu? Dia pasti\lmenyayangimu.

entries.original:
"[player]!
You should take a quick rest."
entries.translation_source: [player]! You should take a quick rest.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu harus beristirahat
sejenak.

entries.original:
"Oh, good! You and your
Pokémon are looking great.

Take care now!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
entries.translated:
Oh, bagus! Kamu dan Pokémon-mu
terlihat hebat. Hati-hati ya!

entries.original:
"There’s a movie on TV.
Four boys are walking on railroad\ltracks.

\.I better go, too."
entries.translation_source: There’s a movie on TV. Four boys are walking on railroad tracks. \.I better go, too.
entries.translated:
Ada film di TV. Empat anak
laki-laki berjalan di rel kereta\lapi. \.Sebaiknya aku pergi juga.

entries.original:
"There’s a movie on TV.
A girl with her hair in pigtails is\lwalking up a brick road.

\.I better go, too."
entries.translation_source: There’s a movie on TV. A girl with her hair in pigtails is walking up a brick road. \.I better go, too.
entries.translated:
Ada film di TV. Seorang gadis
dengan rambut dikuncir dua berjalan\ldi jalan bata. \.Sebaiknya aku pergi

juga.

entries.original: "Oops, wrong side\."
entries.translation_source: Oops, wrong side\.
entries.translated: Ups, sisi yang salah\.

entries.original:
"[player] played with the Wii.

\.Okay!
It’s time to go!"
entries.translation_source: [player] played with the Wii. \.Okay! It’s time to go!
entries.translated:
[player] bermain dengan Wii. \.Oke!
Waktunya pergi!

entries.original:
"It’s a posted notice\.

If you’re confused, ask for help!
Talk to people!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a posted notice\. If you’re confused, ask for help! Talk to people!
entries.translated:
Ini adalah pemberitahuan yang
ditempel\. Jika kamu bingung, minta\lbantuan! Bicaralah dengan

orang-orang!

entries.original: "That’s Prof. Log’s Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: That’s Prof. Log’s Pokémon.
entries.translated: Itu Pokémon Prof. Log.

entries.original: "Press Start to open the Menu!"
entries.translation_source: Press Start to open the Menu!
entries.translated: Tekan Start untuk membuka Menu!

entries.original:
"The Save option is on the menu.
Use it regularly."
entries.translation_source: The Save option is on the menu. Use it regularly.
entries.translated:
Opsi Simpan ada di menu. Gunakan
secara teratur.

entries.original:
"All Pokémon types have strong and
weak points against others."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon types have strong and weak points against others.
entries.translated:
Semua tipe Pokémon memiliki
kelebihan dan kelemahan terhadap\lsatu sama lain.

entries.original:
"It’s a new computer.

Ooh\.
Fancy."
entries.translation_source: It’s a new computer. Ooh\. Fancy.
entries.translated: Ini komputer baru. Ooh\. Mewah.

entries.original:
"I study Pokémon as Prof. Log’s
Aide."
entries.translation_source: I study Pokémon as Prof. Log’s Aide.
entries.translated:
Saya mempelajari Pokémon sebagai
Asisten Prof. Log.

entries.original:
"Prof. Log has spent many years
studying Pokémon stats.

Many Trainers come to him with
inquiries about them."
entries.translation_source: Prof. Log has spent many years studying Pokémon stats. Many Trainers come to him with inquiries about them.
entries.translated:
Prof. Log telah menghabiskan
bertahun-tahun mempelajari\lstatistik Pokémon. Banyak Trainer

datang kepadanya dengan pertanyaan
tentang itu.

entries.original:
"Thanks!
Please say hi to Prof. Log for me!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks! Please say hi to Prof. Log for me!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih! Tolong sapa Prof. Log
untukku!

entries.original:
"That guy in all black from before
was scary.

Who was he?"
entries.translation_source: That guy in all black from before was scary. Who was he?
entries.translated:
Orang yang semuanya hitam dari tadi
itu menakutkan. Siapa dia?

entries.original:
"You should stock up on a lot of
[green]Potions[blue].

You never know when you’ll be in a
pinch and need some quick healing."
entries.translation_source: You should stock up on a lot of [green]Potions[blue]. You never know when you’ll be in a pinch and need some quick healing.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus menimbun banyak [green]Potion[blue].
Kamu tidak pernah tahu kapan kamu\lakan dalam kesulitan dan butuh

penyembuhan cepat.

entries.original:
"Pokémon Centres heal your tired
and weary Pokémon.

They make all Pokémon completely
healthy again.

Most are free, so don’t be shy
about healing your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Centres heal your tired and weary Pokémon. They make all Pokémon completely healthy again. Most are free, so don’t be shy about healing your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Pusat Pokémon menyembuhkan
Pokémonmu yang lelah dan letih.\lMereka membuat semua Pokémon

menjadi sehat kembali. Sebagian
besar gratis, jadi jangan malu-malu\luntuk menyembuhkan Pokémonmu.

entries.original:
"All Pokémon have special [green]Types[blue],
such as Fire or Water.

These determine how well they stack
up against other Pokémon.

Pokémon Types also give attacking
moves a power boost if they match\lthe Type of the move.

This is known as the Same Type
Attack Bonus, or [green]STAB[blue] for short."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon have special [green]Types[blue], such as Fire or Water. These determine how well they stack up against other Pokémon. Pokémon Types also give attacking moves a power boost if they match the Type of the move. This is known as the Same Type Attack Bonus, or [green]STAB[blue] for short.
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon memiliki [green]Tipe[blue] khusus,
seperti Api atau Air. Tipe-tipe ini\lmenentukan seberapa kuat mereka

melawan Pokémon lain. Tipe Pokémon
juga memberikan dorongan kekuatan\lpada gerakan serangan jika cocok

dengan Tipe gerakan tersebut. Ini
dikenal sebagai Bonus Serangan Tipe\lSama, atau [green]STAB[blue] untuk singkatannya.

entries.original:
"I just don’t know what to do.

Every few days this horrible
Pokémon has been coming into my\lhouse and stealing my food.

If I had a Pokédex, I could know
what it was and how to stop it\."
entries.translation_source: I just don’t know what to do. Every few days this horrible Pokémon has been coming into my house and stealing my food. If I had a Pokédex, I could know what it was and how to stop it\.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apa.
Setiap beberapa hari, Pokémon\lmengerikan ini datang ke rumahku

dan mencuri makananku. Jika aku
memiliki Pokédex, aku bisa tahu apa\litu dan cara menghentikannya\.

entries.original:
"There are some items that exist
soley to be sold.

If you get one of those items, you
should sell it immediately.

I’ve even heard that there are
some maniacs out there who’ll buy\lthose items for an even higher\lamount than Poké Marts."
entries.translation_source: There are some items that exist soley to be sold. If you get one of those items, you should sell it immediately. I’ve even heard that there are some maniacs out there who’ll buy those items for an even higher amount than Poké Marts.
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa item yang hanya ada
untuk dijual. Jika kamu mendapatkan\lsalah satu item itu, kamu harus

menjualnya segera. Aku bahkan
pernah mendengar bahwa ada beberapa\lorang gila di luar sana yang akan

membeli item-item itu dengan harga
lebih tinggi daripada Poké Mart.

entries.original:
"My grandfather survived the
meteorite lots of years ago!

He’s so cool!"
entries.translation_source: My grandfather survived the meteorite lots of years ago! He’s so cool!
entries.translated:
Kakekku selamat dari meteorit
bertahun-tahun yang lalu! Dia\lsangat keren!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, uses
Pokémon that can be found in\l[green]Flower Paradise[blue].

Catching some good Ice-type
Pokémon from [green]Icicle Cave [blue]can\lreally give you the edge against\lhim."
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, uses Pokémon that can be found in [green]Flower Paradise[blue]. Catching some good Ice-type Pokémon from [green]Icicle Cave [blue]can really give you the edge against him.
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, Mirskle, menggunakan
Pokémon yang dapat ditemukan di\l[green]Flower Paradise[blue]. Menangkap beberapa

Pokémon tipe Es yang bagus dari [green]Gua
Es [blue]benar-benar bisa memberimu\lkeunggulan melawannya.

entries.original: "you the edge against\lhim."
entries.translation_source: you the edge against him.
entries.translated: Anda keunggulan melawannya.

entries.original:
"Repel not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak Pokémon.

Put your strongest Pokémon at the
left of the Pokémon List.

If your first Pokémon is strong,
Repel’s effect is boosted."
entries.translation_source: Repel not only keeps bugs away, it also works on weak Pokémon. Put your strongest Pokémon at the left of the Pokémon List. If your first Pokémon is strong, Repel’s effect is boosted.
entries.translated:
Repel tidak hanya mengusir
serangga, tetapi juga bekerja pada\lPokémon lemah. Tempatkan Pokémon

terkuatmu di sebelah kiri Daftar
Pokémon. Jika Pokémon pertamamu\lkuat, efek Repel akan ditingkatkan.

entries.original:
"You should try to beat as many
Pokémon Gyms as possible.

Poké Marts will sell more items to
you if you have more badges."
entries.translation_source: You should try to beat as many Pokémon Gyms as possible. Poké Marts will sell more items to you if you have more badges.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus mencoba mengalahkan
sebanyak mungkin Gym Pokémon. Poké\lMart akan menjual lebih banyak item

kepadamu jika kamu memiliki lebih
banyak lencana.

entries.original:
"This town is fairly quiet.

Not that many enjoy hanging around
a town in the middle of a forest."
entries.translation_source: This town is fairly quiet. Not that many enjoy hanging around a town in the middle of a forest.
entries.translated:
Kota ini cukup sepi. Tidak banyak
yang suka berkeliaran di kota yang\lberada di tengah hutan.

entries.original:
"Yo, yo!
I am the official [green]Name Rater[blue]!

Want me to rate the nicknames of
your Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Yo, yo! I am the official [green]Name Rater[blue]! Want me to rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Yo, yo! Aku adalah [green]Penilai Nama[blue]
resmi! Apakah kamu ingin aku\lmenilai julukan Pokémonmu?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon’s nickname should
I see?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon’s nickname should I see?
entries.translated:
Julukan Pokémon mana yang harus aku
lihat?

entries.original:
"[buffer1], is it?
That is a gucci nickname!

But, would you like me to give it
a swag name?

How about it?"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1], is it? That is a gucci nickname! But, would you like me to give it a swag name? How about it?
entries.translated:
[buffer1], ya? Itu julukan yang
gucci! Tapi, apakah kamu ingin aku\lmemberinya nama yang swag?

Bagaimana?

entries.original:
"Cool. Then, what should the new
nickname be?"
entries.translation_source: Cool. Then, what should the new nickname be?
entries.translated:
Keren. Lalu, apa julukan baru yang
seharusnya?

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It’s a way better name than before!
You’re so swag!"
entries.translation_source: Done! From now on, this Pokémon will be called [buffer1]! It’s a way better name than before! You’re so swag!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Mulai sekarang, Pokémon
ini akan dipanggil [buffer1]! Nama\lini jauh lebih baik dari

sebelumnya! Kamu sangat swag!

entries.original:
"Uh huh.
Come back again."
entries.translation_source: Uh huh. Come back again.
entries.translated: Uh huh. Datang lagi ya.

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It looks the same as before, but
still feels ten times cooler!

You’re so lucky!"

It’s so good, a genius must have
come up with it!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you love this gym’s design? It’s so good, a genius must have come up with it!
entries.translated:
Bukankah kamu suka desain gym ini?
Sangat bagus, pasti seorang jenius\lyang membuatnya!

entries.original:
"Fallshore Pokémon Gym
Leader: Mel

Winning Trainers:
[rival]"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore Pokémon Gym Leader: Mel Winning Trainers: [rival]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Fallshore: Mel
Pelatih yang Menang: [rival]

entries.original:
"Fallshore Pokémon Gym
Leader: Mel

Winning Trainers:
[rival], [player]"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore Pokémon Gym Leader: Mel Winning Trainers: [rival], [player]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Fallshore: Mel
Pelatih yang Menang: [rival],\l[player]

entries.original:
"If you have the [green]Fall Badge[red], you can
buy [green]Ultra Balls[red]!

They’re way better at catching
Pokémon than Great Balls."
entries.translation_source: If you have the [green]Fall Badge[red], you can buy [green]Ultra Balls[red]! They’re way better at catching Pokémon than Great Balls.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memiliki [green]Lencana Fall[red],
kamu bisa membeli [green]Bola Ultra[red]!\lMereka jauh lebih baik untuk

menangkap Pokémon daripada Bola
Hebat.

entries.original:
"I heard that a bunch of people are
up to no good on [green]Route 9[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I heard that a bunch of people are up to no good on [green]Route 9[blue].
entries.translated:
Aku dengar sekelompok orang sedang
berbuat jahat di [green]Rute 9[blue].

entries.original:
"Every step you take, your Pokémon
become more attached to you.

If you have a Pokémon in the
Day-Care, it will get stronger too."
entries.translation_source: Every step you take, your Pokémon become more attached to you. If you have a Pokémon in the Day-Care, it will get stronger too.
entries.translated:
Setiap langkah yang kamu ambil,
Pokémon-mu semakin terikat padamu.\lJika kamu memiliki Pokémon di

Day-Care, ia juga akan menjadi
lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"Did you hear?

Someone took care of the
troublemakers on Route 9!"
entries.translation_source: Did you hear? Someone took care of the troublemakers on Route 9!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu dengar? Seseorang telah
menangani para pembuat onar di Rute\l9!

entries.original:
"Hi! 
I’m one of [green]Prof. Log’s Aides[red].

If your Pokédex has complete data
on [green][buffer1][red] species, I’m supposed to\lgive you a reward.

So, [player], let me ask you.

Have you gathered data on at least[green]
[buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I’m one of [green]Prof. Log’s Aides[red]. If your Pokédex has complete data on [green][buffer1][red] species, I’m supposed to give you a reward. So, [player], let me ask you. Have you gathered data on at least[green] [buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Hai! Aku adalah salah satu [green]Asisten
Prof. Log[red]. Jika Pokédex-mu memiliki\ldata lengkap tentang [green][buffer1][red]

spesies, aku seharusnya memberimu
hadiah. Jadi, [player], biarkan aku\lbertanya. Apakah kamu sudah

mengumpulkan data setidaknya
[green][buffer1][red] jenis Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Great! You have caught [green][buffer3][red]
kinds of Pokémon!

Congratulations!
Here you go!"
entries.translation_source: Great! You have caught [green][buffer3][red] kinds of Pokémon! Congratulations! Here you go!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Kamu telah menangkap
[green][buffer3][red] jenis Pokémon! Selamat!\lIni dia!

entries.original:
"There are items on the ground that
may be hidden from view.

Use the [green]Dowser[red] to detect any
hidden items close to you.

The machine is a bit limited.
It can’t pinpoint item locations.

What it does is show the direction
where the item is.

Use it to get your bearings, then
search the area by hand."
entries.translation_source: There are items on the ground that may be hidden from view. Use the [green]Dowser[red] to detect any hidden items close to you. The machine is a bit limited. It can’t pinpoint item locations. What it does is show the direction where the item is. Use it to get your bearings, then search the area by hand.
entries.translated:
Ada barang-barang di tanah yang
mungkin tersembunyi dari pandangan.\lGunakan [green]Pencari[red] untuk mendeteksi

barang tersembunyi di dekatmu. Alat
ini agak terbatas. Ia tidak bisa\lmenentukan lokasi barang secara

persis. Yang dilakukannya adalah
menunjukkan arah di mana barang itu\lberada. Gunakan untuk menentukan

arah, lalu cari area itu dengan
tangan.

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Guru’s younger
brother.

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Guru’s younger brother. I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Aku adik dari Fishing Guru. Aku
sangat suka memancing! Aku tidak\ltahan jika tidak memancing.

Katakan, apakah kamu suka
memancing?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Aku suka gayamu. Kurasa kita
bisa berteman. Ambil ini dan\lmemancinglah, teman muda!

entries.original:
"[player] received a Super Rod from
the Fishing Guru’s brother."
entries.translation_source: [player] received a Super Rod from the Fishing Guru’s brother.
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Pancing Super
dari saudara Fishing Guru.

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

From the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend.

Now, I have a request.

If you catch a big Magikarp 
with that rod, I want to see it.

As much as I love to fish, I also
love seeing gigantic Magikarp."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, my friend. Now, I have a request. If you catch a big Magikarp with that rod, I want to see it. As much as I love to fish, I also love seeing gigantic Magikarp.
entries.translated:
Memancing adalah gaya hidup! Ibarat
puisi terindah. Dari lautan hingga\lsungai, pergilah dan dapatkan yang

besar, temanku. Sekarang, aku punya
permintaan. Jika kau menangkap\lMagikarp besar dengan pancing itu,

aku ingin melihatnya. Sebesar aku
suka memancing, aku juga suka\lmelihat Magikarp raksasa.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. That’s so disappointing\.
entries.translated: Oh\. Itu sangat mengecewakan\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!
Have you been fishing?

Try fishing with the Super Rod in
any body of water.

You’ll find different Pokémon in
different places.

Oh, and don’t forget to bring me
gigantic Magikarp."
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player]! Have you been fishing? Try fishing with the Super Rod in any body of water. You’ll find different Pokémon in different places. Oh, and don’t forget to bring me gigantic Magikarp.
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]! Apakah kamu sudah
memancing? Coba pancing dengan\lSuper Rod di perairan mana pun.

Kamu akan menemukan Pokémon yang
berbeda di tempat yang berbeda. Oh,\ldan jangan lupa bawa Magikarp

raksasa untukku.

entries.original:
"Oh? [player]?
Why, if it isn’t a Magikarp!

Allow me to see it, quick!"
entries.translation_source: Oh? [player]? Why, if it isn’t a Magikarp! Allow me to see it, quick!
entries.translated:
Oh? [player]? Wah, kalau itu bukan
Magikarp! Biarkan aku melihatnya,\lcepat!

entries.original:
"\. \. \.Whoa!
[buffer2] inches!

You have a rare appreciation for
the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!

You must take this.
I insist!"
entries.translation_source: \. \. \.Whoa! [buffer2] inches! You have a rare appreciation for the fine, poetic aspects of fishing! You must take this. I insist!
entries.translated:
\.\.\.\. \. \.Whoa! [buffer2] inci! Kamu
memiliki apresiasi langka terhadap\laspek puitis yang indah dari

memancing! Kamu harus menerima ini.
Aku bersikeras!

entries.original:
"I’ll look forward to seeing greater
records from you!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll look forward to seeing greater records from you!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menantikan rekor yang
lebih besar darimu!

entries.original:
"Huh?
[buffer2] inches?

This is the same size as the one
I saw before."
entries.translation_source: Huh? [buffer2] inches? This is the same size as the one I saw before.
entries.translated:
Hah? [buffer2] inci? Ini ukuran yang
sama dengan yang aku lihat\lsebelumnya.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
This one is [buffer2] inches long.

It doesn’t measure up to the
[buffer3]-inch one you brought before."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. This one is [buffer2] inches long. It doesn’t measure up to the [buffer3]-inch one you brought before.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Yang ini panjangnya [buffer2]
inci. Tidak sebanding dengan yang\l[buffer3] inci yang kamu bawa

sebelumnya.

entries.original:
"Uh\. That doesn’t look much like
a Magikarp."
entries.translation_source: Uh\. That doesn’t look much like a Magikarp.
entries.translated:
Uh\. Itu tidak terlalu mirip
Magikarp.

entries.original:
"Oh, no!

I had a gift for you, but you have
no room for it."
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I had a gift for you, but you have no room for it.
entries.translated:
Oh, tidak! Aku punya hadiah
untukmu, tetapi kamu tidak punya\lruang untuk itu.

entries.original:
"The most gigantic Magikarp
I have ever witnessed\.

[buffer3] inches!"
entries.translation_source: The most gigantic Magikarp I have ever witnessed\. [buffer3] inches!
entries.translated:
Magikarp paling raksasa yang pernah
aku saksikan\. [buffer3] inci!

entries.original:
"It’s a blank chart of some sort.

It has spaces for writing in
records of some kind."
entries.translation_source: It’s a blank chart of some sort. It has spaces for writing in records of some kind.
entries.translated:
Ini semacam bagan kosong. Ada ruang
untuk menulis catatan semacam itu.

entries.original:
"I’m the Pokémon Move Maniac.

I know every single move that
Pokémon learn growing up.

I’m also a Heart Scale maniac.

Bring me a Heart Scale.

If you do that for me, I’ll teach
a move to one Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Pokémon Move Maniac. I know every single move that Pokémon learn growing up. I’m also a Heart Scale maniac. Bring me a Heart Scale. If you do that for me, I’ll teach a move to one Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku adalah Pokémon Move Maniac. Aku
tahu setiap jurus yang dipelajari\lPokémon saat tumbuh. Aku juga

maniak Heart Scale. Bawakan aku
Heart Scale. Jika kamu\lmelakukannya, aku akan mengajari

satu Pokémon sebuah jurus.

entries.original:
"Oh! That’s an honest to
goodness Heart Scale!

Let me guess, you want me to teach
a move?"
entries.translation_source: Oh! That’s an honest to goodness Heart Scale! Let me guess, you want me to teach a move?
entries.translated:
Oh! Itu benar-benar Heart Scale!
Coba tebak, kamu ingin aku\lmengajari sebuah jurus?

entries.original: "Which Pokémon needs tutoring?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon needs tutoring?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang perlu diajari
jurus?

entries.original: "Which move should I teach?"
entries.translation_source: Which move should I teach?
entries.translated: Jurus mana yang harus kuajarkan?

entries.original:
"Sorry\.

It doesn’t appear as if I have a
move I can teach that Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Sorry\. It doesn’t appear as if I have a move I can teach that Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Maaf\. Tampaknya aku tidak punya
jurus yang bisa kuajarkan pada\lPokémon itu.

entries.original:
"[player] handed over a
Heart Scale in exchange."
entries.translation_source: [player] handed over a Heart Scale in exchange.
entries.translated:
[player] menyerahkan Heart Scale
sebagai gantinya.

entries.original:
"If your Pokémon need to learn a
move, I need a Heart Scale."
entries.translation_source: If your Pokémon need to learn a move, I need a Heart Scale.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémonmu perlu belajar jurus,
aku butuh Heart Scale.

entries.original:
"Hunh? There isn’t a single move
that I can teach an Egg."
entries.translation_source: Hunh? There isn’t a single move that I can teach an Egg.
entries.translated:
Hah? Tidak ada satu pun jurus yang
bisa kuajarkan pada Telur.

entries.translation_source: [player] booted up the PC.
entries.translated: [player] menyalakan PC.

entries.original: "Accessed Someone’s PC."
entries.translation_source: Accessed Someone’s PC.
entries.translated: Mengakses PC seseorang.

entries.original: "Pokémon Storage System opened."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Storage System opened.
entries.translated: Sistem Penyimpanan Pokémon dibuka.

entries.original: "Accessed [player]’s PC."
entries.translation_source: Accessed [player]’s PC.
entries.translated: Mengakses PC [player].

entries.original: "Accessed Ayla’s PC."
entries.translation_source: Accessed Ayla’s PC.
entries.translated: Mengakses PC Ayla.

entries.original: "Please come again!"
entries.translation_source: Please come again!
entries.translated: Silakan datang lagi!

entries.original: "Obtained the [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: Obtained the [buffer2]!
entries.translated: Mendapatkan [buffer2]!

entries.original: "he [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: he [buffer2]!
entries.translated: dia [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"[player] put the [buffer2]
in the [buffer3]."
entries.translation_source: [player] put the [buffer2] in the [buffer3].
entries.translated:
[player] menempatkan [buffer2] di
[buffer3].

entries.original: "[player] found one [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [player] found one [buffer2]!
entries.translated: [player] menemukan satu [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Too bad!
The Bag is full\."
entries.translation_source: Too bad! The Bag is full\.
entries.translated: Sayang sekali! Tas penuh\.

entries.original:
"[player] found
[buffer1] [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [player] found [buffer1] [buffer2]!
entries.translated:
[player] menemukan [buffer1]
[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"[player] put the Coins away in
the Coin Case."
entries.translation_source: [player] put the Coins away in the Coin Case.
entries.translated:
[player] menyimpan Koin di Kotak
Koin.

entries.original:
"Too bad!
The Coin Case is full\."
entries.translation_source: Too bad! The Coin Case is full\.
entries.translated: Sayang sekali! Kotak Koin penuh\.

entries.original:
"Too bad!
There’s nothing to put them in\."
entries.translation_source: Too bad! There’s nothing to put them in\.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali! Tidak ada tempat
untuk meletakkannya\.

entries.original:
"Too bad! There’s no room left for
another [buffer2]\."
entries.translation_source: Too bad! There’s no room left for another [buffer2]\.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali! Tidak ada ruang
tersisa untuk [buffer2] lain\.

entries.original:
"The [buffer2] was transferred
to the PC."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer2] was transferred to the PC.
entries.translated: [buffer2] ditransfer ke PC.

entries.original: "[player] booted up the PC."
entries.translation_source: [player] booted up the PC.
entries.translated: [player] menyalakan PC.

entries.original:
"Welcome to our Pokémon Centre!

Would you like me to heal your
Pokémon back to perfect health?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to our Pokémon Centre! Would you like me to heal your Pokémon back to perfect health?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Pusat Pokémon
kami! Apakah Anda ingin saya\lmenyembuhkan Pokémon Anda hingga

kesehatan sempurna?

entries.original: "Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: Stay safe out there!
entries.translated: Tetap aman di luar sana!

entries.original:
"The water is dyed a deep blue\.
Would you like to Surf?"
entries.translation_source: The water is dyed a deep blue\. Would you like to Surf?
entries.translated:
Airnya diwarnai biru tua\. Apakah
Anda ingin menggunakan Surf?

entries.original: "[buffer1] used Surf!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] used Surf!
entries.translated: [buffer1] menggunakan Surf!

entries.original:
"The current is much too fast!
Surf can’t be used here\."
entries.translation_source: The current is much too fast! Surf can’t be used here\.
entries.translated:
Arusnya terlalu deras! Surf tidak
bisa digunakan di sini\.

entries.original:
"I’m terribly sorry.
The Pokémon Wireless Club is\lundergoing adjustments now."
entries.translation_source: I’m terribly sorry. The Pokémon Wireless Club is undergoing adjustments now.
entries.translated:
Maaf sekali. Klub Nirkabel Pokémon
sedang dalam penyesuaian sekarang.

entries.original:
"It appears to be undergoing
adjustments\."
entries.translation_source: It appears to be undergoing adjustments\.
entries.translated: Tampaknya sedang dalam penyesuaian\.

entries.original:
"Do you want to give a nickname to
this [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Do you want to give a nickname to this [buffer1]?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda ingin memberi nama
panggilan untuk [buffer1] ini?

entries.original:
"[player] dug up one [buffer2]
from deep in the ground."
entries.translation_source: [player] dug up one [buffer2] from deep in the ground.
entries.translated:
[player] menggali satu [buffer2]
dari dalam tanah.

entries.original:
"Let’s see\.
Uh-oh! You have caught only\l[green][buffer3][red] kinds of Pokémon!

You need [green][buffer1][red] kinds."
entries.translation_source: Let’s see\. Uh-oh! You have caught only [green][buffer3][red] kinds of Pokémon! You need [green][buffer1][red] kinds.
entries.translated:
Coba lihat\. Uh-oh! Kamu baru
menangkap [green][buffer3][red] jenis Pokémon!\lKamu perlu [green][buffer1][red] jenis.

entries.original:
"\.Oh. I see.

When you get [green][buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon,
come back."
entries.translation_source: \.Oh. I see. When you get [green][buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon, come back.
entries.translated:
\.Oh, begitu. Saat kamu mendapatkan
[green][buffer1][red] jenis Pokémon, kembalilah.

entries.original:
"Oh! I see you don’t have any
room for the [buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: Oh! I see you don’t have any room for the [buffer2].
entries.translated:
Oh! Sepertinya kamu tidak memiliki
ruang untuk [buffer2].

entries.original:
"I’m looking for the Pokémon
[buffer1]!

Wanna trade one for my
[buffer2]?"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking for the Pokémon [buffer1]! Wanna trade one for my [buffer2]?
entries.translated:
Saya sedang mencari Pokémon
[buffer1]! Mau menukar satu dengan\l[buffer2] saya?

entries.original:
"Awww!
Oh, well\."
entries.translation_source: Awww! Oh, well\.
entries.translated: Awww! Oh, baiklah\.

entries.original:
"What?
That’s no [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: What? That’s no [buffer1]!
entries.translated: Apa? Itu bukan [buffer1]!

entries.original: "Hey, thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, thanks!
entries.translated: Hei, terima kasih!

entries.original: "Isn’t my old [buffer2] great?"
entries.translation_source: Isn’t my old [buffer2] great?
entries.translated: Bukankah [buffer2] lamaku hebat?

entries.original:
"Hi!
Do you have a [buffer1]?

Want to trade it for my
[buffer2]?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Do you have a [buffer1]? Want to trade it for my [buffer2]?
entries.translated:
Hai! Apakah kamu punya [buffer1]?
Mau menukarnya dengan [buffer2]\lsaya?

entries.original: "That’s too bad."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad.
entries.translated: Sayang sekali.

entries.original:
"\.This is no [buffer1].

If you get one, trade it with me."
entries.translation_source: \.This is no [buffer1]. If you get one, trade it with me.
entries.translated:
\.Ini bukan [buffer1]. Jika kamu
mendapatkannya, tukarkan denganku.

entries.original: "Thanks, you’re a pal!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks, you’re a pal!
entries.translated: Terima kasih, kamu teman yang baik!

entries.original:
"How is my old [buffer2]?
My [buffer1] is doing great!"
entries.translation_source: How is my old [buffer2]? My [buffer1] is doing great!
entries.translated:
Bagaimana [buffer2] lamaku? [buffer1]
ku baik-baik saja!

entries.original:
"Bingo!
The Key Card opened the door!"
entries.translation_source: Bingo! The Key Card opened the door!
entries.translated: Bingo! Kartu Kunci membuka pintu!

entries.original:
"Accessed Prof. Log’s PC\.

Accessed the Pokédex Rating
System\."
entries.translation_source: Accessed Prof. Log’s PC\. Accessed the Pokédex Rating System\.
entries.translated:
Mengakses PC Prof. Log\. Mengakses
Sistem Penilaian Pokédex\.

entries.original:
"Would you like to have your
Pokédex rated?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to have your Pokédex rated?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda ingin Pokédex Anda
dinilai?

entries.original: "Closed link to Prof. Log’s PC."
entries.translation_source: Closed link to Prof. Log’s PC.
entries.translated: Tautan ke PC Prof. Log ditutup.

entries.original:
"Someone’s voice rang out,
\qoDon’t run away!\qc"
entries.translation_source: Someone’s voice rang out, \qoDon’t run away!\qc
entries.translated:
Suara seseorang terdengar, \qoJangan
lari!\qc

entries.original: "The door is open\."
entries.translation_source: The door is open\.
entries.translated: Pintunya terbuka\.

"[buffer2] was transferred to
Someone’s PC.

It was placed in 
Box \qo[buffer1].\qc"

entries.translated:
[buffer2] dipindahkan ke PC Someone.
Itu ditempatkan di Kotak\l\qo[buffer1].\qc

entries.original:
"[buffer2] was transferred to
Ayla’s PC.

It was placed in 
Box \qo[buffer1].\qc"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] was transferred to Ayla’s PC. It was placed in Box \qo[buffer1].\qc
entries.translated:
[buffer2] dipindahkan ke PC Ayla.
Itu ditempatkan di Kotak\l\qo[buffer1].\qc

"Box \qo[buffer3]\qc on

[buffer2] was transferred to
Box \qo[buffer1].\qc"
entries.translation_source: Box \qo[buffer3]\qc on Someone’s PC was full. [buffer2] was transferred to Box \qo[buffer1].\qc
entries.translated:
Kotak \qo[buffer3]\qc di PC Someone
penuh. [buffer2] dipindahkan ke\lKotak \qo[buffer1].\qc

entries.original:
"Box \qo[buffer3]\qc on
Ayla’s PC was full.

[buffer2] was transferred to
Box \qo[buffer1].\qc"
entries.translation_source: Box \qo[buffer3]\qc on Ayla’s PC was full. [buffer2] was transferred to Box \qo[buffer1].\qc
entries.translated:
Kotak \qo[buffer3]\qc di PC Ayla penuh.
[buffer2] dipindahkan ke Kotak\l\qo[buffer1].\qc

entries.original:
"There’s no more room for Pokémon!

The Pokémon Boxes are full and
can’t accept any more!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no more room for Pokémon! The Pokémon Boxes are full and can’t accept any more!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada lagi ruang untuk Pokémon!
Kotak Pokémon penuh dan tidak bisa\lmenerima lagi!

entries.original:
"First, you should restore your
Pokémon to full health."
entries.translation_source: First, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
entries.translated:
Pertama, Anda harus memulihkan
Pokémon Anda hingga kesehatan\lpenuh.

entries.original:
"Your Pokémon have been healed
to perfect health.

If your Pokémon’s energy, HP,
is down, please come see us.

If you’re planning to go far in the
