"It’s a large waterfall.
Would you like to use Waterfall?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a large waterfall. Would you like to use Waterfall?
entries.translated:
Ini air terjun besar. Apakah kamu
ingin menggunakan Waterfall?

entries.original: "[buffer1] used Waterfall."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] used Waterfall.
entries.translated: [buffer1] menggunakan Waterfall.

entries.original:
"The sea is deep here. A Pokémon
may be able to go underwater."
entries.translation_source: The sea is deep here. A Pokémon may be able to go underwater.
entries.translated:
Lautnya dalam di sini. Mungkin
seekor Pokémon bisa pergi ke bawah\lair.

entries.original:
"The sea is deep here.
Would you like to use Dive?"
entries.translation_source: The sea is deep here. Would you like to use Dive?
entries.translated:
Lautnya dalam di sini. Apakah kamu
ingin menggunakan Dive?

entries.original: "[buffer1] used Dive."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] used Dive.
entries.translated: [buffer1] menggunakan Dive.

entries.original:
"Light is filtering down from above.
A Pokémon may be able to surface."
entries.translation_source: Light is filtering down from above. A Pokémon may be able to surface.
entries.translated:
Cahaya menyaring turun dari atas.
Mungkin seekor Pokémon bisa muncul\lke permukaan.

entries.original:
"Light is filtering down from above.
Would you like to use Dive?"
entries.translation_source: Light is filtering down from above. Would you like to use Dive?
entries.translated:
Cahaya menyaring turun dari atas.
Apakah kamu ingin menggunakan Dive?

entries.original:
"There is an obstacle above.
Dive can’t be used here."
entries.translation_source: There is an obstacle above. Dive can’t be used here.
entries.translated:
Ada rintangan di atas. Dive tidak
bisa digunakan di sini.

entries.original: "Looks like there’s nothing here\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like there’s nothing here\.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya tidak ada apa-apa di
sini\.

entries.original:
"Hi, glad to meet you!

\.That’s unfriendly of you.
How about saying hi back?

So, come on, tell me about
yourself.

I’d love to hear your profile!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, glad to meet you! \.That’s unfriendly of you. How about saying hi back? So, come on, tell me about yourself. I’d love to hear your profile!
entries.translated:
Hai, senang bertemu denganmu! \.Itu
tidak ramah darimu. Bagaimana kalau\lmembalas salam? Jadi, ayo,

ceritakan tentang dirimu. Aku ingin
mendengar profilmu!

entries.original:
"A profile is written using four
words or phrases.

There’re plenty of words to choose
from for your profile.

The words and phrases are placed
in several convenient groups.

First, choose a group, then choose
a word or phrase.

\.It’s easier than it sounds.
Why don’t you try it?"
entries.translation_source: A profile is written using four words or phrases. There’re plenty of words to choose from for your profile. The words and phrases are placed in several convenient groups. First, choose a group, then choose a word or phrase. \.It’s easier than it sounds. Why don’t you try it?
entries.translated:
Profil ditulis menggunakan empat
kata atau frasa. Ada banyak kata\luntuk dipilih untuk profilmu. Kata

dan frasa ditempatkan dalam
beberapa kelompok yang nyaman.\lPertama, pilih grup, lalu pilih

kata atau frasa. \.Ini lebih mudah
daripada kedengarannya. Kenapa kamu\ltidak mencobanya?

entries.original: "What’s your profile?"
entries.translation_source: What’s your profile?
entries.translated: Apa profilmu?

entries.original:
"Aww\. Don’t be like that.
You can tell me your profile."
entries.translation_source: Aww\. Don’t be like that. You can tell me your profile.
entries.translated:
Aww\. Jangan seperti itu. Kamu bisa
memberitahuku profilmu.

entries.original:
"Oh, you’ve decided not to?
You’re fickle, aren’t you?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you’ve decided not to? You’re fickle, aren’t you?
entries.translated:
Oh, kamu memutuskan untuk tidak?
Kamu plin-plan, ya?

entries.original:
"Hi!
We meet again!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! We meet again!
entries.translated: Hai! Kita bertemu lagi!

entries.original:
"What are you like now?
I’d really like to know."
entries.translation_source: What are you like now? I’d really like to know.
entries.translated:
Seperti apa kamu sekarang? Aku
sangat ingin tahu.

entries.original:
"Okay, you like your profile the
way it is.

I think so, too."
entries.translation_source: Okay, you like your profile the way it is. I think so, too.
entries.translated:
Oke, kamu suka profilmu seperti
sekarang. Aku juga setuju.

entries.original:
"Hmhm\.

Your profile really says something
about who you are.

Now that I know you better, it 
makes us better friends than ever!"
entries.translation_source: Hmhm\. Your profile really says something about who you are. Now that I know you better, it makes us better friends than ever!
entries.translated:
Hmhm\. Profilmu benar-benar
mengatakan sesuatu tentang siapa\ldirimu. Sekarang aku tahu kamu

lebih baik, itu membuat kita
menjadi teman yang lebih baik dari\lsebelumnya!

entries.original:
"Oh, I’ve heard that before\.

My cousin, who lives far away,
always used to say that, I think."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I’ve heard that before\. My cousin, who lives far away, always used to say that, I think.
entries.translated:
Oh, aku pernah mendengar itu
sebelumnya\. Sepupuku, yang tinggal\ljauh, selalu mengatakan itu,

kurasa.

entries.original:
"Please tell me more about
yourself next time!"
entries.translation_source: Please tell me more about yourself next time!
entries.translated:
Tolong ceritakan lebih banyak
tentang dirimu lain kali!

entries.original:
"I’m the Day-Care Man.

I help take care of the precious
Pokémon of Trainers.

If you’d like me to raise your
Pokémon, have a word with my wife."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Day-Care Man. I help take care of the precious Pokémon of Trainers. If you’d like me to raise your Pokémon, have a word with my wife.
entries.translated:
Saya Bapak Penitipan. Saya membantu
merawat Pokémon berharga para\lPelatih. Jika Anda ingin saya

merawat Pokémon Anda, bicaralah
dengan istri saya.

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you!

We were raising your Pokémon, and
my goodness, were we surprised!

Your Pokémon had an Egg!

We don’t know how it got there,
but your Pokémon had it.

You do want it, yes?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, it’s you! We were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised! Your Pokémon had an Egg! We don’t know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it. You do want it, yes?
entries.translated:
Ah, Anda! Kami sedang merawat
Pokémon Anda, dan astaga, betapa\lterkejutnya kami! Pokémon Anda

memiliki Telur! Kami tidak tahu
bagaimana telur itu bisa ada di\lsana, tapi Pokémon Anda

memilikinya. Anda menginginkannya,
bukan?

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you! Good to see you.
Your [buffer1]’s doing fine."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it’s you! Good to see you. Your [buffer1]’s doing fine.
entries.translated:
Ah, Anda! Senang bertemu Anda.
[buffer1] Anda baik-baik saja.

entries.original:
"Fine then, I’ll keep it.
Thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Fine then, I’ll keep it. Thanks!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, saya akan menyimpannya.
Terima kasih!

entries.original:
"You have no room for it\.
Come back when you’ve made room."
entries.translation_source: You have no room for it\. Come back when you’ve made room.
entries.translated:
Anda tidak punya ruang untuknya\.
Kembalilah setelah Anda membuat\lruang.

entries.original: "Take good care of it."
entries.translation_source: Take good care of it.
entries.translated: Jaga baik-baik.

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you! Your [buffer1] and
[buffer2] are doing fine."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it’s you! Your [buffer1] and [buffer2] are doing fine.
entries.translated:
Ah, Anda! [buffer1] dan [buffer2]
Anda baik-baik saja.

entries.original:
"I really will keep it.
You do want this, yes?"
entries.translation_source: I really will keep it. You do want this, yes?
entries.translated:
Saya benar-benar akan menyimpannya.
Anda menginginkan ini, bukan?

entries.original:
"I’m the Day-Care Lady.

We can raise Pokémon for you.

Would you like us to raise one?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Day-Care Lady. We can raise Pokémon for you. Would you like us to raise one?
entries.translated:
Saya Ibu Penitipan. Kami bisa
merawat Pokémon untuk Anda. Apakah\lAnda ingin kami merawat satu?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should we raise for
you?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should we raise for you?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang harus kami rawat
untuk Anda?

entries.original:
"Fine, we’ll raise your [buffer1]
for a while.

Come back for it later."
entries.translation_source: Fine, we’ll raise your [buffer1] for a while. Come back for it later.
entries.translated:
Baik, kami akan merawat [buffer1]
Anda untuk sementara. Kembalilah\lnanti untuk mengambilnya.

entries.original:
"We can raise two of your Pokémon.

Would you like us to raise one
more Pokémon for you?"
entries.translation_source: We can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like us to raise one more Pokémon for you?
entries.translated:
Kami bisa merawat dua Pokémon Anda.
Apakah Anda ingin kami merawat satu\lPokémon lagi?

entries.original: "My husband was looking for you."
entries.translation_source: My husband was looking for you.
entries.translated: Suami saya mencari Anda.

entries.original:
"Oh, fine, then.
Come again."
entries.translation_source: Oh, fine, then. Come again.
entries.translated: Oh, baiklah. Datanglah lagi.

entries.original: "You don’t have enough money\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough money\.
entries.translated: Anda tidak memiliki cukup uang\.

entries.original:
"Will you take back the other one,
too?"
entries.translation_source: Will you take back the other one, too?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda juga akan mengambil
yang satu lagi?

entries.original:
"Fine.
Come again."
entries.translation_source: Fine. Come again.
entries.translated: Baik. Datanglah lagi.

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you!
Good to see you.

Your Pokémon can only be doing
good!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, it’s you! Good to see you. Your Pokémon can only be doing good!
entries.translated:
Ah, Anda! Senang bertemu Anda.
Pokémon Anda pasti baik-baik saja!

entries.original:
"By level, your [buffer1] has
grown by [buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: By level, your [buffer1] has grown by [buffer2].
entries.translated:
Berdasarkan level, [buffer1] Anda
telah naik sebesar [buffer2].

entries.original:
"Your Pokémon party is full.
Make room, then come see me."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon party is full. Make room, then come see me.
entries.translated:
Kelompok Pokémon Anda sudah penuh.
Buat ruang, lalu temui saya.

entries.original:
"If you want your [buffer1] back,
it will cost $[buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: If you want your [buffer1] back, it will cost $[buffer2].
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin [buffer1]mu kembali,
itu akan berharga $[buffer2].

entries.original:
"Perfect!
Here’s your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Perfect! Here’s your Pokémon.
entries.translated: Sempurna! Ini Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"[player] took back [buffer1] from
the Day-Care Lady."
entries.translation_source: [player] took back [buffer1] from the Day-Care Lady.
entries.translated:
[player] mengambil kembali [buffer1]
dari Wanita Penitipan.

entries.original:
"Oh? But you have just one
Pokémon.

Come back another time."
entries.translation_source: Oh? But you have just one Pokémon. Come back another time.
entries.translated:
Oh? Tapi kamu hanya memiliki satu
Pokémon. Kembalilah lain kali.

entries.original: "Will you take your Pokémon back?"
entries.translation_source: Will you take your Pokémon back?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu akan mengambil kembali
Pokémon-mu?

entries.original:
"If you leave me that Pokémon,
what will you battle with?

Come back another time."
entries.translation_source: If you leave me that Pokémon, what will you battle with? Come back another time.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu meninggalkan Pokémon itu
padaku, dengan apa kamu akan\lbertarung? Kembalilah lain kali.

entries.original: "Huh?"
entries.translation_source: Huh?
entries.translated: Hah?

entries.original:
"Would you like to exit the SAFARI
ZONE right now?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE right now?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin keluar dari
SAFARI ZONE sekarang juga?

entries.original:
"PA: Ding-dong!

Time’s up!

PA: Your SAFARI GAME is over!"
entries.translation_source: PA: Ding-dong! Time’s up! PA: Your SAFARI GAME is over!
entries.translated:
PA: Ding-dong! Waktunya habis! PA:
Permainan SAFARI-mu selesai!

entries.original:
"PA: Ding-dong!

You are out of SAFARI BALLS!

PA: Your SAFARI GAME is over!"
entries.translation_source: PA: Ding-dong! You are out of SAFARI BALLS! PA: Your SAFARI GAME is over!
entries.translated:
PA: Ding-dong! Kamu kehabisan BOLA
SAFARI! PA: Permainan SAFARI-mu\lselesai!

entries.original:
"It’s crammed full of Pokémon
books."
entries.translation_source: It’s crammed full of Pokémon books.
entries.translated:
Itu penuh sesak dengan buku-buku
Pokémon.

entries.original: "A Town Map."
entries.translation_source: A Town Map.
entries.translated: Peta Kota.

entries.original:
"Wow!
Tons of Pokémon stuff!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Tons of Pokémon stuff!
entries.translated: Wow! Banyak barang Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Dishes and plates are neatly
lined up."
entries.translation_source: Dishes and plates are neatly lined up.
entries.translated: Piring dan mangkuk tersusun rapi.

entries.original:
"It smells delicious!
Somebody’s been cooking here."
entries.translation_source: It smells delicious! Somebody’s been cooking here.
entries.translated:
Baunya enak! Seseorang baru saja
memasak di sini.

entries.original:
"It’s a nicely made dresser.
It will hold a lot of stuff."
entries.translation_source: It’s a nicely made dresser. It will hold a lot of stuff.
entries.translated:
Itu lemari yang dibuat dengan baik.
Bisa menampung banyak barang.

entries.original: "There’s a pile of snacks here."
entries.translation_source: There’s a pile of snacks here.
entries.translated: Ada tumpukan camilan di sini.

entries.original:
"All your item needs fulfilled!
Pokémon Mart"
entries.translation_source: All your item needs fulfilled! Pokémon Mart
entries.translated:
Semua kebutuhan itemmu terpenuhi!
Pokémon Mart

entries.original:
"Heal Your Pokémon!
Pokémon Center"
entries.translation_source: Heal Your Pokémon! Pokémon Center
entries.translated:
Sembuhkan Pokémon-mu! Pokémon
Center

entries.original:
"INDIGO PLATEAU

The ultimate goal of Trainers!
Pokémon LEAGUE HQ"
entries.translation_source: INDIGO PLATEAU The ultimate goal of Trainers! Pokémon LEAGUE HQ
entries.translated:
DATARAN INDIGO Tujuan utama para
Pelatih! MARKAS BESAR LIGA Pokémon

entries.original:
"INDIGO PLATEAU

The highest Pokémon authority!
Pokémon LEAGUE HQ"
entries.translation_source: INDIGO PLATEAU The highest Pokémon authority! Pokémon LEAGUE HQ
entries.translated:
DATARAN INDIGO Otoritas Pokémon
tertinggi! MARKAS BESAR LIGA\lPOKÉMON

entries.original:
"It should be packed with all kinds
of delicious things to eat."
entries.translation_source: It should be packed with all kinds of delicious things to eat.
entries.translated:
Seharusnya ini berisi berbagai
macam hal lezat untuk dimakan.

entries.original:
"It’s a blueprint of some sort.
It’s filled with diagrams and text."
entries.translation_source: It’s a blueprint of some sort. It’s filled with diagrams and text.
entries.translated:
Ini semacam cetak biru. Penuh
dengan diagram dan teks.

entries.original:
"It’s a pretty picture of a Pokémon.
It looks like it’s feeling good."
entries.translation_source: It’s a pretty picture of a Pokémon. It looks like it’s feeling good.
entries.translated:
Ini gambar Pokémon yang cantik.
Sepertinya dia merasa senang.

entries.original:
"What could this machine be?
Better not mess around with it!"
entries.translation_source: What could this machine be? Better not mess around with it!
entries.translated:
Mesin apa ini? Sebaiknya jangan
main-main dengannya!

entries.original:
"It’s a telephone.
Better not use it."
entries.translation_source: It’s a telephone. Better not use it.
entries.translated:
Ini telepon. Sebaiknya jangan
digunakan.

entries.original:
"It’s all complicated words and
numbers that make no sense\."
entries.translation_source: It’s all complicated words and numbers that make no sense\.
entries.translated:
Ini semua kata-kata dan angka rumit
yang tidak masuk akal\.

entries.original:
"It’s an advertising poster about
all kinds of products."
entries.translation_source: It’s an advertising poster about all kinds of products.
entries.translated:
Ini poster iklan tentang berbagai
macam produk.

entries.original:
"Oh, that smells tasty!
It might get the stomach growling!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, that smells tasty! It might get the stomach growling!
entries.translated:
Oh, baunya enak! Bisa membuat perut
keroncongan!

entries.original:
"Inside this\.
\.\.

There’s nothing here!"
entries.translation_source: Inside this\. \.\. There’s nothing here!
entries.translated:
Di dalam ini\. \.\. Tidak ada apa-apa di
sini!

entries.original:
"It’s a cup with a Pokémon mark
on it."
entries.translation_source: It’s a cup with a Pokémon mark on it.
entries.translated:
Ini cangkir dengan tanda Pokémon di
atasnya.

entries.original: "The window is very well polished."
entries.translation_source: The window is very well polished.
entries.translated: Jendelanya sangat mengkilap.

entries.original:
"Outside the window\.

The sky looks fantastically
beautiful."
entries.translation_source: Outside the window\. The sky looks fantastically beautiful.
entries.translated:
Di luar jendela\. Langit terlihat
sangat indah.

entries.original:
"Lights in different colors are
flashing on and off."
entries.translation_source: Lights in different colors are flashing on and off.
entries.translated:
Lampu dengan berbagai warna
berkedip-kedip.

entries.original:
"All sorts of tools are lined up
neatly."
entries.translation_source: All sorts of tools are lined up neatly.
entries.translated: Berbagai macam alat tertata rapi.

entries.original:
"It’s a machine of some sort.
It sure is impressive."
entries.translation_source: It’s a machine of some sort. It sure is impressive.
entries.translated:
Ini semacam mesin. Sungguh
mengesankan.

entries.original:
"It’s the latest video game!
It sure looks fun!"
entries.translation_source: It’s the latest video game! It sure looks fun!
entries.translated:
Ini video game terbaru!
Kelihatannya menyenangkan!

entries.original:
"There are obvious signs of burglary
here\."
entries.translation_source: There are obvious signs of burglary here\.
entries.translated:
Ada tanda-tanda jelas perampokan di
sini\.

entries.original:
"There’s a Pokémon on TV!
It looks like it’s having fun."
entries.translation_source: There’s a Pokémon on TV! It looks like it’s having fun.
entries.translated:
Ada Pokémon di TV! Sepertinya dia
sedang bersenang-senang.

entries.original:
"SAVING\.
DON’T TURN OFF THE POWER."
entries.translation_source: SAVING\. DON’T TURN OFF THE POWER.
entries.translated: MENYIMPAN\. JANGAN MATIKAN DAYA.

entries.original: "[player] saved the game."
entries.translation_source: [player] saved the game.
entries.translated: [player] menyimpan permainan.

entries.original:
"In the world which you are about to
enter, you will embark on a grand
adventure with you as the hero."
entries.translation_source: In the world which you are about to enter, you will embark on a grand adventure with you as the hero.
entries.translated:
Di dunia yang akan kamu masuki,
kamu akan memulai petualangan besar
dengan dirimu sebagai pahlawan.

entries.original:
"Speak to people and check things
wherever you go, be it towns, roads,
or caves. Gather information and
hints from every source."
entries.translation_source: Speak to people and check things wherever you go, be it towns, roads, or caves. Gather information and hints from every source.
entries.translated:
Bicaralah dengan orang-orang dan
periksa benda-benda di mana pun
kamu pergi, baik di kota, jalan,
atau gua. Kumpulkan informasi dan

petunjuk dari setiap sumber.

entries.original:
"During your adventure, you will
have the opportunity to make many
decisions.

Always remember, your actions can
affect and change the world around
you."
entries.translation_source: During your adventure, you will have the opportunity to make many decisions. Always remember, your actions can affect and change the world around you.
entries.translated:
Selama petualanganmu, kamu akan
memiliki kesempatan untuk membuat\lbanyak keputusan. Ingatlah selalu,

tindakanmu dapat mempengaruhi dan
mengubah dunia di sekitarmu.

entries.original: "Eevee\CC134B\CC0600 1 500 Coins"
entries.translation_source: Eevee\CC134B\CC0600 1 500 Coins
entries.translated: Eevee\CC134B\CC0600 1 500 Koin

entries.original: "Dratini\CC134B\CC0600 2 800 Coins"
entries.translation_source: Dratini\CC134B\CC0600 2 800 Coins
entries.translated: Dratini\CC134B\CC0600 2 800 Koin

entries.original: "Klefki\CC134B\CC0600 5 000 Coins"
entries.translation_source: Klefki\CC134B\CC0600 5 000 Coins
entries.translated: Klefki\CC134B\CC0600 5 000 Koin

entries.original: "Porygon\CC134B\CC0600 9 999 Coins"
entries.translation_source: Porygon\CC134B\CC0600 9 999 Coins
entries.translated: Porygon\CC134B\CC0600 9 999 Koin

entries.original: " \CC0300  get started then!"
entries.translation_source: \CC0300 get started then!
entries.translated: \CC0300 ayo mulai!

entries.original:
"Now that the entrance to the SES
Expressway isn’t sealed anymore,\lI’ve finally been able to train!

Say, would you like to battle my
newly trained Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Now that the entrance to the SES Expressway isn’t sealed anymore, I’ve finally been able to train! Say, would you like to battle my newly trained Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Sekarang pintu masuk ke SES
Expressway tidak lagi tersegel,\lakhirnya aku bisa berlatih! Hei,

apakah kamu ingin bertarung dengan
Pokémonku yang baru saja dilatih?

entries.original: "Thanks for battling with me!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks for battling with me!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih sudah bertarung
denganku!

entries.original:
"Hello there traveller.

I have three Pokémon in desperate
need of a loving trainer.

Will you take care of them for me?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there traveller. I have three Pokémon in desperate need of a loving trainer. Will you take care of them for me?
entries.translated:
Halo, pengelana. Aku memiliki tiga
Pokémon yang sangat membutuhkan\lpelatih yang penyayang. Maukah kamu

merawat mereka untukku?

entries.original:
"Oh, okay then. If you change your
mind you’re welcome anytime!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, okay then. If you change your mind you’re welcome anytime!
entries.translated:
Oh, baiklah. Jika kamu berubah
pikiran, kamu dipersilakan kapan\lsaja!

entries.original:
"I tried travelling through the
Great Desert to the east of town,\lbut the sandstorm was too strong.

It kept whipping sand in my face
and I couldn’t see anything.

Without any sort of protection,
it’s impossible to go anywhere.

I just wish I could find some\."
entries.translation_source: I tried travelling through the Great Desert to the east of town, but the sandstorm was too strong. It kept whipping sand in my face and I couldn’t see anything. Without any sort of protection, it’s impossible to go anywhere. I just wish I could find some\.
entries.translated:
Aku mencoba bepergian melintasi
Gurun Besar di timur kota, tapi\lbadai pasirnya terlalu kuat. Pasir

terus menerpa wajahku dan aku tidak
bisa melihat apa pun. Tanpa\lperlindungan apa pun, mustahil

untuk pergi ke mana pun. Aku hanya
berharap bisa menemukan beberapa\.

entries.original: "It won’t have any effect.[pause]"
entries.translation_source: It won’t have any effect.[pause]
entries.translated: Itu tidak akan berpengaruh.[pause]

Badge is obtained.[pause]"

Lencana baru diperoleh.[pause]

[buffer2]!"

entries.translated: [buffer1] mempelajari [buffer2]!

move [buffer2].

However, [buffer1] already
knows four moves.

Should a move be deleted and
replaced with [buffer2]?"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] wants to learn the move [buffer2]. However, [buffer1] already knows four moves. Should a move be deleted and replaced with [buffer2]?
entries.translated:
[buffer1] ingin mempelajari gerakan
[buffer2]. Namun, [buffer1] sudah\lmengetahui empat gerakan. Haruskah

sebuah gerakan dihapus dan diganti
dengan [buffer2]?

entries.original:
"A proverb claims that happiness will come
to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi
stand up."
entries.translation_source: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.
entries.translated:
Sebuah pepatah mengatakan bahwa
kebahagiaan akan datang kepada\lsiapa pun yang bisa membuat Togepi

yang tidur berdiri.

entries.original:
"Dark Forest, Cinder Volcano, Crater
Town, and Route 6"
entries.translation_source: Dark Forest, Cinder Volcano, Crater Town, and Route 6
entries.translated:
Dark Forest, Cinder Volcano, Crater
Town, dan Route 6

"Bellin Town, Icicle Cave, Route 2,
and Dresco Town"
entries.translation_source: Bellin Town, Icicle Cave, Route 2, and Dresco Town
entries.translated:
Bellin Town, Icicle Cave, Route 2,
dan Dresco Town

entries.original:
"Hey, you!

My Gramma makes really good food
for dinner!

You should stay and try it
sometime!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, you! My Gramma makes really good food for dinner! You should stay and try it sometime!
entries.translated:
Hei, kamu! Nenekku membuat makanan
yang sangat enak untuk makan malam!\lKamu harus tinggal dan mencobanya

suatu saat!

entries.original:
"My daddy trained our Pokémon a lot!
It’s really strong now!"
entries.translation_source: My daddy trained our Pokémon a lot! It’s really strong now!
entries.translated:
Ayahku melatih Pokémon kita dengan
keras! Sekarang sangat kuat!

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Cacnea, use Cut!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Cacnea, use Cut!
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Cacnea, gunakan Cut!

entries.translation_source: [green]Cac!
entries.translated: [green]Cac!

entries.original: "Taaaaales!"
entries.translation_source: Taaaaales!
entries.translated: Taaaaales!

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s you!
Champ in the making!

I didn’t see you there!

Welcome to the Crater Town Gym!

Let’s start you off with some
Fresh Water."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s you! Champ in the making! I didn’t see you there! Welcome to the Crater Town Gym! Let’s start you off with some Fresh Water.
entries.translated:
Oh, ini kamu! Calon Juara! Aku
tidak melihatmu di sana! Selamat\ldatang di Crater Town Gym! Mari

kita mulai dengan Fresh Water.

is centred around Dark-types.

If you want to win here, you’re
going to need some powerful\l[green]Fighting[blue], [green]Bug[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue]-types.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: As you can, or can’t see, this Gym is centred around Dark-types. If you want to win here, you’re going to need some powerful [green]Fighting[blue], [green]Bug[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue]-types. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Seperti yang bisa atau tidak bisa
kamu lihat, Gym ini berpusat pada\ltipe Dark. Jika kamu ingin menang

di sini, kamu akan membutuhkan
beberapa [green]Fighting[blue], [green]Bug[blue], atau [green]Fairy[blue]\lyang kuat. Semoga berhasil di luar

sana!

entries.original:
" some powerful\l[green]Fighting[blue], [green]Bug[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue]-types.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: some powerful [green]Fighting[blue], [green]Bug[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue]-types. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
beberapa [green]Fighting[blue], [green]Bug[blue], atau [green]Fairy[blue]
yang kuat. Semoga berhasil di luar\lsana!

entries.original:
"Bug[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue]-types.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Bug[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue]-types. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Bug[blue], atau [green]Fairy[blue]-types. Semoga
berhasil di luar sana!

entries.original:
"Well done!

You managed to find your way
through the dark and take down\lVéga!

Take this, as an extra reward for
your victory."
entries.translation_source: Well done! You managed to find your way through the dark and take down Véga! Take this, as an extra reward for your victory.
entries.translated:
Bagus! Kamu berhasil menemukan
jalan melalui kegelapan dan\lmengalahkan Véga! Ambil ini,

sebagai hadiah tambahan untuk
kemenanganmu.

entries.original:
" the dark and take down\lVéga!

Take this, as an extra reward for
your victory."

entries.translated:
kegelapan dan mengalahkan Véga!
Ambil ini, sebagai hadiah tambahan\luntuk kemenanganmu.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Dark-type move in battle.

With it, you can unleash your dark
fury!

Mwahahahaha!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Dark-type move in battle. With it, you can unleash your dark fury! Mwahahahaha!
entries.translated:
Permata yang kuberikan padamu dapat
meningkatkan satu jurus tipe Gelap\ldalam pertempuran. Dengan itu, kamu

bisa melepaskan kegelapanmu!
Mwahahahaha!

entries.original:
"ry!

Mwahahahaha!"
entries.translation_source: ry! Mwahahahaha!
entries.translated: ry! Mwahahahaha!

entries.original:
"Ah, I see a challenger has
arrived\.

Tell me, what’s your name?

\.

[player]?
I see\."
entries.translation_source: Ah, I see a challenger has arrived\. Tell me, what’s your name? \. [player]? I see\.
entries.translated:
Ah, aku lihat seorang penantang
telah tiba\. Katakan padaku, siapa\lnamamu? \. [player]? Begitu\.

entries.original: "Whisper\.Mutter\.Whisper\."
entries.translation_source: Whisper\.Mutter\.Whisper\.
entries.translated: Bisik\.Gumam\.Bisik\.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Darkness Badge
from Véga!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Darkness Badge from Véga!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Darkness Badge
dari Véga!

entries.original:
"You can store Pokémon and Items in
that PC in the corner.

It’s free of charge for trainers,
so go right ahead and use it."
entries.translation_source: You can store Pokémon and Items in that PC in the corner. It’s free of charge for trainers, so go right ahead and use it.
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa menyimpan Pokémon dan
Item di PC di sudut itu. Gratis\luntuk pelatih, jadi silakan

gunakan.

entries.original:
"Route 15

\al Route 2, Icicle Cave
\ar Vivill Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 15 \al Route 2, Icicle Cave \ar Vivill Town
entries.translated:
Route 15 \al Route 2, Icicle Cave \ar
Vivill Town

entries.original:
"Hey, there, kid!

-HACK- -COUGH-

Welcome to your first Gym
Challenge!

Let me start you off with a small
gift.

-COUGH- -WHEEZE-"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there, kid! -HACK- -COUGH- Welcome to your first Gym Challenge! Let me start you off with a small gift. -COUGH- -WHEEZE-
entries.translated:
Hei, anak! -HACK- -COUGH- Selamat
datang di Gym Challenge pertamamu!\lBiarkan aku memberimu hadiah kecil.

-COUGH- -WHEEZE-

entries.original:
"It’s some sort of plant with oddly
shaped leaves."
entries.translation_source: It’s some sort of plant with oddly shaped leaves.
entries.translated:
Itu semacam tanaman dengan daun
yang bentuknya aneh.

entries.original:
"To the east of here, beyond the
watery Route 15, lies Vivill Town.

But it seems like you’ll need more
than the HM Surf to get there.

It looks like people are blocking
the way\."
entries.translation_source: To the east of here, beyond the watery Route 15, lies Vivill Town. But it seems like you’ll need more than the HM Surf to get there. It looks like people are blocking the way\.
entries.translated:
Di sebelah timur sini, di seberang
Route 15 yang berair, terletak\lVivill Town. Tapi sepertinya kamu

butuh lebih dari HM Surf untuk
sampai ke sana. Sepertinya ada\lorang yang menghalangi jalannya\.

entries.original:
"Hey, there, travelling trainer.

If you plan on challenging Mirskle,
these should help you out."
entries.translation_source: Hey, there, travelling trainer. If you plan on challenging Mirskle, these should help you out.
entries.translated:
Hei, hai, pelatih pengembara. Jika
kamu berencana menantang Mirskle,\lini akan membantumu.

entries.original:
"I enjoy doing nice things for
travellers.

It’s a hobby of mine."
entries.translation_source: I enjoy doing nice things for travellers. It’s a hobby of mine.
entries.translated:
Aku suka melakukan hal baik untuk
para pelancong. Itu hobi-ku.

entries.original:
"All of the land in these parts is
broken into little chunks.

Now that I think about it, the
whole Borrius region is split into\lbig islands!"
entries.translation_source: All of the land in these parts is broken into little chunks. Now that I think about it, the whole Borrius region is split into big islands!
entries.translated:
Semua daratan di bagian ini
terpecah menjadi potongan-potongan\lkecil. Sekarang kalau

dipikir-pikir, seluruh wilayah
Borrius terbagi menjadi pulau-pulau\lbesar!

entries.original:
"This statue is of the legendary
fiery bird Pokémon, Moltres.

Apparently it lives somewhere in
Cinder Volcano, lighting up the sky\lwith its flames at night."
entries.translation_source: This statue is of the legendary fiery bird Pokémon, Moltres. Apparently it lives somewhere in Cinder Volcano, lighting up the sky with its flames at night.
entries.translated:
Patung ini adalah Pokémon burung
api legendaris, Moltres. Rupanya ia\ltinggal di suatu tempat di Cinder

Volcano, menerangi langit dengan
apinya di malam hari.

entries.original:
"Look, look!

I can see Dehara City from here!"
entries.translation_source: Look, look! I can see Dehara City from here!
entries.translated:
Lihat, lihat! Aku bisa melihat
Dehara City dari sini!

entries.original:
"Grim Woods

\al Cinder Volcano
\ar Dresco Town"
entries.translation_source: Grim Woods \al Cinder Volcano \ar Dresco Town
entries.translated:
Grim Woods \al Cinder Volcano \ar
Dresco Town

entries.original:
"We just undertook a major drug
bust, but our targets got away,\lagain\.

Now we’re sulking."
entries.translation_source: We just undertook a major drug bust, but our targets got away, again\. Now we’re sulking.
entries.translated:
Kami baru saja melakukan
penggerebekan narkoba besar, tapi\ltarget kami lolos lagi\. Sekarang

kami merajuk.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, but you can’t go in here
right now.

My grandfather is taking his daily
nap and doesn’t want anyone to\ldisturb him.

Come back later when he’s awake if
you want to talk with him."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, but you can’t go in here right now. My grandfather is taking his daily nap and doesn’t want anyone to disturb him. Come back later when he’s awake if you want to talk with him.
entries.translated:
Maaf, tapi kamu tidak bisa masuk ke
sini sekarang. Kakekku sedang tidur\lsiang dan tidak ingin diganggu.

Kembali lagi nanti saat dia bangun
jika kamu ingin bicara dengannya.

entries.original:
"Have you visited the Dresco Town
Trainer House yet?

It’s the black and blue building at
the south end of town."
entries.translation_source: Have you visited the Dresco Town Trainer House yet? It’s the black and blue building at the south end of town.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah mengunjungi
Dresco Town Trainer House? Itu\ladalah gedung hitam dan biru di

ujung selatan kota.

entries.original:
"This is a relatively new entrance
to the SES Expressway.

So we’re still working on building
a bridge to it."
entries.translation_source: This is a relatively new entrance to the SES Expressway. So we’re still working on building a bridge to it.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah pintu masuk yang relatif
baru ke SES Expressway. Jadi kami\lmasih mengerjakan pembangunan

jembatan ke sana.

entries.original:
"There’s this really pretty place to
the north of here called Flower\lParadise!

There are flowers everywhere!"
entries.translation_source: There’s this really pretty place to the north of here called Flower Paradise! There are flowers everywhere!
entries.translated:
Ada tempat yang sangat indah di
utara sini bernama Flower Paradise!\lAda bunga di mana-mana!

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Fire Pokémon, Moltres.

It says here that Moltres was once
used as a herald to a great\ldarkness, but now it resides in\lCinder Volcano."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Fire Pokémon, Moltres. It says here that Moltres was once used as a herald to a great darkness, but now it resides in Cinder Volcano.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah patung Pokémon Api
Legendaris, Moltres. Di sini\ltertulis bahwa Moltres pernah

digunakan sebagai pertanda
kegelapan besar, tapi sekarang ia\ltinggal di Cinder Volcano.

entries.original:
"Welcome to Flower Paradise!

Please be careful to respect the
flowers and the Pokémon that live\lin them, while you are here."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to Flower Paradise! Please be careful to respect the flowers and the Pokémon that live in them, while you are here.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Flower Paradise!
Mohon berhati-hati untuk\lmenghormati bunga dan Pokémon yang

tinggal di dalamnya, selama kamu di
sini.

entries.original:
"Route 3

\au Flower Paradise
\ad Dresco Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 3 \au Flower Paradise \ad Dresco Town
entries.translated:
Route 3 \au Flower Paradise \ad Dresco
Town

entries.original:
"Here we go!

Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!"
entries.translation_source: Here we go! Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!
entries.translated: Ini dia! Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind let
me know."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind let me know.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berubah pikiran, beri
tahu aku.

entries.original:
"Hey kid!
Listen up.

The road up ahead is frought with
trainers wanting to battle.

Some people have even dubbed it
\qoChallenge Road\qc.

But hey, I understand if you don’t
want to battle them.

So using my amazing psychic powers,
I can teleport you to the other\lside for free!

What do you say, are you in?"
entries.translation_source: Hey kid! Listen up. The road up ahead is frought with trainers wanting to battle. Some people have even dubbed it \qoChallenge Road\qc. But hey, I understand if you don’t want to battle them. So using my amazing psychic powers, I can teleport you to the other side for free! What do you say, are you in?
entries.translated:
Hei, nak! Dengar. Jalan di depan
penuh dengan pelatih yang ingin\lbertarung. Beberapa orang bahkan

menjulukinya \qoChallenge Road\qc. Tapi
hei, aku mengerti jika kamu tidak\lingin bertarung dengan mereka. Jadi

dengan menggunakan kemampuan
psikisku yang luar biasa, aku dapat\lmemindahkanmu ke sisi lain secara

gratis! Bagaimana, apakah kamu
setuju?

entries.original:
"Dresco Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Mirskle\lThe high up hippy!"
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Mirskle The high up hippy!
entries.translated:
Dresco Town Pokémon Gym Leader:
Mirskle Si hipi yang tinggi!

entries.original:
"Breathe it all in\.

That wonderful smell!"
entries.translation_source: Breathe it all in\. That wonderful smell!
entries.translated:
Hirup dalam-dalam\. Aroma yang luar
biasa!

entries.original:
"The Darkness Badge makes all
Pokémon up to Lv. 30 obey you.

That includes even outsiders you
received in a trade.

You can also now use the [green]HM Cut[blue]
anytime outside of battle.

Use it to cut down small trees to
open up new pathways.

I want you to have my favourite
TM, as well."
entries.translation_source: The Darkness Badge makes all Pokémon up to Lv. 30 obey you. That includes even outsiders you received in a trade. You can also now use the [green]HM Cut[blue] anytime outside of battle. Use it to cut down small trees to open up new pathways. I want you to have my favourite TM, as well.
entries.translated:
Lencana Kegelapan membuat semua
Pokémon hingga Lv. 30 patuh padamu.\lItu termasuk bahkan Pokémon luar

yang kamu terima melalui
perdagangan. Kamu juga sekarang\lbisa menggunakan [green]HM Potong[blue] kapan

saja di luar pertempuran. Gunakan
untuk menebang pohon kecil untuk\lmembuka jalur baru. Aku ingin kamu

mendapatkan TM favoritku juga.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, this feature is
unavailable right now."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, this feature is unavailable right now.
entries.translated:
Maaf, fitur ini tidak tersedia saat
ini.

entries.original:
"Sigh...

My poor Pokémon.

Ever since the entrance to the SES
Expressway froze over, they have\lhad nowhere to train.

Say, how would you like to battle
my Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Sigh... My poor Pokémon. Ever since the entrance to the SES Expressway froze over, they have had nowhere to train. Say, how would you like to battle my Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Huh... Pokémonku yang malang. Sejak
pintu masuk SES Expressway membeku,\lmereka tidak punya tempat untuk

berlatih. Bagaimana, apakah kamu
ingin bertarung dengan Pokémonku?

entries.original:
"Well if you change your mind, feel
free to come back anytime!"
entries.translation_source: Well if you change your mind, feel free to come back anytime!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, jika kamu berubah pikiran,
silakan kembali kapan saja!

entries.original: "Let’s get started then!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get started then!
entries.translated: Kalau begitu, ayo mulai!

entries.original:
"Now that the entrance to the SES
Expressway isn’t sealed anymore,\lI’ve finally been able to train!

Say, would you like to battle my
newly trained Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Now that the entrance to the SES Expressway isn’t sealed anymore, I’ve finally been able to train! Say, would you like to battle my newly trained Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Sekarang pintu masuk SES Expressway
tidak lagi tersegel, aku akhirnya\lbisa berlatih! Bagaimana, apakah

kamu ingin bertarung dengan
Pokémonku yang baru terlatih?

entries.original: "Thanks for battling with me!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks for battling with me!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah bertarung
denganku!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya opened up a pathway
for yurself.

Now just keep heading [green]east[blue] until
you reach [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya opened up a pathway for yurself. Now just keep heading [green]east[blue] until you reach [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Sepertinya kamu
membuka jalan untuk dirimu sendiri.\lSekarang teruslah ke [green]timur[blue] sampai

kamu mencapai [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

entries.original:
"Sometimes the [green]Oddish Leaves [blue]get to
me and I see things that aren’t\lreally there."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes the [green]Oddish Leaves [blue]get to me and I see things that aren’t really there.
entries.translated:
Kadang-kadang [green]Daun Oddish
[blue]mempengaruhiku dan aku melihat\lhal-hal yang tidak benar-benar ada.

entries.original: "Do you know what a [green]Gem [blue]is?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know what a [green]Gem [blue]is?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu tahu apa itu [green]Permata [blue]?

entries.original: "[black]Krook: [green]Dile!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Krook: [green]Dile!
entries.translated: [black]Krook: [green]Dile!

entries.original: "Skull!"
entries.translation_source: Skull!
entries.translated: Skull!

entries.original:
"TM46 teaches [green]Thief[blue].

It’s the perfect TM for sneaky
trainers."
entries.translation_source: TM46 teaches [green]Thief[blue]. It’s the perfect TM for sneaky trainers.
entries.translated:
TM46 mengajarkan [green]Pencuri[blue]. Ini TM
yang sempurna untuk pelatih licik.

entries.original:
"One last piece of advice.

Try to stay in the light and out of
the shadows as much as possible.

If you follow this advice, it will
not bring you to ruin.

I promise\."
entries.translation_source: One last piece of advice. Try to stay in the light and out of the shadows as much as possible. If you follow this advice, it will not bring you to ruin. I promise\.
entries.translated:
Satu nasihat terakhir. Cobalah
untuk tetap di tempat terang dan\lsebisa mungkin hindari bayangan.

Jika kamu mengikuti nasihat ini,
itu tidak akan membawamu\lkehancuran. Aku janji\.

entries.original:
"Looks like you already have
Thief\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you already have Thief\.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu sudah memiliki
Pencuri\.

entries.original: "[black]Hitmontop: [green]Top!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Hitmontop: [green]Top!
entries.translated: [black]Hitmontop: [green]Top!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Ahh\.
Right on schedule.

Tell me, [buffer1], what’s your name?

\.

[player], is it?

At last, we finally meet.

I am Zeph, the man in charge of
The Shadows.

I’ve been informed that you have
trespassed in our laboratory and\lare aware of what we have created.

This is unacceptable.

If word of our experiments got out,
it’d be the end for us.

Our secret must remain in the
shadows until we have reached our\lgoals."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Ahh\. Right on schedule. Tell me, [buffer1], what’s your name? \. [player], is it? At last, we finally meet. I am Zeph, the man in charge of The Shadows. I’ve been informed that you have trespassed in our laboratory and are aware of what we have created. This is unacceptable. If word of our experiments got out, it’d be the end for us. Our secret must remain in the shadows until we have reached our goals.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Ahh\. Tepat waktu. Katakan
padaku, [buffer1], siapa namamu? \.\l[player], kan? Akhirnya kita

bertemu. Aku Zeph, pria yang
memimpin The Shadows. Aku telah\ldiberi tahu bahwa kamu telah

menyusup ke laboratorium kami dan
mengetahui apa yang telah kami\lciptakan. Ini tidak dapat diterima.

Jika berita tentang eksperimen kami
tersebar, itu akan menjadi akhir\lbagi kami. Rahasia kami harus tetap

dalam bayangan sampai kami mencapai
tujuan kami.

entries.original:
"[blue]Therefore, Ivory here will be
giving you a little incentive for\lkeeping your mouth shut."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Therefore, Ivory here will be giving you a little incentive for keeping your mouth shut.
entries.translated:
[blue]Karena itu, Ivory di sini akan
memberikan sedikit insentif untuk\lmenjaga mulutmu tetap tertutup.

entries.original:
"I’m camping out here to scare
anyone who passes by."
entries.translation_source: I’m camping out here to scare anyone who passes by.
entries.translated:
Aku berkemah di sini untuk menakuti
siapa pun yang lewat.

entries.original:
"Epidimy Town

A quaint town surrounded by
mountains."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town A quaint town surrounded by mountains.
entries.translated:
Epidimy Town Sebuah kota kecil yang
dikelilingi pegunungan.

entries.original:
"Fallshore City

The waterfall capital of Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City The waterfall capital of Borrius.
entries.translated:
Fallshore City Ibu kota air terjun
di Borrius.

entries.original:
"Tehl Town

A town where it’s always Autumn."
entries.translation_source: Tehl Town A town where it’s always Autumn.
entries.translated:
Tehl Town Sebuah kota yang selalu
musim gugur.

entries.original:
"I hope I don’t slip and fall off of
this bridge."
entries.translation_source: I hope I don’t slip and fall off of this bridge.
entries.translated:
Semoga aku tidak tergelincir dan
jatuh dari jembatan ini.

entries.original:
"I don’t think it’s a such a good
idea to paint in the rain.

Everything I paint gets
washed away\."
entries.translation_source: I don’t think it’s a such a good idea to paint in the rain. Everything I paint gets washed away\.
entries.translated:
Kupikir bukan ide bagus untuk
melukis saat hujan. Semua yang\lkulukis akan hanyut\.

entries.original:
"A life of gambling is a life of no
regrets."
entries.translation_source: A life of gambling is a life of no regrets.
entries.translated:
Hidup berjudi adalah hidup tanpa
penyesalan.

entries.original:
"I train myself everyday by running
barefoot across these stones."
entries.translation_source: I train myself everyday by running barefoot across these stones.
entries.translated:
Aku melatih diriku setiap hari
dengan berlari tanpa alas kaki di\latas batu-batu ini.

entries.original:
"I am but the first of many
trainers on this road."
entries.translation_source: I am but the first of many trainers on this road.
entries.translated:
Aku hanyalah yang pertama dari
sekian banyak pelatih di jalan ini.

entries.original:
"Drat!
A Zubat bit me back in that cave."
entries.translation_source: Drat! A Zubat bit me back in that cave.
entries.translated:
Sial! Seekor Zubat menggigitku di
dalam gua itu.

entries.original:
"You came from Icicle Cave?
May I have a Swinub?"
entries.translation_source: You came from Icicle Cave? May I have a Swinub?
entries.translated:
Kamu datang dari Gua Icicle? Boleh
aku punya Swinub?

entries.original:
"Let’s watch them set up hazards
when you’re around, Hitmontop!

We’ll dominate [green]OU Doubles[blue]!

All will fall beneath your head
spike!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s watch them set up hazards when you’re around, Hitmontop! We’ll dominate [green]OU Doubles[blue]! All will fall beneath your head spike!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita lihat mereka memasang
rintangan saat kamu ada, Hitmontop!\lKita akan mendominasi [green]OU Doubles[blue]!

Semua akan jatuh di bawah paku
kepalamu!

entries.original: "Pokémon Day Care"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Day Care
entries.translated: Penitipan Pokémon

entries.original:
"When Pokémon gain enough
experience, they can evolve and\lgrow stronger.

Some even learn special moves after
evolution.

However, not all Pokémon can
evolve just by battling enough.

Some require special items like
[green]Fire Stones[blue] or [green]Water Stones[blue]."
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon gain enough experience, they can evolve and grow stronger. Some even learn special moves after evolution. However, not all Pokémon can evolve just by battling enough. Some require special items like [green]Fire Stones[blue] or [green]Water Stones[blue].
entries.translated:
Saat Pokémon mendapatkan cukup
pengalaman, mereka dapat berevolusi\ldan menjadi lebih kuat. Beberapa

bahkan mempelajari jurus khusus
setelah evolusi. Namun, tidak semua\lPokémon bisa berevolusi hanya

dengan bertarung cukup. Beberapa
membutuhkan item khusus seperti\l[green]Batu Api[blue] atau [green]Batu Air[blue].

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Here’s a taste of what’ll
happen to you if you spill!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Here’s a taste of what’ll happen to you if you spill!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Inilah sedikit gambaran apa
yang akan terjadi padamu jika kamu\ltumpah!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Oh, Ivory\.

How could you and Marlon both fail
me?

I thought you were stronger than
this\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Oh, Ivory\. How could you and Marlon both fail me? I thought you were stronger than this\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Oh, Ivory\. Bagaimana bisa kamu
dan Marlon berdua mengecewakanku?\lKupikir kalian lebih kuat dari ini\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Zeph, we’re scientists.

We’re not meant to be doing this
kind of thing\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Zeph, we’re scientists. We’re not meant to be doing this kind of thing\.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Zeph, kami ilmuwan. Kami
tidak seharusnya melakukan hal\lseperti ini\.

entries.original: "\au Pokemon Day Care"
entries.translation_source: \au Pokemon Day Care
entries.translated: \au Penitipan Pokémon

entries.original:
"The bookshelf by the wall has
great books on advanced battling\ltechniques.

Right now, I’m studying up on the
various [green]Terrains [blue]and their\leffects in battle.

You should definitely check it out
if you’re aiming for the top."
entries.translation_source: The bookshelf by the wall has great books on advanced battling techniques. Right now, I’m studying up on the various [green]Terrains [blue]and their effects in battle. You should definitely check it out if you’re aiming for the top.
entries.translated:
Rak buku di dekat dinding memiliki
buku-buku bagus tentang teknik\lbertarung tingkat lanjut. Saat ini,

aku sedang mempelajari berbagai
[green]Medan [blue]dan efeknya dalam\lpertempuran. Kamu harus benar-benar

memeriksanya jika kamu ingin
mencapai puncak.

entries.original:
"I’m studying up on the
various [green]Terrains [blue]and their\leffects in battle.

You should definitely check it out
if you’re aiming for the top."
entries.translation_source: I’m studying up on the various [green]Terrains [blue]and their effects in battle. You should definitely check it out if you’re aiming for the top.
entries.translated:
Aku sedang mempelajari berbagai
[green]Medan [blue]dan efeknya dalam\lpertempuran. Kamu harus benar-benar

memeriksanya jika kamu ingin
mencapai puncak.

entries.original: "the top."
entries.translation_source: the top.
entries.translated: puncak.

entries.original:
"Hah!

Those [green]Protective Pads [blue]look great
on you, Krook!

The next time we come up against a
[green]Ferrothorn [blue]holding a [green]Rocky Helmet[blue],\lit’ll be in for a real shocker!"
entries.translation_source: Hah! Those [green]Protective Pads [blue]look great on you, Krook! The next time we come up against a [green]Ferrothorn [blue]holding a [green]Rocky Helmet[blue], it’ll be in for a real shocker!
entries.translated:
Hah! [green]Bantalan Pelindung [blue]terlihat
bagus padamu, Krook! Lain kali kita\lbertemu [green]Ferrothorn [blue]yang memegang

[green]Helm Batu[blue], dia akan kaget besar!

entries.original:
"rotective Pads [blue]look great
on you, Krook!

The next time we come up against a
[green]Ferrothorn [blue]holding a [green]Rocky Helmet[blue],\lit’ll be in for a real shocker!"
entries.translation_source: rotective Pads [blue]look great on you, Krook! The next time we come up against a [green]Ferrothorn [blue]holding a [green]Rocky Helmet[blue], it’ll be in for a real shocker!
entries.translated:
Bantalan rotective [blue]terlihat bagus
padamu, Krook! Lain kali kita\lbertemu [green]Ferrothorn [blue]yang memegang

[green]Helm Batu[blue], dia akan kaget besar!

entries.original:
"As you can clearly see, the Battle
Tower is a great facility.

Apparently, there are similar
facilities dotted around Borrius."
entries.translation_source: As you can clearly see, the Battle Tower is a great facility. Apparently, there are similar facilities dotted around Borrius.
entries.translated:
Seperti yang bisa kamu lihat dengan
jelas, Battle Tower adalah\lfasilitas yang hebat. Tampaknya,

ada fasilitas serupa yang tersebar
di sekitar Borrius.

entries.original:
"Do you see that [green]Porygon[red]?

If you talk to it, you can directly
interface with the Pokémon Storage\lSystem!

Why use a PC when a Pokémon can do
it for you?"
entries.translation_source: Do you see that [green]Porygon[red]? If you talk to it, you can directly interface with the Pokémon Storage System! Why use a PC when a Pokémon can do it for you?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat [green]Porygon[red] itu?
Jika kamu berbicara dengannya, kamu\lbisa langsung berinteraksi dengan

Pokémon Storage System! Kenapa
menggunakan PC ketika Pokémon bisa\lmelakukannya untukmu?

entries.original:
"Huh?
I don’t do Oddish Leaves!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? I don’t do Oddish Leaves!
entries.translated:
Hah? Aku tidak melakukan Oddish
Leaves!

entries.original:
"As soon as we finished the bridge
to this new entrance, the walls\lcracked open and the sea water\lstarted flooding in!

Because why would we get a day off?"
entries.translation_source: As soon as we finished the bridge to this new entrance, the walls cracked open and the sea water started flooding in! Because why would we get a day off?
entries.translated:
Begitu kami selesai membangun
jembatan ke pintu masuk baru ini,\ldinding-dindingnya retak dan air

laut mulai masuk! Karena kenapa
kami bisa dapat hari libur?

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, this road is closed at
the moment.

We’re about to undertake a major
drug bust, and we can’t let anyone\lescape!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, this road is closed at the moment. We’re about to undertake a major drug bust, and we can’t let anyone escape!
entries.translated:
Maaf, jalan ini ditutup saat ini.
Kami akan melakukan penggerebekan\lnarkoba besar-besaran, dan kami

tidak bisa membiarkan siapa pun
kabur!

entries.original:
"Get moving [player].

You don’t want to miss Jax taking
on The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Get moving [player]. You don’t want to miss Jax taking on The Shadows.
entries.translated:
Bergeraklah [player]. Kamu tidak
ingin ketinggalan Jax melawan The\lShadows.

entries.original:
"I will uncover the secrets of
Cinder Volcano!"
entries.translation_source: I will uncover the secrets of Cinder Volcano!
entries.translated:
Aku akan mengungkap rahasia Gunung
Berapi Cinder!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Hold the [green]B-button[black] to run!

Press the [green]L-button[black] to toggle
auto-run!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Hold the [green]B-button[black] to run! Press the [green]L-button[black] to toggle auto-run!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Tahan [green]Tombol B[black] untuk
berlari! Tekan [green]Tombol L[black] untuk\lmengaktifkan lari otomatis!

entries.original: "???: [blue][buffer3]’s unconcious, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue][buffer3]’s unconcious, Hoopa.
entries.translated:
???: [blue][buffer3] tidak sadarkan diri,
Hoopa.

entries.original:
"Stop!

What did I tell you about
travelling through my Cube Space?

Just because you can’t travel
through your Rings, it doesn’t\lmean you can use my Cube without\lpermission!"
entries.translation_source: Stop! What did I tell you about travelling through my Cube Space? Just because you can’t travel through your Rings, it doesn’t mean you can use my Cube without permission!
entries.translated:
Berhenti! Apa yang sudah kukatakan
tentang bepergian melalui Cube\lSpace-ku? Hanya karena kamu tidak

bisa bepergian melalui Rings-mu,
bukan berarti kamu bisa menggunakan\lCube-ku tanpa izin!

entries.original:
"And were you responsible for
bringing these two here?"
entries.translation_source: And were you responsible for bringing these two here?
entries.translated:
Dan apakah kamu yang bertanggung
jawab membawa dua orang ini ke\lsini?

entries.original:
"I don’t know what you wanted with
them, but you’ve been a nuisance\lever since I found you on that\lbeach 16 years ago!

I may not be your true \qoguardian\qc,
but I’m your trainer now!

And you will obey me!

These two won’t rescue you from me!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t know what you wanted with them, but you’ve been a nuisance ever since I found you on that beach 16 years ago! I may not be your true \qoguardian\qc, but I’m your trainer now! And you will obey me! These two won’t rescue you from me!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu apa yang kamu
inginkan dari mereka, tapi kamu\lsudah menjadi gangguan sejak aku

menemukanmu di pantai itu 16 tahun
lalu! Aku mungkin bukan \qopenjaga\qc\lsejatimu, tapi aku pelatihmu

sekarang! Dan kamu akan patuh
padaku! Kedua orang ini tidak akan\lmenyelamatkanmu dariku!

entries.original: "What a pain\."
entries.translation_source: What a pain\.
entries.translated: Sungguh merepotkan\.

entries.original:
"Where do you think you’re going,
kid?

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Where do you think you’re going, kid? I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Kamu mau ke mana, nak? Aku mendapat
perintah ketat untuk menguncimu.

entries.original:
"He’s unconscious.
Better leave him alone for now."
entries.translation_source: He’s unconscious. Better leave him alone for now.
entries.translated:
Dia tidak sadarkan diri. Lebih baik
biarkan dia sendiri untuk saat ini.

entries.original:
"He’s unconscious.

What’s this?

There’s something written on his
shirt.

It’s his name!
It is\."
entries.translation_source: He’s unconscious. What’s this? There’s something written on his shirt. It’s his name! It is\.
entries.translated:
Dia tidak sadarkan diri. Ada apa
ini? Ada sesuatu yang tertulis di\lbajunya. Itu namanya! Benar\.

entries.original: "Is his name [rival]?"
entries.translation_source: Is his name [rival]?
entries.translated: Apakah namanya [rival]?

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]\.

Huh? What’s going on?
Where am I?"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]\. Huh? What’s going on? Where am I?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]\. Hah? Ada apa? Di mana
aku?

entries.original:
"What’s going on?

\.

Oh, wait\.

You’re that kid from down the
road.

[player], right?

Do you know what we’re doing here?"
entries.translation_source: What’s going on? \. Oh, wait\. You’re that kid from down the road. [player], right? Do you know what we’re doing here?
entries.translated:
Ada apa? \. Oh, tunggu\. Kamu anak dari
ujung jalan itu, kan? [player],\lbenar? Kamu tahu apa yang kami

lakukan di sini?

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Looks like I’m here.

I’d better get moving then."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Looks like I’m here. I’d better get moving then.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Sepertinya aku sudah sampai.
Lebih baik aku bergerak sekarang.

entries.original:
"Maybe I should check if I have a
fever\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should check if I have a fever\.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku harus periksa apakah
aku demam\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Duskull, use Shadow Sneak!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Duskull, use Shadow Sneak!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Duskull, gunakan Bayangan
Siluman!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Your shadowy reign of terror
stops here and now!

I won’t let you escape from Cinder
Volcano with Moltres in hand!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Your shadowy reign of terror stops here and now! I won’t let you escape from Cinder Volcano with Moltres in hand!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Kekuasaan bayanganmu yang
menakutkan berakhir di sini dan\lsekarang! Aku tidak akan

membiarkanmu melarikan diri dari
Cinder Volcano dengan Moltres di\ltangan!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]INSOLENT WHELP!

Who do you think you are
to threaten The Shadows!?

We’ve been ordered to assist Lady
Ivory, so don’t even think for a\lsecond that you can stop us!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]INSOLENT WHELP! Who do you think you are to threaten The Shadows!? We’ve been ordered to assist Lady Ivory, so don’t even think for a second that you can stop us!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]ANAK KURANG AJAR! Siapa kau
pikir kau untuk mengancam The\lShadows!? Kami diperintahkan untuk

membantu Lady Ivory, jadi jangan
pernah berpikir kau bisa\lmenghentikan kami!

entries.original: "Ivory: [red]Well spoken, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Well spoken, Marlon.
entries.translated: Ivory: [red]Bagus, Marlon.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Moltres is sealed away.

I’m heading back to HQ.

You might want to take care of that
kid watching, before you join me."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Moltres is sealed away. I’m heading back to HQ. You might want to take care of that kid watching, before you join me.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Moltres sudah disegel. Aku
kembali ke HQ. Sebaiknya urus anak\lyang menonton itu, sebelum kau

bergabung denganku.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Ohh...
My head..."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Ohh... My head...
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Ohh... Kepalaku...

entries.original:
"[blue]Ahh...

That hurt quite a bit.

Let’s head back to my grandfather’s
house to tell him what happened."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Ahh... That hurt quite a bit. Let’s head back to my grandfather’s house to tell him what happened.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ahh... Itu sangat menyakitkan. Ayo
kembali ke rumah kakekku untuk\lmenceritakan apa yang terjadi.

entries.original:
"[blue]Wha...
How could I lose!?

I’ll retreat for now, but I won’t
forget this!

You’ll be seeing me again soon!

I guarantee it\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Wha... How could I lose!? I’ll retreat for now, but I won’t forget this! You’ll be seeing me again soon! I guarantee it\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa... Bagaimana bisa aku kalah!?
Aku akan mundur untuk sekarang,\ltapi aku tidak akan melupakan ini!

Kau akan melihatku lagi! Aku jamin
itu\.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Hmm\.

This isn’t good.

At this point, only one Legendary
bird remains, [green]Zapdos[blue].

It’s imperative that it be rescued
before The Shadows can capture it."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [blue]Hmm\. This isn’t good. At this point, only one Legendary bird remains, [green]Zapdos[blue]. It’s imperative that it be rescued before The Shadows can capture it.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Hmm\. Ini tidak baik. Pada
titik ini, hanya satu Burung\lLegendaris yang tersisa, [green]Zapdos[blue].

Sangat penting untuk
menyelamatkannya sebelum The\lShadows menangkapnya.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Understood, Grandpa.

I’ll go to it right away."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Understood, Grandpa. I’ll go to it right away.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Dimengerti, Kakek. Aku akan
pergi ke sana segera.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Actually, Jax, I have a
different task for you.

To the best of my knowledge, The
Shadows are still missing the\lobject used to seal away the dark\lforce.

A friend of mine that lives on
[green]Route 9, [blue]should know its location.

Go to him and explain the sitution.

I’m sure he’ll be willing to help
us find it before The Shadows do."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [blue]Actually, Jax, I have a different task for you. To the best of my knowledge, The Shadows are still missing the object used to seal away the dark force. A friend of mine that lives on [green]Route 9, [blue]should know its location. Go to him and explain the sitution. I’m sure he’ll be willing to help us find it before The Shadows do.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Sebenarnya, Jax, aku punya
tugas lain untukmu. Sejauh\lpengetahuanku, The Shadows masih

kehilangan benda yang digunakan
untuk menyegel kekuatan gelap.\lSeorang temanku yang tinggal di

[green]Route 9, [blue]seharusnya tahu lokasinya.
Temui dia dan jelaskan situasinya.\lAku yakin dia akan bersedia

membantu kita menemukannya sebelum
The Shadows melakukannya.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Okay, Grandpa."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Okay, Grandpa.
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Baik, Kakek.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Good, good.

As for you, [player], I want you
to head to [green]Thundercap Mt. [blue]and\lsave [green]Zapdos[blue].

You’ve proven yourself by defending
Jax back in Cinder Volcano, and I\lthink you’re up for the task.

You can get to [green]Thundercap Mt. [blue]
by taking the highway southeast\lfrom the next town over, [green]Crater\lTown[blue].

If you don’t hurry, the Borrius
region will be doomed."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [blue]Good, good. As for you, [player], I want you to head to [green]Thundercap Mt. [blue]and save [green]Zapdos[blue]. You’ve proven yourself by defending Jax back in Cinder Volcano, and I think you’re up for the task. You can get to [green]Thundercap Mt. [blue] by taking the highway southeast from the next town over, [green]Crater Town[blue]. If you don’t hurry, the Borrius region will be doomed.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Baik, baik. Untukmu,
[player], aku ingin kau pergi ke\l[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] dan selamatkan

[green]Zapdos[blue]. Kau telah membuktikan
dirimu dengan membela Jax di Cinder\lVolcano, dan aku pikir kau mampu

untuk tugas itu. Kau bisa mencapai
[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] dengan mengambil\ljalan raya tenggara dari kota

berikutnya, [green]Crater Town[blue]. Jika kau
tidak cepat, wilayah Borrius akan\lhancur.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]I’ll be heading back to [green]Frozen
Heights[blue], [player].

I’ll let your mother know what the
situation is."
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]I’ll be heading back to [green]Frozen Heights[blue], [player]. I’ll let your mother know what the situation is.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Aku akan kembali ke [green]Frozen
Heights[blue], [player]. Aku akan memberi\ltahu ibumu tentang situasinya.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]My Staraptor is still pretty
weak from that fight from before,\lbut I should be able to give you a\lride up to Cinder Volcano.

We don’t have much time, so let’s
head out right away."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]My Staraptor is still pretty weak from that fight from before, but I should be able to give you a ride up to Cinder Volcano. We don’t have much time, so let’s head out right away.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Staraptor-ku masih cukup lemah
dari pertarungan sebelumnya, tapi\laku seharusnya bisa mengantarmu ke

Cinder Volcano. Kita tidak punya
banyak waktu, jadi ayo berangkat\lsekarang.

entries.original:
"Crater Town is an ideal place for
researchers like myself.

So much history\.

So much mystery\."
entries.translation_source: Crater Town is an ideal place for researchers like myself. So much history\. So much mystery\.
entries.translated:
Crater Town adalah tempat yang
ideal bagi peneliti seperti diriku.\lBegitu banyak sejarah\. Begitu banyak

misteri\.

entries.original:
"The meteorites in Crater Town are
imbued with some sort of cosmic\lpower.

They say that if a certain
Pokémon comes in contact with\lone, strange things will happen."
entries.translation_source: The meteorites in Crater Town are imbued with some sort of cosmic power. They say that if a certain Pokémon comes in contact with one, strange things will happen.
entries.translated:
Meteorit-meteorit di Crater Town
diresapi dengan semacam kekuatan\lkosmik. Mereka mengatakan bahwa

jika suatu Pokémon bersentuhan
dengan salah satunya, hal-hal aneh\lakan terjadi.

entries.original:
"Through that cave over there is
another way to leave Crater Town.

But since you need the Darkness
Badge to access it, most people\ljust stick to the SES Expressway."
entries.translation_source: Through that cave over there is another way to leave Crater Town. But since you need the Darkness Badge to access it, most people just stick to the SES Expressway.
entries.translated:
Di balik gua di sana ada jalan lain
untuk keluar dari Crater Town. Tapi\lkarena kamu membutuhkan Lencana

Kegelapan untuk mengaksesnya,
kebanyakan orang hanya menggunakan\lSES Expressway.

entries.original:
"It’s a mysterious meteorite that
fell from the stars."
entries.translation_source: It’s a mysterious meteorite that fell from the stars.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah meteorit misterius yang
jatuh dari bintang-bintang.

entries.original:
"There appears to be a hidden path
behind the bookshelf.

Would you like to follow it?"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be a hidden path behind the bookshelf. Would you like to follow it?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya ada jalan tersembunyi di
balik rak buku. Apakah kamu ingin\lmengikutinya?

entries.original: "The trash can is empty."
entries.translation_source: The trash can is empty.
entries.translated: Tempat sampahnya kosong.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Dresco Town Trainer
House!

Feel free to battle our five
trainers as many times as you want.

If you wish to rebattle someone,
please leave and come back in.

Enjoy your time!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Dresco Town Trainer House! Feel free to battle our five trainers as many times as you want. If you wish to rebattle someone, please leave and come back in. Enjoy your time!
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Rumah Pelatih
Dresco Town! Bebas bertarung dengan\llima pelatih kami sebanyak yang

kamu mau. Jika kamu ingin bertarung
ulang dengan seseorang, silakan\lkeluar dan masuk kembali. Nikmati

waktumu!

entries.original:
"Hello, there.

Wait\.

Can it be\.

Are you the [buffer1] of the
legendary Arceus trainer, [green]Aros[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hello, there. Wait\. Can it be\. Are you the [buffer1] of the legendary Arceus trainer, [green]Aros[blue]?
entries.translated:
Halo, ada. Tunggu\. Mungkinkah\. Apakah
kamu [buffer1] dari pelatih\llegendaris Arceus, [green]Aros[blue]?

entries.original:
"Hey there [buffer1]\.

How’z it hangin’?

You wanna sniff on some
Oddish Leaves?

They’re really good for the soul.
Makes it nice and mellow\."
entries.translation_source: Hey there [buffer1]\. How’z it hangin’? You wanna sniff on some Oddish Leaves? They’re really good for the soul. Makes it nice and mellow\.
entries.translated:
Hei [buffer1]\. Apa kabar? Kamu mau
menghirup daun Oddish? Itu sangat\lbaik untuk jiwa. Membuatnya tenang

dan lembut\.

entries.original:
"[black]You sniffed on some Oddish Leaves.

The repugnant scent assails your
nostrils."
entries.translation_source: [black]You sniffed on some Oddish Leaves. The repugnant scent assails your nostrils.
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu menghirup beberapa daun
Oddish. Aroma menjijikkan menyerang\llubang hidungmu.

entries.original:
"Now, I’m guessin’ you came for a
battle?

I’m in the perfect mood to indulge
you\."
entries.translation_source: Now, I’m guessin’ you came for a battle? I’m in the perfect mood to indulge you\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, kutebak kamu datang untuk
bertarung? Aku sedang dalam suasana\lhati yang sempurna untuk melayanimu\.

entries.original:
"My brother caught his Pokémon
by talking a Poké Ball in\lVivill Woods.

But I heard different Pokémon
appear for different trainers."
entries.translation_source: My brother caught his Pokémon by talking a Poké Ball in Vivill Woods. But I heard different Pokémon appear for different trainers.
entries.translated:
Saudaraku menangkap Pokémon-nya
dengan melempar Poké Ball di Vivill\lWoods. Tapi kudengar Pokémon yang

berbeda muncul untuk pelatih yang
berbeda.

entries.original:
"They say the warehouse on the hill
was abadoned after some experiment\lwent horribly wrong inside."
entries.translation_source: They say the warehouse on the hill was abadoned after some experiment went horribly wrong inside.
entries.translated:
Mereka bilang gudang di bukit itu
ditinggalkan setelah suatu\lpercobaan berjalan salah besar di

dalamnya.

entries.original:
"You came down from the mountain?

It must feel pretty warm to you
here."
entries.translation_source: You came down from the mountain? It must feel pretty warm to you here.
entries.translated:
Kamu turun dari gunung? Pasti
terasa cukup hangat di sini bagimu.

entries.original:
"Normally when the road is clear,
you can visit Dewp’s Bike Shop and\lget some handy bikes!"
entries.translation_source: Normally when the road is clear, you can visit Dewp’s Bike Shop and get some handy bikes!
entries.translated:
Biasanya saat jalan sedang sepi,
kamu bisa mengunjungi Toko Sepeda\lDewp dan mendapatkan sepeda yang

berguna!

entries.original:
"No matter how many times I lose, I
will always play after!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how many times I lose, I will always play after!
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli berapa kali aku kalah,
aku akan selalu bermain lagi!

entries.original: "I’m where I love to be."
entries.translation_source: I’m where I love to be.
entries.translated: Aku berada di tempat yang kucintai.

entries.original:
"It’s you!
The big [buffer1] who saved me!

You’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you! The big [buffer1] who saved me! You’re the best!
entries.translated:
Itu kamu! [buffer1] hebat yang
menyelamatkanku! Kamu yang terbaik!

entries.original:
"The warehouse on the hill has sat
abandoned for as long as I can\lremember.

Apparently it goes so deep into the
ground, there were floors unused by\leven the gang that was there.

I can only imagine what treasures
they hold!"
entries.translation_source: The warehouse on the hill has sat abandoned for as long as I can remember. Apparently it goes so deep into the ground, there were floors unused by even the gang that was there. I can only imagine what treasures they hold!
entries.translated:
Gudang di bukit itu sudah
terbengkalai selama yang aku ingat.\lRupanya gudang itu sangat dalam ke

dalam tanah, ada lantai yang bahkan
tidak digunakan oleh geng yang ada\ldi sana. Aku hanya bisa

membayangkan harta karun apa yang
mereka simpan!

entries.original:
"The SES Expressway runs from Crater
Town to Tehl Town beneath us."
entries.translation_source: The SES Expressway runs from Crater Town to Tehl Town beneath us.
entries.translated:
SES Expressway berjalan dari Crater
Town ke Tehl Town di bawah kita.

entries.original:
"If 100 people like me stood here,
do you the ground could support it?"
entries.translation_source: If 100 people like me stood here, do you the ground could support it?
entries.translated:
Jika 100 orang sepertiku berdiri di
sini, apa tanahnya bisa\lmenopangnya?

entries.original:
"If only there was someone to have a
picnic with\."
entries.translation_source: If only there was someone to have a picnic with\.
entries.translated:
Andai saja ada seseorang untuk
berpiknik\.

entries.original: "What are you looking at?"
entries.translation_source: What are you looking at?
entries.translated: Apa yang kamu lihat?

entries.original:
"Even roughnecks like me need a
break once in a while."
entries.translation_source: Even roughnecks like me need a break once in a while.
entries.translated:
Bahkan orang kasar sepertiku butuh
istirahat sesekali.

entries.original:
"When those strange thugs marched
into town, we were all sure to lock\lour doors very quickly.

If we hadn’t, they most likely
would’ve barged right in like you,\land taken all our valuables for\ltheir nefarious plot,"
entries.translation_source: When those strange thugs marched into town, we were all sure to lock our doors very quickly. If we hadn’t, they most likely would’ve barged right in like you, and taken all our valuables for their nefarious plot,
entries.translated:
Saat preman aneh itu berbaris masuk
kota, kami semua pasti mengunci\lpintu dengan cepat. Jika tidak,

kemungkinan besar mereka akan
menerobos masuk sepertimu, dan\lmengambil semua barang berharga

kami untuk rencana jahat mereka,

entries.original:
"This dude thinks you’re a big one.
No, you’re a big-one-to-be!"
entries.translation_source: This dude thinks you’re a big one. No, you’re a big-one-to-be!
entries.translated:
Orang ini mengira kamu yang besar.
Tidak, kamu calon yang besar!

entries.original:
"Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll hook
a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll hook a big one!
entries.translated:
Oh, tidak! Aku punya perasaan aku
akan memancing yang besar!

entries.original:
"I must refine the art of concealment.
I bid thee farewell."
entries.translation_source: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
entries.translated:
Aku harus memperhalus seni
penyembunyian. Aku ucapkan selamat\ltinggal.

entries.original:
"Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call
myself an Expert now, can I?"
entries.translation_source: Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call myself an Expert now, can I?
entries.translated:
Nah, nah, aku kalah. Aku tidak bisa
menyebut diriku seorang Pakar\lsekarang, kan?

entries.original:
"It’d be a handful if I hooked
your tough Pokémon!"
