entries.translation_source: It’d be a handful if I hooked your tough Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Akan merepotkan jika aku memancing
Pokémon tangguhmu!

entries.original: "Stay safe in the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Stay safe in the Great Desert!
entries.translated: Tetap aman di Gurun Besar!

entries.original:
"There used to be a Clefairy by
the bookshelf a long time ago.

I wonder where it went?"
entries.translation_source: There used to be a Clefairy by the bookshelf a long time ago. I wonder where it went?
entries.translated:
Dulu ada Clefairy di dekat rak
buku. Aku ingin tahu ke mana\lperginya?

entries.original:
"How’s about I toss a free [green]TM[blue]
your way?"
entries.translation_source: How’s about I toss a free [green]TM[blue] your way?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kalau aku lempar [green]TM[blue]
gratis untukmu?

entries.original: "Would you like to open the door?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to open the door?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu ingin membuka pintu?

entries.original: "The door is open."
entries.translation_source: The door is open.
entries.translated: Pintunya terbuka.

entries.original: "Would you like to open the door?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to open the door?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu ingin membuka pintu?

entries.original: "The door is open."
entries.translation_source: The door is open.
entries.translated: Pintunya terbuka.

entries.original:
"The people who live here aren’t
letting me in, so I’m forced to sit\lout here."
entries.translation_source: The people who live here aren’t letting me in, so I’m forced to sit out here.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang yang tinggal di sini
tidak mengizinkanku masuk, jadi aku\lterpaksa duduk di luar sini.

entries.original:
"People say that to the east of the
city is a hidden forest with a\lpowerful Pokémon inside.

But it’s probably just a rumour, so
most people tend to ignore it."
entries.translation_source: People say that to the east of the city is a hidden forest with a powerful Pokémon inside. But it’s probably just a rumour, so most people tend to ignore it.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang mengatakan bahwa di
timur kota ada hutan tersembunyi\ldengan Pokémon kuat di dalamnya.

Tapi itu mungkin hanya rumor, jadi
kebanyakan orang cenderung\lmengabaikannya.

entries.original:
"I’m eating roasted Snover!
It’s so delicious!"
entries.translation_source: I’m eating roasted Snover! It’s so delicious!
entries.translated:
Aku makan Snover panggang! Enak
sekali!

entries.original:
"Some guy in one of the residences
around here is giving away an item\lthat allows you to rebattle\ltrainers.

But it doesn’t really work so well
on the mountain coming up here\lsince all of those trainers are\ldead tired."
entries.translation_source: Some guy in one of the residences around here is giving away an item that allows you to rebattle trainers. But it doesn’t really work so well on the mountain coming up here since all of those trainers are dead tired.
entries.translated:
Seorang pria di salah satu tempat
tinggal di sekitar sini memberikan\litem yang memungkinkanmu untuk

bertarung ulang dengan pelatih.
Tapi itu tidak berfungsi dengan\lbaik di gunung yang akan datang di

sini karena semua pelatih itu
kelelahan.

entries.original:
"Hey! Listen up.

Have you been travelling and
noticed some boulders in your path\lthat you just couldn’t budge?

Well there’s a guy in Epidimy Town
who is the master of teaching\lPokémon how to move big boulders.

Talk to him ASAP if you want to
move those pesky things."
entries.translation_source: Hey! Listen up. Have you been travelling and noticed some boulders in your path that you just couldn’t budge? Well there’s a guy in Epidimy Town who is the master of teaching Pokémon how to move big boulders. Talk to him ASAP if you want to move those pesky things.
entries.translated:
Hei! Dengar. Apakah kamu bepergian
dan melihat beberapa batu besar di\ljalanmu yang tidak bisa kamu

gerakkan? Nah, ada seorang pria di
Epidimy Town yang ahli mengajari\lPokémon cara memindahkan batu

besar. Bicaralah padanya secepatnya
jika kamu ingin memindahkan\lbenda-benda menjengkelkan itu.

entries.original: "Try going the other way."
entries.translation_source: Try going the other way.
entries.translated: Coba pergi ke arah lain.

entries.original:
"Sorry bud, but this isn’t the right
way to go."
entries.translation_source: Sorry bud, but this isn’t the right way to go.
entries.translated:
Maaf sobat, tapi ini bukan jalan
yang benar.

entries.original:
"The fans make the gym really
confusing."
entries.translation_source: The fans make the gym really confusing.
entries.translated:
Para kipas angin membuat gym ini
sangat membingungkan.

entries.original:
"I swear\.

Those weird guys have been blocking
off [green]Route 9[blue] for days\.

I wonder what they’re up to?"
entries.translation_source: I swear\. Those weird guys have been blocking off [green]Route 9[blue] for days\. I wonder what they’re up to?
entries.translated:
Saya bersumpah\. Orang-orang aneh itu
sudah memblokir [green]Route 9[blue] selama\lberhari-hari\. Saya penasaran apa

yang mereka rencanakan?

entries.original:
"[red]Gliscor!
Use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Gliscor! Use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: [red]Gliscor! Gunakan Rock Smash!

entries.original:
"[red]Gliscor!
Return!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Gliscor! Return!
entries.translated: [red]Gliscor! Kembali!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Staraptor!
Use Aerial Ace!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Staraptor! Use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Staraptor! Gunakan Aerial Ace!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Tell me how to get past the
barrier on Route 9!

I don’t have time to deal with you
Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Tell me how to get past the barrier on Route 9! I don’t have time to deal with you Shadows!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Beritahu saya cara melewati
penghalang di Route 9! Saya tidak\lpunya waktu untuk berurusan dengan

kalian Shadows!

entries.original: "Food!"
entries.translation_source: Food!
entries.translated: Makanan!

entries.original:
"What?
You don’t know?

So you must be in the same
situation as I am\.

Have you seen any sort of exit
around?

\.

There is one, but it’s blocked by
a man dressed in black\.

Take me there.

I’m going to try to break through."
entries.translation_source: What? You don’t know? So you must be in the same situation as I am\. Have you seen any sort of exit around? \. There is one, but it’s blocked by a man dressed in black\. Take me there. I’m going to try to break through.
entries.translated:
Apa? Kamu tidak tahu? Jadi kamu
pasti berada dalam situasi yang\lsama sepertiku\. Apakah kamu melihat

jalan keluar di sekitar? \. Ada satu,
tapi terhalang oleh seorang pria\lberpakaian hitam\. Bawa aku ke sana.

Aku akan mencoba menerobos.

entries.original:
"Take me to that guy in black.

I’m going to make him wish he
wasn’t there!"
entries.translation_source: Take me to that guy in black. I’m going to make him wish he wasn’t there!
entries.translated:
Bawa aku ke pria berbaju hitam itu.
Aku akan membuatnya menyesal berada\ldi sana!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player].
Let’s find another way out of here."
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player]. Let’s find another way out of here.
entries.translated:
Ayo, [player]. Mari cari jalan
keluar lain dari sini.

entries.original:
"We need to find those Pokémon!
They could be our way out!"
entries.translation_source: We need to find those Pokémon! They could be our way out!
entries.translated:
Kita harus menemukan
Pokémon-Pokémon itu! Mereka bisa\lmenjadi jalan keluar kita!

entries.original:
"Hurry up, [player], choose a
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Hurry up, [player], choose a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Cepat, [player], pilih satu
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Let’s use our new Pokémon to break
out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s use our new Pokémon to break out of here!
entries.translated:
Ayo gunakan Pokémon baru kita untuk
kabur dari sini!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Hey!

Who do you think you are?

Do you think you can keep us locked
up in here and get away with it?

You’d better let us through right
now or you’re going to suffer!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Hey! Who do you think you are? Do you think you can keep us locked up in here and get away with it? You’d better let us through right now or you’re going to suffer!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Hei! Kau pikir kau siapa?
Kau pikir kau bisa mengurung kami\ldi sini dan lolos begitu saja?

Sebaiknya kau biarkan kami lewat
sekarang atau kau akan menderita!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Back off, kid.

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Back off, kid. I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Mundur, nak. Aku di bawah
perintah ketat untuk mengurung\lkalian.

entries.original:
"[blue]So scram, unless you want
to\.suffer."
entries.translation_source: [blue]So scram, unless you want to\.suffer.
entries.translated:
[blue]Jadi pergilah, kecuali kau
ingin\.menderita.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Smart choice.

Keep far away from this door, and
you won’t regret it."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Smart choice. Keep far away from this door, and you won’t regret it.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Pilihan yang cerdas. Jauhi
pintu ini, dan kau tidak akan\lmenyesal.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]It doesn’t look like he’s
going to move, [player].

We’d better look for another way
out of here."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]It doesn’t look like he’s going to move, [player]. We’d better look for another way out of here.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Sepertinya dia tidak akan
bergerak, [player]. Sebaiknya kita\lcari jalan keluar lain dari sini.

entries.original:
"Did you hear that, [player]?

It sounded like some Pokémon are
trapped in that cage over there!

Let’s go check it out."
entries.translation_source: Did you hear that, [player]? It sounded like some Pokémon are trapped in that cage over there! Let’s go check it out.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu mendengar itu,
[player]? Sepertinya ada beberapa\lPokémon yang terperangkap di dalam

kandang di sana! Ayo kita periksa.

entries.original:
"There are many Pokémon locked
away in the cage\."
entries.translation_source: There are many Pokémon locked away in the cage\.
entries.translated:
Ada banyak Pokémon yang terkunci di
dalam kandang\.

entries.original:
"The cage door is unlocked.
The Pokémon are gone."
entries.translation_source: The cage door is unlocked. The Pokémon are gone.
entries.translated:
Pintu kandang tidak terkunci.
Pokémon-nya sudah pergi.

entries.original:
"The lock appears fragile.
Would you like to break it?"
entries.translation_source: The lock appears fragile. Would you like to break it?
entries.translated:
Kuncinya tampak rapuh. Apakah kamu
ingin memecahkannya?

entries.original:
"The lock has been broken, and the
cage door is now open."
entries.translation_source: The lock has been broken, and the cage door is now open.
entries.translated:
Kuncinya telah dipatahkan, dan
pintu kandang sekarang terbuka.

entries.original:
"[blue]It looks like these Pokémon are
grateful and want to join us!

If we each take one, we can use them
to attack the guard and escape!

Here, take this Poké Ball I
picked up."
entries.translation_source: [blue]It looks like these Pokémon are grateful and want to join us! If we each take one, we can use them to attack the guard and escape! Here, take this Poké Ball I picked up.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya Pokémon-Pokémon ini
berterima kasih dan ingin bergabung\ldengan kita! Jika kita

masing-masing mengambil satu, kita
bisa menggunakannya untuk menyerang\lpenjaga dan melarikan diri! Ini,

ambil Poké Ball yang aku temukan.

entries.original: "[blue]Go ahead, choose a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Go ahead, choose a Pokémon.
entries.translated: [blue]Silakan, pilih satu Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Will you take the [buffer2] Pokémon,
[buffer1]? ([green][buffer3][black])"
entries.translation_source: Will you take the [buffer2] Pokémon, [buffer1]? ([green][buffer3][black])
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu akan mengambil Pokémon
[buffer2], [buffer1]? ([green][buffer3][black])

entries.original: "The [buffer1] joined [player]’s party!"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] joined [player]’s party!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] bergabung dengan tim
[player]!

entries.original: "[blue]I’ll take this one, then."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I’ll take this one, then.
entries.translated: [blue]Kalau begitu, aku ambil yang ini.

entries.original: "[black]Disheartened, the [buffer1] left."
entries.translation_source: [black]Disheartened, the [buffer1] left.
entries.translated: [black]Dengan kecewa, [buffer1] pergi.

entries.original:
"Now that we have our own Pokémon,
let’s head back to the exit.

We’ll force our way out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Now that we have our own Pokémon, let’s head back to the exit. We’ll force our way out of here!
entries.translated:
Sekarang kita punya Pokémon
sendiri, ayo kembali ke pintu\lkeluar. Kita akan memaksa keluar

dari sini!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I told you before.

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]I told you before. I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Sudah kubilang sebelumnya.
Aku mendapat perintah ketat untuk\lmengurungmu.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Heh heh heh\.
You don’t really have a choice now.

You’re going to let us out or face
my wrath."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Heh heh heh\. You don’t really have a choice now. You’re going to let us out or face my wrath.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Heh heh heh\. Kamu tidak
punya pilihan sekarang. Kamu akan\lmembiarkan kami keluar atau

menghadapi kemarahanku.

entries.original:
"I’m searching for rare Bug
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m searching for rare Bug Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku sedang mencari Pokémon Serangga
langka.

entries.original:
"Who knew that there’d be a whole
other cave, within Icicle Cave?

If it hadn’t been for that
Sandslash, this place may have\lremained hidden forever.

But now that it’s accessible, just
imagine all of the secrets this\lit holds!

Take this tablet for instance.

It has to be at least a thousand
years old, if not more.

I intend to discover all of the
secrets hidden within.

Maybe if you come back some day,
the truth will reveal itself..."
entries.translation_source: Who knew that there’d be a whole other cave, within Icicle Cave? If it hadn’t been for that Sandslash, this place may have remained hidden forever. But now that it’s accessible, just imagine all of the secrets this it holds! Take this tablet for instance. It has to be at least a thousand years old, if not more. I intend to discover all of the secrets hidden within. Maybe if you come back some day, the truth will reveal itself...
entries.translated:
Siapa sangka akan ada gua lain di
dalam Gua Es? Jika bukan karena\lSandslash itu, tempat ini mungkin

akan tetap tersembunyi selamanya.
Tapi sekarang setelah bisa diakses,\lbayangkan saja semua rahasia yang

dimilikinya! Ambil tablet ini
misalnya. Umurnya setidaknya seribu\ltahun, jika tidak lebih. Aku

berniat menemukan semua rahasia
yang tersembunyi di dalamnya.\lMungkin jika suatu hari nanti kamu

kembali, kebenaran akan
terungkap...

entries.original:
"Who knew that there’d be a whole
other cave, within Icicle Cave?

If it hadn’t been for that
Sandslash, this place may have\lremained hidden forever.

But now that it’s accessible, just
imagine all of the secrets that\lit holds!

Take this tablet for instance.

It has to be at least a thousand
years old, if not more.

I intend to discover all of the
secrets hidden within.

Maybe if you come back some day,
the truth will reveal itself\."
entries.translation_source: Who knew that there’d be a whole other cave, within Icicle Cave? If it hadn’t been for that Sandslash, this place may have remained hidden forever. But now that it’s accessible, just imagine all of the secrets that it holds! Take this tablet for instance. It has to be at least a thousand years old, if not more. I intend to discover all of the secrets hidden within. Maybe if you come back some day, the truth will reveal itself\.
entries.translated:
Siapa sangka akan ada gua lain di
dalam Gua Es? Jika bukan karena\lSandslash itu, tempat ini mungkin

akan tetap tersembunyi selamanya.
Tapi sekarang setelah bisa diakses,\lbayangkan saja semua rahasia yang

dimilikinya! Ambil tablet ini
misalnya. Umurnya setidaknya seribu\ltahun, jika tidak lebih. Aku

berniat menemukan semua rahasia
yang tersembunyi di dalamnya.\lMungkin jika suatu hari nanti kamu

kembali, kebenaran akan terungkap\.

entries.original:
"I just don’t know what to do.

Every few days this horrible
Pokémon has been coming into my\lhouse and stealing my food.

If I had a Pokémon of my own I
could stop it, but unfortunately I\lhave none.

Oh!
I just had an idea!

Would you be able to..."
entries.translation_source: I just don’t know what to do. Every few days this horrible Pokémon has been coming into my house and stealing my food. If I had a Pokémon of my own I could stop it, but unfortunately I have none. Oh! I just had an idea! Would you be able to...
entries.translated:
Aku benar-benar tidak tahu harus
berbuat apa. Setiap beberapa hari,\lPokémon mengerikan ini masuk ke

rumahku dan mencuri makananku. Jika
aku punya Pokémon sendiri, aku bisa\lmenghentikannya, tapi sayangnya aku

tidak punya. Oh! Aku baru punya
ide! Bisakah kamu...

entries.original:
"Ahh!

There it is again!

It’s come to steal more food!"
entries.translation_source: Ahh! There it is again! It’s come to steal more food!
entries.translated:
Ahh! Itu dia lagi! Dia datang untuk
mencuri lebih banyak makanan!

entries.original: "It’s stealing my food!"
entries.translation_source: It’s stealing my food!
entries.translated: Dia mencuri makananku!

entries.original:
"[black]Daughter: [red]I’ll stop it from
leaving, Daddy!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Daughter: [red]I’ll stop it from leaving, Daddy!
entries.translated:
[black]Anak Perempuan: [red]Aku akan
menghentikannya pergi, Ayah!

entries.original:
"[black]Daughter: [red]Waaaah!

Daddy! It hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Daughter: [red]Waaaah! Daddy! It hurt me!
entries.translated:
[black]Anak Perempuan: [red]Waaaah! Ayah! Itu
menyakitiku!

entries.original:
"[black]Guy: [blue]It’s alright sweetie...

Daddy’s not going to let that
Pokémon hurt you anymore."
entries.translation_source: [black]Guy: [blue]It’s alright sweetie... Daddy’s not going to let that Pokémon hurt you anymore.
entries.translated:
[black]Pria: [blue]Tidak apa-apa sayang... Ayah
tidak akan membiarkan Pokémon itu\lmenyakitimu lagi.

entries.original:
"If you can help me out and get my
food back from that Pokémon I’d\lbe extremely grateful!

There might be a little something
in it for you as well..."
entries.translation_source: If you can help me out and get my food back from that Pokémon I’d be extremely grateful! There might be a little something in it for you as well...
entries.translated:
Jika Anda bisa membantu saya dan
mendapatkan kembali makanan saya\ldari Pokémon itu, saya akan sangat

berterima kasih! Mungkin ada
sedikit imbalan untuk Anda juga...

entries.original:
"I’m extremely grateful for your
help!

I’m going to train my new Pokémon,
and if you’re lucky, maybe you’ll\lbe able to battle me someday."
entries.translation_source: I’m extremely grateful for your help! I’m going to train my new Pokémon, and if you’re lucky, maybe you’ll be able to battle me someday.
entries.translated:
Saya sangat berterima kasih atas
bantuan Anda! Saya akan melatih\lPokémon baru saya, dan jika Anda

beruntung, mungkin suatu hari nanti
Anda bisa bertarung melawan saya.

entries.original:
"Hey! It’s you again! Thanks again
for your help!

Now, how would you like to battle
my Pokémon and me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! It’s you again! Thanks again for your help! Now, how would you like to battle my Pokémon and me?
entries.translated:
Hei! Kamu lagi! Terima kasih lagi
atas bantuanmu! Sekarang, bagaimana\lkalau kamu bertarung melawan

Pokémonku dan aku?

entries.original:
"Alright!

Just wait and see how strong my
Sandslash has become!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! Just wait and see how strong my Sandslash has become!
entries.translated:
Baiklah! Tunggu saja dan lihat
seberapa kuat Sandslashku sekarang!

entries.original:
"Thanks for the battle!

Feel free to come back anytime and
battle me again."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for the battle! Feel free to come back anytime and battle me again.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih untuk pertarungannya!
Jangan ragu untuk kembali kapan\lsaja dan bertarung lagi denganku.

entries.original:
"Whatever will I do\.

My beloved baby was taken from me
by some\.some\.crook!

How can I perform on stage without
her?

Please, help me get my baby back!"
entries.translation_source: Whatever will I do\. My beloved baby was taken from me by some\.some\.crook! How can I perform on stage without her? Please, help me get my baby back!
entries.translated:
Apa yang harus kulakukan\. Bayi
kesayanganku diambil oleh\lbeberapa\.beberapa\.penjahat! Bagaimana

aku bisa tampil di panggung
tanpanya? Tolong, bantu aku\lmendapatkan bayiku kembali!

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you!

Thank you, thank you!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you! Thank you, thank you!
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih! Terima kasih,
terima kasih!

entries.original:
"I know that my baby was taken by a
man dressed in gray.

But that’s all I know\.
I wish I knew where he went\."
entries.translation_source: I know that my baby was taken by a man dressed in gray. But that’s all I know\. I wish I knew where he went\.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu bayiku diambil oleh
seorang pria berpakaian abu-abu.\lTapi hanya itu yang kuketahui\.

Kuharap aku tahu ke mana dia pergi\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Silence!

If you think a surprise attack on
me will get me to take down the\lbarrier, you’re dead wrong!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Silence! If you think a surprise attack on me will get me to take down the barrier, you’re dead wrong!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Diam! Jika kamu pikir
serangan mendadak padaku akan\lmembuatku menurunkan penghalang,

kamu salah besar!

entries.original:
"[red]Alakazam!
Get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Alakazam! Get rid of him!
entries.translated: [red]Alakazam! Singkirkan dia!

entries.original:
"Oh no, no, no\.

I hope I can find someone to help
me before it’s too late\."
entries.translation_source: Oh no, no, no\. I hope I can find someone to help me before it’s too late\.
entries.translated:
Oh tidak, tidak, tidak\. Kuharap aku
bisa menemukan seseorang untuk\lmembantuku sebelum terlambat\.

entries.original:
"It’s you again!

The burglar who stole my baby came
back and returned her to me!

I can now perform again!
Thank you, thank you, thank you!

Please, take this [green]Egg[red] she layed!
It’s the least I can do."
entries.translation_source: It’s you again! The burglar who stole my baby came back and returned her to me! I can now perform again! Thank you, thank you, thank you! Please, take this [green]Egg[red] she layed! It’s the least I can do.
entries.translated:
Kamu lagi! Pencuri yang mencuri
bayiku kembali dan mengembalikannya\lpadaku! Aku sekarang bisa tampil

lagi! Terima kasih, terima kasih,
terima kasih! Tolong, ambil [green]Telur[red]\lyang dia keluarkan ini! Ini yang

paling bisa kulakukan.

entries.original: "Would you like to ride on Lapras?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to ride on Lapras?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu ingin menaiki Lapras?

entries.original:
"Be careful here.

There is plenty of exposed magma
everywhere."
entries.translation_source: Be careful here. There is plenty of exposed magma everywhere.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati di sini. Ada banyak magma
terbuka di mana-mana.

entries.original:
"This place is so hot, it’s so easy
to light fires here."
entries.translation_source: This place is so hot, it’s so easy to light fires here.
entries.translated:
Tempat ini sangat panas, sangat
mudah untuk menyalakan api di sini.

entries.original:
"It’s up to me to construct bridges
that can withstand the heat."
entries.translation_source: It’s up to me to construct bridges that can withstand the heat.
entries.translated:
Terserah padaku untuk membangun
jembatan yang bisa menahan panas.

entries.original:
"A talented trainer like you fits
right in, in this volcano."
entries.translation_source: A talented trainer like you fits right in, in this volcano.
entries.translated:
Pelatih berbakat sepertimu sangat
cocok di gunung berapi ini.

entries.original:
"I will continue to train.

Forever and ever..."
entries.translation_source: I will continue to train. Forever and ever...
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus berlatih. Selamanya
dan seterusnya...

entries.original: "The lava here is my inspiration."
entries.translation_source: The lava here is my inspiration.
entries.translated: Lava di sini adalah inspirasiku.

entries.original:
"I came here to train my Pokémon
since they are naturally weak to\lfire."
entries.translation_source: I came here to train my Pokémon since they are naturally weak to fire.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini untuk melatih
Pokémonku karena mereka secara\lalami lemah terhadap api.

entries.original: "The lava is beautiful, isn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: The lava is beautiful, isn’t it?
entries.translated: Lavanya indah, bukan?

entries.original:
"[red]Mission complete.

Let’s move out."
entries.translation_source: [red]Mission complete. Let’s move out.
entries.translated: [red]Misi selesai. Ayo kita pergi.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Stop right there Shadow!

Release the Moltres you captured!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Stop right there Shadow! Release the Moltres you captured!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Berhenti di situ, Shadow!
Lepaskan Moltres yang kautangkap!

entries.original:
"Oh\.

You don’t have space in your party
for the Egg\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. You don’t have space in your party for the Egg\.
entries.translated:
Oh\. Kamu tidak memiliki ruang di
timmu untuk Telur itu\.

entries.original: "Raptor!"
entries.translation_source: Raptor!
entries.translated: Raptor!

entries.original:
"Would you also like me to keep the
rest of your Eggs?

I’m holding on to [green][buffer1][blue] in total."
entries.translation_source: Would you also like me to keep the rest of your Eggs? I’m holding on to [green][buffer1][blue] in total.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu juga ingin aku
menyimpan sisa Telurmu? Aku\lmenyimpan total [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Fine then, I’ll keep them all.
Thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Fine then, I’ll keep them all. Thanks!
entries.translated:
Baiklah kalau begitu, aku akan
menyimpan semuanya. Terima kasih!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep holding onto your Eggs
for you, then."
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep holding onto your Eggs for you, then.
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus menyimpan
Telur-telurmu untukmu, kalau\lbegitu.

entries.original:
"Would you like another Egg?

I’m holding on to [green][buffer1][blue] in total."
entries.translation_source: Would you like another Egg? I’m holding on to [green][buffer1][blue] in total.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin Telur lain? Aku
menyimpan total [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"As you travel, your Pokémon grows
with you\.

Be always bonded in friendship.
-Pokémon Day Care"
entries.translation_source: As you travel, your Pokémon grows with you\. Be always bonded in friendship. -Pokémon Day Care
entries.translated:
Saat kamu bepergian, Pokémonmu
tumbuh bersamamu\. Selalu terikat\ldalam persahabatan. -Penitipan

Pokémon

entries.original:
"Sometimes, when a boy and girl
Pokémon like each other very much,\lthey lay an Egg!

And the Day-Care couple are kind
enough to hold onto [green]100 [blue]of them\lfor you!

I wish I could breed Pokémon as
great as them."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes, when a boy and girl Pokémon like each other very much, they lay an Egg! And the Day-Care couple are kind enough to hold onto [green]100 [blue]of them for you! I wish I could breed Pokémon as great as them.
entries.translated:
Kadang-kadang, ketika Pokémon
jantan dan betina saling menyukai,\lmereka bertelur! Dan pasangan

Penitipan cukup baik untuk
menyimpan [green]100 [blue]dari mereka untukmu!\lAku berharap bisa membiakkan

Pokémon sehebat mereka.

entries.original:
"I learned in Breeding School that
the best way to raise your partner\lPokémon is to battle with them as\lmuch as possible.

Will you help me raise my
Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: I learned in Breeding School that the best way to raise your partner Pokémon is to battle with them as much as possible. Will you help me raise my Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Aku belajar di Sekolah Pembiakan
bahwa cara terbaik untuk\lmembesarkan Pokémon mitramu adalah

bertarung dengan mereka sebanyak
mungkin. Maukah kamu membantuku\lmembesarkan Pokémonku?

entries.original:
"Well, I’ll still be here if you
want to help me out later!"
entries.translation_source: Well, I’ll still be here if you want to help me out later!
entries.translated:
Yah, aku akan tetap di sini jika
kamu ingin membantuku nanti!

entries.original: "Let’s get started!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get started!
entries.translated: Ayo mulai!

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me!

I look forward to training my
babies with you again!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me! I look forward to training my babies with you again!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah bertarung
denganku! Aku berharap bisa melatih\lbayi-bayiku denganmu lagi!

entries.original: "Take care of my baby’s baby!"
entries.translation_source: Take care of my baby’s baby!
entries.translated: Jagalah bayi dari bayiku!

entries.original:
"Burglar: [blue]Huh, who are you?
What are you doing back here?

This is my quiet spot for training
my precious Pokémon.

I don’t like it when other people
come here uninvited.

\.

So you’ve come to take my Pokémon
away from me, is that it?

I won’t let you take her from me!"
entries.translation_source: Burglar: [blue]Huh, who are you? What are you doing back here? This is my quiet spot for training my precious Pokémon. I don’t like it when other people come here uninvited. \. So you’ve come to take my Pokémon away from me, is that it? I won’t let you take her from me!
entries.translated:
Pencuri: [blue]Huh, siapa kamu? Apa yang
kamu lakukan di sini? Ini tempat\ltenangku untuk melatih Pokémon

kesayanganku. Aku tidak suka jika
orang lain datang ke sini tanpa\ldiundang\. Jadi kamu datang untuk

mengambil Pokémonku dariku, begitu?
Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu\lmengambilnya dariku!

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of [green]Ayla[red]?

She’s the one responsible for
porting Bill’s PC to Borrius!

Thanks to her, we can store our
Pokémon somewhere!"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of [green]Ayla[red]? She’s the one responsible for porting Bill’s PC to Borrius! Thanks to her, we can store our Pokémon somewhere!
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang
[green]Ayla[red]? Dialah yang bertanggung jawab\lmemindahkan PC Bill ke Borrius!

Berkat dia, kita bisa menyimpan
Pokémon kita di suatu tempat!

entries.original:
"Crater Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Vega

Winning Trainers:
[rival]"
entries.translation_source: Crater Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Vega Winning Trainers: [rival]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Crater Town:
Vega Pelatih Pemenang: [rival]

entries.original:
"Crater Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Vega

Winning Trainers:
[rival], [player]"
entries.translation_source: Crater Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Vega Winning Trainers: [rival], [player]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Crater Town:
Vega Pelatih Pemenang: [rival],\l[player]

entries.original: "With your skills you’ll go far!"
entries.translation_source: With your skills you’ll go far!
entries.translated:
Dengan kemampuanmu, kamu akan
melangkah jauh!

entries.original: "It’s over."
entries.translation_source: It’s over.
entries.translated: Sudah berakhir.

entries.original:
"Times have changed since back in my
day."
entries.translation_source: Times have changed since back in my day.
entries.translated:
Zaman telah berubah sejak masa saya
dulu.

entries.original:
"I’d better refine my calculations
for the next time we battle."
entries.translation_source: I’d better refine my calculations for the next time we battle.
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya aku memperbaiki
perhitunganku untuk pertarungan\lberikutnya.

entries.original:
"Of all the battles I’ve partaken
in, one stands out above the rest.

It was a sweltering day, and
my oppenent had just sent out her\lRotom-Fan, holding an Air Balloon.

Up until that point, I had been
barely holding on, but upon seeing\lthat redundant freak of nature, I\lcouldn’t take it anymore.

I fainted in disbelief and lost the
battle.

Never underestimate the power of a
[green]Rotom-Fan [red]holding an [green]Air Balloon[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Of all the battles I’ve partaken in, one stands out above the rest. It was a sweltering day, and my oppenent had just sent out her Rotom-Fan, holding an Air Balloon. Up until that point, I had been barely holding on, but upon seeing that redundant freak of nature, I couldn’t take it anymore. I fainted in disbelief and lost the battle. Never underestimate the power of a [green]Rotom-Fan [red]holding an [green]Air Balloon[red]!
entries.translated:
Dari semua pertarungan yang pernah
saya ikuti, satu pertarungan\lmenonjol di atas yang lain. Itu

adalah hari yang terik, dan lawan
saya baru saja mengeluarkan\lRotom-Fan miliknya, yang memegang

Air Balloon. Sampai saat itu, saya
hampir tidak bertahan, tetapi saat\lmelihat makhluk aneh yang

berlebihan itu, saya tidak tahan
lagi. Saya pingsan karena tidak\lpercaya dan kalah dalam

pertarungan. Jangan pernah
meremehkan kekuatan [green]Rotom-Fan [red]yang\lmemegang [green]Air Balloon[red]!

entries.original: "Friiie!"
entries.translation_source: Friiie!
entries.translated: Friiie!

entries.original: "The [buffer1] ran away."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] ran away.
entries.translated: [buffer1] melarikan diri.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]I can’t control my body!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]I can’t control my body!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Aku tidak bisa mengendalikan
tubuhku!

entries.original: "[red]Return to me."
entries.translation_source: [red]Return to me.
entries.translated: [red]Kembali padaku.

entries.original:
"[red]Now that that’s been taken care of,
I’d better get back to Route 9."
entries.translation_source: [red]Now that that’s been taken care of, I’d better get back to Route 9.
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang setelah itu diurus,
sebaiknya aku kembali ke Route 9.

entries.original:
"If you want to battle me again,
leave and come back inside."
entries.translation_source: If you want to battle me again, leave and come back inside.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin bertarung denganku
lagi, keluar dan masuk lagi.

entries.original: "Pump it!"
entries.translation_source: Pump it!
entries.translated: Pompa!

entries.original:
"There’s so much to buy here! I just
can’t stop shopping!"
entries.translation_source: There’s so much to buy here! I just can’t stop shopping!
entries.translated:
Ada banyak sekali yang bisa dibeli
di sini! Aku tidak bisa berhenti\lberbelanja!

entries.original:
"There are a whole bunch of useful
items for Trainers here!"
entries.translation_source: There are a whole bunch of useful items for Trainers here!
entries.translated:
Ada banyak sekali barang berguna
untuk Pelatih di sini!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Quit fooling yourself.

There’s nothing you can do to make
me let you through."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Quit fooling yourself. There’s nothing you can do to make me let you through.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Berhenti membodohi dirimu
sendiri. Tidak ada yang bisa kamu\llakukan untuk membuatku

membiarkanmu lewat.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue][player], would you like
to do the honours?"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue][player], would you like to do the honours?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue][player], apakah kamu
ingin melakukannya?

entries.original:
"Burglar: [blue]Alright\.

Truth be told, this Ninetales
doesn’t really belong to me\.

I sort of\.uh\.borrowed it! Yeah
that’s right\.for training!

I was just so lonely, that I
figured I’d do that lady a favour.

I was about to head back when\."
entries.translation_source: Burglar: [blue]Alright\. Truth be told, this Ninetales doesn’t really belong to me\. I sort of\.uh\.borrowed it! Yeah that’s right\.for training! I was just so lonely, that I figured I’d do that lady a favour. I was about to head back when\.
entries.translated:
Burglar: [blue]Baiklah\. Sejujurnya,
Ninetales ini bukan milikku\. Aku\lagak\.uh\.meminjamnya! Ya benar\.untuk

pelatihan! Aku sangat kesepian,
jadi aku pikir aku akan membantu\lwanita itu. Aku hendak kembali

ketika\.

entries.original:
"[blue]What was that!

Could it be\.?

No it couldn’t be\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]What was that! Could it be\.? No it couldn’t be\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa itu! Mungkinkah\\.? Tidak, tidak
mungkin\\.

entries.original: "[blue]Oh, it was nothing after all\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh, it was nothing after all\.
entries.translated: [blue]Oh, ternyata tidak ada apa-apa\\.

entries.original: "[blue]Now, as I was saying\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now, as I was saying\.
entries.translated: [blue]Sekarang, seperti yang kukatakan\\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Wahhhh! It’s the monster that
lives in the forest!

[green]The Crabominable Snowman[blue]!

Run for your lives!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Wahhhh! It’s the monster that lives in the forest! [green]The Crabominable Snowman[blue]! Run for your lives!
entries.translated:
[blue]Wahhhh! Itu monster yang tinggal di
hutan! [green]Manusia Salju Crabominable[blue]!\lLari selamatkan diri kalian!

entries.original: "[blue]Oof!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oof!
entries.translated: [blue]Oof!

entries.original:
"Route 17

\al Route 16
\ar Seaport City"
entries.translation_source: Route 17 \al Route 16 \ar Seaport City
entries.translated: Rute 17 \\al Rute 16 \\ar Seaport City

entries.original:
"You’re in for a real shocker, kid.

I’ve just called back all grunts
standing guard at the barrier, so\lnow we’re all over this route!"
entries.translation_source: You’re in for a real shocker, kid. I’ve just called back all grunts standing guard at the barrier, so now we’re all over this route!
entries.translated:
Kamu bakal kaget, nak. Aku baru
saja memanggil kembali semua\lbawahan yang berjaga di penghalang,

jadi sekarang kami tersebar di
seluruh rute ini!

entries.original:
"\.\.

Go away."
entries.translation_source: \.\. Go away.

entries.original:
"I’ll catch something good
eventually. You just go have fun."
entries.translation_source: I’ll catch something good eventually. You just go have fun.
entries.translated:
Aku akan menangkap sesuatu yang
bagus pada akhirnya. Kamu pergi\lsaja bersenang-senang.

entries.original:
"To be honest, I’ve been here for
days too."
entries.translation_source: To be honest, I’ve been here for days too.
entries.translated:
Sejujurnya, aku juga sudah berada
di sini selama berhari-hari.

entries.original:
"Route 5 is at the foot of
Cinder Volcano."
entries.translation_source: Route 5 is at the foot of Cinder Volcano.
entries.translated:
Rute 5 berada di kaki Cinder
Volcano.

entries.original:
"Mutter\.Mutter\.

\.wait for signal\.

Whisper\.Whisper\.

\.asset on lookout\.

Mutter\.Mutter\."
entries.translation_source: Mutter\.Mutter\. \.wait for signal\. Whisper\.Whisper\. \.asset on lookout\. Mutter\.Mutter\.
entries.translated:
Bergumam\\.Bergumam\\. \\.tunggu sinyal\\.
Berbisik\\.Berbisik\\. \\.aset di\lpengintaian\\. Bergumam\\.Bergumam\\.

entries.original: "Crabominable: [green]Crah rah rah rah rah!"
entries.translation_source: Crabominable: [green]Crah rah rah rah rah!
entries.translated: Crabominable: [green]Crah rah rah rah rah!

entries.original: "The air is beautiful, isn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: The air is beautiful, isn’t it?
entries.translated: Udaranya indah, bukan?

entries.original: "One day, I’ll be truly invincible!"
entries.translation_source: One day, I’ll be truly invincible!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, aku akan benar-benar
tak terkalahkan!

entries.original: "I’m not cut out for battling."
entries.translation_source: I’m not cut out for battling.
entries.translated: Aku tidak cocok untuk bertarung.

entries.original:
"[blue]Quick!

Grab him now!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Quick! Grab him now!
entries.translated: [blue]Cepat! Tangkap dia sekarang!

entries.original: "Get lost, punk."
entries.translation_source: Get lost, punk.
entries.translated: Pergi, kurang ajar.

entries.original:
"This ecosystem must maintain a
delicate balance."
entries.translation_source: This ecosystem must maintain a delicate balance.
entries.translated:
Ekosistem ini harus menjaga
keseimbangan yang rapuh.

entries.original: "Please let me stroll peacefully."
entries.translation_source: Please let me stroll peacefully.
entries.translated:
Tolong biarkan aku berjalan-jalan
dengan damai.

entries.original:
"No one is allowed into Tehl Town
right now.

Scram kid!"
entries.translation_source: No one is allowed into Tehl Town right now. Scram kid!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang diizinkan masuk ke
Tehl Town saat ini. Pergi, nak!

entries.original: "Exit A: Frozen Heights"
entries.translation_source: Exit A: Frozen Heights
entries.translated: Keluar A: Frozen Heights

entries.original: "Exit B: Dresco Town"
entries.translation_source: Exit B: Dresco Town
entries.translated: Keluar B: Dresco Town

entries.original: "Exit D: Blizzard City"
entries.translation_source: Exit D: Blizzard City
entries.translated: Keluar D: Blizzard City

entries.original: "Exit E: Tehl Town"
entries.translation_source: Exit E: Tehl Town
entries.translated: Keluar E: Tehl Town

entries.original: "Exit F: Fallshore City"
entries.translation_source: Exit F: Fallshore City
entries.translated: Keluar F: Fallshore City

entries.original:
"\al Blizzard City
\au Frozen Heights"
entries.translation_source: \al Blizzard City \au Frozen Heights
entries.translated: \al Blizzard City \au Frozen Heights

entries.original: "\ar Dresco Town"
entries.translation_source: \ar Dresco Town
entries.translated: \ar Dresco Town

entries.original:
"Hi there! If you can beat me, I’ll
heal your Pokémon for free!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there! If you can beat me, I’ll heal your Pokémon for free!
entries.translated:
Halo! Jika kamu bisa mengalahkanku,
aku akan menyembuhkan Pokémon-mu\lgratis!

entries.original: "Time to heal up!"
entries.translation_source: Time to heal up!
entries.translated: Saatnya memulihkan diri!

entries.original:
"Technology is incredible!

You can now play GBA ROMs
on your phone and computer!"
entries.translation_source: Technology is incredible! You can now play GBA ROMs on your phone and computer!
entries.translated:
Teknologi luar biasa! Kamu sekarang
bisa memainkan ROM GBA di ponsel\ldan komputermu!

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough room in
your party."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough room in your party.
entries.translated: Tidak ada cukup ruang di timmu.

entries.original:
"Have you checked out the local
facilities?

The Pokémon Centre heals your
Pokémon for free.

The Poké Mart provides useful
items for trainers."
entries.translation_source: Have you checked out the local facilities? The Pokémon Centre heals your Pokémon for free. The Poké Mart provides useful items for trainers.
entries.translated:
Sudahkah kamu memeriksa fasilitas
lokal? Pusat Pokémon menyembuhkan\lPokémon-mu secara gratis. Poké Mart

menyediakan barang-barang berguna
untuk para pelatih.

entries.original: "I’m on duty, go away."
entries.translation_source: I’m on duty, go away.
entries.translated: Aku lagi tugas, pergi.

entries.original:
"Being nestled in the mountains, our
town is fairly quiet.

Even so, our police officer still
takes his job pretty seriously."
entries.translation_source: Being nestled in the mountains, our town is fairly quiet. Even so, our police officer still takes his job pretty seriously.
entries.translated:
Terletak di pegunungan, kota kami
cukup tenang. Meski begitu, petugas\lpolisi kami masih menjalankan

tugasnya dengan cukup serius.

entries.original:
"Burglar: [blue]That monster was
terrifying!

We must’ve woken it up during our
battle.

\.

So I uh\.guess I’m done training
this Ninetales now\.

It’s time for me to return her to
her owner."
entries.translation_source: Burglar: [blue]That monster was terrifying! We must’ve woken it up during our battle. \. So I uh\.guess I’m done training this Ninetales now\. It’s time for me to return her to her owner.
entries.translated:
Pencuri: [blue]Monster itu sangat
menakutkan! Pasti kami\lmembangunkannya selama pertarungan

kami. \. Jadi aku uh\.kurasa aku
selesai melatih Ninetales ini\lsekarang\. Saatnya aku

mengembalikannya kepada pemiliknya.

entries.original:
"[green]Alice[blue], the Gym Leader, likes to use
[green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon.

I know, it’s not what you’d expect
from a Gym up here."
entries.translation_source: [green]Alice[blue], the Gym Leader, likes to use [green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon. I know, it’s not what you’d expect from a Gym up here.
entries.translated:
[green]Alice[blue], Pemimpin Gym, suka
menggunakan Pokémon tipe [green]Terbang[blue].\lAku tahu, itu bukan yang kau

harapkan dari sebuah Gym di sini.

entries.original: "How is my old Pokémon doing?"
entries.translation_source: How is my old Pokémon doing?
entries.translated: Bagaimana kabar Pokémon lamaku?

entries.original:
"Hello there.

By any chance would you like to
have a Riolu?

I hatched it from an egg and have
nothing to do with it."
entries.translation_source: Hello there. By any chance would you like to have a Riolu? I hatched it from an egg and have nothing to do with it.
entries.translated:
Halo. Apakah kamu kebetulan ingin
memiliki Riolu? Aku menetaskannya\ldari telur dan tidak ada yang bisa

kulakukan dengannya.

entries.original:
"Please take care of my dear
Riolu."
entries.translation_source: Please take care of my dear Riolu.
entries.translated: Tolong jaga Riolu kesayanganku.

entries.original: "You don’t have to take it..."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have to take it...
entries.translated: Kamu tidak perlu mengambilnya...

entries.original:
"How’z it hangin’ down there?

I say down there, ’cause I’m all
the way up in the clouds!"
entries.translation_source: How’z it hangin’ down there? I say down there, ’cause I’m all the way up in the clouds!
entries.translated:
Gimana kabarmu di bawah sana? Aku
bilang di bawah sana, karena aku\ljauh di atas awan!

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

I heard from your mother that
you’re finally leaving town!

This is very exciting news!

You can finally follow in your
father’s footsteps and become a\lgreat Pokémon trainer!

Who knows? Perhaps you may even
come to command the great Arceus,\ljust as he did\.

The road to that point will be long
and arduous, but I have faith that\lyou can, and will make it there!

Take this item to help you on your
journey.

It is a rare gemstone that can
power up a single attack in battle.

Use it wisely."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player]! I heard from your mother that you’re finally leaving town! This is very exciting news! You can finally follow in your father’s footsteps and become a great Pokémon trainer! Who knows? Perhaps you may even come to command the great Arceus, just as he did\. The road to that point will be long and arduous, but I have faith that you can, and will make it there! Take this item to help you on your journey. It is a rare gemstone that can power up a single attack in battle. Use it wisely.
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, [player]! Aku dengar dari
ibumu bahwa kamu akhirnya\lmeninggalkan kota! Ini kabar yang

sangat menggembirakan! Kamu
akhirnya bisa mengikuti jejak\layahmu dan menjadi pelatih Pokémon

hebat! Siapa tahu? Mungkin kamu
bahkan bisa memerintah Arceus yang\lagung, seperti yang dia lakukan\.

Jalan menuju titik itu akan panjang
dan sulit, tapi aku percaya kamu\lbisa dan akan sampai di sana! Ambil

barang ini untuk membantu
perjalananmu. Ini adalah batu\lpermata langka yang dapat

meningkatkan satu serangan dalam
pertempuran. Gunakan dengan bijak.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

How is your journey going?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player]! How is your journey going?
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, [player]! Bagaimana
perjalananmu?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

It appears that you have no space
for my gift."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. It appears that you have no space for my gift.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Sepertinya kamu tidak memiliki
ruang untuk hadiahku.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I heard a special package
arrived today.

I want to buy it from you."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]I heard a special package arrived today. I want to buy it from you.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Aku dengar ada paket khusus
yang tiba hari ini. Aku ingin\lmembelinya darimu.

entries.original:
"Stop!

Where do you think you’re going?

If you think you’re ready to handle
Icicle Cave, prove it to me by\ldelivering [green]Log’s package [blue]to him."
entries.translation_source: Stop! Where do you think you’re going? If you think you’re ready to handle Icicle Cave, prove it to me by delivering [green]Log’s package [blue]to him.
entries.translated:
Berhenti! Kau pikir mau ke mana?
Jika kau pikir kau siap menghadapi\lGua Icicle, buktikan padaku dengan

mengantarkan [green]paket Log [blue]kepadanya.

entries.original:
"I [green]chain[blue] my fishing so I can see
[green]Shiny[blue] Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I [green]chain[blue] my fishing so I can see [green]Shiny[blue] Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku [green]merantai [blue]pancinganku agar bisa
melihat Pokémon [green]Shiny[blue].

entries.original:
"Hello there stranger!

Be careful when travelling through
Icicle Cave.

It may not seem that big, but it is
bigger than you would think!"
entries.translation_source: Hello there stranger! Be careful when travelling through Icicle Cave. It may not seem that big, but it is bigger than you would think!
entries.translated:
Halo, orang asing! Hati-hati saat
bepergian melalui Gua Icicle.\lMungkin tidak terlihat sebesar itu,

tapi lebih besar dari yang kamu
kira!

entries.original:
"I’m going to make my Rattata even
stronger!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to make my Rattata even stronger!
entries.translated:
Aku akan membuat Rattata-ku menjadi
lebih kuat!

entries.original:
"When Pokémon evolve, they get
stronger.

But there is a benefit for not
evolving your Pokémon right away.

Pokémon that can still evolve can
utilise an [green]Eviolite[blue] to become\ltougher to beat in battle.

I have an extra, so why don’t you
take one?"
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon evolve, they get stronger. But there is a benefit for not evolving your Pokémon right away. Pokémon that can still evolve can utilise an [green]Eviolite[blue] to become tougher to beat in battle. I have an extra, so why don’t you take one?
entries.translated:
Saat Pokémon berevolusi, mereka
menjadi lebih kuat. Tapi ada\lkeuntungan jika tidak langsung

mengevolusi Pokémon-mu. Pokémon
yang masih bisa berevolusi dapat\lmenggunakan [green]Eviolite[blue] untuk menjadi

lebih sulit dikalahkan dalam
pertempuran. Aku punya cadangan,\ljadi kenapa kamu tidak mengambil

satu?

entries.original:
"Have a Pokémon that can still
evolve hold an [green]Eviolite[blue] in battle\lto double its defenses."
entries.translation_source: Have a Pokémon that can still evolve hold an [green]Eviolite[blue] in battle to double its defenses.
entries.translated:
Mintalah Pokémon yang masih bisa
berevolusi untuk memegang [green]Eviolite[blue]\ldalam pertempuran untuk

menggandakan pertahanannya.

entries.original:
"Where the wind is ice cold, so are
my hands.

Would you like me to teach one of
your Pokémon [green]Ice Punch[blue]?

I require [green]2 [buffer1]s[blue] to share
my frosty hands."
entries.translation_source: Where the wind is ice cold, so are my hands. Would you like me to teach one of your Pokémon [green]Ice Punch[blue]? I require [green]2 [buffer1]s[blue] to share my frosty hands.
entries.translated:
Di mana angin sedingin es, begitu
pula tanganku. Apakah kamu ingin\laku mengajari salah satu Pokémon-mu

[green]Ice Punch[blue]? Aku membutuhkan [green]2
[buffer1]s[blue] untuk berbagi tangan\ldinginku.

entries.original:
"Clerk: [blue]I’m sorry sir, I can’t do
that.

That package belongs to someone
already."
entries.translation_source: Clerk: [blue]I’m sorry sir, I can’t do that. That package belongs to someone already.
entries.translated:
Petugas: [blue]Maaf Pak, saya tidak bisa
melakukan itu. Paket itu sudah\lmilik seseorang.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Maybe you misheard me."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Maybe you misheard me.
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Mungkin kamu salah dengar.

entries.original:
"[blue]Give me that package!

I won’t ask again."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Give me that package! I won’t ask again.
entries.translated:
[blue]Berikan aku paket itu! Aku tidak
akan bertanya lagi.

entries.original:
"Clerk: [blue]I really can’t, sir!

As a faithful employee of Poké
Mart, it goes against what I stand\lfor to give you that package!"
entries.translation_source: Clerk: [blue]I really can’t, sir! As a faithful employee of Poké Mart, it goes against what I stand for to give you that package!
entries.translated:
Petugas: [blue]Benar-benar tidak bisa,
Pak! Sebagai karyawan setia Poké\lMart, memberikan paket itu

bertentangan dengan prinsip saya!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I see.

Well, then\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]I see. Well, then\.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Begitu. Baiklah, kalau
begitu\.

entries.original:
"[blue][buffer1]!

Grab that package!"
entries.translation_source: [blue][buffer1]! Grab that package!
entries.translated: [blue][buffer1]! Ambil paket itu!

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Good work, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Good work, [buffer1].
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Kerja bagus, [buffer1].

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon would like to have
their hands frozen with [green]Ice Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon would like to have their hands frozen with [green]Ice Punch[blue]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang ingin tangannya
dibekukan dengan [green]Pukulan Es[blue]?

entries.original:
"My hands shall remain cold for
all eternity."
entries.translation_source: My hands shall remain cold for all eternity.
entries.translated:
Tanganku akan tetap dingin untuk
selamanya.

entries.original:
"You do not have enough
[green][buffer1]s[blue].

I cannot share my frosty hands with
you for nothing\."
entries.translation_source: You do not have enough [green][buffer1]s[blue]. I cannot share my frosty hands with you for nothing\.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup [green][buffer1][blue].
Aku tidak bisa membagikan tanganku\lyang dingin ini kepadamu dengan

cuma-cuma\.

entries.original:
"That TM I gave you contains
[green]Aurora Veil[blue].

It has an effect similar to both
Reflect and Light Screen combined.

The only catch is that it can only
be used in Hail weather."
entries.translation_source: That TM I gave you contains [green]Aurora Veil[blue]. It has an effect similar to both Reflect and Light Screen combined. The only catch is that it can only be used in Hail weather.
entries.translated:
TM yang kuberikan padamu berisi
[green]Tirai Aurora[blue]. Efeknya mirip dengan\lgabungan Refleksi dan Layar Cahaya.

Satu-satunya syarat adalah hanya
bisa digunakan saat cuaca Hujan Es.

entries.original:
"ined.

The only catch is that it can only
be used in Hail weather."
entries.translation_source: ined. The only catch is that it can only be used in Hail weather.
entries.translated:
ined. Satu-satunya syarat adalah
hanya bisa digunakan saat cuaca\lHujan Es.

entries.original: "Your loss, pal."
entries.translation_source: Your loss, pal.
entries.translated: Rugi sendiri, sobat.

entries.original:
"My brother!

Please help me!

I was babysitting him when he ran
away down the mountain!

Please, help me find him!"
entries.translation_source: My brother! Please help me! I was babysitting him when he ran away down the mountain! Please, help me find him!
entries.translated:
Adikku! Tolong aku! Aku sedang
menjaga dia ketika dia lari ke\lbawah gunung! Tolong, bantu aku

menemukannya!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue][player]!

I flew here as soon as the barrier
went down.

What happened?

\.

So The Shadows got away again\."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue][player]! I flew here as soon as the barrier went down. What happened? \. So The Shadows got away again\.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue][player]! Aku terbang ke sini
begitu penghalangnya turun. Apa\lyang terjadi? \. Jadi The Shadows

lolos lagi\.

entries.original: "[green]Moo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Moo!
entries.translated: [green]Moo!

entries.original: "Break Room"
entries.translation_source: Break Room
entries.translated: Ruang Istirahat

entries.original:
"Fallshore City is home of the
[green]Inverse Battle House[blue] and the\l[green]Mission HQ[blue].

Isn’t that neat?
It’s so cool to live here!"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City is home of the [green]Inverse Battle House[blue] and the [green]Mission HQ[blue]. Isn’t that neat? It’s so cool to live here!
entries.translated:
Fallshore City adalah rumah dari
[green]Inverse Battle House[blue] dan [green]Markas\lMisi[blue]. Bukankah itu keren? Sangat

keren tinggal di sini!

entries.original: "Go away."
entries.translation_source: Go away.
entries.translated: Pergi.

entries.original:
"Huah, fellow trainer!

I am training my body and soul by
staring at this tree intently!

You too, can train, with this!"
entries.translation_source: Huah, fellow trainer! I am training my body and soul by staring at this tree intently! You too, can train, with this!
entries.translated:
Huah, sesama pelatih! Aku melatih
tubuh dan jiwaku dengan menatap\lpohon ini dengan saksama! Kamu juga

bisa berlatih, dengan ini!

entries.original:
"One day, I will be the most
focused trainer."
entries.translation_source: One day, I will be the most focused trainer.
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, aku akan menjadi
pelatih paling fokus.

entries.original: "Please come again!"
entries.translation_source: Please come again!
entries.translated: Silakan datang lagi!

entries.original:
"Only the uncool kids actually go
to school\."
entries.translation_source: Only the uncool kids actually go to school\.
entries.translated:
Hanya anak-anak yang tidak keren
yang benar-benar pergi ke sekolah\.

entries.original:
"Hmm...
I wonder how to get that item?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm... I wonder how to get that item?
entries.translated:
Hmm... Aku penasaran bagaimana cara
mendapatkan item itu?

entries.original:
"Wow! You managed to get that item!
Good job!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! You managed to get that item! Good job!
entries.translated:
Wow! Kamu berhasil mendapatkan item
itu! Kerja bagus!

entries.original:
"I can’t thank you enough!

My brother’s small so he can’t have
gone far.

My bet is he’s somewhere on
[green]Route 8[red] right about now.

And last I saw, he was wearing his
favourite [green]Pikachu costume[red]."
entries.translation_source: I can’t thank you enough! My brother’s small so he can’t have gone far. My bet is he’s somewhere on [green]Route 8[red] right about now. And last I saw, he was wearing his favourite [green]Pikachu costume[red].
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa cukup berterima
kasih! Adikku kecil jadi dia pasti\lbelum pergi jauh. Taruhanku dia ada

di suatu tempat di [green]Rute 8[red] sekarang.
Dan terakhir kulihat, dia memakai\l[green]kostum Pikachu[red] kesayangannya.

entries.original: "My parents are going to kill me!"
entries.translation_source: My parents are going to kill me!
entries.translated: Orang tuaku akan membunuhku!

entries.original:
"My brother told me all about his
journey back up here!

You’re amazing!"
entries.translation_source: My brother told me all about his journey back up here! You’re amazing!
entries.translated:
Kakakku bercerita semua tentang
perjalanannya kembali ke sini! Kamu\lluar biasa!

entries.original:
"That TM is my thanks for your help!
It contains [green]Return[red]!

It’s a move that gets stronger the
more your Pokémon likes you.

It’s the perfect TM for such a nice
person like you!"
entries.translation_source: That TM is my thanks for your help! It contains [green]Return[red]! It’s a move that gets stronger the more your Pokémon likes you. It’s the perfect TM for such a nice person like you!
entries.translated:
TM itu adalah ucapan terima kasihku
atas bantuanmu! Isinya [green]Return[red]! Itu\ladalah jurus yang semakin kuat

semakin Pokémonmu menyukaimu. TM
yang sempurna untuk orang baik\lsepertimu!

entries.original:
"It’s the amazing person who saved
my brother!

Thank you again!"
entries.translation_source: It’s the amazing person who saved my brother! Thank you again!
entries.translated:
Ini dia orang luar biasa yang
menyelamatkan kakakku! Terima kasih\llagi!

entries.original:
"Ahhh!
Please don’t eat me!"
entries.translation_source: Ahhh! Please don’t eat me!
entries.translated: Ahhh! Tolong jangan makan aku!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

You’re not a Pokémon.

I thought a Pokémon was going to
eat me."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. You’re not a Pokémon. I thought a Pokémon was going to eat me.
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Kamu bukan Pokémon. Kupikir
ada Pokémon yang akan memakanku.

entries.original:
"I will keep running and enduring
the pain."
entries.translation_source: I will keep running and enduring the pain.
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus berlari dan menahan
rasa sakit.

entries.original:
"An obnoxiously loud episode of a
Unova Pokémon Musical is on.

Watch for too long and it might
fry your brain."
entries.translation_source: An obnoxiously loud episode of a Unova Pokémon Musical is on. Watch for too long and it might fry your brain.
entries.translated:
Sebuah episode yang sangat berisik
dari Pokémon Musical Unova sedang\lditayangkan. Terlalu lama

menontonnya bisa menggoreng otakmu.

entries.original:
"Don’t you wish you could just a
break from life sometimes?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you wish you could just a break from life sometimes?
entries.translated:
Tidakkah kamu kadang ingin
istirahat dari kehidupan?

entries.original:
"I’m in the process of creating a
masterpiece."
entries.translation_source: I’m in the process of creating a masterpiece.
entries.translated:
Aku sedang dalam proses menciptakan
sebuah mahakarya.

entries.original:
"I love evolutions of starters from
other regions!"
entries.translation_source: I love evolutions of starters from other regions!
entries.translated:
Aku suka evolusi starter dari
region lain!

entries.original:
"Well, then, I won’t stand in your
way anymore."
entries.translation_source: Well, then, I won’t stand in your way anymore.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kalau begitu, aku tidak
akan menghalangimu lagi.

entries.original:
"I want to go home.

I ran away from my mean sister, but
I really miss her now\."
entries.translation_source: I want to go home. I ran away from my mean sister, but I really miss her now\.
entries.translated:
Aku ingin pulang. Aku kabur dari
kakak perempuanku yang jahat, tapi\lsekarang aku sangat merindukannya\.

entries.original:
"Please, take me back up to
[green]Blizzard City[blue].

I’ll follow you there."
entries.translation_source: Please, take me back up to [green]Blizzard City[blue]. I’ll follow you there.
entries.translated:
Tolong, bawa aku kembali ke
[green]Blizzard City[blue]. Aku akan mengikutimu\lke sana.

entries.original:
"You see those rocks on the wall?

If you have a Pokémon that knows
[green]Rock Climb[blue], you can cruise up ’em!"
entries.translation_source: You see those rocks on the wall? If you have a Pokémon that knows [green]Rock Climb[blue], you can cruise up ’em!
entries.translated:
Kamu lihat batu-batu di dinding
itu? Jika kamu punya Pokémon yang\lbisa [green]Rock Climb[blue], kamu bisa naik

dengan mudah!

entries.original:
"I like pretending I’m meant for
something greater than just standing\lhere in this cave."
entries.translation_source: I like pretending I’m meant for something greater than just standing here in this cave.
entries.translated:
Aku suka berpura-pura bahwa aku
ditakdirkan untuk sesuatu yang\llebih besar daripada hanya berdiri

di sini di gua ini.

entries.original:
"This cave is pretty small,
isn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: This cave is pretty small, isn’t it?
entries.translated: Gua ini cukup kecil, bukan?

entries.original: "Fallshore City"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City
entries.translated: Fallshore City

entries.original: "Would you look at that..."
entries.translation_source: Would you look at that...
entries.translated: Coba lihat itu...

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]You both are really
starting to get on my nerves!

Inkay!

Show [buffer1] why you don’t mess
with [black]The Shadows[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]You both are really starting to get on my nerves! Inkay! Show [buffer1] why you don’t mess with [black]The Shadows[blue]!
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Kalian berdua benar-benar
mulai membuatku kesal! Inkay!\lTunjukkan pada [buffer1] kenapa

kalian tidak boleh main-main dengan
[black]The Shadows[blue]!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Not bad, [player]!
You showed him!

I’ll take it from here.

Use this Potion on your Pokémon
to heal it in the meantime."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Not bad, [player]! You showed him! I’ll take it from here. Use this Potion on your Pokémon to heal it in the meantime.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Tidak buruk, [player]!
Kamu berhasil mengalahkannya!\lBiarkan aku yang menangani

selanjutnya. Gunakan Potion ini
pada Pokémonmu untuk\lmenyembuhkannya sementara.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]That’s a letdown.

I really thought you’d be able to
handle him.

I guess I’ll deal with him myself.

Use this Potion on your Pokémon
to make it feel better."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]That’s a letdown. I really thought you’d be able to handle him. I guess I’ll deal with him myself. Use this Potion on your Pokémon to make it feel better.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Itu mengecewakan. Aku
benar-benar mengira kau bisa\lmenghadapinya. Sepertinya aku akan

menanganinya sendiri. Gunakan
Potion ini pada Pokémonmu untuk\lmembuatnya merasa lebih baik.

entries.original:
"[blue]Fine, then.
I’ll do it myself."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Fine, then. I’ll do it myself.
entries.translated:
[blue]Baiklah, kalau begitu. Aku akan
melakukannya sendiri.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]No!
My Inkay!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]No! My Inkay!
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Tidak! Inkay-ku!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue][buffer1]!
Move in and strike!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue][buffer1]! Move in and strike!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue][buffer1]! Maju dan
serang!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Alright, alright, I give up!
I’ll let you through!

Please have mercy on me!
Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Alright, alright, I give up! I’ll let you through! Please have mercy on me! Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Baik, baik, aku menyerah!
Aku akan membiarkanmu lewat! Tolong\lkasihanilah aku! Jangan sakiti aku

lagi! Tolong!

entries.original: "[blue][buffer1]! Return!"
entries.translation_source: [blue][buffer1]! Return!
entries.translated: [blue][buffer1]! Kembali!

entries.original:
"[blue]I’m getting out of here now,
[player].

I’m sure you’re capable of taking
care of yourself from here on out.

If you run into any trouble, just
use your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I’m getting out of here now, [player]. I’m sure you’re capable of taking care of yourself from here on out. If you run into any trouble, just use your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku akan pergi dari sini sekarang,
[player]. Aku yakin kau mampu\lmengurus dirimu sendiri mulai

sekarang. Jika kau menemui masalah,
gunakan saja Pokémonmu.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You impressed me earlier, and I
want to see how I’ll fare against\lyou.

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You impressed me earlier, and I want to see how I’ll fare against you. Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, satu hal lagi. Segera setelah
kau sampai di rumah, kita akan\lbertarung. Kau membuatku terkesan

sebelumnya, dan aku ingin melihat
bagaimana aku melawanmu. Sampai\lsaat itu, jangan terlalu memforsir

dirimu.

entries.original: "Missions Completed: [green][buffer3]"
entries.translation_source: Missions Completed: [green][buffer3]
entries.translated: Misi Selesai: [green][buffer3]

entries.original:
"I wish we had our own Pokémon.

I’m always so bored at home."
entries.translation_source: I wish we had our own Pokémon. I’m always so bored at home.
entries.translated:
Aku berharap kita memiliki Pokémon
sendiri. Aku selalu sangat bosan di\lrumah.

entries.original:
"Wahh!

That Pokémon hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: Wahh! That Pokémon hurt me!
entries.translated: Wahh! Pokémon itu menyakitiku!

entries.original: "Sandslash: [green]Slash!"
entries.translation_source: Sandslash: [green]Slash!
entries.translated: Sandslash: [green]Slash!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon appears to be heading
towards [green]Icicle Cave."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon appears to be heading towards [green]Icicle Cave.
entries.translated:
Pokémon itu tampaknya menuju ke
[green]Icicle Cave.

entries.original:
"Hi [player]!

How are you?

I was just cooking some food for my
family."
entries.translation_source: Hi [player]! How are you? I was just cooking some food for my family.
entries.translated:
Hai [player]! Apa kabar? Aku baru
saja memasak makanan untuk\lkeluargaku.

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Ice Pokémon, Articuno.

It says here that Articuno was once
used as a herald to a great\ldarkness, but now it resides near\lFrozen Heights."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Ice Pokémon, Articuno. It says here that Articuno was once used as a herald to a great darkness, but now it resides near Frozen Heights.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah patung dari Pokémon Es
Legendaris, Articuno. Tertulis di\lsini bahwa Articuno pernah

digunakan sebagai pembawa kegelapan
besar, tetapi sekarang ia tinggal\ldi dekat Frozen Heights.

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Electric Pokémon, Zapdos.

It says here that Zapdos was once
used as a herald to a great\ldarkness, but now it resides in\lThundercap Mountain."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Electric Pokémon, Zapdos. It says here that Zapdos was once used as a herald to a great darkness, but now it resides in Thundercap Mountain.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah patung dari Pokémon
Listrik Legendaris, Zapdos.\lTertulis di sini bahwa Zapdos

pernah digunakan sebagai pembawa
kegelapan besar, tetapi sekarang ia\ltinggal di Thundercap Mountain.

entries.original:
"I know, right?
Life is so stressful sometimes!"
entries.translation_source: I know, right? Life is so stressful sometimes!
entries.translated:
Aku tahu, kan? Hidup kadang sangat
stres!

entries.original:
"Route 13

\au Route 4, Cinder Volcano,
Grim Woods\l\ad Route 14\l\ar Dehara City"
entries.translation_source: Route 13 \au Route 4, Cinder Volcano, Grim Woods \ad Route 14 \ar Dehara City
entries.translated:
Rute 13 \au Rute 4, Gunung Berapi
Cinder, Hutan Grim \ad Rute 14 \ar Kota\lDehara

entries.original:
"You’re in for a fun time here.

This place is like a maze."
entries.translation_source: You’re in for a fun time here. This place is like a maze.
entries.translated:
Kau akan bersenang-senang di sini.
Tempat ini seperti labirin.

entries.original:
"Sorry!
I was possessed!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry! I was possessed!
entries.translated: Maaf! Aku kerasukan!

entries.original:
"Whew...
I made it out of Dark Forest okay.\lI even managed to catch some creepy\lPokémon in there also!"
entries.translation_source: Whew... I made it out of Dark Forest okay. I even managed to catch some creepy Pokémon in there also!
entries.translated:
Whew... Aku berhasil keluar dari
Hutan Gelap dengan selamat. Aku\lbahkan berhasil menangkap beberapa

Pokémon menyeramkan di sana juga!

entries.original:
"[blue]Sniff\.

I know the way home from here.

I had fun walking with you!
You’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Sniff\. I know the way home from here. I had fun walking with you! You’re the best!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hiks\. Aku tahu jalan pulang dari
sini. Aku senang berjalan denganmu!\lKamu yang terbaik!

entries.original:
"[blue]Sniff\.

I don’t think this is the right way
home\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Sniff\. I don’t think this is the right way home\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Hiks\. Aku rasa ini bukan jalan
pulang yang benar\.

entries.original:
"\qoWho builds a city on top of a
frozen mountain?\qc-you may be\lwondering.

Well, about 20 years ago, a bunch
of Bird Keepers got together and\ldecided they wanted a nice high\lplace for their Pokémon to train.

With the help of this dude named
[green]Aros[blue] and his Arceus, they built\lthis city in under a year!

It amazes me what great things
people and Pokémon can accomplish\lby working together.

Say\.

Your face reminds me of him a
little\."
entries.translation_source: \qoWho builds a city on top of a frozen mountain?\qc-you may be wondering. Well, about 20 years ago, a bunch of Bird Keepers got together and decided they wanted a nice high place for their Pokémon to train. With the help of this dude named [green]Aros[blue] and his Arceus, they built this city in under a year! It amazes me what great things people and Pokémon can accomplish by working together. Say\. Your face reminds me of him a little\.
entries.translated:
\qoSiapa yang membangun kota di atas
gunung beku?\qc-mungkin kamu\lbertanya-tanya. Nah, sekitar 20

tahun lalu, sekelompok Bird Keeper
berkumpul dan memutuskan mereka\lingin tempat tinggi yang bagus

untuk melatih Pokémon mereka.
Dengan bantuan pria bernama [green]Aros[blue]\ldan Arceus-nya, mereka membangun

kota ini dalam waktu kurang dari
setahun! Sungguh menakjubkan\lhal-hal hebat yang bisa dicapai

manusia dan Pokémon dengan bekerja
sama. Ngomong-ngomong\. Wajahmu\lsedikit mengingatkanku padanya\.

entries.original: "I’ve been expecting you\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been expecting you\.
entries.translated: Aku sudah menunggumu\.

entries.original:
"You don’t?
Well I do."
entries.translation_source: You don’t? Well I do.
entries.translated: Kamu tidak? Yah, aku punya.

entries.original:
"Excuse me, trainer, would you be
able to lend me a hand please?

You see, my family and I are having
a big feast soon, and we need lots\lof honey for our meal.

I’ve already collected seven jars,
but I need at least three more.

I heard they could be found on wild
Combee, but I’m not having much\lluck catching them.

So how about it?

Are you able to catch three Combee
and give me their honey please?"
entries.translation_source: Excuse me, trainer, would you be able to lend me a hand please? You see, my family and I are having a big feast soon, and we need lots of honey for our meal. I’ve already collected seven jars, but I need at least three more. I heard they could be found on wild Combee, but I’m not having much luck catching them. So how about it? Are you able to catch three Combee and give me their honey please?
entries.translated:
Permisi, trainer, bisakah kamu
membantu saya? Begini, saya dan\lkeluarga saya akan mengadakan pesta

besar sebentar lagi, dan kami
membutuhkan banyak madu untuk\lhidangan kami. Saya sudah

mengumpulkan tujuh stoples, tapi
saya butuh setidaknya tiga lagi.\lSaya dengar madu bisa ditemukan di

Combee liar, tapi saya belum
beruntung menangkapnya. Jadi\lbagaimana? Bisakah kamu menangkap

tiga Combee dan memberikan madu
mereka kepada saya?

entries.original:
"That’s too bad.

I’ll have to keep looking myself
then."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad. I’ll have to keep looking myself then.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali. Aku harus terus
mencariku sendiri kalau begitu.

entries.original:
"Great!
Thanks for agreeing to help!

Combee can be found all over Flower
Paradise, however they are more\llikely to appear in the [green]blue\lflowers[red].

And remember, I need at least [green]3
Honey[red] jars."
entries.translation_source: Great! Thanks for agreeing to help! Combee can be found all over Flower Paradise, however they are more likely to appear in the [green]blue flowers[red]. And remember, I need at least [green]3 Honey[red] jars.
entries.translated:
Bagus! Terima kasih sudah setuju
membantu! Combee dapat ditemukan di\lseluruh Flower Paradise, namun

mereka lebih mungkin muncul di
[green]bunga biru[red]. Dan ingat, saya butuh\lsetidaknya [green]3 Madu[red] stoples.

entries.original:
"You got them! Thank you so much!
Let me take them off your hands."
entries.translation_source: You got them! Thank you so much! Let me take them off your hands.
entries.translated:
Kamu mendapatkannya! Terima kasih
banyak! Biarkan saya mengambilnya\ldarimu.

entries.original: "The lady took 3 Honeys."
entries.translation_source: The lady took 3 Honeys.
entries.translated: Wanita itu mengambil 3 Madu.

entries.original:
"For helping me out, please take
this TM as a reward. I insist!"
entries.translation_source: For helping me out, please take this TM as a reward. I insist!
entries.translated:
Sebagai bantuanmu, tolong ambil TM
ini sebagai hadiah. Aku bersikeras!

entries.original:
"What the\.

How’d you get onto Route 9?

However it was, you’re still not
getting through here."
entries.translation_source: What the\. How’d you get onto Route 9? However it was, you’re still not getting through here.
entries.translated:
Apa apaan\. Bagaimana kamu bisa
sampai ke Route 9? Bagaimanapun\lcaranya, kamu tetap tidak bisa

melewati sini.

entries.original: "[green]Slash!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Slash!
entries.translated: [green]Tebasan!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]I’m sorry, but unfortunately
I won’t be able to do that.

It is too vital to our plans.

And besides, I wouldn’t belittle
myself to listen to someone of the\llikes of you."
