entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]I’m sorry, but unfortunately I won’t be able to do that. It is too vital to our plans. And besides, I wouldn’t belittle myself to listen to someone of the likes of you.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Maaf, tapi sayangnya aku
tidak bisa melakukan itu. Itu\lterlalu penting bagi rencana kami.

Lagipula, aku tidak akan
merendahkan diriku untuk\lmendengarkan seseorang sepertimu.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]I’m not letting you leave
until that Pokémon is free.

Prepare for a battle!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]I’m not letting you leave until that Pokémon is free. Prepare for a battle!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu
pergi sampai Pokémon itu bebas.\lBersiaplah untuk bertarung!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]All right, then.

I’ll indulge your little request.

But know, when you lose, I’ll have
my Pokémon incinerate you!

Go! Incine..."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]All right, then. I’ll indulge your little request. But know, when you lose, I’ll have my Pokémon incinerate you! Go! Incine...
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Baiklah, kalau begitu. Aku
akan memenuhi permintaan kecilmu.\lTapi ketahuilah, saat kamu kalah,

aku akan menyuruh Pokémonku
membakarmu! Keluar! Incine...

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Ivory! Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Ivory! Wait!
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Ivory! Tunggu!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Ivory!

You don’t have time to fight this
trainer right now.

We have a tight schedule to keep.

Get going, I’ll hold him at bay
while you escape."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Ivory! You don’t have time to fight this trainer right now. We have a tight schedule to keep. Get going, I’ll hold him at bay while you escape.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Ivory! Kamu tidak punya
waktu untuk bertarung dengan\ltrainer ini sekarang. Kita punya

jadwal yang ketat. Pergilah, aku
akan menahannya sementara kamu\lmelarikan diri.

entries.original: "Ivory: [red]Let’s go, Shadow Warriors."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Let’s go, Shadow Warriors.
entries.translated: Ivory: [red]Ayo pergi, Shadow Warriors.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Drat...

They escaped with Moltres..."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Drat... They escaped with Moltres...
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Sial... Mereka kabur dengan
Moltres...

entries.original:
"[blue]Staraptor.

Let’s cut them off at the exit."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Staraptor. Let’s cut them off at the exit.
entries.translated:
[blue]Staraptor. Ayo kita potong jalan
mereka di pintu keluar.

entries.original:
"Ç
Oh\.

You’re [player] right?

I’ve heard about you from [rival].

It’s nothing personal, but try not
to get in his way.

He doesn’t have time to deal with
you."
entries.translation_source: Ç Oh\. You’re [player] right? I’ve heard about you from [rival]. It’s nothing personal, but try not to get in his way. He doesn’t have time to deal with you.
entries.translated:
Ç Oh\. Kamu [player] kan? Aku sudah
dengar tentangmu dari [rival]. Ini\lbukan masalah pribadi, tapi cobalah

jangan menghalangi jalannya. Dia
tidak punya waktu untuk berurusan\ldenganmu.

entries.original:
"Oh\.

You’re [player] right?

I’ve heard about you from [rival].

It’s nothing personal, but try not
to get in his way.

He doesn’t have time to deal with
you."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. You’re [player] right? I’ve heard about you from [rival]. It’s nothing personal, but try not to get in his way. He doesn’t have time to deal with you.
entries.translated:
Oh\. Kamu [player] kan? Aku sudah
dengar tentangmu dari [rival]. Ini\lbukan masalah pribadi, tapi cobalah

jangan menghalangi jalannya. Dia
tidak punya waktu untuk berurusan\ldenganmu.

entries.original:
"???: [red]...one with the wind, one with
the flames.

A raging inferno.

A world on fire.

Sankren bolganone!

Heed my call!

Moltres!

Come to me!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [red]...one with the wind, one with the flames. A raging inferno. A world on fire. Sankren bolganone! Heed my call! Moltres! Come to me!
entries.translated:
???: [red]...satu dengan angin, satu
dengan api. Amukan api neraka.\lDunia yang terbakar. Sankren

bolganone! Dengarkan panggilanku!
Moltres! Datanglah padaku!

entries.original:
"Hi, there!
May I help you?

\.

You’re here for Prof. Log’s
package?

Sorry, it\.uh\.hasn’t come in
yet.

Could you come back later?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, there! May I help you? \. You’re here for Prof. Log’s package? Sorry, it\.uh\.hasn’t come in yet. Could you come back later?
entries.translated:
Halo! Ada yang bisa saya bantu? \.
Anda di sini untuk paket Prof. Log?\lMaaf, itu\.uh\.belum datang. Bisakah

Anda kembali nanti?

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You have a lot to learn about
battling, and I wouldn’t mind\lshowing you a thing or two.

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You have a lot to learn about battling, and I wouldn’t mind showing you a thing or two. Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, satu hal lagi. Begitu kamu
sampai rumah, kita akan bertarung.\lKamu masih banyak yang harus

dipelajari tentang bertarung, dan
aku tidak keberatan menunjukkan\lbeberapa hal. Sampai saat itu,

jangan terlalu memforsir dirimu.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You torchickened out earlier, but I
won’t let you skip out next time!

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You torchickened out earlier, but I won’t let you skip out next time! Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, satu hal lagi. Begitu kamu
sampai rumah, kita akan bertarung.\lKamu torchickened out tadi, tapi

aku tidak akan membiarkanmu kabur
lain kali! Sampai saat itu, jangan\lterlalu memforsir dirimu.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue][player]!
You finally made it out!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue][player]! You finally made it out!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue][player]! Akhirnya kamu
berhasil keluar!

entries.original:
"[blue]Have you met Old Man Log?

He’s an expert on Pokémon stats or
something or other\.

I’ve been filling him in on what
happened."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Have you met Old Man Log? He’s an expert on Pokémon stats or something or other\. I’ve been filling him in on what happened.
entries.translated:
[blue]Apakah kamu sudah bertemu Kakek
Log? Dia ahli tentang statistik\lPokémon atau sesuatu seperti itu\.

Aku sudah memberitahunya apa yang
terjadi.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]I study all aspects of
Pokémon stats and capture rates.

And my title is Professor, not Old
Man!

Dear Arceus\.

I’ve told you that too many
times\.

Anyway, that must have been quite
an ordeal you went through.

I’m relieved to hear both of you
are unharmed.

You both even managed to acquire
your very own Pokémon!

I was planning on giving [rival]
one, someday or another, but now I\ldon’t have to!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]I study all aspects of Pokémon stats and capture rates. And my title is Professor, not Old Man! Dear Arceus\. I’ve told you that too many times\. Anyway, that must have been quite an ordeal you went through. I’m relieved to hear both of you are unharmed. You both even managed to acquire your very own Pokémon! I was planning on giving [rival] one, someday or another, but now I don’t have to! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Aku mempelajari semua aspek
statistik Pokémon dan tingkat\lpenangkapan. Dan gelarku adalah

Profesor, bukan Kakek! Astaga
Arceus\. Aku sudah bilang itu\lberkali-kali\. Bagaimanapun, itu

pasti cobaan berat yang kamu alami.
Aku lega mendengar kalian berdua\ltidak terluka. Kalian bahkan

berhasil mendapatkan Pokémon
sendiri! Aku berencana memberikan\lsatu kepada [rival], suatu hari

nanti, tapi sekarang aku tidak
perlu! Ho ho ho!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Someday?

It’s been 13 years since you
started looking after me, old man!

I’ve been asking for Arceus knows
how long!

Honestly, I gave up believing you
would, years ago\."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Someday? It’s been 13 years since you started looking after me, old man! I’ve been asking for Arceus knows how long! Honestly, I gave up believing you would, years ago\.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Suatu hari nanti? Sudah
13 tahun sejak kau mulai menjagaku,\lKakek! Aku sudah meminta entah

berapa lama! Jujur, aku sudah
menyerah percaya kau akan\lmelakukannya, bertahun-tahun lalu\.

entries.original: "Log: [blue][player]!"
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue][player]!
entries.translated: Log: [blue][player]!

entries.translated:

entries.translation_source: Frost Mountain
entries.translated: Frost Mountain

entries.translated:
Rute 8 \au Blizzard City \ad Frost
Mountain, Rute 7

\au Route 7, Frost Mountain

Rute 9 \au Rute 7, Frost Mountain \ar
Tehl Town

"Route 10

\al Tehl Town
\au Auburn Waterwa\l\ar Fallshore City"

entries.translated:
Rute 10 \al Tehl Town \au Auburn
Waterwa \ar Fallshore City

entries.original:
"Route 10

\al Tehl Town

entries.translation_source: Route 10 \al Tehl Town \ar Fallshore City
entries.translated:
Rute 10 \al Tehl Town \ar Fallshore
City

entries.original:
"Crater Town

A town built from ash."
entries.translation_source: Crater Town A town built from ash.
entries.translated:
Crater Town Sebuah kota yang
dibangun dari abu.

entries.original:
"Frozen Heights

An island town on a frozen lake."
entries.translation_source: Frozen Heights An island town on a frozen lake.
entries.translated:
Frozen Heights Sebuah kota pulau di
danau beku.

entries.original:
"My grandfather knows a lot of
interesting people!

You should talk to him!"
entries.translation_source: My grandfather knows a lot of interesting people! You should talk to him!
entries.translated:
Kakekku kenal banyak orang menarik!
Kamu harus bicara dengannya!

entries.original:
"You are his [buffer1]!

I knew my eyesight was not
deceiving me!

Your father was, to put it simply,
an amazing man.

I’m sure if you introduced yourself
to people as his [buffer1], you\lwould instantly be regarded with\lmuch affection.

There aren’t many people out there
who have not heard of his exploits.

It’s a shame he disappeared.

If only someone knew what happened
to him, I could finally have a\lsense of closure."
entries.translation_source: You are his [buffer1]! I knew my eyesight was not deceiving me! Your father was, to put it simply, an amazing man. I’m sure if you introduced yourself to people as his [buffer1], you would instantly be regarded with much affection. There aren’t many people out there who have not heard of his exploits. It’s a shame he disappeared. If only someone knew what happened to him, I could finally have a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Kamu adalah [buffer1]-nya! Aku tahu
penglihatanku tidak menipuku!\lAyahmu, sederhananya, adalah pria

yang luar biasa. Aku yakin jika
kamu memperkenalkan dirimu kepada\lorang-orang sebagai [buffer1]-nya,

kamu akan langsung disambut dengan
banyak kasih sayang. Tidak banyak\lorang yang belum mendengar tentang

prestasinya. Sayang sekali dia
menghilang. Andai saja seseorang\ltahu apa yang terjadi padanya, aku

akhirnya bisa merasa tenang.

entries.original:
"Oh.
I could have sworn you were\.

My eyesight must be going in my old
age."
entries.translation_source: Oh. I could have sworn you were\. My eyesight must be going in my old age.
entries.translated:
Oh. Aku yakin kamu adalah\. Mungkin
penglihatanku mulai menurun di usia\ltuaku.

entries.original:
"What?
You know what happened to [green]Aros[blue]?

Please!
You must tell me!

\.

So he burned to ashes\.

That is a very unfortunate way to
leave this world."
entries.translation_source: What? You know what happened to [green]Aros[blue]? Please! You must tell me! \. So he burned to ashes\. That is a very unfortunate way to leave this world.
entries.translated:
Apa? Kamu tahu apa yang terjadi
pada [green]Aros[blue]? Tolong! Kamu harus\lmemberitahuku! \. Jadi dia terbakar

menjadi abu\. Itu cara yang sangat
disayangkan untuk meninggalkan\ldunia ini.

entries.original:
"This may seem a little ironic, but
please, I wish to give you this\litem as thanks for bringing me\la sense of closure."
entries.translation_source: This may seem a little ironic, but please, I wish to give you this item as thanks for bringing me a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Ini mungkin terdengar sedikit
ironis, tetapi tolong, aku ingin\lmemberikan item ini sebagai ucapan

terima kasih karena telah memberiku
rasa tenang.

entries.original:
"If only someone could tell me what
happened to your father\.

It would bring be such a sense of
closure."
entries.translation_source: If only someone could tell me what happened to your father\. It would bring be such a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Andai saja seseorang bisa
memberitahuku apa yang terjadi pada\layahmu\. Itu akan memberiku rasa

tenang yang begitu besar.

entries.original:
"Hello, there, [buffer1] of the
legendary Aros.

I hope your travels are going well."
entries.translation_source: Hello, there, [buffer1] of the legendary Aros. I hope your travels are going well.
entries.translated:
Halo, [buffer1] dari Aros yang
legendaris. Semoga perjalananmu\lberjalan lancar.

entries.original:
"Didja know that if you talk to the
Gym referees before beating the\lGym Leader, they’ll give you a\lfree gift?

Didja? Didja?"
entries.translation_source: Didja know that if you talk to the Gym referees before beating the Gym Leader, they’ll give you a free gift? Didja? Didja?
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa jika kamu
berbicara dengan wasit Gym sebelum\lmengalahkan Pemimpin Gym, mereka

akan memberimu hadiah gratis?
Tahukah? Tahukah?

entries.original:
"To the west of Dresco Town is Grim
Woods.

It’s filled with lots of cool Bug
and Ghost type Pokémon.

When you have a chance you should
check it out."
entries.translation_source: To the west of Dresco Town is Grim Woods. It’s filled with lots of cool Bug and Ghost type Pokémon. When you have a chance you should check it out.
entries.translated:
Di sebelah barat Dresco Town adalah
Grim Woods. Tempat itu dipenuhi\ldengan banyak Pokémon tipe Serangga

dan Hantu yang keren. Jika ada
kesempatan, kamu harus periksa ke\lsana.

entries.original: "It’s always important to stay warm."
entries.translation_source: It’s always important to stay warm.
entries.translated: Penting untuk selalu tetap hangat.

entries.original:
"Go, train, and become the strongest
trainer to ever live."
entries.translation_source: Go, train, and become the strongest trainer to ever live.
entries.translated:
Pergilah, berlatihlah, dan jadilah
pelatih terkuat yang pernah hidup.

entries.original:
"This place reminds of Cliff Cave
from the Johto region.

Why it’s named Thundercap Mountain
and not Cliff Cave is beyond me."
entries.translation_source: This place reminds of Cliff Cave from the Johto region. Why it’s named Thundercap Mountain and not Cliff Cave is beyond me.
entries.translated:
Tempat ini mengingatkanku pada
Cliff Cave dari region Johto.\lKenapa dinamai Thundercap Mountain

dan bukan Cliff Cave, aku tidak
mengerti.

entries.original:
"I like to pretend I can fly like my
birds.

Being grounded sucks."
entries.translation_source: I like to pretend I can fly like my birds. Being grounded sucks.
entries.translated:
Aku suka berpura-pura bisa terbang
seperti burung-burungku. Tidak bisa\lterbang itu menyebalkan.

entries.original:
"I eat lots of carrots to improve
my vision.

Maybe that’s why my skin is turning
orange..."
entries.translation_source: I eat lots of carrots to improve my vision. Maybe that’s why my skin is turning orange...
entries.translated:
Aku makan banyak wortel untuk
meningkatkan penglihatanku. Mungkin\litu sebabnya kulitku berubah

menjadi oranye...

entries.original:
"Route 9, Tehl Town, Fallshore City,
Epidimy Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 9, Tehl Town, Fallshore City, Epidimy Town
entries.translated:
Rute 9, Tehl Town, Fallshore City,
Epidimy Town

entries.original:
"Heh\.

You’re just getting more and more
powerful, [player].

Just wait until the next time we
meet.

By then, I’ll be tough enough to
make you feel defeat at my hands!

Now, if you’ll excuse me, I have
important things to do."
entries.translation_source: Heh\. You’re just getting more and more powerful, [player]. Just wait until the next time we meet. By then, I’ll be tough enough to make you feel defeat at my hands! Now, if you’ll excuse me, I have important things to do.
entries.translated:
Heh\. Kamu semakin kuat saja,
[player]. Tunggu saja sampai\lpertemuan kita berikutnya. Saat

itu, aku akan cukup tangguh untuk
membuatmu merasakan kekalahan di\ltanganku! Sekarang, permisi, aku

punya urusan penting.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Well of course I was planning
on it, [rival]!

There are plenty of errands I’m too
old to run myself!

It’s just that\.well\.when your
parents left you with me, they\lasked that I watch over you until\lyou were at least 18 years old\."
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]Well of course I was planning on it, [rival]! There are plenty of errands I’m too old to run myself! It’s just that\.well\.when your parents left you with me, they asked that I watch over you until you were at least 18 years old\.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Tentu saja aku sudah
merencanakannya, [rival]! Ada\lbanyak tugas yang sudah terlalu tua

untuk aku lakukan sendiri! Hanya
saja\.yah\.saat orang tuamu\lmeninggalkanmu denganku, mereka

meminta aku menjagamu sampai kamu
setidaknya berusia 18 tahun\.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Whatever, Log.
Believe what you want."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Whatever, Log. Believe what you want.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Terserah, Log. Percayalah
apa yang kamu mau.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh yeah, almost forgot.

Now that we’re outside, let me show
you how a real trainer battles!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh yeah, almost forgot. Now that we’re outside, let me show you how a real trainer battles!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh ya, hampir lupa. Sekarang kita
sudah di luar, biarkan aku\ltunjukkan cara pelatih sejati

bertarung!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh yeah, almost forgot.

Now that we’re outside, let me give
you a few battling pointers."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh yeah, almost forgot. Now that we’re outside, let me give you a few battling pointers.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh ya, hampir lupa. Sekarang kita
sudah di luar, biarkan aku berikan\lbeberapa tips bertarung.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh yeah, almost forgot.

Now that we’re outside, let’s see
how you battle!

There’s no torchickening out this
time!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh yeah, almost forgot. Now that we’re outside, let’s see how you battle! There’s no torchickening out this time!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh ya, hampir lupa. Sekarang kita
sudah di luar, mari lihat bagaimana\lkamu bertarung! Tidak ada kata

mengecut kali ini!

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]That was a fine battle.

Very enthralling if I do say so
myself."
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]That was a fine battle. Very enthralling if I do say so myself.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Pertarungan yang bagus. Sangat
mengasyikkan, menurutku.

entries.original:
"The sand castle came alive and
attacked!"
entries.translation_source: The sand castle came alive and attacked!
entries.translated:
Istana pasir itu hidup dan
menyerang!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] receded into the
sand."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] receded into the sand.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] itu menghilang ke dalam
pasir.

entries.original:
"I tried taking on the Gym here, but
I couldn’t even get to the Leader!

It was so dark I had no idea where
I was going.

I couldn’t even use Flash to see
better.

That’s how dark it was."
entries.translation_source: I tried taking on the Gym here, but I couldn’t even get to the Leader! It was so dark I had no idea where I was going. I couldn’t even use Flash to see better. That’s how dark it was.
entries.translated:
Aku mencoba menantang Gym di sini,
tapi aku bahkan tidak bisa sampai\lke Pemimpin Gym! Gelap sekali

sampai aku tidak tahu arah. Aku
bahkan tidak bisa menggunakan Flash\luntuk melihat lebih baik. Segelap

itulah.

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]The asset has sent word.

The target is on the move."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [blue]The asset has sent word. The target is on the move.
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Aset telah mengirim pesan.
Target sedang bergerak.

entries.original:
"Grint 2: [blue]Alright, then.

Let’s move into position."
entries.translation_source: Grint 2: [blue]Alright, then. Let’s move into position.
entries.translated:
Grint 2: [blue]Baiklah, kalau begitu. Ayo
bergerak ke posisi.

entries.original:
"Epidimy Town

The town of happiness and bliss."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town The town of happiness and bliss.
entries.translated:
Epidimy Town Kota kebahagiaan dan
sukacita.

entries.original: "Afterlife"
entries.translation_source: Afterlife
entries.translated: Alam Baka

entries.original:
"Hi there, young traveller.
Your Pokémon look tired.

Let me heal them for you."
entries.translation_source: Hi there, young traveller. Your Pokémon look tired. Let me heal them for you.
entries.translated:
Halo, pengelana muda. Pokémon-mu
terlihat lelah. Biarkan aku\lmemulihkan mereka untukmu.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]No one cares how it made
you feel, Log.

It only matters if our Pokémon
seem strong."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]No one cares how it made you feel, Log. It only matters if our Pokémon seem strong.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Tidak ada yang peduli
bagaimana perasaanmu, Log. Yang\lpenting hanyalah apakah Pokémon

kita terlihat kuat.

entries.original:
"Hello, [buffer1].
May I heal your Pokémon for you?"
entries.translation_source: Hello, [buffer1]. May I heal your Pokémon for you?
entries.translated:
Halo, [buffer1]. Bolehkah aku
memulihkan Pokémon-mu untukmu?

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Did you actually just use
Shadow Sneak?

Do you know nothing about
immunity?

Staraptor, use Aerial Ace!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Did you actually just use Shadow Sneak? Do you know nothing about immunity? Staraptor, use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Apakah kamu benar-benar baru
saja menggunakan Shadow Sneak? Kamu\ltidak tahu apa-apa tentang

kekebalan? Staraptor, gunakan
Aerial Ace!

entries.original:
"Whoa, man\.

Take this fine, fine, badge as
proof of your victory\."
entries.translation_source: Whoa, man\. Take this fine, fine, badge as proof of your victory\.
entries.translated:
Whoa, kawan\. Ambillah lencana yang
bagus, bagus ini sebagai bukti\lkemenanganmu\.

entries.original:
"Your Pokémon are looking much
better now, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon are looking much better now, [buffer1].
entries.translated:
Pokémon-mu terlihat jauh lebih baik
sekarang, [buffer1].

entries.original:
"We policemen are the only things
standing between the gangs and\ltotal destruction of the port."
entries.translation_source: We policemen are the only things standing between the gangs and total destruction of the port.
entries.translated:
Kami para polisi adalah
satu-satunya yang menghalangi\lgeng-geng dan kehancuran total

pelabuhan.

entries.original: "\ar Antisis City Port"
entries.translation_source: \ar Antisis City Port
entries.translated: \ar Antisis City Port

entries.original:
"Do you like my sand castle?

I worked really hard to make it!"
entries.translation_source: Do you like my sand castle? I worked really hard to make it!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu suka istana pasirku?
Aku bekerja sangat keras untuk\lmembuatnya!

entries.original:
"Wahhhh!

My sand castle is gone!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! My sand castle is gone!
entries.translated: Wahhhh! Istana pasirku hilang!

entries.original:
"Ho ho\.sure is humid\.like a
sauna\."
entries.translation_source: Ho ho\.sure is humid\.like a sauna\.
entries.translated: Ho ho\.memang lembap\.seperti sauna\.

entries.original:
"I’m going to perfect that art of
throwing Poké Balls!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to perfect that art of throwing Poké Balls!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menyempurnakan seni
melempar Poké Ball!

entries.original:
"If you’re going to get stronger,
I’ll get stronger too."
entries.translation_source: If you’re going to get stronger, I’ll get stronger too.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu akan menjadi lebih kuat,
aku juga akan menjadi lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"No matter what, my Pokémon will
stick with me until the end!"
entries.translation_source: No matter what, my Pokémon will stick with me until the end!
entries.translated:
Apa pun yang terjadi, Pokémonku
akan tetap bersamaku sampai akhir!

entries.original:
"Even when I lose, I still get some
enjoyment out of it."
entries.translation_source: Even when I lose, I still get some enjoyment out of it.
entries.translated:
Bahkan saat aku kalah, aku masih
bisa mendapatkan kesenangan dari\litu.

entries.original:
"If you run and run, you’ll become
one with the wind."
entries.translation_source: If you run and run, you’ll become one with the wind.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berlari dan berlari, kamu
akan menjadi satu dengan angin.

entries.original:
"I’ll forget about losing and just
enjoy this snowy hike."
entries.translation_source: I’ll forget about losing and just enjoy this snowy hike.
entries.translated:
Aku akan melupakan kekalahan dan
menikmati perjalanan salju ini.

entries.original:
"No one knows the mountains better
than I, I tells ya."
entries.translation_source: No one knows the mountains better than I, I tells ya.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang tahu gunung lebih
baik dariku, kataku.

entries.original:
"You have set me free\.

I am truly grateful from the bottom
of my heart\."
entries.translation_source: You have set me free\. I am truly grateful from the bottom of my heart\.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah membebaskanku\. Aku
benar-benar berterima kasih dari\llubuk hatiku\.

entries.original:
"Whoa\.
You look exhausted.

Did you climb all the way up the
mountain from Crater Town?"
entries.translation_source: Whoa\. You look exhausted. Did you climb all the way up the mountain from Crater Town?
entries.translated:
Whoa\. Kamu terlihat kelelahan.
Apakah kamu mendaki gunung dari\lCrater Town?

entries.original:
"Now that the entrance to the SES
Expressway is clear, travellers can

save their strength by coming up
through there, instead of hiking up!"
entries.translation_source: Now that the entrance to the SES Expressway is clear, travellers can save their strength by coming up through there, instead of hiking up!
entries.translated:
Sekarang pintu masuk SES Expressway
sudah jelas, para pelancong bisa\lmenghemat tenaga dengan naik

melalui sana, daripada mendaki!

entries.original:
"[blue]I’m sorry about this.

Take this for your trouble."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I’m sorry about this. Take this for your trouble.
entries.translated:
[blue]Maaf tentang ini. Ambil ini untuk
masalahmu.

entries.original: "Clerk: [blue]Money\.?"
entries.translation_source: Clerk: [blue]Money\.?
entries.translated: Petugas: [blue]Uang\.?

entries.original:
"[blue]What?

You came to get that package too?

Well, unless you’re willing to fight
for it, get out of the way!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]What? You came to get that package too? Well, unless you’re willing to fight for it, get out of the way!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa? Kamu datang untuk mengambil
paket itu juga? Yah, kecuali kamu\lmau bertarung untuk itu, minggir!

entries.original: "Fight"
entries.translation_source: Fight
entries.translated: Bertarung

entries.original: "Move"
entries.translation_source: Move
entries.translated: Minggir

entries.original: "[blue]I’m going to put you in your place!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I’m going to put you in your place!
entries.translated: [blue]Aku akan menempatkanmu di tempatmu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Did you honestly think that I would
give up the package even if I lost?

I didn’t come all this way just to
give in to some stupid kid.

Now move!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Did you honestly think that I would give up the package even if I lost? I didn’t come all this way just to give in to some stupid kid. Now move!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apakah kamu benar-benar berpikir
aku akan menyerahkan paket itu\lmeskipun aku kalah? Aku tidak

datang sejauh ini hanya untuk
mengalah pada anak bodoh. Sekarang\lminggir!

entries.original: "[blue]Get out of my way!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Get out of my way!
entries.translated: [blue]Minggir dari jalanku!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Did you receive the
package from the Mart?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Did you receive the package from the Mart?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Apakah kamu sudah menerima
paket dari Mart?

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, I did, sir."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Yes, I did, sir.
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Ya, sudah, Pak.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Were you discreet in doing
so?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Were you discreet in doing so?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Apakah kamu melakukannya
dengan hati-hati?

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I was, sir.

I tried not to cause too
much of a commotion.

I even paid for the package as
instructed."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]I was, sir. I tried not to cause too much of a commotion. I even paid for the package as instructed.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Iya, Pak. Saya berusaha
tidak menimbulkan keributan. Saya\lbahkan membayar paket itu sesuai

instruksi.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Good work.

The last thing we need right now is
the police after us.

We’re too close to the end game to
be stopped now."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Good work. The last thing we need right now is the police after us. We’re too close to the end game to be stopped now.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Kerja bagus. Hal terakhir
yang kita butuhkan sekarang adalah\lpolisi mengejar kita. Kita terlalu

dekat dengan akhir permainan untuk
dihentikan sekarang.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Report to Zeph, and inform
him of my current status."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Report to Zeph, and inform him of my current status.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Laporkan kepada Zeph, dan
beri tahu dia status saya saat ini.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Siap, Pak!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers
flowery Pokémon.

If you come prepared with a Fire or
Flying-type Pokémon, you should be\lable to take him out no sweat!

-COUGH- -COUGH-

Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to
hotbox his gym from time to time,\land this may have an effect on your\lbattling.

If you notice a \qothick fog\qc rolling
in, you’ll dodge hits easier, but\lyou’ll also have a harder time\llanding them as well!

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers flowery Pokémon. If you come prepared with a Fire or Flying-type Pokémon, you should be able to take him out no sweat! -COUGH- -COUGH- Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to hotbox his gym from time to time, and this may have an effect on your battling. If you notice a \qothick fog\qc rolling in, you’ll dodge hits easier, but you’ll also have a harder time landing them as well! Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, Mirskle, lebih
menyukai Pokémon berbunga. Jika\lkamu datang dengan Pokémon tipe Api

atau Terbang, kamu seharusnya bisa
mengalahkannya dengan mudah!\l-BATUK- -BATUK- Juga, perlu

diketahui, Mirskle suka mengasapi
gym-nya dari waktu ke waktu, dan\lini mungkin memengaruhi

pertarunganmu. Jika kamu melihat
\qokabut tebal\qc datang, kamu akan\llebih mudah menghindari serangan,

tetapi kamu juga akan lebih sulit
mengenai mereka! Semoga berhasil di\lluar sana!

If you notice a \qothick fog\qc rolling
in, you’ll dodge hits easier, but\lyou’ll also have a harder time\llanding them as well!

Good luck out there!"

"ling.

juga akan lebih sulit mengenai
mereka! Semoga berhasil di luar\lsana!

entries.original:
"I’m impressed!

You managed to beat Mirskle even
with your eyes full of \qofog\qc!

Take this as some extra proof of
your victory here."
entries.translation_source: I’m impressed! You managed to beat Mirskle even with your eyes full of \qofog\qc! Take this as some extra proof of your victory here.
entries.translated:
Saya terkesan! Kamu berhasil
mengalahkan Mirskle bahkan dengan\lmatamu penuh \qokabut\qc! Ambil ini

sebagai bukti tambahan kemenanganmu
di sini.

entries.original:
"That’s a rare gemstone that can
power up a grassy move in battle\lfor you!

I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ
in the making."
entries.translation_source: That’s a rare gemstone that can power up a grassy move in battle for you! I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ in the making.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah batu permata langka yang
bisa memperkuat jurus rumput dalam\lpertarungan untukmu! Saya yakin itu

akan membantumu, calon juara.

entries.original:
"Huh.

You have no space for it."
entries.translation_source: Huh. You have no space for it.
entries.translated:
Huh. Kamu tidak punya ruang untuk
itu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Leaf Badge
from Mirskle!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Leaf Badge from Mirskle!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Lencana Daun dari
Mirskle!

entries.original: "Take this cool, grassy TM toooo\."
entries.translation_source: Take this cool, grassy TM toooo\.
entries.translated:
Ambil TM rumput yang keren ini
jugaaa\.

entries.original:
"In case you were wonderin’, that
TM contains [green]Grass Knot[blue].

I knew this guy, once.

He’d always be fallin’ over. Said
it was some sorta genetic problem.

But the truth is\.

I just kept usin’ Grass Knot on
him!

It’s a good thing he wasn’t toooo
heavy, or it woulda really hurt."
entries.translation_source: In case you were wonderin’, that TM contains [green]Grass Knot[blue]. I knew this guy, once. He’d always be fallin’ over. Said it was some sorta genetic problem. But the truth is\. I just kept usin’ Grass Knot on him! It’s a good thing he wasn’t toooo heavy, or it woulda really hurt.
entries.translated:
Kalau kamu penasaran, TM itu berisi
[green]Grass Knot[blue]. Saya kenal seseorang,\ldulu. Dia selalu jatuh. Katanya itu

semacam masalah genetik. Tapi
sebenarnya\. Saya terus menggunakan\lGrass Knot padanya! Untung saja dia

tidak terlalu berat, atau itu akan
sangat menyakitkan.

entries.original:
"Aww, man\.

You already have Grass Knot\."
entries.translation_source: Aww, man\. You already have Grass Knot\.
entries.translated:
Aduh, sob\. Kamu sudah punya Grass
Knot\.

entries.original:
"Everyone hide!

The popo’s here to get us again!"
entries.translation_source: Everyone hide! The popo’s here to get us again!
entries.translated:
Semua bersembunyi! Polisi datang
untuk menangkap kita lagi!

entries.original:
"Officer 1: [blue]Hey, kid!

Did you see which way the Gym
Leader ran?

He’s wanted for trafficking in
Oddish leaves!"
entries.translation_source: Officer 1: [blue]Hey, kid! Did you see which way the Gym Leader ran? He’s wanted for trafficking in Oddish leaves!
entries.translated:
Petugas 1: [blue]Hei, nak! Apakah kamu
melihat ke arah mana Pemimpin Gym\litu lari? Dia dicari karena

perdagangan daun Oddish!

entries.original: "Would you like to tell them?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to tell them?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin memberitahu
mereka?

entries.original:
"Officer 1: [blue]Looks like [buffer2]
doesn’t know, Frank\.

Should we let [buffer1] off?"
entries.translation_source: Officer 1: [blue]Looks like [buffer2] doesn’t know, Frank\. Should we let [buffer1] off?
entries.translated:
Petugas 1: [blue]Sepertinya [buffer2]
tidak tahu, Frank\. Haruskah kita\lmelepaskan [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Officer 2: [blue]Let’s let [buffer1] off.

[buffer3] probably just fell victim to
Mirskle’s lies.

Poor kid\."
entries.translation_source: Officer 2: [blue]Let’s let [buffer1] off. [buffer3] probably just fell victim to Mirskle’s lies. Poor kid\.
entries.translated:
Petugas 2: [blue]Mari kita lepaskan
[buffer1]. [buffer3] mungkin saja\lmenjadi korban kebohongan Mirskle.

Anak malang\.

entries.original:
"Officer 1: [blue]Uh, yeah\.

Your story checks out.
You’re free to go."
entries.translation_source: Officer 1: [blue]Uh, yeah\. Your story checks out. You’re free to go.
entries.translated:
Petugas 1: [blue]Uh, ya\. Ceritamu cocok.
Kamu bebas pergi.

entries.original:
"Officer 1: [blue]The pond?
Thank you!

You’ve made a big difference in the
war on drugs! Good work!"
entries.translation_source: Officer 1: [blue]The pond? Thank you! You’ve made a big difference in the war on drugs! Good work!
entries.translated:
Petugas 1: [blue]Kolam? Terima kasih!
Kamu telah membuat perbedaan besar\ldalam perang melawan narkoba! Kerja

bagus!

entries.original:
"Well, then, didja know that if you
talk to the Gym referees after\lbeating the Gym Leader, they’ll\lgive you a gift then, also?

Didja? Didja?"
entries.translation_source: Well, then, didja know that if you talk to the Gym referees after beating the Gym Leader, they’ll give you a gift then, also? Didja? Didja?
entries.translated:
Nah, kalau begitu, tahukah kamu
bahwa jika kamu berbicara dengan\lwasit Gym setelah mengalahkan

Pemimpin Gym, mereka akan memberimu
hadiah juga? Tahukah? Tahukah?

entries.original: "Cacnea, use Cut!"
entries.translation_source: Cacnea, use Cut!
entries.translated: Cacnea, gunakan Potong!

entries.original: "Cac!"
entries.translation_source: Cac!
entries.translated: Cac!

entries.original:
"No!
You need to recover the package!"
entries.translation_source: No! You need to recover the package!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Kamu harus mengambil kembali
paketnya!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon League is airing a
special on Borrian history.

Would you like to watch it?"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon League is airing a special on Borrian history. Would you like to watch it?
entries.translated:
Liga Pokémon sedang menayangkan
acara spesial tentang sejarah\lBorria. Apakah kamu ingin

menontonnya?

entries.original:
"No!
You need to return the package!"
entries.translation_source: No! You need to return the package!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Kamu harus mengembalikan
paketnya!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, [green]Alice[red], lives
downstairs.

She’s away running the Gym most of
the time, so she usually leaves\lher kid home alone.

I, personally, would never leave my
son home alone.

His mind is too delicate.

He can’t bear to be without his
mama!"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, [green]Alice[red], lives downstairs. She’s away running the Gym most of the time, so she usually leaves her kid home alone. I, personally, would never leave my son home alone. His mind is too delicate. He can’t bear to be without his mama!
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, [green]Alice[red], tinggal di
lantai bawah. Dia pergi menjalankan\lGym sebagian besar waktu, jadi dia

biasanya meninggalkan anaknya
sendirian di rumah. Saya, secara\lpribadi, tidak akan pernah

meninggalkan putra saya sendirian
di rumah. Pikirannya terlalu\llembut. Dia tidak tahan tanpa

mamanya!

entries.original:
"You there, young trainer!

Would you mind helping me with a
task?"
entries.translation_source: You there, young trainer! Would you mind helping me with a task?
entries.translated:
Hei, Pelatih muda! Maukah kamu
membantuku dengan sebuah tugas?

entries.original:
"Ahaha, young trainer!

Would you mind helping me with
another task?"
entries.translation_source: Ahaha, young trainer! Would you mind helping me with another task?
entries.translated:
Ahaha, Pelatih muda! Maukah kamu
membantuku dengan tugas lain?

entries.original:
"Oh!
You found Prof. Log’s package!

If it isn’t too much to ask, would
you be able to deliver it to him?

It’s his order, but he doesn’t want
to come pick it up."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You found Prof. Log’s package! If it isn’t too much to ask, would you be able to deliver it to him? It’s his order, but he doesn’t want to come pick it up.
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu menemukan paket Prof. Log!
Jika tidak terlalu merepotkan,\lbisakah kamu mengantarkannya

kepadanya? Itu pesanannya, tapi dia
tidak mau datang mengambilnya.

entries.original:
"Are you sure?
I promise the reward is good."
entries.translation_source: Are you sure? I promise the reward is good.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu yakin? Aku janji
hadiahnya bagus.

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you!

My grandson’s birthday is coming up
and I want to bake him a pie, but I\ldon’t have all of the ingredients.

I only need:
[green][buffer1][red]

If you could bring them to me as
soon as possible, it would be much\lappreciated."
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you! My grandson’s birthday is coming up and I want to bake him a pie, but I don’t have all of the ingredients. I only need: [green][buffer1][red] If you could bring them to me as soon as possible, it would be much appreciated.
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih! Ulang tahun cucu
laki-lakiku akan datang dan aku\lingin memanggangkan kue pai

untuknya, tapi aku tidak memiliki
semua bahan. Aku hanya perlu:\l[green][buffer1][red] Jika kamu bisa

membawakannya padaku secepat
mungkin, akan sangat dihargai.

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you again!

My son’s anniversary is coming up,
and I want to bake him a pie too.

This time I need:
[green][buffer1][red]

Bring them to me with haste, young
trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you again! My son’s anniversary is coming up, and I want to bake him a pie too. This time I need: [green][buffer1][red] Bring them to me with haste, young trainer!
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih lagi! Hari jadi
putraku akan datang, dan aku juga\lingin memanggangkan kue pai

untuknya. Kali ini aku perlu:
[green][buffer1][red] Bawakan padaku dengan\lcepat, Pelatih muda!

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you again!

My ex-husband has found love with
another woman, and I want to bake\la pie to smash in his face!

This time I need:
[green][buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you again! My ex-husband has found love with another woman, and I want to bake a pie to smash in his face! This time I need: [green][buffer1]
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih lagi! Mantan
suamiku telah menemukan cinta\ldengan wanita lain, dan aku ingin

memanggang kue pai untuk
dihantamkan ke wajahnya! Kali ini\laku perlu: [green][buffer1]

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][red]

Bring them to me with extreme
haste, young trainer!"
entries.translation_source: [green][buffer1][red] Bring them to me with extreme haste, young trainer!
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red] Bawalah mereka kepadaku
dengan sangat cepat, pelatih muda!

entries.original:
"I still need:
[green][buffer1][red]

Please bring them as soon as you
can."
entries.translation_source: I still need: [green][buffer1][red] Please bring them as soon as you can.
entries.translated:
Aku masih butuh: [green][buffer1][red] Tolong
bawa mereka secepat yang kamu bisa.

entries.original:
"I still need:
[green][buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: I still need: [green][buffer1]
entries.translated: Aku masih butuh: [green][buffer1]

entries.original:
"If I had a bike, it would be much
easier to climb.

But where can you even get a bike
around here?"
entries.translation_source: If I had a bike, it would be much easier to climb. But where can you even get a bike around here?
entries.translated:
Jika aku punya sepeda, akan lebih
mudah untuk mendaki. Tapi di mana\lkamu bisa mendapatkan sepeda di

sekitar sini?

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Well\.erm\.

From what I can see, your Pokémon
do have some nice stats\.

I see potential for them to become
strong Pokémon some day."
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]Well\.erm\. From what I can see, your Pokémon do have some nice stats\. I see potential for them to become strong Pokémon some day.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Well\.erm\. Dari yang bisa
kulihat, Pokémon-mu memiliki\lbeberapa stat yang bagus\. Aku

melihat potensi bagi mereka untuk
menjadi Pokémon yang kuat suatu\lhari nanti.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Thank you, Log.

That’s the first useful thing
you’ve said all day.

And it’ll be the last.
’Cause I’m outta here."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Thank you, Log. That’s the first useful thing you’ve said all day. And it’ll be the last. ’Cause I’m outta here.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Terima kasih, Log. Itu
adalah hal berguna pertama yang\lkamu katakan sepanjang hari. Dan

itu akan menjadi yang terakhir.
Karena aku pergi dari sini.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Well, he’s certainly a handful,
isn’t he?

And now that he’s gone, who’ll run
my errands for me?"
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]Well, he’s certainly a handful, isn’t he? And now that he’s gone, who’ll run my errands for me?
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Yah, dia pasti merepotkan,
bukan? Dan sekarang setelah dia\lpergi, siapa yang akan menjalankan

tugas-tugasku untukku?

entries.original:
"[blue]Aha!

[player], you seem capable, would
you like to run my errands for me?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Aha! [player], you seem capable, would you like to run my errands for me?
entries.translated:
[blue]Aha! [player], kamu tampak cakap,
apakah kamu mau menjalankan\ltugas-tugasku untukku?

entries.original:
"[blue]Are you sure?

It’s always good to have an in with
the Pokémon Professor!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Are you sure? It’s always good to have an in with the Pokémon Professor!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu yakin? Selalu baik untuk
memiliki hubungan dengan Profesor\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"[blue]What are you doing?

I told you to check in with your
mother!

\.

Don’t look at me like that.

Didn’t your mother ever teach you
to listen to your elders?

Go see her!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]What are you doing? I told you to check in with your mother! \. Don’t look at me like that. Didn’t your mother ever teach you to listen to your elders? Go see her!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa yang kamu lakukan? Aku sudah
bilang untuk mengecek ibumu! \.\lJangan menatapku seperti itu.

Bukankah ibumu pernah mengajarimu
untuk mendengarkan orang yang lebih\ltua? Pergi temui dia!

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][red]

Please bring them as soon as you
can."
entries.translation_source: [green][buffer1][red] Please bring them as soon as you can.
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red] Tolong bawa mereka secepat
yang kamu bisa.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo, it seems you’ve
brought my ingredients.

Much appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo, it seems you’ve brought my ingredients. Much appreciated.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo, sepertinya kamu telah
membawa bahan-bahanku. Sangat\ldihargai.

entries.original:
"The Old Lady took:
[green][buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: The Old Lady took: [green][buffer1]
entries.translated: Nenek tua mengambil: [green][buffer1]

entries.original:
"I’m sure my [buffer2] will love
this pie.

Please, take these in exchange for
your hard work, young trainer."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure my [buffer2] will love this pie. Please, take these in exchange for your hard work, young trainer.
entries.translated:
Aku yakin [buffer2]ku akan menyukai
pai ini. Silakan, ambil ini sebagai\limbalan atas kerja kerasmu, pelatih

muda.

entries.original:
"My umbrella always protects me when
it’s raining!"
entries.translation_source: My umbrella always protects me when it’s raining!
entries.translated:
Payungku selalu melindungiku saat
hujan!

entries.original:
"Did you know there is a special
Poké Ball that heals Pokémon?

When you capture a Pokémon, all
damage done to it is undone!

Don’t you wish you had some?"

I’m not really in the mood to go
back right now, so if you don’t put\lup a good fight, I’m gonna loose my\lMega Punch on you!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, sorry! I forgot to introduce myself! I’m Mel, the Gym Leader of [green]Fallshore City[blue]. You’re a challenger? Then meet me at my Gym. I’m not really in the mood to go back right now, so if you don’t put up a good fight, I’m gonna loose my Mega Punch on you!
entries.translated:
Oh, maaf! Aku lupa memperkenalkan
diri! Aku Mel, Pemimpin Gym dari\l[green]Fallshore City[blue]. Kamu seorang

penantang? Kalau begitu temui aku
di Gym-ku. Aku sedang tidak ingin\lkembali sekarang, jadi jika kamu

tidak bertarung dengan baik, aku
akan melepaskan Mega Punch padamu!

entries.original:
"The sea\.

Full of fury one moment, calm as a
Pokémon’s nature the next\."
entries.translation_source: The sea\. Full of fury one moment, calm as a Pokémon’s nature the next\.
entries.translated:
Laut\. Penuh amarah suatu saat,
tenang seperti sifat Pokémon saat\lberikutnya\.

entries.original:
"A Gem is a special type of held
item that powers up a single attack\lin battle, then disappears\lforever.

Each Gem corresponds to specific
type, and can only power up that\ltype of move.

Every Gym Leader in Borrius has at
least one of their Pokémon holding\la Gem, so be wary.

If you’re concerned about this, you
can use the move [green]Incinerate[blue] to\lmelt their Gem first, before they\lhave a chance to use it."
entries.translation_source: A Gem is a special type of held item that powers up a single attack in battle, then disappears forever. Each Gem corresponds to specific type, and can only power up that type of move. Every Gym Leader in Borrius has at least one of their Pokémon holding a Gem, so be wary. If you’re concerned about this, you can use the move [green]Incinerate[blue] to melt their Gem first, before they have a chance to use it.
entries.translated:
Sebuah Gem adalah item yang
dipegang khusus yang memperkuat\lsatu serangan dalam pertarungan,

lalu menghilang selamanya. Setiap
Gem berhubungan dengan tipe\ltertentu, dan hanya dapat

memperkuat jurus dengan tipe itu.
Setiap Pemimpin Gym di Borrius\lmemiliki setidaknya satu Pokémon

yang memegang Gem, jadi
berhati-hatilah. Jika kamu khawatir\ltentang ini, kamu bisa menggunakan

jurus [green]Incinerate[blue] untuk melelehkan
Gem mereka terlebih dahulu, sebelum\lmereka memiliki kesempatan

menggunakannya.

entries.original: "You must be an experienced trainer."
entries.translation_source: You must be an experienced trainer.
entries.translated:
Kamu pasti seorang pelatih yang
berpengalaman.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I will tolerate no screw
ups!

Last time, some kid noticed us and
tried to interfere.

I can’t have that happening again.

We don’t have the luxury of 
dealing with [buffer1] now.

Keep a low profile at all costs,
and no matter what, do not get\lnoticed!

Do I make myself clear?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]I will tolerate no screw ups! Last time, some kid noticed us and tried to interfere. I can’t have that happening again. We don’t have the luxury of dealing with [buffer1] now. Keep a low profile at all costs, and no matter what, do not get noticed! Do I make myself clear?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Aku tidak akan mentolerir
kesalahan! Terakhir kali, seorang\lanak memperhatikan kita dan mencoba

ikut campur. Aku tidak bisa
membiarkan itu terjadi lagi. Kita\ltidak punya kemewahan untuk

berurusan dengan [buffer1] sekarang.
Tetaplah rendah diri bagaimanapun\lcaranya, dan jangan sampai

diperhatikan! Apakah aku cukup
jelas?

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Move out."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Move out.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Bergerak.

entries.original:
"You did well delivering Log’s
package to him.

Oh?

What’s this?

I see that Log has entrusted you
with your very own Poké Balls.

I used to be a whiz Trainer back in
my day.

I could show you a thing or two
about capturing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You did well delivering Log’s package to him. Oh? What’s this? I see that Log has entrusted you with your very own Poké Balls. I used to be a whiz Trainer back in my day. I could show you a thing or two about capturing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu melakukannya dengan baik
mengantarkan paket Log kepadanya.\lOh? Apa ini? Aku lihat Log telah

mempercayakanmu dengan Poké Ball
milikmu sendiri. Dulu aku adalah\lPelatih yang hebat di zamanku. Aku

bisa menunjukkan beberapa hal
tentang menangkap Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Alright!
Here we go!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! Here we go!
entries.translated: Baiklah! Ayo kita mulai!

entries.original:
"Phew\.

That one was too close for
comfort\."
entries.translation_source: Phew\. That one was too close for comfort\.
entries.translated:
Fiuh\. Itu terlalu dekat untuk
kenyamanan\.

entries.original:
"Let me tell you a secret.

The Gym Leader in Dehara City,
Galavan, uses Electric Pokémon.

He tries to catch opponents who use
Water Pokémon off guard.

But whenever he’s not up to it, he
lowers the bridge between the city\land his gym.

So if you want to battle him then,
you’ll just have to wait."
entries.translation_source: Let me tell you a secret. The Gym Leader in Dehara City, Galavan, uses Electric Pokémon. He tries to catch opponents who use Water Pokémon off guard. But whenever he’s not up to it, he lowers the bridge between the city and his gym. So if you want to battle him then, you’ll just have to wait.
entries.translated:
Biarkan aku memberitahumu sebuah
rahasia. Pemimpin Gym di Dehara\lCity, Galavan, menggunakan Pokémon

Listrik. Dia mencoba mengecoh lawan
yang menggunakan Pokémon Air. Tapi\lsetiap kali dia tidak siap, dia

menurunkan jembatan antara kota dan
gym-nya. Jadi jika kamu ingin\lbertarung dengannya saat itu, kamu

hanya perlu menunggu.

entries.original:
"Through here is the entrance to the
Tomb of Borrius.

It is said that the ancient king,
who summoned the dark force long\lago, is burried here.

But you won’t be able to go
anywhere inside without Galavan’s\lpermission, so don’t bother trying."
entries.translation_source: Through here is the entrance to the Tomb of Borrius. It is said that the ancient king, who summoned the dark force long ago, is burried here. But you won’t be able to go anywhere inside without Galavan’s permission, so don’t bother trying.
entries.translated:
Di sini adalah pintu masuk ke Makam
Borrius. Konon, raja kuno yang\lmemanggil kekuatan gelap dahulu

kala dimakamkan di sini. Tapi kamu
tidak akan bisa masuk ke dalam\ltanpa izin Galavan, jadi jangan

repot-repot mencoba.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to make sure this city
stays a beautiful oasis at the edge\lof the desert.

All these trees aren’t natural to
this area.

I was responsible for planting
them!"
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to make sure this city stays a beautiful oasis at the edge of the desert. All these trees aren’t natural to this area. I was responsible for planting them!
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah memastikan kota ini
tetap menjadi oasis yang indah di\ltepi gurun. Semua pohon ini bukan

asli daerah ini. Akulah yang
bertanggung jawab menanamnya!

entries.original:
"Dehara City is the perfect blend
between tourism and living.

This whole area of the city is
designed to attract tourists, but\lpeople are still able to live in\lthis city in the north-eastern part\lof town."
entries.translation_source: Dehara City is the perfect blend between tourism and living. This whole area of the city is designed to attract tourists, but people are still able to live in this city in the north-eastern part of town.
entries.translated:
Dehara City adalah perpaduan
sempurna antara pariwisata dan\ltempat tinggal. Seluruh area kota

ini dirancang untuk menarik
wisatawan, tetapi orang-orang masih\lbisa tinggal di kota ini di bagian

timur laut kota.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like you have
enough space in your party for my\ldear Riolu.

Come back when you’ve made space,
so I can give it to you."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like you have enough space in your party for my dear Riolu. Come back when you’ve made space, so I can give it to you.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak memiliki
cukup ruang di timmu untuk Riolu\lkesayanganku. Kembalilah setelah

kamu membuat ruang, agar aku bisa
memberikannya kepadamu.

entries.original:
"The strange creature was sucked into
the Cube!"
entries.translation_source: The strange creature was sucked into the Cube!
entries.translated:
Makhluk aneh tersedot ke dalam
Kubus!

entries.original:
"You have collected [green][buffer3] percent[black]
of cells."
entries.translation_source: You have collected [green][buffer3] percent[black] of cells.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah mengumpulkan [green][buffer3]
persen[black] dari sel.

entries.original:
"You, there!

Trainer!

Wait!"
entries.translation_source: You, there! Trainer! Wait!
entries.translated: Hei, kau! Pelatih! Tunggu!

entries.original:
"Is that a Super Cube in your
pocket?

\.

It is!

You’re just the person I’ve been
looking for!

Please come with me."
entries.translation_source: Is that a Super Cube in your pocket? \. It is! You’re just the person I’ve been looking for! Please come with me.
entries.translated:
Apakah itu Super Cube di sakumu? \.
Benar! Kamulah orang yang selama\lini aku cari! Tolong ikut aku.

entries.original:
"[blue]Thank you for coming with me.

\.

What’s that?

It’s not like you really had a
choice?

Such nonsense.

I don’t know what you’re talking
about.

Let’s get down to business."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Thank you for coming with me. \. What’s that? It’s not like you really had a choice? Such nonsense. I don’t know what you’re talking about. Let’s get down to business.
entries.translated:
[blue]Terima kasih sudah ikut denganku. \.
Apa itu? Bukannya kau punya\lpilihan? Omong kosong. Aku tidak

tahu apa yang kau bicarakan. Mari
kita mulai bisnisnya.

entries.original:
"[red]Recently pieces of a Pokémon known
as Zygarde have been appearing all\lover Borrius.

However, these pieces can only be
seen if you have a Super Cube with\la special feature installed."
entries.translation_source: [red]Recently pieces of a Pokémon known as Zygarde have been appearing all over Borrius. However, these pieces can only be seen if you have a Super Cube with a special feature installed.
entries.translated:
[red]Akhir-akhir ini, potongan-potongan
dari Pokémon yang dikenal sebagai\lZygarde telah muncul di seluruh

Borrius. Namun, potongan-potongan
ini hanya bisa dilihat jika kamu\lmemiliki Super Cube dengan fitur

khusus terpasang.

entries.original:
"[blue]Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos
that appears when the ecosystem is\lin danger.

Why it’s appearing here, and now,
is a mystery to us.

We’re trying to find the answer to
this, but we need someone to go\land collect all of the individual\l\qocells\qc and \qocores\qc of Zygarde."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos that appears when the ecosystem is in danger. Why it’s appearing here, and now, is a mystery to us. We’re trying to find the answer to this, but we need someone to go and collect all of the individual \qocells\qc and \qocores\qc of Zygarde.
entries.translated:
[blue]Zygarde adalah Pokémon dari Kalos
yang muncul saat ekosistem dalam\lbahaya. Mengapa ia muncul di sini,

dan sekarang, adalah misteri bagi
kami. Kami sedang mencoba mencari\ljawabannya, tapi kami butuh

seseorang untuk pergi mengumpulkan
semua \qosel\qc dan \qointi\qc dari\lZygarde.

entries.original:
"[red]Do you think you’d be able to help
us with our research?

We need an experienced trainer who
plans on travelling around Borrius."
entries.translation_source: [red]Do you think you’d be able to help us with our research? We need an experienced trainer who plans on travelling around Borrius.
entries.translated:
[red]Apakah menurutmu kau bisa membantu
kami dengan penelitian kami? Kami\lmembutuhkan pelatih berpengalaman

yang berencana berkeliling Borrius.

entries.original:
"[red]Are you sure about that?

Your help would be invaluable to
us."
entries.translation_source: [red]Are you sure about that? Your help would be invaluable to us.
entries.translated:
[red]Apakah kau yakin? Bantuanmu akan
sangat berharga bagi kami.

entries.original:
"[blue]Great!

Thank you for agreeing to help!

If you could please give me your
Cube for a sec...

\.

Okay!

Your Cube has been updated to allow
you to see and collect Zygarde\lCells.

The cells can be found scattered
around both West and East Borrius.

Once you’ve collected at least 10
percent, please come see me.

But for now, good luck!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Great! Thank you for agreeing to help! If you could please give me your Cube for a sec... \. Okay! Your Cube has been updated to allow you to see and collect Zygarde Cells. The cells can be found scattered around both West and East Borrius. Once you’ve collected at least 10 percent, please come see me. But for now, good luck!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hebat! Terima kasih telah setuju
membantu! Tolong berikan Kubusmu\lsebentar... \. Oke! Kubusmu telah

diperbarui sehingga kamu bisa
melihat dan mengumpulkan Sel\lZygarde. Sel-sel tersebut dapat

ditemukan tersebar di sekitar
Borrius Barat dan Timur. Setelah\lkamu mengumpulkan setidaknya 10

persen, tolong temui aku. Tapi
untuk saat ini, semoga berhasil!

entries.original:
"Back in the day, my husband
travelled the world in search of\lrare Pokémon.

If you have the Pokémon he’s
looking for, would you please trade\lwith him?"
entries.translation_source: Back in the day, my husband travelled the world in search of rare Pokémon. If you have the Pokémon he’s looking for, would you please trade with him?
entries.translated:
Dulu, suamiku berkeliling dunia
mencari Pokémon langka. Jika kamu\lmemiliki Pokémon yang dia cari,

maukah kamu bertukar dengannya?

entries.original:
"Mel is always surrounding himself
with many different women.

He must feel always be feeling
really lonely\."
entries.translation_source: Mel is always surrounding himself with many different women. He must feel always be feeling really lonely\.
entries.translated:
Mel selalu mengelilingi dirinya
dengan banyak wanita berbeda. Dia\lpasti merasa sangat kesepian\.

entries.original:
"Hmm...

There have been numerous reports of
cells being spotted, lately...

What could this mean..."
entries.translation_source: Hmm... There have been numerous reports of cells being spotted, lately... What could this mean...
entries.translated:
Hmm... Akhir-akhir ini, ada banyak
laporan tentang sel-sel yang\lterlihat... Apa artinya ini...

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
10 percent of cells, please report\lback to my husband."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least 10 percent of cells, please report back to my husband.
entries.translated:
Ketika kamu telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 10 persen dari sel,\ltolong laporkan kembali kepada

suamiku.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least 10 percent of the cells.

Good work!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my husband."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least 10 percent of the cells. Good work! If you haven’t already, please talk to my husband.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 10 persen dari sel.\lKerja bagus! Jika belum, tolong

bicaralah dengan suamiku.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least 50 percent of the cells.

You’re half way there!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my husband."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least 50 percent of the cells. You’re half way there! If you haven’t already, please talk to my husband.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 50 persen dari sel-sel\litu. Kamu sudah setengah jalan!

Jika belum, silakan bicara dengan
suamiku.

entries.original:
"You’ve collected all of the cells!

This is a major help to our
research!

Thank you so much!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve collected all of the cells! This is a major help to our research! Thank you so much!
entries.translated:
Kamu telah mengumpulkan semua sel!
Ini sangat membantu penelitian\lkami! Terima kasih banyak!

entries.original:
"A trainer!

Thank you so much for coming to my
home!

My wife and I have something very
important that we need taken care\lof."
entries.translation_source: A trainer! Thank you so much for coming to my home! My wife and I have something very important that we need taken care of.
entries.translated:
Seorang pelatih! Terima kasih
banyak sudah datang ke rumahku! Aku\ldan istriku memiliki sesuatu yang

sangat penting yang perlu diurus.

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
10 percent of cells, please report\lback to me."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least 10 percent of cells, please report back to me.
entries.translated:
Setelah kamu mengumpulkan
setidaknya 10 persen dari sel,\llaporkan kembali kepadaku.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least 10 percent of the cells.

I can’t do much for you right now,
but I can quickly assemble these\lcells into a temporary Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least 10 percent of the cells. I can’t do much for you right now, but I can quickly assemble these cells into a temporary Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 10 persen dari sel. Aku\ltidak bisa melakukan banyak untukmu

sekarang, tapi aku bisa merakit
sel-sel ini menjadi Pokémon\lsementara dengan cepat.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like you have any
space in your party for this\lPokémon.

Come back when you’ve made more
space."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like you have any space in your party for this Pokémon. Come back when you’ve made more space.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak memiliki
ruang di timmu untuk Pokémon ini.\lKembalilah saat kamu sudah membuat

lebih banyak ruang.

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
50 percent of cells, please report\lback to me."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least 50 percent of cells, please report back to me.
entries.translated:
Setelah kamu mengumpulkan
setidaknya 50 persen dari sel,\llaporkan kembali kepadaku.

entries.original:
"Please be aware that this Zygarde
is only a temporary construct, and\lany stat changes will be lost when\lit is disassembled."
entries.translation_source: Please be aware that this Zygarde is only a temporary construct, and any stat changes will be lost when it is disassembled.
entries.translated:
Harap diingat bahwa Zygarde ini
hanya konstruksi sementara, dan\lperubahan stat apa pun akan hilang

saat dibongkar.

entries.original:
"[player] received a Zygarde from the
scientist!"
entries.translation_source: [player] received a Zygarde from the scientist!
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Zygarde dari
ilmuwan!

entries.original:
"He traded me his [green]Magmar[blue] holding a
[green]Magmarizer[blue], and it evolved!"
entries.translation_source: He traded me his [green]Magmar[blue] holding a [green]Magmarizer[blue], and it evolved!
entries.translated:
Dia menukarkan [green]Magmar[blue] miliknya yang
membawa [green]Magmarizer[blue] denganku, dan ia\lberevolusi!

entries.original:
"Oh\.

My whole body aches\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. My whole body aches\.
entries.translated: Oh\. Seluruh tubuhku sakit\.

entries.original:
"I have had this Pokémon Egg for a
while, but I think it’s finally\lclose to hatching.

Which Pokémon could it be?"
entries.translation_source: I have had this Pokémon Egg for a while, but I think it’s finally close to hatching. Which Pokémon could it be?
entries.translated:
Aku sudah memiliki Telur Pokémon
ini cukup lama, tapi sepertinya\lakhirnya hampir menetas. Pokémon

apa itu?

entries.original:
"Log’s words echoed in your head:
[blue]Go make sure [rival] is okay!"
entries.translation_source: Log’s words echoed in your head: [blue]Go make sure [rival] is okay!
entries.translated:
Kata-kata Log bergema di kepalamu:
[blue]Pergi pastikan [rival] baik-baik\lsaja!

entries.original: "I’m going to catch even more cuties!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to catch even more cuties!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menangkap lebih banyak
yang imut!

entries.original: "I lost because of the cold."
entries.translation_source: I lost because of the cold.
entries.translated: Aku kalah karena kedinginan.

entries.original:
"Greetings, [player].

I am a researcher studying seasonal
form changes of Pokémon.

Since the seasons don’t change in
Borrius, I’m very interested in\llearning how certain Pokémon\lchange form in this region.

Would you like to help me with my
research?"
entries.translation_source: Greetings, [player]. I am a researcher studying seasonal form changes of Pokémon. Since the seasons don’t change in Borrius, I’m very interested in learning how certain Pokémon change form in this region. Would you like to help me with my research?
entries.translated:
Salam, [player]. Aku seorang
peneliti yang mempelajari perubahan\lbentuk musiman Pokémon. Karena

musim tidak berubah di Borrius, aku
sangat tertarik untuk mempelajari\lbagaimana beberapa Pokémon berubah

bentuk di wilayah ini. Apakah kamu
mau membantu penelitianku?

entries.original:
"Splendid!

I’m currently researching the
Pokémon known as [green][buffer1][blue].

To start off the research, I’d like
to study a [green][buffer1][blue] in [green][buffer2][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Splendid! I’m currently researching the Pokémon known as [green][buffer1][blue]. To start off the research, I’d like to study a [green][buffer1][blue] in [green][buffer2][blue] form.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Saat ini aku sedang
meneliti Pokémon yang dikenal\lsebagai [green][buffer1][blue]. Untuk memulai

penelitian, aku ingin mempelajari
[green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"No?

If you change your mind, your help
would still be invaluable."
entries.translation_source: No? If you change your mind, your help would still be invaluable.
entries.translated:
Tidak? Jika kamu berubah pikiran,
bantuanmu akan tetap sangat\lberharga.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a [green][buffer1][blue] in
[green][buffer2][blue] form to study?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a [green][buffer1][blue] in [green][buffer2][blue] form to study? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu membawakan aku [green][buffer1][blue]
dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue] untuk\ldipelajari? *Frisk* *Frisk*

entries.original:
"Ah, it doesn’t appear you have
brought one.

I’d like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in
[green][buffer2][blue] form, please."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it doesn’t appear you have brought one. I’d like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in [green][buffer2][blue] form, please.
entries.translated:
Ah, sepertinya kamu tidak membawa
satu. Aku ingin melihat [green][buffer1][blue]\ldalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue], tolong.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, you have.

Please wait a moment while I study
it."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, you have. Please wait a moment while I study it.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya, benar. Mohon tunggu
sebentar sementara saya\lmempelajarinya.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.

I’ve added invaluable data to my
research.

Next, I’d like to see a [green][buffer1][blue]
in [green][buffer3][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Interesting\. I’ve added invaluable data to my research. Next, I’d like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in [green][buffer3][blue] form.
entries.translated:
Menarik\. Saya telah menambahkan data
yang sangat berharga ke penelitian\lsaya. Selanjutnya, saya ingin

melihat [green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk
[green][buffer3][blue].

entries.original:
"I’ve done it!
I’ve completed the study!

Several key observations have led
me to the conclusion that although\lthere are no seasonal changes in\lBorrius, different forms of\lseasonal Pokémon appear in\ldifferent locations around Borrius.

Your help has been invaluable in
coming to this conclusion!

If you don’t already have this,
please, take this TM!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve done it! I’ve completed the study! Several key observations have led me to the conclusion that although there are no seasonal changes in Borrius, different forms of seasonal Pokémon appear in different locations around Borrius. Your help has been invaluable in coming to this conclusion! If you don’t already have this, please, take this TM!
entries.translated:
Saya berhasil! Saya telah
menyelesaikan penelitian ini!\lBeberapa pengamatan kunci telah

membawa saya pada kesimpulan bahwa
meskipun tidak ada perubahan musim\ldi Borrius, berbagai bentuk Pokémon

musiman muncul di lokasi yang
berbeda di sekitar Borrius. Bantuan\lAnda sangat berharga dalam mencapai

kesimpulan ini! Jika Anda belum
memilikinya, silakan ambil TM ini!

entries.original:
"I passed on my findings to the
National Science Society and was\lregarded with the highest of\lhonours.

I have you to thank you for this.
I will always remember your work."
entries.translation_source: I passed on my findings to the National Science Society and was regarded with the highest of honours. I have you to thank you for this. I will always remember your work.
entries.translated:
Saya menyampaikan temuan saya
kepada National Science Society dan\lmendapat penghargaan tertinggi.

Saya berterima kasih kepada Anda
untuk ini. Saya akan selalu\lmengingat kerja keras Anda.

as the sea."
entries.translation_source: Battle me. Show me you too, can be as furious as the sea.
entries.translated:
Bertarunglah denganku. Tunjukkan
bahwa dirimu juga bisa seganas\llaut.

Pokémon’s physical fury."

entries.translated:
[green]Sabuk Otot[blue] dapat meningkatkan
keganasan fisik Pokémonmu.

weakened, before you’ll be able to\lcapture them."

Seperti yang kamu saksikan, aku
berhasil menangkap Pokémon itu\ldengan melempar [green]Bola Poké[blue]. Namun,

ini tidak selalu berhasil.
Seringkali, Pokémon harus\ldilemahkan terlebih dahulu, sebelum

kamu bisa menangkapnya.

silakan mampir.

Zeph is worried about this happening again and disrupting the mission. melalui portal di Cinder Volcano.\lZeph khawatir hal ini akan terjadi

entries.translated:

penghalang yang kuat, aku harus\lmenuju ke puncak Gunung Frost\.

entries.translated: Antisis City

The Black Emboar tidak akan jatuh

entries.translated:
The Black Emboar! Jangan pernah
berhenti, dan jangan pernah menoleh\lke belakang!

tempat.

Tarmigan Town Kota yang terletak di
Thundercap Highland.

entries.original:
"Here at the Dream Research Lab,
we study the dreams of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Here at the Dream Research Lab, we study the dreams of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Di sini di Dream Research Lab, kami
mempelajari mimpi-mimpi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"In the Unova Region, a scientist
named Fennel created a device that\lallowed people to visually see the\ldreams of Pokémon.

It allowed you to go to the
Pokémon’s \qoDream World\qo and\linteract with them.

We’re trying to create a device
just like it and pass it off as our\lown invention, so don’t tell\lanybody."
entries.translation_source: In the Unova Region, a scientist named Fennel created a device that allowed people to visually see the dreams of Pokémon. It allowed you to go to the Pokémon’s \qoDream World\qo and interact with them. We’re trying to create a device just like it and pass it off as our own invention, so don’t tell anybody.
entries.translated:
Di Wilayah Unova, seorang ilmuwan
bernama Fennel menciptakan alat\lyang memungkinkan orang melihat

mimpi Pokémon secara visual. Itu
memungkinkanmu pergi ke \qoDream\lWorld\qo milik Pokémon dan

berinteraksi dengan mereka. Kami
berusaha menciptakan alat yang sama\ldan mengakuinya sebagai penemuan

kami sendiri, jadi jangan beri tahu
siapa pun.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon, Darkrai, has the
unique ability to damage Pokémon\lwhile they are asleep.

My goal is to find out the reason
why it can just enter a Pokémon’s\ldream without using an attack."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon, Darkrai, has the unique ability to damage Pokémon while they are asleep. My goal is to find out the reason why it can just enter a Pokémon’s dream without using an attack.
entries.translated:
Pokémon, Darkrai, memiliki
kemampuan unik untuk merusak\lPokémon saat mereka tidur. Tujuanku

adalah mencari tahu alasan mengapa
ia bisa langsung memasuki mimpi\lPokémon tanpa menggunakan serangan.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon walking around this
lab all assist in the research.

They’re all special Pokémon known
for eating dreams."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon walking around this lab all assist in the research. They’re all special Pokémon known for eating dreams.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang berjalan di sekitar
lab ini semuanya membantu\lpenelitian. Mereka semua adalah

Pokémon spesial yang dikenal karena
memakan mimpi.

entries.translated: Sharna!

entries.translation_source: Na!
entries.translated: Na!

called the Dream Research Lab.

research dreams.

I’m taking a breather."
entries.translation_source: I work at the facility over here called the Dream Research Lab. We do exactly as it sounds, we research dreams. But my work isn’t going so well, so I’m taking a breather.

Saya bekerja di fasilitas di sini
yang disebut Dream Research Lab.\lKami melakukan persis seperti

namanya, kami meneliti mimpi. Tapi
pekerjaanku tidak berjalan dengan\lbaik, jadi aku sedang istirahat.

"Tarmigan Town is so seculuded in

you’ll have to walk."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is so seculuded in the mountains, it doesn’t have its own entrance to the [green]SES Expressway[red]! If you wanna go down the mountain, you’ll have to walk.

Tarmigan Town sangat terpencil di
pegunungan, sehingga tidak memiliki\lpintu masuk sendiri ke [green]SES

Expressway[red]! Jika kamu ingin turun
gunung, kamu harus berjalan kaki.

"I prefer swimming in a calm lake
much more than in the sea."
entries.translation_source: I prefer swimming in a calm lake much more than in the sea.
entries.translated:
Saya lebih suka berenang di danau
yang tenang daripada di laut.

entries.translation_source: Maybe I should start wearing pants.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku harus mulai memakai
celana.

entries.translation_source: Next time I will crush you!
entries.translated: Lain kali aku akan menghancurkanmu!

[green]Tehl Town[red], that tiny town to the\lwest of here, is a secret\lunderground passage to [green]Route 9[red].

Aku dengar dari seorang teman bahwa
di bawah [green]Tehl Town[red], kota kecil di\lsebelah barat sini, ada lorong

Egg with me ever since it was laid.

However, I am willing to give it to
a healthy young person.

Would you like to raise the [green]Egg[red],
for me?"
entries.translation_source: Young trainer. I have been carrying around this Egg with me ever since it was laid. However, I am willing to give it to a healthy young person. Would you like to raise the [green]Egg[red], for me?
