Pelatih muda. Aku telah membawa
Telur ini bersamaku sejak ia\lditelurkan. Namun, aku bersedia

memberikannya kepada orang muda
yang sehat. Maukah kamu merawat\l[green]Telur[red] itu untukku?

"Here.
Please take good care of it.

It is a very special Egg."

entries.translated:
Ini. Tolong rawat dengan baik. Ini
adalah Telur yang sangat spesial.

famous.

Many people come to Fallshore
City just to battle there."

[green]Inverse Trainer House[blue] terkenal.
Banyak orang datang ke Fallshore\lCity hanya untuk bertarung di sana.

House!

Feel free to battle any of the
trainers here as many times as you\lwant.

If you need an explanation
of Inverse Battles, please come\ltalk to me.

Enjoy battling!"

entries.translated:
Hai! Selamat datang di Inverse
Battle House! Silakan bertarung\ldengan pelatih mana pun di sini

sebanyak yang kamu mau. Jika kamu
butuh penjelasan tentang Inverse\lBattles, silakan bicara denganku.

Selamat bertarung!

entries.original:
"An inverse battle works similar to
a normal battle.

The only difference is with
weaknesses and resistances.

In an inverse battle, they swap
places.

So a water type becomes weak to
fire, but it resists grass."
entries.translation_source: An inverse battle works similar to a normal battle. The only difference is with weaknesses and resistances. In an inverse battle, they swap places. So a water type becomes weak to fire, but it resists grass.

Pertarungan invers bekerja mirip

kelemahan dan ketahanan. Dalam
pertarungan invers, mereka bertukar\ltempat. Jadi Tipe Air menjadi lemah

terhadap Api, tetapi ia tahan
terhadap Rumput.

But I’m pretty sure you can’t surf until you have the [green]Zap Badge[blue]. And that badge comes after the Fall Badge\.

Gym Mel adalah labirin rumit dari
kolam, daun teratai, dan air\lterjun. Mungkin akan sangat mudah

dilewati jika kamu memiliki Pokémon
yang tahu Surf dan Waterfall. Tapi\laku cukup yakin kamu tidak bisa

berselancar sampai kamu memiliki
[green]Zap Badge[blue]. Dan lencana itu datang\lsetelah Fall Badge\.

entries.translation_source: My mother has horrible seperation anxiety. So much so, that when I moved away, she forced me to install and path between our houses.

Ibuku mengalami kecemasan
perpisahan yang parah. Begitu\lparahnya, sehingga ketika aku

memasang dan jalur di antara\lrumah-rumah kami.

Ibu mertuaku adalah orang gila!

\.

Tautan[blue]! Ini, kamu akan lihat!

Aku berlatih di bawah Alice di Gym

kami. Tidak ada cara bagimu untuk

Evolusi[blue], dan ia berevolusi!

Kebanyakan Pemimpin Gym

Evolusi, anggap saja sebagai

entries.original:
"Thirty years ago, a large meteorite
was hurtling towards Borrius.

The astronomers in Seaport City
predicted that if it wasn’t\lstopped, it would fall directly on\lValley City, this city, and end all\llife living here.

With great haste, we began our
evacuation of the city.

As we were about to make our escape
through the SES Expressway, we\lheard the news.

The meteorite was now predicted to
crush half of the region!

If we attempted to flee
underground, there would be a\llarge chance we’d be buried alive.

Chaos ensued.

All was thought hopeless\.until
HE arrived.

[green]Aros[blue], the legend.

He arrived alongside Arceus
and used a small Pokémon to\lteleport everyone to East Borrius,\lsafe from harm.

He planned to attack the meteorite
head on and smash it to bits.

Once he had transported everyone to
safety, it is said that he rode on\la Rayquaza and smashed into\lthe meteorite!

It shattered, and most of the
smaller fragments fell on\lValley City.

The city was destroyed, but Aros
had saved a region.

I will never forget the heroic act
that man performed."
entries.translation_source: Thirty years ago, a large meteorite was hurtling towards Borrius. The astronomers in Seaport City predicted that if it wasn’t stopped, it would fall directly on Valley City, this city, and end all life living here. With great haste, we began our evacuation of the city. As we were about to make our escape through the SES Expressway, we heard the news. The meteorite was now predicted to crush half of the region! If we attempted to flee underground, there would be a large chance we’d be buried alive. Chaos ensued. All was thought hopeless\.until HE arrived. [green]Aros[blue], the legend. He arrived alongside Arceus and used a small Pokémon to teleport everyone to East Borrius, safe from harm. He planned to attack the meteorite head on and smash it to bits. Once he had transported everyone to safety, it is said that he rode on a Rayquaza and smashed into the meteorite! It shattered, and most of the smaller fragments fell on Valley City. The city was destroyed, but Aros had saved a region. I will never forget the heroic act that man performed.
entries.translated:
Tiga puluh tahun yang lalu, sebuah
meteorit besar meluncur menuju\lBorrius. Para astronom di Seaport

City memprediksi bahwa jika tidak
dihentikan, meteorit itu akan jatuh\llangsung ke Valley City, kota ini,

dan mengakhiri semua kehidupan yang
tinggal di sini. Dengan\ltergesa-gesa, kami memulai evakuasi

kota. Saat kami hendak melarikan
diri melalui SES Expressway, kami\lmendengar kabar. Meteorit itu

sekarang diprediksi akan
menghancurkan setengah dari\lwilayah! Jika kami mencoba

melarikan diri ke bawah tanah, akan
ada kemungkinan besar kami terkubur\lhidup-hidup. Kekacauan terjadi.

Semua dianggap tidak ada
harapan\.sampai DIA tiba. [green]Aros[blue], sang\llegenda. Dia tiba bersama Arceus

dan menggunakan seekor Pokémon
kecil untuk memindahkan semua orang\lke East Borrius, aman dari bahaya.

Dia berencana menyerang meteorit
itu secara langsung dan\lmenghancurkannya menjadi kepingan.

Setelah dia memindahkan semua orang
ke tempat aman, dikatakan bahwa dia\lmenaiki Rayquaza dan menabrak

meteorit itu! Meteorit itu pecah,
dan sebagian besar pecahan kecil\ljatuh ke Valley City. Kota itu

hancur, tetapi Aros telah
menyelamatkan satu wilayah. Aku\ltidak akan pernah melupakan

tindakan heroik yang dilakukan pria
itu.

entries.original:

untuk memecahkan es!

Poké Ball langka yang dapat
menangkap Pokémon apa pun tanpa\lgagal. Pria yang memberikannya

padaku, [green]Aros[red], berkata untuk
menjaganya seolah-olah hidupku\lbergantung padanya. Itu sampai

Pokémon ungu kecil, [green]Hoopa[red]. Aros\lberkata bahwa yang mengendalikan

evolusi bukan dengan menekan [green]Tombol\lB[blue] saat Pokémonku akan berevolusi,

\.

If you need anything from me, I’ll
be in my lab.

It’s not that far, just down the
road.

But before you go anywhere, you
should check in with your mother.

She is likely very worried
about you.

Good luck, [player].
My studies depend on you."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Splendid! In [green]Bellin Town[blue] at the [green]Poké Mart[blue], there is a package waiting for me. I need you to pick it up. I would get it myself, however, like I said previously, I am too old to travel. I have already informed the clerk that I was not going to get it myself, but he insisted that it must be picked up from [green]Bellin Town[blue]. It should not be too hard for you since you have your own Pokémon. Ho ho ho! If you need anything from me, I’ll be in my lab. It’s not that far, just down the road. But before you go anywhere, you should check in with your mother. She is likely very worried about you. Good luck, [player]. My studies depend on you.
entries.translated:
[blue]Luar biasa! Di [green]Kota Bellin[blue] di [green]Poké
Mart[blue], ada paket yang menungguku.\lAku ingin kamu mengambilnya. Aku

akan mengambilnya sendiri, namun,
seperti yang kukatakan sebelumnya,\laku terlalu tua untuk bepergian.

Aku sudah memberi tahu pegawai itu
bahwa aku tidak akan mengambilnya\lsendiri, tapi dia bersikeras bahwa

itu harus diambil dari [green]Kota Bellin[blue].
Seharusnya tidak terlalu sulit\lbagimu karena kamu memiliki Pokémon

sendiri. Ho ho ho! Jika kamu
membutuhkan sesuatu dariku, aku\lakan berada di laboratoriumku.

Tempatnya tidak jauh, hanya di
ujung jalan. Tapi sebelum kamu\lpergi ke mana pun, kamu harus

menemui ibumu. Dia mungkin sangat
khawatir padamu. Semoga berhasil,\l[player]. Studiku bergantung

padamu.

be in my lab.

It’s not that far, just down the
road.

But before you go anywhere, you
should check in with your mother.

She is likely very worried
about you.

Good luck, [player].
My studies depend on you."
entries.translation_source: ll be in my lab. It’s not that far, just down the road. But before you go anywhere, you should check in with your mother. She is likely very worried about you. Good luck, [player]. My studies depend on you.
entries.translated:

Tempatnya tidak jauh, hanya di\lujung jalan. Tapi sebelum kamu

pergi ke mana pun, kamu harus
menemui ibumu. Dia mungkin sangat\lkhawatir padamu. Semoga berhasil,

[player]. Studiku bergantung
padamu.

entries.original:
"[blue]Lately, the citizens of Epidimy
Town have been complaining about\ltheir inability to visit Thundercap\lMountain.

Some strange guy is apparently
blocking the entrance and saying\lthat he’s there to keep you from\lentering.

I don’t know what’s going on, but
my head can’t handle these\lcomplaints anymore.

As this is likely your mess, meet
me in [green]Epidimy Town[blue] to help clean\lit up.

I don’t have all day, so take this
to get yourself there faster."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Lately, the citizens of Epidimy Town have been complaining about their inability to visit Thundercap Mountain. Some strange guy is apparently blocking the entrance and saying that he’s there to keep you from entering. I don’t know what’s going on, but my head can’t handle these complaints anymore. As this is likely your mess, meet me in [green]Epidimy Town[blue] to help clean it up. I don’t have all day, so take this to get yourself there faster.
entries.translated:
[blue]Akhir-akhir ini, warga Kota Epidimy
mengeluh tentang ketidakmampuan\lmereka mengunjungi Gunung

Thundercap. Seorang pria aneh
nampaknya memblokir pintu masuk dan\lmengatakan bahwa dia ada di sana

untuk mencegahmu masuk. Aku tidak
tahu apa yang terjadi, tapi\lkepalaku tidak bisa menahan keluhan

ini lagi. Karena ini mungkin
masalahmu, temui aku di [green]Kota\lEpidimy[blue] untuk membantu

membereskannya. Aku tidak punya
banyak waktu, jadi ambillah ini\luntuk sampai ke sana lebih cepat.

entries.original:
"[blue]Don’t keep me waiting too long,
[player].

I’d rather get this problem solved
sooner rather than later."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Don’t keep me waiting too long, [player]. I’d rather get this problem solved sooner rather than later.
entries.translated:
[blue]Jangan membuatku menunggu terlalu
lama, [player]. Aku lebih suka\lmasalah ini diselesaikan lebih

cepat daripada nanti.

entries.original:
"Galavan likes to use both [green]Electric[blue]-
and [green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon.

Bringing a [green]Ground[blue]-type Pokémon is
a good way to wreck him.

[green]Fire[blue]- and [green]Fighting[blue]-types are also
good against his [green]Steel[blue]-types.

Be advised, however.

An electric current runs across
the battlefield.

This means that all [green]Electric[blue]-type
moves will be powered up.

A hit from one could be
devastating!

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Galavan likes to use both [green]Electric[blue]- and [green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon. Bringing a [green]Ground[blue]-type Pokémon is a good way to wreck him. [green]Fire[blue]- and [green]Fighting[blue]-types are also good against his [green]Steel[blue]-types. Be advised, however. An electric current runs across the battlefield. This means that all [green]Electric[blue]-type moves will be powered up. A hit from one could be devastating! Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Galavan suka menggunakan Pokémon
tipe [green]Listrik[blue] dan [green]Baja[blue]. Membawa\lPokémon tipe [green]Tanah[blue] adalah cara yang

bagus untuk menghancurkannya. Tipe
[green]Api[blue] dan [green]Pertarungan[blue] juga bagus\lmelawan tipe [green]Baja[blue]-nya. Namun, perlu

diketahui. Ada aliran listrik yang
melintasi medan pertempuran. Ini\lberarti semua jurus tipe [green]Listrik[blue]

akan ditingkatkan kekuatannya.
Serangan dari satu jurus bisa\lsangat menghancurkan! Semoga

berhasil di luar sana!

entries.original:
"Well done!

Not only did you manage to overcome
the Electric Terrain, but you\lalso managed to fight through\lGalavan’s surprise sandstorm!

Take these two Gems as further
recognition of your accomplishment."
entries.translation_source: Well done! Not only did you manage to overcome the Electric Terrain, but you also managed to fight through Galavan’s surprise sandstorm! Take these two Gems as further recognition of your accomplishment.
entries.translated:
Bagus! Kamu tidak hanya berhasil
mengatasi Medan Listrik, tetapi\ljuga berhasil bertarung melewati

badai pasir kejutan Galavan! Ambil
dua Permata ini sebagai pengakuan\llebih atas pencapaianmu.

entries.original:
"My Pokémon evolved from the energy
in this cave!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon evolved from the energy in this cave!
entries.translated:
Pokémonku berevolusi dari energi di
gua ini!

entries.original:
"Those Gems I can gave you can power
up [green]Electric[blue]- and [green]Steel[blue]-type moves,\lrespectively.

You can zap your opponent with one
Pokémon, then pummel with another!"
entries.translation_source: Those Gems I can gave you can power up [green]Electric[blue]- and [green]Steel[blue]-type moves, respectively. You can zap your opponent with one Pokémon, then pummel with another!
entries.translated:
Permata yang bisa kuberikan padamu
dapat menguatkan gerakan tipe\l[green]Listrik[blue]- dan [green]Baja[blue]. Kamu bisa

menyetrum lawan dengan satu
Pokémon, lalu menghajarnya dengan\lyang lain!

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!

Welcome to the crime-ridden slums
that is Antisis City!

Have some Fresh Water straight from
my tap."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! Welcome to the crime-ridden slums that is Antisis City! Have some Fresh Water straight from my tap.
entries.translated:
Calon juara! Selamat datang di
daerah kumuh penuh kejahatan yang\lbernama Antisis City! Ambillah Air

Segar langsung dari keranku.

entries.original:
"There are many watery routes that
you can swim in Borrius.

It puts the Hoenn region to shame!"
entries.translation_source: There are many watery routes that you can swim in Borrius. It puts the Hoenn region to shame!
entries.translated:
Ada banyak rute berair yang bisa
kamu renangi di Borrius. Itu\lmembuat wilayah Hoenn malu!

entries.original:
"My top speed went down when I got
trapped in that electric web!"
entries.translation_source: My top speed went down when I got trapped in that electric web!
entries.translated:
Kecepatan maksimumku turun saat aku
terperangkap dalam jaring listrik\litu!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt.

\al Epidimy Town
\ar Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. \al Epidimy Town \ar Antisis City
entries.translated:
Gunung Thundercap \al Epidimy Town \ar
Antisis City

entries.original: "Have you seen the rare Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Have you seen the rare Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu pernah melihat Pokémon
langka?

entries.original:
"Big Mo is a lover of tough,
[green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon.

If you have a [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or
[green]Fairy[blue]-type, you’ll win no prob!

But before you can face Big Mo,
you’ll need to clear the Antisis\lGym [green]Ring Challenge[blue].

And for that, no [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-,
or [green]Fairy[blue] types are allowed.

But honestly, as long as you’re not
using a Pokémon weak to Fighting-\lmoves, it’ll be easy to clear.

Good luck in the ring!"
entries.translation_source: Big Mo is a lover of tough, [green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon. If you have a [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type, you’ll win no prob! But before you can face Big Mo, you’ll need to clear the Antisis Gym [green]Ring Challenge[blue]. And for that, no [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue] types are allowed. But honestly, as long as you’re not using a Pokémon weak to Fighting- moves, it’ll be easy to clear. Good luck in the ring!
entries.translated:
Big Mo adalah penggemar Pokémon
tipe [green]Petarung[blue] yang tangguh. Jika\lkamu memiliki tipe [green]Terbang[blue]-,

[green]Psikis[blue]-, atau [green]Peri[blue]-, kamu akan
menang tanpa masalah! Tapi sebelum\lkamu bisa menghadapi Big Mo, kamu

harus menyelesaikan [green]Ring Challenge[blue]
Gym Antisis. Dan untuk itu, tidak\lada tipe [green]Terbang[blue]-, [green]Psikis[blue]-, atau

[green]Peri[blue] yang diizinkan. Tapi
sejujurnya, selama kamu tidak\lmenggunakan Pokémon yang lemah

terhadap gerakan Petarung, akan
mudah untuk menyelesaikannya.\lSemoga berhasil di ring!

entries.original:
"That guy, he just came out of
nowhere\."
entries.translation_source: That guy, he just came out of nowhere\.
entries.translated:
Orang itu, dia datang entah dari
mana\.

entries.original:
"The item is sealed behind the
elctric barrier."
entries.translation_source: The item is sealed behind the elctric barrier.
entries.translated:
Barang itu tersegel di balik
penghalang listrik.

entries.original:
"It’s not smart to pick a fight with
The Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: It’s not smart to pick a fight with The Shadows!
entries.translated:
Tidak pintar untuk melawan The
Shadows!

entries.original:
"Doesn’t matter.
You will be consumed."
entries.translation_source: Doesn’t matter. You will be consumed.
entries.translated:
Tidak masalah. Kamu akan
dikonsumsi.

entries.original:
"Give up.

Life is meaningless."
entries.translation_source: Give up. Life is meaningless.
entries.translated: Menyerahlah. Hidup tidak berarti.

entries.original: "Even you, will die."
entries.translation_source: Even you, will die.
entries.translated: Bahkan kamu, akan mati.

entries.original: "So, you want to see Ivory?"
entries.translation_source: So, you want to see Ivory?
entries.translated: Jadi, kamu ingin melihat Ivory?

entries.original: "I’d better warn Ivory about you\."
entries.translation_source: I’d better warn Ivory about you\.
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya aku memperingatkan Ivory
tentangmu\.

entries.original:
"You’ll never defeat all of us!
We’re invincible!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll never defeat all of us! We’re invincible!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak akan pernah mengalahkan
kami semua! Kami tak terkalahkan!

entries.original:
"You won’t find Ivory by just
scurrying around!"
entries.translation_source: You won’t find Ivory by just scurrying around!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak akan menemukan Ivory
hanya dengan berlarian!

entries.original:
"I’m Ivory’s last line of defense!

You may have been able to break
onto the route, but you won’t be\lable to break through me!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Ivory’s last line of defense! You may have been able to break onto the route, but you won’t be able to break through me!
entries.translated:
Aku adalah garis pertahanan
terakhir Ivory! Kamu mungkin bisa\lmasuk ke rute ini, tapi kamu tidak

akan bisa menembus diriku!

entries.original: "I’d better go warn Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: I’d better go warn Ivory!
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya aku pergi memperingatkan
Ivory!

entries.original:
"[red][player], I forgot to show you
something!

Please come with me to the
SES Expressway."
entries.translation_source: [red][player], I forgot to show you something! Please come with me to the SES Expressway.
entries.translated:
[red][player], aku lupa menunjukkan
sesuatu padamu! Tolong ikut aku ke\lSES Expressway.

entries.original:
"Oh man, I haven’t seen anyone beat
Big Mo in a while, let alone clear\lthe Ring Challenge!

Well done!
You’ve proven your toughness!

Take this Gem to improve it even
further!"
entries.translation_source: Oh man, I haven’t seen anyone beat Big Mo in a while, let alone clear the Ring Challenge! Well done! You’ve proven your toughness! Take this Gem to improve it even further!
entries.translated:
Oh, aku sudah lama tidak melihat
orang mengalahkan Big Mo, apalagi\lmenyelesaikan Tantangan Ring!

Bagus! Kamu sudah membuktikan
ketangguhanmu! Ambil Permata ini\luntuk meningkatkannya lebih jauh!

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Fighting-type move in battle.

If you use it, you’ll seem tougher
than you already are!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Fighting-type move in battle. If you use it, you’ll seem tougher than you already are!
entries.translated:
Permata yang kuberikan padamu dapat
memperkuat satu serangan tipe\lPetarung dalam pertempuran. Jika

kamu menggunakannya, kamu akan
terlihat lebih tangguh dari\lsebelumnya!

entries.original:
"Maybe I should go back to
Antisis City.

I’m out of my depth in here."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should go back to Antisis City. I’m out of my depth in here.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku harus kembali ke
Antisis City. Aku tidak cocok di\lsini.

entries.original:
"Your skill makes my rubber gear
seem useless.

Maybe I should invest in a more
expensive brand."
entries.translation_source: Your skill makes my rubber gear seem useless. Maybe I should invest in a more expensive brand.
entries.translated:
Kemampuanmu membuat peralatan
karetku terlihat tidak berguna.\lMungkin aku harus berinvestasi di

merek yang lebih mahal.

entries.original:
"Youngsters like you\.
No respect for their elders."
entries.translation_source: Youngsters like you\. No respect for their elders.
entries.translated:
Anak muda sepertimu\. Tidak hormat
pada yang lebih tua.

entries.original:
"Bellin Town

A quiet town nestled deep in the
mountains."
entries.translation_source: Bellin Town A quiet town nestled deep in the mountains.
entries.translated:
Kota Bellin, sebuah kota kecil yang
tersembunyi di pegunungan.

entries.original:
"Trainer House
Battle to your heart’s content!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer House Battle to your heart’s content!
entries.translated: Rumah Pelatih, bertarung sepuasnya!

entries.original:
"Did you know there is a special
Poké Ball that heals Pokémon?

When you capture a Pokémon, all
damage done to it is undone!

Here, try some!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know there is a special Poké Ball that heals Pokémon? When you capture a Pokémon, all damage done to it is undone! Here, try some!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tahu ada Poké Ball
khusus yang menyembuhkan Pokémon?\lSaat kamu menangkap Pokémon, semua

kerusakan yang diterimanya akan
hilang! Ini, cobalah!

entries.original:
"Use them in good health!
Heh, heh, see what I did there?"
entries.translation_source: Use them in good health! Heh, heh, see what I did there?
entries.translated:
Gunakan dengan sehat! Heh, heh,
lihat apa yang aku lakukan?

entries.original:
"That is Hoopa!
That is Hoopa!

You are the Guardian of Borrius!
Take the Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: That is Hoopa! That is Hoopa! You are the Guardian of Borrius! Take the Master Ball!
entries.translated:
Itu Hoopa! Itu Hoopa! Kamu adalah
Penjaga Borrius! Ambil Master Ball!

entries.original:
"Then, I have no time for you.
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Then, I have no time for you. Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, aku tidak punya waktu
untukmu. Pergi! Pergi!

entries.original: "Let’s go, Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: Let’s go, Staraptor.
entries.translated: Ayo, Staraptor.

entries.original:
"Dresco Town

The archipelago of the Borrius
Region."
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town The archipelago of the Borrius Region.
entries.translated:
Kota Dresco, kepulauan dari Wilayah
Borrius.

entries.original:
"Cinder Volcano
Passage"
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano Passage
entries.translated: Jalur Gunung Berapi Cinder

entries.original:
"Crater Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Vega\lThe Double Agent."
entries.translation_source: Crater Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Vega The Double Agent.
entries.translated:
Kota Crater, Pemimpin Gym Pokémon:
Vega, Agen Ganda.

entries.original: "The door is locked."
entries.translation_source: The door is locked.
entries.translated: Pintu terkunci.

entries.original: "SES Expressway"
entries.translation_source: SES Expressway
entries.translated: SES Expressway

entries.original:
"That is not Hoopa!

I have no time for you!
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: That is not Hoopa! I have no time for you! Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Itu bukan Hoopa! Aku tidak punya
waktu untukmu! Pergi! Pergi!

entries.original:
"Guardian of Borrius!
It is pleasure being in your midst!"
entries.translation_source: Guardian of Borrius! It is pleasure being in your midst!
entries.translated:
Penjaga Borrius! Merupakan suatu
kesenangan berada di\ltengah-tengahmu!

entries.original:
"Blizzard City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Alice\lThe High Flying Ice Queen."
entries.translation_source: Blizzard City Pokémon Gym Leader: Alice The High Flying Ice Queen.
entries.translated:
Kota Blizzard, Pemimpin Gym
Pokémon: Alice, Ratu Es yang\lTerbang Tinggi.

entries.original:
"Blizzard City
The chilly mountain city."
entries.translation_source: Blizzard City The chilly mountain city.
entries.translated:
Kota Blizzard Kota pegunungan yang
dingin.

entries.original:
"This lighthouse was once a beacon
of hope for tourists.

But ever since Antisis City was
turned into a crime-filled slum,\ltourists have stopped coming to\lthis port."
entries.translation_source: This lighthouse was once a beacon of hope for tourists. But ever since Antisis City was turned into a crime-filled slum, tourists have stopped coming to this port.
entries.translated:
Mercusuar ini dulunya adalah
mercusuar harapan bagi para\lwisatawan. Namun sejak Kota Antisis

berubah menjadi kawasan kumuh penuh
kejahatan, para wisatawan berhenti\ldatang ke pelabuhan ini.

entries.original:
"There are plenty of different
healing methods available to you\lin the mansion.

It’s honestly a little redundant\."
entries.translation_source: There are plenty of different healing methods available to you in the mansion. It’s honestly a little redundant\.
entries.translated:
Ada banyak metode penyembuhan
berbeda yang tersedia untukmu di\lmansion. Sejujurnya ini agak

redundan\.

entries.original:
" different
healing methods available to you\lin the mansion.

It’s honestly a little redundant\."
entries.translation_source: different healing methods available to you in the mansion. It’s honestly a little redundant\.
entries.translated:
metode penyembuhan berbeda yang
tersedia untukmu di mansion.\lSejujurnya ini agak redundan\.

entries.original:
"I’m responsible for gathering the
daily ingredients."
entries.translation_source: I’m responsible for gathering the daily ingredients.
entries.translated:
Aku bertanggung jawab mengumpulkan
bahan-bahan harian.

entries.original: "Which way will you choose to go?"
entries.translation_source: Which way will you choose to go?
entries.translated: Jalan mana yang akan kamu pilih?

entries.original:
"Hahhh!
I have no need for HM slaves!

I will keep smashing rocks with
my bare hands!"
entries.translation_source: Hahhh! I have no need for HM slaves! I will keep smashing rocks with my bare hands!
entries.translated:
Hahhh! Aku tidak butuh budak HM!
Aku akan terus menghancurkan batu\ldengan tangan kosong!

entries.original:
"No matter how fast you run, we’ll
be there to stop you!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how fast you run, we’ll be there to stop you!
entries.translated:
Secepat apa pun kamu berlari, kami
akan ada di sana untuk\lmenghentikanmu!

entries.original:
"Even though I lost, I’m still
very happy!

The cavern is glowing with the
fires of passion!"
entries.translation_source: Even though I lost, I’m still very happy! The cavern is glowing with the fires of passion!
entries.translated:
Meskipun aku kalah, aku tetap
sangat senang! Gua itu bersinar\ldengan api semangat!

entries.original:
"It appears I need to spend more
time honing my clairvoyance."
entries.translation_source: It appears I need to spend more time honing my clairvoyance.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku perlu meluangkan
lebih banyak waktu untuk mengasah\lkewaskitaanku.

entries.original:
"The last Guardian of Borrius, [green]Aros[blue],
tasked several older couples with\lguarding rare or powerful objects.

We are one such couple.

Another couple, I believe, lives on
Route 9."
entries.translation_source: The last Guardian of Borrius, [green]Aros[blue], tasked several older couples with guarding rare or powerful objects. We are one such couple. Another couple, I believe, lives on Route 9.
entries.translated:
Penjaga terakhir Borrius, [green]Aros[blue],
menugaskan beberapa pasangan yang\llebih tua untuk menjaga benda

langka atau kuat. Kami adalah salah
satu pasangan itu. Pasangan lain,\laku yakin, tinggal di Route 9.

entries.original: "[black]Lapras: [green]Prasss!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Lapras: [green]Prasss!
entries.translated: [black]Lapras: [green]Prasss!

entries.original:
"There was a Pokémon hiding under
the lily pad!

The Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: There was a Pokémon hiding under the lily pad! The Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
Ada seekor Pokémon bersembunyi di
bawah daun teratai! Pokémon itu\lmenyerang!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] dove back into the
pond."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] dove back into the pond.
entries.translated: [buffer1] menyelam kembali ke kolam.

entries.original:
"Oh, you finally made it.

My head started hurting again while
waiting for you to show up.

I hope you can make my return to
the Gym, worth it."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you finally made it. My head started hurting again while waiting for you to show up. I hope you can make my return to the Gym, worth it.
entries.translated:
Oh, akhirnya kamu sampai. Kepalaku
mulai sakit lagi saat menunggumu\lmuncul. Aku harap kamu bisa membuat

kembaliku ke Gym menjadi sepadan.

entries.original:
"Well then, I guess you should take
the [green]Fall Badge[blue].

You sure earned it."
entries.translation_source: Well then, I guess you should take the [green]Fall Badge[blue]. You sure earned it.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, kurasa kamu harus
mengambil [green]Fall Badge[blue]. Kamu pasti\lpantas mendapatkannya.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Fall Badge
from Mel!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Fall Badge from Mel!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Fall Badge dari
Mel!

entries.original:
"With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon
up to Lv. 60 will obey you.

It also allows your Pokémon to
move heavy boulders with [green]Strength[blue].

Honestly, I don’t know why any
strong Pokémon can’t already do\lthis\.

But what can you do?

That’s just the way the world
works.

Anyways, take this TM to go along
with that badge. "
entries.translation_source: With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon up to Lv. 60 will obey you. It also allows your Pokémon to move heavy boulders with [green]Strength[blue]. Honestly, I don’t know why any strong Pokémon can’t already do this\. But what can you do? That’s just the way the world works. Anyways, take this TM to go along with that badge.
entries.translated:
Dengan Fall Badge, Pokémon apa pun
hingga Lv. 60 akan mematuhimu. Ini\ljuga memungkinkan Pokémon-mu

memindahkan batu besar dengan
[green]Kekuatan[blue]. Sejujurnya, aku tidak\ltahu mengapa Pokémon kuat mana pun

belum bisa melakukan ini\. Tapi mau
bagaimana lagi? Begitulah cara\ldunia bekerja. Pokoknya, ambil TM

ini sebagai pelengkap lencana itu.

entries.original:
"TM42 contains [green]Facade[blue].

If your Pokémon has a status
condition, this move’ll get twice\las powerful.

Even stronger than Mega Punch!

Use it, and make your enemies
regret inflicting you with status!"
entries.translation_source: TM42 contains [green]Facade[blue]. If your Pokémon has a status condition, this move’ll get twice as powerful. Even stronger than Mega Punch! Use it, and make your enemies regret inflicting you with status!
entries.translated:
TM42 berisi [green]Fasad[blue]. Jika Pokémon-mu
memiliki kondisi status, jurus ini\lakan menjadi dua kali lebih kuat.

Bahkan lebih kuat dari Pukulan
Mega! Gunakan itu, dan buat musuhmu\lmenyesal telah memberimu status!

entries.original:
"Now that you’ve beaten me, here
comes another splitting headache\."
entries.translation_source: Now that you’ve beaten me, here comes another splitting headache\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang setelah kamu
mengalahkanku, datang lagi sakit\lkepala yang luar biasa\.

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!
How go the battles?

Welcome to the Fallshore City Gym!

Have some Fresh Water, straight
from the ponds of this Gym."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! How go the battles? Welcome to the Fallshore City Gym! Have some Fresh Water, straight from the ponds of this Gym.
entries.translated:
Juara yang sedang berkembang!
Bagaimana pertarungannya? Selamat\ldatang di Gym Fallshore City!

Silakan ambil Air Segar, langsung
dari kolam Gym ini.

entries.original:
"Mel?
Well, he’s just a normal guy!

Punching him or his Pokémon with
some powerful [green]Fighting[blue]-types is a\lgood way to take him down.

If you’re ready to battle, start by
sliding down the slide next to me!

But make sure you’re stocked up on
supplies first.

There’s no going back until you
reach Mel."
entries.translation_source: Mel? Well, he’s just a normal guy! Punching him or his Pokémon with some powerful [green]Fighting[blue]-types is a good way to take him down. If you’re ready to battle, start by sliding down the slide next to me! But make sure you’re stocked up on supplies first. There’s no going back until you reach Mel.
entries.translated:
Mel? Yah, dia pria biasa!
Memukulnya atau Pokémonnya dengan\lbeberapa [green]Fighting[blue] yang kuat adalah

cara yang baik untuk
mengalahkannya. Jika kamu siap\lbertarung, mulailah dengan meluncur

menuruni seluncuran di sebelahku!
Tapi pastikan kamu sudah membekali\ldiri dengan perlengkapan dulu.

Tidak ada jalan kembali sampai kamu
mencapai Mel.

entries.original:
"Bravo!

Mel took quite a beating, didn’t
he?

I bet he’d have taken an even worse
one, had you had this Gem."
entries.translation_source: Bravo! Mel took quite a beating, didn’t he? I bet he’d have taken an even worse one, had you had this Gem.
entries.translated:
Bravo! Mel mendapat pukulan
lumayan, bukan? Aku yakin dia akan\lmendapat yang lebih buruk lagi,

jika kamu memiliki Gem ini.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Normal-type move in battle.

Normal-type moves may not be
Super-Effective against anything,\lbut with that Gem, they can sure\lfeel like they are!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Normal-type move in battle. Normal-type moves may not be Super-Effective against anything, but with that Gem, they can sure feel like they are!
entries.translated:
Gem yang kuberikan padamu bisa
memperkuat satu gerakan tipe Normal\ldalam pertempuran. Gerakan tipe

Normal mungkin tidak Super Efektif
terhadap apa pun, tapi dengan Gem\litu, mereka pasti terasa seperti

itu!

entries.original:
"You should stock up on [green]revives[red]!

They heal a fainted Pokémon back
to half health!"
entries.translation_source: You should stock up on [green]revives[red]! They heal a fainted Pokémon back to half health!
entries.translated:
Kamu harus membeli [green]Revive[red]! Mereka
menyembuhkan Pokémon yang pingsan\lkembali ke setengah kesehatan!

entries.original:
"I must study this mountain
some more.

My knowledge is insufficient."
entries.translation_source: I must study this mountain some more. My knowledge is insufficient.
entries.translated:
Aku harus mempelajari gunung ini
lebih lanjut. Pengetahuanku tidak\lcukup.

entries.original:
"Be careful when climbing the rock
walls, the fall can be treacherous."
entries.translation_source: Be careful when climbing the rock walls, the fall can be treacherous.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati saat memanjat dinding
batu, jatuhnya bisa berbahaya.

entries.original:
"I guess I need to train more to
match Galavan."
entries.translation_source: I guess I need to train more to match Galavan.
entries.translated:
Kurasa aku perlu berlatih lebih
banyak untuk menyamai Galavan.

entries.original:
"The electric barrier blocks you
from passing through."
entries.translation_source: The electric barrier blocks you from passing through.
entries.translated:
Penghalang listrik menghalangimu
untuk melewatinya.

entries.original:
"The electric barrier has been
disengaged."
entries.translation_source: The electric barrier has been disengaged.
entries.translated:
Penghalang listrik telah
dinonaktifkan.

entries.original:
"The path through this mountain is
exhausting, isn’t it?

Let me heal you up so you can
continue on, worry free!"
entries.translation_source: The path through this mountain is exhausting, isn’t it? Let me heal you up so you can continue on, worry free!
entries.translated:
Jalan melalui gunung ini
melelahkan, bukan? Biarkan aku\lmenyembuhkanmu agar kamu bisa

melanjutkan perjalanan tanpa
khawatir!

entries.original:
"If you’re working on a Pokédex,
visit Thundercap Mountain.

All sorts of rare Electric Pokémon
live there.

It’s even said that Zapdos roosts
at the peak!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re working on a Pokédex, visit Thundercap Mountain. All sorts of rare Electric Pokémon live there. It’s even said that Zapdos roosts at the peak!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu sedang mengerjakan
Pokédex, kunjungi Gunung\lThundercap. Segala jenis Pokémon

Listrik langka tinggal di sana.
Bahkan dikatakan bahwa Zapdos\lbersarang di puncaknya!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out here
often with some of his closer,\l\qofriends\qc."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out here often with some of his closer, \qofriends\qc.
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, sering datang ke
sini dengan beberapa \qoteman\qc\ldekatnya.

entries.original:
"Apparently Mel has his own private
island somewhere out in the ocean!"
entries.translation_source: Apparently Mel has his own private island somewhere out in the ocean!
entries.translated:
Rupanya Mel memiliki pulau
pribadinya sendiri di suatu tempat\ldi lautan!

entries.original:
"Are you up to no good?

\.

Just checking.

There’s no telling when a ruffian
will sneak past the gate check."
entries.translation_source: Are you up to no good? \. Just checking. There’s no telling when a ruffian will sneak past the gate check.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu berbuat jahat? \. Hanya
memeriksa. Tidak ada yang tahu\lkapan seorang penjahat akan

menyelinap melewati pos pemeriksaan
gerbang.

entries.original: "Wiped out in an instant\."
entries.translation_source: Wiped out in an instant\.
entries.translated: Dihancurkan dalam sekejap\.

entries.original:
"This guy with red hair just came
out of nowhere and obliterated all\lof my Pokémon before I even had a\lchance to react!"
entries.translation_source: This guy with red hair just came out of nowhere and obliterated all of my Pokémon before I even had a chance to react!
entries.translated:
Orang berambut merah ini muncul
entah dari mana dan menghancurkan\lsemua Pokémonku bahkan sebelum aku

sempat bereaksi!

entries.original:
"Route 11

\al Fallshore City
\ar Epidimy Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 11 \al Fallshore City \ar Epidimy Town
entries.translated:
Rute 11 \al Fallshore City \ar Epidimy
Town

entries.original:
"Route 1

\au Frozen Heights
\ad Bellin Town, Icicle Cave"
entries.translation_source: Route 1 \au Frozen Heights \ad Bellin Town, Icicle Cave
entries.translated:
Rute 1 \au Frozen Heights \ad Bellin
Town, Icicle Cave

entries.original:
"Route 1

\au Frozen Heights, Icicle Cave
\ad Bellin Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 1 \au Frozen Heights, Icicle Cave \ad Bellin Town
entries.translated:
Rute 1 \au Frozen Heights, Icicle
Cave \ad Bellin Town

entries.original:
"Route 2

\al Dresco Town
\ar Icicle Cave"
entries.translation_source: Route 2 \al Dresco Town \ar Icicle Cave
entries.translated: Rute 2 \al Kota Dresco \ar Gua Icicle

entries.original: "Research Lab"
entries.translation_source: Research Lab
entries.translated: Laboratorium Penelitian

entries.original:
"Afterlife, Shadow Base,
Great Desert, Gurun Town"
entries.translation_source: Afterlife, Shadow Base, Great Desert, Gurun Town
entries.translated:
Afterlife, Markas Bayangan, Gurun
Besar, Kota Gurun

entries.original:
"Route 5

\au Route 4
\ad Crater Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 5 \au Route 4 \ad Crater Town
entries.translated: Rute 5 \au Rute 4 \ad Kota Crater

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is located on the
\qoThundercap Highland\qc.

But if you came to see the
lightning storms, you’re out of\lluck.

Those only happen to the east of
here, by Epidimy Town."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is located on the \qoThundercap Highland\qc. But if you came to see the lightning storms, you’re out of luck. Those only happen to the east of here, by Epidimy Town.
entries.translated:
Kota Tarmigan terletak di \qoDataran
Tinggi Thundercap\qc. Tapi jika kamu\ldatang untuk melihat badai petir,

kamu kurang beruntung. Itu hanya
terjadi di sebelah timur sini,\ldekat Kota Epidimy.

entries.original:
"My family has owned Tarmigan
Mansion for generations.

In fact, my ancestors were
responsible for the formation of\lTarmigan Town itself!

As such, I like to sit out here and
watch the town every now and then.

Don’t just sit around like me,
youngster.

Carpe diem, child!
Seize the day!"
entries.translation_source: My family has owned Tarmigan Mansion for generations. In fact, my ancestors were responsible for the formation of Tarmigan Town itself! As such, I like to sit out here and watch the town every now and then. Don’t just sit around like me, youngster. Carpe diem, child! Seize the day!
entries.translated:
Keluargaku telah memiliki Puri
Tarmigan selama beberapa generasi.\lFaktanya, nenek moyangku

bertanggung jawab atas terbentuknya
Kota Tarmigan sendiri! Oleh karena\litu, aku suka duduk di sini dan

mengamati kota dari waktu ke waktu.
Jangan hanya duduk diam seperti\laku, anak muda. Carpe diem, nak!

Raih harinya!

entries.original:
"Someone has been experimenting
today\."
entries.translation_source: Someone has been experimenting today\.
entries.translated:
Seseorang telah bereksperimen hari
ini\.

entries.original:
"Yo, wazzup fella?

Howzit goin’?

The name’s Galavan.

If ya couldn’t tell, I’m the Gym
Leader here.

I’m sure ya had a tough time
making your way across the\lshocking floor, didn’t ya?

Well, don’t fret, ’cause you
won’t have to fight at a\ldisadvantage anymore."
entries.translation_source: Yo, wazzup fella? Howzit goin’? The name’s Galavan. If ya couldn’t tell, I’m the Gym Leader here. I’m sure ya had a tough time making your way across the shocking floor, didn’t ya? Well, don’t fret, ’cause you won’t have to fight at a disadvantage anymore.
entries.translated:
Yo, apa kabar sobat? Gimana
kabarnya? Namaku Galavan. Kalau\lkamu belum tahu, aku adalah

Pemimpin Gym di sini. Aku yakin
kamu kesulitan melewati lantai yang\lmengejutkan itu, kan? Yah, jangan

khawatir, karena kamu tidak perlu
bertarung dalam posisi tidak\ldiuntungkan lagi.

entries.original:
"Ever since ancient times, the
mythical Pokémon Darkrai has\lhaunted this town.

It is said, every night when the
clock strikes one, he comes out\lto haunt the dreams of the masses.

Be wary, child!
Don’t fall into the dark void!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since ancient times, the mythical Pokémon Darkrai has haunted this town. It is said, every night when the clock strikes one, he comes out to haunt the dreams of the masses. Be wary, child! Don’t fall into the dark void!
entries.translated:
Sejak zaman kuno, Pokémon mistis
Darkrai telah menghantui kota ini.\lDikatakan, setiap malam saat jam

menunjukkan pukul satu, ia keluar
untuk menghantui mimpi orang-orang.\lHati-hati, nak! Jangan jatuh ke

dalam kegelapan hampa!

entries.original:
"of the masses.

Be wary, child!
Don’t fall into the dark void!"
entries.translation_source: of the masses. Be wary, child! Don’t fall into the dark void!
entries.translated:
dari orang-orang. Hati-hati, nak!
Jangan jatuh ke dalam kegelapan\lhampa!

entries.original:
"If I can’t slow you down, at least
this room will."
entries.translation_source: If I can’t slow you down, at least this room will.
entries.translated:
Jika aku tidak bisa memperlambatmu,
setidaknya ruangan ini bisa.

entries.original: "[black]Chansey: [red]Seyyyy!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Chansey: [red]Seyyyy!
entries.translated: [black]Chansey: [red]Seyyyy!

entries.original:
"Suprisingly, you can’t catch any
[green]Voltorb[blue] here.

I hear they’re only found in one of
the Gyms."
entries.translation_source: Suprisingly, you can’t catch any [green]Voltorb[blue] here. I hear they’re only found in one of the Gyms.
entries.translated:
Yang mengejutkan, kamu tidak bisa
menangkap [green]Voltorb[blue] di sini. Kudengar\lmereka hanya ditemukan di salah

satu Gym.

entries.original:
"I hope none of the other grunts
fell off the mountain\."
entries.translation_source: I hope none of the other grunts fell off the mountain\.
entries.translated:
Semoga tidak ada preman lain yang
jatuh dari gunung\.

entries.original:
"If those tremors mean what I think
they mean\."
entries.translation_source: If those tremors mean what I think they mean\.
entries.translated:
Jika getaran itu artinya seperti
yang kukira\.

entries.original:
"Now I can’t get back up the ladder,
no matter how hard I try."
entries.translation_source: Now I can’t get back up the ladder, no matter how hard I try.
entries.translated:
Sekarang aku tidak bisa naik
kembali ke tangga, tidak peduli\lsekeras apa pun aku berusaha.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [red]Uh oh!

[player]’s hot on our tails!

I’d better go warn Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [red]Uh oh! [player]’s hot on our tails! I’d better go warn Marlon!
entries.translated:
Preman: [red]Uh oh! [player] mengikuti
kita dari belakang! Lebih baik aku\lperingatkan Marlon!

entries.original:
"Me? No, I’m not lost.
I live here!"
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not lost. I live here!
entries.translated:
Aku? Tidak, aku tidak tersesat. Aku
tinggal di sini!

entries.original:
"Whew\. I better take a rest\.

Groan\.

That volcano takes a lot out of
you!

Let me heal your Pokémon so you
don’t get tired too."
entries.translation_source: Whew\. I better take a rest\. Groan\. That volcano takes a lot out of you! Let me heal your Pokémon so you don’t get tired too.
entries.translated:
Whew\. Lebih baik aku istirahat\.
Erangan\. Gunung berapi itu sangat\lmenguras tenagamu! Biarkan aku

menyembuhkan Pokémonmu agar kamu
tidak ikut lelah.

entries.original: "Take care of yourself."
entries.translation_source: Take care of yourself.
entries.translated: Jaga dirimu baik-baik.

entries.original:
"[blue]Quick!

Grab her now!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Quick! Grab her now!
entries.translated: [blue]Cepat! Tangkap dia sekarang!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I’m really sorry sir, those
people you asked me to guard\lfound some Pokémon and escaped."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]I’m really sorry sir, those people you asked me to guard found some Pokémon and escaped.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Maaf, Pak, orang-orang yang
Anda minta saya jaga menemukan\lbeberapa Pokémon dan melarikan

diri.

entries.original: "???: [blue]FOOL!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]FOOL!
entries.translated: ???: [blue]BODOH!

entries.original:
"Auburn Waterway

\au Route 6, Valley Cave
\ad Route 10"
entries.translation_source: Auburn Waterway \au Route 6, Valley Cave \ad Route 10
entries.translated:
Jalur Air Auburn \au Rute 6, Gua
Lembah \ad Rute 10

entries.original: "Power Grid"
entries.translation_source: Power Grid
entries.translated: Jaringan Listrik

entries.original: "Rest Room"
entries.translation_source: Rest Room
entries.translated: Kamar Istirahat

entries.original:
"Dream Research Lab

We study your dreams."
entries.translation_source: Dream Research Lab We study your dreams.
entries.translated:
Lab Penelitian Mimpi Kami
mempelajari mimpi Anda.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]No sir, I don’t. But it was
just a small mistake.

I promise, it won’t happen again."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]No sir, I don’t. But it was just a small mistake. I promise, it won’t happen again.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Tidak, Pak. Tapi itu hanya
kesalahan kecil. Saya janji, tidak\lakan terulang lagi.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Marlon, I need you to send
someone to obtain the weekly\lsupplies from the Poké Mart.

Make sure they also obtain a
special package that is arriving\ltoday.

It’s critical for our operation to
capture specimen UNO."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Marlon, I need you to send someone to obtain the weekly supplies from the Poké Mart. Make sure they also obtain a special package that is arriving today. It’s critical for our operation to capture specimen UNO.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Marlon, saya perlu Anda
mengirim seseorang untuk mengambil\lperlengkapan mingguan dari Poké

Mart. Pastikan mereka juga
mengambil paket khusus yang tiba\lhari ini. Ini penting untuk operasi

kami menangkap spesimen UNO.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]On it."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]On it.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Siap.

entries.original: "[blue]Grunt!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Grunt!
entries.translated: [blue]Grunt!

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir?"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir?
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Ya, Pak?

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]\.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Right away."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Right away.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Segera.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Ya, Pak!

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Anything else?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Anything else?
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Ada lagi?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Once that grunt has obtained
that package, take it, and use it\lto capture specimen UNO."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Once that grunt has obtained that package, take it, and use it to capture specimen UNO.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Setelah grunt itu mendapatkan
paket tersebut, ambil, dan gunakan\luntuk menangkap spesimen UNO.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]As for you, I’m going to make
an example out of you.

It’s time you pay for your blunder."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]As for you, I’m going to make an example out of you. It’s time you pay for your blunder.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Sedangkan untukmu, aku akan
menjadikanmu sebagai contoh. Sudah\lsaatnya kau membayar atas

kesalahanmu.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]No! Please!
I’m really sorry!\lI’ll do anything to fix this!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]No! Please! I’m really sorry! I’ll do anything to fix this!
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Tidak! Tolong! Maaf! Aku
akan lakukan apa saja untuk\lmemperbaikinya!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Houndoom, incinerate this
piece of trash."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Houndoom, incinerate this piece of trash.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Houndoom, bakar habis sampah
ini.

entries.original: "Here, take some potions."
entries.translation_source: Here, take some potions.
entries.translated: Ini, ambil beberapa Potion.

entries.original:
"But let’s see how ya do in a
sandstorm!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: But let’s see how ya do in a sandstorm! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Tapi lihat saja bagaimana kau
bertahan dalam badai pasir! Ha ha\lha!

entries.original:
"Man\.

You sure zapped me silly!

Take the [green]Zap Badge[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Man\. You sure zapped me silly! Take the [green]Zap Badge[blue]!
entries.translated:
Bung\. Kau benar-benar menyetrumku
habis-habisan! Ambil [green]Zap Badge[blue] ini!

entries.original:
"But I’m too scared to go home as
long as there are trainers around\lhere who haven’t been beaten\."
entries.translation_source: But I’m too scared to go home as long as there are trainers around here who haven’t been beaten\.
entries.translated:
Tapi aku terlalu takut pulang
selama masih ada pelatih di sekitar\lsini yang belum dikalahkan\.

entries.original:
"I hear there’s a Pokémon that has
mushrooms growing on its back.

Not around here, though.
I wonder if they taste any good?"
entries.translation_source: I hear there’s a Pokémon that has mushrooms growing on its back. Not around here, though. I wonder if they taste any good?
entries.translated:
Kudengar ada Pokémon yang tumbuh
jamur di punggungnya. Tapi bukan di\lsini. Aku penasaran apakah rasanya

enak?

entries.original:
"Speaking of crying, I’m positive I
heard before\."
entries.translation_source: Speaking of crying, I’m positive I heard before\.
entries.translated:
Bicara soal menangis, aku yakin
pernah mendengarnya sebelumnya\.

entries.original:
"I’m playing hide-and-seek here.
I like some underground tag, too."
entries.translation_source: I’m playing hide-and-seek here. I like some underground tag, too.
entries.translated:
Aku main petak umpet di sini. Aku
juga suka main kejar-kejaran bawah\ltanah.

entries.original:
"I got separated from my friends\.

I’ve got my Pokémon with me so
I’m okay, but\."
entries.translation_source: I got separated from my friends\. I’ve got my Pokémon with me so I’m okay, but\.
entries.translated:
Aku terpisah dari teman-temanku\. Aku
membawa Pokémon-ku jadi aku\lbaik-baik saja, tapi\.

entries.original:
"I just wanted to have a picnic in
Thundercap Mt.

I didn’t think I would get lost
in a place like this\."
entries.translation_source: I just wanted to have a picnic in Thundercap Mt. I didn’t think I would get lost in a place like this\.
entries.translated:
Aku hanya ingin piknik di
Thundercap Mt. Aku tidak menyangka\lakan tersesat di tempat seperti ini\.

entries.original:
"Why have a picnic here?
I don’t know.

There’s no deep meaning to it."
entries.translation_source: Why have a picnic here? I don’t know. There’s no deep meaning to it.
entries.translated:
Kenapa piknik di sini? Entahlah.
Tidak ada makna mendalam di\lbaliknya.

entries.original:
"I’m not lost, I tell you!
I’m camping! That’s my story!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not lost, I tell you! I’m camping! That’s my story!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tersesat, kubilang! Aku
berkemah! Itulah ceritaku!

entries.original:
"I’m Milo\.

I was catching Pokémon, and then
I got lost\.

I’m so scared\.

Please!
Please take me to the exit!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Milo\. I was catching Pokémon, and then I got lost\. I’m so scared\. Please! Please take me to the exit!
entries.translated:
Aku Milo\. Aku sedang menangkap
Pokémon, lalu tersesat\. Aku sangat\ltakut\. Tolong! Tolong antar aku ke

pintu keluar!

entries.original: "[player] decided to go with Milo!"
entries.translation_source: [player] decided to go with Milo!
entries.translated:
[player] memutuskan untuk pergi
bersama Milo!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy
all the time!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy all the time!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menjaga Pokémon-mu tetap
sehat setiap saat!

entries.original:
"Oh\.
I’m so scared\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. I’m so scared\.
entries.translated: Oh\. Aku sangat takut\.

entries.original:
"I like useful moves like Growl and
Tail Whip.

Those are my favourites."
entries.translation_source: I like useful moves like Growl and Tail Whip. Those are my favourites.
entries.translated:
Aku suka jurus berguna seperti
Raung dan Gebukan Ekor. Itu\lfavoritku.

entries.original:
"The mountain\.
It’s so easy to get confused.

Do you know where we are?"
entries.translation_source: The mountain\. It’s so easy to get confused. Do you know where we are?
entries.translated:
Gunung\. Sangat mudah bingung. Kau
tahu kita di mana?

entries.original:
"[player], did you get to be
so good because you’re always\lwith your Pokémon?

Yes! That has to be it!
Milo will try like you!"
entries.translation_source: [player], did you get to be so good because you’re always with your Pokémon? Yes! That has to be it! Milo will try like you!
entries.translated:
[player], apakah kau menjadi begitu
hebat karena selalu bersama\lPokémon-mu? Ya! Pasti itu! Milo

akan berusaha sepertimu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh! There’s the ladder!

I want to get tougher so I
won’t be such a scaredy-cat.

[player], bye-bye!
Thank you!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh! There’s the ladder! I want to get tougher so I won’t be such a scaredy-cat. [player], bye-bye! Thank you!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh! Itu tangganya! Aku ingin
menjadi lebih kuat agar tidak\lmenjadi penakut. [player], bye-bye!

Terima kasih!

entries.original:
"It appears Milo has left something
behind\."
entries.translation_source: It appears Milo has left something behind\.
entries.translated: Tampaknya Milo meninggalkan sesuatu\.

entries.original:
"People assume just because I’m a
Super Nerd, I’m required to do\lnerdy things.

I can study rocks if I want to!

Nobody can tell me who I have
to be!"
entries.translation_source: People assume just because I’m a Super Nerd, I’m required to do nerdy things. I can study rocks if I want to! Nobody can tell me who I have to be!
entries.translated:
Orang-orang beranggapan hanya
karena aku seorang Super Nerd, aku\lharus melakukan hal-hal kutu buku.

Aku bisa mempelajari batu jika aku
mau! Tidak ada yang bisa menentukan\laku harus jadi apa!

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn my Electric-types
were acting funny until they were\lknocked out\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn my Electric-types were acting funny until they were knocked out\.
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah Pokémon Tipe
Listrikku bertingkah aneh sampai\lmereka KO\.

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]No\.Electivire\.please!
Why are you acting like this?"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [blue]No\.Electivire\.please! Why are you acting like this?
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Tidak\.Electivire\.kumohon!
Kenapa kau bersikap seperti ini?

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.why don’t you
go back in your Poké Ball?

Yes\.come on, now\.return!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.why don’t you go back in your Poké Ball? Yes\.come on, now\.return!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.kenapa kau tidak
kembali ke Poké Ball-mu? Ya\.ayo,\lsekarang\.kembali!

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Oh\.come on, Electivire\.
don’t knock your ball away\."
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [blue]Oh\.come on, Electivire\. don’t knock your ball away\.
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Oh\.ayo, Electivire\. jangan
lempar bola-mu pergi\.

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.that could’ve
killed me!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.that could’ve killed me!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.itu bisa saja
membunuhku!

entries.original:
"[blue]Help!

Somebody help me!

My Electivire’s gone rogue!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Help! Somebody help me! My Electivire’s gone rogue!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tolong! Seseorang tolong aku!
Electivire-ku menjadi liar!

entries.original: "Would you like to protect the nerd?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to protect the nerd?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin melindungi si
Nerd?

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Thank you!
Thank you for protecting me!

Now, please, battle my Electivire
and bring it back to its senses!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [blue]Thank you! Thank you for protecting me! Now, please, battle my Electivire and bring it back to its senses!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Terima kasih! Terima kasih
telah melindungiku! Sekarang,\ltolong, bertarunglah dengan

Electivire-ku dan buat dia sadar
kembali!

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire!
Come back!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [blue]Electivire! Come back!
entries.translated: Nerd: [blue]Electivire! Kembalilah!

entries.original: "[blue]And he’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]And he’s gone\.
entries.translated: [blue]Dan dia pergi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Please\.you were kind enough to
protect me\.so please, chase after\lmy Electivire!

He’s the only friend I have\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Please\.you were kind enough to protect me\.so please, chase after my Electivire! He’s the only friend I have\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kumohon\.kau cukup baik untuk
melindungiku\.jadi tolong, kejar\lElectivire-ku! Dia satu-satunya

teman yang kumiliki\.

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.please\.just
listen to me\.

Return to your Poké Ball!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.please\.just listen to me\. Return to your Poké Ball!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.kumohon\.dengarkan
aku\. Kembali ke Poké Ball-mu!

entries.original:
"[blue]I owe you one for helping my
Electivire.

I can’t give you anything here, so
meet me in the [green]Epidimy Town\lPokémon Centre [blue]if you want a\lreward for your help."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I owe you one for helping my Electivire. I can’t give you anything here, so meet me in the [green]Epidimy Town Pokémon Centre [blue]if you want a reward for your help.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku berhutang budi padamu karena
telah membantu Electivire-ku. Aku\ltidak bisa memberikan apa pun di

sini, jadi temui aku di [green]Epidimy
Town Pokémon Centre [blue]jika kamu ingin\lhadiah atas bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"???: [red]Epidimy Town you say\.

Then I must head there\.for the
sake of science\."
entries.translation_source: ???: [red]Epidimy Town you say\. Then I must head there\.for the sake of science\.
entries.translated:
???: [red]Epidimy Town katamu\. Maka aku
harus pergi ke sana\.demi ilmu\lpengetahuan\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
I didn’t expect to see you here!

Shouldn’t you be running errands
for Log or something?

\.

Oh, so you are running an errand\.

That cheapskate\.can’t do anything
himself\."
entries.translation_source: [player]! I didn’t expect to see you here! Shouldn’t you be running errands for Log or something? \. Oh, so you are running an errand\. That cheapskate\.can’t do anything himself\.
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku tidak menyangka
melihatmu di sini! Bukankah\lseharusnya kau menjalankan tugas

untuk Log atau sesuatu? \. Oh, jadi
kau sedang menjalankan tugas\. Si\lpelit itu\.tidak bisa melakukan apa

pun sendiri\.

entries.original:
"What’s that?
Log gave you something for me?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Log gave you something for me?
entries.translated:
Apa itu? Log memberimu sesuatu
untukku?

entries.original:
"[player] handed the Pokedex
over to [rival]."
entries.translation_source: [player] handed the Pokedex over to [rival].
entries.translated:
[player] menyerahkan Pokedex kepada
[rival].

entries.original:
"Oh, great.

Now Log’s voice’ll never stop
echoing in my head."
entries.translation_source: Oh, great. Now Log’s voice’ll never stop echoing in my head.
entries.translated:
Oh, bagus. Sekarang suara Log tidak
akan pernah berhenti bergema di\lkepalaku.

entries.original:
"Well, if Log has you filling this
out, let’s see if you’ve gotten any\lstronger because of it!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if Log has you filling this out, let’s see if you’ve gotten any stronger because of it!
entries.translated:
Nah, jika Log menyuruhmu mengisi
ini, mari kita lihat apakah kau\lmenjadi lebih kuat karenanya!

entries.original:
"Well, if Log has you filling this
out, let’s see if your Pokémon can\lbeat mine this time."
entries.translation_source: Well, if Log has you filling this out, let’s see if your Pokémon can beat mine this time.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, jika Log menyuruhmu
mengisi ini, mari kita lihat apakah\lPokémon-mu bisa mengalahkan

Pokémon-ku kali ini.

entries.original:
"Yeah, I guess I can help fill this
thing out.

If it leads to me becoming
stronger, I’ll take it.

When I find my parents they’ll be
amazed at how far I’ve come.

Next time our paths cross, the
outcome of our battle won’t be the\lsame!

I promise you that!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, I guess I can help fill this thing out. If it leads to me becoming stronger, I’ll take it. When I find my parents they’ll be amazed at how far I’ve come. Next time our paths cross, the outcome of our battle won’t be the same! I promise you that!
entries.translated:
Ya, kurasa aku bisa membantu
mengisi ini. Jika ini membuatku\lsemakin kuat, aku akan menerimanya.

Saat aku menemukan orang tuaku,
mereka akan takjub melihat sejauh\lmana aku telah berkembang. Lain

kali kita bertemu, hasil
pertarungan kita tidak akan sama!\lAku janji!

entries.original:
"Aha!

I’ve cornered you!

After that battle, you’re too weak
to escape!

Now, return the food you stole!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! I’ve cornered you! After that battle, you’re too weak to escape! Now, return the food you stole!
entries.translated:
Aha! Aku telah menjebakmu! Setelah
pertarungan itu, kamu terlalu lemah\luntuk kabur! Sekarang, kembalikan

makanan yang kau curi!

entries.original:
"Huh, what’s this?

Have you been stealing my food for
your friends and family?"
entries.translation_source: Huh, what’s this? Have you been stealing my food for your friends and family?
entries.translated:
Hah, apa ini? Apa kau mencuri
makananku untuk teman dan\lkeluargamu?

entries.original:
"That cry\.

I’ve heard it somewhere before\.

Ah!

You must be one of those rare Ice-
type Sandslash that lives up here!

Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped
coming to feed you?

Now that I mention it, I haven’t
seen them around in a while\."
entries.translation_source: That cry\. I’ve heard it somewhere before\. Ah! You must be one of those rare Ice- type Sandslash that lives up here! Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped coming to feed you? Now that I mention it, I haven’t seen them around in a while\.
entries.translated:
Tangisan itu\. Aku pernah
mendengarnya di suatu tempat\lsebelumnya\. Ah! Kau pasti salah satu

dari Sandslash tipe Es langka yang
tinggal di sini! Apakah Pokémon\lRangers berhenti datang untuk

memberimu makan? Sekarang kusebut,
aku sudah lama tidak melihat mereka\ldi sekitar\.

entries.original:
"Then I was right.

You’ve been hungry because your
food supply stopped coming.

Let me make you a deal then,
Sandslash.

If you become my Pokémon and help
me make an income through battling,\lI will support you, your friends,\land your family through the money\lwe make.

Does that work for you?"
entries.translation_source: Then I was right. You’ve been hungry because your food supply stopped coming. Let me make you a deal then, Sandslash. If you become my Pokémon and help me make an income through battling, I will support you, your friends, and your family through the money we make. Does that work for you?
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu aku benar. Kamu lapar
karena pasokan makanannya berhenti.\lBiar aku buat kesepakatan denganmu,

Sandslash. Jika kau menjadi
Pokémon-ku dan membantu aku mencari\lnafkah melalui pertarungan, aku

akan mendukungmu, teman-temanmu,
dan keluargamu dengan uang yang\lkita hasilkan. Apakah itu cocok

untukmu?

entries.original: "Then it’s settled, let’s go."
entries.translation_source: Then it’s settled, let’s go.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu sudah sepakat, ayo
pergi.

entries.original:
"Thanks for helping track down the
food thief!

As promised, here’s your little
something."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for helping track down the food thief! As promised, here’s your little something.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah membantu melacak
pencuri makanan! Seperti yang\ldijanjikan, ini hadiah kecil

untukmu.

entries.original:
"That TM contains [green]Hone Claws[blue].

If you plan on challenging the
[green]Dresco Gym[blue], it’ll help you a lot.

It’s very foggy and hard to see in
there\."
entries.translation_source: That TM contains [green]Hone Claws[blue]. If you plan on challenging the [green]Dresco Gym[blue], it’ll help you a lot. It’s very foggy and hard to see in there\.
entries.translated:
TM itu berisi [green]Cakar Gila[blue]. Jika kamu
berencana menantang [green]Gym Dresco[blue], itu\lakan sangat membantumu. Di dalam

sana sangat berkabut dan sulit
melihat\.

entries.original: "Hello, good citizen!"
entries.translation_source: Hello, good citizen!
entries.translated: Halo, warga yang baik!

entries.original:
"Oh, I remember you!

You’re that [buffer1] who assisted us in
the Dresco Town Gym!

For that, you can have these
five Revives."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I remember you! You’re that [buffer1] who assisted us in the Dresco Town Gym! For that, you can have these five Revives.
entries.translated:
Oh, aku ingat kamu! Kamu adalah
[buffer1] yang membantu kami di Gym\lDresco Town! Untuk itu, kamu bisa

mendapatkan lima Revive ini.

entries.original:
"Say, would you like to help out by
assisting the police again?"
entries.translation_source: Say, would you like to help out by assisting the police again?
entries.translated:
Hei, apakah kamu ingin membantu
dengan membantu polisi lagi?

entries.original:
"Would you like to lend a hand to
the local police force?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to lend a hand to the local police force?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin membantu
kepolisian setempat?

entries.original:
"Don’t you know its rude to barge in
on someone else’s meeting?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you know its rude to barge in on someone else’s meeting?
entries.translated:
Tidakkah kamu tahu itu tidak sopan
masuk ke pertemuan orang lain?

entries.original:
"Goon 1: [blue]Huh?
It’s some punk kid!

Let’s rough [buffer2] up and steal [buffer1]
cash!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 1: [blue]Huh? It’s some punk kid! Let’s rough [buffer2] up and steal [buffer1] cash!
entries.translated:
Goon 1: [blue]Hah? Itu anak punk! Ayo
kita main hakimi [buffer2] dan curi\luang [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Goon 2: [blue]Yeah, we’ll make [buffer2] cry
for [buffer1] mommy!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 2: [blue]Yeah, we’ll make [buffer2] cry for [buffer1] mommy!
entries.translated:
Goon 2: [blue]Ya, kita akan buat [buffer2]
menangis minta [buffer1] mama!

entries.original:
"Goon 1: [blue]I wanna hear you snivel,
kid!

We’re gonna beat you so hard
you’re never gonna forget us!

The Terror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 1: [blue]I wanna hear you snivel, kid! We’re gonna beat you so hard you’re never gonna forget us! The Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
Goon 1: [blue]Aku ingin mendengarmu
merengek, nak! Kami akan\lmenghajarmu habis-habisan sampai

kamu tidak akan pernah melupakan
kami! The Terror Granbull!

entries.original: "Cop: [blue]You’re all under arrest!"
entries.translation_source: Cop: [blue]You’re all under arrest!
entries.translated: Polisi: [blue]Kalian semua ditahan!

entries.original:
"Goon 2: [blue]Oh man, it’s the popo!

Scatter, boys!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 2: [blue]Oh man, it’s the popo! Scatter, boys!
entries.translated:
Goon 2: [blue]Oh astaga, itu polisi!
Bubar, kawan-kawan!

entries.original:
"[blue]Darn\.
They got away\.

They can’t have gone far.
Let’s split up and look for them."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Darn\. They got away\. They can’t have gone far. Let’s split up and look for them.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sial\. Mereka kabur\. Mereka pasti
belum pergi jauh. Ayo kita berpisah\ldan cari mereka.

entries.original:
"Hey!
You there!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! You there!
entries.translated: Hei! Kamu di sana!

entries.original:
"It’s you!
That punk kid from before!

Not so tough now, huh?

Without the police, you’re just
some pathetic wimp!

And pathetic wimps gotta cry!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you! That punk kid from before! Not so tough now, huh? Without the police, you’re just some pathetic wimp! And pathetic wimps gotta cry!
entries.translated:
Itu kamu! Anak nakal dari tadi!
Tidak begitu tangguh sekarang, ya?\lTanpa polisi, kamu hanya seorang

pengecut menyedihkan! Dan pengecut
menyedihkan harus menangis!

entries.original:
"[black]Cop: [blue]You’re under arrest for
several felonies.

You’re coming with me."
entries.translation_source: [black]Cop: [blue]You’re under arrest for several felonies. You’re coming with me.
entries.translated:
[black]Polisi: [blue]Kamu ditangkap karena
beberapa kejahatan berat. Kamu ikut\ldengan saya.

entries.original:
"In Borrius, it is well known that
thugs and hoodlums are mainly\lconfined to Antisis City.

However, one of the gangs from
there, the \qoTerror Granbull\qc,\lseems to have left that area.

We’ve received several reports
lately about some of their members\lcongregating and causing trouble\lon [green]Route 10[blue].

Our police force is spread fairly
thin at the moment, and any extra\lhelp rounding up these goons would\lbe much appreciated.

I’ll ask you again.

Would you like to lend a hand to
the local police force?"
entries.translation_source: In Borrius, it is well known that thugs and hoodlums are mainly confined to Antisis City. However, one of the gangs from there, the \qoTerror Granbull\qc, seems to have left that area. We’ve received several reports lately about some of their members congregating and causing trouble on [green]Route 10[blue]. Our police force is spread fairly thin at the moment, and any extra help rounding up these goons would be much appreciated. I’ll ask you again. Would you like to lend a hand to the local police force?
entries.translated:
Di Borrius, diketahui bahwa preman
dan penjahat sebagian besar\lterbatas di Antisis City. Namun,

salah satu geng dari sana, \qoTerror
Granbull\qc, tampaknya telah\lmeninggalkan area itu. Kami

menerima beberapa laporan
akhir-akhir ini tentang beberapa\langgota mereka berkumpul dan

menyebabkan masalah di [green]Rute 10[blue].
Pasukan polisi kami saat ini cukup\ltipis, dan bantuan tambahan untuk

menangkap para preman ini akan
sangat dihargai. Aku akan bertanya\llagi. Apakah kamu ingin membantu

kepolisian setempat?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Welcome, [player].

We’ve been expecting you."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Welcome, [player]. We’ve been expecting you.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Selamat datang, [player].
Kami sudah menantikanmu.

entries.original:
"[red]I want you to watch what is about
to happen."
entries.translation_source: [red]I want you to watch what is about to happen.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku ingin kamu menyaksikan apa yang
akan terjadi.

entries.original:
"[red]Now, Harth, please be cooperative
and hand over the void stone.

If you don’t, I can’t guarantee
your wife’s safety\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Now, Harth, please be cooperative and hand over the void stone. If you don’t, I can’t guarantee your wife’s safety\.
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang, Harth, tolong bersikap
kooperatif dan serahkan batu void.\lJika tidak, aku tidak bisa menjamin

keselamatan istrimu\.

entries.original:
"Wife: [red]Don’t do it! If you hand it
over, we’ll all be doomed!"
entries.translation_source: Wife: [red]Don’t do it! If you hand it over, we’ll all be doomed!
entries.translated:
Istri: [red]Jangan lakukan itu! Jika kau
serahkan, kita semua akan binasa!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Silence you old hag!

Keep your head out of what doesn’t
concern you."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Silence you old hag! Keep your head out of what doesn’t concern you.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Diam kau perempuan tua!
Jangan ikut campur urusan yang\lbukan bagianmu.

entries.original:
"Harth: [blue]I’m sorry dear, but I can’t
let them harm you.

If the world ends because of my
actions, then so be it."
entries.translation_source: Harth: [blue]I’m sorry dear, but I can’t let them harm you. If the world ends because of my actions, then so be it.
entries.translated:
Harth: [blue]Maaf sayang, tapi aku tidak
bisa membiarkan mereka menyakitimu.\lJika dunia berakhir karena

tindakanku, biarlah.

entries.original: "[blue]Here, take it."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Here, take it.
entries.translated: [blue]Ini, ambillah.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Thanks, Harth.

You’ve just helped us pave the way
to doing the impossible\.

It’s too bad that you won’t live
long enough to see it."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Thanks, Harth. You’ve just helped us pave the way to doing the impossible\. It’s too bad that you won’t live long enough to see it.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Terima kasih, Harth. Kamu
baru saja membantu kami membuka\ljalan menuju hal yang mustahil\.

Sayang sekali kamu tidak akan hidup
cukup lama untuk melihatnya.

entries.original: "Harth: [blue]Wait, huh\.?"
entries.translation_source: Harth: [blue]Wait, huh\.?
entries.translated: Harth: [blue]Tunggu, hah\.?

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Zap Badge from
Galavan!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Zap Badge from Galavan!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Lencana Zap dari
Galavan!

entries.original:
"Ah, thank you for your assistance.

When you are prepared, meet me at
the east side of [green]Route 10[blue], just up\lthe first set of stairs you see.

I recommend making sure your
Pokémon are healed up."
entries.translation_source: Ah, thank you for your assistance. When you are prepared, meet me at the east side of [green]Route 10[blue], just up the first set of stairs you see. I recommend making sure your Pokémon are healed up.
entries.translated:
Ah, terima kasih atas bantuanmu.
Jika sudah siap, temui aku di sisi\ltimur [green]Rute 10[blue], tepat di atas tangga

pertama yang kamu lihat. Aku
sarankan pastikan Pokémon-mu sudah\ldipulihkan.

entries.original:
"The power of evolution\.
It compels me to give this to you!"
entries.translation_source: The power of evolution\. It compels me to give this to you!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan evolusi\. Itu mendorongku
untuk memberikan ini kepadamu!

entries.original:
"I’m not talking to you.
You’re too mean."
entries.translation_source: I’m not talking to you. You’re too mean.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak berbicara denganmu. Kamu
terlalu jahat.

entries.original:
"I may feel compelled to give you
something tomorrow, as well."
entries.translation_source: I may feel compelled to give you something tomorrow, as well.
entries.translated:
Aku mungkin akan merasa terdorong
untuk memberikan sesuatu kepadamu\lbesok juga.

entries.original:
"Please, return as many times as
you wish.

As long as you have [green]Yellow Shards[red],
of course."
entries.translation_source: Please, return as many times as you wish. As long as you have [green]Yellow Shards[red], of course.
entries.translated:
Silakan, kembali sebanyak yang kamu
mau. Selama kamu memiliki [green]Pecahan\lKuning[red], tentu saja.

entries.original: "Distortion World"
entries.translation_source: Distortion World
entries.translated: Dunia Distorsi

entries.original: "[green]Dollllll!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Dollllll!
entries.translated: [green]Dollllll!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his head
by the SES Expressway in Tehl Town."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head by the SES Expressway in Tehl Town.
entries.translated:
Mel, Pimpinan Gym, sedang tidak ada
di sini. Dia mungkin pergi\lmenjernihkan pikiran di dekat Jalan

Bebas Hambatan SES di Kota Tehl.
