entries.original: "Here, take these!"
entries.translation_source: Here, take these!
entries.translated: Ini, ambillah!

entries.original:
"One of Professor Log’s Aides who
lives in Tehl Town will give you a\lgift if you’ve captured enough\lPokémon.

I hope those help you fill up your
Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: One of Professor Log’s Aides who lives in Tehl Town will give you a gift if you’ve captured enough Pokémon. I hope those help you fill up your Pokédex!
entries.translated:
Salah satu Asisten Profesor Log
yang tinggal di Kota Tehl akan\lmemberimu hadiah jika kamu sudah

menangkap cukup banyak Pokémon.
Semoga itu membantu mengisi\lPokédex-mu!

entries.original: "Hey there! Please, enjoy this gift!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there! Please, enjoy this gift!
entries.translated: Hei! Silakan, nikmati hadiah ini!

entries.original:
"There are a few Pokémon in this
area that only evolve via a Water\lStone."
entries.translation_source: There are a few Pokémon in this area that only evolve via a Water Stone.
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Pokémon di area ini
yang hanya berevolusi dengan Batu\lAir.

entries.original:
"Our forces will be spread thin for
the forseeable future.

If you would like to lend a hand,
it will always be appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Our forces will be spread thin for the forseeable future. If you would like to lend a hand, it will always be appreciated.
entries.translated:
Pasukan kami akan tersebar tipis
dalam waktu dekat. Jika Anda ingin\lmembantu, itu akan selalu dihargai.

entries.original:
"Good work, [player].

Now there’s one less criminal on
the loose.

Only [buffer1] left.

Keep searching while I take this
man back to the station."
entries.translation_source: Good work, [player]. Now there’s one less criminal on the loose. Only [buffer1] left. Keep searching while I take this man back to the station.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, [player]. Sekarang ada
satu penjahat yang lebih sedikit\lberkeliaran. Hanya [buffer1]

tersisa. Teruslah mencari sementara
saya membawa orang ini kembali ke\lkantor polisi.

entries.original:
"Good work, [player].

You appear to have apprehended all
of the goons.

Only their boss is still is at
large.

Let’s regroup on [green]Route 10[blue] by the
stairs to determine his location."
entries.translation_source: Good work, [player]. You appear to have apprehended all of the goons. Only their boss is still is at large. Let’s regroup on [green]Route 10[blue] by the stairs to determine his location.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, [player]. Kamu
tampaknya telah menangkap semua\lpreman. Hanya bos mereka yang masih

buron. Mari berkumpul kembali di
[green]Rute 10[blue] dekat tangga untuk\lmenentukan lokasinya.

entries.original:
"Hoo hah!

This little punk kid found me!

I’m gonna teach this punk kid a
little lesson!"
entries.translation_source: Hoo hah! This little punk kid found me! I’m gonna teach this punk kid a little lesson!
entries.translated:
Hoo hah! Anak nakal kecil ini
menemukanku! Aku akan mengajari\lanak nakal ini sebuah pelajaran!

entries.original:
"Heh, looks like the little
detective has come after me.

I’ll teach you not to cross the
Terror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: Heh, looks like the little detective has come after me. I’ll teach you not to cross the Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
Heh, sepertinya detektif kecil itu
datang mengejarku. Aku akan\lmengajarimu untuk tidak melawan

Terror Granbull!

entries.original:
"My hidden power is telling me that
you want this!"
entries.translation_source: My hidden power is telling me that you want this!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan tersembunyiku mengatakan
bahwa kamu menginginkan ini!

entries.original:
"In Borrius, the move Hidden Power,
has a Base Power of 70.

So no matter what type it is, it’ll
always do the same amount of harm!"
entries.translation_source: In Borrius, the move Hidden Power, has a Base Power of 70. So no matter what type it is, it’ll always do the same amount of harm!
entries.translated:
Di Borrius, jurus Kekuatan
Tersembunyi memiliki Kekuatan Dasar\l70. Jadi tidak peduli tipe apa pun

itu, akan selalu memberikan
kerusakan yang sama!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader Mel lives here when
he’s not on Gym duty.

I just take care of his house for
him."
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader Mel lives here when he’s not on Gym duty. I just take care of his house for him.
entries.translated:
Pimpinan Gym Mel tinggal di sini
saat tidak bertugas di Gym. Aku\lhanya merawat rumahnya untuknya.

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated: Siap! Tetap aman di luar sana!

entries.original:
"They say the grass is always
greener on the other side.

That’s especially true in Epidimy
Town. Just look at the grass here!"
entries.translation_source: They say the grass is always greener on the other side. That’s especially true in Epidimy Town. Just look at the grass here!
entries.translated:
Mereka bilang rumput tetangga
selalu lebih hijau. Itu terutama\lbenar di Epidimy Town. Lihat saja

rumput di sini!

entries.original:
"He’s sleeping peacefully on the
bench.

Better leave him alone."
entries.translation_source: He’s sleeping peacefully on the bench. Better leave him alone.
entries.translated:
Dia tidur nyenyak di bangku.
Sebaiknya biarkan dia sendiri.

entries.original:
"Ahh\.

I love coming out here every day
and relaxing on this bench.

It’s always the most enjoyable part
of my day."
entries.translation_source: Ahh\. I love coming out here every day and relaxing on this bench. It’s always the most enjoyable part of my day.
entries.translated:
Ahh\. Aku suka datang ke sini setiap
hari dan bersantai di bangku ini.\lItu selalu menjadi bagian paling

menyenangkan dari hariku.

entries.original:
"Antisis City Port

\al Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Antisis City Port \al Antisis City
entries.translated:
Pelabuhan Kota Antisis \al Kota
Antisis

entries.original:
"Epidimy town is the epitome of
bliss!

\.

\.

What? You don’t think its funny?
Sorry\.

I feel bad now\.

You know what? Take these. It’ll
help me feel better."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy town is the epitome of bliss! \. \. What? You don’t think its funny? Sorry\. I feel bad now\. You know what? Take these. It’ll help me feel better.
entries.translated:
Epidimy Town adalah lambang
kebahagiaan! \. \. Apa? Kamu tidak\lmenganggapnya lucu? Maaf\. Aku merasa

bersalah sekarang\. Kamu tahu? Ambil
ini. Ini akan membantuku merasa\llebih baik.

entries.original:
"I wish our town had a better name
to make a joke of."
entries.translation_source: I wish our town had a better name to make a joke of.
entries.translated:
Aku berharap kota kita punya nama
yang lebih baik untuk dijadikan\lbahan lelucon.

entries.original:
"Punk kid!

Prepare to face the terrors of the
Terror Granbull!

\.

That sounded better in my head\."
entries.translation_source: Punk kid! Prepare to face the terrors of the Terror Granbull! \. That sounded better in my head\.
entries.translated:
Anak punk! Bersiaplah menghadapi
kengerian dari Terror Granbull! \.\lKedengarannya lebih baik di

kepalaku\.

entries.original:
"I’m Lily, President of the Skiers
Club.

I’m warning you, I’m not easy to
beat!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Lily, President of the Skiers Club. I’m warning you, I’m not easy to beat!
entries.translated:
Aku Lily, Presiden Klub Ski. Aku
peringatkan kamu, aku tidak mudah\ldikalahkan!

entries.original:
"resident of the Skiers
Club.

I’m warning you, I’m not easy to
beat!"
entries.translation_source: resident of the Skiers Club. I’m warning you, I’m not easy to beat!
entries.translated:
Aku seorang anggota Klub Ski. Aku
peringatkan kamu, aku tidak mudah\ldikalahkan!

entries.original:
"Oh yeah?

Well my Miltank is super powerful,
too!

I got it on Route 10!
You’re going down!"
entries.translation_source: Oh yeah? Well my Miltank is super powerful, too! I got it on Route 10! You’re going down!
entries.translated:
Oh ya? Nah Miltank-ku juga sangat
kuat! Aku mendapatkannya di Route\l10! Kamu akan kalah!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] disappeared into the
ruins."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] disappeared into the ruins.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] menghilang ke dalam
reruntuhan.

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mountain can be accessed
through that hole down the stairs.

It’s really dangerous, so if you
go, make sure you have lots of\lrevives and Paralyze Heals!"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mountain can be accessed through that hole down the stairs. It’s really dangerous, so if you go, make sure you have lots of revives and Paralyze Heals!
entries.translated:
Gunung Thundercap bisa diakses
melalui lubang itu di bawah tangga.\lTempat itu sangat berbahaya, jadi

jika kamu pergi, pastikan kamu
punya banyak Revive dan Obat\lLumpuh!

entries.original:
"I really wanna explore Thundercap
Mountain!

But my mommy says it’s too
dangerous ’cause there are a bunch\lof bad men on the other side."
entries.translation_source: I really wanna explore Thundercap Mountain! But my mommy says it’s too dangerous ’cause there are a bunch of bad men on the other side.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat ingin menjelajahi Gunung
Thundercap! Tapi ibuku bilang itu\lterlalu berbahaya karena ada banyak

orang jahat di sisi lain.

entries.original:
"Great job!

You rounded up all four of those
Terror Granbull goons.

However, their leader is still at
large.

I wonder where he could be\.
Maybe back in Antisis City?"
entries.translation_source: Great job! You rounded up all four of those Terror Granbull goons. However, their leader is still at large. I wonder where he could be\. Maybe back in Antisis City?
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus! Kamu berhasil
mengumpulkan keempat preman Terror\lGranbull itu. Namun, pemimpin

mereka masih buron. Aku penasaran
di mana dia berada\. Mungkin kembali\ldi Antisis City?

entries.original:
"[black]???: [blue]Hahaha!

I, the great G-Roughs, haven’t gone
anywhere!"
entries.translation_source: [black]???: [blue]Hahaha! I, the great G-Roughs, haven’t gone anywhere!
entries.translated:
[black]???: [blue]Hahaha! Aku, G-Roughs yang
hebat, belum pergi ke mana pun!

entries.original:
"[black]Cop: [blue]Stop!

You’re under arrest for
several felonies.

You’re coming with me."
entries.translation_source: [black]Cop: [blue]Stop! You’re under arrest for several felonies. You’re coming with me.
entries.translated:
[black]Polisi: [blue]Berhenti! Kamu ditangkap
karena beberapa kejahatan. Kamu\likut denganku.

entries.original:
"[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha!
Good luck trying!

As for you, punk kid, you did
alright beating my goons.

But you’ll find I’m not as much of
a weakling!

Let’s see what you got!"
entries.translation_source: [black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha! Good luck trying! As for you, punk kid, you did alright beating my goons. But you’ll find I’m not as much of a weakling! Let’s see what you got!
entries.translated:
[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha! Cobalah saja!
Sedangkan untukmu, anak punk, kamu\llumayan mengalahkan

preman-premanku. Tapi kamu akan
lihat aku bukan orang lemah! Mari\llihat kemampuanmu!

entries.original:
"[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha!

Just because you beat me, it
doesn’t mean I’m turning myself in!

I’m hopping on the next boat to
East Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: [black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha! Just because you beat me, it doesn’t mean I’m turning myself in! I’m hopping on the next boat to East Borrius!
entries.translated:
[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha! Hanya karena kamu
mengalahkanku, bukan berarti aku\lakan menyerahkan diri! Aku akan

naik kapal berikutnya ke East
Borrius!

entries.original:
"Thanks for all your help,
[player].

I’ll radio my colleagues in
Seaport City so he can’t escape\lthrough there.

Anyway, here’s a reward for a model
citizen such as yourself."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for all your help, [player]. I’ll radio my colleagues in Seaport City so he can’t escape through there. Anyway, here’s a reward for a model citizen such as yourself.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih atas semua bantuanmu,
[player]. Aku akan menghubungi\lrekan-rekanku di Seaport City agar

dia tidak bisa melarikan diri
melalui sana. Omong-omong, ini\lhadiah untuk warga teladan

sepertimu.

entries.original:
"I’m looking forward to solving more
cases with you in the future.

Until then, stay safe and be
vigilant."
entries.translation_source: I’m looking forward to solving more cases with you in the future. Until then, stay safe and be vigilant.
entries.translated:
Aku menantikan untuk memecahkan
lebih banyak kasus bersamamu di\lmasa depan. Sampai saat itu, tetap

aman dan waspada.

entries.original:
"I come here every day to pray to
Zapdos.

Zapdos saved me once, and I can
never thank it enough."
entries.translation_source: I come here every day to pray to Zapdos. Zapdos saved me once, and I can never thank it enough.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini setiap hari
untuk berdoa kepada Zapdos. Zapdos\lpernah menyelamatkanku, dan aku

tidak bisa cukup berterima kasih
padanya.

entries.original:
"We girls make Mel feel
better when he’s down."
entries.translation_source: We girls make Mel feel better when he’s down.
entries.translated:
Kami para gadis membuat Mel merasa
lebih baik ketika dia sedih.

entries.original:
"I wonder if you’ll figure out the
way from here?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder if you’ll figure out the way from here?
entries.translated:
Aku penasaran apakah kamu akan
menemukan jalan dari sini?

entries.original:
"Mel surrounds himself with as many
beautiful women as he can to\lalleviate the stress of the\lpounding waterfall behind him."
entries.translation_source: Mel surrounds himself with as many beautiful women as he can to alleviate the stress of the pounding waterfall behind him.
entries.translated:
Mel mengelilingi dirinya dengan
sebanyak mungkin wanita cantik\luntuk mengurangi stres dari gemuruh

air terjun di belakangnya.

entries.original:
"I may not be a woman, but I’m still
part of Mel’s fighting force!"
entries.translation_source: I may not be a woman, but I’m still part of Mel’s fighting force!
entries.translated:
Aku mungkin bukan wanita, tapi aku
masih bagian dari pasukan tempur\lMel!

entries.original:
"You’re pretty powerful, I’m
impressed!

You should make a career change and
join our club.

\.

What\.not interested?

Then at least take this!"
entries.translation_source: You’re pretty powerful, I’m impressed! You should make a career change and join our club. \. What\.not interested? Then at least take this!
entries.translated:
Kamu cukup kuat, aku terkesan! Kamu
harus ganti karier dan bergabung\ldengan klub kami. \. Apa\. tidak

tertarik? Kalau begitu setidaknya
ambil ini!

entries.original:
"We have plenty of Ice Gems here at
the Skiers Club.

They always stick to the bottoms of
our skis!"
entries.translation_source: We have plenty of Ice Gems here at the Skiers Club. They always stick to the bottoms of our skis!
entries.translated:
Kami punya banyak Permata Es di
sini di Klub Pemain Ski. Mereka\lselalu menempel di dasar ski kami!

entries.original:
"I’ve watched over this port ever
since the once glorious Antisis\lCity stood proud\.

This port is all that remains of
that city\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve watched over this port ever since the once glorious Antisis City stood proud\. This port is all that remains of that city\.
entries.translated:
Aku telah menjaga pelabuhan ini
sejak Kota Antisis yang dulu megah\lberdiri dengan bangga\. Pelabuhan ini

adalah satu-satunya yang tersisa
dari kota itu\.

entries.original:
"Do you plan on exploring Thundercap
Mountain?

If you do, you’re going to need
these!"
entries.translation_source: Do you plan on exploring Thundercap Mountain? If you do, you’re going to need these!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu berencana menjelajahi
Gunung Thundercap? Jika iya, kamu\lakan membutuhkan ini!

entries.original:
"It never hurt to be prepared for
anything!"
entries.translation_source: It never hurt to be prepared for anything!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada salahnya selalu siap
untuk apa pun!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mountain is a dangerous
place!

I tried exploring it once, but oh
boy, I got smoked!

Ever since then, my lovely wife has
been giving Max Repels to any\ltravellers who talk to her."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mountain is a dangerous place! I tried exploring it once, but oh boy, I got smoked! Ever since then, my lovely wife has been giving Max Repels to any travellers who talk to her.
entries.translated:
Gunung Thundercap adalah tempat
yang berbahaya! Aku pernah mencoba\lmenjelajahinya sekali, tapi oh, aku

kewalahan! Sejak itu, istriku yang
manis telah memberikan Max Repel\lkepada setiap pelancong yang

berbicara dengannya.

entries.original:
"These boulders have been placed so
strategically!

It’s almost as if someone doesn’t
want people going this way\lright now\."
entries.translation_source: These boulders have been placed so strategically! It’s almost as if someone doesn’t want people going this way right now\.
entries.translated:
Batu-batu besar ini ditempatkan
dengan sangat strategis!\lSeolah-olah seseorang tidak ingin

orang-orang lewat sini sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Strength lets you move giant
boulders with raw power!

But only if you have the Fall
Badge from the Fallshore Gym!

Huah!"
entries.translation_source: Strength lets you move giant boulders with raw power! But only if you have the Fall Badge from the Fallshore Gym! Huah!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan memungkinkanmu memindahkan
batu raksasa dengan tenaga mentah!\lTapi hanya jika kamu memiliki

Lencana Fall dari Gym Fallshore!
Huah!

entries.original: "[player] found one Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: [player] found one Master Ball!
entries.translated:
[player] menemukan satu Master
Ball!

entries.original:
"Thief! Put that back!
That’s my prized possesion!"
entries.translation_source: Thief! Put that back! That’s my prized possesion!
entries.translated:
Pencuri! Kembalikan itu! Itu barang
berhargaku!

entries.original:
"Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis
Port is mainly used for the import\lof goods from other regions.

Once dropped off here, the goods
are moved along to Fallshore City\lwhere they can be distributed\lacross Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis Port is mainly used for the import of goods from other regions. Once dropped off here, the goods are moved along to Fallshore City where they can be distributed across Borrius.
entries.translated:
Tidak seperti Kota Seaport,
Pelabuhan Antisis terutama\ldigunakan untuk impor barang dari

wilayah lain. Setelah diturunkan di
sini, barang-barang tersebut\ldipindahkan ke Kota Fallshore di

mana barang-barang itu dapat
didistribusikan ke seluruh Borrius.

entries.original:
"The yellow barricades are moved
routinely throughout the day to\lcorrespond to the arrivals of\ldifferent shipments.

If you want to get to an area
that’s blocked off, you’ll just\lhave to come back later."
entries.translation_source: The yellow barricades are moved routinely throughout the day to correspond to the arrivals of different shipments. If you want to get to an area that’s blocked off, you’ll just have to come back later.
entries.translated:
Penghalang kuning dipindahkan
secara rutin sepanjang hari sesuai\ldengan kedatangan kiriman yang

berbeda. Jika kamu ingin pergi ke
area yang diblokir, kamu harus\lkembali lagi nanti.

entries.original:
"Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies
to Fallshore City during the day.

It’s too dangerous to move them
through Antisis City, which is why\lthis job exists."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies to Fallshore City during the day. It’s too dangerous to move them through Antisis City, which is why this job exists.
entries.translated:
Ya, akulah orang yang memindahkan
persediaan ke Kota Fallshore pada\lsiang hari. Terlalu berbahaya untuk

memindahkannya melalui Kota
Antisis, itulah mengapa pekerjaan\lini ada.

entries.original:
"Ya know what’s not fair?

That I have to go through a
rigourous screenin’ process just to\lbe let onto the port so I can work\levery day!

If it weren’t for those lunkheads in
Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be\lan issue."
entries.translation_source: Ya know what’s not fair? That I have to go through a rigourous screenin’ process just to be let onto the port so I can work every day! If it weren’t for those lunkheads in Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be an issue.
entries.translated:
Tahu apa yang tidak adil? Bahwa aku
harus melalui proses pemeriksaan\lyang ketat hanya untuk diizinkan

masuk ke pelabuhan agar aku bisa
bekerja setiap hari! Jika bukan\lkarena orang-orang bodoh di Kota

Antisis, ini bahkan tidak akan
menjadi masalah.

entries.original:
"You know the Pokémon Miltank?
That big adorable pink cow?

I’ve always wanted one, but they’re
just so hard to catch!

Would you be willing to trade one
for my [buffer2]?"
entries.translation_source: You know the Pokémon Miltank? That big adorable pink cow? I’ve always wanted one, but they’re just so hard to catch! Would you be willing to trade one for my [buffer2]?
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu Pokémon Miltank? Sapi
merah muda besar yang menggemaskan\litu? Aku selalu menginginkannya,

tapi mereka sangat sulit ditangkap!
Maukah kamu menukar satu dengan\l[buffer2]ku?

entries.original:
"Thank you so much! I’m going to
take good care of it!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much! I’m going to take good care of it!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih banyak! Aku akan
merawatnya dengan baik!

entries.original:
"I was taking inventory for the
berry shipments this morning, and\las usual, we have a surplus.

Why don’t you take a berry?"
entries.translation_source: I was taking inventory for the berry shipments this morning, and as usual, we have a surplus. Why don’t you take a berry?
entries.translated:
Aku sedang melakukan inventarisasi
untuk pengiriman buah beri pagi\lini, dan seperti biasa, kita punya

kelebihan. Mengapa kamu tidak
mengambil satu buah beri?

entries.original:
"Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency
to send a few extra berries.

There may be some more in
tomorrow’s shipment too.

I wonder how they don’t lose
money\."
entries.translation_source: Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency to send a few extra berries. There may be some more in tomorrow’s shipment too. I wonder how they don’t lose money\.
entries.translated:
Tropius Berries Inc. cenderung
mengirim beberapa buah beri\ltambahan. Mungkin ada lebih banyak

lagi di pengiriman besok. Aku heran
bagaimana mereka tidak rugi\.

entries.original:
"Night deliveries are by far better
than day deliveries.

Why?

For starters, there’s less ocean
traffic!"
entries.translation_source: Night deliveries are by far better than day deliveries. Why? For starters, there’s less ocean traffic!
entries.translated:
Pengiriman malam hari jauh lebih
baik daripada pengiriman siang\lhari. Kenapa? Pertama, lalu lintas

laut lebih sedikit!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Lava Cookie[blue] before?

If you take it, you won’t need a
Burn Heal!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [green]Lava Cookie[blue] before? If you take it, you won’t need a Burn Heal!
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mencoba [green]Lava Cookie[blue]
sebelumnya? Jika kamu memakannya,\lkamu tidak perlu Burn Heal!

entries.original:
"Pardon me\.

Would you care for an [green]Old Gateau[blue]?

Oui, oui, yes, you would."
entries.translation_source: Pardon me\. Would you care for an [green]Old Gateau[blue]? Oui, oui, yes, you would.
entries.translated:
Maafkan saya\. Apakah Anda mau [green]Old
Gateau[blue]? Oui, oui, ya, Anda mau.

entries.original:
"Quick!

Take a [green]Casteliacone[blue] before it
melts!"
entries.translation_source: Quick! Take a [green]Casteliacone[blue] before it melts!
entries.translated:
Cepat! Ambil [green]Casteliacone[blue] sebelum
meleleh!

entries.original:
"The city of lights and biscuits\.

Have this token of Lumiose City,
the [green]Lumiose Galette[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The city of lights and biscuits\. Have this token of Lumiose City, the [green]Lumiose Galette[blue].
entries.translated:
Kota cahaya dan biskuit\. Ambillah
tanda kenang-kenangan dari Kota\lLumiose ini, [green]Lumiose Galette[blue].

entries.original:
"The fact that you battled me, means
that you’re going the right way."
entries.translation_source: The fact that you battled me, means that you’re going the right way.
entries.translated:
Fakta bahwa kamu bertarung
denganku, berarti kamu menuju ke\larah yang benar.

entries.original: "5F: Medicine Box"
entries.translation_source: 5F: Medicine Box
entries.translated: Lt. 5: Kotak Obat

entries.original:
"Feel the power of Mega Evolution
when you bite into this [green]Shalour\lSable[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Feel the power of Mega Evolution when you bite into this [green]Shalour Sable[blue]!
entries.translated:
Rasakan kekuatan Mega Evolution
saat kamu menggigit [green]Shalour Sable[blue]\lini!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Big Malasada[blue]
before?

I hear it’s really good for the
heart.

Try some, straight from the Alola
region!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [green]Big Malasada[blue] before? I hear it’s really good for the heart. Try some, straight from the Alola region!
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mencoba [green]Big
Malasada[blue]? Kudengar itu sangat baik\luntuk jantung. Cobalah, langsung

dari daerah Alola!

entries.original:
"Feed the [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon with a status condition.

It’ll get all better, just like
that!"
entries.translation_source: Feed the [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon with a status condition. It’ll get all better, just like that!
entries.translated:
Berikan [green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon
yang mengalami kondisi status.\lPokémon itu akan sembuh total,

begitu saja!

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local
shipments today.

If you come by any other day of the
week, I may have souvenirs from\lvarious regions to give out."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local shipments today. If you come by any other day of the week, I may have souvenirs from various regions to give out.
entries.translated:
Maaf, nak, saya hanya membawa
kiriman lokal hari ini. Jika kamu\ldatang di hari lain dalam seminggu,

saya mungkin punya oleh-oleh dari
berbagai daerah untuk dibagikan.

entries.original:
"Yawn\.
These early morning are rough\.

I don’t know how you Borrian folk
do it\."
entries.translation_source: Yawn\. These early morning are rough\. I don’t know how you Borrian folk do it\.
entries.translated:
Menguap\. Pagi-pagi begini berat\. Aku
tidak tahu bagaimana kalian orang\lBorrius melakukannya\.

entries.original:
"I’ve got a shipment for one\.uh\.
Swomoli?

Man\.these names are hard to read
sometimes."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got a shipment for one\.uh\. Swomoli? Man\.these names are hard to read sometimes.
entries.translated:
Aku punya kiriman untuk satu\.uh\.
Swomoli? Wah\.nama-nama ini kadang\lsulit dibaca.

entries.original:
"A fresh batch of [green]Premier Balls[blue] has
just arrived!

Why don’t you take a few?
They’ll never notice\."
entries.translation_source: A fresh batch of [green]Premier Balls[blue] has just arrived! Why don’t you take a few? They’ll never notice\.
entries.translated:
Satu set [green]Premier Ball[blue] segar baru
saja tiba! Kenapa tidak kamu ambil\lbeberapa? Mereka tidak akan sadar\.

entries.original:
"I’ve always advocated for a smaller
Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio.

Ten to one? Are you kidding me?
Who even buys ten Poké Balls?"
entries.translation_source: I’ve always advocated for a smaller Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio. Ten to one? Are you kidding me? Who even buys ten Poké Balls?
entries.translated:
Aku selalu menganjurkan rasio Poké
Ball ke Premier Ball yang lebih\lkecil. Sepuluh banding satu? Kamu

bercanda? Siapa yang bahkan membeli
sepuluh Poké Ball?

entries.original:
"My [green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon!

I train them to smash the
[green]challenge rock[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: My [green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon! I train them to smash the [green]challenge rock[blue]!
entries.translated:
Pokémon tipe [green]Petarung[blue] milikku! Aku
melatih mereka untuk menghancurkan\l[green]batu tantangan[blue]!

entries.original:
"Okay, then!

Abra, use teleport!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, then! Abra, use teleport!
entries.translated: Baiklah! Abra, gunakan Teleport!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind,
come back.

We’ll be sitting here."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind, come back. We’ll be sitting here.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berubah pikiran,
kembalilah. Kami akan duduk di\lsini.

entries.original:
"There’s been this locked house near
[green]Tarmigan Mansion[red] for a really long\ltime.

I think it was once a small inn for
visitors of this town.

But it closed down after the guests
started suffering from horrendous\lnightmares."
entries.translation_source: There’s been this locked house near [green]Tarmigan Mansion[red] for a really long time. I think it was once a small inn for visitors of this town. But it closed down after the guests started suffering from horrendous nightmares.
entries.translated:
Sudah sejak lama ada rumah terkunci
di dekat [green]Tarmigan Mansion[red]. Aku\lpikir itu dulunya adalah sebuah

penginapan kecil untuk pengunjung
kota ini. Tapi tutup setelah para\ltamu mulai menderita mimpi buruk

yang mengerikan.

entries.original:
"Those are some hot hands ya got
there, fella!

You wannem to burn up with fiery
power?

I can teach your Pokémon [green]Fire
Punch[blue] for just [green]2 [buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Those are some hot hands ya got there, fella! You wannem to burn up with fiery power? I can teach your Pokémon [green]Fire Punch[blue] for just [green]2 [buffer1]s[blue]!
entries.translated:
Tanganmu panas sekali, kawan! Kamu
ingin mereka terbakar dengan\lkekuatan api? Aku bisa mengajari

Pokémonmu [green]Fire Punch[blue] hanya dengan [green]2
[buffer1]s[blue]!

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon is raring to fire up
their hands with [green]Fire Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is raring to fire up their hands with [green]Fire Punch[blue]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang bersemangat untuk
menghangatkan tangannya dengan [green]Fire\lPunch[blue]?

entries.original: "Fire power!"
entries.translation_source: Fire power!
entries.translated: Kekuatan api!

entries.original:
"Fizzle\.
You don’t have enough [green][buffer1]s[blue].

I can’t burn up those hands for
nothing\."
entries.translation_source: Fizzle\. You don’t have enough [green][buffer1]s[blue]. I can’t burn up those hands for nothing\.
entries.translated:
Fizzle\. Kamu tidak memiliki cukup
[green][buffer1]s[blue]. Aku tidak bisa membakar\ltangan-tangan itu tanpa imbalan\.

entries.original:
"Listen up, youngster.

That swindler over there is
constantly extorting [green]Red Shards[blue]\lfrom youngsters, like yourself.

Here, I stole a couple from his
collection for you to enjoy."
entries.translation_source: Listen up, youngster. That swindler over there is constantly extorting [green]Red Shards[blue] from youngsters, like yourself. Here, I stole a couple from his collection for you to enjoy.
entries.translated:
Dengar, nak. Penipu di sana
terus-menerus memeras [green]Pecahan Merah[blue]\ldari anak-anak sepertimu. Ini, aku

mencuri beberapa dari koleksinya
untukmu nikmati.

entries.original:
"I hold by the principle that it is
permitted to steal from thieves."
entries.translation_source: I hold by the principle that it is permitted to steal from thieves.
entries.translated:
Saya berpegang pada prinsip bahwa
mencuri dari pencuri itu\ldiperbolehkan.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should learn
[green]Thunder Punch[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should learn [green]Thunder Punch[red]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang harus mempelajari
[green]Pukulan Petir[red]?

entries.original:
"The door is tightly shut.
It appears impossible to open."
entries.translation_source: The door is tightly shut. It appears impossible to open.
entries.translated:
Pintu tertutup rapat. Tampaknya
tidak mungkin untuk dibuka.

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Inn\.
The text is too faded to read."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Inn\. The text is too faded to read.
entries.translated:
Penginapan Tarmigan\. Teksnya terlalu
pudar untuk dibaca.

entries.original: "It’s an ordinary statue."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ordinary statue.
entries.translated: Itu patung biasa.

entries.original:
"It’s a book detailing various
aspects of Mega Evolution."
entries.translation_source: It’s a book detailing various aspects of Mega Evolution.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah buku yang merinci
berbagai aspek Mega Evolusi.

entries.original:
"Rumour has it, if you can fight
your way through this mansion, you\lcan learn the valuable art of\lMega Evolution."
entries.translation_source: Rumour has it, if you can fight your way through this mansion, you can learn the valuable art of Mega Evolution.
entries.translated:
Konon, jika kamu bisa bertarung
melewati mansion ini, kamu bisa\lmempelajari seni berharga Mega

Evolusi.

entries.original:
"Somewhere in this house resides
Successor Maxima.

If you find you her, she’ll give
you something special."
entries.translation_source: Somewhere in this house resides Successor Maxima. If you find you her, she’ll give you something special.
entries.translated:
Di suatu tempat di rumah ini
tinggal Penerus Maxima. Jika kamu\lmenemukannya, dia akan memberimu

sesuatu yang istimewa.

entries.original:
"A switch is hidden in one of the
statues in the Mansion.

If you manage to find it, it will
open up a new passageway."
entries.translation_source: A switch is hidden in one of the statues in the Mansion. If you manage to find it, it will open up a new passageway.
entries.translated:
Sebuah saklar tersembunyi di salah
satu patung di Mansion. Jika kamu\lberhasil menemukannya, itu akan

membuka jalan baru.

entries.original:
"As chefs, it is our sworn duty to
prepare the finest quality food for\lthe master of this mansion.

That being Successor Maxima of
course."
entries.translation_source: As chefs, it is our sworn duty to prepare the finest quality food for the master of this mansion. That being Successor Maxima of course.
entries.translated:
Sebagai koki, tugas suci kami
adalah menyiapkan makanan kualitas\lterbaik untuk tuan mansion ini.

Tentu saja itu adalah Penerus
Maxima.

entries.original:
"I got stuck on dishes duty\.
What a drag\."
entries.translation_source: I got stuck on dishes duty\. What a drag\.
entries.translated:
Aku terjebak tugas cuci piring\.
Membosankan\.

entries.original:
"I’m cooking a meal fit for a king!
It’s called \qoBidoof Roussir.\qo"
entries.translation_source: I’m cooking a meal fit for a king! It’s called \qoBidoof Roussir.\qo
entries.translated:
Aku sedang memasak hidangan yang
layak untuk raja! Itu disebut\l\qoBidoof Roussir.\qo

entries.original:
"When I was kid, I started my own
cooking show.

It was called \qoCooking With Simon\qo,
or \qoCWS\qo for short."
entries.translation_source: When I was kid, I started my own cooking show. It was called \qoCooking With Simon\qo, or \qoCWS\qo for short.
entries.translated:
Saat aku masih kecil, aku memulai
acara memasak sendiri. Itu disebut\l\qoCooking With Simon\qo, atau \qoCWS\qo

untuk singkatnya.

entries.original:
"The Zap Badge let’s ya Surf over
both water and lava!

But not only that, any Pokémon
will also obey ya as long as it’s\lnot over level 70!

How electrifying is that?"
entries.translation_source: The Zap Badge let’s ya Surf over both water and lava! But not only that, any Pokémon will also obey ya as long as it’s not over level 70! How electrifying is that?
entries.translated:
Lencana Zap memungkinkanmu Selancar
di atas air dan lava! Tapi bukan\lhanya itu, Pokémon mana pun juga

akan mematuhimu asalkan levelnya
tidak di atas 70! Betapa\lmenggembirakan itu?

entries.original:
"Mega Evolution was first discovered
in the Kalos Region by the renowned\lProfessor Sycamore.

Thanks to his research, Pokémon
are now able to Mega Evolve\lmid-battle.

However, a large part of Mega
Evolution still remains a mystery."
entries.translation_source: Mega Evolution was first discovered in the Kalos Region by the renowned Professor Sycamore. Thanks to his research, Pokémon are now able to Mega Evolve mid-battle. However, a large part of Mega Evolution still remains a mystery.
entries.translated:
Mega Evolusi pertama kali ditemukan
di Wilayah Kalos oleh Profesor\lSycamore yang terkenal. Berkat

penelitiannya, Pokémon sekarang
dapat melakukan Mega Evolusi di\ltengah pertempuran. Namun, sebagian

besar Mega Evolusi masih tetap
menjadi misteri.

entries.original:
"Remember this: power corrupts, and
absolute power corrupts absolutely.

The same can be said about
Mega Evolution.

Be careful."
entries.translation_source: Remember this: power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely. The same can be said about Mega Evolution. Be careful.
entries.translated:
Ingat ini: kekuasaan mengkorupsi,
dan kekuasaan mutlak mengkorupsi\lsecara mutlak. Hal yang sama dapat

dikatakan tentang Mega Evolusi.
Berhati-hatilah.

entries.original:
"I need to grow even stronger to
surpass the others."
entries.translation_source: I need to grow even stronger to surpass the others.
entries.translated:
Aku perlu menjadi lebih kuat lagi
untuk melampaui yang lain.

entries.original:
"I’d say this point in the challenge
is around the mid-point."
entries.translation_source: I’d say this point in the challenge is around the mid-point.
entries.translated:
Menurutku, titik dalam tantangan
ini sekitar titik tengah.

entries.original:
"You’d better hope you have enough
healing items."
entries.translation_source: You’d better hope you have enough healing items.
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya kau berharap memiliki
cukup item penyembuh.

entries.original:
"One day my dragons will soar high
in their Mega-Evolved forms!"
entries.translation_source: One day my dragons will soar high in their Mega-Evolved forms!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari naga-nagaku akan terbang
tinggi dalam bentuk Mega-Evolusi\lmereka!

entries.original:
"Unlike the other experts, I’m still
young and free!"
entries.translation_source: Unlike the other experts, I’m still young and free!
entries.translated:
Tidak seperti ahli lainnya, aku
masih muda dan bebas!

entries.original: "The end is nigh."
entries.translation_source: The end is nigh.
entries.translated: Akhir sudah dekat.

entries.original:
"Whenever you’re ready to face
Maxima, just walk off the ledge.

Don’t worry, it won’t hurt."
entries.translation_source: Whenever you’re ready to face Maxima, just walk off the ledge. Don’t worry, it won’t hurt.
entries.translated:
Kapan pun kau siap menghadapi
Maxima, cukup berjalan dari tepian.\lJangan khawatir, tidak akan sakit.

entries.original:
"The Mega Ring lets you use the
power of Mega Evolution.

To access it, the Pokémon battling
must be holding its Mega Stone.

To Mega Evolve in battle, when you
see the Mega symbol appear, press\lthe Start Button.

Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve
and become even more powerful!

Just remember, you can only Mega
Evolve one Pokémon per battle.

The Mega Evolution’s effects will
wear off once the battle is over,\lso choose carefully.

I have faith that you’ll use this
Mega Ring to help benefit humanity.

Don’t let me down, [player].

I’m counting on you to make a
difference in the world."
entries.translation_source: The Mega Ring lets you use the power of Mega Evolution. To access it, the Pokémon battling must be holding its Mega Stone. To Mega Evolve in battle, when you see the Mega symbol appear, press the Start Button. Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve and become even more powerful! Just remember, you can only Mega Evolve one Pokémon per battle. The Mega Evolution’s effects will wear off once the battle is over, so choose carefully. I have faith that you’ll use this Mega Ring to help benefit humanity. Don’t let me down, [player]. I’m counting on you to make a difference in the world.
entries.translated:
Mega Ring memungkinkanmu
menggunakan kekuatan Mega Evolusi.\lUntuk mengaksesnya, Pokémon yang

bertarung harus memegang Batu
Mega-nya. Untuk Mega Berevolusi\ldalam pertempuran, saat kamu

melihat simbol Mega muncul, tekan
Tombol Start. Pokémon-mu akan Mega\lBerevolusi dan menjadi lebih kuat!

Ingat, kamu hanya bisa Mega
Berevolusi satu Pokémon per\lpertempuran. Efek Mega Evolusi akan

hilang setelah pertempuran selesai,
jadi pilihlah dengan hati-hati. Aku\lpercaya kamu akan menggunakan Mega

Ring ini untuk membantu
kemanusiaan. Jangan mengecewakanku,\l[player]. Aku mengandalkanmu untuk

membuat perubahan di dunia.

entries.original:
"elp benefit humanity.

Don’t let me down, [player].

I’m counting on you to make a
difference in the world."
entries.translation_source: elp benefit humanity. Don’t let me down, [player]. I’m counting on you to make a difference in the world.
entries.translated:
elp bantu kemanusiaan. Jangan
mengecewakanku, [player]. Aku\lmengandalkanmu untuk membuat

perubahan di dunia.

entries.original:
"Hello there, trainer.
My name is Successor Maxima.

Making it through my mansion is no
easy feat.

There are so many ups and downs
even I get lost some times!

But in the end I always end up back
down here.

You’ve fought hard to get down
here and that is commendable.

Am I correct in assuming you’ve
come seeking the power of Mega\lEvolution?

\.\.\.

\.\.\.

I see\."
entries.translation_source: Hello there, trainer. My name is Successor Maxima. Making it through my mansion is no easy feat. There are so many ups and downs even I get lost some times! But in the end I always end up back down here. You’ve fought hard to get down here and that is commendable. Am I correct in assuming you’ve come seeking the power of Mega Evolution? \.\.\. \.\.\. I see\.
entries.translated:
Halo, trainer. Nama saya Penerus
Maxima. Melewati mansionku bukanlah\lprestasi mudah. Ada begitu banyak

naik turun bahkan aku sendiri
kadang tersesat! Tapi pada akhirnya\laku selalu kembali ke sini. Kau

telah berjuang keras untuk sampai
ke sini dan itu patut dipuji.\lApakah aku benar jika mengira kau

datang mencari kekuatan Mega
Evolusi? \.\.\. \.\.\. Begitu rupanya\.

entries.original:
"Then if you want the power, you’ll
have to fight me for it!"
entries.translation_source: Then if you want the power, you’ll have to fight me for it!
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu jika kau menginginkan
kekuatannya, kau harus bertarung\ldenganku untuk mendapatkannya!

entries.original: "Ughhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: Ughhhhh\.
entries.translated: Ughhhhh\.

entries.original: "It’s a challenge rock."
entries.translation_source: It’s a challenge rock.
entries.translated: Ini batu tantangan.

entries.original:
"Would you like to have [buffer1]
smash the rock?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to have [buffer1] smash the rock?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin [buffer1]
menghancurkan batu itu?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] tried to smash the
challenge rock.

A piece of the rock broke away!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] tried to smash the challenge rock. A piece of the rock broke away!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] mencoba menghancurkan batu
tantangan. Sepotong batu itu pecah!

entries.original:
"Be cautious, trainer!

You’re about to enter Antisis City!
A very dangerous place!

If you’re coming from there, well\.
this gate only really goes one way."
entries.translation_source: Be cautious, trainer! You’re about to enter Antisis City! A very dangerous place! If you’re coming from there, well\. this gate only really goes one way.
entries.translated:
Berhati-hatilah, trainer! Kau akan
memasuki Antisis City! Tempat yang\lsangat berbahaya! Jika kau datang

dari sana, yah\. gerbang ini hanya
satu arah.

entries.original:
"Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy
Town and terrorize ’em, for fun.

But then that white-haired Gym
Leader always chases me away.

I give him such a headache\."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy Town and terrorize ’em, for fun. But then that white-haired Gym Leader always chases me away. I give him such a headache\.
entries.translated:
Kadang aku berjalan ke Epidimy Town
dan meneror mereka, untuk\lbersenang-senang. Tapi kemudian

Pemimpin Gym berambut putih itu
selalu mengusirku. Aku membuatnya\lpusing sekali\.

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt.
East Entrance

\ar Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. East Entrance \ar Antisis City
entries.translated:
Pintu Masuk Timur Gn. Thundercap \ar
Antisis City

entries.original:
"Would you like to return to the
[green]Ruins of Void[black]?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to return to the [green]Ruins of Void[black]?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin kembali ke [green]Ruins
of Void[black]?

entries.original:
"Would you like to return to
[green]Dehara City[black]?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to return to [green]Dehara City[black]?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin kembali ke [green]Dehara
City[black]?

entries.original:
"Hello, there!

Do you happen to have one of those
rare [green]Ice-type [buffer1][blue]?

I’ve always had trouble getting my
hands on one.

If you do, would you agree to a
trade for my [green][buffer2][blue]?

It’s very useful against the Gym,
here."
entries.translation_source: Hello, there! Do you happen to have one of those rare [green]Ice-type [buffer1][blue]? I’ve always had trouble getting my hands on one. If you do, would you agree to a trade for my [green][buffer2][blue]? It’s very useful against the Gym, here.
entries.translated:
Halo, di sana! Apakah kebetulan kau
memiliki salah satu [green]tipe Es\l[buffer1][blue]? Aku selalu kesulitan

mendapatkannya. Jika kau punya,
apakah kau setuju untuk bertukar\ldengan [green][buffer2][blue] milikku? Sangat

berguna melawan Gym di sini.

entries.original: "Many thanks."
entries.translation_source: Many thanks.
entries.translated: Terima kasih banyak.

entries.original:
"The [buffer2] that I traded you,
has it helped you out?"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer2] that I traded you, has it helped you out?
entries.translated:
[buffer2] yang saya tukarkan
denganmu, apakah itu membantumu?

entries.original: "Well, if you don’t want to\."
entries.translation_source: Well, if you don’t want to\.
entries.translated: Yah, jika kamu tidak mau\.

entries.original:
"Hmmm?
This isn’t an [green]Ice-type [buffer1][blue].

Think of me if you get one."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm? This isn’t an [green]Ice-type [buffer1][blue]. Think of me if you get one.
entries.translated:
Hmmm? Ini bukan [green]tipe Es [buffer1][blue].
Ingat aku jika kamu mendapatkannya.

entries.original:
"We just undertook a major drug bust
and finally apprehended the\lcriminal responsible for selling\l[green]Oddish Leaves [blue]in Borrius!

Now we’re dancing here to
celebrate."
entries.translation_source: We just undertook a major drug bust and finally apprehended the criminal responsible for selling [green]Oddish Leaves [blue]in Borrius! Now we’re dancing here to celebrate.
entries.translated:
Kami baru saja melakukan
penggerebekan narkoba besar dan\lakhirnya menangkap penjahat yang

bertanggung jawab menjual [green]Daun
Oddish [blue]di Borrius! Sekarang kami\lmenari di sini untuk merayakannya.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]\.one with the wind.
One with the snow.

A howling blizzard.

A world frozen.

Heed my call!

Articuno!

Sankren fimbulvetr!

Come to me!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]\.one with the wind. One with the snow. A howling blizzard. A world frozen. Heed my call! Articuno! Sankren fimbulvetr! Come to me!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]\.satu dengan angin. Satu
dengan salju. Badai salju yang\lmenderu. Dunia yang beku. Dengarkan

panggilanku! Articuno! Sankren
fimbulvetr! Datanglah padaku!

entries.original:
"[blue]Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated: [blue]Shadow Warriors! Tahan dia!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to
become mine."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to become mine.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang, Articuno, saatnya kau
menjadi milikku.

entries.original:
"[blue]The mission has been completed.

Now let’s report back to Zeph."
entries.translation_source: [blue]The mission has been completed. Now let’s report back to Zeph.
entries.translated:
[blue]Misi telah selesai. Sekarang mari
kita lapor kembali ke Zeph.

entries.original:
"[blue]You again!

What are you doing here?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]You again! What are you doing here?
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu lagi! Apa yang kamu lakukan di
sini?

entries.original:
"[blue]Grunts!

One of you, get rid of [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Grunts! One of you, get rid of [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
[blue]Grunts! Salah satu dari kalian,
singkirkan [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[red]Don’t expect any mercy from
[black]The Shadows[red]!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Don’t expect any mercy from [black]The Shadows[red]!
entries.translated:
[red]Jangan harap belas kasihan dari [black]The
Shadows[red]!

entries.original:
"[red]It doesn’t matter.

I bought enough time for everyone
else to escape.

But nice try, kid.

Take this package as a consolation
prize.

We’ve taken what we needed from it."
entries.translation_source: [red]It doesn’t matter. I bought enough time for everyone else to escape. But nice try, kid. Take this package as a consolation prize. We’ve taken what we needed from it.
entries.translated:
[red]Tidak masalah. Aku membeli cukup
waktu untuk semua orang lain\lmelarikan diri. Tapi usaha yang

bagus, nak. Ambil paket ini sebagai
hadiah hiburan. Kami sudah\lmengambil apa yang kami butuhkan

darinya.

entries.original:
"I’m a lover of all things wings.

If you show me some beautiful wings
over the course of 4 different\ldays, I’ll share some of my\lbeautiful wings with you.

You wing it?"
entries.translation_source: I’m a lover of all things wings. If you show me some beautiful wings over the course of 4 different days, I’ll share some of my beautiful wings with you. You wing it?
entries.translated:
Aku pencinta segala hal tentang
sayap. Jika kamu menunjukkan padaku\lbeberapa sayap indah selama 4 hari

berbeda, aku akan berbagi beberapa
sayap indahku denganmu. Kamu siap?

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

For today, I’d like to see the
beautiful wings of a [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! For today, I’d like to see the beautiful wings of a [green][buffer1][blue].
entries.translated:
Wingderful! Untuk hari ini, aku
ingin melihat sayap indah dari\l[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original: "That wings."
entries.translation_source: That wings.
entries.translated: Itu sayap.

entries.original:
"Let’s see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s see those beautiful [green][buffer1][blue] wings!
entries.translated:
Mari lihat sayap [green][buffer1][blue] yang
indah itu!

entries.original: "Those are some mighty fine wings\."
entries.translation_source: Those are some mighty fine wings\.
entries.translated: Itu adalah sayap yang sangat bagus\.

entries.original:
"What\.?

I can’t see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings anywhere\."
entries.translation_source: What\.? I can’t see those beautiful [green][buffer1][blue] wings anywhere\.
entries.translated:
Apa\.? Aku tidak bisa melihat sayap
[green][buffer1][blue] yang indah itu di mana pun\.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer1][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [green][buffer1][blue] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Besok aku ingin melihat sayap
[green][buffer1][blue] yang bagus. Jangan bawa\lhari ini. Aku sudah kelelahan

sayap.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer2][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [green][buffer2][blue] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Besok aku ingin melihat sayap
[green][buffer2][blue] yang bagus. Jangan bawa\lhari ini. Aku sudah kelelahan

sayap.

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

I’ve seen all those beautiful wings
I’ve never seen before!

As promised, I’d like to share my
wings with you!"
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! I’ve seen all those beautiful wings I’ve never seen before! As promised, I’d like to share my wings with you!
entries.translated:
Wingderful! Aku telah melihat semua
sayap indah yang belum pernah\lkulihat sebelumnya! Sesuai janji,

aku ingin berbagi sayapku denganmu!

entries.original:
"After seeing all those beautiful
wings, I’m all winged out for life!"
entries.translation_source: After seeing all those beautiful wings, I’m all winged out for life!
entries.translated:
Setelah melihat semua sayap indah
itu, aku sudah puas dengan sayap\lseumur hidup!

entries.original:
"Oh heavens\.

My daughter, I can’t find her!

We were on holiday at the [green]beach[red],
when all of sudden, she vanished!

Please, [buffer1], search for her!"
entries.translation_source: Oh heavens\. My daughter, I can’t find her! We were on holiday at the [green]beach[red], when all of sudden, she vanished! Please, [buffer1], search for her!
entries.translated:
Oh heavens\. Putriku, aku tidak bisa
menemukannya! Kami sedang liburan\ldi [green]pantai[red], ketika tiba-tiba, dia

menghilang! Tolong, [buffer1],
carilah dia!

entries.original:
"Thank you, [buffer1]!

As appearances go, she resembles
any ordinary [green]female tuber[red]."
entries.translation_source: Thank you, [buffer1]! As appearances go, she resembles any ordinary [green]female tuber[red].
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, [buffer1]! Dari
penampilannya, dia mirip [green]tuber\lbetina[red] biasa.

entries.original:
"Oh, dear\.

What will I do now\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear\. What will I do now\.
entries.translated:
Oh, sayang\. Apa yang akan kulakukan
sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Pardon me?

You say my daughter was blown away
by a strong wind?

She cannot have been blown far!

Strong winds like those aren’t
powerful enough to carry a child\loutside of the city limits.

Please, continue to search for her!"
entries.translation_source: Pardon me? You say my daughter was blown away by a strong wind? She cannot have been blown far! Strong winds like those aren’t powerful enough to carry a child outside of the city limits. Please, continue to search for her!
entries.translated:
Maaf? Kamu bilang putriku terbawa
angin kencang? Dia tidak mungkin\lterbawa jauh! Angin kencang seperti

itu tidak cukup kuat untuk membawa
anak kecil keluar dari batas kota.\lTolong, lanjutkan mencarinya!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

My mommy left me out here all
alone\.

I don’t think she cares about me
anymore\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. My mommy left me out here all alone\. I don’t think she cares about me anymore\.
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Ibuku meninggalkanku di sini
sendirian\. Aku rasa dia tidak peduli\llagi padaku\.

entries.original:
"What’s that?

Did you say my mommy sent you to
find me?

Sniff\.

Maybe she really does care about
me\."
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Did you say my mommy sent you to find me? Sniff\. Maybe she really does care about me\.
entries.translated:
Apa? Apakah kamu bilang ibuku
mengirimmu untuk mencariku? Hiks\.\lMungkin dia benar-benar peduli

padaku\.

entries.original:
"Okay\.

Please take me back to my mommy."
entries.translation_source: Okay\. Please take me back to my mommy.
entries.translated:
Oke\. Tolong antar aku kembali ke
ibuku.

entries.original:
"The little girl appears to have
been blown away."
entries.translation_source: The little girl appears to have been blown away.
entries.translated:
Gadis kecil itu tampaknya telah
terbawa angin.

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

This big wind blew me all the way
out here!

Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow
away, again!"
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! This big wind blew me all the way out here! Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow away, again!
entries.translated:
Waaaah! Angin besar ini
menerbangkanku sampai ke sini!\lBiarkan aku berpegangan padamu agar

aku tidak terbawa lagi!

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

That big wind blew me away again!

I’m scared now\.
I wanna go home\."
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! That big wind blew me away again! I’m scared now\. I wanna go home\.
entries.translated:
Waaaah! Angin besar itu
menerbangkanku lagi! Aku takut\lsekarang\. Aku ingin pulang\.

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I hate the wind\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. I hate the wind\.
entries.translated: Hiks\. Aku benci angin\.

entries.original:
"Huh?

I’m not being blown away anymore\.

Yay!

It’s over!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? I’m not being blown away anymore\. Yay! It’s over!
entries.translated:
Hah? Aku tidak lagi terbawa angin\.
Yay! Sudah selesai!

entries.original: "I’m\.so\.dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I’m\.so\.dizzy\.
entries.translated: Aku\.sangat\.pusing\.

entries.original:
"Mommy!
You found me!

I missed you so much!
I was so scared\.

This big bad wind kept blowing me
all over!

But I’m okay now, thanks to this
person!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy! You found me! I missed you so much! I was so scared\. This big bad wind kept blowing me all over! But I’m okay now, thanks to this person!
entries.translated:
Ibu! Kamu menemukanku! Aku sangat
merindukanmu! Aku sangat takut\.\lAngin jahat besar ini terus

menerbangkanku ke mana-mana! Tapi
aku baik-baik saja sekarang, berkat\lorang ini!

entries.original:
"I wanna go home now, Mommy.
I’m really dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I wanna go home now, Mommy. I’m really dizzy\.
entries.translated:
Aku ingin pulang sekarang, Ibu. Aku
benar-benar pusing\.

entries.original: "Mommy, wait!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy, wait!
entries.translated: Ibu, tunggu!

entries.original:
"We forgot to give a gift to the
[buffer1] who helped me!"
entries.translation_source: We forgot to give a gift to the [buffer1] who helped me!
entries.translated:
Kita lupa memberikan hadiah kepada
[buffer1] yang membantuku!

entries.original:
"Mommy\.

What happened to you\.?"
entries.translation_source: Mommy\. What happened to you\.?
entries.translated: Ibu\. Apa yang terjadi padamu\.?

entries.original:
"Aye, I do deliveries from the
Antisis Port during the day.

Without me, there’d be no
Fallshore Market!"
entries.translation_source: Aye, I do deliveries from the Antisis Port during the day. Without me, there’d be no Fallshore Market!
entries.translated:
Ya, saya melakukan pengiriman dari
Pelabuhan Antisis pada siang hari.\lTanpa saya, tidak akan ada Pasar

Fallshore!

entries.original:
"Aye, I just finished delivering
goods to all the Poké Marts.

Soon, I’ll be heading back to
Antisis City for the night."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I just finished delivering goods to all the Poké Marts. Soon, I’ll be heading back to Antisis City for the night.
entries.translated:
Ya, saya baru saja selesai mengirim
barang ke semua Poké Mart. Sebentar\llagi, saya akan kembali ke Kota

Antisis untuk bermalam.

entries.original:
"But it looks like I have some
leftover items.

How about instead of tossing ’em, I
let you have ’em!"
entries.translation_source: But it looks like I have some leftover items. How about instead of tossing ’em, I let you have ’em!
entries.translated:
Tapi sepertinya saya punya beberapa
barang sisa. Bagaimana kalau\ldaripada membuangnya, saya berikan

saja padamu!

entries.original:
"Hoo boy, Trainer!

I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m
wondering if you can help me out.

I got to this island by digging
up from a hidden tunnel, but my\lGraveler forgot Dig when it\llearned a new move.

Now I’m stuck here with no way off
this island.

Can you help me get back home?"
entries.translation_source: Hoo boy, Trainer! I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m wondering if you can help me out. I got to this island by digging up from a hidden tunnel, but my Graveler forgot Dig when it learned a new move. Now I’m stuck here with no way off this island. Can you help me get back home?
entries.translated:
Wah, Pelatih! Saya dalam sedikit
masalah, dan saya ingin tahu apakah\lAnda bisa membantu saya. Saya

sampai di pulau ini dengan menggali
dari terowongan tersembunyi, tapi\lGraveler saya lupa Gali saat

mempelajari jurus baru. Sekarang
saya terjebak di sini tanpa jalan\lkeluar dari pulau ini. Bisakah Anda

membantu saya pulang?

entries.original:
"Awesome!

All you need is a Pokemon that
knows [green]Dig[blue].

Do you have one with you?"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! All you need is a Pokemon that knows [green]Dig[blue]. Do you have one with you?
entries.translated:
Mantap! Yang Anda butuhkan hanyalah
Pokemon yang tahu [green]Gali[blue]. Apakah Anda\lpunya satu bersama Anda?

entries.original:
"Amazing!

The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re
ready to go into the tunnel.

There is no going back until you
reach the other exit."
entries.translation_source: Amazing! The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re ready to go into the tunnel. There is no going back until you reach the other exit.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Pertanyaan terakhir
saya adalah apakah Anda siap masuk\lke terowongan. Tidak ada jalan

kembali sampai Anda mencapai pintu
keluar lainnya.

entries.original:
"I’m going to challenge you to a
battle before we go.

I need to be sure you’re strong
enough to survive down there."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to challenge you to a battle before we go. I need to be sure you’re strong enough to survive down there.
entries.translated:
Saya akan menantang Anda bertarung
sebelum kita pergi. Saya perlu\lmemastikan Anda cukup kuat untuk

bertahan di sana.

entries.original:
"Alrighty, let’s go!
Use Dig!"
entries.translation_source: Alrighty, let’s go! Use Dig!
entries.translated: Baiklah, ayo pergi! Gunakan Gali!

entries.original:
"What are you getting at?
None of your Pokemon know [green]Dig[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: What are you getting at? None of your Pokemon know [green]Dig[blue]!
entries.translated:
Apa maksudmu? Tidak ada Pokemonmu
yang tahu [green]Gali[blue]!

entries.original:
"No?

Well I hope the rising tide won’t
drown me\."
entries.translation_source: No? Well I hope the rising tide won’t drown me\.
entries.translated:
Tidak? Yah, saya harap pasang naik
tidak akan menenggelamkan saya\.

entries.original:
"No?

[green]Sandshrew[blue] and [green]Sandslash[blue] in the
[green]Great Desert[blue] usually know Dig."
entries.translation_source: No? [green]Sandshrew[blue] and [green]Sandslash[blue] in the [green]Great Desert[blue] usually know Dig.
entries.translated:
Tidak? [green]Sandshrew[blue] dan [green]Sandslash[blue] di
[green]Gurun Besar[blue] biasanya tahu Gali.

entries.original:
"It’s just a tunnel, what’s there
to be scared about?"
entries.translation_source: It’s just a tunnel, what’s there to be scared about?
entries.translated:
Ini hanya terowongan, apa yang
perlu ditakutkan?

entries.original:
"Well, we’re here!
The Lost Tunnel\.

It’s rather dank in here\.
It’s also really dark.

I don’t think even a Pokemon could
light it up.

Well, we’d better get going!

There’s a ladder up, somewhere
around here.

I’ll keep you healed up after
every battle."
entries.translation_source: Well, we’re here! The Lost Tunnel\. It’s rather dank in here\. It’s also really dark. I don’t think even a Pokemon could light it up. Well, we’d better get going! There’s a ladder up, somewhere around here. I’ll keep you healed up after every battle.
entries.translated:
Yah, kita sampai! Terowongan Hilang\.
Di sini agak lembap\. Juga sangat\lgelap. Saya rasa bahkan Pokemon pun

tidak bisa meneranginya. Yah,
sebaiknya kita berangkat! Ada\ltangga ke atas, di suatu tempat di

sekitar sini. Saya akan menjaga
Anda tetap sembuh setelah setiap\lpertempuran.

entries.original:
"Yo, I ain’t done yet!

Take this TM too!"
entries.translation_source: Yo, I ain’t done yet! Take this TM too!
entries.translated:
Hei, saya belum selesai! Ambil TM
ini juga!

entries.original:
"TM92 is [green]Volt Switch[blue]!

It lets you switch out when you’re
at a disadvantage!

Shows your enemies what you’re
made of!"
entries.translation_source: TM92 is [green]Volt Switch[blue]! It lets you switch out when you’re at a disadvantage! Shows your enemies what you’re made of!
entries.translated:
TM92 adalah [green]Ganti Volt[blue]! Itu
memungkinkan Anda bertukar saat\lAnda dalam posisi tidak

menguntungkan! Menunjukkan kepada
musuh Anda siapa Anda sebenarnya!

entries.original:
"Don’t let anything stand in your
way, [player]!

And never let any disadvantage hold
you back from realizing your goals!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let anything stand in your way, [player]! And never let any disadvantage hold you back from realizing your goals!
entries.translated:
Jangan biarkan apa pun menghalangi
jalanmu, [player]! Dan jangan\lpernah biarkan kerugian apa pun

menghalangimu untuk mewujudkan
tujuanmu!

entries.original:
"What?
An earthquake? Now?"
entries.translation_source: What? An earthquake? Now?
entries.translated: Apa? Gempa bumi? Sekarang?

entries.original:
"Wow, you wiped the floor with
that Diglett!

Have you ever wondered what a
Diglett’s feet look like?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you wiped the floor with that Diglett! Have you ever wondered what a Diglett’s feet look like?
entries.translated:
Wow, kamu mengalahkan Diglett itu
dengan mudah! Apakah kamu pernah\lbertanya-tanya seperti apa kaki

Diglett?

entries.original:
"Again?
I hope no rocks fall on me\."
entries.translation_source: Again? I hope no rocks fall on me\.
entries.translated:
Lagi? Saya harap tidak ada batu
yang jatuh menimpa saya\.

entries.original:
"That was a tough Golem!

I wonder if it would get along
with my Graveler\."
entries.translation_source: That was a tough Golem! I wonder if it would get along with my Graveler\.
entries.translated:
Itu Golem yang tangguh! Saya ingin
tahu apakah ia akan akur dengan\lGraveler saya\.

entries.original:
"A third time?
This can’t be a coincidence!"
entries.translation_source: A third time? This can’t be a coincidence!
entries.translated:
Untuk ketiga kalinya? Ini pasti
bukan kebetulan!

entries.original:
"Phew, that was a tough battle!
I’m tired just from watching!

But now that you took out that
Dugtrio, the tremors should stop."
entries.translation_source: Phew, that was a tough battle! I’m tired just from watching! But now that you took out that Dugtrio, the tremors should stop.
entries.translated:
Fiuh, pertarungan yang berat! Aku
saja lelah hanya dengan menonton!\lTapi sekarang setelah kau

mengalahkan Dugtrio itu, getaran
seharusnya berhenti.

entries.original:
"There’s the ladder!

I thought we would be stuck here
forever\.

Let’s get out of here."
entries.translation_source: There’s the ladder! I thought we would be stuck here forever\. Let’s get out of here.
entries.translated:
Itu tangganya! Kupikir kita akan
terjebak di sini selamanya\. Ayo\lkeluar dari sini.

entries.original:
"What? A dead end!

I’m sure there’s a way out of
here\."
entries.translation_source: What? A dead end! I’m sure there’s a way out of here\.
entries.translated:
Apa? Jalan buntu! Aku yakin ada
jalan keluar dari sini\.

entries.original: "Let me see\."
entries.translation_source: Let me see\.
entries.translated: Coba kulihat\.

entries.original:
"Aha! Found it!

A weak spot in the wall, right
here."
entries.translation_source: Aha! Found it! A weak spot in the wall, right here.
entries.translated:
Aha! Ketemu! Titik lemah di
dinding, tepat di sini.

entries.original: "Graveler, use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Graveler, use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: Graveler, gunakan Penghancur Batu!

entries.original:
"[red]Now, Moltres, it’s time for you to
become ours."
entries.translation_source: [red]Now, Moltres, it’s time for you to become ours.
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang, Moltres, saatnya kau
menjadi milik kami.

entries.original:
"Thanks for all your help!
Here, take this TM.

I forgot I had it this whole
time."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for all your help! Here, take this TM. I forgot I had it this whole time.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih atas bantuanmu! Ini,
ambil TM ini. Aku lupa kalau aku\lmemilikinya selama ini.

entries.original:
"TM28 contains [green]Dig[blue].

We should have just used it right
away, eh?"
entries.translation_source: TM28 contains [green]Dig[blue]. We should have just used it right away, eh?
entries.translated:
TM28 berisi [green]Gali[blue]. Seharusnya kita
langsung menggunakannya, ya?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]If Ivory is unable, then
Houndoom and I will have to show\lyou the meaning of pain ourselves!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]If Ivory is unable, then Houndoom and I will have to show you the meaning of pain ourselves!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Jika Ivory tidak mampu, maka
Houndoom dan aku harus menunjukkan\larti sakit padamu sendiri!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Zeph, I really don’t think
you should\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Zeph, I really don’t think you should\.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Zeph, menurutku sebaiknya
kau jangan\.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]Silence, Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Silence, Ivory!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Diam, Ivory!

entries.original: "[blue]Time to suffer!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Time to suffer!
entries.translated: [blue]Waktunya menderita!

entries.original:
"[blue]Enjoy your victory while you can,
because you’re about to leave this\lworld.

It’s too risky to leave you alive
at this point."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Enjoy your victory while you can, because you’re about to leave this world. It’s too risky to leave you alive at this point.
entries.translated:
[blue]Nikmati kemenanganmu selagi bisa,
karena kau akan meninggalkan dunia\lini. Terlalu berisiko membiarkanmu

hidup pada titik ini.

entries.original:
"[blue]Houndoom!

Incinerate!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Houndoom! Incinerate!
entries.translated: [blue]Houndoom! Insinerasi!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Wait!

Houndoom!
Pull back!

Something’s happening!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Wait! Houndoom! Pull back! Something’s happening!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Tunggu! Houndoom! Mundur!
Sesuatu terjadi!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Grunts!

Grab [buffer1] now before [buffer2] gets away!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Grunts! Grab [buffer1] now before [buffer2] gets away!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Grunt! Tangkap [buffer1]
sekarang sebelum [buffer2] kabur!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

If that ain’t the darndest thing
I ever did see!

A [buffer1] coming outta some magic
portal!

Where’d ya come from, [buffer1]?

\.

What’s that?

Ya were tryin’ to get to
Thundercap Mt. when all of a\lsudden ya were kidnapped!

Hoooo weeee!

That sure sounds scary, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! If that ain’t the darndest thing I ever did see! A [buffer1] coming outta some magic portal! Where’d ya come from, [buffer1]? \. What’s that? Ya were tryin’ to get to Thundercap Mt. when all of a sudden ya were kidnapped! Hoooo weeee! That sure sounds scary, [buffer1].
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Kalau itu bukan hal
paling aneh yang pernah kulihat!\lSeekor [buffer1] keluar dari portal

ajaib! Dari mana kau datang,
[buffer1]? \. Apa itu? Kau sedang\lmencoba pergi ke Gunung Thundercap

ketika tiba-tiba kau diculik! Hoooo
weeee! Pasti terdengar menakutkan,\l[buffer1].

entries.original:
"Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped,
ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble\lgettin’ to Thundercap Mt.

Ya see, part of the ceiling
collapsed not long ago and\lblocked off the road!

And unless ya have the HM for [green]Rock
Smash[blue], you’ll be in a bit of a\lpickle gettin’ through ’em.

But\.

I’m guessin’ ya don’t or ya
wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me.

In thatta case, a friend of mine in
[green]Blizzard City[blue] can help ya out by\lgiving ya Rock Smash.

So, take this HM to help yurself
get to him."
entries.translation_source: Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped, ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble gettin’ to Thundercap Mt. Ya see, part of the ceiling collapsed not long ago and blocked off the road! And unless ya have the HM for [green]Rock Smash[blue], you’ll be in a bit of a pickle gettin’ through ’em. But\. I’m guessin’ ya don’t or ya wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me. In thatta case, a friend of mine in [green]Blizzard City[blue] can help ya out by giving ya Rock Smash. So, take this HM to help yurself get to him.
entries.translated:
Nah, jika kau tidak diculik, kau
akan mengalami lebih sedikit\lmasalah untuk sampai ke Gunung

Thundercap. Kau lihat, sebagian
langit-langit runtuh belum lama ini\ldan memblokir jalan! Dan kecuali

kau memiliki HM untuk [green]Penghancur
Batu[blue], kau akan sedikit kesulitan\lmelewatinya. Tapi\. Kurasa kau tidak

punya atau kau tidak akan masih
bicara denganku. Dalam hal itu,\lseorang temanku di [green]Kota Blizzard[blue]

bisa membantumu dengan memberikan
Penghancur Batu. Jadi, ambil HM ini\luntuk membantu dirimu sampai ke

dia.

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya made contact with my
friend.

Now go over to those rocks and give
’em a good smashin’!"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya made contact with my friend. Now go over to those rocks and give ’em a good smashin’!
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Sepertinya kamu sudah
menghubungi temanku. Sekarang\lpergilah ke batu-batu itu dan

hancurkan mereka!

entries.original:
"Use [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of that pesky
tree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Use [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of that pesky tree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue].
entries.translated:
Gunakan [green]Potong[blue] untuk menyingkirkan
pohon mengganggu yang menghalangi\l[green]Gua Lembah[blue].

entries.original:
"Mel: [blue]This is your final warning.
Move or be moved."
entries.translation_source: Mel: [blue]This is your final warning. Move or be moved.
entries.translated:
Mel: [blue]Ini peringatan terakhirmu.
Bergerak atau kau akan dipindahkan.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I refuse to abandon my post.

I must prevent [player] from entering
Thundercap Mountain at all cost."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]I refuse to abandon my post. I must prevent [player] from entering Thundercap Mountain at all cost.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Aku menolak meninggalkan
posku. Aku harus mencegah [player]\lmemasuki Gunung Thundercap dengan

cara apa pun.

entries.original:
"Mel: [blue]I don’t have time for this
right now.

My head is pounding and I have a
Gym to run."
entries.translation_source: Mel: [blue]I don’t have time for this right now. My head is pounding and I have a Gym to run.
entries.translated:
Mel: [blue]Aku tidak punya waktu untuk
ini sekarang. Kepalaku berdenyut\ldan aku harus menjalankan Gym.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Arghhhhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Arghhhhhhh\.
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Arghhhhhhh\.

entries.original:
"[blue]You can handle the rest from here
[player].

Whatever they’re up to, they
obviously don’t want you\linterfering.

So go nuts."
entries.translation_source: [blue]You can handle the rest from here [player]. Whatever they’re up to, they obviously don’t want you interfering. So go nuts.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu bisa menangani sisanya dari
sini [player]. Apa pun yang mereka\llakukan, jelas mereka tidak ingin

kamu campur tangan. Jadi berbuatlah
sesukamu.

entries.original: "[buffer1], use [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1], use [buffer2]!
entries.translated: [buffer1], gunakan [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Owww\.
My head\."
entries.translation_source: Owww\. My head\.
entries.translated: Owww\. Kepalaku\.

entries.original: "STOP!"
entries.translation_source: STOP!
entries.translated: BERHENTI!

entries.original:
"I can’t let you through!

If you get past me, I’ll be burned
alive!

You’re not getting any farther!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t let you through! If you get past me, I’ll be burned alive! You’re not getting any farther!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu lewat!
Jika kau melewatiku, aku akan\ldibakar hidup-hidup! Kau tidak akan

melangkah lebih jauh!

entries.original:
"What’s that?

Ya don’t know what an HM is?

Hoooo weeee!

Well, an [green]HM[blue], or Hidden Machine, is
a special type of move a Pokémon\lcan learn to bypass obstacles.

When a Pokémon learns an HM, as
long as it takes a [green]single step[blue]\lknowin’ that move, it can keep\lusin’ that move in the field, even\lif it can’t in battle!

In other words, [green]yur Pokémon don’t
need to know the HM to use it[blue].

Ain’t that convenient!

Anyways, use that HM for [green]Cut[blue] to get
rid of that pesky tree blocking\l[green]Valley Cave[blue].

Then head on up to [green]Blizzard City[blue] to
get [green]Rock Smash[blue] from my friend.

Best of luck on yur quest!"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Ya don’t know what an HM is? Hoooo weeee! Well, an [green]HM[blue], or Hidden Machine, is a special type of move a Pokémon can learn to bypass obstacles. When a Pokémon learns an HM, as long as it takes a [green]single step[blue] knowin’ that move, it can keep usin’ that move in the field, even if it can’t in battle! In other words, [green]yur Pokémon don’t need to know the HM to use it[blue]. Ain’t that convenient! Anyways, use that HM for [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of that pesky tree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue]. Then head on up to [green]Blizzard City[blue] to get [green]Rock Smash[blue] from my friend. Best of luck on yur quest!
entries.translated:
Apa itu? Kamu tidak tahu apa itu
HM? Hoooo weeee! Nah, [green]HM[blue], atau\lHidden Machine (Mesin Tersembunyi),

adalah tipe gerakan khusus yang
bisa dipelajari Pokémon untuk\lmelewati rintangan. Ketika Pokémon

mempelajari HM, selama ia mengambil
[green]satu langkah[blue] mengetahui gerakan\litu, ia bisa terus menggunakan

gerakan itu di lapangan, meskipun
tidak bisa dalam pertempuran!\lDengan kata lain, [green]Pokémon-mu tidak

perlu tahu HM untuk menggunakannya[blue].
Bukankah itu praktis! Pokoknya,\lgunakan HM untuk [green]Potong[blue] untuk

menyingkirkan pohon mengganggu yang
menghalangi [green]Gua Lembah[blue]. Lalu\lpergilah ke [green]Kota Badai Salju[blue] untuk

mendapatkan [green]Penghancur Batu[blue] dari
temanku. Semoga beruntung dalam\lpetualanganmu!

entries.original:
"Then head on up to [green]Blizzard City[blue] to
get [green]Rock Smash[blue] from my friend.

Best of luck on yur quest!"
entries.translation_source: Then head on up to [green]Blizzard City[blue] to get [green]Rock Smash[blue] from my friend. Best of luck on yur quest!
entries.translated:
Lalu pergilah ke [green]Kota Badai Salju[blue]
untuk mendapatkan [green]Penghancur Batu[blue]\ldari temanku. Semoga beruntung

dalam petualanganmu!

entries.original:
"As proof of your victory at the
Crater Town Gym, take the\l[green]Darkness Badge[blue]."
entries.translation_source: As proof of your victory at the Crater Town Gym, take the [green]Darkness Badge[blue].
entries.translated:
