Sebagai bukti kemenanganmu di Gym
Kota Kawah, ambillah [green]Lencana\lKegelapan[blue].

entries.original:
"Come on\.

I really need your help.
Please\."
entries.translation_source: Come on\. I really need your help. Please\.
entries.translated:
Ayo\\. Aku sangat membutuhkan
bantuanmu. Tolong\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Houndoom!

Zeph gave you to me to fulfill one
purpose!

Incinerate this old fool!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Houndoom! Zeph gave you to me to fulfill one purpose! Incinerate this old fool!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Houndoom! Zeph memberikannya
kepadaku untuk memenuhi satu\ltujuan! Bakar orang tua bodoh ini!

entries.original:
"Wife: [red]NOOOOOO!

You killed him you vile scum!"
entries.translation_source: Wife: [red]NOOOOOO! You killed him you vile scum!
entries.translated:
Istri: [red]TIDAAAAAK! Kau membunuhnya,
dasar sampah keji!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Incinerate her also,
Houndoom.

We have no more use for her."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Incinerate her also, Houndoom. We have no more use for her.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Bakar dia juga, Houndoom.
Kami tidak lagi membutuhkannya.

entries.original:
"Have you ever been in the SES
Expressway?

It’s an undergound highway that
goes all around Borrius.

It a real backpacker’s paradise!"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever been in the SES Expressway? It’s an undergound highway that goes all around Borrius. It a real backpacker’s paradise!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu pernah berada di Jalan
Bebas Hambatan SES? Itu adalah\ljalan raya bawah tanah yang

mengelilingi seluruh Borrius.
Tempat ini benar-benar surga bagi\lpara backpacker!

entries.original:
"I heard that there’s someone in
Tarmigan Town that teaches the art\lof Mega Evolution!"
entries.translation_source: I heard that there’s someone in Tarmigan Town that teaches the art of Mega Evolution!
entries.translated:
Kudengar ada seseorang di Kota
Tarmigan yang mengajarkan seni Mega\lEvolusi!

entries.original:
"Did you come up here to obtain the
power of [green]Mega Evolution[blue] from\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]?

Most people who come here are
usually after it.

All this town has to offer
otherwise, is horrific nightmares."
entries.translation_source: Did you come up here to obtain the power of [green]Mega Evolution[blue] from [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]? Most people who come here are usually after it. All this town has to offer otherwise, is horrific nightmares.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu datang ke sini untuk
mendapatkan kekuatan [green]Mega Evolution[blue]\ldari [green]Puri Tarmigan[blue]? Kebanyakan

orang yang datang ke sini biasanya
mencarinya. Yang ditawarkan kota\lini selain itu hanyalah mimpi buruk

yang mengerikan.

entries.original:
"Hi [player]!

I can show you your Pokémon’s
specific EVs and IVs if you want."
entries.translation_source: Hi [player]! I can show you your Pokémon’s specific EVs and IVs if you want.
entries.translated:
Hai [player]! Aku bisa menunjukkan
EV dan IV spesifik Pokémon-mu jika\lkamu mau.

entries.original:
"Feel free to come back and see them
any time."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to come back and see them any time.
entries.translated:
Jangan ragu untuk kembali dan
melihatnya kapan saja.

entries.original:
"Well if you change your mind let me
know.

I’ll be happy to show you."
entries.translation_source: Well if you change your mind let me know. I’ll be happy to show you.
entries.translated:
Kalau kamu berubah pikiran, beri
tahu aku. Aku akan dengan senang\lhati menunjukkannya padamu.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]At long last, the final
piece of the puzzle is ours."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]At long last, the final piece of the puzzle is ours.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Akhirnya, bagian terakhir
dari teka-teki ini milik kita.

entries.original:
"[blue]One with thunder, one with
lightning.

A fierce storm.

A world paralyzed.

Heed my call!

Zapdos!

Sankren thoron!

I command you!

Come forth from the stormy clouds
in which you dwell!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]One with thunder, one with lightning. A fierce storm. A world paralyzed. Heed my call! Zapdos! Sankren thoron! I command you! Come forth from the stormy clouds in which you dwell!
entries.translated:
[blue]Satu dengan guntur, satu dengan
petir. Badai yang dahsyat. Dunia\lyang lumpuh. Dengarkan panggilanku!

Zapdos! Sankren thoron! Aku
memerintahkanmu! Keluarlah dari\lawan badai tempatmu berdiam!

entries.original: "[blue]Now, Zapdos, you will become\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now, Zapdos, you will become\.
entries.translated: [blue]Sekarang, Zapdos, kamu akan menjadi\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]It just disintigrated
him\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]It just disintigrated him\.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Itu baru saja
menghancurkannya\.

entries.original:
"[blue]All remaining grunts and Shadow
Warriors, restrain Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]All remaining grunts and Shadow Warriors, restrain Zapdos!
entries.translated:
[blue]Semua bawahan dan Shadow Warriors
yang tersisa, tahan Zapdos!

entries.original: "[blue]They were wiped out by Discharge\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]They were wiped out by Discharge\.
entries.translated: [blue]Mereka dilenyapkan oleh Discharge\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Well, Zapdos, you leave me no
choice\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Well, Zapdos, you leave me no choice\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Yah, Zapdos, kau tidak memberiku
pilihan\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Heh\.
Nice try, Zapdos.

But I don’t fall as easily as the
grunts."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Heh\. Nice try, Zapdos. But I don’t fall as easily as the grunts.
entries.translated:
[blue]Heh\. Usaha bagus, Zapdos. Tapi aku
tidak jatuh semudah para bawahan.

entries.original: "[blue]Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!
entries.translated: [blue]Krookodile! Gunakan Stone Edge!

entries.original: "A critical hit!"
entries.translation_source: A critical hit!
entries.translated: Serangan kritis!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you to
become mine."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you to become mine.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang, Zapdos, saatnya kau
menjadi milikku.

entries.original:
"[blue]That took a lot longer than
expected."
entries.translation_source: [blue]That took a lot longer than expected.
entries.translated:
[blue]Itu memakan waktu lebih lama dari
yang diperkirakan.

entries.original:
"[blue]It’s finally time to head to the
[green]Ruins of Void[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]It’s finally time to head to the [green]Ruins of Void[blue]\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Akhirnya saatnya menuju ke
[green]Reruntuhan Kekosongan[blue]\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I had countless guards stationed to
prevent you from showing up!

I even had the stairs destroyed!

How did you manage to get past all
of it\.?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I had countless guards stationed to prevent you from showing up! I even had the stairs destroyed! How did you manage to get past all of it\.?
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku menempatkan banyak penjaga
untuk mencegahmu datang! Aku bahkan\lmenghancurkan tangga! Bagaimana

caramu melewati semua itu\.?

entries.original:
"[blue]Eh, It doesn’t matter anymore.
We’ve already won.

Zapdos now belongs to me.

And with this new power, I’ll
finally succeed in wiping you out!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Eh, It doesn’t matter anymore. We’ve already won. Zapdos now belongs to me. And with this new power, I’ll finally succeed in wiping you out!
entries.translated:
[blue]Eh, itu tidak penting lagi. Kita
sudah menang. Zapdos sekarang\lmilikku. Dan dengan kekuatan baru

ini, aku akhirnya akan berhasil
melenyapkanmu!

entries.original:
"I can only imagine the horrors
Zeph will instill on him\."
entries.translation_source: I can only imagine the horrors Zeph will instill on him\.
entries.translated:
Aku hanya bisa membayangkan
kengerian yang akan ditimpakan Zeph\lpadanya\.

entries.original:
"There is only one way to free the
Pokémon.

But I’m not telling you what it is!"
entries.translation_source: There is only one way to free the Pokémon. But I’m not telling you what it is!
entries.translated:
Hanya ada satu cara untuk
membebaskan Pokémon. Tapi aku tidak\lakan memberitahumu apa itu!

entries.original:
"One of us has a key to release
the Pokémon.

But I’m not telling you who has it."
entries.translation_source: One of us has a key to release the Pokémon. But I’m not telling you who has it.
entries.translated:
Salah satu dari kami memiliki kunci
untuk melepaskan Pokémon. Tapi aku\ltidak akan memberitahumu siapa yang

memilikinya.

entries.original:
"I’ve blown up the stairs so nothing
can interrupt the procedure."
entries.translation_source: I’ve blown up the stairs so nothing can interrupt the procedure.
entries.translated:
Aku telah meledakkan tangga
sehingga tidak ada yang bisa\lmengganggu prosedurnya.

entries.original:
"I have the key to free the
Pokémon!

But you’re not getting it!"
entries.translation_source: I have the key to free the Pokémon! But you’re not getting it!
entries.translated:
Aku memiliki kunci untuk
membebaskan Pokémon! Tapi kau tidak\lakan mendapatkannya!

entries.original:
"The other grunts are gonna kill
me\."
entries.translation_source: The other grunts are gonna kill me\.
entries.translated: Preman lainnya akan membunuhku\.

entries.original:
"There appear to be some Pokémon
sealed behind an electric barrier."
entries.translation_source: There appear to be some Pokémon sealed behind an electric barrier.
entries.translated:
Tampaknya ada beberapa Pokémon yang
tersegel di balik penghalang\llistrik.

entries.original:
"Would you like to disengage the
barrier and free them?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to disengage the barrier and free them?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin melepaskan
penghalang dan membebaskan mereka?

entries.original: "[player] disengaged the barrier!"
entries.translation_source: [player] disengaged the barrier!
entries.translated: [player] melepaskan penghalang!

entries.original:
"The captive Pokémon have escaped
back into the wild."
entries.translation_source: The captive Pokémon have escaped back into the wild.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang ditawan telah
melarikan diri kembali ke alam\lliar.

entries.original:
"You never cease to impress me,
[player].

But take a word of advice: don’t
follow me.

If you keep your head out of other
people’s business, you won’t get\lhurt.

It’s better to stay safe than to
try to play the hero\."
entries.translation_source: You never cease to impress me, [player]. But take a word of advice: don’t follow me. If you keep your head out of other people’s business, you won’t get hurt. It’s better to stay safe than to try to play the hero\.
entries.translated:
Kau tidak pernah berhenti membuatku
terkesan, [player]. Tapi ambillah\lnasihat: jangan ikuti aku. Jika kau

tidak ikut campur urusan orang
lain, kau tidak akan terluka. Lebih\lbaik tetap aman daripada mencoba

menjadi pahlawan\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

What are you doing here?

Are you trying to complete your
Pokédex?

\.

So you’re trying to get Rock Smash
in order to stop The Shadows\.

Well while you’ve been running
around playing hero, I’ve gotten\lmuch more powerful.

You don’t even stand a chance
against me any more.

In fact, I’ll demonstrate my might,
here and now!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! What are you doing here? Are you trying to complete your Pokédex? \. So you’re trying to get Rock Smash in order to stop The Shadows\. Well while you’ve been running around playing hero, I’ve gotten much more powerful. You don’t even stand a chance against me any more. In fact, I’ll demonstrate my might, here and now!
entries.translated:
[player]! Apa yang kau lakukan di
sini? Apakah kau mencoba melengkapi\lPokédex-mu? \. Jadi kau mencoba

mendapatkan Rock Smash untuk
menghentikan The Shadows\. Nah,\lsementara kau berlarian berlagak

pahlawan, aku menjadi jauh lebih
kuat. Kau bahkan tidak memiliki\lkesempatan lagi melawanku. Bahkan,

aku akan menunjukkan kekuatanku, di
sini dan sekarang!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]And just in case [rival] is
following me\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]And just in case [rival] is following me\.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Dan untuk berjaga-jaga
[rival] mengikutiku\.

entries.original:
"[red]As for you, [player], I’m not going
to kill you yet.

You need to be made into an example
for anyone who is foolish enough to\lbelieve that they can take on The\lShadows.

I’m going to do what both Marlon
and Zeph have failed to do.

It’s time to meet your end in
battle!"
entries.translation_source: [red]As for you, [player], I’m not going to kill you yet. You need to be made into an example for anyone who is foolish enough to believe that they can take on The Shadows. I’m going to do what both Marlon and Zeph have failed to do. It’s time to meet your end in battle!
entries.translated:
[red]Sedangkan untukmu, [player], aku
belum akan membunuhmu. Kau harus\ldijadikan contoh bagi siapa pun

yang cukup bodoh untuk percaya
bahwa mereka bisa melawan The\lShadows. Aku akan melakukan apa

yang gagal dilakukan Marlon dan
Zeph. Saatnya kau berakhir dalam\lpertempuran!

entries.original:
"[red]\.

I may have failed as well, but
we’re not done here, yet!

Houndoom!

I want [buffer1] ashes to stain the floor
black!"
entries.translation_source: [red]\. I may have failed as well, but we’re not done here, yet! Houndoom! I want [buffer1] ashes to stain the floor black!
entries.translated:
[red]\. Aku mungkin juga gagal, tapi kita
belum selesai di sini! Houndoom!\lAku ingin abu [buffer1] membasahi

lantai menjadi hitam!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Houndoom!

Do it now, before [buffer2] gets
away again!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Houndoom! Do it now, before [buffer2] gets away again!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Houndoom! Lakukan sekarang,
sebelum [buffer2] kabur lagi!

entries.original:
"Actually, that guy over there is my
only friend now\."
entries.translation_source: Actually, that guy over there is my only friend now\.
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, orang di sana adalah
satu-satunya temanku sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Do you know what frustrates me the
most about this?

The police won’t even do anything
about them, because they refuse to\lbelieve me that some shadowy\lorganization even exists!

They still treat me like a kid,
despite what I’ve accomplished\.

Argh\."
entries.translation_source: Do you know what frustrates me the most about this? The police won’t even do anything about them, because they refuse to believe me that some shadowy organization even exists! They still treat me like a kid, despite what I’ve accomplished\. Argh\.
entries.translated:
Tahukah kau apa yang paling
membuatku frustrasi? Polisi bahkan\ltidak akan melakukan apa pun

terhadap mereka, karena mereka
menolak percaya padaku bahwa\lorganisasi bayangan semacam itu

ada! Mereka masih memperlakukanku
seperti anak kecil, meskipun apa\lyang telah aku capai\. Argh\.

entries.original:
"Wait\.

I remember now\.

There is someone I can contact for
help after all\."
entries.translation_source: Wait\. I remember now\. There is someone I can contact for help after all\.
entries.translated:
Tunggu\. Aku ingat sekarang\. Ada
seseorang yang bisa kuhubungi untuk\lmeminta bantuan ternyata\.

entries.original:
"While I’m doing that, you should be
heading to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

The move [green]Strength[blue] is needed to go
anywhere inside, so you’ll need to\lbeat the [green]Fallshore Gym[blue] first.

I think I saw the Gym Leader
standing around in [green]Tehl Town[blue],\lactually\.

I’ll catch up with you again after
you rescue [green]Zapdos[blue]."
entries.translation_source: While I’m doing that, you should be heading to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] The move [green]Strength[blue] is needed to go anywhere inside, so you’ll need to beat the [green]Fallshore Gym[blue] first. I think I saw the Gym Leader standing around in [green]Tehl Town[blue], actually\. I’ll catch up with you again after you rescue [green]Zapdos[blue].
entries.translated:
Selagi aku melakukan itu, kau harus
menuju ke [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] Gerakan\l[green]Strength[blue] diperlukan untuk pergi ke

mana pun di dalam, jadi kau harus
mengalahkan [green]Fallshore Gym[blue] terlebih\ldahulu. Aku pikir aku melihat

Pemimpin Gym berdiri di [green]Tehl Town[blue],
sebenarnya\. Aku akan menyusulmu lagi\lsetelah kau menyelamatkan [green]Zapdos[blue].

entries.original: "Let’s go, Starapator!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s go, Starapator!
entries.translated: Ayo, Starapator!

entries.original:
"My dream is to one day team up with
a Fighting-type trainer.

We will be called\.
\qoBrains & Brawn\qc."
entries.translation_source: My dream is to one day team up with a Fighting-type trainer. We will be called\. \qoBrains & Brawn\qc.
entries.translated:
Impianku adalah suatu hari bekerja
sama dengan pelatih Tipe Petarung.\lKami akan dipanggil\. \qoBrains &

Brawn\qc.

entries.original:
"When I climb down the bluffs, I
find very interesting things hidden\lin the seashells on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: When I climb down the bluffs, I find very interesting things hidden in the seashells on the beach!
entries.translated:
Saat aku turun dari tebing, aku
menemukan hal-hal yang sangat\lmenarik tersembunyi di dalam

kerang-kerang di pantai!

entries.original:
"Huff\.Puff\.

Jogging and battling make a tiring
combo!"
entries.translation_source: Huff\.Puff\. Jogging and battling make a tiring combo!
entries.translated:
Huff\.Puff\. Joging dan bertarung
adalah kombinasi yang melelahkan!

entries.original:
"I trained my Zangoose and Seviper
to play together nicely!"
entries.translation_source: I trained my Zangoose and Seviper to play together nicely!
entries.translated:
Aku melatih Zangoose dan Seviper-ku
untuk bermain bersama dengan baik!

entries.original:
"I know there are bug Pokémon
around here!

One day I saw a huge [green]swarm[blue] of them
flying around!"
entries.translation_source: I know there are bug Pokémon around here! One day I saw a huge [green]swarm[blue] of them flying around!
entries.translated:
Aku tahu ada Pokémon Serangga di
sekitar sini! Suatu hari aku\lmelihat [green]kawanan[blue] besar mereka

terbang!

entries.original:
"Thank you again for helping me
before!

My family and I had a great two day
feast because of your help.

Now it’s time to prepare for next
year’s feast!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you again for helping me before! My family and I had a great two day feast because of your help. Now it’s time to prepare for next year’s feast!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih lagi karena telah
membantuku sebelumnya! Aku dan\lkeluargaku mengadakan pesta dua

hari yang luar biasa berkat
bantuanmu. Sekarang saatnya\lmempersiapkan pesta tahun depan!

entries.original:
"Cinder Volcano is dangerous.

If you don’t have your Pokémon to
protect you, you could die."
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano is dangerous. If you don’t have your Pokémon to protect you, you could die.
entries.translated:
Gunung Berapi Cinder berbahaya.
Jika kamu tidak memiliki Pokémon\luntuk melindungimu, kamu bisa mati.

entries.original:
"Never mind\.

You have enough."
entries.translation_source: Never mind\. You have enough.
entries.translated: Sudahlah\. Kamu sudah cukup.

entries.original:
"One day my babies will use a
powerful Return and beat you up\lfor what you did to them!"
entries.translation_source: One day my babies will use a powerful Return and beat you up for what you did to them!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari anak-anakku akan
menggunakan Return yang kuat dan\lmengalahkanmu karena apa yang telah

kau lakukan pada mereka!

entries.original:
"Well, well, well\.
If it isn’t [player]!

The boss told me not to let you
into Thundercap Mountain, so you\lcan’t interfere with our plans.

Even if I did let you in, you’d be
toast without the power of Mega\lEvolution.

So don’t you see?

You should stay out here for your
own good."
entries.translation_source: Well, well, well\. If it isn’t [player]! The boss told me not to let you into Thundercap Mountain, so you can’t interfere with our plans. Even if I did let you in, you’d be toast without the power of Mega Evolution. So don’t you see? You should stay out here for your own good.
entries.translated:
Wah, wah, wah\. Bukankah ini
[player]! Bos menyuruhku untuk\ltidak membiarkanmu masuk ke Gunung

Thundercap, jadi kamu tidak bisa
mengganggu rencana kami. Bahkan\ljika aku membiarkanmu masuk, kamu

akan hangus tanpa kekuatan Evolusi
Mega. Jadi tidakkah kau lihat? Kamu\lsebaiknya tetap di sini demi

kebaikanmu sendiri.

entries.original:
"As per our arrangement, for
defeating me, take this Mega Ring."
entries.translation_source: As per our arrangement, for defeating me, take this Mega Ring.
entries.translated:
Sesuai kesepakatan kita, karena
mengalahkanku, ambillah Lingkaran\lMega ini.

entries.original:
"[player] received the Mega Ring from
Successor Maxima!"
entries.translation_source: [player] received the Mega Ring from Successor Maxima!
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Lingkaran Mega
dari Successor Maxima!

entries.original:
"[player] put the Mega Ring in the
Key Items Sector."
entries.translation_source: [player] put the Mega Ring in the Key Items Sector.
entries.translated:
[player] menempatkan Lingkaran Mega
di Sektor Item Kunci.

entries.original:
"Oh, one last thing.

Take this Mega Stone for the
Pokémon, Lucario, from me."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one last thing. Take this Mega Stone for the Pokémon, Lucario, from me.
entries.translated:
Oh, satu hal lagi. Ambillah Batu
Mega untuk Pokémon, Lucario,\ldariku.

entries.original:
"Sorry, it doesn’t look like you
have any space for my gift."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, it doesn’t look like you have any space for my gift.
entries.translated:
Maaf, sepertinya kamu tidak
memiliki ruang untuk hadiahku.

entries.original:
"I’m glad I caught up to you.

I just destroyed Successor Maxima.

Let me guess, you’ve also claimed
the power of Mega Evolution?"
entries.translation_source: I’m glad I caught up to you. I just destroyed Successor Maxima. Let me guess, you’ve also claimed the power of Mega Evolution?
entries.translated:
Aku senang bisa menyusulmu. Aku
baru saja menghancurkan Successor\lMaxima. Coba kutebak, kamu juga

telah mengklaim kekuatan Evolusi
Mega?

entries.original:
"Of course you did, [player].

I’d expect nothing less from the
[buffer1] who beat me all those times.

Now, let’s see if you can still
beat me!"
entries.translation_source: Of course you did, [player]. I’d expect nothing less from the [buffer1] who beat me all those times. Now, let’s see if you can still beat me!
entries.translated:
Tentu saja kau melakukannya,
[player]. Aku tidak akan\lmengharapkan yang kurang dari

[buffer1] yang mengalahkanku
berkali-kali itu. Sekarang, mari\lkita lihat apakah kau masih bisa

mengalahkanku!

entries.original:
"What are you saying, [player]?

I can clearly see that Mega Ring on
your finger!

Is it, maybe, you don’t know how
to use Mega Evolution?

Well, first you’ve gotta be able to
battle like this!"
entries.translation_source: What are you saying, [player]? I can clearly see that Mega Ring on your finger! Is it, maybe, you don’t know how to use Mega Evolution? Well, first you’ve gotta be able to battle like this!
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau katakan, [player]? Aku
bisa melihat jelas Lingkaran Mega\ldi jarimu! Mungkin saja, kau tidak

tahu cara menggunakan Evolusi Mega?
Nah, pertama-tama kau harus bisa\lbertarung seperti ini!

entries.original:
"Nice job, [player].

For defeating me yet again, I want
you to take this."
entries.translation_source: Nice job, [player]. For defeating me yet again, I want you to take this.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, [player]. Karena
mengalahkanku lagi, aku ingin kau\lmengambil ini.

entries.original:
"That old fart Log caught up with
me a while back.

He gave that to me, and said that I
should give it to you the next time\lwe crossed paths.

He gave me my own also, but he
knows I would’ve wrecked him if\lhe hadn’t\."
entries.translation_source: That old fart Log caught up with me a while back. He gave that to me, and said that I should give it to you the next time we crossed paths. He gave me my own also, but he knows I would’ve wrecked him if he hadn’t\.
entries.translated:
Orang tua Log itu menyusulku
beberapa waktu lalu. Dia memberikan\litu padaku, dan berkata bahwa aku

harus memberikannya padamu saat
kita bertemu lagi. Dia juga\lmemberiku punyaku sendiri, tapi dia

tahu aku akan menghancurkannya jika
dia tidak melakukannya\.

entries.original:
"So, where are you going next,
[player]?

\.

Dehara City, huh?
I’m headed there too.

Log mentioned a guy over there who
knows how to cross water.

As you know, I’ve been looking for
my parents, and my research is\ltelling me that The Shadows were\linvolved in their disappearance.

I managed to track The Shadows to
the Ruins of Void, but I can’t get\lthere on foot or by flight yet.

If you need a way to ride the
waves too, you should find [green]Dehara\lCity’s surfing guy[blue].

See you later, [player]."
entries.translation_source: So, where are you going next, [player]? \. Dehara City, huh? I’m headed there too. Log mentioned a guy over there who knows how to cross water. As you know, I’ve been looking for my parents, and my research is telling me that The Shadows were involved in their disappearance. I managed to track The Shadows to the Ruins of Void, but I can’t get there on foot or by flight yet. If you need a way to ride the waves too, you should find [green]Dehara City’s surfing guy[blue]. See you later, [player].
entries.translated:
Jadi, mau ke mana selanjutnya,
[player]? \. Kota Dehara, ya? Aku\ljuga ke sana. Log bilang ada

seseorang di sana yang tahu cara
menyeberangi air. Seperti yang kau\ltahu, aku sedang mencari orang

tuaku, dan risetku menunjukkan
bahwa The Shadows terlibat dalam\lpenghilangan mereka. Aku berhasil

melacak The Shadows ke Reruntuhan
Void, tapi aku belum bisa ke sana\ldengan berjalan kaki atau terbang.

Jika kau juga butuh cara untuk
berselancar di ombak, temui [green]pemain\lselancar Kota Dehara[blue]. Sampai jumpa,

[player].

entries.original:
"Go make some more space in your Cube
for this Mega Stone."
entries.translation_source: Go make some more space in your Cube for this Mega Stone.
entries.translated:
Buat ruang lagi di Cube-mu untuk
Mega Stone ini.

entries.original:
"Did you make space in your Cube
for the Mega Stone?"
entries.translation_source: Did you make space in your Cube for the Mega Stone?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah membuat ruang di
Cube-mu untuk Mega Stone?

entries.original:
"My Malamar’s [green]Suction Cups[blue] ability
helps me reel in Pokémon!

At least, I think it has Suction
Cups\."
entries.translation_source: My Malamar’s [green]Suction Cups[blue] ability helps me reel in Pokémon! At least, I think it has Suction Cups\.
entries.translated:
Ability Malamar saya [green]Pengisap[blue]
membantu saya menarik Pokémon!\lSetidaknya, saya pikir ia punya

Pengisap\.

entries.original: "It’s a seashell."
entries.translation_source: It’s a seashell.
entries.translated: Ini kerang.

entries.original: "[blue]Derrrr!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Derrrr!
entries.translated: [blue]Derrrr!

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid!

A fight between some Zangoose and
Seviper took out the bridge.

It’ll take some time before we get
it fixed.

You should talk to our boss about
finding an alternative way to\lSeaport City in the meantime."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid! A fight between some Zangoose and Seviper took out the bridge. It’ll take some time before we get it fixed. You should talk to our boss about finding an alternative way to Seaport City in the meantime.
entries.translated:
Maaf, nak! Pertarungan antara
Zangoose dan Seviper menghancurkan\ljembatan. Butuh beberapa waktu

sebelum kami memperbaikinya.
Sementara itu, bicaralah dengan bos\lkami tentang mencari jalan

alternatif ke Kota Seaport.

entries.original:
"Oh, geez\.
Another trainer\.

Well, here you go."
entries.translation_source: Oh, geez\. Another trainer\. Well, here you go.
entries.translated:
Oh, astaga\. Pelatih lain\. Ya, ini
untukmu.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]It’s finally time for Zeph
to finish what he started.

He now has all three legendary
birds in his possesion.

All that’s left is for me to join
him at the Ruins of Void.

So why do I feel so much dread?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]It’s finally time for Zeph to finish what he started. He now has all three legendary birds in his possesion. All that’s left is for me to join him at the Ruins of Void. So why do I feel so much dread?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Akhirnya tiba waktunya bagi
Zeph untuk menyelesaikan apa yang\ldia mulai. Dia sekarang memiliki

ketiga burung legendaris. Yang
tersisa hanyalah aku bergabung\ldengannya di Reruntuhan Void. Lalu

kenapa aku merasa begitu cemas?

entries.original:
"[blue]No\.

I shouldn’t be feeling this way\.

Everything we’ve worked for is 
about to transpire.

I’ll even be able to see my son
again\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]No\. I shouldn’t be feeling this way\. Everything we’ve worked for is about to transpire. I’ll even be able to see my son again\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Tidak\. Seharusnya aku tidak merasa
begini\. Semua yang telah kita\lperjuangkan akan segera terwujud.

Aku bahkan akan bisa melihat
putraku lagi\.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Sorry, old man.

If you’re getting cold feet now,
you could be a big problem down\lthe road.

I can’t have anything standing in
the way of the unbinding.

Your son will just have to be
fatherless forever."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Sorry, old man. If you’re getting cold feet now, you could be a big problem down the road. I can’t have anything standing in the way of the unbinding. Your son will just have to be fatherless forever.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Maaf, pak tua. Jika kau mulai
ragu-ragu sekarang, kau bisa\lmenjadi masalah besar nantinya. Aku

tidak bisa membiarkan ada yang
menghalangi pembebasan. Putramu\lharus menjadi yatim selamanya.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]What is this, Hoopa?

I asked you to summon me a powerful
Pokémon capable of flying us to\lthe Ruins of Void, and this is what\lyou give me?

Pathetic!

This Pokémon is just so\.so\.
so nebby!

A poor excuse for a legendary
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]What is this, Hoopa? I asked you to summon me a powerful Pokémon capable of flying us to the Ruins of Void, and this is what you give me? Pathetic! This Pokémon is just so\.so\. so nebby! A poor excuse for a legendary Pokémon.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Apa ini, Hoopa? Aku memintamu
untuk memanggilkan Pokémon kuat\lyang bisa membawa kami terbang ke

Reruntuhan Void, dan ini yang kau
berikan? Memalukan! Pokémon ini\lsangat\.sangat\. sangat nebby! Alasan

buruk untuk disebut Pokémon
legendaris.

entries.original:
"[blue]Stay in the bag, you useless
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Stay in the bag, you useless Pokémon.
entries.translated:
[blue]Tetap di dalam tas, Pokémon tidak
berguna.

entries.original:
"[blue]I guess we have no choice but to
leave it here, Hoopa.

Maybe some lucky trainer will find
it and decide to train the useless\lthing."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I guess we have no choice but to leave it here, Hoopa. Maybe some lucky trainer will find it and decide to train the useless thing.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya kita tidak punya pilihan
selain meninggalkannya di sini,\lHoopa. Mungkin beberapa pelatih

beruntung akan menemukannya dan
memutuskan untuk melatih benda\ltidak berguna itu.

entries.original:
"[blue]We don’t have any more time to
waste, Hoopa.

I know I didn’t want to go this
way, but I need you to send me\lthrough one of your rings to\lthe Ruins of Void.

I’ll go ahead, and since you can’t
travel through your own rings\lwithout a tether, latch onto my\lCube’s signal once I arrive there.

Just try to make it inconspicuous,
please.

I can’t have Zeph catching on to
our plan.

Don’t take too long, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: [blue]We don’t have any more time to waste, Hoopa. I know I didn’t want to go this way, but I need you to send me through one of your rings to the Ruins of Void. I’ll go ahead, and since you can’t travel through your own rings without a tether, latch onto my Cube’s signal once I arrive there. Just try to make it inconspicuous, please. I can’t have Zeph catching on to our plan. Don’t take too long, Hoopa.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kita tidak punya waktu lagi untuk
disia-siakan, Hoopa. Aku tahu aku\ltidak ingin pergi dengan cara ini,

tapi aku perlu kau mengirimku
melalui salah satu cincinmu ke\lReruntuhan Void. Aku akan pergi

duluan, dan karena kau tidak bisa
bepergian melalui cincinmu sendiri\ltanpa pengait, ikatkan dirimu ke

sinyal Cube-ku begitu aku sampai di
sana. Cobalah untuk melakukannya\ldengan tidak mencolok. Aku tidak

bisa membiarkan Zeph mengetahui
rencana kita. Jangan terlalu lama,\lHoopa.

entries.original: "[green]Hoop!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoop!
entries.translated: [green]Hoop!

entries.original:
"There appears to be a Pokémon in
the bag.

Would you like to take it?"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be a Pokémon in the bag. Would you like to take it?
entries.translated:
Tampaknya ada Pokémon di dalam tas.
Apakah kamu ingin mengambilnya?

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough space for
this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough space for this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak punya cukup ruang untuk
Pokémon ini.

entries.original:
"This mountain pass has a very
unique layout.

It descends slowly, but then dips
suddenly!"
entries.translation_source: This mountain pass has a very unique layout. It descends slowly, but then dips suddenly!
entries.translated:
Jalur gunung ini memiliki tata
letak yang sangat unik. Menurun\lperlahan, lalu tiba-tiba menukik!

entries.original:
"Some man in a red hood was pushed
into the ocean.

He hasn’t resurfaced yet, either\."
entries.translation_source: Some man in a red hood was pushed into the ocean. He hasn’t resurfaced yet, either\.
entries.translated:
Seseorang berkerudung merah
didorong ke laut. Dia juga belum\lmuncul kembali\.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn that that
Pokémon from the legends floated\lthrough here just now\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn that that Pokémon from the legends floated through here just now\.
entries.translated:
Aku yakin sekali bahwa Pokémon dari
legenda itu baru saja melayang\llewat sini\.

entries.original:
"Passing through this gate can
either get you to Dehara City or\lRoute 12."
entries.translation_source: Passing through this gate can either get you to Dehara City or Route 12.
entries.translated:
Melewati gerbang ini bisa membawamu
ke Dehara City atau Route 12.

entries.original:
"Would you happen to be [player] by
any chance?

\.

I thought so.

I recognized you from this picture
I found of you, on the interwebs.

My name is Looker.

Agent Looker, of the International
Police.

I had just finished dealing with
Team Rocket in the Kanto Region,\lwhen I was deployed to deal with a\lsituation that was brewing in the\lBorrius Region.

A young man, Jax, I believe, has
informed me that you have some\levidence for crimes committed by an\lorganization calling themselves\l\qoThe Shadows\qc.

Please meet me in the [green]Dehara Game
Corner [blue]so we can discuss further.

Jax is there, as well.

Looker, out."
entries.translation_source: Would you happen to be [player] by any chance? \. I thought so. I recognized you from this picture I found of you, on the interwebs. My name is Looker. Agent Looker, of the International Police. I had just finished dealing with Team Rocket in the Kanto Region, when I was deployed to deal with a situation that was brewing in the Borrius Region. A young man, Jax, I believe, has informed me that you have some evidence for crimes committed by an organization calling themselves \qoThe Shadows\qc. Please meet me in the [green]Dehara Game Corner [blue]so we can discuss further. Jax is there, as well. Looker, out.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu kebetulan [player]? \.
Aku pikir begitu. Aku mengenalimu\ldari foto yang kutemukan tentangmu

di internet. Namaku Looker. Agen
Looker, dari Polisi Internasional.\lAku baru saja selesai menangani

Team Rocket di Region Kanto, ketika
aku ditugaskan untuk menangani\lsituasi yang berkembang di Region

Borrius. Seorang pemuda, Jax,
seingatku, telah memberitahuku\lbahwa kamu memiliki beberapa bukti

kejahatan yang dilakukan oleh
organisasi yang menyebut diri\lmereka \qoThe Shadows\qc. Tolong temui

aku di [green]Game Corner Dehara [blue]agar kita
bisa berdiskusi lebih lanjut. Jax\ljuga ada di sana. Looker, selesai.

entries.original:
"He’s too engrossed in his slot game
to hear you from behind.

Maybe try yelling in his ear?"
entries.translation_source: He’s too engrossed in his slot game to hear you from behind. Maybe try yelling in his ear?
entries.translated:
Dia terlalu asyik dengan permainan
slotnya untuk mendengarmu dari\lbelakang. Mungkin coba berteriak di

telinganya?

entries.original:
"He appears to be deeply engrossed
in a slot game."
entries.translation_source: He appears to be deeply engrossed in a slot game.
entries.translated:
Dia tampak sangat asyik dengan
permainan slot.

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Jax!
The game finally cashed out!

I just won big!"
entries.translation_source: Looker: [blue]Jax! The game finally cashed out! I just won big!
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Jax! Permainannya akhirnya
membayar! Aku baru saja menang\lbesar!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Just now, Mr. Looker?
I cashed out ages ago!

I’ve already won it big several
times!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Just now, Mr. Looker? I cashed out ages ago! I’ve already won it big several times!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Baru saja, Tuan Looker? Aku
sudah mencairkannya sejak lama! Aku\lsudah menang besar beberapa kali!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh! [player]!

You came just in time!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh! [player]! You came just in time!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh! [player]! Kamu datang tepat
waktu!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Ah, it is you, [player].
Sorry, I did not see you, there.

I was too wrapped up in trying to
win this slot game.

You know, there is actually a Game
Corner just like this in Kanto.

Except there it was a cover for
Team Rocket\.

Anyway, thank you for meeting me.

Let us all go outside, where it is
quieter, to discuss."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [blue]Ah, it is you, [player]. Sorry, I did not see you, there. I was too wrapped up in trying to win this slot game. You know, there is actually a Game Corner just like this in Kanto. Except there it was a cover for Team Rocket\. Anyway, thank you for meeting me. Let us all go outside, where it is quieter, to discuss.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Ah, ini kamu, [player].
Maaf, aku tidak melihatmu di sana.\lAku terlalu sibuk mencoba

memenangkan permainan slot ini.
Kamu tahu, sebenarnya ada Game\lCorner seperti ini di Kanto. Hanya

saja di sana itu adalah kedok untuk
Team Rocket\. Bagaimanapun, terima\lkasih sudah menemuiku. Ayo kita

semua ke luar, di tempat yang lebih
tenang, untuk berdiskusi.

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Alright, [player].

Now that we are outside, tell me
everything that transpired,\lstarting from the beginning.

\.

\.

Hmm\.

With these facts, there is clear
evidence that The Shadows wish to\lrelease the dark force and cause\lchaos in Borrius.

Now, if only there were some way we
could reach the Ruins of Void\lquickly so we could stop them\."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [blue]Alright, [player]. Now that we are outside, tell me everything that transpired, starting from the beginning. \. \. Hmm\. With these facts, there is clear evidence that The Shadows wish to release the dark force and cause chaos in Borrius. Now, if only there were some way we could reach the Ruins of Void quickly so we could stop them\.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Baiklah, [player]. Sekarang
kita sudah di luar, ceritakan\lpadaku semua yang terjadi, mulai

dari awal. \. \. Hmm\. Dengan fakta-fakta
ini, ada bukti jelas bahwa The\lShadows ingin melepaskan kekuatan

gelap dan menyebabkan kekacauan di
Borrius. Andai saja ada cara kita\lbisa mencapai Ruins of Void dengan

cepat agar kita bisa menghentikan
mereka\.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]What’s going on?

[player]!
Look out!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]What’s going on? [player]! Look out!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Apa yang terjadi? [player]!
Awas!

entries.original: "Jax: [blue][player]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue][player]!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue][player]!

entries.original:
"It is the Ruins of Void!

And those\.

Those are Shadow Grunts!"
entries.translation_source: It is the Ruins of Void! And those\. Those are Shadow Grunts!
entries.translated:
Ini Ruins of Void! Dan mereka\.
Mereka adalah Shadow Grunts!

entries.original:
"Are you alright?

This strange ring appeared beneath
you, back in Dehara City.

I was afraid something bad was
about to happen, so I grabbed onto\lyour shirt before you were\lteleported away.

But it looks like Looker didn’t
have the same idea\."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright? This strange ring appeared beneath you, back in Dehara City. I was afraid something bad was about to happen, so I grabbed onto your shirt before you were teleported away. But it looks like Looker didn’t have the same idea\.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak apa-apa? Cincin aneh ini
muncul di bawahmu, di Dehara City.\lAku takut sesuatu yang buruk akan

terjadi, jadi aku meraih bajumu
sebelum kamu diteleportasi. Tapi\lsepertinya Looker tidak punya ide

yang sama\.

entries.original:
"Where are we, anyways?

Could this be\.
the Ruins of Void?"
entries.translation_source: Where are we, anyways? Could this be\. the Ruins of Void?
entries.translated:
Ngomong-ngomong, kita di mana?
Mungkinkah ini\. Ruins of Void?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]This is where we make our
stand, men.

For the sake of the unbinding, they
must not be allowed up here.

Execute Light of Ruin order number
sixty-five!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]This is where we make our stand, men. For the sake of the unbinding, they must not be allowed up here. Execute Light of Ruin order number sixty-five!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Di sinilah kita bertahan,
kawan-kawan. Demi pelepasan ikatan,\lmereka tidak boleh diizinkan naik

ke sini. Jalankan perintah Light of
Ruin nomor enam puluh lima!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Staraptor!

Take out those Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Staraptor! Take out those Shadows!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Staraptor! Hancurkan para
Shadows itu!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]STARAPTOR!

NOOOOOO!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]STARAPTOR! NOOOOOO!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]STARAPTOR! TIDAAAAK!

entries.original:
"[blue]They just destroyed our only way
up, along with my Staraptor\.

Sniff\.

No.

I can’t focus on that right now.

I need to stay strong."
entries.translation_source: [blue]They just destroyed our only way up, along with my Staraptor\. Sniff\. No. I can’t focus on that right now. I need to stay strong.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mereka baru saja menghancurkan
satu-satunya jalan kita ke atas,\lbersama dengan Staraptor-ku\. Hiks\.

Tidak. Aku tidak bisa fokus pada
itu sekarang. Aku harus tetap kuat.

entries.original:
"[blue]It looks like an entrance to the
ruins was uncovered by the blast."
entries.translation_source: [blue]It looks like an entrance to the ruins was uncovered by the blast.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya sebuah pintu masuk ke
reruntuhan terungkap oleh ledakan\litu.

entries.original:
"[blue]You should go in and try to find
another way up to the top.

I would come along, but Staraptor
was the only Pokémon I had on me.

I’d just wear you down if you had
to protect me from wild Pokémon.

Instead, I’ll wait here and take
care of healing for you."
entries.translation_source: [blue]You should go in and try to find another way up to the top. I would come along, but Staraptor was the only Pokémon I had on me. I’d just wear you down if you had to protect me from wild Pokémon. Instead, I’ll wait here and take care of healing for you.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu harus masuk dan mencoba
mencari jalan lain ke atas. Aku\lakan ikut, tapi Staraptor adalah

satu-satunya Pokémon yang ada
padaku. Aku hanya akan membuatmu\llelah jika kamu harus melindungiku

dari Pokémon liar. Sebaliknya, aku
akan menunggu di sini dan merawat\lpenyembuhan untukmu.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, and if you find Staraptor,
please, bring him back to me."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh, and if you find Staraptor, please, bring him back to me.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, dan jika kamu menemukan
Staraptor, tolong, bawa dia kembali\lpadaku.

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient switch.
Would you like to flip it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient switch. Would you like to flip it?
entries.translated:
Ini saklar kuno. Apakah kamu ingin
membaliknya?

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient switch.
Would you like to flip it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient switch. Would you like to flip it?
entries.translated:
Ini saklar kuno. Apakah kamu ingin
membaliknya?

entries.original:
"PROVE YOUR WORTH TO THE GUARDIAN OF
THE RUINS, IF YOU WISH TO PASS!"
entries.translation_source: PROVE YOUR WORTH TO THE GUARDIAN OF THE RUINS, IF YOU WISH TO PASS!
entries.translated:
BUKTIKAN KELAYAKANMU KEPADA PENJAGA
RERUNTUHAN, JIKA KAMU INGIN LEWAT!

entries.original: "YOU HAVE PROVEN YOUR WORTH."
entries.translation_source: YOU HAVE PROVEN YOUR WORTH.
entries.translated: KAMU TELAH MEMBUKTIKAN KELAYAKANMU.

entries.original: "Grunt 1: [blue]Uh oh."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [blue]Uh oh.
entries.translated: Grunt 1: [blue]Uh oh.

entries.original:
"Grunt 2: [blue]Sir, [player] is attempting
to make [buffer1] way up here by coming\lthrough the ruins!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [blue]Sir, [player] is attempting to make [buffer1] way up here by coming through the ruins!
entries.translated:
Grunt 2: [blue]Tuan, [player] sedang
mencoba membuat jalan [buffer1] ke\lsini dengan melewati reruntuhan!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]It doesn’t matter.

By the time [player] gets up here,
Zeph will be ready for the\lunbinding.

However, I still need you two to
stall [player] as much as possible."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]It doesn’t matter. By the time [player] gets up here, Zeph will be ready for the unbinding. However, I still need you two to stall [player] as much as possible.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Tidak masalah. Saat [player]
sampai di sini, Zeph akan siap\luntuk pelepasan ikatan. Namun, aku

masih membutuhkan kalian berdua
untuk menunda [player] sebanyak\lmungkin.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]If I didn’t need you, Hoopa,
I’d throw your Poké Ball into the\locean for all of the\linconveniencies you’ve caused me!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]If I didn’t need you, Hoopa, I’d throw your Poké Ball into the ocean for all of the inconveniencies you’ve caused me!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Jika aku tidak membutuhkanmu,
Hoopa, aku akan melempar Poké\lBallmu ke laut atas semua

ketidaknyamanan yang telah kamu
timbulkan padaku!

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]I’ve got a bad feeling
about that Claydol\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [blue]I’ve got a bad feeling about that Claydol\.
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Aku punya firasat buruk
tentang Claydol itu\.

entries.original: "Grunt 2: [blue]What the\.?"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [blue]What the\.?
entries.translated: Grunt 2: [blue]Apa-apaan\.

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]We’ve got nothing to
prove!

We’re The Shadows!

Let’s take it down!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [blue]We’ve got nothing to prove! We’re The Shadows! Let’s take it down!
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Kami tidak perlu
membuktikan apa pun! Kami adalah\lThe Shadows! Ayo kita hancurkan!

entries.original: "Grunts: [blue]Groan\."
entries.translation_source: Grunts: [blue]Groan\.
entries.translated: Grunts: [blue]Mengerang\.

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU HAVE FAILED TO PROVE YOUR
WORTH!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]YOU HAVE FAILED TO PROVE YOUR WORTH!
entries.translated: [blue]KAMU GAGAL MEMBUKTIKAN KELAYAKANMU!

entries.original:
"DEFEAT THE GUARDIANS OF THE PORTAL
IF YOU WISH TO PROCEED!"
entries.translation_source: DEFEAT THE GUARDIANS OF THE PORTAL IF YOU WISH TO PROCEED!
entries.translated:
KALAHKAN PENJAGA PORTAL JIKA KAMU
INGIN MELANJUTKAN!

entries.original:
"You gaze into the portal\.

\.

Pokémon are attempting to cross
through from the other side!

Are you ready to face them?

Be aware, once the battles begin,
there will be no chance to recover."
entries.translation_source: You gaze into the portal\. \. Pokémon are attempting to cross through from the other side! Are you ready to face them? Be aware, once the battles begin, there will be no chance to recover.
entries.translated:
Kamu menatap ke dalam portal\. \.
Pokémon sedang mencoba menyeberang\ldari sisi lain! Apakah kamu siap

menghadapi mereka? Sadarlah,
setelah pertempuran dimulai, tidak\lakan ada kesempatan untuk pulih.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] ran back into the
portal."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] ran back into the portal.
entries.translated: [buffer1] lari kembali ke portal.

entries.original:
"Another Pokémon is making its way
through the portal!"
entries.translation_source: Another Pokémon is making its way through the portal!
entries.translated:
Pokémon lain sedang berjalan
melewati portal!

entries.original: "YOU HAVE PROVEN YOURSELF!"
entries.translation_source: YOU HAVE PROVEN YOURSELF!
entries.translated:
KAMU TELAH MEMBUKTIKAN DIRIMU
SENDIRI!

entries.original:
"It’s a mysterious portal.

Where could it lead?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a mysterious portal. Where could it lead?
entries.translated:
Ini portal misterius. Ke mana
arahnya?

entries.original: "It’s Jax’s Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: It’s Jax’s Staraptor.
entries.translated: Itu Staraptor milik Jax.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue][player]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue][player]!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue][player]

entries.original:
"[blue]Thank you for finding my Staraptor!

I was able to heal him in time, so
it looks like he’ll be alright.

Great job, by the way, on getting
this far.

It looks like we’re almost at the
top.

One more floor up, and we’ll be
able to stop The Shadows.

I’ll leave you to it, then.

If you need healing, I’ll be
waiting by the side entrance on\lthis floor of the ruins."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Thank you for finding my Staraptor! I was able to heal him in time, so it looks like he’ll be alright. Great job, by the way, on getting this far. It looks like we’re almost at the top. One more floor up, and we’ll be able to stop The Shadows. I’ll leave you to it, then. If you need healing, I’ll be waiting by the side entrance on this floor of the ruins.
entries.translated:
[blue]Terima kasih sudah menemukan
Staraptorku! Aku berhasil\lmenyembuhkannya tepat waktu, jadi

sepertinya dia akan baik-baik saja.
Kerja bagus, ngomong-ngomong,\lkarena sudah sampai sejauh ini.

Sepertinya kita hampir sampai di
puncak. Satu lantai lagi, dan kita\lbisa menghentikan The Shadows. Aku

akan menyerahkan sisanya padamu.
Jika kamu perlu penyembuhan, aku\lakan menunggu di pintu samping di

lantai reruntuhan ini.

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]That Claydol may have
temporarily incapacitated us, but\lwe’re still not going to let you\lthrough without a fight!

The unbinding must not be
disrupted!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [blue]That Claydol may have temporarily incapacitated us, but we’re still not going to let you through without a fight! The unbinding must not be disrupted!
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Claydol itu mungkin untuk
sementara melumpuhkan kita, tapi\lkami tetap tidak akan membiarkanmu

lewat tanpa perlawanan! Unbinding
tidak boleh diganggu!

entries.original:
"Grunt 2: [blue]We’re not done here, yet!

It’s my turn to take you down!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [blue]We’re not done here, yet! It’s my turn to take you down!
entries.translated:
Grunt 2: [blue]Kita belum selesai di
sini! Giliranku untuk\lmenjatuhkanmu!

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Wait!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Tunggu!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue][player] has more important
things to do, than deal with you.

If you want to take someone on, why
don’t you try me on for size!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue][player] has more important things to do, than deal with you. If you want to take someone on, why don’t you try me on for size!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue][player] memiliki hal yang
lebih penting untuk dilakukan,\ldaripada berurusan dengan kalian.

Jika kalian ingin melawan
seseorang, kenapa tidak coba aku!

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!

I’ll take care of these goons.

You go stop The Shadows from
carrying out their \qounbinding\qc.

We’re counting on you."
entries.translation_source: [blue][player]! I’ll take care of these goons. You go stop The Shadows from carrying out their \qounbinding\qc. We’re counting on you.
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Aku akan mengurus para
preman ini. Kamu pergi hentikan The\lShadows melaksanakan \qounbinding\qc.

Kami mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"Once we take care of you, we’re
going to finish [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Once we take care of you, we’re going to finish [player]!
entries.translated:
Setelah kami mengurusmu, kami akan
habisi [player]!

entries.original: "Need healing, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: Need healing, [player]?
entries.translated: Butuh penyembuhan, [player]?

entries.original:
"Okay, you’re all set, [player].

I’ll be here if you need to heal
again."
entries.translation_source: Okay, you’re all set, [player]. I’ll be here if you need to heal again.
entries.translated:
Oke, kamu sudah siap, [player]. Aku
akan di sini jika kamu perlu\lpenyembuhan lagi.

entries.original:
"[player]!

I’m trying to battle these grunts,
but I can heal you quickly!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! I’m trying to battle these grunts, but I can heal you quickly!
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku mencoba bertarung
dengan para preman ini, tapi aku\lbisa menyembuhkanmu dengan cepat!

entries.original: "Grunt 1: [red]Some people never learn\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [red]Some people never learn\.
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [red]Beberapa orang tidak
pernah belajar\.

entries.original:
"Grunt 2: [blue]Get moving, kid.
You’re going to want to see this\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [blue]Get moving, kid. You’re going to want to see this\.
entries.translated:
Grunt 2: [blue]Bergeraklah, nak. Kamu
pasti ingin melihat ini\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]All preparations have been
completed, Zeph.

You can proceed with the unbinding
when ready."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]All preparations have been completed, Zeph. You can proceed with the unbinding when ready.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Semua persiapan telah
selesai, Zeph. Kamu bisa\lmelanjutkan unbinding kapan pun

siap.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Thank you, Ivory.

Just one more thing before I am
ready to begin.

Where is Marlon?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Thank you, Ivory. Just one more thing before I am ready to begin. Where is Marlon?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Terima kasih, Ivory. Satu hal
lagi sebelum aku siap memulai. Di\lmana Marlon?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]I’m sorry, Zeph, but I’m not
sure where he is.

He confirmed that he was on his way
here a while ago, but I haven’t\lheard from him since."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]I’m sorry, Zeph, but I’m not sure where he is. He confirmed that he was on his way here a while ago, but I haven’t heard from him since.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Maaf, Zeph, tapi aku tidak
yakin di mana dia. Dia\lmengkonfirmasi bahwa dia sedang

dalam perjalanan ke sini beberapa
waktu lalu, tapi aku belum\lmendengar kabarnya sejak itu.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Hmm\.

He has been rather on edge
lately\.

I hope he hasn’t gotten cold
feet\.

It would be a shame for him to miss
what we’ve worked so hard for."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Hmm\. He has been rather on edge lately\. I hope he hasn’t gotten cold feet\. It would be a shame for him to miss what we’ve worked so hard for.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Hmm\. Dia agak gelisah
akhir-akhir ini\. Kuharap dia tidak\lmundur\. Akan sangat disayangkan jika

dia melewatkan apa yang telah kita
perjuangkan.

entries.original:
"[blue]Either way, with or without him, I
am now ready to begin."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Either way, with or without him, I am now ready to begin.
entries.translated:
[blue]Bagaimanapun, dengan atau tanpa
dia, aku sekarang siap memulai.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]The time has come to make my
dream a reality.

Once the dark force is unbound, I
will use it to undo the tragedies\lof all those years ago\.

Then, finally, I will be able to
see his smile once again\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]The time has come to make my dream a reality. Once the dark force is unbound, I will use it to undo the tragedies of all those years ago\. Then, finally, I will be able to see his smile once again\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Waktunya telah tiba untuk
mewujudkan mimpiku. Begitu kekuatan\lgelap terlepas, aku akan

menggunakannya untuk membatalkan
tragedi dari bertahun-tahun lalu\.\lKemudian, akhirnya, aku akan bisa

melihat senyumnya lagi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Zapdos!

Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Zapdos! Come forth!
entries.translated: [blue]Zapdos! Maju!

entries.original:
"[blue]Moltres!

Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Moltres! Come forth!
entries.translated: [blue]Moltres! Maju!

entries.original:
"[blue]Articuno!

Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Articuno! Come forth!
entries.translated: [blue]Articuno! Maju!

entries.original:
"[blue]With these three legendary bird
Pokémon assembled here alongside\lthe Void Stone, the seal can\lbe broken."
entries.translation_source: [blue]With these three legendary bird Pokémon assembled here alongside the Void Stone, the seal can be broken.
entries.translated:
[blue]Dengan tiga Pokémon burung
legendaris ini berkumpul di sini\lbersama Batu Kekosongan, segelnya

bisa dipecahkan.

entries.original:
"[blue]One with the shadows, and one with
the night.

A dark hole.

A ring of fury.

A force encapsulated.

Let that be no longer!

What was once sealed is now free!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]One with the shadows, and one with the night. A dark hole. A ring of fury. A force encapsulated. Let that be no longer! What was once sealed is now free!
entries.translated:
[blue]Satu dengan bayangan, satu dengan
malam. Lubang gelap. Cincin\lkemarahan. Kekuatan yang terkurung.

Biarkan itu tidak lagi! Apa yang
dulu tersegel kini bebas!

entries.original:
"[blue]The bottle is now free.

Once I open it, the dark force will
be mine to command."
entries.translation_source: [blue]The bottle is now free. Once I open it, the dark force will be mine to command.
entries.translated:
[blue]Botolnya kini bebas. Begitu aku
membukanya, kekuatan gelap akan\lmenjadi milikku untuk diperintah.

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh?
Why is nothing happening?

The bottle is open\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Huh? Why is nothing happening? The bottle is open\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Hah? Kenapa tidak terjadi apa-apa?
Botolnya terbuka\.

entries.original: "???: [blue]Heh heh heh."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Heh heh heh.
entries.translated: ???: [blue]Heh heh heh.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Who do you think you are!?

And what have you done to the
unbinding!?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Who do you think you are!? And what have you done to the unbinding!?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Kamu pikir kamu siapa!? Dan
apa yang telah kau lakukan pada\lpelepasan!?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Who, me?

The name is Aklove.

I’m just a lowly grunt of The
Shadows."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Who, me? The name is Aklove. I’m just a lowly grunt of The Shadows.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Siapa, aku? Namaku Aklove. Aku
hanyalah seorang Grunt rendahan\ldari The Shadows.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Answer my question, Grunt!

What have you done!?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Answer my question, Grunt! What have you done!?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Jawab pertanyaanku, Grunt!
Apa yang telah kau lakukan!?

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]What have I done?

I have done nothing to interrupt
the unbinding.

In fact, I commend you on an almost
flawless execution.

However, there was one key
component you were missing."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]What have I done? I have done nothing to interrupt the unbinding. In fact, I commend you on an almost flawless execution. However, there was one key component you were missing.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Apa yang telah aku lakukan?
Aku tidak melakukan apa pun untuk\lmengganggu pelepasan. Bahkan, aku

memujimu atas eksekusi yang hampir
sempurna. Namun, ada satu komponen\lkunci yang kau lewatkan.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]And what would that be?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]And what would that be?
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Dan apa itu?

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]If you want to release the
power from the Prison Bottle, there\lneeds to be somewhere for that\lpower to go.

Or more specifically, you need the
Pokémon that used to be the dark\lforce, something you’re lacking.

Of course, you would know that had
I not erased that detail from your\lfiles.

Honestly, I knew it would be easy
to manipulate you if I infiltrated\lyour organization, but I didn’t\lthink it would be this easy!

You played right into my hands,
Zeph!

You unsealed the Prison Bottle
right in front of me!

And now I can use it to truly
finish the unbinding!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]If you want to release the power from the Prison Bottle, there needs to be somewhere for that power to go. Or more specifically, you need the Pokémon that used to be the dark force, something you’re lacking. Of course, you would know that had I not erased that detail from your files. Honestly, I knew it would be easy to manipulate you if I infiltrated your organization, but I didn’t think it would be this easy! You played right into my hands, Zeph! You unsealed the Prison Bottle right in front of me! And now I can use it to truly finish the unbinding!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Jika kau ingin melepaskan
kekuatan dari Botol Penjara, harus\lada tempat untuk menampung kekuatan

itu. Atau lebih spesifiknya, kau
membutuhkan Pokémon yang dulunya\ladalah kekuatan gelap, sesuatu yang

kurang padamu. Tentu saja, kau akan
tahu itu jika aku tidak menghapus\ldetail itu dari berkasmu.

Sejujurnya, aku tahu akan mudah
memanipulasimu jika aku menyusup ke\lorganisasimu, tapi aku tidak

mengira akan semudah ini! Kau jatuh
ke dalam perangkapku, Zeph! Kau\lmembuka segel Botol Penjara tepat

di depanku! Dan sekarang aku bisa
menggunakannya untuk benar-benar\lmenyelesaikan pelepasan!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Wha\.

How dare you make a fool of me!

You’ll pay for this!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Wha\. How dare you make a fool of me! You’ll pay for this!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Apa\. Beraninya kau
mempermalukanku! Kau akan membayar\luntuk ini!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Houndoom!

Incinerate this fool!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Houndoom! Incinerate this fool!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Houndoom! Hanguskan si bodoh
ini!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Hoopa!
Get rid of Houndoom!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Hoopa! Get rid of Houndoom!
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Hoopa! Singkirkan Houndoom!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]No way\.

My Houndoom\.

So then it was you who rescued
[player] all those times\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]No way\. My Houndoom\. So then it was you who rescued [player] all those times\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Tidak mungkin\. Houndoomku\. Jadi
kaulah yang menyelamatkan [player]\lsetiap saat itu\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Actually, that was Hoopa
acting on its own accord.

It was desperate for someone to
rescue it from me.

It felt obligated to protect
[player] as [buffer2] is its true trainer.

I want nothing more than to see
[player] eliminated.

Once [buffer2]’s gone, Hoopa will finally
accept me as its true trainer\.

Only then will I be able to use
its full power, capable of moving\lentire land masses\."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Actually, that was Hoopa acting on its own accord. It was desperate for someone to rescue it from me. It felt obligated to protect [player] as [buffer2] is its true trainer. I want nothing more than to see [player] eliminated. Once [buffer2]’s gone, Hoopa will finally accept me as its true trainer\. Only then will I be able to use its full power, capable of moving entire land masses\.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Sebenarnya, itu adalah
Hoopa yang bertindak atas\lkemauannya sendiri. Ia sangat

menginginkan seseorang untuk
menyelamatkannya dariku. Ia merasa\lberkewajiban untuk melindungi

[player] karena [buffer2] adalah
pelatih sejatinya. Aku tidak\lmenginginkan apa pun selain melihat

[player] disingkirkan. Setelah
[buffer2] tidak ada, Hoopa akhirnya\lakan menerimaku sebagai pelatih

sejatinya\. Hanya saat itulah aku
bisa menggunakan kekuatan penuhnya,\lyang mampu memindahkan seluruh

daratan\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I concede\.

I stand no chance against a
Pokémon like that."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]I concede\. I stand no chance against a Pokémon like that.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Saya mengaku kalah\. Saya tidak
punya peluang melawan Pokémon\lseperti itu.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]That’s a wise decision.

Now move out of my way!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]That’s a wise decision. Now move out of my way!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Itu keputusan yang bijak.
Sekarang minggirlah dari jalanku!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I’m sorry, Ivory.

I wasn’t able to complete the
mission.

However, this isn’t the end.

We will still find a way to bring
them back\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]I’m sorry, Ivory. I wasn’t able to complete the mission. However, this isn’t the end. We will still find a way to bring them back\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Maafkan aku, Ivory. Aku tidak
bisa menyelesaikan misinya. Namun,\lini belum berakhir. Kami tetap akan

menemukan cara untuk membawa mereka
kembali\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]And now, let the main event
begin."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]And now, let the main event begin.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Dan sekarang, mari acara
utama dimulai.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa, prepare yourself!

Your true power is about to be
released from the Prison Bottle!

And as your trainer, I am fully
capable of releasing it!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hoopa, prepare yourself! Your true power is about to be released from the Prison Bottle! And as your trainer, I am fully capable of releasing it!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa, bersiap-siaplah! Kekuatan
sejatimu akan segera dilepaskan\ldari Prison Bottle! Dan sebagai

pelatihmu, aku sepenuhnya mampu
melepaskannya!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]At last!

I’ve waited years for this moment!

Hoopa!

The seal on your power has finally
been broken!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]At last! I’ve waited years for this moment! Hoopa! The seal on your power has finally been broken!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Akhirnya! Aku sudah
menunggu bertahun-tahun untuk momen\lini! Hoopa! Segel kekuatanmu

akhirnya terpecahkan!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Aklove, tell me!

What is your reason for doing all
of this?

Perhaps if we have a common goal,
we can work together!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Aklove, tell me! What is your reason for doing all of this? Perhaps if we have a common goal, we can work together!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Aklove, katakan padaku! Apa
alasanmu melakukan semua ini?\lMungkin jika kita memiliki tujuan

yang sama, kita bisa bekerja sama!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Fool.

We have no common goal.

I am a descendant of the king of
Kalos during the Great War.

My goal is simply to finish what he
started and destroy this region.

With this unbound Hoopa, I will
bring the Ultimate Weapon of Kalos\lhere and use it to turn Borrius\linto a region of death and\ldestruction!

Then, finally, his suffering will
be at its end\.

Now tell me, Zeph. What are your
goals?"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Fool. We have no common goal. I am a descendant of the king of Kalos during the Great War. My goal is simply to finish what he started and destroy this region. With this unbound Hoopa, I will bring the Ultimate Weapon of Kalos here and use it to turn Borrius into a region of death and destruction! Then, finally, his suffering will be at its end\. Now tell me, Zeph. What are your goals?
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Bodoh. Kami tidak punya
tujuan yang sama. Aku adalah\lketurunan raja Kalos selama Perang

Besar. Tujuanku hanyalah
menyelesaikan apa yang dia mulai\ldan menghancurkan wilayah ini.

Dengan Hoopa yang tak terkekang
ini, aku akan membawa Ultimate\lWeapon of Kalos ke sini dan

menggunakannya untuk mengubah
Borrius menjadi wilayah kematian\ldan kehancuran! Lalu, akhirnya,

penderitaannya akan berakhir\.
Sekarang katakan padaku, Zeph. Apa\ltujuanmu?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]My goals?

I have but one goal.

To see those I cared about once
more."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]My goals? I have but one goal. To see those I cared about once more.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Tujuanku? Aku hanya punya
satu tujuan. Untuk bertemu lagi\ldengan mereka yang kuperhatikan.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]To use such a great power
for something like that\.

I never could’ve imagined anyone
would try that!

You are truly a strange one, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]To use such a great power for something like that\. I never could’ve imagined anyone would try that! You are truly a strange one, Zeph.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Menggunakan kekuatan
sebesar itu untuk hal seperti itu\.\lAku tidak pernah membayangkan ada

yang akan mencoba itu! Kamu
benar-benar aneh, Zeph.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]I\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]I\.
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Aku\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Enough!

Remove yourself from my presence.

The Shadows are finshed.

It’s time for Borrius to be
enveloped in The Light of Ruin.

But first\.

Grunts!

Bring [player] to me!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Enough! Remove yourself from my presence. The Shadows are finshed. It’s time for Borrius to be enveloped in The Light of Ruin. But first\. Grunts! Bring [player] to me!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Cukup! Enyahlah dari
hadapanku. The Shadows sudah\lselesai. Saatnya Borrius diselimuti

oleh The Light of Ruin. Tapi
pertama\. Grunts! Bawa [player] ke\lhadapanku!

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]My grunts\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]My grunts\.
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Grunts-ku\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Are you really surprised
your grunts would join me?

You burn them alive if they disobey
you!

I promised them safety
from the coming storm if they\lworked for me instead."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Are you really surprised your grunts would join me? You burn them alive if they disobey you! I promised them safety from the coming storm if they worked for me instead.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Apa kau benar-benar heran
jika grunts-mu bergabung denganku?\lKau membakar mereka hidup-hidup

jika mereka tidak patuh padamu! Aku
menjanjikan mereka keselamatan dari\lbadai yang akan datang jika mereka

bekerja untukku sebagai gantinya.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Now, [player], it’s time you
were eliminated once and for all.

I’ve watched as you’ve been a
repeated nuisance to The Shadows.

I can’t have you becoming a
nuisance to me, as well."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Now, [player], it’s time you were eliminated once and for all. I’ve watched as you’ve been a repeated nuisance to The Shadows. I can’t have you becoming a nuisance to me, as well.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Sekarang, [player], saatnya
kau dilenyapkan sekali dan untuk\lselamanya. Aku telah melihat

bagaimana kau terus-menerus menjadi
gangguan bagi The Shadows. Aku\ltidak bisa membiarkanmu menjadi

gangguan bagiku juga.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Summon a Pokémon to eliminate
[player]!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hoopa! Summon a Pokémon to eliminate [player]!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa! Panggil seekor Pokémon untuk
melenyapkan [player]!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] flew back into the
portal."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] flew back into the portal.
entries.translated: [buffer1] terbang kembali ke portal.

entries.original: "Aklove: [blue]Summon another, Hoopa!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Summon another, Hoopa!
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Panggil yang lain, Hoopa!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Is that the best you’ve
got, Hoopa?"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Is that the best you’ve got, Hoopa?
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Itukah yang terbaik yang
kau punya, Hoopa?

entries.original:
"[blue]It’s over, [player].
I’ve had enough of this.

I’m going to have you incinerated.

My Hoopa won’t save you now."
entries.translation_source: [blue]It’s over, [player]. I’ve had enough of this. I’m going to have you incinerated. My Hoopa won’t save you now.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sudah berakhir, [player]. Aku sudah
muak dengan ini. Aku akan membuatmu\ldibakar hangus. Hoopa-ku tidak akan

menyelamatkanmu sekarang.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Summon an incineration!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hoopa! Summon an incineration!
entries.translated: [blue]Hoopa! Panggil pembakaran!

entries.original: "Aklove: [blue]Farewell, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Farewell, [player].
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Selamat tinggal, [player].

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s you.

I guess your time was finally up
then, huh?

So tell me, how did you go?

\.

Incineration\.

That figures\.

Well, it’s still a better way than
drowning."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s you. I guess your time was finally up then, huh? So tell me, how did you go? \. Incineration\. That figures\. Well, it’s still a better way than drowning.
entries.translated:
Oh, ternyata kamu. Kurasa waktumu
habis, ya? Jadi, ceritakan,\lbagaimana kau mati? \. Dibakar\. Itu

masuk akal\. Yah, itu masih lebih
baik daripada tenggelam.

entries.original:
"You must be wondering where we are,
am I right?

\.

I thought so.

I guess you could say this is what
people call the \qoJudgement Zone\qc.

It is here where the great creator
of the universe, Arceus himself,\lpasses judgement on those who have\lleft the world."
entries.translation_source: You must be wondering where we are, am I right? \. I thought so. I guess you could say this is what people call the \qoJudgement Zone\qc. It is here where the great creator of the universe, Arceus himself, passes judgement on those who have left the world.
entries.translated:
Kamu pasti bertanya-tanya di mana
kita, {B4}kan? \. Benar dugaanku. Kurasa\lini yang disebut \qoZona

Penghakiman\qc. Di sinilah pencipta
agung alam semesta, Arceus sendiri,\lmenghakimi mereka yang telah

meninggalkan dunia.

entries.original:
"I’ve heard that this place is
supposed to reflect your home.

\.

I don’t know what you see, but I
see the sea, everywhere I look.

The region I’m from\.

Well, as some would put it, it had
\qotoo much water\qc.

I think I may have stayed there
forever, had Zeph not convinced\lIvory and me to leave."
entries.translation_source: I’ve heard that this place is supposed to reflect your home. \. I don’t know what you see, but I see the sea, everywhere I look. The region I’m from\. Well, as some would put it, it had \qotoo much water\qc. I think I may have stayed there forever, had Zeph not convinced Ivory and me to leave.
entries.translated:
Kudengar tempat ini seharusnya
mencerminkan rumahmu. \. Aku tak tahu\lapa yang kau lihat, tapi aku

melihat laut, ke mana pun aku
memandang. Daerah asalku\. Yah,\lseperti yang sebagian orang bilang,

daerah itu \qokelebihan air\qc. Kurasa
aku mungkin tinggal di sana\lselamanya, jika Zeph tidak

meyakinkan Ivory dan aku untuk
pergi.

entries.original:
"What do you see, [player]?

\.

Snow, huh?

Makes sense\.

Frozen Heights is the home your
father chose for you, after all."
entries.translation_source: What do you see, [player]? \. Snow, huh? Makes sense\. Frozen Heights is the home your father chose for you, after all.
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau lihat, [player]? \.
Salju, ya? Masuk akal\. Frozen\lHeights adalah rumah yang ayahmu

pilih untukmu.

entries.original:
"You know, [player], I knew your
father well.

He was a good man.

I even had the pleasure of working
with him at one point\."
entries.translation_source: You know, [player], I knew your father well. He was a good man. I even had the pleasure of working with him at one point\.
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, [player], aku kenal baik
ayahmu. Dia pria yang baik. Aku\lbahkan pernah bekerja sama

dengannya\.

entries.original:
"He used to say that even the
worst of men had the best of\lintent at some point in their\lcareer.

\.

His words echoed in my head until
the day I died."
entries.translation_source: He used to say that even the worst of men had the best of intent at some point in their career. \. His words echoed in my head until the day I died.
entries.translated:
Dia sering berkata bahwa bahkan
orang terburuk pun punya niat\lterbaik di suatu titik dalam karier

mereka. \. Kata-katanya bergema di
kepalaku sampai hari kematianku.

entries.original:
"I know you must have the impression
that I’m some sort of \qodespicable\lvillain\qc, but I can’t even begin to\ltell you how wrong that notion is.

It just seems that way because of
the things you’ve witnessed The\lShadows do."
entries.translation_source: I know you must have the impression that I’m some sort of \qodespicable villain\qc, but I can’t even begin to tell you how wrong that notion is. It just seems that way because of the things you’ve witnessed The Shadows do.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu pasti kau punya kesan
bahwa aku semacam \qovillain keji\qc,\ltapi aku bahkan tak bisa mulai

mengatakan betapa salahnya anggapan
itu. Tampak seperti itu karena\lhal-hal yang kau saksikan dilakukan

The Shadows.

entries.original:
"We started out with good intent.
