It was only some time later on when
things began to get out of hand.

When did it go all wrong\."
entries.translation_source: We started out with good intent. It was only some time later on when things began to get out of hand. When did it go all wrong\.
entries.translated:
Kami mulai dengan niat baik. Hanya
beberapa waktu kemudian keadaan\lmulai tidak terkendali. Kapan

semuanya menjadi salah\.

entries.original: "It’s time, [player]."
entries.translation_source: It’s time, [player].
entries.translated: Sudah waktunya, [player].

entries.original: "MARLON. [player]."
entries.translation_source: MARLON. [player].
entries.translated: MARLON. [player].

entries.original:
"[black]Marlon: [blue]Arceus\.

The creator of the universe\."
entries.translation_source: [black]Marlon: [blue]Arceus\. The creator of the universe\.
entries.translated:
[black]Marlon: [blue]Arceus\. Pencipta alam
semesta\.

entries.original:
"[black]Arceus: [blue]\.YES.

IT IS TIME FOR YOUR JUDGEMENT."
entries.translation_source: [black]Arceus: [blue]\.YES. IT IS TIME FOR YOUR JUDGEMENT.
entries.translated:
[black]Arceus: [blue]\.YA. SUDAH WAKTUNYA
PENGHAKIMANMU.

entries.original:
"MARLON!

DABBLING IN THE FORBIDDEN ART.

RESSURECTION.

SIN.

YOU WILL BE RETURNED TO YOUR
WORLD, IMMORTAL UNTIL THE WORLD\lIS CLEANSED.

ONLY ONE OTHER HAS EVER ENDURED
THIS PUNISHMENT, AND TO THIS DAY\lHE STILL ROAMS THE WORLD, A\lTHOUSAND YEARS LATER!

RIGHT YOUR WRONGS!

FREE THOSE WHOSE SOULS HAVE BEEN
TRAPPED IN [green]CINDER VOLCANO[blue]!

BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE\.

THIS IS MY VERDICT!

BEGONE!"
entries.translation_source: MARLON! DABBLING IN THE FORBIDDEN ART. RESSURECTION. SIN. YOU WILL BE RETURNED TO YOUR WORLD, IMMORTAL UNTIL THE WORLD IS CLEANSED. ONLY ONE OTHER HAS EVER ENDURED THIS PUNISHMENT, AND TO THIS DAY HE STILL ROAMS THE WORLD, A THOUSAND YEARS LATER! RIGHT YOUR WRONGS! FREE THOSE WHOSE SOULS HAVE BEEN TRAPPED IN [green]CINDER VOLCANO[blue]! BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE\. THIS IS MY VERDICT! BEGONE!
entries.translated:
MARLON! MENCAMPURI SENI TERLARANG.
KEBANGKITAN. DOSA. KAU AKAN\lDIKEMBALIKAN KE DUNIAMU, ABADI

HINGGA DUNIA INI DIBERSIHKAN. HANYA
SATU ORANG LAIN YANG PERNAH\lMENJALANI HUKUMAN INI, DAN HINGGA

SAAT INI DIA MASIH BERKELIARAN DI
DUNIA, SERIBU TAHUN KEMUDIAN!\lPERBAIKI KESALAHANMU! BEBASKAN

MEREKA YANG JIWANYA TERPERANGKAP DI
[green]CINDER VOLCANO[blue]! SEBELUM TERLAMBAT\.\lINI PUTUSANKU! PERGILAH!

entries.original:
"[player]!

PREMATURE DEATH.

A CURSE ON YOUR SOUL.

FOR AROS, I SHALL RESTORE YOU TO
LIFE!

ONE CONDITION.

SUCCEED IN STOPPING THE ENDLESS
TORMENT OF SOULS, OR I WILL\lRETURN YOU TO ASH.

THIS IS MY VERDICT.

BEGONE!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! PREMATURE DEATH. A CURSE ON YOUR SOUL. FOR AROS, I SHALL RESTORE YOU TO LIFE! ONE CONDITION. SUCCEED IN STOPPING THE ENDLESS TORMENT OF SOULS, OR I WILL RETURN YOU TO ASH. THIS IS MY VERDICT. BEGONE!
entries.translated:
[player]! KEMATIAN PREMATUR.
KUTUKAN PADA JIWAMU. DEMI AROS, AKU\lAKAN MENGHIDUPKANMU KEMBALI! SATU

SYARAT. BERHASILLAH MENGHENTIKAN
SIKSAAN TAK BERAKHIR PARA JIWA,\lATAU AKU AKAN MENGEMBALIKANMU

MENJADI ABU. INI PUTUSANKU.
PERGILAH!

entries.original:
"I don’t know who you are, but
you’re not getting past me like\lthat other guy did!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t know who you are, but you’re not getting past me like that other guy did!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu siapa dirimu, tapi
kau tidak akan melewatiku seperti\lyang dilakukan orang lain itu!

entries.original:
"\.[player]?

But\.but\.but you’re supposed to
be dead!

How is this possible?

I need to warn the others!"
entries.translation_source: \.[player]? But\.but\.but you’re supposed to be dead! How is this possible? I need to warn the others!
entries.translated:
\.[player]? Tapi\.tapi\.tapi kau
seharusnya sudah mati! Bagaimana\lini mungkin? Aku harus

memperingatkan yang lain!

entries.original: "[red]No, no, no, no, no!"
entries.translation_source: [red]No, no, no, no, no!
entries.translated: [red]Tidak, tidak, tidak, tidak, tidak!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Véga!

How could you betray The Shadows!?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Véga! How could you betray The Shadows!?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Véga! Bagaimana kau bisa
mengkhianati The Shadows!?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Marlon!?

Aklove told us he killed you!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Marlon!? Aklove told us he killed you!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Marlon!? Aklove bilang dia
sudah membunuhmu!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I don’t care what this
\qoAklove\qc person told you!

What have you done with all of the
Shadow Warriors?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]I don’t care what this \qoAklove\qc person told you! What have you done with all of the Shadow Warriors?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Aku tidak peduli apa yang
dikatakan orang \qoAklove\qc itu\lpadamu! Apa yang kau lakukan

terhadap semua Shadow Warriors?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Don’t worry, Marlon.

They were moved to a more\.secure
location, long before you arrived."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Don’t worry, Marlon. They were moved to a more\.secure location, long before you arrived.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Jangan khawatir, Marlon.
Mereka sudah dipindahkan ke lokasi\lyang lebih\.aman, jauh sebelum kau

tiba.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Tell me where they are,
Véga!

Or so help me I’ll have you turned
into one of them!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Tell me where they are, Véga! Or so help me I’ll have you turned into one of them!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Katakan di mana mereka,
Véga! Atau aku sumpah aku akan\lmengubahmu menjadi salah satu dari

mereka!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Do you think that you can
still order me around?

I’m no longer an undercover agent
of The Shadows.

Aklove had me promoted, and now I’m
an admin of the Light of Ruin!

And as of now, my first assignment
is virtually complete."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Do you think that you can still order me around? I’m no longer an undercover agent of The Shadows. Aklove had me promoted, and now I’m an admin of the Light of Ruin! And as of now, my first assignment is virtually complete.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Apakah kau pikir kau masih
bisa memerintahku? Aku bukan lagi\lagen rahasia The Shadows. Aklove

mempromosikanku, dan sekarang aku
admin dari Light of Ruin! Dan saat\lini, tugas pertamaku hampir

selesai.

entries.original:
"[blue]One of you!

Help me get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]One of you! Help me get rid of him!
entries.translated:
[blue]Salah satu dari kalian! Bantu aku
menyingkirkannya!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]You’re going to wish you
stayed dead, Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]You’re going to wish you stayed dead, Marlon!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Kau akan menyesal tidak mati
saja, Marlon!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [red]Sir!

[player] is still alive!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [red]Sir! [player] is still alive!
entries.translated: Grunt: [red]Pak! [player] masih hidup!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]I’m adept at dealing with
Dark-types, not Ghosts\."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]I’m adept at dealing with Dark-types, not Ghosts\.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Aku mahir dalam menangani
Tipe Gelap, bukan Tipe Hantu\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]So you made it back too,
[player]\.

Quick, help me deal with these
\qoLight of Ruin\qc tools."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]So you made it back too, [player]\. Quick, help me deal with these \qoLight of Ruin\qc tools.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Jadi kau juga berhasil
kembali, [player]\. Cepat, bantu aku\lberurusan dengan orang-orang \qoLight

of Ruin\qc ini.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]All grunts, retreat back to
the base in [green]Vivill Town[blue]!

We’re not equipped to deal with
these\.zombies right now!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]All grunts, retreat back to the base in [green]Vivill Town[blue]! We’re not equipped to deal with these\.zombies right now!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Semua grunt, mundur kembali
ke markas di [green]Vivill Town[blue]! Kami\ltidak siap untuk berurusan dengan

zombie\. ini sekarang!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Oh no you don’t!

You’re not getting away yet!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Oh no you don’t! You’re not getting away yet!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Oh tidak, jangan! Kau tidak
akan kabur begitu saja!

entries.original: "Véga: [blue]You can’t restrain me!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]You can’t restrain me!
entries.translated: Véga: [blue]Kau tidak bisa menahanku!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]There’s nowhere to run,
Véga.

One more step and you’ll be burned
alive.

So I suggest that if you want to
live, you’ll tell me where Aklove\lis keeping the Shadow Warriors."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]There’s nowhere to run, Véga. One more step and you’ll be burned alive. So I suggest that if you want to live, you’ll tell me where Aklove is keeping the Shadow Warriors.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Tidak ada tempat untuk
lari, Véga. Satu langkah lagi dan\lkau akan terbakar hidup-hidup. Jadi

aku sarankan jika kau ingin hidup,
kau akan memberitahuku di mana\lAklove menyembunyikan Shadow

Warriors.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Huh.

I guess I have no choice then.

\.

\.

Now if only he would hurry up\."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Huh. I guess I have no choice then. \. \. Now if only he would hurry up\.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Huh. Kurasa aku tidak punya
pilihan. \. \. Sekarang andai saja dia\lcepat\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]What the\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]What the\.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Apa apaan\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Did you see that?

He just disappeared into that
portal\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Did you see that? He just disappeared into that portal\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa kau lihat itu? Dia baru saja
menghilang ke dalam portal itu\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Follow my lead, [player].

We’re going in after him."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Follow my lead, [player]. We’re going in after him.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ikuti aku, [player]. Kita akan
mengejarnya.

entries.original:
"[blue]On my count\.

3\.

2\.

1\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]On my count\. 3\. 2\. 1\.
entries.translated: [blue]Menurut hitunganku\. 3\. 2\. 1\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Oof!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Oof!
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Oof!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Heh, sorry, I just went to
get something from Aklove in Hoenn.

No need to be so violent, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Heh, sorry, I just went to get something from Aklove in Hoenn. No need to be so violent, Marlon.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Heh, maaf, aku baru saja
pergi mengambil sesuatu dari Aklove\ldi Hoenn. Tidak perlu bersikap

begitu kasar, Marlon.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]You know, I heard an
interesting little tidbit of info\lfrom back when Aklove was a guard\lhere."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]You know, I heard an interesting little tidbit of info from back when Aklove was a guard here.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Kau tahu, aku mendengar
sedikit informasi menarik dari saat\lAklove masih menjadi penjaga di

sini.

entries.original:
"[blue]Apparently, when Zeph was having
this cave dug out, the grunts\ldigging found the ancient Pokémon\lGroudon fast asleep beneath the\lmagma.

But instead of reporting it to
Zeph, they quickly covered it back\lup and proceeded to dig around it.

However, had they possesed the
correct object back then, maybe\lZeph never would have lost the\lupper hand."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Apparently, when Zeph was having this cave dug out, the grunts digging found the ancient Pokémon Groudon fast asleep beneath the magma. But instead of reporting it to Zeph, they quickly covered it back up and proceeded to dig around it. However, had they possesed the correct object back then, maybe Zeph never would have lost the upper hand.
entries.translated:
[blue]Rupanya, saat Zeph menyuruh
menggali gua ini, para kru yang\lmenggali menemukan Pokémon kuno

Groudon yang tertidur lelap di
bawah magma. Namun alih-alih\lmelaporkannya ke Zeph, mereka

segera menutupnya kembali dan
melanjutkan penggalian di\lsekitarnya. Namun, seandainya

mereka memiliki objek yang tepat
saat itu, mungkin Zeph tidak akan\lpernah kehilangan keunggulannya.

entries.original:
"[blue]Groudon!

Respond to the Red Orb!

Awaken, and revert to your
primordial state!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Groudon! Respond to the Red Orb! Awaken, and revert to your primordial state!
entries.translated:
[blue]Groudon! Tanggapi Bola Merah!
Bangunlah, dan kembalilah ke wujud\lprimordialmu!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]What will you do, Marlon?

If you keep holding me here I’ll
die and your only source of info\lon the whereabouts of the Shadow\lWarriors will vanish in a puff of\lsmoke."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]What will you do, Marlon? If you keep holding me here I’ll die and your only source of info on the whereabouts of the Shadow Warriors will vanish in a puff of smoke.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Apa yang akan kau lakukan,
Marlon? Jika kau terus menahanku di\lsini, aku akan mati dan

satu-satunya sumber informasi
tentang keberadaan Shadow Warriors\lakan lenyap begitu saja.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Even if you die, Véga,
I’ll still know the location of\lyour base.

You ordered your grunts to retreat
to [green]Vivill Town[blue], did you not?

After I get Zeph from [green]Frozen
Heights[blue], I’ll head there to look\lfor the Shadow Warriors."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Even if you die, Véga, I’ll still know the location of your base. You ordered your grunts to retreat to [green]Vivill Town[blue], did you not? After I get Zeph from [green]Frozen Heights[blue], I’ll head there to look for the Shadow Warriors.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Bahkan jika kau mati, Véga,
aku tetap tahu lokasi markasmu. Kau\lmemerintahkan kru-mu mundur ke

[green]Vivill Town[blue], bukan? Setelah aku
menjemput Zeph dari [green]Frozen Heights[blue],\laku akan pergi ke sana untuk

mencari Shadow Warriors.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Groudon!

Shake the earth!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Groudon! Shake the earth!
entries.translated: Véga: [blue]Groudon! Goncangkan bumi!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Can’t keep your footing,
Marlon?

In that case, until we meet again."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Can’t keep your footing, Marlon? In that case, until we meet again.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Tidak bisa menjaga
keseimbanganmu, Marlon? Kalau\lbegitu, sampai jumpa lagi.

entries.original:
"[blue][player], you need to prevent Groudon
from going on a rampage.

If you don’t, the cave will
collapse and we’ll be trapped in\lhere!"
entries.translation_source: [blue][player], you need to prevent Groudon from going on a rampage. If you don’t, the cave will collapse and we’ll be trapped in here!
entries.translated:
[blue][player], kau harus mencegah
Groudon mengamuk. Jika tidak, gua\lini akan runtuh dan kita akan

terjebak di sini!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] sunk into the lava and
fell into a deep slumber once more."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] sunk into the lava and fell into a deep slumber once more.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] tenggelam ke dalam lava
dan tertidur lelap kembali.

entries.original:
"[blue]Not bad, [player].

I now realize why Arceus sent you
back as well.

However from here on out, I need to
do things alone.

If you come to our base in [green]Frozen
Heights [blue]too, Zeph will not agree to\lhelp me find the Shadow Warriors.

I’m grateful for your help, but
please, [player], don’t follow me to\l[green]our base in Frozen Heights[blue]."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Not bad, [player]. I now realize why Arceus sent you back as well. However from here on out, I need to do things alone. If you come to our base in [green]Frozen Heights [blue]too, Zeph will not agree to help me find the Shadow Warriors. I’m grateful for your help, but please, [player], don’t follow me to [green]our base in Frozen Heights[blue].
entries.translated:
[blue]Tidak buruk, [player]. Sekarang aku
sadar mengapa Arceus juga\lmengirimmu kembali. Namun mulai

sekarang, aku harus melakukan
semuanya sendiri. Jika kau datang\ljuga ke markas kami di [green]Frozen

Heights [blue]juga, Zeph tidak akan
setuju membantu saya mencari Shadow\lWarriors. Aku berterima kasih atas

bantuanmu, tapi tolong, [player],
jangan ikuti aku ke [green]markas kami di\lFrozen Heights[blue].

entries.original:
"It looks like someone left their
uniform on the floor.

Would you like to put it on?"
entries.translation_source: It looks like someone left their uniform on the floor. Would you like to put it on?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya seseorang meninggalkan
seragamnya di lantai. Apakah kamu\lingin memakainya?

entries.original: "You put on the clothes."
entries.translation_source: You put on the clothes.
entries.translated: Kamu memakai pakaian itu.

entries.original:
"Your clothes are on the ground.
Would you like to put them on?"
entries.translation_source: Your clothes are on the ground. Would you like to put them on?
entries.translated:
Pakaianmu ada di tanah. Apakah kamu
ingin memakainya?

entries.original:
"You put on the clothes and placed
Marlon’s uniform in the Cube."
entries.translation_source: You put on the clothes and placed Marlon’s uniform in the Cube.
entries.translated:
Kamu memakai pakaian itu dan
meletakkan seragam Marlon di Cube.

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I know what it looks like, but I
promise, I’m not slacking off!

Zeph told me to watch the news, and
keep an eye out for anyone who\llooks like they might belong to the\lLight of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I know what it looks like, but I promise, I’m not slacking off! Zeph told me to watch the news, and keep an eye out for anyone who looks like they might belong to the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Marlon, Tuan! Aku tahu ini terlihat
seperti apa, tapi aku berjanji, aku\ltidak bermalas-malasan! Zeph

menyuruhku menonton berita, dan
mewaspadai siapa pun yang terlihat\lseperti anggota Light of Ruin.

entries.original:
"With most of the other grunts gone,
our manpower has become very\llimited.

So it is essential that each of us
become as strong as possible.

Would you allow me the privilege of
battling with you, sir?"
entries.translation_source: With most of the other grunts gone, our manpower has become very limited. So it is essential that each of us become as strong as possible. Would you allow me the privilege of battling with you, sir?
entries.translated:
Dengan sebagian besar kru lainnya
pergi, tenaga kita menjadi sangat\lterbatas. Jadi penting bagi kita

masing-masing untuk menjadi sekuat
mungkin. Maukah Tuan mengizinkan\lsaya bertarung dengan Tuan?

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me,
sir.

Now we are both more prepared for
the inevitable confrontation with\lthe Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me, sir. Now we are both more prepared for the inevitable confrontation with the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah bertarung
denganku, Tuan. Sekarang kita\lberdua lebih siap menghadapi

konfrontasi yang tak terhindarkan
dengan Light of Ruin.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I wouldn’t expect you to waste your
time on a grunt, such as myself."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I wouldn’t expect you to waste your time on a grunt, such as myself.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Tuan. Saya tidak akan
mengharapkan Tuan membuang waktu\luntuk seorang kru seperti saya.

entries.original:
"The base has been so quiet ever
since most of the grunts pledged\lthe allegiances to the Light of\lRuin.

To be honest, sir, I was asked to
join too, but I refused.

I would have told you about the
betrayal, but they threatened to\lkill my family if I said anything.

I’m sorry sir, but I couldn’t
sacrifice my family.

You get that, right?"
entries.translation_source: The base has been so quiet ever since most of the grunts pledged the allegiances to the Light of Ruin. To be honest, sir, I was asked to join too, but I refused. I would have told you about the betrayal, but they threatened to kill my family if I said anything. I’m sorry sir, but I couldn’t sacrifice my family. You get that, right?
entries.translated:
Markas menjadi sangat sepi sejak
sebagian besar kru menyatakan\lkesetiaan kepada Light of Ruin.

Sejujurnya, Tuan, saya juga diminta
bergabung, tapi saya menolak.\lSeharusnya saya memberi tahu Tuan

tentang pengkhianatan itu, tapi
mereka mengancam akan membunuh\lkeluarga saya jika saya mengatakan

apapun. Maaf Tuan, tapi saya tidak
bisa mengorbankan keluarga saya.\lTuan mengerti, kan?

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I heard rumours that you were
murdered by Aklove.

I’m glad you’re still alive.

Maybe with you around now, someone
will be able to bring Zeph back to\la good state of mind."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I heard rumours that you were murdered by Aklove. I’m glad you’re still alive. Maybe with you around now, someone will be able to bring Zeph back to a good state of mind.
entries.translated:
Marlon, Tuan! Saya mendengar rumor
bahwa Anda dibunuh oleh Aklove.\lSaya senang Anda masih hidup.

Mungkin dengan kehadiran Anda
sekarang, seseorang akan bisa\lmembawa Zeph kembali ke kondisi

pikiran yang baik.

entries.original:
"I’m using a complicated algorithm
to determine the approximate\llocation of the Light of Ruin HQ.

Once I have the results, Zeph plans
on using the information to take\lhis revenge on the Light of Ruin.

The only thing is, I don’t know how
long it will take to finish\."
entries.translation_source: I’m using a complicated algorithm to determine the approximate location of the Light of Ruin HQ. Once I have the results, Zeph plans on using the information to take his revenge on the Light of Ruin. The only thing is, I don’t know how long it will take to finish\.
entries.translated:
Saya menggunakan algoritma rumit
untuk menentukan perkiraan lokasi\lMarkas Light of Ruin. Setelah saya

mendapatkan hasilnya, Zeph
berencana menggunakan informasi itu\luntuk membalas dendam pada Light of

Ruin. Satu-satunya masalah adalah,
saya tidak tahu berapa lama waktu\lyang dibutuhkan untuk

menyelesaikannya\.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry about the huge mess in
the base, sir.

When most of the grunts left to
join the Light of Ruin, they just\ldropped all of their things on the\lfloor.

I’m sure some of them even left
their clearance cards behind\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry about the huge mess in the base, sir. When most of the grunts left to join the Light of Ruin, they just dropped all of their things on the floor. I’m sure some of them even left their clearance cards behind\.
entries.translated:
Saya minta maaf tentang kekacauan
besar di pangkalan, Tuan. Saat\lsebagian besar anak buah pergi

untuk bergabung dengan Light of
Ruin, mereka menjatuhkan semua\lbarang mereka di lantai. Saya yakin

beberapa dari mereka bahkan
meninggalkan kartu akses mereka\.

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened."
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened.
entries.translated:
Pintu ini memerlukan Kartu Kunci
dengan Tingkat Akses: [green][buffer1][black],\luntuk dibuka.

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened.

Would you like to open the door?"
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened. Would you like to open the door?
entries.translated:
Pintu ini memerlukan Kartu Kunci
dengan Tingkat Akses: [green][buffer1][black],\luntuk dibuka. Apakah Anda ingin

membuka pintu?

entries.original:
"It appears as if the door has been
blown apart."
entries.translation_source: It appears as if the door has been blown apart.
entries.translated:
Tampaknya pintu telah hancur
terbang.

entries.original:
"Oh, Marlon, sir!

I’ve been working on new ways to
make The Shadows’ Pokémon\lstronger.

Would you like to see them in
battle?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Marlon, sir! I’ve been working on new ways to make The Shadows’ Pokémon stronger. Would you like to see them in battle?
entries.translated:
Oh, Marlon, Tuan! Saya telah
mengerjakan cara-cara baru untuk\lmembuat Pokémon The Shadows lebih

kuat. Apakah Anda ingin melihat
mereka dalam pertempuran?

entries.original:
"For spending your valuable time
battling me, I’d like to thank you\lby healing your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: For spending your valuable time battling me, I’d like to thank you by healing your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Karena telah meluangkan waktu
berharga Anda untuk bertarung\ldengan saya, saya ingin berterima

kasih dengan menyembuhkan Pokémon
Anda.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I’m sure you have much more,
important, business to attend to."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I’m sure you have much more, important, business to attend to.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Tuan. Saya yakin Anda
memiliki urusan yang jauh lebih\lpenting untuk diurus.

entries.original:
"The final batch of Shadow Warriors
that Zeph requested, are almost\lfully synthesized.

Once the process is complete, it
should give us enough fighting\lpower to take down the Light of\lRuin."
entries.translation_source: The final batch of Shadow Warriors that Zeph requested, are almost fully synthesized. Once the process is complete, it should give us enough fighting power to take down the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Kelompok terakhir Shadow Warriors
yang diminta Zeph, hampir\lsepenuhnya disintesis. Setelah

proses selesai, itu akan memberi
kita kekuatan tempur yang cukup\luntuk menjatuhkan Light of Ruin.

entries.original:
"For this final batch of Shadow
Warriors, Zeph requested that only\lthe strongest of Pokémon be used,\lto get the greatest results."
entries.translation_source: For this final batch of Shadow Warriors, Zeph requested that only the strongest of Pokémon be used, to get the greatest results.
entries.translated:
Untuk kelompok terakhir Shadow
Warriors ini, Zeph meminta agar\lhanya Pokémon terkuat yang

digunakan, untuk mendapatkan hasil
terbaik.

entries.original: "The cage is empty."
entries.translation_source: The cage is empty.
entries.translated: Kandang itu kosong.

entries.original:
"Hey, hey, kid!
It’s dangerous!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, hey, kid! It’s dangerous!
entries.translated: Hei, hei, nak! Itu berbahaya!

entries.original:
"Sir!

Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone
without the proper clearance from\lentering the lab.

However, I’m sure it’s fine if I
allow you in."
entries.translation_source: Sir! Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone without the proper clearance from entering the lab. However, I’m sure it’s fine if I allow you in.
entries.translated:
Tuan! Zeph telah memerintahkan saya
untuk menghentikan siapa pun tanpa\lizin yang tepat untuk memasuki lab.

Namun, saya yakin tidak apa-apa
jika saya mengizinkan Anda masuk.

entries.original:
"Please feel free to enter the lab,
sir."
entries.translation_source: Please feel free to enter the lab, sir.
entries.translated: Silakan masuk ke lab, Tuan.

entries.original:
"I’ve been instructed by my
superiors to hand out that HM to\lany trainers coming this way.

Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll
need to use that HM for [green]Rock Climb[blue]\lif you want to go to [green]Seaport City[blue].

Just face that rock wall over
there to use it."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been instructed by my superiors to hand out that HM to any trainers coming this way. Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll need to use that HM for [green]Rock Climb[blue] if you want to go to [green]Seaport City[blue]. Just face that rock wall over there to use it.
entries.translated:
Saya diperintahkan oleh atasan saya
untuk membagikan HM itu kepada\lsetiap pelatih yang datang ke sini.

Sampai jembatan diperbaiki, Anda
perlu menggunakan HM itu untuk\l[green]Memanjat Tebing[blue] jika Anda ingin

pergi ke [green]Seaport City[blue]. Hadapi saja
dinding batu di sana untuk\lmenggunakannya.

entries.original: "You’re already on this floor."
entries.translation_source: You’re already on this floor.
entries.translated: Anda sudah berada di lantai ini.

entries.translation_source: F1
entries.translated: F1

entries.original: "B1F"
entries.translation_source: B1F
entries.translated: B1F

entries.original: "B2F"
entries.translation_source: B2F
entries.translated: B2F

entries.original: "B3F"
entries.translation_source: B3F
entries.translated: B3F

entries.original:
"[red]Now, Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Now, Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang, Shadow Warriors! Tahan
dia!

entries.original:
"No!

I’d rather drown than be turned
into one of those\.things!"
entries.translation_source: No! I’d rather drown than be turned into one of those\.things!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Aku lebih baik tenggelam
daripada diubah menjadi salah satu\ldari\.makhluk itu!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Zeph\.

What’s happened to you?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Zeph\. What’s happened to you?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Zeph\. Apa yang terjadi
padamu?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Marlon’s disappeared\.

Ivory’s left me to find her son\.

There’s no point in going on
anymore\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Marlon’s disappeared\. Ivory’s left me to find her son\. There’s no point in going on anymore\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Marlon telah menghilang\. Ivory
meninggalkanku untuk mencari\lputranya\. Tidak ada gunanya

melanjutkan lagi\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Snap out of it, Zeph!

Come back to your senses!

It’s me, Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Snap out of it, Zeph! Come back to your senses! It’s me, Marlon!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Sadarlah, Zeph! Kembalilah
ke akal sehatmu! Ini aku, Marlon!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Marlon?

Is that really you?

You look different\.

That scar on your face is gone\.

And where’s your uniform?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Marlon? Is that really you? You look different\. That scar on your face is gone\. And where’s your uniform?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Marlon? Apakah itu
benar-benar kamu? Kamu terlihat\lberbeda\. Bekas luka di wajahmu

hilang\. Dan di mana seragammu?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Yes, it’s me, Zeph.

I took off my uniform after I
blasted my way in here.

It’s not like I’m going to need it
anymore\.

Based on what I heard from the
remaining grunts, The Shadows have\lessentially disbanded\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Yes, it’s me, Zeph. I took off my uniform after I blasted my way in here. It’s not like I’m going to need it anymore\. Based on what I heard from the remaining grunts, The Shadows have essentially disbanded\.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Ya, ini aku, Zeph. Aku
melepas seragamku setelah aku\lmenerobos masuk ke sini. Bukan

berarti aku akan membutuhkannya
lagi\. Berdasarkan apa yang kudengar\ldari para grunt yang tersisa, The

Shadows pada dasarnya sudah bubar\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]We’re not done yet\.

We still have one more mission to
complete\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]We’re not done yet\. We still have one more mission to complete\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Kita belum selesai\. Kita masih
punya satu misi lagi untuk\ldiselesaikan\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]What happened, Zeph?

Why were we abandoned?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]What happened, Zeph? Why were we abandoned?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Apa yang terjadi, Zeph?
Kenapa kita ditinggalkan?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]After Aklove made a fool out
of me and carried out the\lunbinding, many grunts were\lawestruck by his power and pledged\lallegiance to the Light of Ruin.

Those fools have no idea what
they’ve done\.

They’re helping him destroy their
homes\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]After Aklove made a fool out of me and carried out the unbinding, many grunts were awestruck by his power and pledged allegiance to the Light of Ruin. Those fools have no idea what they’ve done\. They’re helping him destroy their homes\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Setelah Aklove
mempermalukanku dan melakukan\lpelepasan, banyak grunt yang kagum

pada kekuatannya dan bersumpah
setia kepada Light of Ruin.\lOrang-orang bodoh itu tidak tahu

apa yang telah mereka lakukan\.
Mereka membantu dia menghancurkan\lrumah mereka\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Why did you come back, Marlon?

You had a chance to get out of this
mess.

I know you’ve been having second
thoughts lately, so why stay?

You could have left to be with your
children again\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Why did you come back, Marlon? You had a chance to get out of this mess. I know you’ve been having second thoughts lately, so why stay? You could have left to be with your children again\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kenapa kau kembali, Marlon? Kau
punya kesempatan untuk keluar dari\lkekacauan ini. Aku tahu kau telah

ragu-ragu akhir-akhir ini, jadi
kenapa tetap tinggal? Kau bisa\lpergi untuk bersama anak-anakmu

lagi\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I can’t yet.

I first must destroy all of the
Shadow Warriors we created.

Otherwise I’ll be forced to live
for eternity and watch my children\ldie before me\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]I can’t yet. I first must destroy all of the Shadow Warriors we created. Otherwise I’ll be forced to live for eternity and watch my children die before me\.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Aku belum bisa. Aku pertama
harus menghancurkan semua Shadow\lWarriors yang kita ciptakan. Jika

tidak, aku akan dipaksa hidup
selamanya dan melihat anak-anakku\lmati di depanku\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]What are you saying, Marlon?

Those Shadow Warriors are the best
weapons The Shadows have left!

But either way, even if I wanted
to go along with your ridiculous\lmission, I couldn’t.

The Light of Ruin took possession
of most of them.

The only ones remaining are still
being synthesized in the lab.

But that’s what we get for storing
all of them in one place\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]What are you saying, Marlon? Those Shadow Warriors are the best weapons The Shadows have left! But either way, even if I wanted to go along with your ridiculous mission, I couldn’t. The Light of Ruin took possession of most of them. The only ones remaining are still being synthesized in the lab. But that’s what we get for storing all of them in one place\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Apa yang kau katakan, Marlon?
Shadow Warriors itu adalah senjata\lterbaik yang dimiliki The Shadows!

Tapi bagaimanapun, bahkan jika aku
ingin ikut dengan misi konyolmu,\laku tidak bisa. Light of Ruin

mengambil alih sebagian besar dari
mereka. Satu-satunya yang tersisa\lmasih disintesis di lab. Tapi

itulah yang kita dapatkan karena
menyimpan semuanya di satu tempat\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I’m aware.

I was just there with [player].

We fought Véga and and the Light
of Ruin together."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]I’m aware. I was just there with [player]. We fought Véga and and the Light of Ruin together.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Aku tahu. Aku baru saja di
sana dengan [player]. Kami\lbertarung melawan Véga dan Light of

Ruin bersama.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue][player]!

[buffer3]’s dead!

I watched [buffer1] burn alive!

You can’t honestly expect me to
believe that you actually teamed\lup with someone who’s dead!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue][player]! [buffer3]’s dead! I watched [buffer1] burn alive! You can’t honestly expect me to believe that you actually teamed up with someone who’s dead!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue][player]! [buffer3] sudah
mati! Aku melihat [buffer1] terbakar\lhidup-hidup! Kau tidak bisa

sungguh-sungguh mengharapkan aku
percaya bahwa kau benar-benar\lbekerja sama dengan seseorang yang

sudah mati!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I can explain, Zeph.

I just need you to calm down, first."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]I can explain, Zeph. I just need you to calm down, first.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Aku bisa menjelaskan, Zeph.
Aku hanya perlu kau tenang dulu.

entries.original:
"[blue]What the\.

Wait\.

Is that you, [player]?

I thought I told you not to come
here!

You’ve just made a really big
mistake\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]What the\. Wait\. Is that you, [player]? I thought I told you not to come here! You’ve just made a really big mistake\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa yang\. Tunggu\. Apakah itu kau,
[player]? Kukira sudah kubilang\ljangan datang ke sini! Kau baru

saja membuat kesalahan besar\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue][player]!?

How are you still alive?

I watched you burn up!

I thought Marlon was lying at
first, but I have no choice but to\lbelieve him now that I’ve seen\lyour face under that hood!

You’re going to pay for the damage
you’ve caused!

Everything that’s happened\.it was
all because of you!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue][player]!? How are you still alive? I watched you burn up! I thought Marlon was lying at first, but I have no choice but to believe him now that I’ve seen your face under that hood! You’re going to pay for the damage you’ve caused! Everything that’s happened\.it was all because of you!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue][player]!? Bagaimana kau
masih hidup? Aku melihatmu\lterbakar! Awalnya kupikir Marlon

berbohong, tapi aku tidak punya
pilihan selain percaya padanya\lsekarang karena aku telah melihat

wajahmu di balik hoodie itu! Kau
akan membayar atas kerusakan yang\lkau sebabkan! Semua yang terjadi\.itu

semua karena dirimu!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]It’s time for you to burn
again!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]It’s time for you to burn again!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Saatnya kau terbakar lagi!

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]I’ve had it with you!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]I’ve had it with you!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Aku sudah muak denganmu!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Zeph!

Stop!

We don’t have time for fighting
right now!

[player] isn’t the enemy you should
be focusing on!

The Light of Ruin is!

Now you can either accept that
fact, or I’ll be assuming command\lof what’s left of The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Zeph! Stop! We don’t have time for fighting right now! [player] isn’t the enemy you should be focusing on! The Light of Ruin is! Now you can either accept that fact, or I’ll be assuming command of what’s left of The Shadows.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Zeph! Hentikan! Kita tidak
punya waktu untuk bertarung\lsekarang! [player] bukan musuh yang

harus kamu fokuskan! The Light of
Ruin-lah musuhnya! Sekarang, kamu\lbisa menerima kenyataan itu, atau

aku akan mengambil alih komando
dari sisa-sisa The Shadows.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Thank you.

Now\.

I’ve been hearing rumours that
you’ve been planning an attack on\lthe Light of Ruin base.

Care to fill me in on the details?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Thank you. Now\. I’ve been hearing rumours that you’ve been planning an attack on the Light of Ruin base. Care to fill me in on the details?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Terima kasih. Sekarang\. Aku
mendengar rumor bahwa kamu sedang\lmerencanakan serangan ke markas

Light of Ruin. Maukah kamu
memberitahuku detailnya?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]You heard right\.

Once our scientists locate their
base, The Shadows are going to take\lthem by surprise and destroy their\lbase from within.

However, I’m still unsure as to how
long it will take to locate them\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]You heard right\. Once our scientists locate their base, The Shadows are going to take them by surprise and destroy their base from within. However, I’m still unsure as to how long it will take to locate them\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Kamu dengar benar\. Begitu
ilmuwan kami menemukan markas\lmereka, The Shadows akan

mengejutkan mereka dan
menghancurkan markas mereka dari\ldalam. Namun, aku masih belum yakin

berapa lama waktu yang dibutuhkan
untuk menemukan mereka\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Fortunately, I know where
their base is.

When I was in Cinder Volcano with
[player], Véga ordered his grunts to\lretreat to Vivill Town.

That’s most likely where they’re
hiding."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Fortunately, I know where their base is. When I was in Cinder Volcano with [player], Véga ordered his grunts to retreat to Vivill Town. That’s most likely where they’re hiding.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Untungnya, aku tahu di mana
markas mereka. Saat aku berada di\lCinder Volcano bersama [player],

Véga memerintahkan anak buahnya
untuk mundur ke Vivill Town.\lKemungkinan besar di situlah mereka

bersembunyi.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Véga, that traitor\.

I should’ve known he’d turn on
us\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Véga, that traitor\. I should’ve known he’d turn on us\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Véga, pengkhianat itu\.
Seharusnya aku tahu dia akan\lberbalik melawan kita\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I’ll need to confirm with the
scientists, but if you’re correct,\lnow would be the perfect time to\lstrike.

Aklove has taken Hoopa to Hoenn in
order to test its strength before\lhe unleashes its power here.

If we take out his base while he’s
gone, he’ll have nothing to return\lto\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I’ll need to confirm with the scientists, but if you’re correct, now would be the perfect time to strike. Aklove has taken Hoopa to Hoenn in order to test its strength before he unleashes its power here. If we take out his base while he’s gone, he’ll have nothing to return to\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku perlu mengonfirmasi dengan para
ilmuwan, tapi jika kamu benar,\lsekarang adalah waktu yang tepat

untuk menyerang. Aklove telah
membawa Hoopa ke Hoenn untuk\lmenguji kekuatannya sebelum dia

melepaskan kekuatannya di sini.
Jika kita menghancurkan markasnya\lsaat dia pergi, dia tidak akan

punya tempat untuk kembali\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Agreed.

We’ll need all the manpower we can
get for the attack, so I suggest we\lbring [player] along as well."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Agreed. We’ll need all the manpower we can get for the attack, so I suggest we bring [player] along as well.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Setuju. Kita akan
membutuhkan semua tenaga yang bisa\lkita dapatkan untuk serangan itu,

jadi aku sarankan kita membawa
[player] juga.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]What!?

Wasn’t it enough that you allowed
[buffer1] to aid you before?

Why have you put so much faith in
[buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]What!? Wasn’t it enough that you allowed [buffer1] to aid you before? Why have you put so much faith in [buffer1]?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Apa!? Bukankah cukup kamu
mengizinkan [buffer1] membantumu\lsebelumnya? Mengapa kamu begitu

percaya pada [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]We both died, Zeph.

We were together in the afterlife.

When Arceus restored me to life, I
learned who [player] was\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]We both died, Zeph. We were together in the afterlife. When Arceus restored me to life, I learned who [player] was\.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Kami berdua mati, Zeph.
Kami bersama di alam baka. Ketika\lArceus mengembalikanku ke

kehidupan, aku tahu siapa [player]
sebenarnya\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Arceus?

As in the Pokémon that Aros
managed to capture and tame?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Arceus? As in the Pokémon that Aros managed to capture and tame?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Arceus? Maksudmu Pokémon yang
berhasil ditangkap dan dijinakkan\loleh Aros?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Yes, that Arceus.

It appears that before Aros’
death, Arceus was set free and\lreturned to govern the\lJudgement Zone."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Yes, that Arceus. It appears that before Aros’ death, Arceus was set free and returned to govern the Judgement Zone.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Ya, Arceus itu. Tampaknya
sebelum kematian Aros, Arceus\ldibebaskan dan kembali untuk

memerintah Judgement Zone.

entries.original:
"[blue]So, how about it, [player]?

I know we haven’t really seen eye
to eye before, but are you willing\lto join our raid on the [green]Light of\lRuin base[blue] in [green]Vivill Town[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]So, how about it, [player]? I know we haven’t really seen eye to eye before, but are you willing to join our raid on the [green]Light of Ruin base[blue] in [green]Vivill Town[blue]?
entries.translated:
[blue]Jadi, bagaimana, [player]? Aku tahu
kita belum benar-benar sepakat\lsebelumnya, tapi apakah kamu

bersedia bergabung dalam
penggerebekan kita ke [green]markas Light\lof Ruin[blue] di [green]Vivill Town[blue]?

entries.original:
"[blue]Really?

You would, just like that?

I guess it makes sense.

They are the true threat to the
Borrius Region, after all.

However, I would still like to be
certain that I have your complete\lsupport.

Please, allow me to explain to you
the true purpose of The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Really? You would, just like that? I guess it makes sense. They are the true threat to the Borrius Region, after all. However, I would still like to be certain that I have your complete support. Please, allow me to explain to you the true purpose of The Shadows.
entries.translated:
[blue]Benarkah? Kamu mau, begitu saja?
Kurasa itu masuk akal. Mereka\ladalah ancaman nyata bagi Region

Borrius, bagaimanapun juga. Namun,
aku masih ingin memastikan bahwa\laku mendapat dukungan penuhmu.

Tolong, izinkan aku menjelaskan
tujuan sebenarnya dari The Shadows.

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t blame you, [player].

Why should you trust the
organization you’ve been fighting\lto stop this entire time?

So, in that case, there is only one
thing I can do to gain your trust.

Please, allow me to explain to you
the true purpose of The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I don’t blame you, [player]. Why should you trust the organization you’ve been fighting to stop this entire time? So, in that case, there is only one thing I can do to gain your trust. Please, allow me to explain to you the true purpose of The Shadows.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku tidak menyalahkanmu, [player].
Mengapa kamu harus mempercayai\lorganisasi yang selama ini kamu

lawan? Jadi, dalam hal ini, hanya
ada satu hal yang bisa aku lakukan\luntuk mendapatkan kepercayaanmu.

Tolong, izinkan aku menjelaskan
tujuan sebenarnya dari The Shadows.

entries.original:
"It all started eighteen years
ago\.

Zeph’s son had just passed away.

To comfort him, Ivory and I came to
visit from Hoenn\."
entries.translation_source: It all started eighteen years ago\. Zeph’s son had just passed away. To comfort him, Ivory and I came to visit from Hoenn\.
entries.translated:
Semuanya dimulai delapan belas
tahun yang lalu\. Putra Zeph baru\lsaja meninggal. Untuk menghiburnya,

Ivory dan aku datang berkunjung
dari Hoenn\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Zeph\.

How are you holding up?

Marlon and I heard about your
son\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Zeph\. How are you holding up? Marlon and I heard about your son\.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Zeph\. Bagaimana kabarmu?
Marlon dan aku mendengar tentang\lputramu\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Ivory\.

Marlon\.

Thank you both for coming to visit
me\.

It’s good to see you again after
all these years\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Ivory\. Marlon\. Thank you both for coming to visit me\. It’s good to see you again after all these years\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Ivory\. Marlon\. Terima kasih
kalian berdua sudah datang\lmengunjungiku\. Senang bertemu kalian

lagi setelah bertahun-tahun\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I take it you travelled by boat to
get here?

How was the journey?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I take it you travelled by boat to get here? How was the journey?
entries.translated:
[blue]Kurasa kalian bepergian dengan
kapal untuk sampai ke sini?\lBagaimana perjalanannya?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Very pleasant.

It took a few days to arrive here,
but the journey was very nice."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Very pleasant. It took a few days to arrive here, but the journey was very nice.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Sangat menyenangkan. Butuh
beberapa hari untuk sampai ke sini,\ltapi perjalanannya sangat bagus.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]If I remember correctly, you
have a son too\.right?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]If I remember correctly, you have a son too\.right?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Jika saya ingat dengan benar,
Anda juga punya anak laki-laki\.kan?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]We did\.

He caught an illness and
passed away very young\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]We did\. He caught an illness and passed away very young\.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Kami memang\. Dia terkena
penyakit dan meninggal sangat muda\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Have you ever thought about
trying to bring him back?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Have you ever thought about trying to bring him back?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Pernahkah Anda berpikir untuk
mencoba membawanya kembali?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]We did actually\.

As moleculur biologists, we figured
that if anyone could find a way it\lwould be us.

But of course, only Arceus truly
has the power to restore the dead.

We had no choice but to move on.

Then about a year ago, Ivory gave
birth to twins.

It was the happiest moment of our
lives\.

Ever since then, the voids in our
hearts have almost been filled\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]We did actually\. As moleculur biologists, we figured that if anyone could find a way it would be us. But of course, only Arceus truly has the power to restore the dead. We had no choice but to move on. Then about a year ago, Ivory gave birth to twins. It was the happiest moment of our lives\. Ever since then, the voids in our hearts have almost been filled\.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Kami sebenarnya pernah\.
Sebagai ahli biologi molekuler,\lkami pikir jika ada yang bisa

menemukan cara, itu pasti kami.
Tapi tentu saja, hanya Arceus yang\lbenar-benar memiliki kekuatan untuk

menghidupkan kembali orang mati.
Kami tidak punya pilihan selain\lmelanjutkan hidup. Lalu sekitar

setahun yang lalu, Ivory melahirkan
bayi kembar. Itu adalah momen\lpaling bahagia dalam hidup kami\.

Sejak saat itu, kekosongan di hati
kami hampir terisi\.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]Where are your children now?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Where are your children now?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Di mana anak-anak Anda
sekarang?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Our friend Euler Log is
taking care of them in Frozen\lHeights while we visit you."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Our friend Euler Log is taking care of them in Frozen Heights while we visit you.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Teman kami Euler Log sedang
merawat mereka di Frozen Heights\lsementara kami mengunjungi Anda.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]A friend of mine, a Pokémon
Biologist, lives in Frozen Heights\las well.

He’s known around here as the
\qoGuardian of Borrius\qc.

He’s even managed to capture
Arceus!

I think his wife just gave birth to
a [buffer2], actually.

However, I’m having difficultly
remembering the [buffer1]’s name\.

Oh, I forgot to ask earlier, but
what are your children’s names?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]A friend of mine, a Pokémon Biologist, lives in Frozen Heights as well. He’s known around here as the \qoGuardian of Borrius\qc. He’s even managed to capture Arceus! I think his wife just gave birth to a [buffer2], actually. However, I’m having difficultly remembering the [buffer1]’s name\. Oh, I forgot to ask earlier, but what are your children’s names?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Seorang teman saya, seorang
Ahli Biologi Pokémon, tinggal di\lFrozen Heights juga. Dia dikenal di

sini sebagai \qoGuardian of Borrius\qc.
Dia bahkan berhasil menangkap\lArceus! Sebenarnya saya pikir

istrinya baru saja melahirkan
seorang [buffer2]. Namun, saya\lkesulitan mengingat nama [buffer1]

itu\. Oh, saya lupa bertanya
sebelumnya, tapi siapa nama\lanak-anak Anda?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Their names are [rival] and
Melony.

They’re the most beautiful children
in the world."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]Their names are [rival] and Melony. They’re the most beautiful children in the world.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Nama mereka [rival] dan
Melony. Mereka adalah anak-anak\ltercantik di dunia.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]With such beautiful names
to match too\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]With such beautiful names to match too\.
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Dengan nama yang indah juga\.

entries.original:
"[blue]How would you like to help me with
something?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]How would you like to help me with something?
entries.translated:
[blue]Bagaimana jika Anda membantu saya
dengan sesuatu?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Anything, Zeph.
We’re here for you."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Anything, Zeph. We’re here for you.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Apa saja, Zeph. Kami di
sini untukmu.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I want your help in bringing
my son back to life."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]I want your help in bringing my son back to life.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Saya ingin bantuan kalian
untuk menghidupkan kembali anakku.

entries.original:
"[blue]I know it can be done!

With your expertise and Aros’
control of Arceus, maybe we can\lfind a way to bring him back!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I know it can be done! With your expertise and Aros’ control of Arceus, maybe we can find a way to bring him back!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku tahu itu bisa dilakukan! Dengan
keahlian kalian dan kendali Aros\latas Arceus, mungkin kita bisa

menemukan cara untuk membawanya
kembali!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]It just can’t be done,
Zeph!

Trust us, we’ve tried!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]It just can’t be done, Zeph! Trust us, we’ve tried!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Itu tidak mungkin, Zeph!
Percayalah, kami sudah mencoba!

entries.original:
"It took many tries, but eventually,
Zeph convinced us to move to\lFrozen Heights and assist him.

We met up with your father soon
after.

He was more hesistant to help at
first, but he came around after a\lfew years.

By that point he had already
released Arceus.

Thus, we had no choice but to find
a more scientific approach\."
entries.translation_source: It took many tries, but eventually, Zeph convinced us to move to Frozen Heights and assist him. We met up with your father soon after. He was more hesistant to help at first, but he came around after a few years. By that point he had already released Arceus. Thus, we had no choice but to find a more scientific approach\.
entries.translated:
Butuh banyak percobaan, tapi
akhirnya Zeph meyakinkan kami untuk\lpindah ke Frozen Heights dan

membantunya. Kami bertemu dengan
ayahmu segera setelahnya. Awalnya\ldia lebih ragu untuk membantu, tapi

dia berubah setelah beberapa tahun.
Pada saat itu dia sudah melepaskan\lArceus. Karena itu, kami tidak

punya pilihan selain mencari
pendekatan yang lebih ilmiah\.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]What’s the current status?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]What’s the current status?
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Apa status saat ini?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]We’re ready to begin the
first trial, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [red]We’re ready to begin the first trial, Zeph.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Kami siap memulai uji coba
pertama, Zeph.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Good.

Everyone, take your positions."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Good. Everyone, take your positions.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Baik. Semua orang, ambil
posisi masing-masing.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Would you do us the honours,
Aros?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Would you do us the honours, Aros?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Maukah Anda memberi kami
kehormatan, Aros?

entries.original: "Aros: [blue]Of course, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: Aros: [blue]Of course, Zeph.
entries.translated: Aros: [blue]Tentu saja, Zeph.

entries.original:
"Aros: [blue]To start, I just place this
Pokémon here\."
entries.translation_source: Aros: [blue]To start, I just place this Pokémon here\.
entries.translated:
Aros: [blue]Untuk memulai, aku hanya
menempatkan Pokémon ini di sini\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, I place the sample ashes
beside it\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now, I place the sample ashes beside it\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang, aku menempatkan abu
sampel di sampingnya\.

entries.original:
"[blue]And finally, turn on the molecular
fusion device!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]And finally, turn on the molecular fusion device!
entries.translated:
[blue]Dan akhirnya, nyalakan perangkat
fusi molekuler!

entries.original:
"[blue]Once I cover it with this blanket
the fusion should be complete\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Once I cover it with this blanket the fusion should be complete\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Setelah aku menutupinya dengan
selimut ini, fusi seharusnya\lselesai\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Haha! I did it!

I created the first human-Pokémon
hybrid!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Haha! I did it! I created the first human-Pokémon hybrid!
entries.translated:
[blue]Haha! Aku berhasil! Aku menciptakan
hibrida manusia-Pokémon pertama!

entries.original:
"[blue]With more tests like this, I should
be able to bring back your son,\lZeph!

Yours as well, Marlon and Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]With more tests like this, I should be able to bring back your son, Zeph! Yours as well, Marlon and Ivory!
entries.translated:
[blue]Dengan lebih banyak tes seperti
ini, aku seharusnya bisa\lmengembalikan putramu, Zeph! Juga

milikmu, Marlon dan Ivory!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Aros!

No!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Aros! No!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Aros! Tidak!

entries.original:
"[blue]Quick, Marlon!

Hand me the control gauntlet that
Aros made for this creature."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Quick, Marlon! Hand me the control gauntlet that Aros made for this creature.
entries.translated:
[blue]Cepat, Marlon! Berikan aku sarung
tangan kendali yang dibuat Aros\luntuk makhluk ini.

entries.original:
"[blue]Stay, creature!

You must obey my command!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Stay, creature! You must obey my command!
entries.translated:
[blue]Diam, makhluk! Kamu harus mematuhi
perintahku!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, Aros\.

How could I lose you too\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh, Aros\. How could I lose you too\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, Aros\. Bagaimana bisa aku
kehilanganmu juga\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Marlon, Ivory, we can’t let this
deter us!

However, I no longer think it can
be done with just the three of us.

We’ll need more manpower if we want
to get this done."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Marlon, Ivory, we can’t let this deter us! However, I no longer think it can be done with just the three of us. We’ll need more manpower if we want to get this done.
entries.translated:
[blue]Marlon, Ivory, kita tidak bisa
biarkan ini menghalangi kita!\lNamun, aku tidak lagi berpikir ini

bisa dilakukan hanya dengan kita
bertiga. Kita akan membutuhkan\llebih banyak tenaga jika kita ingin

menyelesaikan ini.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]But where will we get the
money to hire workers?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]But where will we get the money to hire workers?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Tapi di mana kita akan
mendapatkan uang untuk\lmempekerjakan pekerja?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Money is no object.

I have plenty of funds saved up
from when I sold Cube Corp.

With those funds, we can hire the
faceless drones we need\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Money is no object. I have plenty of funds saved up from when I sold Cube Corp. With those funds, we can hire the faceless drones we need\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Uang bukan masalah. Aku punya
banyak dana yang ditabung dari saat\laku menjual Cube Corp. Dengan dana

itu, kita bisa mempekerjakan drone
tanpa wajah yang kita butuhkan\.

entries.original:
"Although Aros was gone, we
continued the trials in his memory.

However, our \qoShadow Warriors\qc
were difficult to control at first.

Some lashed out, scarring my
face\.

Despite this, we pressed on.

Over the next several years, we
continued capturing Pokémon and\lcombining them with the ashes of\lhumans.

And the more we did this, the more
our hesistancy to kill decreased.

Eventually, after determining we
wouldn’t be able to create a\lcreature that would retain its\lmemories of its former life, we\ldecided on a new approach."
entries.translation_source: Although Aros was gone, we continued the trials in his memory. However, our \qoShadow Warriors\qc were difficult to control at first. Some lashed out, scarring my face\. Despite this, we pressed on. Over the next several years, we continued capturing Pokémon and combining them with the ashes of humans. And the more we did this, the more our hesistancy to kill decreased. Eventually, after determining we wouldn’t be able to create a creature that would retain its memories of its former life, we decided on a new approach.
entries.translated:
Meskipun Aros pergi, kami
melanjutkan percobaan untuk\lmengenangnya. Namun, \qoShadow

Warriors\qc kami sulit dikendalikan
pada awalnya. Beberapa menyerang,\lmelukai wajahku\. Meskipun demikian,

kami terus maju. Selama beberapa
tahun berikutnya, kami terus\lmenangkap Pokémon dan

menggabungkannya dengan abu
manusia. Dan semakin sering kami\lmelakukan ini, semakin berkurang

keraguan kami untuk membunuh.
Akhirnya, setelah menentukan bahwa\lkami tidak akan bisa menciptakan

makhluk yang bisa mengingat
kehidupan sebelumnya, kami\lmemutuskan pendekatan baru.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Marlon, Ivory, I believe its
time we try something new.

In the last several years, we have
barely made any progress.

We may have managed to create a few
hundred Shadow Warriors, but they\lare all still just mindless beasts.

You both have given up so much to
help me\.

You’ve abandoned your children for
me\.

It’s time to end this so we can
all go home again.

Therefore, I suggest we begin work
on Operation Eternal Flower.

If we can find a way to bring the
Ultimate Weapon here, then we can\luse it to restore our children\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Marlon, Ivory, I believe its time we try something new. In the last several years, we have barely made any progress. We may have managed to create a few hundred Shadow Warriors, but they are all still just mindless beasts. You both have given up so much to help me\. You’ve abandoned your children for me\. It’s time to end this so we can all go home again. Therefore, I suggest we begin work on Operation Eternal Flower. If we can find a way to bring the Ultimate Weapon here, then we can use it to restore our children\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Marlon, Ivory, aku percaya
ini waktunya kita mencoba sesuatu\lyang baru. Dalam beberapa tahun

terakhir, kita hampir tidak membuat
kemajuan. Mungkin kita berhasil\lmenciptakan beberapa ratus Shadow

Warriors, tapi mereka semua masih
hanya binatang tanpa pikiran.\lKalian berdua telah mengorbankan

begitu banyak untuk membantu aku\.
Kalian telah meninggalkan anak-anak\lkalian demi aku\. Saatnya mengakhiri

ini sehingga kita semua bisa pulang
lagi. Oleh karena itu, aku sarankan\lkita mulai bekerja pada Operasi

Bunga Abadi. Jika kita bisa
menemukan cara untuk membawa\lSenjata Tertinggi ke sini, maka

kita bisa menggunakannya untuk
memulihkan anak-anak kita\.

entries.original:
"[blue]And thus, we began collecting
information on the dark force of\lBorrius so we could use its power\lto bring us the Ultimate Weapon.

From there you know the rest.

\.

\.

Phew\.

Take it all in, [player].

\.

\.

Okay, now that I’ve told you
essentially everything, you should\lhave no hesitation about trusting\lus anymore."
entries.translation_source: [blue]And thus, we began collecting information on the dark force of Borrius so we could use its power to bring us the Ultimate Weapon. From there you know the rest. \. \. Phew\. Take it all in, [player]. \. \. Okay, now that I’ve told you essentially everything, you should have no hesitation about trusting us anymore.
entries.translated:
[blue]Maka, kami mulai mengumpulkan
informasi tentang kekuatan gelap\lBorrius sehingga kami bisa

menggunakan kekuatannya untuk
membawa Senjata Tertinggi kepada\lkami. Dari situ kamu tahu sisanya. \.

\. Fiuh\. Pahami semuanya, [player]. \. \.
Oke, sekarang setelah aku\lmemberitahumu pada dasarnya

segalanya, kamu seharusnya tidak
ragu lagi untuk mempercayai kami.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]You’re Aros’ [buffer2]\.

If I had known, I never would have
tried to have you killed!

I’m sorry, [player].

I truly am."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]You’re Aros’ [buffer2]\. If I had known, I never would have tried to have you killed! I’m sorry, [player]. I truly am.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Kamu adalah [buffer2] milik
Aros\. Jika aku tahu, aku tidak akan\lpernah mencoba untuk membunuhmu!

Maafkan aku, [player]. Sungguh.

entries.original:
"[blue]Marlon\.

We can’t stay here any longer.

It’s time to rally our fighting
force and head to Vivill Town."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Marlon\. We can’t stay here any longer. It’s time to rally our fighting force and head to Vivill Town.
entries.translated:
[blue]Marlon\. Kita tidak bisa tinggal di
sini lebih lama lagi. Saatnya\lmengumpulkan pasukan tempur kita

dan menuju ke Kota Vivill.

entries.original:
"[blue]Marlon: Right away, Zeph.

Let’s get to Vivill Town as fast as
possible.

I doubt we’ll have much time before
Aklove returns."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Marlon: Right away, Zeph. Let’s get to Vivill Town as fast as possible. I doubt we’ll have much time before Aklove returns.
entries.translated:
[blue]Marlon: Segera, Zeph. Ayo kita
pergi ke Kota Vivill secepat\lmungkin. Aku ragu kita punya banyak

waktu sebelum Aklove kembali.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, one last thing, [player].

Keep the outfit, it looks good on
you.

Who knows, it may come in handy
someday."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh, one last thing, [player]. Keep the outfit, it looks good on you. Who knows, it may come in handy someday.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, satu hal terakhir, [player].
Simpan pakaiannya, itu terlihat\lbagus padamu. Siapa tahu, mungkin

berguna suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"[blue]Get to [green]Vivill Town [blue]as soon as
possible.

We don’t have long.

Head [green]northeast[blue] from [green]Dehara City
[blue]to get there the quickest."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Get to [green]Vivill Town [blue]as soon as possible. We don’t have long. Head [green]northeast[blue] from [green]Dehara City [blue]to get there the quickest.
entries.translated:
[blue]Pergilah ke [green]Vivill Town [blue]secepat
mungkin. Kita tidak punya banyak\lwaktu. Pergi ke [green]timur laut[blue] dari

[green]Dehara City [blue]untuk sampai ke sana
dengan cepat.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo!
You thaved me!

I was looking for berries on behalf
of Tropius Berries Inc., when all of\la thudden these boulders fell down\laround me!

But you rescued me and now I can go
home for the day!

Because of your heroic efforts, I
want you to take thome berries!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo! You thaved me! I was looking for berries on behalf of Tropius Berries Inc., when all of a thudden these boulders fell down around me! But you rescued me and now I can go home for the day! Because of your heroic efforts, I want you to take thome berries!
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo! Anda menyelamatkan
saya! Saya sedang mencari berry\latas nama Tropius Berries Inc.,

ketika tiba-tiba batu-batu besar
ini jatuh di sekitar saya! Tapi\lAnda menyelamatkan saya dan

sekarang saya bisa pulang untuk
hari ini! Karena usaha heroik Anda,\lsaya ingin Anda mengambil beberapa

berry!

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo!

I’ll be back tomorrow to look for
more berries!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo! I’ll be back tomorrow to look for more berries!
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo! Saya akan kembali
besok untuk mencari lebih banyak\lberry!

entries.original:
"Great Desert

\al Dehara City
\ar Gurun Town"
entries.translation_source: Great Desert \al Dehara City \ar Gurun Town
entries.translated:
Great Desert \al Dehara City \ar Gurun
Town

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, someone take his ashes to the
lab!

Let’s at least make something
useful of this failure."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now, someone take his ashes to the lab! Let’s at least make something useful of this failure.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang, seseorang bawa abunya ke
laboratorium! Setidaknya mari kita\lbuat sesuatu yang berguna dari

kegagalan ini.

entries.original:
"Oh, sir!

Some guy with red hair blasted his
way in here!

I tried to stop him, but he just
shoved me aside."
entries.translation_source: Oh, sir! Some guy with red hair blasted his way in here! I tried to stop him, but he just shoved me aside.
entries.translated:
Oh, pak! Seseorang dengan rambut
merah menerobos masuk ke sini! Saya\lmencoba menghentikannya, tapi dia

hanya mendorong saya ke samping.

entries.original:
"You’ll never be able to beat my
super, rare, awesome, Sandslash!

I got it all the way up in Icicle
Cave!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll never be able to beat my super, rare, awesome, Sandslash! I got it all the way up in Icicle Cave!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak akan pernah bisa
mengalahkan Sandslash super,\llangka, dan luar biasaku! Saya

mendapatkannya jauh di dalam Icicle
Cave!

entries.original:
"[blue]How could you let them escape!?

They saw what we were doing in the
lab!

If they realize what we were doing
and tell anyone, our whole\loperation could be ruined!

And you think a simple apology will
make everything alright?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]How could you let them escape!? They saw what we were doing in the lab! If they realize what we were doing and tell anyone, our whole operation could be ruined! And you think a simple apology will make everything alright?
entries.translated:
[blue]Bagaimana bisa kamu membiarkan
mereka melarikan diri!? Mereka\lmelihat apa yang kita lakukan di

laboratorium! Jika mereka menyadari
apa yang kita lakukan dan memberi\ltahu siapa pun, seluruh operasi

kita bisa hancur! Dan kamu pikir
permintaan maaf sederhana akan\lmembuat semuanya baik-baik saja?

entries.original:
"If you’re going north, you’ll head
towards Route 6, a grassy route.

If you’re going south, you’ll head
towards the Auburn Waterway."
entries.translation_source: If you’re going north, you’ll head towards Route 6, a grassy route. If you’re going south, you’ll head towards the Auburn Waterway.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu pergi ke utara, kamu akan
menuju ke Route 6, rute berumput.\lJika kamu pergi ke selatan, kamu

akan menuju ke Auburn Waterway.

entries.original:
"They say some of the ugliest people
shop at Poké Mart.

I heard there’s even a website
documenting them all."
entries.translation_source: They say some of the ugliest people shop at Poké Mart. I heard there’s even a website documenting them all.
entries.translated:
Mereka bilang beberapa orang paling
jelek berbelanja di Poké Mart. Saya\ldengar bahkan ada situs web yang

mendokumentasikan mereka semua.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there, Borrius trainer.

I moved here recently with my three
Pokémon from the Unova region.

I’ve been raising them on my own up
until this point, but lately,\lthey’ve been craving adventure.

I don’t really want to leave my
home, so I’ve been searching for\lsomeone to take them off my hands.

How would you like to take care of
them for me?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there, Borrius trainer. I moved here recently with my three Pokémon from the Unova region. I’ve been raising them on my own up until this point, but lately, they’ve been craving adventure. I don’t really want to leave my home, so I’ve been searching for someone to take them off my hands. How would you like to take care of them for me?
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, pelatih Borrius. Saya
baru saja pindah ke sini dengan\ltiga Pokémon saya dari wilayah

Unova. Saya telah membesarkan
mereka sendiri sampai saat ini,\ltapi akhir-akhir ini mereka

mendambakan petualangan. Saya tidak
benar-benar ingin meninggalkan\lrumah, jadi saya telah mencari

seseorang untuk mengambil alih
mereka. Apakah Anda ingin merawat\lmereka untuk saya?

entries.original:
"Oh, okay then.

I guess I’ll have to keep searching
for a trainer."
entries.translation_source: Oh, okay then. I guess I’ll have to keep searching for a trainer.
entries.translated:
Oh, baiklah kalau begitu. Saya kira
saya harus terus mencari pelatih.

entries.original:
"Hello again!

How are my old friends doing?"
entries.translation_source: Hello again! How are my old friends doing?
entries.translated:
Halo lagi! Bagaimana kabar
teman-teman lama saya?

entries.original:
"You received a [green]Snivy[black], [red]Tepig[black], and
[blue]Oshawott [black]from the woman!"
entries.translation_source: You received a [green]Snivy[black], [red]Tepig[black], and [blue]Oshawott [black]from the woman!
entries.translated:
Anda menerima [green]Snivy[black], [red]Tepig[black], dan
[blue]Oshawott [black]dari wanita itu!

entries.original:
"Unless you can Surf, going this
way just leads to a dead end."
entries.translation_source: Unless you can Surf, going this way just leads to a dead end.
entries.translated:
Kecuali kamu bisa Surf, pergi ke
sini hanya akan menemui jalan\lbuntu.

entries.original:
"Route 12

\au Dehara City
\ad Tarmigan Town\l\al Route 14"
entries.translation_source: Route 12 \au Dehara City \ad Tarmigan Town \al Route 14
entries.translated:
Route 12 \au Dehara City \ad Tarmigan
Town \al Route 14

entries.original:
"It appears to be the remains of
what used to be a Shadow Warrior.

Remove the cloak and lay it to
rest?"
entries.translation_source: It appears to be the remains of what used to be a Shadow Warrior. Remove the cloak and lay it to rest?
entries.translated:
Tampaknya sisa-sisa dari yang
dulunya adalah Shadow Warrior.\lLepaskan jubahnya dan istirahatkan?

entries.original:
"You removed the cloak from the
Shadow Warrior."
entries.translation_source: You removed the cloak from the Shadow Warrior.
entries.translated:
Anda melepas jubah dari Shadow
Warrior.

entries.original:
"The remains of the Shadow Warrior
fell apart, and its soul was laid\lto rest."
entries.translation_source: The remains of the Shadow Warrior fell apart, and its soul was laid to rest.
entries.translated:
Sisa-sisa Shadow Warrior hancur,
dan jiwanya diistirahatkan.

entries.original:
"Route 5

\au Route 4, Cinder Volcano,
Grim Woods\l\al Crater Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 5 \au Route 4, Cinder Volcano, Grim Woods \al Crater Town
entries.translated:
Route 5 \au Route 4, Cinder Volcano,
Grim Woods \al Crater Town

entries.original:
"Hi! Welcome to the Double Battle
House!

Feel free to battle any of the
trainers here as many times as you\lwant.

If you need an explanation
of Double Battles, please come\ltalk to me.

Enjoy battling!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Welcome to the Double Battle House! Feel free to battle any of the trainers here as many times as you want. If you need an explanation of Double Battles, please come talk to me. Enjoy battling!
entries.translated:
Hai! Selamat datang di Rumah
Pertarungan Ganda! Silakan\lbertarung dengan pelatih mana pun

di sini sebanyak yang kamu mau.
Jika kamu membutuhkan penjelasan\ltentang Pertarungan Ganda, silakan

bicara padaku. Selamat bertarung!

entries.original:
"The guys downstairs claim they
created the world we live in.

But I just think that’s just a load
of Tauros waste."
entries.translation_source: The guys downstairs claim they created the world we live in. But I just think that’s just a load of Tauros waste.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang di bawah mengaku bahwa
merekalah yang menciptakan dunia\lyang kita tinggali. Tapi menurutku

itu hanya tumpukan kotoran Tauros.

entries.original:
"Let me tell ya something young
feller.

To the east of here is a vast
desert.

It is so amazing, that it is
simply called the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Words can’t even begin to describe
it!

However, it’s really difficult to
traverse without the proper gear.

So don’t think ya can just waltz
out their without preppin’ first.

Yer outfit seems a little hot
for the desert, but it’ll do ya a\lgood job of protecing yer body.

As for yer eyes, I’d recommend
getting yerself a good pair of\l[green]Go-Goggles[blue].

In fact, I’d actually be willing to
give ya mine if ya can show me how\lstrong ya are by [green]beatin’ the Gym[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Let me tell ya something young feller. To the east of here is a vast desert. It is so amazing, that it is simply called the [green]Great Desert[blue]. Words can’t even begin to describe it! However, it’s really difficult to traverse without the proper gear. So don’t think ya can just waltz out their without preppin’ first. Yer outfit seems a little hot for the desert, but it’ll do ya a good job of protecing yer body. As for yer eyes, I’d recommend getting yerself a good pair of [green]Go-Goggles[blue]. In fact, I’d actually be willing to give ya mine if ya can show me how strong ya are by [green]beatin’ the Gym[blue].
entries.translated:
Biarkan aku memberitahumu sesuatu,
nak. Di sebelah timur sini ada\lgurun yang luas. Sangat

menakjubkan, sehingga disebut [green]Gurun
Besar[blue]. Kata-kata bahkan tidak bisa\lmenggambarkannya! Namun, sangat

sulit untuk melintasinya tanpa
perlengkapan yang tepat. Jadi\ljangan berpikir kamu bisa begitu

saja berjalan ke sana tanpa
persiapan dulu. Pakaianmu tampak\lagak panas untuk gurun, tapi itu

akan melindungi tubuhmu dengan
baik. Untuk matamu, aku sarankan\lkamu mendapatkan [green]Kacamata Go[blue] yang

bagus. Bahkan, aku bersedia
memberikan milikku jika kamu bisa\lmenunjukkan seberapa kuatmu dengan

[green]mengalahkan Gym[blue].

entries.original:
"Go young feller!

Explore the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Go young feller! Explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Pergilah, nak! Jelajahi Gurun
Besar!

entries.original:
"My daughter tried venturing into
Rift Cave all by herself.

She was very lucky that someone
stopped her.

If she had gone in there\.

I shudder every time I think of
what could have happened!"
