entries.translation_source: My daughter tried venturing into Rift Cave all by herself. She was very lucky that someone stopped her. If she had gone in there\. I shudder every time I think of what could have happened!
entries.translated:
Anak perempuanku mencoba
berpetualang ke Gua Rift sendirian.\lDia sangat beruntung ada yang

menghentikannya. Jika dia masuk ke
sana\. Aku gemetar setiap kali\lmemikirkan apa yang bisa terjadi!

entries.original:
"There are stories of people never
returning from Rift Cave.

They say that whole groups who have
gone down there have never been\lseen again."
entries.translation_source: There are stories of people never returning from Rift Cave. They say that whole groups who have gone down there have never been seen again.
entries.translated:
Ada cerita tentang orang-orang yang
tidak pernah kembali dari Gua Rift.\lMereka mengatakan bahwa seluruh

kelompok yang pernah masuk ke sana
tidak pernah terlihat lagi.

entries.original:
"Hello there, deary.

From my many years as a Pokémon
expert, I have gained the ability\lto teach the move, Thunder Punch.

However, if you wish for me to
teach one of your Pokémon this\lmove, it’ll cost you a Yellow Shard.

What do you say?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, deary. From my many years as a Pokémon expert, I have gained the ability to teach the move, Thunder Punch. However, if you wish for me to teach one of your Pokémon this move, it’ll cost you a Yellow Shard. What do you say?
entries.translated:
Halo, sayang. Dari pengalamanku
bertahun-tahun sebagai ahli\lPokémon, aku memperoleh kemampuan

untuk mengajarkan jurus Pukulan
Petir. Namun, jika kamu ingin aku\lmengajarkan jurus ini pada salah

satu Pokémonmu, itu akan
membutuhkan satu Pecahan Kuning.\lBagaimana?

entries.original:
"It appears that you do not have any
Yellow Shards.

You can find them popping up
occassionally in the Great Desert.

If you come back with any, I’ll be
happy to teach your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It appears that you do not have any Yellow Shards. You can find them popping up occassionally in the Great Desert. If you come back with any, I’ll be happy to teach your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak memiliki
Pecahan Kuning. Kamu bisa\lmenemukannya muncul sesekali di

Gurun Besar. Jika kamu kembali
dengan membawanya, aku akan dengan\lsenang hati mengajari Pokémonmu.

entries.original:
"I’ll be here, waiting, if you
change your mind."
entries.translation_source: I’ll be here, waiting, if you change your mind.
entries.translated:
Aku akan di sini, menunggu, jika
kamu berubah pikiran.

entries.original:
"Hi there!

My grandmother has a business of
teaching Pokémon a move in\lexchange for a Yellow Shard.

If you haven’t had a chance to find
any, let me help you out."
entries.translation_source: Hi there! My grandmother has a business of teaching Pokémon a move in exchange for a Yellow Shard. If you haven’t had a chance to find any, let me help you out.
entries.translated:
Halo! Nenekku memiliki bisnis
mengajari Pokémon sebuah jurus\ldengan imbalan Pecahan Kuning. Jika

kamu belum sempat menemukannya,
biarkan aku membantumu.

entries.original:
"You’ll be able to shock your
enemies when you learn her move!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll be able to shock your enemies when you learn her move!
entries.translated:
Kamu akan bisa mengejutkan
musuh-musuhmu saat kamu mempelajari\ljurusnya!

entries.original:
"Looks like you don’t need any after
all. You have no space."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you don’t need any after all. You have no space.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak
membutuhkannya lagi. Kamu tidak\lpunya ruang.

entries.original:
"Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet
deal for ya!

You know how Pokemon like to hide
behind stones or rocks, yeah?

Sometimes they hide cool bones,
too.

If you find a [green]Rare Bone [blue]somewhere,
you should bring it to me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet deal for ya! You know how Pokemon like to hide behind stones or rocks, yeah? Sometimes they hide cool bones, too. If you find a [green]Rare Bone [blue]somewhere, you should bring it to me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Hei, lihat ini. Aku punya penawaran
menarik untukmu! Kamu tahu\lbagaimana Pokémon suka bersembunyi

di balik batu, kan? Kadang mereka
juga menyembunyikan tulang keren.\lJika kamu menemukan [green]Tulang Langka

[blue]di suatu tempat, bawalah padaku.
Aku akan membuatnya berharga\luntukmu.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Did you find a [green]Rare Bone [blue]for me?

Looks like you did.

If you want to sell it, I’ll buy
it from you for [green]$10000[blue]."
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Did you find a [green]Rare Bone [blue]for me? Looks like you did. If you want to sell it, I’ll buy it from you for [green]$10000[blue].
entries.translated:
Ada apa? Apakah kamu menemukan
[green]Tulang Langka [blue]untukku? Sepertinya\lkamu menemukannya. Jika kamu ingin

menjualnya, aku akan membelinya
darimu seharga [green]$10000[blue].

entries.original:
"[black]You gave the guy a Rare Bone in
exchange for $10000."
entries.translation_source: [black]You gave the guy a Rare Bone in exchange for $10000.
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu memberikan seorang pria Tulang
Langka sebagai ganti $10000.

entries.original:
"If you find any more Rare Bones
come see me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: If you find any more Rare Bones come see me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu menemukan lebih banyak
Tulang Langka, temui aku. Aku akan\lmembuatnya berharga.

entries.original:
"Hey, come see me if you find a
Rare Bone, got it?

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, come see me if you find a Rare Bone, got it? I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Hei, temui aku jika kamu menemukan
Tulang Langka, mengerti? Aku akan\lmembuatnya berharga.

entries.original:
"I just simply adore ores.

Don’t you have an adorable ore that
shakes my core?"
entries.translation_source: I just simply adore ores. Don’t you have an adorable ore that shakes my core?
entries.translated:
Aku sangat menyukai bijih. Apa kau
tidak memiliki bijih menggemaskan\lyang mengguncang intiku?

entries.original:
"Oh, I do adore the ores!

That [green][buffer3][blue], it’s shaking me!
Will you sell it for [green]$[buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I do adore the ores! That [green][buffer3][blue], it’s shaking me! Will you sell it for [green]$[buffer2][blue]?
entries.translated:
Oh, aku sangat menyukai
bijih-bijih! Itu [green][buffer3][blue],\lmengguncangku! Maukah kamu

menjualnya seharga [green]$[buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Turned over the [green][buffer3] [blue]and
received [green]$[buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Turned over the [green][buffer3] [blue]and received [green]$[buffer2][blue]!
entries.translated:
Menyerahkan [green][buffer3] [blue]dan menerima
[green]$[buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"The deal is done!
I’ve scored an ore I can adore!"
entries.translation_source: The deal is done! I’ve scored an ore I can adore!
entries.translated:
Kesepakatan selesai! Aku
mendapatkan bijih yang bisa\lkukagumi!

entries.original:
"Hmmmm. You don’t seem to have any
[green][buffer3]s[blue]. Come back again."
entries.translation_source: Hmmmm. You don’t seem to have any [green][buffer3]s[blue]. Come back again.
entries.translated:
Hmmmm. Sepertinya kamu tidak punya
[green][buffer3]s[blue]. Kembalilah lagi.

entries.original:
"Hmmm. My core won’t change.
I hope you sell it to me someday."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm. My core won’t change. I hope you sell it to me someday.
entries.translated:
Hmmm. Intiku tidak akan berubah.
Kuharap kamu menjualnya padaku\lsuatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Never mind, looks ya already beat
it.

Great job!

Take these Go-Goggles and explore
the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Never mind, looks ya already beat it. Great job! Take these Go-Goggles and explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Sudahlah, sepertinya kamu sudah
mengalahkannya. Kerja bagus! Ambil\lGo-Goggles ini dan jelajahi Gurun

Besar!

entries.original:
"It’s my job to keep the torches
around here lit at night.

The desert can pretty cold once the
sun goes down.

Those torches are our only reliable
source of heat during that time."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to keep the torches around here lit at night. The desert can pretty cold once the sun goes down. Those torches are our only reliable source of heat during that time.
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah menjaga obor di
sekitar sini tetap menyala di malam\lhari. Gurun bisa menjadi sangat

dingin setelah matahari terbenam.
Obor-obor itu adalah satu-satunya\lsumber panas yang bisa diandalkan

saat itu.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to keep the torches
around here lit at night.

The desert can pretty cold now that
the sun is down.

Those torches are our only reliable
source of heat right now."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to keep the torches around here lit at night. The desert can pretty cold now that the sun is down. Those torches are our only reliable source of heat right now.
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah menjaga obor di
sekitar sini tetap menyala di malam\lhari. Gurun bisa menjadi sangat

dingin sekarang karena matahari
sudah terbenam. Obor-obor itu\ladalah satu-satunya sumber panas

yang bisa diandalkan saat ini.

entries.original:
"It seems pretty odd that there’s a
forest filled with so many rare\lBug Pokémon, so close to a desert.

Well, that’s Borrius for you!"
entries.translation_source: It seems pretty odd that there’s a forest filled with so many rare Bug Pokémon, so close to a desert. Well, that’s Borrius for you!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya cukup aneh bahwa ada
hutan yang dipenuhi begitu banyak\lPokémon Serangga langka, begitu

dekat dengan gurun. Yah, begitulah
Borrius!

entries.original:
"Gurun Town

A town that has survived the sands
of time."
entries.translation_source: Gurun Town A town that has survived the sands of time.
entries.translated:
Kota Gurun Sebuah kota yang
bertahan dari pasir waktu.

entries.original: "We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Emboar, dasar
bocah!

entries.original:
"I’ve spent years trying to uncover
the secret of the Regi Pokémon!

I’ve had some progress lately and
discovered that Regirock must live\lin that strange rock formation in\lthe Great Desert.

Now if only there were some way to
unseal it\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve spent years trying to uncover the secret of the Regi Pokémon! I’ve had some progress lately and discovered that Regirock must live in that strange rock formation in the Great Desert. Now if only there were some way to unseal it\.
entries.translated:
Aku telah bertahun-tahun mencoba
mengungkap rahasia Pokémon Regi!\lAkhir-akhir ini aku mendapat

kemajuan dan menemukan bahwa
Regirock pasti tinggal di formasi\lbatu aneh di Great Desert. Andai

saja ada cara untuk membuka
segelnya\.

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Rock Pokémon, Regirock.

It says here that in ancient times,
Regirock helped Regigigas form and\lmove together the Borrius Region.

It now dwells somewhere in the
Great Desert."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Rock Pokémon, Regirock. It says here that in ancient times, Regirock helped Regigigas form and move together the Borrius Region. It now dwells somewhere in the Great Desert.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah patung Pokémon Batu
Legendaris, Regirock. Tertulis di\lsini bahwa di zaman kuno, Regirock

membantu Regigigas membentuk dan
menyatukan Wilayah Borrius. Kini ia\lberdiam di suatu tempat di Great

Desert.

entries.original:
"The desert ends pretty soon after
you leave the town to the south of\lhere.

However, the route itself to
Antisis and Seaport Cities is\lnot as straightforward as you\lwould think\."
entries.translation_source: The desert ends pretty soon after you leave the town to the south of here. However, the route itself to Antisis and Seaport Cities is not as straightforward as you would think\.
entries.translated:
Gurun berakhir tak lama setelah
kamu meninggalkan kota di selatan\lsini. Namun, rute menuju Antisis

dan Kota Seaport tidak semudah yang
kamu kira\.

entries.original:
"The houses here are based off a
design found in the Unova region.

They’re from some town that boasts
of pottery made from volcanic clay.

There’s actually a maniac here as
well, who’ll buy some kind of relic\lpottery for a high price."
entries.translation_source: The houses here are based off a design found in the Unova region. They’re from some town that boasts of pottery made from volcanic clay. There’s actually a maniac here as well, who’ll buy some kind of relic pottery for a high price.
entries.translated:
Rumah-rumah di sini didasarkan pada
desain yang ditemukan di wilayah\lUnova. Mereka dari suatu kota yang

bangga dengan tembikar yang terbuat
dari tanah liat vulkanik.\lSebenarnya ada juga seorang maniak

di sini, yang akan membeli semacam
tembikar kuno dengan harga tinggi.

entries.original:
"Just your average everyday
warehouse.

Nothing to see here."
entries.translation_source: Just your average everyday warehouse. Nothing to see here.
entries.translated:
Hanya gudang biasa sehari-hari.
Tidak ada yang bisa dilihat di\lsini.

entries.original:
"Vivill Town

The town filled with light and
prosperity."
entries.translation_source: Vivill Town The town filled with light and prosperity.
entries.translated:
Kota Vivill Kota yang dipenuhi
cahaya dan kemakmuran.

entries.original: "The door is locked."
entries.translation_source: The door is locked.
entries.translated: Pintu terkunci.

entries.original:
"Hey there.

\.

What? You want me to say something
interesting?

Fine then\.

I’ve been having trouble with my
brother, lately.

He’s gotten himself in deep with
this gang calling themselves the\l\qoBlack Emboar\qo.

I don’t really know what it’s all
about, but I’m really worried for\lhis safety.

I haven’t spoken with him in days
so I’m afraid something bad has\lhappened to him.

\.

What’s that?

You’d be willing to check up on
him for me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey there. \. What? You want me to say something interesting? Fine then\. I’ve been having trouble with my brother, lately. He’s gotten himself in deep with this gang calling themselves the \qoBlack Emboar\qo. I don’t really know what it’s all about, but I’m really worried for his safety. I haven’t spoken with him in days so I’m afraid something bad has happened to him. \. What’s that? You’d be willing to check up on him for me?
entries.translated:
Halo. \. Apa? Kamu ingin aku
mengatakan sesuatu yang menarik?\lBaiklah\. Akhir-akhir ini aku punya

masalah dengan saudaraku. Dia
terlibat dalam geng yang menamakan\ldiri \qoBlack Emboar\qo. Aku tidak tahu

apa itu semua, tapi aku sangat
khawatir akan keselamatannya. Aku\lsudah tidak berbicara dengannya

selama berhari-hari, jadi aku
khawatir sesuatu yang buruk telah\lterjadi padanya. \. Ada apa? Kamu

bersedia mengeceknya untukku?

entries.original:
"Thank you!

My brother can probably be found
in the northern SES Expressway.

I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of
a trainer.

They say these Black Emboar are
insanely vicious."
entries.translation_source: Thank you! My brother can probably be found in the northern SES Expressway. I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of a trainer. They say these Black Emboar are insanely vicious.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih! Saudaraku mungkin
bisa ditemukan di SES Expressway\lbagian utara. Aku akan pergi

sendiri, tapi aku terlalu lemah
sebagai pelatih. Mereka bilang\lBlack Emboar ini sangat ganas.

entries.original: "You’re the one who asked."
entries.translation_source: You’re the one who asked.
entries.translated: Kamu yang meminta.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Yeah, you, the little brat
there!

Get over here!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hey! Yeah, you, the little brat there! Get over here!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hei! Ya, kamu, bocah kecil di sana!
Kemarilah!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass through
here?

This place belongs to us, the Black
Emboar!

It’s like our Gym, kid!

So scram! Toddle off home to your
ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This place belongs to us, the Black Emboar! It’s like our Gym, kid! So scram! Toddle off home to your ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hei! Siapa bilang kau bisa lewat
sini? Tempat ini milik kami, Black\lEmboar! Ini seperti Gym kami, nak!

Jadi enyahlah! Pulanglah ke mamamu,
kau bocah culun!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ha! Fine!

Brats like you with a future so
bright\.

Just go on back home and be nice to
your parents.

Don’t forget your baby bottle!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Ha! Fine! Brats like you with a future so bright\. Just go on back home and be nice to your parents. Don’t forget your baby bottle!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ha! Baiklah! Bocah seperti kau
dengan masa depan begitu cerah\.\lKembalilah ke rumah dan bersikap

baiklah pada orang tuamu. Jangan
lupa botol susumu!

entries.original:
"[blue]What didja say, ya little creep?

I’ll teach ya to take the Black
Emboar seriously!

I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon
right down to the ground!

With relish!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]What didja say, ya little creep? I’ll teach ya to take the Black Emboar seriously! I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon right down to the ground! With relish!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa katamu, bocah kecil? Akan
kuajari kau untuk menganggap serius\lBlack Emboar! Aku akan menghajar

Pokémon cantikmu sampai ke tanah!
Dengan senang hati!

entries.original:
"[blue]Don’t get all high and mighty
because you beat me!

If you really want to pick a fight
with the Black Emboar,\lgo duke it out with our leader!

He’s somewhere in this tunnel!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Don’t get all high and mighty because you beat me! If you really want to pick a fight with the Black Emboar, go duke it out with our leader! He’s somewhere in this tunnel!
entries.translated:
[blue]Jangan sombong hanya karena kau
mengalahkanku! Jika kau benar-benar\lingin bertengkar dengan Black

Emboar, lawanlah pemimpin kami! Dia
ada di suatu tempat di terowongan\lini!

entries.original:
"What do you think you’re up to,
brat?

This is the Black Emboar’s ultimate
paradise\.

A little pest like you has no
business here\.

It couldn’t be that you think you
can stand up to me, the head of the\lBlack Emboar?"
entries.translation_source: What do you think you’re up to, brat? This is the Black Emboar’s ultimate paradise\. A little pest like you has no business here\. It couldn’t be that you think you can stand up to me, the head of the Black Emboar?
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau lakukan, bocah? Ini
adalah surga utama Black Emboar\.\lHama kecil sepertimu tidak ada

urusan di sini\. Mungkinkah kau pikir
bisa melawanku, kepala Black\lEmboar?

entries.original:
"That all you got?

Nah, you got one option left--get
lost!

This is our place, the Black
Emboar.

We got no place else to go, and we
don’t want nobody gettin’ in our\lway."
entries.translation_source: That all you got? Nah, you got one option left--get lost! This is our place, the Black Emboar. We got no place else to go, and we don’t want nobody gettin’ in our way.
entries.translated:
Itu saja yang kau punya? Tidak, kau
hanya punya satu pilihan--pergi!\lIni tempat kami, Black Emboar. Kami

tidak punya tempat lain untuk
pergi, dan kami tidak ingin ada\lyang menghalangi kami.

entries.original: "4F: TM Corner"
entries.translation_source: 4F: TM Corner
entries.translated: Lantai 4: Sudut TM

entries.original:
"Whadya’ want kid?

We’re busy!"
entries.translation_source: Whadya’ want kid? We’re busy!
entries.translated: Mau apa, nak? Kami sibuk!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass through
here?

This is Black Emboar territory!

Go back from where you came from!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This is Black Emboar territory! Go back from where you came from!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hei! Siapa bilang kau bisa lewat
sini? Ini wilayah Black Emboar!\lKembali darimana kau datang!

entries.original:
"Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it!
You’ve got you share of guts, kid!

I’ll show you what the guy who
holds the Black Emboar together can\lreally do!"
entries.translation_source: Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it! You’ve got you share of guts, kid! I’ll show you what the guy who holds the Black Emboar together can really do!
entries.translated:
Gwa ha ha ha! Ayo! Kau punya nyali,
nak! Akan kutunjukkan apa yang bisa\ldilakukan oleh orang yang

mempersatukan Black Emboar!

entries.original:
"You ain’t half bad, kid\.
I like ya.

Get a loaf of this\.

From now on, our team’s name is
gonna be the Black [player]!

Yeah! We’re taking on your rough
and tough name!

It’s a wilder name for a wilder
team!

The Black [player]!
Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!"
entries.translation_source: You ain’t half bad, kid\. I like ya. Get a loaf of this\. From now on, our team’s name is gonna be the Black [player]! Yeah! We’re taking on your rough and tough name! It’s a wilder name for a wilder team! The Black [player]! Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!
entries.translated:
Kau lumayan, nak\. Aku suka kau.
Dengar ini\. Mulai sekarang, nama tim\lkami akan menjadi Black [player]!

Yeah! Kami mengambil namamu yang
keras dan tangguh! Nama yang lebih\lliar untuk tim yang lebih liar!

Black [player]! Gwa ha ha ha! Itu
keren!

entries.original:
"What, you want somethin’ else, kid?

\.

My bro?

Geez, that punk never quits.

It’s time I settled things once and
for all with him\."
entries.translation_source: What, you want somethin’ else, kid? \. My bro? Geez, that punk never quits. It’s time I settled things once and for all with him\.
entries.translated:
Apa, kau mau sesuatu yang lain,
nak? \. Saudaraku? Ya ampun, bocah\litu tidak pernah berhenti. Sudah

waktunya aku menyelesaikan masalah
sekali untuk selamanya dengannya\.

entries.original:
"Leader: [blue]I’ve told you time and
time again, bro, quit tryin’ to\lmess with the Black Emboar!"
entries.translation_source: Leader: [blue]I’ve told you time and time again, bro, quit tryin’ to mess with the Black Emboar!
entries.translated:
Pemimpin: [blue]Aku sudah bilang
berkali-kali, bro, berhentilah\lmengganggu Black Emboar!

entries.original:
"Brother: [blue]I can’t, James.
You’re my brother.

You mean everything to me.

And I can’t let you go down this
path any longer!"
entries.translation_source: Brother: [blue]I can’t, James. You’re my brother. You mean everything to me. And I can’t let you go down this path any longer!
entries.translated:
Saudara: [blue]Aku tidak bisa, James. Kau
adalah saudaraku. Kau berarti\lsegalanya bagiku. Dan aku tidak

bisa membiarkanmu terus di jalan
ini!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]You claim you care about me,
but you ain’t got no guts, bro.

You keep sending these trainers to
harass me ’cause you’re too scared\lto get your own hands dirty."
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]You claim you care about me, but you ain’t got no guts, bro. You keep sending these trainers to harass me ’cause you’re too scared to get your own hands dirty.
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Kau mengaku peduli padaku,
tapi kau tidak punya nyali, bro.\lKau terus mengirim pelatih-pelatih

ini untuk menggangguku karena kau
terlalu takut untuk mengotori\ltanganmu sendiri.

entries.original: "[blue]This kid, [player]’s, got guts!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]This kid, [player]’s, got guts!
entries.translated: [blue]Bocah ini, [player], punya nyali!

entries.original:
"[blue]Let me tell ya!

No one has ever wrecked me as good
as he did!

I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar
to the Black [player], after him!

So it’s time for a fresh start.

The Black [player] and I are moving
to Antisis City!

I hear the old gang that used to
run that joint got run outta town.

Now that city is ripe for the
picking by the Black [player]!

Gwa ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Let me tell ya! No one has ever wrecked me as good as he did! I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar to the Black [player], after him! So it’s time for a fresh start. The Black [player] and I are moving to Antisis City! I hear the old gang that used to run that joint got run outta town. Now that city is ripe for the picking by the Black [player]! Gwa ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
[blue]Biarkan aku bilang! Tidak ada yang
pernah mengalahkanku sebaik dia!\lAku bahkan telah mengganti nama

Black Emboar menjadi Black
[player], sesuai namanya! Jadi\lsaatnya untuk awal yang baru. Black

[player] dan aku pindah ke Antisis
City! Kudengar geng lama yang dulu\lmenguasai tempat itu sudah diusir

dari kota. Sekarang kota itu siap
untuk diambil oleh Black [player]!\lGwa ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Brother: [blue]But James, you can’t just
leave me all alone!"
entries.translation_source: Brother: [blue]But James, you can’t just leave me all alone!
entries.translated:
Saudara: [blue]Tapi James, kau tidak bisa
meninggalkanku sendirian!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]I thought about making you
one of us too, but I can’t have\lsomeone who’s so weak in my gang!

Instead, I’ve decided to let [player]
join our ranks."
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]I thought about making you one of us too, but I can’t have someone who’s so weak in my gang! Instead, I’ve decided to let [player] join our ranks.
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Aku sempat berpikir untuk
menjadikanmu salah satu dari kami\ljuga, tapi aku tidak bisa memiliki

seseorang yang begitu lemah di
gengku! Sebaliknya, aku memutuskan\luntuk membiarkan [player] bergabung

dengan barisan kami.

entries.original:
"[blue]Welcome to the Black [player], kid!

All members gotta have a bike so
take this."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Welcome to the Black [player], kid! All members gotta have a bike so take this.
entries.translated:
[blue]Selamat datang di Black [player],
nak! Semua anggota harus punya\lsepeda, jadi ambil ini.

entries.original:
"[blue]Look us up if you ever come by
Antisis City.

We’ll welcome you with open arms."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Look us up if you ever come by Antisis City. We’ll welcome you with open arms.
entries.translated:
[blue]Carilah kami jika kamu pernah
mampir ke Antisis City. Kami akan\lmenyambutmu dengan tangan terbuka.

entries.original:
"[player] received a Bicycle from the
leader of the Black [player]!"
entries.translation_source: [player] received a Bicycle from the leader of the Black [player]!
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Sepeda dari
pemimpin Black [player]!

entries.original:
"[blue]Sorry you got caught up in all of
that.

I may have lied when I told you I
hadn’t heard from my brother.

In truth, I knew he was the leader
of the Black Emboar.

I just thought you wouldn’t have
wanted to help if you knew you’d\lbe going up against their leader.

But now he’s gone for good, and I’m
all alone for good\.

Anyways, thank you for helping me.

Please take this TM as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Sorry you got caught up in all of that. I may have lied when I told you I hadn’t heard from my brother. In truth, I knew he was the leader of the Black Emboar. I just thought you wouldn’t have wanted to help if you knew you’d be going up against their leader. But now he’s gone for good, and I’m all alone for good\. Anyways, thank you for helping me. Please take this TM as my thanks.
entries.translated:
[blue]Maaf kamu terlibat dalam semua itu.
Mungkin aku berbohong ketika aku\lbilang aku belum mendengar kabar

dari kakakku. Sebenarnya, aku tahu
dia adalah pemimpin Black Emboar.\lAku pikir kamu tidak akan mau

membantu jika kamu tahu kamu akan
melawan pemimpin mereka. Tapi\lsekarang dia pergi untuk selamanya,

dan aku sendirian untuk selamanya\.
Bagaimanapun, terima kasih telah\lmembantuku. Silakan ambil TM ini

sebagai ucapan terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"[player] received the TM98
from the guy!"
entries.translation_source: [player] received the TM98 from the guy!
entries.translated:
[player] menerima TM98 dari pria
itu!

entries.original:
"If you ever see my brother again,
please let him know that I’m still\lworried about him."
entries.translation_source: If you ever see my brother again, please let him know that I’m still worried about him.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu pernah melihat kakakku
lagi, tolong beri tahu dia bahwa\laku masih khawatir padanya.

entries.original:
"[blue]Let me tell ya!

No one has ever wrecked me as good
as she did!

I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar
to the Black [player], after her!

So it’s time for a fresh start.

The Black [player] and I are moving
to Antisis City!

I hear the old gang that used to
run that joint got run outta town.

Now that city is ripe for the
picking by the Black [player]!

Gwa ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Let me tell ya! No one has ever wrecked me as good as she did! I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar to the Black [player], after her! So it’s time for a fresh start. The Black [player] and I are moving to Antisis City! I hear the old gang that used to run that joint got run outta town. Now that city is ripe for the picking by the Black [player]! Gwa ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
[blue]Biarkan aku memberitahumu! Tidak
ada yang pernah menghancurkanku\lsebaik dia! Aku bahkan mengganti

nama Black Emboar menjadi Black
[player], sesuai namanya! Jadi\lsaatnya untuk awal yang baru. Black

[player] dan aku pindah ke Antisis
City! Kudengar geng lama yang dulu\lmenguasai tempat itu diusir dari

kota. Sekarang kota itu siap untuk
diambil alih oleh Black [player]!\lGwa ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] rolled off into the
Gym."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] rolled off into the Gym.
entries.translated: [buffer1] berguling masuk ke Gym.

entries.original:
"Those light bulbs control the flow
of electricity in the Gym.

Turn them on or off, and the flow
of electricity diverts to or from\lthem."
entries.translation_source: Those light bulbs control the flow of electricity in the Gym. Turn them on or off, and the flow of electricity diverts to or from them.
entries.translated:
Bohlam lampu itu mengontrol aliran
listrik di Gym. Nyalakan atau\lmatikan, dan aliran listrik akan

dialihkan ke atau dari mereka.

entries.original:
"I’m not paralyzed, but I seem to
be struck by you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not paralyzed, but I seem to be struck by you!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak lumpuh, tapi aku
sepertinya tersambar olehmu!

entries.original:
"Just because you turned a bulb on,
it doesn’t mean you won’t need to\lturn it off later."
entries.translation_source: Just because you turned a bulb on, it doesn’t mean you won’t need to turn it off later.
entries.translated:
Hanya karena kamu menyalakan
bohlam, bukan berarti kamu tidak\lperlu mematikannya nanti.

entries.original: "Keep on pushing through the pain!"
entries.translation_source: Keep on pushing through the pain!
entries.translated:
Teruslah bertahan melewati rasa
sakit!

entries.original:
"Many of the Pokémon in this Gym
benefit from the electrified\lfloor.

Meaning, you’re a disadvantage!"
entries.translation_source: Many of the Pokémon in this Gym benefit from the electrified floor. Meaning, you’re a disadvantage!
entries.translated:
Banyak Pokémon di Gym ini mendapat
manfaat dari lantai yang dialiri\llistrik. Artinya, kamu dalam posisi

tidak menguntungkan!

entries.original:
"Galavan loves Electric types, but
he couldn’t leave Steel types out."
entries.translation_source: Galavan loves Electric types, but he couldn’t leave Steel types out.
entries.translated:
Galavan menyukai tipe Listrik, tapi
dia tidak bisa meninggalkan tipe\lBaja.

entries.original:
"Not only do I get to collect
Electric types, but I also get to\lcollect Steel types!

I love them both!"
entries.translation_source: Not only do I get to collect Electric types, but I also get to collect Steel types! I love them both!
entries.translated:
Tidak hanya aku bisa mengoleksi
tipe Listrik, tapi aku juga bisa\lmengoleksi tipe Baja! Aku suka

keduanya!

entries.original:
"If you can beat the master engineer
of the Dehara Gym, you’re ready to\lface Galavan."
entries.translation_source: If you can beat the master engineer of the Dehara Gym, you’re ready to face Galavan.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa mengalahkan insinyur
utama Gym Dehara, kamu siap\lmenghadapi Galavan.

entries.original:
"It’s a bulb of some sort.

Would you like to turn it on?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a bulb of some sort. Would you like to turn it on?
entries.translated:
Ini semacam bohlam. Apakah kamu
ingin menyalakannya?

entries.original:
"It’s a bulb of some sort.

Would you like to turn it off?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a bulb of some sort. Would you like to turn it off?
entries.translated:
Ini semacam bohlam. Apakah kamu
ingin mematikannya?

entries.original:
"As long as the floor is
electrified, no Pokémon on the\lground can fall asleep!"
entries.translation_source: As long as the floor is electrified, no Pokémon on the ground can fall asleep!
entries.translated:
Selama lantai dialiri listrik,
tidak ada Pokémon di tanah yang\lbisa tertidur!

entries.original:
"Oh, who might you be?

\.

[player]?

Am I correct in assuming you’re
looking for [rival]?

He came by here a while ago asking
how to get to The Ruins of Void.

I’ll tell you exactly what I told
him.

The only way I’m aware of is by
taking a boat or by or surfing\ldown Route 14.

I’m sorry if that doesn’t help you
much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, who might you be? \. [player]? Am I correct in assuming you’re looking for [rival]? He came by here a while ago asking how to get to The Ruins of Void. I’ll tell you exactly what I told him. The only way I’m aware of is by taking a boat or by or surfing down Route 14. I’m sorry if that doesn’t help you much.
entries.translated:
Oh, siapa kamu? \. [player]? Benarkah
aku mengira kamu mencari [rival]?\lDia datang ke sini beberapa waktu

lalu bertanya bagaimana cara menuju
ke Reruntuhan Kekosongan. Aku akan\lmemberitahumu persis seperti yang

aku katakan padanya. Satu-satunya
cara yang aku tahu adalah dengan\lnaik perahu atau berselancar

menyusuri Rute 14. Maaf jika itu
tidak banyak membantumu.

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of Prof. Log?

He’s an old research buddy of mine.

We used to research the history of
Borrius together.

That is until we discovered
something one day that we\lshouldn’t have\.

Ever since then he’s been studying
Pokémon stats and capture rates,\lwhile I sit here retired."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of Prof. Log? He’s an old research buddy of mine. We used to research the history of Borrius together. That is until we discovered something one day that we shouldn’t have\. Ever since then he’s been studying Pokémon stats and capture rates, while I sit here retired.
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mendengar Prof. Log?
Dia adalah teman riset lama ku.\lKami dulu bersama-sama meneliti

sejarah Borrius. Sampai suatu hari
kami menemukan sesuatu yang\lseharusnya tidak kami temukan\. Sejak

saat itu dia mempelajari statistik
Pokémon dan tingkat tangkapan,\lsementara aku duduk di sini

pensiun.

entries.original:
"1F: Service Counter
2F: Trainer’s Market\l3F: Evolution Items\l4F: TM Corner\l5F: Medicine Box\l6F: Wiseman Gifts"
entries.translation_source: 1F: Service Counter 2F: Trainer’s Market 3F: Evolution Items 4F: TM Corner 5F: Medicine Box 6F: Wiseman Gifts
entries.translated:
1F: Loket Layanan 2F: Pasar Trainer
3F: Item Evolusi 4F: Pojok TM 5F:\lKotak Obat 6F: Hadiah Wiseman

entries.original:
"Sniff, sniff\.Sniff, sniff\.

Oh, that aroma!
It smells so gourmet!

Do you have a wonderful ingredient
in your bag?

Would you consider selling it to
me?"
entries.translation_source: Sniff, sniff\.Sniff, sniff\. Oh, that aroma! It smells so gourmet! Do you have a wonderful ingredient in your bag? Would you consider selling it to me?
entries.translated:
Sniff, sniff\.Sniff, sniff\. Oh, aroma
itu! Baunya sangat gourmet! Apakah\lkau punya bahan yang luar biasa di

tasmu? Apakah kau bersedia
menjualnya padaku?

entries.original:
"Oh, it smells so good!

That [green][buffer3] [blue]of yours is a very
rare ingedient indeed!

Would you take [green]$[buffer2] [blue]for it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, it smells so good! That [green][buffer3] [blue]of yours is a very rare ingedient indeed! Would you take [green]$[buffer2] [blue]for it?
entries.translated:
Oh, baunya sangat enak! Itu
[green][buffer3] [blue]milikmu adalah bahan yang\lsangat langka! Apakah kau mau

menerima [green]$[buffer2] [blue]untuknya?

entries.original:
"Merci! Thank you!

With this, I can create a superb
menu!

My customers will love it!"
entries.translation_source: Merci! Thank you! With this, I can create a superb menu! My customers will love it!
entries.translated:

aku bisa membuat menu yang luar\lbiasa! Pelangganku akan

menyukainya!

[green][buffer3]s[blue]. Jika kamu menemukan\lbahan gourmet untukku, tolong beri

tahu aku!

entries.original:
"Aww\.Well, that’s okay.

If you find a gourmet ingredient
for me, please let me know!"

entries.translated:
Aww\.Yah, tidak apa-apa. Jika kamu
menemukan bahan gourmet untukku,\ltolong beri tahu aku!

"I love the Dehara Department
Store!

I’ve been shopping here since it
opened back in the day!"
entries.translation_source: I love the Dehara Department Store! I’ve been shopping here since it opened back in the day!
entries.translated:
Aku suka Department Store Dehara!
Aku sudah berbelanja di sini sejak\ldibuka dulu!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.

My wife has insisted I bring her
here ever since this store opened.

Oh!

That’s the sign she just purchased
something with my credit card.

That’s another ten years of my
life, wasted\."
entries.translation_source: Sigh\. My wife has insisted I bring her here ever since this store opened. Oh! That’s the sign she just purchased something with my credit card. That’s another ten years of my life, wasted\.
entries.translated:
Sigh\. Istriku bersikeras aku
membawanya ke sini sejak toko ini\ldibuka. Oh! Itu tandanya dia baru

saja membeli sesuatu dengan kartu
kreditku. Itu sepuluh tahun lagi\lhidupku, terbuang sia-sia\.

"I hear some Trainers on higher
floors will try to battle you.

You should make sure you’re stocked
up with essential items from the\lvendors on this floor."

entries.translated:
Kudengar beberapa Trainer di lantai
atas akan mencoba bertarung\ldenganmu. Kamu harus memastikan

kamu sudah membeli barang-barang
penting dari penjual di lantai ini.

entries.translated:
Mungkin suatu hari mereka akan

"A lover of sea is of course one to

entries.translation_source: A lover of sea is of course one to dabble with the evolutionary!

Pencinta laut tentu saja suka
bermain-main dengan evolusi!

entries.original:
"Maybe I should invest in some

Mungkin aku harus berinvestasi pada

entries.original:
"I’m looking for the perfect letter
to send to my boyfriend.

But there are just so many options!

I just don’t know which one to
choose!"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking for the perfect letter to send to my boyfriend. But there are just so many options! I just don’t know which one to choose!
entries.translated:
Aku sedang mencari surat yang
sempurna untuk dikirim ke pacarku.\lTapi ada begitu banyak pilihan! Aku

jadi tidak tahu harus memilih yang
mana!

entries.original:
"I must go into seculsion to
study the art of the shop."

entries.translated:
Aku harus mengasingkan diri untuk
mempelajari seni berbelanja.

entries.original: "Uh\.we are already on that floor?"

Magma berkilau merah tua\. Apakah

entries.original:
"This desert hoards mysteries in
its shifting sands!"
entries.translation_source: This desert hoards mysteries in its shifting sands!
entries.translated:
Gurun ini menyimpan misteri di
pasirnya yang bergerak!

entries.original:
"If they can find fossils in the desert,
it must have been a sea before."
entries.translation_source: If they can find fossils in the desert, it must have been a sea before.
entries.translated:
Jika mereka bisa menemukan fosil di
gurun, pasti dulunya adalah laut.

entries.original:
"Shattering rocks here can yield
valuable rewards!"
entries.translation_source: Shattering rocks here can yield valuable rewards!
entries.translated:
Menghancurkan batu di sini bisa
memberikan hadiah berharga!

entries.original:
"Because of my efforts, this desert
is like a paradise for Pokémon!

It’s a true desert resort!"
entries.translation_source: Because of my efforts, this desert is like a paradise for Pokémon! It’s a true desert resort!
entries.translated:
Berkat usahaku, gurun ini seperti
surga bagi Pokémon! Ini benar-benar\lresor gurun!

entries.original:
"I’m going to be a real hero one day.
I’m going to work harder to make me\land my POKéMON stronger."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to be a real hero one day. I’m going to work harder to make me and my POKéMON stronger.
entries.translated:
Suatu hari nanti aku akan menjadi
pahlawan sejati. Aku akan bekerja\llebih keras untuk membuatku dan

POKéMON-ku menjadi lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"Hmph.

I really dug myself into a hole,
haven’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Hmph. I really dug myself into a hole, haven’t I?
entries.translated:
Hmph. Aku benar-benar menggali
lubang untuk diriku sendiri, ya?

entries.original: "ZZZ\."
entries.translation_source: ZZZ\.
entries.translated: ZZZ\.

entries.original:
"This desert’ll always keep me
fired up!"
entries.translation_source: This desert’ll always keep me fired up!
entries.translated:
Gurun ini akan selalu membuatku
bersemangat!

entries.original:
"I came to play music in the desert,
but sand is getting in my guitar."
entries.translation_source: I came to play music in the desert, but sand is getting in my guitar.
entries.translated:
Aku datang untuk bermain musik di
gurun, tapi pasir masuk ke gitarku.

entries.original:
"I want to add some rare fossils to
my collection."
entries.translation_source: I want to add some rare fossils to my collection.
entries.translated:
Aku ingin menambahkan beberapa
fosil langka ke koleksiku.

entries.original:
"I’m telling you, this rock
formation has significance!

I can feel it!"
entries.translation_source: I’m telling you, this rock formation has significance! I can feel it!
entries.translated:
Aku bilang, formasi batu ini
memiliki arti penting! Aku bisa\lmerasakannya!

entries.original:
"This desert sure is dangerous.

If you can beat me, I heal you and
help you get through it safely!"
entries.translation_source: This desert sure is dangerous. If you can beat me, I heal you and help you get through it safely!
entries.translated:
Gurun ini memang berbahaya. Jika
kamu bisa mengalahkanku, aku akan\lmenyembuhkanmu dan membantumu

melewatinya dengan aman!

entries.original:
"Okay, let’s get you all fixed up!
Just leave it up to me!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, let’s get you all fixed up! Just leave it up to me!
entries.translated:
Oke, biarkan aku merapikanmu!
Serahkan saja padaku!

entries.original:
"Be careful of sandstorms as you
explore the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Be careful of sandstorms as you explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Hati-hati dengan badai pasir saat
menjelajahi Great Desert!

entries.original:
"I’m studying up on how to revive
Pokémon fossils.

Apparently many can be found by
smashing rocks in the [green]Great Desert[red]\land other places around Borrius.

Do you have any you would like me
to revive for you?"
entries.translation_source: I’m studying up on how to revive Pokémon fossils. Apparently many can be found by smashing rocks in the [green]Great Desert[red] and other places around Borrius. Do you have any you would like me to revive for you?
entries.translated:
Aku sedang mempelajari cara
menghidupkan kembali fosil Pokémon.\lRupanya banyak yang bisa ditemukan

dengan menghancurkan batu di [green]Great
Desert[red] dan tempat lain di sekitar\lBorrius. Apakah kamu memiliki fosil

yang ingin aku hidupkan untukmu?

entries.original:
"\.Huh?

That doesn’t look like a fossil to
me\."
entries.translation_source: \.Huh? That doesn’t look like a fossil to me\.
entries.translated:
\.Hah? Itu tidak terlihat seperti
fosil bagiku\.

entries.original:
"That’s [buffer2], a fossil of
[buffer1].

Would you like me to revive it into
[green][buffer1][red], for you?"
entries.translation_source: That’s [buffer2], a fossil of [buffer1]. Would you like me to revive it into [green][buffer1][red], for you?
entries.translated:
Itu adalah [buffer2], fosil dari
[buffer1]. Apakah kamu ingin aku\lmenghidupkannya menjadi [green][buffer1][red]

untukmu?

entries.original: "Please give me the fossil."
entries.translation_source: Please give me the fossil.
entries.translated: Tolong berikan fosilnya padaku.

entries.original:
"[player] handed over the [buffer2]
to the scientist."
entries.translation_source: [player] handed over the [buffer2] to the scientist.
entries.translated:
[player] menyerahkan [buffer2]
kepada ilmuwan.

entries.original:
"It’ll take some time to revive.
Come back later."
entries.translation_source: It’ll take some time to revive. Come back later.
entries.translated:
Butuh waktu untuk menghidupkannya.
Kembalilah nanti.

entries.original:
"Go out there, smash some rocks, and
get your hands on some fossils!"
entries.translation_source: Go out there, smash some rocks, and get your hands on some fossils!
entries.translated:
Pergilah ke luar, hancurkan
beberapa batu, dan dapatkan fosil!

entries.original:
"I see\.

I’ll be here if you ever want to
revive it."
entries.translation_source: I see\. I’ll be here if you ever want to revive it.
entries.translated:
Begitu ya\. Aku akan di sini jika
kamu ingin menghidupkannya.

entries.original:
"Welcome back!

I’ve successfully revived your
fossil into a healthy [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome back! I’ve successfully revived your fossil into a healthy [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
Selamat datang kembali! Aku
berhasil menghidupkan fosilmu\lmenjadi [buffer1] yang sehat!

entries.original:
"They say that long ago Regirock
assisted in the construction of\lthis town.

But once the town had been built,
it disappeared into the desert,\lnever to be seen again."
entries.translation_source: They say that long ago Regirock assisted in the construction of this town. But once the town had been built, it disappeared into the desert, never to be seen again.
entries.translated:
Mereka bilang bahwa dahulu kala
Regirock membantu pembangunan kota\lini. Tapi setelah kota selesai

dibangun, ia menghilang ke dalam
gurun, tidak pernah terlihat lagi.

entries.original:
"We used to have a festival every
year to commemorate when Regirock\lfinished building this town.

But interest in it has sort of
just faded away in recent years.

No one really wants to come here
anymore so we stopped having it."
entries.translation_source: We used to have a festival every year to commemorate when Regirock finished building this town. But interest in it has sort of just faded away in recent years. No one really wants to come here anymore so we stopped having it.
entries.translated:
Dulu kami mengadakan festival
setiap tahun untuk memperingati\lsaat Regirock menyelesaikan

pembangunan kota ini. Tapi minat
terhadapnya agak memudar dalam\lbeberapa tahun terakhir. Tidak ada

yang benar-benar ingin datang ke
sini lagi jadi kami berhenti\lmengadakannya.

entries.original:
"One of these days you’re going to
need to cross the ocean.

When that day comes, you’ll need a
Pokémon to take you across the\lwaters.

I’ve had this Lapras for many
years, but it’s finally time for me\lto retire from a life of fishing.

Please, take it for me, and allow
it to keep swimming."
entries.translation_source: One of these days you’re going to need to cross the ocean. When that day comes, you’ll need a Pokémon to take you across the waters. I’ve had this Lapras for many years, but it’s finally time for me to retire from a life of fishing. Please, take it for me, and allow it to keep swimming.
entries.translated:
Suatu hari nanti kamu perlu
menyeberangi lautan. Saat hari itu\ltiba, kamu akan membutuhkan Pokémon

untuk membawamu menyeberangi
perairan. Aku sudah memiliki Lapras\lini selama bertahun-tahun, tapi

akhirnya tiba waktunya bagiku untuk
pensiun dari kehidupan memancing.\lTolong, ambillah untukku, dan

biarkan ia terus berenang.

entries.original:
"But my poor Lapras\.
How will it swim?"
entries.translation_source: But my poor Lapras\. How will it swim?
entries.translated:
Tapi Lapras malangku\. Bagaimana ia
akan berenang?

entries.original:
"Ohhhhhhhhhhhh yeahhhhhhhhh!

Now that I’ve gotten rid of that
dead weight, it’s finally time to\lparty in East Borrius!

See you around kid!"
entries.translation_source: Ohhhhhhhhhhhh yeahhhhhhhhh! Now that I’ve gotten rid of that dead weight, it’s finally time to party in East Borrius! See you around kid!
entries.translated:
Ohhhhhhhhhhhh yeahhhhhhhhh!
Sekarang setelah aku menyingkirkan\lbeban itu, akhirnya waktunya

berpesta di East Borrius! Sampai
jumpa, Nak!

entries.original:
"Oh no.

You don’t have any space in your
party for my Lapras.

Hurry up and make space so I can
give it to you."
entries.translation_source: Oh no. You don’t have any space in your party for my Lapras. Hurry up and make space so I can give it to you.
entries.translated:
Oh tidak. Kamu tidak memiliki ruang
di timmu untuk Lapras-ku. Cepat\lbuat ruang agar aku bisa

memberikannya padamu.

entries.original:
"Hey, you.

I have a favour to ask you.

I’m an enthusiast.

A lover of hard things if I say so
myself.

A fellow enthusiast of mine lives
in Dehara City, but unlike him, I’m\lnot interested in buying anything\loff of you.

I just want you to collect
[green]5 Hard Stones [blue]for me.

You down?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, you. I have a favour to ask you. I’m an enthusiast. A lover of hard things if I say so myself. A fellow enthusiast of mine lives in Dehara City, but unlike him, I’m not interested in buying anything off of you. I just want you to collect [green]5 Hard Stones [blue]for me. You down?
entries.translated:
Hei, kamu. Ada sesuatu yang ingin
aku minta. Aku seorang penggemar.\lPencinta benda keras menurutku

sendiri. Sesama penggemar tinggal
di Dehara City, tapi tidak seperti\ldia, aku tidak tertarik membeli apa

pun darimu. Aku hanya ingin kamu
mengumpulkan [green]5 Hard Stones[blue] untukku.\lKamu mau?

entries.original:
"I’ll have to send someone else
to do it for me, then."
entries.translation_source: I’ll have to send someone else to do it for me, then.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu aku harus menyuruh
orang lain untuk melakukannya\luntukku.

entries.original:
"Great.

[green]Hard Stones [blue]occasionally appear
when you smash rocks in the\l[green]Great Desert[blue].

Find 5 and bring them to me
please."
entries.translation_source: Great. [green]Hard Stones [blue]occasionally appear when you smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue]. Find 5 and bring them to me please.
entries.translated:
Bagus. [green]Batu Keras [blue]kadang muncul
saat kamu menghancurkan batu di\l[green]Gurun Besar[blue]. Temukan 5 dan bawa ke

saya.

entries.original:
"Nice, you got them.

Let me take them from you."
entries.translation_source: Nice, you got them. Let me take them from you.
entries.translated:
Bagus, kamu mendapatkannya. Biarkan
saya mengambilnya dari kamu.

entries.original: "The guy took [green]5 Hard Stones[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The guy took [green]5 Hard Stones[blue].
entries.translated: Orang itu mengambil [green]5 Batu Keras[blue].

entries.original:
"Oh, I assume you want something as
a reward, right?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I assume you want something as a reward, right?
entries.translated:
Oh, saya kira kamu ingin sesuatu
sebagai hadiah, kan?

entries.original:
"You need more space if you want
this from me."
entries.translation_source: You need more space if you want this from me.
entries.translated:
Kamu perlu lebih banyak ruang jika
kamu menginginkan ini dari saya.

entries.original:
"You should give that [green]Pearl String
[blue]to my fellow enthusiast in [green]Dehara\lCity[blue].

He’ll pay a good deal of money for
it."
entries.translation_source: You should give that [green]Pearl String [blue]to my fellow enthusiast in [green]Dehara City[blue]. He’ll pay a good deal of money for it.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus memberikan [green]Untaian
Mutiara [blue]itu kepada sesama penggemar\lsaya di [green]Kota Dehara[blue]. Dia akan

membayar banyak uang untuk itu.

entries.original:
"Why are there no Ghost Pokémon
here?"
entries.translation_source: Why are there no Ghost Pokémon here?
entries.translated:
Kenapa tidak ada Pokémon Hantu di
sini?

entries.original: "How do I get out of here?"
entries.translation_source: How do I get out of here?
entries.translated: Bagaimana cara keluar dari sini?

entries.original:
"I thought I had the ultimate
swarm\."
entries.translation_source: I thought I had the ultimate swarm\.
entries.translated:
Saya kira saya memiliki gerombolan
pamungkas\.

entries.original:
"You should search the mushrooms on
the ground."
entries.translation_source: You should search the mushrooms on the ground.
entries.translated: Kamu harus mencari jamur di tanah.

entries.original:
"I came from Vivill Town.

For some reason its been raining a
lot there, lately."
entries.translation_source: I came from Vivill Town. For some reason its been raining a lot there, lately.
entries.translated:
Saya datang dari Kota Vivill. Untuk
beberapa alasan, di sana sering\lhujan akhir-akhir ini.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] scurried off into the
forest."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] scurried off into the forest.
entries.translated:
Si [buffer1] bergegas pergi ke
hutan.

entries.original:
"Vivill Woods

\au Vivill Town
\ad Gurun Town"
entries.translation_source: Vivill Woods \au Vivill Town \ad Gurun Town
entries.translated:
Hutan Vivill \au Kota Vivill \ad Kota
Gurun

entries.original:
"People used to be afraid to
leave their homes because of\lthat cloaked gang."
entries.translation_source: People used to be afraid to leave their homes because of that cloaked gang.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang dulu takut meninggalkan
rumah mereka karena geng berjubah\litu.

entries.original:
"Ever since the cloaked gang left
town, the sun has started shining\land the flowers are blooming again!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since the cloaked gang left town, the sun has started shining and the flowers are blooming again!
entries.translated:
Sejak geng berjubah itu
meninggalkan kota, matahari mulai\lbersinar dan bunga-bunga bermekaran

kembali!

entries.original:
"The sea\.

Watching the waves is so calming,
isn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: The sea\. Watching the waves is so calming, isn’t it?
entries.translated:
Laut\. Melihat ombak begitu
menenangkan, bukan?

entries.original:
"I knew you’d agree with me!

Tell you what.

If you can defeat me in a battle by
the sea, I’ll let you have one of\lmy prized Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I knew you’d agree with me! Tell you what. If you can defeat me in a battle by the sea, I’ll let you have one of my prized Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Saya tahu kamu akan setuju dengan
saya! Begini saja. Jika kamu bisa\lmengalahkanku dalam pertarungan di

tepi laut, aku akan memberimu salah
satu Pokémon berhargaku!

entries.original:
"You’ve made my day!

Please, take my prized Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve made my day! Please, take my prized Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kamu membuat hariku! Silakan, ambil
Pokémon berhargaku!

entries.original:
"Please, let that Pokémon transform
your world."
entries.translation_source: Please, let that Pokémon transform your world.
entries.translated:
Tolong, biarkan Pokémon itu
mengubah duniamu.

entries.original:
"I see\.

That is unfortunate."
entries.translation_source: I see\. That is unfortunate.
entries.translated: Begitu\. Itu sangat disayangkan.

entries.original:
"If you want my prized Pokémon,
you’ll need to make room for it\lin your party first."
entries.translation_source: If you want my prized Pokémon, you’ll need to make room for it in your party first.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin Pokémon berhargaku,
kamu harus menyediakan ruang\luntuknya di timmu terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Route 14

\au Route 13\l\al Route 6, Ruins of Void\l\ar Route 12"
entries.translation_source: Route 14 \au Route 13 \al Route 6, Ruins of Void \ar Route 12
entries.translated:
Rute 14 \au Rute 13 \al Rute 6, Ruins
of Void \ar Rute 12

entries.original:
"Route 14

h7B Route 6\l\ar Ruins of Void, Route 12"
entries.translation_source: Route 14 h7B Route 6 \ar Ruins of Void, Route 12
entries.translated:
Rute 14 h7B Rute 6 \ar Ruins of Void,
Rute 12

entries.original:
"With my fists, I am trying to
smash this rock that continuously\lreappears under my umbrella.

Aiyah!

But it is not working\."
entries.translation_source: With my fists, I am trying to smash this rock that continuously reappears under my umbrella. Aiyah! But it is not working\.
entries.translated:
Dengan tinjuku, aku mencoba
menghancurkan batu ini yang terus\lmuncul kembali di bawah payungku.

Aiyah! Tapi tidak berhasil\.

entries.original: "Aiyah! You smashed it!"
entries.translation_source: Aiyah! You smashed it!
entries.translated: Aiyah! Kamu menghancurkannya!

entries.original:
"I sunbathe here every day to
attract the attention of random men\lso I can feel good about myself."
entries.translation_source: I sunbathe here every day to attract the attention of random men so I can feel good about myself.
entries.translated:
Aku berjemur di sini setiap hari
untuk menarik perhatian pria-pria\lacak agar aku merasa baik tentang

diriku sendiri.

entries.original:
"Scientist: [blue]What the\.?

Where did this kid come from?"
entries.translation_source: Scientist: [blue]What the\.? Where did this kid come from?
entries.translated:
Ilmuwan: [blue]Apa apaan\.? Dari mana
datangnya anak ini?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Quick, scientist!

What are you standing around for?

Grab him!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Quick, scientist! What are you standing around for? Grab him!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Cepat, ilmuwan! Kamu berdiri
saja di situ? Tangkap dia!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Quick, scientist!

What are you standing around for?

Grab her!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Quick, scientist! What are you standing around for? Grab her!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Cepat, ilmuwan! Kamu berdiri
saja di situ? Tangkap dia!

entries.original:
"Now knock him out and lock him
up in the warehouse!

The boss is going to freak when he
hears about this\."
entries.translation_source: Now knock him out and lock him up in the warehouse! The boss is going to freak when he hears about this\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang buat dia pingsan dan kunci
dia di gudang! Bos akan panik saat\lmendengar tentang ini\.

entries.original:
"Now knock her out and lock her
up in the warehouse!

The boss is going to freak when
he hears about this\."
entries.translation_source: Now knock her out and lock her up in the warehouse! The boss is going to freak when he hears about this\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang buat dia pingsan dan kunci
dia di gudang! Bos akan panik saat\lmendengar tentang ini\.

entries.original:
"Route 4

\al Grim Woods, Cinder Volcano
Route 5\l\ar Dresco Town\l\ad Route 13"
entries.translation_source: Route 4 \al Grim Woods, Cinder Volcano Route 5 \ar Dresco Town \ad Route 13
entries.translated:
Rute 4 \al Grim Woods, Cinder Volcano
Rute 5 \ar Dresco Town \ad Rute 13

entries.original:
"What do you think you’re doing?

You can’t go explore the Great
Desert dressed like that!

If you don’t get the proper
eyewear, I won’t be able to let\lyou through."
entries.translation_source: What do you think you’re doing? You can’t go explore the Great Desert dressed like that! If you don’t get the proper eyewear, I won’t be able to let you through.
entries.translated:
Apa yang kamu pikirkan? Kamu tidak
bisa menjelajahi Great Desert\ldengan pakaian seperti itu! Jika

kamu tidak mendapatkan kacamata
yang tepat, aku tidak akan bisa\lmembiarkanmu lewat.

entries.original:
"Whenever I stand here, I can see
really cool things!

It’s like the water goes into the
trees!"
entries.translation_source: Whenever I stand here, I can see really cool things! It’s like the water goes into the trees!
entries.translated:
Setiap kali aku berdiri di sini,
aku bisa melihat hal-hal yang\lsangat keren! Seperti air masuk ke

pohon-pohon!

entries.original:
"My big sister tries to avoid saying
bad words as much as possible.

But instead she just says things
like \qofeces\qc and \qoTauros waste\qc.

So I dunno if it’s any better than
just saying the real things\.

Now when I grow big, I’m going to
say those dumb things too!"
entries.translation_source: My big sister tries to avoid saying bad words as much as possible. But instead she just says things like \qofeces\qc and \qoTauros waste\qc. So I dunno if it’s any better than just saying the real things\. Now when I grow big, I’m going to say those dumb things too!
entries.translated:
Kakak perempuanku berusaha
menghindari kata-kata buruk sebisa\lmungkin. Tapi malah dia mengatakan

hal-hal seperti \qofeces\qc dan \qoTauros
waste\qc. Jadi aku tidak tahu apakah\litu lebih baik daripada mengatakan

hal yang sebenarnya\. Sekarang ketika
aku besar nanti, aku akan\lmengatakan hal-hal bodoh itu juga!

entries.original: "Nice of you to finally make it."
entries.translation_source: Nice of you to finally make it.
entries.translated:
Senang kamu akhirnya berhasil
datang.

entries.original:
"While you were taking your time, I
tried scouting out the area to\llook for The Shadows, but so far\lI’ve had no luck."
entries.translation_source: While you were taking your time, I tried scouting out the area to look for The Shadows, but so far I’ve had no luck.
entries.translated:
Sementara kamu santai-santai, aku
mencoba mengintai area untuk\lmencari The Shadows, tapi sejauh

ini belum ada hasil.

entries.original:
"And it’s not like there’s even
anyone to ask.

This town is practically deserted\.

I’ve only seen one guy in a cloak
standing by a warehouse on the\lnorth end of town, but that’s it."
entries.translation_source: And it’s not like there’s even anyone to ask. This town is practically deserted\. I’ve only seen one guy in a cloak standing by a warehouse on the north end of town, but that’s it.
entries.translated:
Dan tidak ada siapa pun untuk
ditanya. Kota ini praktis sepi\. Aku\lhanya melihat satu pria berjubah

berdiri di dekat gudang di ujung
utara kota, hanya itu.

entries.original:
"I’m going to head on up there.

Whoever that guy is, he’s going to
give us some answers.

Meet me there. But this time, don’t
take too long."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to head on up there. Whoever that guy is, he’s going to give us some answers. Meet me there. But this time, don’t take too long.
entries.translated:
Aku akan pergi ke sana. Siapa pun
pria itu, dia akan memberi kita\ljawaban. Temui aku di sana. Tapi

kali ini, jangan terlalu lama.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Looks like you couldn’t
keep your balance\.

Heh, I told you we’d find a way in!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Looks like you couldn’t keep your balance\. Heh, I told you we’d find a way in!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Sepertinya kamu tidak
bisa menjaga keseimbanganmu\. Heh,\laku sudah bilang kita akan

menemukan jalan masuk!

entries.original:
"[blue]What?

He had it coming to him."
entries.translation_source: [blue]What? He had it coming to him.
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa? Dia memang pantas
mendapatkannya.

entries.original:
"[blue]Quick, let’s head inside while he’s
still unconcious."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Quick, let’s head inside while he’s still unconcious.
entries.translated:
[blue]Cepat, ayo masuk ke dalam selagi
dia masih tidak sadar.

entries.original:
"[blue]Man\.

What an entrance\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Man\. What an entrance\.
entries.translated: [blue]Astaga\. Sungguh sebuah penampilan\.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]You, thug!

What are you doing here?"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]You, thug! What are you doing here?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Hei, preman! Apa yang kau
lakukan di sini?

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Standing guard against the
likes of you.

Véga told me to make sure no one,
especially [player], goes inside.

There’s an impending attack, so it
was only a matter of time before\lsomeone tried barging past me.

But I have to say, I expected more
of a fighting force."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Standing guard against the likes of you. Véga told me to make sure no one, especially [player], goes inside. There’s an impending attack, so it was only a matter of time before someone tried barging past me. But I have to say, I expected more of a fighting force.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Berjaga-jaga dari orang
sepertimu. Véga menyuruhku\lmemastikan tidak ada seorang pun,

terutama [player], yang masuk ke
dalam. Ada serangan yang akan\ldatang, jadi hanya masalah waktu

sebelum seseorang mencoba
menerobosku. Tapi harus kuakui, aku\lmengharapkan lebih banyak kekuatan

tempur.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]If you think this is the
full force, you’re sorely mistaken.

Just wait, any minute now,
The Shadows will show up and blow\lyou out of the way!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]If you think this is the full force, you’re sorely mistaken. Just wait, any minute now, The Shadows will show up and blow you out of the way!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Jika kau pikir ini adalah
kekuatan penuh, kau salah besar.\lTunggu saja, sebentar lagi, The

Shadows akan muncul dan
menyingkirkanmu!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Heh, thanks for confirming our
suspicions about the Shadows.

But that doesn’t really matter
either way.

Even if someone did get past
me, our security measures our\limpenetrable.

Beyond this one entrance, are rows
and rows of other grunts, ready to\lkill anyone who tries to break in!

So chew on that you arrogant little
dunce."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Heh, thanks for confirming our suspicions about the Shadows. But that doesn’t really matter either way. Even if someone did get past me, our security measures our impenetrable. Beyond this one entrance, are rows and rows of other grunts, ready to kill anyone who tries to break in! So chew on that you arrogant little dunce.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Heh, terima kasih telah
mengonfirmasi kecurigaan kami\ltentang The Shadows. Tapi itu tidak

terlalu penting. Bahkan jika
seseorang berhasil melewati saya,\ltindakan keamanan kami tidak dapat

ditembus. Di luar pintu masuk ini,
ada barisan barisan grunt lain,\lsiap membunuh siapa pun yang

mencoba masuk! Jadi cerna itu,
dasar bocah sombong.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Then I’ll just have to
destroy them all myself!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Then I’ll just have to destroy them all myself!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Kalau begitu aku harus
menghancurkan mereka semua seorang\ldiri!

entries.original:
"[blue]We don’t have much time, [player].

That grunt I knocked out could
come to any minute now.

We need to get moving.

The only thing is\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]We don’t have much time, [player]. That grunt I knocked out could come to any minute now. We need to get moving. The only thing is\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kita tidak punya banyak waktu,
[player]. Grunt yang aku pingsankan\lbisa sadar kapan saja. Kita harus

bergerak. Hanya saja\.

entries.original:
"[blue]There’s that security door in the
way\.

Not to mention those grunts on the
other side don’t look so keen on\lletting us through without a fight."
entries.translation_source: [blue]There’s that security door in the way\. Not to mention those grunts on the other side don’t look so keen on letting us through without a fight.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ada pintu keamanan itu yang
menghalangi\. Belum lagi grunt-grunt\ldi sisi lain tidak terlihat ingin

membiarkan kita lewat tanpa
perlawanan.

entries.original:
"[blue]What do you think we should we do
[player]?

Do you think we should just knock
that door down with our Pokémon\land take them all out?

Or should we try to scale the cliff
and use the Shadows’ entrance?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]What do you think we should we do [player]? Do you think we should just knock that door down with our Pokémon and take them all out? Or should we try to scale the cliff and use the Shadows’ entrance?
entries.translated:
[blue]Menurutmu, apa yang harus kita
lakukan, [player]? Apakah menurutmu\lkita harus merobohkan pintu itu

dengan Pokémon kita dan mengalahkan
mereka semua? Atau kita harus\lmencoba memanjat tebing dan

menggunakan pintu masuk The
Shadows?

entries.original: "Knock ’em down!"
entries.translation_source: Knock ’em down!
entries.translated: Hancurkan mereka!

entries.original: "Scale the cliff!"
entries.translation_source: Scale the cliff!
entries.translated: Panjat tebing!

entries.original:
"[blue]I completely agree with you,
[player].

Let’s knock ’em down!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I completely agree with you, [player]. Let’s knock ’em down!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku setuju sepenuhnya denganmu,
[player]. Ayo hancurkan mereka!

entries.original:
"[blue]I’m not a huge fan of that idea,
[player].

It would take a lot more effort
just to climb down the cliff.

And besides, we’ll miss all of the
action if we do that!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I’m not a huge fan of that idea, [player]. It would take a lot more effort just to climb down the cliff. And besides, we’ll miss all of the action if we do that!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku tidak terlalu suka ide itu,
[player]. Akan butuh lebih banyak\lusaha untuk turun dari tebing.

Lagipula, kita akan melewatkan
semua aksi jika melakukan itu!

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]What the\.

Is that a Shadow Warrior!?"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [blue]What the\. Is that a Shadow Warrior!?
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Apa-apaan\. Apakah itu
Shadow Warrior!?

entries.original:
"Grunt 4: [blue]Wait! No, Please!

I have a family, a wife, a baby
girl\.

I need to live for them!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 4: [blue]Wait! No, Please! I have a family, a wife, a baby girl\. I need to live for them!
entries.translated:
Grunt 4: [blue]Tunggu! Tidak, Kumohon!
Aku punya keluarga, istri, bayi\lperempuan\. Aku harus hidup untuk

mereka!

entries.original: "[rival]: [blue]What are these things?"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]What are these things?
entries.translated: [rival]: [blue]Makhluk apa ini?

entries.original:
"[blue]Do something, [player]!

Can’t you talk to it or something?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Do something, [player]! Can’t you talk to it or something?
entries.translated:
[blue]Lakukan sesuatu, [player]! Apa kau
tidak bisa bicara padanya atau\lsemacamnya?

entries.original:
"[blue]That was a close one, [player].

A few more seconds and we both
could have been burnt to a crisp!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]That was a close one, [player]. A few more seconds and we both could have been burnt to a crisp!
entries.translated:
[blue]Itu tadi hampir saja, [player].
Beberapa detik lagi dan kita berdua\lbisa hangus terbakar!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now that the path has been
cleared, let’s head down.

Hopefully we can avoid more of
those\.things\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now that the path has been cleared, let’s head down. Hopefully we can avoid more of those\.things\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang setelah jalannya bersih,
ayo turun. Semoga kita bisa\lmenghindari lebih banyak dari

itu\.hal-hal\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t know how you got past all
of the guards, but I’m still not\lgoing to let you head downstairs!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I don’t know how you got past all of the guards, but I’m still not going to let you head downstairs!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku tidak tahu bagaimana kau bisa
melewati semua penjaga, tapi aku\ltetap tidak akan membiarkanmu turun

ke lantai bawah!

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t really care about stopping
you anyways.

It’s your friend who needs to pay
for what he did to me!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I don’t really care about stopping you anyways. It’s your friend who needs to pay for what he did to me!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku tidak begitu peduli untuk
menghentikanmu. Temanmulah yang\lharus membayar atas apa yang dia

lakukan padaku!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Next time, don’t try to
mess with someone you can’t beat."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Next time, don’t try to mess with someone you can’t beat.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Lain kali, jangan
coba-coba mengganggu seseorang yang\ltidak bisa kau kalahkan.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Why you\.

I’ll be back!

You may have lucked out this time,
but once I get reinforcements,\lyou’ll be toast!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]Why you\. I’ll be back! You may have lucked out this time, but once I get reinforcements, you’ll be toast!
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Kenapa kau\. Aku akan kembali!
Kau mungkin beruntung kali ini,\ltapi begitu aku mendapat bala

bantuan, kau akan habis!

entries.original:
"[blue]Heh, there wasn’t a chance in the
world that he could beat me.

Maybe if he had those \qorows and
rows\qo of grunts to back him up.

But solo? Nah!

Speaking of, what do you think
happened to those grunts?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Heh, there wasn’t a chance in the world that he could beat me. Maybe if he had those \qorows and rows\qo of grunts to back him up. But solo? Nah! Speaking of, what do you think happened to those grunts?
entries.translated:
[blue]Heh, tidak ada satu pun kesempatan
di dunia ini dia bisa\lmengalahkanku. Mungkin jika dia

memiliki \qorows dan rows\qo anak buah
untuk mendukungnya. Tapi sendirian?\lNah! Ngomong-ngomong, menurutmu apa

yang terjadi pada anak buah itu?

entries.original: "              Earlier "
entries.translation_source: Earlier
entries.translated: Sebelumnya

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]This is your Admin, Véga,
speaking.

I’ll be monitoring the situation
from the command room.

All grunts, stand firm!

Once The Shadows break through the
door, annihilate them!

Their manpower is severely limited,
and we heavily outnumber them.

They stand no chance!

Envelop them in the Light of Ruin!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]This is your Admin, Véga, speaking. I’ll be monitoring the situation from the command room. All grunts, stand firm! Once The Shadows break through the door, annihilate them! Their manpower is severely limited, and we heavily outnumber them. They stand no chance! Envelop them in the Light of Ruin!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Ini Admin Véga yang
berbicara. Aku akan memantau\lsituasi dari ruang komando. Semua

anak buah, bertahan! Begitu The
Shadows menerobos pintu, musnahkan\lmereka! Personel mereka sangat

terbatas, dan kami jauh lebih
banyak jumlahnya. Mereka tidak\lpunya peluang! Selimuti mereka

dengan Cahaya Kehancuran!

entries.original: "             Currently"
entries.translation_source: Currently
entries.translated: Saat ini

entries.original:
"[blue]Well whatever happened to them,
it’s a good thing it did."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Well whatever happened to them, it’s a good thing it did.
entries.translated:
[blue]Yah, apa pun yang terjadi pada
mereka, itu adalah hal yang baik.

entries.original:
"[blue]I think we should split up [player].

Let’s find the Shadows so they can
tell us what the end game is."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I think we should split up [player]. Let’s find the Shadows so they can tell us what the end game is.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kupikir kita harus berpisah
[player]. Ayo cari The Shadows\lsehingga mereka bisa memberi tahu

kita apa tujuan akhirnya.

entries.original: "[red]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!
entries.translated: [red]Floette! Gunakan Badai Petal!

entries.original: "[blue]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!
entries.translated: [blue]Floette! Gunakan Badai Petal!

entries.original: "[blue]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!
entries.translated: [blue]Floette! Gunakan Badai Petal!

entries.original:
"We’re responsible for maintaining
the power grid.

If it were to go offline, all of
the warp panels would stop working\land everyone would be trapped."
entries.translation_source: We’re responsible for maintaining the power grid. If it were to go offline, all of the warp panels would stop working and everyone would be trapped.
entries.translated:
Kami bertanggung jawab untuk
memelihara jaringan listrik. Jika\litu mati, semua panel warp akan

berhenti bekerja dan semua orang
akan terjebak.

entries.original:
"If one of those creatures detroys
the power grid, we’ll be doomed!

They’ll be no escape for any of us!"
entries.translation_source: If one of those creatures detroys the power grid, we’ll be doomed! They’ll be no escape for any of us!
entries.translated:
Jika salah satu dari makhluk itu
menghancurkan jaringan listrik,\lkita akan binasa! Tidak akan ada

jalan keluar bagi kita semua!

entries.original:
"No!

I’m too young to die!

\.

Oh, wait.
You’re not a Shadow Warrior.

Those things have overrun the base,
killing everyone they see.

If you’re not one of them, I have
no fears about taking you down!"
entries.translation_source: No! I’m too young to die! \. Oh, wait. You’re not a Shadow Warrior. Those things have overrun the base, killing everyone they see. If you’re not one of them, I have no fears about taking you down!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Aku terlalu muda untuk mati!
\. Oh, tunggu. Kau bukan Shadow\lWarrior. Makhluk-makhluk itu telah

membanjiri markas, membunuh semua
yang mereka lihat. Jika kau bukan\lsalah satu dari mereka, aku tidak

takut untuk mengalahkanmu!

entries.original:
"If I can’t beat you, there’s no way
I could beat a Shadow Warrior.

But maybe Véga can\.

I’d get him from the command
centre, but I only know the first\lletter of the password to open the\ldoor.

I’m going to need more than just [green]A
[blue]if I want to open it."
entries.translation_source: If I can’t beat you, there’s no way I could beat a Shadow Warrior. But maybe Véga can\. I’d get him from the command centre, but I only know the first letter of the password to open the door. I’m going to need more than just [green]A [blue]if I want to open it.
entries.translated:
Jika aku tidak bisa mengalahkanmu,
tidak mungkin aku bisa mengalahkan\lShadow Warrior. Tapi mungkin Véga

bisa\. Aku akan memanggilnya dari
pusat komando, tapi aku hanya tahu\lhuruf pertama dari kata sandi untuk

membuka pintu. Aku akan membutuhkan
lebih dari sekadar [green]A [blue]jika aku ingin\lmembukanya.

entries.original:
"The Shadow Warrior is currently in
battle with a Floette.

Would you like to remove its
cloak?"
entries.translation_source: The Shadow Warrior is currently in battle with a Floette. Would you like to remove its cloak?
entries.translated:
Shadow Warrior saat ini sedang
