bertarung dengan Floette. Apakah\lkamu ingin melepas jubahnya?

entries.original:
"[blue]You just destroyed the Shadow
Warrior by removing its cloak!

The only way you could’ve known how
to defeat it so easily, is if you\lwere in league with The Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]You just destroyed the Shadow Warrior by removing its cloak! The only way you could’ve known how to defeat it so easily, is if you were in league with The Shadows!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu baru saja menghancurkan Shadow
Warrior dengan melepas jubahnya!\lSatu-satunya cara kamu bisa tahu

cara mengalahkannya dengan mudah,
adalah jika kamu bersekutu dengan\lThe Shadows!

entries.original:
"[blue]And if you’re in league with the
Shadows, then I must defeat you!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]And if you’re in league with the Shadows, then I must defeat you!
entries.translated:
[blue]Dan jika kamu bersekutu dengan
Shadows, maka aku harus\lmengalahkanmu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Why don’t you do what you came to
do then, huh?

Go fight Véga, but just leave the
rest of us alone!

The second letter of the password
to the command centre is [green]K[blue]!

That’s where he is, so go!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Why don’t you do what you came to do then, huh? Go fight Véga, but just leave the rest of us alone! The second letter of the password to the command centre is [green]K[blue]! That’s where he is, so go!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kenapa kamu tidak melakukan apa
yang kamu datang lakukan, hah?\lPergi lawan Véga, tapi tinggalkan

kami yang lain sendiri! Huruf kedua
dari kata sandi pusat komando\ladalah [green]K[blue]! Itu tempat dia berada,

jadi pergilah!

entries.original:
"[blue]You\.

You’re one of them, aren’t you!

You came to attack our base!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]You\. You’re one of them, aren’t you! You came to attack our base!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu\. Kamu salah satu dari mereka,
kan! Kamu datang untuk menyerang\lbasis kami!

entries.original: "[blue]I won’t let you destroy it!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I won’t let you destroy it!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu
menghancurkannya!

entries.original:
"[blue]I’ll tell you one of the letters
to the password for the command\lcentre!

The third letter is [green]L[blue]!

Just please stop attacking the
base!

If not, at least leave the power
grid alone!

If it goes down, we’ll be trapped
in here!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I’ll tell you one of the letters to the password for the command centre! The third letter is [green]L[blue]! Just please stop attacking the base! If not, at least leave the power grid alone! If it goes down, we’ll be trapped in here!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku akan memberitahumu salah satu
huruf kata sandi pusat komando!\lHuruf ketiga adalah [green]L[blue]! Tolong

hentikan serangan ke basis! Jika
tidak, setidaknya tinggalkan\ljaringan listrik! Jika mati, kita

akan terjebak di sini!

entries.original:
"Whoever you are, you shouldn’t be
here.

Don’t you know?

Those creatures roaming around burn
up anything they see."
entries.translation_source: Whoever you are, you shouldn’t be here. Don’t you know? Those creatures roaming around burn up anything they see.
entries.translated:
Siapa pun kamu, kamu tidak
seharusnya di sini. Tidakkah kamu\ltahu? Makhluk-makhluk yang

berkeliaran itu membakar apa pun
yang mereka lihat.

entries.original:
"If you’re looking for Véga, he’s
in the [green]Command Centre[blue].

You can get there by taking the
warp panel in the [green]Research Room[blue]."
entries.translation_source: If you’re looking for Véga, he’s in the [green]Command Centre[blue]. You can get there by taking the warp panel in the [green]Research Room[blue].
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mencari Véga, dia di
[green]Pusat Komando[blue]. Kamu bisa ke sana\ldengan mengambil panel warp di

[green]Ruang Penelitian[blue].

entries.original:
"[red]Oh!

You just beat that Shadow Warrior!
You saved me!

How did you know how to do that?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Oh! You just beat that Shadow Warrior! You saved me! How did you know how to do that?
entries.translated:
[red]Oh! Kamu baru saja mengalahkan
Shadow Warrior itu! Kamu\lmenyelamatkanku! Bagaimana kamu

tahu cara melakukannya?

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, you must be with The Shadows.

But it’s alright, I won’t attack
you.

You can’t be all bad if you got
rid of one of your own.

Besides, I’m very grateful for your
help."
entries.translation_source: [red]Oh, you must be with The Shadows. But it’s alright, I won’t attack you. You can’t be all bad if you got rid of one of your own. Besides, I’m very grateful for your help.
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, kamu pasti bersama The Shadows.
Tapi tidak apa-apa, aku tidak akan\lmenyerangmu. Kamu tidak bisa

sepenuhnya jahat jika kamu
menyingkirkan salah satu dari\lkeluargamu. Lagipula, aku sangat

berterima kasih atas bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"If you need anything from me,
please feel free to ask."
entries.translation_source: If you need anything from me, please feel free to ask.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu butuh sesuatu dariku,
silakan tanya.

entries.original: "Heal Pokémon"
entries.translation_source: Heal Pokémon
entries.translated: Menyembuhkan Pokémon

entries.original: "Password"
entries.translation_source: Password
entries.translated: Kata Sandi

entries.original: "Information"
entries.translation_source: Information
entries.translated: Informasi

entries.original: "Nope"
entries.translation_source: Nope
entries.translated: Tidak

entries.original:
"Sure, I can heal your Pokémon.

Please lie down on one of these
beds, first."
entries.translation_source: Sure, I can heal your Pokémon. Please lie down on one of these beds, first.
entries.translated:
Tentu, aku bisa menyembuhkan
Pokémon-mu. Silakan berbaring di\lsalah satu tempat tidur ini, dulu.

entries.original:
"All set!

You and your Pokémon are
all rested up."
entries.translation_source: All set! You and your Pokémon are all rested up.
entries.translated:
Selesai! Kamu dan Pokémon-mu sudah
beristirahat penuh.

entries.original:
"Oh, you want to know what the
password for the [green]Command Centre [red]is?

Sorry, but I only know the fourth
letter.

It’s [green]O[red].

I hope that helps!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you want to know what the password for the [green]Command Centre [red]is? Sorry, but I only know the fourth letter. It’s [green]O[red]. I hope that helps!
entries.translated:
Oh, kamu ingin tahu apa kata sandi
untuk [green]Pusat Komando [red]adalah? Maaf,\ltapi aku hanya tahu huruf keempat.

Itu [green]O[red]. Semoga membantu!

entries.original:
"The base is split into eight
different sections.

The main areas are the Power Grid,
Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room,\land Research Room.

Other, smaller areas include the
storage areas, the living spaces,\land the Command Centre.

The living spaces and the Command
Centre can only be accessed through\lthe Research Room.

But with the Research Room now
underwater, the living spaces as\lwell as some storage areas have\lbeen completely cut off.

However, for some reason, the
Command Centre is still accessible."
entries.translation_source: The base is split into eight different sections. The main areas are the Power Grid, Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room, and Research Room. Other, smaller areas include the storage areas, the living spaces, and the Command Centre. The living spaces and the Command Centre can only be accessed through the Research Room. But with the Research Room now underwater, the living spaces as well as some storage areas have been completely cut off. However, for some reason, the Command Centre is still accessible.
entries.translated:
Basis ini terbagi menjadi delapan
bagian berbeda. Area utamanya\ladalah Jaringan Listrik, Ruang

Istirahat, Kantin, Kamar Istirahat,
dan Ruang Penelitian. Area lain\lyang lebih kecil termasuk area

penyimpanan, ruang tinggal, dan
Pusat Komando. Ruang tinggal dan\lPusat Komando hanya bisa diakses

melalui Ruang Penelitian. Tapi
dengan Ruang Penelitian sekarang di\lbawah air, ruang tinggal serta

beberapa area penyimpanan telah
terputus total. Namun, untuk\lbeberapa alasan, Pusat Komando

masih dapat diakses.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]No, get away from me!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]No, get away from me!
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Tidak, menjauhlah dariku!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]You! This is your fault!

If you and your friend hadn’t wiped
out my Granbull, I’d be able to\ldefend myself!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [blue]You! This is your fault! If you and your friend hadn’t wiped out my Granbull, I’d be able to defend myself!
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Kamu! Ini salahmu! Jika kamu
dan temanmu tidak menghabisi\lGranbull-ku, aku akan bisa membela

diriku sendiri!

entries.original:
"Shadow Warrior: [blue]You\.\.\.\.

Die\.\.\."
entries.translation_source: Shadow Warrior: [blue]You\.\.\.\. Die\.\.\.
entries.translated: Shadow Warrior: [blue]Kamu\.\.\.\. Mati\.\.\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Serves you right.

But I owe you and your friend one.

If he hadn’t knocked me out
earlier, I could’ve been burnt up\lwith those other grunts before\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Serves you right. But I owe you and your friend one. If he hadn’t knocked me out earlier, I could’ve been burnt up with those other grunts before\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Pantas kau dapat. Tapi aku
berhutang budi padamu dan temanmu.\lJika dia tidak melumpuhkanku lebih

awal, aku bisa saja terbakar
bersama anggota lain sebelumnya\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t know much, but I can tell
you that the fifth letter to the\lCommand Centre password is [green]V[blue].

Now we’re even."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I don’t know much, but I can tell you that the fifth letter to the Command Centre password is [green]V[blue]. Now we’re even.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku tidak tahu banyak, tapi aku
bisa memberitahumu bahwa huruf\lkelima untuk kata sandi Pusat

Komando adalah [green]V[blue]. Sekarang kita
setara.

entries.original:
"Shadow Grunt: [blue]How could you betray
The Shadows, Billy?

They made you the man you are!

[black]LOR Grunt: [blue]I made myself into the
man I am, Ronald.

I chose my own path!"
entries.translation_source: Shadow Grunt: [blue]How could you betray The Shadows, Billy? They made you the man you are! [black]LOR Grunt: [blue]I made myself into the man I am, Ronald. I chose my own path!
entries.translated:
Anggota Bayangan: [blue]Bagaimana kau
bisa mengkhianati The Shadows,\lBilly? Mereka menjadikanmu pria

seperti sekarang! [black]Anggota LOR: [blue]Aku
menjadikan diriku sendiri pria\lseperti diriku, Ronald. Aku memilih

jalanku sendiri!

entries.original:
"LOR Grunt: [blue]I lost many friends when
your ship broke through the wall!

[black]Shadow Grunt: [red]They deserved to die
for abandoning The Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: LOR Grunt: [blue]I lost many friends when your ship broke through the wall! [black]Shadow Grunt: [red]They deserved to die for abandoning The Shadows!
entries.translated:
Anggota LOR: [blue]Aku kehilangan banyak
teman saat kapalmu menembus\ldinding! [black]Anggota Bayangan: [red]Mereka

pantas mati karena meninggalkan The
Shadows!

entries.original:
"The Shadow Warrior is standing,
motionless."
entries.translation_source: The Shadow Warrior is standing, motionless.
entries.translated:
Shadow Warrior berdiri, tak
bergerak.

entries.original:
"[player], glad you could make it.

I hope you haven’t been having any
problems with the Shadow Warriors.

They were ordered to kill anyone
who isn’t a member of The Shadows,\lbut I forgot to make a specific\lmention for you.

Well, I’m sure you managed to avoid
them considering you’re here now.

Just please try and stay out of
their way.

Those six elite Shadow Warriors are
the last ones we have left."
entries.translation_source: [player], glad you could make it. I hope you haven’t been having any problems with the Shadow Warriors. They were ordered to kill anyone who isn’t a member of The Shadows, but I forgot to make a specific mention for you. Well, I’m sure you managed to avoid them considering you’re here now. Just please try and stay out of their way. Those six elite Shadow Warriors are the last ones we have left.
entries.translated:
[player], senang kau bisa datang.
Kuharap kau tidak mengalami masalah\ldengan Shadow Warriors. Mereka

diperintahkan untuk membunuh siapa
pun yang bukan anggota The Shadows,\ltapi aku lupa menyebutkan secara

spesifik untukmu. Yah, aku yakin
kau berhasil menghindari mereka\lmengingat kau ada di sini sekarang.

Tolong cobalah untuk tidak
menghalangi mereka. Enam Shadow\lWarrior elit itu adalah yang

terakhir tersisa.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Get that door open,
scientist!

There’s a traiter on the other side
that needs to burn\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Get that door open, scientist! There’s a traiter on the other side that needs to burn\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Buka pintu itu, ilmuwan! Ada
pengkhianat di sisi lain yang harus\lterbakar\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
We could use your assistance.

Try to help that scientist figure
out the password for the door.

If you interrogate everyone you
see, someone will spill it."
entries.translation_source: [player]! We could use your assistance. Try to help that scientist figure out the password for the door. If you interrogate everyone you see, someone will spill it.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kami butuh bantuanmu.
Cobalah bantu ilmuwan itu mencari\ltahu kata sandi pintu. Jika kau

menginterogasi semua yang kau
lihat, seseorang akan\lmemberitahukannya.

entries.original:
"What?
You want to help?

I need [green]6 [blue]letters to open this door.

I already have 1, I just need [green]5
[blue]more.

Do you know the other letters?"
entries.translation_source: What? You want to help? I need [green]6 [blue]letters to open this door. I already have 1, I just need [green]5 [blue]more. Do you know the other letters?
entries.translated:
Apa? Kau ingin membantu? Aku butuh
[green]6 [blue]huruf untuk membuka pintu ini.\lAku sudah punya 1, aku hanya butuh

[green]5 [blue]lagi. Apakah kau tahu huruf
lainnya?

entries.original: "You only know [green][buffer1] [blue]letters."
entries.translation_source: You only know [green][buffer1] [blue]letters.
entries.translated: Kau hanya tahu [green][buffer1] [blue]huruf.

entries.original:
"You don’t know any of the other
letters\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t know any of the other letters\.
entries.translated:
Kau tidak tahu huruf lainnya sama
sekali\.

entries.original:
"Come talk to me when you’ve
learned all [green]5[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Come talk to me when you’ve learned all [green]5[blue].
entries.translated:
Datang bicara padaku saat kau sudah
mempelajari semua [green]5[blue].

entries.original: "Please enter the other [green]5 [blue]letters."
entries.translation_source: Please enter the other [green]5 [blue]letters.
entries.translated: Silakan masukkan [green]5 [blue]huruf lainnya.

entries.original: "That’s not the correct password\."
entries.translation_source: That’s not the correct password\.
entries.translated: Itu bukan kata sandi yang benar\.

entries.original: "And the last letter is E\."
entries.translation_source: And the last letter is E\.
entries.translated: Dan huruf terakhir adalah E\.

entries.original:
"Scientist: [blue]The door is open for you,
Zeph."
entries.translation_source: Scientist: [blue]The door is open for you, Zeph.
entries.translated:
Ilmuwan: [blue]Pintu sudah terbuka
untukmu, Zeph.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Good work, scientist.

I should’ve known that arrogant
fool would make the password his\lown name\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Good work, scientist. I should’ve known that arrogant fool would make the password his own name\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Kerja bagus, ilmuwan.
Seharusnya aku tahu bahwa si\lsombong bodoh itu akan membuat kata

sandi dengan namanya sendiri\.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]I’m back.

And I was able to figure out the
rest of the password."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]I’m back. And I was able to figure out the rest of the password.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Aku kembali. Dan aku
berhasil menemukan sisa kata\lsandinya.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!

Looks like you finally found
The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: [blue][player]! Looks like you finally found The Shadows.
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Sepertinya kau akhirnya
menemukan The Shadows.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]And he brought the password
too, [rival]."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]And he brought the password too, [rival].
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Dan dia juga membawa kata
sandinya, [rival].

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]And she brought the password
too, [rival]."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]And she brought the password too, [rival].
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Dan dia juga membawa kata
sandinya, [rival].

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]I cant believe it,
[player].

You actually got somewhere before I
did\.

I’m amazed\."
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]I cant believe it, [player]. You actually got somewhere before I did\. I’m amazed\.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Aku tidak percaya,
[player]. Kamu benar-benar sampai\ldi suatu tempat sebelum aku\. Aku

kagum\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Now isn’t the time to act
awestruck, [rival].

We have more pressing matters to
attend to."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]Now isn’t the time to act awestruck, [rival]. We have more pressing matters to attend to.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Sekarang bukan saatnya
untuk bersikap kagum, [rival]. Ada\lurusan yang lebih mendesak yang

harus kita tangani.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]What do you think gives you
the right to talk down to me?

I don’t even know you!

Stop treating me like I’m some kid!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]What do you think gives you the right to talk down to me? I don’t even know you! Stop treating me like I’m some kid!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Apa yang membuatmu
berpikir kamu berhak merendahkanku?\lAku bahkan tidak mengenalmu!

Berhenti memperlakukanku seperti
anak kecil!

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]I\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]I\.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Aku\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Enough!

If we don’t act now, Véga will
make his escape.

Once we finish the Light or Ruin
and reclaim what they stole from\lus, you can have your little chat."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Enough! If we don’t act now, Véga will make his escape. Once we finish the Light or Ruin and reclaim what they stole from us, you can have your little chat.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Cukup! Jika kita tidak
bertindak sekarang, Véga akan\lmelarikan diri. Setelah kita

menyelesaikan Light atau Ruin dan
mengambil kembali apa yang mereka\lcuri dari kita, kamu bisa mengobrol

kecilmu.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Give it up Véga!

It’s over!

Without Aklove to back you up,
you’re nothing!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]Give it up Véga! It’s over! Without Aklove to back you up, you’re nothing!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Menyerahlah, Véga! Ini sudah
berakhir! Tanpa dukungan Aklove,\lkamu bukan siapa-siapa!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Those are fighting words,
Zeph!

Are you sure you want to go down
that path?"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Those are fighting words, Zeph! Are you sure you want to go down that path?
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Itu kata-kata perang, Zeph!
Apa kamu yakin ingin menempuh jalan\litu?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Bring it on, Zeph.

I’m stronger now than I ever was
before.

I don’t need Aklove’s help to take
you down."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Bring it on, Zeph. I’m stronger now than I ever was before. I don’t need Aklove’s help to take you down.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Ayo, Zeph. Aku sekarang lebih
kuat dari sebelumnya. Aku tidak\lperlu bantuan Aklove untuk

mengalahkanmu.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I figured you’d say that.

\.

Go! Shadow Warrior!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]I figured you’d say that. \. Go! Shadow Warrior!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Aku sudah menduga kamu akan
mengatakan itu. \. Ayo! Shadow\lWarrior!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]What now, Zeph?

You going to have me incinerated
like the grunts?"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]What now, Zeph? You going to have me incinerated like the grunts?
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Sekarang bagaimana, Zeph?
Kamu akan membakarku seperti para\lprajurit?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]No\.

It’s too soon for you to die.

Once I recover the Shadow Warriors
you stole from me, I’m going to\lmake you watch me raze your base\land your grunts to the ground.

Only then, after watching
everything you care about burn\laway, I’ll incinerate you as well."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]No\. It’s too soon for you to die. Once I recover the Shadow Warriors you stole from me, I’m going to make you watch me raze your base and your grunts to the ground. Only then, after watching everything you care about burn away, I’ll incinerate you as well.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Tidak\. Masih terlalu cepat
bagimu untuk mati. Setelah aku\lmendapatkan kembali Shadow Warriors

yang kau curi dariku, aku akan
membuatmu menonton aku meratakan\lmarkasmu dan prajuritmu ke tanah.

Hanya setelah itu, setelah melihat
semua yang kau sayangi terbakar,\laku akan membakarmu juga.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Heh.

Ha ha ha ha ha ha!

You think I actually care about
these grunts?

I never bought into the Light of
Ruin’s philosophy!

I only defected so I could take my
revenge on you for turning my wife\linto a Shadow Warrior\.

\.

I hate you, Zeph.

And nothing gives me more pleasure
than watching you suffer\."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]Heh. Ha ha ha ha ha ha! You think I actually care about these grunts? I never bought into the Light of Ruin’s philosophy! I only defected so I could take my revenge on you for turning my wife into a Shadow Warrior\. \. I hate you, Zeph. And nothing gives me more pleasure than watching you suffer\.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Heh. Ha ha ha ha ha ha! Kamu
pikir aku benar-benar peduli pada\lprajurit ini? Aku tidak pernah

mempercayai filosofi Light of Ruin!
Aku membelot hanya untuk membalas\ldendam padamu karena mengubah

istriku menjadi Shadow Warrior\. \. Aku
membencimu, Zeph. Dan tidak ada\lyang lebih menyenangkan bagiku

selain melihatmu menderita\.

entries.original: "Véga: [blue]It’s about time\."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]It’s about time\.
entries.translated: Véga: [blue]Sudah saatnya\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]No!
My Shadow Warrior!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]No! My Shadow Warrior!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Tidak! Shadow Warrior-ku!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]First, you interrupt my
trip to Hoenn.

And now, you interrupt my search in
Kalos for the ultimate weapon\.

This better be worth it, Véga\."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]First, you interrupt my trip to Hoenn. And now, you interrupt my search in Kalos for the ultimate weapon\. This better be worth it, Véga\.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Pertama, kamu mengganggu
perjalananku ke Hoenn. Dan\lsekarang, kamu mengganggu

pencarianku di Kalos untuk senjata
pamungkas\. Ini seharusnya berharga,\lVéga\.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]I have some bad news,
Aklove.

The Shadows crashed their boat
into the cliff, shattering the wall\land flooding the Research Room."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]I have some bad news, Aklove. The Shadows crashed their boat into the cliff, shattering the wall and flooding the Research Room.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Aku punya kabar buruk,
Aklove. Para Shadows menabrakkan\lperahu mereka ke tebing,

menghancurkan dinding dan
membanjiri Ruang Penelitian.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]WHAT!?

My data on the ultimate weapon has
been detroyed!?"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]WHAT!? My data on the ultimate weapon has been detroyed!?
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]APA!? Data-ku tentang
senjata pamungkas telah hancur!?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]I made a partial backup
before the attack, but over half of\lthe data is now corrupt."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [blue]I made a partial backup before the attack, but over half of the data is now corrupt.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Aku membuat cadangan parsial
sebelum serangan, tetapi lebih dari\lsetengah data kini rusak.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]You’d better hope we still
have enough to locate the weapon\.

Or so help me\."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]You’d better hope we still have enough to locate the weapon\. Or so help me\.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Sebaiknya kau berharap kita
masih punya cukup untuk menemukan\lsenjatanya\. Atau aku akan marah\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]You’re really grasping at
straws, huh, Zeph?

Was this your last ditch attempt
to take back everything I took\lfrom you?

Pathetic."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]You’re really grasping at straws, huh, Zeph? Was this your last ditch attempt to take back everything I took from you? Pathetic.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Kau benar-benar berpegang
pada jerami, ya, Zeph? Apakah ini\lupaya terakhirmu untuk mengambil

kembali semua yang kuambil darimu?
Mengerikan.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]No\.

That was just an attempt to stop
whatever you were planning.

You took my Shadow Warriors from
me, so it was time for you to pay\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [blue]No\. That was just an attempt to stop whatever you were planning. You took my Shadow Warriors from me, so it was time for you to pay\.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Tidak\. Itu hanya upaya untuk
menghentikan apa pun yang kau\lrencanakan. Kau mengambil Shadow

Warriors dariku, jadi sudah saatnya
kau membayar\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Why don’t you go burn in
Cinder Volcano.

It’s your just reward for all the
lives you’ve reduced to ash."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Why don’t you go burn in Cinder Volcano. It’s your just reward for all the lives you’ve reduced to ash.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Kenapa kau tidak pergi
terbakar di Cinder Volcano. Itulah\lhadiah yang pantas untuk semua

nyawa yang telah kau jadikan abu.

entries.original: "[rival]: [blue]You just\.\.killed him!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]You just\.\.killed him!
entries.translated: [rival]: [blue]Kau baru saja\.\.membunuhnya!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]He had it coming to him.

The blood of all the people he’s
killed has been avenged."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]He had it coming to him. The blood of all the people he’s killed has been avenged.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Dia pantas mendapatkannya.
Darah semua orang yang dibunuhnya\ltelah dibalaskan.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]No\.

Zeph may have done many
questionable things, but his heart\lwas in the right place.

You, on the other hand, plan on
ending more lives than Zeph ever\ldid.

You are the true villain here."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [blue]No\. Zeph may have done many questionable things, but his heart was in the right place. You, on the other hand, plan on ending more lives than Zeph ever did. You are the true villain here.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Tidak\. Zeph mungkin telah
melakukan banyak hal yang\lmeragukan, tetapi hatinya berada di

tempat yang benar. Kamu,
sebaliknya, berencana untuk\lmengakhiri lebih banyak nyawa

daripada yang pernah dilakukan
Zeph. Kaulah penjahat sejati di\lsini.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Is that you, Marlon?

I didn’t recognize you without your
getup.

Véga told me you and [player] were
back from the dead, so this time, I\lhave a much better way of getting\lrid of you both."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Is that you, Marlon? I didn’t recognize you without your getup. Véga told me you and [player] were back from the dead, so this time, I have a much better way of getting rid of you both.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Apakah itu kau, Marlon? Aku
tidak mengenalimu tanpa pakaianmu.\lVéga memberitahuku bahwa kau dan

[player] telah kembali dari
kematian, jadi kali ini, aku punya\lcara yang jauh lebih baik untuk

menyingkirkan kalian berdua.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]No!
I needed answers from him!

Where did you send him?

Tell me!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]No! I needed answers from him! Where did you send him? Tell me!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Tidak! Aku butuh jawaban
darinya! Ke mana kau mengirimnya?\lKatakan padaku!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Oh I just sent him to a
remote island in the middle of the\locean somewhere.

Even if he can’t die, that’ll still
buy me enough time to carry out my\lplan until he finds his way back.

If he finds his way back\."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Oh I just sent him to a remote island in the middle of the ocean somewhere. Even if he can’t die, that’ll still buy me enough time to carry out my plan until he finds his way back. If he finds his way back\.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Oh, aku baru saja
mengirimnya ke pulau terpencil di\ltengah lautan entah di mana. Bahkan

jika dia tidak bisa mati, itu masih
akan memberiku cukup waktu untuk\lmelaksanakan rencanaku sampai dia

menemukan jalan kembali. Jika dia
menemukan jalan kembali\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t know who you are red kid,
but I’ll give you a chance to walk\laway right now.

You haven’t irked me much yet, so I
see no reason to end your life.

It needs to go on so you can
witness my grand finale."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I don’t know who you are red kid, but I’ll give you a chance to walk away right now. You haven’t irked me much yet, so I see no reason to end your life. It needs to go on so you can witness my grand finale.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku tidak tahu siapa dirimu, red
kid, tapi aku akan memberimu\lkesempatan untuk pergi sekarang

juga. Kau belum terlalu
menggangguku, jadi aku tidak\lmelihat alasan untuk mengakhiri

hidupmu. Itu harus berlanjut
sehingga kau bisa menyaksikan grand\lfinale-ku.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]No way!

I came here to take down the
Light of Ruin, so that’s what\lI’m going to do!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]No way! I came here to take down the Light of Ruin, so that’s what I’m going to do!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Tidak mungkin! Aku datang
ke sini untuk menghancurkan Light\lof Ruin, jadi itulah yang akan

kulakukan!

entries.original: "Aklove: [blue]Send him home, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [blue]Send him home, Hoopa.
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Kirim dia pulang, Hoopa.

entries.original: "Stay and Fight"
entries.translation_source: Stay and Fight
entries.translated: Tetap Bertarung

entries.original: "Run Away"
entries.translation_source: Run Away
entries.translated: Lari

entries.original:
"[blue]You’ve got guts, [player].

If it’s a fight you want, it’s a
fight you’ll get!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]You’ve got guts, [player]. If it’s a fight you want, it’s a fight you’ll get!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kau punya nyali, [player]. Jika
pertarungan yang kau inginkan,\lpertarungan yang akan kau dapatkan!

entries.original:
"[blue]There’s no escape for you [player]!

I’m going to get rid of you today,
one way or another!

You just need you to bear witness
to the power I posses, first!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]There’s no escape for you [player]! I’m going to get rid of you today, one way or another! You just need you to bear witness to the power I posses, first!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tidak ada jalan keluar bagimu,
[player]! Aku akan menyingkirkamu\lhari ini, dengan satu atau lain

cara! Kau hanya perlu menyaksikan
kekuatan yang kumiliki, pertama!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Let’s show [player] what he’s really
up against!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hoopa! Let’s show [player] what he’s really up against!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa! Mari tunjukkan pada [player]
apa yang sebenarnya dia hadapi!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Let’s show [player] what she’s really
up against!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hoopa! Let’s show [player] what she’s really up against!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa! Mari tunjukkan pada [player]
apa yang sebenarnya dia hadapi!

entries.original:
"[blue]What was the point of all the
training we did in Hoenn if you\lcan’t even beat a single trainer!?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]What was the point of all the training we did in Hoenn if you can’t even beat a single trainer!?
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa gunanya semua latihan yang kita
lakukan di Hoenn jika kau bahkan\ltidak bisa mengalahkan satu Pelatih

pun!?

entries.original:
"[blue]I can’t allow your stench to linger
any longer!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I can’t allow your stench to linger any longer!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku tidak bisa membiarkan baumu
bertahan lebih lama lagi!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now you see.

You never stood a chance against
me.

But you’re still too much of a
threat to keep around

I can’t allow your presence to
exist in this world any longer!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now you see. You never stood a chance against me. But you’re still too much of a threat to keep around I can’t allow your presence to exist in this world any longer!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang kau lihat. Kau tidak
pernah punya kesempatan melawanku.\lTapi kau masih terlalu menjadi

ancaman untuk dibiarkan
berkeliaran, aku tidak bisa\lmengizinkan keberadaanmu di dunia

ini lebih lama lagi!

entries.original:
"[blue]I’m going to send you to the one
place you’ll never return from!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I’m going to send you to the one place you’ll never return from!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku akan mengirimmu ke satu tempat
yang tidak akan pernah bisa kau\lkembali!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Send [player] to join his friend!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hoopa! Send [player] to join his friend!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa! Kirim [player] untuk
bergabung dengan temannya!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Send [player] to join her friend!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hoopa! Send [player] to join her friend!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa! Kirim [player] untuk
bergabung dengan temannya!

entries.original:
"[blue]This place\.

Can you feel it?
There are no Pokémon here at all.

Time isn’t flowing.
And space isn’t stable.

A world where the rules are broken.

My grandfather told me about a
world like this, once.

He said it’s some sort of distorted
world\.

Ruled over by a single Pokémon\.

Giratina\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]This place\. Can you feel it? There are no Pokémon here at all. Time isn’t flowing. And space isn’t stable. A world where the rules are broken. My grandfather told me about a world like this, once. He said it’s some sort of distorted world\. Ruled over by a single Pokémon\. Giratina\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Tempat ini\. Dapatkah kau
merasakannya? Tidak ada Pokémon\lsama sekali di sini. Waktu tidak

mengalir. Dan ruang tidak stabil.
Sebuah dunia yang aturannya rusak.\lKakekku pernah bercerita tentang

dunia seperti ini, suatu saat. Dia
bilang itu semacam dunia yang\lterdistorsi\. Diperintah oleh satu

Pokémon\. Giratina\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Let’s find Giratina.

Maybe it can show us the way out."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Let’s find Giratina. Maybe it can show us the way out.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ayo temukan Giratina. Mungkin dia
bisa menunjukkan jalan keluar.

entries.original:
"[blue]Will we get to see Giratina if we
keep going down?

\.In the Distortion World, are we
really travelling downward?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Will we get to see Giratina if we keep going down? \.In the Distortion World, are we really travelling downward?
entries.translated:
[blue]Akankah kita bisa melihat Giratina
jika kita terus turun? \.Di Dunia\lDistorsi, apakah kita benar-benar

bepergian ke bawah?

entries.original:
"[blue]This rock slab\.

It appears to move if you step in a
certain spot\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]This rock slab\. It appears to move if you step in a certain spot\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Lempengan batu ini\. Tampaknya
bergerak jika kau menginjak titik\ltertentu\.

entries.original:
"The legend of Giratina has been all
but forgetten but to a few\.

The legend told of a world on the
other side of ours. This world.

Why does this world exist?
Why is Giratina here all alone?

There’s so much that can’t be
explained\."
entries.translation_source: The legend of Giratina has been all but forgetten but to a few\. The legend told of a world on the other side of ours. This world. Why does this world exist? Why is Giratina here all alone? There’s so much that can’t be explained\.
entries.translated:
Legenda Giratina hampir dilupakan
kecuali oleh segelintir orang\.\lLegenda itu bercerita tentang dunia

di sisi lain dari dunia kita. Dunia
ini. Mengapa dunia ini ada? Mengapa\lGiratina di sini sendirian? Ada

begitu banyak yang tidak bisa
dijelaskan\.

entries.original:
"Let’s split up.
We have to find the right way."
entries.translation_source: Let’s split up. We have to find the right way.
entries.translated:
Ayo berpisah. Kita harus menemukan
jalan yang benar.

entries.original:
"[blue]Call it a Trainer’s intuition,
but we’re getting close.

Let’s keep going!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Call it a Trainer’s intuition, but we’re getting close. Let’s keep going!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sebut saja intuisi Pelatih, tapi
kita semakin dekat. Ayo terus\lberjalan!

entries.original:
"[blue]This is it\.
Giratina is up ahead."
entries.translation_source: [blue]This is it\. Giratina is up ahead.
entries.translated: [blue]Ini dia\. Giratina ada di depan.

entries.original:
"[blue]Looks like you found the right
path, [player].

It’s a good thing I caught up to
you.

Let’s keep going, together."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Looks like you found the right path, [player]. It’s a good thing I caught up to you. Let’s keep going, together.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya kau menemukan jalan yang
benar, [player]. Untunglah aku\lmenyusulmu. Ayo terus berjalan,

bersama.

entries.original:
"Let’s go meet Giratina.

\.Whoops, let me heal your
Pokémon first."
entries.translation_source: Let’s go meet Giratina. \.Whoops, let me heal your Pokémon first.
entries.translated:
Ayo pergi menemui Giratina. \.Wah,
biarkan aku menyembuhkan Pokémonmu\ldulu.

entries.original: "Now let’s go meet Giratina!"
entries.translation_source: Now let’s go meet Giratina!
entries.translated:
Sekarang ayo pergi menemui
Giratina!

entries.original:
"There’s nothing to fear from
Giratina.

It may be the ruler of this world,
but I’m sure you can defeat it and\lshow the tight bond you share with\lyour Pokémon!

If you succeed, Giratina will
understand us.

It’ll show us the way out!"
entries.translation_source: There’s nothing to fear from Giratina. It may be the ruler of this world, but I’m sure you can defeat it and show the tight bond you share with your Pokémon! If you succeed, Giratina will understand us. It’ll show us the way out!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang perlu ditakutkan
dari Giratina. Mungkin dia adalah\lpenguasa dunia ini, tapi aku yakin

kau bisa mengalahkannya dan
menunjukkan ikatan erat yang kau\lmiliki dengan Pokémon-mu! Jika

berhasil, Giratina akan mengerti
kita. Dia akan menunjukkan jalan\lkeluar!

entries.original:
"There is a portal where Giratina
was.

Will you leap into the portal?"
entries.translation_source: There is a portal where Giratina was. Will you leap into the portal?
entries.translated:
Ada portal di tempat Giratina
berada. Apakah kau akan melompat ke\lportal itu?

entries.original: "[player] leapt into the portal."
entries.translation_source: [player] leapt into the portal.
entries.translated: [player] melompat ke portal.

entries.original: "[green]Giygogagohgwooh!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Giygogagohgwooh!
entries.translated: [green]Giygogagohgwooh!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Giratina seems to have
understood us!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Giratina seems to have understood us!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Giratina sepertinya sudah
mengerti kita!

entries.original:
"[blue]Let’s go back home.

The portal where Giratina was
should lead back to our world.

Giratina was written in legend as
being on the other side of our\lworld.

It stands to reason that it has a
link to the other side."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Let’s go back home. The portal where Giratina was should lead back to our world. Giratina was written in legend as being on the other side of our world. It stands to reason that it has a link to the other side.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ayo pulang ke rumah. Portal tempat
Giratina berada seharusnya mengarah\lkembali ke dunia kita. Giratina

ditulis dalam legenda sebagai
berada di sisi lain dunia kita.\lMasuk akal bahwa ia memiliki

hubungan dengan sisi lain.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]\.This place?!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]\.This place?!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]\.Tempat ini?!

entries.original:
"[blue]It’s Rift Cave\.

It’s said to somehow have a
connection to the great beyond\.

And Giratina was said to live in an
opposite world from ours\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]It’s Rift Cave\. It’s said to somehow have a connection to the great beyond\. And Giratina was said to live in an opposite world from ours\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ini adalah Rift Cave\. Dikatakan
entah bagaimana memiliki hubungan\ldengan alam baka\. Dan Giratina

dikatakan tinggal di dunia yang
berlawanan dengan dunia kita\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I guess that must mean we’ve
arrived back in our world.

I can’t thank you enough for
helping me escape that place.

But now we need to focus.

It’s time to find The Shadows and
end their evil plan!

\.

What?
The Shadows are already finished?

But there’s a new threat hiding in
Vivill Town?

There’s no time to waste then!
Off to Vivill Town!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I guess that must mean we’ve arrived back in our world. I can’t thank you enough for helping me escape that place. But now we need to focus. It’s time to find The Shadows and end their evil plan! \. What? The Shadows are already finished? But there’s a new threat hiding in Vivill Town? There’s no time to waste then! Off to Vivill Town!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kurasa itu berarti kita sudah
kembali ke dunia kita. Aku tidak\lbisa cukup berterima kasih karena

telah membantu saya melarikan diri
dari tempat itu. Tapi sekarang kita\lperlu fokus. Saatnya menemukan The

Shadows dan mengakhiri rencana
jahat mereka! \. Apa? The Shadows\lsudah selesai? Tapi ada ancaman

baru yang bersembunyi di Vivill
Town? Kalau begitu tidak ada waktu\luntuk disia-siakan! Ayo ke Vivill

Town!

entries.original: "Something unseeable is in the way."
entries.translation_source: Something unseeable is in the way.
entries.translated:
Sesuatu yang tidak terlihat
menghalangi jalan.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Move, kid!

You’re blocking the road!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Move, kid! You’re blocking the road!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Minggir, nak! Kamu menghalangi
jalan!

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh?

There’s somethin’ in the way?

It better not be that Pokémon
again\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Huh? There’s somethin’ in the way? It better not be that Pokémon again\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Hah? Ada sesuatu yang menghalangi
jalan? Lebih baik itu bukan Pokémon\litu lagi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Take this.

It should get rid of whatever’s
blocking the road."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Take this. It should get rid of whatever’s blocking the road.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ambil ini. Ini seharusnya
menyingkirkan apa pun yang\lmenghalangi jalan.

entries.original: "[blue]Try talking to the obstacle now."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Try talking to the obstacle now.
entries.translated:
[blue]Coba bicara dengan penghalangnya
sekarang.

entries.original:
"Something unseeable is in the way.

Want to use the Devon Scope?"
entries.translation_source: Something unseeable is in the way. Want to use the Devon Scope?
entries.translated:
Sesuatu yang tidak terlihat
menghalangi jalan. Ingin\lmenggunakan Lensa Devon?

entries.original:
"[player] used the Devon Scope.

An invisible Pokémon became
completely visible!"
entries.translation_source: [player] used the Devon Scope. An invisible Pokémon became completely visible!
entries.translated:
[player] menggunakan Lensa Devon.
Seekor Pokémon tak terlihat menjadi\lterlihat sepenuhnya!

entries.original: "The startled Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: The startled Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang terkejut itu
menyerang!

entries.original: "The [buffer1] ran way."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] ran way.
entries.translated: Si [buffer1] melarikan diri.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Hmph.

I like the way you battle, kid.
You’ve got potential.

You should take on the Antisis Gym
with your Pokémon.

I hear the Gym Leader there has
been pretty bored lately."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Hmph. I like the way you battle, kid. You’ve got potential. You should take on the Antisis Gym with your Pokémon. I hear the Gym Leader there has been pretty bored lately.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Hmph. Aku suka caramu
bertarung, nak. Kamu punya potensi.\lKamu harus menantang Gym Antisis

dengan Pokémon-mu. Kudengar
Pemimpin Gym di sana akhir-akhir\lini cukup bosan.

entries.original:
"I came here in hopes of bringing
new life back into the area."
entries.translation_source: I came here in hopes of bringing new life back into the area.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini dengan harapan
menghidupkan kembali daerah ini.

entries.original:
"Did you know that there’s a bird
Pokémon that can mimic speech?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that there’s a bird Pokémon that can mimic speech?
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa ada seekor
Pokémon burung yang bisa meniru\lucapan?

entries.original:
"Is it possible to become more
powerful by understanding Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Is it possible to become more powerful by understanding Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah mungkin menjadi lebih kuat
dengan memahami Pokémon?

entries.original:
"I just can’t decide which Pokémon
to pamper."
entries.translation_source: I just can’t decide which Pokémon to pamper.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa memutuskan Pokémon
mana yang akan dimanja.

entries.original:
"This is a nice place to camp out.
It’s not too far from the city."
entries.translation_source: This is a nice place to camp out. It’s not too far from the city.
entries.translated:
Ini tempat yang bagus untuk
berkemah. Tidak terlalu jauh dari\lkota.

entries.original:
"Listen, you! Whatever happens,
never lose sight of your dream!"
entries.translation_source: Listen, you! Whatever happens, never lose sight of your dream!
entries.translated:
Dengar, kau! Apa pun yang terjadi,
jangan pernah melupakan mimpimu!

entries.original:
"If you don’t know how, I’m willing
to show you how to swim."
entries.translation_source: If you don’t know how, I’m willing to show you how to swim.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu tidak tahu caranya, aku
bersedia menunjukkan cara berenang.

entries.original:
"Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if
I don’t like mountain men.

But, you know, my favourite kind of
guy looks great with Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if I don’t like mountain men. But, you know, my favourite kind of guy looks great with Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Jangan salah paham, bukan berarti
aku tidak suka pria gunung. Tapi,\ltahu, tipe pria favoritku tampak

hebat bersama Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Oh right\.
I was fishing, wasn’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Oh right\. I was fishing, wasn’t I?
entries.translated: Oh benar\. Aku sedang memancing, kan?

entries.original:
"I get my kicks by harassing people
with my stinking Pokémon.

They’re great for startling people.
And, they bite, too."
entries.translation_source: I get my kicks by harassing people with my stinking Pokémon. They’re great for startling people. And, they bite, too.
entries.translated:
Aku merasa senang dengan mengganggu
orang menggunakan Pokémon busukku.\lMereka hebat untuk mengejutkan

orang. Dan, mereka juga menggigit.

entries.original:
"Forget it!
I don’t need your money!"
entries.translation_source: Forget it! I don’t need your money!
entries.translated: Lupakan! Aku tidak butuh uangmu!

entries.original:
"Route 16

\au Gurun Town
\ad Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Route 16 \au Gurun Town \ad Antisis City
entries.translated:
Route 16 \au Gurun Town \ad Antisis
City

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]\.but now the whole base
has been mostly abandoned\."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [blue]\.but now the whole base has been mostly abandoned\.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]\.tapi sekarang seluruh basis
ini sebagian besar telah\lditinggalkan\.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!

I’m glad you could join us.
There’s much we need to discuss."
entries.translation_source: [blue][player]! I’m glad you could join us. There’s much we need to discuss.
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Aku senang kamu bisa
bergabung. Ada banyak yang perlu\lkita bicarakan.

entries.original:
"[blue]I was just catching up Jax on
everything that has occured since\lyour disappearance from Dehara City."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I was just catching up Jax on everything that has occured since your disappearance from Dehara City.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku baru saja memberi tahu Jax
tentang semua yang terjadi sejak\lkamu menghilang dari Dehara City.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Looker has been filling me in
on a ton.

A lot has happened since I was sent
to the Distortion World\.

I may have only been there for a
few hours by the time you showed\lup, but a lot more time passed in\lthe real world while I was there."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Looker has been filling me in on a ton. A lot has happened since I was sent to the Distortion World\. I may have only been there for a few hours by the time you showed up, but a lot more time passed in the real world while I was there.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Looker sudah banyak memberi
tahu saya. Banyak hal terjadi sejak\lsaya dikirim ke Distortion World\.

Saya mungkin hanya berada di sana
beberapa jam saat kamu muncul,\ltetapi lebih banyak waktu berlalu

di dunia nyata saat saya di sana.

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]You missed quite a lot as
well, [player].

As planned, I was waiting outside
the warehouse for you and [rival],\lwhen some cloaked figures exited\lthe warehouse with a large,\lpurple Pokémon.

I was prepared to arrest them, when
all of a sudden, their leader\lyelled something to the Pokémon\lbehind them.

The next thing I knew, they had
vanished without a trace.

I immediately searched the
warehouse for any stragglers, but\lbut I was only able to find one\lgrunt who remained behind.

He informed me that all he knew,
was that the Light of Ruin is\lheading somewhere in [green]East Borrius[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [blue]You missed quite a lot as well, [player]. As planned, I was waiting outside the warehouse for you and [rival], when some cloaked figures exited the warehouse with a large, purple Pokémon. I was prepared to arrest them, when all of a sudden, their leader yelled something to the Pokémon behind them. The next thing I knew, they had vanished without a trace. I immediately searched the warehouse for any stragglers, but but I was only able to find one grunt who remained behind. He informed me that all he knew, was that the Light of Ruin is heading somewhere in [green]East Borrius[blue].
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Kamu juga melewatkan cukup
banyak, [player]. Seperti yang\ldirencanakan, saya menunggu di luar

gudang untukmu dan [rival], ketika
beberapa figur berjubah keluar dari\lgudang dengan Pokémon ungu besar.

Saya bersiap untuk menangkap
mereka, ketika tiba-tiba, pemimpin\lmereka berteriak sesuatu kepada

Pokémon di belakang mereka.
Selanjutnya saya tahu, mereka telah\llenyap tanpa jejak. Saya segera

mencari gudang untuk orang yang
tertinggal, tapi saya hanya bisa\lmenemukan satu anggota rendahan

yang masih tinggal. Dia memberi
tahu saya bahwa yang dia tahu,\lCahaya Kehancuran menuju ke suatu

tempat di [green]East Borrius[blue].

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue][green]East Borrius[blue]?

What would the Light of Ruin be
doing there?"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue][green]East Borrius[blue]? What would the Light of Ruin be doing there?
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue][green]East Borrius[blue]? Apa yang
dilakukan Cahaya Kehancuran di\lsana?

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]I’m not sure, Jax.

That’s all the grunt knew, and all
data had been wiped from their\lcomputer system."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [blue]I’m not sure, Jax. That’s all the grunt knew, and all data had been wiped from their computer system.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Saya tidak yakin, Jax. Itu
yang diketahui anggota rendahan\litu, dan semua data telah dihapus

dari sistem komputer mereka.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Well we won’t figure anything
out by just standing here.

We need to hop on a boat to [green]East
Borrius [blue]from [green]Seaport City[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Well we won’t figure anything out by just standing here. We need to hop on a boat to [green]East Borrius [blue]from [green]Seaport City[blue]!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Kita tidak akan menemukan apa
pun hanya dengan berdiri di sini.\lKita harus naik kapal ke [green]East

Borrius [blue]dari [green]Seaport City[blue]!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Agreed.
I’ll arrange the tickets.

You two should meet me there."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [blue]Agreed. I’ll arrange the tickets. You two should meet me there.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Setuju. Saya akan mengatur
tiketnya. Kalian berdua harus\lmenemuiku di sana.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]You got that, [player]?

We’re going to [green]Seaport City!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]You got that, [player]? We’re going to [green]Seaport City!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Kau mengerti, [player]? Kita
akan pergi ke [green]Seaport City!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Excuse me.
I must be going now as well."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [blue]Excuse me. I must be going now as well.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Permisi. Saya juga harus
pergi sekarang.

entries.original: "[rival]: [blue]I’m going to end him!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]I’m going to end him!
entries.translated: [rival]: [blue]Aku akan mengakhirinya!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]They’re gone\.
All gone!"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]They’re gone\. All gone!
entries.translated: [rival]: [blue]Mereka pergi\. Semua pergi!

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!

Where’s the Light of Ruin?

\.

[green]East Borrius[blue]?

Then I need to hurry to [green]Seaport
City [blue]before the next boat leaves!"
entries.translation_source: [blue][player]! Where’s the Light of Ruin? \. [green]East Borrius[blue]? Then I need to hurry to [green]Seaport City [blue]before the next boat leaves!
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Di mana Cahaya
Kehancuran? \. [green]East Borrius[blue]? Kalau\lbegitu aku harus bergegas ke

[green]Seaport City [blue]sebelum kapal
berikutnya berangkat!

entries.original:
"Its a news report:

The Terror Granbull, the gang
responsible for terrorizing the\lcitizens of Antisis City, has\ldisappeared!

Will this usher in a new age of
peace and prosperity for the city,\lnow that all crime has been wiped\laway?

Citizens are encouraged to leave
their homes and restore Antisis\lCity to its former glory.

Make Antisis great again!"
entries.translation_source: Its a news report: The Terror Granbull, the gang responsible for terrorizing the citizens of Antisis City, has disappeared! Will this usher in a new age of peace and prosperity for the city, now that all crime has been wiped away? Citizens are encouraged to leave their homes and restore Antisis City to its former glory. Make Antisis great again!
entries.translated:
Ini laporan berita: Terror
Granbull, geng yang bertanggung\ljawab meneror warga Antisis City,

telah menghilang! Akankah ini
membawa era baru perdamaian dan\lkemakmuran bagi kota itu, sekarang

setelah semua kejahatan terhapus?
Warga didorong untuk meninggalkan\lrumah mereka dan mengembalikan

Antisis City ke kejayaannya dulu.
Buat Antisis hebat lagi!

entries.original:
"Those poozers think that Antisis
City is safe now that the Terror\lGranbull are gone!

Haw haw!

They couldn’t be more wrong!"
entries.translation_source: Those poozers think that Antisis City is safe now that the Terror Granbull are gone! Haw haw! They couldn’t be more wrong!
entries.translated:
Para poozers itu pikir Antisis City
aman sekarang setelah Terror\lGranbull pergi! Haw haw! Mereka

tidak mungkin lebih salah!

entries.original:
"My boyfriend is so strong and
tough!

There ain’t no one like him here in
the city!

Well, aside from Big Mo, of course."
entries.translation_source: My boyfriend is so strong and tough! There ain’t no one like him here in the city! Well, aside from Big Mo, of course.
entries.translated:
Pacarku sangat kuat dan tangguh!
Tidak ada yang seperti dia di kota\lini! Yah, selain Big Mo, tentu

saja.

entries.original:
"You wanna prove you’re tough?
Huh, boy?

You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo.

He’s the biggest, toughest guy in
all of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You wanna prove you’re tough? Huh, boy? You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo. He’s the biggest, toughest guy in all of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kamu mau buktiin kalau kamu
tangguh? Hah, nak? Kamu harus\lmenghadapi Big Mo. Dia pria

terbesar dan terkuat di seluruh
Antisis City.

entries.original:
"You wanna prove you’re tough?
Huh, girly?

You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo.

He’s the biggest, toughest guy in
all of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You wanna prove you’re tough? Huh, girly? You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo. He’s the biggest, toughest guy in all of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kamu mau buktiin kalau kamu
tangguh? Hah, cewek? Kamu harus\lmenghadapi Big Mo. Dia pria

terbesar dan terkuat di seluruh
Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You must be pretty tough if you
took down Big Mo.

That ain’t easy.

You know what, take these as a
congrats from me."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. You must be pretty tough if you took down Big Mo. That ain’t easy. You know what, take these as a congrats from me.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Kamu pasti cukup tangguh jika
berhasil mengalahkan Big Mo. Itu\ltidak mudah. Tahu tidak, ambil ini

sebagai ucapan selamat dariku.

entries.original:
"Use those balls to catch even more
tough Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Use those balls to catch even more tough Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Gunakan bola-bola itu untuk
menangkap Pokémon yang lebih\ltangguh lagi.

entries.original: "You don’t need ’em."
entries.translation_source: You don’t need ’em.
entries.translated: Kamu tidak perlu itu.

entries.original: "Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!"
entries.translation_source: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!
entries.translated: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!

entries.original:
"Yeah\.I think your Pokémon are
healed.

But I didn’t go through Nursing
School so I can’t really tell."
entries.translation_source: Yeah\.I think your Pokémon are healed. But I didn’t go through Nursing School so I can’t really tell.
entries.translated:
Ya\. Aku pikir Pokémon-mu sudah
sembuh. Tapi aku tidak melalui\lSekolah Perawat jadi aku tidak bisa

benar-benar tahu.

entries.original:
"I really hope I see you and your
money again."
entries.translation_source: I really hope I see you and your money again.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat berharap bisa melihatmu
dan uangmu lagi.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Antisis City
Police HQ!

\.

Well, actually its just my home,
now.

The gangs around here have gotten
too rowdy for us, lately."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Antisis City Police HQ! \. Well, actually its just my home, now. The gangs around here have gotten too rowdy for us, lately.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Markas Polisi
Antisis City! \. Yah, sebenarnya ini\lhanya rumahku sekarang. Geng-geng

di sekitar sini sudah terlalu gaduh
bagi kami akhir-akhir ini.

entries.original:
"It’s good that someone your age is
pursuing the healthy career of\lPokémon Trainer.

It’s much better than being part of
a gang.

Trust me, I know.
I see what goes on around here."
entries.translation_source: It’s good that someone your age is pursuing the healthy career of Pokémon Trainer. It’s much better than being part of a gang. Trust me, I know. I see what goes on around here.
entries.translated:
Bagus bahwa seseorang seusiamu
mengejar karir sehat sebagai\lPelatih Pokémon. Jauh lebih baik

daripada menjadi bagian dari geng.
Percayalah, aku tahu. Aku melihat\lapa yang terjadi di sini.

entries.original:
"It’s too bad that someone of your
age is part of a gang.

It’s a shame, really.

You could’ve had so much potential,
but now, you have none at all."
entries.translation_source: It’s too bad that someone of your age is part of a gang. It’s a shame, really. You could’ve had so much potential, but now, you have none at all.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali seseorang seusiamu
menjadi bagian dari geng.\lBenar-benar memalukan. Kamu bisa

memiliki begitu banyak potensi,
tapi sekarang, kamu tidak memiliki\lsama sekali.

entries.original:
"It’s nice that in a city like this,
an outcast, like me, can fit in.

No one judges me for anything I do,
anymore."
entries.translation_source: It’s nice that in a city like this, an outcast, like me, can fit in. No one judges me for anything I do, anymore.
entries.translated:
Senang bahwa di kota seperti ini,
seorang orang buangan, sepertiku,\lbisa cocok. Tidak ada yang

menghakimiku untuk apa pun yang
kulakukan lagi.

entries.original:
"I used to be part of the Terror
Granbull, the gang that ran this\ltown.

But the Black Ferrothorn took us by
surprise and attacked our base\lthrough the sewers.

Now I’m back to being a nobody,
living with their mom.

Don’t let that ever happen to you,
kid!

Stay in school!"
entries.translation_source: I used to be part of the Terror Granbull, the gang that ran this town. But the Black Ferrothorn took us by surprise and attacked our base through the sewers. Now I’m back to being a nobody, living with their mom. Don’t let that ever happen to you, kid! Stay in school!
entries.translated:
Dulu aku bagian dari Terror
Granbull, geng yang menguasai kota\lini. Tapi Black Ferrothorn

mengejutkan kami dan menyerang
markas kami melalui selokan.\lSekarang aku kembali menjadi orang

tidak berarti, tinggal dengan
ibuku. Jangan biarkan itu terjadi\lpadamu, nak! Tetaplah di sekolah!

entries.original:
"My son is such a lowlife.

When will he ever get a real job
and leave the house?"
entries.translation_source: My son is such a lowlife. When will he ever get a real job and leave the house?
entries.translated:
Anakku benar-benar orang rendahan.
Kapan dia akan mendapatkan\lpekerjaan nyata dan keluar rumah?

entries.original:
"Antisis City is the most
crime-ridden city in Borrius.

But because of its existance, most
lowlives in the region are drawn\lhere, causing crime rates to\ldecrease everywhere else."
entries.translation_source: Antisis City is the most crime-ridden city in Borrius. But because of its existance, most lowlives in the region are drawn here, causing crime rates to decrease everywhere else.
entries.translated:
Antisis City adalah kota paling
penuh kejahatan di Borrius. Tapi\lkarena keberadaannya, sebagian

besar orang rendahan di wilayah ini
tertarik ke sini, menyebabkan\ltingkat kejahatan menurun di tempat

lain.

entries.original: "Don’t come back."
entries.translation_source: Don’t come back.
entries.translated: Jangan kembali.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], buddy, how’s it
hangin’?

Listen, man, the other day I
accidentally flushed my favourite\lpair of socks down the toilet."
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player], buddy, how’s it hangin’? Listen, man, the other day I accidentally flushed my favourite pair of socks down the toilet.
entries.translated:
Hei, [player], kawan, gimana
kabarnya? Denger ya, beberapa hari\lyang lalu aku gak sengaja nyiram

kaus kaki favoritku ke toilet.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], buddy, how’s it
hangin’?

Listen, girl, the other day I
accidentally flushed my favourite\lpair of socks down the toilet."
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player], buddy, how’s it hangin’? Listen, girl, the other day I accidentally flushed my favourite pair of socks down the toilet.
entries.translated:
Hei, [player], kawan, gimana
kabarnya? Denger ya, cewek,\lbeberapa hari yang lalu aku gak

sengaja nyiram kaus kaki favoritku
ke toilet.

entries.original:
"I went down to the sewers to go
look for ’em, but I just couldn’t\lfind ’em for the life of me.

Now I know you must be wondering
why my socks were even in the\ltoilet in the first place.

But that’s another story for
another time.

So I was thinkin’ maybe you could
have a go at searching for me?"
entries.translation_source: I went down to the sewers to go look for ’em, but I just couldn’t find ’em for the life of me. Now I know you must be wondering why my socks were even in the toilet in the first place. But that’s another story for another time. So I was thinkin’ maybe you could have a go at searching for me?
entries.translated:
Aku turun ke selokan untuk
mencarinya, tapi aku benar-benar\lgak nemu. Sekarang aku tahu kau

pasti penasaran kenapa kaus kakiku
ada di toilet. Tapi itu cerita lain\luntuk lain waktu. Jadi aku mikir,

mungkin kau bisa coba
mencarikannya?

entries.original:
"Thanks, man. I knew I could count
on you."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, man. I knew I could count on you.
entries.translated:
Makasih, kawan. Aku tahu aku bisa
mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"Thanks, girl. I knew I could count
on you."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, girl. I knew I could count on you.
entries.translated:
Makasih, cewek. Aku tahu aku bisa
mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"Just go down to the sewers and look
for my socks.

The main entrance is by the SES
Expressway."
entries.translation_source: Just go down to the sewers and look for my socks. The main entrance is by the SES Expressway.
entries.translated:
Pergi aja ke selokan dan cari kaus
kakiku. Pintu masuk utamanya di\ldekat SES Expressway.

entries.original:
"I don’t blame you, [player].
No hard feelin’s.

I’ll just have to live without my
favourite pair of socks from now\lon.  Sniff ."
entries.translation_source: I don’t blame you, [player]. No hard feelin’s. I’ll just have to live without my favourite pair of socks from now on. Sniff .
entries.translated:
Aku gak nyalahin kamu, [player].
Gak ada perasaan sakit hati. Aku\lharus hidup tanpa kaus kaki

favoritku mulai sekarang. Hiks.

entries.original:
"You found ’em!

But oh man, do they reek!"
entries.translation_source: You found ’em! But oh man, do they reek!
entries.translated: Kamu nemuin! Tapi ampun, baunya!

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the grimy socks
to the Black [player] goon."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over the grimy socks to the Black [player] goon.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan kaus kaki
kotor itu kepada goon Black\l[player].

entries.original:
"Uh\.oh yeah, I should probably
give you something for your\ltrouble."
entries.translation_source: Uh\.oh yeah, I should probably give you something for your trouble.
entries.translated:
Uh\.oh ya, aku mungkin harus kasih
sesuatu sebagai hadiah.

entries.original:
"I wiped that grime off of my socks,
but I don’t know what it does.

I’m sure you can make better use
of it than me."
entries.translation_source: I wiped that grime off of my socks, but I don’t know what it does. I’m sure you can make better use of it than me.
entries.translated:
Aku udah bersihin kotoran itu dari
kaus kakiku, tapi aku gak tau\lfungsinya apa. Aku yakin kamu bisa

memanfaatkannya lebih baik dariku.

entries.original:
"I put my socks right on without
even washing em’!

That’s how excited I am to have
’em back."
entries.translation_source: I put my socks right on without even washing em’! That’s how excited I am to have ’em back.
entries.translated:
Aku langsung pakai kaus kakiku
tanpa dicuci! Begitu senangnya aku\lpunya mereka lagi.

entries.original:
"If you want it, you need more space
in your bag."
entries.translation_source: If you want it, you need more space in your bag.
entries.translated:
Kalau kamu mau, kamu perlu ruang
lebih di tasmu.

entries.original:
"This base used to belong to the old
gang that used to run Antisis City.

After the Black Ferrothorn kicked
them out, they left this base\labandoned.

We fixed it up when we came, and
even replaced the hole to the sewer\lwith stairs!"
entries.translation_source: This base used to belong to the old gang that used to run Antisis City. After the Black Ferrothorn kicked them out, they left this base abandoned. We fixed it up when we came, and even replaced the hole to the sewer with stairs!
entries.translated:
Markas ini dulunya milik geng lama
yang dulu menguasai Antisis City.\lSetelah Black Ferrothorn mengusir

mereka, mereka meninggalkan markas
ini terbengkalai. Kami\lmemperbaikinya saat datang, dan

bahkan mengganti lubang ke selokan
dengan tangga!

entries.original:
"We’re discussing our strategy for
taking down the Black Ferrothorn."
entries.translation_source: We’re discussing our strategy for taking down the Black Ferrothorn.
entries.translated:
Kami sedang mendiskusikan strategi
untuk mengalahkan Black Ferrothorn.

entries.original:
"James: [blue][player]!

You made it!
Welcome to the Black [player] HQ!"
entries.translation_source: James: [blue][player]! You made it! Welcome to the Black [player] HQ!
entries.translated:
James: [blue][player]! Kamu berhasil!
Selamat datang di Markas Black\l[player]!

entries.original:
"[blue]It may not look like much right
now, but once we take out the Black\lFerrothorn, we’ll fix it up.

You’re more than welcome to stick
around and help us deal with ’em.

We’re still discussing our
strategy, so in the mean time, you\lshould see if any of your fellow\lBlack [player]s need a hand."
entries.translation_source: [blue]It may not look like much right now, but once we take out the Black Ferrothorn, we’ll fix it up. You’re more than welcome to stick around and help us deal with ’em. We’re still discussing our strategy, so in the mean time, you should see if any of your fellow Black [player]s need a hand.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mungkin saat ini tampak biasa aja,
tapi begitu kita kalahkan Black\lFerrothorn, kita akan merapikannya.

Kamu dipersilakan untuk tetap di
sini dan bantu kami menghadapi\lmereka. Kami masih mendiskusikan

strategi, jadi sementara itu, kamu
harus lihat apakah ada rekan Black\l[player] lain yang butuh bantuan.

entries.original:
"James: [blue]You’re just in time,
[player].

We figured out how we’re gonna take
down those Black Ferrothorns.

We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and
attack from the sewers.

Gwa ha ha ha!

Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t
know what hit em’!"
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]You’re just in time, [player]. We figured out how we’re gonna take down those Black Ferrothorns. We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and attack from the sewers. Gwa ha ha ha! Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t know what hit em’!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Kamu datang pas banget,
[player]. Kami udah tau cara\lmengalahkan Black Ferrothorn itu.

Kita akan lakukan langkah nekat dan
menyerang dari selokan. Gwa ha ha\lha! Gumpalan daging sombong itu gak

bakal tau apa yang menimpa mereka!

entries.original:
"[blue]Goons! Mount your bikes!
We’re goin’ to the sewers!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Goons! Mount your bikes! We’re goin’ to the sewers!
entries.translated:
[blue]Para goon! Naiki sepeda kalian!
Kita ke selokan!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]Help out your fellow Black
[player]s while we plan our attack."
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]Help out your fellow Black [player]s while we plan our attack.
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Bantu rekan Black [player]mu
sementara kami merencanakan\lserangan.

entries.original:
"One day I’m gonna strike it rich
and buy a real couch."
entries.translation_source: One day I’m gonna strike it rich and buy a real couch.
entries.translated:
Suatu hari aku akan jadi kaya raya
dan membeli sofa sungguhan.

entries.original:
"Yo! [player]!

This lady in the city has really
been pissin’ me off, lately.

Help me nab her prized Pokémon!
She needs to be suffer!"
entries.translation_source: Yo! [player]! This lady in the city has really been pissin’ me off, lately. Help me nab her prized Pokémon! She needs to be suffer!
entries.translated:
Hei! [player]! Wanita di kota ini
benar-benar membuatku kesal\lakhir-akhir ini. Bantu aku mencuri

Pokémon berharganya! Dia perlu
menderita!

entries.original:
"Alright!

Before we go, you probably should
put on a mask or somethin’ so no\lone can recognize you.

I don’t want you to end up like me
’cause someone saw you commit a\lfelony when you were young."
entries.translation_source: Alright! Before we go, you probably should put on a mask or somethin’ so no one can recognize you. I don’t want you to end up like me ’cause someone saw you commit a felony when you were young.
entries.translated:
Baiklah! Sebelum kita pergi,
sebaiknya kau pakai topeng atau\lsesuatu agar tidak ada yang bisa

mengenalimu. Aku tidak ingin kau
berakhir sepertiku karena seseorang\lmelihatmu melakukan kejahatan saat

kau masih muda.

entries.original: "[black]Put on Marlon’s uniform?"
entries.translation_source: [black]Put on Marlon’s uniform?
entries.translated: [black]Pakai seragam Marlon?

entries.original: "Fine! I’ll do it myself, then!"
entries.translation_source: Fine! I’ll do it myself, then!
entries.translated:
Baik! Aku akan melakukannya
sendiri!

entries.original:
"How’re you enjoying that fancy new
Pokémon, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: How’re you enjoying that fancy new Pokémon, [player]?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kau menikmati Pokémon
baru yang keren itu, [player]?

entries.original:
"Yo, [player].

I tried sending the Pokémon out to
see what it was, but when I did, it\ljust refused to obey me.

I was thinking that the reason is
because we stole the Pokémon.

So here’s what we’re gonna do.

I’m gonna release the Pokémon from
its ball, and you’re gonna battle,\land capture it yourself,

You ready?"
entries.translation_source: Yo, [player]. I tried sending the Pokémon out to see what it was, but when I did, it just refused to obey me. I was thinking that the reason is because we stole the Pokémon. So here’s what we’re gonna do. I’m gonna release the Pokémon from its ball, and you’re gonna battle, and capture it yourself, You ready?
entries.translated:
Hei, [player]. Aku mencoba
mengeluarkan Pokémon untuk melihat\lapa itu, tapi saat melakukannya, ia

menolak mematuhiku. Aku pikir
alasannya karena kita mencuri\lPokémon itu. Jadi begini yang akan

kita lakukan. Aku akan melepaskan
Pokémon dari bolanya, dan kau akan\lbertarung, dan menangkapnya

sendiri. Kau siap?

entries.original:
"Take these Ultra Balls to help you
catch it."
entries.translation_source: Take these Ultra Balls to help you catch it.
entries.translated:
Ambil Bola Ultra ini untuk
membantumu menangkapnya.

entries.original:
"Hurry up and get ready.

I think it’s a Lv. 35 Poison type
of some kind."
entries.translation_source: Hurry up and get ready. I think it’s a Lv. 35 Poison type of some kind.
entries.translated:
Cepat bersiap. Kurasa ini adalah
tipe Racun Lv. 35.

entries.original:
"Never mind, looks like you don’t
need ’em."
entries.translation_source: Never mind, looks like you don’t need ’em.
entries.translated:
Sudahlah, sepertinya kau tidak
membutuhkannya.

entries.original:
"Alright!
You caught it!

That’ll show that lady!

Her Pokémon is now in the hands of
a grade A trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! You caught it! That’ll show that lady! Her Pokémon is now in the hands of a grade A trainer!
entries.translated:
Baik! Kau menangkapnya! Itu akan
memberi pelajaran pada wanita itu!\lPokémonnya sekarang ada di tangan

pelatih kelas A!

entries.original:
"Why’d you go and knock it out?

Now I we have to heal it, and you
have to battle it all over again!"
entries.translation_source: Why’d you go and knock it out? Now I we have to heal it, and you have to battle it all over again!
entries.translated:
Kenapa kau malah melumpuhkannya?
Sekarang kita harus\lmenyembuhkannya, dan kau harus

bertarung lagi dari awal!

entries.original:
"The Grimer is all healed up.
Are you ready to fight it, again?"
entries.translation_source: The Grimer is all healed up. Are you ready to fight it, again?
entries.translated:
Grimer sudah sembuh total. Kau siap
bertarung lagi?

entries.original: "You have already solved the puzzle."
entries.translation_source: You have already solved the puzzle.
entries.translated:
Kamu sudah memecahkan teka-teki
ini.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], you wanna help out
with a little problem I’m having\lwith those Black Ferrothorns?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player], you wanna help out with a little problem I’m having with those Black Ferrothorns?
entries.translated:
Hei, [player], kau mau membantu
dengan masalah kecil yang kuhadapi\ldengan Black Ferrothorn itu?

entries.original:
"Here’s the low down.

I fought these Black Ferrothorn
goons a while back, but they\lwrecked me totally.

One of the goons used his partner’s
Pokémon also to battle me, so I\ldidn’t stand a chance.

I really wanna put ’em in their
place, but I just ain’t strong\lenough.

You think you can take ’em both out
for me?"
entries.translation_source: Here’s the low down. I fought these Black Ferrothorn goons a while back, but they wrecked me totally. One of the goons used his partner’s Pokémon also to battle me, so I didn’t stand a chance. I really wanna put ’em in their place, but I just ain’t strong enough. You think you can take ’em both out for me?
entries.translated:
Ini ceritanya. Aku bertarung dengan
preman Black Ferrothorn beberapa\lwaktu lalu, tapi mereka

menghancurkanku total. Salah satu
preman juga menggunakan Pokémon\lrekannya untuk bertarung melawanku,

jadi aku tidak punya kesempatan.
Aku benar-benar ingin memberi\lmereka pelajaran, tapi aku tidak

cukup kuat. Kau pikir kau bisa
melumpuhkan mereka berdua untukku?

entries.original:
"You’re gutsy, [player].

I’ll take you to ’em now."
entries.translation_source: You’re gutsy, [player]. I’ll take you to ’em now.
entries.translated:
Kau berani, [player]. Aku akan
membawamu ke mereka sekarang.

entries.original:
"Hmph.
I thought you had guts, kid."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. I thought you had guts, kid.
entries.translated:
Hmph. Kukira kau punya keberanian,
nak.

entries.original:
"You’re gonna need at least two
Pokemon if they team up on you."
