entries.translation_source: You’re gonna need at least two Pokemon if they team up on you.
entries.translated:
Kau harus punya setidaknya dua
Pokémon jika mereka bekerja sama\lmelawanmu.

entries.original:
"You ready to give it another shot
[player]?

Those goons need to be put in their
place."
entries.translation_source: You ready to give it another shot [player]? Those goons need to be put in their place.
entries.translated:
Kau siap mencoba lagi, [player]?
Preman-preman itu perlu diberi\lpelajaran.

entries.original:
"You really showed those Black
Ferrothorn goons, [player].

You really are the gutsiest trainer
I know."
entries.translation_source: You really showed those Black Ferrothorn goons, [player]. You really are the gutsiest trainer I know.
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar menunjukkan kepada
para preman Black Ferrothorn itu,\l[player]. Kamu benar-benar pelatih

paling berani yang aku kenal.

entries.original:
"That item I just gave you is an
essential for any gutsy trainer.

Whenever your enemy touches your
Pokémon they’ll get hurt too."
entries.translation_source: That item I just gave you is an essential for any gutsy trainer. Whenever your enemy touches your Pokémon they’ll get hurt too.
entries.translated:
Item yang baru aku berikan itu
penting bagi pelatih pemberani.\lSetiap kali musuh menyentuh

Pokémon-mu, mereka juga akan
terluka.

entries.original:
"Those goons won’t be bothering me
anymore. Thanks [player]."
entries.translation_source: Those goons won’t be bothering me anymore. Thanks [player].
entries.translated:
Para preman itu tidak akan
menggangguku lagi. Terima kasih\l[player].

entries.original:
"I wanted to give you an item, but
you don’t have space."
entries.translation_source: I wanted to give you an item, but you don’t have space.
entries.translated:
Aku ingin memberikanmu sebuah item,
tetapi ruangmu penuh.

entries.original:
"Goon: [blue]Hey, you Black Ferrothorn
bozos! I’m here for a rematch!"
entries.translation_source: Goon: [blue]Hey, you Black Ferrothorn bozos! I’m here for a rematch!
entries.translated:
Preman: [blue]Hei, kalian para bodoh
Black Ferrothorn! Aku di sini untuk\lpertandingan ulang!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]You hear that, Chad?

This weak punk thinks he can beat
us!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [blue]You hear that, Chad? This weak punk thinks he can beat us!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Kau dengar itu, Chad?
Pengecut lemah ini pikir dia bisa\lmengalahkan kita!

entries.original:
"Goon: [blue]Oh, I aint gonna be doin’ any
fightin’.

My pal, [player], here, is gonna
destroy youse guys for me!"
entries.translation_source: Goon: [blue]Oh, I aint gonna be doin’ any fightin’. My pal, [player], here, is gonna destroy youse guys for me!
entries.translated:
Preman: [blue]Oh, aku tidak akan
bertarung. Temanku, [player], di\lsini, akan menghancurkan kalian

untukku!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]Is that so?

Well, then we’re just gonna have to
pummel him into the ground!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [blue]Is that so? Well, then we’re just gonna have to pummel him into the ground!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Begitu ya? Kalau begitu, kami
harus menghajarnya habis-habisan!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]Is that so?

Well, then we’re just gonna have to
pummel her into the ground!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [blue]Is that so? Well, then we’re just gonna have to pummel her into the ground!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Begitu ya? Kalau begitu, kami
harus menghajarnya habis-habisan!

entries.original:
"[blue]Chad! Gimme your Pokémon!

I’m gonna take ’em down with our
combined strength!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Chad! Gimme your Pokémon! I’m gonna take ’em down with our combined strength!
entries.translated:
[blue]Chad! Berikan Pokémon-mu! Aku akan
menjatuhkan mereka dengan kekuatan\lgabungan kita!

entries.original:
"Chad: [blue]Go do this, man!

Rock their socks off and throw ’em in
the sewer like that other guy’s!"
entries.translation_source: Chad: [blue]Go do this, man! Rock their socks off and throw ’em in the sewer like that other guy’s!
entries.translated:
Chad: [blue]Lakukan saja, bung! Kocok
mereka sampai kocar-kacir dan buang\lmereka ke selokan seperti yang

lain!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]You’d better hope you’re
prepared for my double rage!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [blue]You’d better hope you’re prepared for my double rage!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Kamu lebih baik berharap kamu
siap menghadapi amarah gandaku!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]Wha\.you shouldn’t be able
to beat the Black Ferrothorn!

Our hides are iron thick!
How’s this possible!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [blue]Wha\.you shouldn’t be able to beat the Black Ferrothorn! Our hides are iron thick! How’s this possible!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Apa\.kamu seharusnya tidak bisa
mengalahkan Black Ferrothorn! Kulit\lkami setebal besi! Bagaimana

mungkin!

entries.original:
"Goon: [blue]Now you see the real
toughness of the Black [player]!

Your hides aren’t thick, they’re as
soft as a Smoochum!

Hahaha!"
entries.translation_source: Goon: [blue]Now you see the real toughness of the Black [player]! Your hides aren’t thick, they’re as soft as a Smoochum! Hahaha!
entries.translated:
Preman: [blue]Sekarang kamu lihat
ketangguhan asli Black [player]!\lKulit kalian tidak tebal, setenang

Smoochum! Hahaha!

entries.original:
"[blue]You’re one gutsy trainer,
[player]!

I dunno anyone else who’d had the
guts to take on two trainers’\lPokémon at once!

Ya know what\.come back to the
base an’ I’ll give you a little\lsomething for your help."
entries.translation_source: [blue]You’re one gutsy trainer, [player]! I dunno anyone else who’d had the guts to take on two trainers’ Pokémon at once! Ya know what\.come back to the base an’ I’ll give you a little something for your help.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu pelatih pemberani, [player]!
Aku tidak tahu siapa lagi yang\lpunya nyali untuk menghadapi

Pokémon dua pelatih sekaligus! Kau
tahu\.kembali ke markas dan aku akan\lmemberimu sesuatu kecil sebagai

imbalan bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]What\.did you actually think
you could beat us?

The Black Ferrothorn?"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [blue]What\.did you actually think you could beat us? The Black Ferrothorn?
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Apa\.apa kamu benar-benar
berpikir bisa mengalahkan kami?\lBlack Ferrothorn?

entries.original:
"Goon: [blue]I thought you could beat ’em
[player]\.

Now you’ve gone and humiliated the
Black [player]\.

You better get stronger so ya can
take ’em out next time."
entries.translation_source: Goon: [blue]I thought you could beat ’em [player]\. Now you’ve gone and humiliated the Black [player]\. You better get stronger so ya can take ’em out next time.
entries.translated:
Preman: [blue]Aku pikir kamu bisa
mengalahkan mereka [player]\.\lSekarang kamu telah mempermalukan

Black [player]\. Kamu harus menjadi
lebih kuat agar bisa mengalahkan\lmereka lain kali.

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]Is that so?

Well, then it’s time to get
pummelled into the ground again!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [blue]Is that so? Well, then it’s time to get pummelled into the ground again!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Begitu ya? Kalau begitu,
saatnya dihajar habis-habisan lagi!

entries.original:
"Since we built this sewer, all
kinds of Pokémon have shown up."
entries.translation_source: Since we built this sewer, all kinds of Pokémon have shown up.
entries.translated:
Sejak kami membangun selokan ini,
berbagai macam Pokémon telah\lmuncul.

entries.original:
"Isn’t it fun how shouting in a
sewer makes your voice echo?"
entries.translation_source: Isn’t it fun how shouting in a sewer makes your voice echo?
entries.translated:
Bukankah menyenangkan bagaimana
berteriak di selokan membuat\lsuaramu bergema?

entries.original:
"Even odours that might seem awful to
humans might be perfume to Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Even odours that might seem awful to humans might be perfume to Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Bau yang mungkin terasa buruk bagi
manusia bisa menjadi parfum bagi\lPokémon.

entries.original: "What a catastrophic theorem!"
entries.translation_source: What a catastrophic theorem!
entries.translated: Teorema yang sangat dahsyat!

entries.original:
"I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m
never working a day in my life!"
entries.translation_source: I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m never working a day in my life!
entries.translated:
Aku suka membersihkan, jadi rasanya
aku tidak pernah bekerja sehari pun\ldalam hidupku!

entries.original:
"You can crawl through a pipe to go
to the sewers underneath the\lsouthern half of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You can crawl through a pipe to go to the sewers underneath the southern half of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa merangkak melalui pipa
untuk pergi ke selokan di bawah\lbagian selatan Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Lots of toxins build up in the
sewer system.

I think I can use them to make
medicines!

So I’m running an experiment!

If this works, I might be able to
use the venom of Poison-type\lPokémon to make different\lmedicines. How exciting!

Well, well\.

The result of today’s experiment
was\."
entries.translation_source: Lots of toxins build up in the sewer system. I think I can use them to make medicines! So I’m running an experiment! If this works, I might be able to use the venom of Poison-type Pokémon to make different medicines. How exciting! Well, well\. The result of today’s experiment was\.
entries.translated:
Banyak racun menumpuk di sistem
saluran pembuangan. Aku pikir aku\lbisa menggunakannya untuk membuat

obat! Jadi aku sedang menjalankan
eksperimen! Jika ini berhasil, aku\lmungkin bisa menggunakan racun

Pokémon tipe Racun untuk membuat
obat yang berbeda. Menyenangkan\lsekali! Nah, nah\. Hasil eksperimen

hari ini adalah\.

entries.original:
"Wow! Today’s experiment was super
successful!

Here! Please accept
the [buffer1] I made!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Today’s experiment was super successful! Here! Please accept the [buffer1] I made!
entries.translated:
Wow! Eksperimen hari ini sangat
sukses! Ini! Silakan terima\l[buffer1] yang kubuat!

entries.original:
"There’s no more space in the bag
for a [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no more space in the bag for a [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada lagi ruang di tas untuk
[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep experimenting every day!
It’s important to keep trying.

Come back and see how it’s going!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep experimenting every day! It’s important to keep trying. Come back and see how it’s going!
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus bereksperimen setiap
hari! Penting untuk terus mencoba.\lKembalilah dan lihat bagaimana

kelanjutannya!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]Alright ya goons!
It’s game time!"
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]Alright ya goons! It’s game time!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Baiklah kalian para preman!
Saatnya bermain!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]The bomb’s ready to blow!

Cover your freakin’ ears unless ya
wanna lose em!"
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]The bomb’s ready to blow! Cover your freakin’ ears unless ya wanna lose em!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Bomnya siap meledak! Tutup
telinga kalian kalau tidak mau\lkehilangannya!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]Let’s go!
Jump up through the hole!"
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]Let’s go! Jump up through the hole!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Ayo! Lompat ke atas melalui
lubang itu!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Who do you bozos think you
are, comin’ into my home, and\lattackin’ my goons?

We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
And I’m Barbs, the leader!

Do ya really want to keep messin’
with us?

We’ll destroy ya in an instant!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Who do you bozos think you are, comin’ into my home, and attackin’ my goons? We’re the Black Ferrothorn! And I’m Barbs, the leader! Do ya really want to keep messin’ with us? We’ll destroy ya in an instant!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Kalian pikir kalian siapa,
masuk ke rumahku dan menyerang anak\lbuahku? Kami adalah Black

Ferrothorn! Dan aku Barbs,
pemimpinnya! Apakah kalian\lbenar-benar ingin terus main-main

dengan kami? Kami akan
menghancurkan kalian dalam sekejap!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]We’re the Black [player]!

And we’re gonna take you Black
Ferrothorns out so we can rule\lthis town instead of ya!

Gwa ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]We’re the Black [player]! And we’re gonna take you Black Ferrothorns out so we can rule this town instead of ya! Gwa ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Kami adalah Black [player]!
Dan kami akan menyingkirkan kalian\lBlack Ferrothorn sehingga kami bisa

menguasai kota ini menggantikan
kalian! Gwa ha ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]The Black [player]?

Youse guys must be that low-level
gang I’ve been hearin’ about\.

Someone oughta put ya in your
place!

And that someone oughta be me!

Who is this [player] youse guys keep
talkin’ about?

I’m gonna take ’em out and teach
youse a lesson ya won’t forget!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [blue]The Black [player]? Youse guys must be that low-level gang I’ve been hearin’ about\. Someone oughta put ya in your place! And that someone oughta be me! Who is this [player] youse guys keep talkin’ about? I’m gonna take ’em out and teach youse a lesson ya won’t forget!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Black [player]? Kalian pasti
geng kelas rendah yang pernah\lkudengar\. Seseorang harus

menempatkan kalian pada tempatnya!
Dan orang itu harus aku! Siapa\l[player] yang terus kalian

bicarakan? Aku akan menyingkirkan
mereka dan memberi kalian pelajaran\lyang tidak akan kalian lupakan!

entries.original: "James: [blue]This fella, right here!"
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]This fella, right here!
entries.translated: James: [blue]Orang ini, di sini!

entries.original:
"[blue]But ya ain’t near strong enough to
take [player] out!

You’ll be crushed tryin’!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]But ya ain’t near strong enough to take [player] out! You’ll be crushed tryin’!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tapi kalian tidak cukup kuat untuk
menyingkirkan [player]! Kalian akan\lhancur jika mencoba!

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]Chaw ha ha ha!

Ya really think some kid can beat
me? Barbs?

I lead the Black Ferrothorn!

I am the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [blue]Chaw ha ha ha! Ya really think some kid can beat me? Barbs? I lead the Black Ferrothorn! I am the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Chaw ha ha ha! Kalian
benar-benar berpikir anak kecil\lbisa mengalahkanku? Barbs? Aku

memimpin Black Ferrothorn! Akulah
Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]Let’s see who the real
toughest chump in Antisis City is!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [blue]Let’s see who the real toughest chump in Antisis City is!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Mari kita lihat siapa orang
paling tangguh di Antisis City\lsebenarnya!

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]You put up a good fight,
[player].

I’d be proud if you were one of us,
the Black Ferrothorn.

It’s too bad you’re loyal to those
bozos.

Speaking of those bozos, looks like
my men utterly totalled ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [blue]You put up a good fight, [player]. I’d be proud if you were one of us, the Black Ferrothorn. It’s too bad you’re loyal to those bozos. Speaking of those bozos, looks like my men utterly totalled ’em!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Kamu bertarung dengan baik,
[player]. Aku akan bangga jika kamu\ladalah salah satu dari kami, Black

Ferrothorn. Sayang sekali kamu
setia pada para goon itu. Bicara\lsoal mereka, sepertinya anak buahku

benar-benar menghabisi mereka!

entries.original: "James: [blue]No, my gang, my life’s work!"
entries.translation_source: James: [blue]No, my gang, my life’s work!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Tidak, gengku, hasil kerja
hidupku!

entries.original:
"[blue]Well, [player], looks like this is
it.

Ya put up a good fight, kid.
Ya made us proud ’til the end.

But it’s time for the Black
[player] to move on.

We’ve been run outta town, so it’s
back to fittin’ in no place, again.

We’re living life on the lam until
we find a new home."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Well, [player], looks like this is it. Ya put up a good fight, kid. Ya made us proud ’til the end. But it’s time for the Black [player] to move on. We’ve been run outta town, so it’s back to fittin’ in no place, again. We’re living life on the lam until we find a new home.
entries.translated:
[blue]Nah, [player], sepertinya ini dia.
Kau bertarung dengan baik, nak. Kau\lmembuat kami bangga sampai akhir.

Tapi sekarang saatnya untuk Black
[player] melanjutkan hidup. Kami\lsudah diusir dari kota, jadi

kembali tidak punya tempat, lagi.
Kami menjalani hidup sebagai\lburonan sampai menemukan rumah

baru.

entries.original:
"[blue]Maybe we’ll run into each other
somewhere down the line, kid.

I look foward to that day."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Maybe we’ll run into each other somewhere down the line, kid. I look foward to that day.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mungkin kita akan bertemu lagi
suatu saat nanti, nak. Aku\lmenantikan hari itu.

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]Look, kid, I respect ya,
now, I really do.

But it’s time for ya to get outta
our house an’ never come back.

\.

I’m serious.

GET OUT!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [blue]Look, kid, I respect ya, now, I really do. But it’s time for ya to get outta our house an’ never come back. \. I’m serious. GET OUT!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Dengar, nak, aku
menghormatimu, sekarang, sungguh.\lTapi sudah waktunya kau keluar dari

rumah kami dan jangan pernah
kembali. \. Aku serius. KELUAR!

entries.original:
"This is the Antisis Gym!

Do ya think ya got what it takes to
survive the ring?"
entries.translation_source: This is the Antisis Gym! Do ya think ya got what it takes to survive the ring?
entries.translated:
Ini adalah Antisis Gym! Apa kau
pikir kau punya kemampuan untuk\lbertahan di ring?

entries.original:
"Not many challengers survive the
ring like you did.

You’re a real special one, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not many challengers survive the ring like you did. You’re a real special one, kid.
entries.translated:
Tidak banyak penantang yang
bertahan di ring sepertimu. Kau\lbenar-benar istimewa, nak.

entries.original: "Enter"
entries.translation_source: Enter
entries.translated: Masuk

entries.original: "Rules"
entries.translation_source: Rules
entries.translated: Aturan

entries.original: "Leave"
entries.translation_source: Leave
entries.translated: Keluar

entries.original: "Stay here."
entries.translation_source: Stay here.
entries.translated: Tetap di sini.

entries.original:
"I’m gonna knock ya right outta the
ring before ya can even get going!"
entries.translation_source: I’m gonna knock ya right outta the ring before ya can even get going!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menjatuhkanmu langsung
keluar ring sebelum kau sempat\lmulai!

entries.original:
"I have come to test your strength
in the ring.

Hiyah!"
entries.translation_source: I have come to test your strength in the ring. Hiyah!
entries.translated:
Aku datang untuk menguji kekuatanmu
di ring. Hiyah!

entries.original:
"Beat me and it’s smooth sailin’ to
Big Mo!

It’s too bad I ain’t gonna let that
happen!"
entries.translation_source: Beat me and it’s smooth sailin’ to Big Mo! It’s too bad I ain’t gonna let that happen!
entries.translated:
Kalahkan aku dan kau akan meluncur
mulus ke Big Mo! Sayangnya aku\ltidak akan membiarkan itu terjadi!

entries.original:
"You survived the ring.
Good job.

Go through that door, now, if you
want to see Big Mo."
entries.translation_source: You survived the ring. Good job. Go through that door, now, if you want to see Big Mo.
entries.translated:
Kau selamat dari ring. Kerja bagus.
Lewati pintu itu, sekarang, jika\lkau ingin bertemu Big Mo.

entries.original:
"The rules are simple.

You choose one Pokémon to battle
three trainers in a row.

Each trainer is also only using
one Pokémon.

But no [green]Flying[blue], [green]Psychic[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue]
types!

You can use those types if you get
to Big Mo, but we don’t like those\ltypes here, in the ring."
entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. You choose one Pokémon to battle three trainers in a row. Each trainer is also only using one Pokémon. But no [green]Flying[blue], [green]Psychic[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue] types! You can use those types if you get to Big Mo, but we don’t like those types here, in the ring.
entries.translated:
Aturannya sederhana. Kau pilih satu
Pokémon untuk bertarung melawan\ltiga pelatih berturut-turut. Setiap

pelatih juga hanya menggunakan satu
Pokémon. Tapi tidak ada tipe\l[green]Terbang[blue], [green]Psychic[blue], atau [green]Peri[blue]! Kau

bisa menggunakan tipe-tipe itu jika
sampai ke Big Mo, tapi kami tidak\lsuka tipe-tipe itu di sini, di

ring.

entries.original:
"You have too many Pokémon!
You can only use one!

Go get rid of some Pokémon if you
want to take the challenge!"
entries.translation_source: You have too many Pokémon! You can only use one! Go get rid of some Pokémon if you want to take the challenge!
entries.translated:
Kau punya terlalu banyak Pokémon!
Kau hanya bisa menggunakan satu!\lSingkirkan beberapa Pokémon jika

kau ingin menerima tantangan!

entries.original:
"No [green][buffer1][blue]-type Pokémon are
allowed in the ring!

Go change your Pokémon if you
want to fight!"
entries.translation_source: No [green][buffer1][blue]-type Pokémon are allowed in the ring! Go change your Pokémon if you want to fight!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada Pokémon tipe [green][buffer1][blue]
yang diizinkan di ring! Ganti\lPokémonmu jika kau ingin bertarung!

entries.original:
"Not only did you survive the ring,
but you also took down Big Mo!

I don’t get impressed easy, but
you’ve done the job, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not only did you survive the ring, but you also took down Big Mo! I don’t get impressed easy, but you’ve done the job, kid.
entries.translated:
Kau tidak hanya selamat dari ring,
tapi juga mengalahkan Big Mo! Aku\ltidak mudah terkesan, tapi kau

berhasil, nak.

entries.original:
"Look who finally decided to ease
my boredom!

Kid from Route 16!

\.

What’s that?
Your name is [player]?

Then allow me to introduce myself
properly too!

Folks around here call me Big Mo!

I’m the one force that keeps the
Antisis underworld under control!"
entries.translation_source: Look who finally decided to ease my boredom! Kid from Route 16! \. What’s that? Your name is [player]? Then allow me to introduce myself properly too! Folks around here call me Big Mo! I’m the one force that keeps the Antisis underworld under control!
entries.translated:
Lihat siapa yang akhirnya
memutuskan untuk menghilangkan\lkebosananku! Nak dari Route 16! \.

Ada apa? Namamu [player]? Kalau
begitu izinkan aku memperkenalkan\ldiri juga! Orang-orang di sini

memanggilku Big Mo! Akulah
satu-satunya kekuatan yang menjaga\ldunia bawah Antisis tetap

terkendali!

entries.original:
"Oh, man, kid\.
What a fight\.

Take the Brawl Badge as proof of
your victory at the Antisis Gym!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, man, kid\. What a fight\. Take the Brawl Badge as proof of your victory at the Antisis Gym!
entries.translated:
Oh, astaga, nak\. Pertarungan yang
hebat\. Ambil Brawl Badge sebagai\lbukti kemenanganmu di Antisis Gym!

entries.original:
"[player] received the Brawl Badge
from Big Mo!"
entries.translation_source: [player] received the Brawl Badge from Big Mo!
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Brawl Badge dari
Big Mo!

entries.original:
"With the Brawl Badge, all Pokémon
up to Lv. 70 will acknowledge your\lstrength and obey you!

You can also now scale rocky cliffs
with the move, Rock Climb!

Tell me that ain’t useful!

Take this TM too!"
entries.translation_source: With the Brawl Badge, all Pokémon up to Lv. 70 will acknowledge your strength and obey you! You can also now scale rocky cliffs with the move, Rock Climb! Tell me that ain’t useful! Take this TM too!
entries.translated:
Dengan Lencana Brawl, semua Pokémon
hingga Lv. 70 akan mengakui\lkekuatanmu dan menuruti perintahmu!

Kamu juga sekarang bisa memanjat
tebing berbatu dengan jurus Panjat\lTebing! Katakan itu tidak berguna!

Ambil TM ini juga!

entries.original:
"[player] received TM60
from Big Mo!"
entries.translation_source: [player] received TM60 from Big Mo!
entries.translated: [player] menerima TM60 dari Big Mo!

entries.original:
"TM60 contains Drain Punch!

It does damage and saps your
enemy’s health at the same time!"
entries.translation_source: TM60 contains Drain Punch! It does damage and saps your enemy’s health at the same time!
entries.translated:
TM60 berisi Pukulan Penguras! Jurus
ini memberikan kerusakan dan\lmenguras kesehatan lawan pada saat

bersamaan!

entries.original:
"If you want my TM, you’ll need to
make some room in your bag!"
entries.translation_source: If you want my TM, you’ll need to make some room in your bag!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu menginginkan TM-ku, kamu
perlu mengosongkan sedikit ruang di\ltasmu!

entries.original:
"If you ever come back to Antisis
City, [player], just know I’ve got my\leye on you!

Ha ha ha ha!

I’ve got my eye on everyone here!
It’s my job!"
entries.translation_source: If you ever come back to Antisis City, [player], just know I’ve got my eye on you! Ha ha ha ha! I’ve got my eye on everyone here! It’s my job!
entries.translated:
Jika suatu saat kamu kembali ke
Antisis City, [player], ketahuilah\laku mengawasimu! Ha ha ha ha! Aku

mengawasi semua orang di sini! Itu
tugasku!

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo? Huh?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo? Huh?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu benar-benar berpikir
bisa mengalahkan Big Mo? Hah?

entries.original:
"You’re the new toughest chump in
Antisis City!"
entries.translation_source: You’re the new toughest chump in Antisis City!
entries.translated:
Kamu adalah orang terkuat baru di
Antisis City!

entries.original:
"Antisis Pokémon Gym
Leader: Big Mo

Winning Trainers:
[rival]"
entries.translation_source: Antisis Pokémon Gym Leader: Big Mo Winning Trainers: [rival]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Antisis: Big
Mo Pelatih Pemenang: [rival]

entries.original:
"Antisis Pokémon Gym
Leader: Big Mo

Winning Trainers:
[rival], [player]"
entries.translation_source: Antisis Pokémon Gym Leader: Big Mo Winning Trainers: [rival], [player]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Antisis: Big
Mo Pelatih Pemenang: [rival],\l[player]

entries.original:
"[buffer1] used Sunny Day!
It became Sunny outside."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] used Sunny Day! It became Sunny outside.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] menggunakan Hari Cerah!
Cuaca menjadi Cerah di luar.

entries.original: "Can’t make it sunny inside\."
entries.translation_source: Can’t make it sunny inside\.
entries.translated:
Tidak bisa membuatnya cerah di
dalam\.

entries.original:
"The wall is very rocky\.
Would you like to use [buffer2]?"
entries.translation_source: The wall is very rocky\. Would you like to use [buffer2]?
entries.translated:
Dindingnya sangat berbatu\. Apakah
kamu ingin menggunakan [buffer2]?

entries.original: "[buffer1] used [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] used [buffer2]!
entries.translated: [buffer1] menggunakan [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"The wall is very rocky\.
Will a Pokémon’s move scale it?"
entries.translation_source: The wall is very rocky\. Will a Pokémon’s move scale it?
entries.translated:
Dindingnya sangat berbatu\. Apakah
jurus Pokémon bisa memanjatnya?

entries.original: "Rock Climb can’t be used here!"
entries.translation_source: Rock Climb can’t be used here!
entries.translated:
Panjat Tebing tidak bisa digunakan
di sini!

entries.original:
"Would you like to climb the
ladder?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to climb the ladder?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu ingin menaiki tangga?

entries.original:
"You can’t reach the ladder from
here."
entries.translation_source: You can’t reach the ladder from here.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak bisa meraih tangga dari
sini.

entries.original: "[player] used a Repel."
entries.translation_source: [player] used a Repel.
entries.translated: [player] menggunakan Pengusir.

entries.original: "[player] used a Super Repel."
entries.translation_source: [player] used a Super Repel.
entries.translated:
[player] menggunakan Pengusir
Super.

entries.original: "[player] used a Max Repel."
entries.translation_source: [player] used a Max Repel.
entries.translated: [player] menggunakan Pengusir Max.

entries.original: "The Repel’s effect wore off\."
entries.translation_source: The Repel’s effect wore off\.
entries.translated: Efek Pengusir telah habis\.

entries.original: "You have no Repels left."
entries.translation_source: You have no Repels left.
entries.translated: Kamu tidak memiliki Pengusir lagi.

entries.original: "You have no Super Repels left."
entries.translation_source: You have no Super Repels left.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki Pengusir Super
lagi.

entries.original: "You have no Max Repels left"
entries.translation_source: You have no Max Repels left
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki Pengusir Max
lagi

entries.original:
"Would you like to use another
Repel?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to use another Repel?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin menggunakan
Pengusir lain?

entries.original: "AKLOV"
entries.translation_source: AKLOV
entries.translated: AKLOV

entries.original: "It’s a meteor that fell from space..."
entries.translation_source: It’s a meteor that fell from space...
entries.translated:
Itu adalah meteor yang jatuh dari
luar angkasa...

entries.original: "[buffer2] is reacting to the meteorite..."
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] is reacting to the meteorite...
entries.translated:
[buffer2] bereaksi terhadap
meteorit...

entries.original:
"Would you like to bring
the Deoxys in your party

closer to the meteorite?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to bring the Deoxys in your party closer to the meteorite?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin mendekatkan
Deoxys dalam timmu ke meteorit?

entries.original:
"[buffer2] has changed to have
superior stats for attacking!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] has changed to have superior stats for attacking!
entries.translated:
[buffer2] telah berubah memiliki
statistik unggul untuk menyerang!

entries.original:
"[buffer2] has changed to have
superior stats when defending!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] has changed to have superior stats when defending!
entries.translated:
[buffer2] telah berubah memiliki
statistik unggul saat bertahan!

entries.original:
"[buffer2] has changed to have
increased speed!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] has changed to have increased speed!
entries.translated:
[buffer2] telah berubah memiliki
kecepatan meningkat!

entries.original:
"[buffer2] has changed to have
balanced stats!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] has changed to have balanced stats!
entries.translated:
[buffer2] telah berubah memiliki
statistik seimbang!

entries.original:
"The pokémon does not react
to the meteor."
entries.translation_source: The pokémon does not react to the meteor.
entries.translated:
Pokémon tidak bereaksi terhadap
meteor.

entries.original: "[buffer2] changed form!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] changed form!
entries.translated: [buffer2] berubah bentuk!

entries.original: "It wont have any effect!"
entries.translation_source: It wont have any effect!
entries.translated: Itu tidak akan berpengaruh!

entries.original: "[buffer2] changed form!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] changed form!
entries.translated: [buffer2] berubah bentuk!

entries.original: "There is no Kyurem in the party!"
entries.translation_source: There is no Kyurem in the party!
entries.translated: Tidak ada Kyurem di dalam tim!

entries.original: "Multiple fusions are not allowed!"
entries.translation_source: Multiple fusions are not allowed!
entries.translated: Fusi ganda tidak diizinkan!

entries.original: "There is no enough space in the party!"
entries.translation_source: There is no enough space in the party!
entries.translated: Tidak ada cukup ruang di dalam tim!

entries.original:
"Oh? [buffer2] would like to
investigate the motors of\lthe electrical appliances."
entries.translation_source: Oh? [buffer2] would like to investigate the motors of the electrical appliances.
entries.translated:
Oh? [buffer2] ingin menyelidiki
motor-motor dari peralatan listrik.

entries.original: "Is that OK?"
entries.translation_source: Is that OK?
entries.translated: Apakah itu oke?

entries.original: "[buffer2] entered the motors."
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] entered the motors.
entries.translated: [buffer2] memasuki motor-motor.

entries.original: "[buffer2] emerged from the motors."
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] emerged from the motors.
entries.translated: [buffer2] muncul dari motor-motor.

entries.original: "[buffer2] forgot [buffer3]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] forgot [buffer3]!
entries.translated: [buffer2] lupa [buffer3]!

entries.original: "[buffer2] learned [buffer3]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] learned [buffer3]!
entries.translated: [buffer2] belajar [buffer3]!

entries.original:
"[buffer2] is trying to
learn [buffer3].

But, it can’t learn
more than four moves.

Delete a move to make
room for [buffer3]?"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] is trying to learn [buffer3]. But, it can’t learn more than four moves. Delete a move to make room for [buffer3]?
entries.translated:
[buffer2] sedang mencoba mempelajari
[buffer3]. Namun, tidak bisa\lmempelajari lebih dari empat jurus.

Hapus satu jurus untuk memberi
ruang bagi [buffer3]?

entries.original:
"This Rotom has already entered
that appliance motor."
entries.translation_source: This Rotom has already entered that appliance motor.
entries.translated:
Rotom ini sudah memasuki motor alat
listrik itu.

entries.original: "[buffer2] hasn’t entered a motor."
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] hasn’t entered a motor.
entries.translated: [buffer2] belum memasuki motor.

entries.original: "Not a valid Rotom."
entries.translation_source: Not a valid Rotom.
entries.translated: Bukan Rotom yang valid.

entries.original: "[buffer2] changed form!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] changed form!
entries.translated: [buffer2] berubah bentuk!

entries.original: "[buffer2] changed to [darknavyblue]Therian[black] form!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] changed to [darknavyblue]Therian[black] form!
entries.translated:
[buffer2] berubah menjadi bentuk
[darknavyblue]Therian[black]!

entries.original: "[buffer2] changed to [darknavyblue]Incarnate[black] form!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2] changed to [darknavyblue]Incarnate[black] form!
entries.translated:
[buffer2] berubah menjadi bentuk
[darknavyblue]Incarnate[black]!

entries.original:
"It’s full of cardboard boxes with
electrical appliances in them."
entries.translation_source: It’s full of cardboard boxes with electrical appliances in them.
entries.translated:
Itu penuh dengan kotak kardus yang
berisi peralatan listrik.

entries.original: "Hold the [green]B Button [black]to run!"
entries.translation_source: Hold the [green]B Button [black]to run!
entries.translated: Tahan [green]Tombol B [black]untuk lari!

entries.original: "[buffer1] blew away the fog!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] blew away the fog!
entries.translated: [buffer1] meniup kabut!

entries.original:
"[buffer1] used [buffer2]!

But there was no fog to blow
away\."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] used [buffer2]! But there was no fog to blow away\.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] menggunakan [buffer2]! Tapi
tidak ada kabut untuk ditiup\.

entries.original:
"[black]Mom: [red][player]!
Where have you been?

I was really worried about you!

\.

Wow\.

That sounds awfully frightening!
I’m really glad you’re safe now!

Before you do anything else, you
should take a nice, long rest."
entries.translation_source: [black]Mom: [red][player]! Where have you been? I was really worried about you! \. Wow\. That sounds awfully frightening! I’m really glad you’re safe now! Before you do anything else, you should take a nice, long rest.
entries.translated:
[black]Ibu: [red][player]! Kamu dari mana saja?
Aku sangat khawatir padamu! \. Wow\.\lKedengarannya sangat menakutkan!

Aku sangat senang kamu selamat
sekarang! Sebelum melakukan hal\llain, kamu harus istirahat yang

panjang dan nyaman.

entries.original:
"Don’t you feel much better now,
sweetie?

Much more rested to run Prof. Log’s
errand for him!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you feel much better now, sweetie? Much more rested to run Prof. Log’s errand for him!
entries.translated:
Bukankah kamu merasa jauh lebih
baik sekarang, sayang? Jauh lebih\lberistirahat untuk menjalankan

tugas Prof. Log untuknya!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I always knew that day would come
when you would leave home\.

It said so on TV.

If only your father could see you
now\.he’d be so proud!

Well, if you’re going to run
errands for Prof. Log, you’ll need\lthis!"
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. I always knew that day would come when you would leave home\. It said so on TV. If only your father could see you now\.he’d be so proud! Well, if you’re going to run errands for Prof. Log, you’ll need this!
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Aku selalu tahu hari itu akan
tiba saat kamu meninggalkan rumah\.\lItu dikatakan di TV. Seandainya

ayahmu bisa melihatmu sekarang\.dia
pasti sangat bangga! Nah, jika kamu\lakan menjalankan tugas untuk Prof.

Log, kamu akan membutuhkan ini!

entries.original:
"That’s a [green]Quest Log[red] function for
your Super Cube!

It keeps track of anything you’ve
been asked to do!

Oh, and before I forget, you left
a key component of your Super Cube\lon the floor of your room.

I know it wasn’t necessary before,
but now that you have your very\lown Pokémon, you’ll need it if\lyou want to use items in battle."
entries.translation_source: That’s a [green]Quest Log[red] function for your Super Cube! It keeps track of anything you’ve been asked to do! Oh, and before I forget, you left a key component of your Super Cube on the floor of your room. I know it wasn’t necessary before, but now that you have your very own Pokémon, you’ll need it if you want to use items in battle.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah fungsi [green]Quest Log[red] untuk
Super Cube-mu! Ini melacak semua\lyang kamu diminta lakukan! Oh, dan

sebelum aku lupa, kamu meninggalkan
komponen penting dari Super Cube-mu\ldi lantai kamarmu. Aku tahu itu

tidak diperlukan sebelumnya, tetapi
sekarang kamu memiliki Pokémon\lmilikmu sendiri, kamu akan

membutuhkannya jika kamu ingin
menggunakan item dalam pertempuran.

entries.original:
"Just in case you’ve forgotten, the
Super Cube acts just like a bag.

But unlike those cheap bags from
Dalmart that can only hold 42\litems, the Super Cube, or as it’s\lmore commonly known, [green]Cube[red], has an\linfinite amount of space!

It works by digitizing the item’s
data put into it, so essentially,\lit’s like you’re carrying nothing\lextra at all!

Stay safe out there, honey!

Bring Prof. Log his package!"
entries.translation_source: Just in case you’ve forgotten, the Super Cube acts just like a bag. But unlike those cheap bags from Dalmart that can only hold 42 items, the Super Cube, or as it’s more commonly known, [green]Cube[red], has an infinite amount of space! It works by digitizing the item’s data put into it, so essentially, it’s like you’re carrying nothing extra at all! Stay safe out there, honey! Bring Prof. Log his package!
entries.translated:
Untuk jaga-jaga jika kamu lupa,
Super Cube berfungsi seperti tas.\lTapi tidak seperti tas murah dari

Dalmart itu yang hanya bisa
menampung 42 item, Super Cube, atau\lyang lebih dikenal sebagai [green]Cube[red],

memiliki ruang tak terbatas! Cara
kerjanya dengan mendigitalkan data\litem yang dimasukkan ke dalamnya,

jadi pada dasarnya, seperti kamu
tidak membawa beban tambahan sama\lsekali! Tetap aman di luar sana,

sayang! Bawakan Prof. Log paketnya!

entries.original:
"You should visit your [green]mother[blue] before
getting my package, [player].

She is likely very worried
about you."
entries.translation_source: You should visit your [green]mother[blue] before getting my package, [player]. She is likely very worried about you.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus mengunjungi [green]ibumu[blue]
sebelum mengambil paketku,\l[player]. Dia mungkin sangat

khawatir tentangmu.

entries.original:
"Please get my package from the
[green]Bellin Town Poké Mart[blue], [player].

I need it, and only you can get it."
entries.translation_source: Please get my package from the [green]Bellin Town Poké Mart[blue], [player]. I need it, and only you can get it.
entries.translated:
Tolong ambil paketku dari [green]Poké Mart
Bellin Town[blue], [player]. Aku\lmembutuhkannya, dan hanya kamu yang

bisa mendapatkannya.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]!
You returned with my package!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player]! You returned with my package!
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Kamu kembali dengan
paketku!

entries.original: "[player] delivered the parcel."
entries.translation_source: [player] delivered the parcel.
entries.translated:
[player] mengantarkan paket
tersebut.

entries.original:
"Ah!

It’s a shipment from my friend,
Oak, in the Kanto Region!

Let’s see here\.

Poké Balls, Pokédexes, and\.huh?
Where are the Master Balls?

Did you open this package and take
anything from it, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: Ah! It’s a shipment from my friend, Oak, in the Kanto Region! Let’s see here\. Poké Balls, Pokédexes, and\.huh? Where are the Master Balls? Did you open this package and take anything from it, [player]?
entries.translated:
Ah! Ini kiriman dari temanku, Oak,
dari Region Kanto! Mari kita lihat\ldisini\. Bola Poké, Pokédex, dan\.hah?

Di mana Bola Master? Apakah kamu
membuka paket ini dan mengambil\lsesuatu darinya, [player]?

entries.original:
"You did?

Didn’t your mother ever teach you
not to open someone else’s mail?"
entries.translation_source: You did? Didn’t your mother ever teach you not to open someone else’s mail?
entries.translated:
Kamu lakukan? Bukankah ibumu pernah
mengajarimu untuk tidak membuka\lsurat orang lain?

entries.original:
"Then where are my Master Balls?

Clearly, someone was rummaging
about in here!"
entries.translation_source: Then where are my Master Balls? Clearly, someone was rummaging about in here!
entries.translated:
Lalu di mana Bola Masterku? Jelas,
seseorang telah mengobrak-abrik di\lsini!

entries.original:
"\.

Ah\.
I see.

You recovered my package from some
thugs\.

And they must have taken the
Master Balls\.

\."
entries.translation_source: \. Ah\. I see. You recovered my package from some thugs\. And they must have taken the Master Balls\. \.
entries.translated:
\. Ah\. Aku lihat. Kamu mengambil
kembali paketku dari beberapa\lpreman\. Dan mereka pasti telah

mengambil Bola Master\. \.

entries.original:
"What!?

You saw them use one to capture
Articuno?

Hmm\.

If I’m correct, we could be in
grave danger\."
entries.translation_source: What!? You saw them use one to capture Articuno? Hmm\. If I’m correct, we could be in grave danger\.
entries.translated:
Apa!? Kamu melihat mereka
menggunakan satu untuk menangkap\lArticuno? Hmm\. Jika aku benar, kita

bisa berada dalam bahaya besar\.

entries.original:
"I have one more errand for you
to run, [player].

An old friend of mine lives in
[green]Dresco Town[blue].

He’s very knowledgeable in Borrian
history.

I need you to tell him everything
that has transpired so far.

I have a theory about what is going
on, but I need him to confirm it.

You have your own Pokémon now, so
this shouldn’t be too difficult.

You can get to [green]Dresco Town[blue] by going
through [green]Icicle Cave[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I have one more errand for you to run, [player]. An old friend of mine lives in [green]Dresco Town[blue]. He’s very knowledgeable in Borrian history. I need you to tell him everything that has transpired so far. I have a theory about what is going on, but I need him to confirm it. You have your own Pokémon now, so this shouldn’t be too difficult. You can get to [green]Dresco Town[blue] by going through [green]Icicle Cave[blue].
entries.translated:
Aku punya satu tugas lagi untuk
kamu jalankan, [player]. Seorang\lteman lamaku tinggal di [green]Dresco

Town[blue]. Dia sangat berpengetahuan
dalam sejarah Borrian. Aku ingin\lkamu memberitahu dia semua yang

telah terjadi sejauh ini. Aku punya
teori tentang apa yang sedang\lterjadi, tapi aku butuh dia untuk

mengonfirmasinya. Kamu punya
Pokémon milikmu sendiri sekarang,\ljadi ini seharusnya tidak terlalu

sulit. Kamu bisa sampai ke [green]Dresco
Town[blue] dengan melewati [green]Icicle Cave[blue].

entries.original:
"Oh!
Silly me!

How can I expect you to find [green]Icicle
Cave[blue] if you don’t know the way?

This [green]Town Map[blue] should aid you
immensely!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! Silly me! How can I expect you to find [green]Icicle Cave[blue] if you don’t know the way? This [green]Town Map[blue] should aid you immensely!
entries.translated:
Oh! Bodohnya aku! Bagaimana aku
bisa mengharapkan kamu menemukan\l[green]Icicle Cave[blue] jika kamu tidak tahu

jalannya? [green]Town Map[blue] ini seharusnya
sangat membantu kamu!

entries.original:
"And you know what?

If you’re going to Dresco Town, you
should assist me with another task!

My friend, Oak, requested that I
give his Pokédex to two trainers.

It’s some sort of high-tech
encyclopedia for recording Pokémon\ldata.

Apparently, Borrius is known for
having plenty of Pokémon Kanto\ldoes not."
entries.translation_source: And you know what? If you’re going to Dresco Town, you should assist me with another task! My friend, Oak, requested that I give his Pokédex to two trainers. It’s some sort of high-tech encyclopedia for recording Pokémon data. Apparently, Borrius is known for having plenty of Pokémon Kanto does not.
entries.translated:
Dan kamu tahu? Jika kamu pergi ke
Dresco Town, kamu harus membantu\lsaya dengan tugas lain! Temanku,

Oak, meminta saya memberikan
Pokédex-nya kepada dua pelatih. Itu\lsemacam ensiklopedia teknologi

tinggi untuk merekam data Pokémon.
Rupanya, Borrius dikenal memiliki\lbanyak Pokémon yang tidak dimiliki

Kanto.

entries.original:
"You can’t get detailed data on
Pokémon by just seeing them.

You must catch them to obtain
complete data.

So, here are some tools for
catching wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You can’t get detailed data on Pokémon by just seeing them. You must catch them to obtain complete data. So, here are some tools for catching wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak bisa mendapatkan data
detail tentang Pokémon hanya dengan\lmelihat mereka. Kamu harus

menangkap mereka untuk mendapatkan
data lengkap. Jadi, ini adalah\lbeberapa alat untuk menangkap

Pokémon liar.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received 5 Poké Balls
from Log!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received 5 Poké Balls from Log!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima 5 Bola Poké dari
Log!

entries.original:
"If you don’t know how to capture
Wild Pokémon, an old friend of\lmine on Route 1 can show you how."
entries.translation_source: If you don’t know how to capture Wild Pokémon, an old friend of mine on Route 1 can show you how.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu tidak tahu cara menangkap
Pokémon Liar, seorang teman lamaku\ldi Route 1 bisa menunjukkan

caranya.

entries.original:
"Oh!

My memory seems to be going\.I
have one more thing to give you.

Please, the next time you see
[rival], give him this Pokédex."
entries.translation_source: Oh! My memory seems to be going\.I have one more thing to give you. Please, the next time you see [rival], give him this Pokédex.
entries.translated:
Oh! Ingatanku mulai hilang\.Aku punya
satu hal lagi untuk diberikan\lkepadamu. Tolong, lain kali kamu

melihat [rival], berikan dia
Pokédex ini.

entries.original:
"He’s been rather cold to me ever
since his parents left him with me\las a child, but he seems to get\lalong fine with you.

I’m sure if you give him the
Pokédex he’d be willing to assist."
entries.translation_source: He’s been rather cold to me ever since his parents left him with me as a child, but he seems to get along fine with you. I’m sure if you give him the Pokédex he’d be willing to assist.
entries.translated:
Dia agak dingin terhadapku sejak
orang tuanya meninggalkannya\ldenganku saat masih kecil, tapi dia

tampaknya akrab denganmu. Aku yakin
jika kamu memberinya Pokédex, dia\lakan bersedia membantu.

entries.original:
"Please visit my friend in [green]Dresco
Town[blue], [player].

I’m counting on you."
entries.translation_source: Please visit my friend in [green]Dresco Town[blue], [player]. I’m counting on you.
entries.translated:
Tolong kunjungi temanku di [green]Dresco
Town[blue], [player]. Aku mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"[player], You need to hurry to
[green]Thundercap Mountain[blue]!

If The Shadows get there before
you, Borrius is doomed!

Head north of town and take the [green]SES
Expressway[blue] far [green]south[blue] to go quickly."
entries.translation_source: [player], You need to hurry to [green]Thundercap Mountain[blue]! If The Shadows get there before you, Borrius is doomed! Head north of town and take the [green]SES Expressway[blue] far [green]south[blue] to go quickly.
entries.translated:
[player], Kamu harus cepat ke
[green]Gunung Thundercap[blue]! Jika The Shadows\lsampai di sana sebelum kamu,

Borrius akan hancur! Pergi ke utara
kota dan ambil [green]Jalan Tol SES[blue] jauh\lke [green]selatan[blue] untuk pergi cepat.

entries.original:
"With Zapdos now in their possesion,
all The Shadows need to do to\lrelease the dark force is bring the\lthree birds to the [green]Ruins of Void[blue].

If they succeed in doing so and
break the seal\.

I don’t even want to think about
it.

Please hurry there with Jax and
make one last attempt to stop them.

The future is in your hands,
[player]!"
entries.translation_source: With Zapdos now in their possesion, all The Shadows need to do to release the dark force is bring the three birds to the [green]Ruins of Void[blue]. If they succeed in doing so and break the seal\. I don’t even want to think about it. Please hurry there with Jax and make one last attempt to stop them. The future is in your hands, [player]!
entries.translated:
Dengan Zapdos sekarang dalam
kepemilikan mereka, yang perlu\ldilakukan The Shadows untuk

melepaskan kekuatan gelap adalah
membawa tiga burung itu ke\l[green]Reruntuhan Void[blue]. Jika mereka

berhasil melakukannya dan
mematahkan segel\. Aku bahkan tidak\lingin memikirkannya. Tolong cepat

ke sana bersama Jax dan lakukan
satu upaya terakhir untuk\lmenghentikan mereka. Masa depan ada

di tanganmu, [player]!

entries.original:
"Now that dark force has been
released, our end is near.

But until then, all we can do is
live our lives normally."
entries.translation_source: Now that dark force has been released, our end is near. But until then, all we can do is live our lives normally.
entries.translated:
Sekarang kekuatan gelap telah
dilepaskan, akhir kita sudah dekat.\lTapi sampai saat itu, yang bisa

kita lakukan hanyalah menjalani
hidup kita secara normal.

entries.original:
"[player]!

You saved Borrius!
You saved us all!

Thank you!

Your father would be proud of you,
Guardian of Borrius."
entries.translation_source: [player]! You saved Borrius! You saved us all! Thank you! Your father would be proud of you, Guardian of Borrius.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu menyelamatkan
Borrius! Kamu menyelamatkan kita\lsemua! Terima kasih! Ayahmu akan

bangga padamu, Pelindung Borrius.

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, [player], I have no
more errands for you to run.

Have you considered taking on the
[green]Pokémon League[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, [player], I have no more errands for you to run. Have you considered taking on the [green]Pokémon League[blue]?
entries.translated:
Sayangnya, [player], aku tidak
punya tugas lagi untukmu. Apakah\lkamu sudah mempertimbangkan untuk

mengikuti [green]Liga Pokémon[blue]?

entries.original: "Long ago\."
entries.translation_source: Long ago\.
entries.translated: Dahulu kala\.

entries.original:
"The Borrius Region was engulfed by
a great war with the Kalos Region.

It was a brutal war, one lasting
many years.

In that time, Kalos managed to
seize the upper hand\."
entries.translation_source: The Borrius Region was engulfed by a great war with the Kalos Region. It was a brutal war, one lasting many years. In that time, Kalos managed to seize the upper hand\.
entries.translated:
Region Borrius dilanda perang besar
dengan Region Kalos. Itu adalah\lperang brutal, berlangsung

bertahun-tahun. Pada saat itu,
Kalos berhasil merebut keunggulan\.

entries.original:
"On the brink of defeat, the Borrian
king summoned a dark force to help\lturn the tides of battle\."
entries.translation_source: On the brink of defeat, the Borrian king summoned a dark force to help turn the tides of battle\.
entries.translated:
Di ambang kekalahan, raja Borrius
memanggil kekuatan gelap untuk\lmembantu membalikkan keadaan

pertempuran\.

entries.original:
"The Kalosian army’s advantage was
lost almost instantly.

As soon as it entered the battlefield,
the dark force used its power to\lcreate portals and transport the\linvading army back to Kalos\."
entries.translation_source: The Kalosian army’s advantage was lost almost instantly. As soon as it entered the battlefield, the dark force used its power to create portals and transport the invading army back to Kalos\.
entries.translated:
Keunggulan pasukan Kalos hilang
hampir seketika. Begitu memasuki\lmedan perang, kekuatan gelap

menggunakan kekuatannya untuk
membuat portal dan memindahkan\lpasukan penyerang kembali ke Kalos\.

entries.original:
"With the foreign army gone, the war
seemed at an end for Borrius.

However, their king, overcome by
his lust for power, sent the Borrian\larmy through the portals as well\."
entries.translation_source: With the foreign army gone, the war seemed at an end for Borrius. However, their king, overcome by his lust for power, sent the Borrian army through the portals as well\.
entries.translated:
Dengan pasukan asing pergi, perang
tampaknya berakhir bagi Borrius.\lNamun, raja mereka, yang diliputi

oleh nafsu kekuasaan, mengirim
pasukan Borrius melalui portal juga\.

entries.original:
"The war continued to rage in Kalos
for several years.

Many more men and Pokémon were
conscripted to fight and inevitably\lmet their end on the battlefield.

One such Pokémon having been a
dear friend of the Kalosian king\."
entries.translation_source: The war continued to rage in Kalos for several years. Many more men and Pokémon were conscripted to fight and inevitably met their end on the battlefield. One such Pokémon having been a dear friend of the Kalosian king\.
entries.translated:
Perang terus berkecamuk di Kalos
selama beberapa tahun. Lebih banyak\lmanusia dan Pokémon yang direkrut

untuk bertempur dan akhirnya
menemui ajal di medan perang. Salah\lsatu Pokémon tersebut adalah teman

dekat raja Kalos\.

entries.original:
"Overcome with grief, the king built a
device to restore it to life, granting\lhimself immortality in the process."
entries.translation_source: Overcome with grief, the king built a device to restore it to life, granting himself immortality in the process.
entries.translated:
Diliputi kesedihan, raja membangun
sebuah perangkat untuk\lmenghidupkannya kembali, memberikan

dirinya keabadian dalam prosesnya.

entries.original:
"But this traumatic event left him
scarred and filled with anger.

Unable to forgive the world that
had hurt his precious Pokémon, he\lturned his machine into a giant\lweapon, the Ultimate Weapon.

The king became a bringer of
destruction that ended the war."
entries.translation_source: But this traumatic event left him scarred and filled with anger. Unable to forgive the world that had hurt his precious Pokémon, he turned his machine into a giant weapon, the Ultimate Weapon. The king became a bringer of destruction that ended the war.
entries.translated:
Tapi peristiwa traumatis ini
membuatnya terluka dan dipenuhi\lkemarahan. Tidak bisa memaafkan

dunia yang telah menyakiti Pokémon
kesayangannya, dia mengubah\lmesinnya menjadi senjata raksasa,

Senjata Pamungkas. Raja menjadi
pembawa kehancuran yang mengakhiri\lperang.

entries.original:
"With the war over, what little
remained of the Borrian army\lreturned home.

The king’s Pokémon left him, and
the battlefield became silent\."
entries.translation_source: With the war over, what little remained of the Borrian army returned home. The king’s Pokémon left him, and the battlefield became silent\.
entries.translated:
Dengan perang berakhir, sedikit
yang tersisa dari pasukan Borrius\lkembali ke rumah. Pokémon raja

meninggalkannya, dan medan perang
menjadi sunyi\.

entries.original: "Yet, peace was still to come."
entries.translation_source: Yet, peace was still to come.
entries.translated:
Namun, perdamaian masih akan
datang.

entries.original:
"The dark force of Borrius wanted
compensation for its help.

When the king had nothing to offer
it, the dark force was enraged.

It began to destroy countless
cities and towns for sport."
entries.translation_source: The dark force of Borrius wanted compensation for its help. When the king had nothing to offer it, the dark force was enraged. It began to destroy countless cities and towns for sport.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan gelap Borrius menginginkan
kompensasi atas bantuannya. Ketika\lraja tidak memiliki apa pun untuk

ditawarkan, kekuatan gelap menjadi
marah. Ia mulai menghancurkan\lbanyak kota dan desa untuk

bersenang-senang.

entries.original:
"In an effort to stop its madness,
the Borrian king gathered the\llegendary Pokémon:"
entries.translation_source: In an effort to stop its madness, the Borrian king gathered the legendary Pokémon:
entries.translated:
Dalam upaya menghentikan
kegilaannya, raja Borrius\lmengumpulkan Pokémon legendaris:

entries.original:
"Using the power of the three birds
combined with a divine bottle given\lto him by Arceus, creator of all\lPokémon, the dark force was bound."
entries.translation_source: Using the power of the three birds combined with a divine bottle given to him by Arceus, creator of all Pokémon, the dark force was bound.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan kekuatan tiga burung
yang digabungkan dengan botol ilahi\lyang diberikan kepadanya oleh

Arceus, pencipta semua Pokémon,
kekuatan gelap terikat.

entries.original:
"It became a shadow of its former
self."
entries.translation_source: It became a shadow of its former self.
entries.translated:
Ia menjadi bayangan dari dirinya
yang dulu.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until one, fateful day\."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until one, fateful day\.
entries.translated:
Dicabut dari kekuatannya, ia
diambil oleh raja, dan diawasi oleh\lketurunannya, hingga suatu hari

yang menentukan\.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until this very day."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until this very day.
entries.translated:
Dicabut dari kekuatannya, ia
diambil oleh raja, dan diawasi oleh\lketurunannya, hingga hari ini juga.

entries.original: "            16 Years Ago"
entries.translation_source: 16 Years Ago
entries.translated: 16 Tahun Lalu

entries.original: "             Elsewhere"
entries.translation_source: Elsewhere
entries.translated: Di Tempat Lain

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Arceus\.

I can’t go on like this\."
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Arceus\. I can’t go on like this\.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Arceus\. Aku tidak bisa terus
seperti ini\.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon\.

I know it’s my duty to watch over
it, but where I’m headed, it\lcannot go!"
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon\. I know it’s my duty to watch over it, but where I’m headed, it cannot go!
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini\. Aku tahu itu tugasku
untuk mengawasinya, tapi ke mana\laku pergi, ia tidak bisa pergi!

entries.original:
"I know I told him that using its
power would be a bad idea, but I\lworry that soon, he’ll no longer\llisten to me\."
entries.translation_source: I know I told him that using its power would be a bad idea, but I worry that soon, he’ll no longer listen to me\.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu aku mengatakan padanya
bahwa menggunakan kekuatannya akan\lmenjadi ide yang buruk, tapi aku

khawatir bahwa segera, dia tidak
akan lagi mendengarkan aku\.

entries.original: "And that’s why I need to do this!"
entries.translation_source: And that’s why I need to do this!
entries.translated:
Dan itulah mengapa aku perlu
melakukan ini!

entries.original: "It’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: It’s gone\.
entries.translated: Ia hilang\.

entries.original:
"Now it’s time for you to go too,
Arceus\.

I don’t want you around for what
will happen next\.

Just promise me one thing\.

Please, watch over my child\."
entries.translation_source: Now it’s time for you to go too, Arceus\. I don’t want you around for what will happen next\. Just promise me one thing\. Please, watch over my child\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang waktunya bagimu untuk
pergi juga, Arceus\. Aku tidak ingin\lkamu ada di sini untuk apa yang

akan terjadi selanjutnya\. Janjikan
aku satu hal\. Tolong, jaga anakku\.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]ARGH!

How can I fulfill Grampy’s wish if I
can’t even catch a single Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]ARGH! How can I fulfill Grampy’s wish if I can’t even catch a single Pokémon!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]ARGH! Bagaimana aku bisa
memenuhi keinginan Grampy jika aku\lbahkan tidak bisa menangkap satu

Pokémon pun!

entries.original:
"[blue]I promised Grampy I’d eradicate the
root of the suffering, but at this\lpoint, I don’t see how that’ll\leven be possible!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I promised Grampy I’d eradicate the root of the suffering, but at this point, I don’t see how that’ll even be possible!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku berjanji pada Grampy aku akan
memberantas akar penderitaan, tapi\lpada titik ini, aku tidak melihat

bagaimana itu mungkin!

entries.original:
"[blue]Please, Arceus!

If you’re real, give me a sign that
everything will work out!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Please, Arceus! If you’re real, give me a sign that everything will work out!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tolong, Arceus! Jika kamu nyata,
beri aku tanda bahwa semuanya akan\lberhasil!

entries.original:
"[blue]A Poké Ball? Here? Now?

Arceus is real after all\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]A Poké Ball? Here? Now? Arceus is real after all\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sebuah Poké Ball? Di sini?
Sekarang? Arceus benar-benar nyata\.

entries.original: "[blue]This Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]This Pokémon\.
entries.translated: [blue]Pokémon ini\.

entries.original: "[green]Hoo...pa\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoo...pa\.
entries.translated: [green]Hoo...pa\.

entries.original:
"[blue]It appears, Grampy, that there may
be a way after all\.

It’s time for the eternal flower to
bloom, once more\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]It appears, Grampy, that there may be a way after all\. It’s time for the eternal flower to bloom, once more\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Tampaknya, Grampy, mungkin ada
jalan setelah semua\. Saatnya bagi\lbunga abadi untuk mekar, sekali

lagi\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, young [buffer1]!
What can I do for you?

\.

\.

Ah, so Log sent you.

I hope I can shed a little light on
what is bothering him.

Are you well versed in Borrian
history?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, young [buffer1]! What can I do for you? \. \. Ah, so Log sent you. I hope I can shed a little light on what is bothering him. Are you well versed in Borrian history?
entries.translated:
Halo, [buffer1] muda! Ada yang bisa
saya bantu? \. \. Ah, jadi Log yang\lmengirimmu. Saya harap saya bisa

menjelaskan sedikit tentang apa
yang mengganggunya. Apakah kamu\lpaham tentang sejarah Borrian?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
Is that so\.

There is a special airing on the
television right now, that could\ljog your memory."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. Is that so\. There is a special airing on the television right now, that could jog your memory.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Begitu ya\. Ada tayangan khusus
di televisi sekarang, yang bisa\lmengingatkanmu.

entries.original:
"Excellent.

Then, as you know, the dark force
of Borrius was sealed away, many\lyears ago.

But it is said that if the three
legendary Pokémon used to seal it\laway are brought back together at\lthe [green]Ruins of Void[blue], the power can be\lreleased once again.

This must be what those thugs you
encountered are after.

They must want to engulf Borrius in
shadows once again.

If I’m right, then their next
target will be\."
entries.translation_source: Excellent. Then, as you know, the dark force of Borrius was sealed away, many years ago. But it is said that if the three legendary Pokémon used to seal it away are brought back together at the [green]Ruins of Void[blue], the power can be released once again. This must be what those thugs you encountered are after. They must want to engulf Borrius in shadows once again. If I’m right, then their next target will be\.
entries.translated:
Bagus. Lalu, seperti yang kamu
tahu, kekuatan gelap Borrius\ldisegel, bertahun-tahun yang lalu.

Tapi dikatakan bahwa jika tiga
Pokémon legendaris yang digunakan\luntuk menyegelnya dikumpulkan

kembali di [green]Ruins of Void[blue], kekuatan
itu bisa dilepaskan lagi. Ini pasti\lyang dikejar oleh para preman yang

kamu temui. Mereka pasti ingin
menyelimuti Borrius dalam kegelapan\lsekali lagi. Jika aku benar, maka

target mereka selanjutnya adalah\.

entries.original: "???: [blue]Grampa Arthur! "
entries.translation_source: ???: [blue]Grampa Arthur!
entries.translated: ???: [blue]Kakek Arthur!

entries.original: "Arthur: [blue]What’s wrong, Jax?"
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [blue]What’s wrong, Jax?
entries.translated: Arthur: [blue]Ada apa, Jax?

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]I just saw those guys in black
heading in the direction of\l[green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]I just saw those guys in black heading in the direction of [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Aku baru saja melihat
orang-orang berbaju hitam menuju ke\larah [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]I was just telling
[player], here, about their\lpossible aim, but this\lconfirms my suspicions.

They are going after the Legendary
bird Pokémon, [green]Moltres[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [blue]I was just telling [player], here, about their possible aim, but this confirms my suspicions. They are going after the Legendary bird Pokémon, [green]Moltres[blue].
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Aku baru saja memberi tahu
[player], di sini, tentang\lkemungkinan tujuan mereka, tapi ini

mengonfirmasi kecurigaanku. Mereka
mengejar Pokémon burung legendaris,\l[green]Moltres[blue].

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Should I try and stop them?"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Should I try and stop them?
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Haruskah aku mencoba
menghentikan mereka?

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Not yet, Jax.

I need you to first fly to Frozen
Heights and bring Prof. Log here."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [blue]Not yet, Jax. I need you to first fly to Frozen Heights and bring Prof. Log here.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Belum, Jax. Aku perlu kamu
pertama-tama terbang ke Frozen\lHeights dan bawa Prof. Log ke sini.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Right away, Grampa!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Right away, Grampa!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Baik, Kakek!

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Hmm\.

So it is as bad as I feared\.

What do you think should be done
about this, Arthur?"
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]Hmm\. So it is as bad as I feared\. What do you think should be done about this, Arthur?
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Hmm\. Jadi ini seburuk yang aku
khawatirkan\. Menurutmu apa yang\lharus dilakukan tentang ini,

Arthur?

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]I think Jax is capable of
solving this problem.

He has proven himself at this
point.

I was planning on sending him to
confront these \qoShadows\qc and stop\lthem before they reach Moltres."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [blue]I think Jax is capable of solving this problem. He has proven himself at this point. I was planning on sending him to confront these \qoShadows\qc and stop them before they reach Moltres.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Kurasa Jax mampu
menyelesaikan masalah ini. Dia\lsudah membuktikan dirinya saat ini.

Aku berencana mengirimnya untuk
menghadapi \qoShadows\qc ini dan\lmenghentikan mereka sebelum

mencapai Moltres.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Of course.

I’m sure the police are already on
their way, but his assistance could\lbe invaluble to them."
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]Of course. I’m sure the police are already on their way, but his assistance could be invaluble to them.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Tentu saja. Aku yakin polisi
sudah dalam perjalanan, tapi\lbantuannya bisa sangat berharga

bagi mereka.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Understood, Grampa.

I’m heading out.

I’ll stop them and save Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [blue]Understood, Grampa. I’m heading out. I’ll stop them and save Moltres!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Dimengerti, Kakek. Aku akan
berangkat. Aku akan menghentikan\lmereka dan menyelamatkan Moltres!

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Well, [player], I think it
is time for you to head home.

You’ve completed your errand, and
I’m sure your mother misses you."
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]Well, [player], I think it is time for you to head home. You’ve completed your errand, and I’m sure your mother misses you.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Nah, [player], kurasa sudah
waktunya kamu pulang. Kamu sudah\lmenyelesaikan tugasmu, dan aku

yakin ibumu merindukanmu.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Now, wait just a minute,
Log.

I’m sure [player] could gain some
valuable experience watching Jax\ltake on The Shadows.

I think you should let [buffer1] go."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [blue]Now, wait just a minute, Log. I’m sure [player] could gain some valuable experience watching Jax take on The Shadows. I think you should let [buffer1] go.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Tunggu sebentar, Log. Aku
yakin [player] bisa mendapatkan\lpengalaman berharga dengan melihat

Jax melawan The Shadows. Kurasa
kamu harus membiarkan [buffer1]\lpergi.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Hmm\.

Maybe you’re right.

If [buffer2] gains experience, I can send
[buffer1] on more complicated errands\."
entries.translation_source: Log: [blue]Hmm\. Maybe you’re right. If [buffer2] gains experience, I can send [buffer1] on more complicated errands\.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Hmm\. Mungkin kamu benar. Jika
[buffer2] mendapat pengalaman, aku\lbisa mengirim [buffer1] untuk tugas

yang lebih rumit\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Alright, [player], I think you
should follow Jax.

I’ll tell your mother you’ll be a
while.

I’m sure she’ll be fine with it."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Alright, [player], I think you should follow Jax. I’ll tell your mother you’ll be a while. I’m sure she’ll be fine with it.
entries.translated:
[blue]Baiklah, [player], kurasa kamu
harus mengikuti Jax. Aku akan\lmemberi tahu ibumu bahwa kamu akan

agak lama. Aku yakin dia akan
baik-baik saja dengan itu.

entries.original:
"Head to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] and watch
Jax save [green]Moltres[blue].

You could gain some valauable
experience that way."
entries.translation_source: Head to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] and watch Jax save [green]Moltres[blue]. You could gain some valauable experience that way.
entries.translated:
Pergi ke [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] dan
saksikan Jax menyelamatkan [green]Moltres[blue].\lKamu bisa mendapatkan pengalaman

berharga dengan cara itu.

entries.original:
"We’re running out of time,
[player].

You need to hurry to [green]Thundercap
Mountain[blue] and save [green]Zapdos[blue]!

If it’s captured too, we’ll all be
doomed\."
entries.translation_source: We’re running out of time, [player]. You need to hurry to [green]Thundercap Mountain[blue] and save [green]Zapdos[blue]! If it’s captured too, we’ll all be doomed\.
entries.translated:
Kita kehabisan waktu, [player].
Kamu harus cepat ke [green]Thundercap\lMountain[blue] dan menyelamatkan [green]Zapdos[blue]!

Jika ia juga ditangkap, kita semua
akan binasa\.

entries.original:
"With all three legendary Pokémon
in their grasp, The Shadows are\lonly momemnts away from releasing\lthe dark force.

Jax is in [green]Dehara City[blue] waiting to
take you to the [green]Ruins of Void[blue] and\lstop The Shadows from carrying out\ltheir plan."
entries.translation_source: With all three legendary Pokémon in their grasp, The Shadows are only momemnts away from releasing the dark force. Jax is in [green]Dehara City[blue] waiting to take you to the [green]Ruins of Void[blue] and stop The Shadows from carrying out their plan.
entries.translated:
Dengan ketiga Pokémon legendaris
dalam genggaman mereka, The Shadows\lhanya berjarak beberapa momen dari

melepaskan kekuatan gelap. Jax
berada di [green]Dehara City[blue] menunggu\luntuk membawamu ke [green]Ruins of Void[blue]

dan menghentikan The Shadows
menjalankan rencana mereka.

entries.original:
"So, the dark force has been
released\.

If it isn’t stopped, it could
destroy the whole region!

You must find Jax and seal it away
once more!"
entries.translation_source: So, the dark force has been released\. If it isn’t stopped, it could destroy the whole region! You must find Jax and seal it away once more!
entries.translated:
Jadi, kekuatan gelap telah
dilepaskan\. Jika tidak dihentikan,\lia bisa menghancurkan seluruh

wilayah! Kamu harus menemukan Jax
dan menyegelnya lagi!

entries.original:
"You did it!

You defeated the Light of Ruin and
saved us!

You are a true Guardian of Borrius!

Your father would be proud."
entries.translation_source: You did it! You defeated the Light of Ruin and saved us! You are a true Guardian of Borrius! Your father would be proud.
entries.translated:
Kamu berhasil! Kamu mengalahkan
Light of Ruin dan menyelamatkan\lkami! Kamu adalah Penjaga Borrius

sejati! Ayahmu pasti bangga.

entries.original:
"Now that everything is at peace
once more, why don’t you take on\lthe [green]Pokémon League[blue]?

I’m sure someone with your skill
could easily become the champion."
entries.translation_source: Now that everything is at peace once more, why don’t you take on the [green]Pokémon League[blue]? I’m sure someone with your skill could easily become the champion.
entries.translated:
Sekarang semuanya sudah damai
kembali, mengapa kamu tidak mencoba\l[green]Liga Pokémon[blue]? Saya yakin seseorang

dengan kemampuan sepertimu bisa
dengan mudah menjadi Juara.

entries.original: "How go your travels, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: How go your travels, [player]?
entries.translated: Bagaimana perjalananmu, [player]?

entries.original:
"Welcome to Pokémon Unbound!

Before you begin playing, please
be aware that this is a non-profit
fan game.

If you paid for this game, reclaim
your money immediately!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to Pokémon Unbound! Before you begin playing, please be aware that this is a non-profit fan game. If you paid for this game, reclaim your money immediately!
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Pokémon Unbound!
Sebelum mulai bermain, harap sadari
bahwa ini adalah game buatan

penggemar non-profit. Jika kamu
membayar untuk game ini, segera
klaim kembali uangmu!

entries.original:
"With that in mind, you are almost
ready to enter the Borrius Region!
But first\."
entries.translation_source: With that in mind, you are almost ready to enter the Borrius Region! But first\.
entries.translated:
Dengan begitu, kamu hampir siap
memasuki Wilayah Borrius! Tapi
pertama-tama\.

entries.original:
"Last, but not least, what is your
name?"
entries.translation_source: Last, but not least, what is your name?
entries.translated:
Terakhir, tapi tidak kalah penting,
siapa namamu?

entries.original: "Your name is [player]?"
entries.translation_source: Your name is [player]?
entries.translated: Namamu [player]?

entries.original: "             Present Day"
entries.translation_source: Present Day
entries.translated: Hari Ini

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Mission HQ!

This is your first time here, isn’t
it?

Then, tell me, do you know about
[green]Missions[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Mission HQ! This is your first time here, isn’t it? Then, tell me, do you know about [green]Missions[blue]?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Mission HQ! Ini
pertama kalinya kamu di sini,\lbukan? Kalau begitu, beri tahu aku,

apakah kamu tahu tentang [green]Misi[blue]?

entries.original:
"Of course you do!
Who doesn’t?

But\.

Just in case your absentmindedly
saying yes, allow me to give a\lformal explanation."
entries.translation_source: Of course you do! Who doesn’t? But\. Just in case your absentmindedly saying yes, allow me to give a formal explanation.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja kamu tahu! Siapa yang
tidak? Tapi\. Untuk jaga-jaga jika\lkamu dengan linglung mengatakan ya,

izinkan aku memberikan penjelasan
resmi.

entries.original:
"I see\.

Well, then in that case, allow me
to give a formal explanation."
entries.translation_source: I see\. Well, then in that case, allow me to give a formal explanation.
entries.translated:
Begitu ya\. Baiklah, kalau begitu,
izinkan aku memberikan penjelasan\lresmi.

entries.original:
"A Mission is an extra objective you
receive by accepting a request for\lhelp.

Many people out there are unable to
solve their own problems and\lrequire assistance from others.

Once you accept the Mission, the
details are automatically recorded\lin the Quest Log.

Missions can often yield great
rewards, be it items, money, or\leven new areas to explore.

If someone requests a Mission from
you, accept it immediately.

Even if you have no intention of
completing it right away, there’s\lno harm in having it registered in\lyour Quest Log.

With that being said, there are
several people here in need of\lassistance.

Look around and see if there’s
anyone you’d like to help!

And come see me when you’ve
completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: A Mission is an extra objective you receive by accepting a request for help. Many people out there are unable to solve their own problems and require assistance from others. Once you accept the Mission, the details are automatically recorded in the Quest Log. Missions can often yield great rewards, be it items, money, or even new areas to explore. If someone requests a Mission from you, accept it immediately.
