Even if you have no intention of completing it right away, there’s no harm in having it registered in your Quest Log. With that being said, there are several people here in need of assistance. Look around and see if there’s anyone you’d like to help! And come see me when you’ve completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions.
entries.translated:
Misi adalah tujuan tambahan yang
kamu terima dengan menerima\lpermintaan bantuan. Banyak orang di

luar sana tidak dapat menyelesaikan
masalah mereka sendiri dan\lmembutuhkan bantuan dari orang

lain. Setelah kamu menerima Misi,
detailnya secara otomatis tercatat\ldi Log Misi. Misi sering kali

memberikan hadiah besar, baik itu
item, uang, atau bahkan area baru\luntuk dijelajahi. Jika seseorang

meminta Misi darimu, terimalah
segera. Meskipun kamu tidak berniat\lmenyelesaikannya saat ini, tidak

ada salahnya mendaftarkannya di Log
Misi. Dengan demikian, ada beberapa\lorang di sini yang membutuhkan

bantuan. Lihatlah sekeliling dan
lihat apakah ada seseorang yang\lingin kamu bantu! Dan temui aku

setelah kamu menyelesaikan
setidaknya [green]5[blue] Misi.

entries.original:
"Come see me when you’ve completed
at least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: Come see me when you’ve completed at least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions.
entries.translated:
Temui aku setelah kamu
menyelesaikan setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]\lMisi.

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ve completed at
least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions!

For that, you get\.

[buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ve completed at least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions! For that, you get\. [buffer2]!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu telah menyelesaikan
setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] Misi! Untuk\litu, kamu mendapatkan\. [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"I’ve given you all I can give!
You’ve exceeded my expectations!

Any Missions you complete now will
just have to count for bonus."
entries.translation_source: I’ve given you all I can give! You’ve exceeded my expectations! Any Missions you complete now will just have to count for bonus.
entries.translated:
Aku sudah memberikan semua yang
bisa kuberikan! Kamu telah\lmelampaui ekspektasiku! Misi apa

pun yang kamu selesaikan sekarang
hanya akan dihitung sebagai bonus.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any space left in
your party or PC for this Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any space left in your party or PC for this Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki ruang tersisa
di tim atau PC untuk Pokémon ini!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Man, you’re only leaving
Dehara City now?

You sure are slow!

Well, while you were loitering
around, I figured out how to get\lto the Ruins of Void.

But by the time I got over there,
it was too late to do anything.

Whatever The Shadows were planning,
they’d already done.

There were some signs of a battle
in the main room and a strange pile\lof ashes on the floor.

Maybe it was used in some sort of
ritual?

\.

\.

What!?

That’s insane!

You died and came back to life!?"
entries.translation_source: [rival]: [blue]Man, you’re only leaving Dehara City now? You sure are slow! Well, while you were loitering around, I figured out how to get to the Ruins of Void. But by the time I got over there, it was too late to do anything. Whatever The Shadows were planning, they’d already done. There were some signs of a battle in the main room and a strange pile of ashes on the floor. Maybe it was used in some sort of ritual? \. \. What!? That’s insane! You died and came back to life!?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Bung, kamu baru
meninggalkan Dehara City sekarang?\lKamu benar-benar lamban! Nah, saat

kamu berkeliaran, aku menemukan
cara menuju ke Ruins of Void. Tapi\lketika aku sampai di sana, sudah

entries.original: "[green]Dodogyuuun!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Dodogyuuun!
entries.translated: [green]Dodogyuuun!

entries.original: "[buffer1] vanished."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] vanished.
entries.translated: [buffer1] menghilang.

entries.original:
"This is Antisis City!

It’s the antithesis of bliss!"
entries.translation_source: This is Antisis City! It’s the antithesis of bliss!
entries.translated:
Ini adalah Antisis City! Ini adalah
antitesis dari kebahagiaan!

entries.original:
"The Black Ferrothorn was the
roughest and toughest gang in town\luntil we showed up!

The Black [player]!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Ferrothorn was the roughest and toughest gang in town until we showed up! The Black [player]!
entries.translated:
Black Ferrothorn adalah geng paling
kasar dan paling tangguh di kota\lsampai kami muncul! The Black

[player]!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
We own this town!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! We own this town!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Ferrothorn! Kami
memiliki kota ini!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
Stay out of our way!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! Stay out of our way!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Ferrothorn!
Jangan halangi kami!

entries.original:
"What do you think you’re doin’,
huh, kid?

This is Black Ferrothorn turf!
You’re not welcome here!"
entries.translation_source: What do you think you’re doin’, huh, kid? This is Black Ferrothorn turf! You’re not welcome here!
entries.translated:
Apa yang kamu lakukan, hah, nak?
Ini wilayah Black Ferrothorn! Kamu\ltidak diterima di sini!

entries.original:
"Hey!
What’s goin’ on in there?

You think it’s funny to lock me
out? Huh?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! What’s goin’ on in there? You think it’s funny to lock me out? Huh?
entries.translated:
Hei! Ada apa di dalam sana? Kamu
pikir lucu mengunciku di luar? Hah?

entries.original:
"It’s too scary to go into the city\.

There are bad people everywhere!"
entries.translation_source: It’s too scary to go into the city\. There are bad people everywhere!
entries.translated:
Terlalu menakutkan untuk masuk ke
kota\. Ada orang jahat di mana-mana!

entries.original:
"I came here with my grandson to
show him the city I grew up in, but\lhe’s much too afraid to enter it.

Sometime after I moved away, it was
overrun by hoodlums."
entries.translation_source: I came here with my grandson to show him the city I grew up in, but he’s much too afraid to enter it. Sometime after I moved away, it was overrun by hoodlums.
entries.translated:
Saya datang ke sini dengan cucu
saya untuk menunjukkan kepadanya\lkota tempat saya dibesarkan, tetapi

dia terlalu takut untuk
memasukinya. Beberapa waktu setelah\lsaya pindah, kota itu dikuasai oleh

preman.

entries.original:
"I can’t believe it\.

The legend\.\CC0820 the conquerer\.\CC0820
[player]!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t believe it\. The legend\.\CC0820 the conquerer\.\CC0820 [player]!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak percaya\. Legenda\.\CC0820 sang
penakluk\.\CC0820 [player]!

entries.original:
"  VROOM   VROOM

The Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: VROOM VROOM The Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated: VROOM VROOM The Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"I’m a member of the Black
Ferrothorn!

Stare at me too long and I’ll
poke you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m a member of the Black Ferrothorn! Stare at me too long and I’ll poke you!
entries.translated:
Saya adalah anggota Black
Ferrothorn! Jika kamu menatapku\lterlalu lama, aku akan menusukmu!

entries.original:
"Those Black [player] always gettin’
in the way\.

Hey!
Quit starin’!"
entries.translation_source: Those Black [player] always gettin’ in the way\. Hey! Quit starin’!
entries.translated:
Black [player] itu selalu
menghalangi\. Hei! Berhenti menatap!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
Ain’t nobody ever takin’ us down!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! Ain’t nobody ever takin’ us down!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Ferrothorn! Tidak
ada yang pernah mengalahkan kami!

entries.original:
"We just booted the old gang around
here outta town!

We’re set to rule it, now!
We’re the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: We just booted the old gang around here outta town! We’re set to rule it, now! We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Kami baru saja mengusir geng lama
di sini keluar kota! Kami siap\luntuk memerintahnya sekarang! Kami

adalah Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"One day, we’re gonna boot those
Black [player] right outta town\.

Hey!
Quit starin’!"
entries.translation_source: One day, we’re gonna boot those Black [player] right outta town\. Hey! Quit starin’!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, kami akan mengusir
Black [player] itu keluar kota\. Hei!\lBerhenti menatap!

entries.original:
"We just booted the new gang around
here outta town!

The Black [player] is gone forever!
We’re the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: We just booted the new gang around here outta town! The Black [player] is gone forever! We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Kami baru saja mengusir geng baru
di sini keluar kota! Black [player]\ltelah pergi selamanya! Kami adalah

Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original: "The trash bin is empty."
entries.translation_source: The trash bin is empty.
entries.translated: Tempat sampah kosong.

entries.original:
"It’s a dumpster.
Open it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a dumpster. Open it?
entries.translated: Itu adalah tong sampah. Buka?

entries.original: "The dumpster is empty."
entries.translation_source: The dumpster is empty.
entries.translated: Dumpster kosong.

entries.original:
"There is a Pokémon feeding on the
garbage in the dumpster.

The Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: There is a Pokémon feeding on the garbage in the dumpster. The Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
Ada seekor Pokémon yang sedang
memakan sampah di dalam dumpster.\lPokémon itu menyerang!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] dug deeper into
the dumpster."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] dug deeper into the dumpster.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] menggali lebih dalam ke
dalam dumpster.

entries.original:
"Some words are crossed out.

It appears to read now:
Black [player] HQ"
entries.translation_source: Some words are crossed out. It appears to read now: Black [player] HQ
entries.translated:
Beberapa kata dicoret. Tampaknya
sekarang terbaca: Black [player] HQ

entries.original:
"The words are faded.

It appears to read:
Black [player] HQ"
entries.translation_source: The words are faded. It appears to read: Black [player] HQ
entries.translated:
Kata-katanya pudar. Tampaknya
terbaca: Black [player] HQ

entries.original:
"The words are faded.

It appears to read:
Terror Granbull HQ"
entries.translation_source: The words are faded. It appears to read: Terror Granbull HQ
entries.translated:
Kata-katanya pudar. Tampaknya
terbaca: Terror Granbull HQ

entries.original:
"It’s full of cardboard boxes with
electrical appliances in them."
entries.translation_source: It’s full of cardboard boxes with electrical appliances in them.
entries.translated:
Penuh dengan kotak karton berisi
alat-alat listrik.

entries.original:
"Oh? [buffer1] would like to
investigate the motors of\lthe electrical appliances."
entries.translation_source: Oh? [buffer1] would like to investigate the motors of the electrical appliances.
entries.translated:
Oh? [buffer1] ingin menyelidiki
motor-motor dari alat-alat listrik\ltersebut.

entries.original:
"Which appliance’s motor should
[buffer1] enter?"
entries.translation_source: Which appliance’s motor should [buffer1] enter?
entries.translated:
Motor alat mana yang harus dimasuki
[buffer1]?

entries.original: "[buffer1] entered the motor."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] entered the motor.
entries.translated: [buffer1] masuk ke dalam motor.

entries.original: "Which move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Which move should be forgotten?
entries.translated: Gerakan mana yang harus dilupakan?

entries.original: "[buffer1] emerged from the motor."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] emerged from the motor.
entries.translated: [buffer1] muncul dari dalam motor.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] didn’t learn
[buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] didn’t learn [buffer2].
entries.translated:
[buffer1] tidak mempelajari
[buffer2].

entries.original: "[buffer1] is already in this motor."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] is already in this motor.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] sudah berada di dalam
motor ini.

entries.original: "[buffer1] is not in this motor."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] is not in this motor.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] tidak berada di dalam
motor ini.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Antisis City
Police HQ!

Well\. actually, now it’s just
my home.

Ever since the gangs\.\CC0818 er\.\CC0818
\qorequested\qc that we leave, the\lpolice force around here has been\lbasically nonexistent.

And you can see what that has
led to.

Total anarchy and lawlessness."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Antisis City Police HQ! Well\. actually, now it’s just my home. Ever since the gangs\.\CC0818 er\.\CC0818 \qorequested\qc that we leave, the police force around here has been basically nonexistent. And you can see what that has led to. Total anarchy and lawlessness.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Markas Polisi
Antisis City! Yah\. sebenarnya,\lsekarang ini hanya rumahku. Sejak

geng-geng\.\CC0818 eh\.\CC0818 \qomeminta\qc kami pergi,
kepolisian di sini pada dasarnya\ltidak ada. Dan kau bisa lihat apa

yang terjadi. Anarki total dan
tanpa hukum.

entries.original:
"It’s great to see someone your age
pursuing the healthy career of\lPokémon Trainer.

You’ve made a much better choice
than by joining a gang.

Trust me, I know.

I see what goes on around here.
You want no part in that."
entries.translation_source: It’s great to see someone your age pursuing the healthy career of Pokémon Trainer. You’ve made a much better choice than by joining a gang. Trust me, I know. I see what goes on around here. You want no part in that.
entries.translated:
Senang melihat seseorang seusiamu
mengejar karir sehat sebagai\lPelatih Pokémon. Kau telah membuat

pilihan yang jauh lebih baik
daripada bergabung dengan geng.\lPercayalah, aku tahu. Aku lihat apa

yang terjadi di sini. Kau tidak mau
terlibat dalam itu.

entries.original:
"It’s a shame that someone your age
is part of a gang.

You could’ve had so much potential,
but now, you have none at all."
entries.translation_source: It’s a shame that someone your age is part of a gang. You could’ve had so much potential, but now, you have none at all.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali seseorang seusiamu
menjadi bagian dari geng. Kau bisa\lmemiliki begitu banyak potensi,

tapi sekarang, kau tidak punya sama
sekali.

entries.original:
"It’s been almost\.\CC0818 too calm lately.

I just can’t take it, anymore!

I think I need some\.\CC0818 some sort of
[green]eerie pulse[blue] to shake the nerves\."
entries.translation_source: It’s been almost\.\CC0818 too calm lately. I just can’t take it, anymore! I think I need some\.\CC0818 some sort of [green]eerie pulse[blue] to shake the nerves\.
entries.translated:
Akhir-akhir ini hampir\.\CC0818 terlalu
tenang. Aku sudah tidak tahan lagi!\lKurasa aku butuh semacam\.\CC0818 semacam

[green]denyut misterius[blue] untuk menenangkan
saraf\.

entries.original:
"Your [buffer1] has just given me
the chills!

Its Eerie Impulse sure brings back
memories from the days when I was\la Bird Keeper.

The power of Electric-types was
what inspired me to change which\lkind of Pokémon I trained.

Since I have no more use for this,
I want you to have it."
entries.translation_source: Your [buffer1] has just given me the chills! Its Eerie Impulse sure brings back memories from the days when I was a Bird Keeper. The power of Electric-types was what inspired me to change which kind of Pokémon I trained. Since I have no more use for this, I want you to have it.
entries.translated:
[buffer1]mu baru saja membuatku
merinding! Dengung Misteriusnya\lpasti membangkitkan kenangan dari

masa ketika aku masih menjadi
Penjaga Burung. Kekuatan tipe\lListriklah yang menginspirasiku

untuk mengubah jenis Pokémon yang
aku latih. Karena aku tidak lagi\lmembutuhkan ini, aku ingin kamu

memilikinya.

entries.original:
"[green]Acrobatics[blue] becomes a powerful
attack if your Pokémon isn’t\lholdin’ an item.

It’s not eerie at all, but it’ll
still make Fightin’-types go\lrunnin’ in terror!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Acrobatics[blue] becomes a powerful attack if your Pokémon isn’t holdin’ an item. It’s not eerie at all, but it’ll still make Fightin’-types go runnin’ in terror!
entries.translated:
[green]Acrobatics[blue] menjadi serangan kuat
jika Pokémon-mu tidak memegang\litem. Ini tidak menyeramkan sama

sekali, tapi tetap akan membuat
tipe Petarung lari ketakutan!

entries.original:
"Antisis City is the most
crime-ridden city in Borrius.

However, because of its existence,
most lowlives in the region are\ldrawn here, causing crime rates to\ldecrease everywhere else.

That’s the main reason the police
didn’t fight back after they were\lforcibly expelled during the riots.

They won’t tell you that, though.

In order for Antisis City to keep
on existing as is, the police need\lto feign ignorance to anything\lthat’s not too serious of a crime.

But if anything starts to get out
of hand around here, that’s when\lBig Mo comes in and takes control."
entries.translation_source: Antisis City is the most crime-ridden city in Borrius. However, because of its existence, most lowlives in the region are drawn here, causing crime rates to decrease everywhere else. That’s the main reason the police didn’t fight back after they were forcibly expelled during the riots. They won’t tell you that, though. In order for Antisis City to keep on existing as is, the police need to feign ignorance to anything that’s not too serious of a crime. But if anything starts to get out of hand around here, that’s when Big Mo comes in and takes control.
entries.translated:
Antisis City adalah kota paling
kriminal di Borrius. Namun, karena\lkeberadaannya, sebagian besar

penjahat di wilayah tersebut
tertarik ke sini, menyebabkan\ltingkat kejahatan menurun di tempat

lain. Itulah alasan utama polisi
tidak melawan balik setelah mereka\ldiusir secara paksa selama

kerusuhan. Mereka tidak akan
memberitahumu itu, sih. Agar\lAntisis City bisa terus ada seperti

sekarang, polisi perlu pura-pura
tidak tahu terhadap kejahatan yang\ltidak terlalu serius. Tapi jika ada

sesuatu yang mulai lepas kendali di
sekitar sini, saat itulah Big Mo\lmuncul dan mengambil alih kendali.

entries.original: "[green]Crooooak\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Crooooak\.
entries.translated: [green]Crooooak\.

entries.original:
"I used to be a proud member of the
Terror Granbull - the gang that\lran this joint.

We were at the top of our game
until those Black Ferrothorn\lshowed up.

They took us by surprise and
attacked our base through the\lsewers.

Now, I’m back to bein’ a nobody,
livin’ with his mama.

And since I don’t really battle
anymore, there ain’t much I can\ldo with this."
entries.translation_source: I used to be a proud member of the Terror Granbull - the gang that ran this joint. We were at the top of our game until those Black Ferrothorn showed up. They took us by surprise and attacked our base through the sewers. Now, I’m back to bein’ a nobody, livin’ with his mama. And since I don’t really battle anymore, there ain’t much I can do with this.
entries.translated:
Aku dulu adalah anggota bangga dari
Terror Granbull - geng yang\lmenguasai tempat ini. Kami berada

di puncak permainan sampai Black
Ferrothorn muncul. Mereka\lmengejutkan kami dan menyerang

markas kami melalui selokan.
Sekarang, aku kembali menjadi orang\ltak berarti, tinggal bersama

mamaku. Dan karena aku tidak
benar-benar bertarung lagi, tidak\lbanyak yang bisa aku lakukan dengan

ini.

entries.original:
"Don’t let what happened to me,
happen to you, kid!

Stay away from gangs, and stay
in school!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let what happened to me, happen to you, kid! Stay away from gangs, and stay in school!
entries.translated:
Jangan biarkan apa yang terjadi
padaku menimpamu, nak! Jauhi geng,\ldan tetap di sekolah!

entries.original:
"I was so happy for my son when he
joined the Terror Granbull.

Yes, I admit that joining a gang is
not the best of careers, but at\lleast he had one!

Now, he’s just another lowlife.

When will he ever get a real job
and leave the house again?"
entries.translation_source: I was so happy for my son when he joined the Terror Granbull. Yes, I admit that joining a gang is not the best of careers, but at least he had one! Now, he’s just another lowlife. When will he ever get a real job and leave the house again?
entries.translated:
Aku sangat senang untuk putraku
ketika dia bergabung dengan Terror\lGranbull. Ya, aku akui bergabung

dengan geng bukanlah karier
terbaik, tapi setidaknya dia punya\lsatu! Sekarang, dia hanya seorang

penjahat rendahan. Kapan dia akan
mendapatkan pekerjaan nyata dan\lmeninggalkan rumah lagi?

entries.original:
"Those poozers think that Antisis
City is safe now that the Terror\lGranbull are gone!

Haw haw!

They couldn’t be more wrong!"
entries.translation_source: Those poozers think that Antisis City is safe now that the Terror Granbull are gone! Haw haw! They couldn’t be more wrong!
entries.translated:
Orang-orang bodoh itu pikir Antisis
City aman sekarang setelah Terror\lGranbull pergi! Haw haw! Mereka

tidak bisa lebih salah lagi!

entries.original:
"My boyfriend is so strong and
tough!

There ain’t no one like him here in
the city!

Well, aside from Big Mo, of course."
entries.translation_source: My boyfriend is so strong and tough! There ain’t no one like him here in the city! Well, aside from Big Mo, of course.
entries.translated:
Pacarku sangat kuat dan tangguh!
Tidak ada yang seperti dia di kota\lini! Yah, selain Big Mo, tentu

saja.

entries.original: "Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!"
entries.translation_source: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!
entries.translated: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!

entries.original:
"You wanna prove you’re tough?
Huh, [buffer1]?

You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo.

He’s the biggest, toughest guy in
all of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You wanna prove you’re tough? Huh, [buffer1]? You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo. He’s the biggest, toughest guy in all of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kamu ingin membuktikan dirimu
tangguh? Huh, [buffer1]? Kamu pasti\lingin menghadapi Big Mo. Dia pria

terbesar dan terkuat di seluruh
Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You must be pretty tough if you
took down Big Mo.

That ain’t easy.

You know what, take these as a
congrats from me."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. You must be pretty tough if you took down Big Mo. That ain’t easy. You know what, take these as a congrats from me.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Kamu pasti cukup tangguh jika
bisa mengalahkan Big Mo. Itu tidak\lmudah. Begini, ambil ini sebagai

ucapan selamat dariku.

entries.original:
"Use those Balls to catch even more
tough Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Use those Balls to catch even more tough Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Gunakan Bola-Bola itu untuk
menangkap Pokémon yang lebih\ltangguh.

entries.original: "Uh\. whaddya want?"
entries.translation_source: Uh\. whaddya want?
entries.translated: Uh\. mau apa?

entries.original: "Don’t come back."
entries.translation_source: Don’t come back.
entries.translated: Jangan kembali.

entries.original: "[green]Kek!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Kek!
entries.translated: [green]Kek!

entries.original:
"Be cautious, Trainer!

You’re about to enter Antisis City!
A very dangerous place!

If you’re coming from there\. well\.
this gate really only goes one way."
entries.translation_source: Be cautious, Trainer! You’re about to enter Antisis City! A very dangerous place! If you’re coming from there\. well\. this gate really only goes one way.
entries.translated:
Berhati-hatilah, Trainer! Kamu akan
memasuki Antisis City! Tempat yang\lsangat berbahaya! Jika kamu datang

dari sana\. well\. gerbang ini
sebenarnya hanya satu arah.

entries.original:
"You will need to possess some sort
of valid identification if you wish\laccess to the port."
entries.translation_source: You will need to possess some sort of valid identification if you wish access to the port.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus memiliki semacam
identifikasi yang valid jika ingin\lakses ke pelabuhan.

entries.original:
"Do not even think of bringing in
any illegal merchandise into\lAntisis City.

I will know if you try something."
entries.translation_source: Do not even think of bringing in any illegal merchandise into Antisis City. I will know if you try something.
entries.translated:
Jangan pernah berpikir untuk
membawa barang dagangan ilegal ke\lAntisis City. Aku akan tahu jika

kamu mencoba sesuatu.

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Feel free to come and go as
you please.

With a Trainer Card like yours,
you have more than proved your\ltrustworthiness."
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player]! Feel free to come and go as you please. With a Trainer Card like yours, you have more than proved your trustworthiness.
entries.translated:
Hai, [player]! Silakan datang dan
pergi sesukamu. Dengan Kartu\lTrainer sepertimu, kamu telah lebih

dari membuktikan kepercayaanmu.

entries.original:
"Yawn\.
These early mornings are rough\.

I don’t know how you Borrian folk
do it\."
entries.translation_source: Yawn\. These early mornings are rough\. I don’t know how you Borrian folk do it\.
entries.translated:
Yawn\. Pagi-pagi ini berat\. Aku tidak
tahu bagaimana kalian orang Borrius\lmelakukannya\.

entries.original:
"I’ve got a shipment for one\. uh\.
Swomoli?

Man\. these names are hard to
read sometimes."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got a shipment for one\. uh\. Swomoli? Man\. these names are hard to read sometimes.
entries.translated:
Saya punya kiriman untuk satu\. uh\.
Swomoli? Ya ampun\. nama-nama ini\lkadang susah dibaca.

entries.original:
"A fresh batch of [green]Premier Balls[blue] has
just arrived!

Why don’t you take a few?
They’ll never notice\."
entries.translation_source: A fresh batch of [green]Premier Balls[blue] has just arrived! Why don’t you take a few? They’ll never notice\.
entries.translated:
Sekumpulan [green]Premier Balls[blue] segar baru
saja tiba! Kenapa tidak kau ambil\lbeberapa? Mereka tidak akan pernah

menyadari\.

entries.original:
"I’ve always advocated for a smaller
Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio.

Ten to one? Are you kidding me?
Who even buys ten Poké Balls?

At least you Borrian folk hand them
out for any type of Poké Ball."
entries.translation_source: I’ve always advocated for a smaller Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio. Ten to one? Are you kidding me? Who even buys ten Poké Balls? At least you Borrian folk hand them out for any type of Poké Ball.
entries.translated:
Saya selalu menganjurkan rasio Poké
Ball ke Premier Ball yang lebih\lkecil. Sepuluh banding satu? Kau

bercanda? Siapa yang bahkan membeli
sepuluh Poké Ball? Setidaknya\lkalian orang Borrius memberikannya

untuk segala jenis Poké Ball.

entries.original:
"Night deliveries are by far better
than day deliveries.

Why?

For starters, there’s less
ocean traffic!"
entries.translation_source: Night deliveries are by far better than day deliveries. Why? For starters, there’s less ocean traffic!
entries.translated:
Pengiriman malam jauh lebih baik
daripada pengiriman siang. Kenapa?\lPertama, lalu lintas laut lebih

sedikit!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Lava Cookie[blue] before?

If you take it, you won’t need a
Burn Heal!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [green]Lava Cookie[blue] before? If you take it, you won’t need a Burn Heal!
entries.translated:
Kau pernah punya [green]Lava Cookie[blue]
sebelumnya? Jika kau memakannya,\lkau tidak perlu Burn Heal!

entries.original:
"Pardon me\.

Would you care for an [green]Old Gateau[blue]?

Oui, oui, yes, you would."
entries.translation_source: Pardon me\. Would you care for an [green]Old Gateau[blue]? Oui, oui, yes, you would.
entries.translated:
Maafkan saya\. Apakah kau ingin [green]Old
Gateau[blue]? Oui, oui, ya, tentu.

entries.original:
"Quick!

Take a [green]Casteliacone[blue] before
it melts!"
entries.translation_source: Quick! Take a [green]Casteliacone[blue] before it melts!
entries.translated:
Cepat! Ambil [green]Casteliacone[blue] sebelum
meleleh!

entries.original:
"The city of lights and biscuits\.

Have this token of Lumiose City,
the [green]Lumiose Galette[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The city of lights and biscuits\. Have this token of Lumiose City, the [green]Lumiose Galette[blue].
entries.translated:
Kota lampu dan biskuit\. Ambil
kenang-kenangan dari Lumiose City\lini, [green]Lumiose Galette[blue].

entries.original:
"Feel the power of Mega Evolution
when you take a bite out of this\l[green]Shalour Sable[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Feel the power of Mega Evolution when you take a bite out of this [green]Shalour Sable[blue]!
entries.translated:
Rasakan kekuatan Mega Evolution
saat kau menggigit [green]Shalour Sable[blue]\lini!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Big Malasada[blue]
before?

I hear it’s really good for
the heart.

Try some, straight from the
Alola region!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [green]Big Malasada[blue] before? I hear it’s really good for the heart. Try some, straight from the Alola region!
entries.translated:
Kau pernah punya [green]Big Malasada[blue]
sebelumnya? Kudengar itu baik untuk\ljantung. Coba beberapa, langsung

dari region Alola!

entries.original:
"Feed the [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon with a status condition.

It’ll get all better, just
like that!"
entries.translation_source: Feed the [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon with a status condition. It’ll get all better, just like that!
entries.translated:
Berikan [green][buffer1][blue] pada Pokémon yang
memiliki kondisi status. Dia akan\lsembuh total, begitu saja!

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local
shipments today.

If you come by any other day of the
week, I may have souvenirs from\lvarious regions to give out."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local shipments today. If you come by any other day of the week, I may have souvenirs from various regions to give out.
entries.translated:
Maaf, nak, saya hanya membawa
kiriman lokal hari ini. Jika kau\ldatang di hari lain dalam seminggu,

saya mungkin punya suvenir dari
berbagai region untuk dibagikan.

entries.original:
"I was taking inventory for the
Berry shipments this morning, and\las usual, we have a surplus.

Why don’t you take a Berry?"
entries.translation_source: I was taking inventory for the Berry shipments this morning, and as usual, we have a surplus. Why don’t you take a Berry?
entries.translated:
Saya sedang mengambil inventaris
untuk kiriman Berry pagi ini, dan\lseperti biasa, kita kelebihan stok.

Kenapa kau tidak ambil Berry?

entries.original:
"Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency
to send a few extra Berries.

There may be some more in
tomorrow’s shipment, too.

I wonder how they don’t lose
money\."
entries.translation_source: Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency to send a few extra Berries. There may be some more in tomorrow’s shipment, too. I wonder how they don’t lose money\.
entries.translated:
Tropius Berries Inc. cenderung
mengirim beberapa Berry ekstra.\lMungkin ada lagi di kiriman besok.

Aku heran bagaimana mereka tidak
kehilangan uang\.

entries.original:
"Oh, drat!

I’m going to be late for my
next job!

I’ll be back tomorrow morning,
as usual!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, drat! I’m going to be late for my next job! I’ll be back tomorrow morning, as usual!
entries.translated:
Oh, sial! Saya akan terlambat untuk
pekerjaan saya selanjutnya! Saya\lakan kembali besok pagi, seperti

biasa!

entries.original:
"Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies
to Fallshore City during the day.

It’s too dangerous to move them
through Antisis City, which is why\lthis job exists."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies to Fallshore City during the day. It’s too dangerous to move them through Antisis City, which is why this job exists.
entries.translated:
Ya, sayalah orang yang memindahkan
persediaan ke Fallshore City pada\lsiang hari. Terlalu berbahaya untuk

memindahkannya melalui Antisis
City, itulah mengapa pekerjaan ini\lada.

entries.original:
"We policemen are the only things
standing between the gangs and\ltotal destruction of the port."
entries.translation_source: We policemen are the only things standing between the gangs and total destruction of the port.
entries.translated:
Kami polisi adalah satu-satunya
yang berdiri di antara geng-geng\ldan kehancuran total pelabuhan.

entries.original:
"Are you up to no good?

\.

Just checking.

There’s no telling when a ruffian
will sneak past the gate check."
entries.translation_source: Are you up to no good? \. Just checking. There’s no telling when a ruffian will sneak past the gate check.
entries.translated:
Apakah kau berbuat jahat? \. Hanya
bertanya. Tidak ada yang tahu kapan\lseorang preman akan menyelinap

melewati pemeriksaan gerbang.

entries.original:
"I’ve watched over this port ever
since the once glorious Antisis\lCity stood proud\.

This port is all that remains of
that city\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve watched over this port ever since the once glorious Antisis City stood proud\. This port is all that remains of that city\.
entries.translated:
Saya telah menjaga pelabuhan ini
sejak Antisis City yang dulu megah\lberdiri dengan bangga\. Pelabuhan ini

adalah satu-satunya yang tersisa
dari kota itu\.

entries.original:
"This lighthouse was once a beacon
of hope for tourists.

But ever since Antisis City was
turned into a crime-filled slum,\ltourists have stopped coming to\lthis port."
entries.translation_source: This lighthouse was once a beacon of hope for tourists. But ever since Antisis City was turned into a crime-filled slum, tourists have stopped coming to this port.
entries.translated:
Mercusuar ini dulunya adalah
mercusuar harapan bagi turis. Tapi\lsejak Antisis City berubah menjadi

daerah kumuh penuh kejahatan, turis
berhenti datang ke pelabuhan ini.

entries.original:
"Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis
Port is mainly used for the import\lof goods from other regions.

Once dropped off here, the goods
are moved along to Fallshore City\lwhere they can then be distributed\lacross Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis Port is mainly used for the import of goods from other regions. Once dropped off here, the goods are moved along to Fallshore City where they can then be distributed across Borrius.
entries.translated:
Tidak seperti Kota Seaport,
Pelabuhan Antisis terutama\ldigunakan untuk mengimpor barang

dari daerah lain. Setelah
diturunkan di sini, barang-barang\ltersebut dipindahkan ke Kota

Fallshore di mana mereka kemudian
dapat didistribusikan ke seluruh\lBorrius.

entries.original:
"The yellow barricades are moved
routinely throughout the day to\lcorrespond to the arrivals of\ldifferent shipments.

If you want to get to an area
that’s blocked off, you’ll just\lhave to come back later."
entries.translation_source: The yellow barricades are moved routinely throughout the day to correspond to the arrivals of different shipments. If you want to get to an area that’s blocked off, you’ll just have to come back later.
entries.translated:
Barikade kuning dipindahkan secara
rutin sepanjang hari untuk\lmenyesuaikan dengan kedatangan

kiriman yang berbeda. Jika kamu
ingin pergi ke area yang diblokir,\lkamu harus kembali lagi nanti.

entries.original:
"Ya know what’s not fair?

That I have to go through a
rigourous screenin’ process just to\lbe let onto the port so I can work\levery day!

If it weren’t for those lunkheads in
Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be\lan issue."
entries.translation_source: Ya know what’s not fair? That I have to go through a rigourous screenin’ process just to be let onto the port so I can work every day! If it weren’t for those lunkheads in Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be an issue.
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu apa yang tidak adil?
Bahwa aku harus melalui proses\lpemeriksaan yang ketat hanya untuk

diizinkan masuk ke pelabuhan agar
bisa bekerja setiap hari! Jika\lbukan karena orang-orang bodoh di

Kota Antisis, ini bahkan tidak akan
menjadi masalah.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\.
Stinky, stinky!

What a stench, what a stench!

Assail my nostrils\.
It is necessary!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. Stinky, stinky! What a stench, what a stench! Assail my nostrils\. It is necessary!
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. Bau, bau! Sungguh
bau, sungguh bau! Serang lubang\lhidungku\. Itu perlu!

entries.original:
"Boo hoo\.
Stinky, stinky!"
entries.translation_source: Boo hoo\. Stinky, stinky!
entries.translated: Boo hoo\. Bau, bau!

entries.original:
"Boo hoo\.
Still stinky, stinky!"
entries.translation_source: Boo hoo\. Still stinky, stinky!
entries.translated: Boo hoo\. Masih bau, bau!

entries.original:
"Ahhhhh\.

The foul stench has evaporated\.
You have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ahhhhh\. The foul stench has evaporated\. You have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ahhhhh\. Bau busuk telah menguap\. Kamu
mendapat rasa terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"’Til the sweet smelling aromas
bringeth us together again, I bid\lyou adieu."
entries.translation_source: ’Til the sweet smelling aromas bringeth us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Sampai aroma yang harum
mempertemukan kita lagi, aku\lucapkan selamat tinggal.

entries.original:
"Lots of toxins build up in the
sewer system.

I think I can use them to make
medicines!

So, I’m running an experiment!

If this works, I might be able to
use the venom of Poison-type\lPokémon to make different\lmedicines. How exciting!

Well, well\.

The result of today’s experiment
was\."
entries.translation_source: Lots of toxins build up in the sewer system. I think I can use them to make medicines! So, I’m running an experiment! If this works, I might be able to use the venom of Poison-type Pokémon to make different medicines. How exciting! Well, well\. The result of today’s experiment was\.
entries.translated:
Banyak racun menumpuk di sistem
saluran pembuangan. Aku pikir aku\lbisa menggunakannya untuk membuat

obat! Jadi, aku sedang melakukan
eksperimen! Jika ini berhasil, aku\lmungkin bisa menggunakan racun

Pokémon tipe Racun untuk membuat
berbagai obat. Sangat menarik! Nah,\lnah\. Hasil eksperimen hari ini

adalah\.

entries.original:
"Wow! Today’s experiment was super
successful!

Here! Please accept
the [buffer1] I made!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Today’s experiment was super successful! Here! Please accept the [buffer1] I made!
entries.translated:
Wow! Eksperimen hari ini sukses
besar! Ini! Silakan terima [buffer1]\lyang aku buat!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep experimenting every day!
It’s important to keep trying.

Come back and see how it’s going!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep experimenting every day! It’s important to keep trying. Come back and see how it’s going!
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus bereksperimen setiap
hari! Penting untuk terus mencoba.\lKembalilah dan lihat bagaimana

perkembangannya!

entries.original:
"I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m
never working a day in my life!"
entries.translation_source: I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m never working a day in my life!
entries.translated:
Aku suka membersihkan, jadi rasanya
aku tidak pernah bekerja sehari pun\ldalam hidupku!

entries.original:
"[green]Whirlipede[blue] infest the sewers from
time to time.

They like to cause all sorts of
trouble down here."
entries.translation_source: [green]Whirlipede[blue] infest the sewers from time to time. They like to cause all sorts of trouble down here.
entries.translated:
[green]Whirlipede[blue] kadang-kadang
menginfestasi saluran pembuangan.\lMereka suka menyebabkan berbagai

masalah di sini.

entries.original:
"You can crawl through a pipe to go
to the sewers underneath the\lsouthern half of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You can crawl through a pipe to go to the sewers underneath the southern half of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa merayap melalui pipa
untuk pergi ke saluran pembuangan\ldi bawah bagian selatan Kota

Antisis.

entries.original:
"Since we built this sewer, all
kinds of Pokémon have shown up."
entries.translation_source: Since we built this sewer, all kinds of Pokémon have shown up.
entries.translated:
Sejak kami membangun saluran
pembuangan ini, semua jenis Pokémon\ltelah muncul.

entries.original:
"Even odours that might seem awful to
humans might be perfume to Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Even odours that might seem awful to humans might be perfume to Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Bahkan bau yang mungkin tampak
buruk bagi manusia mungkin\lmerupakan parfum bagi Pokémon.

entries.original: "What a catastrophic theorem!"
entries.translation_source: What a catastrophic theorem!
entries.translated: Teorema yang dahsyat!

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!
You found this old clown!

I thought the rain would wash away
my tears forever.

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! You found this old clown! I thought the rain would wash away my tears forever. For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Kamu menemukan
badut tua ini! Kupikir hujan akan\lmenghanyutkan air mataku selamanya.

Untuk itu, aku berterima kasih
padamu.

entries.original:
"’Til the rain bringeth us together
again, I bid you adieu."
entries.translation_source: ’Til the rain bringeth us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Sampai hujan mempertemukan kita
lagi, aku ucapkan selamat tinggal.

entries.original:
"I prefer swimming in a calm lake
much more than in the sea."
entries.translation_source: I prefer swimming in a calm lake much more than in the sea.
entries.translated:
Aku lebih suka berenang di danau
yang tenang daripada di laut.

entries.original:
"Brr\. I’m starting to get chilly.
I could use a win to get warmed up."
entries.translation_source: Brr\. I’m starting to get chilly. I could use a win to get warmed up.
entries.translated:
Brr\. Aku mulai kedinginan. Aku butuh
kemenangan untuk menghangatkan\lbadan.

entries.original:
"Maybe I should switch to surfing,
too\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should switch to surfing, too\.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku juga harus beralih ke
berselancar\.

entries.original:
"There are many watery routes that
you can swim in Borrius.

It puts the Hoenn region to shame!"
entries.translation_source: There are many watery routes that you can swim in Borrius. It puts the Hoenn region to shame!
entries.translated:
Ada banyak rute air yang bisa kamu
renangi di Borrius. Ini membuat\lwilayah Hoenn malu!

entries.original:
"Go on.

Don’t be shy about talking to
lonely fishermen.

Just don’t you talk to me."
entries.translation_source: Go on. Don’t be shy about talking to lonely fishermen. Just don’t you talk to me.
entries.translated:
Ayo. Jangan malu-malu berbicara
dengan nelayan yang kesepian. Tapi\ljangan bicara denganku.

entries.original: "Battleground"
entries.translation_source: Battleground
entries.translated: Battleground

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!

Or should I say, Champ?

Long time no see!

Guess all my advice really helped
you out, eh?

Welcome to the Battleground!

In this club, you can battle with
the best in Borrius.

So enjoy your time here, especially
because you’re one of them!

Oh, and if you want to take part in
the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], come find me."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! Or should I say, Champ? Long time no see! Guess all my advice really helped you out, eh? Welcome to the Battleground! In this club, you can battle with the best in Borrius. So enjoy your time here, especially because you’re one of them! Oh, and if you want to take part in the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], come find me.
entries.translated:
Juara dalam pembuatan! Atau lebih
tepatnya, Juara? Lama tidak\lbertemu! Sepertinya semua saranku

benar-benar membantumu, ya? Selamat
datang di Battleground! Di klub\lini, kamu bisa bertarung dengan

yang terbaik di Borrius. Jadi
nikmati waktumu di sini, terutama\lkarena kamu adalah salah satu dari

mereka! Oh, dan jika kamu ingin
mengikuti [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], datang\ldan temui aku.

entries.original:
"[black]Stand and face [buffer1] on the other
side of the field to begin battling."
entries.translation_source: [black]Stand and face [buffer1] on the other side of the field to begin battling.
entries.translated:
[black]Berdiri dan hadapi [buffer1] di sisi
lain lapangan untuk memulai\lpertarungan.

entries.original: "Are you ready to begin the battle?"
entries.translation_source: Are you ready to begin the battle?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu siap memulai
pertarungan?

entries.original:
"Hey, Champ!

Interested in taking part in the
[green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Champ! Interested in taking part in the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?
entries.translated:
Hei, Juara! Tertarik untuk
mengikuti [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?

entries.original:
"Hey, Champ!

If you’re interested in taking part in
the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], get rid of\lthat guy following you first!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Champ! If you’re interested in taking part in the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], get rid of that guy following you first!
entries.translated:
Hei, Juara! Jika kamu tertarik
mengikuti [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue],\lsingkirkan dulu orang yang

mengikutimu itu!

entries.original:
"Interested in taking part in the
[green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Interested in taking part in the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?
entries.translated:
Tertarik untuk mengikuti [green]Leaders
Gauntlet[blue]?

entries.original:
"You need at least [green]2 Pokémon[blue] if you
want to take part in this gauntlet."
entries.translation_source: You need at least [green]2 Pokémon[blue] if you want to take part in this gauntlet.
entries.translated:
Kamu membutuhkan setidaknya [green]2
Pokémon[blue] jika ingin mengikuti\lgauntlet ini.

entries.original:
"Sorry, Champ, but the [green]Insane[blue] Classic
Leaders Gauntlet is still locked.

You’ll need to clear the [green]Expert[blue]
Classic Leaders Gauntlet first.

Just open up the [green]Options Menu[blue] and
lower your [green]Battle Difficulty[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, Champ, but the [green]Insane[blue] Classic Leaders Gauntlet is still locked. You’ll need to clear the [green]Expert[blue] Classic Leaders Gauntlet first. Just open up the [green]Options Menu[blue] and lower your [green]Battle Difficulty[blue].
entries.translated:
Maaf, Juara, tetapi [green]Insane[blue] Classic
Leaders Gauntlet masih terkunci.\lKamu harus menyelesaikan [green]Expert[blue]

Classic Leaders Gauntlet terlebih
dahulu. Buka saja [green]Options Menu[blue] dan\lturunkan [green]Battle Difficulty[blue].

entries.original:
"No prob, Champ.

If you ever want to take part,
just let me know."
entries.translation_source: No prob, Champ. If you ever want to take part, just let me know.
entries.translated:
Tidak masalah, Juara. Jika kamu
ingin ikut, beri tahu aku saja.

entries.original:
"Which Leaders Gauntlet should
I explain?"
entries.translation_source: Which Leaders Gauntlet should I explain?
entries.translated:
Leaders Gauntlet mana yang harus
aku jelaskan?

entries.original:
"In the [green]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[blue],
you’ll be pitted against each Gym\lLeader, one after the other.

But despite the fights being back
to back, you will get a chance to\lsave and adjust your team in\lbetween each fight.

As for the Gym Leaders’ teams,
they’ll be using much stronger\lPokémon than when you fought\lthem in their Gyms.

They’ll also be fighting with the
same battle effects as back then,\lso keep that in mind.

If you manage to defeat a Gym
Leader, and you’ve already\lreceived a Z-Crystal from them,\lthey’ll give you their daily Gem\lafter the battle, assuming they\lhaven’t already given you one.

If you manage to defeat
all of them, you’ll win fantastic\lprizes!

And of course, the harder your
[green]Battle Difficulty[blue], the better the\lprizes you can win."
entries.translation_source: In the [green]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[blue], you’ll be pitted against each Gym Leader, one after the other. But despite the fights being back to back, you will get a chance to save and adjust your team in between each fight. As for the Gym Leaders’ teams, they’ll be using much stronger Pokémon than when you fought them in their Gyms. They’ll also be fighting with the same battle effects as back then, so keep that in mind. If you manage to defeat a Gym Leader, and you’ve already received a Z-Crystal from them, they’ll give you their daily Gem after the battle, assuming they haven’t already given you one. If you manage to defeat all of them, you’ll win fantastic prizes! And of course, the harder your [green]Battle Difficulty[blue], the better the prizes you can win.
entries.translated:
Di [green]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[blue], kamu
akan berhadapan dengan setiap\lPemimpin Gym, satu per satu.

Meskipun pertarungannya berlangsung
berturut-turut, kamu akan mendapat\lkesempatan untuk menyimpan dan

menyesuaikan tim di antara setiap
pertarungan. Sedangkan untuk tim\lPemimpin Gym, mereka akan

menggunakan Pokémon yang jauh lebih
kuat daripada saat kamu bertarung\lmelawan mereka di Gym mereka.

Mereka juga akan bertarung dengan
efek pertarungan yang sama seperti\lsaat itu, jadi ingatlah itu. Jika

kamu berhasil mengalahkan seorang
Pemimpin Gym, dan kamu sudah\lmenerima Z-Crystal dari mereka,

mereka akan memberimu Gem harian
mereka setelah pertarungan, dengan\lasumsi mereka belum memberimu satu.

Jika kamu berhasil mengalahkan
mereka semua, kamu akan memenangkan\lhadiah fantastis! Dan tentu saja,

semakin sulit [green]Battle Difficulty[blue]-mu,
semakin baik hadiah yang bisa kamu\lmenangkan.

entries.original:
"In the [green]Frontier Leaders Gauntlet[blue],
you’ll be pitted against each Gym\lLeader, one after the other.

Each battle is fought like a 6v6
battle in the Battle Frontier.

Your Pokémon will automatically be
set to \Lv 100 for the fights, and\lyour team cannot be adjusted in\lbetween each fight.

However, you will see a preview of
your opponents’ teams before each\lbattle, and you will be allowed to\lchoose your leads.

If you can clear the gauntlet
without taking a break, you will\learn a generous amount of BP.

This gauntlet is unaffected by your
chosen [green]Battle Difficulty[blue]."
entries.translation_source: In the [green]Frontier Leaders Gauntlet[blue], you’ll be pitted against each Gym Leader, one after the other. Each battle is fought like a 6v6 battle in the Battle Frontier. Your Pokémon will automatically be set to \Lv 100 for the fights, and your team cannot be adjusted in between each fight. However, you will see a preview of your opponents’ teams before each battle, and you will be allowed to choose your leads. If you can clear the gauntlet without taking a break, you will earn a generous amount of BP. This gauntlet is unaffected by your chosen [green]Battle Difficulty[blue].
entries.translated:
Di [green]Frontier Leaders Gauntlet[blue], kamu
akan berhadapan dengan setiap\lPemimpin Gym, satu per satu. Setiap

pertarungan dilakukan seperti

ini tidak terpengaruh oleh [green]Battle\lDifficulty[blue] yang kamu pilih.

entries.translated:
Gah! Polisi di sini! Tunggu\.\CC0818 kamu

aku dengar kamu sekarang, seperti\.\lseorang big-shot, sih. Begini saja.

[buffer3]. Aku harus mencari cara\lpergi besok\.

Kereeeeeen\.\CC0818 uh, di mana medan

[blue]Getaran itu\.\CC0818 [buffer3]\.\CC0818 benar-benar\.\CC0818 di

Lencana lain\. Tapi aku punya sesuatu

[buffer3], aku masih belum bisa

Oke?

Hah? Seberapa sering aku akan

anggota khusus ini\. cukup jauh\.
Tidak, sungguh, [buffer3]. Jauh\.\CC0818\lmaksudnya, jauh dari polisi mana

pun.

entries.original:
"Ah, [player].
I hope life finds you well.

No, I’m not here on any assignment.

I have my own\.\CC0818 personal reasons.

You’ve recently become the new
Champion of the Borrius Region,\lyes?

You see, my responsibilities as Gym
Leader, and as an agent, require\lme to often\.\CC0818 conceal my true\lstrength.

But now, I see little reason not to
indulge myself, now that peace has\lreturned.

If you are willing, perhaps you
would care to test yourself\lagainst me?

I’m aware, of course, that you may
still hold some grudges for my\lactions back at Cinder Volcano.

If nothing else, think of it as an
opportunity to\.\CC0818 relieve some pent-\lup frustrations."
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player]. I hope life finds you well. No, I’m not here on any assignment. I have my own\.\CC0818 personal reasons. You’ve recently become the new Champion of the Borrius Region, yes? You see, my responsibilities as Gym Leader, and as an agent, require me to often\.\CC0818 conceal my true strength. But now, I see little reason not to indulge myself, now that peace has returned. If you are willing, perhaps you would care to test yourself against me? I’m aware, of course, that you may still hold some grudges for my actions back at Cinder Volcano. If nothing else, think of it as an opportunity to\.\CC0818 relieve some pent- up frustrations.
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]. Aku harap hidupmu
baik-baik saja. Tidak, aku di sini\lbukan untuk tugas. Aku punya alasan

pribadi sendiri\.\CC0818 Kamu baru saja
menjadi Juara baru Region Borrius,\lya? Kamu lihat, tanggung jawabku

sebagai Pemimpin Gym, dan sebagai
agen, mengharuskanku untuk sering\.\CC0818\lmenyembunyikan kekuatan sejatiku.

Tapi sekarang, aku tidak melihat
alasan untuk tidak memanjakan diri,\lsekarang setelah perdamaian

kembali. Jika kamu bersedia,
mungkin kamu ingin menguji dirimu\lmelawanku? Aku tahu, tentu saja,

bahwa kamu mungkin masih menyimpan
dendam atas tindakanku di Cinder\lVolcano. Jika tidak ada yang lain,

anggap saja ini sebagai kesempatan
untuk\.\CC0818 melepaskan beberapa frustrasi\lyang terpendam.

menunggumu di area pertarungan.

[blue]Seperti malam yang mengikuti siang,
kekalahanmu sudah di depan mata!

entries.original:
"[blue]Heh\. I see that you do not
consider becoming Champion the\lend of your growth.

I truly unleashed all I had, and
yet my intel, my strength\.\lit was not enough.

Very well.

I believe you are deserving of one
of my favourite Z-Crystals\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Heh\. I see that you do not consider becoming Champion the end of your growth. I truly unleashed all I had, and yet my intel, my strength\. it was not enough. Very well. I believe you are deserving of one of my favourite Z-Crystals\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Heh\. Aku lihat kau tidak menganggap
menjadi Juara sebagai akhir dari\lpertumbuhanmu. Aku benar-benar

mengeluarkan semua yang kumiliki,
namun intelku, kekuatanku\. itu tidak\lcukup. Baiklah. Aku yakin kau layak

mendapatkan salah satu Kristal Z
favoritku\.

Trainer’s energy, so it is advised\lto only use it once per battle.

[green]Black Hole Eclipse[blue]\.

However, it can exhaust its Trainer’s energy, so it is advised to only use it once per battle. [green]Black Hole Eclipse[blue]\. It reminds me very much of a fellow agent I once knew. He wore so many disguises, he forgot his true name and face in the end\. and became much like an endless abyss\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Seekor Pokémon yang memegang
[green]Darkinium Z[blue] akan memperkuat\lserangan tipe [green]Gelap[blue]-nya, baik untuk

meningkatkan kekuatannya atau untuk
pukulan yang kuat. Namun, itu bisa\lmenguras energi Pelatihnya, jadi

disarankan untuk hanya
menggunakannya sekali per\lpertempuran. [green]Gerhana Lubang Hitam[blue]\.

Itu sangat mengingatkanku pada
seorang agen rekan yang pernah\lkukenal. Dia memakai begitu banyak

penyamaran, dia lupa nama dan wajah
aslinya pada akhirnya\. dan menjadi\lseperti jurang tak berujung\.

entries.original:
"[player]\. a pleasure to see you
again.

I have been pouring over the intel

to battle once more?"

[player]\. senang bertemu lagi. Aku
telah mempelajari intel yang\lkukumpulkan dari pertarungan

terakhir kita\. Aku yakin sekarang
aku memiliki cukup informasi untuk\lpeluang menang yang lebih baik.

bertarung sekali lagi?

entries.original:
"[blue]Tch\. I see.

There was something different,
compared to last time\.

But I shall make no excuses.

Here, a small reward from me, for
meeting my expectations once again."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Tch\. I see. There was something different, compared to last time\. But I shall make no excuses. Here, a small reward from me, for meeting my expectations once again.
entries.translated:
[blue]Cih\. Begitu. Ada sesuatu yang
berbeda, dibandingkan terakhir kali\.\lTapi aku tidak akan membuat alasan.

Ini, hadiah kecil dariku, karena
telah memenuhi ekspektasiku sekali\llagi.

entries.original:
"I remember I once remarked on how
you would make a good agent.

Now, however, I believe this
occupation suits you best.

A life of secrecy is for those with
secrets to hide\. that cannot ever\lsee the light\.

And I\.\CC0818 no, forget it.

It is not for a public hero such as
yourself to know."
entries.translation_source: I remember I once remarked on how you would make a good agent. Now, however, I believe this occupation suits you best. A life of secrecy is for those with secrets to hide\. that cannot ever see the light\. And I\.\CC0818 no, forget it. It is not for a public hero such as yourself to know.
entries.translated:
Aku ingat aku pernah berkomentar
tentang bagaimana kau akan menjadi\lagen yang baik. Namun sekarang, aku

yakin pekerjaan ini paling cocok
untukmu. Kehidupan penuh\lkerahasiaan adalah untuk mereka

yang memiliki rahasia untuk
disembunyikan\. yang tidak akan\lpernah bisa melihat cahaya\. Dan aku\.\CC0818

tidak, lupakan. Ini bukan untuk
pahlawan publik sepertimu untuk\lmengetahuinya.

"[player]! Quite the chance meeting
we’ve got here!

Look at you!
You’re the new Champion of Borrius!

You’ve soared to heights not even
I dared to reach!

And it got me wondering\. what sort
of winds blew your way, to let you\lreach the apex?

Well, I just got me the dandiest

angin macam apa yang bertiup ke
arahmu, sehingga kamu bisa mencapai\lpuncak? Yah, aku baru saja punya

pertarungan lain. Aku ingin melihat\langin mana yang kamu tumpangi

Fantastis! Aku akan menunggu di
