I was moved, all the same.

You can have this.

Perhaps this Z-Crystal can turn the
next battle on its ear\. just like\lthat."
entries.translation_source: [red]Hah\. so that’s how it panned out in the end? That was inspiring. Truly. I suppose whether it was chance or skill\. it hardly matters. I was moved, all the same. You can have this. Perhaps this Z-Crystal can turn the next battle on its ear\. just like that.
entries.translated:
[red]Hah\. jadi seperti itulah hasilnya
pada akhirnya? Itu menginspirasi.\lSungguh. Aku rasa apakah itu

kebetulan atau keahlian\. itu hampir
tidak penting. Aku tetap terharu.\lKamu boleh ambil ini. Mungkin

Kristal Z ini bisa mengubah
pertarungan berikutnya\. seperti itu.

entries.original:
"[red]The [green]Flyinium Z[red] changes a [green]Flying[red]-type
attack into a powerful [green]Z-Move[red].

Z-Moves can only be used once per
battle, however.

Keep that in mind.

The steeper the climb, the more
painful the crash\.

As I’m sure any Pokémon will know
after a good [green]Supersonic Skystrike[red]!"
entries.translation_source: [red]The [green]Flyinium Z[red] changes a [green]Flying[red]-type attack into a powerful [green]Z-Move[red]. Z-Moves can only be used once per battle, however. Keep that in mind. The steeper the climb, the more painful the crash\. As I’m sure any Pokémon will know after a good [green]Supersonic Skystrike[red]!
entries.translated:
[red]The [green]Flyinium Z[red] mengubah serangan
tipe [green]Terbang[red] menjadi [green]Jurus Z[red] yang\lkuat. Jurus Z hanya bisa digunakan

sekali per pertempuran, namun.
Ingat itu. Semakin curam pendakian,\lsemakin menyakitkan kejatuhan\.

Seperti yang saya yakin Pokémon
mana pun akan tahu setelah [green]Serangan\lSupersonik[red] yang baik!

entries.original:
"[player]!
So you’re here today, too\.

I got the urge to battle again, so
I’m back for another shot!

I don’t care how often it takes,
how many times I must fall\.

I just need to seize one single
moment.

You agree, don’t you?"
entries.translation_source: [player]! So you’re here today, too\. I got the urge to battle again, so I’m back for another shot! I don’t care how often it takes, how many times I must fall\. I just need to seize one single moment. You agree, don’t you?
entries.translated:
[player]! Jadi kamu di sini hari
ini juga\. Aku mendapat keinginan\luntuk bertarung lagi, jadi aku

kembali untuk mencoba lagi! Aku
tidak peduli berapa kali yang\ldiperlukan, berapa kali aku harus

jatuh\. Aku hanya perlu merebut satu
momen. Kamu setuju, kan?

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, fiddlesticks.

I don’t think this losing streak can
be chalked up to coincidence\lanymore\. here.

I have something that might just
come in handy for your next battle."
entries.translation_source: [red]Oh, fiddlesticks. I don’t think this losing streak can be chalked up to coincidence anymore\. here. I have something that might just come in handy for your next battle.
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, sial. Aku rasa kekalahan
beruntun ini tidak bisa lagi\ldianggap kebetulan\. ini. Aku punya

sesuatu yang mungkin berguna untuk
pertarunganmu selanjutnya.

entries.original:
"Truthfully?

I don’t have patience for people
who bleat on about \qodestiny\qc or\lnonsense like that.

What people call destiny, I call
\qocalculated chance.\qc

Even if it is 99% certain I’ll lose\.

If my life were on the line, I
would gamble on that 1%.

You understand, right?"
entries.translation_source: Truthfully? I don’t have patience for people who bleat on about \qodestiny\qc or nonsense like that. What people call destiny, I call \qocalculated chance.\qc Even if it is 99% certain I’ll lose\. If my life were on the line, I would gamble on that 1%. You understand, right?
entries.translated:
Sejujurnya? Aku tidak punya
kesabaran untuk orang-orang yang\lterus meracau tentang \qodestiny\qc

atau omong kosong seperti itu. Apa
yang orang sebut takdir, aku sebut\l\qocalculated chance.\qc Bahkan jika

99% aku akan kalah\. Jika hidupku
dipertaruhkan, aku akan bertaruh\lpada 1% itu. Kamu mengerti, kan?

entries.original:
"Well, lookie here\.

If it ain’t [player].

I guess all that ruckus after
Thundercap Mt. worked out, right?

Since then\. there’s been somethin’
different about yer look.

Nah, ya didn’t get as handsome
as me\.

No-one’s more of a looker than
ol’ Mel.

I mean yer more relaxed.

I remember at my Gym, y’all were
wound up tight as a lasso.

Actually\. now that we’re here\.
how’d ya like a rematch with this\lhandsome fella?

I wanna see how ya really battle -
no distractions to hold ya back.

What do ya say?
To another rodeo?"
entries.translation_source: Well, lookie here\. If it ain’t [player]. I guess all that ruckus after Thundercap Mt. worked out, right? Since then\. there’s been somethin’ different about yer look. Nah, ya didn’t get as handsome as me\. No-one’s more of a looker than ol’ Mel. I mean yer more relaxed. I remember at my Gym, y’all were wound up tight as a lasso. Actually\. now that we’re here\. how’d ya like a rematch with this handsome fella? I wanna see how ya really battle - no distractions to hold ya back. What do ya say? To another rodeo?
entries.translated:
Nah, lihat ini\. Kalau bukan [player]
ya. Kurasa semua keributan setelah\lThundercap Mt. berhasil, kan? Sejak

itu\. ada sesuatu yang berbeda dari
penampilanmu. Nah, kau tidak\lmenjadi setampan aku\. Tidak ada yang

lebih tampan dari Mel tua.
Maksudku, kau lebih santai. Aku\lingat di Gym-ku, kalian tegang

seperti tali laso. Sebenarnya\.
sekarang kita di sini\. bagaimana\lkalau pertarungan ulang dengan pria

tampan ini? Aku ingin melihat
bagaimana pertarunganmu yang\lsebenarnya – tanpa gangguan yang

menahanmu. Bagaimana menurutmu?
Untuk rodeo lagi?

entries.original:
"Aw\. well, I ain’t goin’ anywhere
’til tomorrow.

If y’all change yer mind\. I’ll be
right here."
entries.translation_source: Aw\. well, I ain’t goin’ anywhere ’til tomorrow. If y’all change yer mind\. I’ll be right here.
entries.translated:
Ah\. yah, aku tidak akan ke mana-mana
sampai besok. Jika kalian berubah\lpikiran\. Aku akan di sini.

entries.original:
"That’s the spirit. I’ll just mosey
along to the battle area, shall I?"
entries.translation_source: That’s the spirit. I’ll just mosey along to the battle area, shall I?
entries.translated:
Itu semangat. Aku akan berjalan
santai ke area pertarungan, ya?

entries.original:
"[blue]Brace yerself, partner! Yer getting
the full body experience!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Brace yerself, partner! Yer getting the full body experience!
entries.translated:
[blue]Bersiaplah, partner! Kau akan
mendapatkan pengalaman penuh badan!

entries.original:
"[blue]So\.\CC0818 that’s the new Champion of
Borrius, huh\.?

Well, ain’t that really somethin’\.

That’s a way different battle ya
showed me.

It felt more natural, focused - no
wasted movements at all.

Alright!

Someone who can battle like that
just has to have this Z-Crystal!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]So\.\CC0818 that’s the new Champion of Borrius, huh\.? Well, ain’t that really somethin’\. That’s a way different battle ya showed me. It felt more natural, focused - no wasted movements at all. Alright! Someone who can battle like that just has to have this Z-Crystal!
entries.translated:
[blue]Jadi\.\CC0818 itulah Juara baru Borrius, ya\.?
Wah, itu sungguh sesuatu\.\lPertarungan yang sangat berbeda

yang kau tunjukkan padaku. Terasa
lebih alami, fokus – tidak ada\lgerakan yang sia-sia. Baiklah!

Seseorang yang bisa bertarung
seperti itu pasti harus memiliki\lZ-Crystal ini!

entries.original:
"[green]Normalium Z[blue]\. it’s basic, but [green]Normal[blue]-
type attacks transform into [green]Z-Moves[blue]\lwhen activated.

Only good once per battle, though -
any more and ya’d wear yerself out.

Usually, nothin’ takes extra damage
from Normal-type attacks, so that’s\lwhy Inverse Battles are more\lmy thing.

[green]Breakneck Blitz[blue]\.

It gets overlooked over other Z
Moves, but I’m sure some use’ll\lcome of it!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Normalium Z[blue]\. it’s basic, but [green]Normal[blue]- type attacks transform into [green]Z-Moves[blue] when activated. Only good once per battle, though - any more and ya’d wear yerself out. Usually, nothin’ takes extra damage from Normal-type attacks, so that’s why Inverse Battles are more my thing. [green]Breakneck Blitz[blue]\. It gets overlooked over other Z Moves, but I’m sure some use’ll come of it!
entries.translated:
[green]Normalium Z[blue]\. ini dasar, tapi
serangan tipe [green]Normal[blue] berubah\lmenjadi [green]Z-Move[blue] saat diaktifkan.

Hanya bagus sekali per pertarungan,
lebih dari itu kau akan kelelahan.\lBiasanya, tidak ada yang menerima

damage tambahan dari serangan tipe
Normal, jadi itulah mengapa\lPertarungan Inverse lebih menjadi

keahlianku. [green]Breakneck Blitz[blue]\. Itu
sering diabaikan dibandingkan\lZ-Move lainnya, tapi aku yakin

pasti ada gunanya!

entries.original:
"Howdy, [player].
Back again?

Thought if I hung around long
enough, y’all would show up!

Listen\. I got itchin’\. for another
battle.

Though I’d do ya a favour.

After all, surely ya can’t keep
yerself away from ol’ Mel for too\llong, right?"
entries.translation_source: Howdy, [player]. Back again? Thought if I hung around long enough, y’all would show up! Listen\. I got itchin’\. for another battle. Though I’d do ya a favour. After all, surely ya can’t keep yerself away from ol’ Mel for too long, right?
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]. Kembali lagi?
Kupikir jika aku bertahan cukup\llama, kalian akan muncul! Dengar\.

Aku gatal\. untuk pertarungan lain.
Tapi aku akan membantumu. Lagipula,\lpasti kau tidak bisa menjauh dari

Mel tua terlalu lama, kan?

entries.original:
"[blue]Not bad, partner.

Sometimes ya grabbed that Tauros
by the horns\. other times, ya let\lit go where it will.

It was a fun battle.

Here, a little present from me."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Not bad, partner. Sometimes ya grabbed that Tauros by the horns\. other times, ya let it go where it will. It was a fun battle. Here, a little present from me.
entries.translated:
[blue]Tidak buruk, partner. Kadang kau
memegang Tauros itu dengan\ltanduknya\. di lain waktu, kau

biarkan pergi ke mana ia mau. Itu
pertarungan yang menyenangkan. Ini,\lhadiah kecil dariku.

entries.original:
"Recently, I got myself thinkin’
about what I’d do if I hung up mah\lhat, an’ quit the whole Gym Leader\lschding.

Not like I’m keepin’ these good
looks forever, ya know what I’m\lsayin’?

Kind of a soberin’ thought, but I
once dated a gal\. who said I can’t\lhold onto everthin’.

So\. I’ll age gracefully with time,
and not a moment sooner, understand?"
entries.translation_source: Recently, I got myself thinkin’ about what I’d do if I hung up mah hat, an’ quit the whole Gym Leader schding. Not like I’m keepin’ these good looks forever, ya know what I’m sayin’? Kind of a soberin’ thought, but I once dated a gal\. who said I can’t hold onto everthin’. So\. I’ll age gracefully with time, and not a moment sooner, understand?
entries.translated:
Baru-baru ini, aku berpikir tentang
apa yang akan kulakukan jika aku\lmenggantung topiku, dan berhenti

dari seluruh urusan Pemimpin Gym.
Bukannya aku akan menjaga\lketampanan ini selamanya, kau tahu

maksudku? Pemikiran yang agak
menyadarkan, tapi aku pernah\lberpacaran dengan seorang cewek\.

yang bilang aku tidak bisa memegang
semuanya. Jadi\. Aku akan menua\ldengan anggun seiring waktu, dan

tidak lebih cepat, mengerti?

entries.original:
"Yo, wazzap, fella?

Howzit goin’?

Ha ha ha ha!
I’m back, baby!

Galavan’s in the house, louder and
brighter than ever!

I’ve been temperin’ my Pokémon’s
iron bodies, all for another match\lwith ya!

And now, you’re lookin’ at the
latest, greatest, most up-to-date\ledition of Galavan!

So ya know what I’m gonna ask
next, right? Course ya do!

Battle me! Let me show off my latest
pride and joy right here!

In return, I can get to see how ya
improved on your own techs and\ltricks.

Two fellow tech-heads, striving to
improve.

C’mon, whaddya say?"
entries.translation_source: Yo, wazzap, fella? Howzit goin’? Ha ha ha ha! I’m back, baby! Galavan’s in the house, louder and brighter than ever! I’ve been temperin’ my Pokémon’s iron bodies, all for another match with ya! And now, you’re lookin’ at the latest, greatest, most up-to-date edition of Galavan! So ya know what I’m gonna ask next, right? Course ya do! Battle me! Let me show off my latest pride and joy right here! In return, I can get to see how ya improved on your own techs and tricks. Two fellow tech-heads, striving to improve. C’mon, whaddya say?
entries.translated:
Yo, apa kabar, bung? Gimana
kabarnya? Ha ha ha ha! Aku kembali,\lsayang! Galavan ada di rumah, lebih

keras dan lebih terang dari
sebelumnya! Aku telah menempa tubuh\lbesi Pokémon-ku, semua demi

pertandingan lain denganmu! Dan
sekarang, kau melihat edisi\lterbaru, terhebat, paling mutakhir

dari Galavan! Jadi kau tahu apa
yang akan kutanyakan selanjutnya,\lkan? Tentu saja kau tahu!

Bertarunglah denganku! Biarkan aku
menunjukkan kebanggaan dan\lkegembiraan terbaruku di sini!

Sebagai balasannya, aku bisa
melihat bagaimana kau meningkatkan\lteknik dan trikmu sendiri. Dua

sesama penggemar teknologi,
berusaha untuk maju. Ayo, bagaimana\lmenurutmu?

entries.original:
"Whaaaaa?

C’mon, don’t leave ol’ Galavan
hanging here - ya gotta say yes!"
entries.translation_source: Whaaaaa? C’mon, don’t leave ol’ Galavan hanging here - ya gotta say yes!
entries.translated:
Whaaaaa? Ayolah, jangan biarkan
Galavan tua tergantung di sini -\lkau harus bilang ya!

entries.original:
"Ah, what a champ ya are!

And for such a champ, let’s do our
battle as a [green]Double Battle[blue]!

Awright, race ya to the battle area!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, what a champ ya are! And for such a champ, let’s do our battle as a [green]Double Battle[blue]! Awright, race ya to the battle area!
entries.translated:
Ah, kau seorang juara sejati! Dan
untuk juara seperti itu, mari kita\llakukan pertarungan sebagai

[green]Pertarungan Ganda[blue]! Baiklah, adu
cepat ke area pertarungan!

entries.original:
"[blue]My machines of war are geared up
and ready to roll! Woooooar!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]My machines of war are geared up and ready to roll! Woooooar!
entries.translated:
[blue]Mesin perangku sudah siap dan siap
untuk bergerak! Woooooar!

entries.original:
"[blue]Gaaaah!

How do ya keep doin’ that?
Seriously?

Guess it’s back to the drawing
board for ol’ Galavan, and so soon\lafter, too\.

Actually, why don’t ya improve
your own battling on the side?

I got two of these Z-Crystals
here\. ah, I’m such a swell guy,\lI’ll let ya have both!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Gaaaah! How do ya keep doin’ that? Seriously? Guess it’s back to the drawing board for ol’ Galavan, and so soon after, too\. Actually, why don’t ya improve your own battling on the side? I got two of these Z-Crystals here\. ah, I’m such a swell guy, I’ll let ya have both!
entries.translated:
[blue]Gaaaah! Bagaimana kau bisa terus
melakukan itu? Serius? Sepertinya\lGalavan tua harus kembali ke papan

gambar, dan begitu cepat juga\.
Sebenarnya, kenapa kau tidak\lmeningkatkan pertarunganmu sendiri

di samping? Aku punya dua Z-Crystal
di sini\. ah, aku pria yang baik, aku\lakan memberimu keduanya!

entries.original:
"[green]Steelium Z[blue], [green]Electrium Z[blue]\. those two
crystals supercharge [green]Steel[blue]- and\l[green]Electric[blue]-type attacks.

Shame ya can’t use both in the
same battle, but I guess life ain’t\lfair sometimes.

Honestly, I can’t really decide
which one’s better for shaking up\lthe battlefield myself.

Grind ’em into the floor with
[green]Corkscrew Crash[blue]\.

Or leave ’em twitchin’ on the floor
with a good ol’ [green]Gigavolt Havoc[blue]?

They’re both great!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Steelium Z[blue], [green]Electrium Z[blue]\. those two crystals supercharge [green]Steel[blue]- and [green]Electric[blue]-type attacks. Shame ya can’t use both in the same battle, but I guess life ain’t fair sometimes. Honestly, I can’t really decide which one’s better for shaking up the battlefield myself. Grind ’em into the floor with [green]Corkscrew Crash[blue]\. Or leave ’em twitchin’ on the floor with a good ol’ [green]Gigavolt Havoc[blue]? They’re both great!
entries.translated:
[green]Steelium Z[blue], [green]Electrium Z[blue]\. dua kristal
itu memperkuat serangan tipe [green]Baja[blue]-\ldan [green]Listrik[blue]. Sayang kau tidak bisa

menggunakan keduanya dalam
pertarungan yang sama, tapi kurasa\lhidup tidak adil kadang-kadang.

Sejujurnya, aku sendiri tidak bisa
memutuskan mana yang lebih baik\luntuk mengguncang medan

pertempuran. Hancurkan mereka ke
lantai dengan [green]Corkscrew Crash[blue]\. Atau\lbiarkan mereka kejang-kejang di

lantai dengan [green]Gigavolt Havoc[blue] yang
lama? Keduanya bagus!

entries.original:
"[player]! You’re back!
Great timing!

There’s still a few bugs in my own
battling, I think, but there’s only\lone way to know!

And that’s with a good old-
fashioned field test!

I’ll help ya iron out your own
team, too!

Let’s help us help each other
here!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! You’re back! Great timing! There’s still a few bugs in my own battling, I think, but there’s only one way to know! And that’s with a good old- fashioned field test! I’ll help ya iron out your own team, too! Let’s help us help each other here!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kau kembali! Waktu yang
tepat! Masih ada beberapa bug dalam\lpertarunganku sendiri, kurasa, tapi

hanya ada satu cara untuk tahu! Dan
itu dengan uji coba lapangan\ltradisional! Aku akan membantumu

merapikan timmu juga! Mari kita
saling membantu di sini!

entries.original:
"[blue]Gaaaah! Broken down again!

We gotta do this again sometime!

Here, consider this a promise from
me, because ol’ Galavan ain’t done\lwith ya yet!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Gaaaah! Broken down again! We gotta do this again sometime! Here, consider this a promise from me, because ol’ Galavan ain’t done with ya yet!
entries.translated:
[blue]Gaaaah! Rusak lagi! Kita harus
melakukan ini lagi suatu saat! Ini,\langgap ini janji dariku, karena

Galavan tua belum selesai denganmu!

entries.original:
"There’s a stereotype among Electric-
type Trainers\.

Apparently, ya gotta be good with
machines to even train ’em properly.

I mean, ol’ Galavan doesn’t believe
in labels, but I see their point.

Have you SEEN the damage they can
do to our tech?

We’d go broke if we couldn’t fix what
they break ourselves!

Ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: There’s a stereotype among Electric- type Trainers\. Apparently, ya gotta be good with machines to even train ’em properly. I mean, ol’ Galavan doesn’t believe in labels, but I see their point. Have you SEEN the damage they can do to our tech? We’d go broke if we couldn’t fix what they break ourselves! Ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Ada stereotip di antara Pelatih
tipe Listrik\. Rupanya, kau harus\lpandai dengan mesin untuk bisa

melatih mereka dengan benar.
Maksudku, Galavan tua tidak percaya\lpada label, tapi aku mengerti

maksud mereka. Pernahkah kau
MELIHAT kerusakan yang bisa mereka\llakukan pada teknologi kita? Kami

akan bangkrut jika tidak bisa
memperbaiki apa yang mereka rusak\lsendiri! Ha ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha ha!
Look who decided to show up!

If it isn’t our latest Champion,
[player]!

Hah! If you’re here, then I guess
you’ve staked a claim on this turf\lalready, huh?

Last time I lost, I knew I had to
get out and\. let’s say, assert\lmyself elsewhere, you get me?

But I guess I gotta keep lookin’
for Big Mo’s new base, huh?

Unless\. you wanna try taking on the
kingpin, right here, right now?

For real this time. The joint
belongs to whoever wins.

I warn ya, I’m not the same as
before!

Well? What’s it gonna be, squirt?
Or are you quaking in yer boots\lalready?"
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha ha! Look who decided to show up! If it isn’t our latest Champion, [player]! Hah! If you’re here, then I guess you’ve staked a claim on this turf already, huh? Last time I lost, I knew I had to get out and\. let’s say, assert myself elsewhere, you get me? But I guess I gotta keep lookin’ for Big Mo’s new base, huh? Unless\. you wanna try taking on the kingpin, right here, right now? For real this time. The joint belongs to whoever wins. I warn ya, I’m not the same as before! Well? What’s it gonna be, squirt? Or are you quaking in yer boots already?
entries.translated:
Ha ha ha ha! Lihat siapa yang
memutuskan untuk muncul! Kalau\lbukan Juara terbaru kita, [player]!

Hah! Jika kau di sini, kurasa kau
sudah mengklaim wilayah ini, ya?\lTerakhir kali aku kalah, aku tahu

aku harus keluar dan\. katakanlah,
menegaskan diri di tempat lain, kau\lmengerti? Tapi kurasa aku harus

terus mencari markas baru Big Mo,
ya? Kecuali\. kau ingin mencoba\lmelawan bos besar, di sini,

sekarang? Sungguhan kali ini.
Tempat ini milik siapa pun yang\lmenang. Aku peringatkan, aku tidak

sama seperti sebelumnya! Nah?
Bagaimana, bocah? Atau kau sudah\lgemetar di sepatumu?

entries.original:
"Grr\. you lookin’ down on me, ya
snot-nosed punk?

Well, I’m stayin’ here until ya
chase me out, got it?

\.or until the next day.
I got places to be."
entries.translation_source: Grr\. you lookin’ down on me, ya snot-nosed punk? Well, I’m stayin’ here until ya chase me out, got it? \.or until the next day. I got places to be.
entries.translated:
Grr\. kamu meremehkan aku, ya bocah
ingusan? Baiklah, aku akan tetap di\lsini sampai kamu mengusirku,

mengerti? \.atau sampai besok. Aku
ada urusan.

entries.original:
"Heh\. sucker.

Alright, let’s take this to the
battle area already."
entries.translation_source: Heh\. sucker. Alright, let’s take this to the battle area already.
entries.translated:
Heh\. bodoh. Baiklah, ayo kita bawa
ini ke area pertarungan sekarang.

entries.original:
"[blue]You’re trapped in this cage with me,
and there’s nowhere to run, punk!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]You’re trapped in this cage with me, and there’s nowhere to run, punk!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu terjebak di dalam sangkar ini
bersamaku, dan tidak ada tempat\luntuk lari, bocah!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ha! So even the kingpin can’t do a
thing against the Champion, huh?

But don’t think that’s gonna keep
Big Mo down forever!

I just need to see more of
whatever the world outside Antisis\lhas to offer!

Here. Use this Z-Crystal.

That should keep you winning\. until
I take ya down myself!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Ha! So even the kingpin can’t do a thing against the Champion, huh? But don’t think that’s gonna keep Big Mo down forever! I just need to see more of whatever the world outside Antisis has to offer! Here. Use this Z-Crystal. That should keep you winning\. until I take ya down myself!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ha! Jadi bahkan raja kriminal tidak
bisa berbuat apa-apa melawan Juara,\lya? Tapi jangan kira itu akan

membuat Big Mo terpuruk selamanya!
Aku hanya perlu melihat lebih\lbanyak apa yang dunia di luar

Antisis tawarkan! Ini. Gunakan
Z-Crystal ini. Itu akan membuatmu\lterus menang\. sampai aku

mengalahkanmu sendiri!

entries.original:
"[blue]That’s the [green]Fightinium Z[blue]!

[green]Fighting[blue]-type attacks get all
souped up with that thing!

But, they’re pretty exhausting.

I’m Big Mo, and even I can only do
it once a battle!

But for the one moment I tap into
that Z-Crystal\.

Any poor sucker in the way gets an
[green]All-Out Pummeling[blue]!

No-holds barred!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]That’s the [green]Fightinium Z[blue]! [green]Fighting[blue]-type attacks get all souped up with that thing! But, they’re pretty exhausting. I’m Big Mo, and even I can only do it once a battle! But for the one moment I tap into that Z-Crystal\. Any poor sucker in the way gets an [green]All-Out Pummeling[blue]! No-holds barred!
entries.translated:
[blue]Itu [green]Fightinium Z[blue]! Serangan tipe
[green]Pertarungan[blue] menjadi sangat kuat\ldengan benda itu! Tapi, itu cukup

melelahkan. Aku Big Mo, dan bahkan
aku hanya bisa melakukannya sekali\ldalam pertarungan! Tapi untuk satu

saat aku memanfaatkan Z-Crystal itu\.
Setiap orang malang yang\lmenghalangi akan mendapatkan

[green]Pukulan Total[blue]! Tanpa aturan!

entries.original:
"Well, look who’s here!

I’m back for another chance to
settle the score with ya!

One more try at dethroning the
untouchable Champion!

So, you willin’ to put it all on the
line and take on the kingpin?"
entries.translation_source: Well, look who’s here! I’m back for another chance to settle the score with ya! One more try at dethroning the untouchable Champion! So, you willin’ to put it all on the line and take on the kingpin?
entries.translated:
Nah, lihat siapa yang ada di sini!
Aku kembali untuk kesempatan lain\luntuk menyelesaikan skor denganmu!

Satu percobaan lagi untuk
menjatuhkan Juara yang tak\ltersentuh! Jadi, kamu bersedia

mempertaruhkan semuanya dan
menghadapi raja kriminal?

entries.original:
"[blue]Tch\. beaten down again\.
unbelievable\.

Ha ha ha ha!
Guess I gotta keep training!

Here, a little something so you
don’t lose your edge!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Tch\. beaten down again\. unbelievable\. Ha ha ha ha! Guess I gotta keep training! Here, a little something so you don’t lose your edge!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tch\. dikalahkan lagi\. tidak percaya\.
Ha ha ha ha! Sepertinya aku harus\lterus berlatih! Ini, sedikit

sesuatu agar kamu tidak kehilangan
keunggulanmu!

entries.original:
"By the way\. I’ve been revamping my
Gym back in Antisis, lately.

Losing to ya made me realize I
needed to let more fish into\lthe pond.

It ain’t much - all it offers is an
extra challenge\.

But all the visitors seem to
like it.

Even if they don’t like me!

Ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: By the way\. I’ve been revamping my Gym back in Antisis, lately. Losing to ya made me realize I needed to let more fish into the pond. It ain’t much - all it offers is an extra challenge\. But all the visitors seem to like it. Even if they don’t like me! Ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Ngomong-ngomong\. Aku baru saja
merenovasi Gym-ku di Antisis,\lakhir-akhir ini. Kalah darimu

membuatku sadar bahwa aku perlu
membiarkan lebih banyak ikan masuk\lke kolam. Ini bukan banyak - yang

ditawarkan hanyalah tantangan
tambahan\. Tapi semua pengunjung\lsepertinya menyukainya. Meskipun

mereka tidak menyukai aku! Ha ha ha
ha!

entries.original:
"Howdy, sugah!
Fancy meeting ya here!

I got worried sick ’bout ya after
our Gym Battle, but I guess I\ldidn’t need to be!

Me? Ah, well\. even I need some time
away from the swamp - clear my\lhead some, see?

Plus, word is that this place here
is where the best in Borrius come\ltogether.

Must be true, if you’re here.

So, while we’re both killin’ time\.
ya fancy another round? You and I?

Last time ya seemed\. a mite
desperate, like getting my Badge\lmeant life or death.

This time, I wanna battle the real
[player].

Whaddya say? I’m itchin’ to show ya
how we’ve gotten better, too!"
entries.translation_source: Howdy, sugah! Fancy meeting ya here! I got worried sick ’bout ya after our Gym Battle, but I guess I didn’t need to be! Me? Ah, well\. even I need some time away from the swamp - clear my head some, see? Plus, word is that this place here is where the best in Borrius come together. Must be true, if you’re here. So, while we’re both killin’ time\. ya fancy another round? You and I? Last time ya seemed\. a mite desperate, like getting my Badge meant life or death. This time, I wanna battle the real [player]. Whaddya say? I’m itchin’ to show ya how we’ve gotten better, too!
entries.translated:
Halo, manis! Senang bertemu kamu di
sini! Aku khawatir setengah mati\ltentangmu setelah Pertarungan Gym

kita, tapi sepertinya tidak perlu!
Aku? Ah, baiklah\. bahkan aku perlu\lwaktu jauh dari rawa - menjernihkan

pikiran, lihat? Plus, kabarnya
tempat ini adalah tempat\lberkumpulnya yang terbaik di

Borrius. Pasti benar, jika kamu di
sini. Jadi, sementara kita berdua\lmembuang waktu\. kamu tertarik untuk

ronde lain? Kamu dan aku? Terakhir
kali kamu tampak\. agak putus asa,\lseperti mendapatkan Lencanaku

berarti hidup atau mati. Kali ini,
aku ingin bertarung melawan\l[player] yang sesungguhnya.

Bagaimana? Aku sangat ingin
menunjukkan bagaimana kami juga\lmenjadi lebih baik!

entries.original:
"Too busy? I get it.

Still, I’m here all day, so if ya
change your mind\. drop by again."
entries.translation_source: Too busy? I get it. Still, I’m here all day, so if ya change your mind\. drop by again.
entries.translated:
Terlalu sibuk? Aku mengerti. Tetap
saja, aku di sini sepanjang hari,\ljadi jika kamu berubah pikiran\.

mampir lagi.

entries.original:
"Aw yeah, that’s what I’m talkin’
about! Meet ya at the battle area!"
entries.translation_source: Aw yeah, that’s what I’m talkin’ about! Meet ya at the battle area!
entries.translated:
Aw yeah, itu yang aku maksud! Temui
aku di area pertarungan!

entries.original:
"[red]Yer already in deep\. and it’s only
gonna get deeper! Get ready!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Yer already in deep\. and it’s only gonna get deeper! Get ready!
entries.translated:
[red]Kamu sudah dalam masalah besar\. dan
itu hanya akan semakin dalam!\lBersiaplah!

entries.original:
"[red]I got swamped again?
Well, don’t that just beat all!

Coulda sworn I trained enough to
catch up to ya, but guess not.

Alright, that settles it!
I’ll let ya have this!

Call it a present, just for being
that dang amazing - it’s my\lfavourite Z-Crystal!"
entries.translation_source: [red]I got swamped again? Well, don’t that just beat all! Coulda sworn I trained enough to catch up to ya, but guess not. Alright, that settles it! I’ll let ya have this! Call it a present, just for being that dang amazing - it’s my favourite Z-Crystal!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku dikalahkan lagi? Wah, itu
benar-benar keterlaluan! Aku\lbersumpah aku berlatih cukup untuk

mengejarmu, tapi ternyata tidak.
Baiklah, itu sudah jelas! Aku akan\lmemberikan ini padamu! Sebut saja

hadiah, hanya karena kamu begitu
luar biasa - ini Z-Crystal\lfavoritku!

entries.original:
"[red]Use that [green]Waterium Z[red], and it’ll turn
any [green]Water[red]-type attack into a\lpowerful [green]Z-Move[red]!

But it’s only good once a battle,
so ya gotta make the shot count.

Watching a move like [green]Hydro Vortex[red]\.

Sure am glad the swamp don’t
suffer from that sorta thing!

I mean, it’s been havin’ its own
problems as it is, lately\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Use that [green]Waterium Z[red], and it’ll turn any [green]Water[red]-type attack into a powerful [green]Z-Move[red]! But it’s only good once a battle, so ya gotta make the shot count. Watching a move like [green]Hydro Vortex[red]\. Sure am glad the swamp don’t suffer from that sorta thing! I mean, it’s been havin’ its own problems as it is, lately\.
entries.translated:
[red]Gunakan [green]Waterium Z[red] itu, dan itu
akan mengubah serangan tipe [green]Air[red]\lmenjadi [green]Z-Move[red] yang kuat! Tapi

hanya berguna sekali dalam
pertarungan, jadi kamu harus\lmemanfaatkannya. Melihat jurus

seperti [green]Pusaran Air[red]\. Tentunya aku
senang rawa tidak menderita dari\lhal semacam itu! Maksudku, rawa

sudah punya masalah sendiri
akhir-akhir ini\.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]! Great timing!

Last time left a li’l raincloud over
my head that won’t go away.

And the only way I’m gonna clear my
mind\. is a shot at redemption!

If y’all have time to spare today,
ya wanna throw down one more time?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player]! Great timing! Last time left a li’l raincloud over my head that won’t go away. And the only way I’m gonna clear my mind\. is a shot at redemption! If y’all have time to spare today, ya wanna throw down one more time?
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Waktu yang tepat!
Terakhir kali meninggalkan awan\lhujan kecil di atas kepalaku yang

tidak akan hilang. Dan satu-satunya
cara untuk menjernihkan pikiranku\.\ladalah kesempatan untuk penebusan!

Jika kalian punya waktu luang hari
ini, kamu mau bertarung sekali\llagi?

entries.original:
"[red]Aw, dangit. You’re a whole lot better
than I thought, sugah.

Here, ya can have this.

Call it a promise to take ya
on again!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Aw, dangit. You’re a whole lot better than I thought, sugah. Here, ya can have this. Call it a promise to take ya on again!
entries.translated:
[red]Ah, sial. Kamu jauh lebih baik dari
yang kukira, manis. Ini, kamu boleh\lpunya ini. Sebut saja janji untuk

melawanku lagi!

entries.original:
"I wonder how Mel’s doin’?

He always had a hard time lettin’
go of anythin’.

Gifts, his past, even grudges\. he
holds ’em tight.

It ain’t obvious unless ya pay
attention, though.

I tried to part on good terms,
when I moved to Polder - gave him\lthe ol’ Gym before I left.

If he showed up here, same day as
me\. wonder what he’d say\.\lor if he’d say anythin’ at all?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder how Mel’s doin’? He always had a hard time lettin’ go of anythin’. Gifts, his past, even grudges\. he holds ’em tight. It ain’t obvious unless ya pay attention, though. I tried to part on good terms, when I moved to Polder - gave him the ol’ Gym before I left. If he showed up here, same day as me\. wonder what he’d say\. or if he’d say anythin’ at all?
entries.translated:
Aku penasaran bagaimana kabar Mel?
Dia selalu sulit melepaskan apapun.\lHadiah, masa lalunya, bahkan dendam\.

dia pegang erat-erat. Itu tidak
jelas kecuali kamu perhatikan. Aku\lmencoba berpisah dengan baik,

ketika aku pindah ke Polder -
memberinya Gym lama sebelum aku\lpergi. Jika dia muncul di sini,

hari yang sama denganku\. aku ingin
tahu apa yang akan dia katakan\. atau\lapakah dia akan mengatakan apapun?

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. it’s been ages\.
ages, I say, since I’ve felt such a\lstrong urge to cross paths with a\lfellow Trainer once more.

Hello again, and my heartiest
congratulations on becoming\lChampion.

And, I suppose, my most heartfelt
thanks for ridding the world of a\lmost terrible evil.

I remember when we last battled, I
was fortunate enough to catch you\lquite near the end of your quest\lto the Pokémon League.

You were much like a Butterfree,
newly emerged, with nothing left\lbut to wait for its wings to dry\land harden.

But now, I wish to see your
strength at its fullest.

What did you experience?

What ground have you tread as you
lived through those moments?

I desire another battle, so I may
observe the results.

Will you indulge this old man?"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. it’s been ages\. ages, I say, since I’ve felt such a strong urge to cross paths with a fellow Trainer once more. Hello again, and my heartiest congratulations on becoming Champion. And, I suppose, my most heartfelt thanks for ridding the world of a most terrible evil. I remember when we last battled, I was fortunate enough to catch you quite near the end of your quest to the Pokémon League. You were much like a Butterfree, newly emerged, with nothing left but to wait for its wings to dry and harden. But now, I wish to see your strength at its fullest. What did you experience? What ground have you tread as you lived through those moments? I desire another battle, so I may observe the results. Will you indulge this old man?
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. sudah berabad-abad\.
berabad-abad, kataku, sejak aku\lmerasakan keinginan kuat untuk

bertemu dengan sesama Pelatih
sekali lagi. Halo lagi, dan ucapan\lselamatku yang paling tulus atas

menjadi Juara. Dan, kurasa, terima
kasihku yang paling tulus karena\ltelah membebaskan dunia dari

kejahatan yang paling mengerikan.
Aku ingat ketika kita terakhir\lbertarung, aku cukup beruntung bisa

bertemu kamu menjelang akhir
perjalananmu ke Pokémon League.\lKamu seperti Butterfree, yang baru

muncul, tanpa sisa apa pun selain
menunggu sayapnya kering dan\lmengeras. Tapi sekarang, aku ingin

melihat kekuatanmu yang paling
penuh. Apa yang kamu alami? Tanah\lapa yang kamu injak saat kamu

menjalani momen-momen itu? Aku
menginginkan pertarungan lain, agar\laku dapat mengamati hasilnya.

Maukah kamu memenuhi permintaan
orang tua ini?

entries.original:
"I see\. if you change your mind,
I’ll be here all day.

I would say I’m not getting any
younger waiting, but\."
entries.translation_source: I see\. if you change your mind, I’ll be here all day. I would say I’m not getting any younger waiting, but\.
entries.translated:
Begitu ya\. jika kamu berubah
pikiran, aku akan di sini sepanjang\lhari. Aku akan mengatakan aku tidak

semakin muda menunggu, tapi\.

entries.original:
"Ah, you have my thanks.

Then I shall make my way to the
battle area."
entries.translation_source: Ah, you have my thanks. Then I shall make my way to the battle area.
entries.translated:
Ah, terima kasih. Maka aku akan
menuju ke area pertarungan.

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, bear witness, to the tempered
resilience of my Pokémon and I!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now, bear witness, to the tempered resilience of my Pokémon and I!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang, saksikanlah, ketahanan
yang ditempa dari Pokémon-ku dan\laku!

entries.original:
"[blue]Goodness\. I think I’ve gotten a bit
too excited again.

But I can’t help it!

I can’t help but smile, when the
pride of Borrius is truly so strong.

Take this Z-Crystal.

I believe that you should have no
problem tapping into its power."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Goodness\. I think I’ve gotten a bit too excited again. But I can’t help it! I can’t help but smile, when the pride of Borrius is truly so strong. Take this Z-Crystal. I believe that you should have no problem tapping into its power.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ya ampun\. Aku rasa aku jadi terlalu
bersemangat lagi. Tapi aku tidak\lbisa menahannya! Aku tidak bisa

tidak tersenyum, ketika kebanggaan
Borrius benar-benar begitu kuat.\lAmbillah Z-Crystal ini. Aku percaya

kamu seharusnya tidak masalah
memanfaatkan kekuatannya.

entries.original:
"[blue]The [green]Buginium Z[blue] empowers [green]Bug[blue]-type
attacks, as you’ve probably\lguessed.

It unleashes a powerful [green]Z-Move[blue],
but this trump card is only useable\lonce per battle.

I found that I have a certain
fondness for the result, the deadly\l[green]Savage Spin-Out[blue].

My old teacher was known to use
it, for students who couldn’t tell\lthe difference between a cocoon\land a chrysalis\.

Incidentally, cocoons are
structures made of silk, made to\lhouse a creature.

A chrysalis IS the creature."
entries.translation_source: [blue]The [green]Buginium Z[blue] empowers [green]Bug[blue]-type attacks, as you’ve probably guessed. It unleashes a powerful [green]Z-Move[blue], but this trump card is only useable once per battle. I found that I have a certain fondness for the result, the deadly [green]Savage Spin-Out[blue]. My old teacher was known to use it, for students who couldn’t tell the difference between a cocoon and a chrysalis\. Incidentally, cocoons are structures made of silk, made to house a creature. A chrysalis IS the creature.
entries.translated:
[blue]Seperti yang mungkin sudah kamu
duga, [green]Buginium Z[blue] memperkuat\lserangan [green]tipe Serangga[blue]. Ini

melepaskan [green]Z-Move[blue] yang kuat, tetapi
kartu truf ini hanya bisa digunakan\lsekali per pertempuran. Aku merasa

aku memiliki kesukaan tertentu pada
hasilnya, yaitu [green]Savage Spin-Out[blue]\lyang mematikan. Guru lamaku dikenal

menggunakannya untuk murid yang
tidak bisa membedakan antara\lkepompong dan krisalis\.

Ngomong-ngomong, kepompong adalah
struktur yang terbuat dari sutra,\ldibuat untuk menampung makhluk.

Krisalis ADALAH makhluk itu
sendiri.

entries.original:
"Ah, [player]\. your arrival is
somewhat timely.

I couldn’t help but think about how
much I wanted to battle you again\.

I suppose your journey with
Pokémon is far from over, and I\lwant to observe your growth,\levery step of the way.

So, would you allow this old man
to be part of your journey,\lonce more?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player]\. your arrival is somewhat timely. I couldn’t help but think about how much I wanted to battle you again\. I suppose your journey with Pokémon is far from over, and I want to observe your growth, every step of the way. So, would you allow this old man to be part of your journey, once more?
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]\. kedatanganmu agak
tepat waktu. Aku tidak bisa tidak\lmemikirkan betapa aku ingin

bertarung denganmu lagi\. Kurasa
perjalananmu dengan Pokémon masih\ljauh dari selesai, dan aku ingin

mengamati pertumbuhanmu, setiap
langkahnya. Jadi, maukah kau\lmengizinkan orang tua ini menjadi

bagian dari perjalananmu, sekali
lagi?

entries.original:
"[blue]Ah\. just seeing how strong the
newest generation of Trainers is\lalways brings a smile to my face.

You never fail to make me feel -
and look - younger.

For that, I think you should
have this."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Ah\. just seeing how strong the newest generation of Trainers is always brings a smile to my face. You never fail to make me feel - and look - younger. For that, I think you should have this.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ah\. hanya melihat betapa kuatnya
generasi Trainer terbaru selalu\lmembuatku tersenyum. Kau tidak

pernah gagal membuatku merasa - dan
terlihat - lebih muda. Untuk itu,\laku pikir kau harus memiliki ini.

entries.original:
"My odd condition\. it is rather
taxing on my body.

Nowadays, my old bones ache, but
when I battle, it’s like all my\ltiredness disappears.

It does, however, throw some
people off, when I don’t act how\lI should.

But no matter my age and
appearance, when it comes to\lPokémon, I will always be a child\lat heart."
entries.translation_source: My odd condition\. it is rather taxing on my body. Nowadays, my old bones ache, but when I battle, it’s like all my tiredness disappears. It does, however, throw some people off, when I don’t act how I should. But no matter my age and appearance, when it comes to Pokémon, I will always be a child at heart.
entries.translated:
Kondisi anehku\. itu cukup membebani
tubuhku. Saat ini, tulang-tulang\llamaku sakit, tetapi saat aku

bertarung, semua kelelahanku
hilang. Namun, hal itu membuat\lbeberapa orang bingung, ketika aku

tidak bertindak sebagaimana
mestinya. Tapi tidak peduli usia\ldan penampilanku, dalam hal

Pokémon, aku akan selalu menjadi
anak kecil di hati.

entries.original: "Referee"
entries.translation_source: Referee
entries.translated: Wasit

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Mirskle, the room will be\lfilled with a dense [green]Fog[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Mirskle, the room will be filled with a dense [green]Fog[blue]\.
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Mirskle, ruangan akan dipenuhi\ldengan [green]Kabut[blue] yang pekat\.

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Véga, [green]negative emotions[blue]\lwill fill the air!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Véga, [green]negative emotions[blue] will fill the air!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Véga, [green]emosi negatif[blue] akan\lmemenuhi udara!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Alice, a [green]Tailwind[blue] will blow\lbehind all Flying-type Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Alice, a [green]Tailwind[blue] will blow behind all Flying-type Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Alice, [green]Angin Ekor[blue] akan bertiup\ldi belakang semua Pokémon tipe

Terbang!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Alice, a [green]Tailwind[blue] will blow\lbehind all Flying-type Pokémon, in\laddition to [green]weakening super\leffective attacks[blue] against them!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Alice, a [green]Tailwind[blue] will blow behind all Flying-type Pokémon, in addition to [green]weakening super effective attacks[blue] against them!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Alice, [green]Angin Ekor[blue] akan bertiup\ldi belakang semua Pokémon tipe

Terbang, selain [green]melemahkan serangan
yang sangat efektif[blue] terhadap\lmereka!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Mel, all [green]type matchups[blue]\lwill be [green]reversed[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Mel, all [green]type matchups[blue] will be [green]reversed[blue]!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Mel, semua [green]kecocokan tipe[blue] akan\l[green]dibalik[blue]!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Galavan, [green]Electric[blue]- and\l[green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon will avoid\l[green]Ground[blue]-type moves!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Galavan, [green]Electric[blue]- and [green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon will avoid [green]Ground[blue]-type moves!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Galavan, Pokémon tipe [green]Listrik[blue]\ldan [green]Baja[blue] akan menghindari serangan

tipe [green]Tanah[blue]!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Galavan, [green]Electric[blue]- and\l[green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon will avoid\l[green]Ground[blue]-type moves, while also\lbenefiting from an [green]Electric Terrain[blue]!"

entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Galavan, Pokémon tipe [green]Listrik[blue]\ldan [green]Baja[blue] akan menghindari serangan

tipe [green]Tanah[blue], sementara juga
mendapatkan keuntungan dari [green]Medan\lListrik[blue]!

Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Big Mo, serangan tipe [green]Terbang[blue]\ldan [green]Peri[blue] tidak dapat digunakan!

Leader, Big Mo, a Pokémon’s speed\lwill be determined by its weight!"

entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Big Mo, kecepatan Pokémon akan\lditentukan oleh beratnya!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Tessy, it will be [green]raining[blue]\land Pokémon will become the [green]types[blue]\lof their [green]first two moves[blue]!"

entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Tessy, akan [green]hujan[blue] dan Pokémon\lakan menjadi [green]tipe[blue] dari [green]dua serangan

pertama[blue] mereka!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Tessy, a [green]heavy rain[blue] will\lbe falling, and Pokémon will take\lthe [green]types[blue] of their [green]first two moves[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Tessy, a [green]heavy rain[blue] will be falling, and Pokémon will take the [green]types[blue] of their [green]first two moves[blue]!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Tessy, [green]hujan lebat[blue] akan turun,\ldan Pokémon akan mengambil [green]tipe[blue]

dari [green]dua serangan pertama[blue] mereka!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Benjamin, Pokémon will\l[green]devolve[blue] when they are defeated!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Benjamin, Pokémon will [green]devolve[blue] when they are defeated!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Benjamin, Pokémon akan [green]mundur\levolusi[blue] saat mereka dikalahkan!

entries.original:
"[red]Mommy brings me here so I can watch
her \qokick some noob heinie!\qc

That what she says, anyway."
entries.translation_source: [red]Mommy brings me here so I can watch her \qokick some noob heinie!\qc That what she says, anyway.
entries.translated:
[red]Ibu membawaku ke sini supaya aku
bisa melihatnya \qomenendang pantat\lnoob!\qc Itulah yang dia katakan,

sih.

Give me an E!

Give me an L!

What does that spell?

Mel, Mel, Mel!

Goooooooooo, Mel!

\.What?

I’m Mel’s personal cheerleader.

It’s my job to cheer him on, and I

entries.translation_source: [red]Give me an M! Give me an E! Give me an L! What does that spell? Mel, Mel, Mel! Goooooooooo, Mel! \.What? I’m Mel’s personal cheerleader. It’s my job to cheer him on, and I don’t care one bit if it bothers you!
entries.translated:
[red]Beri aku M! Beri aku E! Beri aku L!
Apa yang dieja? Mel, Mel, Mel!\lGoooooooooo, Mel! \.Apa? Aku adalah

cheerleader pribadi Mel. Tugasku
untuk menyemangatinya, dan aku\ltidak peduli sedikit pun jika itu

mengganggumu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo? Huh?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo? Huh?
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa kau benar-benar berpikir kau
bisa mengalahkan Big Mo? Hah?

entries.original: "Gimme a V"
entries.translation_source: Gimme a V
entries.translated: Beri aku V

entries.original:
"Do you see this Pokémon I have
here right next to me?

It’s the Mythical Victory Pokémon,
[green]Victini[red].

It’s known for bringing victory to
the Trainers that use it.

But in truth, the victories only come
if Victini chooses to share its\lpower with its Trainer.

And unfortunately for me, it doesn’t
seem too interested in helping\lsomeone who’s overly reliant on it.

Maybe\. if it could see a Trainer
who can win over and over with\lno miracles necessary\.

Actually, now that I think about
it, you’re the Champion, right?

The Gym Leaders seem to visit this
club pretty often\.

So I thought, maybe if you could
defeat all eight of them again\.

Do you think you could show [green]Victini[red]
that you’re worthy of being its\lideal Trainer?"
entries.translation_source: Do you see this Pokémon I have here right next to me? It’s the Mythical Victory Pokémon, [green]Victini[red]. It’s known for bringing victory to the Trainers that use it. But in truth, the victories only come if Victini chooses to share its power with its Trainer. And unfortunately for me, it doesn’t seem too interested in helping someone who’s overly reliant on it. Maybe\. if it could see a Trainer who can win over and over with no miracles necessary\. Actually, now that I think about it, you’re the Champion, right? The Gym Leaders seem to visit this club pretty often\. So I thought, maybe if you could defeat all eight of them again\. Do you think you could show [green]Victini[red] that you’re worthy of being its ideal Trainer?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat Pokémon yang
ada di sebelahku ini? Itu adalah\lPokémon Kemenangan Mitis, [green]Victini[red].

Ia dikenal membawa kemenangan bagi
Pelatih yang menggunakannya. Tetapi\lsebenarnya, kemenangan hanya datang

jika Victini memilih untuk berbagi
kekuatannya dengan Pelatihnya. Dan\lsayangnya bagiku, ia tampaknya

tidak tertarik membantu seseorang
yang terlalu bergantung padanya.\lMungkin\. jika ia bisa melihat

Pelatih yang bisa menang terus
menerus tanpa perlu keajaiban\.\lSebenarnya, sekarang aku

pikir-pikir, kau adalah Juara, kan?
Para Pemimpin Gym tampaknya sering\lmengunjungi klub ini\. Jadi kupikir,

mungkin jika kau bisa mengalahkan
kedelapan dari mereka lagi\. Apa kau\lpikir kau bisa menunjukkan kepada

[green]Victini[red] bahwa kau layak menjadi
Pelatih idealnya?

entries.original:
"Oh\. I see.
I hoped you’d say yes\.

Victini gets up to all sorts of
trouble since it’s always frustrated\lwith me."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. I see. I hoped you’d say yes\. Victini gets up to all sorts of trouble since it’s always frustrated with me.
entries.translated:
Oh\. Aku mengerti. Aku berharap kau
bilang ya\. Victini sering membuat\lmasalah karena ia selalu frustrasi

denganku.

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you so much!

Victini and I will be staying here
for the time being.

I just need you to let us both see
your brilliant victories here at\lthe Battleground\.

But, that’s not enough\.

I think that to really satisfy
Victini\.

You have to clear the entire
[green]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[red].

Beat all eight of Borrius’
Gym Leaders, in a way only the\lChampion of our region can!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you so much! Victini and I will be staying here for the time being. I just need you to let us both see your brilliant victories here at the Battleground\. But, that’s not enough\. I think that to really satisfy Victini\. You have to clear the entire [green]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[red]. Beat all eight of Borrius’ Gym Leaders, in a way only the Champion of our region can!
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih banyak! Victini
dan aku akan tinggal di sini untuk\lsementara waktu. Aku hanya perlu

kau membiarkan kami berdua melihat
kemenangan gemilangmu di\lBattleground\. Tapi, itu belum cukup\.

Menurutku, untuk benar-benar
memuaskan Victini\. Kau harus\lmenyelesaikan seluruh [green]Classic

Leaders Gauntlet[red]. Kalahkan
kedelapan Pemimpin Gym Borrius,\ldengan cara yang hanya bisa

dilakukan oleh Juara daerah kita!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry about either of us.

The establishment serves food and
drink to patrons, so we can stay\lhere for as long as it’s necessary.

You should just focus on winning
and satisfying Victini’s desire\.

A desire for true victory!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry about either of us. The establishment serves food and drink to patrons, so we can stay here for as long as it’s necessary. You should just focus on winning and satisfying Victini’s desire\. A desire for true victory!
entries.translated:
Jangan khawatir tentang kami
berdua. Tempat ini menyajikan\lmakanan dan minuman untuk

pengunjung, jadi kami bisa tinggal
di sini selama yang diperlukan. Kau\lharus fokus pada kemenangan dan

memuaskan keinginan Victini\.
Keinginan untuk kemenangan sejati!

entries.original:
"Oh, your brilliance\. it was something
else altogether!

It shone so bright, and yet neither
Victini nor myself dared to ever\llook away!

I think that settles it, then!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, your brilliance\. it was something else altogether! It shone so bright, and yet neither Victini nor myself dared to ever look away! I think that settles it, then!
entries.translated:
Oh, kecemerlanganmu\. itu benar-benar
luar biasa! Ia bersinar begitu\lterang, namun baik Victini maupun

diriku tidak berani berpaling!
Kurasa itu sudah memutuskannya,\lkalau begitu!

entries.original:
"Oh, but first, you should deposit one
of your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Oh, but first, you should deposit one of your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Oh, tapi pertama, kau harus
menitipkan salah satu Pokémon-mu.

entries.original: "The Victory Pokémon is yours!"
entries.translation_source: The Victory Pokémon is yours!
entries.translated: Pokémon Kemenangan adalah milikmu!

entries.original:
"Just remember, victory is only
meaningful when it’s grasped for\lyourself, with hard work and\ldetermination!"
entries.translation_source: Just remember, victory is only meaningful when it’s grasped for yourself, with hard work and determination!
entries.translated:
Ingatlah, kemenangan hanya berarti
saat diraih sendiri, dengan kerja\lkeras dan tekad!

entries.original:
"Is Victini doing alright with you?

I hope it’s a lot happier with you
than it was with me\."
entries.translation_source: Is Victini doing alright with you? I hope it’s a lot happier with you than it was with me\.
entries.translated:
Apakah Victini baik-baik saja
bersamamu? Aku harap ia jauh lebih\lbahagia bersamamu daripada dulu

denganku\.

entries.original:
"Hello, there.

By any chance, would you like to
have a [green][buffer1][blue]?

I hatched it from an Egg and have
no way to train it."
entries.translation_source: Hello, there. By any chance, would you like to have a [green][buffer1][blue]? I hatched it from an Egg and have no way to train it.
entries.translated:
Halo, hai. Kebetulan, apakah kau
ingin memiliki [green][buffer1][blue]? Aku\lmenetasnya dari Telur dan tidak

punya cara untuk melatihnya.

entries.original:
"I have been holding on to this
Pokémon Egg for a while now.

I think it is finally close
to hatching!

Any moment now, we will know which
Pokémon is contained within!

\.

\.Nope! Not yet!
Come back later!"
entries.translation_source: I have been holding on to this Pokémon Egg for a while now. I think it is finally close to hatching! Any moment now, we will know which Pokémon is contained within! \. \.Nope! Not yet! Come back later!
entries.translated:
Aku sudah menyimpan Telur Pokémon
ini cukup lama. Kupikir akhirnya\lsudah hampir menetas! Kapan saja

sekarang, kita akan tahu Pokémon
mana yang ada di dalam! \. \.Tidak!\lBelum! Kembali lagi nanti!

entries.original:
"I guess I will have to find another
Trainer for it."
entries.translation_source: I guess I will have to find another Trainer for it.
entries.translated:
Kurasa aku harus mencari Pelatih
lain untuknya.

entries.original:
"It does not look like you have
enough space in your party for\lthis newly hatched Pokémon.

Come back when you have made space."
entries.translation_source: It does not look like you have enough space in your party for this newly hatched Pokémon. Come back when you have made space.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kau tidak memiliki cukup
ruang di timmu untuk Pokémon yang\lbaru menetas ini. Kembalilah saat

kau sudah membuat ruang.

entries.original:
"It is new to the world, so please
take good care of this [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: It is new to the world, so please take good care of this [buffer1].
entries.translated:
Ia baru di dunia ini, jadi tolong
rawat [buffer1] ini dengan baik.

entries.original:
"How is my old Pokémon doing?

I hope you have spent time showing
it around this wonderful world!"
entries.translation_source: How is my old Pokémon doing? I hope you have spent time showing it around this wonderful world!
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kabar Pokémon lamaku? Aku
harap kau sudah meluangkan waktu\luntuk menunjukkannya dunia yang

indah ini!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received a [buffer1]!
It has the [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received a [buffer1]! It has the [green][buffer2][black] nature.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima [buffer1]! Ia
memiliki sifat [green][buffer2][black].

entries.original:
"Please, don’t disturb me, citizen.
I’m on duty."
entries.translation_source: Please, don’t disturb me, citizen. I’m on duty.
entries.translated:
Tolong, jangan ganggu aku, warga.
Aku sedang bertugas.

entries.original:
"What’s that, citizen?
A stolen package?

I’ll let the Pokémon Rangers
handle this one.

I’m on duty."
entries.translation_source: What’s that, citizen? A stolen package? I’ll let the Pokémon Rangers handle this one. I’m on duty.
entries.translated:
Apa itu, warga? Paket yang dicuri?
Biar saya serahkan ini kepada\lRanger Pokémon. Saya sedang

bertugas.

entries.original:
"Have you taken a moment to check
out the local facilities?

The [green]Pokémon Center[blue] heals your
Pokémon for free.

The [green]Poké Mart[blue] sells useful
items for Trainers.

In most other towns, the two
buildings can be distinguished by\ltheir unique red and blue colours."
entries.translation_source: Have you taken a moment to check out the local facilities? The [green]Pokémon Center[blue] heals your Pokémon for free. The [green]Poké Mart[blue] sells useful items for Trainers. In most other towns, the two buildings can be distinguished by their unique red and blue colours.
entries.translated:
Sudahkah kamu meluangkan waktu
untuk melihat fasilitas setempat?\l[green]Pusat Pokémon[blue] menyembuhkan

Pokémon-mu secara gratis. [green]Poke Mart[blue]
menjual barang-barang berguna untuk\lPelatih. Di sebagian besar kota

lain, kedua bangunan tersebut dapat
dibedakan dari warna merah dan biru\lyang khas.

entries.original:
"That statue over there is of the
legendary Pokémon, Articuno.

It was built from scratch by none
other than my father, himself!

In fact, I’ll have you know that
he travels around Borrius building\lstatues like this one in many\ldifferent towns!

My father is so cool!

But still not as cool as the
weather here!

Ahahaha!"
entries.translation_source: That statue over there is of the legendary Pokémon, Articuno. It was built from scratch by none other than my father, himself! In fact, I’ll have you know that he travels around Borrius building statues like this one in many different towns! My father is so cool! But still not as cool as the weather here! Ahahaha!
entries.translated:
Patung di sana adalah Pokémon
legendaris, Articuno. Patung itu\ldibuat dari awal oleh ayahku

sendiri! Bahkan, aku akan
memberitahumu bahwa dia bepergian\lkeliling Borrius membangun patung

seperti ini di banyak kota berbeda!
Ayahku keren sekali! Tapi tetap\ltidak sekeren cuaca di sini!

Ahahaha!

entries.original:
"Move!

I’m trying to watch TV!"
entries.translation_source: Move! I’m trying to watch TV!
entries.translated:
Minggir! Aku sedang mencoba
menonton TV!

entries.original: "[black]His eyes are glued to the TV."
entries.translation_source: [black]His eyes are glued to the TV.
entries.translated: [black]Matanya terpaku pada TV.

entries.original:
"A TV?
What’s that?

I only play video games on my
daddy’s phone!"
entries.translation_source: A TV? What’s that? I only play video games on my daddy’s phone!
entries.translated:
TV? Apa itu? Aku hanya bermain
video game di telepon ayahku!

entries.original:
"Did you know there is a special
Poké Ball that heals Pokémon?

When you capture a Pokémon, all
damage done to it is undone!

Maybe if you had a [green]Pokédex[blue] I’d be
inclined to give you some!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know there is a special Poké Ball that heals Pokémon? When you capture a Pokémon, all damage done to it is undone! Maybe if you had a [green]Pokédex[blue] I’d be inclined to give you some!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu ada Bola Pokémon
khusus yang menyembuhkan Pokémon?\lSaat kamu menangkap Pokémon, semua

kerusakan yang diterimanya akan
hilang! Mungkin jika kamu memiliki\l[green]Pokédex[blue] aku akan cenderung

memberimu beberapa!

entries.original:
"Did you know there is a special
Poké Ball that heals Pokémon?

When you capture a Pokémon, all
damage done to it is undone!

Here, try some!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know there is a special Poké Ball that heals Pokémon? When you capture a Pokémon, all damage done to it is undone! Here, try some!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu ada Bola Pokémon
khusus yang menyembuhkan Pokémon?\lSaat kamu menangkap Pokémon, semua

kerusakan yang diterimanya akan
hilang! Ini, coba beberapa!

entries.original:
"Use them in good health!
Heh, heh, see what I did there?"
entries.translation_source: Use them in good health! Heh, heh, see what I did there?
entries.translated:
Gunakan dengan sehat! Heh, heh,
lihat apa yang saya lakukan di\lsana?

entries.original:
"Did you know there is a special
Poké Ball that can capture Pokémon\lfrom other worlds?

Maybe if you had a [green]Pokédex[blue] I’d be
inclined to give you some!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know there is a special Poké Ball that can capture Pokémon from other worlds? Maybe if you had a [green]Pokédex[blue] I’d be inclined to give you some!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu ada Bola Pokémon
khusus yang bisa menangkap Pokémon\ldari dunia lain? Mungkin jika kamu

memiliki [green]Pokédex[blue] aku akan cenderung
memberimu beberapa!

entries.original:
"Did you know there is a special
Poké Ball that can capture Pokémon\lfrom other worlds that appear in\lthe wild sometimes?

Here, try some!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know there is a special Poké Ball that can capture Pokémon from other worlds that appear in the wild sometimes? Here, try some!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu ada Bola Pokémon
khusus yang bisa menangkap Pokémon\ldari dunia lain yang kadang muncul

di alam liar? Ini, coba beberapa!

entries.original:
"Use those [green]Beast Balls[blue] on mysterious
Pokémon from other worlds!"
entries.translation_source: Use those [green]Beast Balls[blue] on mysterious Pokémon from other worlds!
entries.translated:
Gunakan [green]Bola Binatang[blue] itu pada
Pokémon misterius dari dunia lain!

entries.original:
"All Pokémon have special [green]Types[blue],
such as Fire or Water.

These determine how well they stack
up against other Pokémon.

Pokémon Types also give attacking
moves a power boost if they match\lthe Type of the move.

This is known as the Same-Type-
Attack-Bonus.

Moves with this bonus have a little
[black]\+[blue] symbol under their type in battle."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon have special [green]Types[blue], such as Fire or Water. These determine how well they stack up against other Pokémon. Pokémon Types also give attacking moves a power boost if they match the Type of the move. This is known as the Same-Type- Attack-Bonus. Moves with this bonus have a little [black]\+[blue] symbol under their type in battle.
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon memiliki [green]Tipe[blue] khusus,
seperti Api atau Air. Ini\lmenentukan seberapa baik mereka

melawan Pokémon lain. Tipe Pokémon
juga memberikan peningkatan\lkekuatan pada serangan jika sesuai

dengan Tipe gerakan tersebut. Ini
dikenal sebagai Bonus Serangan Tipe\lSama. Gerakan dengan bonus ini

memiliki simbol [black]\+[blue] kecil di bawah
tipenya dalam pertempuran.

entries.original:
"You can store Pokémon and Items in
that PC in the corner.

It’s free of charge for Trainers,
so go right ahead and use it.

Some facilities use the Pokémon
known as [green]Porygon[blue] instead.

If you’re in such a facility, keep
an eye out for this Pokémon:"
entries.translation_source: You can store Pokémon and Items in that PC in the corner. It’s free of charge for Trainers, so go right ahead and use it. Some facilities use the Pokémon known as [green]Porygon[blue] instead. If you’re in such a facility, keep an eye out for this Pokémon:
entries.translated:
Kamu dapat menyimpan Pokémon dan
Barang di PC di sudut itu. Gratis\luntuk Pelatih, jadi silakan

gunakan. Beberapa fasilitas
menggunakan Pokémon yang dikenal\lsebagai [green]Porygon[blue] sebagai gantinya.

Jika kamu berada di fasilitas
seperti itu, waspadalah terhadap\lPokémon ini:

entries.original:
"Pokémon Centers heal your tired
and weary Pokémon.

They make all Pokémon completely
healthy again.

Most are free, so don’t be shy
about healing your Pokémon.

For those that aren’t, well, there
are always [green]Chansey[blue] that can be\lfound in the field.

They’re pink and look like this:"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Centers heal your tired and weary Pokémon. They make all Pokémon completely healthy again. Most are free, so don’t be shy about healing your Pokémon. For those that aren’t, well, there are always [green]Chansey[blue] that can be found in the field. They’re pink and look like this:
entries.translated:
Pusat Pokémon menyembuhkan Pokémon
yang lelah dan capek. Mereka\lmembuat semua Pokémon kembali sehat

sepenuhnya. Sebagian besar gratis,
jadi jangan malu untuk menyembuhkan\lPokémon-mu. Untuk yang tidak

gratis, ya, selalu ada [green]Chansey[blue] yang
bisa ditemukan di lapangan. Mereka\lberwarna merah muda dan terlihat

seperti ini:

entries.original:
"Howdy!
I’m doin’ a survey on Trainers.

I’m collectin’ as many birthdays
as I can.

Wanna participate?"
entries.translation_source: Howdy! I’m doin’ a survey on Trainers. I’m collectin’ as many birthdays as I can. Wanna participate?
entries.translated:
Halo! Aku sedang melakukan survei
tentang Pelatih. Aku mengumpulkan\lsebanyak mungkin ulang tahun. Mau

berpartisipasi?

entries.original:
"Yeehaw!
Okay, so when’s your birthday?"
entries.translation_source: Yeehaw! Okay, so when’s your birthday?
entries.translated:
Yeehaw! Oke, jadi kapan ulang
tahunmu?

entries.original:
"Aww\.

What kind of Trainer doesn’t wanna
share their birthday?"
entries.translation_source: Aww\. What kind of Trainer doesn’t wanna share their birthday?
entries.translated:
Aww\. Pelatih macam apa yang tidak
mau berbagi ulang tahun mereka?

entries.original:
"Okay, so your birthday is on
[buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3].

That means you’re \\07 years old!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, so your birthday is on [buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3]. That means you’re \\07 years old!
entries.translated:
Oke, jadi ulang tahunmu adalah
[buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3]. Itu\lberarti kamu berusia \\07!

entries.original:
"Okay, so your birthday is on
[buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3].

entries.original: "If We Were Meant to Fly"
entries.translation_source: If We Were Meant to Fly
entries.translated: Jika Kita Ditakdirkan Terbang

entries.original:
"Ah, [player]!

Good of you to drop by.

Have you ever heard a saying my
grandmother used to be fond of?

\qoIf humans were meant to fly,
we’d have wings like a Gligar\land feathers like a Pidgeotto.\qc

Well, I’m pretty sure I’ve got the
first part down, but\.

I might need a little bit of help
for the second.

So if you have any time today,
would you be willing to help\la nice lady out?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player]! Good of you to drop by. Have you ever heard a saying my grandmother used to be fond of? \qoIf humans were meant to fly, we’d have wings like a Gligar and feathers like a Pidgeotto.\qc Well, I’m pretty sure I’ve got the first part down, but\. I might need a little bit of help for the second. So if you have any time today, would you be willing to help a nice lady out?
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]! Senang kamu mampir.
Pernahkah kamu mendengar pepatah\lyang disukai nenekku? \qoJika manusia

ditakdirkan terbang, kita akan
memiliki sayap seperti Gligar dan\lbulu seperti Pidgeotto.\qc Yah, aku

cukup yakin aku sudah menguasai
bagian pertama, tapi\. aku mungkin\lbutuh sedikit bantuan untuk bagian

kedua. Jadi jika kamu punya waktu
hari ini, apakah kamu bersedia\lmembantu seorang wanita baik?

entries.original:
"Ah, excellent!

Then, let me explain the problem
here.

I need the feathers necessary
to finish the wings I’ve been\lworking on.

But not just any feathers will do -
I need [green]Pretty Wings[red].

[green][buffer2][red] of them, to be exact.

I mean, I could use other wings,
but a lady’s gotta have nice\lthings, right?

So, if you could fetch me [green][buffer2][red]
of those [green]Pretty Wings[red] and bring\lthem here, there’ll be something\lnice in it for you, too!

You can find Pretty Wings being
carried by wild [green]Wingull[red]\land [green]Pelipper[red].

If you have a Pokémon with Thief,
Covet, or Knock Off, getting those\lPretty Wings will be a lot easier.

I recommend [green]Knock Off[red] the most,
because it saves you having to\ltake the item from your Pokémon.

Also, a Pokémon with [green]Compound Eyes[red]
or [green]Super Luck[red] at the front of\lyour party increases the odds of\lwild Pokémon holding items, so keep\lthat in mind!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, excellent! Then, let me explain the problem here. I need the feathers necessary to finish the wings I’ve been working on. But not just any feathers will do - I need [green]Pretty Wings[red]. [green][buffer2][red] of them, to be exact. I mean, I could use other wings, but a lady’s gotta have nice things, right? So, if you could fetch me [green][buffer2][red] of those [green]Pretty Wings[red] and bring them here, there’ll be something nice in it for you, too! You can find Pretty Wings being carried by wild [green]Wingull[red] and [green]Pelipper[red]. If you have a Pokémon with Thief, Covet, or Knock Off, getting those Pretty Wings will be a lot easier. I recommend [green]Knock Off[red] the most, because it saves you having to take the item from your Pokémon. Also, a Pokémon with [green]Compound Eyes[red] or [green]Super Luck[red] at the front of your party increases the odds of wild Pokémon holding items, so keep that in mind!
entries.translated:
Ah, bagus! Kalau begitu, biarkan
aku menjelaskan masalahnya. Aku\lmembutuhkan bulu-bulu yang

diperlukan untuk menyelesaikan
sayap yang sedang aku kerjakan.\lTapi bukan sembarang bulu - aku

butuh [green]Pretty Wings[red]. [green][buffer2][red] buah,
tepatnya. Maksudku, aku bisa\lmenggunakan sayap lain, tapi

seorang wanita harus punya barang
bagus, kan? Jadi, jika kamu bisa\lmengambilkanku [green][buffer2][red] dari [green]Pretty

Wings[red] itu dan membawanya ke sini,
akan ada sesuatu yang bagus juga\luntukmu! Kamu bisa menemukan Pretty

Wings dibawa oleh [green]Wingull[red] dan
[green]Pelipper[red] liar. Jika kamu memiliki\lPokémon dengan Pencuri, Mengincar,

atau Pukul Jatuh, mendapatkan
Pretty Wings itu akan jauh lebih\lmudah. Aku paling merekomendasikan

[green]Pukul Jatuh[red], karena itu menghematmu
harus mengambil barang dari\lPokémon-mu. Juga, Pokémon dengan

[green]Mata Majemuk[red] atau [green]Keberuntungan
Super[red] di depan timmu meningkatkan\lpeluang Pokémon liar membawa

barang, jadi ingatlah itu!

entries.original:
"Now [buffer1], I don’t think this
amount of Pretty Wings will do\lat all\.

see if we have what it takes!"
entries.translation_source: Now [buffer1], I don’t think this amount of Pretty Wings will do at all\. I need [green][buffer2] Pretty Wings[red] total. I mean, I could use other wings, but a lady’s gotta have nice things, right? My advice? Use the [green]DexNav[red] to catch a [green]Skorupi[red] with its [green]Hidden Ability[red] on [green]Route 9[red]. It learns [green]Knock Off[red] naturally, and when it evolves its Hidden Ability becomes [green]Super Luck[red]! This makes it a great pick for stealing [green]Pretty Wings[red] from wild [green]Wingull[red] and [green]Pelipper[red]. I’m counting on you, [buffer1], let’s see if we have what it takes!
