It’s only dangerous if you come
near it on a [green]Thursday[blue]."
entries.translation_source: A powerful Pokémon sleeps in the forest to the east of the city. Have no fear - it won’t cause you any harm. It’s only dangerous if you come near it on a [green]Thursday[blue].
entries.translated:
Seekor Pokémon kuat tidur di hutan
di sebelah timur kota. Jangan takut\l- itu tidak akan membahayakanmu.

Itu hanya berbahaya jika kamu
mendekatinya pada hari [green]Kamis[blue].

entries.original:
"The people who live here aren’t
letting me in, so I’m forced\lto sit out here.

Other people get to just press
\btn00 next to the door and get let in.

But not me.
Life sucks."
entries.translation_source: The people who live here aren’t letting me in, so I’m forced to sit out here. Other people get to just press \btn00 next to the door and get let in. But not me. Life sucks.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang yang tinggal di sini
tidak mengizinkanku masuk, jadi aku\lterpaksa duduk di luar. Orang lain

bisa hanya menekan \btn00 di sebelah
pintu dan diizinkan masuk. Tapi\lbukan aku. Hidup menyebalkan.

entries.original:
"The urge to battle with someone
you’ve tangled with before\.

Have you ever had that urge?
I’m sure you have.

I wanted to battle certain people
again over and over, too.

So, I’ve been giving these away.
Please, take one!"
entries.translation_source: The urge to battle with someone you’ve tangled with before\. Have you ever had that urge? I’m sure you have. I wanted to battle certain people again over and over, too. So, I’ve been giving these away. Please, take one!
entries.translated:
Keinginan untuk bertarung dengan
seseorang yang pernah kamu lawan\lsebelumnya\. Apakah kamu pernah

merasakan keinginan itu? Aku yakin
kamu pernah. Aku juga ingin\lbertarung dengan orang tertentu

berulang kali. Jadi, aku telah
membagikan ini. Silakan, ambil\lsatu!

entries.original:
"Use that device and you’ll find
Trainers looking for a rematch.

You have to charge its battery to
use it, though."
entries.translation_source: Use that device and you’ll find Trainers looking for a rematch. You have to charge its battery to use it, though.
entries.translated:
Gunakan perangkat itu dan kamu akan
menemukan Pelatih yang mencari\lpertarungan ulang. Namun, kamu

harus mengisi baterainya untuk
menggunakannya.

entries.original:
"How do you use the [green]VS Seeker[blue]?
There’s nothing to it.

Use it like beep-beep-beep, and
Trainers around you will notice.

If any Trainer wants a rematch,
it will let you know immediately.

Charge its battery and use it
while you’re on a road."
entries.translation_source: How do you use the [green]VS Seeker[blue]? There’s nothing to it. Use it like beep-beep-beep, and Trainers around you will notice. If any Trainer wants a rematch, it will let you know immediately. Charge its battery and use it while you’re on a road.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana cara menggunakan [green]VS
Seeker[blue]? Tidak ada yang sulit.\lGunakan seperti bip-bip-bip, dan

Pelatih di sekitarmu akan
menyadarinya. Jika ada Pelatih yang\lingin pertarungan ulang, itu akan

memberitahumu segera. Isi
baterainya dan gunakan saat kamu\lberada di jalan.

entries.original:
"Where the wind is ice cold, so are
my hands.

Would you like me to teach one of
your Pokémon [green]Ice Punch[blue]?

I require [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue] to share
my frosty hands."
entries.translation_source: Where the wind is ice cold, so are my hands. Would you like me to teach one of your Pokémon [green]Ice Punch[blue]? I require [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue] to share my frosty hands.
entries.translated:
Di mana angin sedingin es, begitu
juga tanganku. Apakah kamu ingin\laku mengajari salah satu Pokémonmu

[green]Pukulan Es[blue]? Aku membutuhkan
[green][buffer2] [buffer1][blue] untuk berbagi\ltanganku yang dingin.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon would like to have
their hands frozen with [green]Ice Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon would like to have their hands frozen with [green]Ice Punch[blue]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang ingin tangannya
dibekukan dengan [green]Pukulan Es[blue]?

entries.original:
"My hands shall remain cold for
all eternity."
entries.translation_source: My hands shall remain cold for all eternity.
entries.translated:
Tanganku akan tetap dingin
selamanya.

entries.original:
"You do not have enough
[buffer1]s.

I cannot share my frosty hands with
you for nothing\."
entries.translation_source: You do not have enough [buffer1]s. I cannot share my frosty hands with you for nothing\.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup
[buffer1]s. Aku tidak bisa\lmembagikan tanganku yang dingin

kepadamu dengan cuma-cuma\.

entries.original:
"How’s about I toss a [green]free TM[blue]
your way?"
entries.translation_source: How’s about I toss a [green]free TM[blue] your way?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kalau aku melempar [green]TM
gratis[blue] kepadamu?

entries.original:
"That TM I gave you contains
[green]Aurora Veil[blue].

It has an effect similar to both
Reflect and Light Screen combined.

The only catch is that it can only
be used in [green]Hail[blue] weather."
entries.translation_source: That TM I gave you contains [green]Aurora Veil[blue]. It has an effect similar to both Reflect and Light Screen combined. The only catch is that it can only be used in [green]Hail[blue] weather.
entries.translated:
TM yang kuberikan itu berisi [green]Tirai
Aurora[blue]. Efeknya mirip dengan\lgabungan Reflektor dan Layar

Cahaya. Satu-satunya kekurangan
adalah hanya bisa digunakan saat\lcuaca [green]Hujan Es[blue].

entries.original: "Your loss, pal."
entries.translation_source: Your loss, pal.
entries.translated: Rugi kamu, kawan.

entries.original:
"Some guy in one of the residences
around here is giving away\lan item that allows you to\lrebattle Trainers.

It doesn’t really work in caves,
but on routes it’s super useful!"
entries.translation_source: Some guy in one of the residences around here is giving away an item that allows you to rebattle Trainers. It doesn’t really work in caves, but on routes it’s super useful!
entries.translated:
Seseorang di salah satu rumah di
sekitar sini memberikan item yang\lmemungkinkanmu bertarung ulang

dengan Pelatih. Item itu tidak
terlalu berfungsi di gua, tapi di\lrute sangat berguna!

entries.original:
"[red]Hi!
Do you have an [green][buffer1][red]?

Wanna trade it for my
[green][buffer2][red]?

It’s great for if you want to
battle my mommy!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Hi! Do you have an [green][buffer1][red]? Wanna trade it for my [green][buffer2][red]? It’s great for if you want to battle my mommy!
entries.translated:
[red]Hai! Apakah kamu punya [green][buffer1][red]?
Mau menukarnya dengan [green][buffer2][red]\lmilikku? Bagus jika kamu ingin

bertarung melawan mamaku!

entries.original:
"[red]My mommy’s gonna flip when she sees
my new Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: [red]My mommy’s gonna flip when she sees my new Pokémon!
entries.translated:
[red]Mamaku pasti akan heboh saat
melihat Pokémon baruku!

entries.original:
"[red]How is my old [buffer2]?

My [buffer1] is doing amazing!

It almost made a hole in the
ceiling when I let it out!"
entries.translation_source: [red]How is my old [buffer2]? My [buffer1] is doing amazing! It almost made a hole in the ceiling when I let it out!
entries.translated:
[red]Bagaimana kabar [buffer2] lamaku?
[buffer1]ku sangat hebat! Ia hampir\lmembuat lubang di langit-langit

saat kukeluarkan!

entries.original:
"[red]Aww\.

Don’t you know who my Mommy is?
I’m going to tell on you!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Aww\. Don’t you know who my Mommy is? I’m going to tell on you!
entries.translated:
[red]Aduh\. Apa kamu tidak tahu siapa
Mamaku? Aku akan mengadu kepadamu!

entries.original:
"[red]I’m little, not stupid.
That’s not an [green][buffer1][red]!"
entries.translation_source: [red]I’m little, not stupid. That’s not an [green][buffer1][red]!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku kecil, tapi tidak bodoh. Itu
bukan [green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, [green]Alice[red], lives
downstairs.

She’s away running the Gym most of
the time, so she usually leaves\lher kid home alone.

I, personally, would never leave my
son home alone.

His mind is too delicate.

He can’t bear to be without
his mama!"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, [green]Alice[red], lives downstairs. She’s away running the Gym most of the time, so she usually leaves her kid home alone. I, personally, would never leave my son home alone. His mind is too delicate. He can’t bear to be without his mama!
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, [green]Alice[red], tinggal di
lantai bawah. Dia sering pergi\lmengurus Gym, jadi biasanya dia

meninggalkan anaknya sendirian di
rumah. Saya pribadi tidak akan\lpernah meninggalkan putra saya

sendirian di rumah. Pikirannya
terlalu lembut. Dia tidak tahan\ltanpa mamanya!

entries.original:
"\qoWho builds a city on top of a
frozen mountain?\qc you may\lbe wondering.

Well, about 20 years ago, a bunch
of Bird Keepers got together and\ldecided they wanted a nice high\lplace for their Pokémon to train.

With the help of this dude named
Aros and his partner Pokémon, they\lbuilt this city in under a year!

It amazes me what great things
people and Pokémon can accomplish\lby working together.

Say\.

Your face reminds me of his
a little\."
entries.translation_source: \qoWho builds a city on top of a frozen mountain?\qc you may be wondering. Well, about 20 years ago, a bunch of Bird Keepers got together and decided they wanted a nice high place for their Pokémon to train. With the help of this dude named Aros and his partner Pokémon, they built this city in under a year! It amazes me what great things people and Pokémon can accomplish by working together. Say\. Your face reminds me of his a little\.
entries.translated:
\qoSiapa yang membangun kota di atas
gunung beku?\qc mungkin kamu\lbertanya-tanya. Nah, sekitar 20

tahun yang lalu, sekumpulan
Pemelihara Burung berkumpul dan\lmemutuskan mereka menginginkan

tempat tinggi yang bagus untuk
melatih Pokémon mereka. Dengan\lbantuan seorang pria bernama Aros

dan Pokémon rekannya, mereka
membangun kota ini dalam waktu\lkurang dari setahun! Saya kagum

dengan hal-hal hebat yang bisa
dicapai manusia dan Pokémon dengan\lbekerja sama. Omong-omong\. Wajahmu

sedikit mengingatkanku padanya\.

entries.original: "Nat Log"
entries.translation_source: Nat Log
entries.translated: Nat Log

entries.original:
"Oh!
You’re [player]!

Euler said you’d be coming.

Oh, who am I?

I may not look it, but I’m
his sister! Natasha Log!

He told me to expect a new Trainer
with a Pokédex, so if you’ve\lcaught at least [green][buffer1][red] species of\lPokémon, I have just the thing\lprepared."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You’re [player]! Euler said you’d be coming. Oh, who am I? I may not look it, but I’m his sister! Natasha Log! He told me to expect a new Trainer with a Pokédex, so if you’ve caught at least [green][buffer1][red] species of Pokémon, I have just the thing prepared.
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu [player]! Euler bilang
kamu akan datang. Oh, siapa aku?\lAku mungkin tidak terlihat seperti

itu, tapi aku adalah saudarinya!
Natasha Log! Dia bilang untuk\lmenunggu seorang Pelatih baru

dengan Pokédex, jadi jika kamu
sudah menangkap setidaknya [green][buffer1][red]\lspesies Pokémon, aku sudah

menyiapkan sesuatu.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You’ve only caught [buffer2] species
so far.

Get to [green][buffer1][red] and I’ll upgrade your
Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. You’ve only caught [buffer2] species so far. Get to [green][buffer1][red] and I’ll upgrade your Pokédex!
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Kamu baru menangkap [buffer2]
spesies sejauh ini. Capai [green][buffer1][red]\ldan aku akan meningkatkan

Pokédex-mu!

entries.original:
"[black][player]’s Pokédex was upgraded
with the [green]DexNav[black]!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player]’s Pokédex was upgraded with the [green]DexNav[black]!
entries.translated:
[black][player]Pokédex milik [player]
telah ditingkatkan dengan [green]DexNav[black]!

entries.original:
"What I gave you was a [green]DexNav[red]!

It’ll make your task of capturing
Pokémon plenty easier.

Once you’ve seen a Pokémon, search
for it using the DexNav, and\lthen there’s a high chance of it\lappearing around you!

My assistant can provide
further explanations."
entries.translation_source: What I gave you was a [green]DexNav[red]! It’ll make your task of capturing Pokémon plenty easier. Once you’ve seen a Pokémon, search for it using the DexNav, and then there’s a high chance of it appearing around you! My assistant can provide further explanations.
entries.translated:
Apa yang kuberikan adalah [green]DexNav[red]!
Itu akan membuat tugasmu menangkap\lPokémon jauh lebih mudah. Setelah

kamu melihat Pokémon, carilah
menggunakan DexNav, maka ada\lkemungkinan besar ia akan muncul di

sekitarmu! Asistenku bisa
memberikan penjelasan lebih lanjut.

entries.original:
"The name’s Ayla!

Under the tutelage of Nat, I was
able to bring Bill’s PC over to\lBorrius and develop my own version!

Thanks to my improvements, you can
now store up to [green]750[red] different\lPokémon in my PC!

That’s a far cry from the 420
allowed in Bill’s PC."
entries.translation_source: The name’s Ayla! Under the tutelage of Nat, I was able to bring Bill’s PC over to Borrius and develop my own version! Thanks to my improvements, you can now store up to [green]750[red] different Pokémon in my PC! That’s a far cry from the 420 allowed in Bill’s PC.
entries.translated:
Namaku Ayla! Di bawah bimbingan
Nat, aku bisa membawa PC Bill ke\lBorrius dan mengembangkan versiku

sendiri! Berkat perbaikanku, kamu
sekarang bisa menyimpan hingga [green]750[red]\lPokémon berbeda di PC-ku! Itu jauh

berbeda dari 420 yang diizinkan di
PC Bill.

entries.original:
"As Nat’s assistant, I am capable of
explaining the DexNav to you."
entries.translation_source: As Nat’s assistant, I am capable of explaining the DexNav to you.
entries.translated:
Sebagai asisten Nat, saya mampu
menjelaskan DexNav kepada Anda.

entries.original:
"The DexNav is a complicated
device.

Its explanations are available
from me whenever you may need them."
entries.translation_source: The DexNav is a complicated device. Its explanations are available from me whenever you may need them.
entries.translated:
DexNav adalah perangkat yang rumit.
Penjelasannya tersedia dari saya\lkapan pun Anda membutuhkannya.

entries.original: "Candice"
entries.translation_source: Candice
entries.translated: Candice

entries.original:
"Oh, hi there!

I don’t think I’ve seen you around
here yet!

Are you on vacation, like Candice?

Oh? Those are Gym Badges you’ve got
there, aren’t they\.?

Hmm? No, I’m not the Blizzard City
Gym Leader - I’m just taking a\lbreak here.

But if you’re looking for a battle
anyway, I sure wouldn’t say no to\lone right now!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hi there! I don’t think I’ve seen you around here yet! Are you on vacation, like Candice? Oh? Those are Gym Badges you’ve got there, aren’t they\.? Hmm? No, I’m not the Blizzard City Gym Leader - I’m just taking a break here. But if you’re looking for a battle anyway, I sure wouldn’t say no to one right now!
entries.translated:
Oh, hai! Sepertinya saya belum
pernah melihat Anda di sini\lsebelumnya! Apakah Anda sedang

berlibur, seperti Candice? Oh? Itu
Lencana Gym yang Anda miliki,\lbukan\.? Hmm? Tidak, saya bukan

Pemimpin Gym Blizzard City - saya
hanya beristirahat di sini. Tapi\ljika Anda ingin bertarung, saya

pasti tidak akan menolak sekarang!

entries.original:
"Hiya! What’s up?

I bet you can’t tell what
I’m thinking!

I’ll give the answer away.
I want to battle with you!"
entries.translation_source: Hiya! What’s up? I bet you can’t tell what I’m thinking! I’ll give the answer away. I want to battle with you!
entries.translated:
Hai! Ada apa? Saya yakin Anda tidak
bisa menebak apa yang saya\lpikirkan! Saya akan memberikan

jawabannya. Saya ingin bertarung
dengan Anda!

entries.original:
"I may be on vacation, but that’s no
excuse not to focus!

That’s because fashion, romance,
battles\. they’re all about focus!

Lemme show you what I mean!
Get ready, because here I come!"
entries.translation_source: I may be on vacation, but that’s no excuse not to focus! That’s because fashion, romance, battles\. they’re all about focus! Lemme show you what I mean! Get ready, because here I come!
entries.translated:
Saya mungkin sedang berlibur, tapi
itu bukan alasan untuk tidak fokus!\lItu karena mode, romansa,

pertarungan\. semuanya tentang fokus!
Biarkan saya tunjukkan maksud saya!\lBersiaplah, karena saya datang!

entries.original:
"Oh\.
Did my willpower intimidate you?"
entries.translation_source: Oh\. Did my willpower intimidate you?
entries.translated:
Oh\. Apakah kemauanku mengintimidasi
Anda?

entries.original:
"Listen, listen.

You battled really well, so I want
you to have this."
entries.translation_source: Listen, listen. You battled really well, so I want you to have this.
entries.translated:
Dengar, dengar. Anda bertarung
dengan sangat baik, jadi saya ingin\lAnda memiliki ini.

entries.original:
"I was thinking of challenging [green]Alice[red],
Blizzard City’s Gym Leader, with\lthat, but I think that’s better off\lwith you.

If you wanna do this again, then
come see me tomorrow!

I’ll focus even harder and win next
time, for sure!"
entries.translation_source: I was thinking of challenging [green]Alice[red], Blizzard City’s Gym Leader, with that, but I think that’s better off with you. If you wanna do this again, then come see me tomorrow! I’ll focus even harder and win next time, for sure!
entries.translated:
Saya tadinya berpikir untuk
menantang [green]Alice[red], Pemimpin Gym\lBlizzard City, dengan itu, tapi

saya pikir itu lebih cocok untuk
Anda. Jika Anda ingin melakukannya\llagi, temui saya besok! Saya akan

fokus lebih keras dan menang lain
kali, pasti!

entries.original:
"Listen, listen.

If you wanna do this again, then
come see me tomorrow!

I’ll focus even harder and win next
time, for sure!"
entries.translation_source: Listen, listen. If you wanna do this again, then come see me tomorrow! I’ll focus even harder and win next time, for sure!
entries.translated:
Dengar, dengar. Jika Anda ingin
melakukannya lagi, temui saya\lbesok! Saya akan fokus lebih keras

dan menang lain kali, pasti!

entries.original: "I’ve been expecting you\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been expecting you\.
entries.translated: Saya sudah menunggu Anda\.

entries.original:
"Ho, ho, ho!

The look on your face
is priceless!

Don’t worry, my friend, the Cut
Master told me you were coming!"
entries.translation_source: Ho, ho, ho! The look on your face is priceless! Don’t worry, my friend, the Cut Master told me you were coming!
entries.translated:
Ho, ho, ho! Ekspresi wajahmu tak
ternilai! Jangan khawatir, temanku,\lMaster Tebas memberitahuku bahwa

kamu akan datang!

entries.original:
"Ah, ha, ha!
So I was right!

I’ve been saying that to every
person who’s walked through my door\lsince I received his call, but\lyou’re the first person to have\la look of relief on their face!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, ha, ha! So I was right! I’ve been saying that to every person who’s walked through my door since I received his call, but you’re the first person to have a look of relief on their face!
entries.translated:
Ah, ha, ha! Jadi aku benar! Aku
sudah mengatakan itu kepada setiap\lorang yang melewati pintuku sejak

aku menerima teleponnya, tapi kamu
orang pertama yang menunjukkan\lekspresi lega di wajah mereka!

entries.original:
"That HM contains [green]Rock Smash[blue], if
it wasn’t already obvious!

You can use it to smash any cracked
rocks in your path.

Just remember, in order to use Rock
Smash, you first need to obtain\l[green]Blizzard City’s[blue] Gym Badge."
entries.translation_source: That HM contains [green]Rock Smash[blue], if it wasn’t already obvious! You can use it to smash any cracked rocks in your path. Just remember, in order to use Rock Smash, you first need to obtain [green]Blizzard City’s[blue] Gym Badge.
entries.translated:
HM itu berisi [green]Penghancur Batu[blue], jika
belum jelas! Kamu bisa\lmenggunakannya untuk menghancurkan

batu retak di jalanmu. Ingat, untuk
menggunakan Penghancur Batu, kamu\lharus mendapatkan [green]Blizzard City[blue]

Lencana Gym terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Gahhhhhhhh\.

[black]His brain appears to be fried."
entries.translation_source: Gahhhhhhhh\. [black]His brain appears to be fried.
entries.translated: Gahhhhhhhh\. [black]Otaknya tampak gosong.

entries.original:
"Fried foods are my favourite!

French fries, Basculin sticks\.
they’re all great!"
entries.translation_source: Fried foods are my favourite! French fries, Basculin sticks\. they’re all great!
entries.translated:
Makanan goreng adalah favoritku!
Kentang goreng, stik Basculin\.\lsemuanya enak!

entries.original:
"Hey! Listen up.

Have you been travelling and
noticed some boulders in your path\lthat you just couldn’t budge?

Well, there’s a guy in [green]Epidimy Town[blue]
who is the master of teaching\lPokémon how to move big boulders.

Talk to him ASAP if you want to
move those pesky things."
entries.translation_source: Hey! Listen up. Have you been travelling and noticed some boulders in your path that you just couldn’t budge? Well, there’s a guy in [green]Epidimy Town[blue] who is the master of teaching Pokémon how to move big boulders. Talk to him ASAP if you want to move those pesky things.
entries.translated:
Hei! Dengarkan. Apakah kamu
bepergian dan melihat bongkahan\lbatu di jalanmu yang tidak bisa

kamu gerakkan? Nah, ada seseorang
di [green]Epidimy Town[blue] yang ahli dalam\lmengajari Pokémon cara memindahkan

batu besar. Bicaralah padanya
segera jika kamu ingin memindahkan\lbenda-benda mengganggu itu.

entries.original: "Sweet Pie"
entries.translation_source: Sweet Pie
entries.translated: Sweet Pie

entries.original: "Juicy Pie"
entries.translation_source: Juicy Pie
entries.translated: Juicy Pie

entries.original: "Ultimate Pie"
entries.translation_source: Ultimate Pie
entries.translated: Ultimate Pie

entries.original:
"You there, young Trainer!

Would you be a dear and help me
with a task?"
entries.translation_source: You there, young Trainer! Would you be a dear and help me with a task?
entries.translated:
Hei, Pelatih Muda! Maukah kau
menjadi orang baik dan membantuku\ldengan sebuah tugas?

entries.original:
"Ahaha, young Trainer!

Would you be a dear and help me
with another task?"
entries.translation_source: Ahaha, young Trainer! Would you be a dear and help me with another task?
entries.translated:
Ahaha, Pelatih Muda! Maukah kau
menjadi orang baik dan membantuku\ldengan tugas lain?

entries.original:
"Are you sure?
I promise the reward is good."
entries.translation_source: Are you sure? I promise the reward is good.
entries.translated:
Kau yakin? Aku janji hadiahnya
bagus.

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you!

My grandson’s birthday is coming up,
and I want to bake him a pie, but\lI don’t have all of the ingredients.

I only need:
[green]\\07[red]

If you could bring them to me as
soon as possible, it would be\lmuch appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you! My grandson’s birthday is coming up, and I want to bake him a pie, but I don’t have all of the ingredients. I only need: [green]\\07[red] If you could bring them to me as soon as possible, it would be much appreciated.
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih! Ulang tahun cucu
laki-lakiku akan segera tiba, dan\laku ingin membuatkan dia kue pai,

tapi aku tidak memiliki semua
bahan. Aku hanya perlu: [green]\\07[red] Jika kau\lbisa membawanya secepat mungkin,

itu akan sangat dihargai.

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you again!

My son’s anniversary is coming up,
and I want to bake him a pie, too.

This time I need:
[green]\\07[red]

Bring them to me with haste, young
Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you again! My son’s anniversary is coming up, and I want to bake him a pie, too. This time I need: [green]\\07[red] Bring them to me with haste, young Trainer!
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih lagi! Hari jadi
pernikahan putraku akan segera\ltiba, dan aku juga ingin membuatkan

dia kue pai. Kali ini aku perlu: [green]\\07[red]
Bawalah dengan cepat, Pelatih Muda!

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you again!

My ex-husband has found love with
another woman, and I want to bake\la pie to smash in his face!

This time I need:
[green]\\07"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you again! My ex-husband has found love with another woman, and I want to bake a pie to smash in his face! This time I need: [green]\\07
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih lagi! Mantan
suamiku telah menemukan cinta\ldengan wanita lain, dan aku ingin

memanggang kue pai untuk
dihantamkan ke wajahnya! Kali ini\laku perlu: [green]\\07

entries.original:
"I still need:
[green]\\07[red]

Please bring them as soon
as you can."
entries.translation_source: I still need: [green]\\07[red] Please bring them as soon as you can.
entries.translated:
Aku masih perlu: [green]\\07[red] Tolong bawa
mereka secepat yang kau bisa.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo, it seems you’ve
brought my ingredients.

Much appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo, it seems you’ve brought my ingredients. Much appreciated.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo, sepertinya kau telah
membawa bahan-bahanku. Sangat\ldihargai.

entries.original:
"[black]The Old Lady took:
[green]\\07"
entries.translation_source: [black]The Old Lady took: [green]\\07
entries.translated: [black]Wanita Tua mengambil: [green]\\07

entries.original:
"I’m sure my [buffer2] will love
this pie.

Please, take these in exchange for
your hard work, young Trainer."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure my [buffer2] will love this pie. Please, take these in exchange for your hard work, young Trainer.
entries.translated:
Aku yakin [buffer2] ku akan menyukai
kue pai ini. Tolong, ambil ini\lsebagai imbalan atas kerja kerasmu,

Pelatih Muda.

entries.original:
"I’m sure I’ll enjoy smashing this
pie into my ex-husband’s face!

Please, take these in exchange for
your hard work, young Trainer."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure I’ll enjoy smashing this pie into my ex-husband’s face! Please, take these in exchange for your hard work, young Trainer.
entries.translated:
Aku yakin aku akan menikmati
menghantamkan kue pai ini ke wajah\lmantan suamiku! Tolong, ambil ini

sebagai imbalan atas kerja kerasmu,
Pelatih Muda.

entries.original:
"Come back again in the future
sometime.

There are no shortage of
celebrations to bake pies for."
entries.translation_source: Come back again in the future sometime. There are no shortage of celebrations to bake pies for.
entries.translated:
Kembalilah lagi di masa depan
nanti. Tidak ada kekurangan\lperayaan untuk membuat kue pai.

entries.original:
"My family loved all of the pies!

I couldn’t have made such wonderful
food without your help."
entries.translation_source: My family loved all of the pies! I couldn’t have made such wonderful food without your help.
entries.translated:
Keluargaku menyukai semua pai! Aku
tidak bisa membuat makanan lezat\lseperti itu tanpa bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of [green]Ayla[red]?

She’s the one responsible for
bringing Bill’s PC to Borrius!

Thanks to her, we can store our
Pokémon somewhere!"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of [green]Ayla[red]? She’s the one responsible for bringing Bill’s PC to Borrius! Thanks to her, we can store our Pokémon somewhere!
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kau mendengar [green]Ayla[red]?
Dialah yang bertanggung jawab\lmembawa PC Bill ke Borrius! Berkat

dia, kita bisa menyimpan Pokémon
kita di suatu tempat!

entries.original:
"You know [green]Ayla[red], right, Champion?

The one responsible for bringing
Bill’s PC to Borrius?

Rumour has it, she’s been working on
a way to store Pokémon on the\lcloud and trade them across the\lglobe\.

But that can’t be true, can it?

Everyone knows you need a Link Cable
to trade!"
entries.translation_source: You know [green]Ayla[red], right, Champion? The one responsible for bringing Bill’s PC to Borrius? Rumour has it, she’s been working on a way to store Pokémon on the cloud and trade them across the globe\. But that can’t be true, can it? Everyone knows you need a Link Cable to trade!
entries.translated:
Kau tahu [green]Ayla[red], kan, Juara? Yang
bertanggung jawab membawa PC Bill\lke Borrius? Kabar burung

mengatakan, dia sedang mengerjakan
cara untuk menyimpan Pokémon di\lcloud dan menukarnya di seluruh

dunia\. Tapi itu tidak mungkin benar,
kan? Semua orang tahu kau perlu\lKabel Link untuk bertukar!

entries.original:
"[green]Alice[blue], the Gym Leader, likes to use
[green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon.

I know, it’s not what you’d expect
from a Gym up here."
entries.translation_source: [green]Alice[blue], the Gym Leader, likes to use [green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon. I know, it’s not what you’d expect from a Gym up here.
entries.translated:
[green]Alice[blue], Pemimpin Gym, suka
menggunakan Pokémon tipe [green]Terbang[blue].\lAku tahu, itu bukan yang kau

harapkan dari sebuah Gym di sini.

entries.original:
"When Pokémon evolve, they
get stronger.

But there is a benefit to not
evolving your Pokémon right away.

Pokémon that can still evolve can
utilise an [green]Eviolite[blue] to become\ltougher to beat in battle.

I have an extra, so I’d be willing
to part with it if you can show me\la Pokémon that can still evolve."
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon evolve, they get stronger. But there is a benefit to not evolving your Pokémon right away. Pokémon that can still evolve can utilise an [green]Eviolite[blue] to become tougher to beat in battle. I have an extra, so I’d be willing to part with it if you can show me a Pokémon that can still evolve.
entries.translated:
Saat Pokémon berevolusi, mereka
menjadi lebih kuat. Tapi ada\lkeuntungan untuk tidak

mengevolusikan Pokémonmu segera.
Pokémon yang masih bisa berevolusi\ldapat menggunakan [green]Eviolite[blue] untuk

menjadi lebih sulit dikalahkan
dalam pertarungan. Aku punya satu\lekstra, jadi aku bersedia

memberikannya jika kau bisa
menunjukkan padaku Pokémon yang\lmasih bisa berevolusi.

entries.original:
"Pokémon that can still evolve are
in abundance in the wild."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon that can still evolve are in abundance in the wild.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang masih bisa berevolusi
berlimpah di alam liar.

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, that Pokémon can
evolve no longer.

Even if you were to give it an
Eviolite, it would have no effect."
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, that Pokémon can evolve no longer. Even if you were to give it an Eviolite, it would have no effect.
entries.translated:
Sayangnya, Pokémon itu tidak bisa
berevolusi lagi. Bahkan jika kau\lmemberinya Eviolite, itu tidak akan

berpengaruh.

entries.original:
"There’s no guarantee that whatever
is in that Egg can evolve.

Not to mention the fact that Eggs
can’t hold items."
entries.translation_source: There’s no guarantee that whatever is in that Egg can evolve. Not to mention the fact that Eggs can’t hold items.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada jaminan bahwa apa pun
yang ada di dalam Telur itu bisa\lberevolusi. Belum lagi fakta bahwa

Telur tidak bisa membawa item.

entries.original:
"You are correct.

Your [buffer1] can indeed still
evolve.

So, as promised\."
entries.translation_source: You are correct. Your [buffer1] can indeed still evolve. So, as promised\.
entries.translated:
Kamu benar. [buffer1] milikmu masih
bisa berevolusi. Jadi, sesuai janji\.

entries.original:
"Have a Pokémon that can still
evolve hold an [green]Eviolite[blue] in battle\lto increase its defenses."
entries.translation_source: Have a Pokémon that can still evolve hold an [green]Eviolite[blue] in battle to increase its defenses.
entries.translated:
Mintalah Pokémon yang masih bisa
berevolusi memegang [green]Eviolit[blue] dalam\lpertarungan untuk meningkatkan

pertahanannya.

entries.original:
"They say some of the ugliest people
shop at Poké Mart.

I’ve heard there’s even a website
documenting them all."
entries.translation_source: They say some of the ugliest people shop at Poké Mart. I’ve heard there’s even a website documenting them all.
entries.translated:
Katanya beberapa orang paling jelek
berbelanja di Poké Mart. Kudengar\lbahkan ada situs web yang

mendokumentasikan mereka semua.

entries.original:
"One of the Sinnoh Gym Leaders likes
to come here on vacation.

She likes battling, so if you find
her, make sure you’re prepared\lfor a tough fight!"
entries.translation_source: One of the Sinnoh Gym Leaders likes to come here on vacation. She likes battling, so if you find her, make sure you’re prepared for a tough fight!
entries.translated:
Salah satu Pemimpin Gym Sinnoh suka
datang ke sini untuk liburan. Dia\lsuka bertarung, jadi jika kau

menemukannya, pastikan kau siap
untuk pertarungan sengit!

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of a Pokémon
called [green]Eevee[red]?

It’s a super adorable Pokémon!

I’d love to see an Eevee
some day\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of a Pokémon called [green]Eevee[red]? It’s a super adorable Pokémon! I’d love to see an Eevee some day\.
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kau mendengar Pokémon
bernama [green]Eevee[red]? Itu Pokémon yang\lsangat menggemaskan! Aku ingin

sekali melihat Eevee suatu hari
nanti\.

entries.original:
"That’s an Eevee!
That’s an Eevee!

You have an Eevee!

So cute!"
entries.translation_source: That’s an Eevee! That’s an Eevee! You have an Eevee! So cute!
entries.translated:
Itu Eevee! Itu Eevee! Kamu punya
Eevee! Sangat imut!

entries.original:
"That’s for showing me an Eevee!

That item can evolve [green]Eevee[red] into
[green]Glaceon[red]!"
entries.translation_source: That’s for showing me an Eevee! That item can evolve [green]Eevee[red] into [green]Glaceon[red]!
entries.translated:
Itu untuk menunjukkan Eevee padaku!
Item itu dapat mengevolusikan [green]Eevee[red]\lmenjadi [green]Glaceon[red]!

entries.original:
"Eevee used to evolve into [green]Glaceon[red]
by touching some rock around here.

But lately it seems all it needs
is an [green]Ice Stone[red]."
entries.translation_source: Eevee used to evolve into [green]Glaceon[red] by touching some rock around here. But lately it seems all it needs is an [green]Ice Stone[red].
entries.translated:
Eevee dulu berevolusi menjadi
[green]Glaceon[red] dengan menyentuh batu di\lsekitar sini. Tapi belakangan ini

sepertinya yang dibutuhkan hanya
[green]Batu Es[red].

entries.original:
"Ooh, ooh, Champion!
Can you show me [green][buffer1][red] now?"
entries.translation_source: Ooh, ooh, Champion! Can you show me [green][buffer1][red] now?
entries.translated:
Ooh, ooh, Juara! Bisakah kau
tunjukkan padaku [green][buffer1][red] sekarang?

entries.original:
"That’s [buffer1]!
That’s [buffer1]!

You have [buffer1]!

So cute!"
entries.translation_source: That’s [buffer1]! That’s [buffer1]! You have [buffer1]! So cute!
entries.translated:
Itu [buffer1]! Itu [buffer1]! Kamu
punya [buffer1]! Sangat imut!

entries.original:
"That [green]Eevium Z[red] is for showing me
all of Eevee’s evolutions!

You can turn [green]Eevee[red]’s [green]Last Resort[red]
into a [green]Z-Move[red] that can boost all of\lits stats if you let Eevee hold it!"
entries.translation_source: That [green]Eevium Z[red] is for showing me all of Eevee’s evolutions! You can turn [green]Eevee[red]’s [green]Last Resort[red] into a [green]Z-Move[red] that can boost all of its stats if you let Eevee hold it!
entries.translated:
Itu [green]Eevium Z[red] untuk menunjukkan
semua evolusi Eevee padaku! Kamu\lbisa mengubah [green]Eevee[red]{B4}s [green]Last Resort[red]

menjadi [green]Gerakan Z[red] yang bisa
meningkatkan semua statnya jika\lkamu biarkan Eevee memegangnya!

entries.original:
"Ooh aww\.

I wanted to see a [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh aww\. I wanted to see a [buffer1]\.
entries.translated: Ooh aww\. Aku ingin melihat [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Ooh aww\.

That’s not a [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh aww\. That’s not a [buffer1]\.
entries.translated: Ooh aww\. Itu bukan [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Ooh aww\.

That’s an Egg\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh aww\. That’s an Egg\.
entries.translated: Ooh aww\. Itu Telur\.

entries.original: "[green]Gyaoo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Gyaoo!
entries.translated: [green]Gyaoo!

entries.original: "[green]Gwogobo gwobobobo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Gwogobo gwobobobo!
entries.translated: [green]Gwogobo gwobobobo!

entries.original: "[green]Grrgggrrrrah!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Grrgggrrrrah!
entries.translated: [green]Grrgggrrrrah!

entries.original:
"[black]Volcanion filled itself with steam
and increased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Volcanion filled itself with steam and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Volcanion mengisi dirinya dengan
uap dan meningkatkan ukurannya!

entries.original: "[black]The [buffer1] flew away!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] flew away!
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] terbang menjauh!

entries.original: "[black]The [buffer1] dove into the magma."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] dove into the magma.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] menyelam ke dalam magma.

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] receded into the magma."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] receded into the magma.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] surut ke dalam magma.

entries.original: "Call out to [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Call out to [buffer1]?
entries.translated: Panggil [buffer1]?

entries.original: "Sankren bolganone!"
entries.translation_source: Sankren bolganone!
entries.translated: Sankren bolganone!

entries.original:
"[player]’s Red Orb suddenly
began glowing!"
entries.translation_source: [player]’s Red Orb suddenly began glowing!
entries.translated:
[player]Red Orb milik [player]
tiba-tiba mulai bersinar!

entries.original:
"PRESSURE IS
THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: PRESSURE IS THE KEY.
entries.translated: TEKANAN ADALAH KUNCI.

entries.original:
"This tablet\.
What could it be?

I’m sure the answer will reveal
itself someday soon\."
entries.translation_source: This tablet\. What could it be? I’m sure the answer will reveal itself someday soon\.
entries.translated:
Tablet ini\. Ada apa gerangan? Aku
yakin jawabannya akan terungkap\lsuatu hari nanti\.

entries.original:
"The tablet!

I was studying it when, all of a
sudden, it collapsed before my\lvery eyes!

What could this mean?
Is it a sign?

Or, perhaps, was this your doing?"
entries.translation_source: The tablet! I was studying it when, all of a sudden, it collapsed before my very eyes! What could this mean? Is it a sign? Or, perhaps, was this your doing?
entries.translated:
Tablet itu! Aku sedang
mempelajarinya ketika, tiba-tiba,\ltablet itu runtuh di depan mataku!

Apa artinya ini? Apakah ini sebuah
pertanda? Atau, mungkin, ini\lulahmu?

entries.original:
"[black]It appears to be the remains of
what used to be a Shadow Warrior.

Remove the cloak and lay it
to rest?"
entries.translation_source: [black]It appears to be the remains of what used to be a Shadow Warrior. Remove the cloak and lay it to rest?
entries.translated:
[black]Tampaknya ini adalah sisa-sisa dari
seorang Shadow Warrior. Lepaskan\ljubahnya dan istirahatkan?

entries.original:
"[black]The cloak was removed from the
Shadow Warrior."
entries.translation_source: [black]The cloak was removed from the Shadow Warrior.
entries.translated:
[black]Jubah telah dilepaskan dari Shadow
Warrior.

entries.original:
"[black]The remains of the Shadow Warrior
fell apart, and its soul was laid\lto rest."
entries.translation_source: [black]The remains of the Shadow Warrior fell apart, and its soul was laid to rest.
entries.translated:
[black]Sisa-sisa Shadow Warrior hancur,
dan jiwanya telah diistirahatkan.

entries.original:
"Be careful while exploring
the volcano.

There’s plenty of exposed magma
everywhere."
entries.translation_source: Be careful while exploring the volcano. There’s plenty of exposed magma everywhere.
entries.translated:
Berhati-hatilah saat menjelajahi
gunung berapi. Ada banyak magma\lterbuka di mana-mana.

entries.original:
"There’s no such thing as a
bird-type Pokémon, is there?

No wonder I can’t find the
rare Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no such thing as a bird-type Pokémon, is there? No wonder I can’t find the rare Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang namanya Pokémon tipe
burung, kan? Pantas saja aku tidak\lbisa menemukan Pokémon langka itu!

entries.original: "Which way will you choose to go?"
entries.translation_source: Which way will you choose to go?
entries.translated: Kamu akan memilih jalan yang mana?

entries.original:
"This place is so hot.

It’s too easy to start a fire!"
entries.translation_source: This place is so hot. It’s too easy to start a fire!
entries.translated:
Tempat ini sangat panas. Sangat
mudah untuk memulai api!

entries.original:
"I came here to train my Pokémon
that have a natural weakness to\lFire-types."
entries.translation_source: I came here to train my Pokémon that have a natural weakness to Fire-types.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini untuk melatih
Pokémon-ku yang memiliki kelemahan\lalami terhadap tipe Api.

entries.original:
"All these bridges were designed
to withstand the immense heat.

That’s why they’re red, as opposed
to the normal light blue."
entries.translation_source: All these bridges were designed to withstand the immense heat. That’s why they’re red, as opposed to the normal light blue.
entries.translated:
Semua jembatan ini dirancang untuk
menahan panas yang sangat besar.\lItulah mengapa warnanya merah,

berbeda dengan biru muda biasa.

entries.original:
"I will continue to train.

Someday, I will become the
ultimate warrior."
entries.translation_source: I will continue to train. Someday, I will become the ultimate warrior.
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus berlatih. Suatu
hari, aku akan menjadi prajurit\lyang ulung.

entries.original:
"The lava here is the inspiration
for all my greatest works."
entries.translation_source: The lava here is the inspiration for all my greatest works.
entries.translated:
Lava di sini adalah inspirasi untuk
semua karya terbesarku.

entries.original:
"I will unravel the secrets of
Cinder Volcano!"
entries.translation_source: I will unravel the secrets of Cinder Volcano!
entries.translated:
Aku akan mengungkap rahasia Gunung
Api Cinder!

entries.original:
"I’m going to stay rooted to this
spot for all of eternity."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to stay rooted to this spot for all of eternity.
entries.translated:
Aku akan tetap tertancap di tempat
ini untuk selamanya.

entries.original:
"Who in their right mind would
believe that Slugma and Magcargo\lburn hotter than the sun?

We’d all roast alive if they did!"
entries.translation_source: Who in their right mind would believe that Slugma and Magcargo burn hotter than the sun? We’d all roast alive if they did!
entries.translated:
Siapa yang waras akan percaya bahwa
Slugma dan Magcargo membakar lebih\lpanas dari matahari? Kita semua

akan hangus hidup-hidup jika itu
benar!

entries.original:
"Staring out into the vast ocean of
lava just melts my heart."
entries.translation_source: Staring out into the vast ocean of lava just melts my heart.
entries.translated:
Menatap ke lautan lava yang luas
melelehkan hatiku.

entries.original:
"Sometimes I like to stare at Gems
like these to become one with the\lmagma.

You are deserving of this Gem."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes I like to stare at Gems like these to become one with the magma. You are deserving of this Gem.
entries.translated:
Kadang aku suka menatap Permata
seperti ini untuk menyatu dengan\lmagma. Kamu layak mendapatkan

Permata ini.

entries.original:
"The magma is beautiful, isn’t it?

Sometimes I like to let my
[green]Fire[red]-type Pokémon take me for a\lride on it."
entries.translation_source: The magma is beautiful, isn’t it? Sometimes I like to let my [green]Fire[red]-type Pokémon take me for a ride on it.
entries.translated:
Magma itu indah, bukan? Kadang aku
suka membiarkan Pokémon tipe [green]Api[red]ku\lmengajakku berkeliling di atasnya.

entries.original:
"The fact that you are here means
you have acquired at least four\lGym Badges.

But Badges alone are not enough to
prove your worth to me.

I will challenge you to a battle
if, and only if you defeat all\lother Trainers in Cinder Volcano."
entries.translation_source: The fact that you are here means you have acquired at least four Gym Badges. But Badges alone are not enough to prove your worth to me. I will challenge you to a battle if, and only if you defeat all other Trainers in Cinder Volcano.
entries.translated:
Fakta bahwa kamu di sini berarti
kamu telah memperoleh setidaknya\lempat Lencana Gym. Tapi Lencana

saja tidak cukup untuk membuktikan
nilaimu padaku. Aku akan\lmenantangmu bertarung jika, dan

hanya jika kamu mengalahkan semua
Trainer lain di Cinder Volcano.

entries.original:
"The fact that you’re here means
you have acquired at least four\lGym Badges.

Now, show me the strength of a
Trainer with four Badges!"
entries.translation_source: The fact that you’re here means you have acquired at least four Gym Badges. Now, show me the strength of a Trainer with four Badges!
entries.translated:
Fakta bahwa kamu di sini berarti
kamu telah memperoleh setidaknya\lempat Lencana Gym. Sekarang,

tunjukkan padaku kekuatan seorang
Trainer dengan empat Lencana!

entries.original: "Take this."
entries.translation_source: Take this.
entries.translated: Ambil ini.

entries.original:
"That is a gift for defeating me.

Give it to a [green]Camerupt[blue] and it will
be able to Mega Evolve in battle,\lassuming you have a Keystone."
entries.translation_source: That is a gift for defeating me. Give it to a [green]Camerupt[blue] and it will be able to Mega Evolve in battle, assuming you have a Keystone.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah hadiah karena
mengalahkanku. Berikan pada\l[green]Camerupt[blue] dan ia akan bisa Mega

Berevolusi dalam pertarungan,
asalkan kamu memiliki Batu Kunci.

entries.original: "Hunter of the Swamp"
entries.translation_source: Hunter of the Swamp
entries.translated: Pemburu Rawa

entries.original:
"Hi, Trainer.

Oh! I see you possess a DexNav.
I have just the task for you.

Would you use your DexNav to aid
yourself in the capture of all of\lthe Pokémon that live in this area?

I want to know all about the
Pokémon that live in Cootes Bog."
entries.translation_source: Hi, Trainer. Oh! I see you possess a DexNav. I have just the task for you. Would you use your DexNav to aid yourself in the capture of all of the Pokémon that live in this area? I want to know all about the Pokémon that live in Cootes Bog.
entries.translated:
Hai, Trainer. Oh! Aku lihat kamu
memiliki DexNav. Aku punya tugas\luntukmu. Maukah kamu menggunakan

DexNav-mu untuk membantu dirimu
sendiri menangkap semua Pokémon\lyang tinggal di area ini? Aku ingin

tahu semua tentang Pokémon yang
tinggal di Cootes Bog.

entries.original:
"Hi, Trainer.

If you acquire a DexNav, would you
come back and speak with me?

I have a task only capable of
being completed by a Trainer\lpossessing a DexNav."
entries.translation_source: Hi, Trainer. If you acquire a DexNav, would you come back and speak with me? I have a task only capable of being completed by a Trainer possessing a DexNav.
entries.translated:
Hai, Trainer. Jika kamu mendapatkan
DexNav, maukah kamu kembali dan\lbicara denganku? Aku punya tugas

yang hanya bisa diselesaikan oleh
seorang Trainer yang memiliki\lDexNav.

entries.original:
"Perfect!

Please report back to me when your
DexNav indicates that all of the\lPokémon here have been caught."
entries.translation_source: Perfect! Please report back to me when your DexNav indicates that all of the Pokémon here have been caught.
entries.translated:
Sempurna! Tolong laporkan kembali
padaku saat DexNav-mu menunjukkan\lbahwa semua Pokémon di sini telah

tertangkap.

entries.original:
"It seems you are not as interested
in your DexNav as I am, I suppose."
entries.translation_source: It seems you are not as interested in your DexNav as I am, I suppose.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak tertarik
dengan DexNav-mu seperti aku,\lkurasa.

entries.original:
"Your DexNav shows that you’ve
caught all of the Pokémon that\llive in the swamp!

Perfect!
This is my thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Your DexNav shows that you’ve caught all of the Pokémon that live in the swamp! Perfect! This is my thanks!
entries.translated:
DexNav-mu menunjukkan bahwa kamu
telah menangkap semua Pokémon yang\ltinggal di rawa! Sempurna! Ini

hadiahku!

entries.original: "And let me modify your DexNav, too!"
entries.translation_source: And let me modify your DexNav, too!
entries.translated:
Dan biarkan aku memodifikasi
DexNav-mu juga!

entries.original:
"[black]The DexNav has been upgraded to
show possible held items!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The DexNav has been upgraded to show possible held items!
entries.translated:
[black]DexNav telah ditingkatkan untuk
menunjukkan kemungkinan item yang\ldibawa!

entries.original:
"Your DexNav shows that there are
still some Pokémon here you\lhaven’t caught, yet.

Keep on hunting!"
entries.translation_source: Your DexNav shows that there are still some Pokémon here you haven’t caught, yet. Keep on hunting!
entries.translated:
DexNav-mu menunjukkan bahwa masih
ada beberapa Pokémon di sini yang\lbelum kamu tangkap. Terus berburu!

entries.original:
"Finding all of the Pokémon that can
be found in the swamp is amazing!"
entries.translation_source: Finding all of the Pokémon that can be found in the swamp is amazing!
entries.translated:
Menemukan semua Pokémon yang bisa
ditemukan di rawa itu luar biasa!

entries.original:
"This is the path through the bog.

You can take it to get to
Crystal Peak.

If you want to take the bridge
path, go back."
entries.translation_source: This is the path through the bog. You can take it to get to Crystal Peak. If you want to take the bridge path, go back.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah jalan melalui rawa. Kamu
bisa mengambilnya untuk sampai ke\lCrystal Peak. Jika kamu ingin

mengambil jalan jembatan, kembali
saja.

entries.original:
"We Rangers assist the swamp’s
protector by any means necessary."
entries.translation_source: We Rangers assist the swamp’s protector by any means necessary.
entries.translated:
Kami para Ranger membantu pelindung
rawa dengan cara apa pun yang\ldiperlukan.

entries.original:
"This swamp has so many places
to hide, who knows what might\lbe hidden here?"
entries.translation_source: This swamp has so many places to hide, who knows what might be hidden here?
entries.translated:
Rawa ini memiliki banyak tempat
untuk bersembunyi, siapa yang tahu\lapa yang mungkin tersembunyi di

sini?

entries.original:
"We must respect the spirit of the
swamp, so don’t litter."
entries.translation_source: We must respect the spirit of the swamp, so don’t litter.
entries.translated:
Kita harus menghormati roh rawa,
jadi jangan membuang sampah\lsembarangan.

entries.original:
"I hope my method is approved by
PETP: People for the Ethical\lTreatment of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I hope my method is approved by PETP: People for the Ethical Treatment of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Saya harap metode saya disetujui
oleh PETP: People for the Ethical\lTreatment of Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Swamps: good to play with Pokémon
in, not to eat in."
entries.translation_source: Swamps: good to play with Pokémon in, not to eat in.
entries.translated:
Rawa: baik untuk bermain dengan
Pokémon, tidak untuk makan di\ldalamnya.

entries.original:
"More pretty flowers will make
anything pretty, even an icky\lswamp such as this one."
entries.translation_source: More pretty flowers will make anything pretty, even an icky swamp such as this one.
entries.translated:
Lebih banyak bunga cantik akan
membuat apa pun menjadi cantik,\lbahkan rawa yang menjijikkan

seperti ini.

entries.original:
"Just go up that waterfall, and
you’re at the base of Crystal Peak."
entries.translation_source: Just go up that waterfall, and you’re at the base of Crystal Peak.
entries.translated:
Naik saja air terjun itu, dan kamu
akan berada di kaki Puncak Kristal.

entries.original:
"Have you ever used the
KBT Expressway?

It’s an underground highway that
goes around most of West Borrius!

The acronym \qoKBT\qc is short for
King Borrius the Third.

He was the king of Borrius that
created the concept of a region-\lwide highway."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever used the KBT Expressway? It’s an underground highway that goes around most of West Borrius! The acronym \qoKBT\qc is short for King Borrius the Third. He was the king of Borrius that created the concept of a region- wide highway.
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu menggunakan Jalan
Tol KBT? Itu adalah jalan raya\lbawah tanah yang mengelilingi

sebagian besar Borrius Barat!
Akronim \qoKBT\qc adalah singkatan dari\lRaja Borrius Ketiga. Dia adalah

raja Borrius yang menciptakan
konsep jalan raya di seluruh\lwilayah.

entries.original:
"The meteorites in Crater Town
are imbued with some sort of\lcosmic power.

They say that if a certain Pokémon
comes in contact with one, strange\lthings will happen."
entries.translation_source: The meteorites in Crater Town are imbued with some sort of cosmic power. They say that if a certain Pokémon comes in contact with one, strange things will happen.
entries.translated:
Meteorit di Kota Kawah diresapi
dengan semacam kekuatan kosmik.\lMereka bilang bahwa jika Pokémon

tertentu bersentuhan dengan satu,
hal-hal aneh akan terjadi.

entries.original:
"This cave takes you out of town
to Route 6.

From there, it’s a straight shot
through Route 7, up Frost Mountain,\land up Route 8 to [green]Blizzard City[blue].

If you’re going to hike all the way
up there, make sure you have many\lPoké Balls for catching Pokémon.

Most people don’t go that way,
though, since they don’t have the\l[green]Vision Badge[blue].

Without it, they can’t cut down
that [green]Skinny Tree[blue] in front of the\lentrance."
entries.translation_source: This cave takes you out of town to Route 6. From there, it’s a straight shot through Route 7, up Frost Mountain, and up Route 8 to [green]Blizzard City[blue]. If you’re going to hike all the way up there, make sure you have many Poké Balls for catching Pokémon. Most people don’t go that way, though, since they don’t have the [green]Vision Badge[blue]. Without it, they can’t cut down that [green]Skinny Tree[blue] in front of the entrance.
entries.translated:
Gua ini membawamu keluar kota
menuju Rute 6. Dari sana, langsung\lmelalui Rute 7, naik ke Frost

Mountain, dan naik Rute 8 ke
[green]Blizzard City[blue]. Jika kamu akan\lmendaki sampai ke sana, pastikan

kamu memiliki banyak Poké Ball
untuk menangkap Pokémon. Kebanyakan\lorang tidak pergi ke sana, karena

mereka tidak memiliki [green]Lencana Visi[blue].
Tanpanya, mereka tidak bisa\lmenebang [green]Pohon Kurus[blue] di depan pintu

masuk.

entries.original:
"That cave down there takes you out
of town to Route 6.

From there, it’s a straight shot
through Route 7, up Frost Mountain,\land up Route 8 to [green]Blizzard City[blue].

If you’re going to hike all the way
up there, make sure you have many\lPoké Balls for catching Pokémon.

Now that the Skinny Tree blocking
it has been cut down, it is much\lmore frequently used."
entries.translation_source: That cave down there takes you out of town to Route 6. From there, it’s a straight shot through Route 7, up Frost Mountain, and up Route 8 to [green]Blizzard City[blue]. If you’re going to hike all the way up there, make sure you have many Poké Balls for catching Pokémon. Now that the Skinny Tree blocking it has been cut down, it is much more frequently used.
entries.translated:
Gua di bawah sana membawamu keluar
kota menuju Rute 6. Dari sana,\llangsung melalui Rute 7, naik ke

Frost Mountain, dan naik Rute 8 ke
[green]Blizzard City[blue]. Jika kamu akan\lmendaki sampai ke sana, pastikan

kamu memiliki banyak Poké Ball
untuk menangkap Pokémon. Sekarang\lPohon Kurus yang menghalangi telah

ditebang, jalan itu lebih sering
digunakan.

entries.original:
"I heard there’s someone in
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] who teaches\lthe art of [green]Mega Evolution[red]!"
entries.translation_source: I heard there’s someone in [green]Tarmigan Town[red] who teaches the art of [green]Mega Evolution[red]!
entries.translated:
Aku dengar ada seseorang di
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] yang mengajarkan seni\l[green]Mega Evolusi[red]!

entries.original:
"I heard there’s someone in
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] who teaches\lthe art of [green]Mega Evolution[red]!

But you already knew that,
didn’t you?

That [buffer1] you’re wearing
gave it away."
entries.translation_source: I heard there’s someone in [green]Tarmigan Town[red] who teaches the art of [green]Mega Evolution[red]! But you already knew that, didn’t you? That [buffer1] you’re wearing gave it away.
entries.translated:
Aku dengar ada seseorang di
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] yang mengajarkan seni\l[green]Mega Evolusi[red]! Tapi kamu sudah tahu

itu, kan? [buffer1] yang kamu pakai
itu memberitahukannya.

entries.original:
"Didja know that if you talk to the
Gym referees before beating the\lGym Leader, they’ll give you a\lfree gift?

Didja? Didja?"
entries.translation_source: Didja know that if you talk to the Gym referees before beating the Gym Leader, they’ll give you a free gift? Didja? Didja?
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu kalau kamu berbicara
dengan wasit Gym sebelum\lmengalahkan Pemimpin Gym, mereka

akan memberimu hadiah gratis?
Tahukah? Tahukah?

entries.original:
"Well, then, didja know that if you
talk to the Gym referees after\lbeating the Gym Leader, they’ll\lgive you a gift then, too?

Didja? Didja?"
entries.translation_source: Well, then, didja know that if you talk to the Gym referees after beating the Gym Leader, they’ll give you a gift then, too? Didja? Didja?
entries.translated:
Nah, kalau begitu, tahukah kamu
kalau kamu berbicara dengan wasit\lGym setelah mengalahkan Pemimpin

Gym, mereka akan memberimu hadiah
juga? Tahukah? Tahukah?

entries.original: "You learn something new every day!"
entries.translation_source: You learn something new every day!
entries.translated:
Kamu belajar sesuatu yang baru
setiap hari!

entries.original: "Oh, look at you, smarty pants."
entries.translation_source: Oh, look at you, smarty pants.
entries.translated: Oh, lihat dirimu, si pandai.

entries.original:
"Mutter\. Mutter\.

\.wait for signal\.

Whisper\. Whisper\.

\.asset on lookout\.

Mutter\. Mutter\."
entries.translation_source: Mutter\. Mutter\. \.wait for signal\. Whisper\. Whisper\. \.asset on lookout\. Mutter\. Mutter\.
entries.translated:
Bergumam\. Bergumam\. \.tunggu sinyal\.
Berbisik\. Berbisik\. \.aset di pos\lpengintaian\. Bergumam\. Bergumam\.

entries.original: "Major Miner"
entries.translation_source: Major Miner
entries.translated: Major Miner

entries.original:
"There are rumours of rare Pokémon
known as [green]Carbink[blue] appearing in\lthe KBT Expressway.

However, the rumours indicate
that they can only be found\lbehind the collapsed doorways\lthat litter the tunnel.

If only there were some way to
[green]mine[blue] through the rubble\."
entries.translation_source: There are rumours of rare Pokémon known as [green]Carbink[blue] appearing in the KBT Expressway. However, the rumours indicate that they can only be found behind the collapsed doorways that litter the tunnel. If only there were some way to [green]mine[blue] through the rubble\.
entries.translated:
Ada rumor tentang Pokémon langka
yang dikenal sebagai [green]Carbink[blue] muncul\ldi Jalan Tol KBT. Namun, rumor

tersebut menunjukkan bahwa mereka
hanya dapat ditemukan di balik\lpintu yang runtuh yang berserakan

di terowongan. Seandainya ada cara
untuk [green]menambang[blue] puing-puing\.

entries.original:
"That ADM you own, it’s just the
machine I’m searching for!

I’m looking for a way to destroy
the collapsed doorways that litter\lthe KBT Expressway, and you can\lprovide me just the method!

Please, use your [green]ADM[blue] and assist
me in my task!"
entries.translation_source: That ADM you own, it’s just the machine I’m searching for! I’m looking for a way to destroy the collapsed doorways that litter the KBT Expressway, and you can provide me just the method! Please, use your [green]ADM[blue] and assist me in my task!
entries.translated:
ADM yang kamu miliki, itulah mesin
yang aku cari! Aku mencari cara\luntuk menghancurkan pintu-pintu

yang runtuh yang berserakan di
Jalan Tol KBT, dan kamu bisa\lmemberiku metode yang tepat!

Tolong, gunakan [green]ADM[blue] milikmu dan
bantu aku dalam tugas ini!

entries.original:
"Splendid!

My task involves the following:
destroy the [green]collapsed doorways[blue]\lthat litter the [green]KBT Expressway[blue]\lusing your [green]ADM[blue] and capture\l[green]3 Carbink[blue], starting now.

In order to break down a doorway,
you’ll need to charge your ADM\lfirst.

If you charge up your ADM with [green]3
Light Clay[blue], it will be powerful\lenough to destroy the rubble!

Where do you find Light Clay?

It has a decent chance of appearing
when you mine in the walls of the\lKBT Expressway.

Once you have done that, please
return to me for a reward."
entries.translation_source: Splendid! My task involves the following: destroy the [green]collapsed doorways[blue] that litter the [green]KBT Expressway[blue] using your [green]ADM[blue] and capture [green]3 Carbink[blue], starting now. In order to break down a doorway, you’ll need to charge your ADM first. If you charge up your ADM with [green]3 Light Clay[blue], it will be powerful enough to destroy the rubble! Where do you find Light Clay? It has a decent chance of appearing when you mine in the walls of the KBT Expressway. Once you have done that, please return to me for a reward.
entries.translated:
Hebat! Tugasku melibatkan hal
berikut: hancurkan [green]pintu yang\lruntuh[blue] yang berserakan di [green]KBT

Expressway[blue] menggunakan [green]ADM[blue] milikmu
dan tangkap [green]3 Carbink[blue], mulai\lsekarang. Untuk menghancurkan

sebuah pintu, kamu harus mengisi
daya ADM-mu terlebih dahulu. Jika\lkamu mengisi ADM-mu dengan [green]3 Tanah

Liat Ringan[blue], itu akan cukup kuat
untuk menghancurkan reruntuhan! Di\lmana kamu menemukan Tanah Liat

Ringan? Ada kemungkinan yang cukup
besar untuk muncul saat kamu\lmenambang di dinding KBT

Expressway. Setelah kamu
melakukannya, silakan kembali\lkepadaku untuk mendapatkan hadiah.

entries.original:
"Not very splendid.

You are the only Trainer I am aware
of that has purchased an ADM.

Without you, my purpose here
is meaningless."
entries.translation_source: Not very splendid. You are the only Trainer I am aware of that has purchased an ADM. Without you, my purpose here is meaningless.
entries.translated:
Tidak terlalu hebat. Kamu adalah
satu-satunya Trainer yang kuketahui\ltelah membeli ADM. Tanpamu,

tujuanku di sini tidak berarti.

entries.original:
"Destroy the [green]collapsed doorways[blue]
that litter the [green]KBT Expressway[blue]\lusing your [green]ADM[blue] and capture\lat least [green][buffer1] more Carbink[blue].

In order to break down a doorway,
you’ll need to charge your ADM\lfirst.

If you charge up your ADM with [green]3
Light Clay[blue], it will be powerful\lenough to destroy the rubble!

Where do you find Light Clay?

It has a decent chance of appearing
when you mine in the walls of the\lKBT Expressway.

Once you have done that, please
return to me for a reward."
entries.translation_source: Destroy the [green]collapsed doorways[blue] that litter the [green]KBT Expressway[blue] using your [green]ADM[blue] and capture at least [green][buffer1] more Carbink[blue]. In order to break down a doorway, you’ll need to charge your ADM first. If you charge up your ADM with [green]3 Light Clay[blue], it will be powerful enough to destroy the rubble! Where do you find Light Clay? It has a decent chance of appearing when you mine in the walls of the KBT Expressway. Once you have done that, please return to me for a reward.
entries.translated:
Hancurkan [green]pintu yang runtuh[blue] yang
berserakan di [green]KBT Expressway[blue]\lmenggunakan [green]ADM[blue] milikmu dan tangkap

setidaknya [green][buffer1] Carbink lagi[blue].
Untuk menghancurkan sebuah pintu,\lkamu harus mengisi daya ADM-mu

terlebih dahulu. Jika kamu mengisi
ADM-mu dengan [green]3 Tanah Liat Ringan[blue],\litu akan cukup kuat untuk

menghancurkan reruntuhan! Di mana
kamu menemukan Tanah Liat Ringan?\lAda kemungkinan yang cukup besar

untuk muncul saat kamu menambang di
dinding KBT Expressway. Setelah\lkamu melakukannya, silakan kembali

kepadaku untuk mendapatkan hadiah.

entries.original:
"You and your ADM have done
wonderful work!

Please, accept this, a rare
Mega Stone!"
entries.translation_source: You and your ADM have done wonderful work! Please, accept this, a rare Mega Stone!
entries.translated:
Kamu dan ADM-mu telah melakukan
pekerjaan yang luar biasa! Silakan,\lterimalah ini, sebuah Batu Mega

yang langka!

entries.original:
"The true reward for my task still
lies within the KBT Expressway.

I would not be surprised if a
certain Pokémon appeared in one\lof those caves some day soon\."
entries.translation_source: The true reward for my task still lies within the KBT Expressway. I would not be surprised if a certain Pokémon appeared in one of those caves some day soon\.
entries.translated:
Hadiah sebenarnya dari tugasku
masih berada di dalam KBT\lExpressway. Aku tidak akan terkejut

jika seekor Pokémon tertentu muncul
di salah satu gua itu suatu hari\lnanti\.

entries.original: "[green]Weeooweeoowee!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Weeooweeoowee!
entries.translated: [green]Weeooweeoowee!

entries.original: "[green]Weeeeooooweeeeeeeeoooo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Weeeeooooweeeeeeeeoooo!
entries.translated: [green]Weeeeooooweeeeeeeeoooo!

entries.original:
"[black]Oh, no!
Diancie ran away!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Oh, no! Diancie ran away!
entries.translated: [black]Oh, tidak! Diancie kabur!

entries.original:
"Touching the meteorite balanced
out the attributes of a certain\lPokémon."
entries.translation_source: Touching the meteorite balanced out the attributes of a certain Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Menyentuh meteorit menyeimbangkan
atribut seekor Pokémon tertentu.

entries.original:
"Touching the meteorite heightened
the offensive capabilities of\la certain Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Touching the meteorite heightened the offensive capabilities of a certain Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Menyentuh meteorit meningkatkan
kemampuan ofensif seekor Pokémon\ltertentu.

entries.original:
"Touching the meteorite heightened
the defensive capabilities of\la certain Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Touching the meteorite heightened the defensive capabilities of a certain Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Menyentuh meteorit meningkatkan
kemampuan defensif seekor Pokémon\ltertentu.

entries.original:
"Touching the meteorite boosted the
Speed of a certain Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Touching the meteorite boosted the Speed of a certain Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Menyentuh meteorit meningkatkan
Kecepatan seekor Pokémon tertentu.

entries.original:
"It’s a mysterious meteorite that
fell from the stars."
entries.translation_source: It’s a mysterious meteorite that fell from the stars.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah meteorit misterius yang
jatuh dari bintang-bintang.

entries.original: "Dad"
entries.translation_source: Dad
entries.translated: Ayah

entries.original: "Daughter"
entries.translation_source: Daughter
entries.translated: Putri

entries.original:
"You know what I saw on TV?

[green][buffer1][red]! They said there’s
a whole bunch of [green][buffer2][red] there!"
entries.translation_source: You know what I saw on TV? [green][buffer1][red]! They said there’s a whole bunch of [green][buffer2][red] there!
entries.translated:
Tahu apa yang kulihat di TV?
[green][buffer1][red]! Mereka bilang ada banyak\lsekali [green][buffer2][red] di sana!

entries.original:
"You know what it said on
the radio?

[green][buffer1][red]! They said there’s
a whole bunch of [green][buffer2][red] there!"
entries.translation_source: You know what it said on the radio? [green][buffer1][red]! They said there’s a whole bunch of [green][buffer2][red] there!
entries.translated:
Tahu apa yang dikatakan di radio?
[green][buffer1][red]! Mereka bilang ada banyak\lsekali [green][buffer2][red] di sana!

entries.original:
"[black]It’s an old radio.

It’s broadcasting something about
Pokémon Swarms."
entries.translation_source: [black]It’s an old radio. It’s broadcasting something about Pokémon Swarms.
entries.translated:
[black]Itu adalah radio tua. Ini
menyiarkan sesuatu tentang Kawanan\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"My daughter loves [buffer1].

I’d set a time limit, but if it
weren’t for her, my son would never\lknow when Pokémon [green]Swarms[red] appear!

And it’s not like those Pokémon
are easy to find any other time\."
entries.translation_source: My daughter loves [buffer1]. I’d set a time limit, but if it weren’t for her, my son would never know when Pokémon [green]Swarms[red] appear! And it’s not like those Pokémon are easy to find any other time\.
entries.translated:
Putriku menyukai [buffer1]. Aku akan
menetapkan batas waktu, tetapi jika\lbukan karena dia, anakku tidak akan

pernah tahu kapan [green]Kawanan[red] Pokémon
muncul! Dan tidak seperti Pokémon\litu mudah ditemukan di waktu lain\.

entries.original:
"Every hour, different groups of
Pokémon roam around Borrius.

My daughter loves hearing about
these Pokémon on [buffer2], and\lshe’s been dying to meet\lone of them.

You don’t by any chance happen to
have a [green][buffer1][blue], do you?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Every hour, different groups of Pokémon roam around Borrius. My daughter loves hearing about these Pokémon on [buffer2], and she’s been dying to meet one of them. You don’t by any chance happen to have a [green][buffer1][blue], do you? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Setiap jam, kelompok Pokémon yang
berbeda berkeliaran di sekitar\lBorrius. Putriku suka mendengar

tentang Pokémon ini di [buffer2],
dan dia sangat ingin bertemu salah\lsatu dari mereka. Apakah kamu

kebetulan memiliki [green][buffer1][blue]?
*Frisk* *Frisk*

entries.original:
"Sweetie!

Look at what this nice young
Trainer brought you."
entries.translation_source: Sweetie! Look at what this nice young Trainer brought you.
entries.translated:
Sayang! Lihat apa yang dibawakan
oleh Pelatih muda yang baik ini\luntukmu.

entries.original:
"[red]Whoa! Is that a [buffer1]?

It’s so [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Twenty years ago, a large meteorite
was hurtling towards Borrius.

The astronomers at Cube Corp.
predicted that if it wasn’t\lstopped, it would fall directly on\lValley City, this city, and end all\llife living here.

With great haste, we began our
evacuation of the city.

As we were about to make our escape
through the KBT Expressway, we\lheard the news.

The meteorite was now predicted to
crush half of the region!

If we attempted to flee
underground, there would be a\llarge chance we’d be buried alive.

Chaos ensued.

All was thought hopeless\. until
HE arrived.

[green]Aros[blue], the legend.

He arrived alongside a small Pokémon
he used to teleport everyone to\lEast Borrius, safe from harm.

He planned to attack the meteorite
head on and smash it to bits.

Once he had transported everyone to
safety, it is said that he rode on\la Rayquaza and smashed into\lthe meteorite!

It shattered, and most of the
smaller fragments fell on\lValley City.

The city was destroyed, but Aros
had saved a region.

I will never forget the heroic act
that man performed."
entries.translation_source: Twenty years ago, a large meteorite was hurtling towards Borrius. The astronomers at Cube Corp. predicted that if it wasn’t stopped, it would fall directly on Valley City, this city, and end all life living here. With great haste, we began our evacuation of the city. As we were about to make our escape through the KBT Expressway, we heard the news. The meteorite was now predicted to crush half of the region! If we attempted to flee underground, there would be a large chance we’d be buried alive. Chaos ensued. All was thought hopeless\. until HE arrived. [green]Aros[blue], the legend. He arrived alongside a small Pokémon he used to teleport everyone to East Borrius, safe from harm. He planned to attack the meteorite head on and smash it to bits. Once he had transported everyone to safety, it is said that he rode on a Rayquaza and smashed into the meteorite! It shattered, and most of the smaller fragments fell on Valley City. The city was destroyed, but Aros had saved a region. I will never forget the heroic act that man performed.
entries.translated:
Dua puluh tahun yang lalu, sebuah
meteorit besar meluncur menuju\lBorrius. Para astronom di Cube

Corp. memperkirakan bahwa jika
tidak dihentikan, meteorit itu akan\ljatuh langsung di Valley City, kota

ini, dan mengakhiri semua kehidupan
yang tinggal di sini. Dengan\ltergesa-gesa, kami memulai evakuasi

kota. Saat kami hendak melarikan
diri melalui KBT Expressway, kami\lmendengar berita. Meteorit itu

sekarang diperkirakan akan
menghancurkan setengah dari\lwilayah! Jika kami mencoba

melarikan diri ke bawah tanah,
kemungkinan besar kami akan\lterkubur hidup-hidup. Kekacauan

terjadi. Semua dikira tidak ada
harapan\. sampai DIA tiba. [green]Aros[blue], sang\llegenda. Dia tiba bersama seekor

Pokémon kecil yang dia gunakan
untuk memindahkan semua orang ke\lEast Borrius, aman dari bahaya. Dia

berencana menyerang meteorit itu
secara langsung dan\lmenghancurkannya menjadi kepingan.

Setelah dia memindahkan semua orang
ke tempat aman, dikatakan bahwa dia\lmenaiki Rayquaza dan menabrak

meteorit itu! Meteorit itu hancur,
dan sebagian besar pecahan yang\llebih kecil jatuh di Valley City.

Kota itu hancur, tetapi Aros telah
menyelamatkan satu wilayah. Aku\ltidak akan pernah melupakan

tindakan heroik yang dilakukan pria
itu.

those years ago, two Pokémon were\ldiscovered to have landed on Earth.

One of them was a very powerful
Pokémon capable of granting any\lwish the heart desired.

At first, the townspeople and I
thought this was wonderful!

We could use it to restore our
broken city!

However, we soon learned that all
our wishes came at a cost.

Fearing an even more devastating
outcome, we locked up this Pokémon.

But now that the [buffer2] of Aros
has become Champion, I feel that it\lis fitting we bestow this Pokémon\lunto you.

Would you care to give this
Pokémon a loving home?"
entries.translation_source: Following the meteorite strike all those years ago, two Pokémon were discovered to have landed on Earth. One of them was a very powerful Pokémon capable of granting any wish the heart desired. At first, the townspeople and I thought this was wonderful! We could use it to restore our broken city! However, we soon learned that all our wishes came at a cost. Fearing an even more devastating outcome, we locked up this Pokémon. But now that the [buffer2] of Aros has become Champion, I feel that it is fitting we bestow this Pokémon unto you. Would you care to give this Pokémon a loving home?
