entries.translated: Geser kristal ke atas?

entries.original: "Slide the crystal downwards?"
entries.translation_source: Slide the crystal downwards?
entries.translated: Geser kristal ke bawah?

entries.original:
"These crystals are just full of
wonders.

Dig in a little, and you’ll find
loads of Gems!

How about I share one with you?"
entries.translation_source: These crystals are just full of wonders. Dig in a little, and you’ll find loads of Gems! How about I share one with you?
entries.translated:
Kristal-kristal ini penuh
keajaiban. Gali sedikit, dan kamu\lakan menemukan banyak Gems!

Bagaimana kalau aku berbagi satu
denganmu?

entries.original:
"I dig for Gems in this room with my
ADM every single day.

If you have an ADM, you should dig
in here, too!

It’s the one place in Crystal Peak
that you can!"
entries.translation_source: I dig for Gems in this room with my ADM every single day. If you have an ADM, you should dig in here, too! It’s the one place in Crystal Peak that you can!
entries.translated:
Aku menggali Gems di ruangan ini
dengan ADM-ku setiap hari. Jika\lkamu punya ADM, kamu harus menggali

di sini juga! Ini satu-satunya
tempat di Crystal Peak yang bisa!

entries.original: "One Purple Balloon"
entries.translation_source: One Purple Balloon
entries.translated: Satu Balon Ungu

entries.original:
"[red]Oh heavens\.

My daughter, I can’t find her!

We were on holiday in this place
when all of a sudden, an evil\lPokémon carried her away!

I followed it out here, but I’ve
lost sight of it\.

Please, [buffer1], search for her!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Oh heavens\. My daughter, I can’t find her! We were on holiday in this place when all of a sudden, an evil Pokémon carried her away! I followed it out here, but I’ve lost sight of it\. Please, [buffer1], search for her!
entries.translated:
[red]Oh astaga\. Putriku, aku tidak bisa
menemukannya! Kami sedang liburan\ldi tempat ini ketika tiba-tiba,

Pokémon jahat membawanya pergi! Aku
mengikutinya ke sini, tapi aku\lkehilangan jejaknya\. Tolong,

[buffer1], carilah dia!

entries.original:
"[red]Thank you, [buffer1]!

She was taken by one of those evil
Pokémon\. [green]Drifloon[red]!

If you find the Drifloon, you will
find my daughter!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Thank you, [buffer1]! She was taken by one of those evil Pokémon\. [green]Drifloon[red]! If you find the Drifloon, you will find my daughter!
entries.translated:
[red]Terima kasih, [buffer1]! Dia dibawa
oleh salah satu Pokémon jahat itu\.\l[green]Drifloon[red]! Jika kamu menemukan

Drifloon, kamu akan menemukan
putriku!

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, dear\.

What will I do now\.?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Oh, dear\. What will I do now\.?
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, sayang\. Apa yang akan aku
lakukan sekarang\.?

entries.original:
"[red]Sniff\.

This scary balloon carried me
out here!

I wanna go home, but I’m too scared
to leave while it’s watching me\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Sniff\. This scary balloon carried me out here! I wanna go home, but I’m too scared to leave while it’s watching me\.
entries.translated:
[red]Hiks\. Balon menakutkan ini membawaku
ke sini! Aku ingin pulang, tapi aku\lterlalu takut untuk pergi selama

dia mengawasiku\.

entries.original:
"[red]The scary balloon carried me back
to my mommy!

But I know when we turn around it
will grab me again!"
entries.translation_source: [red]The scary balloon carried me back to my mommy! But I know when we turn around it will grab me again!
entries.translated:
[red]Balon menakutkan itu membawaku
kembali ke ibuku! Tapi aku tahu\lsaat kita berbalik, dia akan

menangkapku lagi!

entries.original: "[green]Floooooon!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Floooooon!
entries.translated: [green]Floooooon!

entries.original:
"[black]The little girl was carried off
by the Drifloon."
entries.translation_source: [black]The little girl was carried off by the Drifloon.
entries.translated:
[black]Gadis kecil itu terbawa pergi oleh
Drifloon.

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, thank heavens you’re back!

This\. this\. evil Pokémon won’t
leave my daughter alone!

No matter what I do, it just
won’t\.\CC0820 go\.\CC0820 away\.\CC0820 urk\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Oh, thank heavens you’re back! This\. this\. evil Pokémon won’t leave my daughter alone! No matter what I do, it just won’t\.\CC0820 go\.\CC0820 away\.\CC0820 urk\.
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, syukurlah kau kembali! Ini\. ini\.
Pokémon jahat tidak akan\lmeninggalkan anakku sendirian!

Tidak peduli apa yang kulakukan, ia
tidak akan\.\CC0820 pergi\.\CC0820 menjauh\.\CC0820 urk\.

entries.original:
"[black]The Ditto was carried off
by the Drifloon.

Oh?

It looks like the Ditto dropped
something before it disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Ditto was carried off by the Drifloon. Oh? It looks like the Ditto dropped something before it disappeared.
entries.translated:
[black]Ditto terbawa pergi oleh Drifloon.
Oh? Sepertinya Ditto menjatuhkan\lsesuatu sebelum menghilang.

entries.original: "Blazing Emeralds"
entries.translation_source: Blazing Emeralds
entries.translated: Blazing Emeralds

entries.original:
"Heeyo!

I gots deez emeralds on fiya!

Deya so hot I had ta bury ’em in
the ground!

But den, oh, no!

Crystals covered dem!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

Find my hot, hot, emeralds for me,
pretty please?"
entries.translation_source: Heeyo! I gots deez emeralds on fiya! Deya so hot I had ta bury ’em in the ground! But den, oh, no! Crystals covered dem! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! Find my hot, hot, emeralds for me, pretty please?
entries.translated:
Heeyo! Aku punya zamrud ini yang
terbakar! Mereka sangat panas\lsampai aku harus menguburnya di

tanah! Tapi kemudian, oh, tidak!
Kristal menutupi mereka!\lAhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! Temukan

zamrudku yang panas, panas untukku,
tolong dong?

entries.original:
"Heeyo!

My emeralds were all on fiya!

Now dem no longer on fiya, but
crystals everywhere!

Hide the crystals and find dem [green][buffer1]
emeralds[blue], pretty please!"
entries.translation_source: Heeyo! My emeralds were all on fiya! Now dem no longer on fiya, but crystals everywhere! Hide the crystals and find dem [green][buffer1] emeralds[blue], pretty please!
entries.translated:
Heeyo! Zamrudku semuanya terbakar!
Sekarang mereka tidak lagi\lterbakar, tapi kristal di

mana-mana! Sembunyikan kristal dan
temukan [green][buffer1] zamrud[blue], tolong\ldong!

entries.original:
"Heeyo!

It’s da muffin man!

Gimme my emeralds!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!"
entries.translation_source: Heeyo! It’s da muffin man! Gimme my emeralds! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
entries.translated:
Heeyo! Ini si tukang muffin!
Berikan zamrudku!\lAhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over [buffer1] emeralds
to the strange guy."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over [buffer1] emeralds to the strange guy.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer1]
zamrud kepada pria aneh itu.

entries.original:
"Heeya!

My emeralds!

Deya no longer on fiya!

Woo! Woo! Woo!

Okee dookee, here you go."
entries.translation_source: Heeya! My emeralds! Deya no longer on fiya! Woo! Woo! Woo! Okee dookee, here you go.
entries.translated:
Heeya! Zamrudku! Mereka tidak lagi
terbakar! Woo! Woo! Woo! Okee\ldookee, ini dia.

entries.original:
"Heeyo!

Dem emeralds you don’t got all!

You only gotta [green][buffer2][blue] emerald\\07!

Dem rest are still on fiya!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

Bring me all [green][buffer1][blue] of dem emeralds!"
entries.translation_source: Heeyo! Dem emeralds you don’t got all! You only gotta [green][buffer2][blue] emerald\\07! Dem rest are still on fiya! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! Bring me all [green][buffer1][blue] of dem emeralds!
entries.translated:
Heeyo! Zamrud itu tidak semuanya
kau punya! Kau hanya punya [green][buffer2][blue]\lzamrud\\07! Sisanya masih terbakar!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! Bawakan aku
semua [green][buffer1][blue] zamrud itu!

entries.original: "Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!"
entries.translation_source: Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
entries.translated: Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

entries.original:
"Watch me! Watch me!

My emeralds are on fiya!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

So hot!"
entries.translation_source: Watch me! Watch me! My emeralds are on fiya! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! So hot!
entries.translated:
Lihat aku! Lihat aku! Zamrudku
terbakar! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!\lSangat panas!

entries.original:
"The emerald was absorbed by
the Cube!"
entries.translation_source: The emerald was absorbed by the Cube!
entries.translated: Zamrud diserap oleh Kubus!

entries.original: "Emeralds Remaining: [green][buffer1][black]"
entries.translation_source: Emeralds Remaining: [green][buffer1][black]
entries.translated: Zamrud Tersisa: [green][buffer1][black]

entries.original:
"[player]’s Jade Orb suddenly
began glowing!"
entries.translation_source: [player]’s Jade Orb suddenly began glowing!
entries.translated:
[player]{B4}s Jade Orb tiba-tiba mulai
bersinar!

entries.original: "[green]Kiyuryursheeah!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Kiyuryursheeah!
entries.translated: [green]Kiyuryursheeah!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] flew away!"
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] flew away!
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] terbang menjauh!

entries.original:
"That giant crystal at the summit is
definitely not the Ultimate Weapon\lin disguise.

No siree!"
entries.translation_source: That giant crystal at the summit is definitely not the Ultimate Weapon in disguise. No siree!
entries.translated:
Kristal raksasa di puncak itu jelas
bukan Senjata Pamungkas yang\lmenyamar. Tidak mungkin!

entries.original:
"[red]Okay, fine, I give.

We couldn’t care less about the
Pokémon living here.

It’s not like they’re going to be
around much longer anyway."
entries.translation_source: [red]Okay, fine, I give. We couldn’t care less about the Pokémon living here. It’s not like they’re going to be around much longer anyway.
entries.translated:
[red]Baiklah, oke, aku menyerah. Kami
tidak peduli dengan Pokémon yang\ltinggal di sini. Lagipula mereka

tidak akan bertahan lama lagi.

entries.original:
"Aklove hired me himself.

He promised me untold riches if I
helped him, but I never got squat!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove hired me himself. He promised me untold riches if I helped him, but I never got squat!
entries.translated:
Aklove sendiri yang
mempekerjakanku. Dia menjanjikan\lkekayaan tak terhingga jika aku

membantunya, tapi aku tidak
mendapatkan apa-apa!

entries.original:
"[red]Now that I’ve failed my one job,
there’s nothing left for me to do.

I should just join some other
group\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Now that I’ve failed my one job, there’s nothing left for me to do. I should just join some other group\.
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang setelah aku gagal dalam
satu tugasku, tidak ada lagi yang\lbisa kulakukan. Aku sebaiknya

bergabung dengan grup lain saja\.

entries.original:
"You think I’d be grateful for your
help, right?

Feh\."
entries.translation_source: You think I’d be grateful for your help, right? Feh\.
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir aku akan berterima kasih
atas bantuanmu, kan? Feh\.

entries.original:
"Why didn’t you Trainers just come
up together?

It would save us a whole lot of
trouble having to deal with you\lTrainers multiple times."
entries.translation_source: Why didn’t you Trainers just come up together? It would save us a whole lot of trouble having to deal with you Trainers multiple times.
entries.translated:
Kenapa kalian para Pelatih tidak
datang bersama saja? Itu akan\lmenghemat banyak masalah bagi kami

untuk berurusan dengan kalian para
Pelatih berkali-kali.

entries.original:
"You know that Pokémon Aklove walks
around with?

It gives me nightmares\."
entries.translation_source: You know that Pokémon Aklove walks around with? It gives me nightmares\.
entries.translated:
Kau tahu Pokémon yang dibawa Aklove
kemana-mana? Itu memberiku mimpi\lburuk\.

entries.original:
"I’m from Hoenn.

So I’m all for decreasing the
landmass around here.

There just isn’t enough water,
y’know?"
entries.translation_source: I’m from Hoenn. So I’m all for decreasing the landmass around here. There just isn’t enough water, y’know?
entries.translated:
Aku dari Hoenn. Jadi aku sangat
setuju untuk mengurangi daratan di\lsini. Airnya tidak cukup, kan?

entries.original:
"Aha!

Do you think Aklove left me with
nothing to use against you?

Surprise!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! Do you think Aklove left me with nothing to use against you? Surprise!
entries.translated:
Aha! Apa kamu pikir Aklove tidak
meninggalkan aku apa-apa untuk\lmelawanmu? Kejutan!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now stay in our prison for your
own safekeeping.

When the weapon goes off, this
mountain will be the only safe\lplace to be in Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now stay in our prison for your own safekeeping. When the weapon goes off, this mountain will be the only safe place to be in Borrius!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang tinggallah di penjara kami
untuk keselamatanmu sendiri. Saat\lsenjata itu meledak, gunung ini

akan menjadi satu-satunya tempat
aman di Borrius!

entries.original:
"Don’t let the ghost balloons carry
you away, child!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let the ghost balloons carry you away, child!
entries.translated:
Jangan biarkan balon hantu
membawamu pergi, Nak!

entries.original:
"The natural energy found here is
even stronger than electricity!"
entries.translation_source: The natural energy found here is even stronger than electricity!
entries.translated:
Energi alami yang ditemukan di sini
bahkan lebih kuat dari listrik!

entries.original:
"That giant crystal is said to have
mysteriously appeared on top of\lthis mountain centuries ago.

No one knows where it came from or
how it got there."
entries.translation_source: That giant crystal is said to have mysteriously appeared on top of this mountain centuries ago. No one knows where it came from or how it got there.
entries.translated:
Kristal raksasa itu dikatakan
secara misterius muncul di puncak\lgunung ini berabad-abad yang lalu.

Tidak ada yang tahu dari mana
asalnya atau bagaimana sampai di\lsana.

entries.original:
"You again?

You must really like the dragon
Pokémon I use."
entries.translation_source: You again? You must really like the dragon Pokémon I use.
entries.translated:
Kamu lagi? Kamu pasti sangat suka
Pokémon Naga yang aku gunakan.

entries.original:
"I train here to make my tough
Pokémon even tougher."
entries.translation_source: I train here to make my tough Pokémon even tougher.
entries.translated:
Aku berlatih di sini untuk membuat
Pokémon tangguhku semakin tangguh.

entries.original:
"Would you believe it if I told you
Crystal Peak was the tallest\lmountain in all of Borrius?"
entries.translation_source: Would you believe it if I told you Crystal Peak was the tallest mountain in all of Borrius?
entries.translated:
Apa kau percaya jika kukatakan
bahwa Puncak Kristal adalah gunung\ltertinggi di seluruh Borrius?

entries.original:
"Stop by Cube Corp. sometime!

Using the energy only found here,
we’ve been able to put together\lsome truly wonderful products!"
entries.translation_source: Stop by Cube Corp. sometime! Using the energy only found here, we’ve been able to put together some truly wonderful products!
entries.translated:
Mampirlah ke Cube Corp. suatu saat!
Dengan menggunakan energi yang\lhanya ditemukan di sini, kami telah

berhasil membuat beberapa produk
yang benar-benar luar biasa!

entries.original:
"I’ve been a proud member of Cube
Corp. since way back when it was\lowned by Mr. Zeph!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve been a proud member of Cube Corp. since way back when it was owned by Mr. Zeph!
entries.translated:
Aku telah menjadi anggota bangga
Cube Corp. sejak dulu ketika masih\ldimiliki oleh Tuan Zeph!

entries.original:
"My name is Krystal.

Yes\. my parents were very fond
of this place.

So it’s only fitting that I became
the strongest Trainer in here.

If you can defeat all of the other
Trainers in Crystal Peak, I’ll let\lyou have a go at my title."
entries.translation_source: My name is Krystal. Yes\. my parents were very fond of this place. So it’s only fitting that I became the strongest Trainer in here. If you can defeat all of the other Trainers in Crystal Peak, I’ll let you have a go at my title.
entries.translated:
Namaku Krystal. Ya\. orang tuaku
sangat menyukai tempat ini. Jadi\lsudah sepantasnya aku menjadi

Pelatih terkuat di sini. Jika kamu
bisa mengalahkan semua Pelatih lain\ldi Puncak Kristal, aku akan

memberimu kesempatan untuk merebut
gelarku.

entries.original:
"My name is Krystal.

Yes\. my parents were very fond
of this place.

So it’s only fitting that I became
the strongest Trainer in here.

If you can defeat me, I’ll let you
call yourself Krystal, too!"
entries.translation_source: My name is Krystal. Yes\. my parents were very fond of this place. So it’s only fitting that I became the strongest Trainer in here. If you can defeat me, I’ll let you call yourself Krystal, too!
entries.translated:
Namaku Krystal. Ya\. orang tuaku
sangat menyukai tempat ini. Jadi\lsudah sepantasnya aku menjadi

Pelatih terkuat di sini. Jika kamu
bisa mengalahkanku, aku akan\lmembiarkanmu memanggil dirimu

Krystal juga!

entries.original:
"Well done.

I confer upon you the title of
Krystal.

\.What?
You want more?

Fine\. take this, too."
entries.translation_source: Well done. I confer upon you the title of Krystal. \.What? You want more? Fine\. take this, too.
entries.translated:
Bagus sekali. Saya menganugerahkan
gelar Krystal kepadamu. \.Apa? Kamu\lingin lebih? Baik\. ambil ini juga.

entries.original:
"If [green]Absol[red] holds the [green]Absolite[red],
it can Mega Evolve and be worthy\lof even Trainers named Krystal."
entries.translation_source: If [green]Absol[red] holds the [green]Absolite[red], it can Mega Evolve and be worthy of even Trainers named Krystal.
entries.translated:
Jika [green]Absol[red] memegang [green]Absolit[red], ia
dapat Mega Evolve dan layak bahkan\lbagi Pelatih bernama Krystal.

entries.original: "[blue]Gastrodon! Use [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Gastrodon! Use [buffer1]!
entries.translated: [blue]Gastrodon! Gunakan [buffer1]!

entries.original: "[blue]Roserade! Counter with [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Roserade! Counter with [buffer1]!
entries.translated: [blue]Roserade! Balas dengan [buffer1]!

entries.original: "[buffer1]! Protect yourself!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1]! Protect yourself!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Lindungi dirimu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Krookodile! Let’s shake things up
with Earthquake!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Krookodile! Let’s shake things up with Earthquake!
entries.translated:
[blue]Krookodile! Ayo kita guncang dengan
Gempa Bumi!

entries.original:
"[red]Alakazam! Increase your Defense
with Barrier!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Alakazam! Increase your Defense with Barrier!
entries.translated:
[red]Alakazam! Tingkatkan Pertahananmu
dengan Penghalang!

entries.original:
"[black]Hoopa looks like it wants to
join you!

Accept it onto your team?"
entries.translation_source: [black]Hoopa looks like it wants to join you! Accept it onto your team?
entries.translated:
[black]Hoopa sepertinya ingin bergabung
denganmu! Terima dia ke dalam\ltimmu?

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] happily joined your side!
It has a [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] happily joined your side! It has a [green][buffer2][black] nature.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] dengan senang hati
bergabung ke sisimu! Ia memiliki\lsifat [green][buffer2][black].

entries.original:
"Oh, [rival]\.
Why can’t you just see what I see\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, [rival]\. Why can’t you just see what I see\.
entries.translated:
Oh, [rival]\. Kenapa kamu tidak bisa
melihat apa yang aku lihat\.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
Where did my daddy go?"
entries.translation_source: Oh\. Where did my daddy go?
entries.translated: Oh\. Ke mana perginya ayahku?

entries.original:
"We’ve been assigned by the police
department to guard this rather\llarge crystal.

Don’t try anything funny, kid.
We’re keeping an eye on you."
entries.translation_source: We’ve been assigned by the police department to guard this rather large crystal. Don’t try anything funny, kid. We’re keeping an eye on you.
entries.translated:
Kami ditugaskan oleh departemen
polisi untuk menjaga kristal yang\lcukup besar ini. Jangan coba-coba

melakukan sesuatu yang aneh, nak.
Kami mengawasimu.

entries.original: "Cube Corp."
entries.translation_source: Cube Corp.
entries.translated: Cube Corp.

entries.original:
"Poké Balls and Cubes are pretty
similar, right?

I mean, they’re built to make things
smaller and easier to carry.

I guess I should be grateful that
the Cube is\. well, a cube.

Can you imagine if you tried throwing
your Cube to catch a wild Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Poké Balls and Cubes are pretty similar, right? I mean, they’re built to make things smaller and easier to carry. I guess I should be grateful that the Cube is\. well, a cube. Can you imagine if you tried throwing your Cube to catch a wild Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Poké Ball dan Cube cukup mirip,
kan? Maksudku, mereka dibuat untuk\lmembuat benda lebih kecil dan lebih

mudah dibawa. Kurasa aku harus
bersyukur bahwa Cube itu\. ya, sebuah\lkubus. Bisakah kamu bayangkan jika

kamu mencoba melempar Cube-mu untuk
menangkap Pokémon liar?

entries.original:
"All I wanted was to speak to
someone to fix my Cube V3\.

And somehow, I came away with this
brand-new robot arm."
entries.translation_source: All I wanted was to speak to someone to fix my Cube V3\. And somehow, I came away with this brand-new robot arm.
entries.translated:
Yang saya inginkan hanyalah
berbicara dengan seseorang untuk\lmemperbaiki Cube V3 saya\. Dan entah

bagaimana, saya pergi dengan lengan
robot baru ini.

entries.original:
"Here at Cube Corp., we believe that
with science, we should always\lshoot for the moon.

\.And if we miss, shoot for it
again.

One day, you’ll succeed in destroying
the moon once and for all."
entries.translation_source: Here at Cube Corp., we believe that with science, we should always shoot for the moon. \.And if we miss, shoot for it again. One day, you’ll succeed in destroying the moon once and for all.
entries.translated:
Di sini di Cube Corp., kami percaya
bahwa dengan sains, kita harus\lselalu membidik bulan. \.Dan jika

kita meleset, bidik lagi. Suatu
hari, kamu akan berhasil\lmenghancurkan bulan untuk

selamanya.

entries.original:
"Pokémon Rangers regularly protest
outside this place.

Seriously, why don’t they go back to
protecting the public, like they’re\lpaid to do?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Rangers regularly protest outside this place. Seriously, why don’t they go back to protecting the public, like they’re paid to do?
entries.translated:
Pokémon Rangers secara teratur
memprotes di luar tempat ini.\lSerius, kenapa mereka tidak kembali

melindungi publik, seperti yang
mereka dibayar untuk lakukan?

entries.original:
"Oh no\. my uniform’s colours ran in
the wash\.

I really hope they don’t mind me
taking casual wear to work\."
entries.translation_source: Oh no\. my uniform’s colours ran in the wash\. I really hope they don’t mind me taking casual wear to work\.
entries.translated:
Oh tidak\. warna seragamku luntur
saat dicuci\. Aku sangat berharap\lmereka tidak keberatan aku memakai

pakaian santai ke kerja\.

entries.original:
"I paid some lady with [green]Bottle Caps[red] to
increase my Pokémon’s potential\.

And I paid money to have a scientist
at the [green]Battle Frontier[red] change my\lPokémon’s [green]Nature[red]\.

So what if I’m sacrificing their
wellbeing and happiness?

All that matters is if they can win
a battle!"
entries.translation_source: I paid some lady with [green]Bottle Caps[red] to increase my Pokémon’s potential\. And I paid money to have a scientist at the [green]Battle Frontier[red] change my Pokémon’s [green]Nature[red]\. So what if I’m sacrificing their wellbeing and happiness? All that matters is if they can win a battle!
entries.translated:
Saya membayar seorang wanita dengan
[green]Bottle Caps[red] untuk meningkatkan\lpotensi Pokémon saya\. Dan saya

membayar uang kepada seorang
ilmuwan di [green]Battle Frontier[red] untuk\lmengubah [green]Sifat[red] Pokémon saya\. Jadi

bagaimana jika saya mengorbankan
kesejahteraan dan kebahagiaan\lmereka? Yang penting adalah apakah

mereka bisa memenangkan
pertempuran!

entries.original:
"The workers at Cube Corp. are so
great, they even take time out of\ltheir busy schedules to conduct\ltours of the place!

But word is, though, there’s a secret
lab underground they don’t take\lyou to see."
entries.translation_source: The workers at Cube Corp. are so great, they even take time out of their busy schedules to conduct tours of the place! But word is, though, there’s a secret lab underground they don’t take you to see.
entries.translated:
Para pekerja di Cube Corp. sangat
hebat, mereka bahkan meluangkan\lwaktu dari jadwal sibuk mereka

untuk melakukan tur di tempat ini!
Tapi kata orang, ada laboratorium\lrahasia di bawah tanah yang tidak

mereka ajak kamu lihat.

entries.original:
"All these Rangers ever do is protest
the \qoevils\qc of Cube Corp.

I’ll have you know there’s nothing
evil about Cube Corp. whatsoever!

Let me tell you, they were even so
generous as to grant us police\lofficers extra storage sectors in\lour Cubes!

Why? So we may better serve the
people, of course!

Tell me, is that really so wrong?"
entries.translation_source: All these Rangers ever do is protest the \qoevils\qc of Cube Corp. I’ll have you know there’s nothing evil about Cube Corp. whatsoever! Let me tell you, they were even so generous as to grant us police officers extra storage sectors in our Cubes! Why? So we may better serve the people, of course! Tell me, is that really so wrong?
entries.translated:
Yang dilakukan para Rangers ini
hanyalah memprotes \qokejahatan\qc Cube\lCorp. Saya beri tahu, tidak ada

yang jahat tentang Cube Corp sama
sekali! Biar saya beri tahu, mereka\lbahkan begitu murah hati memberi

kami petugas polisi sektor
penyimpanan ekstra di Cube kami!\lKenapa? Tentu saja agar kami bisa

lebih melayani masyarakat! Katakan,
apakah itu benar-benar salah?

entries.original:
"Now that management has had a
complete overhaul, what will\lbecome of Cube Corp.?

Will we continuously strive to
improve the lives of the Borrian\lcitizens, or was that just a lie\lfrom the very beginning?"
entries.translation_source: Now that management has had a complete overhaul, what will become of Cube Corp.? Will we continuously strive to improve the lives of the Borrian citizens, or was that just a lie from the very beginning?
entries.translated:
Sekarang setelah manajemen
mengalami perombakan total, apa\lyang akan terjadi dengan Cube

Corp.? Akankah kita terus berusaha
meningkatkan kehidupan warga\lBorrian, atau itu hanya kebohongan

sejak awal?

entries.original:
"There’s no Pokémon Center here at
Cube Corp., so let me heal your\lPokémon for you instead!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no Pokémon Center here at Cube Corp., so let me heal your Pokémon for you instead!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada Pokémon Center di sini di
Cube Corp., jadi biarkan saya\lmenyembuhkan Pokémon Anda sebagai

gantinya!

entries.original:
"While there may be no Pokémon
Center here, you’ll find no\lshortage of [green]Porygon[red] if you need\lto access the Pokémon PC.

Isn’t that convenient?

These scientists sure thought of
everything!"
entries.translation_source: While there may be no Pokémon Center here, you’ll find no shortage of [green]Porygon[red] if you need to access the Pokémon PC. Isn’t that convenient? These scientists sure thought of everything!
entries.translated:
Meskipun tidak ada Pokémon Center
di sini, Anda tidak akan kekurangan\l[green]Porygon[red] jika Anda perlu mengakses

Pokémon PC. Bukankah itu nyaman?
Para ilmuwan ini benar-benar\lmemikirkan segalanya!

entries.original: "Where could my girl be\.?"
entries.translation_source: Where could my girl be\.?
entries.translated: Di mana gadisku berada\.?

entries.original:
"Sorry, champ!

You mind waiting a little before
heading in there?

I’m waiting for my girl to show up,
so I need all this space to keep\lan eye out for her!

I appreciate ya, Champ!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry, champ! You mind waiting a little before heading in there? I’m waiting for my girl to show up, so I need all this space to keep an eye out for her! I appreciate ya, Champ!
entries.translated:
Maaf, juara! Tidak keberatan
menunggu sebentar sebelum masuk ke\lsana? Saya menunggu gadis saya

muncul, jadi saya butuh ruang ini
untuk mengawasinya! Terima kasih,\lJuara!

entries.original:
"Down with Cube Corp!
Down with Cube Corp!

I’m protesting against the evils of
Cube Corp, and especially the\lScience Society.

They’ve been running cruel
experiments on Pokémon, including\lthe ones I’m responsible for!

Hmm\.? I have [green]hard, snowy scales[blue]
stuck to my clothes?

Yes, that’s right\. I help keep one
of their imported experiments fed,\lafter their population increased\lhere in Borrius, at [green]Icicle Cave[blue].

I forget their names\. they’re some
sort of Pokémon from the [green]Alola\lregion[blue]\.

What were they called?"
entries.translation_source: Down with Cube Corp! Down with Cube Corp! I’m protesting against the evils of Cube Corp, and especially the Science Society. They’ve been running cruel experiments on Pokémon, including the ones I’m responsible for! Hmm\.? I have [green]hard, snowy scales[blue] stuck to my clothes? Yes, that’s right\. I help keep one of their imported experiments fed, after their population increased here in Borrius, at [green]Icicle Cave[blue]. I forget their names\. they’re some sort of Pokémon from the [green]Alola region[blue]\. What were they called?
entries.translated:
Hancurkan Cube Corp! Hancurkan Cube
Corp! Saya memprotes kejahatan Cube\lCorp, dan terutama Science Society.

Mereka telah melakukan eksperimen
kejam pada Pokémon, termasuk yang\lmenjadi tanggung jawab saya! Hmm\.?

Saya memiliki [green]sisik keras dan
bersalju[blue] menempel di pakaian saya?\lYa, benar\. Saya membantu memberi

makan salah satu eksperimen impor
mereka, setelah populasi mereka\lmeningkat di sini di Borrius, di

[green]Icicle Cave[blue]. Saya lupa nama mereka\.
mereka semacam Pokémon dari [green]wilayah\lAlola[blue]\. Siapa nama mereka?

entries.original: "No\. that wasn’t it\."
entries.translation_source: No\. that wasn’t it\.
entries.translated: Tidak\. bukan itu\.

entries.original:
"That’s it! They’re the ones!

Wait\.\CC0818 how long has it been since
I last checked on their food\lsupply\.?

That was\.

\.ack! Ages ago!

How have they managed without
me all this time!?

I can’t be wasting time here!

But first, uh\.\CC0818 thanks for
reminding me!"
entries.translation_source: That’s it! They’re the ones! Wait\.\CC0818 how long has it been since I last checked on their food supply\.? That was\. \.ack! Ages ago! How have they managed without me all this time!? I can’t be wasting time here! But first, uh\.\CC0818 thanks for reminding me!
entries.translated:
Itu dia! Merekalah itu! Tunggu\.\CC0818
sudah berapa lama sejak saya\lterakhir memeriksa pasokan makanan

mereka\.? Itu tadi\. \.astaga! Sudah lama
sekali! Bagaimana mereka bisa\lbertahan tanpa saya selama ini!?

Saya tidak bisa membuang waktu di
sini! Tapi pertama, eh\.\CC0818 terima kasih\lsudah mengingatkan saya!

entries.original:
"These Ice-type Sandshrew and
Sandslash aren’t native to Borrius.

Someone always has to be here, to
make sure they don’t interfere with\lthe other Pokémon in Icicle Cave\.

After all, it’s impossible to capture
the whole population now, anyway."
entries.translation_source: These Ice-type Sandshrew and Sandslash aren’t native to Borrius. Someone always has to be here, to make sure they don’t interfere with the other Pokémon in Icicle Cave\. After all, it’s impossible to capture the whole population now, anyway.
entries.translated:
Sandshrew dan Sandslash tipe Es ini
bukan asli Borrius. Seseorang harus\lselalu ada di sini, untuk

memastikan mereka tidak mengganggu
Pokémon lain di Icicle Cave\.\lLagipula, tidak mungkin menangkap

seluruh populasi sekarang.

entries.original:
"Down with Cube Corp.!
Down with the Science Society!"
entries.translation_source: Down with Cube Corp.! Down with the Science Society!
entries.translated:
Hancurkan Cube Corp.! Hancurkan
Science Society!

entries.original:
"We’re risking our jobs just protesting
here, I know that.

But this is about taking a stand
against injustice, against unethical\labuse of Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We’re risking our jobs just protesting here, I know that. But this is about taking a stand against injustice, against unethical abuse of Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kami mempertaruhkan pekerjaan kami
hanya dengan memprotes di sini,\lsaya tahu itu. Tapi ini tentang

mengambil sikap melawan
ketidakadilan, melawan\lpenyalahgunaan Pokémon yang tidak

etis!

entries.original:
"Only Pokémon Breeders have the right
to meddle with Pokémon genetics!

Not a crazy group of scientists!

Grr\.\CC0818 just thinking about it makes my
blood boil as hot as a [green]Magma Stone[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Only Pokémon Breeders have the right to meddle with Pokémon genetics! Not a crazy group of scientists! Grr\.\CC0818 just thinking about it makes my blood boil as hot as a [green]Magma Stone[blue]!
entries.translated:
Hanya Pokémon Breeders yang berhak
mencampuri genetika Pokémon! Bukan\lsekelompok ilmuwan gila! Grr\.\CC0818

memikirkannya saja sudah membuat
darahku mendidih sepanas [green]Magma\lStone[blue]!

entries.original:
"That Magma Stone in your Cube\.

It radiates such intense heat!

It reminds me of the days when I
was an avid Pokémon Breeder.

\.

Hold on a minute\.

Ack! That’s right!

I completely forgot about my
precious partner!

I should have picked her up from
the Day Care ages ago!

Uh\. thanks for reminding me.
Here, you can have this."
entries.translation_source: That Magma Stone in your Cube\. It radiates such intense heat! It reminds me of the days when I was an avid Pokémon Breeder. \. Hold on a minute\. Ack! That’s right! I completely forgot about my precious partner! I should have picked her up from the Day Care ages ago! Uh\. thanks for reminding me. Here, you can have this.
entries.translated:
Magma Stone di Cube-mu\. Memancarkan
panas yang begitu intens! Itu\lmengingatkanku pada masa-masa

ketika aku adalah seorang Pokémon
Breeder yang rajin. \. Tunggu\lsebentar\. Ack! Benar! Aku

benar-benar lupa tentang pasangan
berhargaku! Aku seharusnya\lmenjemputnya dari Day Care sejak

lama! Uh\. terima kasih sudah
mengingatkanku. Ini, kau bisa ambil\lini.

entries.original:
"You should bring that [green]Magma Stone[blue]
to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue].

I hear a rare Pokémon will appear
when it senses one in your Cube."
entries.translation_source: You should bring that [green]Magma Stone[blue] to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]. I hear a rare Pokémon will appear when it senses one in your Cube.
entries.translated:
Kau harus membawa [green]Magma Stone[blue] itu
ke [green]Gunung Berapi Cinder[blue]. Kudengar\lPokémon langka akan muncul saat

merasakannya di Cube-mu.

entries.original:
"Grr\.\CC0818 I must leave for now,
Cube Corp\.

But I’ll be back, time and again,
until justice is finally served!"
entries.translation_source: Grr\.\CC0818 I must leave for now, Cube Corp\. But I’ll be back, time and again, until justice is finally served!
entries.translated:
Grr\.\CC0818 Aku harus pergi untuk sekarang,
Cube Corp\. Tapi aku akan kembali,\llagi dan lagi, sampai keadilan

akhirnya ditegakkan!

entries.original:
"It’s only a matter of time before
the public finds out what’s been\lreally going on in there!

We know you’ve been making monsters,
and soon we’ll be able to prove it!"
entries.translation_source: It’s only a matter of time before the public finds out what’s been really going on in there! We know you’ve been making monsters, and soon we’ll be able to prove it!
entries.translated:
Hanya masalah waktu sebelum publik
mengetahui apa yang sebenarnya\lterjadi di dalam sana! Kami tahu

kau telah membuat monster, dan
segera kami akan bisa\lmembuktikannya!

entries.original:
"You can’t fool us, Cube Corp!
We know what you’re up to in there!

We know you’re really run by the
Science Society!

And one day, we’ll oust you
once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t fool us, Cube Corp! We know what you’re up to in there! We know you’re really run by the Science Society! And one day, we’ll oust you once and for all!
entries.translated:
Kau tidak bisa membodohi kami, Cube
Corp! Kami tahu apa yang kau\llakukan di dalam sana! Kami tahu

kau sebenarnya dijalankan oleh
Science Society! Dan suatu hari,\lkami akan mengusirmu untuk

selamanya!

entries.original:
"People say that [green]Master Balls[blue] are
effective, but in exchange,\lthey’re hard to produce\.

Shows what they know, because I’m
knee-deep\.\CC0818 in Balls!

In fact, I’ll let you take my many
[green]Master Balls[blue] off my hands\.

But only if you can spare me
[green][buffer2] Gems[blue] for my research."
entries.translation_source: People say that [green]Master Balls[blue] are effective, but in exchange, they’re hard to produce\. Shows what they know, because I’m knee-deep\.\CC0818 in Balls! In fact, I’ll let you take my many [green]Master Balls[blue] off my hands\. But only if you can spare me [green][buffer2] Gems[blue] for my research.
entries.translated:
Orang bilang bahwa [green]Master Balls[blue]
efektif, tetapi sebagai gantinya,\lmereka sulit diproduksi\. Itu

menunjukkan apa yang mereka tahu,
karena saya sampai ke lutut\.\CC0818 dalam\lBalls! Faktanya, saya akan

membiarkan Anda mengambil banyak
[green]Master Balls[blue] dari tangan saya\. Tapi\lhanya jika Anda bisa memberikan

saya [green][buffer2] Gems[blue] untuk penelitian
saya.

entries.original: "Which Gems are you offering?"
entries.translation_source: Which Gems are you offering?
entries.translated: Gems apa yang Anda tawarkan?

entries.original:
"And we have a deal!
Here you go.

Don’t blow it on anything stupid,
like a Magikarp."
entries.translation_source: And we have a deal! Here you go. Don’t blow it on anything stupid, like a Magikarp.
entries.translated:
Dan kita sepakat! Ini dia. Jangan
habiskan untuk hal bodoh, seperti\lMagikarp.

entries.original:
"I’m still knees-deep in Balls!

Bring another [green][buffer2][blue] Gems and I’ll trade
you some more Master Balls."
entries.translation_source: I’m still knees-deep in Balls! Bring another [green][buffer2][blue] Gems and I’ll trade you some more Master Balls.
entries.translated:
Aku masih sibuk dengan Balls!
Bawakan [green][buffer2][blue] Gems lagi dan aku\lakan menukarnya dengan beberapa

Master Balls lagi.

entries.original:
"Come on, now\.

I’m running out of room to hide
them all\."
entries.translation_source: Come on, now\. I’m running out of room to hide them all\.
entries.translated:
Ayolah, sekarang\. Aku kehabisan
tempat untuk menyembunyikan\lsemuanya\.

entries.original:
"Come on, now\.
That’s not a Gem!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, now\. That’s not a Gem!
entries.translated: Ayolah, sekarang\. Itu bukan Gem!

entries.original:
"Come on, now\.

You don’t have at least [green][buffer2][blue]
[green][buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, now\. You don’t have at least [green][buffer2][blue] [green][buffer1]s[blue]!
entries.translated:
Ayolah, sekarang\. Kamu tidak punya
setidaknya [green][buffer2][blue] [green][buffer1]s[blue]!

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

I recognize you\. you’re the Champion
of Borrius, aren’t you?

Have you found any of those strange
portals around Borrius yet?

And have you found strange creatures
from another dimension emerging\lfrom the other side\.

Fierce creatures, resistant to
almost every type of Poké Ball in\lyour Cube?

Well, you need a special kind of
Poké Ball to take them on - [green]Beast\lBalls[red]!

And it just so happens I know how to
create them!

All I require is the most important
raw material - [green]Iron Balls[red].

If you bring enough of those, I can
create [green]Beast Balls[red] for you."
entries.translation_source: Upupupu\. I recognize you\. you’re the Champion of Borrius, aren’t you? Have you found any of those strange portals around Borrius yet? And have you found strange creatures from another dimension emerging from the other side\. Fierce creatures, resistant to almost every type of Poké Ball in your Cube? Well, you need a special kind of Poké Ball to take them on - [green]Beast Balls[red]! And it just so happens I know how to create them! All I require is the most important raw material - [green]Iron Balls[red]. If you bring enough of those, I can create [green]Beast Balls[red] for you.
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. Aku mengenalimu\. kamu adalah
Juara Borrius, kan? Apakah kamu\lsudah menemukan portal aneh di

sekitar Borrius? Dan apakah kamu
sudah menemukan makhluk aneh dari\ldimensi lain yang muncul dari sisi

lain\. Makhluk ganas, kebal terhadap
hampir semua jenis Poké Ball di\lKubusmu? Nah, kamu perlu jenis Poké

Ball khusus untuk menghadapi mereka
- [green]Beast Balls[red]! Dan kebetulan aku\ltahu cara membuatnya! Yang aku

butuhkan hanyalah bahan baku yang
paling penting - [green]Iron Balls[red]. Jika\lkamu membawa cukup banyak, aku bisa

membuatkan [green]Beast Balls[red] untukmu.

entries.original:
"So, have you brought any
[green]Iron Balls[red]?

I’ll make [green]Beast Balls[red] out of
them, if you want."
entries.translation_source: So, have you brought any [green]Iron Balls[red]? I’ll make [green]Beast Balls[red] out of them, if you want.
entries.translated:
Jadi, apakah kamu membawa [green]Iron
Balls[red]? Aku akan membuat [green]Beast Balls[red]\ldari mereka, jika kamu mau.

entries.original:
"How many Iron Balls will you
part with?"
entries.translation_source: How many Iron Balls will you part with?
entries.translated:
Berapa banyak Iron Balls yang akan
kamu berikan?

entries.original:
"You’ll part with [buffer1] of the
Iron Balls?"
entries.translation_source: You’ll part with [buffer1] of the Iron Balls?
entries.translated:
Kamu akan memberikan [buffer1] Iron
Balls?

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

Thank you kindly.

There’s an art to this\. they respond
badly to the dimensions inside a\lPoké Ball\.

So, I create an alternate space for
them, and\.\CC0815 \.\CC0815 \.\CC0815\CC103100there we go!"
entries.translation_source: Upupupu\. Thank you kindly. There’s an art to this\. they respond badly to the dimensions inside a Poké Ball\. So, I create an alternate space for them, and\.\CC0815 \.\CC0815 \.\CC0815\CC103100there we go!
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. Terima kasih banyak. Ada
seni tersendiri dalam hal ini\.\lmereka bereaksi buruk terhadap

dimensi di dalam Poké Ball\. Jadi,
aku menciptakan ruang alternatif\luntuk mereka, dan\.\CC0815 \.\CC0815 \.\CC0815\CC103100ini dia!

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

The portals from which those
creatures emerge tend to reappear.

I hope you’ll use those Beast Balls
for good, and tame these threats\lto our world\."
entries.translation_source: Upupupu\. The portals from which those creatures emerge tend to reappear. I hope you’ll use those Beast Balls for good, and tame these threats to our world\.
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. Portal tempat
makhluk-makhluk itu muncul\lcenderung muncul kembali. Aku harap

kamu akan menggunakan Beast Balls
itu untuk kebaikan, dan menjinakkan\lancaman-ancaman ini terhadap dunia

kita\.

entries.original:
"Not interested?

How can you not find monsters from
another world fascinating?"
entries.translation_source: Not interested? How can you not find monsters from another world fascinating?
entries.translated:
Tidak tertarik? Bagaimana bisa kamu
tidak merasa monster dari dunia\llain itu menarik?

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

You have no Iron Balls\."
entries.translation_source: Upupupu\. You have no Iron Balls\.
entries.translated: Upupupu\. Kamu tidak punya Iron Balls\.

entries.original:
"Bwahahaha! You there, Trainer!

If you will let me, I shall
demonstrate a feat of science many\lbelieve to be impossible!

Just give me [green][buffer2] Everstones[blue], and I will
transform them into a rare Evolution\lStone - any kind you please!"
entries.translation_source: Bwahahaha! You there, Trainer! If you will let me, I shall demonstrate a feat of science many believe to be impossible! Just give me [green][buffer2] Everstones[blue], and I will transform them into a rare Evolution Stone - any kind you please!
entries.translated:
Bwahahaha! Hei, Trainer! Jika kamu
mengizinkanku, aku akan\lmendemonstrasikan prestasi sains

yang banyak orang percaya mustahil!
Beri aku [green][buffer2] Everstones[blue], dan\laku akan mengubahnya menjadi

Evolution Stone langka - jenis apa
pun yang kamu mau!

entries.original: "Which Stone shall I make for you?"
entries.translation_source: Which Stone shall I make for you?
entries.translated:
Batu mana yang harus aku buat
untukmu?

entries.original:
"Then, you want me to turn your
Everstones into a [green][buffer1][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Then, you want me to turn your Everstones into a [green][buffer1][blue]?
entries.translated:
Lalu, kamu ingin aku mengubah
Everstones-mu menjadi [green][buffer1][blue]?

entries.original: "Into the machine they go\. and\."
entries.translation_source: Into the machine they go\. and\.
entries.translated: Ke dalam mesin mereka masuk\. dan\.

entries.original:
"Bwahahaha! Did you see that!?

They all said an item meant to
prevent evolution could never\linduce evolution!

FOOLS! FOOLS, ALL OF THEM!

\.Oh, right.
Here, take it\. I guess."
entries.translation_source: Bwahahaha! Did you see that!? They all said an item meant to prevent evolution could never induce evolution! FOOLS! FOOLS, ALL OF THEM! \.Oh, right. Here, take it\. I guess.
entries.translated:
Bwahahaha! Apa kamu melihat itu!?
Mereka semua mengatakan bahwa benda\lyang dimaksudkan untuk mencegah

evolusi tidak akan pernah bisa
menginduksi evolusi! BODOH! BODOH,\lSEMUANYA! \.Oh, benar. Ini, ambil\. Aku

rasa.

entries.original:
"If you come across any more
Everstones, I’ll be happy to tell\lconventional science to sit down\land shut up for you again."
entries.translation_source: If you come across any more Everstones, I’ll be happy to tell conventional science to sit down and shut up for you again.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu menemukan Everstones
lagi, aku akan dengan senang hati\lmemberi tahu ilmu konvensional

untuk diam dan tutup mulut untukmu
lagi.

entries.original:
"Shun! Shun the non-believer!

Shuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuun!"
entries.translation_source: Shun! Shun the non-believer! Shuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuun!
entries.translated:
Jauhi! Jauhi orang yang tidak
percaya! Jauuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuhi!

entries.original:
"So, you would hoard your
Everstones, like a fool?

What purpose would that ever
serve anyone?"
entries.translation_source: So, you would hoard your Everstones, like a fool? What purpose would that ever serve anyone?
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau akan menimbun Batu
Abadi-mu, seperti orang bodoh? Apa\lgunanya itu bagi siapa pun?

entries.original:
"Gah! You lack the Everstones for my
grand demonstration!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! You lack the Everstones for my grand demonstration!
entries.translated:
Gah! Kau tidak memiliki Batu Abadi
untuk demonstrasi besarku!

entries.original:
"Hey, you! Yes, you!

Have you any [green]Star Pieces[blue] or [green]Fossils[blue]
to spare this humble researcher?

In exchange, I can offer you a
special concoction, one that\lcan raise how often a Pokémon can\luse its attacks\."
entries.translation_source: Hey, you! Yes, you! Have you any [green]Star Pieces[blue] or [green]Fossils[blue] to spare this humble researcher? In exchange, I can offer you a special concoction, one that can raise how often a Pokémon can use its attacks\.
entries.translated:
Hei, kau! Ya, kau! Apakah kau
memiliki [green]Potongan Bintang[blue] atau\l[green]Fosil[blue] untuk disumbangkan kepada

peneliti sederhana ini? Sebagai
gantinya, aku dapat menawarkan\lramuan istimewa, yang dapat

meningkatkan seberapa sering
Pokémon dapat menggunakan\lserangannya\.

entries.original: "What will you trade?"
entries.translation_source: What will you trade?
entries.translated: Apa yang akan kau tukarkan?

entries.original:
"How many [green][buffer1]s[blue] will
you trade?"
entries.translation_source: How many [green][buffer1]s[blue] will you trade?
entries.translated:
Berapa banyak [green][buffer1]s[blue] yang akan
kau tukarkan?

entries.original:
"So, you’re willing to part with your
[green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], in exchange for\l[green][buffer3][blue] of my [green]PP Ups[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: So, you’re willing to part with your [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], in exchange for [green][buffer3][blue] of my [green]PP Ups[blue]?
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau rela berpisah dengan
[green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], sebagai ganti\l[green][buffer3][blue] [green]PP Up[blue] milikku?

entries.original:
"Excellent! I’ll just take those,
thank you very much!"
entries.translation_source: Excellent! I’ll just take those, thank you very much!
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Aku akan mengambilnya,
terima kasih banyak!

entries.original:
"And now, for me to hold up my end
of the deal\. here!"
entries.translation_source: And now, for me to hold up my end of the deal\. here!
entries.translated:
Dan sekarang, untuk aku memenuhi
bagianku dari perjanjian\\. ini!

entries.original:
"If you come across more Star Pieces
or Fossils, tell me at once."
entries.translation_source: If you come across more Star Pieces or Fossils, tell me at once.
entries.translated:
Jika kau menemukan lebih banyak
Potongan Bintang atau Fosil, beri\ltahu aku segera.

entries.original:
"Grr\.

\CC0600(How hard must it be to raise my
glorious Fossilised army\CC0601\.\CC0600?)

\CC0601Uh\. never mind.

If you do come across Star Pieces
or Fossils, tell me at once."
entries.translation_source: Grr\. \CC0600(How hard must it be to raise my glorious Fossilised army\CC0601\.\CC0600?) \CC0601Uh\. never mind. If you do come across Star Pieces or Fossils, tell me at once.
entries.translated:
Grr\\. \CC0600(Betapa sulitnya untuk
membesarkan pasukan Fosilku yang\lmulia\CC0601\. \CC0600?) \CC0601Uh\\. lupakan. Jika kau

memang menemukan Potongan Bintang
atau Fosil, beri tahu aku segera.

entries.original:
"Nice try.

I know perfectly well that’s not a
Star Piece or a Fossil."
entries.translation_source: Nice try. I know perfectly well that’s not a Star Piece or a Fossil.
entries.translated:
Coba lagi. Aku tahu betul itu bukan
Potongan Bintang atau Fosil.

entries.original:
"Nice try.

I know perfectly well you haven’t
enough [buffer1]s to trade."
entries.translation_source: Nice try. I know perfectly well you haven’t enough [buffer1]s to trade.
entries.translated:
Coba lagi. Aku tahu betul kau tidak
memiliki cukup [buffer1]s untuk\lditukarkan.

entries.original:
"Is\.\CC0818 is that\.\CC0818 a Comet Shard!?

Forget PP Ups, for each of those,
I can give you one [green]PP Max[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Is\.\CC0818 is that\.\CC0818 a Comet Shard!? Forget PP Ups, for each of those, I can give you one [green]PP Max[blue]!
entries.translated:
Apakah\\. \CC0818 apakah itu\\. \CC0818 sebuah
Pecahan Komet!? Lupakan PP Up,\luntuk masing-masing itu, aku bisa

memberimu satu [green]PP Max[blue]!

entries.original:
"So, you’re willing to part with [green][buffer1][blue]
of your [green]Comet Shards[blue], in exchange\lfor [green][buffer1][blue] of my [green]PP Maxes[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: So, you’re willing to part with [green][buffer1][blue] of your [green]Comet Shards[blue], in exchange for [green][buffer1][blue] of my [green]PP Maxes[blue]?
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau rela berpisah dengan
[green][buffer1][blue] dari [green]Pecahan Komet[blue]\lmilikmu, sebagai ganti [green][buffer1][blue] [green]PP

Max[blue] milikku?

entries.original:
"Ah, so the Champion deigns to visit
our humble headquarters.

There is a Pokémon that we have left
with a [green]Ranger[red], in [green]Fallshore City[red].

If you can prove yourself caring
enough to tame it, please show it\lto me."
entries.translation_source: Ah, so the Champion deigns to visit our humble headquarters. There is a Pokémon that we have left with a [green]Ranger[red], in [green]Fallshore City[red]. If you can prove yourself caring enough to tame it, please show it to me.
entries.translated:
Ah, jadi Sang Juara berkenan
mengunjungi markas kami yang\lsederhana. Ada seekor Pokémon yang

kami tinggalkan bersama seorang
[green]Ranger[red], di [green]Kota Fallshore[red]. Jika kau\lbisa membuktikan dirimu cukup

peduli untuk menjinakkannya, tolong
tunjukkan padaku.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, there’s no mistaking it -
that is the same Pokémon that we\ltrusted to that Ranger.

Very well\. I would like for you to
have this - another of its kind."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, there’s no mistaking it - that is the same Pokémon that we trusted to that Ranger. Very well\. I would like for you to have this - another of its kind.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya, tidak ada salahnya - itu
adalah Pokémon yang sama yang kami\lpercayakan kepada Ranger itu.

Baiklah\\. Aku ingin kau memiliki ini
- satu lagi dari jenisnya.

entries.original:
"According to these research notes
I received from the Alola Region\.

That Pokémon was modelled after the
mythical Pokémon, Arceus\.

They wanted to recreate its power
in order to fight creatures from\lanother world.

We’ve tried to do the same here in
Borrius, but our results were no\lmore successful than theirs.

The Pokémon I gave you was one of
the two we created.

But, just in case a time ever
comes when its true powers can be\lunlocked\.

Then, I can create the tools that it
needs to change its type."
entries.translation_source: According to these research notes I received from the Alola Region\. That Pokémon was modelled after the mythical Pokémon, Arceus\. They wanted to recreate its power in order to fight creatures from another world. We’ve tried to do the same here in Borrius, but our results were no more successful than theirs. The Pokémon I gave you was one of the two we created. But, just in case a time ever comes when its true powers can be unlocked\. Then, I can create the tools that it needs to change its type.
entries.translated:
Menurut catatan penelitian ini yang
kuterima dari Region Alola\\. Pokémon\litu dimodelkan setelah Pokémon

mitos, Arceus\\. Mereka ingin
menciptakan kembali kekuatannya\luntuk melawan makhluk dari dunia

lain. Kami telah mencoba melakukan
hal yang sama di sini di Borrius,\ltetapi hasil kami tidak lebih

sukses dari mereka. Pokémon yang
kuberikan padamu adalah salah satu\ldari dua yang kami ciptakan. Tapi,

untuk berjaga-jaga jika suatu saat
tiba ketika kekuatan sejatinya\ldapat terbuka\\. Maka, aku dapat

menciptakan alat yang dibutuhkan
untuk mengubah tipenya.

entries.original:
"Oh, but first, find a PC or one of
our Porygon, so you can empty a\lspace in the party."
entries.translation_source: Oh, but first, find a PC or one of our Porygon, so you can empty a space in the party.
entries.translated:
Oh, tapi pertama, cari PC atau
salah satu Porygon kami, agar kau\lbisa mengosongkan ruang di tim.

entries.original:
"If you have any of Arceus’ [green]Plates[red],
I can import [green]3[red] of them into a\lMemory disk, meant to change the\ltype of the Pokémon we created."
entries.translation_source: If you have any of Arceus’ [green]Plates[red], I can import [green]3[red] of them into a Memory disk, meant to change the type of the Pokémon we created.
entries.translated:
Jika kau memiliki [green]Piring[red] milik
Arceus, aku bisa mengimpor [green]3[red] di\lantaranya ke dalam Cakram Memori,

yang dimaksudkan untuk mengubah
tipe Pokémon yang kami ciptakan.

entries.original: "Which Plates will you give me?"
entries.translation_source: Which Plates will you give me?
entries.translated:
Piring mana yang akan kau berikan
padaku?

entries.original:
"If I import [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[red] into
the Memory disk, I can make you\lone [green][buffer3][red]."
entries.translation_source: If I import [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[red] into the Memory disk, I can make you one [green][buffer3][red].
entries.translated:
Jika saya mengimpor [green][buffer2]
[buffer1]s[red] ke dalam Memory disk,\lsaya bisa membuatkanmu satu

[green][buffer3][red].

entries.original:
"Then, I shall import the Plate
into the Memory disk\."
entries.translation_source: Then, I shall import the Plate into the Memory disk\.
entries.translated:
Lalu, saya akan mengimpor Plate ke
dalam Memory disk\.

entries.original:
"And it is done!

One [green][buffer1][red], ready to go!"
entries.translation_source: And it is done! One [green][buffer1][red], ready to go!
entries.translated:
Dan selesai! Satu [green][buffer1][red], siap
digunakan!

entries.original:
"If you have any more of Arceus’
[green]Plates[red], I can import them into\lMemory disks for you as well."
entries.translation_source: If you have any more of Arceus’ [green]Plates[red], I can import them into Memory disks for you as well.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu punya [green]Plates[red] Arceus
lainnya, saya bisa mengimpornya ke\lMemory disk untukmu juga.

entries.original:
"If you intend to use the Pokémon as
is, that is fine with me as well."
entries.translation_source: If you intend to use the Pokémon as is, that is fine with me as well.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berniat menggunakan
Pokémon itu apa adanya, itu juga\ltidak masalah bagiku.

entries.original:
"I cannot import that item into a
Memory disk.

Unfortunately, it is not one of
Arceus’ Plates."
entries.translation_source: I cannot import that item into a Memory disk. Unfortunately, it is not one of Arceus’ Plates.
entries.translated:
Saya tidak bisa mengimpor item itu
ke Memory disk. Sayangnya, itu\lbukan Plate milik Arceus.

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, you need at least 3
[buffer1]s if you want me to\limport them into a Memory disk."
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, you need at least 3 [buffer1]s if you want me to import them into a Memory disk.
entries.translated:
Sayangnya, kamu perlu setidaknya 3
[buffer1] jika kamu ingin saya\lmengimpornya ke Memory disk.

entries.original:
"It’s mah Mega Stone Maker - mah
pride and joy, right here!

Er\.\CC0818 admittedly, it can only make
three kinds of Mega Stones, but\ldon’t ya worry!

If ye’d like, I can make one of
those Mega Stones right now!

Let’s see\. how about [green][buffer1] Grass Gems[blue]?

Gimme those, and I can use mah
MSM’s pressure chamber to convert\l’em into a [green]Sceptilite[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: It’s mah Mega Stone Maker - mah pride and joy, right here! Er\.\CC0818 admittedly, it can only make three kinds of Mega Stones, but don’t ya worry! If ye’d like, I can make one of those Mega Stones right now! Let’s see\. how about [green][buffer1] Grass Gems[blue]? Gimme those, and I can use mah MSM’s pressure chamber to convert ’em into a [green]Sceptilite[blue]!
entries.translated:
Ini Mesin Pembuat Mega Stone
milikku - kebanggaan dan\lkesenanganku, di sini! Eh\.\CC0818

sejujurnya, mesin ini hanya bisa
membuat tiga jenis Mega Stones,\ltapi jangan khawatir! Jika kamu

mau, aku bisa membuat salah satu
Mega Stones itu sekarang! Coba\llihat\. bagaimana dengan [green][buffer1]

Grass Gems[blue]? Berikan itu, dan aku
bisa menggunakan ruang tekan MSM-ku\luntuk mengubahnya menjadi

[green]Sceptilite[blue]!

entries.original:
"If ye’d like, I can make another
for ya, too!

Let’s see\. how about [green][buffer1] Fire Gems[blue]?

Give me those, and I can use my
MSM’s pressure chamber to convert\l’em into a [green]Blazikenite[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: If ye’d like, I can make another for ya, too! Let’s see\. how about [green][buffer1] Fire Gems[blue]? Give me those, and I can use my MSM’s pressure chamber to convert ’em into a [green]Blazikenite[blue]!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mau, aku bisa membuat
yang lain juga! Coba lihat\.\lbagaimana dengan [green][buffer1] Fire

Gems[blue]? Berikan itu, dan aku bisa
menggunakan ruang tekan MSM-ku\luntuk mengubahnya menjadi

[green]Blazikenite[blue]!

entries.original:
"If ye’d like, I can make another
for ya, too!

Let’s see\. how about [green][buffer1] Water Gems[blue]?

Give me those, and I can use my
MSM’s pressure chamber to convert\l’em into a [green]Swampertite[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: If ye’d like, I can make another for ya, too! Let’s see\. how about [green][buffer1] Water Gems[blue]? Give me those, and I can use my MSM’s pressure chamber to convert ’em into a [green]Swampertite[blue]!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mau, aku bisa membuat
yang lain juga! Coba lihat\.\lbagaimana dengan [green][buffer1] Water

Gems[blue]? Berikan itu, dan aku bisa
menggunakan ruang tekan MSM-ku\luntuk mengubahnya menjadi

[green]Swampertite[blue]!

entries.original:
"A little bit of Evolution Energy in
here, switch it on, and\."
entries.translation_source: A little bit of Evolution Energy in here, switch it on, and\.
entries.translated:
Sedikit Evolution Energy di sini,
nyalakan, dan\.

entries.original:
"We’re done! Here’s one of Hoenn’s
finest, ready to go!"
entries.translation_source: We’re done! Here’s one of Hoenn’s finest, ready to go!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Ini salah satu yang
terbaik dari Hoenn, siap digunakan!

entries.original:
"Oh no! Mah Mega Stone Maker
just caught fire!

Quick, put it out!

Put it ouuuuuuuut!"
entries.translation_source: Oh no! Mah Mega Stone Maker just caught fire! Quick, put it out! Put it ouuuuuuuut!
entries.translated:
Oh tidak! Mesin Pembuat Mega Stone
milikku terbakar! Cepat, padamkan!\lPadamkaaaaaan!

entries.original:
"Oh\.\CC0818 mah pride and joy\.\CC0818 damaged
beyond repair\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\.\CC0818 mah pride and joy\.\CC0818 damaged beyond repair\.
entries.translated:
Oh\.\CC0818 kebanggaan dan kesenanganku\.\CC0818
rusak parah\.

entries.original:
"Sniff\.\CC0818 mah life’s work\.\CC0818 gone\.\CC0818 lost in
a tragic and contrived accident\.

\.\CC0818Might as well hit the road, now.

Ain’t no point in stickin’ around
any longer."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\.\CC0818 mah life’s work\.\CC0818 gone\.\CC0818 lost in a tragic and contrived accident\. \.\CC0818Might as well hit the road, now. Ain’t no point in stickin’ around any longer.
entries.translated:
Hiks\.\CC0818 hasil kerja hidupku\.\CC0818 hilang\.\CC0818
lenyap dalam kecelakaan tragis dan\ldirekayasa\. \.\CC0818Mungkin aku pergi

sekarang. Tidak ada gunanya
bertahan lebih lama lagi.

entries.original:
"What, are ya not impressed by its
selection either?

Philistine."
entries.translation_source: What, are ya not impressed by its selection either? Philistine.
entries.translated:
Apa, kamu juga tidak terkesan
dengan pilihannya? Filistin.

entries.original:
"Ya ain’t got enough [buffer1]s for
the MSM to do it’s thing, sorry."
entries.translation_source: Ya ain’t got enough [buffer1]s for the MSM to do it’s thing, sorry.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak punya cukup [buffer1]
untuk MSM melakukan tugasnya, maaf.

entries.original: "And Den There Were None"
entries.translation_source: And Den There Were None
entries.translated: And Den There Were None

entries.original:
"Have you seen the various
[green]Raid Dens[blue] across Borrius?

Aren’t they fascinating?

They were made when a meteorite
containing otherworldly energy\lnearly crashed into Borrius.

I’ve heard that in a faraway region,
the people there underwent very\lmuch the same thing\.

Thus creating the Dens - a space
where Pokémon receive the energy\lto grow very large, and yet cannot\lleave that space until captured\.

Would you be willing to take on a
quick test for me, now that you’ve\lheard my little spiel?"
entries.translation_source: Have you seen the various [green]Raid Dens[blue] across Borrius? Aren’t they fascinating? They were made when a meteorite containing otherworldly energy nearly crashed into Borrius. I’ve heard that in a faraway region, the people there underwent very much the same thing\. Thus creating the Dens - a space where Pokémon receive the energy to grow very large, and yet cannot leave that space until captured\. Would you be willing to take on a quick test for me, now that you’ve heard my little spiel?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah melihat berbagai
[green]Raid Dens[blue] di seluruh Borrius?\lBukankah itu menarik? Mereka

terbentuk ketika sebuah meteorit
yang mengandung energi dunia lain\lhampir menabrak Borrius. Kudengar

di daerah yang jauh, orang-orang di
sana mengalami hal yang sangat sama\.\lDengan demikian terciptalah Dens -

sebuah ruang di mana Pokémon
menerima energi untuk tumbuh sangat\lbesar, namun tidak bisa

meninggalkan ruang itu sampai
tertangkap\. Maukah kamu mengikuti\ltes singkat untukku, sekarang

setelah kamu mendengar penjelasan
kecilku?

entries.original:
"Ah, good, good.

Then, I’m tasking you to find all of
the [green][buffer1][blue] Raid Dens hidden around\lBorrius, and clear them out.

And of course, this all has to be
done within [green]a single day[blue].

Well, good luck, Trainer! I hope my
test won’t be too hard!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, good, good. Then, I’m tasking you to find all of the [green][buffer1][blue] Raid Dens hidden around Borrius, and clear them out. And of course, this all has to be done within [green]a single day[blue]. Well, good luck, Trainer! I hope my test won’t be too hard!
entries.translated:
Ah, bagus, bagus. Kalau begitu, aku
menugaskanmu untuk menemukan semua\l[green][buffer1][blue] Raid Dens yang tersembunyi

di sekitar Borrius, dan habisi
semuanya. Dan tentu saja, semua ini\lharus dilakukan dalam [green]satu hari[blue].

Baiklah, semoga berhasil, Trainer!
Semoga tesku tidak terlalu sulit!

entries.original:
"I’m tasking you to find all of
the [green][buffer1][blue] Raid Dens hidden\laround Borrius, and clear them out.

There are still [green][buffer3][blue] remaining, so
hurry before they’re populated\lagain at the end of the day!"
entries.translation_source: I’m tasking you to find all of the [green][buffer1][blue] Raid Dens hidden around Borrius, and clear them out. There are still [green][buffer3][blue] remaining, so hurry before they’re populated again at the end of the day!
entries.translated:
Saya menugaskan Anda untuk
menemukan semua [green][buffer1][blue] Raid Den\lyang tersembunyi di sekitar

Borrius, dan membersihkannya. Masih
ada [green][buffer3][blue] yang tersisa, jadi\lcepatlah sebelum mereka diisi

kembali pada akhir hari!

entries.original:
"Ah, I do believe that you’ve managed
to find and conquer all the Raid\lDens. Good, good!

Well, thank you for aiding my
research.

Here, have this, I invented it
myself."
entries.translation_source: Ah, I do believe that you’ve managed to find and conquer all the Raid Dens. Good, good! Well, thank you for aiding my research. Here, have this, I invented it myself.
entries.translated:
Ah, saya percaya Anda berhasil
menemukan dan menaklukkan semua\lRaid Den. Bagus, bagus! Baiklah,

terima kasih telah membantu
penelitian saya. Ini, ambil ini,\lsaya sendiri yang menemukannya.

entries.original:
"Oh, you’ve fallen asleep listening to
me, haven’t you\.?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you’ve fallen asleep listening to me, haven’t you\.?
entries.translated:
Oh, Anda tertidur saat mendengarkan
saya, bukan\\.?

entries.original:
"Thanks to your help, I’ve discovered
that if you throw a Wishing Piece\lin a Raid Den, then the Pokémon in\levery other Raid Den seems to\lchange as well!

Could they all be linked by some
sort of mysterious power?"
entries.translation_source: Thanks to your help, I’ve discovered that if you throw a Wishing Piece in a Raid Den, then the Pokémon in every other Raid Den seems to change as well! Could they all be linked by some sort of mysterious power?
entries.translated:
Berkat bantuan Anda, saya menemukan
bahwa jika Anda melempar Wishing\lPiece ke dalam Raid Den, maka

Pokémon di setiap Raid Den lainnya
juga tampak berubah! Mungkinkah\lmereka semua terhubung oleh semacam

kekuatan misterius?

entries.original: "The Daily Grind"
entries.translation_source: The Daily Grind
entries.translated: The Daily Grind

entries.original:
"Hmm, yes\. I’m a very important
scientist\. hoh, hoh.

Hmm\. yes, I’m very sure of it.
The people of Borrius\.

All of them, they\. hmm, yes\.
they get up and do the same\lroutine every single day.

Creatures of habit, they are\.
hoh, hoh. That’s them.

Hmm\. yes, you look like you could
help me - with my research, hmm,\lyes. Hoh, hoh.

I’ve been spying on\. erm, discreetly
monitoring\. certain people around\lBorrius, hmm, yes.

I’d like you to\. hmm, what was it\.?

Hmm, yes\. find these people, the
ones with too much time on their\lhands\. hoh, hoh.

Find them all, and do whatever
they ask of you\. or just take\lwhatever they offer\. hoh, hoh.

So, uh\. would you be willing
to help a very important scientist?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm, yes\. I’m a very important scientist\. hoh, hoh. Hmm\. yes, I’m very sure of it. The people of Borrius\. All of them, they\. hmm, yes\. they get up and do the same routine every single day. Creatures of habit, they are\. hoh, hoh. That’s them. Hmm\. yes, you look like you could help me - with my research, hmm, yes. Hoh, hoh. I’ve been spying on\. erm, discreetly monitoring\. certain people around Borrius, hmm, yes. I’d like you to\. hmm, what was it\.? Hmm, yes\. find these people, the ones with too much time on their hands\. hoh, hoh. Find them all, and do whatever they ask of you\. or just take whatever they offer\. hoh, hoh. So, uh\. would you be willing to help a very important scientist?
entries.translated:
Hmm, ya\\. Saya adalah ilmuwan yang
sangat penting\\. hoh, hoh. Hmm\\. ya,\lsaya sangat yakin akan hal itu.

Orang-orang Borrius\\. Semuanya,
mereka\\. hmm, ya\\. mereka bangun dan\lmelakukan rutinitas yang sama

setiap hari. Makhluk kebiasaan,
mereka\\. hoh, hoh. Itulah mereka.\lHmm\\. ya, kamu kelihatannya bisa
