Please, you have to take this
specially bred Pokémon Egg!"
entries.translation_source: When added on to all of the other scents you brought me, this scent is overwhleming! It must be because you’ve done it! You helped me finish my research! You’ve become a true master breeder. Please, you have to take this specially bred Pokémon Egg!
entries.translated:
Ketika ditambahkan ke semua aroma
lain yang kau bawakan untukku,\laroma ini sangat luar biasa! Pasti

karena kau berhasil! Kau membantuku
menyelesaikan penelitianku! Kau\ltelah menjadi peternak ahli sejati.

Tolong, kau harus mengambil Telur
Pokémon yang dibiakkan secara\lkhusus ini!

entries.original:
"You received a specially bred Egg
from the Pokémon Breeder!"
entries.translation_source: You received a specially bred Egg from the Pokémon Breeder!
entries.translated:
Kau menerima Telur yang dibiakkan
secara khusus dari Peternak\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"Or, I mean I would give it you, but
you must make space for it, first!"
entries.translation_source: Or, I mean I would give it you, but you must make space for it, first!
entries.translated:
Atau, maksudku aku akan
memberikannya padamu, tapi kau\lharus membuat ruang untuknya dulu!

entries.original:
"You’ve been a great help with my
research!

I feel like now, I can finally
be the Breeder I was meant to be."
entries.translation_source: You’ve been a great help with my research! I feel like now, I can finally be the Breeder I was meant to be.
entries.translated:
Kau telah sangat membantu
penelitianku! Aku merasa sekarang,\lakhirnya aku bisa menjadi Peternak

yang seharusnya aku jadi.

entries.original:
"When I was a student in the
Pokémon Breeder’s School, I\llearned that the best way to raise\lloving Pokémon is to battle with\lthem in important battles.

You seem like an important Trainer.
Can you help me raise my Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: When I was a student in the Pokémon Breeder’s School, I learned that the best way to raise loving Pokémon is to battle with them in important battles. You seem like an important Trainer. Can you help me raise my Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Saat aku menjadi murid di Sekolah
Peternak Pokémon, aku belajar bahwa\lcara terbaik untuk membesarkan

Pokémon yang penuh kasih adalah
dengan bertarung bersama mereka\ldalam pertarungan penting. Kau

tampak seperti Pelatih yang
penting. Bisakah kau membantu\lmembesarkan Pokémon-ku?

entries.original: "Let’s get started!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get started!
entries.translated: Ayo mulai!

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me!

Come back tomorrow to help train
my babies again!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me! Come back tomorrow to help train my babies again!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah bertarung
denganku! Kembali besok untuk\lmembantu melatih bayi-bayiku lagi!

entries.original:
"Well, I’ll still be here if you
want to help me out later!"
entries.translation_source: Well, I’ll still be here if you want to help me out later!
entries.translated:
Yah, aku akan tetap di sini jika
kau ingin membantuku nanti!

entries.original:
"Sometimes, when a boy and girl
Pokémon like each other very much,\lthey lay an Egg!

And the Day-Care couple is kind
enough to hold onto [green]100[blue] of those\lEggs for you!

I wish I could breed Pokémon as
great as they can."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes, when a boy and girl Pokémon like each other very much, they lay an Egg! And the Day-Care couple is kind enough to hold onto [green]100[blue] of those Eggs for you! I wish I could breed Pokémon as great as they can.
entries.translated:
Kadang-kadang, saat Pokémon jantan
dan betina saling menyukai, mereka\lbertelur! Dan pasangan Penitipan

cukup baik untuk menyimpan [green]100[blue]
Telur itu untukmu! Aku berharap\lbisa membiakkan Pokémon sehebat

mereka.

entries.original:
"The Clefairy out in the yard was
captured by a Ranger hailing from\lCrater Town.

Where did he get it from, though?

Last I remember, there were no wild
Clefairy around here\.

No wonder the one in the yard looks
so sad\. it has no friends!"
entries.translation_source: The Clefairy out in the yard was captured by a Ranger hailing from Crater Town. Where did he get it from, though? Last I remember, there were no wild Clefairy around here\. No wonder the one in the yard looks so sad\. it has no friends!
entries.translated:
Clefairy di halaman itu ditangkap
oleh seorang Ranger dari Kota\lKawah. Tapi dari mana dia

mendapatkannya? Terakhir aku ingat,
tidak ada Clefairy liar di sekitar\lsini\. Pantasan yang di halaman

terlihat sangat sedih\. dia tidak
punya teman!

entries.original:
"There used to be a Clefairy out in
the yard that was left by a Ranger\lhailing from Crater Town.

Where did he get it from, though?

Last I remember, there were no wild
Clefairy around here\."
entries.translation_source: There used to be a Clefairy out in the yard that was left by a Ranger hailing from Crater Town. Where did he get it from, though? Last I remember, there were no wild Clefairy around here\.
entries.translated:
Dulu ada Clefairy di halaman yang
ditinggalkan oleh seorang Ranger\ldari Kota Kawah. Tapi dari mana dia

mendapatkannya? Terakhir aku ingat,
tidak ada Clefairy liar di sekitar\lsini\.

entries.original:
"There are some horrible Trainers
out there who breed, and breed,\land breed\. and when they’re done\lbreeding, they release any Pokémon\lthey don’t want!

How despicable!

You’re not one of those Trainers,
are you?"
entries.translation_source: There are some horrible Trainers out there who breed, and breed, and breed\. and when they’re done breeding, they release any Pokémon they don’t want! How despicable! You’re not one of those Trainers, are you?
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Pelatih mengerikan di
luar sana yang membiakkan, dan\lmembiakkan, dan membiakkan\. dan

ketika selesai membiakkan, mereka
melepaskan Pokémon yang tidak\lmereka inginkan! Betapa kejinya!

Kau bukan salah satu dari Pelatih
itu, kan?

entries.original:
"Ugh, you again! Did you come to
leave more Pokémon with me?"
entries.translation_source: Ugh, you again! Did you come to leave more Pokémon with me?
entries.translated:
Ugh, kau lagi! Apa kau datang untuk
meninggalkan lebih banyak Pokémon\lpadaku?

entries.original:
"Ugh! You are?
How despicable!

\.Well, I can’t stop you from
releasing those Pokémon, so how\labout leaving them in my care\linstead?"
entries.translation_source: Ugh! You are? How despicable! \.Well, I can’t stop you from releasing those Pokémon, so how about leaving them in my care instead?
entries.translated:
Ugh! Kau begitu? Betapa kejinya!
\.Yah, aku tidak bisa menghentikanmu\lmelepaskan Pokémon itu, jadi

bagaimana kalau meninggalkannya
dalam perawatanku saja?

entries.original:
"So to confirm, you want to leave
all Pokémon in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc\lwith me?"
entries.translation_source: So to confirm, you want to leave all Pokémon in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc with me?
entries.translated:
Jadi untuk konfirmasi, kau ingin
meninggalkan semua Pokémon di Kotak\l\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc padaku?

entries.original:
"You will never see any of these
Pokémon again.

Are you absolutely SURE you want
to leave all Pokémon in Box\l\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc with me?"
entries.translation_source: You will never see any of these Pokémon again. Are you absolutely SURE you want to leave all Pokémon in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc with me?
entries.translated:
Kau tidak akan pernah melihat
Pokémon-Pokémon ini lagi. Apakah\lkau BENAR-BENAR yakin ingin

meninggalkan semua Pokémon di Kotak
\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc padaku?

entries.original:
"Okay, your Pokémon that were in
Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc will now have a\lloving home in my care.

You’re a despicable Trainer and I
wish you would mend your ways."
entries.translation_source: Okay, your Pokémon that were in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc will now have a loving home in my care. You’re a despicable Trainer and I wish you would mend your ways.
entries.translated:
Oke, Pokémon-mu yang ada di Kotak
\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc sekarang akan memiliki\lrumah yang penuh kasih dalam

perawatanku. Kau adalah Pelatih
yang keji dan aku berharap kau\lmemperbaiki sikapmu.

entries.original:
"I didn’t think so.
You don’t look the part."
entries.translation_source: I didn’t think so. You don’t look the part.
entries.translated:
Aku pikir tidak. Kamu tidak
terlihat seperti itu.

entries.original: "Ugh, how despicable!"
entries.translation_source: Ugh, how despicable!
entries.translated: Uh, betapa kejinya!

entries.original:
"Fortunately, you have no Pokémon
in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red].\qc

I won’t be needing to rescue any
Pokémon from you this time."
entries.translation_source: Fortunately, you have no Pokémon in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red].\qc I won’t be needing to rescue any Pokémon from you this time.
entries.translated:
Untungnya, kamu tidak memiliki
Pokémon di Kotak \qo[green][buffer1][red].\qc Aku\ltidak perlu menyelamatkan Pokémon

apa pun darimu kali ini.

entries.original:
"Everyone knows about Egg Moves.

They’re those special moves
Pokémon can only learn when\lbreeding with another Pokémon\lthat knows one.

But listen here.

I have a special technique that can
move Egg Moves from one Pokémon\lto another!

Provided that they’re in the same
species family, of course.

What do you say, would you like me
to move Egg Moves from one Pokémon\lto another?

It’ll only cost you $[green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Everyone knows about Egg Moves. They’re those special moves Pokémon can only learn when breeding with another Pokémon that knows one. But listen here. I have a special technique that can move Egg Moves from one Pokémon to another! Provided that they’re in the same species family, of course. What do you say, would you like me to move Egg Moves from one Pokémon to another? It’ll only cost you $[green][buffer1][blue].
entries.translated:
Semua orang tahu tentang Gerakan
Telur. Itu adalah gerakan spesial\lyang hanya bisa dipelajari Pokémon

saat berkembang biak dengan Pokémon
lain yang tahu salah satunya. Tapi\ldengarkan. Aku punya teknik spesial

yang bisa memindahkan Gerakan Telur
dari satu Pokémon ke Pokémon lain!\lAsalkan mereka berada dalam

keluarga spesies yang sama, tentu
saja. Bagaimana, apakah kamu ingin\laku memindahkan Gerakan Telur dari

satu Pokémon ke Pokémon lain?
Harganya hanya $[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Would you like me to move Egg Moves
from one Pokémon to another in the\lsame species family?

It’ll only cost you $[green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Would you like me to move Egg Moves from one Pokémon to another in the same species family? It’ll only cost you $[green][buffer1][blue].
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin aku memindahkan
Gerakan Telur dari satu Pokémon ke\lPokémon lain dalam keluarga spesies

yang sama? Harganya hanya
$[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon will you be
transferring Egg Moves from?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon will you be transferring Egg Moves from?
entries.translated:
Dari Pokémon mana kamu akan
mentransfer Gerakan Telur?

entries.original:
"So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves
from [green][buffer1][blue]?

Choose the Pokémon in the
[green][buffer2][blue] family to transfer\lmoves to."
entries.translation_source: So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves from [green][buffer1][blue]? Choose the Pokémon in the [green][buffer2][blue] family to transfer moves to.
entries.translated:
Jadi kamu akan mentransfer Gerakan
Telur dari [green][buffer1][blue]? Pilih Pokémon\ldalam keluarga [green][buffer2][blue] untuk

mentransfer gerakan ke sana.

entries.original:
"So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves
from [green][buffer1][blue] to [green][buffer2][blue].

Should the new moves only fill the
remaining space [buffer2] has\lavailable in its moveset, or can\lmoves be deleted if need be?"
entries.translation_source: So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves from [green][buffer1][blue] to [green][buffer2][blue]. Should the new moves only fill the remaining space [buffer2] has available in its moveset, or can moves be deleted if need be?
entries.translated:
Jadi kamu akan mentransfer Gerakan
Telur dari [green][buffer1][blue] ke [green][buffer2][blue].\lHaruskah gerakan baru hanya mengisi

ruang tersisa yang dimiliki
[buffer2] di movesetnya, atau\lbisakah gerakan dihapus jika perlu?

entries.original:
"The transfer was a success!
[buffer1] has learned new moves.

And that’ll be $[green][buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: The transfer was a success! [buffer1] has learned new moves. And that’ll be $[green][buffer2][blue]!
entries.translated:
Transfer berhasil! [buffer1] telah
mempelajari gerakan baru. Dan itu\lakan menjadi $[green][buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"If you need to transfer Egg Moves,
come see me anytime!"
entries.translation_source: If you need to transfer Egg Moves, come see me anytime!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu perlu mentransfer Gerakan
Telur, datanglah menemuiku kapan\lsaja!

entries.original:
"I’m afraid you don’t have enough
money for my special technique."
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid you don’t have enough money for my special technique.
entries.translated:
Maaf, kamu tidak memiliki cukup
uang untuk teknik spesialku.

entries.original:
"My technique is for Egg Moves,
not Eggs themselves."
entries.translation_source: My technique is for Egg Moves, not Eggs themselves.
entries.translated:
Teknikku untuk Gerakan Telur, bukan
untuk Telur itu sendiri.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like [buffer1]
knows any Egg Moves.

It won’t be able to transfer any
moves unless it learns some."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like [buffer1] knows any Egg Moves. It won’t be able to transfer any moves unless it learns some.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya [buffer1] tidak tahu
Gerakan Telur apa pun. Ia tidak\lakan bisa mentransfer gerakan apa

pun kecuali ia mempelajarinya.

entries.original:
"Whoops, looks like you already
chose that Pokémon.

Could you choose a different
Pokémon in [green][buffer1][blue]’s family?"
entries.translation_source: Whoops, looks like you already chose that Pokémon. Could you choose a different Pokémon in [green][buffer1][blue]’s family?
entries.translated:
Ups, sepertinya kamu sudah memilih
Pokémon itu. Bisakah kamu memilih\lPokémon lain dalam keluarga

[green][buffer1][blue]?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] and [buffer2] don’t
belong to the same species family.

My technique only works on Pokémon
that have evolutions in common.

For instance, I can transfer moves
between a Snorunt and a Glalie, or\la Glalie and a Froslass.

I cannot, however, transfer moves
from Snorunt to Vanillite, as they\lshare no evolutions."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] and [buffer2] don’t belong to the same species family. My technique only works on Pokémon that have evolutions in common. For instance, I can transfer moves between a Snorunt and a Glalie, or a Glalie and a Froslass. I cannot, however, transfer moves from Snorunt to Vanillite, as they share no evolutions.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] dan [buffer2] tidak
termasuk dalam keluarga spesies\lyang sama. Teknikku hanya bekerja

pada Pokémon yang memiliki evolusi
yang sama. Misalnya, aku bisa\lmentransfer gerakan antara Snorunt

dan Glalie, atau Glalie dan
Froslass. Namun, aku tidak bisa\lmentransfer gerakan dari Snorunt ke

Vanillite, karena mereka tidak
memiliki evolusi yang sama.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like [buffer2] has
any space in its moveset to learn\lnew moves.

If you don’t want me to delete the
moves at the top of its moveset,\lthen choose moves to delete at the\l[green]Move Deleter[blue] in [green]Epidimy Town[blue]."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like [buffer2] has any space in its moveset to learn new moves. If you don’t want me to delete the moves at the top of its moveset, then choose moves to delete at the [green]Move Deleter[blue] in [green]Epidimy Town[blue].
entries.translated:
Sepertinya [buffer2] tidak memiliki
ruang di movesetnya untuk\lmempelajari gerakan baru. Jika kamu

tidak ingin aku menghapus gerakan
di bagian atas movesetnya, maka\lpilih gerakan untuk dihapus di

[green]Penghapus Gerakan[blue] di [green]Epidimy Town[blue].

entries.original:
"Whoops, looks like [buffer1]
already knows the moves it was\lgoing to learn.

I guess I won’t be charging you
after all!"
entries.translation_source: Whoops, looks like [buffer1] already knows the moves it was going to learn. I guess I won’t be charging you after all!
entries.translated:
Ups, sepertinya [buffer1] sudah tahu
gerakan yang akan dipelajarinya.\lSepertinya aku tidak akan

menagihmu!

entries.original: "Fill Remaining Space"
entries.translation_source: Fill Remaining Space
entries.translated: Isi Ruang Tersisa

entries.original: "Delete Old Moves"
entries.translation_source: Delete Old Moves
entries.translated: Hapus Gerakan Lama

entries.original:
"Whooa, [buffer1]!

If a Pokémon uses the move [green]Surf[blue],
it can catch a wave!

I’ve seen the move lying around
somewhere in the city, [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: Whooa, [buffer1]! If a Pokémon uses the move [green]Surf[blue], it can catch a wave! I’ve seen the move lying around somewhere in the city, [buffer1]\.
entries.translated:
Whooa, [buffer1]! Jika Pokémon
menggunakan gerakan [green]Berselancar[blue], ia\lbisa menangkap ombak! Aku pernah

melihat gerakan itu berserakan di
suatu tempat di kota, [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Whooa, [buffer1]!

If a Pokémon uses the move [green]Surf[blue],
it can catch a wave!

And if a [green]Fire[blue]-type Pokémon goes to
the volcano, it can ride on [green]lava[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Whooa, [buffer1]! If a Pokémon uses the move [green]Surf[blue], it can catch a wave! And if a [green]Fire[blue]-type Pokémon goes to the volcano, it can ride on [green]lava[blue]!
entries.translated:
Whooa, [buffer1]! Jika seekor
Pokémon menggunakan jurus [green]Surf[blue], ia\lbisa menangkap gelombang! Dan jika

Pokémon [green]Api[blue] pergi ke gunung berapi,
ia bisa menaiki [green]lava[blue]!

entries.original:
"I just can’t stop shopping!

There’s so much variety at the
[green]Dehara Department Store[red]!"
entries.translation_source: I just can’t stop shopping! There’s so much variety at the [green]Dehara Department Store[red]!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa berhenti berbelanja!
Ada begitu banyak variasi di [green]Dehara\lDepartment Store[red]!

entries.original:
"It’s my job to make sure this city
stays a beautiful oasis at the edge\lof the desert.

All these trees aren’t natural to
this area.

I planted each and every one
of ’em!"
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to make sure this city stays a beautiful oasis at the edge of the desert. All these trees aren’t natural to this area. I planted each and every one of ’em!
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah memastikan kota ini
tetap menjadi oasis yang indah di\ltepi gurun. Semua pohon ini bukan

asli dari daerah ini. Aku menanam
setiap satu dari mereka!

entries.original:
"The history books say the ancient
king of Borrius had his castle\lbuilt in this very spot!

That makes sense - his tomb is
nearby in the Great Desert,\lafter all."
entries.translation_source: The history books say the ancient king of Borrius had his castle built in this very spot! That makes sense - his tomb is nearby in the Great Desert, after all.
entries.translated:
Buku-buku sejarah mengatakan raja
kuno Borrius membangun istananya di\ltempat ini! Itu masuk akal -

makamnya ada di dekatnya di Great
Desert.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.

A park at the edge of a desert city
is so relaxing.

Dehara City is just a wonderful
oasis paradise!"
entries.translation_source: Mmm\. A park at the edge of a desert city is so relaxing. Dehara City is just a wonderful oasis paradise!
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Sebuah taman di tepi kota gurun
sangat menenangkan. Dehara City\lbenar-benar surga oasis yang indah!

entries.original:
"This house over here is known as
the [green]Double Battle House[blue].

Like the other Trainer Houses, the
Trainers inside can be battled as\lmany times as you want.

It’s a great place for training up
your Pokémon if you’re thinking of\ltaking on the Gym."
entries.translation_source: This house over here is known as the [green]Double Battle House[blue]. Like the other Trainer Houses, the Trainers inside can be battled as many times as you want. It’s a great place for training up your Pokémon if you’re thinking of taking on the Gym.
entries.translated:
Rumah di sini dikenal sebagai
[green]Double Battle House[blue]. Seperti Rumah\lPelatih lainnya, Pelatih di

dalamnya bisa ditantang sebanyak
yang kamu mau. Tempat yang bagus\luntuk melatih Pokémon-mu jika kamu

berpikir untuk menantang Gym.

entries.original:
"This cave is known as Rift Cave.

During my research, I discovered
it has many similarities with\lSinnoh’s [green]Turnback Cave[blue].

Could this mean it is somehow
connected to the mysterious\l[green]Distortion World[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: This cave is known as Rift Cave. During my research, I discovered it has many similarities with Sinnoh’s [green]Turnback Cave[blue]. Could this mean it is somehow connected to the mysterious [green]Distortion World[blue]?
entries.translated:
Gua ini dikenal sebagai Rift Cave.
Selama penelitianku, aku menemukan\lbahwa gua ini memiliki banyak

kesamaan dengan [green]Turnback Cave[blue] di
Sinnoh. Mungkinkah ini berarti gua\lini terhubung dengan [green]Distortion

World[blue] yang misterius?

entries.original:
"Aren’t you boiling in those clothes?

What would compel you to wear
that outfit by the desert?"
entries.translation_source: Aren’t you boiling in those clothes? What would compel you to wear that outfit by the desert?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tidak kepanasan dengan
pakaian itu? Apa yang mendorongmu\lmemakai pakaian itu di dekat gurun?

entries.original:
"What’s with your getup?

You couldn’t have picked a worse
thing to wear out here!

The whole cloak-and-dagger look is
sure to burn you to a crisp!"
entries.translation_source: What’s with your getup? You couldn’t have picked a worse thing to wear out here! The whole cloak-and-dagger look is sure to burn you to a crisp!
entries.translated:
Ada apa dengan penampilanmu? Kamu
tidak bisa memilih pakaian yang\llebih buruk untuk dipakai di sini!

Tampilan jubah dan belati pasti
akan membuatmu terbakar hangus!

entries.original:
"That outfit you’re wearing really
gives off the aura of \qoChampion\qc,\ly’know?

There’s no one else who could pull
it off but you, Champion!"
entries.translation_source: That outfit you’re wearing really gives off the aura of \qoChampion\qc, y’know? There’s no one else who could pull it off but you, Champion!
entries.translated:
Pakaian yang kamu pakai benar-benar
memancarkan aura \qoJuara\qc, tahu?\lTidak ada orang lain yang bisa

melakukannya selain dirimu, Juara!

entries.original:
"Your outfit looks nice and cool!

It’s not perfect for the desert,
but you won’t boil, that’s for sure!"
entries.translation_source: Your outfit looks nice and cool! It’s not perfect for the desert, but you won’t boil, that’s for sure!
entries.translated:
Pakaianmu terlihat bagus dan sejuk!
Tidak sempurna untuk gurun, tapi\lkamu tidak akan kepanasan, itu

pasti!

entries.original:
"Your outift is nice and silvery!

Or is that a golden sheen I
see?

Either way, you’re looking like quite
the hero in that outfit!"
entries.translation_source: Your outift is nice and silvery! Or is that a golden sheen I see? Either way, you’re looking like quite the hero in that outfit!
entries.translated:
Pakaianmu bagus dan keperakan! Atau
apakah itu kilau emas yang kulihat?\lBagaimanapun, kamu terlihat seperti

pahlawan dengan pakaian itu!

entries.original:
"I tried travelling through the
[green]Great Desert[red] to the east of town,\lbut the sandstorm was too strong.

It kept whipping sand in my face,
and I couldn’t see anything.

Without [green]Go-Goggles[red] to protect my
eyes, it was impossible to go\lanywhere.

I know some guy around here has a
whole collection of them, but he’s\lvery particular about who he gives\lout to."
entries.translation_source: I tried travelling through the [green]Great Desert[red] to the east of town, but the sandstorm was too strong. It kept whipping sand in my face, and I couldn’t see anything. Without [green]Go-Goggles[red] to protect my eyes, it was impossible to go anywhere. I know some guy around here has a whole collection of them, but he’s very particular about who he gives out to.
entries.translated:
Aku mencoba bepergian melalui [green]Great
Desert[red] di timur kota, tapi badai\lpasirnya terlalu kuat. Pasir terus

menerpa wajahku, dan aku tidak bisa
melihat apa pun. Tanpa [green]Kacamata\lPasir[red] untuk melindungi mataku,

mustahil untuk pergi ke mana pun.
Aku tahu beberapa orang di sini\lmemiliki koleksi lengkapnya, tapi

dia sangat selektif tentang siapa
yang dia berikan.

entries.original:
"I tried travelling through the
[green]Great Desert[red] to the east of town,\lbut the sandstorm was too strong.

It kept whipping sand in my face,
and I couldn’t see anything.

If I had Go-Goggles like you, I’d
be able to explore it no problem!"
entries.translation_source: I tried travelling through the [green]Great Desert[red] to the east of town, but the sandstorm was too strong. It kept whipping sand in my face, and I couldn’t see anything. If I had Go-Goggles like you, I’d be able to explore it no problem!
entries.translated:
Aku mencoba bepergian melalui [green]Great
Desert[red] di timur kota, tapi badai\lpasirnya terlalu kuat. Pasir terus

menerpa wajahku, dan aku tidak bisa
melihat apa pun. Jika aku punya\lKacamata Pasir sepertimu, aku pasti

bisa menjelajahinya tanpa masalah!

entries.original:
"Whew.

I.\CC0818 Am.\CC0818 Parched.

I could really go for a Soda Pop
right about now\."
entries.translation_source: Whew. I.\CC0818 Am.\CC0818 Parched. I could really go for a Soda Pop right about now\.
entries.translated:
Whew. Aku.\CC0818 Sangat.\CC0818 Haus. Aku
benar-benar ingin Soda Pop saat ini\ljuga\.

entries.original:
"Hey! That’s a Soda Pop I sense
in your Cube!

Mind sharing it with me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! That’s a Soda Pop I sense in your Cube! Mind sharing it with me?
entries.translated:
Hei! Itu Soda Pop yang kurasakan di
Cube-mu! Mau berbagi denganku?

entries.original:
"[black]You shared a Soda Pop with the
Battle Girl."
entries.translation_source: [black]You shared a Soda Pop with the Battle Girl.
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu berbagi Soda Pop dengan Gadis
Pertarungan.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.\CC0820 That.\CC0818 Was.\CC0818 Sweet!

Thanks a whole bunch, Trainer!
Here, you can have this."
entries.translation_source: Mmm\.\CC0820 That.\CC0818 Was.\CC0818 Sweet! Thanks a whole bunch, Trainer! Here, you can have this.
entries.translated:
Mmm\.\CC0820 Itu.\CC0818 Sangat.\CC0818 Manis! Terima
kasih banyak, Pelatih! Ini, kamu\lboleh punya ini.

entries.original:
"Give the [green]Expert Belt[red] to a Pokémon,
and all its super effective attacks\lwill deal more damage!

Sweet, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: Give the [green]Expert Belt[red] to a Pokémon, and all its super effective attacks will deal more damage! Sweet, yeah?
entries.translated:
Berikan [green]Sabuk Ahli[red] kepada Pokémon,
dan semua serangan yang sangat\lefektif akan memberikan lebih

banyak kerusakan! Manis, kan?

entries.original:
"You sure are stingy, Trainer.

That’s a habit you should drop if
you know what’s good for you."
entries.translation_source: You sure are stingy, Trainer. That’s a habit you should drop if you know what’s good for you.
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar pelit, Pelatih.
Itu kebiasaan yang harus kamu\lhentikan jika kamu tahu yang

terbaik untukmu.

entries.original:
"Whenever I play with sand castles on
[green]Sundays[blue] and [green]Wednesdays[blue], they jump\lup and attack me!

It’s really scary!"
entries.translation_source: Whenever I play with sand castles on [green]Sundays[blue] and [green]Wednesdays[blue], they jump up and attack me! It’s really scary!
entries.translated:
Setiap kali aku bermain dengan
istana pasir pada [green]hari Minggu[blue] dan\l[green]hari Rabu[blue], mereka melompat dan

menyerangku! Sangat menakutkan!

entries.original:
"Do you like my sand castle?

I worked really hard to make it!"
entries.translation_source: Do you like my sand castle? I worked really hard to make it!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu suka istana pasirku?
Aku berusaha keras untuk\lmembuatnya!

entries.original:
"Wahhhh!

My sand castle is gone!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! My sand castle is gone!
entries.translated: Wahhhh! Istana pasirku hilang!

entries.original:
"Galavan lowers the bridge to his
Gym while he’s out travelling.

He’ll return eventually, you just
need to be patient."
entries.translation_source: Galavan lowers the bridge to his Gym while he’s out travelling. He’ll return eventually, you just need to be patient.
entries.translated:
Galavan menurunkan jembatan ke
Gym-nya saat dia bepergian. Dia\lakan kembali pada akhirnya, kamu

hanya perlu bersabar.

entries.original:
"Looks like Galavan has raised the
bridge to his Gym!

Now would be a great time to head
in there and challenge him."
entries.translation_source: Looks like Galavan has raised the bridge to his Gym! Now would be a great time to head in there and challenge him.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Galavan telah menaikkan
jembatan ke Gym-nya! Sekarang\ladalah waktu yang tepat untuk masuk

ke sana dan menantangnya.

entries.original:
"Looks like Galavan has raised the
bridge to his Gym!

Now’s a great time for aspiring
Trainers to challenge him.

Lucky for you, you already did!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like Galavan has raised the bridge to his Gym! Now’s a great time for aspiring Trainers to challenge him. Lucky for you, you already did!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Galavan telah menaikkan
jembatan ke Gym-nya! Sekarang\ladalah waktu yang tepat bagi

Pelatih yang bercita-cita tinggi
untuk menantangnya. Beruntung\lbagimu, kamu sudah melakukannya!

entries.original:
"Aw, jeez\.

I blew all of my money at the
Game Corner!

Looks like I won’t be needing
this anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Aw, jeez\. I blew all of my money at the Game Corner! Looks like I won’t be needing this anymore!
entries.translated:
Ah, ya ampun\. Aku menghabiskan semua
uangku di Game Corner! Sepertinya\laku tidak akan membutuhkan ini

lagi!

entries.original: "I always thought I could win\."
entries.translation_source: I always thought I could win\.
entries.translated: Aku selalu berpikir aku bisa menang\.

entries.original:
"This apartment is owned by an
illustrious businessman in\lSeaport City.

The apartment is in high demand, so
I’m afraid you will not be able to\lrent it for yourself."
entries.translation_source: This apartment is owned by an illustrious businessman in Seaport City. The apartment is in high demand, so I’m afraid you will not be able to rent it for yourself.
entries.translated:
Apartemen ini dimiliki oleh seorang
pengusaha terkemuka di Seaport\lCity. Apartemen ini sangat

diminati, jadi aku khawatir kamu
tidak akan bisa menyewanya untuk\ldirimu sendiri.

entries.original:
"I’m pretty lucky for scoring
this apartment!

Everyone knows it’s hard to score
an apartment owned by that guy\ldown in Seaport."
entries.translation_source: I’m pretty lucky for scoring this apartment! Everyone knows it’s hard to score an apartment owned by that guy down in Seaport.
entries.translated:
Aku cukup beruntung mendapatkan
apartemen ini! Semua orang tahu\lsulit untuk mendapatkan apartemen

yang dimiliki oleh pria itu di
Seaport.

entries.original:
"Hey you!
Let me play with your Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Hey you! Let me play with your Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Hei kamu! Biarkan aku bermain
dengan Pokémon-mu!

entries.original:
"[black]The little boy played with
[buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [black]The little boy played with [buffer1].
entries.translated:
[black]Anak kecil itu bermain dengan
[buffer1].

entries.original:
"But\. but\. but in Magnolia Town, I
play so much with the Pokémon!

They’ve all become super [green]friendly[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: But\. but\. but in Magnolia Town, I play so much with the Pokémon! They’ve all become super [green]friendly[blue]!
entries.translated:
Tapi\. tapi\. tapi di Magnolia Town,
aku sering bermain dengan Pokémon!\lMereka semua menjadi super [green]ramah[blue]!

entries.original:
"I can’t play with an Egg!

I wanna play with a Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t play with an Egg! I wanna play with a Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa bermain dengan
Telur! Aku ingin bermain dengan\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"I wanna play with your Pokémon
again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: I wanna play with your Pokémon again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Aku ingin bermain dengan Pokémon-mu
lagi besok!

entries.original:
"If you treat your Pokémon nicely,
they will love you in return.

Oh? Let me see your Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: If you treat your Pokémon nicely, they will love you in return. Oh? Let me see your Pokémon\.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memperlakukan Pokémon-mu
dengan baik, mereka akan\lmencintaimu kembali. Oh? Biarkan

aku melihat Pokémon-mu\.

entries.original: "Pyukumuku Chucker"
entries.translation_source: Pyukumuku Chucker
entries.translated: Pyukumuku Chucker

entries.original:
"The Dehara beach used to be a
popular tourist destination for\lmany tourists from East Borrius.

But their attendance has dwindled
recently ever since Pokémon known\las Pyukumuku began to wash ashore.

They’re spiky and cause injuries
to the tourists who step on them.

I’m in dire need of a Trainer to
throw them back in the ocean.

So what do you say?

Think you’ve got what it takes to
be a [green]Pyukumuku chucker[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: The Dehara beach used to be a popular tourist destination for many tourists from East Borrius. But their attendance has dwindled recently ever since Pokémon known as Pyukumuku began to wash ashore. They’re spiky and cause injuries to the tourists who step on them. I’m in dire need of a Trainer to throw them back in the ocean. So what do you say? Think you’ve got what it takes to be a [green]Pyukumuku chucker[blue]?
entries.translated:
Pantai Dehara dulu menjadi tujuan
wisata populer bagi banyak turis\ldari East Borrius. Namun kunjungan

mereka menurun akhir-akhir ini
sejak Pokémon yang dikenal sebagai\lPyukumuku mulai terdampar di

pantai. Mereka berduri dan
menyebabkan cedera pada turis yang\lmenginjak mereka. Aku sangat

membutuhkan seorang Pelatih untuk
melempar mereka kembali ke laut.\lJadi bagaimana? Apa kamu pikir kamu

punya kemampuan untuk menjadi
[green]Pyukumuku chucker[blue]?

entries.original:
"It really doesn’t take much skill!

Besides, being a Pyukumuku chucker
is fun!"
entries.translation_source: It really doesn’t take much skill! Besides, being a Pyukumuku chucker is fun!
entries.translated:
Ini benar-benar tidak membutuhkan
banyak keterampilan! Lagipula,\lmenjadi Pyukumuku chucker itu

menyenangkan!

entries.original:
"Get every last Pyukumuku on the
beach diving right back to the sea!

Let’s see\.

I can still see [buffer1] Pyukumuku left on
the sand and in need of chucking."
entries.translation_source: Get every last Pyukumuku on the beach diving right back to the sea! Let’s see\. I can still see [buffer1] Pyukumuku left on the sand and in need of chucking.
entries.translated:
Dapatkan setiap Pyukumuku terakhir
di pantai untuk menyelam kembali ke\llaut! Mari kita lihat\. Aku masih

bisa melihat [buffer1] Pyukumuku
tersisa di pasir dan perlu\ldilempar.

entries.original:
"Good job!

You’ve got every last Pyukumuku
that was stranded on the beach\lback into the sea!

You’re a real good worker,
you know?

You have a real knack for
Pyukumuku chucking.

Now they are safe back where they
should be, and the beach is safe\lfor tourists.

And I’ve got your reward ready for
you right here.

Take it!
You’ve earned it!"
entries.translation_source: Good job! You’ve got every last Pyukumuku that was stranded on the beach back into the sea! You’re a real good worker, you know? You have a real knack for Pyukumuku chucking. Now they are safe back where they should be, and the beach is safe for tourists. And I’ve got your reward ready for you right here. Take it! You’ve earned it!
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus! Kamu telah
mengembalikan semua Pyukumuku yang\lterdampar di pantai ke laut! Kamu

pekerja yang sangat baik, tahu?
Kamu benar-benar ahli dalam\lmelempar Pyukumuku. Sekarang mereka

aman kembali ke tempat seharusnya,
dan pantai aman bagi turis. Dan aku\lsudah menyiapkan hadiahmu di sini.

Ambil! Kamu pantas mendapatkannya!

entries.original:
"Pyukumuku are one of the most
famous Alolan Pokémon.

But a lot of tourists from
East Borrius don’t understand\ltheir appeal.

It’s a real shame."
entries.translation_source: Pyukumuku are one of the most famous Alolan Pokémon. But a lot of tourists from East Borrius don’t understand their appeal. It’s a real shame.
entries.translated:
Pyukumuku adalah salah satu Pokémon
Alola yang paling terkenal. Tapi\lbanyak turis dari Borrius Timur

tidak mengerti daya tarik mereka.
Sangat disayangkan.

entries.original:
"[green]Puke?

Muke\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Puke? Muke\.
entries.translated: [green]Puke? Muke\.

entries.original:
"[black]You chucked the Pyukumuku back
into the sea\."
entries.translation_source: [black]You chucked the Pyukumuku back into the sea\.
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu melempar Pyukumuku kembali ke
laut\.

entries.original:
"[black]There are no more Pyukumuku left
on the beach."
entries.translation_source: [black]There are no more Pyukumuku left on the beach.
entries.translated:
[black]Tidak ada lagi Pyukumuku yang
tersisa di pantai.

entries.original:
"Hi! I am a humble Maid!

My master has a big heart to match
his big belly. He’s a gourmet!

So I am looking for ingredients
that will make his heart jump\lfor joy!

Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\.

Oh, that aroma!
It smells so gourmet!

Do you have a wonderful ingredient
in your bag?

Would you consider selling it
to me?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I am a humble Maid! My master has a big heart to match his big belly. He’s a gourmet! So I am looking for ingredients that will make his heart jump for joy! Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\. Oh, that aroma! It smells so gourmet! Do you have a wonderful ingredient in your bag? Would you consider selling it to me?
entries.translated:
Hai! Aku seorang Maid yang rendah
hati! Tuanku memiliki hati yang\lbesar sepadan dengan perutnya yang

besar. Dia seorang gourmet! Jadi
aku mencari bahan-bahan yang akan\lmembuat hatinya melompat

kegirangan! Sniff, sniff\. Sniff,
sniff\. Oh, aroma itu! Baunya sangat\lgourmet! Apakah kamu memiliki bahan

yang luar biasa di tasmu? Maukah
kamu menjualnya padaku?

entries.original:
"Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\.

Oh, that aroma!
It smells so gourmet!

Do you have a wonderful ingredient
in your bag?

Would you consider selling it
to me?"
entries.translation_source: Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\. Oh, that aroma! It smells so gourmet! Do you have a wonderful ingredient in your bag? Would you consider selling it to me?
entries.translated:
Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\. Oh, aroma
itu! Baunya sangat gourmet! Apakah\lkamu memiliki bahan yang luar biasa

di tasmu? Maukah kamu menjualnya
padaku?

entries.original:
"Oh, it smells so good!

That [green][buffer3][red] of yours is a
very rare ingredient indeed!

Would you take $[green][buffer2][red] for it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, it smells so good! That [green][buffer3][red] of yours is a very rare ingredient indeed! Would you take $[green][buffer2][red] for it?
entries.translated:
Oh, baunya enak sekali! [green][buffer3][red]
milikmu adalah bahan yang sangat\llangka! Maukah kamu menerima

$[green][buffer2][red] untuk itu?

entries.original:
"Merci! Thank you!

With this, I can create a superb
menu!

My master will be so surprised!"
entries.translation_source: Merci! Thank you! With this, I can create a superb menu! My master will be so surprised!
entries.translated:
Merci! Terima kasih! Dengan ini,
aku bisa membuat menu yang luar\lbiasa! Tuanku akan sangat terkejut!

entries.original:
"Hmm\. This is not quite what I’m
looking for.

I don’t think my master will be
satisfied with such a smell\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. This is not quite what I’m looking for. I don’t think my master will be satisfied with such a smell\.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Ini bukan yang aku cari. Aku
rasa tuanku tidak akan puas dengan\laroma seperti itu\.

entries.original:
"Aww\. Well, that’s okay.

If you find a gourmet ingredient
for me, please let me know!"
entries.translation_source: Aww\. Well, that’s okay. If you find a gourmet ingredient for me, please let me know!
entries.translated:
Aww\. Baiklah, tidak apa-apa. Jika
kamu menemukan bahan gourmet\luntukku, tolong beri tahu aku!

entries.original: "Choose Item"
entries.translation_source: Choose Item
entries.translated: Pilih Item

entries.original: "Choose Berry"
entries.translation_source: Choose Berry
entries.translated: Pilih Berry

entries.original:
"I just simply adore ores.

Don’t you have an adorable ore that
shakes my core?"
entries.translation_source: I just simply adore ores. Don’t you have an adorable ore that shakes my core?
entries.translated:
Aku sangat mengagumi bijih. Apakah
kamu tidak memiliki bijih yang\lmenggemaskan yang mengguncang

intiku?

entries.original:
"Don’t you have an adorable ore that
shakes my core?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you have an adorable ore that shakes my core?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tidak memiliki bijih
yang menggemaskan yang mengguncang\lintiku?

entries.original:
"Oh, I do adore the ores!

That [green][buffer3][blue], it’s shaking me!
Will you sell it for $[green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I do adore the ores! That [green][buffer3][blue], it’s shaking me! Will you sell it for $[green][buffer2][blue]?
entries.translated:
Oh, aku sangat menyukai bijih-bijih
itu! [green][buffer3][blue] itu, itu\lmengguncangku! Maukah kamu

menjualnya seharga $[green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"[black]Handed over [green][buffer1][black] of [green][buffer3][black]
and received $[green][buffer2][black]!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Handed over [green][buffer1][black] of [green][buffer3][black] and received $[green][buffer2][black]!
entries.translated:
[black]Menyerahkan [green][buffer1][black] dari [green][buffer3][black]
dan menerima $[green][buffer2][black]!

entries.original:
"The deal is done!
I’ve scored an ore I can adore!"
entries.translation_source: The deal is done! I’ve scored an ore I can adore!
entries.translated:
Kesepakatan selesai! Aku
mendapatkan bijih yang bisa\lkukagumi!

entries.original:
"Huh? What on earth is this?

You can’t shake my core with
an ore so poor!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What on earth is this? You can’t shake my core with an ore so poor!
entries.translated:
Hah? Apa ini? Kamu tidak bisa
mengguncang intiku dengan bijih\lyang begitu buruk!

entries.original:
"Hmmm. My core won’t change.
I hope you sell it to me someday."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm. My core won’t change. I hope you sell it to me someday.
entries.translated:
Hmmm. Intiku tidak akan berubah.
Kuharap kamu menjualnya padaku\lsuatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet
deal for ya!

You know how Pokémon like to hide
behind stones or rocks, yeah?

Sometimes they hide cool bones,
too.

If you find a [green]Rare Bone[blue] somewhere,
you should bring it to me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet deal for ya! You know how Pokémon like to hide behind stones or rocks, yeah? Sometimes they hide cool bones, too. If you find a [green]Rare Bone[blue] somewhere, you should bring it to me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Hei, lihat ini. Aku punya tawaran
menguntungkan untukmu! Kamu tahu\lbagaimana Pokémon suka bersembunyi

di balik batu atau bebatuan, kan?
Kadang mereka juga menyembunyikan\ltulang keren. Jika kamu menemukan

[green]Rare Bone[blue] di suatu tempat, kamu
harus membawanya padaku. Aku akan\lmembuatnya sepadan.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Did you find a [green]Rare Bone[blue] for me?

Looks like you did.

If you want to sell it, I’ll buy
it from you for $[green]10000[blue]."
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Did you find a [green]Rare Bone[blue] for me? Looks like you did. If you want to sell it, I’ll buy it from you for $[green]10000[blue].
entries.translated:
Ada apa? Apakah kamu menemukan [green]Rare
Bone[blue] untukku? Sepertinya kamu\lmenemukannya. Jika kamu ingin

menjualnya, aku akan membelinya
darimu seharga $[green]10000[blue].

entries.original:
"If you find any more Rare Bones
come see me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: If you find any more Rare Bones come see me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu menemukan Rare Bone lagi,
temui aku. Aku akan membuatnya\lsepadan.

entries.original:
"Hey, come see me if you find a
Rare Bone, got it?

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, come see me if you find a Rare Bone, got it? I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Hei, temui aku jika kamu menemukan
Rare Bone, mengerti? Aku akan\lmembuatnya sepadan.

entries.original:
"Ha hoo!
You have a Pokédex.

How many Pokémon have you found?"
entries.translation_source: Ha hoo! You have a Pokédex. How many Pokémon have you found?
entries.translated:
Ha hoo! Kamu punya Pokédex. Berapa
banyak Pokémon yang sudah kamu\ltemukan?

entries.original:
"Hoo ha! You’ve found [buffer1] or more!
Now we’re talking! This is for you!"
entries.translation_source: Hoo ha! You’ve found [buffer1] or more! Now we’re talking! This is for you!
entries.translated:
Hoo ha! Kamu sudah menemukan
[buffer1] atau lebih! Nah, itu baru\lnamanya! Ini untukmu!

entries.original:
"Hoo ha!
You’ve only found [green][buffer2][blue].

Come show me your Pokédex again
when you’ve found at least [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Hoo ha! You’ve only found [green][buffer2][blue]. Come show me your Pokédex again when you’ve found at least [green][buffer1][blue].
entries.translated:
Hoo ha! Kamu hanya menemukan
[green][buffer2][blue]. Datang tunjukkan\lPokédex-mu lagi ketika kamu sudah

menemukan setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"A Pokémon holding a [green]Binding Band[blue]
can do more continuous damage with\lits trapping moves.

But what’s more important is this.

Have you shown your Pokédex to a
professor?"
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon holding a [green]Binding Band[blue] can do more continuous damage with its trapping moves. But what’s more important is this. Have you shown your Pokédex to a professor?
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang memegang [green]Binding Band[blue]
dapat memberikan kerusakan\lberkelanjutan lebih besar dengan

gerakan menjebaknya. Tapi yang
lebih penting adalah ini. Apakah\lkamu sudah menunjukkan Pokédex-mu

ke seorang profesor?

entries.original:
"Yawn\.

Raising so many Pokémon from the
Sinnoh region is exhausting\.

Oh!

You seem like a strong Trainer!

How would you like to raise one
for me?"
entries.translation_source: Yawn\. Raising so many Pokémon from the Sinnoh region is exhausting\. Oh! You seem like a strong Trainer! How would you like to raise one for me?
entries.translated:
Menguap\. Membesarkan begitu banyak
Pokémon dari wilayah Sinnoh sangat\lmelelahkan\. Oh! Kamu terlihat

seperti Pelatih yang kuat!
Bagaimana jika kamu membesarkan\lsatu untukku?

entries.original:
"Yawn\.

Raising so many Pokémon from the
Sinnoh region is exhausting\.

Which of my Pokémon would you like?"
entries.translation_source: Yawn\. Raising so many Pokémon from the Sinnoh region is exhausting\. Which of my Pokémon would you like?
entries.translated:
Menguap\. Membesarkan begitu banyak
Pokémon dari wilayah Sinnoh sangat\lmelelahkan\. Pokémon mana yang kamu

inginkan?

entries.original:
"Oh, alright.

I’ll just have to keep struggling,
then."
entries.translation_source: Oh, alright. I’ll just have to keep struggling, then.
entries.translated:
Oh, baiklah. Aku harus terus
berjuang, kalau begitu.

entries.original:
"I’m so exhausted\.

But you’re in no state to help me
with a full party of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m so exhausted\. But you’re in no state to help me with a full party of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat lelah\. Tapi kamu tidak
dalam kondisi membantu saya dengan\lparty Pokémon yang penuh.

entries.original:
"Please raise it well!

If you come back when you have [green][buffer1]
Badges[red], I’ll give you another."
entries.translation_source: Please raise it well! If you come back when you have [green][buffer1] Badges[red], I’ll give you another.
entries.translated:
Mohon besarkan dengan baik! Jika
kamu kembali ketika kamu memiliki\l[green][buffer1] Badges[red], aku akan memberimu

satu lagi.

entries.original:
"I have been able to get much more
rest now that I have fewer Pokémon\lto look after!

Thank you for that, Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: I have been able to get much more rest now that I have fewer Pokémon to look after! Thank you for that, Trainer!
entries.translated:
Aku bisa mendapatkan lebih banyak
istirahat sekarang karena aku\lmemiliki lebih sedikit Pokémon yang

harus diurus! Terima kasih untuk
itu, Pelatih!

entries.original:
"[black]Oh! The Pokémon has something in
its mouth."
entries.translation_source: [black]Oh! The Pokémon has something in its mouth.
entries.translated:
[black]Oh! Pokémon itu memiliki sesuatu di
mulutnya.

entries.original: "[green]Ooh ooh!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Ooh ooh!
entries.translated: [green]Ooh ooh!

entries.original:
"Hiya!

My grandmother has a business of
teaching Pokémon a move in\lexchange for some Yellow Shards.

If you haven’t had a chance to find
any, let me help you out."
entries.translation_source: Hiya! My grandmother has a business of teaching Pokémon a move in exchange for some Yellow Shards. If you haven’t had a chance to find any, let me help you out.
entries.translated:
Haiya! Nenekku memiliki bisnis
mengajari Pokémon suatu jurus\ldengan imbalan beberapa Yellow

Shards. Jika kamu belum sempat
menemukannya, biarkan aku\lmembantumu.

entries.original:
"You’ll be able to shock your
enemies when you learn her move!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll be able to shock your enemies when you learn her move!
entries.translated:
Kamu akan bisa menyetrum
musuh-musuhmu saat kamu mempelajari\ljurusnya!

entries.original:
"Hello there, dearie.

From my many years as a Pokémon
expert, I have gained the ability\lto teach the move, [green]Thunder Punch[red].

However, if you wish for me to
teach one of your Pokémon this\lmove, it’ll cost [green]2 Yellow Shards[red].

What do you say?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, dearie. From my many years as a Pokémon expert, I have gained the ability to teach the move, [green]Thunder Punch[red]. However, if you wish for me to teach one of your Pokémon this move, it’ll cost [green]2 Yellow Shards[red]. What do you say?
entries.translated:
Halo, sayang. Dari bertahun-tahun
sebagai ahli Pokémon, aku telah\lmemperoleh kemampuan untuk

mengajari jurus [green]Thunder Punch[red].
Namun, jika kamu ingin aku\lmengajari salah satu Pokémon-mu

jurus ini, biayanya [green]2 Yellow
Shards[red]. Bagaimana?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should learn
[green]Thunder Punch[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should learn [green]Thunder Punch[red]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang harus mempelajari
[green]Thunder Punch[red]?

entries.original:
"Please, return as many times
as you wish.

As long as you have [green]Yellow Shards[red],
of course."
entries.translation_source: Please, return as many times as you wish. As long as you have [green]Yellow Shards[red], of course.
entries.translated:
Silakan, kembalilah sebanyak yang
Anda mau. Selama Anda memiliki\l[green]Pecahan Kuning[red], tentu saja.

entries.original:
"It appears that you do not have
any Yellow Shards.

You can find them popping up
occassionally in the Great Desert.

If you come back with any, I’ll be
happy to teach your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It appears that you do not have any Yellow Shards. You can find them popping up occassionally in the Great Desert. If you come back with any, I’ll be happy to teach your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda tidak memiliki
Pecahan Kuning. Anda dapat\lmenemukannya sesekali muncul di

Gurun Besar. Jika Anda kembali
dengan membawanya, saya akan dengan\lsenang hati mengajari Pokémon Anda.

entries.original:
"I am a balloon man!

And I wish to see a balloon
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I am a balloon man! And I wish to see a balloon Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Saya adalah pria balon! Dan saya
ingin melihat Pokémon balon!

entries.original:
"Yes! That is it!

Now, I’ll give this to you!
I’ll give you the item, Air Balloon!"
entries.translation_source: Yes! That is it! Now, I’ll give this to you! I’ll give you the item, Air Balloon!
entries.translated:
Ya! Itu dia! Sekarang, saya akan
memberikan ini kepada Anda! Saya\lakan memberi Anda item, Balon

Udara!

entries.original:
"A Pokémon who has an [green]Air Balloon[blue]
can float!

Until it gets hurt, it can avoid
[green]Ground[blue]-type moves.

Yes!
I am a balloon man!"
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon who has an [green]Air Balloon[blue] can float! Until it gets hurt, it can avoid [green]Ground[blue]-type moves. Yes! I am a balloon man!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang memiliki [green]Balon Udara[blue]
dapat melayang! Sampai dia terluka,\ldia bisa menghindari jurus [green]Tanah[blue].

Ya! Saya adalah pria balon!

entries.original: "I am a balloon man!"
entries.translation_source: I am a balloon man!
entries.translated: Saya adalah pria balon!

entries.original:
"No!
I wish to see a balloon Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: No! I wish to see a balloon Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Saya ingin melihat Pokémon
balon!

entries.original:
"Let me tell ya something, young
feller.

To the east of here is a
vast desert.

It is so amazing, that it is
simply called the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Words can’t even begin to
describe it!

However, it’s really difficult to
traverse without the proper gear.

So don’t think ya can just waltz
out there without preppin’ first.

Yer outfit seems a little hot
for the desert, but it’ll do ya a\lgood job of protecting yer body.

As for yer eyes, I’d recommend
getting yerself a good pair of\l[green]Go-Goggles[blue].

In fact, I’d actually be willing to
give ya mine if ya can show me how\lstrong ya are by [green]beatin’ the Gym[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Let me tell ya something, young feller. To the east of here is a vast desert. It is so amazing, that it is simply called the [green]Great Desert[blue]. Words can’t even begin to describe it! However, it’s really difficult to traverse without the proper gear. So don’t think ya can just waltz out there without preppin’ first. Yer outfit seems a little hot for the desert, but it’ll do ya a good job of protecting yer body. As for yer eyes, I’d recommend getting yerself a good pair of [green]Go-Goggles[blue]. In fact, I’d actually be willing to give ya mine if ya can show me how strong ya are by [green]beatin’ the Gym[blue].
entries.translated:
Biarkan saya memberi tahu Anda
sesuatu, anak muda. Di sebelah\ltimur sini ada gurun yang luas.

Sangat menakjubkan sehingga disebut
[green]Gurun Besar[blue]. Kata-kata tidak bisa\lmenggambarkannya! Namun, sangat

sulit untuk melintasinya tanpa
perlengkapan yang tepat. Jadi\ljangan berpikir Anda bisa begitu

saja berjalan-jalan di sana tanpa
persiapan. Pakaian Anda terlihat\lagak panas untuk gurun, tapi itu

akan melindungi tubuh Anda dengan
baik. Untuk mata Anda, saya\lsarankan Anda mendapatkan [green]Kacamata

Go[blue] yang bagus. Bahkan, saya
bersedia memberikan milik saya jika\lAnda bisa menunjukkan seberapa kuat

Anda dengan [green]mengalahkan Gym[blue].

entries.original:
"Never mind, looks ya already beat
it.

Great job!

Take these Go-Goggles, and explore
the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Never mind, looks ya already beat it. Great job! Take these Go-Goggles, and explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Sudahlah, sepertinya Anda sudah
mengalahkannya. Kerja bagus! Ambil\lKacamata Go ini, dan jelajahi Gurun

Besar!

entries.original:
"Go young feller!

Explore the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Go young feller! Explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Pergilah anak muda! Jelajahi Gurun
Besar!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!

I’m Skeli, the main developer of
Pokémon Unbound.

I’m glad you took the time to play
up to this point!

Keep playing, and if you defeat
the Pokémon League, I’d love\lto battle you!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Skeli, the main developer of Pokémon Unbound. I’m glad you took the time to play up to this point! Keep playing, and if you defeat the Pokémon League, I’d love to battle you!
entries.translated:
Halo! Saya Skeli, pengembang utama
Pokémon Unbound. Saya senang Anda\lmeluangkan waktu untuk bermain

sampai titik ini! Teruslah bermain,
dan jika Anda mengalahkan Liga\lPokémon, saya ingin bertarung

dengan Anda!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!

I’m Skeli, the main developer of
Pokémon Unbound.

I’m glad you took the time to
complete the game and continue\lexploring!

You wanna have a battle?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Skeli, the main developer of Pokémon Unbound. I’m glad you took the time to complete the game and continue exploring! You wanna have a battle?
entries.translated:
Halo! Saya Skeli, pengembang utama
Pokémon Unbound. Saya senang Anda\lmeluangkan waktu untuk

menyelesaikan game dan terus
menjelajah! Anda ingin bertarung?

entries.original:
"Sweet!

I’m warning you, though, this isn’t
going to be easy!"
entries.translation_source: Sweet! I’m warning you, though, this isn’t going to be easy!
entries.translated:
Mantap! Tapi saya peringatkan, ini
tidak akan mudah!

entries.original:
"Sweet!

Let’s have ourselves a
Double Battle today!

I’m warning you, though, this isn’t
going to be easy!"
entries.translation_source: Sweet! Let’s have ourselves a Double Battle today! I’m warning you, though, this isn’t going to be easy!
entries.translated:
Mantap! Mari kita lakukan
Pertarungan Ganda hari ini! Tapi\lsaya peringatkan, ini tidak akan

mudah!

entries.original:
"Sure, no prob.

If you wanna battle me, I’ll still
be here."
entries.translation_source: Sure, no prob. If you wanna battle me, I’ll still be here.
entries.translated:
Tentu, tidak masalah. Jika Anda
ingin bertarung dengan saya, saya\lmasih akan di sini.

entries.original:
"Oh, you don’t have enough Pokémon
to battle me today.

On even dates I like to battle two
on two, so you’ll need more."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you don’t have enough Pokémon to battle me today. On even dates I like to battle two on two, so you’ll need more.
entries.translated:
Oh, Anda tidak memiliki cukup
Pokémon untuk bertarung dengan saya\lhari ini. Pada tanggal genap saya

suka bertarung dua lawan dua, jadi
Anda perlu lebih banyak.

entries.original:
"That was a fun battle!
You were a tough opponent!

Come again tomorrow for another
battle!"
entries.translation_source: That was a fun battle! You were a tough opponent! Come again tomorrow for another battle!
entries.translated:
Itu pertarungan yang menyenangkan!
Anda lawan yang tangguh! Datang\llagi besok untuk pertarungan lain!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!
I’m Golche!

The strategies of the Trainers
you faced?

I helped design them!

If you can defeat the Pokémon
League, I’d even be willing to\lshow you my own strategies!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Golche! The strategies of the Trainers you faced? I helped design them! If you can defeat the Pokémon League, I’d even be willing to show you my own strategies!
entries.translated:
Halo! Saya Golche! Strategi Pelatih
yang Anda hadapi? Saya membantu\lmerancangnya! Jika Anda bisa

mengalahkan Liga Pokémon, saya
bahkan bersedia menunjukkan\lstrategi saya sendiri!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!
I’m Golche!

The strategies of the Trainers
you faced?

I helped design them!

If you want, I’m willing to show
you my own strategy."
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Golche! The strategies of the Trainers you faced? I helped design them! If you want, I’m willing to show you my own strategy.
entries.translated:
Halo! Saya Golche! Strategi Pelatih
yang Anda hadapi? Saya membantu\lmerancangnya! Jika mau, saya

bersedia menunjukkan strategi saya
sendiri.

entries.original:
"Time to face off against the
ultimate strategy!"
entries.translation_source: Time to face off against the ultimate strategy!
entries.translated:
Waktunya berhadapan dengan strategi
pamungkas!

entries.original:
"No pressure.

Take your time coming up against a
way to combat my strategy."
entries.translation_source: No pressure. Take your time coming up against a way to combat my strategy.
entries.translated:
Tidak usah terburu-buru. Ambil
waktumu mencari cara untuk melawan\lstrategiku.

entries.original:
"Your strategy was something else!

Let me refine mine, and we can
battle again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: Your strategy was something else! Let me refine mine, and we can battle again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Strategimu luar biasa! Biarkan aku
menyempurnakanku, dan kita bisa\lbertarung lagi besok!

entries.original:
"I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer\.
Thanasis!

It’s thanks to me, you were even
able to get up to this point!

I found and fixed a ton of bugs.

Not to mention, I tested the entire
battle engine from start to finish!

You’re welcome!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer\. Thanasis! It’s thanks to me, you were even able to get up to this point! I found and fixed a ton of bugs. Not to mention, I tested the entire battle engine from start to finish! You’re welcome!
entries.translated:
Aku Pelatih Pokémon warisan\.
Thanasis! Berkat aku, kamu bahkan\lbisa sampai sejauh ini! Aku

menemukan dan memperbaiki banyak
bug. Belum lagi, aku menguji\lseluruh mesin pertarungan dari awal

hingga akhir! Sama-sama!

entries.original:
"I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer\.
Thanasis!

It’s thanks to me, you were even
able to get up to this point!

I found and fixed a ton of bugs.

Not to mention I tested the entire
battle engine from start to finish!

Do you want to sample what the
battle engine is capable of by\lbattling Lixdel and me?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer\. Thanasis! It’s thanks to me, you were even able to get up to this point! I found and fixed a ton of bugs. Not to mention I tested the entire battle engine from start to finish! Do you want to sample what the battle engine is capable of by battling Lixdel and me?
entries.translated:
Aku Pelatih Pokémon warisan\.
Thanasis! Berkat aku, kamu bahkan\lbisa sampai sejauh ini! Aku

menemukan dan memperbaiki banyak
bug. Belum lagi aku menguji seluruh\lmesin pertarungan dari awal hingga

akhir! Apakah kamu ingin mencoba
apa yang bisa dilakukan mesin\lpertarungan dengan bertarung

melawan Lixdel dan aku?

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, we can’t battle you
unless you have two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, we can’t battle you unless you have two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Sayangnya, kami tidak bisa
bertarung denganmu kecuali kamu\lmemiliki dua Pokémon!

entries.original:
"The legacy Pokémon Trainer\.
Is ready to begin his battle!"
entries.translation_source: The legacy Pokémon Trainer\. Is ready to begin his battle!
entries.translated:
Pelatih Pokémon warisan\. Siap
memulai pertarungannya!

entries.original:
"No?
Your loss."
entries.translation_source: No? Your loss.
entries.translated: Tidak? Rugi sendiri.

entries.original:
"You see?

That battle was only possible
because I helped make sure it\lwas bug-free!

Let’s do this again some other
day."
entries.translation_source: You see? That battle was only possible because I helped make sure it was bug-free! Let’s do this again some other day.
entries.translated:
Lihat? Pertarungan itu hanya
mungkin karena aku membantu\lmemastikannya bebas bug! Ayo

lakukan ini lagi lain hari.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
I’m Lixdel!

I created a large chunk of those
beautiful attack animations you’ve\lbeen seeing."
entries.translation_source: What’s up? I’m Lixdel! I created a large chunk of those beautiful attack animations you’ve been seeing.
entries.translated:
Ada apa? Aku Lixdel! Aku
menciptakan sebagian besar animasi\lserangan indah yang kamu lihat.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
I’m Lixdel!

I created a large chunk of those
beautiful attack animations you’ve\lbeen seeing.

Do you want to experience some by
battling Thanasis and me?"
entries.translation_source: What’s up? I’m Lixdel! I created a large chunk of those beautiful attack animations you’ve been seeing. Do you want to experience some by battling Thanasis and me?
entries.translated:
Ada apa? Aku Lixdel! Aku
menciptakan sebagian besar animasi\lserangan indah yang kamu lihat.

Apakah kamu ingin merasakan
beberapa di antaranya dengan\lbertarung melawan Thanasis dan aku?

entries.original:
"Sorry, you can’t battle us without
two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry, you can’t battle us without two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Maaf, kamu tidak bisa bertarung
melawan kami tanpa dua Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Let us show you some beautiful
animations!"
entries.translation_source: Let us show you some beautiful animations!
entries.translated:
Biarkan kami menunjukkan beberapa
animasi indah!

entries.original: "Not ready yet, huh?"
entries.translation_source: Not ready yet, huh?
entries.translated: Belum siap, ya?

entries.original:
"That was a great battle with some
great animations!

Come back tomorrow and we can do
this again!"
entries.translation_source: That was a great battle with some great animations! Come back tomorrow and we can do this again!
entries.translated:
Itu adalah pertarungan yang hebat
dengan beberapa animasi yang hebat!\lKembali besok dan kita bisa lakukan

ini lagi!

entries.original:
"Hi there, I’m Criminon!

I dedicated countless hours to a
ton of the art that you’ve seen.

I’ve sprited Trainers, Pokémon,
interfaces, and much much more.

The hardest thing that I worked on
was definitely the Costume Box.

It was so much work!

I would say my favourite thing that
I did is Cube Space!

I hope you enjoyed it!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, I’m Criminon! I dedicated countless hours to a ton of the art that you’ve seen. I’ve sprited Trainers, Pokémon, interfaces, and much much more. The hardest thing that I worked on was definitely the Costume Box. It was so much work! I would say my favourite thing that I did is Cube Space! I hope you enjoyed it!
entries.translated:
Halo, aku Criminon! Aku mencurahkan
waktu yang tak terhitung jumlahnya\luntuk banyak seni yang telah kamu

lihat. Aku membuat sprite Pelatih,
Pokémon, antarmuka, dan masih\lbanyak lagi. Hal tersulit yang aku

kerjakan pastinya adalah Kotak
Kostum. Itu sangat banyak\lpekerjaan! Menurutku hal favorit

yang aku lakukan adalah Cube Space!
Semoga kamu menikmatinya!

entries.original:
"Hi there, I’m Criminon!

I dedicated countless hours to a
ton of the art that you’ve seen.

I can’t show you my favorite Pokémon
just yet, but how about you try\lthis team on for size!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, I’m Criminon! I dedicated countless hours to a ton of the art that you’ve seen. I can’t show you my favorite Pokémon just yet, but how about you try this team on for size!
entries.translated:
Halo, aku Criminon! Aku mencurahkan
waktu yang tak terhitung jumlahnya\luntuk banyak seni yang telah kamu

lihat. Aku belum bisa menunjukkan
Pokémon favoritku, tetapi bagaimana\lkalau kamu coba tim ini?

entries.original: "Now, watch as you get stalled out!"
entries.translation_source: Now, watch as you get stalled out!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, saksikan saat kamu
terjebak!

entries.original:
"Yeah, I knew you wouldn’t be able
to handle it.

Toxic stall teams are the best!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, I knew you wouldn’t be able to handle it. Toxic stall teams are the best!
entries.translated:
Ya, aku tahu kamu tidak akan bisa
mengatasinya. Tim Toxic stall\ladalah yang terbaik!

entries.original:
"I’m gonna get back to training and
toughen up my team!

I’ll show you how much better I’ll
be tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: I’m gonna get back to training and toughen up my team! I’ll show you how much better I’ll be tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Aku akan kembali berlatih dan
memperkuat timku! Akan kutunjukkan\lbetapa lebih baiknya aku besok!

entries.original: "Dr. Fuji"
entries.translation_source: Dr. Fuji
entries.translated: Dr. Fuji

entries.original:
"The name’s Fuji.

I made the maps from Seaport City
to Cootes Bog.

And not only that, I’m largely
to thank for the game being done!

Crystal Peak was the last big
obstacle in Skeli’s way, and if I\lhadn’t created the tileset for it,\lthe game never would have been\lfinished!"
entries.translation_source: The name’s Fuji. I made the maps from Seaport City to Cootes Bog. And not only that, I’m largely to thank for the game being done! Crystal Peak was the last big obstacle in Skeli’s way, and if I hadn’t created the tileset for it, the game never would have been finished!
entries.translated:
Namaku Fuji. Aku membuat peta dari
Seaport City hingga Cootes Bog. Dan\lbukan hanya itu, aku yang paling

layak disyukuri karena game ini
selesai! Crystal Peak adalah\lrintangan besar terakhir di jalan

Skeli, dan jika aku tidak membuat
tileset untuknya, game ini tidak\lakan pernah selesai!

entries.original: "Sound Director"
entries.translation_source: Sound Director
entries.translated: Direktur Suara

entries.original:
"I’m the Sound Director!

I make sure all of the music works
properly!

Did you know a whopping 17 people
worked on the completely original\lsoundtrack and custom instruments?

I hope you’ve been enjoying all of
the music so far!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Sound Director! I make sure all of the music works properly! Did you know a whopping 17 people worked on the completely original soundtrack and custom instruments? I hope you’ve been enjoying all of the music so far!
entries.translated:
Aku adalah Direktur Suara! Aku
memastikan semua musik berfungsi\ldengan baik! Tahukah kamu bahwa

sebanyak 17 orang mengerjakan
soundtrack orisinal dan instrumen\lkustom? Aku harap kamu menikmati

semua musik sejauh ini!

entries.original: "Kwen"
entries.translation_source: Kwen
entries.translated: Kwen

entries.original:
"Hi, I’m Kwen.

Being an amateur fashion designer
is a huge hassle\. deadlines just\lkeep piling up!

I left my career as a Trainer to
tailor Aklove’s clothes\.
