No-one else would be living here, in the Distortion World? Ha ha\. that’s true, but my friend is a special case\. But if he hasn’t shown up by now, then he’s probably not going to ever arrive\. Not unlikely - it’s not as though time passes here, not really. Say\. You must be very strong, if you can come here of your own free will. It may be a bit odd, considering where we are right now, but could you battle me?
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, di sana\. Aku Nex. Um\. apa
yang sebenarnya kamu lakukan di\lsini? Aku sendiri sedang menunggu

seorang teman datang, tapi\. Maaf?
Tidak ada orang lain yang tinggal\ldi sini, di Distortion World? Ha ha\.

itu benar, tapi temanku adalah
kasus khusus\. Tapi jika dia belum\lmuncul sampai sekarang, kemungkinan

dia tidak akan pernah datang\. Tidak
mustahil - ini bukan tempat di mana\lwaktu berjalan, sungguh. Katakanlah\.

Kamu pasti sangat kuat, jika bisa
datang ke sini atas kemauan\lsendiri. Mungkin agak aneh,

mengingat di mana kita sekarang,
tapi bisakah kamu bertarung\ldenganku?

entries.original:
"Show me the strength that lets you
connect yourself to this world!"
entries.translation_source: Show me the strength that lets you connect yourself to this world!
entries.translated:
Tunjukkan padaku kekuatan yang
membuatmu terhubung dengan dunia\lini!

entries.original:
"I see\.

I thought Giratina must have been
defeated, from the change in\lstructure of this world.

But if that’s how strong you are, I
can understand how.

In that case, here - take this."
entries.translation_source: I see\. I thought Giratina must have been defeated, from the change in structure of this world. But if that’s how strong you are, I can understand how. In that case, here - take this.
entries.translated:
Begitu\. Aku pikir Giratina pasti
sudah dikalahkan, dari perubahan\lstruktur dunia ini. Tapi jika

sekuat itu dirimu, aku bisa
mengerti bagaimana. Kalau begitu,\lini - ambil ini.

entries.original:
"That allows Giratina to retain its
true form, even when it must stray\loutside the Distortion World.

I planned on delivering it to
someone, but I guess since he’s not\lhere, I should give it to someone\lworthy, at least.

I should be getting back to my own
world now.

Thanks for the battle - I had fun."
entries.translation_source: That allows Giratina to retain its true form, even when it must stray outside the Distortion World. I planned on delivering it to someone, but I guess since he’s not here, I should give it to someone worthy, at least. I should be getting back to my own world now. Thanks for the battle - I had fun.
entries.translated:
Itu memungkinkan Giratina
mempertahankan bentuk aslinya,\lbahkan saat harus berada di luar

Distortion World. Aku berencana
memberikannya kepada seseorang,\ltapi karena dia tidak di sini,

sebaiknya aku memberikannya kepada
seseorang yang layak, setidaknya.\lAku harus kembali ke duniaku

sekarang. Terima kasih untuk
pertarungannya - aku\lbersenang-senang.

entries.original:
"I understand\. this world isn’t meant
for others\. only that Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: I understand\. this world isn’t meant for others\. only that Pokémon\.
entries.translated:
Aku mengerti\. dunia ini bukan untuk
yang lain\. hanya Pokémon itu\.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, but you can’t go in here
right now.

My grandfather is taking his daily
nap and doesn’t want anyone to\ldisturb him.

Try taking on the [green]Dresco Town Gym[blue]
while you’re waiting.

It’s pretty foggy in there, so a
Pokémon with a weather changing\lmove like [green]Sandstorm[blue] or [green]Defog[blue] could\lreally help you out.

Now that I think about it, one of
my grandfather’s friends was\ltrying to trade away a [green]Ducklett[blue]\lwith Defog, recently\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, but you can’t go in here right now. My grandfather is taking his daily nap and doesn’t want anyone to disturb him. Try taking on the [green]Dresco Town Gym[blue] while you’re waiting. It’s pretty foggy in there, so a Pokémon with a weather changing move like [green]Sandstorm[blue] or [green]Defog[blue] could really help you out. Now that I think about it, one of my grandfather’s friends was trying to trade away a [green]Ducklett[blue] with Defog, recently\.
entries.translated:
Maaf, kamu tidak bisa masuk ke sini
sekarang. Kakekku sedang tidur\lsiang dan tidak ingin diganggu.

Coba tantang [green]Dresco Town Gym[blue] sambil
menunggu. Di dalamnya cukup\lberkabut, jadi Pokémon dengan jurus

pengubah cuaca seperti [green]Sandstorm[blue]
atau [green]Defog[blue] bisa sangat membantu.\lKalau dipikir-pikir, salah satu

teman kakekku baru-baru ini mencoba
menukarkan [green]Ducklett[blue] dengan Defog\.

entries.original:
"Have you noticed all of the adorable
little Pokémon on [green]Route 2[red]?

Many of them only evolve once they
warm up to you.

May I see one of those Pokémon if
you have caught one?"
entries.translation_source: Have you noticed all of the adorable little Pokémon on [green]Route 2[red]? Many of them only evolve once they warm up to you. May I see one of those Pokémon if you have caught one?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu memperhatikan semua
Pokémon kecil yang menggemaskan di\l[green]Route 2[red]? Banyak dari mereka hanya

berevolusi setelah mereka akrab
denganmu. Bolehkah aku melihat\lsalah satu Pokémon itu jika kamu

sudah menangkapnya?

entries.original:
"Which one of your Pokémon evolves
when it warms up to its Trainer?"
entries.translation_source: Which one of your Pokémon evolves when it warms up to its Trainer?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana dari milikmu yang
berevolusi saat ia akrab dengan\lTrainernya?

entries.original:
"Correct! That Pokémon only evolves
once it warms up to you!

The evolution usually takes a
while to happen, though, but if you\llet it hold this, it’ll warm up to\lyou much quicker!"
entries.translation_source: Correct! That Pokémon only evolves once it warms up to you! The evolution usually takes a while to happen, though, but if you let it hold this, it’ll warm up to you much quicker!
entries.translated:
Benar! Pokémon itu hanya berevolusi
setelah ia akrab denganmu! Evolusi\lbiasanya memakan waktu, tapi jika

kamu membiarkannya memegang ini, ia
akan lebih cepat akrab denganmu!

entries.original:
"Many people around Borrius are as
friendly as I am.

So don’t hesitate to talk to
everyone you see!"
entries.translation_source: Many people around Borrius are as friendly as I am. So don’t hesitate to talk to everyone you see!
entries.translated:
Banyak orang di sekitar Borrius
sama ramahnya dengan saya. Jadi\ljangan ragu untuk berbicara dengan

semua orang yang kamu lihat!

entries.original:
"There are plenty of Pokémon on
[green]Route 2[red] that only evolve once they\lwarm up to you.

If you catch one and show it to me,
I’ll give you something nice."
entries.translation_source: There are plenty of Pokémon on [green]Route 2[red] that only evolve once they warm up to you. If you catch one and show it to me, I’ll give you something nice.
entries.translated:
Ada banyak Pokémon di [green]Rute 2[red] yang
hanya berevolusi saat mereka sudah\lakrab denganmu. Jika kamu menangkap

salah satunya dan menunjukkannya
padaku, aku akan memberimu sesuatu\lyang bagus.

entries.original:
"Nope, sorry!

That’s not one of the Pokémon I
was referring to."
entries.translation_source: Nope, sorry! That’s not one of the Pokémon I was referring to.
entries.translated:
Tidak, maaf! Itu bukan salah satu
Pokémon yang kumaksud.

entries.original:
"Nope, sorry!

An Egg isn’t what I was referring
to."
entries.translation_source: Nope, sorry! An Egg isn’t what I was referring to.
entries.translated:
Tidak, maaf! Bukan Telur yang
kumaksud.

entries.original: "Basic Literacy"
entries.translation_source: Basic Literacy
entries.translated: Literasi Dasar

entries.original:
"Can you read?
Not everyone can.

I can’t, and I failed the first
grade a couple of times now.

Can you show me the awesome power
of basic literacy?

Trainer Tips signs should be good
examples for words and such."
entries.translation_source: Can you read? Not everyone can. I can’t, and I failed the first grade a couple of times now. Can you show me the awesome power of basic literacy? Trainer Tips signs should be good examples for words and such.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu bisa membaca? Tidak
semua orang bisa. Aku tidak bisa,\ldan aku sudah beberapa kali gagal

di kelas satu. Bisakah kamu
menunjukkan padaku kekuatan luar\lbiasa dari literasi dasar? Papan

Trainer Tips seharusnya menjadi
contoh yang bagus untuk kata-kata\ldan sebagainya.

entries.original:
"Cool, you’ll need to read all [green][buffer1][blue]
[green]Trainer Tips[blue] signs completely, in\lorder to properly demonstrate this\lpower.

If you walk away before finishing
a sign, I won’t count it!"
entries.translation_source: Cool, you’ll need to read all [green][buffer1][blue] [green]Trainer Tips[blue] signs completely, in order to properly demonstrate this power. If you walk away before finishing a sign, I won’t count it!
entries.translated:
Keren, kamu harus membaca semua
papan [green][buffer1][blue] [green]Trainer Tips[blue]\lsepenuhnya, untuk mendemonstrasikan

kekuatan ini dengan benar. Jika
kamu pergi sebelum menyelesaikan\lsebuah papan, aku tidak akan

menghitungnya!

entries.original:
"I get it, you’re illiterate, too.

We can communicate through 8-bit
sounds, then."
entries.translation_source: I get it, you’re illiterate, too. We can communicate through 8-bit sounds, then.
entries.translated:
Aku mengerti, kamu juga tidak bisa
membaca. Kita bisa berkomunikasi\lmelalui suara 8-bit, kalau begitu.

entries.original:
"You’ve only read [green][buffer2][blue] Trainer Tips
sign\\07 completely.

I still want to see [green][buffer3][blue] more
example\\08 of this awesome power."
entries.translation_source: You’ve only read [green][buffer2][blue] Trainer Tips sign\\07 completely. I still want to see [green][buffer3][blue] more example\\08 of this awesome power.
entries.translated:
Kamu baru membaca [green][buffer2][blue] papan
Trainer Tips\\07 sepenuhnya. Aku masih\lingin melihat [green][buffer3][blue] contoh\\08 lagi

dari kekuatan luar biasa ini.

entries.original:
"Thank you for demonstrating the
ability of basic literacy.

You’ve shown me that it’s overrated,
and I will now drop out of school\land become a punk rocker.

But before I do, take this book.

I think the owner’s name is written on
the inside, but I still can’t read\."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for demonstrating the ability of basic literacy. You’ve shown me that it’s overrated, and I will now drop out of school and become a punk rocker. But before I do, take this book. I think the owner’s name is written on the inside, but I still can’t read\.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah
mendemonstrasikan kemampuan\lliterasi dasar. Kamu telah

menunjukkan padaku bahwa itu
berlebihan, dan aku sekarang akan\lputus sekolah dan menjadi seorang

punk rocker. Tapi sebelum itu,
ambillah buku ini. Sepertinya nama\lpemiliknya tertulis di dalam, tapi

aku masih tidak bisa membaca\.

entries.original:
"Who needs school, when I have the
power of music and angst."
entries.translation_source: Who needs school, when I have the power of music and angst.
entries.translated:
Siapa yang butuh sekolah, ketika
aku memiliki kekuatan musik dan\lkegelisahan.

entries.original:
"Look, look!

I can see Dehara City from here!

It’s so close by, there isn’t even
a route separating it from here!"
entries.translation_source: Look, look! I can see Dehara City from here! It’s so close by, there isn’t even a route separating it from here!
entries.translated:
Lihat, lihat! Aku bisa melihat
Dehara City dari sini! Jaraknya\lsangat dekat, bahkan tidak ada rute

yang memisahkannya dari sini!

entries.original:
"Have you visited the Dresco Town
[green]Trainer House[blue] yet?

It’s the black and blue building at
the south end of town.

You can battle the Trainers there
as much as you want.

I even hear the Trainers can get
stronger as you do."
entries.translation_source: Have you visited the Dresco Town [green]Trainer House[blue] yet? It’s the black and blue building at the south end of town. You can battle the Trainers there as much as you want. I even hear the Trainers can get stronger as you do.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah mengunjungi [green]Rumah
Pelatih[blue] di Dresco Town? Itu adalah\lbangunan hitam dan biru di ujung

selatan kota. Kamu bisa bertarung
dengan para Pelatih di sana\lsebanyak yang kamu mau. Aku dengar

para Pelatih bisa menjadi lebih
kuat seiring denganmu.

entries.original:
"This statue is of the legendary
fiery bird Pokémon, Moltres.

Apparently it lives somewhere in
[green]Cinder Volcano[red], lighting up the sky\lwith its flames at night."
entries.translation_source: This statue is of the legendary fiery bird Pokémon, Moltres. Apparently it lives somewhere in [green]Cinder Volcano[red], lighting up the sky with its flames at night.
entries.translated:
Patung ini adalah patung Pokémon
burung api legendaris, Moltres.\lRupanya ia tinggal di suatu tempat

di [green]Gunung Berapi Cinder[red], menerangi
langit dengan apinya di malam hari.

entries.original:
"You see that yellow Poké Ball
down there?

It’s a [green]TM[red], a special kind of move
you can teach to your Pokémon as\lmany times as you want!

If you get one, just open up the
TM Case and look for the move you\lwant to teach.

Pokémon in your party that can
learn the move will be highlighted\las you search.

That means you won’t need to check
your team each time you want to\lteach one!"
entries.translation_source: You see that yellow Poké Ball down there? It’s a [green]TM[red], a special kind of move you can teach to your Pokémon as many times as you want! If you get one, just open up the TM Case and look for the move you want to teach. Pokémon in your party that can learn the move will be highlighted as you search. That means you won’t need to check your team each time you want to teach one!
entries.translated:
Kamu melihat Poké Ball kuning di
bawah sana? Itu adalah [green]TM[red], jenis\ljurus khusus yang bisa kamu ajarkan

ke Pokémon-mu sebanyak yang kamu
mau! Jika kamu mendapatkannya, buka\lsaja TM Case dan cari jurus yang

ingin kamu ajarkan. Pokémon di
timmu yang bisa mempelajari jurus\litu akan disorot saat kamu mencari.

Itu berarti kamu tidak perlu
memeriksa timmu setiap kali kamu\lingin mengajarkan satu!

entries.original:
"If you get a [green]TM[red], just open up the
TM Case and look for the move you\lwant to teach.

Pokémon in your party that can
learn the move will be highlighted\las you search.

That means you won’t need to check
your team each time you want to\lteach one!"
entries.translation_source: If you get a [green]TM[red], just open up the TM Case and look for the move you want to teach. Pokémon in your party that can learn the move will be highlighted as you search. That means you won’t need to check your team each time you want to teach one!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mendapatkan [green]TM[red], buka saja
TM Case dan cari jurus yang ingin\lkamu ajarkan. Pokémon di timmu yang

bisa mempelajari jurus itu akan
disorot saat kamu mencari. Itu\lberarti kamu tidak perlu memeriksa

timmu setiap kali kamu ingin
mengajarkan satu!

entries.original: "Do you know what a [green]Gem[blue] is?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know what a [green]Gem[blue] is?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu tahu apa itu [green]Permata[blue]?

entries.original:
"A Gem is a special type of held
item that powers up a single attack\lin battle.

Each Gem corresponds to a specific
Type and can only power up that\lType of move.

Gems usually disappear after use,
but like most consumable items,\lthey’re returned to you after\limportant battles, such as battles\lagainst Gym Leaders.

Most Gym Leaders in Borrius have at
least one of their Pokémon holding\la Gem, so be wary.

If you’re concerned about this, you
can use the move [green]Incinerate[blue] to\lmelt their Gem first, before they\lhave a chance to use it."
entries.translation_source: A Gem is a special type of held item that powers up a single attack in battle. Each Gem corresponds to a specific Type and can only power up that Type of move. Gems usually disappear after use, but like most consumable items, they’re returned to you after important battles, such as battles against Gym Leaders. Most Gym Leaders in Borrius have at least one of their Pokémon holding a Gem, so be wary. If you’re concerned about this, you can use the move [green]Incinerate[blue] to melt their Gem first, before they have a chance to use it.
entries.translated:
Permata adalah jenis item yang
dipegang khusus yang memperkuat\lsatu serangan dalam pertempuran.

Setiap Permata sesuai dengan Tipe
tertentu dan hanya bisa memperkuat\ljurus tipe itu. Permata biasanya

hilang setelah digunakan, tetapi
seperti kebanyakan item habis\lpakai, mereka dikembalikan kepadamu

setelah pertempuran penting,
seperti pertempuran melawan\lPemimpin Gym. Kebanyakan Pemimpin

Gym di Borrius memiliki setidaknya
satu Pokémon mereka yang memegang\lPermata, jadi waspadalah. Jika kamu

khawatir tentang ini, kamu bisa
menggunakan jurus [green]Insinerasi[blue] untuk\lmelelehkan Permata mereka terlebih

dahulu, sebelum mereka memiliki
kesempatan untuk menggunakannya.

entries.original: "You must be an experienced Trainer."
entries.translation_source: You must be an experienced Trainer.
entries.translated:
Kamu pasti seorang Pelatih yang
berpengalaman.

entries.original:
"This is a relatively new entrance
to the KBT Expressway.

The bridge to it is still under
construction."
entries.translation_source: This is a relatively new entrance to the KBT Expressway. The bridge to it is still under construction.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah pintu masuk yang relatif
baru ke Jalan Tol KBT. Jembatan\lmenuju ke sana masih dalam

pembangunan.

entries.original:
"To the west of Dresco Town is
Grim Woods.

It’s filled with lots of cool Bug-
and Ghost-type Pokémon.

You should check it out when you
have a chance."
entries.translation_source: To the west of Dresco Town is Grim Woods. It’s filled with lots of cool Bug- and Ghost-type Pokémon. You should check it out when you have a chance.
entries.translated:
Di sebelah barat Dresco Town ada
Grim Woods. Tempat itu dipenuhi\lbanyak Pokémon tipe Serangga dan

Hantu yang keren. Kamu harus mampir
kalau ada kesempatan.

entries.original:
"You, there!

Trainer!

Wait!"
entries.translation_source: You, there! Trainer! Wait!
entries.translated: Hei, kau! Trainer! Tunggu!

entries.original:
"Is that a Super Cube in
your pocket?

\.

It is!

You’re just the person I’ve been
looking for!

Please, come with me."
entries.translation_source: Is that a Super Cube in your pocket? \. It is! You’re just the person I’ve been looking for! Please, come with me.
entries.translated:
Apakah itu Super Cube di sakumu? \.
Iya! Kamulah orang yang selama ini\lkucari! Silakan, ikut aku.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon League is airing a
special on Borrian history.

Would you like to watch it?
(Same as the opening cutscene)"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon League is airing a special on Borrian history. Would you like to watch it? (Same as the opening cutscene)
entries.translated:
Liga Pokémon sedang menayangkan
acara spesial tentang sejarah\lBorria. Apakah kamu ingin

menontonnya? (Sama dengan cutscene
pembukaan)

entries.original:
"Jax,

I have taken your grandfather into
the [green]depths[black] of the [green]Ruins of Void[black].

Come alone if you ever want to
see him again.

-A"
entries.translation_source: Jax, I have taken your grandfather into the [green]depths[black] of the [green]Ruins of Void[black]. Come alone if you ever want to see him again. -A
entries.translated:
Jax, aku telah membawa kakekmu ke
dalam [green]kedalaman[black] [green]Reruntuhan Void[black].\lDatanglah sendiri jika kau ingin

melihatnya lagi. -A

entries.original:
"[player], what a splendid outfit
you’re wearing!

It reminds me of the one I would don
when I was the Champion myself!

Ah, the memories\."
entries.translation_source: [player], what a splendid outfit you’re wearing! It reminds me of the one I would don when I was the Champion myself! Ah, the memories\.
entries.translated:
[player], pakaian yang kamu kenakan
sungguh indah! Itu mengingatkanku\lpada pakaian yang biasa kupakai

saat aku menjadi Champion sendiri!
Ah, kenangan\.

entries.original:
"Hello, Trainer.

Wait\.

Can it be\.

Are you the [buffer2] of the
legendary Trainer, [green]Aros[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hello, Trainer. Wait\. Can it be\. Are you the [buffer2] of the legendary Trainer, [green]Aros[blue]?
entries.translated:
Halo, Trainer. Tunggu\. Mungkinkah\.
Apakah kamu [buffer2] dari Trainer\llegendaris, [green]Aros[blue]?

entries.original:
"You are his [buffer2]!

I knew my eyesight was not
deceiving me!

Your father was, to put it simply,
an amazing man.

I’m sure if you introduced yourself
to people as his [buffer2], you\lwould instantly be regarded with\lmuch affection.

There aren’t many people out there
who have not heard of his exploits.

It’s a shame he disappeared.

If only someone knew what happened
to him, I would finally have a\lsense of closure."
entries.translation_source: You are his [buffer2]! I knew my eyesight was not deceiving me! Your father was, to put it simply, an amazing man. I’m sure if you introduced yourself to people as his [buffer2], you would instantly be regarded with much affection. There aren’t many people out there who have not heard of his exploits. It’s a shame he disappeared. If only someone knew what happened to him, I would finally have a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Kamu adalah [buffer2]-nya! Aku tahu
penglihatanku tidak menipuku!\lAyahmu, secara sederhana, adalah

pria yang luar biasa. Aku yakin
jika kamu memperkenalkan dirimu\lsebagai [buffer2]-nya, kamu akan

langsung disambut dengan penuh
kasih sayang. Tidak banyak orang\lyang belum mendengar tentang

pencapaiannya. Sayang sekali dia
menghilang. Andai saja seseorang\ltahu apa yang terjadi padanya, aku

akhirnya akan merasa tenang.

entries.original:
"If only someone could tell me what
happened to your father\.

It would bring me such a sense
of closure."
entries.translation_source: If only someone could tell me what happened to your father\. It would bring me such a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Andai saja seseorang bisa
memberitahuku apa yang terjadi pada\layahmu\. Itu akan membuatku merasa

sangat tenang.

entries.original:
"What?
You know what happened to Aros?

Please!
You must tell me!

\."
entries.translation_source: What? You know what happened to Aros? Please! You must tell me! \.
entries.translated:
Apa? Kamu tahu apa yang terjadi
pada Aros? Kumohon! Kamu harus\lmemberitahuku! \.

entries.original:
"Inside a Cube!

You’re joking with me!

I refuse to believe it!"
entries.translation_source: Inside a Cube! You’re joking with me! I refuse to believe it!
entries.translated:
Di dalam sebuah Cube! Kamu bercanda
denganku! Aku tidak percaya!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

But I presume you are telling
the truth.

You have no reason to lie to me."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. But I presume you are telling the truth. You have no reason to lie to me.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Tapi aku kira kamu mengatakan
yang sebenarnya. Kamu tidak punya\lalasan untuk berbohong padaku.

entries.original:
"Please, I wish to give you this
item as thanks for bringing me\la sense of closure.

It may not help your father out,
but it should assist you if you\lencounter one of those creatures\lyour father tasked you with\ldismantling."
entries.translation_source: Please, I wish to give you this item as thanks for bringing me a sense of closure. It may not help your father out, but it should assist you if you encounter one of those creatures your father tasked you with dismantling.
entries.translated:
Kumohon, aku ingin memberikan item
ini sebagai ucapan terima kasih\lkarena telah memberiku rasa tenang.

Mungkin tidak bisa membantu ayahmu,
tapi ini akan membantumu jika kamu\lmenemui salah satu makhluk yang

ayahmu tugaskan untuk kamu bongkar.

entries.original:
"Oh.
I could have sworn you were\.

My eyesight must be going in my
old age."
entries.translation_source: Oh. I could have sworn you were\. My eyesight must be going in my old age.
entries.translated:
Oh. Aku bersumpah kamu tadi\.
Penglihatanku pasti mulai menurun\ldi usia tuaku.

entries.original:
"Hello, [buffer2] of Aros.
I hope your travels are going well."
entries.translation_source: Hello, [buffer2] of Aros. I hope your travels are going well.
entries.translated:
Halo, [buffer2] dari Aros. Semoga
perjalananmu berjalan lancar.

entries.original: "Don’t Turn Off the Power"
entries.translation_source: Don’t Turn Off the Power
entries.translated: Jangan Matikan Daya

entries.original:
"Fun fact, did you know that when
you turn off your console without\lsaving, a powerful bomb goes off\land destroys our entire world?

You never notice because a parallel
dimension is created whenever you\lreload.

Please commit to not destroying our
world anymore.

[green][buffer1][blue] times will show your commitment."
entries.translation_source: Fun fact, did you know that when you turn off your console without saving, a powerful bomb goes off and destroys our entire world? You never notice because a parallel dimension is created whenever you reload. Please commit to not destroying our world anymore. [green][buffer1][blue] times will show your commitment.
entries.translated:
Fakta menarik, tahukah kamu bahwa
saat kamu mematikan konsol tanpa\lmenyimpan, sebuah bom kuat meledak

dan menghancurkan seluruh dunia
kita? Kamu tidak pernah\lmenyadarinya karena dimensi paralel

tercipta setiap kali kamu memuat
ulang. Tolong berkomitmen untuk\ltidak menghancurkan dunia kita

lagi. [green][buffer1][blue] kali akan
menunjukkan komitmenmu.

entries.original:
"Thank you for agreeing to not
start armageddon, again.

I will reward you once I see your
commitment of [green][buffer1][blue] manual saves."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for agreeing to not start armageddon, again. I will reward you once I see your commitment of [green][buffer1][blue] manual saves.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah setuju untuk
tidak memulai kiamat lagi. Aku akan\lmemberimu hadiah setelah aku

melihat komitmenmu sebanyak
[green][buffer1][blue] penyimpanan manual.

entries.original:
"Some people just want to watch the
world burn\."
entries.translation_source: Some people just want to watch the world burn\.
entries.translated:
Beberapa orang hanya ingin melihat
dunia terbakar\.

entries.original:
"You have managed to save [green][buffer2][blue]
world\\07.

But I will only believe your
commitment to non-aggression if\lyou save [green][buffer3][blue] more world\\08."
entries.translation_source: You have managed to save [green][buffer2][blue] world\\07. But I will only believe your commitment to non-aggression if you save [green][buffer3][blue] more world\\08.
entries.translated:
Kamu berhasil menyelamatkan
[green][buffer2][blue] dunia\\07. Tapi aku hanya\lakan percaya komitmenmu untuk tidak

agresif jika kamu menyelamatkan
[green][buffer3][blue] dunia lagi\\08.

entries.original:
"Here is your reward for not
destroying our world.

It is a relic of a world that was
destroyed by a selfish child.

Please, don’t let us go through
that again\."
entries.translation_source: Here is your reward for not destroying our world. It is a relic of a world that was destroyed by a selfish child. Please, don’t let us go through that again\.
entries.translated:
Ini hadiahmu karena tidak
menghancurkan dunia kami. Ini\ladalah peninggalan dari dunia yang

dihancurkan oleh seorang anak yang
egois. Tolong, jangan biarkan kami\lmengalaminya lagi\.

entries.original:
"Remember to save before you power
down!

Otherwise we’ll all suffer a slow
and painful demise\."
entries.translation_source: Remember to save before you power down! Otherwise we’ll all suffer a slow and painful demise\.
entries.translated:
Ingat untuk menyimpan sebelum kamu
mematikan! Kalau tidak, kami semua\lakan mengalami kematian yang lambat

dan menyakitkan\.

entries.original:
"Hello, there!

Do you happen to have one of those
rare [green]Ice[blue]-type [green][buffer1][blue]?

I’ve always had trouble getting my
hands on one.

If you do, would you agree to a
trade for my [green][buffer2][blue]?

It’ll be very useful if you plan to
fight in a foggy area."
entries.translation_source: Hello, there! Do you happen to have one of those rare [green]Ice[blue]-type [green][buffer1][blue]? I’ve always had trouble getting my hands on one. If you do, would you agree to a trade for my [green][buffer2][blue]? It’ll be very useful if you plan to fight in a foggy area.
entries.translated:
Halo! Apakah kamu kebetulan
memiliki salah satu [green]Es[blue]-type\l[green][buffer1][blue] yang langka itu? Aku

selalu kesulitan mendapatkannya.
Jika kamu punya, maukah kamu setuju\luntuk bertukar dengan [green][buffer2][blue]

milikku? Itu akan sangat berguna
jika kamu berencana bertarung di\larea berkabut.

entries.original: "Well, if you don’t want to\."
entries.translation_source: Well, if you don’t want to\.
entries.translated: Yah, jika kamu tidak mau\.

entries.original:
"Hmmm?
This isn’t an [green]Ice[blue]-type [green][buffer1][blue].

Think of me if you get one."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm? This isn’t an [green]Ice[blue]-type [green][buffer1][blue]. Think of me if you get one.
entries.translated:
Hmmm? Ini bukan [green]Es[blue]-type [green][buffer1][blue].
Ingat aku jika kamu mendapatkannya.

entries.original:
"Many thanks.

The [buffer2] I traded you knows
[green]Defog[blue], and you can use it to\lremove the fog from the Gym!"
entries.translation_source: Many thanks. The [buffer2] I traded you knows [green]Defog[blue], and you can use it to remove the fog from the Gym!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih banyak. [buffer2] yang
aku tukarkan padamu tahu [green]Kabut[blue], dan\lkamu bisa menggunakannya untuk

menghilangkan kabut dari Gym!

entries.original: "Many thanks."
entries.translation_source: Many thanks.
entries.translated: Terima kasih banyak.

entries.original:
"The [buffer2] that I traded you,
has it helped you out?"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer2] that I traded you, has it helped you out?
entries.translated:
[buffer2] yang aku tukarkan padamu,
apakah itu membantumu?

entries.original:
"Back in his younger days, my
husband travelled the world in\lsearch of rare Pokémon.

Unfortunately, his search was cut
short when he fell victim to an\luntimely illness.

If you have the Pokémon he’s
looking for, would you please\ltrade with him?

The doctor says that it could help
speed up the recovery if you do."
entries.translation_source: Back in his younger days, my husband travelled the world in search of rare Pokémon. Unfortunately, his search was cut short when he fell victim to an untimely illness. If you have the Pokémon he’s looking for, would you please trade with him? The doctor says that it could help speed up the recovery if you do.
entries.translated:
Dulu di masa mudanya, suamiku
berkeliling dunia mencari Pokémon\llangka. Sayangnya, pencariannya

terhenti ketika ia menjadi korban
penyakit yang datang di waktu yang\ltidak tepat. Jika kamu memiliki

Pokémon yang ia cari, maukah kamu
bertukar dengannya? Dokter\lmengatakan bahwa hal itu dapat

membantu mempercepat pemulihan jika
kamu melakukannya.

entries.original:
"Oh, Trainer, thank you for trading
Pokémon with my husband!

It seems that thanks to you, he’ll
soon be making a full recovery from\lhis illness.

Take these as a show of gratitude
for what you’ve done for him!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Trainer, thank you for trading Pokémon with my husband! It seems that thanks to you, he’ll soon be making a full recovery from his illness. Take these as a show of gratitude for what you’ve done for him!
entries.translated:
Oh, Pelatih, terima kasih telah
bertukar Pokémon dengan suamiku!\lSepertinya berkatmu, dia akan

segera pulih sepenuhnya dari
penyakitnya. Ambillah ini sebagai\ltanda terima kasih atas apa yang

telah kamu lakukan untuknya!

entries.original:
"My husband is on his way to making
a full recovery.

Thank you again, Trainer!
We are forever in your debt."
entries.translation_source: My husband is on his way to making a full recovery. Thank you again, Trainer! We are forever in your debt.
entries.translated:
Suamiku sedang dalam proses
pemulihan penuh. Terima kasih lagi,\lPelatih! Kami berhutang budi

selamanya padamu.

entries.original: "Can I help you with something?"
entries.translation_source: Can I help you with something?
entries.translated: Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

entries.original:
"Feel free to battle our Trainers
as many times as you wish.

If you have the urge to rebattle
someone, please leave and then\lcome back inside.

Enjoy your time!"
entries.translation_source: Feel free to battle our Trainers as many times as you wish. If you have the urge to rebattle someone, please leave and then come back inside. Enjoy your time!
entries.translated:
Silakan bertarung dengan Pelatih
kami sebanyak yang kamu mau. Jika\lkamu ingin bertarung lagi dengan

seseorang, silakan keluar lalu
masuk kembali. Nikmati waktumu!

entries.original: "Should I move in front of the door?"
entries.translation_source: Should I move in front of the door?
entries.translated: Haruskah aku pindah ke depan pintu?

entries.original: "Should I move next to the door?"
entries.translation_source: Should I move next to the door?
entries.translated:
Haruskah aku pindah di samping
pintu?

entries.original: "Enjoy your time!"
entries.translation_source: Enjoy your time!
entries.translated: Nikmati waktumu!

entries.original: "Change Position"
entries.translation_source: Change Position
entries.translated: Ubah Posisi

entries.original:
"If you want to battle me again,
leave and come back inside."
entries.translation_source: If you want to battle me again, leave and come back inside.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin bertarung denganku
lagi, keluar dan masuk kembali.

entries.original:
"[red]If you want to battle me again,
leave and come back inside."
entries.translation_source: [red]If you want to battle me again, leave and come back inside.
entries.translated:
[red]Jika kamu ingin bertarung denganku
lagi, keluar dan masuk kembali.

entries.original:
"Whoa, [buffer3]\.

Welcome to the Soil.

Feel free to make yourself at home
as long as you want, [buffer3].

Take in all the good air\."
entries.translation_source: Whoa, [buffer3]\. Welcome to the Soil. Feel free to make yourself at home as long as you want, [buffer3]. Take in all the good air\.
entries.translated:
Whoa, [buffer3]\. Selamat datang di
Soil. Silakan buat dirimu senyaman\lmungkin selama yang kamu mau,

[buffer3]. Hiruplah semua udara baik\.

entries.original:
"I’m the one guy with a clear head
around here.

If you bring me [green]Oddish[blue], I can
harvest the leaves and make some\lgood mist for your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m the one guy with a clear head around here. If you bring me [green]Oddish[blue], I can harvest the leaves and make some good mist for your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Akulah satu-satunya orang yang
berpikiran jernih di sini. Jika kau\lmembawakanku [green]Oddish[blue], aku bisa

memanen daunnya dan membuat kabut
yang bagus untuk Pokémonmu.

entries.original: "Do you have some Oddish for me?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have some Oddish for me?
entries.translated:
Apakah kau punya beberapa Oddish
untukku?

entries.original: "Choose from Party"
entries.translation_source: Choose from Party
entries.translated: Pilih dari Party

entries.original: "All in Party"
entries.translation_source: All in Party
entries.translated: Semua dalam Party

entries.original: "All in PC Box"
entries.translation_source: All in PC Box
entries.translated: Semua dalam PC Box

entries.original: "Which Oddish will you give me?"
entries.translation_source: Which Oddish will you give me?
entries.translated:
Oddish mana yang akan kau berikan
padaku?

entries.original: "You want to give me [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: You want to give me [buffer1]?
entries.translated:
Kau ingin memberikan [buffer1]
padaku?

to the Scientist."

[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer1]
kepada Ilmuwan.

entries.translated:
Kau ingin memberikan Oddish
[green][buffer1][blue] dalam timmu padaku?

"[black][player] handed [buffer1] Oddish over

[buffer1] kepada Ilmuwan.

in Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?"
entries.translation_source: You want to give me the [green][buffer2][blue] Oddish in Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?
entries.translated:
Kau ingin memberikan Oddish
[green][buffer2][blue] di dalam Kotak \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\lpadaku?

"Looks like I have just enough
Oddish now to make some mist for\lyour Pokémon!

Just give me a sec\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like I have just enough Oddish now to make some mist for your Pokémon! Just give me a sec\.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku punya cukup Oddish
sekarang untuk membuat kabut untuk\lPokémonmu! Tunggu sebentar\.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.

That smells nice\.

\.

Uh\. anyway, here you go!"
entries.translation_source: Mmm\. That smells nice\. \. Uh\. anyway, here you go!
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Baunya enak\. \. Uh\. pokoknya, ini
dia!

entries.original:
"That’s [green]Dream Mist[blue].

Have a Pokémon inhale it to unlock
its [green]Hidden Ability[blue].

Just make sure you don’t breathe
it in yourself!"
entries.translation_source: That’s [green]Dream Mist[blue]. Have a Pokémon inhale it to unlock its [green]Hidden Ability[blue]. Just make sure you don’t breathe it in yourself!
entries.translated:
Itu [green]Dream Mist[blue]. Suruh Pokémon
menghirupnya untuk membuka\l[green]Kemampuan Tersembunyi[blue]nya. Pastikan

kau tidak menghirupnya sendiri!

entries.original:
"Welcome back, [player]!

So far you’ve given me [green][buffer2] Oddish[blue].
I need [green][buffer1][blue] to make a special mist\.

Do you want to give me more?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome back, [player]! So far you’ve given me [green][buffer2] Oddish[blue]. I need [green][buffer1][blue] to make a special mist\. Do you want to give me more?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang kembali, [player]!
Sejauh ini kau telah memberikan\l[green][buffer2] Oddish[blue] padaku. Aku butuh

[green][buffer1][blue] untuk membuat kabut
spesial\. Apakah kau ingin memberikan\llebih?

entries.original:
"You’re not the sensible type,
are you?"
entries.translation_source: You’re not the sensible type, are you?
entries.translated: Kau bukan tipe yang bijaksana, ya?

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough Pokémon in
your party to hand over any more\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough Pokémon in your party to hand over any more\.
entries.translated:
Kau tidak punya cukup Pokémon di
timmu untuk menyerahkan lebih\lbanyak\.

entries.original:
"I can’t take those Oddish if you
don’t have at least one other\lPokémon that can battle in your\lparty\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t take those Oddish if you don’t have at least one other Pokémon that can battle in your party\.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa mengambil Oddish itu
jika kau tidak memiliki setidaknya\lsatu Pokémon lain yang bisa

bertarung di timmu\.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Oddish in your
party\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Oddish in your party\.
entries.translated: Kau tidak memiliki Oddish di timmu\.

entries.original:
"I can’t harvest Oddish Leaves
from an Egg\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t harvest Oddish Leaves from an Egg\.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa memanen Daun Oddish
dari Telur\.

entries.original:
"I can’t harvest Oddish Leaves
from that Pokémon.

It’s not an Oddish\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t harvest Oddish Leaves from that Pokémon. It’s not an Oddish\.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa memanen Daun Oddish
dari Pokémon itu. Itu bukan Oddish\.

entries.original:
"I can’t take that Oddish.

You’d have no Pokémon left to
fight with\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t take that Oddish. You’d have no Pokémon left to fight with\.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa mengambil Oddish
itu. Kamu tidak akan punya Pokémon\llagi untuk bertarung\.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Oddish in the
Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Oddish in the Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki Oddish apa pun
di dalam Kotak \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\.

entries.original:
"Bring me [green][buffer1][blue] more Oddish and I can
make you a special mist."
entries.translation_source: Bring me [green][buffer1][blue] more Oddish and I can make you a special mist.
entries.translated:
Bawakan aku [green][buffer1][blue] lebih banyak
Oddish dan aku bisa membuatkanmu\lkabut spesial.

entries.original:
"Heyyyy\.

You wanna buy some herbs?"
entries.translation_source: Heyyyy\. You wanna buy some herbs?
entries.translated: Heeeeey\. Kamu mau beli ramuan?

entries.original: "Come back anytimeeeee\."
entries.translation_source: Come back anytimeeeee\.
entries.translated: Kembali kapanpun yaaaa\.

entries.original:
"Heyyyy\.
I remember you\.

You wanna gimme some mushrooooms\.?

I’ll give you some Heart Scales
for ’emmmm\."
entries.translation_source: Heyyyy\. I remember you\. You wanna gimme some mushrooooms\.? I’ll give you some Heart Scales for ’emmmm\.
entries.translated:
Heeeey\. Aku ingat kamu\. Kamu mau
kasih aku jamuuuurnya\.? Aku akan\lmemberimu beberapa Heart Scales

untuk {B4}emmmm\.

entries.original:
"How many mushrooooms are you gonna
gimmeeee\.?"
entries.translation_source: How many mushrooooms are you gonna gimmeeee\.?
entries.translated:
Berapa banyak jamuuuur yang akan
kamu kasih akuiii\.?

entries.original:
"Mmmm\.

Mushrooooms\."
entries.translation_source: Mmmm\. Mushrooooms\.
entries.translated: Mmmm\. Jamuuuur\.

"[black][player] handed over [buffer2]
[buffer1]."

entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2]
[buffer1].

"[black][player] handed over a total of
[buffer2] [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over a total of [buffer2] [buffer1].
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan total [buffer2]
[buffer1].

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough of those
mushrooooms\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough of those mushrooooms\.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup jamuuur
tersebut\.

entries.original:
"When Pokémon gain enough
experience, they can evolve and\lgrow stronger.

Some even learn special moves
immediately after evolution.

However, not all Pokémon can
evolve just by battling enough.

Some require special items like
[green]Fire Stones[blue] or [green]Link Stones[blue]."
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon gain enough experience, they can evolve and grow stronger. Some even learn special moves immediately after evolution. However, not all Pokémon can evolve just by battling enough. Some require special items like [green]Fire Stones[blue] or [green]Link Stones[blue].
entries.translated:
Ketika Pokémon mendapatkan cukup
pengalaman, mereka dapat berevolusi\ldan menjadi lebih kuat. Beberapa

bahkan mempelajari jurus spesial
segera setelah evolusi. Namun,\ltidak semua Pokémon dapat

berevolusi hanya dengan bertarung
cukup. Beberapa membutuhkan item\lkhusus seperti [green]Batu Api[blue] atau [green]Batu

Koneksi[blue].

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, likes to
fill his Gym with a dense fog.

Usually, this makes it harder for
attacks to land.

But if you bring a Pokémon
with the abilities [green]Keen Eye[blue] or\l[green]Infiltrator[blue], its attacks will\lland no problem.

[green]Pikipek[blue] and [green]Hoothoot[blue] on [green]Route 2[blue] can
be caught with Keen Eye, so why\ldon’t you head over there and nab\lyourself one of them?"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, likes to fill his Gym with a dense fog. Usually, this makes it harder for attacks to land. But if you bring a Pokémon with the abilities [green]Keen Eye[blue] or [green]Infiltrator[blue], its attacks will land no problem. [green]Pikipek[blue] and [green]Hoothoot[blue] on [green]Route 2[blue] can be caught with Keen Eye, so why don’t you head over there and nab yourself one of them?
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, Mirskle, suka
memenuhi Gym-nya dengan kabut\ltebal. Biasanya, ini membuat

serangan lebih sulit mengenai.
Tetapi jika kamu membawa Pokémon\ldengan kemampuan [green]Mata Tajam[blue] atau

[green]Infiltran[blue], serangannya akan
mengenai dengan mudah. [green]Pikipek[blue] dan\l[green]Hoothoot[blue] di [green]Rute 2[blue] dapat ditangkap

dengan Mata Tajam, jadi kenapa kamu
tidak pergi ke sana dan menangkap\lsalah satunya?

entries.original:
"Pokémon with the abilities [green]Keen
Eye[blue] and [green]Infiltrator[blue] can easily land\ltheir attacks in foggy weather.

I don’t think that can happen
anywhere outside of Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon with the abilities [green]Keen Eye[blue] and [green]Infiltrator[blue] can easily land their attacks in foggy weather. I don’t think that can happen anywhere outside of Borrius!
entries.translated:
Pokémon dengan kemampuan [green]Mata Tajam[blue]
dan [green]Infiltran[blue] dapat dengan mudah\lmengenai serangan mereka dalam

cuaca berkabut. Aku rasa itu tidak
bisa terjadi di mana pun di luar\lBorrius!

entries.original:
"[green]Flower Paradise[red] is so pretty!

Everywhere you look, there are
different coloured flowers with\ldifferent Pokémon hiding in them!

I caught my [green]Cutiefly[red] up there, and
I used [green]Sweet Scent[red] to make it\leasier to hit Pokémon in the Gym!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Flower Paradise[red] is so pretty! Everywhere you look, there are different coloured flowers with different Pokémon hiding in them! I caught my [green]Cutiefly[red] up there, and I used [green]Sweet Scent[red] to make it easier to hit Pokémon in the Gym!
entries.translated:
[green]Firdaus Bunga[red] sangat indah! Ke mana
pun kamu melihat, ada bunga\lberwarna-warni dengan berbagai

Pokémon yang bersembunyi di
dalamnya! Aku menangkap [green]Cutiefly[red]ku\ldi sana, dan aku menggunakan [green]Aroma

Manis[red] untuk memudahkan mengenai
Pokémon di Gym!

entries.original:
"Like repellants, some Pokémon
Abilities like [green]Stench[blue] can also\lhelp keep wild Pokémon away."
entries.translation_source: Like repellants, some Pokémon Abilities like [green]Stench[blue] can also help keep wild Pokémon away.
entries.translated:
Seperti pengusir, beberapa
kemampuan Pokémon seperti [green]Bau Busuk[blue]\ljuga dapat membantu menjauhkan

Pokémon liar.

entries.original:
"You should try to beat as many
Pokémon Gyms as possible.

Poké Marts will sell more items to
you the more Badges you have."
entries.translation_source: You should try to beat as many Pokémon Gyms as possible. Poké Marts will sell more items to you the more Badges you have.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus mencoba mengalahkan
sebanyak mungkin Gym Pokémon. Poké\lMart akan menjual lebih banyak item

padamu semakin banyak Lencana yang
kamu miliki.

entries.original:
"I come here every day to pray
to Zapdos.

Zapdos saved me once, and I can
never thank it enough."
entries.translation_source: I come here every day to pray to Zapdos. Zapdos saved me once, and I can never thank it enough.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini setiap hari
untuk berdoa kepada Zapdos. Zapdos\lpernah menyelamatkanku, dan aku

tidak akan pernah bisa cukup
berterima kasih.

entries.original:
"Ahh\.

I love coming out here every day
and relaxing on this bench.

It’s always the most enjoyable part
of my day.

Why don’t you take a break on the
bench next to me?

I assure you, it’s very relaxing.

There’s just something magical
about sitting down on a bench\."
entries.translation_source: Ahh\. I love coming out here every day and relaxing on this bench. It’s always the most enjoyable part of my day. Why don’t you take a break on the bench next to me? I assure you, it’s very relaxing. There’s just something magical about sitting down on a bench\.
entries.translated:
Ahh\. Aku suka datang ke sini setiap
hari dan bersantai di bangku ini.\lIni selalu menjadi bagian paling

menyenangkan dari hariku. Kenapa
kamu tidak istirahat di bangku di\lsebelahku? Aku jamin, sangat

santai. Ada sesuatu yang ajaib
tentang duduk di bangku\.

entries.original:
"They say the grass is always
greener on the other side.

That’s especially true in
Epidimy Town.

Just look at the grass here!"
entries.translation_source: They say the grass is always greener on the other side. That’s especially true in Epidimy Town. Just look at the grass here!
entries.translated:
Mereka bilang rumput selalu lebih
hijau di sisi lain. Itu terutama\lbenar di Epidimy Town. Lihat saja

rumput di sini!

entries.original:
"Epidimy Town is the epitome
of bliss!

\.

\.

What? You don’t think it’s funny?
Sorry\.

I feel bad now\.

You know what? Take these.
It’ll help me feel better."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town is the epitome of bliss! \. \. What? You don’t think it’s funny? Sorry\. I feel bad now\. You know what? Take these. It’ll help me feel better.
entries.translated:
Epidimy Town adalah lambang
kebahagiaan! \. \. Apa? Kamu pikir itu\ltidak lucu? Maaf\. Aku merasa

bersalah sekarang\. Kamu tahu? Ambil
ini. Ini akan membantuku merasa\llebih baik.

entries.original:
"I wish it was easier to make a good
joke out of our town’s name."
entries.translation_source: I wish it was easier to make a good joke out of our town’s name.
entries.translated:
Aku berharap lebih mudah untuk
membuat lelucon yang bagus dari\lnama kota kita.

entries.original:
"I really wanna explore
Thundercap Mt!

But my mommy says it’s too
dangerous ’cause there are a bunch\lof bad men on the other side."
entries.translation_source: I really wanna explore Thundercap Mt! But my mommy says it’s too dangerous ’cause there are a bunch of bad men on the other side.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat ingin menjelajahi
Thundercap Mt! Tapi ibuku bilang\litu terlalu berbahaya karena ada

sekelompok pria jahat di sisi lain.

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt. can be accessed
through that hole down the stairs.

It’s really dangerous, so if you
go, make sure you have lots of\lRevives and Paralyze Heals!"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. can be accessed through that hole down the stairs. It’s really dangerous, so if you go, make sure you have lots of Revives and Paralyze Heals!
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mt. dapat diakses
melalui lubang itu di bawah tangga.\lItu sangat berbahaya, jadi jika

kamu pergi, pastikan kamu memiliki
banyak Revive dan Obat Lumpuh!

entries.original:
"Well, well, well\.
If it isn’t [player]!

Marlon told me not to let you
into Thundercap Mt., so you\lcan’t interfere with our plans.

Even if I did let you in, you’d be
toast without the power of\l[green]Mega Evolution[blue].

So don’t you see?

You should stay out here for your
own good."
entries.translation_source: Well, well, well\. If it isn’t [player]! Marlon told me not to let you into Thundercap Mt., so you can’t interfere with our plans. Even if I did let you in, you’d be toast without the power of [green]Mega Evolution[blue]. So don’t you see? You should stay out here for your own good.
entries.translated:
Nah, nah, nah\. Kalau bukan [player]!
Marlon menyuruhku untuk tidak\lmembiarkanmu masuk ke Thundercap

Mt., jadi kamu tidak bisa
mengganggu rencana kami. Bahkan\ljika aku membiarkanmu masuk, kamu

akan habis tanpa kekuatan [green]Mega
Evolution[blue]. Jadi tidakkah kamu\llihat? Kamu harus tetap di sini

demi kebaikanmu sendiri.

entries.original:
"You placed yourself firmly on
the bench."
entries.translation_source: You placed yourself firmly on the bench.
entries.translated: Kamu duduk dengan mantap di bangku.

entries.original:
"Huh? What’s this?

It looks like someone left
something on the bench!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What’s this? It looks like someone left something on the bench!
entries.translated:
Hah? Apa ini? Sepertinya seseorang
meninggalkan sesuatu di bangku!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt. has two different
entrances: one in Epidimy Town, and\lthe other in Antisis City.

These entrances take you to the
peak where Zapdos roosts.

I don’t recommend you use the
entrance by Antisis City, though.

That place is messed up\."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. has two different entrances: one in Epidimy Town, and the other in Antisis City. These entrances take you to the peak where Zapdos roosts. I don’t recommend you use the entrance by Antisis City, though. That place is messed up\.
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mt. memiliki dua pintu
masuk berbeda: satu di Epidimy\lTown, dan yang lainnya di Antisis

City. Pintu masuk ini membawamu ke
puncak tempat Zapdos bertengger.\lAku tidak merekomendasikan kamu

menggunakan pintu masuk dekat
Antisis City. Tempat itu kacau\.

entries.original:
"I tried exploring Thundercap Mt.
through the nearby entrance once.

The opening where Zapdos is said to
roost goes really high up!

I actually got really dizzy and
fell down while climbing!

The doctor says I now suffer from
minor head trauma.

Take this item, so you don’t have
to worry about head trauma, too."
entries.translation_source: I tried exploring Thundercap Mt. through the nearby entrance once. The opening where Zapdos is said to roost goes really high up! I actually got really dizzy and fell down while climbing! The doctor says I now suffer from minor head trauma. Take this item, so you don’t have to worry about head trauma, too.
entries.translated:
Aku pernah mencoba menjelajahi
Thundercap Mt. melalui pintu masuk\lterdekat. Bukaan tempat Zapdos

dikatakan bertengger sangat tinggi!
Aku benar-benar pusing dan jatuh\lsaat mendaki! Dokter mengatakan aku

sekarang menderita trauma kepala
ringan. Ambil item ini, agar kamu\ltidak perlu khawatir tentang trauma

kepala juga.

entries.original:
"If your Pokémon wears the [green]Rocky
Helmet[red], any Pokémon that touches\lit will suffer from head trauma!"
entries.translation_source: If your Pokémon wears the [green]Rocky Helmet[red], any Pokémon that touches it will suffer from head trauma!
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémonmu memakai [green]Helm Batu[red],
Pokémon apa pun yang menyentuhnya\lakan menderita trauma kepala!

entries.original:
"[black]Too bad!

There’s no room in the Cube for
a [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Too bad! There’s no room in the Cube for a [buffer2]!
entries.translated:
[black]Sayang sekali! Tidak ada ruang di
Kubus untuk [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Huah!
Move boulders with pure power!

Take this!"
entries.translation_source: Huah! Move boulders with pure power! Take this!
entries.translated:
Huah! Pindahkan batu besar dengan
kekuatan murni! Ambil ini!

entries.original:
"[green]Strength[blue] lets you move giant
boulders with raw power!

But only if you have the [green]Fall
Badge[blue] from the Fallshore Gym!

Huah!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Strength[blue] lets you move giant boulders with raw power! But only if you have the [green]Fall Badge[blue] from the Fallshore Gym! Huah!
entries.translated:
[green]Kekuatan[blue] memungkinkanmu memindahkan
batu raksasa dengan kekuatan\lmentah! Tapi hanya jika kamu

memiliki [green]Lencana Jatuh[blue] dari Gym
Fallshore! Huah!

entries.original:
"One day, I’m going to be a ninja!

My parents strike with brute force,
but I’m going to be sneaky!

I’m going to hide in holes in
sand and scare Trainers!"
entries.translation_source: One day, I’m going to be a ninja! My parents strike with brute force, but I’m going to be sneaky! I’m going to hide in holes in sand and scare Trainers!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, aku akan menjadi ninja!
Orang tuaku menyerang dengan\lkekerasan, tapi aku akan licik! Aku

akan bersembunyi di lubang pasir
dan menakuti Pelatih!

entries.original:
"You know the Pokémon [green][buffer1][red]?
That big adorable pink blob?

I’ve always wanted one, but they’re
just so hard to catch!

Would you be willing to trade one
for my [green][buffer2][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You know the Pokémon [green][buffer1][red]? That big adorable pink blob? I’ve always wanted one, but they’re just so hard to catch! Would you be willing to trade one for my [green][buffer2][red]?
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu Pokémon [green][buffer1][red]?
Gumpalan merah muda besar yang\lmenggemaskan itu? Aku selalu

menginginkannya, tapi mereka sangat
sulit ditangkap! Maukah kamu\lmenukar satu dengan [green][buffer2][red]

milikku?

entries.original: "That’s too bad."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad.
entries.translated: Sayang sekali.

entries.original:
"In what universe is that a [buffer1],
huh?

If you get one, trade it with me."
entries.translation_source: In what universe is that a [buffer1], huh? If you get one, trade it with me.
entries.translated:
Di alam semesta mana itu adalah
[buffer1], ya? Jika kamu\lmendapatkannya, tukarkan denganku.

entries.original:
"Thank you so much! I’m going to
take good care of it!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much! I’m going to take good care of it!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih banyak! Aku akan
merawatnya dengan baik!

entries.original:
"My old [buffer2], has it helped you
win any battles?"
entries.translation_source: My old [buffer2], has it helped you win any battles?
entries.translated:
[buffer2] lamaku, apakah itu
membantumu memenangkan pertempuran?

entries.original:
"Do you see that item on the table?

That is my prized possession,
the [green]Master Ball[red].

It is a rare Poké Ball that can
capture any Pokémon without fail.

The man who gave it to me, [green]Aros[red],
said to watch over it as if my life\ldepended on it.

That is until someone shows me a
small purple Pokémon, [green]Hoopa[red].

Aros said the one who controls
Hoopa is the Guardian of Borrius\land worthy of this Ball.

Are you the Guardian of Borrius,
or just another brat?"
entries.translation_source: Do you see that item on the table? That is my prized possession, the [green]Master Ball[red]. It is a rare Poké Ball that can capture any Pokémon without fail. The man who gave it to me, [green]Aros[red], said to watch over it as if my life depended on it. That is until someone shows me a small purple Pokémon, [green]Hoopa[red]. Aros said the one who controls Hoopa is the Guardian of Borrius and worthy of this Ball. Are you the Guardian of Borrius, or just another brat?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat benda di atas
meja itu? Itu adalah harta\lberharganya, [green]Master Ball[red]. Ini

adalah Bola Poké langka yang bisa
menangkap Pokémon apa pun tanpa\lgagal. Pria yang memberikannya

padaku, [green]Aros[red], berkata untuk
menjaganya seolah hidupku\lbergantung padanya. Sampai

seseorang menunjukkan padaku
Pokémon ungu kecil, [green]Hoopa[red]. Aros\lberkata bahwa orang yang

mengendalikan Hoopa adalah Guardian
of Borrius dan layak mendapatkan\lBola ini. Apakah kamu Guardian of

Borrius, atau hanya bocah nakal
lainnya?

entries.original:
"Really?
Prove it to me!

Show me the Pokémon known
as [green]Hoopa[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Really? Prove it to me! Show me the Pokémon known as [green]Hoopa[red]!
entries.translated:
Benarkah? Buktikan padaku!
Tunjukkan padaku Pokémon yang\ldikenal sebagai [green]Hoopa[red]!

entries.original:
"That is Hoopa!
That is Hoopa!

You are the Guardian of Borrius!
Take the Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: That is Hoopa! That is Hoopa! You are the Guardian of Borrius! Take the Master Ball!
entries.translated:
Itu Hoopa! Itu Hoopa! Kamu adalah
Guardian of Borrius! Ambil Master\lBall!

entries.original:
"Then, I have no time for you.
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Then, I have no time for you. Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, aku tidak punya waktu
untukmu. Pergi! Pergi!

entries.original:
"That is not Hoopa!

I have no time for you!
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: That is not Hoopa! I have no time for you! Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Itu bukan Hoopa! Aku tidak punya
waktu untukmu! Pergi! Pergi!

entries.original:
"Guardian of Borrius!
It is pleasure being in your midst!"
entries.translation_source: Guardian of Borrius! It is pleasure being in your midst!
entries.translated:
Guardian of Borrius! Senang berada
di tengah-tengahmu!

entries.original: "[player] found one Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: [player] found one Master Ball!
entries.translated:
[player] menemukan satu Master
Ball!

entries.original:
"Thief! Put that back!
That’s my prized possession!"
entries.translation_source: Thief! Put that back! That’s my prized possession!
entries.translated:
Pencuri! Kembalikan! Itu harta
berhargaku!

entries.original:
"The last Guardian of Borrius, [green]Aros[blue],
tasked several older couples with\lguarding rare or powerful objects.

We are one such couple.

Another couple, I believe, lives
on Route 9."
entries.translation_source: The last Guardian of Borrius, [green]Aros[blue], tasked several older couples with guarding rare or powerful objects. We are one such couple. Another couple, I believe, lives on Route 9.
entries.translated:
Guardian of Borrius terakhir, [green]Aros[blue],
menugaskan beberapa pasangan tua\luntuk menjaga benda langka atau

kuat. Kami adalah salah satu
pasangan itu. Pasangan lain, saya\lyakin, tinggal di Route 9.

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Dude’s older
brother.

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Dude’s older brother. I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Aku kakak dari Fishing Dude. Aku
sangat suka memancing! Aku tidak\ltahan tanpa memancing. Katakan,

apakah kamu suka memancing?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Aku suka gayamu. Kurasa kita
bisa berteman. Ambil ini dan\lpancinglah, teman muda!

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

A crummy Old Rod can only catch
Magikarp, yes?

But with a Good Rod, you can
catch much better Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. A crummy Old Rod can only catch Magikarp, yes? But with a Good Rod, you can catch much better Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Memancing adalah gaya hidup! Ibarat
puisi terindah. Pancing Tua yang\ljelek cuma bisa menangkap Magikarp,

ya? Tapi dengan Pancing Bagus, kamu
bisa menangkap Pokémon yang jauh\llebih baik.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. That’s so disappointing\.
entries.translated: Oh\. Itu sangat mengecewakan\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!

How are the fish biting?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player]! How are the fish biting?
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]! Bagaimana hasil
pancinganmu?

entries.original:
"Do you plan on exploring
Thundercap Mt.?

If you do, you’re going to
need these!"
entries.translation_source: Do you plan on exploring Thundercap Mt.? If you do, you’re going to need these!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu berencana menjelajahi
Thundercap Mt.? Jika iya, kamu akan\lmembutuhkan ini!

entries.original:
"It never hurts to be prepared
for anything!"
entries.translation_source: It never hurts to be prepared for anything!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada salahnya bersiap untuk
apa pun!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt. is a dangerous
place!

I tried exploring it once, but oh
boy, I got smoked!

Ever since then, my lovely wife has
been giving Max Repels daily to any\ltravellers who talk to her."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. is a dangerous place! I tried exploring it once, but oh boy, I got smoked! Ever since then, my lovely wife has been giving Max Repels daily to any travellers who talk to her.
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mt. adalah tempat
berbahaya! Aku pernah mencoba\lmenjelajahinya, tapi astaga, aku

kewalahan! Sejak itu, istriku yang
cantik memberikan Max Repel setiap\lhari kepada setiap pelancong yang

berbicara dengannya.

entries.original:
"Uh\.
Er, yes, I’m the Move Deleter.

I can make Pokémon forget their
moves.

Would you like me to do that?"
entries.translation_source: Uh\. Er, yes, I’m the Move Deleter. I can make Pokémon forget their moves. Would you like me to do that?
entries.translated:
Uh\. Er, ya, aku adalah Penghapus
Gerakan. Aku bisa membuat Pokémon\lmelupakan gerakan mereka. Apakah

kamu ingin aku melakukannya?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should forget a
move?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should forget a move?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang harus melupakan
sebuah gerakan?

entries.original: "Which move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Which move should be forgotten?
entries.translated: Gerakan mana yang harus dilupakan?

entries.original:
"Hm! [green][buffer1][blue]’s [green][buffer2][blue]?
That move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Hm! [green][buffer1][blue]’s [green][buffer2][blue]? That move should be forgotten?
entries.translated:
Hm! [green][buffer1][blue] punya [green][buffer2][blue]?
Gerakan itu harus dilupakan?

entries.original:
"It worked to perfection!

[buffer1] has forgotten
[buffer2] completely."
entries.translation_source: It worked to perfection! [buffer1] has forgotten [buffer2] completely.
entries.translated:
Berhasil dengan sempurna! [buffer1]
telah melupakan [buffer2]\lsepenuhnya.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] seems to know only one
move\."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] seems to know only one move\.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] sepertinya hanya tahu satu
gerakan\.

entries.original:
"What?
No Egg should know any moves."
entries.translation_source: What? No Egg should know any moves.
entries.translated:
Apa? Tidak ada Telur yang
seharusnya tahu gerakan apa pun.

entries.original:
"Come again if there are other
moves to be forgotten."
entries.translation_source: Come again if there are other moves to be forgotten.
entries.translated:
Datang lagi jika ada gerakan lain
yang harus dilupakan.

entries.original:
"If you’re working on a Pokédex,
visit [green]Thundercap Mt.[red]!

All sorts of rare Electric-type
Pokémon live there.

It’s even said that Zapdos roosts
at the peak!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re working on a Pokédex, visit [green]Thundercap Mt.[red]! All sorts of rare Electric-type Pokémon live there. It’s even said that Zapdos roosts at the peak!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu sedang mengerjakan
Pokédex, kunjungi [green]Thundercap Mt.[red]!\lBerbagai macam Pokémon langka tipe

Listrik tinggal di sana. Bahkan
dikatakan bahwa Zapdos bertengger\ldi puncaknya!

entries.original:
"A [green]Dusk Ball[blue] is one of the best
Balls you could use at night or\lin a cave.

It’s much more useful than the
inferior Ultra Ball.

Plus, it has the most excellent
name!

Dusk!
The Dusk Ball!

I believe it can even catch
and control the darkness found\lin hearts."
entries.translation_source: A [green]Dusk Ball[blue] is one of the best Balls you could use at night or in a cave. It’s much more useful than the inferior Ultra Ball. Plus, it has the most excellent name! Dusk! The Dusk Ball! I believe it can even catch and control the darkness found in hearts.
entries.translated:
[green]Bola Dusk[blue] adalah salah satu Bola
terbaik yang bisa kamu gunakan di\lmalam hari atau di gua. Ini jauh

lebih berguna daripada Bola Ultra
yang inferior. Plus, namanya sangat\lkeren! Dusk! Bola Dusk! Aku percaya

ia bahkan bisa menangkap dan
mengendalikan kegelapan yang ada di\ldalam hati.

entries.original:
"I hear Hyper Potions are diluted in
other regions to be less potent.

Whoever came up with that idea is
a thief and a crook."
entries.translation_source: I hear Hyper Potions are diluted in other regions to be less potent. Whoever came up with that idea is a thief and a crook.
entries.translated:
Kudengar Hiper Potion diencerkan di
daerah lain agar kurang manjur.\lSiapa pun yang punya ide itu adalah

pencuri dan bajingan.

entries.original:
"Heya!

Get your stat reducing items here!"
entries.translation_source: Heya! Get your stat reducing items here!
entries.translated:
Hei! Dapatkan item pengurang stat
di sini!

entries.original:
"Huah!

Get your stat boosting items here!"
entries.translation_source: Huah! Get your stat boosting items here!
entries.translated:
Huah! Dapatkan item penambah stat
di sini!

entries.original:
"How’d you like some Moomoo Milk?

It’s the pride and joy of
Magnolia Town!

Give it to a Pokémon to restore
HP!

I’ll give it to you for just $550."
entries.translation_source: How’d you like some Moomoo Milk? It’s the pride and joy of Magnolia Town! Give it to a Pokémon to restore HP! I’ll give it to you for just $550.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kalau sedikit Susu
Moomoo? Itu adalah kebanggaan dan\lkegembiraan Kota Magnolia! Berikan

pada Pokémon untuk memulihkan HP!
Aku akan memberikannya padamu hanya\ldengan $550.

entries.original: "And that’ll be $550!"
entries.translation_source: And that’ll be $550!
entries.translated: Dan itu akan menjadi $550!

entries.original: "And that’ll be $6600!"
entries.translation_source: And that’ll be $6600!
entries.translated: Dan itu akan menjadi $6600!

entries.original:
"Aye, I do deliveries from the
Antisis Port during the day.

Without me, there’d be no
Fallshore Market!"
entries.translation_source: Aye, I do deliveries from the Antisis Port during the day. Without me, there’d be no Fallshore Market!
entries.translated:
Ya, saya melakukan pengiriman dari
Pelabuhan Antisis pada siang hari.\lTanpa saya, tidak akan ada Pasar

Fallshore!

entries.original:
"Aye, I just finished delivering
goods to all the Poké Marts.

Soon, I’ll be heading back to
Antisis City for the night.

But it looks like I still have
some leftover items.

How about instead of tossing ’em,
I let you have ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Aye, I just finished delivering goods to all the Poké Marts. Soon, I’ll be heading back to Antisis City for the night. But it looks like I still have some leftover items. How about instead of tossing ’em, I let you have ’em!
entries.translated:
Ya, saya baru saja selesai mengirim
barang ke semua Poké Mart. Sebentar\llagi, saya akan kembali ke Antisis

City untuk malam hari. Tapi
sepertinya saya masih memiliki\lbeberapa barang sisa. Bagaimana

kalau alih-alih membuangnya, saya
biarkan kamu memilikinya!

entries.original:
"Aye, I just finished delivering
goods to all the Poké Marts.

Soon, I’ll be heading back to
Antisis City for the night."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I just finished delivering goods to all the Poké Marts. Soon, I’ll be heading back to Antisis City for the night.
entries.translated:
Ya, saya baru saja selesai mengirim
barang ke semua Poké Mart. Sebentar\llagi, saya akan kembali ke Antisis

City untuk malam hari.

entries.original:
"Whenever I’m battling in the
[green]Inverse Battle House[blue], I try to\lmake the most of the effectiveness\larrows shown when selecting a move.

It’s a lot easier than actually
knowing what’s good on what,\lya catch my drift?"
entries.translation_source: Whenever I’m battling in the [green]Inverse Battle House[blue], I try to make the most of the effectiveness arrows shown when selecting a move. It’s a lot easier than actually knowing what’s good on what, ya catch my drift?
entries.translated:
Setiap kali saya bertarung di
[green]Inverse Battle House[blue], saya mencoba\lmemanfaatkan panah efektivitas yang

ditampilkan saat memilih jurus. Itu
jauh lebih mudah daripada\lbenar-benar tahu apa yang bagus

untuk apa, paham maksud saya?

entries.original:
"I heard from a friend that under
[green]Tehl Town[red], that tiny town to the\lwest of here, is a secret\lunderground passage to [green]Route 9[red].

But there can’t actually be\.
Come on! Who’d believe that?"
entries.translation_source: I heard from a friend that under [green]Tehl Town[red], that tiny town to the west of here, is a secret underground passage to [green]Route 9[red]. But there can’t actually be\. Come on! Who’d believe that?
entries.translated:
Saya dengar dari seorang teman
bahwa di bawah [green]Tehl Town[red], kota\lkecil di sebelah barat sini, ada

jalan bawah tanah rahasia menuju
[green]Route 9[red]. Tapi sebenarnya tidak\lmungkin ada\. Ayolah! Siapa yang

percaya itu?

entries.original:
"You’d never catch me outside when
it’s raining!

\.

Actually, most people here would
probably head indoors."
entries.translation_source: You’d never catch me outside when it’s raining! \. Actually, most people here would probably head indoors.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak akan pernah melihatku di
luar saat hujan! \. Sebenarnya,\lkebanyakan orang di sini mungkin

akan masuk ke dalam.

entries.original:
"Mel’s Gym is a complicated maze of
ponds, lily pads, and waterfalls.

It originally belonged to the
Water-type Gym Leader, Tessy.

When she moved back to East
Borrius, Mel took over the Gym.

He was too busy working on his
perfectly toned body to redesign\lthe entire Gym, so now he runs his\l[green]Normal[blue]-type Gym in a place that’s\lfull of water."
entries.translation_source: Mel’s Gym is a complicated maze of ponds, lily pads, and waterfalls. It originally belonged to the Water-type Gym Leader, Tessy. When she moved back to East Borrius, Mel took over the Gym. He was too busy working on his perfectly toned body to redesign the entire Gym, so now he runs his [green]Normal[blue]-type Gym in a place that’s full of water.
entries.translated:
Gym Mel adalah labirin rumit dari
kolam, daun teratai, dan air\lterjun. Awalnya milik Pemimpin Gym

tipe Air, Tessy. Ketika dia kembali
ke East Borrius, Mel mengambil alih\lGym. Dia terlalu sibuk membentuk

tubuhnya yang sempurna untuk
mendesain ulang seluruh Gym, jadi\lsekarang dia menjalankan Gym

[green]Normal[blue]-type di tempat yang penuh
air.

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out
here often with some of his\lcloser friends."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out here often with some of his closer friends.
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, sering datang ke
sini dengan beberapa teman\ldekatnya.

entries.original:
"Apparently, Mel has his own private
island somewhere out in the ocean!"
entries.translation_source: Apparently, Mel has his own private island somewhere out in the ocean!
entries.translated:
Rupanya, Mel memiliki pulau pribadi
sendiri entah di mana di lautan!

entries.original:
"The [green]Moomoo Milk[red] they sell here is
so sweet!

I buy a dozen at once each time
I come here!"
entries.translation_source: The [green]Moomoo Milk[red] they sell here is so sweet! I buy a dozen at once each time I come here!
entries.translated:
[green]Moomoo Milk[red] yang mereka jual di
sini sangat manis! Aku membeli\lselusin sekaligus setiap kali aku

datang ke sini!

entries.original:
"My umbrella always protects me
when it’s raining!"
entries.translation_source: My umbrella always protects me when it’s raining!
entries.translated:
Payungku selalu melindungiku saat
hujan!

entries.original:
"There are a whole bunch of useful
items for Trainers here!

My favourites are the Berries
they sell.

They reduce Effort Values by
a whole ten points!"
entries.translation_source: There are a whole bunch of useful items for Trainers here! My favourites are the Berries they sell. They reduce Effort Values by a whole ten points!
entries.translated:
Ada banyak sekali barang berguna
untuk Pelatih di sini! Favoritku\ladalah Berry yang mereka jual.

Mereka mengurangi Effort Values
sebanyak sepuluh poin penuh!

entries.original:
"I hate it when it rains.

I don’t live here, so it’s not like
I can go inside like everyone else\."
entries.translation_source: I hate it when it rains. I don’t live here, so it’s not like I can go inside like everyone else\.
entries.translated:
Aku benci saat hujan. Aku tidak
tinggal di sini, jadi aku tidak\lbisa masuk ke dalam seperti orang

lain\.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

How do I get the TM contained in
that yellow Poké Ball\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. How do I get the TM contained in that yellow Poké Ball\.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Bagaimana cara mendapatkan TM
yang ada di dalam Poké Ball kuning\litu\.

entries.original:
"Wow!

I saw you glide up that waterfall
like an angel and grab that TM!

Good job!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! I saw you glide up that waterfall like an angel and grab that TM! Good job!
entries.translated:
Wow! Aku melihatmu meluncur naik
air terjun itu seperti malaikat dan\lmengambil TM itu! Kerja bagus!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his
head somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head somewhere.
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, sedang tidak ada
di sini sekarang. Dia mungkin pergi\lmenjernihkan pikirannya di suatu

tempat.

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his head
by the [green]KBT Expressway[red] in [green]Tehl Town[red]."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head by the [green]KBT Expressway[red] in [green]Tehl Town[red].
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, sedang tidak ada
di sini sekarang. Dia mungkin pergi\lmenjernihkan pikirannya di [green]KBT

Expressway[red] di [green]Tehl Town[red].

entries.original:
"My hidden power is telling me that
you want this!"
entries.translation_source: My hidden power is telling me that you want this!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan tersembunyiku mengatakan
bahwa kamu menginginkan ini!

entries.original:
"[green]Hidden Power[blue] is a special move
that changes type depending on\lwhich Pokémon uses it."
entries.translation_source: [green]Hidden Power[blue] is a special move that changes type depending on which Pokémon uses it.
entries.translated:
[green]Hidden Power[blue] adalah serangan
spesial yang tipe-nya berubah\ltergantung Pokémon yang

menggunakannya.

entries.original:
"I can tell you which type of
Hidden Power your Pokémon\lwill learn!

Do you want to know?"
entries.translation_source: I can tell you which type of Hidden Power your Pokémon will learn! Do you want to know?
entries.translated:
Aku bisa memberitahumu tipe Hidden
Power apa yang akan dipelajari\lPokémon-mu! Apakah kamu ingin tahu?

entries.original:
"If [green][buffer1][blue] were to learn
Hidden Power, the move’s type\lwould be [green][buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: If [green][buffer1][blue] were to learn Hidden Power, the move’s type would be [green][buffer2][blue]!
entries.translated:
Jika [green][buffer1][blue] mempelajari Hidden
Power, tipe serangan itu akan\lmenjadi [green][buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"If you want to know, ask me, and
I’ll activate my hidden power!"
entries.translation_source: If you want to know, ask me, and I’ll activate my hidden power!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin tahu, tanyakan
padaku, dan aku akan menggunakan\lkekuatan tersembunyiku!

entries.original:
"It’s not possible for an Egg to
use Hidden Power!"
entries.translation_source: It’s not possible for an Egg to use Hidden Power!
entries.translated:
Tidak mungkin bagi Telur untuk
menggunakan Hidden Power!

entries.original:
"Young Trainer.

I have been carrying around this
Egg with me ever since it was laid.

However, I am willing to give it to
a healthy young person.
