Would you like to hatch the [green]Egg[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Young Trainer. I have been carrying around this Egg with me ever since it was laid. However, I am willing to give it to a healthy young person. Would you like to hatch the [green]Egg[red]?
entries.translated:
Pelatih Muda. Aku telah membawa
Telur ini sejak pertama kali\ldikeluarkan. Namun, aku bersedia

memberikannya kepada seorang muda
yang sehat. Apakah kamu ingin\lmenetaskan [green]Telur[red]?

entries.original:
"Here.
Please take good care of it.

It is a very special Egg."
entries.translation_source: Here. Please take good care of it. It is a very special Egg.
entries.translated:
Ini dia. Tolong jaga baik-baik. Ini
adalah Telur yang sangat istimewa.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received an Egg from
the kindly old woman!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received an Egg from the kindly old woman!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Telur dari wanita
tua yang baik hati!

entries.original:
"The Egg belongs to a special
Pokémon.

Nowadays, it is considered by
many to be a Fairy."
entries.translation_source: The Egg belongs to a special Pokémon. Nowadays, it is considered by many to be a Fairy.
entries.translated:
Telur ini milik Pokémon spesial.
Saat ini, banyak yang menganggapnya\lsebagai tipe Peri.

entries.original:
"As you wish, then\.

If you have a change of heart about
hatching this Egg, I will be here."
entries.translation_source: As you wish, then\. If you have a change of heart about hatching this Egg, I will be here.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, sesuai keinginanmu\. Jika
kamu berubah pikiran tentang\lmenetaskan Telur ini, aku akan ada

di sini.

entries.original:
"Oh? You’ve too many Pokémon.
There’s no room for this Egg\."
entries.translation_source: Oh? You’ve too many Pokémon. There’s no room for this Egg\.
entries.translated:
Oh? Kamu memiliki terlalu banyak
Pokémon. Tidak ada ruang untuk\lTelur ini\.

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mel, lives here
when he’s not on Gym duty or\lstaring at brightly coloured trees.

I just take care of his house for
him while he’s away."
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mel, lives here when he’s not on Gym duty or staring at brightly coloured trees. I just take care of his house for him while he’s away.
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, Mel, tinggal di sini
saat dia tidak bertugas di Gym atau\lmenatap pohon-pohon berwarna cerah.

Aku hanya merawat rumahnya selama
dia pergi.

entries.original:
"Mel used to date Tessy, the old
Fallshore City Gym Leader.

They broke up when she moved away
to Polder Town in East Borrius, but\lshe left him her Gym as a parting\lgift.

I think that’s the real reason he
didn’t renovate the Gym after she\lleft.

It’s the one thing he has left
from her\."
entries.translation_source: Mel used to date Tessy, the old Fallshore City Gym Leader. They broke up when she moved away to Polder Town in East Borrius, but she left him her Gym as a parting gift. I think that’s the real reason he didn’t renovate the Gym after she left. It’s the one thing he has left from her\.
entries.translated:
Mel dulu berkencan dengan Tessy,
mantan Pemimpin Gym Kota Fallshore.\lMereka putus saat dia pindah ke

Kota Polder di Borrius Timur, tapi
dia meninggalkan Gym-nya sebagai\lhadiah perpisahan. Kupikir itu

alasan sebenarnya dia tidak
merenovasi Gym setelah dia pergi.\lItu satu-satunya hal yang tersisa

darinya\.

entries.original:
"Mel is always surrounding himself
with many different women.

He must always be feeling
really lonely\."
entries.translation_source: Mel is always surrounding himself with many different women. He must always be feeling really lonely\.
entries.translated:
Mel selalu mengelilingi dirinya
dengan banyak wanita berbeda.\lPastinya dia selalu merasa sangat

kesepian\.

entries.original:
"He traded me his [green]Magmar[blue] holding a
[green]Magmarizer[blue], and it evolved!"
entries.translation_source: He traded me his [green]Magmar[blue] holding a [green]Magmarizer[blue], and it evolved!
entries.translated:
Dia menukarkan [green]Magmar[blue]-nya yang
membawa [green]Magmarizer[blue] padaku, dan ia\lberevolusi!

entries.original:
"He traded me his [green]Electabuzz[blue], so I
used an [green]Electirizer[blue] on it like an\l[green]Evolution Stone[blue], and it evolved!"
entries.translation_source: He traded me his [green]Electabuzz[blue], so I used an [green]Electirizer[blue] on it like an [green]Evolution Stone[blue], and it evolved!
entries.translated:
Dia menukarkan [green]Electabuzz[blue]-nya
padaku, jadi aku menggunakan\l[green]Electirizer[blue] padanya seperti

[green]Evolution Stone[blue], dan ia berevolusi!

entries.original:
"There are some Pokémon that can
only evolve during a trade.

But who really trades anymore,
y’know?

That fad died out years ago.

Now you can evolve those Pokémon
using a [green]Link Stone[blue]!

Here, you’ll see!"
entries.translation_source: There are some Pokémon that can only evolve during a trade. But who really trades anymore, y’know? That fad died out years ago. Now you can evolve those Pokémon using a [green]Link Stone[blue]! Here, you’ll see!
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Pokémon yang hanya
bisa berevolusi saat perdagangan.\lTapi siapa yang masih bertukar

lagi, tahukah? Mode itu sudah punah
bertahun-tahun lalu. Sekarang kamu\lbisa mengevolusi Pokémon itu

menggunakan [green]Link Stone[blue]! Ini, kamu
akan lihat!

entries.original:
"The [green]Link Stone[blue] can be used to
evolve certain Pokémon that only\levolve by trading normally."
entries.translation_source: The [green]Link Stone[blue] can be used to evolve certain Pokémon that only evolve by trading normally.
entries.translated:
[green]Link Stone[blue] dapat digunakan untuk
mengevolusi Pokémon tertentu yang\lbiasanya hanya berevolusi melalui

perdagangan.

entries.original:
"Everyone around here is like,
\qoevolution this\qc and \qoevolution\lthat.\qc

But I think evolution is stupid!

My personal favourite way of
preventing evolution is not by\lpressing \btn01 when my Pokémon is\labout to evolve, but by having it\lhold an [green]Everstone[blue].

That way I can skip the whole
evolution thing altogether!

And you know what?

I’ll actually share one with you
if you can show me a Pokémon that\lhas never evolved and can’t evolve!

Do you have a Pokémon like this in
your party?"
entries.translation_source: Everyone around here is like, \qoevolution this\qc and \qoevolution that.\qc But I think evolution is stupid! My personal favourite way of preventing evolution is not by pressing \btn01 when my Pokémon is about to evolve, but by having it hold an [green]Everstone[blue]. That way I can skip the whole evolution thing altogether! And you know what? I’ll actually share one with you if you can show me a Pokémon that has never evolved and can’t evolve! Do you have a Pokémon like this in your party?
entries.translated:
Semua orang di sini seperti,
\qoevolusi ini\qc dan \qoevolusi itu.\qc\lTapi menurutku evolusi itu bodoh!

Cara favoritku untuk mencegah
evolusi bukan dengan menekan \btn01 saat\lPokémonku akan berevolusi, tetapi

dengan membuatnya membawa
[green]Everstone[blue]. Dengan begitu aku bisa\lmelewati urusan evolusi sama

sekali! Dan tahukah kamu? Aku akan
memberikannya padamu jika kamu bisa\lmenunjukkan Pokémon yang belum

pernah berevolusi dan tidak bisa
berevolusi! Apakah kamu memiliki\lPokémon seperti itu di timmu?

entries.original: "Which Pokémon is it?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is it?
entries.translated: Pokémon yang mana itu?

entries.original:
"Yup, that Pokémon has never
evolved and can never evolve.

As promised, take an [green]Everstone[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Yup, that Pokémon has never evolved and can never evolve. As promised, take an [green]Everstone[blue]!
entries.translated:
Ya, Pokémon itu tidak pernah
berevolusi dan tidak bisa\lberevolusi. Sesuai janji, ambil

[green]Everstone[blue]!

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon holds an [green]Everstone[blue] it
won’t evolve!

If a Pokémon holds one while
breeding, it’ll pass on its nature!

Aren’t Everstones great?

If you’re looking for more, I hear
there are a whole bunch of them\lstuck in the [green]walls[blue] of the [green]KBT\lExpressway[blue].

How do you get them out, though?
I have no idea\."
entries.translation_source: If a Pokémon holds an [green]Everstone[blue] it won’t evolve! If a Pokémon holds one while breeding, it’ll pass on its nature! Aren’t Everstones great? If you’re looking for more, I hear there are a whole bunch of them stuck in the [green]walls[blue] of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue]. How do you get them out, though? I have no idea\.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon memegang [green]Everstone[blue], ia
tidak akan berevolusi! Jika Pokémon\lmemegang satu saat pembiakan, ia

akan mewariskan sifatnya! Bukankah
Everstone hebat? Jika kamu mencari\llebih banyak, aku dengar ada banyak

yang tersangkut di [green]dinding[blue] [green]KBT
Expressway[blue]. Bagaimana cara\lmengeluarkannya? Aku tidak tahu\.

entries.original:
"I’ll stick around in the Evolution
House in case you ever bring one."
entries.translation_source: I’ll stick around in the Evolution House in case you ever bring one.
entries.translated:
Aku akan tetap di Evolution House
kalau-kalau kamu membawa satu\lnanti.

entries.original:
"Nope, I’m not looking for an Egg.

I’m looking for a Pokémon that
hasn’t evolved and can never\levolve."
entries.translation_source: Nope, I’m not looking for an Egg. I’m looking for a Pokémon that hasn’t evolved and can never evolve.
entries.translated:
Tidak, aku tidak mencari Telur. Aku
mencari Pokémon yang belum\lberevolusi dan tidak bisa

berevolusi.

entries.original:
"Nope, that’s not one of the
Pokémon I’m looking for.

I’m looking for a Pokémon that
hasn’t evolved and can never\levolve."
entries.translation_source: Nope, that’s not one of the Pokémon I’m looking for. I’m looking for a Pokémon that hasn’t evolved and can never evolve.
entries.translated:
Tidak, itu bukan salah satu Pokémon
yang aku cari. Aku mencari Pokémon\lyang belum berevolusi dan tidak

bisa berevolusi.

entries.original:
"I used a [green]Thunder Stone[blue] on my
[green]Pikachu[blue] while [green]standing[blue] on the\l[green]seashore[blue] and when [green]water was\lsplashing beneath my feet[blue], and now\lit looks like its surfing on its tail!"
entries.translation_source: I used a [green]Thunder Stone[blue] on my [green]Pikachu[blue] while [green]standing[blue] on the [green]seashore[blue] and when [green]water was splashing beneath my feet[blue], and now it looks like its surfing on its tail!
entries.translated:
Aku menggunakan [green]Thunder Stone[blue] pada
[green]Pikachu[blue]-ku sambil [green]berdiri[blue] di [green]tepian\llaut[blue] dan ketika [green]air terciprat di

bawah kakiku[blue], dan sekarang
sepertinya ia berselancar di atas\lekornya!

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][red]![red]

I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!"
entries.translation_source: [green][buffer1][red]![red] I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red]![red] Aku ingin melihat
[green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]!
It’s so cuddly and pink!

You should use the [green]Oval Stone[red] to
evolve it!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1]! It’s so cuddly and pink! You should use the [green]Oval Stone[red] to evolve it!
entries.translated:
[buffer1]! Ia sangat lucu dan merah
muda! Kamu harus menggunakan [green]Oval\lStone[red] untuk mengevolusikannya!

entries.original:
"Your [green][buffer1][red] should hold the [green]Oval
Stone[red] during the [green]daytime[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Your [green][buffer1][red] should hold the [green]Oval Stone[red] during the [green]daytime[red]!
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red] milikmu harus memegang
[green]Oval Stone[red] pada [green]siang hari[red]!

entries.original:
"Waaaah!
I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!"
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!
entries.translated: Waaaah! Aku ingin melihat [green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"That’s not a [green][buffer1][red]!

Waaaah!
I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!"
entries.translation_source: That’s not a [green][buffer1][red]! Waaaah! I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!
entries.translated:
Itu bukan [green][buffer1][red]! Waaaah! Aku
ingin melihat [green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"Hiya! They call me the \qoevolution
master\qc!

I know all the ways Pokémon can
evolve!

Do you want to know how your
Pokémon evolves?"
entries.translation_source: Hiya! They call me the \qoevolution master\qc! I know all the ways Pokémon can evolve! Do you want to know how your Pokémon evolves?
entries.translated:
Hai! Mereka memanggilku \qomaster
evolusi\qc! Aku tahu semua cara\lPokémon bisa berevolusi! Apakah

kamu ingin tahu bagaimana
Pokémon-mu berevolusi?

entries.original:
"I get it, you’re in too much awe of
my wisdom to ask, right?"
entries.translation_source: I get it, you’re in too much awe of my wisdom to ask, right?
entries.translated:
Aku mengerti, kamu terlalu kagum
dengan kebijaksanaanku untuk\lbertanya, kan?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon do you want to know
about?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon do you want to know about?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang ingin kamu
ketahui?

entries.original:
"An Egg\.

Doesn’t evolve!"
entries.translation_source: An Egg\. Doesn’t evolve!
entries.translated: Telur\. Tidak berevolusi!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]\.

Doesn’t evolve!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1]\. Doesn’t evolve!
entries.translated: [buffer1]\. Tidak berevolusi!

entries.original:
"[buffer1] can evolve one of
[green][buffer2][red] ways!

So pick a number from 1 to [buffer2].

I’ll tell you how it evolves based
on the number you choose!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] can evolve one of [green][buffer2][red] ways! So pick a number from 1 to [buffer2]. I’ll tell you how it evolves based on the number you choose!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] dapat berevolusi dengan
salah satu dari [green][buffer2][red] cara! Jadi\lpilih angka dari 1 sampai [buffer2].

Aku akan memberitahu cara
berevolusi berdasarkan angka yang\lkamu pilih!

entries.original: "Pick a number from 1 to [buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: Pick a number from 1 to [buffer2].
entries.translated: Pilih angka dari 1 sampai [buffer2].

entries.original:
"I said one of [green][buffer2][red] ways!

That number is too large."
entries.translation_source: I said one of [green][buffer2][red] ways! That number is too large.
entries.translated:
Aku bilang salah satu dari [green][buffer2][red]
cara! Angka itu terlalu besar.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] will evolve if\.

\\0C"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] will evolve if\. \\0C
entries.translated: [buffer1] akan berevolusi jika\. \\0C

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Inverse
Battle House!

Feel free to battle any of the
Trainers here as many times as\lyou want.

If you need an explanation
of [green]Inverse Battles[blue], please come\ltalk to me.

Enjoy battling!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Inverse Battle House! Feel free to battle any of the Trainers here as many times as you want. If you need an explanation of [green]Inverse Battles[blue], please come talk to me. Enjoy battling!
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Rumah Pertempuran
Terbalik! Jangan ragu untuk\lbertarung dengan Pelatih mana pun

di sini sebanyak yang kau mau. Jika
kau butuh penjelasan tentang\l[green]Pertempuran Terbalik[blue], silakan

bicara denganku. Selamat bertarung!

entries.original:
"An [green]Inverse Battle[blue] works similar
to a normal battle, with the key\ldifference lying in how weaknesses\land resistances are handled.

In an Inverse Battle, weaknesses
and resistances swap places.

So a Water-type becomes weak to
Fire but resists Grass."
entries.translation_source: An [green]Inverse Battle[blue] works similar to a normal battle, with the key difference lying in how weaknesses and resistances are handled. In an Inverse Battle, weaknesses and resistances swap places. So a Water-type becomes weak to Fire but resists Grass.
entries.translated:
Sebuah [green]Pertempuran Terbalik[blue] bekerja
mirip dengan pertempuran normal,\ldengan perbedaan utama terletak

pada cara kelemahan dan ketahanan
ditangani. Dalam Pertempuran\lTerbalik, kelemahan dan ketahanan

bertukar tempat. Jadi tipe Air
menjadi lemah terhadap Api tetapi\lkebal terhadap Rumput.

entries.original: "No Survivors"
entries.translation_source: No Survivors
entries.translated: Tidak Ada yang Selamat

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Mission HQ!

This is your first time here,
isn’t it?

Then, tell me, do you know
about [green]Missions[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Mission HQ! This is your first time here, isn’t it? Then, tell me, do you know about [green]Missions[blue]?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Markas Misi! Ini
pertama kalinya kau ke sini, kan?\lKalau begitu, beri tahu aku, apa

kau tahu tentang [green]Misi[blue]?

entries.original:
"Of course you do!
Who doesn’t?

So come see me when you’ve
completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: Of course you do! Who doesn’t? So come see me when you’ve completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja kau tahu! Siapa yang
tidak? Jadi temui aku setelah kau\lmenyelesaikan setidaknya [green]5[blue] Misi.

entries.original:
"I see\.

Well, then in that case, allow me
to give a formal explanation."
entries.translation_source: I see\. Well, then in that case, allow me to give a formal explanation.
entries.translated:
Aku mengerti\. Baiklah, kalau begitu,
izinkan aku memberikan penjelasan\lresmi.

entries.original:
"A Mission is an extra objective you
receive by accepting a request\lfor help.

Many people out there are unable to
solve their own problems and\lrequire assistance from others.

Once you accept the Mission, the
details are automatically recorded\lin the Mission Log.

Missions can often yield great
rewards, be it items, money, or\leven new areas to explore.

If someone requests a Mission from
you, accept it immediately.

Even if you have no intention of
completing it right away, there’s\lno harm in having it registered\lin your Mission Log.

With that being said, there are
several people here in need\lof assistance.

Look around and see if there’s
anyone you’d like to help!

And come see me when you’ve
completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: A Mission is an extra objective you receive by accepting a request for help. Many people out there are unable to solve their own problems and require assistance from others. Once you accept the Mission, the details are automatically recorded in the Mission Log. Missions can often yield great rewards, be it items, money, or even new areas to explore. If someone requests a Mission from you, accept it immediately. Even if you have no intention of completing it right away, there’s no harm in having it registered in your Mission Log. With that being said, there are several people here in need of assistance. Look around and see if there’s anyone you’d like to help! And come see me when you’ve completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions.
entries.translated:
Misi adalah tujuan tambahan yang
kau terima dengan menerima\lpermintaan bantuan. Banyak orang di

luar sana tidak dapat menyelesaikan
masalah mereka sendiri dan\lmembutuhkan bantuan dari orang

lain. Setelah kau menerima Misi,
detailnya secara otomatis tercatat\ldi Log Misi. Misi sering kali

memberikan hadiah besar, baik itu
barang, uang, atau bahkan area baru\luntuk dijelajahi. Jika seseorang

memintamu melakukan Misi, terimalah
segera. Bahkan jika kau tidak\lberniat menyelesaikannya saat itu,

tidak ada salahnya untuk
mendaftarkannya di Log Misi-mu.\lDengan demikian, ada beberapa orang

di sini yang membutuhkan bantuan.
Lihatlah sekeliling dan lihat\lapakah ada orang yang ingin kau

bantu! Dan temui aku setelah kau
menyelesaikan setidaknya [green]5[blue] Misi.

entries.original:
"So far, you’ve completed
[green][buffer2][blue] Missions.

Come see me when you’ve completed
at least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: So far, you’ve completed [green][buffer2][blue] Missions. Come see me when you’ve completed at least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions.
entries.translated:
Sejauh ini, kau telah menyelesaikan
[green][buffer2][blue] Misi. Temui aku setelah\lkau menyelesaikan setidaknya

[green][buffer1][blue] Misi.

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ve completed at
least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions!

For that, you get\.

[buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ve completed at least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions! For that, you get\. [buffer2]!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kau telah menyelesaikan
setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] Misi! Untuk\litu, kau mendapatkan\. [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Additionally, [green][buffer1][blue] has now
begun to roam around Borrius!

You can check its current location
using your [green]Town Map[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Additionally, [green][buffer1][blue] has now begun to roam around Borrius! You can check its current location using your [green]Town Map[blue].
entries.translated:
Selain itu, [green][buffer1][blue] sekarang mulai
berkeliaran di sekitar Borrius! Kau\ldapat memeriksa lokasinya saat ini

menggunakan [green]Peta Kota[blue] milikmu.

entries.original:
"I’ve given you all I can give!
You’ve exceeded my expectations!

Any Missions you complete now will
just have to count for bonus."
entries.translation_source: I’ve given you all I can give! You’ve exceeded my expectations! Any Missions you complete now will just have to count for bonus.
entries.translated:
Aku sudah memberikan semua yang
bisa kuberikan! Kau telah melampaui\lharapanku! Misi apa pun yang kau

selesaikan sekarang hanya akan
dihitung sebagai bonus.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any space left in
your party for this Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any space left in your party for this Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kau tidak memiliki ruang tersisa di
timmu untuk Pokémon ini!

entries.original:
"And now that your feet are in the
water, let me give you a Mission!

Use the [green]Trainer Catalogue[blue] and
defeat every Trainer listed in it.

All those Trainers are itching for
a fight, so you’ll be doing them a\lgreat service by battling them all!"
entries.translation_source: And now that your feet are in the water, let me give you a Mission! Use the [green]Trainer Catalogue[blue] and defeat every Trainer listed in it. All those Trainers are itching for a fight, so you’ll be doing them a great service by battling them all!
entries.translated:
Dan sekarang setelah kakimu sudah
basah, izinkan aku memberimu sebuah\lMisi! Gunakan [green]Katalog Pelatih[blue] dan

kalahkan setiap Pelatih yang
terdaftar di dalamnya. Semua\lPelatih itu sangat ingin bertarung,

jadi kau akan melakukan layanan
besar bagi mereka dengan bertarung\lmelawan mereka semua!

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ve left no survivors
among the Trainers of Borrius!

For that, you get\.

[buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ve left no survivors among the Trainers of Borrius! For that, you get\. [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kau tidak meninggalkan
satu pun yang selamat di antara\lPelatih Borrius! Untuk itu, kau

mendapatkan\. [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"I have a feeling that if you bring
a certain Pokémon alongside that\l[green][buffer1][blue] to a place where [green]only the\lstrongest can go[blue], you may be\lapproached by something powerful\."
entries.translation_source: I have a feeling that if you bring a certain Pokémon alongside that [green][buffer1][blue] to a place where [green]only the strongest can go[blue], you may be approached by something powerful\.
entries.translated:
Aku merasa jika kau membawa Pokémon
tertentu bersama [green][buffer1][blue] itu ke\ltempat yang [green]hanya yang terkuat bisa

pergi[blue], kau mungkin akan didekati
oleh sesuatu yang kuat\.

entries.original: "Wingin’ It"
entries.translation_source: Wingin’ It
entries.translated: Wingin{B4} It

entries.original:
"I’m a lover of all things wings.

If you show me some beautiful wings
over the course of 4 different\ldays, I’ll share some of my\lbeautiful wings with you.

You wing it?"
entries.translation_source: I’m a lover of all things wings. If you show me some beautiful wings over the course of 4 different days, I’ll share some of my beautiful wings with you. You wing it?
entries.translated:
Aku pecinta segala hal yang
bersayap. Jika kau menunjukkan\lpadaku sayap-sayap indah selama 4

hari berbeda, aku akan berbagi
sebagian sayap indahku denganmu.\lKau mengerti?

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

For today, I’d like to see the
beautiful wings of a [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! For today, I’d like to see the beautiful wings of a [green][buffer1][blue].
entries.translated:
Wingderful! Untuk hari ini, aku
ingin melihat sayap indah dari\lseekor [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original: "That wings."
entries.translation_source: That wings.
entries.translated: Itu sayap.

entries.original:
"Let’s see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings!

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Let’s see those beautiful [green][buffer1][blue] wings! *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Mari lihat sayap [green][buffer1][blue] yang
indah itu! *Meraba* *Meraba*

entries.original: "Those are some mighty fine wings\."
entries.translation_source: Those are some mighty fine wings\.
entries.translated: Itu adalah sayap yang sangat bagus\.

entries.original:
"What\.?

I can’t see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings anywhere\."
entries.translation_source: What\.? I can’t see those beautiful [green][buffer1][blue] wings anywhere\.
entries.translated:
Apa\.? Aku tidak bisa melihat sayap
[green][buffer1][blue] yang indah itu di mana pun\.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer1][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [green][buffer1][blue] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Besok aku ingin melihat sayap
[green][buffer1][blue] yang bagus. Jangan bawa\lmereka hari ini. Aku sudah bosan

dengan sayap.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer2][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [green][buffer2][blue] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Besok aku ingin melihat sayap
[green][buffer2][blue] yang bagus. Jangan bawa\lmereka hari ini. Aku sudah bosan

dengan sayap.

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

I’ve seen all those beautiful wings
I’d never seen before!

As promised, I’d like to share my
wings with you!"
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! I’ve seen all those beautiful wings I’d never seen before! As promised, I’d like to share my wings with you!
entries.translated:
Wingderful! Aku sudah melihat semua
sayap indah yang belum pernah\lkulihat sebelumnya! Seperti yang

dijanjikan, aku ingin berbagi
sayapku denganmu!

entries.original:
"After seeing all those beautiful
wings, I’m all winged out for life!"
entries.translation_source: After seeing all those beautiful wings, I’m all winged out for life!
entries.translated:
Setelah melihat semua sayap indah
itu, aku sudah bosan dengan sayap\lseumur hidup!

entries.original: "Bye-Bye, Butterfree"
entries.translation_source: Bye-Bye, Butterfree
entries.translated: Sampai jumpa, Butterfree

entries.original:
"No\.

I need an experienced Trainer who’s
proven themself by defeating the\lElite 4 for my task."
entries.translation_source: No\. I need an experienced Trainer who’s proven themself by defeating the Elite 4 for my task.
entries.translated:
Tidak\. Aku butuh Pelatih
berpengalaman yang telah\lmembuktikan diri dengan mengalahkan

Elite Empat untuk tugasku.

entries.original:
"Ah, if it isn’t the Champion of the
Borrius region!

I have just the request for someone
of your skill level.

Would you like to hear it?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, if it isn’t the Champion of the Borrius region! I have just the request for someone of your skill level. Would you like to hear it?
entries.translated:
Ah, bukankah itu Juara dari wilayah
Borrius! Aku memiliki permintaan\lyang tepat untuk seseorang dengan

level keahlianmu. Apakah kamu ingin
mendengarnya?

entries.original:
"The task is simple: train a
[green]Butterfree[blue] to Level [green]70[blue] and\lpresent it to me.

It can be over Level 70, but it
must be at least that.

Once you’ve done that, I’ll inform
you of the next part of the task."
entries.translation_source: The task is simple: train a [green]Butterfree[blue] to Level [green]70[blue] and present it to me. It can be over Level 70, but it must be at least that. Once you’ve done that, I’ll inform you of the next part of the task.
entries.translated:
Tugasnya sederhana: latih seekor
[green]Butterfree[blue] ke Level [green]70[blue] dan\ltunjukkan padaku. Boleh di atas

Level 70, tapi setidaknya harus
begitu. Setelah kamu melakukannya,\laku akan memberitahumu bagian

selanjutnya dari tugas.

entries.original:
"Trainers like you don’t come
around every day."
entries.translation_source: Trainers like you don’t come around every day.
entries.translated:
Pelatih sepertimu tidak muncul
setiap hari.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a
Level [green]70 Butterfree[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a Level [green]70 Butterfree[blue]?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu membawakanku Level [green]70
Butterfree[blue]?

entries.original:
"Good, that’s just the Butterfree I
was looking for.

Now, [lightgreen]release[blue] it into the wild so
it can find love."
entries.translation_source: Good, that’s just the Butterfree I was looking for. Now, [lightgreen]release[blue] it into the wild so it can find love.
entries.translated:
Bagus, itulah Butterfree yang aku
cari. Sekarang, [lightgreen]lepaskan[blue] ke alam\lliar agar ia bisa menemukan cinta.

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] was released.
Bye-bye, [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] was released. Bye-bye, [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] telah dilepaskan. Sampai
jumpa, [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

Isn’t it beautiful?

That Butterfree will now find love
and be happy forever\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. Isn’t it beautiful? That Butterfree will now find love and be happy forever\.
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Bukankah itu indah? Butterfree
itu sekarang akan menemukan cinta\ldan bahagia selamanya\.

entries.original:
"For your heroic actions, I want
you to have my Butterfree in\lplace of the one you released."
entries.translation_source: For your heroic actions, I want you to have my Butterfree in place of the one you released.
entries.translated:
Atas tindakan heroikmu, aku ingin
kamu mendapatkan Butterfree-ku\lsebagai ganti yang kamu lepaskan.

entries.original:
"That Butterfree I gave you is
capable of [green]Gigantamaxing[blue]!

What’s that?

Well, use it in a [green]Hidden Grotto
Raid Battle[blue] and you’ll see!"
entries.translation_source: That Butterfree I gave you is capable of [green]Gigantamaxing[blue]! What’s that? Well, use it in a [green]Hidden Grotto Raid Battle[blue] and you’ll see!
entries.translated:
Butterfree yang kuberikan padamu
mampu melakukan [green]Gigantamax[blue]! Apa\litu? Nah, gunakan dalam [green]Pertempuran

Raid Gua Tersembunyi[blue] dan kamu akan
lihat!

entries.original:
"I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has
been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue].
entries.translated:
Aku ingin melihat [green]Butterfree[blue] yang
telah dilatih hingga setidaknya\lLevel [green]70[blue].

entries.original:
"That’s not the Pokémon I’m
looking for.

I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has
been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That’s not the Pokémon I’m looking for. I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue].
entries.translated:
Itu bukan Pokémon yang aku cari.
Aku ingin melihat [green]Butterfree[blue] yang\ltelah dilatih hingga setidaknya

Level [green]70[blue].

entries.original:
"That Butterfree is indeed Level 70
or higher, but you didn’t train it\lyourself!

I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has
been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That Butterfree is indeed Level 70 or higher, but you didn’t train it yourself! I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue].
entries.translated:
Butterfree itu memang Level 70 atau
lebih tinggi, tapi kamu tidak\lmelatihnya sendiri! Aku ingin

melihat [green]Butterfree[blue] yang telah
dilatih hingga setidaknya Level [green]70[blue].

entries.original:
"But\.

If you don’t release it, how will
your Butterfree ever find love?"
entries.translation_source: But\. If you don’t release it, how will your Butterfree ever find love?
entries.translated:
Tetapi\. Jika kamu tidak
melepaskannya, bagaimana\lButterfree-mu akan menemukan cinta?

entries.original: "The Communist Revolution"
entries.translation_source: The Communist Revolution
entries.translated: Revolusi Komunis

entries.original:
"Come here, kid, quietly.

Our whole region is secretly
controlled by the bourgeoisie\land the capitalists.

We in the working class have to
band together and rise up against\lthem in the name of communism!

Their weakness is free services.

If you heal at a Pokémon Center
enough times, their machine of\loppression will crumble."
entries.translation_source: Come here, kid, quietly. Our whole region is secretly controlled by the bourgeoisie and the capitalists. We in the working class have to band together and rise up against them in the name of communism! Their weakness is free services. If you heal at a Pokémon Center enough times, their machine of oppression will crumble.
entries.translated:
Kemari, nak, diam-diam. Seluruh
wilayah kita diam-diam dikuasai\loleh borjuasi dan kapitalis. Kita

di kelas pekerja harus bersatu dan
bangkit melawan mereka atas nama\lkomunisme! Kelemahan mereka adalah

layanan gratis. Jika kamu cukup
sering menyembuhkan di Pusat\lPokémon, mesin penindasan mereka

akan hancur.

entries.original:
"Workers of the world unite!

All you need to do is heal [green][buffer1][red]
times at any Pokémon Center.

Other than the one in Antisis City,
they’re all in on the revolution."
entries.translation_source: Workers of the world unite! All you need to do is heal [green][buffer1][red] times at any Pokémon Center. Other than the one in Antisis City, they’re all in on the revolution.
entries.translated:
Pekerja di seluruh dunia bersatu!
Yang perlu kamu lakukan adalah\lmenyembuhkan [green][buffer1][red] kali di Pusat

Pokémon mana pun. Selain yang ada
di Antisis City, semuanya terlibat\ldalam revolusi.

entries.original:
"Another proletarian brainwashed by
the capitalist machine of tyranny."
entries.translation_source: Another proletarian brainwashed by the capitalist machine of tyranny.
entries.translated:
Proletar lain yang dicuci otak oleh
mesin tirani kapitalis.

entries.original:
"So far you have used our free
service [green][buffer2][red] time\\07.

In order to overthrow the
capitalist tyrants, you will\lneed to heal another [green][buffer3][red] time\\08."
entries.translation_source: So far you have used our free service [green][buffer2][red] time\\07. In order to overthrow the capitalist tyrants, you will need to heal another [green][buffer3][red] time\\08.
entries.translated:
Sejauh ini kamu telah menggunakan
layanan gratis kami [green][buffer2][red] kali\\07.\lUntuk menggulingkan tiran

kapitalis, kamu perlu menyembuhkan
lagi [green][buffer3][red] kali\\08.

entries.original:
"Great work!

Now that the cogs of the capitalist
machine are broken, the workers of\lour world will unite in revolution\lagainst the bourgeoisie!

Here is a token of our
appreciation, comrade [player]."
entries.translation_source: Great work! Now that the cogs of the capitalist machine are broken, the workers of our world will unite in revolution against the bourgeoisie! Here is a token of our appreciation, comrade [player].
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus! Sekarang setelah roda
gigi mesin kapitalis hancur, para\lpekerja di dunia kita akan bersatu

dalam revolusi melawan borjuasi!
Ini adalah tanda penghargaan kami,\lkamerad [player].

entries.original:
"The communist revolution will
always be thankful to you,\lcomrade [player]."
entries.translation_source: The communist revolution will always be thankful to you, comrade [player].
entries.translated:
Revolusi komunis akan selalu
berterima kasih kepadamu, kamerad\l[player].

entries.original: "The Capitalist Revolution"
entries.translation_source: The Capitalist Revolution
entries.translated: Revolusi Kapitalis

entries.original:
"Shush, quiet.

Did you know that the Borrius
region is secretly governed by a\lcommunist consortium, that does\lcommunist things?

We can fight the power by you
buying enough unregistered goods\lfrom Poké Marts.

All Poké Marts are in on it.
You up for a capitalist revolution?"
entries.translation_source: Shush, quiet. Did you know that the Borrius region is secretly governed by a communist consortium, that does communist things? We can fight the power by you buying enough unregistered goods from Poké Marts. All Poké Marts are in on it. You up for a capitalist revolution?
entries.translated:
Ssst, diam. Apa kamu tahu bahwa
wilayah Borrius diam-diam\ldiperintah oleh konsorsium komunis,

yang melakukan hal-hal komunis?
Kita bisa melawan kekuasaan itu\ldengan kamu membeli cukup banyak

barang tidak terdaftar dari Poké
Mart. Semua Poké Mart terlibat.\lKamu siap untuk revolusi kapitalis?

entries.original:
"Long live the revolution!

If you make [green][buffer1][red] purchases from
Poké Marts, the communist system\lwill collapse, and our capitalist\lrevolution can begin."
entries.translation_source: Long live the revolution! If you make [green][buffer1][red] purchases from Poké Marts, the communist system will collapse, and our capitalist revolution can begin.
entries.translated:
Hidup revolusi! Jika kamu melakukan
[green][buffer1][red] pembelian dari Poké Mart,\lsistem komunis akan runtuh, dan

revolusi kapitalis kita bisa
dimulai.

entries.original:
"You are just another pawn of the
communist swines."
entries.translation_source: You are just another pawn of the communist swines.
entries.translated:
Kamu hanyalah pion lain dari babi
komunis itu.

entries.original:
"Our records show that so far you
have made [green][buffer2][red] purchase\\07.

We need another [green][buffer3][red] before our
capitalist revolution can begin."
entries.translation_source: Our records show that so far you have made [green][buffer2][red] purchase\\07. We need another [green][buffer3][red] before our capitalist revolution can begin.
entries.translated:
Catatan kami menunjukkan bahwa
sejauh ini kamu telah melakukan\l[green][buffer2][red] pembelian\\07. Kami

membutuhkan [green][buffer3][red] lagi sebelum
revolusi kapitalis kita bisa\ldimulai.

entries.original:
"Our records show that you have made
enough purchases.

We can now begin our capitalist
revolution.

Here, take these.

You will need them in our fight
against the communist swine."
entries.translation_source: Our records show that you have made enough purchases. We can now begin our capitalist revolution. Here, take these. You will need them in our fight against the communist swine.
entries.translated:
Catatan kami menunjukkan bahwa kamu
telah melakukan cukup banyak\lpembelian. Kita sekarang bisa

memulai revolusi kapitalis kita.
Ini, ambillah ini. Kamu akan\lmembutuhkannya dalam pertarungan

kita melawan babi komunis.

entries.original:
"The great war between the
capitalists and the communists\lwill begin any moment now."
entries.translation_source: The great war between the capitalists and the communists will begin any moment now.
entries.translated:
Perang besar antara kapitalis dan
komunis akan dimulai kapan saja\lsekarang.

entries.original: "Population Control"
entries.translation_source: Population Control
entries.translated: Kontrol Populasi

entries.original:
"Pokémon are evolutionarily
superior to people.

But as a consequence of this, they
have started to overpopulate.

We need to lower their wild
population before they realize that\lthey have the upper hand over us.

Can you catch [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon outside
of the Safari Zone in one day to\lslow their growth rate?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon are evolutionarily superior to people. But as a consequence of this, they have started to overpopulate. We need to lower their wild population before they realize that they have the upper hand over us. Can you catch [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon outside of the Safari Zone in one day to slow their growth rate?
entries.translated:
Pokémon superior secara evolusioner
dibanding manusia. Tetapi sebagai\lkonsekuensinya, mereka mulai

kelebihan populasi. Kita perlu
menurunkan populasi liar mereka\lsebelum mereka menyadari bahwa

mereka memiliki keunggulan atas
kita. Bisakah kamu menangkap\l[green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon di luar Safari

Zone dalam satu hari untuk
memperlambat laju pertumbuhan\lmereka?

entries.original:
"Hurry!

You must stop the Pokémon before
their numbers become too great."
entries.translation_source: Hurry! You must stop the Pokémon before their numbers become too great.
entries.translated:
Cepat! Kamu harus menghentikan
Pokémon sebelum jumlah mereka\lmenjadi terlalu besar.

entries.original:
"If Pokémon multiply and take over
the world, it’s your fault!"
entries.translation_source: If Pokémon multiply and take over the world, it’s your fault!
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon berkembang biak dan
menguasai dunia, itu salahmu!

entries.original:
"You have caught [green][buffer2][blue] Pokémon so far,
so you still need to capture [green][buffer3][blue]\lPokémon today.

Otherwise, there will be nothing
stopping the wild Pokémon from\lbecoming the dominant life forms."
entries.translation_source: You have caught [green][buffer2][blue] Pokémon so far, so you still need to capture [green][buffer3][blue] Pokémon today. Otherwise, there will be nothing stopping the wild Pokémon from becoming the dominant life forms.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah menangkap [green][buffer2][blue]
Pokémon sejauh ini, jadi kamu masih\lperlu menangkap [green][buffer3][blue] Pokémon

hari ini. Jika tidak, tidak akan
ada yang menghentikan Pokémon liar\lmenjadi bentuk kehidupan yang

dominan.

entries.original:
"Excellent work!

After your catching spree, you have
reduced the number of wild Pokémon\lby a significant number!

They will no longer be able to
overthrow us humans, and will\lalways remain subservient to us.

Here is a reward for your help to
the species."
entries.translation_source: Excellent work! After your catching spree, you have reduced the number of wild Pokémon by a significant number! They will no longer be able to overthrow us humans, and will always remain subservient to us. Here is a reward for your help to the species.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus! Setelah aksi
menangkapmu, kamu telah mengurangi\ljumlah Pokémon liar secara

signifikan! Mereka tidak akan bisa
lagi menggulingkan kita manusia,\ldan akan selalu tunduk pada kita.

Ini hadiah untuk bantuanmu kepada
spesies ini.

entries.original:
"[black]All Poké Ball catch rates have
been increased by [buffer1]%!"
entries.translation_source: [black]All Poké Ball catch rates have been increased by [buffer1]%!
entries.translated:
[black]Semua tingkat tangkapan Poké Ball
telah ditingkatkan sebesar\l[buffer1]%!

entries.original:
"Pokémon should not be allowed to
rule over humans."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon should not be allowed to rule over humans.
entries.translated:
Pokémon tidak boleh diizinkan untuk
memerintah manusia.

entries.original: "The Trash-Man"
entries.translation_source: The Trash-Man
entries.translated: Manusia Sampah

entries.original:
"I am the Trash-Man!

I live in trash!
I eat trash!

Don’t ask, that’s what I do.

I am not looking for garbage, I am
looking for the classiest pieces of\ltrash, but this requires effort.

I would rather pay you to do it
for me.

Will you search trash cans for me
to find at least [green][buffer1][blue] items?"
entries.translation_source: I am the Trash-Man! I live in trash! I eat trash! Don’t ask, that’s what I do. I am not looking for garbage, I am looking for the classiest pieces of trash, but this requires effort. I would rather pay you to do it for me. Will you search trash cans for me to find at least [green][buffer1][blue] items?
entries.translated:
Aku Manusia Sampah! Aku tinggal di
sampah! Aku makan sampah! Jangan\ltanya, itulah yang aku lakukan. Aku

tidak mencari sampah sembarangan,
aku mencari potongan sampah paling\lkelas, tapi ini butuh usaha. Aku

lebih suka membayarmu untuk
melakukannya untukku. Maukah kamu\lmencari tempat sampah untukku dan

menemukan setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]
barang?

entries.original:
"Go out and find me the most
delectable trash out there!"
entries.translation_source: Go out and find me the most delectable trash out there!
entries.translated:
Pergilah dan temukan sampah paling
lezat di luar sana!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry, I’ll just wait for
the next chump who wants to be\lhandsomely rewarded."
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry, I’ll just wait for the next chump who wants to be handsomely rewarded.
entries.translated:
Jangan khawatir, aku akan menunggu
orang bodoh berikutnya yang ingin\ldiberi hadiah yang menggiurkan.

entries.original:
"My trash senses tell me that you
have found [green][buffer2][blue] item\\07 in the trash\lso far.

Go search more lucrative trash and
find at least [green][buffer3][blue] more item\\08!"
entries.translation_source: My trash senses tell me that you have found [green][buffer2][blue] item\\07 in the trash so far. Go search more lucrative trash and find at least [green][buffer3][blue] more item\\08!
entries.translated:
Indra sampahku mengatakan bahwa
kamu telah menemukan [green][buffer2][blue] item\\07\ldi sampah sejauh ini. Pergi cari

sampah yang lebih menguntungkan dan
temukan setidaknya [green][buffer3][blue] item\\08\llagi!

entries.original:
"That’s some fine trash you got
there!

Here is some of my garbage for you
to take off my hands."
entries.translation_source: That’s some fine trash you got there! Here is some of my garbage for you to take off my hands.
entries.translated:
Itu sampah yang bagus yang kamu
dapatkan! Ini beberapa sampahku\luntuk kamu ambil dariku.

entries.original:
"Trash!

You can’t take my garbage if your
party is full."
entries.translation_source: Trash! You can’t take my garbage if your party is full.
entries.translated:
Sampah! Kamu tidak bisa mengambil
sampahku jika party-mu penuh.

entries.original:
"The Trash-Man is satisfied with the
trash you have gathered for him."
entries.translation_source: The Trash-Man is satisfied with the trash you have gathered for him.
entries.translated:
Manusia Sampah puas dengan sampah
yang kamu kumpulkan untuknya.

entries.original: "Darwin Was Right"
entries.translation_source: Darwin Was Right
entries.translated: Darwin Benar

entries.original:
"I believe that Arceus creates all
Pokémon, but I am also a woman of\lscience.

I am trying to figure out whether
religion or science is right.

I believe Pokémon evolution holds
the key to the answer.

Care to help?
I need [green][buffer1][red] observations."
entries.translation_source: I believe that Arceus creates all Pokémon, but I am also a woman of science. I am trying to figure out whether religion or science is right. I believe Pokémon evolution holds the key to the answer. Care to help? I need [green][buffer1][red] observations.
entries.translated:
Aku percaya bahwa Arceus
menciptakan semua Pokémon, tapi aku\ljuga seorang wanita sains. Aku

mencoba mencari tahu apakah agama
atau sains yang benar. Aku percaya\levolusi Pokémon memegang kunci

jawabannya. Mau membantu? Aku perlu
[green][buffer1][red] pengamatan.

entries.original:
"Excellent, I will need you to view
[green][buffer1][red] Pokémon evolutions, and report\lyour unbiased opinion."
entries.translation_source: Excellent, I will need you to view [green][buffer1][red] Pokémon evolutions, and report your unbiased opinion.
entries.translated:
Bagus, aku akan membutuhkanmu untuk
melihat [green][buffer1][red] evolusi Pokémon,\ldan laporkan pendapatmu yang tidak

memihak.

entries.original:
"I guess some people will always
remain ignorant of the secrets of\lscience and religion."
entries.translation_source: I guess some people will always remain ignorant of the secrets of science and religion.
entries.translated:
Kurasa beberapa orang akan selalu
tetap tidak tahu tentang rahasia\lsains dan agama.

entries.original:
"Your data is still not complete.

You need to evolve [green][buffer3][red] more
Pokémon to complete the dataset."
entries.translation_source: Your data is still not complete. You need to evolve [green][buffer3][red] more Pokémon to complete the dataset.
entries.translated:
Datamu masih belum lengkap. Kamu
perlu mengevulosi [green][buffer3][red] Pokémon\llagi untuk melengkapi dataset.

entries.original:
"Wow, you’re done!
Now, let’s look at the data.

\.

It says that there are both
scientific and religious facets to\lPokémon evolution.

Perhaps Arceus is more involved
than we know\.

Interesting, please take this
Pokémon as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: Wow, you’re done! Now, let’s look at the data. \. It says that there are both scientific and religious facets to Pokémon evolution. Perhaps Arceus is more involved than we know\. Interesting, please take this Pokémon as my thanks.
entries.translated:
Wow, kamu selesai! Sekarang, mari
kita lihat datanya. \. Data itu\lmengatakan bahwa ada aspek ilmiah

dan religius dalam evolusi Pokémon.
Mungkin Arceus lebih terlibat dari\lyang kita tahu\. Menarik, tolong

ambil Pokémon ini sebagai ucapan
terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"But make some space in your party,
first!"
entries.translation_source: But make some space in your party, first!
entries.translated: Tapi buat ruang di party-mu dulu!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon I gave you is known
as Mew.

It is said to be the species all
Pokémon evolved from.

We cloned it at the Science
Society, so the version you have\lis nothing more than a copy."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon I gave you is known as Mew. It is said to be the species all Pokémon evolved from. We cloned it at the Science Society, so the version you have is nothing more than a copy.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang kuberikan padamu
dikenal sebagai Mew. Dikatakan\lsebagai spesies dari mana semua

Pokémon berevolusi. Kami
mengkloningnya di Science Society,\ljadi versi yang kamu miliki tidak

lebih dari salinan.

entries.original: "Exp. Millionaire"
entries.translation_source: Exp. Millionaire
entries.translated: Jutawan Exp.

entries.original:
"Exp. is like gold. Earn [buffer1]
in one day to become truly rich."
entries.translation_source: Exp. is like gold. Earn [buffer1] in one day to become truly rich.
entries.translated:
Exp. bagaikan emas. Kumpulkan
[buffer1] dalam satu hari untuk\lmenjadi benar-benar kaya.

entries.original:
"I’m so rich, my swimming pool has
its own swimming pool!

And yet\.\CC0820 and yet, all the money
in the world doesn’t make me happy.

True wealth lies in a more
luxurious currency - Exp. Points!

So, are you willing to show me your
drive to become truly wealthy?"
entries.translation_source: I’m so rich, my swimming pool has its own swimming pool! And yet\.\CC0820 and yet, all the money in the world doesn’t make me happy. True wealth lies in a more luxurious currency - Exp. Points! So, are you willing to show me your drive to become truly wealthy?
entries.translated:
Aku sangat kaya, kolam renangku
punya kolam renang sendiri! Tapi\.\CC0820\ldan tetap saja, semua uang di dunia

tidak membuatku bahagia. Kekayaan
sejati terletak pada mata uang yang\llebih mewah - Poin Exp! Jadi,

apakah kamu bersedia menunjukkan
semangatmu untuk menjadi\lbenar-benar kaya?

entries.original:
"Then, demonstrate your hunger for
true wealth to me.

To become truly wealthy, have your
Pokémon earn [green][buffer1][red] Exp. Points\lin total within a single day."
entries.translation_source: Then, demonstrate your hunger for true wealth to me. To become truly wealthy, have your Pokémon earn [green][buffer1][red] Exp. Points in total within a single day.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, tunjukkan padaku rasa
hausmu akan kekayaan sejati. Untuk\lmenjadi benar-benar kaya, buat

Pokémon-mu mengumpulkan total
[green][buffer1][red] Poin Exp. dalam satu hari.

entries.original:
"Hmph. I should have expected no
less from a materialistic cretin."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. I should have expected no less from a materialistic cretin.
entries.translated:
Hmph. Seharusnya aku tidak berharap
lebih dari seorang tolol\lmaterialistis.

entries.original:
"So far, your Pokémon have earned
[green][buffer2][red] Exp. Point\\07 today.

But you must still earn another
[green][buffer3][red] Exp. Point\\08.

Only then can you rise above the
status of \qomoderately wealthy\qc."
entries.translation_source: So far, your Pokémon have earned [green][buffer2][red] Exp. Point\\07 today. But you must still earn another [green][buffer3][red] Exp. Point\\08. Only then can you rise above the status of \qomoderately wealthy\qc.
entries.translated:
Sejauh ini, Pokémon-mu telah
mengumpulkan [green][buffer2][red] Poin Exp\\07\lhari ini. Tapi kamu masih harus

mengumpulkan [green][buffer3][red] Poin Exp\\08
lagi. Hanya dengan itu kamu bisa\lnaik di atas status \qocukup kaya\qc.

entries.original:
"Incredible\.

Truly, you are the most amazingly
wealthy person I’ve ever known.

That drive\.\CC0820 that passion\.\CC0820
I know what I must do!

That’s it!

I won’t be needing my life savings
anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Incredible\. Truly, you are the most amazingly wealthy person I’ve ever known. That drive\.\CC0820 that passion\.\CC0820 I know what I must do! That’s it! I won’t be needing my life savings anymore!
entries.translated:
Luar biasa\. Benar-benar, kamu adalah
orang terkaya paling mengagumkan\lyang pernah kukenal. Semangat itu\.\CC0820

gairah itu\.\CC0820 Aku tahu apa yang harus
kulakukan! Itu dia! Aku tidak akan\lmembutuhkan tabungan hidupku lagi!

entries.original:
"Now I am free of materialistic
desires.

And finally\.\CC0820 finally I am truly
rich.

Most impressive, Trainer.

However, I see that your desire
for true wealth exceeds my own\.

Then, as your reward for your
drive\.\CC0818 ah, yes.

Take these Lucky Eggs."
entries.translation_source: Now I am free of materialistic desires. And finally\.\CC0820 finally I am truly rich. Most impressive, Trainer. However, I see that your desire for true wealth exceeds my own\. Then, as your reward for your drive\.\CC0818 ah, yes. Take these Lucky Eggs.
entries.translated:
Sekarang aku bebas dari keinginan
materialistis. Dan akhirnya\.\CC0820\lakhirnya aku benar-benar kaya.

Sangat mengesankan, Trainer. Namun,
aku melihat hasratmu akan kekayaan\lsejati melebihi milikku\. Maka,

sebagai hadiah atas semangatmu\.\CC0818 ah,
ya. Ambillah Telur Keberuntungan\lini.

entries.original:
"And in addition to those, allow me
to make them even luckier!"
entries.translation_source: And in addition to those, allow me to make them even luckier!
entries.translated:
Dan sebagai tambahan, izinkan aku
membuatnya lebih beruntung lagi!

entries.original:
"[black]The Lucky Egg level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

Pokémon will now gain [green]\\0C[black]* the
amount of Exp. Points when held."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Lucky Egg level has been increased to \Lv [buffer2]! Pokémon will now gain [green]\\0C[black]* the amount of Exp. Points when held.
entries.translated:
[black]Level Telur Keberuntungan telah
ditingkatkan menjadi \Lv [buffer2]!\lPokémon sekarang akan mendapatkan

[green]\\0C[black]* jumlah Poin Exp. saat dibawa.

entries.original:
"If you desire, I can upgrade your
Lucky Eggs even more.

But I’m afraid I’ll need more than
Exp. Points to upgrade them.

Find me [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] and I’ll
upgrade your Lucky Eggs again.

I\.\CC0818 I just realized, I still need
food, after all."
entries.translation_source: If you desire, I can upgrade your Lucky Eggs even more. But I’m afraid I’ll need more than Exp. Points to upgrade them. Find me [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] and I’ll upgrade your Lucky Eggs again. I\.\CC0818 I just realized, I still need food, after all.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mau, aku bisa
meningkatkan Telur Keberuntunganmu\llebih banyak lagi. Tapi aku

khawatir aku membutuhkan lebih dari
Poin Exp. untuk meningkatkannya.\lTemukan aku [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] dan

aku akan meningkatkan Telur
Keberuntunganmu lagi. Aku\.\CC0818 Aku baru\lsadar, aku masih butuh makanan,

bagaimanapun juga.

entries.original:
"Greetings, are you here to have
your [green]Lucky Eggs[red] upgraded?

I’ll need [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] to raise
their luck further to [green]\Lv [buffer2][red]."
entries.translation_source: Greetings, are you here to have your [green]Lucky Eggs[red] upgraded? I’ll need [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] to raise their luck further to [green]\Lv [buffer2][red].
entries.translated:
Salam, apakah kamu di sini untuk
meningkatkan [green]Telur\lKeberuntungan[red]-mu? Aku butuh

[green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] untuk
meningkatkan keberuntungan mereka\llebih lanjut ke [green]\Lv [buffer2][red].

entries.original:
"No? Then could you spare any change
before you leave?"
entries.translation_source: No? Then could you spare any change before you leave?
entries.translated:
Tidak? Kalau begitu, bisakah kamu
menyisihkan sedikit uang sebelum\lpergi?

entries.original:
"I’m afraid you don’t have enough
[green][buffer1][red].

At least, not enough to keep me
fed for the week\."
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid you don’t have enough [green][buffer1][red]. At least, not enough to keep me fed for the week\.
entries.translated:
Maaf, kamu tidak memiliki cukup
[green][buffer1][red]. Setidaknya, tidak cukup\luntuk memberiku makan selama

seminggu\.

entries.original:
"With an Exp. Point bonus of [green]\\0C[red]*,
there’s nothing more I can do\lfor your Lucky Eggs.

Now how will I feed myself?"
entries.translation_source: With an Exp. Point bonus of [green]\\0C[red]*, there’s nothing more I can do for your Lucky Eggs. Now how will I feed myself?
entries.translated:
Dengan bonus Poin Exp. sebesar [green]\\0C[red]*,
tidak ada lagi yang bisa kulakukan\luntuk Telur Keberuntunganmu.

Sekarang bagaimana aku akan memberi
makan diriku sendiri?

entries.original:
"The [green]Inverse Trainer House[blue]
is famous.

Many people come to Fallshore
City just to battle with type\lmatchups reversed."
entries.translation_source: The [green]Inverse Trainer House[blue] is famous. Many people come to Fallshore City just to battle with type matchups reversed.
entries.translated:
[green]Inverse Trainer House[blue] terkenal.
Banyak orang datang ke Kota\lFallshore hanya untuk bertarung

dengan kelemahan tipe yang
terbalik.

entries.original:
"Every step you take, your Pokémon
become more attached to you.

If you have a Pokémon in the
Day-Care, it will get stronger too."
entries.translation_source: Every step you take, your Pokémon become more attached to you. If you have a Pokémon in the Day-Care, it will get stronger too.
entries.translated:
Setiap langkah yang kamu ambil,
Pokémon-mu semakin terikat\ldenganmu. Jika kamu memiliki

Pokémon di Day-Care, ia juga akan
menjadi lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"I heard that a bunch of people are
up to no good on [green]Route 9[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I heard that a bunch of people are up to no good on [green]Route 9[blue].
entries.translated:
Aku dengar sekelompok orang sedang
berbuat jahat di [green]Route 9[blue].

entries.original:
"Did you hear?

Someone took care of the
troublemakers on Route 9!"
entries.translation_source: Did you hear? Someone took care of the troublemakers on Route 9!
entries.translated:
Kau dengar? Seseorang sudah
berurusan dengan para pembuat onar\ldi Route 9!

entries.original:
"I make a ton of my money selling
items I find on Wild Pokémon.

My Venonat’s [green]Compound Eyes[blue] helps
me lure in the ones with items,\lthen I switch out and use [green]Knock Off[blue]\lto nab ’em!"
entries.translation_source: I make a ton of my money selling items I find on Wild Pokémon. My Venonat’s [green]Compound Eyes[blue] helps me lure in the ones with items, then I switch out and use [green]Knock Off[blue] to nab ’em!
entries.translated:
Aku menghasilkan banyak uang dengan
menjual item yang kutemukan dari\lPokémon Liar. Venonat-ku dengan

[green]Mata Majemuk[blue] membantuku memancing
yang memiliki item, lalu aku\lmengganti dan menggunakan [green]Pukulan

Penghabisan[blue] untuk mengambilnya!

entries.original:
"If you have the [green]Fall Badge[red], you can
buy [green]Ultra Balls[red]!

They’re way better at catching
Pokémon than Great Balls."
entries.translation_source: If you have the [green]Fall Badge[red], you can buy [green]Ultra Balls[red]! They’re way better at catching Pokémon than Great Balls.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memiliki [green]Lencana Gugur[red],
kamu bisa membeli [green]Bola Ultra[red]!\lMereka jauh lebih baik dalam

menangkap Pokémon daripada Bola
Hebat.

entries.original:
"Welcome to Flower Paradise!

While you are here, please be
careful to respect the flowers and\lthe Pokémon that live in them."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to Flower Paradise! While you are here, please be careful to respect the flowers and the Pokémon that live in them.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Flower Paradise!
Selama berada di sini, harap\lhati-hati untuk menghormati bunga

dan Pokémon yang hidup di dalamnya.

entries.original:
"Do you know about Gracidea
flowers?

They’re given as bouquets to
express feelings of gratitude.

In fact, some Gracidea flowers
even bloom in this very paradise!"
entries.translation_source: Do you know about Gracidea flowers? They’re given as bouquets to express feelings of gratitude. In fact, some Gracidea flowers even bloom in this very paradise!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tahu tentang Bunga
Gracidea? Bunga ini diberikan\lsebagai karangan bunga untuk

mengungkapkan perasaan terima
kasih. Bahkan, beberapa Bunga\lGracidea mekar di surga ini

sendiri!

entries.original:
"Oh, Shaymin!

When it comes to Shaymin,
Gracidea flowers are important!

I have a lot of Gracidea flowers,
so let me share one with you."
entries.translation_source: Oh, Shaymin! When it comes to Shaymin, Gracidea flowers are important! I have a lot of Gracidea flowers, so let me share one with you.
entries.translated:
Oh, Shaymin! Kalau soal Shaymin,
Bunga Gracidea itu penting! Aku\lpunya banyak Bunga Gracidea, jadi

biarkan aku berbagi satu denganmu.

entries.original:
"Since early times, people have made
bouquets of Gracidea flowers to\lshow their feelings of gratitude.

Isn’t that interesting?

By giving a Gracidea bouquet, you
don’t have to say a word and\lsomeone will know how grateful you\lare.

Quite a delightful custom!"
entries.translation_source: Since early times, people have made bouquets of Gracidea flowers to show their feelings of gratitude. Isn’t that interesting? By giving a Gracidea bouquet, you don’t have to say a word and someone will know how grateful you are. Quite a delightful custom!
entries.translated:
Sejak zaman dahulu, orang membuat
karangan bunga Gracidea untuk\lmenunjukkan perasaan terima kasih.

Menarik, bukan? Dengan memberikan
karangan bunga Gracidea, kamu tidak\lperlu mengucapkan sepatah kata pun

dan seseorang akan tahu betapa
bersyukurnya kamu. Sungguh\lkebiasaan yang menyenangkan!

entries.original:
"Berries are wonderful, don’t you
think?

They’re food for people and
Pokémon alike, and they make\lthe world much more beautiful\lto live in!

Here, let me share with you!"
entries.translation_source: Berries are wonderful, don’t you think? They’re food for people and Pokémon alike, and they make the world much more beautiful to live in! Here, let me share with you!
entries.translated:
Berry itu luar biasa, bukan? Mereka
adalah makanan bagi manusia dan\lPokémon, dan mereka membuat dunia

ini lebih indah untuk ditinggali!
Ini, biarkan aku berbagi denganmu!

entries.original:
"If you’d like some more Berries,
come see me again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: If you’d like some more Berries, come see me again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin Berry lagi, temui
aku lagi besok!

entries.original: "Honey Gather"
entries.translation_source: Honey Gather
entries.translated: Pengumpul Madu

entries.original:
"Excuse me, Trainer, would you be
able to lend me a hand, please?

You see, my family and I are having
a big feast soon, and we need lots\lof Honey for our meal.

I’ve already collected seven jars,
but I need at least three more.

I heard they could be found on wild
Combee, but I’m not having much\lluck finding them.

So how about it?

Are you able to find [green]3[red] Combee
and give me their [green]Honey[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Excuse me, Trainer, would you be able to lend me a hand, please? You see, my family and I are having a big feast soon, and we need lots of Honey for our meal. I’ve already collected seven jars, but I need at least three more. I heard they could be found on wild Combee, but I’m not having much luck finding them. So how about it? Are you able to find [green]3[red] Combee and give me their [green]Honey[red]?
entries.translated:
Maaf, Pelatih, bisakah kamu
membantu saya? Soalnya, keluarga\lsaya dan saya akan mengadakan pesta

besar sebentar lagi, dan kami
membutuhkan banyak Madu untuk\lhidangan kami. Saya sudah

mengumpulkan tujuh toples, tapi
saya butuh setidaknya tiga lagi.\lSaya dengar mereka bisa ditemukan

pada Combee liar, tapi saya kurang
beruntung menemukannya. Jadi\lbagaimana? Bisakah kamu menemukan [green]3[red]

Combee dan memberikan [green]Madu[red] mereka
kepada saya?

entries.original:
"Great!
Thank you for agreeing to help!

Combee can be found all over
Flower Paradise.

Although, you’d have more luck
finding them in the [blue]blue[red] flowers.

You might also want to try catching
a [green]Cutiefly[red] with [green]Honey Gather[red].

There’s a chance it’ll find Honey
after each battle, and you’ll be\lnotified if it does!"
entries.translation_source: Great! Thank you for agreeing to help! Combee can be found all over Flower Paradise. Although, you’d have more luck finding them in the [blue]blue[red] flowers. You might also want to try catching a [green]Cutiefly[red] with [green]Honey Gather[red]. There’s a chance it’ll find Honey after each battle, and you’ll be notified if it does!
entries.translated:
Bagus! Terima kasih sudah setuju
membantu! Combee dapat ditemukan di\lseluruh Flower Paradise. Namun,

kamu akan lebih beruntung
menemukannya di bunga [blue]biru[red]. Kamu\lmungkin juga ingin menangkap

[green]Cutiefly[red] dengan kemampuan [green]Pengumpul
Madu[red]. Ada kemungkinan ia akan\lmenemukan Madu setelah setiap

pertarungan, dan kamu akan diberi
tahu jika itu terjadi!

entries.original:
"You got them! Thank you so much!
Let me take them off your hands."
entries.translation_source: You got them! Thank you so much! Let me take them off your hands.
entries.translated:
Kamu mendapatkannya! Terima kasih
banyak! Biarkan saya mengambilnya\ldarimu.

entries.original:
"For helping me out, please take
this TM as a reward. I insist!"
entries.translation_source: For helping me out, please take this TM as a reward. I insist!
entries.translated:
Sebagai hadiah karena membantu
saya, silakan ambil TM ini. Saya\lbersikeras!

entries.original:
"Combee can be found all over Flower
Paradise, however they are more\llikely to appear in the [blue]blue[red]\lflowers.

If you catch a [green]Cutiefly[red] with [green]Honey
Gather[red], that may help as well.

And remember, I need at least [green]3
Honey[red] jars."
entries.translation_source: Combee can be found all over Flower Paradise, however they are more likely to appear in the [blue]blue[red] flowers. If you catch a [green]Cutiefly[red] with [green]Honey Gather[red], that may help as well. And remember, I need at least [green]3 Honey[red] jars.
entries.translated:
Combee dapat ditemukan di seluruh
Flower Paradise, namun mereka lebih\lmungkin muncul di bunga [blue]biru[red]. Jika

kamu menangkap [green]Cutiefly[red] dengan
kemampuan [green]Pengumpul Madu[red], itu juga\lbisa membantu. Dan ingat, saya

butuh setidaknya [green]3 Madu[red] toples.

entries.original:
"That’s too bad.

I’ll have to keep looking
myself, then."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad. I’ll have to keep looking myself, then.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali. Kalau begitu, saya
harus mencarinya sendiri.

entries.original:
"Thank you again for helping me
before!

My family and I had a great two-day
feast because of your help.

Now it’s time to prepare for next
year’s feast!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you again for helping me before! My family and I had a great two-day feast because of your help. Now it’s time to prepare for next year’s feast!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih lagi atas bantuanmu
sebelumnya! Keluarga saya dan saya\lmenikmati pesta dua hari yang luar

biasa berkat bantuanmu. Sekarang
saatnya mempersiapkan pesta tahun\ldepan!

entries.original: "[green]Kyuu uuhn."
entries.translation_source: [green]Kyuu uuhn.
entries.translated: [green]Kyuu uuhn.

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] fled into the
field of flowers."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] fled into the field of flowers.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] melarikan diri ke ladang
bunga.

entries.original:
"Only Trainers who have proven
themselves worthy in battle may\lpass through here.

\.

You are not worthy."
entries.translation_source: Only Trainers who have proven themselves worthy in battle may pass through here. \. You are not worthy.
entries.translated:
Hanya Pelatih yang telah
membuktikan diri layak dalam\lpertempuran yang boleh lewat sini. \.

Kamu tidak layak.

entries.original:
"Only Trainers who have proven
themselves worthy in battle may\lpass through here.

\.

You are worthy."
entries.translation_source: Only Trainers who have proven themselves worthy in battle may pass through here. \. You are worthy.
entries.translated:
Hanya Pelatih yang telah
membuktikan diri layak dalam\lpertempuran yang boleh lewat sini. \.

Kamu layak.

entries.original: "You may pass."
entries.translation_source: You may pass.
entries.translated: Kamu boleh lewat.

entries.original:
"You see those rocks on the wall?

If you have a Pokémon that can use
[green]Rock Climb[blue], you can cruise up ’em!"
entries.translation_source: You see those rocks on the wall? If you have a Pokémon that can use [green]Rock Climb[blue], you can cruise up ’em!
entries.translated:
Kamu lihat batu-batu di dinding
itu? Jika kamu punya Pokémon yang\lbisa menggunakan [green]Panjat Tebing[blue],

kamu bisa memanjatnya!

entries.original:
"ENGAGING FROM
BEHIND IS THE
KEY."
entries.translation_source: ENGAGING FROM BEHIND IS THE KEY.
entries.translated:
MENYERANG DARI BELAKANG ADALAH
KUNCI.

entries.original:
"[black]Aggron blew you away with its
powerful Roar!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Aggron blew you away with its powerful Roar!
entries.translated:
[black]Aggron menghempaskanmu dengan
Aumannya yang kuat!

entries.original: "[black]Aggron mysteriously disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [black]Aggron mysteriously disappeared.
entries.translated: [black]Aggron menghilang secara misterius.

entries.original:
"I am warning you now, we are not
called the \qoDevil Duo\qc for nothing.

This battle will not go as you
hope.

You have been warned\."
entries.translation_source: I am warning you now, we are not called the \qoDevil Duo\qc for nothing. This battle will not go as you hope. You have been warned\.
entries.translated:
Aku peringatkan sekarang, kami
tidak dipanggil \qoDuo Setan\qc tanpa\lalasan. Pertarungan ini tidak akan

berjalan sesuai harapanmu. Kamu
sudah diperingatkan\.

entries.original:
"It seems my warning was
not necessary\."
entries.translation_source: It seems my warning was not necessary\.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya peringatanku tidak
diperlukan\.

entries.original:
"For your wonderful display of
battle prowess, I confer upon\lyou this special Z-Crystal."
entries.translation_source: For your wonderful display of battle prowess, I confer upon you this special Z-Crystal.
entries.translated:
Atas penampilan luar biasa dalam
pertempuran, aku berikan padamu\lZ-Crystal spesial ini.

entries.original:
"That Mimikium Z can be used to
activate [green]Mimikyu’s[blue] signature Z-Move\lby upgrading its [green]Play Rough[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That Mimikium Z can be used to activate [green]Mimikyu’s[blue] signature Z-Move by upgrading its [green]Play Rough[blue].
entries.translated:
Mimikium Z itu dapat digunakan
untuk mengaktifkan [green]Mimikyu{B4}s[blue] Z-Move\lkhas dengan meningkatkan [green]Play

Rough[blue]-nya.

entries.original:
"Many call us the \qoDevil Duo.\qc

It was a nickname conferred upon us
after defeating every opponent we\lcame across.

As such, we will only challenge the
strongest Trainers.

You are not there yet."
entries.translation_source: Many call us the \qoDevil Duo.\qc It was a nickname conferred upon us after defeating every opponent we came across. As such, we will only challenge the strongest Trainers. You are not there yet.
entries.translated:
Banyak yang memanggil kami \qoDuo
Setan.\qc Julukan itu diberikan\lsetelah kami mengalahkan setiap

lawan yang kami temui. Karena itu,
kami hanya akan menantang Trainer\lterkuat. Kamu belum sampai di level

itu.

entries.original:
"Many call us the \qoDevil Duo.\qc

It was a nickname conferred upon us
after defeating every opponent we\lcame across.

If you wish to defeat us, you must
be able to battle [green]two on two[blue] with\lonly [green]Fighting[blue]- and [green]Dragon[blue]-types."
entries.translation_source: Many call us the \qoDevil Duo.\qc It was a nickname conferred upon us after defeating every opponent we came across. If you wish to defeat us, you must be able to battle [green]two on two[blue] with only [green]Fighting[blue]- and [green]Dragon[blue]-types.
entries.translated:
Banyak yang memanggil kami \qoDuo
Setan.\qc Julukan itu diberikan\lsetelah kami mengalahkan setiap

lawan yang kami temui. Jika kamu
ingin mengalahkan kami, kamu harus\lbisa bertarung [green]dua lawan dua[blue] hanya

dengan [green]Fighting[blue] dan [green]Dragon[blue].

entries.original:
"Fu fu fu\.

Coming here is no simple feat.

You must know, however, they do
not call us the \qoDevil Duo\qc for\lnothing!

Prepare for a trip to the abyss!"
entries.translation_source: Fu fu fu\. Coming here is no simple feat. You must know, however, they do not call us the \qoDevil Duo\qc for nothing! Prepare for a trip to the abyss!
entries.translated:
Fu fu fu\. Datang ke sini bukanlah
prestasi sederhana. Namun, kamu\lharus tahu, mereka tidak memanggil

kami \qoDuo Setan\qc tanpa alasan!
Bersiaplah untuk perjalanan ke\ljurang!

entries.original: "Indeed, you were prepared\."
entries.translation_source: Indeed, you were prepared\.
entries.translated: Memang, kamu sudah siap\.

entries.original:
"For your excellent showing in
battle, I present to you this\lspecial Z-Crystal."
entries.translation_source: For your excellent showing in battle, I present to you this special Z-Crystal.
entries.translated:
Atas penampilanmu yang sangat baik
dalam pertempuran, aku persembahkan\lZ-Crystal spesial ini.

entries.original:
"If you bestow the [green]Mimikium Z[red] upon a
[green]Mimikyu[red], you may upgrade its [green]Play\lRough[red] into its signature Z-Move."
entries.translation_source: If you bestow the [green]Mimikium Z[red] upon a [green]Mimikyu[red], you may upgrade its [green]Play Rough[red] into its signature Z-Move.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memberikan [green]Mimikium Z[red]
kepada [green]Mimikyu[red], kamu dapat\lmeningkatkan [green]Play Rough[red]-nya menjadi

Z-Move khasnya.

entries.original:
"Fu fu fu\.

Coming here is no simple feat.

You must know, however, they do
not call us the \qoDevil Duo\qc for\lnothing!

You, unfortunately, are not capable
of battling us, just yet."
entries.translation_source: Fu fu fu\. Coming here is no simple feat. You must know, however, they do not call us the \qoDevil Duo\qc for nothing! You, unfortunately, are not capable of battling us, just yet.
entries.translated:
Fu fu fu\. Datang ke sini bukanlah
prestasi sederhana. Namun, kamu\lharus tahu, mereka tidak memanggil

kami \qoDuo Setan\qc tanpa alasan!
Sayangnya, kamu belum mampu\lbertarung melawan kami, untuk saat

ini.

entries.original:
"Fu fu fu\.

Coming here is no simple feat.

You must know, however, they do
not call us the \qoDevil Duo\qc for\lnothing!

If you wish to battle with us, you
must be capable of battling [green]two on\ltwo[red] with only [green]Fighting[red]- and [green]Dragon[red]-\ltypes at your side."
entries.translation_source: Fu fu fu\. Coming here is no simple feat. You must know, however, they do not call us the \qoDevil Duo\qc for nothing! If you wish to battle with us, you must be capable of battling [green]two on two[red] with only [green]Fighting[red]- and [green]Dragon[red]- types at your side.
entries.translated:
Fu fu fu\. Datang ke sini bukanlah
prestasi sederhana. Namun, kamu\lharus tahu, mereka tidak memanggil

kami \qoDuo Setan\qc tanpa alasan! Jika
kamu ingin bertarung dengan kami,\lkamu harus mampu bertarung [green]dua

lawan dua[red] hanya dengan [green]Fighting[red] dan
[green]Dragon[red] di sisimu.

entries.original:
"A while ago, some thugs with a big
Granbull face on their backs tried\lto capture the rare blue bird that\lused to live in Frost Mountain.

But it just turned a good chunk of
them into popsicles and flew off\lsomewhere.

I wonder if it’ll come back\."
entries.translation_source: A while ago, some thugs with a big Granbull face on their backs tried to capture the rare blue bird that used to live in Frost Mountain. But it just turned a good chunk of them into popsicles and flew off somewhere. I wonder if it’ll come back\.
entries.translated:
Beberapa waktu lalu, beberapa
preman dengan wajah Granbull besar\ldi punggung mereka mencoba

menangkap burung biru langka yang
dulu tinggal di Frost Mountain.\lTapi burung itu malah mengubah

sebagian besar dari mereka menjadi
es krim dan terbang entah ke mana.\lAku penasaran apakah ia akan

kembali\.

entries.original:
"The frost-covered ground in this
cave is my inspiration."
entries.translation_source: The frost-covered ground in this cave is my inspiration.
entries.translated:
Lantai yang tertutup embun beku di
gua ini adalah inspirasiku.

entries.original:
"My brother likes to challenge
Trainers to hop themselves."
entries.translation_source: My brother likes to challenge Trainers to hop themselves.
entries.translated:
Kakakku suka menantang Trainer
untuk melompat sendiri.

entries.original:
"I won’t stop you from climbing, but
