don’t forget to heal up first!"
entries.translation_source: I won’t stop you from climbing, but don’t forget to heal up first!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak akan menghentikanmu
memanjat, tapi jangan lupa untuk\lmemulihkan diri dulu!

entries.original:
"This cave is pretty small,
isn’t it?

I don’t know why that guy down
below insists on telling Trainers\lit’s 20 floors high\."
entries.translation_source: This cave is pretty small, isn’t it? I don’t know why that guy down below insists on telling Trainers it’s 20 floors high\.
entries.translated:
Gua ini cukup kecil, bukan? Aku
tidak tahu kenapa orang di bawah\litu bersikeras memberi tahu Trainer

bahwa gua ini setinggi 20 lantai\.

entries.original:
"Have you ever read the comics
about Crobatman?

He’s just an ordinary guy who
dresses up like a Crobat to fight\lcrime!

But between you and me, I don’t see
why he can’t just let his Pokémon\ldo the fighting for him\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever read the comics about Crobatman? He’s just an ordinary guy who dresses up like a Crobat to fight crime! But between you and me, I don’t see why he can’t just let his Pokémon do the fighting for him\.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu pernah membaca komik
tentang Crobatman? Dia hanyalah\lpria biasa yang berdandan seperti

Crobat untuk melawan kejahatan!
Tapi antara kamu dan aku, aku tidak\lmengerti kenapa dia tidak bisa

membiarkan Pokémon-nya bertarung
untuknya\.

entries.original:
"The door has been forced shut
behind you."
entries.translation_source: The door has been forced shut behind you.
entries.translated:
Pintu telah ditutup paksa di
belakangmu.

entries.original: "[black]The door is sealed shut."
entries.translation_source: [black]The door is sealed shut.
entries.translated: [black]Pintu tertutup rapat.

entries.original:
"There’s something irresistable
about that sign\."
entries.translation_source: There’s something irresistable about that sign\.
entries.translated:
Ada sesuatu yang tak tertahankan
dari tanda itu\.

entries.original: "What a great read!"
entries.translation_source: What a great read!
entries.translated: Bacaan yang bagus!

entries.original:
"North of here is the entrance to
an underground highway.

The only problem is that it’s
blocked by some skinny tree.

I just wish I knew how to get
past it."
entries.translation_source: North of here is the entrance to an underground highway. The only problem is that it’s blocked by some skinny tree. I just wish I knew how to get past it.
entries.translated:
Di utara sini ada pintu masuk ke
jalan bawah tanah. Satu-satunya\lmasalah adalah itu terhalang oleh

pohon kurus. Aku hanya berharap aku
tahu cara melewatinya.

entries.original:
"The skinny tree that was blocking
the underground highway\lmysteriously disappeared\.

Will it ever return?

That is the question I will be
haunted with for the rest of\lmy life."
entries.translation_source: The skinny tree that was blocking the underground highway mysteriously disappeared\. Will it ever return? That is the question I will be haunted with for the rest of my life.
entries.translated:
Pohon kurus yang menghalangi jalan
bawah tanah itu menghilang secara\lmisterius\. Akankah ia kembali?

Itulah pertanyaan yang akan
menghantuiku selama sisa hidupku.

entries.original:
"Is it true?
You’re leaving home, [player]?

Then don’t forget to take any items
out of your PC before you go!"
entries.translation_source: Is it true? You’re leaving home, [player]? Then don’t forget to take any items out of your PC before you go!
entries.translated:
Benarkah? Kamu akan meninggalkan
rumah, [player]? Maka jangan lupa\lmengambil barang-barang dari PC-mu

sebelum pergi!

entries.original:
"Prof. Log rarely leaves his lab.

When does he go home?
Does he even have a home?"
entries.translation_source: Prof. Log rarely leaves his lab. When does he go home? Does he even have a home?
entries.translated:
Prof. Log jarang meninggalkan
labnya. Kapan dia pulang? Apakah\ldia punya rumah?

entries.original:
"Congrats on becoming the Champion,
[player]!

I bet those items in your PC really
helped you out, eh?"
entries.translation_source: Congrats on becoming the Champion, [player]! I bet those items in your PC really helped you out, eh?
entries.translated:
Selamat menjadi Juara, [player]!
Aku yakin barang-barang di PC-mu\lsangat membantumu, ya?

entries.original:
"Technology is amazing!

You can play ROM Hacks with an
in-game clock on almost any device!"
entries.translation_source: Technology is amazing! You can play ROM Hacks with an in-game clock on almost any device!
entries.translated:
Teknologi luar biasa! Kamu bisa
memainkan ROM Hack dengan jam dalam\lgame di hampir semua perangkat!

entries.original:
"Huh? What’s this?
Are you from the future?

\.

Are you crazy?

What made you think you had the
right to travel through time?

\.

Look, I get it, you made a rookie
mistake.

I can let you off easy this time.

Just this once, if you don’t want
to wait until [green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue] for your\linternal clock to fix itself, I\lcan reset it to today’s date.

But just this once!

Are you sure you want me to reset
your clock?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What’s this? Are you from the future? \. Are you crazy? What made you think you had the right to travel through time? \. Look, I get it, you made a rookie mistake. I can let you off easy this time. Just this once, if you don’t want to wait until [green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue] for your internal clock to fix itself, I can reset it to today’s date. But just this once! Are you sure you want me to reset your clock?
entries.translated:
Hah? Apa ini? Apa kamu dari masa
depan? \. Apa kamu gila? Apa yang\lmembuatmu berpikir kamu punya hak

untuk bepergian melintasi waktu? \.
Dengar, aku mengerti, kamu\lmelakukan kesalahan pemula. Aku

bisa memaafkanmu kali ini. Hanya
sekali ini, jika kamu tidak ingin\lmenunggu sampai

[green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue] agar jam
internalmu memperbaiki dirinya\lsendiri, aku bisa mengatur ulang ke

tanggal hari ini. Tapi hanya sekali
ini! Apa kamu yakin ingin aku\lmengatur ulang jam-mu?

entries.original:
"Okay, doofus, your clock has been
reset.

Don’t go around messing with it
again, because I won’t be able to\lhelp you next time!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, doofus, your clock has been reset. Don’t go around messing with it again, because I won’t be able to help you next time!
entries.translated:
Oke, tolol, jam-mu sudah diatur
ulang. Jangan main-main lagi,\lkarena aku tidak akan bisa

membantumu lain kali!

entries.original:
"Technology is amazing, you know,
and if you wait until [green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue],\lyour internal clock will fix itself."
entries.translation_source: Technology is amazing, you know, and if you wait until [green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue], your internal clock will fix itself.
entries.translated:
Teknologi luar biasa, tahu, dan
jika kamu menunggu sampai\l[green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue], jam

internalmu akan memperbaiki dirinya
sendiri.

entries.original: "Mom"
entries.translation_source: Mom
entries.translated: Ibu

entries.original:
"[player]!
Where have you been?

I was really worried about you!

\.

Wow\.

That sounds awfully frightening!
I’m really glad you’re safe now!

Before you do anything else, you
should take a nice, long rest."
entries.translation_source: [player]! Where have you been? I was really worried about you! \. Wow\. That sounds awfully frightening! I’m really glad you’re safe now! Before you do anything else, you should take a nice, long rest.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kemana saja kamu? Aku
sangat khawatir padamu! \. Wow\.\lKedengarannya sangat menakutkan!

Aku sangat senang kamu aman
sekarang! Sebelum melakukan hal\llain, kamu harus beristirahat

dengan baik dan panjang.

entries.original:
"Don’t you feel much better now,
sweetie?

Now you’ve got the energy to run
Prof. Log’s errand for him!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you feel much better now, sweetie? Now you’ve got the energy to run Prof. Log’s errand for him!
entries.translated:
Bukankah kamu merasa jauh lebih
baik sekarang, sayang? Sekarang\lkamu punya energi untuk menjalankan

tugas Prof. Log untuknya!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I always knew that the day would
come when you would leave home\.

It said so on TV.

If only your father could see you
now\.\CC0820 he’d be so proud!

Well, if you’re going to run
errands for Prof. Log, you’ll\lneed this!"
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. I always knew that the day would come when you would leave home\. It said so on TV. If only your father could see you now\.\CC0820 he’d be so proud! Well, if you’re going to run errands for Prof. Log, you’ll need this!
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Aku selalu tahu bahwa suatu
hari akan tiba saat kamu\lmeninggalkan rumah\. Itu sudah

dikatakan di TV. Andai saja ayahmu
bisa melihatmu sekarang\.\CC0820 dia pasti\lsangat bangga! Nah, jika kamu akan

menjalankan tugas untuk Prof. Log,
kamu akan membutuhkan ini!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Super Cube’s
Mission Log component from Mom!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Super Cube’s Mission Log component from Mom!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima komponen Mission
Log Super Cube dari Ibu!

entries.original:
"That’s a [green]Mission Log[red] function for
your Super Cube!

It keeps track of anything you’ve
been asked to do!

To use it, just open it up from
the [green]Start Menu[red].

And now that you have one, why
don’t we have it keep a record of\lProf Log’s request for you?"
entries.translation_source: That’s a [green]Mission Log[red] function for your Super Cube! It keeps track of anything you’ve been asked to do! To use it, just open it up from the [green]Start Menu[red]. And now that you have one, why don’t we have it keep a record of Prof Log’s request for you?
entries.translated:
Itu adalah fungsi [green]Mission Log[red] untuk
Super Cube-mu! Fungsinya mencatat\lapa pun yang diminta untuk kamu

lakukan! Untuk menggunakannya, buka
saja dari [green]Menu Start[red]. Dan sekarang\lkamu punya satu, kenapa kita tidak

menyuruhnya mencatat permintaan
Prof Log untukmu?

entries.original:
"Oh, and before I forget, you left
a key component of your Super Cube\lon the floor of your room.

I know it wasn’t necessary before,
but now that you have your very\lown Pokémon, you’ll need it if\lyou want to use those stat boosting\litems in battle."
entries.translation_source: Oh, and before I forget, you left a key component of your Super Cube on the floor of your room. I know it wasn’t necessary before, but now that you have your very own Pokémon, you’ll need it if you want to use those stat boosting items in battle.
entries.translated:
Oh, dan sebelum aku lupa, kamu
meninggalkan komponen penting dari\lSuper Cube-mu di lantai kamarmu.

Aku tahu itu tidak perlu
sebelumnya, tapi sekarang setelah\lkamu memiliki Pokémon milikmu

sendiri, kamu akan membutuhkannya
jika kamu ingin menggunakan item\lpeningkat stat itu dalam

pertempuran.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Super Cube’s
battle component from Mom!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Super Cube’s battle component from Mom!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima komponen
pertempuran Super Cube dari Ibu!

entries.original:
"Just in case you’ve forgotten, the
Super Cube acts just like a bag.

But unlike those cheap bags from
Poké Mart that can only hold 42\litems, the Super Cube, or as it’s\lmore commonly known, [green]Cube[red], has an\linfinite amount of space!

It works by digitizing the item’s
data put into it, so essentially,\lit’s like you’re carrying nothing\lextra at all!

And not only that, you can even
automatically sort the Cube by\lpressing \btn04!

Isn’t that convenient?

Of course, if you still think the
Cube is a little cluttered even\lafter sorting, just use \btn02 and \btn03\lto move through it quickly.

Oh, and you can even use it to
store this parting gift I prepared!"
entries.translation_source: Just in case you’ve forgotten, the Super Cube acts just like a bag. But unlike those cheap bags from Poké Mart that can only hold 42 items, the Super Cube, or as it’s more commonly known, [green]Cube[red], has an infinite amount of space! It works by digitizing the item’s data put into it, so essentially, it’s like you’re carrying nothing extra at all! And not only that, you can even automatically sort the Cube by pressing \btn04! Isn’t that convenient? Of course, if you still think the Cube is a little cluttered even after sorting, just use \btn02 and \btn03 to move through it quickly. Oh, and you can even use it to store this parting gift I prepared!
entries.translated:
Untuk jaga-jaga jika kamu lupa,
Super Cube berfungsi seperti tas.\lTapi tidak seperti tas murah dari

Poké Mart yang hanya bisa menampung
42 item, Super Cube, atau yang\llebih dikenal dengan [green]Cube[red], memiliki

ruang tak terbatas! Cara kerjanya
dengan mendigitalkan data item yang\ldimasukkan, jadi pada dasarnya,

seperti kamu tidak membawa apa-apa
tambahan! Dan bukan hanya itu, kamu\lbahkan dapat mengurutkan Cube

secara otomatis dengan menekan \btn04!
Bukankah itu praktis? Tentu saja,\ljika kamu masih merasa Cube sedikit

berantakan setelah diurutkan,
gunakan saja \btn02 dan \btn03 untuk bergerak\lcepat melaluinya. Oh, dan kamu

bahkan bisa menggunakannya untuk
menyimpan hadiah perpisahan yang\laku siapkan ini!

entries.original:
"That’s a [green]Costume Box[red]!

You can use it to change clothes at
any point in your journey.

I’ve filled it with different colours
for you to choose from, but if you\lfind more outfits, make sure you\lstore them in there as well.

Stay safe out there, honey!

Bring Prof. Log his package!"
entries.translation_source: That’s a [green]Costume Box[red]! You can use it to change clothes at any point in your journey. I’ve filled it with different colours for you to choose from, but if you find more outfits, make sure you store them in there as well. Stay safe out there, honey! Bring Prof. Log his package!
entries.translated:
Itu adalah [green]Kotak Kostum[red]! Kamu dapat
menggunakannya untuk berganti\lpakaian kapan saja dalam

perjalananmu. Aku sudah mengisinya
dengan berbagai warna untuk kamu\lpilih, tapi jika kamu menemukan

lebih banyak pakaian, pastikan kamu
menyimpannya di sana juga.\lHati-hati di luar, sayang! Bawakan

Prof. Log paketnya!

entries.original:
"[player]!
You should take a quick rest."
entries.translation_source: [player]! You should take a quick rest.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu sebaiknya
beristirahat sejenak.

entries.original:
"Happy birthday, [player]!
You should take a quick rest."
entries.translation_source: Happy birthday, [player]! You should take a quick rest.
entries.translated:
Selamat ulang tahun, [player]! Kamu
sebaiknya beristirahat sejenak.

entries.original:
"Oh, good! You and your
Pokémon are looking great.

Take care now!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
entries.translated:
Oh, bagus! Kamu dan Pokémon-mu
terlihat hebat. Hati-hati ya!

entries.original:
"[player],

I have taken your mother into
the [green]depths[black] of the [green]Ruins of Void[black].

Come alone if you ever want to
see her again.

-A"
entries.translation_source: [player], I have taken your mother into the [green]depths[black] of the [green]Ruins of Void[black]. Come alone if you ever want to see her again. -A
entries.translated:
[player], aku telah membawa ibumu
ke [green]kedalaman[black] dari [green]Ruins of Void[black].\lDatanglah sendirian jika kamu ingin

melihatnya lagi. -A

entries.original:
"It’s a trophy proving you defeated
the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in\la standard Single Battle!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a trophy proving you defeated the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in a standard Single Battle!
entries.translated:
Ini adalah piala yang membuktikan
kamu mengalahkan Battle Tower\lFrontier Brain dalam Pertarungan

Tunggal standar!

entries.original:
"It’s a trophy proving you defeated
the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in\la standard Double Battle!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a trophy proving you defeated the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in a standard Double Battle!
entries.translated:
Ini adalah piala yang membuktikan
kamu mengalahkan Battle Tower\lFrontier Brain dalam Pertarungan

Ganda standar!

entries.original:
"It’s a trophy proving you defeated
the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in\la standard Multi Battle!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a trophy proving you defeated the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in a standard Multi Battle!
entries.translated:
Ini adalah piala yang membuktikan
kamu mengalahkan Battle Tower\lFrontier Brain dalam Pertarungan

Multi standar!

entries.original:
"[player]! Stopping by for a visit?

You should hurry on over to
[green]Redwood Village[blue]!

The sooner you beat the Gym there,
the sooner you can challenge the\lPokémon League and become the\lnew Champion."
entries.translation_source: [player]! Stopping by for a visit? You should hurry on over to [green]Redwood Village[blue]! The sooner you beat the Gym there, the sooner you can challenge the Pokémon League and become the new Champion.
entries.translated:
[player]! Mampir untuk berkunjung?
Kamu harus cepat-cepat pergi ke\l[green]Redwood Village[blue]! Semakin cepat kamu

mengalahkan Gym di sana, semakin
cepat kamu bisa menantang Pokémon\lLeague dan menjadi Juara baru.

entries.original:
"[player]! Stopping by for a visit?

You should hurry on over to the
[green]Pokémon League[blue]!

The sooner you get there, the
sooner you can become the new\lChampion!

Just head [green]east[blue] from [green]Gurun Town[blue]
along [green]Route 18[blue] to get there."
entries.translation_source: [player]! Stopping by for a visit? You should hurry on over to the [green]Pokémon League[blue]! The sooner you get there, the sooner you can become the new Champion! Just head [green]east[blue] from [green]Gurun Town[blue] along [green]Route 18[blue] to get there.
entries.translated:
[player]! Mampir untuk berkunjung?
Kamu harus cepat-cepat pergi ke\l[green]Pokémon League[blue]! Semakin cepat kamu

sampai di sana, semakin cepat kamu
bisa menjadi Juara baru! Pergilah\lke [green]timur[blue] dari [green]Gurun Town[blue] menyusuri

[green]Route 18[blue] untuk sampai ke sana.

entries.original:
"[black]There’s a Pokémon on the table!

But you have no room for it in
your party\."
entries.translation_source: [black]There’s a Pokémon on the table! But you have no room for it in your party\.
entries.translated:
[black]Ada seekor Pokémon di atas meja!
Tapi kamu tidak punya ruang\luntuknya di timmu\.

entries.original:
"[player], it’s good to see you
again.

I’m just making up for lost time.

Good luck with your endeavors!"
entries.translation_source: [player], it’s good to see you again. I’m just making up for lost time. Good luck with your endeavors!
entries.translated:
[player], senang bertemu kamu lagi.
Aku hanya menebus waktu yang\lhilang. Semoga sukses dengan

usahamu!

entries.original: "Melony"
entries.translation_source: Melony
entries.translated: Melony

entries.original:
"Oh\.

You’re [player], right?

I’ve heard about you from
[rival].

He told me about how you helped
him out earlier.

It’s rare for my brother to
respect anyone, but he seems to\lrespect you."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. You’re [player], right? I’ve heard about you from [rival]. He told me about how you helped him out earlier. It’s rare for my brother to respect anyone, but he seems to respect you.
entries.translated:
Oh\. Kamu [player], kan? Aku pernah
mendengar tentangmu dari [rival].\lDia bercerita tentang bagaimana

kamu membantunya sebelumnya. Jarang
saudaraku menghormati siapa pun,\ltapi dia sepertinya menghormatimu.

entries.original:
"Are you looking for [rival]?

He set out on a journey to find
out what happened to our parents.

They ditched us when we were kids,
and we haven’t seen them since."
entries.translation_source: Are you looking for [rival]? He set out on a journey to find out what happened to our parents. They ditched us when we were kids, and we haven’t seen them since.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu mencari [rival]? Dia
memulai perjalanan untuk mencari\ltahu apa yang terjadi pada orang

tua kami. Mereka meninggalkan kami
saat kami masih kecil, dan kami\ltidak pernah melihat mereka sejak

itu.

entries.original:
"That weird guy from before followed
us back home.

I’m starting to wonder, though\.
What if he really is our dad?"
entries.translation_source: That weird guy from before followed us back home. I’m starting to wonder, though\. What if he really is our dad?
entries.translated:
Pria aneh dari sebelumnya mengikuti
kami pulang. Tapi aku mulai\lbertanya-tanya\. Bagaimana jika dia

benar-benar ayah kami?

entries.original:
"It’s horrible!

My dad asked me to watch over
Zeph’s son while he and [rival]\lare out, but that man from\lCrystal Peak came by and snatched\lhim right up!

I feel terrible\."
entries.translation_source: It’s horrible! My dad asked me to watch over Zeph’s son while he and [rival] are out, but that man from Crystal Peak came by and snatched him right up! I feel terrible\.
entries.translated:
Ini mengerikan! Ayahku memintaku
untuk menjaga putra Zeph saat dia\ldan [rival] pergi, tapi pria dari

Crystal Peak itu datang dan
menculiknya! Aku merasa sangat\lbersalah\.

entries.original:
"That man - Zeph was finally released
from prison.

It seems he had enough money to
post bail.

Although he didn’t serve his full
sentence, when he picked up his\lson, I could tell he was trying to\lmake amends for all he had done."
entries.translation_source: That man - Zeph was finally released from prison. It seems he had enough money to post bail. Although he didn’t serve his full sentence, when he picked up his son, I could tell he was trying to make amends for all he had done.
entries.translated:
Pria itu - Zeph akhirnya dibebaskan
dari penjara. Sepertinya dia punya\lcukup uang untuk membayar jaminan.

Meskipun dia tidak menjalani
hukuman penuh, saat dia menjemput\lputranya, aku bisa melihat dia

berusaha memperbaiki semua
kesalahannya.

entries.original:
"Oh, by the way, [rival] left a
gift for you on the table."
entries.translation_source: Oh, by the way, [rival] left a gift for you on the table.
entries.translated:
Oh, ngomong-ngomong, [rival]
meninggalkan hadiah untukmu di atas\lmeja.

entries.original: "Zeph Jr."
entries.translation_source: Zeph Jr.
entries.translated: Zeph Jr.

entries.original:
"When’s Daddy coming home?
I wanna play with Daddy!"
entries.translation_source: When’s Daddy coming home? I wanna play with Daddy!
entries.translated:
Kapan Ayah pulang? Aku ingin
bermain dengan Ayah!

entries.original: "Neighbourly Assistance"
entries.translation_source: Neighbourly Assistance
entries.translated: Bantuan Tetangga

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

I heard from your mother that
you’re finally leaving town!

This is very exciting news!

Now, might I ask you for a favour?

I’ve been feeling a little under
the weather lately, and I was\lhoping you could pick me up an\l[green]Antidote[blue] from the Poké Mart."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player]! I heard from your mother that you’re finally leaving town! This is very exciting news! Now, might I ask you for a favour? I’ve been feeling a little under the weather lately, and I was hoping you could pick me up an [green]Antidote[blue] from the Poké Mart.
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, [player]! Aku dengar dari
ibumu bahwa kau akhirnya akan\lmeninggalkan kota! Ini kabar yang

sangat menarik! Sekarang, bolehkah
aku meminta bantuan? Akhir-akhir\lini aku merasa kurang enak badan,

dan aku berharap kau bisa
membelikanku [green]Obat Racun[blue] dari Poke\lMart.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

Congratulations on becoming the
Champion!

This is very exciting news!

Now, might I ask you for a favour?

I’ve been feeling a little under
the weather lately, and I was\lhoping you could pick me up an\l[green]Antidote[blue] from the Poké Mart."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player]! Congratulations on becoming the Champion! This is very exciting news! Now, might I ask you for a favour? I’ve been feeling a little under the weather lately, and I was hoping you could pick me up an [green]Antidote[blue] from the Poké Mart.
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, [player]! Selamat menjadi
Juara! Ini kabar yang sangat\lmenarik! Sekarang, bolehkah aku

meminta bantuan? Akhir-akhir ini
aku merasa kurang enak badan, dan\laku berharap kau bisa membelikanku

[green]Obat Racun[blue] dari Poke Mart.

entries.original:
"Oh, that’s unfortunate, [player].

I’ll have to suffer in silence, then."
entries.translation_source: Oh, that’s unfortunate, [player]. I’ll have to suffer in silence, then.
entries.translated:
Oh, sayang sekali, [player]. Aku
harus menderita dalam diam, kalau\lbegitu.

entries.original:
"Wonderful, wonderful.

The closest Poké Mart is in
Bellin Town, and they should be\lwell stocked up with Antidotes!"
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, wonderful. The closest Poké Mart is in Bellin Town, and they should be well stocked up with Antidotes!
entries.translated:
Bagus, bagus. Poke Mart terdekat
ada di Bellin Town, dan mereka\lpasti memiliki persediaan Obat

Racun yang cukup!

entries.original:
"Wonderful, wonderful.

I’m sure the Champion knows where
to find a simple Antidote, yes?

Hurry back now!"
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, wonderful. I’m sure the Champion knows where to find a simple Antidote, yes? Hurry back now!
entries.translated:
Bagus, bagus. Aku yakin sang Juara
tahu di mana menemukan Obat Racun\lsederhana, ya? Cepat kembali

sekarang!

entries.original:
"The closest Poké Mart is in
Bellin Town, and they should be\lwell stocked up with [green]Antidotes[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: The closest Poké Mart is in Bellin Town, and they should be well stocked up with [green]Antidotes[blue]!
entries.translated:
Poke Mart terdekat ada di Bellin
Town, dan mereka pasti memiliki\lpersediaan [green]Obat Racun[blue] yang cukup!

entries.original:
"I’m sure the Champion knows where
to find a simple [green]Antidote[blue], yes?

Hurry back now!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sure the Champion knows where to find a simple [green]Antidote[blue], yes? Hurry back now!
entries.translated:
Aku yakin sang Juara tahu di mana
menemukan [green]Obat Racun[blue] sederhana, ya?\lCepat kembali sekarang!

entries.original:
"Wonderful, [player].

I’ll take that Antidote off your
hands now."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, [player]. I’ll take that Antidote off your hands now.
entries.translated:
Bagus, [player]. Aku akan mengambil
Antidote itu dari tanganmu\lsekarang.

entries.original:
"This is just what I needed,
[player]!

Thank you, I really appreciate it!

You know\.\CC0818 your father would have
done the same thing for me.

No matter how minor the task, he
was always willing to lend a hand.

I can tell you’re already following
in your father’s footsteps.

And who knows?

Perhaps you may even become a great
Pokémon Trainer like he was!

The road to that point will be long
and arduous, but I have faith that\lyou can and will make it there!

Take this item to help you on
your journey.

It is a rare gemstone that can
power up a single attack in battle.

Use it wisely."
entries.translation_source: This is just what I needed, [player]! Thank you, I really appreciate it! You know\.\CC0818 your father would have done the same thing for me. No matter how minor the task, he was always willing to lend a hand. I can tell you’re already following in your father’s footsteps. And who knows? Perhaps you may even become a great Pokémon Trainer like he was! The road to that point will be long and arduous, but I have faith that you can and will make it there! Take this item to help you on your journey. It is a rare gemstone that can power up a single attack in battle. Use it wisely.
entries.translated:
Ini yang kubutuhkan, [player]!
Terima kasih, aku sangat\lmenghargainya! Kau tahu\.\CC0818 ayahmu akan

melakukan hal yang sama untukku.
Tidak peduli sekecil apa tugasnya,\ldia selalu bersedia membantu. Aku

bisa lihat kau sudah mengikuti
jejak ayahmu. Dan siapa tahu?\lMungkin kau bahkan bisa menjadi

Pelatih Pokémon hebat seperti dia!
Jalan menuju titik itu akan panjang\ldan berat, tapi aku percaya kau

bisa dan akan sampai di sana! Ambil
barang ini untuk membantu\lperjalananmu. Ini adalah permata

langka yang bisa memperkuat satu
serangan dalam pertarungan. Gunakan\ldengan bijak.

entries.original:
"This is just what I needed,
[player]!

Thank you, I really appreciate it!

You know\.\CC0818 your father would have
done the same thing for me.

No matter how minor the task, he
was always willing to lend a hand.

I can tell you’ve followed in his
footsteps well.

And you even became a great
Pokémon Trainer, just like he was!

I’m sure the road to this point was
long and arduous, but I always had\lfaith in you, [player]!

Now take this rare gemstone for
the troubles I put you through."
entries.translation_source: This is just what I needed, [player]! Thank you, I really appreciate it! You know\.\CC0818 your father would have done the same thing for me. No matter how minor the task, he was always willing to lend a hand. I can tell you’ve followed in his footsteps well. And you even became a great Pokémon Trainer, just like he was! I’m sure the road to this point was long and arduous, but I always had faith in you, [player]! Now take this rare gemstone for the troubles I put you through.
entries.translated:
Ini yang kubutuhkan, [player]!
Terima kasih, aku sangat\lmenghargainya! Kau tahu\.\CC0818 ayahmu akan

melakukan hal yang sama untukku.
Tidak peduli sekecil apa tugasnya,\ldia selalu bersedia membantu. Aku

bisa lihat kau telah mengikuti
jejaknya dengan baik. Dan kau\lbahkan menjadi Pelatih Pokémon

hebat, seperti dia! Aku yakin jalan
menuju titik ini panjang dan berat,\ltapi aku selalu percaya padamu,

[player]! Sekarang ambil permata
langka ini sebagai imbalan atas\lmasalah yang aku berikan.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

How is your journey going?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player]! How is your journey going?
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, [player]! Bagaimana
perjalananmu?

entries.original:
"If it isn’t our neighbour
the Champion!

How are you today, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: If it isn’t our neighbour the Champion! How are you today, [player]?
entries.translated:
Bukankah ini tetangga kita sang
Juara! Bagaimana kabarmu hari ini,\l[player]?

entries.original:
"Off on an adventure are we,
[player]?

In that case, let me impart a bit
of wisdom on you before you go!"
entries.translation_source: Off on an adventure are we, [player]? In that case, let me impart a bit of wisdom on you before you go!
entries.translated:
Kau akan pergi bertualang,
[player]? Kalau begitu, izinkan aku\lmemberikan sedikit kebijaksanaan

sebelum kau pergi!

entries.original:
"I’m sure you already know, but with
that [green]Mission Log[red] device your mother\lgave you, you can record various\lrequests from people.

Some of these people may ask you
to complete a certain task some\lfinite number of times.

It may seem daunting at first, but
these people really just want to\lknow if you have satisfied their\lrequest at some point in your\ljourney.

So go on, keep exploring!

You’ll be amazed to see what kind
of things you can accomplish while\ltravelling.

In fact, sometimes they will even
make requests for things you have\lalready done!

In that case, you may ask them for
a reward right away.

Good luck on your journey!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sure you already know, but with that [green]Mission Log[red] device your mother gave you, you can record various requests from people. Some of these people may ask you to complete a certain task some finite number of times. It may seem daunting at first, but these people really just want to know if you have satisfied their request at some point in your journey. So go on, keep exploring! You’ll be amazed to see what kind of things you can accomplish while travelling. In fact, sometimes they will even make requests for things you have already done! In that case, you may ask them for a reward right away. Good luck on your journey!
entries.translated:
Aku yakin kau sudah tahu, tapi
dengan [green]Catatan Misi[red] yang diberikan\libumu, kau bisa mencatat berbagai

permintaan dari orang-orang.
Beberapa dari mereka mungkin\lmemintamu menyelesaikan tugas

tertentu sejumlah kali terbatas.
Mungkin terasa menakutkan pada\lawalnya, tetapi orang-orang ini

sebenarnya hanya ingin tahu apakah
kau telah memenuhi permintaan\lmereka di suatu titik dalam

perjalananmu. Jadi teruslah,
jelajahi! Kau akan takjub melihat\lhal-hal yang bisa kau capai selama

bepergian. Bahkan, terkadang mereka
akan meminta hal yang sudah kau\llakukan! Dalam kasus itu, kau bisa

langsung meminta hadiah dari
mereka. Semoga berhasil dalam\lperjalananmu!

Good luck on your journey!"

Aku yakin kau sudah menguasai
keadaan, [player]. Semoga berhasil\ldalam perjalananmu!

[player]!

Your father would be very proud
that you’re finally leaving home!"

Semoga sukses dalam perjalananmu,
[player]! Ayahmu pasti sangat\lbangga bahwa kamu akhirnya

of what you’ve become."

memulai perjalananmu. Ayahmu pasti
sangat bangga dengan apa yang telah\lkamu capai.

[player]! Nenekku bilang kamu akan

entries.translated:

Corner! Apakah kamu membutuhkan\lKoin game? Apakah kamu ingin

entries.original:

Case.

kapan-kapan!

[buffer1] yang mana yang Anda

Anda ingin [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red]? Itu

"You’d like the [green][buffer1][red]?

Maaf, Anda tidak memiliki cukup

"Please make space in your party

Harap kosongkan slot di tim Anda

"I often skip school to come
pop balloons.

Aku sering bolos sekolah untuk

"This silly machine decided to lag

Maybe I’ll play the old slots
instead."
entries.translation_source: This silly machine decided to lag when I turned on my BGM! Maybe I’ll play the old slots instead.
entries.translated:
Mesin konyol ini memutuskan untuk
lag saat aku menyalakan BGM-ku!\lMungkin aku akan main slot lama

saja.

entries.original: "What, you want to play?"

entries.translated: Apa, Anda mau bermain?

you see one!

Not only will it double your Coins,
it’ll speed you up, and any Coins\lcollected while sped up will be\ldoubled too!"
entries.translation_source: Pop a [green]green[blue] balloon as soon as you see one! Not only will it double your Coins, it’ll speed you up, and any Coins collected while sped up will be doubled too!

Letuskan balon [green]hijau[blue] begitu kamu
melihatnya! Tidak hanya akan\lmenggandakan Koinmu, tapi juga akan

dikumpulkan saat dipercepat juga\lakan digandakan!

"[black]Oops!
Don’t have the Coin Case!"

entries.original: "[black]You have too many Coins!"

entries.translated: [black]Anda memiliki terlalu banyak Koin!

"I’ve heard some regions have games

But I also heard that instead of
there being a goal in those\lregions, you’re just supposed to\lfly around an empty map.

Who needs that? That’s so boring!
I’d rather pop balloons any day!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve heard some regions have games just like this one! But I also heard that instead of there being a goal in those regions, you’re just supposed to fly around an empty map. Who needs that? That’s so boring! I’d rather pop balloons any day!
entries.translated:
Aku dengar beberapa daerah punya
permainan seperti ini! Tapi aku\ljuga dengar bahwa alih-alih ada

tujuan di daerah itu, kamu cuma
harus terbang di peta kosong. Siapa\lyang butuh itu? Itu membosankan!

Aku lebih suka meletuskan balon
kapan saja!

entries.original:
"A friend of mine nabbed a ton of
Coins playing on one of these old\lslot machines.

Why mess with a good thing?
I’ll try the same spot, too!"
entries.translation_source: A friend of mine nabbed a ton of Coins playing on one of these old slot machines. Why mess with a good thing? I’ll try the same spot, too!
entries.translated:
Seorang temanku mendapat banyak
Koin dengan bermain di salah satu\lmesin slot tua ini. Kenapa merusak

hal yang bagus? Aku akan coba
tempat yang sama juga!

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Want some Coins?"

entries.translated: Ada apa? Mau beberapa Koin?

entries.translated:
Sial! Balon-balon polkadot itu
terus menyedot semua Koin-ku!

"Hey, what? You’re throwing me off!
Here are some Coins, so shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, what? You’re throwing me off! Here are some Coins, so shoo!
entries.translated:
Hei, apa? Kamu menggangguku! Ini
beberapa Koin, jadi enyahlah!

entries.original:
"The trick is to always play on the
hardest game mode.

Yes, you may get less time, but the
speed more than makes up for it."
entries.translation_source: The trick is to always play on the hardest game mode. Yes, you may get less time, but the speed more than makes up for it.
entries.translated:
Triknya adalah selalu bermain di
mode permainan tersulit. Ya, kamu\lmungkin mendapat waktu lebih

sedikit, tapi kecepatan lebih dari
cukup untuk mengimbanginya.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]!
I haven’t seen you in ages!

Congratulations on becoming the
Champion!

If you haven’t tried already, might
I recommend Cloud Burst?

The Altaria you fly is modeled off
of my own, I’ll have you know.

Play it and you’ll see the
resemblance, I swear it!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player]! I haven’t seen you in ages! Congratulations on becoming the Champion! If you haven’t tried already, might I recommend Cloud Burst? The Altaria you fly is modeled off of my own, I’ll have you know. Play it and you’ll see the resemblance, I swear it!
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Aku sudah lama tidak
melihatmu! Selamat menjadi Juara!\lJika kamu belum mencoba, bolehkah

aku merekomendasikan Cloud Burst?
Altaria yang kamu terbangkan\ldimodelkan dari punyaku, lho.

Mainkan dan kamu akan melihat
kemiripannya, sumpah!

entries.original:
"Play Cloud Burst and you’ll see
the resemblance to my Altaria!

I come here every day just to see
it, you know."
entries.translation_source: Play Cloud Burst and you’ll see the resemblance to my Altaria! I come here every day just to see it, you know.
entries.translated:
Mainkan Cloud Burst dan kamu akan
melihat kemiripannya dengan\lAltaria-ku! Aku datang ke sini

setiap hari hanya untuk melihatnya,
lho.

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient slot machine!
Want to play?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient slot machine! Want to play?
entries.translated: Ini mesin slot kuno! Mau bermain?

entries.original: "A [green]Coin Case[black] is required\."
entries.translation_source: A [green]Coin Case[black] is required\.
entries.translated: Diperlukan [green]Kotak Koin[black]\.

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient slot machine!

But the amount of Coins in your
Coin Case are overwhelming it!

Spend some Coins before trying
to play."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient slot machine! But the amount of Coins in your Coin Case are overwhelming it! Spend some Coins before trying to play.
entries.translated:
Ini mesin slot kuno! Tapi jumlah
Koin di Kotak Koin-mu\lmembanjirinya! Habiskan beberapa

Koin sebelum mencoba bermain.

entries.original:
"OUT OF ORDER
This is broken."
entries.translation_source: OUT OF ORDER This is broken.
entries.translated: RUSAK Ini rusak.

entries.original: "A Life of No Regrets"
entries.translation_source: A Life of No Regrets
entries.translated: Hidup Tanpa Penyesalan

entries.original:
"My mother always told me to get a
job I’d love.

But work requires effort, so I
became a Gambler.

Sometimes, I win and make money;
other times, I become indebted to\lthe Black Ferrothorn.

I want to quit, but I’m the best,
and I can’t quit while I’m number\lone.

Can you out pop me in balloons?"
entries.translation_source: My mother always told me to get a job I’d love. But work requires effort, so I became a Gambler. Sometimes, I win and make money; other times, I become indebted to the Black Ferrothorn. I want to quit, but I’m the best, and I can’t quit while I’m number one. Can you out pop me in balloons?
entries.translated:
Ibuku selalu bilang untuk
mendapatkan pekerjaan yang\lkucintai. Tapi pekerjaan butuh

usaha, jadi aku menjadi Penjudi.
Kadang, aku menang dan menghasilkan\luang; kadang lainnya, aku berhutang

pada Black Ferrothorn. Aku ingin
berhenti, tapi aku yang terbaik,\ldan aku tidak bisa berhenti saat

aku nomor satu. Bisakah kamu
mengalahkanku dalam meletuskan\lbalon?

entries.original:
"You have some spirit.

To beat my record, you’ll need to
collect at least [green][buffer1][blue] Coins in a\lsingle day by playing [green]Cloud Burst[blue].

I would spot you some Coins to
play, but I still owe the Black\lFerrothorn some money."
entries.translation_source: You have some spirit. To beat my record, you’ll need to collect at least [green][buffer1][blue] Coins in a single day by playing [green]Cloud Burst[blue]. I would spot you some Coins to play, but I still owe the Black Ferrothorn some money.
entries.translated:
Kamu punya semangat. Untuk
mengalahkan rekor aku, kamu harus\lmengumpulkan setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]

Koin dalam satu hari dengan bermain
[green]Cloud Burst[blue]. Aku akan meminjaminu\lbeberapa Koin untuk bermain, tapi

aku masih berhutang uang pada Black
Ferrothorn.

entries.original:
"Why, aren’t you an upright fellow,
not wanting to give in to the evils\lof gambling?"
entries.translation_source: Why, aren’t you an upright fellow, not wanting to give in to the evils of gambling?
entries.translated:
Lho, bukankah kamu orang yang
jujur, tidak mau menyerah pada\lkejahatan perjudian?

entries.original:
"Now is not the time to quit.

Your earnings of [buffer1] today are
not so far off from [green][buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Now is not the time to quit. Your earnings of [buffer1] today are not so far off from [green][buffer2][blue]!
entries.translated:
Sekarang bukan waktu untuk
berhenti. Penghasilanmu sebesar\l[buffer1] hari ini tidak terlalu

jauh dari [green][buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"You actually out did me at my
own game\.

I guess I can quit, now that some
possibly underaged kid beat my\lrecord.

Here, take my Pokémon.

I thought it would help me fly to
new heights, but instead it just\lplunged me into deeper debt."
entries.translation_source: You actually out did me at my own game\. I guess I can quit, now that some possibly underaged kid beat my record. Here, take my Pokémon. I thought it would help me fly to new heights, but instead it just plunged me into deeper debt.
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar mengalahkanku
dalam permainanku sendiri\.\lSepertinya aku bisa berhenti,

sekarang setelah anak yang mungkin
di bawah umur mengalahkan rekorku.\lIni, ambil Pokémon-ku. Aku pikir

itu akan membantuku terbang ke
ketinggian baru, tapi malah\lmenjerumuskanku ke hutang yang

lebih dalam.

entries.original:
"Or, I would give it to you, if you
had more space in your party."
entries.translation_source: Or, I would give it to you, if you had more space in your party.
entries.translated:
Atau, aku akan memberikannya
padamu, jika kamu punya lebih\lbanyak ruang di timmu.

entries.original:
"You know, as a long-time customer,
I have a bit of sway here.

If you’d like, I can have
[green]Happy Hour[blue] started for you."
entries.translation_source: You know, as a long-time customer, I have a bit of sway here. If you’d like, I can have [green]Happy Hour[blue] started for you.
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, sebagai pelanggan lama,
aku punya sedikit pengaruh di sini.\lJika kamu mau, aku bisa memulai [green]Jam

Bahagia[blue] untukmu.

entries.original:
"Once Happy Hour is started, for the
next hour you’ll receive Coin\lpayouts from [green]Cloud Burst[blue] twice.

This means you’ll essentially earn
[green]double the Coins[blue] each game!"
entries.translation_source: Once Happy Hour is started, for the next hour you’ll receive Coin payouts from [green]Cloud Burst[blue] twice. This means you’ll essentially earn [green]double the Coins[blue] each game!
entries.translated:
Setelah Happy Hour dimulai, selama
satu jam ke depan Anda akan\lmenerima pembayaran Koin dari [green]Cloud

Burst[blue] dua kali lipat. Ini berarti
Anda pada dasarnya akan mendapatkan\l[green]Koin dua kali lipat[blue] setiap

permainan!

entries.original:
"You prefer to wait until you have
the whole hour to spend here,\lI understand.

Come back when you’re ready to begin
Happy Hour."
entries.translation_source: You prefer to wait until you have the whole hour to spend here, I understand. Come back when you’re ready to begin Happy Hour.
entries.translated:
Anda lebih suka menunggu sampai
Anda memiliki waktu satu jam penuh\luntuk dihabiskan di sini, saya

mengerti. Kembalilah saat Anda siap
untuk memulai Happy Hour.

entries.original:
"Then I’ll let the clerks know it’s
time for a Happy Hour!

For the next hour, payouts from
Cloud Burst will be given twice.

So get moving, whippersnapper!
Go, go, go!"
entries.translation_source: Then I’ll let the clerks know it’s time for a Happy Hour! For the next hour, payouts from Cloud Burst will be given twice. So get moving, whippersnapper! Go, go, go!
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu saya akan memberi tahu
para pegawai bahwa ini waktunya\lHappy Hour! Selama satu jam ke

depan, pembayaran dari Cloud Burst
akan diberikan dua kali lipat. Jadi\lbergeraklah, anak muda! Ayo, ayo,

ayo!

entries.original:
"Only [buffer1] minutes of Happy Hour
are left!

Get moving, whippersnapper!
Go, go, go!"
entries.translation_source: Only [buffer1] minutes of Happy Hour are left! Get moving, whippersnapper! Go, go, go!
entries.translated:
Hanya [buffer1] menit Happy Hour
tersisa! Bergeraklah, anak muda!\lAyo, ayo, ayo!

entries.original:
"Less than a minute of Happy Hour
is left!

Hurry, whippersnapper!
Go, go, go!"
entries.translation_source: Less than a minute of Happy Hour is left! Hurry, whippersnapper! Go, go, go!
entries.translated:
Kurang dari satu menit Happy Hour
tersisa! Cepat, anak muda! Ayo,\layo, ayo!

tomorrow!

it for you again."
entries.translation_source: There can be another Happy Hour tomorrow! Come speak to me then and I’ll start it for you again.
entries.translated:

untukmu.

entries.original:
"New Game \+ is a special feature that
allows you to start a new game\lwith special bonuses:

1) A team of max 6 Pokémon can
be carried over to the new game.

These 6 Pokémon are created from
the party in the previous save.

The Pokémon will be devolved to
their base species and will forget\lany moves barring Egg Moves.

Held items will be retained barring
Z-Crystals.

Additionally, stats such as EVs and
IVs will be retained.

2) If any of the following items
have been obtained in the previous\lsave, they will be carried over to\lthe new game:

Stat Scanner, Motorcycle, DexNav,
Dowsing Machine, Baby Monitor, ADM,\lTrainer Catalogue, Shiny Charm,\lOval Charm, Catching Charm, Magma\lStone, Frontier Card, Porta-PC,\lTime Turner, any unlocked item\lupgrades, and any BP earned.

3) The game’s difficulty may be
increased or decreased at any point\lwithout penalty.

4) Certain main story puzzles
solved in the previous save will\lremain solved in the new game.

5) If the Frontier Card is carried
over, then the Battle Frontier\lmay be accessed immediately upon\larrival in Seaport City.

6) Additional NPCs for modifying
IVs, EVs, and natures will be\lavailable in Crater Town until\lthe game is cleared (when not\lplaying on Sandbox Mode).

Note that some may charge BP for
their services, so make sure you\learn enough before starting the\lnew game.

7) Certain Legendary Pokémon
previously locked to the post-game\lwill now be obtainable before the\lgame is cleared."
entries.translation_source: New Game \+ is a special feature that allows you to start a new game with special bonuses: 1) A team of max 6 Pokémon can be carried over to the new game. These 6 Pokémon are created from the party in the previous save. The Pokémon will be devolved to their base species and will forget any moves barring Egg Moves. Held items will be retained barring Z-Crystals. Additionally, stats such as EVs and IVs will be retained. 2) If any of the following items have been obtained in the previous save, they will be carried over to the new game: Stat Scanner, Motorcycle, DexNav, Dowsing Machine, Baby Monitor, ADM, Trainer Catalogue, Shiny Charm, Oval Charm, Catching Charm, Magma Stone, Frontier Card, Porta-PC, Time Turner, any unlocked item upgrades, and any BP earned. 3) The game’s difficulty may be increased or decreased at any point without penalty. 4) Certain main story puzzles solved in the previous save will remain solved in the new game. 5) If the Frontier Card is carried over, then the Battle Frontier may be accessed immediately upon arrival in Seaport City. 6) Additional NPCs for modifying IVs, EVs, and natures will be available in Crater Town until the game is cleared (when not playing on Sandbox Mode). Note that some may charge BP for their services, so make sure you earn enough before starting the new game. 7) Certain Legendary Pokémon previously locked to the post-game will now be obtainable before the game is cleared.

1) The Stat Scanner can change EVs,
IVs, Natures, Levels, Abilities,\lgenders, moves, and evolutions.

2) The DexNav, Dowsing Machine,
Stat Scanner, Porta-PC, Bicycle,\land Time Turner can be used\linstantly.

3) The in-battle team preview will
always reveal the enemy team.

4) The Pokédex comes prefilled,
allowing easy scans with the\lDexNav.

5) All Pokémon have a 100%
capture rate.

6) Consumable items always return
after Trainer battles.

7) HMs can always be used as long
as the HM is in your Cube.

8) The difficulty CANNOT be reduced
past Expert at any point in the\lgame.

If you are on New Game \+ only, you
may switch between Expert and\lInsane freely.

9) There is LIMITED post-game.

All important battles will be
available from the Battle Frontier\lafter entering the Hall of Fame.

Additionally, fully evolved Pokémon
will be purchaseable in the\lBattle Tower.

However, there will be no more
exploration."
entries.translation_source: In Sandbox Mode, the following changes are present: 1) The Stat Scanner can change EVs, IVs, Natures, Levels, Abilities, genders, moves, and evolutions. 2) The DexNav, Dowsing Machine, Stat Scanner, Porta-PC, Bicycle, and Time Turner can be used instantly. 3) The in-battle team preview will always reveal the enemy team. 4) The Pokédex comes prefilled, allowing easy scans with the DexNav. 5) All Pokémon have a 100% capture rate. 6) Consumable items always return after Trainer battles. 7) HMs can always be used as long as the HM is in your Cube. 8) The difficulty CANNOT be reduced past Expert at any point in the game. If you are on New Game \+ only, you may switch between Expert and Insane freely. 9) There is LIMITED post-game. All important battles will be available from the Battle Frontier after entering the Hall of Fame. Additionally, fully evolved Pokémon will be purchaseable in the Battle Tower. However, there will be no more exploration.

entries.translation_source: [green]Sandbox Mode[black] has been enabled.
entries.translated: [green]Sandbox Mode[black] has been enabled.

entries.original:
"As you’ve played before, would you
like to skip the opening cutscenes?"
entries.translation_source: As you’ve played before, would you like to skip the opening cutscenes?
entries.translated:
As you{B4}ve played before, would you
like to skip the opening cutscenes?

entries.original:
"The opening cutscenes will be
skipped.

If you would like to skip all
cutscenes, please enable this\lfrom the Options Menu."
entries.translation_source: The opening cutscenes will be skipped. If you would like to skip all cutscenes, please enable this from the Options Menu.
entries.translated:
The opening cutscenes will be
skipped. If you would like to skip\lall cutscenes, please enable this

from the Options Menu.

entries.original: "Long ago\."
entries.translation_source: Long ago\.
entries.translated: Long ago\.

entries.original:
"The Borrius Region was engulfed by
a great war with a foreign land.

It was a brutal war, one which
lasted many years.

During that time, the enemy managed
to seize the upper hand\."
entries.translation_source: The Borrius Region was engulfed by a great war with a foreign land. It was a brutal war, one which lasted many years. During that time, the enemy managed to seize the upper hand\.
entries.translated:
The Borrius Region was engulfed by
a great war with a foreign land. It

was a brutal war, one which lasted
many years. During that time, the

enemy managed to seize the upper
hand\.

entries.original:
"On the brink of defeat, the Borrian
king summoned a dark force to help\lturn the tides of battle\."
entries.translation_source: On the brink of defeat, the Borrian king summoned a dark force to help turn the tides of battle\.
entries.translated:
On the brink of defeat, the Borrian
king summoned a dark force to help\lturn the tides of battle\.

entries.original:
"The foreign army’s advantage was
lost almost instantly.

As soon as it entered the battlefield,
the dark force used its power to\lcreate portals and transport the\linvading army back home\."
entries.translation_source: The foreign army’s advantage was lost almost instantly. As soon as it entered the battlefield, the dark force used its power to create portals and transport the invading army back home\.
entries.translated:
The foreign army{B4}s advantage was
lost almost instantly. As soon as\lit entered the battlefield, the

dark force used its power to create
portals and transport the invading\larmy back home\.

entries.original:
"With the foreign army gone, the war
seemed at an end for Borrius.

However, their king, overcome by
his lust for power, sent the Borrian\larmy through the portals as well\."
entries.translation_source: With the foreign army gone, the war seemed at an end for Borrius. However, their king, overcome by his lust for power, sent the Borrian army through the portals as well\.
entries.translated:
With the foreign army gone, the war
seemed at an end for Borrius.\lHowever, their king, overcome by

his lust for power, sent the
Borrian army through the portals as\lwell\.

entries.original:
"The war continued to rage in the
foreign land for several years.

Many more men and Pokémon were
conscripted to fight and inevitably\lmet their end on the battlefield.

One such Pokémon having been a
dear friend of the enemy king\."
entries.translation_source: The war continued to rage in the foreign land for several years. Many more men and Pokémon were conscripted to fight and inevitably met their end on the battlefield. One such Pokémon having been a dear friend of the enemy king\.
entries.translated:
The war continued to rage in the
foreign land for several years.\lMany more men and Pokémon were

conscripted to fight and inevitably
met their end on the battlefield.\lOne such Pokémon having been a dear

friend of the enemy king\.

entries.original:
"Overcome with grief, the king built a
device to restore its life, granting\lhimself immortality in the process."
entries.translation_source: Overcome with grief, the king built a device to restore its life, granting himself immortality in the process.
entries.translated:
Overcome with grief, the king built
a device to restore its life,\lgranting himself immortality in the

process.

entries.original:
"But this traumatic event left him
scarred and filled with anger.

Unable to forgive the world that
had hurt his precious Pokémon, he\lturned his machine into a giant\lweapon, the Ultimate Weapon.

The king became a bringer of
destruction that ended the war."
entries.translation_source: But this traumatic event left him scarred and filled with anger. Unable to forgive the world that had hurt his precious Pokémon, he turned his machine into a giant weapon, the Ultimate Weapon. The king became a bringer of destruction that ended the war.
entries.translated:
But this traumatic event left him
scarred and filled with anger.\lUnable to forgive the world that

had hurt his precious Pokémon, he
turned his machine into a giant\lweapon, the Ultimate Weapon. The

king became a bringer of
destruction that ended the war.

entries.original:
"With the war over, what little
remained of the Borrian army\lreturned home.

The king’s Pokémon left him, and
the battlefield became silent\."
entries.translation_source: With the war over, what little remained of the Borrian army returned home. The king’s Pokémon left him, and the battlefield became silent\.
entries.translated:
Dengan perang berakhir, sedikit
yang tersisa dari pasukan Borrian\lkembali ke rumah. Pokémon raja

meninggalkannya, dan medan perang
menjadi sunyi\.

entries.original: "Yet, peace was still to come."
entries.translation_source: Yet, peace was still to come.
entries.translated:
Namun, perdamaian masih akan
datang.

entries.original:
"Enraged over the fruitless war
fought, survivors of the war wished\lfor ample compensation from the\lBorrian king.

When he had nothing to offer them,
they began to manipulate the dark\lforce to attack the Borrian kingdom\lin an attempted coup."
entries.translation_source: Enraged over the fruitless war fought, survivors of the war wished for ample compensation from the Borrian king. When he had nothing to offer them, they began to manipulate the dark force to attack the Borrian kingdom in an attempted coup.
entries.translated:
Marah atas perang sia-sia yang
diperjuangkan, para penyintas\lperang menginginkan kompensasi yang

cukup dari raja Borrian. Ketika dia
tidak memiliki apa pun untuk\lditawarkan kepada mereka, mereka

mulai memanipulasi kekuatan gelap
untuk menyerang kerajaan Borrian\ldalam upaya kudeta.

entries.original:
"In an effort to stop the madness,
the Borrian king gathered the\llegendary Pokémon:"
entries.translation_source: In an effort to stop the madness, the Borrian king gathered the legendary Pokémon:
entries.translated:
Dalam upaya menghentikan kegilaan,
raja Borrian mengumpulkan Pokémon\llegendaris:

entries.original: "Articuno!"
entries.translation_source: Articuno!
entries.translated: Articuno!

entries.original: "Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: Zapdos!
entries.translated: Zapdos!

entries.original: "Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Moltres!
entries.translated: Moltres!

entries.original:
"Using the power of the three birds,
a Prison was created for the dark\lforce, sealing its power."
entries.translation_source: Using the power of the three birds, a Prison was created for the dark force, sealing its power.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan kekuatan ketiga burung,
sebuah Penjara diciptakan untuk\lkekuatan gelap, menyegel

kekuatannya.

entries.original:
"It became a shadow of its former
self."
entries.translation_source: It became a shadow of its former self.
entries.translated:
Itu menjadi bayangan dari dirinya
yang dulu.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until one fateful day\."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until one fateful day\.
entries.translated:
Dirampas kekuatannya, ia diambil
oleh raja, dan diawasi oleh\lketurunannya, sampai suatu hari

yang menentukan\.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until this very day."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until this very day.
entries.translated:
Dirampas kekuatannya, ia diambil
oleh raja, dan diawasi oleh

keturunannya, sampai hari ini juga.

entries.original: "            16 Years Ago"
entries.translation_source: 16 Years Ago
entries.translated: 16 Tahun yang Lalu

entries.original: "           15 Years Later"
entries.translation_source: 15 Years Later
entries.translated: 15 Tahun Kemudian

entries.original: "Yes   "
entries.translation_source: Yes
entries.translated: Ya

entries.original: "No"
entries.translation_source: No
entries.translated: Tidak

entries.original:
"Hoopa\.

I worry, old friend, for the future
- for if, no\.\CC0818 when SHE arrives."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa\. I worry, old friend, for the future - for if, no\.\CC0818 when SHE arrives.
entries.translated:
Hoopa\. Aku khawatir, teman lama,
untuk masa depan - karena jika,\ltidak\.\CC0818 ketika DIA tiba.

entries.original:
"I won’t be able to protect you if
she tries something.

No\.\CC0818 she will try something.

It’s a matter of what it will be."
entries.translation_source: I won’t be able to protect you if she tries something. No\.\CC0818 she will try something. It’s a matter of what it will be.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak akan bisa melindungimu
jika dia mencoba sesuatu. Tidak\.\CC0818 dia\lakan mencoba sesuatu. Ini masalah

apa yang akan terjadi.

entries.original:
"That’s why, my friend, you must
go into hiding.

I’ll send your Poké Ball adrift,
amidst the waves\.

You’ll surely be safer lost at sea,
than if you were to remain with me.

If I’m wrong, and nothing happens,
I’ll call you back.

But if this is to be our final time
together\.

Protect my [buffer3] if [buffer2] is
ever in danger.

And in turn, should the wrong sort
try to force your true power free\.

Then trust [buffer1] to protect you.

Farewell, my good friend."
entries.translation_source: That’s why, my friend, you must go into hiding. I’ll send your Poké Ball adrift, amidst the waves\. You’ll surely be safer lost at sea, than if you were to remain with me. If I’m wrong, and nothing happens, I’ll call you back. But if this is to be our final time together\. Protect my [buffer3] if [buffer2] is ever in danger. And in turn, should the wrong sort try to force your true power free\. Then trust [buffer1] to protect you. Farewell, my good friend.
entries.translated:
Itulah sebabnya, temanku, kau harus
bersembunyi. Aku akan mengirim Poké\lBall-mu terapung, di tengah ombak\.

Kau pasti akan lebih aman tersesat
di laut, daripada jika kau tetap\lbersamaku. Jika aku salah, dan

tidak terjadi apa-apa, aku akan
memanggilmu kembali. Tapi jika ini\ladalah saat terakhir kita bersama\.

Lindungi [buffer3] jika [buffer2]
pernah dalam bahaya. Dan\lsebaliknya, jika orang yang salah

mencoba memaksa kekuatan sejatimu
bebas\. Maka percayalah [buffer1]\luntuk melindungimu. Selamat

tinggal, teman baikku.

entries.original: "It’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: It’s gone\.
entries.translated: Hilang\.

entries.original:
"So, you came after all.

Let’s get this over with."
entries.translation_source: So, you came after all. Let’s get this over with.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau datang juga. Ayo
selesaikan ini.

entries.original:
"ARGH!

How can I fulfill Grandpapa’s wish
if I cannot catch a single Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: ARGH! How can I fulfill Grandpapa’s wish if I cannot catch a single Pokémon?
entries.translated:
ARGH! Bagaimana aku bisa memenuhi
keinginan Kakek jika aku tidak bisa\lmenangkap satu pun Pokémon?

entries.original:
"I promised him\.\CC0820 I promised I would
finish the war, but right now\.

I cannot even begin to fathom the
possibility!"
entries.translation_source: I promised him\.\CC0820 I promised I would finish the war, but right now\. I cannot even begin to fathom the possibility!
entries.translated:
Aku berjanji padanya\.\CC0820 Aku berjanji
akan mengakhiri perang, tetapi saat\lini\. Aku bahkan tidak bisa mulai

membayangkan kemungkinan itu!

entries.original: "What ever should I do\.?"
entries.translation_source: What ever should I do\.?
entries.translated: Apa yang harus aku lakukan\.?

entries.original: "A Poké Ball? Here? Now?"
entries.translation_source: A Poké Ball? Here? Now?
entries.translated:
Sebuah Poké Ball? Di sini?
Sekarang?

entries.original: "This Pokémon\.\CC0820 it can’t be\.!"
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon\.\CC0820 it can’t be\.!
entries.translated: Pokémon ini\.\CC0820 tidak mungkin\.!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0818 pa\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoo\.\CC0818 pa\.
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0818 pa\.

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha\.

It appears, Grandpapa, there may be
a way after all.

It is time for destruction to engulf
the land\.

And for the Eternal Flower to bloom
once again\."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha\. It appears, Grandpapa, there may be a way after all. It is time for destruction to engulf the land\. And for the Eternal Flower to bloom once again\.
entries.translated:
Ha ha ha\. Tampaknya, Kakek, mungkin
ada jalan setelah semua ini.\lSaatnya kehancuran melanda negeri\.

Dan Bunga Abadi mekar kembali\.

entries.original: "            Present Day"
entries.translation_source: Present Day
entries.translated: Hari Ini

entries.original:
"Okay, let’s get you all fixed up!
Just leave it up to me!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, let’s get you all fixed up! Just leave it up to me!
entries.translated:
Oke, kita perbaiki semuanya!
Serahkan saja padaku!

entries.original:
"Be careful of sandstorms as you
explore the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Be careful of sandstorms as you explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Hati-hati dengan badai pasir saat
menjelajahi Gurun Besar!

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo, you found the
clown of the sand!

But the shackles that bind me
still linger.

As long as there are breakable
rocks to the west of this canyon\land to the north of the southern\lcanyon, I am not truly free\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo, you found the clown of the sand! But the shackles that bind me still linger. As long as there are breakable rocks to the west of this canyon and to the north of the southern canyon, I am not truly free\.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo, kamu menemukan
badut pasir! Tapi belenggu yang\lmengikatku masih ada. Selama masih

ada batu yang bisa dipecahkan di
barat ngarai ini dan di utara\lngarai selatan, aku belum

benar-benar bebas\.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo, you found the
clown of the sand!

And you even broke all of my
shackles along the way!

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo, you found the clown of the sand! And you even broke all of my shackles along the way! For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo, kamu menemukan
badut pasir! Dan kamu bahkan\lmematahkan semua belengguku di

sepanjang jalan! Untuk itu, aku
berterima kasih.

entries.original: "Whirly, twirly, sandy, dandy\."
entries.translation_source: Whirly, twirly, sandy, dandy\.
entries.translated: Whirly, twirly, sandy, dandy\.

entries.original: "Warmonger"
entries.translation_source: Warmonger
entries.translated: Penghasut Perang

entries.original:
"I am a member of the powerful
warrior cult known simply as the\lUndying Lucario.

In the olden days, we would fight
not for riches, but for sport.

However, modern society has deemed
human battles to be \qoinhumane\qc, so\lwe now battle with our Pokémon.

Do you think you have what it takes
to become one of us?"
entries.translation_source: I am a member of the powerful warrior cult known simply as the Undying Lucario. In the olden days, we would fight not for riches, but for sport. However, modern society has deemed human battles to be \qoinhumane\qc, so we now battle with our Pokémon. Do you think you have what it takes to become one of us?
entries.translated:
Aku adalah anggota kultus prajurit
kuat yang dikenal sebagai Undying\lLucario. Di zaman dahulu, kami

bertarung bukan untuk kekayaan,
tetapi untuk olahraga. Namun,\lmasyarakat modern menganggap

pertempuran manusia sebagai \qotidak
manusiawi\qc, jadi kami sekarang\lbertarung dengan Pokémon kami.

Apakah kamu pikir kamu memiliki apa
yang diperlukan untuk menjadi salah\lsatu dari kami?

entries.original:
"In order to complete your initiation,
you must enjoy the thrill of battle\lat least [green][buffer1][blue] times."
entries.translation_source: In order to complete your initiation, you must enjoy the thrill of battle at least [green][buffer1][blue] times.
entries.translated:
Untuk menyelesaikan inisiasimu,
kamu harus menikmati sensasi\lpertempuran setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]

kali.

entries.original:
"Not all have the heart to become of
of the Undying Lucario."
entries.translation_source: Not all have the heart to become of of the Undying Lucario.
entries.translated:
Tidak semua memiliki hati untuk
menjadi dari dari Undying Lucario.

entries.original:
"You have fought many battles.

But in order to be a true member of
the Undying Lucario, you must wage\l[green][buffer3][blue] more."
entries.translation_source: You have fought many battles. But in order to be a true member of the Undying Lucario, you must wage [green][buffer3][blue] more.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah bertarung dalam banyak
pertempuran. Tetapi untuk menjadi\langgota sejati Undying Lucario,

kamu harus berperang [green][buffer3][blue] lagi.

entries.original:
"You have demonstrated that you have
the heart of a warrior.

I now induct you into the cult of
the Undying Lucario, in which you\lwill also receive our sacred rock."
entries.translation_source: You have demonstrated that you have the heart of a warrior. I now induct you into the cult of the Undying Lucario, in which you will also receive our sacred rock.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah menunjukkan bahwa kamu
memiliki hati seorang prajurit. Aku\lsekarang melantikmu ke dalam kultus

Undying Lucario, di mana kamu juga
akan menerima batu suci kami.

entries.original:
"The Undying Lucario always enjoy a
good battle just for the sport of it."
entries.translation_source: The Undying Lucario always enjoy a good battle just for the sport of it.
entries.translated:
Undying Lucario selalu menikmati
pertempuran yang baik hanya demi\lolahraga.

entries.original:
"Through this gateway lies the great
King Borrius the Third.

He is the king who released and
bound the dark force in days past.

No one has yet succeeded in mapping
out the tomb, but legends say that\lthere is immense wealth waiting for\lany who are able to reach the\lburial chamber."
entries.translation_source: Through this gateway lies the great King Borrius the Third. He is the king who released and bound the dark force in days past. No one has yet succeeded in mapping out the tomb, but legends say that there is immense wealth waiting for any who are able to reach the burial chamber.
entries.translated:
Di balik gerbang ini terdapat Raja
Agung Borrius yang Ketiga. Dialah\lraja yang melepaskan dan mengikat

kekuatan gelap di masa lalu. Belum
ada yang berhasil memetakan makam\litu, tetapi legenda mengatakan ada

harta karun besar yang menunggu
siapa pun yang mampu mencapai ruang\lpemakaman.

entries.original:
"Word around here is that I’m the
strongest Trainer in the desert.

It took much time to gain the
respect of the Trainers around\lhere, so if you want my respect,\lyou’ll earn their respect first."
entries.translation_source: Word around here is that I’m the strongest Trainer in the desert. It took much time to gain the respect of the Trainers around here, so if you want my respect, you’ll earn their respect first.
entries.translated:
Kabar di sini mengatakan bahwa aku
adalah Pelatih terkuat di gurun.\lButuh waktu lama untuk mendapatkan

rasa hormat dari para Pelatih di
sini, jadi jika kamu ingin\lhormatku, kamu harus meraih hormat

mereka terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Word around here is that I’m the
strongest Trainer in the desert.

It took much time to gain the
respect of the Trainers around\lhere, so if you want my respect,\lyou’ll have to fight me for it!"
entries.translation_source: Word around here is that I’m the strongest Trainer in the desert. It took much time to gain the respect of the Trainers around here, so if you want my respect, you’ll have to fight me for it!
entries.translated:
Kabar di sini mengatakan bahwa aku
adalah Pelatih terkuat di gurun.\lButuh waktu lama untuk mendapatkan

rasa hormat dari para Pelatih di
sini, jadi jika kamu ingin\lhormatku, kamu harus melawanku

untuk mendapatkannya!

entries.original:
"Any good desert Trainer can use an
item like this."
entries.translation_source: Any good desert Trainer can use an item like this.
entries.translated:
Setiap Pelatih gurun yang baik bisa
menggunakan item seperti ini.

entries.original:
"That item is a [green]Scizorite[blue]!

If you catch a Scyther and evolve
it into a [green]Scizor[blue], let it hold that\lto unleash its metallic fury!"
entries.translation_source: That item is a [green]Scizorite[blue]! If you catch a Scyther and evolve it into a [green]Scizor[blue], let it hold that to unleash its metallic fury!
entries.translated:
Item itu adalah [green]Scizorit[blue]! Jika kamu
menangkap Scyther dan\lmengevolusinya menjadi [green]Scizor[blue],

biarkan ia membawanya untuk
melepaskan amukan metaliknya!

entries.original:
"This desert hoards mysteries in
its shifting sands!"
entries.translation_source: This desert hoards mysteries in its shifting sands!
entries.translated:
Gurun ini menyembunyikan misteri di
pasirnya yang bergerak!

entries.original:
"I’m telling you, this rock
formation has significance!

I can feel it!"
entries.translation_source: I’m telling you, this rock formation has significance! I can feel it!
entries.translated:
Aku bilang, formasi batu ini
memiliki arti penting! Aku bisa\lmerasakannya!

entries.original:
"Hmph.

I really dug myself into a hole,
didn’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Hmph. I really dug myself into a hole, didn’t I?
entries.translated:
Hmph. Aku benar-benar menjebak
diriku sendiri, ya?

entries.original:
"Because of my efforts, this desert
is like a paradise for Pokémon!

It is truly a great desert!"
entries.translation_source: Because of my efforts, this desert is like a paradise for Pokémon! It is truly a great desert!
entries.translated:
Berkat usahaku, gurun ini seperti
surga bagi Pokémon! Ini benar-benar\lgurun yang luar biasa!

entries.original:
"If there are fossils hidden in
the desert, it must have been\lunderwater a long time ago."
entries.translation_source: If there are fossils hidden in the desert, it must have been underwater a long time ago.
entries.translated:
Jika ada fosil yang tersembunyi di
gurun, pasti dulu tempat ini berada\ldi bawah air.

entries.original:
"I’m going to be a real hero
one day.

I’m going to work harder to make me
and my Pokémon stronger."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to be a real hero one day. I’m going to work harder to make me and my Pokémon stronger.
entries.translated:
Suatu hari nanti aku akan menjadi
pahlawan sejati. Aku akan bekerja\llebih keras untuk membuatku dan

Pokémonku lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"I came to play music in the desert,
but sand is getting in my guitar."
entries.translation_source: I came to play music in the desert, but sand is getting in my guitar.
entries.translated:
Aku datang untuk bermain musik di
gurun, tapi pasir masuk ke gitarku.

entries.original:
"In your future, I sense that you
will meet many others.

I think you will be linked to each
other by a strange power."
entries.translation_source: In your future, I sense that you will meet many others. I think you will be linked to each other by a strange power.
entries.translated:
Di masa depanmu, aku merasakan
bahwa kamu akan bertemu banyak\lorang lain. Aku pikir kamu akan

terhubung satu sama lain oleh
kekuatan aneh.

entries.original:
"Shattering rocks here can yield
valuable rewards!"
entries.translation_source: Shattering rocks here can yield valuable rewards!
entries.translated:
Menghancurkan batu di sini bisa
memberikan hadiah berharga!

entries.original:
"I think [green]Rufflet[blue] can only be found
here on [green]Mondays[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I think [green]Rufflet[blue] can only be found here on [green]Mondays[blue].
entries.translated:
Aku pikir [green]Rufflet[blue] hanya bisa
ditemukan di sini pada hari [green]Senin[blue].

entries.original:
"I’ve only seen [green]Vullaby[blue] around here
on [green]Thursdays[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’ve only seen [green]Vullaby[blue] around here on [green]Thursdays[blue].
entries.translated:
Aku hanya melihat [green]Vullaby[blue] di
sekitar sini pada hari [green]Kamis[blue].

entries.original:
"This desert’ll always keep me
fired up!"
entries.translation_source: This desert’ll always keep me fired up!
entries.translated:
Gurun ini akan selalu membuatku
bersemangat!

entries.original:
"Leave me alone!
The desert sand is so warm\.

Zzz\."
entries.translation_source: Leave me alone! The desert sand is so warm\. Zzz\.
entries.translated:
Tinggalkan aku sendiri! Pasir gurun
begitu hangat\. Zzz\.

entries.original:
"I found my Pokémon pretending to
be a cactus!

Or maybe that’s just because it’s
the Cactus Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: I found my Pokémon pretending to be a cactus! Or maybe that’s just because it’s the Cactus Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Aku menemukan Pokémonku
berpura-pura menjadi kaktus! Atau\lmungkin itu karena ia adalah

Pokémon Kaktus?

entries.original: "[green]Ra ra ra ra!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Ra ra ra ra!
entries.translated: [green]Ra ra ra ra!

entries.original: "[green]Awwwk!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Awwwk!
entries.translated: [green]Awwwk!

entries.original: "[green]Blip bloop!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Blip bloop!
entries.translated: [green]Blip bloop!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] disappeared in the
shifting sands."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] disappeared in the shifting sands.
entries.translated:
[black] [buffer1] menghilang di pasir yang
bergeser.

entries.original: "Weed Whacker"
entries.translation_source: Weed Whacker
entries.translated: Weed Whacker

entries.original:
"Hello, Trainer!

You are precisely the type of
person I am looking for.

I am a businessman trying to build
my dream pancake restaurant right\lhere in the forest.

There’s just one problem.

There is all this pesky tall grass
in the way.

Are your services available to Cut
all the tall grass in the area?"
entries.translation_source: Hello, Trainer! You are precisely the type of person I am looking for. I am a businessman trying to build my dream pancake restaurant right here in the forest. There’s just one problem. There is all this pesky tall grass in the way. Are your services available to Cut all the tall grass in the area?
entries.translated:
Halo, Pelatih! Kamu adalah tipe
orang yang saya cari. Saya seorang\lpengusaha yang mencoba membangun

restoran pancake impian saya tepat
di hutan ini. Hanya ada satu\lmasalah. Ada rumput tinggi yang

mengganggu ini di jalan. Apakah
jasamu tersedia untuk memotong\lsemua rumput tinggi di area ini?

entries.original:
"Excellent!

Now get going and use [green]Cut[blue] to take
down all the tall grass!"
entries.translation_source: Excellent! Now get going and use [green]Cut[blue] to take down all the tall grass!
entries.translated:
Bagus! Sekarang pergilah dan
gunakan [green]Potong[blue] untuk menebang semua\lrumput tinggi!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry, Trainer, I will find
someone else who wants to develop\lmy land for a handsome payment."
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry, Trainer, I will find someone else who wants to develop my land for a handsome payment.
entries.translated:
Jangan khawatir, Pelatih, saya akan
menemukan orang lain yang ingin\lmengembangkan tanah saya dengan

bayaran yang menarik.

entries.original:
"There is still tall grass in these
woods you need to [green]Cut[blue] down.

Get hacking!"
entries.translation_source: There is still tall grass in these woods you need to [green]Cut[blue] down. Get hacking!
entries.translated:
