Masih ada rumput tinggi di hutan
ini yang perlu kamu [green]Potong[blue]. Ayo\lpotong!

entries.original:
"Excellent work, but I am afraid I
have some bad news.

The Pokémon Rangers have just shut
down our operation.

Apparently the tall grass around
here is endangered, despite always\lgrowing back.

However, I am still contractually
obligated to pay you for your\lservice."
entries.translation_source: Excellent work, but I am afraid I have some bad news. The Pokémon Rangers have just shut down our operation. Apparently the tall grass around here is endangered, despite always growing back. However, I am still contractually obligated to pay you for your service.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, tapi saya khawatir ada
kabar buruk. Pokémon Rangers baru\lsaja menghentikan operasi kami.

Rupanya rumput tinggi di sekitar
sini terancam punah, meskipun\lselalu tumbuh kembali. Namun, saya

masih terikat kontrak untuk
membayar jasamu.

entries.original:
"First I will take down the
Pokémon Rangers, then I will\lbuild my pancake empire."
entries.translation_source: First I will take down the Pokémon Rangers, then I will build my pancake empire.
entries.translated:
Pertama saya akan menjatuhkan
Pokémon Rangers, lalu saya akan\lmembangun kerajaan pancake saya.

entries.original:
"With a few more battles like the
one we had, this place’ll become\lhappenin’ in no time!"
entries.translation_source: With a few more battles like the one we had, this place’ll become happenin’ in no time!
entries.translated:
Dengan beberapa pertempuran lagi
seperti yang kita lakukan, tempat\lini akan menjadi ramai dalam waktu

singkat!

entries.original:
"I’m pretty sure Caterpie like to
frequent these woods during the\ldaytime while Weedle like to\lpopulate them at night."
entries.translation_source: I’m pretty sure Caterpie like to frequent these woods during the daytime while Weedle like to populate them at night.
entries.translated:
Saya cukup yakin Caterpie suka
sering datang ke hutan ini pada\lsiang hari sementara Weedle suka

menghuninya pada malam hari.

entries.original:
"Pokémon get stronger when they
evolve.

But how much stronger is my Pokémon
compared to other evolved Pokémon?

I bet a whole bunch!"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon get stronger when they evolve. But how much stronger is my Pokémon compared to other evolved Pokémon? I bet a whole bunch!
entries.translated:
Pokémon menjadi lebih kuat saat
berevolusi. Tapi seberapa kuat\lPokémon saya dibandingkan dengan

Pokémon berevolusi lainnya? Saya
yakin jauh lebih kuat!

entries.original:
"Due to the grim nature of these
woods, Ghost-type Pokémon feel\lat home here."
entries.translation_source: Due to the grim nature of these woods, Ghost-type Pokémon feel at home here.
entries.translated:
Karena sifat suram hutan ini,
Pokémon tipe Hantu merasa betah di\lsini.

entries.original:
"According to old tales, Phantump
are tree stumps possessed by the\lspirits of children who died while\llost in these woods."
entries.translation_source: According to old tales, Phantump are tree stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in these woods.
entries.translated:
Menurut cerita lama, Phantump
adalah tunggul pohon yang dirasuki\loleh roh anak-anak yang meninggal

saat tersesat di hutan ini.

entries.original:
"An old colleague of mine in Seaport
City measures and records the sizes\lof all Pumpkaboo she sees."
entries.translation_source: An old colleague of mine in Seaport City measures and records the sizes of all Pumpkaboo she sees.
entries.translated:
Seorang rekan lama saya di Seaport
City mengukur dan mencatat ukuran\lsemua Pumpkaboo yang dia lihat.

entries.original:
"I’ve dedicated my life to studying
the secrets of the legendary titan\lPokémon!

Recently, I discovered that these
Pokémon must live in the strange\lrock formations that can be found\laround Borrius.

If only I had discovered how to
unseal them, too\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve dedicated my life to studying the secrets of the legendary titan Pokémon! Recently, I discovered that these Pokémon must live in the strange rock formations that can be found around Borrius. If only I had discovered how to unseal them, too\.
entries.translated:
Saya telah mengabdikan hidup saya
untuk mempelajari rahasia Pokémon\ltitan legendaris! Baru-baru ini,

saya menemukan bahwa Pokémon ini
pasti tinggal di formasi batuan\laneh yang dapat ditemukan di

sekitar Borrius. Andai saja saya
juga menemukan cara untuk membuka\lsegel mereka\.

entries.original:
"It’s pretty odd that there’s a
forest filled with so many Bug-type\lPokémon this close to a desert.

Well, that’s Borrius for you!"
entries.translation_source: It’s pretty odd that there’s a forest filled with so many Bug-type Pokémon this close to a desert. Well, that’s Borrius for you!
entries.translated:
Cukup aneh ada hutan yang dipenuhi
begitu banyak Pokémon tipe Serangga\lbegitu dekat dengan gurun. Ya,

begitulah Borrius!

entries.original:
"The houses here are based off of a
design found in the Unova region.

They’re from some town that boasts
of pottery made from volcanic clay.

Speaking of, there’s a maniac
somewhere around here who will\lbuy some kind of relic pottery\lfor a high price."
entries.translation_source: The houses here are based off of a design found in the Unova region. They’re from some town that boasts of pottery made from volcanic clay. Speaking of, there’s a maniac somewhere around here who will buy some kind of relic pottery for a high price.
entries.translated:
Rumah-rumah di sini didasarkan pada
desain yang ditemukan di wilayah\lUnova. Mereka berasal dari suatu

kota yang bangga dengan tembikar
yang terbuat dari tanah liat\lvulkanik. Omong-omong, ada seorang

maniak di suatu tempat di sini yang
akan membeli semacam tembikar\lpeninggalan dengan harga tinggi.

entries.original:
"The desert doesn’t continue on for
much longer once you head south\lof town.

Be careful if you decide to travel
in that direction, though.

You’ll end up in Antisis City if
you travel too far.

And Lord knows you don’t want to
go anywhere near that place\."
entries.translation_source: The desert doesn’t continue on for much longer once you head south of town. Be careful if you decide to travel in that direction, though. You’ll end up in Antisis City if you travel too far. And Lord knows you don’t want to go anywhere near that place\.
entries.translated:
Gurun tidak berlanjut lebih jauh
begitu kamu pergi ke selatan kota.\lHati-hati jika kamu memutuskan

untuk bepergian ke arah itu, ya.
Kamu akan berakhir di Antisis City\ljika kamu bepergian terlalu jauh.

Dan Tuhan tahu kamu tidak ingin
mendekati tempat itu\.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to light up all of the
torches at night.

The desert can get pretty cold once
the sun goes down.

The torches then provide a reliable
source of heat."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to light up all of the torches at night. The desert can get pretty cold once the sun goes down. The torches then provide a reliable source of heat.
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah menyalakan semua
obor di malam hari. Gurun bisa\lmenjadi cukup dingin begitu

matahari terbenam. Obor-obor itu
kemudian menyediakan sumber panas\lyang dapat diandalkan.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to keep the torches
around here lit at night.

The desert can get pretty cold,
now that the sun is down.

Those torches are our only reliable
source of heat right now."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to keep the torches around here lit at night. The desert can get pretty cold, now that the sun is down. Those torches are our only reliable source of heat right now.
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah menjaga obor-obor di
sekitar sini tetap menyala di malam\lhari. Gurun bisa menjadi cukup

dingin, sekarang setelah matahari
terbenam. Obor-obor itu adalah\lsatu-satunya sumber panas yang

dapat diandalkan saat ini.

entries.original:
"Hello, I have been stationed here
by the Science Society to study\lfossils.

If you have found one, I can take
a stab at reviving it for you."
entries.translation_source: Hello, I have been stationed here by the Science Society to study fossils. If you have found one, I can take a stab at reviving it for you.
entries.translated:
Halo, aku ditempatkan di sini oleh
Science Society untuk mempelajari\lfosil. Jika kamu menemukan satu,

aku bisa mencoba menghidupkannya
kembali untukmu.

entries.original:
"It seems you haven’t found a fossil
either\."
entries.translation_source: It seems you haven’t found a fossil either\.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu juga belum
menemukan fosil\.

entries.original:
"Oh!
That’s wonderful!

Which fossil would you like me to
revive into a Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Oh! That’s wonderful! Which fossil would you like me to revive into a Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Oh! Itu luar biasa! Fosil mana yang
ingin kamu hidupkan kembali menjadi\lPokémon?

entries.original:
"\.Huh?

That doesn’t look like a fossil
to me\."
entries.translation_source: \.Huh? That doesn’t look like a fossil to me\.
entries.translated:
\.Hah? Menurutku itu tidak terlihat
seperti fosil\.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the
[buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over the [buffer2].
entries.translated: [black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2].

entries.original:
"It will take some time to revive.
Come back later."
entries.translation_source: It will take some time to revive. Come back later.
entries.translated:
Ini akan memakan waktu untuk
dihidupkan kembali. Kembalilah\lnanti.

entries.original:
"Welcome back!

I’ve successfully revived your
fossil into a healthy [buffer1]!

But you’ll need some space in your
party if you want to take it."
entries.translation_source: Welcome back! I’ve successfully revived your fossil into a healthy [buffer1]! But you’ll need some space in your party if you want to take it.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang kembali! Aku
berhasil menghidupkan kembali\lfosilmu menjadi [buffer1] yang

sehat! Tetapi kamu perlu ruang di
timmu jika ingin membawanya.

entries.original:
"Welcome back!

I’ve successfully revived your
fossil into a healthy [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome back! I’ve successfully revived your fossil into a healthy [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
Selamat datang kembali! Aku
berhasil menghidupkan kembali\lfosilmu menjadi [buffer1] yang

sehat!

entries.original:
"Do you have any other fossils you’d
like me to revive into a Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have any other fossils you’d like me to revive into a Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu memiliki fosil lain
yang ingin kamu hidupkan kembali\lmenjadi Pokémon?

entries.original:
"At least I got to study a fossil
earlier!

The Science Society will be pleased
with my research\."
entries.translation_source: At least I got to study a fossil earlier! The Science Society will be pleased with my research\.
entries.translated:
Setidaknya aku bisa mempelajari
fosil sebelumnya! Science Society\lakan senang dengan penelitianku\.

entries.original:
"There’s something that this
enthusiast wants to get his hands\lon, even if it means spending a\llot of money.

Do you have such a rare item?
Do you?"
entries.translation_source: There’s something that this enthusiast wants to get his hands on, even if it means spending a lot of money. Do you have such a rare item? Do you?
entries.translated:
Ada sesuatu yang ingin didapatkan
oleh penggemar ini, meskipun itu\lberarti mengeluarkan banyak uang.

Apakah kamu memiliki barang langka
seperti itu? Apakah kamu?

entries.original:
"That [green][buffer3][blue]! Will you sell it
to me for $[green][buffer2][blue]? Will you?"
entries.translation_source: That [green][buffer3][blue]! Will you sell it to me for $[green][buffer2][blue]? Will you?
entries.translated:
Itu [green][buffer3][blue]! Maukah kamu
menjualnya kepadaku seharga\l$[green][buffer2][blue]? Maukah kamu?

entries.original:
"I got a very good item!
Don’t you think it’s great?\lDon’t you?"
entries.translation_source: I got a very good item! Don’t you think it’s great? Don’t you?
entries.translated:
Aku mendapatkan barang yang sangat
bagus! Bukankah menurutmu itu\lhebat? Bukankah?

entries.original:
"This is slightly different.
Don’t you think so, too? Don’t you?"
entries.translation_source: This is slightly different. Don’t you think so, too? Don’t you?
entries.translated:
Ini sedikit berbeda. Bukankah kamu
juga berpikir begitu? Bukankah?

entries.original:
"If you ever change your mind, will
you sell me the rare item?\lWill you?"
entries.translation_source: If you ever change your mind, will you sell me the rare item? Will you?
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berubah pikiran, maukah
kamu menjual barang langka itu\lkepadaku? Maukah kamu?

entries.original: "As Hard as They Come"
entries.translation_source: As Hard as They Come
entries.translated: As Hard as They Come

entries.original:
"Hey, you.
I gots a favour to ask you for.

I’m an enthusiast.

A lover of hard thin’s, if I do say
so myself.

But unlike my friend over there,
I’m not interested in buyin’\lanythin’ off of ya.

I just want ya to collect
[green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue] for me.

Ya think ya can do it?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, you. I gots a favour to ask you for. I’m an enthusiast. A lover of hard thin’s, if I do say so myself. But unlike my friend over there, I’m not interested in buyin’ anythin’ off of ya. I just want ya to collect [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue] for me. Ya think ya can do it?
entries.translated:
Hei, kamu. Ada bantuan yang
kubutuhkan. Aku seorang penggemar.\lPencinta benda keras, kalau aku

boleh berkata begitu. Tapi tidak
seperti temanku di sana, aku tidak\ltertarik membeli apa pun darimu.

Aku hanya ingin kamu mengumpulkan
[green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue] untukku. Kamu\lpikir bisa?

entries.original:
"Yee haw!

[green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya
smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Heck, I bet if you dug into the
walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue],\lyou’d find ’em there, too."
entries.translation_source: Yee haw! [green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue]. Heck, I bet if you dug into the walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue], you’d find ’em there, too.
entries.translated:
Yee haw! [green]Hard Stones[blue] mungkin muncul
saat kamu menghancurkan batu di\l[green]Great Desert[blue]. Heh, aku yakin jika

kamu menggali di dinding [green]KBT
Expressway[blue], kamu akan menemukannya\ldi sana juga.

entries.original:
"Those hard objects in your Cube are
the items I asked for!

Here, let me take ’em from ya."
entries.translation_source: Those hard objects in your Cube are the items I asked for! Here, let me take ’em from ya.
entries.translated:
Benda-benda keras di Kubusmu adalah
barang yang kuminta! Sini, biarkan\laku mengambilnya darimu.

entries.original:
"Oh, you lookin’ for a reward or
somethin’?

Then, here ya go."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you lookin’ for a reward or somethin’? Then, here ya go.
entries.translated:
Oh, kamu mencari hadiah atau apa?
Kalau begitu, ini dia.

entries.original:
"[green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya
smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Heck, I bet if you dug into the
walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue],\lyou’d find ’em there, too.

Do either one of those thin’s and
bring me [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em."
entries.translation_source: [green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue]. Heck, I bet if you dug into the walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue], you’d find ’em there, too. Do either one of those thin’s and bring me [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em.
entries.translated:
[green]Batu Keras[blue] mungkin muncul saat kamu
menghancurkan batu di [green]Great Desert[blue].\lHeck, aku yakin jika kamu menggali

dinding [green]KBT Expressway[blue], kamu akan
menemukannya di sana juga. Lakukan\lsalah satu dari hal itu dan bawa

aku [green][buffer1][blue] buah.

entries.original:
"I can tell you’re not an
enthusiast."
entries.translation_source: I can tell you’re not an enthusiast.
entries.translated:
Aku bisa tahu kamu bukan seorang
penggemar.

entries.original:
"Say, ya know what?

Bring me even more hard thin’s!

I’ve gotta a mountain of [green]Gems[blue] I’m
sittin’ on over here, and I\lcouldn’t care one lick for ’em!

I’ll give ’em to you in exchange
for some more Hard Stones."
entries.translation_source: Say, ya know what? Bring me even more hard thin’s! I’ve gotta a mountain of [green]Gems[blue] I’m sittin’ on over here, and I couldn’t care one lick for ’em! I’ll give ’em to you in exchange for some more Hard Stones.
entries.translated:
Dengar, kamu tahu? Bawakan aku
lebih banyak benda keras! Aku punya\lgunungan [green]Permata[blue] di sini, dan aku

tidak peduli sedikit pun dengan
mereka! Aku akan memberikannya\lpadamu sebagai ganti beberapa Batu

Keras lagi.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over
[buffer2] [buffer1]s."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over [buffer2] [buffer1]s.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2]
[buffer1].

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the
[buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over the [buffer1].
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer1]
tersebut.

entries.original:
"Didja bring me some more
[green]Hard Stones[blue]?

I’ll give ya some [green]Gems[blue] if you don’t
mind forkin’ [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em over."
entries.translation_source: Didja bring me some more [green]Hard Stones[blue]? I’ll give ya some [green]Gems[blue] if you don’t mind forkin’ [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em over.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu membawaku lagi [green]Batu
Keras[blue]? Aku akan memberimu beberapa\l[green]Permata[blue] jika kamu tidak keberatan

menyerahkan [green][buffer1][blue] buah.

entries.original: "Which Gem can I do you for?"
entries.translation_source: Which Gem can I do you for?
entries.translated:
Permata mana yang bisa aku berikan
untukmu?

entries.original:
"So you’ll fork [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue] over
for a [green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: So you’ll fork [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue] over for a [green][buffer2][blue]?
entries.translated:
Jadi kamu akan menyerahkan [green][buffer1]
Batu Keras[blue] untuk mendapatkan\l[green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Yee haw!

You wanna trade for some more
Gems?"
entries.translation_source: Yee haw! You wanna trade for some more Gems?
entries.translated:
Yee haw! Kamu ingin bertukar untuk
beberapa Permata lagi?

entries.original:
"If you get another [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue],
come back and trade ’em, will ya?"
entries.translation_source: If you get another [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue], come back and trade ’em, will ya?
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mendapat lagi [green][buffer1]
Batu Keras[blue], kembali dan tukarkan,\lya?

entries.original:
"[green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya
smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Heck, I bet if you dug into the
walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue],\lyou’d find ’em there, too.

Do either one of those thin’s and
bring me [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em.

I’ll give ya a Gem of your choosin’
in exchange."
entries.translation_source: [green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue]. Heck, I bet if you dug into the walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue], you’d find ’em there, too. Do either one of those thin’s and bring me [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em. I’ll give ya a Gem of your choosin’ in exchange.
entries.translated:
[green]Batu Keras[blue] mungkin muncul saat kamu
menghancurkan batu di [green]Great Desert[blue].\lHeck, aku yakin jika kamu menggali

dinding [green]KBT Expressway[blue], kamu akan
menemukannya di sana juga. Lakukan\lsalah satu dari hal itu dan bawa

aku [green][buffer1][blue] buah. Aku akan
memberimu Permata pilihanmu sebagai\lgantinya.

entries.original:
"Ya have less than [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue],
pal.

[green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya
smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Heck, I bet if you dug into the
walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue],\lyou’d find ’em there, too."
entries.translation_source: Ya have less than [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue], pal. [green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue]. Heck, I bet if you dug into the walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue], you’d find ’em there, too.
entries.translated:
Kamu punya kurang dari [green][buffer1]
Batu Keras[blue], sobat. [green]Batu Keras[blue]\lmungkin muncul saat kamu

menghancurkan batu di [green]Great Desert[blue].
Heck, aku yakin jika kamu menggali\ldinding [green]KBT Expressway[blue], kamu akan

menemukannya di sana juga.

entries.original:
"Please\.\CC0820
I’m begging you\.

Tell me you’ve fished for Pokémon
at least [green]3[blue] times\."
entries.translation_source: Please\.\CC0820 I’m begging you\. Tell me you’ve fished for Pokémon at least [green]3[blue] times\.
entries.translated:
Tolong\.\CC0820 Aku mohon padamu\. Katakan
kamu telah memancing Pokémon\lsetidaknya [green]3[blue] kali\.

entries.original:
"Ohhhhhhhh yeahhhhhhhh!

A Trainer that actually bothers to
fish showed up at my house!

This is just the inspiration I need
to make a fresh start with my life!

It’s time to go party in
East Borrius, baby!

See ya, Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Ohhhhhhhh yeahhhhhhhh! A Trainer that actually bothers to fish showed up at my house! This is just the inspiration I need to make a fresh start with my life! It’s time to go party in East Borrius, baby! See ya, Trainer!
entries.translated:
Ohhhhhhhh yeahhhhhhhh! Seorang
Pelatih yang benar-benar\lrepot-repot memancing muncul di

rumahku! Ini adalah inspirasi yang
kubutuhkan untuk memulai awal baru\ldalam hidupku! Saatnya berpesta di

East Borrius, sayang! Sampai jumpa,
Pelatih!

entries.original:
"[black]It looks like the Fisherman left
something behind\."
entries.translation_source: [black]It looks like the Fisherman left something behind\.
entries.translated:
[black]Sepertinya Nelayan meninggalkan
sesuatu\.

entries.original:
"Tch\.

Kids these days\."
entries.translation_source: Tch\. Kids these days\.
entries.translated: Tch\. Anak-anak zaman sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Tch\.

You’re a liar!
You haven’t fished 3 times! I know!"
entries.translation_source: Tch\. You’re a liar! You haven’t fished 3 times! I know!
entries.translated:
Tch\. Kamu pembohong! Kamu belum
memancing 3 kali! Aku tahu!

entries.original: "Treasure Hunter"
entries.translation_source: Treasure Hunter
entries.translated: Pemburu Harta

entries.original:
"While you were out there wandering
through the desert, did you happen\lto stumble upon the entrance to the\lTomb of Borrius?

Around here, it’s known that the
ancient people of Borrius hid a\llot of treasure in the tomb."
entries.translation_source: While you were out there wandering through the desert, did you happen to stumble upon the entrance to the Tomb of Borrius? Around here, it’s known that the ancient people of Borrius hid a lot of treasure in the tomb.
entries.translated:
Saat kamu pergi berkelana di padang
pasir, apakah kamu tidak sengaja\lmenemukan pintu masuk ke Makam

Borrius? Di sini, diketahui bahwa
orang kuno Borrius menyembunyikan\lbanyak harta karun di dalam makam.

entries.original:
"It’s you!

The Trainer who found the burial
chamber in the Tomb of Borrius!

You’re the talk of the town!

So please, you must accept my
request!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you! The Trainer who found the burial chamber in the Tomb of Borrius! You’re the talk of the town! So please, you must accept my request!
entries.translated:
Kamu! Pelatih yang menemukan ruang
pemakaman di Makam Borrius! Kamu\lmenjadi bahan pembicaraan di kota!

Jadi, tolong, kamu harus menerima
permintaanku!

entries.original:
"You don’t even know what it is and
you’ve already accepted?

You’re so bold!

No wonder you were able to make it
through the Tomb of Borrius!

Well, here’s my request.

I’m sure you noticed that there
wasn’t much treasure lying around\lin the tomb.

It’s known around here that the
ancient people of Borrius used\lspecial materials to camouflage\ltheir treasure.

So, I want you to go back to the
tomb and find every item the\lancient people hid.

Do you think you can do it?"
entries.translation_source: You don’t even know what it is and you’ve already accepted? You’re so bold! No wonder you were able to make it through the Tomb of Borrius! Well, here’s my request. I’m sure you noticed that there wasn’t much treasure lying around in the tomb. It’s known around here that the ancient people of Borrius used special materials to camouflage their treasure. So, I want you to go back to the tomb and find every item the ancient people hid. Do you think you can do it?
entries.translated:
Kamu bahkan tidak tahu apa itu dan
sudah menerimanya? Kamu sangat\lberani! Tidak heran kamu berhasil

melewati Makam Borrius! Nah, ini
permintaanku. Aku yakin kamu\lmemperhatikan bahwa tidak banyak

harta karun yang berserakan di
dalam makam. Di sini diketahui\lbahwa orang kuno Borrius

menggunakan bahan khusus untuk
menyamarkan harta karun mereka.\lJadi, aku ingin kamu kembali ke

makam dan temukan setiap barang
yang disembunyikan orang kuno.\lApakah kamu pikir kamu bisa

melakukannya?

entries.original:
"You’re so cool!

I can’t sense how much treasure is
still hidden in the tomb, but I’ll\lbe able to sense when you’ve found\lit all."
entries.translation_source: You’re so cool! I can’t sense how much treasure is still hidden in the tomb, but I’ll be able to sense when you’ve found it all.
entries.translated:
Kamu keren sekali! Aku tidak bisa
merasakan berapa banyak harta karun\lyang masih tersembunyi di dalam

makam, tapi aku akan bisa merasakan
saat kamu menemukan semuanya.

entries.original:
"I can sense it\. you found all of
the treasure hidden in the tomb!

You’re so cool!

Take this Egg I found while looking
around the tomb myself."
entries.translation_source: I can sense it\. you found all of the treasure hidden in the tomb! You’re so cool! Take this Egg I found while looking around the tomb myself.
entries.translated:
Aku bisa merasakannya\. kamu
menemukan semua harta karun yang\ltersembunyi di dalam makam! Kamu

keren sekali! Ambil Telur ini yang
aku temukan saat menjelajahi makam\lsendiri.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received an Egg from
the Psychic!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received an Egg from the Psychic!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Telur dari
Psikis!

entries.original:
"I don’t blame you.

An important Trainer like you must
have much more important things\lto do."
entries.translation_source: I don’t blame you. An important Trainer like you must have much more important things to do.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak menyalahkanmu. Seorang
Pelatih penting sepertimu pasti\lmemiliki hal-hal yang lebih penting

untuk dilakukan.

entries.original:
"I can sense that there is still
some hidden treasure in the tomb.

I don’t know how much is left, but
you should use a [green]Dowsing Machine[blue]\lto make sure you find it all."
entries.translation_source: I can sense that there is still some hidden treasure in the tomb. I don’t know how much is left, but you should use a [green]Dowsing Machine[blue] to make sure you find it all.
entries.translated:
Aku bisa merasakan bahwa masih ada
beberapa harta karun tersembunyi di\ldalam makam. Aku tidak tahu berapa

banyak yang tersisa, tapi kamu
harus menggunakan [green]Mesin Pencari[blue]\luntuk memastikan kamu menemukan

semuanya.

entries.original:
"I can sense it\. you found all of
the treasure in the tomb!

But before I can give you a reward,
you’ll need to make space in your\lparty for it."
entries.translation_source: I can sense it\. you found all of the treasure in the tomb! But before I can give you a reward, you’ll need to make space in your party for it.
entries.translated:
Aku bisa merasakannya\. kamu
menemukan semua harta karun di\ldalam makam! Tapi sebelum aku bisa

memberimu hadiah, kamu perlu
membuat ruang di timmu untuk itu.

entries.original:
"That Egg must have been hidden in
the tomb for centuries!

If you hadn’t discovered the burial
chamber, it may have never found a\lTrainer to care for it."
entries.translation_source: That Egg must have been hidden in the tomb for centuries! If you hadn’t discovered the burial chamber, it may have never found a Trainer to care for it.
entries.translated:
Telur itu pasti telah tersembunyi
di dalam makam selama berabad-abad!\lJika kamu tidak menemukan ruang

pemakaman, mungkin telur itu tidak
akan pernah menemukan Pelatih untuk\lmerawatnya.

entries.original:
"Shhhh!

Do you hear them?
The trapped spirits?

Their voices are emanating from
your Cube!

You must free them!"
entries.translation_source: Shhhh! Do you hear them? The trapped spirits? Their voices are emanating from your Cube! You must free them!
entries.translated:
Sssst! Apakah kamu mendengar
mereka? Roh-roh yang terperangkap?\lSuara mereka berasal dari Kubusmu!

Kamu harus membebaskan mereka!

entries.original:
"[black]Spiritomb retreated back into the
Odd Keystone."
entries.translation_source: [black]Spiritomb retreated back into the Odd Keystone.
entries.translated:
[black]Spiritomb mundur kembali ke dalam
Batu Kunci Aneh.

entries.original:
"You mustn’t startle the trapped
spirits!

You must free them by capturing
them."
entries.translation_source: You mustn’t startle the trapped spirits! You must free them by capturing them.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak boleh mengejutkan
roh-roh yang terperangkap! Kamu\lharus membebaskan mereka dengan

menangkap mereka.

entries.original:
"The trapped spirits have been
freed!

Rejoice!"
entries.translation_source: The trapped spirits have been freed! Rejoice!
entries.translated:
Roh-roh yang terperangkap telah
dibebaskan! Bersukacitalah!

entries.original:
"Shhhh!

Do you hear them?
The trapped spirits?

\.\CC0820Of course you don’t\."
entries.translation_source: Shhhh! Do you hear them? The trapped spirits? \.\CC0820Of course you don’t\.
entries.translated:
Sssst! Apakah kamu mendengar
mereka? Roh-roh yang terperangkap?\l\.\CC0820Tentu saja kamu tidak\.

entries.original:
"But they are in pain!
You must free them!"
entries.translation_source: But they are in pain! You must free them!
entries.translated:
Tapi mereka kesakitan! Kamu harus
membebaskan mereka!

entries.original: "[green]Shahhh!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Shahhh!
entries.translated: [green]Syahhh!

entries.original:
"We used to hold a festival every
year to commemorate when the\ltitan Pokémon finished building our\llittle town.

But interest in it has sort of just
faded away in recent years.

People are just too addicted to
their TVs and devices, I suppose\."
entries.translation_source: We used to hold a festival every year to commemorate when the titan Pokémon finished building our little town. But interest in it has sort of just faded away in recent years. People are just too addicted to their TVs and devices, I suppose\.
entries.translated:
Dulu kami mengadakan festival
setiap tahun untuk memperingati\lsaat Pokémon titan selesai

membangun kota kecil kami. Tapi
minat terhadapnya agak memudar\ldalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

Orang-orang terlalu kecanduan TV
dan perangkat mereka, kurasa\.

entries.original:
"If you sail east of Gurun Town,
you’ll approach the entrance to\lVictory Road.

This is a challenging path for
experienced Trainers that leads up\lto the Pokémon League.

It is there you may challenge the
Elite Four and fill the vacant\lseat of the Champion."
entries.translation_source: If you sail east of Gurun Town, you’ll approach the entrance to Victory Road. This is a challenging path for experienced Trainers that leads up to the Pokémon League. It is there you may challenge the Elite Four and fill the vacant seat of the Champion.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berlayar ke timur Gurun
Town, kamu akan mendekati pintu\lmasuk Victory Road. Ini adalah

jalan yang menantang bagi Pelatih
berpengalaman yang menuju ke\lPokémon League. Di sanalah kamu

dapat menantang Empat Elite dan
mengisi kursi Juara yang kosong.

entries.original:
"If you sail east of Gurun Town,
you’ll approach the entrance to\lVictory Road.

This is a challenging path for
experienced Trainers that leads up\lto the Pokémon League.

It is there you may challenge the
Elite Four and defend your title\lof Champion."
entries.translation_source: If you sail east of Gurun Town, you’ll approach the entrance to Victory Road. This is a challenging path for experienced Trainers that leads up to the Pokémon League. It is there you may challenge the Elite Four and defend your title of Champion.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berlayar ke timur Gurun
Town, kamu akan mendekati pintu\lmasuk Victory Road. Ini adalah

jalan yang menantang bagi Pelatih
berpengalaman yang menuju ke\lPokémon League. Di sanalah kamu

dapat menantang Empat Elite dan
mempertahankan gelar Juaramu.

entries.original:
"Shops will give you a discount
on your birthday.

But like all good things, there’s
a catch.

Sure, the items you can buy are
cheaper, but you’ll also get less\lfor selling any back."
entries.translation_source: Shops will give you a discount on your birthday. But like all good things, there’s a catch. Sure, the items you can buy are cheaper, but you’ll also get less for selling any back.
entries.translated:
Toko akan memberikan diskon pada
hari ulang tahunmu. Tapi seperti\lsemua hal baik, ada syaratnya.

Tentu, barang yang bisa kamu beli
lebih murah, tapi kamu juga akan\lmendapat lebih sedikit saat

menjualnya kembali.

entries.original:
"Oh, dear\.
You’re looking faint!

Have you not been drinking enough
liquid?

Here, please have some of mine."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear\. You’re looking faint! Have you not been drinking enough liquid? Here, please have some of mine.
entries.translated:
Oh, sayang\. Kamu terlihat pusing!
Apa kamu kurang minum cairan? Ini,\lsilakan minum punyaku.

entries.original:
"Oh, good, you’re looking much
better now.

Do try to be more careful while
travelling in this heat!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, good, you’re looking much better now. Do try to be more careful while travelling in this heat!
entries.translated:
Oh, bagus, kamu terlihat jauh lebih
baik sekarang. Cobalah lebih\lberhati-hati saat bepergian di

panas ini!

entries.original: "Mirskle"
entries.translation_source: Mirskle
entries.translated: Mirskle

entries.original:
"Huh?
Oh\.\CC0818 hey there, [buffer1]\.

How’z it hangin’?

Your Pokémon wanna sniff on some
uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense?

It’s really good for the soul.
Makes it nice and mellow\."
entries.translation_source: Huh? Oh\.\CC0818 hey there, [buffer1]\. How’z it hangin’? Your Pokémon wanna sniff on some uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense? It’s really good for the soul. Makes it nice and mellow\.
entries.translated:
Huh? Oh\.\CC0818 hei, [buffer1]\. Gimana
kabarnya? Pokémonmu ingin mencium\luh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense? Itu sangat baik

untuk jiwa. Membuatnya tenang dan
rileks\.

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] sniffed on the
strange plant\.

It’s feeling tougher!"
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] sniffed on the strange plant\. It’s feeling tougher!
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] mencium tanaman aneh itu\.
Ia merasa lebih kuat!

entries.original:
"Oh\. what’s this?

It’s lookin’ like Gloom wants a
sniff, too\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. what’s this? It’s lookin’ like Gloom wants a sniff, too\.
entries.translated:
Oh\. apa ini? Sepertinya Gloom juga
ingin menciumnya\.

entries.original:
"[black]Mirskle’s Gloom sniffed on the
strange plant\.

It’s feeling tougher!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Mirskle’s Gloom sniffed on the strange plant\. It’s feeling tougher!
entries.translated:
[black]Gloom milik Mirskle mencium tanaman
aneh itu\. Ia merasa lebih kuat!

entries.original:
"Oh, you’re lookin’ to battle?
My bad.

I’m the Gym Leader, so\.

I guess I’m in the right mood to
indulge you\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you’re lookin’ to battle? My bad. I’m the Gym Leader, so\. I guess I’m in the right mood to indulge you\.
entries.translated:
Oh, kamu ingin bertarung? Maaf. Aku
Pemimpin Gym, jadi\. Kurasa aku\lsedang dalam mood yang tepat untuk

melayanimu\.

entries.original:
"See, I’m the sort of guy who’s
into flowers.

You get me?

Most beautiful part of nature,
[buffer1]\.

You’ll be trippin’ just watchin’
them all! Let’s get funky!"
entries.translation_source: See, I’m the sort of guy who’s into flowers. You get me? Most beautiful part of nature, [buffer1]\. You’ll be trippin’ just watchin’ them all! Let’s get funky!
entries.translated:
Lihat, aku tipe orang yang suka
bunga. Paham? Bagian terindah dari\lalam, [buffer1]\. Kamu akan terpesona

hanya dengan melihat semuanya! Ayo
bergoyang!

entries.original:
"That’s deep, [buffer1].

Dunno if that’s the fog talkin’\.

\.but I really felt it, man.
Body and soul.

Here. Take this fine, fine Badge,
for beatin’ Mirskle, Gym Leader\lof flowers."
entries.translation_source: That’s deep, [buffer1]. Dunno if that’s the fog talkin’\. \.but I really felt it, man. Body and soul. Here. Take this fine, fine Badge, for beatin’ Mirskle, Gym Leader of flowers.
entries.translated:
Itu dalam, [buffer1]. Entah itu
kabut yang bicara\. \.tapi aku\lbenar-benar merasakannya, kawan.

Tubuh dan jiwa. Ini. Ambil Lencana
yang bagus ini, karena mengalahkan\lMirskle, Pemimpin Gym bunga.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Leaf Badge
from Mirskle!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Leaf Badge from Mirskle!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Lencana Daun dari
Mirskle!

entries.original:
"That’s the [green]Leaf Badge[blue].

That useful li’l thin’ makes all
traded Pokémon up to \Lv 26 keep\llistenin’ to your fine, fine\lcommands\.

Oh, and take this cool, cool TM,
toooo\."
entries.translation_source: That’s the [green]Leaf Badge[blue]. That useful li’l thin’ makes all traded Pokémon up to \Lv 26 keep listenin’ to your fine, fine commands\. Oh, and take this cool, cool TM, toooo\.
entries.translated:
Itu [green]Lencana Daun[blue]. Benda kecil yang
berguna itu membuat semua Pokémon\lyang ditukar hingga \Lv 26 tetap

menuruti perintahmu yang bagus\. Oh,
dan ambil TM keren ini, jugaaa\.

entries.original:
"That’s a Technical Machine.

That teaches your Pokémon a
move over and over, to as many\lfine, fine Pokémon as you want.

So don’t be shy about spreadin’
the love.

Preach it, [buffer1]!

Anyway\. that move’s [green]Grass Knot[blue].

I knew this guy once.
He’d always be fallin’ over.

Said it was some sort of
genetic problem.

Truth is\. I just kept usin’
Grass Knot on him!

Good thing he wasn’t too heavy, or
else that woulda REALLY hurt."
entries.translation_source: That’s a Technical Machine. That teaches your Pokémon a move over and over, to as many fine, fine Pokémon as you want. So don’t be shy about spreadin’ the love. Preach it, [buffer1]! Anyway\. that move’s [green]Grass Knot[blue]. I knew this guy once. He’d always be fallin’ over. Said it was some sort of genetic problem. Truth is\. I just kept usin’ Grass Knot on him! Good thing he wasn’t too heavy, or else that woulda REALLY hurt.
entries.translated:
Itu Mesin Teknis. Itu mengajarkan
jurus pada Pokémonmu berulang kali,\lke sebanyak mungkin Pokémon yang

kamu mau. Jadi jangan malu untuk
menyebarkan cinta. Sampaikan itu,\l[buffer1]! Ngomong-ngomong\. jurus itu

[green]Simpul Rumput[blue]. Aku dulu kenal
seseorang. Dia selalu jatuh.\lKatanya itu masalah genetik.

Sebenarnya\. aku terus menggunakan
Simpul Rumput padanya! Untung dia\ltidak terlalu berat, kalau tidak

itu benar-benar akan menyakitkan.

entries.original:
"Oh, wait.

Looks like I won’t be battlin’ you,
after all.

You’re gonna need more than one
Pokémon if you wanna take me on\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, wait. Looks like I won’t be battlin’ you, after all. You’re gonna need more than one Pokémon if you wanna take me on\.
entries.translated:
Oh, tunggu. Sepertinya aku tidak
akan bertarung denganmu, akhirnya.\lKamu perlu lebih dari satu Pokémon

jika ingin melawanku\.

entries.original:
"Everyone hide!

The Ferrothorns are on to us!"
entries.translation_source: Everyone hide! The Ferrothorns are on to us!
entries.translated:
Semua bersembunyi! Ferrothorn
mengetahui kita!

entries.original:
"Where’d he go?

Ain’t nobody here ’cept some punk
Trainer\."
entries.translation_source: Where’d he go? Ain’t nobody here ’cept some punk Trainer\.
entries.translated:
Ke mana dia pergi? Tidak ada
siapa-siapa di sini kecuali\lbeberapa Trainer nakal\.

entries.original:
"Whadda we gonna do?

Barbs ain’t gonna be happy if we
come home without ’dem boosters\."
entries.translation_source: Whadda we gonna do? Barbs ain’t gonna be happy if we come home without ’dem boosters\.
entries.translated:
Apa yang harus kita lakukan? Barbs
tidak akan senang jika kita pulang\ltanpa booster itu\.

entries.original:
"Don’t ask me, you dimwit!

It ain’t my fault this punk Leader
ripped us off!

I told ya to make sure he gave the
boosters before ya paid him!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t ask me, you dimwit! It ain’t my fault this punk Leader ripped us off! I told ya to make sure he gave the boosters before ya paid him!
entries.translated:
Jangan tanya aku, bodoh! Bukan
salahku Pemimpin nakal ini menipu\lkita! Aku sudah bilang pastikan dia

memberikan booster sebelum kamu
bayar dia!

entries.original:
"Whaddabout dose nerds, den?

Now dat Antisis is ours, ain’t no
more Granbulls for dem ta give to!"
entries.translation_source: Whaddabout dose nerds, den? Now dat Antisis is ours, ain’t no more Granbulls for dem ta give to!
entries.translated:
Bagaimana dengan para kutu buku
itu? Sekarang Antisis milik kita,\ltidak ada lagi Granbull untuk

mereka berikan!

entries.original: "Now that ain’t a half bad idea\."
entries.translation_source: Now that ain’t a half bad idea\.
entries.translated: Nah, itu bukan ide yang buruk\.

entries.original: "Véga"
entries.translation_source: Véga
entries.translated: Véga

entries.original:
"Ah, I see a Trainer has passed
my test\.

Tell me, what is your name?

\.

[player]?
I see\. so that’s how it is\."
entries.translation_source: Ah, I see a Trainer has passed my test\. Tell me, what is your name? \. [player]? I see\. so that’s how it is\.
entries.translated:
Ah, saya lihat seorang Pelatih
telah lulus ujian saya\. Katakan,\lsiapa namamu? \. [player]? Begitu ya\.

jadi begitu rupanya\.

entries.original: "Whisper\. Mutter\. Whisper\."
entries.translation_source: Whisper\. Mutter\. Whisper\.
entries.translated: Bisik\. Bergumam\. Bisik\.

entries.original:
"Oh, pay me no mind.
I was merely talking to myself.

I am Véga, the Leader of the
Crater Town Gym.

When I first arrived here, I felt
comfort in the sombre atmosphere\lof this town.

My Pokémon and I therefore
trained here, to hone our skills\lto the apex.

Incidentally, are you afraid of
the dark?

Many people are.

Knowing exactly what you’re up
against gives people courage.

But when they stumble blindly, never
sure when the foe will approach\.

Fear destroys even the largest
armies.

Let’s see if you, too, will be
crushed by the heavy atmosphere\land my might!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, pay me no mind. I was merely talking to myself. I am Véga, the Leader of the Crater Town Gym. When I first arrived here, I felt comfort in the sombre atmosphere of this town. My Pokémon and I therefore trained here, to hone our skills to the apex. Incidentally, are you afraid of the dark? Many people are. Knowing exactly what you’re up against gives people courage. But when they stumble blindly, never sure when the foe will approach\. Fear destroys even the largest armies. Let’s see if you, too, will be crushed by the heavy atmosphere and my might!
entries.translated:
Oh, jangan pedulikan saya. Saya
hanya berbicara pada diri sendiri.\lSaya Véga, Pemimpin Gym Kota Kawah.

Pertama kali saya tiba di sini,
saya merasa nyaman dengan suasana\lsuram kota ini. Oleh karena itu,

saya dan Pokémon saya berlatih di
sini, untuk mengasah kemampuan kami\lhingga puncak. Ngomong-ngomong,

apakah kamu takut gelap? Banyak
orang yang takut. Mengetahui persis\lapa yang kamu hadapi memberi orang

keberanian. Tapi saat mereka
tersandung buta, tidak pernah yakin\lkapan musuh akan mendekat\. Ketakutan

menghancurkan bahkan pasukan
terbesar. Mari kita lihat apakah\lkamu, juga, akan hancur oleh

atmosfer berat dan kekuatanku!

entries.original:
"Remarkable. Both in using the
intel on your foe, that being\lmyself\.

\.and for staying steadfast even
under pressure.

For your outstanding spirit, the
[green]Vision Badge[blue] is yours."
entries.translation_source: Remarkable. Both in using the intel on your foe, that being myself\. \.and for staying steadfast even under pressure. For your outstanding spirit, the [green]Vision Badge[blue] is yours.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa. Baik dalam menggunakan
intel tentang musuhmu, yaitu diriku\lsendiri\. \.dan karena tetap teguh

bahkan di bawah tekanan. Untuk
semangatmu yang luar biasa, [green]Lencana\lVisi[blue] adalah milikmu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Vision Badge
from Véga!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Vision Badge from Véga!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Lencana Visi dari
Véga!

entries.original:
"The Vision Badge will allow
outsider Pokémon up to \Lv 32\lyou received in a trade to obey\lyou without question.

The HM [green]Cut[blue] may also now be used
outside of battle to remove small\ltrees blocking your path.

And as a token of goodwill, I
believe this TM will be useful\lto you."
entries.translation_source: The Vision Badge will allow outsider Pokémon up to \Lv 32 you received in a trade to obey you without question. The HM [green]Cut[blue] may also now be used outside of battle to remove small trees blocking your path. And as a token of goodwill, I believe this TM will be useful to you.
entries.translated:
Lencana Visi akan mengizinkan
Pokémon dari luar hingga \Lv 32 yang\lkamu terima dalam pertukaran untuk

mematuhimu tanpa pertanyaan. HM
[green]Potong[blue] juga sekarang dapat\ldigunakan di luar pertarungan untuk

menebang pohon kecil yang
menghalangi jalurmu. Dan sebagai\ltanda itikad baik, saya percaya TM

ini akan berguna bagimu.

entries.original:
"[green]Thief[blue] steals the held item of an
opposing Pokémon.

In my line of work, I find being
able to use your opponent’s\lresources is advantageous."
entries.translation_source: [green]Thief[blue] steals the held item of an opposing Pokémon. In my line of work, I find being able to use your opponent’s resources is advantageous.
entries.translated:
[green]Pencuri[blue] mencuri item yang dibawa
Pokémon lawan. Dalam pekerjaan\lsaya, saya merasa bisa menggunakan

sumber daya lawan itu
menguntungkan.

entries.original:
"One last word of advice.

Avoid the shadows and stay in the
light whenever possible.

Do this, and you will avoid falling
into ruin.

This I promise you\."
entries.translation_source: One last word of advice. Avoid the shadows and stay in the light whenever possible. Do this, and you will avoid falling into ruin. This I promise you\.
entries.translated:
Satu nasihat terakhir. Hindari
bayang-bayang dan tetaplah dalam\lcahaya kapan pun memungkinkan.

Lakukan ini, dan kamu akan
terhindar dari kehancuran. Ini saya\ljanjikan padamu\.

entries.original:
"[black]NOTE!

Due to time constraints, the
following items are received here.

Normally, Véga would not appear
here and you would receive the\litems elsewhere."
entries.translation_source: [black]NOTE! Due to time constraints, the following items are received here. Normally, Véga would not appear here and you would receive the items elsewhere.
entries.translated:
[black]CATATAN! Karena keterbatasan waktu,
item-item berikut diterima di sini.\lBiasanya, Véga tidak akan muncul di

sini dan kamu akan menerima
item-item tersebut di tempat lain.

entries.original:
"You may have this - I no longer
have use for it."
entries.translation_source: You may have this - I no longer have use for it.
entries.translated:
Kamu boleh memiliki ini - saya
tidak lagi membutuhkannya.

entries.original: "And this as well."
entries.translation_source: And this as well.
entries.translated: Dan ini juga.

entries.original:
"Those items can be used to control
the Legendary Pokémon Groudon and\lKyogre.

Aklove was interested in testing
Hoopa’s power against the two, but\lhe only ever trained against\lKyogre in Vivill Town.

As those two are likely running
wild, it is your responsibility to\lcontrol them.

Good luck, Guardian of Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Those items can be used to control the Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre. Aklove was interested in testing Hoopa’s power against the two, but he only ever trained against Kyogre in Vivill Town. As those two are likely running wild, it is your responsibility to control them. Good luck, Guardian of Borrius.
entries.translated:
Item-item itu dapat digunakan untuk
mengendalikan Pokémon Legendaris\lGroudon dan Kyogre. Aklove tertarik

menguji kekuatan Hoopa melawan
keduanya, tapi dia hanya pernah\lberlatih melawan Kyogre di Vivill

Town. Karena keduanya kemungkinan
berkeliaran liar, adalah tanggung\ljawabmu untuk mengendalikan mereka.

Semoga berhasil, Penjaga Borrius.

entries.original:
"I understand you’ve managed to
capture both Groudon and Kyogre.

Well done, [player].

Your heroics remind me of your
father’s when he saved Borrius\lduring the meteorite strike."
entries.translation_source: I understand you’ve managed to capture both Groudon and Kyogre. Well done, [player]. Your heroics remind me of your father’s when he saved Borrius during the meteorite strike.
entries.translated:
Saya mengerti kamu berhasil
menangkap Groudon dan Kyogre. Kerja\lbagus, [player]. Keberanianmu

mengingatkan saya pada ayahmu saat
dia menyelamatkan Borrius saat\lserangan meteorit.

entries.original: "Alice"
entries.translation_source: Alice
entries.translated: Alice

entries.original:
"Hey there, [buffer1].

The name’s Alice.

I found myself the Gym Leader of
Blizzard City, riding the winds\lof fortune.

Do you believe in luck?

I don’t.
But I do believe in opportunity.

Seizing and riding the winds is
how I got this far off the ground.

And I’m telling you, at this
height, the battles you get to\lsee are something else!

Okay, enough chit-chat. 
Time to take off!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, [buffer1]. The name’s Alice. I found myself the Gym Leader of Blizzard City, riding the winds of fortune. Do you believe in luck? I don’t. But I do believe in opportunity. Seizing and riding the winds is how I got this far off the ground. And I’m telling you, at this height, the battles you get to see are something else! Okay, enough chit-chat. Time to take off!
entries.translated:
Hai, [buffer1]. Namaku Alice. Aku
menjadi Pemimpin Gym Kota Badai\lSalju, mengendarai angin

keberuntungan. Apakah kamu percaya
pada keberuntungan? Aku tidak. Tapi\laku percaya pada kesempatan.

Merebut dan mengendarai angin
adalah bagaimana aku bisa setinggi\lini. Dan aku beri tahu, di

ketinggian ini, pertarungan yang
bisa kamu lihat luar biasa! Oke,\lcukup obrolan. Saatnya lepas

landas!

entries.original:
"Hey there, [buffer1].

The name’s Alice.

I found myself the Gym Leader of
Blizzard City, riding the winds\lof fortune.

Do you believe in luck?

I don’t.
But I do believe in opportunity.

Seizing and riding the winds is
how I got this far off the ground.

And I’m telling you, at this
height, the battles you get to\lsee are something else!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, [buffer1]. The name’s Alice. I found myself the Gym Leader of Blizzard City, riding the winds of fortune. Do you believe in luck? I don’t. But I do believe in opportunity. Seizing and riding the winds is how I got this far off the ground. And I’m telling you, at this height, the battles you get to see are something else!
entries.translated:
Hai, [buffer1]. Namaku Alice. Aku
menjadi Pemimpin Gym Kota Badai\lSalju, mengendarai angin

keberuntungan. Apakah kamu percaya
pada keberuntungan? Aku tidak. Tapi\laku percaya pada kesempatan.

Merebut dan mengendarai angin
adalah bagaimana aku bisa setinggi\lini. Dan aku beri tahu, di

ketinggian ini, pertarungan yang
bisa kamu lihat luar biasa!

entries.original:
"Well, wouldn’t you know it?

I do believe the wind’s blowing
my way.

What about you?

Will you let the storm blow you
away as you try to resist\.

\.or can you ride that out and
make it yours?

Okay, enough chit-chat.
Time to take off!"
entries.translation_source: Well, wouldn’t you know it? I do believe the wind’s blowing my way. What about you? Will you let the storm blow you away as you try to resist\. \.or can you ride that out and make it yours? Okay, enough chit-chat. Time to take off!
entries.translated:
Nah, siapa sangka? Aku percaya
angin bertiup ke arahku. Bagaimana\ldenganmu? Apakah kamu akan

membiarkan badai menerbangkanmu
saat kamu mencoba melawan\. \.atau\lbisakah kamu mengarungi dan

menjadikannya milikmu? Oke, cukup
obrolan. Saatnya lepas landas!

entries.original:
"Ah\. I suppose that is just how
it is. Never mind.

Congratulations on your victory,
truly.

Here.
The [green]Wings Badge[red] is yours."
entries.translation_source: Ah\. I suppose that is just how it is. Never mind. Congratulations on your victory, truly. Here. The [green]Wings Badge[red] is yours.
entries.translated:
Ah\. Saya kira begitulah adanya.
Sudahlah. Selamat atas\lkemenanganmu, sungguh. Ini dia.

[green]Lencana Sayap[red] milikmu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Wings Badge
from Alice!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Wings Badge from Alice!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Wings Badge dari
Alice!

entries.original:
"With that Badge, you can break
rocks apart with [green]Rock Smash[red]\loutside of battle.

Not only that, all Pokémon up to
\Lv 36 will obey your commands.

Oh, and perhaps this TM will be
of some use."
entries.translation_source: With that Badge, you can break rocks apart with [green]Rock Smash[red] outside of battle. Not only that, all Pokémon up to \Lv 36 will obey your commands. Oh, and perhaps this TM will be of some use.
entries.translated:
Dengan Lencana itu, kamu bisa
menghancurkan batu dengan [green]Rock\lSmash[red] di luar pertarungan. Tidak

hanya itu, semua Pokémon hingga \Lv
36 akan menuruti perintahmu. Oh,\ldan mungkin TM ini akan berguna.

entries.original:
"[green]Aerial Ace[red] is an attack that’s
sure to hit.

It’s useful when you’re finding
your attacks missing one too many\ltimes!

Use it if you don’t feel like
trying to walk into the winds\lin a battle.

Now then, that look tells me you
have places to be and things to do.

Don’t let me hold you up, then.
Up and at ’em!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Aerial Ace[red] is an attack that’s sure to hit. It’s useful when you’re finding your attacks missing one too many times! Use it if you don’t feel like trying to walk into the winds in a battle. Now then, that look tells me you have places to be and things to do. Don’t let me hold you up, then. Up and at ’em!
entries.translated:
[green]Aerial Ace[red] adalah serangan yang
pasti mengenai. Berguna saat kamu\lmerasa seranganmu sering meleset!

Gunakan jika kamu tidak ingin repot
melawan angin dalam pertarungan.\lNah, dari raut wajahmu, sepertinya

kamu punya urusan lain. Aku tidak
akan menahanmu. Ayo, semangat!

entries.original:
"By the way, have you met my
daughter yet?

She doesn’t really leave Blizzard
City unless I take her, since the\lweather outside’s so harsh.

That’s why she bugs everyone who
visits our house into showing her\ltheir Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: By the way, have you met my daughter yet? She doesn’t really leave Blizzard City unless I take her, since the weather outside’s so harsh. That’s why she bugs everyone who visits our house into showing her their Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ngomong-ngomong, apakah kamu sudah
bertemu putriku? Dia jarang\lmeninggalkan Blizzard City kecuali

aku yang mengajaknya, karena cuaca
di luar sangat keras. Itulah\lmengapa dia selalu meminta setiap

tamu yang datang ke rumah untuk
menunjukkan Pokémon mereka.

entries.original: "Mel"
entries.translation_source: Mel
entries.translated: Mel

entries.original:
"Howdy there, partner.
Good to see ya again so soon.

I hope my humble abode is to yer
likin’ and all.

If not, I’m sure there’s somethin’
else around ya can keep yer\leyes on\.

I mean, it’s clear ya went all
over this here town and the next,\llookin’ for li’l old me.

\.I kid, I kid.

That look there tells me yer not
battlin’ me fer fun.

Look, I ain’t one to pry.
That’s none o’ my beeswax.

But as Gym Leader, I can’t just up
and fork over a Badge to any ol’\lcowpoke.

So, let’s just get this on.

Let this handsome fella test
yer mettle!"
entries.translation_source: Howdy there, partner. Good to see ya again so soon. I hope my humble abode is to yer likin’ and all. If not, I’m sure there’s somethin’ else around ya can keep yer eyes on\. I mean, it’s clear ya went all over this here town and the next, lookin’ for li’l old me. \.I kid, I kid. That look there tells me yer not battlin’ me fer fun. Look, I ain’t one to pry. That’s none o’ my beeswax. But as Gym Leader, I can’t just up and fork over a Badge to any ol’ cowpoke. So, let’s just get this on. Let this handsome fella test yer mettle!
entries.translated:
Halo, kawan. Senang bertemu lagi
secepat ini. Semoga tempat\ltinggalku yang sederhana ini sesuai

dengan seleramu. Kalau tidak, aku
yakin ada hal lain di sekitar sini\lyang bisa kamu perhatikan\. Maksudku,

jelas kamu sudah pergi ke seluruh
kota ini dan kota berikutnya,\lmencari diriku yang kecil ini. \.Aku

bercanda, aku bercanda. Dari raut
wajahmu, sepertinya kamu tidak\lbertarung denganku untuk

bersenang-senang. Dengar, aku bukan
orang yang suka ikut campur. Itu\lurusanmu. Tapi sebagai Pemimpin

Gym, aku tidak bisa begitu saja
memberikan Lencana kepada sembarang\lkoboi. Jadi, ayo kita mulai.

Biarkan pria tampan ini menguji
ketangguhanmu!

entries.original:
"Holy moly\. thought the format
would trip ya up some, but ya\lsure showed me.

Guess the Badge is yers after all.

Here.
One [green]Fall Badge[blue], compliments of Mel."
entries.translation_source: Holy moly\. thought the format would trip ya up some, but ya sure showed me. Guess the Badge is yers after all. Here. One [green]Fall Badge[blue], compliments of Mel.
entries.translated:
Astaga\. kupikir formatnya akan
membuatmu sedikit kesulitan, tapi\lternyata kamu berhasil. Sepertinya

Lencana ini memang untukmu. Ini.
Satu [green]Fall Badge[blue], hadiah dari Mel.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Fall Badge
from Mel!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Fall Badge from Mel!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Fall Badge dari
Mel!

entries.original:
"With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon
up to \Lv 45 will obey ya.

It also allows ya to move heavy
boulders usin’ [green]Strength[blue].

Honestly, I don’t rightly know why
any strong Pokémon can’t already\ldo this\.

But that’s just one of the weird
ways the world works.

Anyway, take this TM to go along
with that Badge."
entries.translation_source: With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon up to \Lv 45 will obey ya. It also allows ya to move heavy boulders usin’ [green]Strength[blue]. Honestly, I don’t rightly know why any strong Pokémon can’t already do this\. But that’s just one of the weird ways the world works. Anyway, take this TM to go along with that Badge.
entries.translated:
Dengan Fall Badge, semua Pokémon
hingga \Lv 45 akan menuruti\lperintahmu. Juga memungkinkanmu

memindahkan batu besar menggunakan
[green]Strength[blue]. Sejujurnya, aku tidak\ltahu kenapa Pokémon kuat tidak bisa

melakukannya sejak awal\. Tapi
begitulah dunia bekerja.\lBagaimanapun, ambillah TM ini

sebagai pelengkap Lencana itu.

entries.original:
"When ya use [green]Facade[blue], if yer Pokémon
has a status condition, it’ll get\ltwice as powerful!

Use it to make yer enemies regret
inflictin’ ya with status!

Alright, ye’d best skedaddle.

Hope ya get whatever it is yer
lookin’ for."
entries.translation_source: When ya use [green]Facade[blue], if yer Pokémon has a status condition, it’ll get twice as powerful! Use it to make yer enemies regret inflictin’ ya with status! Alright, ye’d best skedaddle. Hope ya get whatever it is yer lookin’ for.
entries.translated:
Saat kamu menggunakan [green]Facade[blue], jika
Pokémon-mu memiliki kondisi status,\lkekuatannya menjadi dua kali lipat!

Gunakan untuk membuat musuh
menyesal memberimu status! Baiklah,\lsebaiknya kamu pergi sekarang.

Semoga kamu mendapatkan apa yang
kamu cari.

entries.original:
"Good luck out there, and remember,
I’m always here if ya need\lsomethin’ good to look at!"
entries.translation_source: Good luck out there, and remember, I’m always here if ya need somethin’ good to look at!
entries.translated:
Semoga berhasil di luar sana, dan
ingat, aku selalu di sini jika kamu\lbutuh pemandangan yang indah!

entries.original: "Galavan"
entries.translation_source: Galavan
entries.translated: Galavan

entries.original:
"Yo, wazzap, fella?
Howzit goin’?

The name’s Galavan.

I’m the Gym Leader, in case ya
couldn’t tell.

How’d ya find navigatin’ my Gym?

The magnetism and electricity by
your feet givin’ ya a rough time?

Ha ha ha! That’s the point!
Invention is born out of necessity!

Machines and technology grow only
because what came before wasn’t\lquite good enough!

That’s what me and my Gym want
to test!

So how are ya gonna advance when
the most obvious weakness isn’t\luseable anymore?

I want you to show me how
ya adapt!

And I want you to show me with two
of your Pokémon at a time!

If ya don’t, I, Galavan, will zap ya
until ya can’t even twitch!"
entries.translation_source: Yo, wazzap, fella? Howzit goin’? The name’s Galavan. I’m the Gym Leader, in case ya couldn’t tell. How’d ya find navigatin’ my Gym? The magnetism and electricity by your feet givin’ ya a rough time? Ha ha ha! That’s the point! Invention is born out of necessity! Machines and technology grow only because what came before wasn’t quite good enough! That’s what me and my Gym want to test! So how are ya gonna advance when the most obvious weakness isn’t useable anymore? I want you to show me how ya adapt! And I want you to show me with two of your Pokémon at a time! If ya don’t, I, Galavan, will zap ya until ya can’t even twitch!
entries.translated:
Yo, apa kabar? Namaku Galavan. Aku
Pemimpin Gym, kalau kamu belum\ltahu. Bagaimana menurutmu

menjelajahi Gym-ku? Magnetisme dan
listrik di bawah kakimu membuatmu\lkesulitan? Ha ha ha! Itulah

tujuannya! Penemuan lahir dari
kebutuhan! Mesin dan teknologi\lberkembang hanya karena yang

sebelumnya tidak cukup baik! Itulah
yang ingin aku dan Gym-ku uji! Jadi\lbagaimana kamu akan maju ketika

kelemahan yang paling jelas tidak
bisa digunakan lagi? Aku ingin kamu\ltunjukkan bagaimana kamu

beradaptasi! Dan aku ingin kamu
tunjukkan dengan dua Pokémon\lsekaligus! Jika tidak, aku,

Galavan, akan menyetrummu sampai
kamu tidak bisa bergerak!

entries.original:
"\.

Did you hear me?

I said I want you to show me with
two of your Pokémon at a time!

One just ain’t gonna cut it!"
entries.translation_source: \. Did you hear me? I said I want you to show me with two of your Pokémon at a time! One just ain’t gonna cut it!
entries.translated:
\. Apakah kamu dengar? Aku bilang aku
ingin kamu tunjukkan dengan dua\lPokémon sekaligus! Satu saja tidak

cukup!

entries.original:
"Man\. ya sure zapped me silly!

Guess your machines of war turned
out better than mine.

Nothin’ else to it!
I gotta hand you this [green]Battery Badge[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Man\. ya sure zapped me silly! Guess your machines of war turned out better than mine. Nothin’ else to it! I gotta hand you this [green]Battery Badge[blue]!
entries.translated:
Astaga\. kamu benar-benar menyetrumku
habis-habisan! Sepertinya mesin\lperangmu lebih baik dari punyaku.

Tidak ada lagi yang bisa dikatakan!
Aku harus memberikan ini [green]Battery\lBadge[blue]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Battery Badge
from Galavan!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Battery Badge from Galavan!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Battery Badge
dari Galavan!

entries.original:
"The Battery Badge lets ya [green]Surf[blue]
over water and lava!

But not only that, any Pokémon
will obey you as long as it’s not\lover \Lv 52!

How electrifyin’ is that?

But yo, I ain’t done yet!
Take this TM, too!"
entries.translation_source: The Battery Badge lets ya [green]Surf[blue] over water and lava! But not only that, any Pokémon will obey you as long as it’s not over \Lv 52! How electrifyin’ is that? But yo, I ain’t done yet! Take this TM, too!
entries.translated:
Battery Badge memungkinkanmu [green]Surf[blue]
di atas air dan lava! Tapi tidak\lhanya itu, semua Pokémon akan

menuruti perintahmu asalkan
levelnya tidak melebihi \Lv 52!\lBetapa menggetarkan, bukan? Tapi

yo, aku belum selesai! Ambil TM ini
juga!

entries.original:
"If you’re at a disadvantage, use
[green]Volt Switch[blue] to get outta there!

And ya know what?
We gotta do this again sometime!

Ya ever feel like chattin’ with
ol’ Galavan, just hang around the\lPokémon Centers.

I’ll rebuild my ’mon of metal
again for that rematch!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re at a disadvantage, use [green]Volt Switch[blue] to get outta there! And ya know what? We gotta do this again sometime! Ya ever feel like chattin’ with ol’ Galavan, just hang around the Pokémon Centers. I’ll rebuild my ’mon of metal again for that rematch!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu dalam posisi tidak
menguntungkan, gunakan [green]Volt Switch[blue]\luntuk kabur! Dan tahu tidak? Kita

harus bertarung lagi lain kali!
Jika kamu ingin ngobrol dengan\lGalavan tua, tunggu saja di Pokémon

Centers. Aku akan membangun kembali
Pokémon logamku untuk pertandingan\lulang itu!

entries.original:
"Don’t let anythin’ stand in your
way, [player]!

And never let any disadvantage hold
you back from realizin’ your goals!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let anythin’ stand in your way, [player]! And never let any disadvantage hold you back from realizin’ your goals!
entries.translated:
Jangan biarkan apapun menghalangi
jalannya, [player]! Dan jangan\lpernah biarkan kekurangan

menghalangimu untuk mencapai
tujuanmu!

entries.original: "Antisis City Gym"
entries.translation_source: Antisis City Gym
entries.translated: Antisis City Gym

entries.original: "Big Mo"
entries.translation_source: Big Mo
entries.translated: Big Mo

entries.original:
"Well, look who decided to ease
my boredom!

You’re that kid I bumped into on
Route 16, ain’tcha?

\.

So, your name’s [player]!

Hah! Then I guess I better
introduce myself properly too!

Everyone around here calls me
Big Mo!

And I’m the only thing here in
Antisis keepin’ the underworld\lunder control!

Every gang’s beneath my heel,
got that?

\\0C

Because you don’t get to where I
am by bein’ a wimp!

So come on! Let’s see what you can
do to the kingpin of Antisis City!"
entries.translation_source: Well, look who decided to ease my boredom! You’re that kid I bumped into on Route 16, ain’tcha? \. So, your name’s [player]! Hah! Then I guess I better introduce myself properly too! Everyone around here calls me Big Mo! And I’m the only thing here in Antisis keepin’ the underworld under control! Every gang’s beneath my heel, got that? \\0C Because you don’t get to where I am by bein’ a wimp! So come on! Let’s see what you can do to the kingpin of Antisis City!
entries.translated:
Wah, lihat siapa yang memutuskan
untuk menghilangkan kebosananku! Lo\litu anak yang gue tabrak di Rute

16, kan? \. Jadi, nama lo [player]!
Hah! Kalau begitu, gue lebih baik\lmemperkenalkan diri dengan benar!

Semua orang di sini manggil gue Big
Mo! Dan gue satu-satunya di Antisis\lyang menjaga dunia bawah tetap

terkendali! Setiap geng ada di
bawah tumit gue, ngerti? \\0C Karena\llo nggak bisa sampai di posisi gue

dengan jadi pengecut! Jadi ayo!
Mari lihat apa yang bisa lo lakukan\lterhadap raja bawah tanah Kota

Antisis!

entries.original:
"Gah! All that time beatin’ on the
little fish made me sloppy!

Even after I had every rule set up
to leave me holdin’ all the cards\.

Ha ha ha ha! Fine, you got me!

Even if Antisis is the pits, I
still have official standings as\lGym Leader!

And a Gym Leader gives this out to
anyone who beats ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! All that time beatin’ on the little fish made me sloppy! Even after I had every rule set up to leave me holdin’ all the cards\. Ha ha ha ha! Fine, you got me! Even if Antisis is the pits, I still have official standings as Gym Leader! And a Gym Leader gives this out to anyone who beats ’em!
entries.translated:
Gah! Selama ini memukuli ikan-ikan
kecil membuat gue ceroboh! Bahkan\lsetelah gue menyusun semua aturan

agar gue memegang semua kartu\. Ha ha
ha ha! Baik, lo berhasil! Meskipun\lAntisis itu tempat sampah, gue

tetap punya status resmi sebagai
Pemimpin Gym! Dan seorang Pemimpin\lGym memberikan ini kepada siapa pun

yang mengalahkannya!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Ring Badge
from Big Mo!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Ring Badge from Big Mo!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Lencana Cincin
dari Big Mo!

entries.original:
"That’s the Ring Badge!

Now all traded Pokémon up to \Lv 57
will know who the real boss is!

And you also get to climb up those
rocky cliff things with the move\l[green]Rock Climb[blue]!

Tell me that ain’t useful!

Oh yeah\. I guess you can have
this.

Call it a goodwill gift from
Big Mo."
entries.translation_source: That’s the Ring Badge! Now all traded Pokémon up to \Lv 57 will know who the real boss is! And you also get to climb up those rocky cliff things with the move [green]Rock Climb[blue]! Tell me that ain’t useful! Oh yeah\. I guess you can have this. Call it a goodwill gift from Big Mo.
entries.translated:
Itu Lencana Cincin! Sekarang semua
Pokémon yang diperdagangkan hingga\l\Lv 57 akan tahu siapa bos

sebenarnya! Dan lo juga bisa
memanjat tebing berbatu itu dengan\ljurus [green]Panjat Tebing[blue]! Bilang itu

nggak berguna! Oh ya\. Gue kira lo
boleh punya ini. Sebut saja hadiah\litikad baik dari Big Mo.

entries.original:
"[green]Drain Punch[blue] hits hard AND saps the
health of your opponent!

Well, what are ya waitin’ for?

Get out. You’re too good to be
wastin’ yourself here.

There’re way bigger fish outside
these walls.

Get out there and be the king of
the pond already!

Ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Drain Punch[blue] hits hard AND saps the health of your opponent! Well, what are ya waitin’ for? Get out. You’re too good to be wastin’ yourself here. There’re way bigger fish outside these walls. Get out there and be the king of the pond already! Ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
[green]Pukulan Penguras[blue] memukul keras DAN
menyedot kesehatan lawan! Nah, lo\ltunggu apa lagi? Keluar. Lo terlalu

baik untuk membuang-buang waktu di
sini. Ada ikan jauh lebih besar di\lluar tembok ini. Keluar sana dan

jadilah raja kolam! Ha ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"If you ever come back to Antisis
City, [player], just know I’ve got my\leye on you!

Ha ha ha ha!

I’ve got my eye on everyone here!
It’s my job!"
entries.translation_source: If you ever come back to Antisis City, [player], just know I’ve got my eye on you! Ha ha ha ha! I’ve got my eye on everyone here! It’s my job!
entries.translated:
Kalo lo suatu saat kembali ke Kota
Antisis, [player], ketahuilah gue\lmengawasi lo! Ha ha ha ha! Gue

mengawasi semua orang di sini! Itu
pekerjaan gue!

entries.original: "Tessy"
entries.translation_source: Tessy
entries.translated: Tessy

entries.original:
"Howdy! So ya got past my little
wave challenge, didja?

Name’s Tessy.

Livin’ in this here swamp taught
my Pokémon and I a whole lot\.

\.Growing and adaptin’ bein’ chiefly
two of ’em.

All my Pokémon have the power to
change their type based on the\lfirst two attacks they know!

And while you’re battlin’ me, yer
own Pokémon will do the same!

But ya already knew that, I’m sure."
entries.translation_source: Howdy! So ya got past my little wave challenge, didja? Name’s Tessy. Livin’ in this here swamp taught my Pokémon and I a whole lot\. \.Growing and adaptin’ bein’ chiefly two of ’em. All my Pokémon have the power to change their type based on the first two attacks they know! And while you’re battlin’ me, yer own Pokémon will do the same! But ya already knew that, I’m sure.
entries.translated:
Halo! Jadi lo berhasil melewati
tantangan gelombang kecil saya, ya?\lNama saya Tessy. Tinggal di rawa

ini mengajari saya dan Pokémon saya
banyak hal\. \.Tumbuh dan beradaptasi\lmenjadi dua hal utama. Semua

Pokémon saya memiliki kekuatan
untuk mengubah tipe mereka\lberdasarkan dua serangan pertama

yang mereka ketahui! Dan saat lo
bertarung dengan saya, Pokémon lo\lsendiri akan melakukan hal yang

sama! Tapi lo pasti sudah tahu itu.

entries.original:
"Huh\. look at that.

Picked a mighty fine time for
a shower.

But hey, ain’t nothin’ gonna
dampen the mood on this battle,\lright?

Alright!
Don’t sink too fast now, ya hear?"
entries.translation_source: Huh\. look at that. Picked a mighty fine time for a shower. But hey, ain’t nothin’ gonna dampen the mood on this battle, right? Alright! Don’t sink too fast now, ya hear?
entries.translated:
Huh\. lihat itu. Memilih waktu yang
tepat untuk mandi. Tapi hei, nggak\lada yang akan merusak suasana

pertempuran ini, kan? Baiklah!
Jangan tenggelam terlalu cepat,\ldengar?

entries.original:
"Ya sure as heck washed me away!

I guess I gotta give ya the
[green]Swamp Badge[red] now!"
entries.translation_source: Ya sure as heck washed me away! I guess I gotta give ya the [green]Swamp Badge[red] now!
entries.translated:
Lo benar-benar menghanyutkan saya!
Saya kira saya harus memberikan lo\l[green]Lencana Rawa[red] sekarang!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Swamp Badge
from Tessy!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Swamp Badge from Tessy!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Lencana Rawa dari
Tessy!

entries.original:
"The Swamp Badge gives you the
ability to handle traded Pokémon\lup to \Lv 61!

And it even grants yer Pokémon
the power to climb up [green]waterfalls[red]!

\.wait, ya don’t have anything
like that?

Well, ain’t that a problem.

Here, I got spares, so just take
this one."
entries.translation_source: The Swamp Badge gives you the ability to handle traded Pokémon up to \Lv 61! And it even grants yer Pokémon the power to climb up [green]waterfalls[red]! \.wait, ya don’t have anything like that? Well, ain’t that a problem. Here, I got spares, so just take this one.
entries.translated:
Lencana Rawa memberi lo kemampuan
untuk menangani Pokémon yang\ldiperdagangkan hingga \Lv 61! Dan

bahkan memberikan Pokémon lo
kekuatan untuk memanjat [green]air terjun[red]!\l\.tunggu, lo nggak punya sesuatu

seperti itu? Yah, bukankah itu
masalah. Ini, saya punya cadangan,\ljadi ambil saja yang ini.

entries.original:
"[green]Waterfall[red] ain’t just for climbin’
up waterfalls, ya know?

In a battle, it might cause your
opponent to freeze up and forget\lto attack!

By the way\.

Couldn’t help but notice how
impatient y’all looked while we\lwere battlin’.

Guess ya really needed that HM for
something, huh?

I don’t rightly know what it’s
for, but I hope ya get it.

Just\. don’t get too reckless now,
okay?

Promise me yer gonna be fine."
entries.translation_source: [green]Waterfall[red] ain’t just for climbin’ up waterfalls, ya know? In a battle, it might cause your opponent to freeze up and forget to attack! By the way\. Couldn’t help but notice how impatient y’all looked while we were battlin’. Guess ya really needed that HM for something, huh? I don’t rightly know what it’s for, but I hope ya get it. Just\. don’t get too reckless now, okay? Promise me yer gonna be fine.
entries.translated:
[green]Air Terjun[red] nggak cuma untuk
memanjat air terjun, lo tahu? Dalam\lpertempuran, itu bisa menyebabkan

lawan lo membeku dan lupa
menyerang! Ngomong-ngomong\. Saya\lnggak bisa tidak memperhatikan

betapa tidak sabarnya lo semua saat
bertarung. Sepertinya lo\lbenar-benar membutuhkan HM itu

untuk sesuatu, ya? Saya tidak tahu
persis untuk apa, tapi saya harap\llo mendapatkannya. Hanya\. jangan

terlalu ceroboh, oke? Janji lo akan
baik-baik saja.

entries.original:
"There ain’t nothin’ to worry about,
now!

The waves ain’t gonna wash ya
nomor’!"
entries.translation_source: There ain’t nothin’ to worry about, now! The waves ain’t gonna wash ya nomor’!
entries.translated:
Nggak ada yang perlu dikhawatirkan
sekarang! Ombak nggak akan\lmenghanyutkan lo lagi!

entries.original: "Benjamin"
entries.translation_source: Benjamin
entries.translated: Benjamin

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\.

It’s been ages\. ages, I say, since
this many Trainers have come to\lchallenge me in a row.

My name is Benjamin, and it is a
pleasure to meet you.

My Pokémon and I, we share a
curious condition.

As you may have seen, Pokémon in
this Gym fight until the very end.

That represents how we live.

As long as we have even a little
strength, we can still resist\lwhatever threatens us.

That is the resilience of Bug-type
Pokémon, plain as day.

Many think Bug-types are weak,
unworthy of being the final test\lfor Trainers in the Borrian League\.

And it’s been my life’s goal to
prove them wrong!

I shall show you our resilience!

And by doing so, I swear to be a
worthy final obstacle before the\lPokémon League!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. It’s been ages\. ages, I say, since this many Trainers have come to challenge me in a row. My name is Benjamin, and it is a pleasure to meet you. My Pokémon and I, we share a curious condition. As you may have seen, Pokémon in this Gym fight until the very end. That represents how we live. As long as we have even a little strength, we can still resist whatever threatens us. That is the resilience of Bug-type Pokémon, plain as day. Many think Bug-types are weak, unworthy of being the final test for Trainers in the Borrian League\. And it’s been my life’s goal to prove them wrong! I shall show you our resilience! And by doing so, I swear to be a worthy final obstacle before the Pokémon League!
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. Sudah berabad-abad\.
berabad-abad, saya katakan, sejak\lbanyak Pelatih datang menantang

saya berturut-turut. Nama saya
Benjamin, dan senang bertemu dengan\lAnda. Pokémon saya dan saya, kami

memiliki kondisi yang aneh. Seperti
yang mungkin Anda lihat, Pokémon di\lGym ini bertarung sampai akhir. Itu

mewakili bagaimana kami hidup.
Selama kami memiliki sedikit\lkekuatan pun, kami masih bisa

melawan apa pun yang mengancam
kami. Itulah ketahanan Pokémon tipe\lSerangga, jelas terlihat. Banyak

yang menganggap tipe Serangga
lemah, tidak layak menjadi ujian\lterakhir bagi Pelatih di Liga

Borrius\. Dan itu sudah menjadi
tujuan hidup saya untuk membuktikan\lmereka salah! Saya akan menunjukkan

ketahanan kami! Dan dengan
melakukannya, saya bersumpah untuk\lmenjadi rintangan terakhir yang

layak sebelum Liga Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Congratulations, Trainer!

You have managed to conquer all
eight Gyms in Borrius!

So please, take the [green]Time Badge[blue]!

That is proof of not only my
