defeat, but also the defeat of\lall the other Gym Leaders, just\lto reach me!"
entries.translation_source: Congratulations, Trainer! You have managed to conquer all eight Gyms in Borrius! So please, take the [green]Time Badge[blue]! That is proof of not only my defeat, but also the defeat of all the other Gym Leaders, just to reach me!
entries.translated:
Selamat, Pelatih! Anda berhasil
menaklukkan semua delapan Gym di\lBorrius! Jadi silakan, ambil

[green]Lencana Waktu[blue]! Itu adalah bukti
tidak hanya kekalahan saya, tetapi\ljuga kekalahan semua Pemimpin Gym

lainnya, hanya untuk mencapai saya!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Time Badge
from Benjamin!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Time Badge from Benjamin!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Lencana Waktu
dari Benjamin!

entries.original:
"With the Time Badge, all Pokémon
will obey you without fail.

And should you have a suitable
vessel to provide oxygen for a\llong period of time, you may use a\lPokémon to take you underwater\lwith [green]Dive[blue].

Additionally, take this TM as a gift
for your outstanding achievement."
entries.translation_source: With the Time Badge, all Pokémon will obey you without fail. And should you have a suitable vessel to provide oxygen for a long period of time, you may use a Pokémon to take you underwater with [green]Dive[blue]. Additionally, take this TM as a gift for your outstanding achievement.
entries.translated:
Dengan Lencana Waktu, semua Pokémon
akan mematuhi Anda tanpa gagal. Dan\ljika Anda memiliki wadah yang

sesuai untuk menyediakan oksigen
dalam waktu lama, Anda dapat\lmenggunakan Pokémon untuk membawa

Anda ke bawah air dengan [green]Menyelam[blue].
Selain itu, ambil TM ini sebagai\lhadiah untuk pencapaian luar biasa

Anda.

entries.original:
"[green]Leech Fang[blue] saps the opponent of
vitality while restoring your own.

Your Pokémon won’t ever worry
about devolving if they can\lmaintain their strength!

Now if you’ll excuse me\. I should
rest.

Don’t fret over me, I’ll age back
to myself in time.

You should be going.
I wish all the best of luck to you!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Leech Fang[blue] saps the opponent of vitality while restoring your own. Your Pokémon won’t ever worry about devolving if they can maintain their strength! Now if you’ll excuse me\. I should rest. Don’t fret over me, I’ll age back to myself in time. You should be going. I wish all the best of luck to you!
entries.translated:
[green]Leech Fang[blue] menguras vitalitas lawan
sambil memulihkan milikmu.\lPokémon-mu tidak perlu khawatir

tentang devolusi jika mereka bisa
mempertahankan kekuatan mereka!\lSekarang, permisi\. Aku harus

istirahat. Jangan khawatir
tentangku, aku akan kembali ke\lusiaku pada waktunya. Kamu harus

pergi. Aku doakan semoga beruntung!

entries.original:
"My old Butterfree and I were born
on the same day.

But as time passed, we began to
notice ourselves steadily growing\lyounger.

It didn’t take long for Butterfree
to regress into a Caterpie and\lfinally fade away\.

This Gym is dedicated in memory of
my first Butterfree.

May his soul forever be at peace\."
entries.translation_source: My old Butterfree and I were born on the same day. But as time passed, we began to notice ourselves steadily growing younger. It didn’t take long for Butterfree to regress into a Caterpie and finally fade away\. This Gym is dedicated in memory of my first Butterfree. May his soul forever be at peace\.
entries.translated:
Butterfree lamaku dan aku lahir
pada hari yang sama. Namun seiring\lwaktu, kami mulai menyadari bahwa

kami semakin muda. Tak lama
kemudian Butterfree berubah kembali\lmenjadi Caterpie dan akhirnya

menghilang\. Gym ini didedikasikan
untuk mengenang Butterfree\lpertamaku. Semoga jiwanya

beristirahat dengan tenang\.

entries.original:
"[black]It’s some sort of plant with oddly
shaped leaves."
entries.translation_source: [black]It’s some sort of plant with oddly shaped leaves.
entries.translated:
[black]Ini semacam tanaman dengan daun
berbentuk aneh.

entries.original:
"Where is all this fog coming from?

Uh\.
Beats me!"
entries.translation_source: Where is all this fog coming from? Uh\. Beats me!
entries.translated:
Dari mana datangnya semua kabut
ini? Uh\. Entahlah!

entries.original:
"Where does the fog come from?

Uh\.
Beats me!"
entries.translation_source: Where does the fog come from? Uh\. Beats me!
entries.translated:
Dari mana datangnya kabut? Uh\.
Entahlah!

entries.original:
"I find that pressing \btn02 to view
my Pokémon’s attack details helps\lme know which moves will land in\lthis fog."
entries.translation_source: I find that pressing \btn02 to view my Pokémon’s attack details helps me know which moves will land in this fog.
entries.translated:
Kurasa menekan \btn02 untuk melihat
detail serangan Pokémon-ku\lmembantuku tahu gerakan mana yang

akan mengenai dalam kabut ini.

entries.original:
"I find that pressing \btn02 to view
my Pokémon’s attack details helps\lme know which moves will land when\lit’s foggy in here."
entries.translation_source: I find that pressing \btn02 to view my Pokémon’s attack details helps me know which moves will land when it’s foggy in here.
entries.translated:
Kurasa menekan \btn02 untuk melihat
detail serangan Pokémon-ku\lmembantuku tahu gerakan mana yang

akan mengenai saat di sini
berkabut.

entries.original: "With your skills, you’ll go far!"
entries.translation_source: With your skills, you’ll go far!
entries.translated:
Dengan keahlianmu, kamu akan pergi
jauh!

entries.original:
"I’d better refine my calculations
for the next time we battle."
entries.translation_source: I’d better refine my calculations for the next time we battle.
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya aku menyempurnakan
perhitunganku untuk pertarungan\lkita selanjutnya.

entries.original: "It’s over."
entries.translation_source: It’s over.
entries.translated: Sudah berakhir.

entries.original:
"Times have changed since back in my
day."
entries.translation_source: Times have changed since back in my day.
entries.translated:
Zaman sudah berubah sejak zamanku
dulu.

entries.original: "Gotcha!"
entries.translation_source: Gotcha!
entries.translated: Kena!

entries.original: "Caught you!"
entries.translation_source: Caught you!
entries.translated: Kena kau!

entries.original: "A Trainer was spotted!"
entries.translation_source: A Trainer was spotted!
entries.translated: Seorang Trainer terlihat!

entries.original:
"The fans make the gym really
confusing."
entries.translation_source: The fans make the gym really confusing.
entries.translated:
Kipas angin membuat gym ini sangat
membingungkan.

entries.original:
"Sorry, Trainer, but this isn’t the
right way to go."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, Trainer, but this isn’t the right way to go.
entries.translated:
Maaf, Trainer, tapi ini bukan jalan
yang benar.

entries.original: "Try going the other way."
entries.translation_source: Try going the other way.
entries.translated: Coba pergi ke arah lain.

entries.original:
"Bird Keepers aren’t afraid of
heights like these!"
entries.translation_source: Bird Keepers aren’t afraid of heights like these!
entries.translated:
Bird Keepers tidak takut pada
ketinggian seperti ini!

entries.original:
"My birds will get stronger from
here on out!"
entries.translation_source: My birds will get stronger from here on out!
entries.translated:
Burung-burungku akan semakin kuat
mulai sekarang!

entries.original:
"Wherever you decide to go, never be
afraid to charge full speed ahead!"
entries.translation_source: Wherever you decide to go, never be afraid to charge full speed ahead!
entries.translated:
Ke mana pun kamu memutuskan untuk
pergi, jangan pernah takut untuk\lmelaju dengan kecepatan penuh!

entries.original:
"It has been scientifically proven
that looking at attractive people,\las opposed to normal ones, reduces\lstress.

I think that’s why Mel employs us."
entries.translation_source: It has been scientifically proven that looking at attractive people, as opposed to normal ones, reduces stress. I think that’s why Mel employs us.
entries.translated:
Telah terbukti secara ilmiah bahwa
melihat orang yang menarik,\ldibandingkan dengan yang biasa,

mengurangi stres. Saya pikir itulah
mengapa Mel mempekerjakan kami.

entries.original:
"I like the water aesthetic; it is
much prettier to look at than a\lnormal background.

I’d assume that’d just be a plain
white void for a Normal-type Gym."
entries.translation_source: I like the water aesthetic; it is much prettier to look at than a normal background. I’d assume that’d just be a plain white void for a Normal-type Gym.
entries.translated:
Saya suka estetika air; jauh lebih
indah dilihat daripada latar\lbelakang biasa. Saya kira itu hanya

akan menjadi kekosongan putih polos
untuk Gym tipe Normal.

entries.original:
"Mel is a very busy man.

It takes a lot of time and effort to
stand in front of waterfalls and\lwait for Trainers."
entries.translation_source: Mel is a very busy man. It takes a lot of time and effort to stand in front of waterfalls and wait for Trainers.
entries.translated:
Mel adalah pria yang sangat sibuk.
Butuh banyak waktu dan usaha untuk\lberdiri di depan air terjun dan

menunggu Pelatih.

entries.original:
"Did you notice?

One of the Lapras is in a different
position than the rest."
entries.translation_source: Did you notice? One of the Lapras is in a different position than the rest.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu perhatikan? Salah satu
Lapras berada dalam posisi berbeda\ldari yang lain.

entries.original:
"You can ride the Lapras to make
your way back up to the top."
entries.translation_source: You can ride the Lapras to make your way back up to the top.
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa menaiki Lapras untuk
kembali ke atas.

entries.original:
"Normal-type Pokémon are the safest
of all Pokémon.

Pokémon shooting fire out of their
mouths or lightning out of their\lcheeks can be very dangerous."
entries.translation_source: Normal-type Pokémon are the safest of all Pokémon. Pokémon shooting fire out of their mouths or lightning out of their cheeks can be very dangerous.
entries.translated:
Pokémon tipe Normal adalah yang
paling aman dari semua Pokémon.\lPokémon yang menembakkan api dari

mulut mereka atau kilat dari pipi
mereka bisa sangat berbahaya.

entries.original:
"Mel takes a lot of pride in his
looks.

That’s why he has me, a full-time
makeup artist here."
entries.translation_source: Mel takes a lot of pride in his looks. That’s why he has me, a full-time makeup artist here.
entries.translated:
Mel sangat bangga dengan
penampilannya. Itulah mengapa dia\lmempekerjakanku, seorang penata

rias penuh waktu di sini.

entries.original:
"There was a Pokémon hiding under
the lily pad!

The Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: There was a Pokémon hiding under the lily pad! The Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
Ada seekor Pokémon bersembunyi di
bawah daun teratai! Pokémon itu\lmenyerang!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] dove back into
the pond."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] dove back into the pond.
entries.translated:
[black]Si [buffer1] menyelam kembali ke
kolam.

entries.original:
"Many of the Pokémon in this Gym
benefit from the magnetized floor.

Meaning, you’re at a disadvantage!"
entries.translation_source: Many of the Pokémon in this Gym benefit from the magnetized floor. Meaning, you’re at a disadvantage!
entries.translated:
Banyak Pokémon di Gym ini
diuntungkan oleh lantai\ltermagnetisasi. Artinya, kamu dalam

posisi rugi!

entries.original:
"Galavan loves Electric-types, but
he couldn’t leave Steel-types out."
entries.translation_source: Galavan loves Electric-types, but he couldn’t leave Steel-types out.
entries.translated:
Galavan menyukai tipe Listrik, tapi
dia tidak bisa meninggalkan tipe\lBaja.

entries.original:
"The magnetic floor lifts all
Electric- and Steel-types right\loff the ground!"
entries.translation_source: The magnetic floor lifts all Electric- and Steel-types right off the ground!
entries.translated:
Lantai magnetik mengangkat semua
tipe Listrik dan Baja dari tanah!

entries.original:
"Just because a bulb was turned on,
that doesn’t mean it won’t have to\lbe turned off later."
entries.translation_source: Just because a bulb was turned on, that doesn’t mean it won’t have to be turned off later.
entries.translated:
Hanya karena bola lampu dinyalakan,
bukan berarti nanti tidak harus\ldimatikan.

entries.original:
"Those light bulbs control the flow
of electricity in the Gym.

By turning them on or off, you’re
changing where the electricity in\lthis Gym goes."
entries.translation_source: Those light bulbs control the flow of electricity in the Gym. By turning them on or off, you’re changing where the electricity in this Gym goes.
entries.translated:
Bola lampu itu mengontrol aliran
listrik di Gym. Dengan menyalakan\latau mematikannya, kamu mengubah ke

mana listrik di Gym ini mengalir.

entries.original:
"As long as the floor is magnetized,
no Electric- or Steel-type will\lbe affected by Spikes!"
entries.translation_source: As long as the floor is magnetized, no Electric- or Steel-type will be affected by Spikes!
entries.translated:
Selama lantai termagnetisasi, tidak
ada tipe Listrik atau Baja yang\lakan terpengaruh oleh Lonjakan!

entries.original:
"If you can beat the master worker
of the Dehara Gym, you’re ready to\lface Galavan."
entries.translation_source: If you can beat the master worker of the Dehara Gym, you’re ready to face Galavan.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa mengalahkan pekerja
ulung dari Gym Dehara, kamu siap\lmenghadapi Galavan.

entries.original:
"I’m not paralyzed, but I seem to
be struck by you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not paralyzed, but I seem to be struck by you!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak lumpuh, tapi aku
sepertinya terpana olehmu!

entries.original:
"Not only do I get to collect
Electric-types, but I also get to\lcollect Steel-types!

I love them both equally!"
entries.translation_source: Not only do I get to collect Electric-types, but I also get to collect Steel-types! I love them both equally!
entries.translated:
Tidak hanya aku bisa mengoleksi
tipe Listrik, tapi aku juga bisa\lmengoleksi tipe Baja! Aku mencintai

keduanya sama rata!

entries.original:
"It’s a bulb of some sort.

Turn it [green][buffer1][black]?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a bulb of some sort. Turn it [green][buffer1][black]?
entries.translated:
Ini semacam bola lampu. Nyalakan
[green][buffer1][black]?

entries.original: "[green]Bzz\. Bzz\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Bzz\. Bzz\.
entries.translated: [green]Bzz\. Bzz\.

entries.original: "[black]The [buffer1] rolled off."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] rolled off.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] jatuh.

entries.original:
"This is the Antisis Gym
Ring Challenge."
entries.translation_source: This is the Antisis Gym Ring Challenge.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah Tantangan Ring Gym
Antisis.

entries.original: "Enter"
entries.translation_source: Enter
entries.translated: Masuk

entries.original: "Rules"
entries.translation_source: Rules
entries.translated: Aturan

entries.original: "Leave"
entries.translation_source: Leave
entries.translated: Keluar

entries.original: "Stay here."
entries.translation_source: Stay here.
entries.translated: Tetaplah di sini.

entries.original: "Your Pokémon has been healed."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon has been healed.
entries.translated: Pokémon Anda telah disembuhkan.

entries.original:
"I’m gonna knock ya right outta the
ring before ya can even get going!"
entries.translation_source: I’m gonna knock ya right outta the ring before ya can even get going!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menjatuhkanmu dari ring
sebelum kamu sempat mulai!

entries.original:
"I have come to test your strength
in the ring.

Hiyah!"
entries.translation_source: I have come to test your strength in the ring. Hiyah!
entries.translated:
Aku datang untuk menguji kekuatanmu
di ring. Hiyah!

entries.original:
"Beat me, an’ it’s smooth sailin’ to
Big Mo!

It’s too bad I ain’t gonna let
that happen!"
entries.translation_source: Beat me, an’ it’s smooth sailin’ to Big Mo! It’s too bad I ain’t gonna let that happen!
entries.translated:
Kalahkan aku, dan perjalananmu ke
Big Mo akan mulus! Sayangnya, aku\ltidak akan membiarkan itu terjadi!

entries.original:
"The rules are simple.

Choose one Pokémon to battle three
Trainers in a row.

Each Trainer is also only using
one Pokémon.

You can use whatever Pokémon you
want in the ring, but you can’t use\l[green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type\lmoves in the battles.

For moves that change their types
in battles, we only care about the\ltypes those moves become.

We don’t like those types here in
the ring, and Big Mo won’t let you\luse the [green]most common of those move\lon your team[blue] if you get to him.

If some types appear equally on
your team, we’ll ban the types in\lthe order of Flying, Psychic, and\lthen Fairy.

So, say you have a Toucannon and an
Alakazam on your team, you won’t\lbe able to use Flying-type moves\lagainst Big Mo, since Flying comes\lbefore Psychic.

Got it?

Don’t get confused!"
entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. Choose one Pokémon to battle three Trainers in a row. Each Trainer is also only using one Pokémon. You can use whatever Pokémon you want in the ring, but you can’t use [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type moves in the battles. For moves that change their types in battles, we only care about the types those moves become. We don’t like those types here in the ring, and Big Mo won’t let you use the [green]most common of those move on your team[blue] if you get to him. If some types appear equally on your team, we’ll ban the types in the order of Flying, Psychic, and then Fairy. So, say you have a Toucannon and an Alakazam on your team, you won’t be able to use Flying-type moves against Big Mo, since Flying comes before Psychic. Got it? Don’t get confused!
entries.translated:
Aturannya sederhana. Pilih satu
Pokémon untuk bertarung melawan\ltiga Pelatih berturut-turut. Setiap

Pelatih juga hanya menggunakan satu
Pokémon. Kamu bisa menggunakan\lPokémon apa pun yang kamu mau di

ring, tetapi kamu tidak boleh
menggunakan gerakan tipe [green]Terbang[blue]-,\l[green]Psikis[blue]-, atau [green]Peri[blue] dalam

pertarungan. Untuk gerakan yang
berubah tipenya saat bertarung,\lkami hanya peduli pada tipe yang

menjadi gerakan tersebut. Kami
tidak suka tipe-tipe itu di ring\lini, dan Big Mo tidak akan

mengizinkanmu menggunakan [green]gerakan
yang paling umum dari tipe-tipe itu\ldi timmu[blue] jika kamu berhasil

mencapainya. Jika beberapa tipe
muncul sama banyak di timmu, kami\lakan melarang tipe sesuai urutan:

Terbang, Psikis, lalu Peri. Jadi,
misalkan kamu memiliki Toucannon\ldan Alakazam di timmu, kamu tidak

akan bisa menggunakan gerakan tipe
Terbang melawan Big Mo, karena\lTerbang lebih dulu dari Psikis.

Mengerti? Jangan bingung!

Choose one Pokémon to battle three
Trainers in a row.

Each Trainer is also only using
one Pokémon.

You can use whatever Pokémon you
want in the ring, but you can’t use\l[green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type\lmoves in the battles.

For moves that change their types
in battles, we only care about the\ltypes those moves become.

We don’t like those types here in
the Gym, but Big Mo is a nice guy\land he’ll let you use ’em if you\lcan get to him."

You can use whatever Pokémon you want in the ring, but you can’t use [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type moves in the battles. For moves that change their types in battles, we only care about the types those moves become. We don’t like those types here in the Gym, but Big Mo is a nice guy and he’ll let you use ’em if you can get to him.

Aturannya sederhana. Pilih satu
Pokémon untuk bertarung melawan\ltiga Pelatih berturut-turut. Setiap

Pelatih juga hanya menggunakan satu
Pokémon. Kamu bisa menggunakan\lPokémon apa pun yang kamu mau di

ring, tetapi kamu tidak boleh
menggunakan gerakan tipe [green]Terbang[blue]-,\l[green]Psikis[blue]-, atau [green]Peri[blue] dalam

pertarungan. Untuk gerakan yang
berubah tipenya saat bertarung,\lkami hanya peduli pada tipe yang

menjadi gerakan tersebut. Kami
tidak suka tipe-tipe itu di Gym\lini, tapi Big Mo adalah orang baik

dan dia akan mengizinkanmu
menggunakannya jika kamu bisa\lmencapainya.

You can use whatever Pokémon you

We don’t like those types here in
the Gym, but Big Mo is a nice guy,\land he’ll only [green]stop[blue] you from using\l[green]Fairy[blue]-type moves if you can get to\lhim."
entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. Choose one Pokémon to battle three Trainers in a row. Each Trainer is also only using one Pokémon. You can use whatever Pokémon you want in the ring, but you can’t use [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type moves in the battles. For moves that change their types in battles, we only care about the types those moves become. We don’t like those types here in the Gym, but Big Mo is a nice guy, and he’ll only [green]stop[blue] you from using [green]Fairy[blue]-type moves if you can get to him.

Aturannya sederhana. Pilih satu
Pokémon untuk bertarung melawan\ltiga Pelatih berturut-turut. Setiap

Pelatih juga hanya menggunakan satu
Pokémon. Kamu bisa menggunakan\lPokémon apa pun yang kamu mau di

ring, tetapi kamu tidak boleh
menggunakan gerakan tipe [green]Terbang[blue]-,\l[green]Psikis[blue]-, atau [green]Peri[blue] dalam

pertarungan. Untuk gerakan yang
berubah tipenya saat bertarung,\lkami hanya peduli pada tipe yang

menjadi gerakan tersebut. Kami
tidak suka tipe-tipe itu di Gym\lini, tapi Big Mo adalah orang baik,

dan dia hanya akan [green]mencegah[blue]mu
menggunakan gerakan tipe [green]Peri[blue] jika\lkamu bisa mencapainya.

entries.original:
"You think I wanna hold onto your
Pokémon for you?

Go dump your Pokémon in the PC
until you only have one left!"
entries.translation_source: You think I wanna hold onto your Pokémon for you? Go dump your Pokémon in the PC until you only have one left!
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir aku mau menahan
Pokémon-mu untukmu? Simpan\lPokémon-mu di PC sampai kamu hanya

punya satu yang tersisa!

entries.original:
"You survived the ring.
Good job, kid.

Go through that door if you wanna
battle Big Mo."
entries.translation_source: You survived the ring. Good job, kid. Go through that door if you wanna battle Big Mo.
entries.translated:
Kamu selamat dari ring. Kerja
bagus, nak. Masuklah melalui pintu\litu jika kamu ingin bertarung

melawan Big Mo.

entries.original:
"Not only did you survive the ring,
but you also took down Big Mo!

I don’t get impressed easy, but
you’ve done the job, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not only did you survive the ring, but you also took down Big Mo! I don’t get impressed easy, but you’ve done the job, kid.
entries.translated:
Tidak hanya kamu selamat dari ring,
tapi kamu juga mengalahkan Big Mo!\lAku tidak mudah terkesan, tapi kamu

berhasil, nak.

entries.original:
"This is the Antisis Gym!

Do ya think ya got what it takes to
survive the ring, and beat Big Mo?"
entries.translation_source: This is the Antisis Gym! Do ya think ya got what it takes to survive the ring, and beat Big Mo?
entries.translated:
Ini Gym Antisis! Apa kamu pikir
kamu punya apa yang diperlukan\luntuk bertahan di ring dan

mengalahkan Big Mo?

entries.original:
"Not many challengers survive the
ring like you did.

You’re a real special one, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not many challengers survive the ring like you did. You’re a real special one, kid.
entries.translated:
Tidak banyak penantang yang selamat
dari ring sepertimu. Kamu\lbenar-benar spesial, nak.

entries.original:
"Big Mo just turned our old Ring
Challenge into some sorta fancy\lbattle facility.

He even convinced those dinguses at
the Battle Frontier to send over\lone of their poozers to referee it!

But no matter what he did, he
couldn’t convince ’em to add it\las an \qoofficial\qc battle facility.

So, since you can’t get any sorta
print by winnin’ here, if you can\lsomehow manage to get to [green]100[blue] wins,\lyou’ll get a shiny new star on your\lTrainer Card.

Now, ain’t that sweet?"
entries.translation_source: Big Mo just turned our old Ring Challenge into some sorta fancy battle facility. He even convinced those dinguses at the Battle Frontier to send over one of their poozers to referee it! But no matter what he did, he couldn’t convince ’em to add it as an \qoofficial\qc battle facility. So, since you can’t get any sorta print by winnin’ here, if you can somehow manage to get to [green]100[blue] wins, you’ll get a shiny new star on your Trainer Card. Now, ain’t that sweet?
entries.translated:
Big Mo baru saja mengubah Tantangan
Ring lama kami menjadi semacam\lfasilitas pertarungan mewah. Dia

bahkan meyakinkan para dingus di
Battle Frontier untuk mengirimkan\lsalah satu poozer mereka untuk

menjadi wasit! Tapi apa pun yang
dia lakukan, dia tidak bisa\lmeyakinkan mereka untuk

menambahkannya sebagai fasilitas
pertarungan \qoofficial\qc. Jadi,\lkarena kamu tidak bisa mendapatkan

cetakan apa pun dengan menang di
sini, jika kamu entah bagaimana\lberhasil mencapai [green]100[blue] kemenangan,

kamu akan mendapatkan bintang baru
yang berkilau di Kartu Pelatihmu.\lNah, bukankah itu manis?

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo with no [green][buffer1][blue]-type\lmoves? Huh?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo with no [green][buffer1][blue]-type moves? Huh?
entries.translated:
Apa kamu benar-benar berpikir kamu
bisa mengalahkan Big Mo tanpa\lgerakan tipe [green][buffer1][blue]? Huh?

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo when your [green]speed[blue] is\lyour [green]weight[blue], and you [green]can’t use[blue]\lany [green]priority Abilities[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo when your [green]speed[blue] is your [green]weight[blue], and you [green]can’t use[blue] any [green]priority Abilities[blue]?
entries.translated:
Apa kau benar-benar berpikir bisa
mengalahkan Big Mo saat [green]kecepatanmu[blue]\ladalah [green]beratmu[blue], dan kau [green]tidak bisa

menggunakan[blue] [green]Ability prioritas[blue]?

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo when your [green]speed[blue] is\lyour [green]weight[blue], and you [green]can’t use[blue] any\l[green]Fairy[blue]-type moves or [green]priority\lAbilities[blue], huh?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo when your [green]speed[blue] is your [green]weight[blue], and you [green]can’t use[blue] any [green]Fairy[blue]-type moves or [green]priority Abilities[blue], huh?
entries.translated:
Apa kau benar-benar berpikir bisa
mengalahkan Big Mo saat [green]kecepatanmu[blue]\ladalah [green]beratmu[blue], dan kau [green]tidak bisa

menggunakan[blue] jurus [green]Tipe Peri[blue] atau
[green]Ability prioritas[blue], ya?

entries.original:
"You’re the new toughest chump in
Antisis City!"
entries.translation_source: You’re the new toughest chump in Antisis City!
entries.translated:
Kau adalah orang tolol terkuat baru
di Antisis City!

entries.original:
"The constant waves have washed all
of the fish away.

Make sure you don’t travel too far
in the water.

Otherwise, you’ll be washed away
like those fish!"
entries.translation_source: The constant waves have washed all of the fish away. Make sure you don’t travel too far in the water. Otherwise, you’ll be washed away like those fish!
entries.translated:
Gelombang konstan telah menyapu
semua ikan. Pastikan kau tidak\lbepergian terlalu jauh di air. Jika

tidak, kau akan tersapu seperti
ikan-ikan itu!

entries.original:
"Staying on land keeps you safe
during the waves.

I don’t really even need my
inner tube!"
entries.translation_source: Staying on land keeps you safe during the waves. I don’t really even need my inner tube!
entries.translated:
Tetap di darat membuatmu aman
selama gelombang. Aku bahkan tidak\lperlu ban dalamku!

entries.original:
"Some platforms allow you to travel
farther from them than others."
entries.translation_source: Some platforms allow you to travel farther from them than others.
entries.translated:
Beberapa platform memungkinkanmu
bepergian lebih jauh dari yang\llain.

entries.original:
"It may be safer, but it’s not
always the best idea to land on\lthe first spot you see.

There are only so many steps you
can take before the wave hits.

Landing farther on a platform can
increase your chances of\lsurviving the following wave."
entries.translation_source: It may be safer, but it’s not always the best idea to land on the first spot you see. There are only so many steps you can take before the wave hits. Landing farther on a platform can increase your chances of surviving the following wave.
entries.translated:
Mungkin lebih aman, tapi tidak
selalu ide terbaik untuk mendarat\ldi tempat pertama yang kau lihat.

Hanya ada sejumlah langkah yang
bisa kau ambil sebelum gelombang\lmenerjang. Mendarat lebih jauh di

platform dapat meningkatkan
peluangmu bertahan dari gelombang\lberikutnya.

entries.original:
"There’s a button embedded in the
rock!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: There’s a button embedded in the rock! Press it?
entries.translated:
Ada tombol yang tertanam di batu!
Tekan?

entries.original:
"The door to the Gym Leader has
been unlocked."
entries.translation_source: The door to the Gym Leader has been unlocked.
entries.translated:
Pintu menuju Pemimpin Gym telah
terbuka.

entries.original:
"The buttons were not pressed in
the correct order.

The puzzle has been reset."
entries.translation_source: The buttons were not pressed in the correct order. The puzzle has been reset.
entries.translated:
Tombol-tombol tidak ditekan dalam
urutan yang benar. Teka-teki telah\ldiatur ulang.

entries.original:
"The button embedded in this rock
has already been pressed."
entries.translation_source: The button embedded in this rock has already been pressed.
entries.translated:
Tombol yang tertanam di batu ini
sudah ditekan.

entries.original:
"The door to the Gym Leader has
already been unlocked."
entries.translation_source: The door to the Gym Leader has already been unlocked.
entries.translated:
Pintu menuju Pemimpin Gym sudah
terbuka.

entries.original:
"Don’t forget, if you press the
buttons in the rocks too early,\lyou won’t be able to get to\lBenjamin!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t forget, if you press the buttons in the rocks too early, you won’t be able to get to Benjamin!
entries.translated:
Jangan lupa, jika kau menekan
tombol di batu terlalu awal, kau\ltidak akan bisa mencapai Benjamin!

entries.original:
"Be careful of the Pokémon you
choose to use!

Sometimes, they forget every move
they know when they devolve!

When that happens, all you’ll be
able to do is Struggle!"
entries.translation_source: Be careful of the Pokémon you choose to use! Sometimes, they forget every move they know when they devolve! When that happens, all you’ll be able to do is Struggle!
entries.translated:
Hati-hati dengan Pokémon yang kau
pilih untuk digunakan!\lKadang-kadang, mereka melupakan

semua jurus yang mereka tahu saat
berevolusi mundur! Saat itu\lterjadi, yang bisa kau lakukan

hanyalah Struggle!

entries.original:
"When I think of the correct order
of the buttons, I think back to the\lcurious case of Benjamin Butterfree\."
entries.translation_source: When I think of the correct order of the buttons, I think back to the curious case of Benjamin Butterfree\.
entries.translated:
Saat aku memikirkan urutan tombol
yang benar, aku teringat pada kasus\laneh Benjamin Butterfree\.

entries.original:
"Use your memories.
They will guide you."
entries.translation_source: Use your memories. They will guide you.
entries.translated:
Gunakan ingatanmu. Mereka akan
membimbingmu.

entries.original:
"Hey there, kid!

-HACK- -COUGH-

Welcome to your first Gym
Challenge!

Let me start you off with a
small gift.

-COUGH- -WHEEZE-"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, kid! -HACK- -COUGH- Welcome to your first Gym Challenge! Let me start you off with a small gift. -COUGH- -WHEEZE-
entries.translated:

entries.original:
"As you can or can’t see, this Gym
is centred around [green]Dark[blue]-types.

If you want to win here, a good
starting point would be bringing\l[green]Fighting[blue]-, [green]Bug[blue]- or [green]Fairy[blue]-types.

Just be aware, because of the many
Trainers that struggle in this Gym,\l[green]negative emotions[blue] will fill the air\las you battle.

These emotions will inflict damage
at the end of each turn.

Only [green]Dark[blue]-types, [green]Psychic[blue]-types,
[green]Ghost[blue]-types, and Pokémon with the\lAbilities [green]Magic Guard[blue], [green]Unaware[blue], or\l[green]Oblivious[blue] are unaffected.

If you end up struggling because of
the negative emotions, bringing a\lPokémon that isn’t affected could\lreally help you out.

Now, getting to Véga, the Leader,
is relatively simple.

Navigate the dimly lit hallways, and
don’t get spotted.

If you get spotted, you’ll either
have to battle some Trainers or be\lsent back to the beginning of\lthe hallway.

Every Trainer you defeat will
brighten up the room, so I\lrecommend battling them all first.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: As you can or can’t see, this Gym is centred around [green]Dark[blue]-types. If you want to win here, a good starting point would be bringing [green]Fighting[blue]-, [green]Bug[blue]- or [green]Fairy[blue]-types. Just be aware, because of the many Trainers that struggle in this Gym, [green]negative emotions[blue] will fill the air as you battle. These emotions will inflict damage at the end of each turn. Only [green]Dark[blue]-types, [green]Psychic[blue]-types, [green]Ghost[blue]-types, and Pokémon with the Abilities [green]Magic Guard[blue], [green]Unaware[blue], or [green]Oblivious[blue] are unaffected. If you end up struggling because of the negative emotions, bringing a Pokémon that isn’t affected could really help you out. Now, getting to Véga, the Leader, is relatively simple. Navigate the dimly lit hallways, and don’t get spotted. If you get spotted, you’ll either have to battle some Trainers or be sent back to the beginning of the hallway. Every Trainer you defeat will brighten up the room, so I recommend battling them all first. Good luck out there!

"Contrary to popular belief, this
Gym is not an Ice-type gym.

It’s a [green]Flying[blue]-type Gym!

And the best way to counter
Flying-types is to clip their\lwings with [green]ice[blue], [green]rocks[blue],\lor [green]electricity[blue]!

But be careful, because there’s a
tailwind in this Gym!

This [green]Tailwind[blue] will increase the
speed of all Flying-type Pokémon,\lso don’t get cocky just because\lyour Pokémon might have a high\lspeed stat.

Unless it’s part Flying-type,
of course.

Getting to Alice requires using
the fans and holes on the ground\lto move between levels of the Gym.

It’s not too complicated, just make
sure you remember where you have\land haven’t been before.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Contrary to popular belief, this Gym is not an Ice-type gym. It’s a [green]Flying[blue]-type Gym! And the best way to counter Flying-types is to clip their wings with [green]ice[blue], [green]rocks[blue], or [green]electricity[blue]! But be careful, because there’s a tailwind in this Gym! This [green]Tailwind[blue] will increase the speed of all Flying-type Pokémon, so don’t get cocky just because your Pokémon might have a high speed stat. Unless it’s part Flying-type, of course. Getting to Alice requires using the fans and holes on the ground to move between levels of the Gym. It’s not too complicated, just make sure you remember where you have and haven’t been before. Good luck out there!

entries.original:
"Mel?
Well, he’s just a [green]normal[blue] guy!

If this were a normal Normal-type
Gym, I’d say using Fighting-types\lwould be a great way to take him\ldown.

But, it isn’t.

In this Gym, all battles are
[green]Inverse Battles[blue]!

Meaning, all type matchups will
be reversed.

So, can you guess what type would
be best suited to take down Mel?

\.

You’re right! There isn’t one!

[green]Ghost[blue]-type moves will be super
effective against his Normal-types,\lbut Normal-type moves will also\lbe super effective on Ghost-types.

Your best bet to take Mel down is to
use a Pokémon that knows Ghost-\ltype moves, but isn’t one itself.

If you need more practice getting
used to this kind of battle, you\lshould check out the [green]Inverse Battle\lHouse[blue] in town.

If you’re ready to start, head
down the slide next to me.

Your goal is to use the Lapras to
make your way back up here.

But make sure you’ve stocked up on
supplies first.

There’s no going back until you
reach Mel."
entries.translation_source: Mel? Well, he’s just a [green]normal[blue] guy! If this were a normal Normal-type Gym, I’d say using Fighting-types would be a great way to take him down. But, it isn’t. In this Gym, all battles are [green]Inverse Battles[blue]! Meaning, all type matchups will be reversed. So, can you guess what type would be best suited to take down Mel? \. You’re right! There isn’t one! [green]Ghost[blue]-type moves will be super effective against his Normal-types, but Normal-type moves will also be super effective on Ghost-types. Your best bet to take Mel down is to use a Pokémon that knows Ghost- type moves, but isn’t one itself. If you need more practice getting used to this kind of battle, you should check out the [green]Inverse Battle House[blue] in town. If you’re ready to start, head down the slide next to me. Your goal is to use the Lapras to make your way back up here. But make sure you’ve stocked up on supplies first. There’s no going back until you reach Mel.

entries.translation_source: Galavan likes to use both [green]Electric[blue]- and [green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon. I’d say Ground-type Pokémon are a good way to wreck him, but that won’t work in this Gym. Unfortunately, the floor here is both magnetized and electrified. entries.translation_source: For the most part, Big Mo is a lover of big, slow, and tough Pokémon, often [green]Fighting[blue]-type. If you’re just an average Trainer, and have a [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type, you may win no prob! But before you can face Big Mo, you’ll need to clear the Gym’s [green]Ring Challenge[blue]. And in that, no [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type moves are allowed. That may seem difficult, but honestly, if you’re not using a Pokémon weak to Fighting-type moves, it should be a cinch for you to clear. And be aware that depending on how hardcore you want to fight, there may be certain restrictions in the battle against Big Mo as well. The [green]boys out back[blue] will let you know what’s up with the fight, though, so don’t sweat remembering. Good luck in the ring!

"Just like back in Mel’s Gym, this
Gym is centred around [green]water[blue].

But unlike his Gym, the Trainers
here actually use [green]Water[blue]-types!

Bringing electrifying [green]Electric[blue]-
types or grassy [green]Grass[blue]-types will\ldo you wonders.

Just be careful.

of adaptation.

When you fight them, all Pokémon
in battle will become the [green]same type[blue]\las their [green]first two moves[blue].

As for how to get to Tessy,
you’ll need a Pokémon that can\lSurf across the waves.

But be careful, spending too much
time in the water can get you\lwashed back to the entrance!

You’ll need to scout ahead and
find the shortest path to the\lnext platform.

And be aware that although moving
on land will advance the timer,\lyou won’t get washed away if\lyou’re not in the water.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Just like back in Mel’s Gym, this Gym is centred around [green]water[blue]. But unlike his Gym, the Trainers here actually use [green]Water[blue]-types! Bringing electrifying [green]Electric[blue]- types or grassy [green]Grass[blue]-types will do you wonders. Just be careful. Trainers in this Gym are masters of adaptation. When you fight them, all Pokémon in battle will become the [green]same type[blue] as their [green]first two moves[blue]. As for how to get to Tessy, you’ll need a Pokémon that can Surf across the waves. But be careful, spending too much time in the water can get you washed back to the entrance! You’ll need to scout ahead and find the shortest path to the next platform. And be aware that although moving on land will advance the timer, you won’t get washed away if you’re not in the water. Good luck out there!

sana!

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of the curious
case of Benjamin Butterfree?

Born a Butterfree, fainted a
Caterpie, poor Benjamin aged\lbackwards his entire life.

And in the spirit of Butterfree,
our Leader, Benjamin designed\lthis Gym.

And you guessed it, in this Gym
Trainers like to use [green]Bug[blue]-types!

Bringing some [green]Rock[blue]-, [green]Flying[blue]-, or
[green]Fire[blue]-types can really put them\lin their place.

But be careful, because in this Gym
when a Pokémon is defeated, it\lregresses to an earlier state.

Pokémon only faint when they can
regress no more.

Because of this unique battling
condition, Pokémon won’t earn any\lExp. in this Gym.

And as for how to find Benjamin,
I’ll tell you this.

In each of the rooms along the
wall, buttons are hidden in rocks.

Press these buttons in the right
order, and you’ll open up a path\lto ol’ Benjamin.

And what is the correct order?

All I can tell you to do is think
back to the curious case of\lBenjamin Butterfree\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of the curious case of Benjamin Butterfree? Born a Butterfree, fainted a Caterpie, poor Benjamin aged backwards his entire life. And in the spirit of Butterfree, our Leader, Benjamin designed this Gym. And you guessed it, in this Gym Trainers like to use [green]Bug[blue]-types! Bringing some [green]Rock[blue]-, [green]Flying[blue]-, or [green]Fire[blue]-types can really put them in their place. But be careful, because in this Gym when a Pokémon is defeated, it regresses to an earlier state. Pokémon only faint when they can regress no more. Because of this unique battling condition, Pokémon won’t earn any Exp. in this Gym. And as for how to find Benjamin, I’ll tell you this. In each of the rooms along the wall, buttons are hidden in rocks. Press these buttons in the right order, and you’ll open up a path to ol’ Benjamin. And what is the correct order? All I can tell you to do is think back to the curious case of Benjamin Butterfree\.
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang
kasus aneh Benjamin Butterfree?\lLahir sebagai Butterfree, pingsan

sebagai Caterpie, Benjamin malang
menua mundur sepanjang hidupnya.\lDan dalam semangat Butterfree,

Pemimpin kami, Benjamin merancang
Gym ini. Dan kamu tebak, di Gym ini\lPelatih suka menggunakan tipe

[green]Serangga[blue]! Membawa beberapa tipe
[green]Batu[blue]-, [green]Terbang[blue]-, atau [green]Api[blue]-\lbenar-benar bisa membuat mereka

pada tempatnya. Namun hati-hati,
karena di Gym ini saat Pokémon\ldikalahkan, ia mundur ke tahap

sebelumnya. Pokémon hanya pingsan
ketika tidak bisa mundur lagi.\lKarena kondisi pertarungan yang

unik ini, Pokémon tidak akan
mendapatkan Exp. di Gym ini. Dan\luntuk cara menemukan Benjamin, aku

akan memberitahumu ini. Di setiap
ruangan di sepanjang dinding,\ltombol tersembunyi di batu. Tekan

tombol-tombol ini dalam urutan yang
benar, dan kamu akan membuka jalan\lmenuju Benjamin tua. Dan apa urutan

yang benar? Yang bisa kukatakan
adalah pikirkan kembali kasus aneh\lBenjamin Butterfree\.

favourites or somethin’?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Now, ol’ Galavan - that guy’s clearly the best Gym Leader, no doubt\. Why? ’Cos he’s handsome, and strong, and he’s a genius at machines! What?\.\CC0820 c’mon, can’t a guy have favourites or somethin’? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, si Galavan - pria itu
jelas Pemimpin Gym terbaik, tidak\ldiragukan\. Kenapa? Karena dia

tampan, kuat, dan jenius dalam
mesin! Apa?\.\CC0820 ayolah, masa pria tidak\lboleh punya favorit? Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Ya ever seen Big Mo?
The guy’s huge - seriously!

He’s so big, a Lickilicky thought
he was its mama!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya ever seen Big Mo? The guy’s huge - seriously! He’s so big, a Lickilicky thought he was its mama! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Kamu pernah lihat Big Mo? Pria itu
besar - serius! Dia begitu besar,\lseekor Lickilicky mengira dia

ibunya! Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Ya know, that Tessy chick’s pretty
young, but don’t be fooled.

That’s a lady who ain’t afraid ta
play as dirty as Cootes Bog!

But hey, ya got everythin’ to beat
her at her own game, right?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya know, that Tessy chick’s pretty young, but don’t be fooled. That’s a lady who ain’t afraid ta play as dirty as Cootes Bog! But hey, ya got everythin’ to beat her at her own game, right? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu, si Tessy itu masih muda,
tapi jangan tertipu. Dia wanita\lyang tidak takut bermain kotor

seperti Cootes Bog! Tapi hei, kamu
punya segalanya untuk\lmengalahkannya dalam permainannya

sendiri, kan? Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"The curious case of Benjamin
Butterfree\.

Man, if I could get younger, that
would be pretty cool.

’Course, bein’ too small to reach
the shelves would be pretty\lannoyin’, no doubt!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: The curious case of Benjamin Butterfree\. Man, if I could get younger, that would be pretty cool. ’Course, bein’ too small to reach the shelves would be pretty annoyin’, no doubt! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Kasus penasaran Benjamin Butterfree\.
Astaga, kalau aku bisa lebih muda,\litu akan sangat keren. Tentu saja,

terlalu kecil untuk mencapai rak
akan sangat menjengkelkan, tidak\ldiragukan lagi! Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"You’re almost there, [player]!

The final climb to the Pokémon
League is about to begin!

And knowing ya, I’m sure you’ll
get there in one piece!

I can’t say the same for the
Trainers you’ll come across on\lthe way, though\.

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: You’re almost there, [player]! The final climb to the Pokémon League is about to begin! And knowing ya, I’m sure you’ll get there in one piece! I can’t say the same for the Trainers you’ll come across on the way, though\. Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Kamu hampir sampai, [player]!
Pendakian terakhir menuju Pokémon\lLeague akan segera dimulai! Dan

mengenalmu, aku yakin kamu akan
sampai di sana dengan selamat! Aku\ltidak bisa mengatakan hal yang sama

untuk para Trainer yang akan kamu
temui di jalan, meskipun\. Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"[player], ya made it to the
Pokémon League!

So, ya wanna hear ol’ Galavan
gossip about the Elite 4, huh?

Man, if ya got time to chat, that’s
time better spent preppin’ for the\lfinal push, right?

Doncha worry ’bout a thing!

Ol’ Galavan’s behind ya, the whole
way, so go get ’em!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: [player], ya made it to the Pokémon League! So, ya wanna hear ol’ Galavan gossip about the Elite 4, huh? Man, if ya got time to chat, that’s time better spent preppin’ for the final push, right? Doncha worry ’bout a thing! Ol’ Galavan’s behind ya, the whole way, so go get ’em! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
[player], kamu berhasil sampai ke
Pokémon League! Jadi, kamu ingin\lmendengar gosip Galavan tua tentang

Elite 4, ya? Astaga, jika kamu
punya waktu untuk mengobrol, itu\lwaktu yang lebih baik digunakan

untuk persiapan dorongan terakhir,
kan? Jangan khawatir tentang apa\lpun! Galavan tua mendukungmu,

sepanjang jalan, jadi kejar mereka!
Ha ha ha!

entries.original: "Am I Blind?"
entries.translation_source: Am I Blind?
entries.translated: Apa Aku Buta?

entries.original:
"Hello there, stranger!

Take time to explore Icicle Cave.

It may not seem that big, but it is
larger than it appears!

Why in fact, just the other day, I
saw a Pokémon burrow its way\lthrough the wall to what must be\lan entirely new cave!"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, stranger! Take time to explore Icicle Cave. It may not seem that big, but it is larger than it appears! Why in fact, just the other day, I saw a Pokémon burrow its way through the wall to what must be an entirely new cave!
entries.translated:
Halo, orang asing! Luangkan waktu
untuk menjelajahi Icicle Cave.\lMungkin tidak terlihat besar,

tetapi lebih besar dari yang
terlihat! Bahkan, baru beberapa\lhari yang lalu, aku melihat seekor

Pokémon menggali jalannya melalui
dinding ke tempat yang pasti\lmerupakan gua yang sama sekali

baru!

entries.original:
"Who could have predicted there
would be a hidden section of\lIcicle Cave?

If it had not been for that
Sandslash’s sloppy digging, this\lplace may have remained hidden for\lfar longer.

But now that it is accessible, I
was able to discover another one\lof the ancient relics!

The tablet that [buffer1] here\. there are
several similar around Borrius.

On each is text in an ancient
dialect, long since forgotten.

However!

After many years of studying the
language, I have created a device\lcapable of translating the text.

In fact, if you are willing to
assist me in uncovering the secrets\lof these stone walls, I will be\lwilling to share it with you."
entries.translation_source: Who could have predicted there would be a hidden section of Icicle Cave? If it had not been for that Sandslash’s sloppy digging, this place may have remained hidden for far longer. But now that it is accessible, I was able to discover another one of the ancient relics! The tablet that [buffer1] here\. there are several similar around Borrius. On each is text in an ancient dialect, long since forgotten. However! After many years of studying the language, I have created a device capable of translating the text. In fact, if you are willing to assist me in uncovering the secrets of these stone walls, I will be willing to share it with you.
entries.translated:
Siapa yang bisa meramalkan akan ada
bagian tersembunyi dari Icicle\lCave? Jika bukan karena penggalian

ceroboh Sandslash itu, tempat ini
mungkin akan tetap tersembunyi\llebih lama lagi. Tapi sekarang

setelah dapat diakses, aku berhasil
menemukan salah satu peninggalan\lkuno lainnya! Tablet yang [buffer1]

di sini\. ada beberapa yang serupa di
sekitar Borrius. Pada masing-masing\lterdapat teks dalam dialek kuno,

yang sudah lama terlupakan. Namun!
Setelah bertahun-tahun mempelajari\lbahasa tersebut, aku telah

menciptakan sebuah perangkat yang
mampu menerjemahkan teks itu.\lFaktanya, jika kamu bersedia

membantuku mengungkap rahasia dari
dinding batu ini, aku akan bersedia\lmembaginya denganmu.

entries.original:
"Hmph\. that is rather unfortunate.

No one in the Archeology Society
has managed to learn this dialect\.\lother than myself, of course.

I doubt an inexperienced Trainer
like you could read it without my\lassistance."
entries.translation_source: Hmph\. that is rather unfortunate. No one in the Archeology Society has managed to learn this dialect\. other than myself, of course. I doubt an inexperienced Trainer like you could read it without my assistance.
entries.translated:
Hmph\. itu sangat disayangkan. Tidak
seorang pun di Archeology Society\lyang berhasil mempelajari dialek

ini\. selain diriku sendiri, tentu
saja. Aku ragu seorang Trainer yang\ltidak berpengalaman sepertimu bisa

membacanya tanpa bantuanku.

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

This is the device you will need to
read the text on these tablets."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! This is the device you will need to read the text on these tablets.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Ini adalah perangkat
yang kamu perlukan untuk membaca\lteks pada tablet-tablet ini.

entries.original:
"With the [green][buffer1][blue] in hand,
you will be able to translate the\lancient dialect, if you so desire.

In fact, it may be advantageous for
you to discover what is behind\lthese tablets.

Once you have solved the riddle on
each of the tablets in Borrius,\lcome see me, and I will reward you\lfor your efforts."
entries.translation_source: With the [green][buffer1][blue] in hand, you will be able to translate the ancient dialect, if you so desire. In fact, it may be advantageous for you to discover what is behind these tablets. Once you have solved the riddle on each of the tablets in Borrius, come see me, and I will reward you for your efforts.
entries.translated:
Dengan [green][buffer1][blue] di tangan, kamu
akan dapat menerjemahkan dialek\lkuno itu, jika kamu

menginginkannya. Faktanya, mungkin
menguntungkan bagimu untuk\lmenemukan apa yang ada di balik

tablet-tablet ini. Setelah kamu
memecahkan teka-teki pada\lmasing-masing tablet di Borrius,

temui aku, dan aku akan memberikan
hadiah atas usahamu.

entries.original:
"As of now, the secrets behind [green][buffer3][blue]
tablet\\08 have yet to be uncovered.

Once you have uncovered what is
behind all of them, come see me\lfor a reward."
entries.translation_source: As of now, the secrets behind [green][buffer3][blue] tablet\\08 have yet to be uncovered. Once you have uncovered what is behind all of them, come see me for a reward.
entries.translated:
Sampai saat ini, rahasia di balik
[green][buffer3][blue] tablet\\08 masih belum\lterungkap. Setelah kamu mengungkap

apa yang ada di balik semuanya,
temui aku untuk mendapatkan hadiah.

entries.original:
"You have done it!

You have uncovered the secrets
behind each of the ancient stone\ltablets in Borrius!

Not even I, the greatest mind in
the Archeology Society, was able to\lsolve the mysteries.

I must be honest\. I may have
misjudged you at first.

However, I have come to learn that
there certainly is more to one than\lcan be discerned at first glance.

You have my apologies, and once
more, my thanks."
entries.translation_source: You have done it! You have uncovered the secrets behind each of the ancient stone tablets in Borrius! Not even I, the greatest mind in the Archeology Society, was able to solve the mysteries. I must be honest\. I may have misjudged you at first. However, I have come to learn that there certainly is more to one than can be discerned at first glance. You have my apologies, and once more, my thanks.
entries.translated:
Kamu berhasil! Kamu telah
mengungkap rahasia di balik setiap\ltablet batu kuno di Borrius! Bahkan

aku, pemikir terhebat di Archeology
Society, tidak mampu memecahkan\lmisteri tersebut. Aku harus jujur\.

Aku mungkin salah menilaimu pada
awalnya. Namun, aku jadi belajar\lbahwa pasti ada lebih banyak hal

pada seseorang daripada yang
terlihat pada pandangan pertama.\lKamu mendapat permintaan maafku,

dan sekali lagi, terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"I am sure you noticed the ancient
dens behind each of the tablets,\lyes?

Once a den has been emptied for the
day, throw in one of those [green]Wishing\lPieces[blue].

They will allow a new Pokémon to
be encountered.

And with that, I tip my hat to you,
Trainer, and farewell.

Until we meet again!"
entries.translation_source: I am sure you noticed the ancient dens behind each of the tablets, yes? Once a den has been emptied for the day, throw in one of those [green]Wishing Pieces[blue]. They will allow a new Pokémon to be encountered. And with that, I tip my hat to you, Trainer, and farewell. Until we meet again!
entries.translated:
Aku yakin kamu memperhatikan sarang
kuno di balik masing-masing tablet,\lkan? Setelah sarang dikosongkan

untuk hari itu, lemparkan salah
satu [green]Wishing Pieces[blue] ke dalamnya.\lMereka akan memungkinkan Pokémon

baru untuk ditemui. Dan dengan itu,
aku angkat topi untukmu, Trainer,\ldan selamat tinggal. Sampai jumpa

lagi!

entries.original: "[green]Seyyyy!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Seyyyy!
entries.translated: [green]Seyyyy!

entries.original:
"This Chansey charges [green]$[buffer1][black] to heal
Insane Trainers."
entries.translation_source: This Chansey charges [green]$[buffer1][black] to heal Insane Trainers.
entries.translated:
Chansey ini mengenakan biaya
[green]$[buffer1][black] untuk menyembuhkan\lTrainer Insane.

entries.original:
"If you are crazy enough to attempt
Insane, then you should be crazy\lenough to buy healing items, or be\lprepared to pay the price of\l6 Full Restores, 5 Revives, and\l6 Max Elixirs every time you need\lto heal.

Don’t like this?

Play on a lower difficulty.

This game mode is not meant for
those who want to take the easy\lway out.

You have been warned."
entries.translation_source: If you are crazy enough to attempt Insane, then you should be crazy enough to buy healing items, or be prepared to pay the price of 6 Full Restores, 5 Revives, and 6 Max Elixirs every time you need to heal. Don’t like this? Play on a lower difficulty. This game mode is not meant for those who want to take the easy way out. You have been warned.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu cukup gila untuk mencoba
Insane, maka kamu harus cukup gila\luntuk membeli item penyembuhan,

atau bersiap membayar harga 6 Full
Restore, 5 Revive, dan 6 Max Elixir\lsetiap kali kamu perlu

menyembuhkan. Tidak suka? Main di
kesulitan yang lebih rendah. Mode\lpermainan ini tidak dimaksudkan

untuk mereka yang ingin mengambil
jalan mudah. Kamu telah\ldiperingatkan.

entries.original: "You don’t have enough money."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough money.
entries.translated: Kamu tidak memiliki cukup uang.

entries.original: "Why"
entries.translation_source: Why
entries.translated: Mengapa

entries.original:
"[player]!
Fancy meeting you here!

Figured you’d be out running one of
Log’s \qoerrands\qc, or something.

\.

Oh, you are. Typical.

He’s such a cheapskate.
He can’t do anything himself."
entries.translation_source: [player]! Fancy meeting you here! Figured you’d be out running one of Log’s \qoerrands\qc, or something. \. Oh, you are. Typical. He’s such a cheapskate. He can’t do anything himself.
entries.translated:
[player]! Senang bertemu kamu di
sini! Kukira kamu sedang\lmenjalankan salah satu \qoerrands\qc

milik Log, atau sesuatu. \. Oh,
ternyata iya. Tipikal. Dia begitu\lpelit. Dia tidak bisa melakukan apa

pun sendiri.

entries.original:
"What’s that?
Log gave you something for me?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Log gave you something for me?
entries.translated:
Apa itu? Log memberimu sesuatu
untukku?

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed the Pokédex
over to [rival]."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed the Pokédex over to [rival].
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan Pokédex kepada
[rival].

entries.original:
"Oh, great\. now I’m never gonna get
Log’s voice out of my head.

But, uh\.\CC0818 thanks, I guess.

He asked you to fill this out,
didn’t he?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, great\. now I’m never gonna get Log’s voice out of my head. But, uh\.\CC0818 thanks, I guess. He asked you to fill this out, didn’t he?
entries.translated:
Oh, bagus\. sekarang aku tidak akan
pernah bisa menghilangkan suara Log\ldari kepalaku. Tapi, eh\.\CC0818 terima

kasih, kurasa. Dia memintamu untuk
mengisi ini, kan?

entries.original:
"Well, if that’s the case, hopefully
you caught some good Pokémon\lto fill its pages, right?

Let’s battle!

I wanna see if you’ve gotten any
better since last time!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if that’s the case, hopefully you caught some good Pokémon to fill its pages, right? Let’s battle! I wanna see if you’ve gotten any better since last time!
entries.translated:
Yah, jika itu masalahnya, semoga
kamu menangkap beberapa Pokémon\lbagus untuk mengisi

halaman-halamannya, kan? Ayo
bertarung! Aku ingin lihat apakah\lkamu sudah menjadi lebih baik sejak

terakhir kali!

entries.original:
"Well, if that’s the case, hopefully
you caught some good Pokémon to\lfill its pages, right?

Let’s battle!

Who knows, maybe you’ll actually
beat me this time!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if that’s the case, hopefully you caught some good Pokémon to fill its pages, right? Let’s battle! Who knows, maybe you’ll actually beat me this time!
entries.translated:
Yah, jika itu masalahnya, semoga
kamu menangkap beberapa Pokémon\lbagus untuk mengisi

halaman-halamannya, kan? Ayo
bertarung! Siapa tahu, mungkin kamu\lbenar-benar akan mengalahkanku kali

ini!

entries.original:
"Okay, fine.

I guess I can help fill
this thing out.

If it’s gonna help me get a bit
stronger, I’ll take it.

And when I find my parents, they
won’t even recognize me for all\lmy power!

Oh, right.

I guess as thanks for getting this
to me, you can have these."
entries.translation_source: Okay, fine. I guess I can help fill this thing out. If it’s gonna help me get a bit stronger, I’ll take it. And when I find my parents, they won’t even recognize me for all my power! Oh, right. I guess as thanks for getting this to me, you can have these.
entries.translated:
Baiklah. Kurasa aku bisa membantu
mengisi barang ini. Jika ini akan\lmembantuku menjadi sedikit lebih

kuat, aku akan menerimanya. Dan
saat aku menemukan orang tuaku,\lmereka bahkan tidak akan

mengenaliku karena semua
kekuatanku! Oh, iya. Kurasa sebagai\lucapan terima kasih karena

memberiku ini, kamu bisa dapatkan
ini.

entries.original:
"Have you considered taking on the
Gym Challenge, [player]?

Just like in my home region of Hoenn,
there are 8 Gyms in Borrius.

If you can beat all of them, you’ll
be hailed as a powerful Trainer.

I started my challenge already, but
I had a tough time in Dresco Town.

The Gym Leader there kept using
[green][buffer1][blue] on my Pokémon, so\lI searched for a way to prevent\lthem from [buffer2].

Fortunately, I found those [green]Safety
Goggles[blue], so he didn’t stand a\lchance after that!

Good luck, [player].

Next time, the battle won’t go the
same way as this one!

I promise you that!"

The Gym Leader there kept using [green][buffer1][blue] on my Pokémon, so I searched for a way to prevent them from [buffer2]. Fortunately, I found those [green]Safety Goggles[blue], so he didn’t stand a chance after that! Good luck, [player]. Next time, the battle won’t go the same way as this one! I promise you that!
entries.translated:
Sudahkah kamu mempertimbangkan
untuk mengikuti Gym Challenge,\l[player]? Sama seperti di daerah

asalku, Hoenn, ada 8 Gym di
Borrius. Jika kamu bisa mengalahkan\lsemuanya, kamu akan dipuji sebagai

Pelatih yang kuat. Aku sudah
memulai tantanganku, tapi aku\lmengalami kesulitan di Dresco Town.

Pemimpin Gym di sana terus
menggunakan [green][buffer1][blue] pada\lPokémon-ku, jadi aku mencari cara

untuk mencegah mereka dari
[buffer2]. Untungnya, aku menemukan\l[green]Kacamata Pelindung[blue] itu, jadi dia

tidak punya kesempatan setelah itu!
Semoga beruntung, [player]. Lain\lkali, pertarungan tidak akan

berjalan seperti yang ini! Aku
janji!
