entries.original:
"It would have been smarter to wear
pants in this cave."
entries.translation_source: It would have been smarter to wear pants in this cave.
entries.translated:
Akan lebih bijak untuk memakai
celana di gua ini.

entries.original: "[red]I’m going to catch even more cuties!"
entries.translation_source: [red]I’m going to catch even more cuties!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku akan menangkap lebih banyak
imut-imut!

entries.original:
"Why am I training in this cave?

My master told me that training in
frigid cold areas is good for the\lmuscles."
entries.translation_source: Why am I training in this cave? My master told me that training in frigid cold areas is good for the muscles.
entries.translated:
Kenapa aku berlatih di gua ini?
Guruku bilang bahwa berlatih di\ldaerah yang sangat dingin itu baik

untuk otot.

entries.original:
"[green]Thick Fat[blue] is a Pokémon’s ability
that halves the damage done by\l[green]Ice[blue]- and [green]Fire[blue]-type moves."
entries.translation_source: [green]Thick Fat[blue] is a Pokémon’s ability that halves the damage done by [green]Ice[blue]- and [green]Fire[blue]-type moves.
entries.translated:
[green]Lemak Tebal[blue] adalah kemampuan
Pokémon yang membagi dua kerusakan\lyang disebabkan oleh jurus tipe [green]Es[blue]

dan [green]Api[blue].

entries.original:
"Running in circles helps boost my
Pokémon’s friendship!"
entries.translation_source: Running in circles helps boost my Pokémon’s friendship!
entries.translated:
Berlari memutar membantu
meningkatkan persahabatan\lPokémon-ku!

entries.original:
"I trained under Alice in the
Blizzard City Gym.

Her Gym’s location is what inspired
me to become a Skier."
entries.translation_source: I trained under Alice in the Blizzard City Gym. Her Gym’s location is what inspired me to become a Skier.
entries.translated:
Aku berlatih di bawah Alice di Gym
Blizzard City. Lokasi Gym-nya yang\lmenginspirasiku menjadi seorang

Pemain Ski.

entries.original:
"Don’t you know its rude to barge in
on someone else’s meeting?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you know its rude to barge in on someone else’s meeting?
entries.translated:
Tidakkah kamu tahu itu tidak sopan
untuk masuk ke pertemuan orang\llain?

entries.original:
"I’m not talking to you.
You’re too mean."
entries.translation_source: I’m not talking to you. You’re too mean.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bicara padamu. Kamu
terlalu jahat.

entries.original:
"I’m Lily, President of the Skiers
Club.

I’m warning you, I’m not easy to
beat!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Lily, President of the Skiers Club. I’m warning you, I’m not easy to beat!
entries.translated:
Aku Lily, Presiden Klub Pemain Ski.
Aku peringatkan, aku tidak mudah\ldikalahkan!

entries.original:
"You’re pretty powerful, I’m
impressed!

You should make a career change and
join our club.

\.

What\. not interested?

Then at least take this!"
entries.translation_source: You’re pretty powerful, I’m impressed! You should make a career change and join our club. \. What\. not interested? Then at least take this!
entries.translated:
Kamu cukup kuat, aku terkesan! Kamu
harus berganti karier dan bergabung\ldengan klub kami. \. Apa\. tidak

tertarik? Kalau begitu setidaknya
ambil ini!

entries.original:
"We have plenty of Glalitites here
at the Skiers Club.

They always stick to the bottoms of
our skis!"
entries.translation_source: We have plenty of Glalitites here at the Skiers Club. They always stick to the bottoms of our skis!
entries.translated:
Kami punya banyak Glalitite di sini
di Klub Pemain Ski. Mereka selalu\lmenempel di bagian bawah ski kami!

entries.original:
"It was about time we found a new
training spot, anyway.

This one is quite cold."
entries.translation_source: It was about time we found a new training spot, anyway. This one is quite cold.
entries.translated:
Sudah waktunya kami menemukan
tempat latihan baru. Tempat ini\lcukup dingin.

entries.original:
"Hmph.

My training was ruined, thanks
to you."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. My training was ruined, thanks to you.
entries.translated:
Hmph. Latihanku hancur, berkat
kamu.

entries.original:
"THE PLATE
IS THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: THE PLATE IS THE KEY.
entries.translated: PIRING ADALAH KUNCI.

entries.original: "Translate the text?"
entries.translation_source: Translate the text?
entries.translated: Terjemahkan teksnya?

entries.original: "Translating.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: Translating.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830
entries.translated: Menerjemahkan.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

I appear to have gotten myself in
quite the predicament, you see.

I can no longer start sliding on
my own!

Would you care to help by giving
me a jump start?"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! I appear to have gotten myself in quite the predicament, you see. I can no longer start sliding on my own! Would you care to help by giving me a jump start?
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Sepertinya saya
berada dalam situasi yang cukup\lsulit, Anda lihat. Saya tidak bisa

lagi mulai meluncur sendiri! Maukah
Anda membantu dengan memberi saya\ldorongan awal?

entries.original:
"You appear to have gotten me out of
my predicament!

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: You appear to have gotten me out of my predicament! For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Anda sepertinya telah mengeluarkan
saya dari situasi sulit! Untuk itu,\lsaya berterima kasih.

entries.original: "Ooh hoo hoo hoo\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo\.
entries.translated: Ooh hoo hoo hoo\.

entries.original:
"’Till another predicament brings us
together again, I bid you adieu."
entries.translation_source: ’Till another predicament brings us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Sampai situasi sulit lain
mempertemukan kita lagi, saya\lucapkan selamat tinggal.

entries.original:
"[black]It’s a statue of a Pokémon.
It seems to exude power\.

[player] read the engraved
writing\.

\.
\.

A body of rock.

A body of ice.

A body of steel.

When gathers the three Pokémon,
the king shall appear."
entries.translation_source: [black]It’s a statue of a Pokémon. It seems to exude power\. [player] read the engraved writing\. \. \. A body of rock. A body of ice. A body of steel. When gathers the three Pokémon, the king shall appear.
entries.translated:
[black]Ini adalah patung Pokémon.
Tampaknya memancarkan kekuatan\.\l[player] membaca tulisan yang

terukir\. \. \. Tubuh batu. Tubuh es.
Tubuh baja. Ketika tiga Pokémon\lberkumpul, raja akan muncul.

entries.original: "[green]\.Zut zutt!"
entries.translation_source: [green]\.Zut zutt!
entries.translated: [green]\.Zut zutt!

entries.original: "[black]Regigigas crumbled to dust."
entries.translation_source: [black]Regigigas crumbled to dust.
entries.translated: [black]Regigigas hancur menjadi debu.

entries.original:
"Multiple items in the Cube can be
registered to \btn05 for easy use."
entries.translation_source: Multiple items in the Cube can be registered to \btn05 for easy use.
entries.translated:
Beberapa item di Cube dapat
didaftarkan ke \btn05 untuk penggunaan\lmudah.

entries.original: "What would you like to do?"
entries.translation_source: What would you like to do?
entries.translated: Apa yang ingin Anda lakukan?

entries.original:
"Your Pokémon have been healed to
perfect health."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
entries.translated:
Pokémon Anda telah disembuhkan
hingga kesehatan sempurna.

entries.original: "Pokémon Storage"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Storage
entries.translated: Penyimpanan Pokémon

entries.original:
"Use [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of that pesky
tree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue].

Then head on up to [green]Blizzard City[blue] to
get [green]Rock Smash[blue] from my friend.

Best of luck on yer quest!"
entries.translation_source: Use [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of that pesky tree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue]. Then head on up to [green]Blizzard City[blue] to get [green]Rock Smash[blue] from my friend. Best of luck on yer quest!
entries.translated:
Gunakan [green]Cut[blue] untuk menyingkirkan
pohon mengganggu yang menghalangi\l[green]Valley Cave[blue]. Lalu pergilah ke

[green]Blizzard City[blue] untuk mendapatkan
[green]Rock Smash[blue] dari temanku. Semoga\lberhasil dalam petualanganmu!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya made contact with
my friend.

Now go over to those rocks and give
’em a good smashin’!"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya made contact with my friend. Now go over to those rocks and give ’em a good smashin’!
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Sepertinya kau sudah
menghubungi temanku. Sekarang\lpergilah ke batu-batu itu dan

hancurkan mereka!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya opened up a pathway
for yerself.

Now just keep heading [green]east[blue] until
you reach [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya opened up a pathway for yerself. Now just keep heading [green]east[blue] until you reach [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Sepertinya kau sudah
membuka jalan untuk dirimu sendiri.\lSekarang teruslah menuju [green]timur[blue]

sampai kamu mencapai [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

entries.original:
"These walls are full of treasure.

I make my living by digging it out
and selling as much as I can.

I’ve hit my limit for now, though,
so why don’t you try instead of me?

It’ll cost you $[green][buffer1][blue], but you’re
free to keep what you dig up!"
entries.translation_source: These walls are full of treasure. I make my living by digging it out and selling as much as I can. I’ve hit my limit for now, though, so why don’t you try instead of me? It’ll cost you $[green][buffer1][blue], but you’re free to keep what you dig up!
entries.translated:
Dinding-dinding ini penuh dengan
harta karun. Saya mencari nafkah\ldengan menggali dan menjual

sebanyak mungkin. Tapi saya sudah
mencapai batas untuk saat ini, jadi\lkenapa kamu tidak mencoba saja

daripada saya? Biayanya $[green][buffer1][blue],
tetapi kamu bebas menyimpan apa\lyang kamu gali!

entries.original:
"Why don’t you try mining instead
of me?

It’ll cost you $[green][buffer1][blue], but you’re
free to keep what you dig up!"
entries.translation_source: Why don’t you try mining instead of me? It’ll cost you $[green][buffer1][blue], but you’re free to keep what you dig up!
entries.translated:
Kenapa kamu tidak mencoba menambang
daripada saya? Biayanya $[green][buffer1][blue],\ltetapi kamu bebas menyimpan apa

yang kamu gali!

entries.original:
"When mining with my tools, you’ll
be able to find Hard Stones, Heart\lScales, Everstones, Evolution\lStones, Shards, and Revives.

You’ll probably dig up Hard Stones
or Everstones, but on the off\lchance you don’t\. you could\lscore big!"
entries.translation_source: When mining with my tools, you’ll be able to find Hard Stones, Heart Scales, Everstones, Evolution Stones, Shards, and Revives. You’ll probably dig up Hard Stones or Everstones, but on the off chance you don’t\. you could score big!
entries.translated:
Saat menambang dengan peralatanku,
kamu akan dapat menemukan Hard\lStones, Heart Scales, Everstones,

Evolution Stones, Shards, dan
Revives. Kamu mungkin akan menggali\lHard Stones atau Everstones, tetapi

jika kebetulan tidak\. kamu bisa
mendapat keuntungan besar!

entries.original:
"Okay, just face the wall to get
started!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, just face the wall to get started!
entries.translated:
Oke, hadapilah dinding untuk
memulai!

entries.original:
"With real machinery like an ADM,
the treasure you’d be able to find\lwould be of much higher quality.

But ADM’s are expensive, and I
can’t afford something like that!

But if you ever want to give
digging another go, you know\lwhere to find me."
entries.translation_source: With real machinery like an ADM, the treasure you’d be able to find would be of much higher quality. But ADM’s are expensive, and I can’t afford something like that! But if you ever want to give digging another go, you know where to find me.
entries.translated:
Dengan mesin sungguhan seperti ADM,
harta yang bisa kamu temukan akan\lberkualitas jauh lebih tinggi. Tapi

ADM itu mahal, dan aku tidak mampu
membeli barang seperti itu! Tapi\ljika kamu ingin mencoba menggali

lagi, kamu tahu di mana mencariku.

entries.original:
"If you ever want to give mining
another go, you know where to\lfind me."
entries.translation_source: If you ever want to give mining another go, you know where to find me.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin mencoba menambang
lagi, kamu tahu di mana mencariku.

entries.original:
"If you ever want to give mining
a go, you know where to find me."
entries.translation_source: If you ever want to give mining a go, you know where to find me.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin mencoba menambang,
kamu tahu di mana mencariku.

entries.original:
"Looks like you don’t have enough
money to pay me.

I can’t just let you do this
for free.

I’m not a saint, you know!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you don’t have enough money to pay me. I can’t just let you do this for free. I’m not a saint, you know!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak punya cukup
uang untuk membayarku. Aku tidak\lbisa membiarkanmu melakukannya

secara gratis. Aku bukan orang
suci, lho!

entries.original:
"These boulders have been placed
so strategically!

It’s almost as if someone doesn’t
want people going this way\lright now\."
entries.translation_source: These boulders have been placed so strategically! It’s almost as if someone doesn’t want people going this way right now\.
entries.translated:
Batu-batu besar ini ditempatkan
dengan sangat strategis! Sepertinya\lada yang tidak ingin orang melewati

jalan ini sekarang\.

entries.original:
"The boulders that were here!
They mysteriously vanished!

One moment I was standing here,
and the next thing I knew, they\lwere gone!

What could have happened to them?"
entries.translation_source: The boulders that were here! They mysteriously vanished! One moment I was standing here, and the next thing I knew, they were gone! What could have happened to them?
entries.translated:
Batu-batu besar yang ada di sini!
Mereka menghilang secara misterius!\lAwalnya aku berdiri di sini, dan

selanjutnya, mereka hilang! Apa
yang mungkin terjadi pada mereka?

entries.original:
"As soon as we finished the bridge
to this new entrance, the walls\lcracked open, and the sea water\lstarted flooding in!

Because why would we get a day off?"
entries.translation_source: As soon as we finished the bridge to this new entrance, the walls cracked open, and the sea water started flooding in! Because why would we get a day off?
entries.translated:
Begitu kami menyelesaikan jembatan
ke pintu masuk baru ini,\ldinding-dindingnya retak, dan air

laut mulai membanjiri! Karena
kenapa kami bisa dapat libur?

entries.original:
"This section of the tunnel will go
to Vivill Town when it’s completed.

We’re working as fast as we can,
but I have no idea when we’ll\lget there."
entries.translation_source: This section of the tunnel will go to Vivill Town when it’s completed. We’re working as fast as we can, but I have no idea when we’ll get there.
entries.translated:
Bagian terowongan ini akan menuju
ke Vivill Town setelah selesai.\lKami bekerja secepat mungkin, tapi

aku tidak tahu kapan kami akan
sampai di sana.

entries.original:
"The walls of the tunnel just keep
collapsing for some reason!

One of these days\. I swear\.

We’re going on strike!"
entries.translation_source: The walls of the tunnel just keep collapsing for some reason! One of these days\. I swear\. We’re going on strike!
entries.translated:
Dinding-dinding terowongan terus
runtuh entah karena apa! Suatu hari\lnanti\. Aku bersumpah\. Kami akan mogok

kerja!

entries.original:
"This section of the Expressway was
intentionally blocked off due to\lthe high crime rate in Antisis\lCity.

If you’re stuck here without a way
back home, I can teleport you over\lthe blockage.

Would you like that?"
entries.translation_source: This section of the Expressway was intentionally blocked off due to the high crime rate in Antisis City. If you’re stuck here without a way back home, I can teleport you over the blockage. Would you like that?
entries.translated:
Bagian dari Expressway ini sengaja
diblokir karena tingginya tingkat\lkejahatan di Antisis City. Jika

kamu terjebak di sini tanpa cara
untuk pulang, aku bisa\lmemindahkanmu melewati penghalang

itu. Apakah kamu mau?

entries.original:
"Okay, here we go!

Solosis, Duosion, Alakazam!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, here we go! Solosis, Duosion, Alakazam!
entries.translated:
Oke, kita mulai! Solosis, Duosion,
Alakazam!

entries.original: "Stay safe in Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: Stay safe in Antisis City.
entries.translated: Tetap aman di Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Workers of Borrius unite!

We must unionize to fight against
the constant collapse of the KBT\lExpressway walls!"
entries.translation_source: Workers of Borrius unite! We must unionize to fight against the constant collapse of the KBT Expressway walls!
entries.translated:
Para pekerja Borrius bersatu! Kita
harus berserikat untuk melawan\lruntuhnya dinding KBT Expressway

yang terus-menerus!

entries.original:
"We’re sick and tired of water
flooding the KBT Expressway!

We’re going on strike until we can
be assured it won’t happen again!"
entries.translation_source: We’re sick and tired of water flooding the KBT Expressway! We’re going on strike until we can be assured it won’t happen again!
entries.translated:
Kami muak dan lelah dengan air yang
membanjiri KBT Expressway! Kami\lakan mogok kerja sampai kami

diyakinkan hal itu tidak akan
terjadi lagi!

entries.original:
"No one’s getting through here until
we’re done protesting!"
entries.translation_source: No one’s getting through here until we’re done protesting!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang bisa lewat sini
sampai kami selesai protes!

entries.original:
"If regular people like you aren’t
suffering because of our protest,\lthen it’s meaningless!"
entries.translation_source: If regular people like you aren’t suffering because of our protest, then it’s meaningless!
entries.translated:
Jika orang biasa sepertimu tidak
menderita karena protes kami, maka\litu tidak berarti!

entries.original:
"Are you being inconvenienced?

Good.

That means our protest is working."
entries.translation_source: Are you being inconvenienced? Good. That means our protest is working.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu merasa terganggu?
Bagus. Itu berarti protes kami\lberhasil.

entries.original:
"No one is allowed to go this way
right now.

Scram, kid!"
entries.translation_source: No one is allowed to go this way right now. Scram, kid!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang diizinkan lewat sini
sekarang. Pergi, nak!

entries.original:
"This wall looks weak!

Charge the ADM with [buffer2] [buffer1]
to knock it down?"
entries.translation_source: This wall looks weak! Charge the ADM with [buffer2] [buffer1] to knock it down?
entries.translated:
Dinding ini tampak lemah! Isi daya
ADM dengan [buffer2] [buffer1] untuk\lmerobohkannya?

entries.original: "The ADM broke through the rubble!"
entries.translation_source: The ADM broke through the rubble!
entries.translated: ADM menerobos puing-puing!

entries.original:
"This wall looks weak!
Could something dig through it?"
entries.translation_source: This wall looks weak! Could something dig through it?
entries.translated:
Dinding ini terlihat lemah!
Mungkinkah sesuatu bisa menggali\lmenembusnya?

entries.original:
"This wall looks weak!

If charged with [green][buffer2] [buffer1][black], the
ADM could knock it down."
entries.translation_source: This wall looks weak! If charged with [green][buffer2] [buffer1][black], the ADM could knock it down.
entries.translated:
Dinding ini terlihat lemah! Jika
diisi dengan [green][buffer2] [buffer1][black], ADM\lbisa merobohkannya.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon will learn
[buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon will learn [buffer1]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang akan mempelajari
[buffer1]?

entries.original:
"This Gem Family member is
disappointed."
entries.translation_source: This Gem Family member is disappointed.
entries.translated: Anggota Gem Family ini kecewa.

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough
[green][buffer2]s."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough [green][buffer2]s.
entries.translated: Kamu tidak memiliki cukup [green][buffer2].

entries.original:
"Score!
More Gems for our family!"
entries.translation_source: Score! More Gems for our family!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Lebih banyak Permata untuk
keluarga kita!

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother that
loves his Ratatta!

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother that loves his Ratatta! I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family yang
mencintai Ratatta-nya! Saya bisa\lmengajarkan [green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon

seharga [green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother with
powerful fists.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother with powerful fists. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family
dengan tinju yang kuat. Saya bisa\lmengajarkan [green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon

seharga [green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother with
wings of light.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother with wings of light. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family
dengan sayap cahaya. Saya bisa\lmengajarkan [green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon

seharga [green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother with
the toxic disposition.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother with the toxic disposition. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family
dengan sifat beracun. Saya bisa\lmengajarkan [green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon

seharga [green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother in
tune with the earth.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother in tune with the earth. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family yang
selaras dengan bumi. Saya bisa\lmengajarkan [green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon

seharga [green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother with
a stone cold heart.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother with a stone cold heart. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family
dengan hati yang dingin seperti\lbatu. Saya bisa mengajarkan

[green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon seharga
[green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother that
simply loves insects.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother that simply loves insects. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family yang
sangat menyukai serangga. Saya bisa\lmengajarkan [green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon

seharga [green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family sister that can
communicate with spirits.

I can teach [green][buffer1][red] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[red]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family sister that can communicate with spirits. I can teach [green][buffer1][red] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[red].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudari Gem Family yang
bisa berkomunikasi dengan roh. Saya\lbisa mengajarkan [green][buffer1][red] kepada

Pokémon seharga [green][buffer3] [buffer2][red].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother that has
an iron-clad will.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother that has an iron-clad will. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family yang
memiliki kemauan baja. Saya bisa\lmengajarkan [green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon

seharga [green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother that’s
a pyromaniac.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother that’s a pyromaniac. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family yang
piromania. Saya bisa mengajarkan\l[green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon seharga

[green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"I’m the Gem Family brother that
would rather be outside by the sea.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother that would rather be outside by the sea. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara Gem Family yang

[green][buffer3] [buffer2][blue].

smells the best.

I can teach [green][buffer1][red] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[red]."

Saya adalah saudari Gem Family yang
paling wangi. Saya bisa mengajarkan\l[green][buffer1][red] kepada Pokémon seharga

[green][buffer3] [buffer2][red].

entries.original:

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."

[buffer2][blue].

Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."

I can teach [green][buffer1][red] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[red]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family sister that loves playing in the snow. I can teach [green][buffer1][red] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[red].

Gem yang suka bermain di salju. Aku\lbisa mengajari [green][buffer1][red] pada

detik[red].

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother that roars with his Dragons! I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:

Gem yang mengaum dengan\lNaga-naganya! Aku bisa mengajari

[green][buffer3] [buffer2] detik[blue].

entries.original:

likes to skulk around in the dark.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother that likes to skulk around in the dark. I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Aku adalah saudara dari Keluarga
Gem yang suka mengendap-endap di\lkegelapan. Aku bisa mengajari

[green][buffer1][blue] pada Pokémon seharga
[green][buffer3] [buffer2] detik[blue].

magical fairy princess!

I can teach [green][buffer1][red] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[red]."

entries.translated:
Aku adalah saudari dari Keluarga
Gem yang merupakan putri peri\lajaib! Aku bisa mengajari [green][buffer1][red]

pada Pokémon seharga [green][buffer3]
[buffer2] detik[red].

entries.original: "The West Borrius Pokédex"
entries.translation_source: The West Borrius Pokédex
entries.translated: Pokédex Borrius Barat

entries.original: "The National Pokédex"
entries.translation_source: The National Pokédex
entries.translated: Pokédex Nasional

entries.original:
"You should visit your [green]mother[blue] before
getting my package, [player].

She is likely very worried
about you."
entries.translation_source: You should visit your [green]mother[blue] before getting my package, [player]. She is likely very worried about you.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus mengunjungi [green]ibumu[blue]
sebelum mengambil paketku,\l[player]. Dia mungkin sangat

khawatir padamu.

entries.original:
"Please get my package from the
[green]Bellin Town Poké Mart[blue], [player].

I need it, and only you can get it."
entries.translation_source: Please get my package from the [green]Bellin Town Poké Mart[blue], [player]. I need it, and only you can get it.
entries.translated:
Tolong ambil paketku dari [green]Bellin
Town Poké Mart[blue], [player]. Aku\lmembutuhkannya, dan hanya kamu yang

bisa mengambilnya.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]!
You returned with my package!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player]! You returned with my package!
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Kamu kembali dengan
paketku!

entries.original: "[black][player] delivered the parcel."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] delivered the parcel.
entries.translated: [black][player] mengantarkan paketnya.

entries.original:
"Now, let me check if they sent what
they were supposed to.

New research equipment\.\CC0820
check.

The latest in Pokémon science\.\CC0820
check.

\.\CC0820Huh?

Where are the Master Balls?

Did you open this package and take
anything from it, [player]?

\.

Ah\.\CC0818 I see.

You recovered my package from
some thugs\.

And they must have taken the
Master Balls\."
entries.translation_source: Now, let me check if they sent what they were supposed to. New research equipment\.\CC0820 check. The latest in Pokémon science\.\CC0820 check. \.\CC0820Huh? Where are the Master Balls? Did you open this package and take anything from it, [player]? \. Ah\.\CC0818 I see. You recovered my package from some thugs\. And they must have taken the Master Balls\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, biarkan aku periksa
apakah mereka mengirim apa yang\lseharusnya. Peralatan penelitian

baru\.\CC0820 cek. Ilmu pengetahuan Pokémon
terbaru\.\CC0820 cek. \.\CC0820Huh? Di mana Master\lBall-nya? Apakah kamu membuka paket

ini dan mengambil sesuatu darinya,
[player]? \. Ah\.\CC0818 Aku mengerti. Kamu\lmendapatkan kembali paketku dari

beberapa penjahat\. Dan mereka pasti
telah mengambil Master Ball-nya\.

entries.original:
"What!?

You saw them use one to capture
Articuno?

Hmm\.

If I’m correct, we could be in
grave danger\."
entries.translation_source: What!? You saw them use one to capture Articuno? Hmm\. If I’m correct, we could be in grave danger\.
entries.translated:
Apa!? Kamu melihat mereka
menggunakannya untuk menangkap\lArticuno? Hmm\. Jika aku benar, kita

bisa dalam bahaya besar\.

entries.original:
"I have one more errand for you
to run, [player].

An old friend of mine lives in
[green]Dresco Town[blue].

He has a vast knowledge of Borrian
history.

I need you to tell him everything
that has transpired thus far.

I have a theory about what is going
on, but I need him to confirm it.

You have your own Pokémon now, so
this shouldn’t be too difficult.

You can get to [green]Dresco Town[blue] by going
through [green]Icicle Cave[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I have one more errand for you to run, [player]. An old friend of mine lives in [green]Dresco Town[blue]. He has a vast knowledge of Borrian history. I need you to tell him everything that has transpired thus far. I have a theory about what is going on, but I need him to confirm it. You have your own Pokémon now, so this shouldn’t be too difficult. You can get to [green]Dresco Town[blue] by going through [green]Icicle Cave[blue].
entries.translated:
Aku punya satu tugas lagi untukmu,
[player]. Seorang teman lamaku\ltinggal di [green]Dresco Town[blue]. Dia

memiliki pengetahuan luas tentang
sejarah Borrius. Aku ingin kamu\lmenceritakan semua yang telah

terjadi sejauh ini. Aku punya teori
tentang apa yang sedang terjadi,\ltapi aku butuh dia untuk

mengonfirmasinya. Kamu sudah
memiliki Pokémon sendiri sekarang,\ljadi ini seharusnya tidak terlalu

sulit. Kamu bisa sampai ke [green]Dresco
Town[blue] dengan melewati [green]Icicle Cave[blue].

entries.original:
"Oh!
Silly me!

How can I expect you to find [green]Icicle
Cave[blue] if you don’t know the way?

This [green]Town Map[blue] should aid you
immensely!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! Silly me! How can I expect you to find [green]Icicle Cave[blue] if you don’t know the way? This [green]Town Map[blue] should aid you immensely!
entries.translated:
Oh! Bodohnya aku! Bagaimana aku
bisa mengharapkan kamu menemukan\l[green]Icicle Cave[blue] jika kamu tidak tahu

jalannya? [green]Peta Kota[blue] ini akan sangat
membantumu!

entries.original:
"Now, let’s take a look at the
Town Map, shall we?"
entries.translation_source: Now, let’s take a look at the Town Map, shall we?
entries.translated:
Sekarang, mari kita lihat Peta
Kota, ya?

entries.original:
"Did you notice the yellow X over
Dresco Town?

That marker will automatically move
when you have a new destination."
entries.translation_source: Did you notice the yellow X over Dresco Town? That marker will automatically move when you have a new destination.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat tanda X kuning
di atas Dresco Town? Penanda itu\lakan bergerak secara otomatis saat

kamu memiliki tujuan baru.

entries.original:
"Did you notice the yellow X over
Dresco Town?

That marker will automatically move
when you have a new destination.

And you know what?

Now that you have your own Mission
Log, allow me to record my request\lfrom earlier!

First, you should aim to see every
Pokémon in the Borrius Pokédex.

Or, as it’s more commonly known,
the West Borrius Pokédex.

Pokémon that only appear in East
Borrius are conspicuously left out."
entries.translation_source: Did you notice the yellow X over Dresco Town? That marker will automatically move when you have a new destination. And you know what? Now that you have your own Mission Log, allow me to record my request from earlier! First, you should aim to see every Pokémon in the Borrius Pokédex. Or, as it’s more commonly known, the West Borrius Pokédex. Pokémon that only appear in East Borrius are conspicuously left out.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat tanda X kuning
di atas Dresco Town? Penanda itu\lakan bergerak secara otomatis saat

kamu memiliki tujuan baru. Dan
tahukah kamu? Sekarang setelah kamu\lmemiliki Mission Log sendiri,

izinkan aku mencatat permintaanku
dari tadi! Pertama, kamu harus\lbertujuan untuk melihat setiap

Pokémon di Pokédex Borrius. Atau,
seperti yang lebih dikenal, Pokédex\lBorrius Barat. Pokémon yang hanya

muncul di Borrius Timur sengaja
ditinggalkan.

entries.original:
"Once you’ve completed that task,
aim to capture every Pokémon\llisted in the Pokédex!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: Once you’ve completed that task, aim to capture every Pokémon listed in the Pokédex! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Setelah kamu menyelesaikan tugas
itu, bertujuan untuk menangkap\lsetiap Pokémon yang terdaftar di

Pokédex! Ho ho ho!

entries.original:
"Additionally, my younger sister,
Natasha Log, lives in [green]Blizzard City[blue].

If you ever meet her, she can
upgrade your Pokédex and make it\leasier for you to encounter\lPokémon you are looking for."
entries.translation_source: Additionally, my younger sister, Natasha Log, lives in [green]Blizzard City[blue]. If you ever meet her, she can upgrade your Pokédex and make it easier for you to encounter Pokémon you are looking for.
entries.translated:
Selain itu, adik perempuanku,
Natasha Log, tinggal di [green]Blizzard\lCity[blue]. Jika kamu bertemu dengannya,

dia bisa meningkatkan Pokédex-mu
dan membuatmu lebih mudah bertemu\lPokémon yang kamu cari.

entries.original:
"Oh!

My memory seems to be going\. I
have one more thing to give you.

Please, the next time you see
[rival], give him this Pokédex."
entries.translation_source: Oh! My memory seems to be going\. I have one more thing to give you. Please, the next time you see [rival], give him this Pokédex.
entries.translated:
Oh! Ingatanku sepertinya mulai
hilang\. Aku punya satu hal lagi\luntuk diberikan padamu. Tolong,

lain kali kamu bertemu [rival],
berikan dia Pokédex ini.

entries.original:
"He’s been rather cold to me ever
since he arrived here, but he seems\lto get along fine with you.

I’m sure if you give him the
Pokédex, he’d be willing to assist."
entries.translation_source: He’s been rather cold to me ever since he arrived here, but he seems to get along fine with you. I’m sure if you give him the Pokédex, he’d be willing to assist.
entries.translated:
Dia agak dingin padaku sejak tiba
di sini, tapi dia tampak akrab\ldenganmu. Aku yakin jika kau

berikan dia Pokédex, dia akan
bersedia membantu.

entries.original:
"Please visit my friend in [green]Dresco
Town[blue], [player].

I’m counting on you."
entries.translation_source: Please visit my friend in [green]Dresco Town[blue], [player]. I’m counting on you.
entries.translated:
Tolong kunjungi temanku di [green]Dresco
Town[blue], [player]. Aku mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"[player], you need to hurry to
[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]!

If the Shadows get there before
you, Borrius is doomed!

Head north of town and take the [green]KBT
Expressway[blue] far [green]south[blue] to go quickly."
entries.translation_source: [player], you need to hurry to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]! If the Shadows get there before you, Borrius is doomed! Head north of town and take the [green]KBT Expressway[blue] far [green]south[blue] to go quickly.
entries.translated:
[player], kau harus cepat ke
[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]! Jika Shadows sampai\ldi sana sebelummu, Borrius akan

hancur! Pergi ke utara kota dan
ambil [green]KBT Expressway[blue] jauh ke\l[green]selatan[blue] agar cepat.

entries.original:
"Ho ho ho!

[player]!
I heard the wonderful news!

Now that Zapdos is safe, we can
all rest easy at night.

But don’t fret, your errands are
not completed yet!

You must now retrieve Articuno and
Moltres from the Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Ho ho ho! [player]! I heard the wonderful news! Now that Zapdos is safe, we can all rest easy at night. But don’t fret, your errands are not completed yet! You must now retrieve Articuno and Moltres from the Shadows.
entries.translated:
Ho ho ho! [player]! Aku dengar
kabar baik! Kini Zapdos aman, kita\lsemua bisa tidur tenang. Tapi

jangan khawatir, tugasmu belum
selesai! Kau harus mengambil\lArticuno dan Moltres dari Shadows.

entries.original:
"Now that the dark force has been
released, the end of Borrius\lis near.

[player]!

You need to find Jax and help him
seal away the power once more!"
entries.translation_source: Now that the dark force has been released, the end of Borrius is near. [player]! You need to find Jax and help him seal away the power once more!
entries.translated:
Kini kekuatan gelap telah
dilepaskan, akhir Borrius sudah\ldekat. [player]! Kau harus

menemukan Jax dan membantu menyegel
kekuatan itu sekali lagi!

entries.original:
"[player]!

You saved Borrius!
You saved us all!

Thank you!

Your father would be proud of you,
Guardian of Borrius.

Unfortunately, I have no more
errands for you to run.

Have you considered taking on the
[green]Pokémon League[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: [player]! You saved Borrius! You saved us all! Thank you! Your father would be proud of you, Guardian of Borrius. Unfortunately, I have no more errands for you to run. Have you considered taking on the [green]Pokémon League[blue]?
entries.translated:
[player]! Kau menyelamatkan
Borrius! Kau menyelamatkan kita\lsemua! Terima kasih! Ayahmu pasti

bangga padamu, Pelindung Borrius.
Sayangnya, aku tidak punya tugas\llagi untukmu. Apakah kau sudah

mempertimbangkan untuk menghadapi
[green]Pokémon League[blue]?

entries.original:
"[player]!
It’s good to see you!

How goes the hunt for the
mysterious portals?"
entries.translation_source: [player]! It’s good to see you! How goes the hunt for the mysterious portals?
entries.translated:
[player]! Senang bertemu denganmu!
Bagaimana perburuan portal\lmisterius?

entries.original:
"My, oh, my!

You’ve done it!
You’ve actually done it!

You’ve completed the National
Pokédex!

But if you want the reward for your
excellent work, you’ll need to make\lspace in your party for it."
entries.translation_source: My, oh, my! You’ve done it! You’ve actually done it! You’ve completed the National Pokédex! But if you want the reward for your excellent work, you’ll need to make space in your party for it.
entries.translated:
Wah, wah, wah! Kau berhasil! Kau
benar-benar berhasil! Kau telah\lmenyelesaikan National Pokédex!

Tapi jika kau ingin hadiah untuk
kerja bagusmu, kau perlu\lmengosongkan tempat di timmu

untuknya.

entries.original:
"My, oh, my!

What a wonderful set of species
you’ve recorded there in your\lWest Borrius Pokédex!

They certainly all have some very
nice stats.

For your excellent work, my friend
has requested that I entrust this\lto you."
entries.translation_source: My, oh, my! What a wonderful set of species you’ve recorded there in your West Borrius Pokédex! They certainly all have some very nice stats. For your excellent work, my friend has requested that I entrust this to you.
entries.translated:
Wah, wah, wah! Kumpulan spesies
yang luar biasa yang kau catat di\lWest Borrius Pokédex-mu! Mereka

pasti memiliki stat yang bagus.
Untuk kerja bagusmu, temanku\lmemintaku untuk memberikan ini

padamu.

entries.original:
"That charm will aid you immensely
in your task of completing the\lNational Pokédex.

Come see me again when you’ve
done that!"
entries.translation_source: That charm will aid you immensely in your task of completing the National Pokédex. Come see me again when you’ve done that!
entries.translated:
Jimat itu akan sangat membantumu
dalam tugas menyelesaikan National\lPokédex. Datang lagi menemuiku

setelah kau melakukannya!

entries.original:
"My, oh, my!

You’ve done it!
You’ve actually done it!

You’ve completed the National
Pokédex!

Ho ho ho!

My friend will be beyond words for
your simply unparalleled work.

As a reward, you deserve nothing
less than this rare Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: My, oh, my! You’ve done it! You’ve actually done it! You’ve completed the National Pokédex! Ho ho ho! My friend will be beyond words for your simply unparalleled work. As a reward, you deserve nothing less than this rare Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Wah, wah, wah! Kau berhasil! Kau
benar-benar berhasil! Kau telah\lmenyelesaikan National Pokédex! Ho

ho ho! Temanku akan tak bisa
berkata-kata untuk kerja mu yang\ltak tertandingi. Sebagai hadiah,

kau pantas mendapatkan Pokémon
langka ini.

entries.original:
"[blue]Although you have already managed
to capture every Pokémon, I’m sure\lyou don’t have one that looks quite\llike that one yet!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Although you have already managed to capture every Pokémon, I’m sure you don’t have one that looks quite like that one yet!
entries.translated:
[blue]Meskipun kau sudah berhasil
menangkap setiap Pokémon, aku yakin\lkau belum punya yang terlihat

seperti itu!

entries.original:
"What are you doing?

I told you to check in with your
mother!

\.

Don’t look at me like that.

Didn’t your mother ever teach you
to listen to your elders?

Go see her!"
entries.translation_source: What are you doing? I told you to check in with your mother! \. Don’t look at me like that. Didn’t your mother ever teach you to listen to your elders? Go see her!
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau lakukan? Aku bilang
periksa dengan ibumu! \. Jangan lihat\laku seperti itu. Apa ibumu tidak

pernah mengajarimu untuk
mendengarkan orang yang lebih tua?\lTemui dia!

entries.original:
"Pokémon have hidden stat potential
that determines how well their\lstats grow.

This potential is indicated by a
letter grading in a Pokémon’s\l[green]summary[blue].

[green]S[blue] represents the best possible
value, while [green]E-[blue] represents the\lworst."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon have hidden stat potential that determines how well their stats grow. This potential is indicated by a letter grading in a Pokémon’s [green]summary[blue]. [green]S[blue] represents the best possible value, while [green]E-[blue] represents the worst.
entries.translated:
Pokémon memiliki potensi stat
tersembunyi yang menentukan\lseberapa baik stat mereka tumbuh.

Potensi ini ditunjukkan dengan
peringkat huruf di [green]ringkasan[blue]\lPokémon. [green]S[blue] mewakili nilai terbaik,

sementara [green]E-[blue] mewakili yang
terburuk.

entries.original:
"Pokémon have hidden stat potential
that determines how well their\lstats grow.

And if you become Champion, an
indicator for this potential will\lappear in your Pokémon’s summary!

Unless\.\CC0818 you’d like to see them on
the summary screen now?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon have hidden stat potential that determines how well their stats grow. And if you become Champion, an indicator for this potential will appear in your Pokémon’s summary! Unless\.\CC0818 you’d like to see them on the summary screen now?
entries.translated:
Pokémon memiliki potensi stat
tersembunyi yang menentukan\lseberapa baik stat mereka tumbuh.

Dan jika kau menjadi Juara,
indikator untuk potensi ini akan\lmuncul di ringkasan Pokémon-mu!

Kecuali\.\CC0818 kau ingin melihatnya di
layar ringkasan sekarang?

entries.original:
"Smart choice, [player]!

Just be happy with the Pokémon
you catch!"
entries.translation_source: Smart choice, [player]! Just be happy with the Pokémon you catch!
entries.translated:
Pilihan cerdas, [player]! Nikmati
saja Pokémon yang kau tangkap!

entries.original:
"Alright, [player].

Your Pokémon’s potential is now
indicated by a letter grading in\ltheir [green]summaries[blue].

[green]S[blue] represents the best possible
value, while [green]E-[blue] represents the\lworst.

If you’d ever like to hide them,
don’t hesitate to ask, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Alright, [player]. Your Pokémon’s potential is now indicated by a letter grading in their [green]summaries[blue]. [green]S[blue] represents the best possible value, while [green]E-[blue] represents the worst. If you’d ever like to hide them, don’t hesitate to ask, [player].
entries.translated:
Baiklah, [player]. Potensi
Pokémon-mu sekarang ditunjukkan\ldengan peringkat huruf di [green]ringkasan[blue]

mereka. [green]S[blue] mewakili nilai terbaik,
sementara [green]E-[blue] mewakili yang\lterburuk. Jika suatu saat kau ingin

menyembunyikannya, jangan ragu
untuk bertanya, [player].

entries.original:
"Pokémon have hidden stat potential
that determines how well their\lstats grow.

This potential is indicated by a
letter grading in a Pokémon’s\l[green]summary[blue].

[green]S[blue] represents the best possible
value, while [green]E-[blue] represents the\lworst.

Would you like to hide these rankings
until you become Champion?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon have hidden stat potential that determines how well their stats grow. This potential is indicated by a letter grading in a Pokémon’s [green]summary[blue]. [green]S[blue] represents the best possible value, while [green]E-[blue] represents the worst. Would you like to hide these rankings until you become Champion?
entries.translated:
Pokémon memiliki potensi stat
tersembunyi yang menentukan\lseberapa baik stat mereka tumbuh.

Potensi ini ditunjukkan dengan
peringkat huruf di [green]ringkasan[blue]\lPokémon. [green]S[blue] mewakili nilai terbaik,

sementara [green]E-[blue] mewakili yang
terburuk. Apakah kau ingin\lmenyembunyikan peringkat ini sampai

kau menjadi Juara?

entries.original:
"If you’d ever like to hide them,
don’t hesitate to ask, [player]."
entries.translation_source: If you’d ever like to hide them, don’t hesitate to ask, [player].
entries.translated:
Jika suatu saat kau ingin
menyembunyikannya, jangan ragu\luntuk bertanya, [player].

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Did you know your Pokémon have
hidden stats called [green]Effort Values[blue]\land [green]Individual Values[blue]?

I can show you those stats if
you’d like!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player]! Did you know your Pokémon have hidden stats called [green]Effort Values[blue] and [green]Individual Values[blue]? I can show you those stats if you’d like!
entries.translated:
Hai, [player]! Tahukah kau bahwa
Pokémon-mu memiliki stat\ltersembunyi yang disebut [green]Nilai

Usaha[blue] dan [green]Nilai Individu[blue]? Aku bisa
menunjukkan stat itu jika kau mau!

entries.original:
"What’s that?

You want this device for yourself?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? You want this device for yourself?
entries.translated:
Ada apa? Kamu menginginkan
perangkat ini untuk dirimu sendiri?

entries.original:
"Of course you can have this
device!

You have been a huge asset to
Prof. Log, after all!"
entries.translation_source: Of course you can have this device! You have been a huge asset to Prof. Log, after all!
entries.translated:
Tentu saja kamu boleh memiliki
perangkat ini! Bagaimanapun, kamu\ltelah menjadi aset besar bagi Prof.

Log!

entries.original:
"I’ll have you know, Prof. Log and I
toiled day and night to create\lthis device!

I can’t just go around handing it
out to just anyone, you know!

However\.

If you were to satisfy part of 
Prof. Log’s request\.

Say\. register at least [green][buffer1][blue] 
different species as [green]captured[blue] in\lyour Pokédex?

If you can do that, I will let you
have this device."
entries.translation_source: I’ll have you know, Prof. Log and I toiled day and night to create this device! I can’t just go around handing it out to just anyone, you know! However\. If you were to satisfy part of Prof. Log’s request\. Say\. register at least [green][buffer1][blue] different species as [green]captured[blue] in your Pokédex? If you can do that, I will let you have this device.
entries.translated:
Begini lho, Prof. Log dan saya
bekerja siang dan malam untuk\lmenciptakan perangkat ini! Saya

tidak bisa sembarangan
memberikannya kepada sembarang\lorang, kamu tahu! Namun\. Jika kamu

memenuhi sebagian permintaan Prof.
Log\. Misalnya\. daftarkan setidaknya\l[green][buffer1][blue] spesies berbeda sebagai

[green]ditangkap[blue] di Pokédex-mu? Jika kamu
bisa melakukannya, saya akan\lmemberimu perangkat ini.

entries.original:
"With the [green]Stat Scanner[blue], you can
view your Pokémon’s hidden stats\lanywhere in the region!

You can even view the moves it can
learn by pressing \btn02 or \btn03!

Oh, and for convenience’s sake, you
can also open it quickly from your\l[green]party list[blue] by pressing \btn03."
entries.translation_source: With the [green]Stat Scanner[blue], you can view your Pokémon’s hidden stats anywhere in the region! You can even view the moves it can learn by pressing \btn02 or \btn03! Oh, and for convenience’s sake, you can also open it quickly from your [green]party list[blue] by pressing \btn03.
entries.translated:
Dengan [green]Stat Scanner[blue], kamu bisa
melihat statistik tersembunyi\lPokémon-mu di mana saja di region!

Kamu bahkan bisa melihat jurus yang
bisa dipelajari dengan menekan \btn02\latau \btn03! Oh, dan demi kenyamanan,

kamu juga bisa membukanya dengan
cepat dari [green]daftar tim[blue] dengan\lmenekan \btn03.

entries.original:
"My notebook!

You found it!

I had recorded the different people
in Borrius who could teach your\lPokémon moves inside the book,\lbut I must’ve misplaced it.

Now that you found it, hand back
your Stat Scanner for a moment."
entries.translation_source: My notebook! You found it! I had recorded the different people in Borrius who could teach your Pokémon moves inside the book, but I must’ve misplaced it. Now that you found it, hand back your Stat Scanner for a moment.
entries.translated:
Buku catatanku! Kamu menemukannya!
Aku mencatat berbagai orang di\lBorrius yang bisa mengajari

Pokémon-mu jurus di dalam buku,
tapi sepertinya aku salah\lmeletakkannya. Sekarang kamu sudah

menemukannya, kembalikan Stat
Scanner-mu sebentar.

entries.original:
"My notebook!

You found it!

I had recorded the different people
in Borrius who could teach your\lPokémon moves inside the book,\lbut I must’ve misplaced it.

Please, take these as my thanks!"
entries.translation_source: My notebook! You found it! I had recorded the different people in Borrius who could teach your Pokémon moves inside the book, but I must’ve misplaced it. Please, take these as my thanks!
entries.translated:
Buku catatanku! Kamu menemukannya!
Aku mencatat berbagai orang di\lBorrius yang bisa mengajari

Pokémon-mu jurus di dalam buku,
tapi sepertinya aku salah\lmeletakkannya. Silakan, terimalah

ini sebagai ucapan terima kasihku!

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the Notebook
and the Stat Scanner."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over the Notebook and the Stat Scanner.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan Buku Catatan
dan Stat Scanner.

entries.original: "[black][player] handed over the Notebook."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over the Notebook.
entries.translated: [black][player] menyerahkan Buku Catatan.

entries.original:
"Okay! The upgrades are all done!
Please take back your Stat Scanner."
entries.translation_source: Okay! The upgrades are all done! Please take back your Stat Scanner.
entries.translated:
Oke! Semua peningkatan sudah
selesai! Silakan ambil kembali Stat\lScanner-mu.

entries.original: "[black][player] took back the Stat Scanner."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] took back the Stat Scanner.
entries.translated:
[black][player] mengambil kembali Stat
Scanner.

entries.original:
"With the upgraded [green]Stat Scanner[blue], not
only can you view your Pokémon’s\lhidden stats and moves anywhere in\lthe region, you can also teach\lyour Pokémon moves that would\lotherwise require you to visit a\lcertain place or person!

Just press \btn02 or \btn03 to view the
moves, and then pick one to teach\lwith \btn00.

And of course, for convenience’s
sake, you can still open it quickly\lfrom your [green]party list[blue] with \btn03."
entries.translation_source: With the upgraded [green]Stat Scanner[blue], not only can you view your Pokémon’s hidden stats and moves anywhere in the region, you can also teach your Pokémon moves that would otherwise require you to visit a certain place or person! Just press \btn02 or \btn03 to view the moves, and then pick one to teach with \btn00. And of course, for convenience’s sake, you can still open it quickly from your [green]party list[blue] with \btn03.
entries.translated:
Dengan [green]Stat Scanner[blue] yang
ditingkatkan, kamu tidak hanya bisa\lmelihat statistik tersembunyi dan

jurus Pokémon-mu di mana saja di
region, tetapi kamu juga bisa\lmengajari Pokémon-mu jurus yang

biasanya membutuhkan kunjungan ke
tempat atau orang tertentu! Cukup\ltekan \btn02 atau \btn03 untuk melihat jurus,

lalu pilih satu untuk diajarkan
dengan \btn00. Dan tentunya, demi\lkenyamanan, kamu masih bisa

membukanya dengan cepat dari [green]daftar
tim[blue] dengan \btn03.

entries.original:
"[player], I have wonderful news
for you!

Thanks to the help of\.\CC0818 a certain
organization, I have cracked the\lcode for altering Pokémon stats!

Please, hand over your Stat Scanner
for a moment."
entries.translation_source: [player], I have wonderful news for you! Thanks to the help of\.\CC0818 a certain organization, I have cracked the code for altering Pokémon stats! Please, hand over your Stat Scanner for a moment.
entries.translated:
[player], aku punya kabar baik
untukmu! Berkat bantuan dari\.\CC0818 sebuah\lorganisasi tertentu, aku telah

berhasil memecahkan kode untuk
mengubah statistik Pokémon! Tolong,\lserahkan Stat Scanner-mu sebentar.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the
Stat Scanner."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over the Stat Scanner.
entries.translated: [black][player] menyerahkan Stat Scanner.

entries.original:
"With the fully upgraded [green]Stat
Scanner[blue], you can modify virtually\lany aspect of your Pokémon!

Just press \btn00 on the Pokémon you
wish to edit, and you’ll be able to\lalter its Ability, Nature, Gender,\lLevel, EVs, IVs, and even its\lHidden Power with ease!

And of course, after pressing \btn02 or
\btn03, you can still teach your\lPokémon new attacks."
entries.translation_source: With the fully upgraded [green]Stat Scanner[blue], you can modify virtually any aspect of your Pokémon! Just press \btn00 on the Pokémon you wish to edit, and you’ll be able to alter its Ability, Nature, Gender, Level, EVs, IVs, and even its Hidden Power with ease! And of course, after pressing \btn02 or \btn03, you can still teach your Pokémon new attacks.
entries.translated:
Dengan [green]Stat Scanner[blue] yang sepenuhnya
ditingkatkan, kamu bisa\lmemodifikasi hampir semua aspek

Pokémon-mu! Cukup tekan \btn00 pada
Pokémon yang ingin kamu edit, dan\lkamu bisa mengubah Ability, Nature,

Gender, Level, EVs, IVs, dan bahkan
Hidden Power-nya dengan mudah! Dan\ltentu saja, setelah menekan \btn02 atau

\btn03, kamu masih bisa mengajari
Pokémon-mu serangan baru.

entries.original:
"Feel free to come back and view
your Pokémon’s stats any time."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to come back and view your Pokémon’s stats any time.
entries.translated:
Jangan ragu untuk kembali dan
melihat statistik Pokémon-mu kapan\lsaja.

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Did you know your Pokémon stats
can grow in more ways that just by\lleveling up?

When you defeat Pokémon in battle,
your team will gain hidden stats\lcorresponding to the Pokémon you\ldefeated.

These stats can also be increased
by using vitamins like Protein.

In fact, Prof. Log and I developed
a device capable of viewing these\lhidden stats, but a [green]vanilla[blue] Trainer\llike you shouldn’t worry about them\lat all.

So just go out and enjoy using
whatever you catch!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player]! Did you know your Pokémon stats can grow in more ways that just by leveling up? When you defeat Pokémon in battle, your team will gain hidden stats corresponding to the Pokémon you defeated. These stats can also be increased by using vitamins like Protein. In fact, Prof. Log and I developed a device capable of viewing these hidden stats, but a [green]vanilla[blue] Trainer like you shouldn’t worry about them at all. So just go out and enjoy using whatever you catch!
entries.translated:
Hai, [player]! Tahukah kamu bahwa
statistik Pokémon-mu bisa tumbuh\llebih dari sekadar naik level? Saat

kamu mengalahkan Pokémon dalam
pertempuran, timmu akan mendapatkan\lstatistik tersembunyi yang sesuai

dengan Pokémon yang kamu kalahkan.
Statistik ini juga bisa\lditingkatkan dengan menggunakan

vitamin seperti Protein. Faktanya,
Prof. Log dan saya mengembangkan\lperangkat yang bisa melihat

statistik tersembunyi ini, tetapi
Pelatih [green]vanila[blue] sepertimu tidak\lperlu khawatir tentang itu sama

sekali. Jadi pergilah dan nikmati
menggunakan apa pun yang kamu\ltangkap!

entries.original:
"Prof. Log has spent many years
studying Pokémon stats.

He even managed to upgrade the
Pokédex to display the base stats\lof every Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Prof. Log has spent many years studying Pokémon stats. He even managed to upgrade the Pokédex to display the base stats of every Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Prof. Log telah menghabiskan
bertahun-tahun mempelajari\lstatistik Pokémon. Dia bahkan

berhasil meningkatkan Pokédex untuk
menampilkan statistik dasar setiap\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"You’ve seen every Pokémon in the
West Borrius Pokédex!

Congratulations!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve seen every Pokémon in the West Borrius Pokédex! Congratulations!
entries.translated:
Kamu telah melihat semua Pokémon di
Pokédex Borrius Barat! Selamat!

entries.original:
"You’ve captured every Pokémon in
listed in the Pokédex!

Ho ho ho!

You are truly a magnificent
Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve captured every Pokémon in listed in the Pokédex! Ho ho ho! You are truly a magnificent Trainer!
entries.translated:
Kamu telah menangkap semua Pokémon
yang terdaftar di Pokédex! Ho ho\lho! Kamu benar-benar Pelatih yang

luar biasa!

entries.original:
"Come by my lab when you get a
chance.

I have a reward for all your
hard work!"
entries.translation_source: Come by my lab when you get a chance. I have a reward for all your hard work!
entries.translated:
Datanglah ke labku jika ada
kesempatan. Aku punya hadiah untuk\lsemua kerja kerasmu!

entries.original:
"Who dares enter the domain of the
Moleman?

Hmm? It’s you\. the surface-dweller
known as the Champion of Borrius\.!

For years, my fellow mole people
and I were forced to scrape a\lliving from mining these walls.

And yet, you have come here to
take our spoils for yourselves!?

Bah! Very well - take this with you,
but you shall have nothing else!"
entries.translation_source: Who dares enter the domain of the Moleman? Hmm? It’s you\. the surface-dweller known as the Champion of Borrius\.! For years, my fellow mole people and I were forced to scrape a living from mining these walls. And yet, you have come here to take our spoils for yourselves!? Bah! Very well - take this with you, but you shall have nothing else!
entries.translated:
Siapa yang berani memasuki wilayah
Moleman? Hmm? Ternyata kamu\.\lpenduduk permukaan yang dikenal

sebagai Juara Borrius\.! Selama
bertahun-tahun, aku dan sesama\lmanusia tikus tanah terpaksa

bertahan hidup dengan menambang
dinding-dinding ini. Namun, kamu\ldatang ke sini untuk mengambil

hasil jerih payah kami untuk dirimu
sendiri!? Bah! Baiklah - bawa ini,\ltetapi kamu tidak akan mendapatkan

apa-apa lagi!

entries.original:
"We mine every day, and yet our
findings are meagre\.

Hmph! And so, I have no intention of
offering any more treasure today!

If I must regularly appease you,
surface-dweller, return tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: We mine every day, and yet our findings are meagre\. Hmph! And so, I have no intention of offering any more treasure today! If I must regularly appease you, surface-dweller, return tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Kami menambang setiap hari, namun
hasil temuan kami sedikit\. Hmph!\lJadi, aku tidak berniat menawarkan

harta lagi hari ini! Jika aku harus
secara teratur memuaskanmu,\lpenduduk permukaan, kembalilah

besok!

entries.original:
"Feller, you ever wanted to charge
right at yer foe like a raging\lMudsdale?

No sweat, I can teach yer Pokémon
[green]HiHorsepower[red] for [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Feller, you ever wanted to charge right at yer foe like a raging Mudsdale? No sweat, I can teach yer Pokémon [green]HiHorsepower[red] for [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[red]!
entries.translated:
Kawan, pernahkah kau ingin menyerbu
langsung ke arah musuhmu seperti\lMudsdale yang mengamuk? Gampang,

aku bisa mengajari Pokémon-mu
[green]Tenaga Kuda Tinggi[red] seharga [green][buffer2]\l[buffer1]s[red]!

entries.original:
"Whoop dee doo, which Pokémon’ll
it be?"
entries.translation_source: Whoop dee doo, which Pokémon’ll it be?
entries.translated:
Whoop dee doo, Pokémon mana yang
akan dipilih?

entries.original:
"I always have a hoot chargin’ like
a Mudsdale!"
entries.translation_source: I always have a hoot chargin’ like a Mudsdale!
entries.translated:
Aku selalu bersenang-senang
menyerbu seperti Mudsdale!

entries.original:
"You ain’t got enough of those
[green][buffer1]s[red] for this\."
entries.translation_source: You ain’t got enough of those [green][buffer1]s[red] for this\.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak punya cukup [green][buffer1]s[red]
untuk ini\.

entries.original:
"Oh, great Landorus!

Please bless this land, so our
fields may yield crops once again!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, great Landorus! Please bless this land, so our fields may yield crops once again!
entries.translated:
Oh, Landorus yang agung! Tolong
berkatilah tanah ini, agar ladang\lkami dapat menghasilkan panen lagi!

entries.original:
"The great Landorus is known as
the \qoGuardian of the Fields.\qc

Lands visited by Landorus grant
such bountiful crops.

If only it would bless our land,
as well."
entries.translation_source: The great Landorus is known as the \qoGuardian of the Fields.\qc Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops. If only it would bless our land, as well.
entries.translated:
Landorus yang agung dikenal sebagai
\qoPenjaga Ladang.\qc Tanah yang\ldikunjungi Landorus memberikan

panen yang melimpah. Andai saja ia
memberkati tanah kami juga.

entries.original:
"They’ve returned!

Those horrible Pokémon that
destroyed our crops!"
entries.translation_source: They’ve returned! Those horrible Pokémon that destroyed our crops!
entries.translated:
Mereka kembali! Pokémon mengerikan
yang menghancurkan panen kami!

entries.original: "[black]Tornadus and Thundurus flew off!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Tornadus and Thundurus flew off!
entries.translated:
[black]Tornadus dan Thundurus terbang
pergi!

entries.original:
"What is this?

Those Pokémon seem to have fled
at the sight of you.

Could they perhaps\. be afraid
of your presence?"
entries.translation_source: What is this? Those Pokémon seem to have fled at the sight of you. Could they perhaps\. be afraid of your presence?
entries.translated:
Apa ini? Pokémon itu sepertinya
melarikan diri saat melihatmu.\lMungkin mereka\. takut dengan

kehadiranmu?

entries.original:
"Those Pokémon seem to have fled
at the sight of you.

I hope they are not terrorizing
other areas in Borrius\."
entries.translation_source: Those Pokémon seem to have fled at the sight of you. I hope they are not terrorizing other areas in Borrius\.
entries.translated:
Pokémon itu sepertinya melarikan
diri saat melihatmu. Kuharap mereka\ltidak meneror daerah lain di

Borrius\.

entries.original:
"The great Landorus!

He has returned to bless our crops!"
entries.translation_source: The great Landorus! He has returned to bless our crops!
entries.translated:
Landorus yang agung! Dia kembali
untuk memberkati panen kita!

entries.original:
"The great Landorus has
disappeared!

Oh\. when will it return to bless
our fields?"
entries.translation_source: The great Landorus has disappeared! Oh\. when will it return to bless our fields?
entries.translated:
Landorus yang agung telah
menghilang! Oh\. kapan dia akan\lkembali memberkati ladang kita?

entries.original:
"Now that our fields have received
a blessing from the great Landorus,\lit is only a matter of weeks before\lthe land around here returns to\lits former state.

Thank you, Trainer, for all you’ve
done.

This is the thanks you deserve."
entries.translation_source: Now that our fields have received a blessing from the great Landorus, it is only a matter of weeks before the land around here returns to its former state. Thank you, Trainer, for all you’ve done. This is the thanks you deserve.
entries.translated:
Sekarang ladang kita telah menerima
berkah dari Landorus yang agung,\lhanya masalah beberapa minggu

sebelum tanah di sekitar sini
kembali ke keadaan semula. Terima\lkasih, Trainer, atas semua yang

telah kau lakukan. Ini adalah
ucapan terima kasih yang layak kau\lterima.

entries.original:
"The [green]Reveal Glass[red] can reveal the
true forms of the Pokémon you\lcaptured.

Take good care of them, Trainer."
entries.translation_source: The [green]Reveal Glass[red] can reveal the true forms of the Pokémon you captured. Take good care of them, Trainer.
entries.translated:
[green]Kaca Pengungkap[red] dapat mengungkapkan
wujud asli dari Pokémon yang kau\ltangkap. Jaga mereka baik-baik,

Trainer.

entries.original: "Tornadus"
entries.translation_source: Tornadus
entries.translated: Tornadus

entries.original: "Thundurus"
entries.translation_source: Thundurus
entries.translated: Thundurus

entries.original: "[green]Whhhwhhhwhhh!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Whhhwhhhwhhh!
entries.translated: [green]Whhhwhhhwhhh!

entries.original: "[green]Krrrkrrrkrrak!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Krrrkrrrkrrak!
entries.translated: [green]Krrrkrrrkrrak!

entries.original:
"[black]Summoning the power of the land,
Landorus grew to an enormous size!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Summoning the power of the land, Landorus grew to an enormous size!
entries.translated:
[black]Memanggil kekuatan tanah, Landorus
tumbuh menjadi ukuran yang sangat\lbesar!

entries.original:
"[red]Hold it!

See these footprints here?

They’re mine!

I stepped in some dung back on the
farm and tracked it all the way\lout here!

Ain’t they fascinatin’?

I gotta take a pitcher!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Hold it! See these footprints here? They’re mine! I stepped in some dung back on the farm and tracked it all the way out here! Ain’t they fascinatin’? I gotta take a pitcher!
entries.translated:
[red]Tahan! Lihat jejak kaki ini? Itu
milikku! Aku menginjak kotoran di\lpertanian dan membawanya sampai ke

sini! Bukankah itu menarik? Aku
harus mengambil gambar!

entries.original:
"Always pay close attention to where
you’re walkin’!

You never know when you might step
in some dung!

But lemme tell you, it sure makes
for some fascinatin’ pitchers!"
entries.translation_source: Always pay close attention to where you’re walkin’! You never know when you might step in some dung! But lemme tell you, it sure makes for some fascinatin’ pitchers!
entries.translated:
Selalu perhatikan ke mana kamu
berjalan! Kamu tidak pernah tahu\lkapan kamu bisa menginjak kotoran!

Tapi biar kubilang, itu pasti
menghasilkan gambar yang menarik!

entries.original: "The Most Dangerous Game"
entries.translation_source: The Most Dangerous Game
entries.translated: Permainan Paling Berbahaya

entries.original:
"Trainer, I am looking for one who
can master the most dangerous of\lbeasts\. Pokémon.

They can shoot fire, summon
lightning, and control your mind.

Truly, the most dangerous game.

Do you think you can get a catch
streak of at least [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon\lin the Safari Zone, and master\lthese creatures?"
entries.translation_source: Trainer, I am looking for one who can master the most dangerous of beasts\. Pokémon. They can shoot fire, summon lightning, and control your mind. Truly, the most dangerous game. Do you think you can get a catch streak of at least [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon in the Safari Zone, and master these creatures?
entries.translated:
Pelatih, aku mencari seseorang yang
bisa menguasai binatang paling\lberbahaya\. Pokémon. Mereka bisa

menembakkan api, memanggil petir,
dan mengendalikan pikiranmu.\lSungguh, permainan paling

berbahaya. Apakah kamu pikir kamu
bisa mendapatkan rekor tangkapan\lsetidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon di

Safari Zone, dan menguasai
makhluk-makhluk ini?

entries.original:
"Good luck, and remember you only
have at most 30 Safari Balls to use\lin one game."
entries.translation_source: Good luck, and remember you only have at most 30 Safari Balls to use in one game.
entries.translated:
Semoga berhasil, dan ingat kamu
hanya memiliki maksimal 30 Safari\lBall untuk digunakan dalam satu

permainan.

entries.original:
"I am sure there is someone out
there who can tame these beasts."
entries.translation_source: I am sure there is someone out there who can tame these beasts.
entries.translated:
Aku yakin ada seseorang di luar
sana yang bisa menjinakkan\lbinatang-binatang ini.

entries.original:
"I see you currently have no streak
in the Safari Game.

You can play a round of the Safari
Game east of Polder Town."
entries.translation_source: I see you currently have no streak in the Safari Game. You can play a round of the Safari Game east of Polder Town.
entries.translated:
Aku lihat kamu saat ini tidak
memiliki rekor di Safari Game. Kamu\lbisa bermain satu putaran Safari

Game di sebelah timur Polder Town.

entries.original:
"I see you were only able to get a
streak of [green][buffer2][blue] in the Safari Zone.

Unfortunately, that is less than
the [green][buffer1][blue] required to master the most\ldangerous game."
entries.translation_source: I see you were only able to get a streak of [green][buffer2][blue] in the Safari Zone. Unfortunately, that is less than the [green][buffer1][blue] required to master the most dangerous game.
entries.translated:
Aku lihat kamu hanya bisa
mendapatkan rekor [green][buffer2][blue] di\lSafari Zone. Sayangnya, itu kurang

dari [green][buffer1][blue] yang diperlukan untuk
menguasai permainan paling\lberbahaya.

entries.original:
"You have truly mastered the
Pokémon hunt.

Here is a reward so you can flaunt
your mastery.

Perhaps these can help you tame
more vicious beasts than the ones\lfound in the Safari Zone."
entries.translation_source: You have truly mastered the Pokémon hunt. Here is a reward so you can flaunt your mastery. Perhaps these can help you tame more vicious beasts than the ones found in the Safari Zone.
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar telah menguasai
perburuan Pokémon. Ini hadiah agar\lkamu bisa memamerkan penguasaanmu.

Mungkin ini bisa membantumu
menjinakkan binatang yang lebih\lbuas daripada yang ditemukan di

Safari Zone.

entries.original:
"I am going to search the world for
a game more dangerous than Pokémon\lto hunt."
entries.translation_source: I am going to search the world for a game more dangerous than Pokémon to hunt.
entries.translated:
Aku akan mencari ke seluruh dunia
untuk permainan yang lebih\lberbahaya daripada Pokémon untuk

diburu.

entries.original:
"When my Furfrou’s hair gets all
mangled, I have Furfrité groom it\lat the [green]Magnolia Cafe[blue].

Now, let me tell you!

That woman is so mysterious!

She just comes and goes whenever
she pleases."
entries.translation_source: When my Furfrou’s hair gets all mangled, I have Furfrité groom it at the [green]Magnolia Cafe[blue]. Now, let me tell you! That woman is so mysterious! She just comes and goes whenever she pleases.
entries.translated:
Saat rambut Furfrouku kusut, aku
menyuruh Furfrité merawatnya di\l[green]Magnolia Cafe[blue]. Sekarang, biar

kukatakan! Wanita itu sangat
misterius! Dia datang dan pergi\lsesuka hati.

entries.original:
"Qwilfish are extremely rare
Pokémon.

They appear here if you fish with
a Super Rod, but you’ll have to\lwait for hours like I did just to\lfind any."
entries.translation_source: Qwilfish are extremely rare Pokémon. They appear here if you fish with a Super Rod, but you’ll have to wait for hours like I did just to find any.
entries.translated:
Qwilfish adalah Pokémon yang sangat
langka. Mereka muncul di sini jika\lkamu memancing dengan Super Rod,

tapi kamu harus menunggu berjam-jam
seperti yang kulakukan hanya untuk\lmenemukannya.

entries.original:
"The great bein’ that used to bless
our crops vanished a while back.

The fields have been dried up,
ever since."
entries.translation_source: The great bein’ that used to bless our crops vanished a while back. The fields have been dried up, ever since.
entries.translated:
Makhluk agung yang biasa memberkati
tanaman kami menghilang beberapa\lwaktu lalu. Ladang-ladang menjadi

kering sejak saat itu.

entries.original:
"Female Unfezant are known for their
stamina, while the males outclass\lthem in terms of speed.

Between you and me, I’ve never seen
a difference in battle."
entries.translation_source: Female Unfezant are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed. Between you and me, I’ve never seen a difference in battle.
entries.translated:
Unfezant betina dikenal karena
stamina mereka, sementara yang\ljantan lebih unggul dalam hal

kecepatan. Di antara kita, aku
tidak pernah melihat perbedaan\ldalam pertarungan.

entries.original:
"I felt something prickly while I
was swimming!

Was that sensation not caused by
Jellicent?"
entries.translation_source: I felt something prickly while I was swimming! Was that sensation not caused by Jellicent?
entries.translated:
Aku merasakan sesuatu yang berduri
saat berenang! Bukankah sensasi itu\ldisebabkan oleh Jellicent?

entries.original:
"I found my Pokémon when I bashed
my head against a tree in Redwood\lVillage!"
entries.translation_source: I found my Pokémon when I bashed my head against a tree in Redwood Village!
entries.translated:
Aku menemukan Pokémonku saat
membenturkan kepalaku ke pohon di\lRedwood Village!

entries.original: "Butterfly Effect"
entries.translation_source: Butterfly Effect
entries.translated: Efek Kupu-Kupu

entries.original:
"I have a dream\.

I’ve had it for many years, yet
no one has been able to make it\la reality\.

Would you like to hear about
my dream?"
entries.translation_source: I have a dream\. I’ve had it for many years, yet no one has been able to make it a reality\. Would you like to hear about my dream?
entries.translated:
Aku memiliki mimpi\. Aku memilikinya
selama bertahun-tahun, namun tidak\lada yang bisa mewujudkannya\. Apakah

kamu ingin mendengar tentang
mimpiku?

entries.original:
"You see\.

I have spent many years of my life
scouring the world in search of\lthe many different Vivillon.

Vivillon is a special Pokémon -
it has many different appearances.

Meadow, Archipelago, Continental,
Elegant, Garden, High Plains, Icy\lSnow, Jungle, Marine, Modern,\lMonsoon, Ocean, Polar, River,\lSandstorm, Savanna, Sun, Tundra,\lFancy, and one final special one.

And after many years, I have
succeeded in finding them all.

Of these 20 forms, I have hidden 19
of them around Borrius.

Do you think you’re up to the
challenge of hunting my Vivillon?

You do not need to capture them,
although, if you’re a collector\llike myself, you may wish to."
entries.translation_source: You see\. I have spent many years of my life scouring the world in search of the many different Vivillon. Vivillon is a special Pokémon - it has many different appearances. Meadow, Archipelago, Continental, Elegant, Garden, High Plains, Icy Snow, Jungle, Marine, Modern, Monsoon, Ocean, Polar, River, Sandstorm, Savanna, Sun, Tundra, Fancy, and one final special one. And after many years, I have succeeded in finding them all. Of these 20 forms, I have hidden 19 of them around Borrius. Do you think you’re up to the challenge of hunting my Vivillon? You do not need to capture them, although, if you’re a collector like myself, you may wish to.
entries.translated:
Kamu lihat\. Aku telah menghabiskan
bertahun-tahun hidupku menjelajahi\ldunia untuk mencari berbagai

Vivillon. Vivillon adalah Pokémon
khusus - ia memiliki banyak\lpenampilan berbeda. Meadow,

Archipelago, Continental, Elegant,
Garden, High Plains, Icy Snow,\lJungle, Marine, Modern, Monsoon,

Ocean, Polar, River, Sandstorm,
Savanna, Sun, Tundra, Fancy, dan\lsatu spesial terakhir. Dan setelah

bertahun-tahun, aku berhasil
menemukan semuanya. Dari 20 bentuk\lini, aku telah menyembunyikan 19 di

antaranya di sekitar Borrius.
Apakah kamu pikir kamu mampu\lmenghadapi tantangan berburu

Vivillon milikku? Kamu tidak perlu
menangkapnya, meskipun, jika kamu\lseorang kolektor seperti diriku,

kamu mungkin ingin.

entries.original:
"Magnificent.

Scour both West and East Borrius to
find the Vivillon I have hidden.

When you have captured or defeated
