all of them in battle, return here."
entries.translation_source: Magnificent. Scour both West and East Borrius to find the Vivillon I have hidden. When you have captured or defeated all of them in battle, return here.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa. Jelajahi Borrius Barat
dan Timur untuk menemukan Vivillon\lyang saya sembunyikan. Setelah kamu

menangkap atau mengalahkan semuanya
dalam pertempuran, kembalilah ke\lsini.

entries.original:
"I see\.

So, you’re no different than all
the rest\."
entries.translation_source: I see\. So, you’re no different than all the rest\.
entries.translated:
Aku lihat\. Jadi, kamu tidak berbeda
dari yang lain\.

entries.original:
"You still have not finished
locating the Vivillon I scattered\lthroughout Borrius.

Of the [green][buffer2][blue] forms I hid, you have
only captured [green][buffer1][blue] so far.

I’ve hidden the following forms
around Borrius:

Meadow, Archipelago, Continental,
Elegant, Garden, High Plains, Icy\lSnow, Jungle, Marine, Modern,\lMonsoon, Ocean, Polar, River,\lSandstorm, Savanna, Sun, Tundra,\land Fancy."
entries.translation_source: You still have not finished locating the Vivillon I scattered throughout Borrius. Of the [green][buffer2][blue] forms I hid, you have only captured [green][buffer1][blue] so far. I’ve hidden the following forms around Borrius: Meadow, Archipelago, Continental, Elegant, Garden, High Plains, Icy Snow, Jungle, Marine, Modern, Monsoon, Ocean, Polar, River, Sandstorm, Savanna, Sun, Tundra, and Fancy.
entries.translated:
Kamu masih belum menyelesaikan
pencarian Vivillon yang saya\lsebarkan di seluruh Borrius. Dari

[green][buffer2][blue] bentuk yang saya
sembunyikan, kamu baru menangkap\l[green][buffer1][blue] sejauh ini. Saya telah

menyembunyikan bentuk-bentuk
berikut di sekitar Borrius: Meadow,\lArchipelago, Continental, Elegant,

Garden, High Plains, Icy Snow,
Jungle, Marine, Modern, Monsoon,\lOcean, Polar, River, Sandstorm,

Savanna, Sun, Tundra, dan Fancy.

entries.original:
"Magnificent\.
You’ve made my dream a reality.

Please, take this one final
Vivillon as a gift from me."
entries.translation_source: Magnificent\. You’ve made my dream a reality. Please, take this one final Vivillon as a gift from me.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa\. Kamu telah mewujudkan
mimpiku. Mohon, ambillah satu\lVivillon terakhir ini sebagai

hadiah dariku.

entries.original:
"Magnificent\.
You’ve made my dream a reality.

However\.

The gift I would like to give you
needs an open space in your party."
entries.translation_source: Magnificent\. You’ve made my dream a reality. However\. The gift I would like to give you needs an open space in your party.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa\. Kamu telah mewujudkan
mimpiku. Namun\. Hadiah yang ingin\lkuberikan padamu membutuhkan ruang

kosong di timmu.

entries.original:
"Thanks to you, my dream has been
made a reality.

I am now at peace\."
entries.translation_source: Thanks to you, my dream has been made a reality. I am now at peace\.
entries.translated:
Berkatmu, mimpiku telah terwujud.
Aku sekarang merasa tenang\.

entries.original: "[green]Vivllll!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Vivllll!
entries.translated: [green]Vivllll!

entries.original:
"[black]The Vivillon returned to its
Trainer in Magnolia Town."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Vivillon returned to its Trainer in Magnolia Town.
entries.translated:
[black]Vivillon kembali ke Pelatihnya di
Kota Magnolia.

entries.original:
"My Pokémon is so awesome!
Here, take a look!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon is so awesome! Here, take a look!
entries.translated:
Pokémon-ku sangat keren! Ini,
lihatlah!

entries.original:
"Wasn’t my Pokémon so cool?

Now you can stare at it in your
Pokédex as much as you want!"
entries.translation_source: Wasn’t my Pokémon so cool? Now you can stare at it in your Pokédex as much as you want!
entries.translated:
Bukankah Pokémon-ku keren? Sekarang
kamu bisa menatapnya di Pokédex-mu\lsebanyak yang kamu mau!

entries.original:
"Oui, oui, I am ze famous Furfrou
stylist known as Furfité.

For [green]$[buffer1][red], I can give your Furfrou
a unique look.

Well, do you have ze [green]Furfrou[red] you
would like me to style?"
entries.translation_source: Oui, oui, I am ze famous Furfrou stylist known as Furfité. For [green]$[buffer1][red], I can give your Furfrou a unique look. Well, do you have ze [green]Furfrou[red] you would like me to style?
entries.translated:
Oui, oui, aku adalah penata gaya
Furfrou terkenal yang dikenal\lsebagai Furfité. Seharga [green]$[buffer1][red],

aku bisa memberikan Furfrou-mu
tampilan unik. Nah, apakah kamu\lmemiliki [green]Furfrou[red] yang ingin aku

tata?

entries.original:
"Of ze following styles, which would
you like?"
entries.translation_source: Of ze following styles, which would you like?
entries.translated:
Dari ze gaya-gaya berikut, mana
yang kamu inginkan?

entries.original:
"Your Furfrou is now magnifique!

You are a very lucky Trainer to
have a Furfrou such as zis."
entries.translation_source: Your Furfrou is now magnifique! You are a very lucky Trainer to have a Furfrou such as zis.
entries.translated:
Furfrou-mu sekarang magnifique!
Kamu adalah Pelatih yang sangat\lberuntung memiliki Furfrou seperti

zis.

entries.original:
"Non, non, my services are not
needed."
entries.translation_source: Non, non, my services are not needed.
entries.translated: Non, non, jasaku tidak diperlukan.

entries.original:
"Non, non, you do not have enough
money for me."
entries.translation_source: Non, non, you do not have enough money for me.
entries.translated:
Non, non, kamu tidak punya cukup
uang untukku.

entries.original: "Non, non, I cannot style an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: Non, non, I cannot style an Egg!
entries.translated:
Non, non, aku tidak bisa menata
gaya Telur!

entries.original:
"Non, non, does zat look like a
[green]Furfrou[red] to you?"
entries.translation_source: Non, non, does zat look like a [green]Furfrou[red] to you?
entries.translated:
Non, non, apakah zat terlihat
seperti [green]Furfrou[red] bagimu?

entries.original:
"Non, non, your Furfrou already has
zat style!"
entries.translation_source: Non, non, your Furfrou already has zat style!
entries.translated:
Non, non, Furfrou-mu sudah memiliki
zat gaya itu!

entries.original:
"Did you know that mud from Cootes
Bog contains minerals that are\lgreat for the skin?

If you’d like, I can massage your
Pokémon with some."
entries.translation_source: Did you know that mud from Cootes Bog contains minerals that are great for the skin? If you’d like, I can massage your Pokémon with some.
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa lumpur dari Rawa
Cootes mengandung mineral yang\lbagus untuk kulit? Jika kamu mau,

aku bisa memijat Pokémon-mu dengan
sedikit lumpur.

entries.original:
"Alright!
Let me get started."
entries.translation_source: Alright! Let me get started.
entries.translated: Baiklah! Mari kita mulai.

entries.original:
"There. All done!

The massage has made your Pokémon
more friendly to you."
entries.translation_source: There. All done! The massage has made your Pokémon more friendly to you.
entries.translated:
Nah. Selesai! Pijatan telah membuat
Pokémon Anda lebih bersahabat\ldengan Anda.

entries.original:
"Sorry!

I am exhausted from the massage
earlier.

Please come back again another day!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry! I am exhausted from the massage earlier. Please come back again another day!
entries.translated:
Maaf! Saya kelelahan karena pijatan
tadi. Silakan kembali lagi lain\lhari!

entries.original:
"Oh, I see.

I won’t be here all day, so come
back quick if you change your mind."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I see. I won’t be here all day, so come back quick if you change your mind.
entries.translated:
Oh, begitu. Saya tidak akan di sini
sepanjang hari, jadi cepatlah\lkembali jika Anda berubah pikiran.

entries.original:
"Massage the Egg?
It may be a bit too early for that."
entries.translation_source: Massage the Egg? It may be a bit too early for that.
entries.translated:
Memijat Telur? Mungkin masih
terlalu dini untuk itu.

entries.original:
"I am the Day-Care Man’s sister.

It’s my job to give away Eggs
Trainers did not want to keep.

Here, take one."
entries.translation_source: I am the Day-Care Man’s sister. It’s my job to give away Eggs Trainers did not want to keep. Here, take one.
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara perempuan dari
Pria Day-Care. Tugas saya adalah\lmemberikan Telur yang tidak ingin

disimpan oleh Pelatih. Ini, ambil
satu.

entries.original:
"I am the Day-Care Man’s sister.

It’s my job to give away Eggs
Trainers did not want to keep.

If you free up a space in your
party, you should come get one."
entries.translation_source: I am the Day-Care Man’s sister. It’s my job to give away Eggs Trainers did not want to keep. If you free up a space in your party, you should come get one.
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara perempuan dari
Pria Day-Care. Tugas saya adalah\lmemberikan Telur yang tidak ingin

disimpan oleh Pelatih. Jika Anda
mengosongkan slot di tim Anda, Anda\lharus datang dan mengambil satu.

entries.original:
"The next time I’m here, I’ll have
more free Eggs to give out.

But if you’re desperate for more,
I can always sell you some\.

I am sure the Day-Care Man wouldn’t
mind some extra pocket cash\.

Come on by again, will you?"
entries.translation_source: The next time I’m here, I’ll have more free Eggs to give out. But if you’re desperate for more, I can always sell you some\. I am sure the Day-Care Man wouldn’t mind some extra pocket cash\. Come on by again, will you?
entries.translated:
Lain kali saya di sini, saya akan
memiliki lebih banyak Telur gratis\luntuk dibagikan. Tapi jika Anda

sangat membutuhkannya, saya selalu
bisa menjual beberapa kepada Anda\.\lSaya yakin Pria Day-Care tidak akan

keberatan dengan uang saku tambahan\.
Datang lagi, ya?

entries.original:
"I am the Day-Care Man’s sister.

I can sell you a rare Egg for
$[green]50000[red]."
entries.translation_source: I am the Day-Care Man’s sister. I can sell you a rare Egg for $[green]50000[red].
entries.translated:
Saya adalah saudara perempuan dari
Pria Day-Care. Saya bisa menjual\lTelur langka seharga $[green]50000[red].

entries.original:
"Back for even more, eh?

My, aren’t you a greedy one,
fufufufu\.

I can sell you a rare Egg for
$[green]100000[red]."
entries.translation_source: Back for even more, eh? My, aren’t you a greedy one, fufufufu\. I can sell you a rare Egg for $[green]100000[red].
entries.translated:
Kembali lagi untuk lebih banyak
lagi, eh? Wah, Anda rakus sekali,\lfufufufu\. Saya bisa menjual Telur

langka seharga $[green]100000[red].

entries.original: "Come on by again, will you?"
entries.translation_source: Come on by again, will you?
entries.translated: Datang lagi, ya?

entries.original:
"The next time I’m here, I’ll have
more free Eggs to give out.

Come on by again, will you?"
entries.translation_source: The next time I’m here, I’ll have more free Eggs to give out. Come on by again, will you?
entries.translated:
Lain kali saya di sini, saya akan
memiliki lebih banyak Telur gratis\luntuk dibagikan. Datang lagi, ya?

entries.original:
"Fufufu\. You don’t have enough
money to buy an Egg.

The next time I’m here, I’ll have
more free Eggs to give out.

Come on by again, will you?"
entries.translation_source: Fufufu\. You don’t have enough money to buy an Egg. The next time I’m here, I’ll have more free Eggs to give out. Come on by again, will you?
entries.translated:
Fufufu\. Anda tidak memiliki cukup
uang untuk membeli Telur. Lain kali\lsaya di sini, saya akan memiliki

lebih banyak Telur gratis untuk
dibagikan. Datang lagi, ya?

entries.original:
"Fufufu\. You don’t have enough
space in your party for an Egg."
entries.translation_source: Fufufu\. You don’t have enough space in your party for an Egg.
entries.translated:
Fufufu\. Anda tidak memiliki cukup
ruang di tim Anda untuk sebuah\lTelur.

entries.original:
"Isn’t the sea breeze so calming?

Take a break!
Relax!

Let the wind wash over you\.

Sometimes you’ve gotta live in the
moment, you know?"
entries.translation_source: Isn’t the sea breeze so calming? Take a break! Relax! Let the wind wash over you\. Sometimes you’ve gotta live in the moment, you know?
entries.translated:
Bukankah angin laut sangat
menenangkan? Beristirahatlah!\lSantai! Biarkan angin menyapu Anda\.

Terkadang Anda harus hidup di saat
ini, Anda tahu?

entries.original: "Lost Hanky"
entries.translation_source: Lost Hanky
entries.translated: Saputangan Hilang

entries.original:
"My handkerchief is my life.
I cannot imagine life without it.

Do you feel the same about your
handkerchief?"
entries.translation_source: My handkerchief is my life. I cannot imagine life without it. Do you feel the same about your handkerchief?
entries.translated:
Saputangan saya adalah hidup saya.
Saya tidak bisa membayangkan hidup\ltanpanya. Apakah Anda merasakan hal

yang sama tentang saputangan Anda?

entries.original:
"My handkerchief!
You found it!

I must have dropped it when I came
to the café last.

Thank heavens you were around to
pick it up!

Please, as my thanks, I want you to
graciously accept this gift."
entries.translation_source: My handkerchief! You found it! I must have dropped it when I came to the café last. Thank heavens you were around to pick it up! Please, as my thanks, I want you to graciously accept this gift.
entries.translated:
Saputangan saya! Anda menemukannya!
Saya pasti menjatuhkannya saat\lterakhir kali saya ke kafe.

Syukurlah Anda ada di sekitar untuk
mengambilnya! Tolong, sebagai\lucapan terima kasih, saya ingin

Anda menerima hadiah ini dengan
lapang dada.

entries.original:
"[black]It looks like someone forgot their
handkerchief.

Best return it to its proper owner!"
entries.translation_source: [black]It looks like someone forgot their handkerchief. Best return it to its proper owner!
entries.translated:
[black]Sepertinya seseorang lupa
saputangan mereka. Sebaiknya\lkembalikan kepada pemiliknya yang

sah!

entries.original:
"Howdy do, I brought my Pokémon
here straight from the ranch."
entries.translation_source: Howdy do, I brought my Pokémon here straight from the ranch.
entries.translated:
Halo, saya membawa Pokémon saya
langsung dari peternakan.

entries.original:
"I bring my Pokémon here from the
ranch often so they can have a\llittle fun."
entries.translation_source: I bring my Pokémon here from the ranch often so they can have a little fun.
entries.translated:
Saya sering membawa Pokémon saya ke
sini dari peternakan agar mereka\lbisa bersenang-senang.

entries.original:
"I’m a master rancher!

What does that even mean?
Battle me and find out!"
entries.translation_source: I’m a master rancher! What does that even mean? Battle me and find out!
entries.translated:
Saya seorang master peternak! Apa
artinya itu? Bertarunglah denganku\ldan cari tahu!

entries.original:
"It means I’m the master of my
ranch!

My word is law!"
entries.translation_source: It means I’m the master of my ranch! My word is law!
entries.translated:
Artinya aku adalah master dari
peternakanku! Kata-kataku adalah\lhukum!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon are raring to go!

We come to this café as much as we
can just for the battles!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon are raring to go! We come to this café as much as we can just for the battles!
entries.translated:
Pokémon-ku sangat bersemangat! Kami
datang ke kafe ini sesering mungkin\lhanya untuk bertarung!

entries.original:
"Next time I’m here, we should have
another go at our battle!"
entries.translation_source: Next time I’m here, we should have another go at our battle!
entries.translated:
Lain kali aku di sini, kita harus
bertarung lagi!

entries.original:
"Do you love the Pokémon Eevee?
I sure do!

I don’t have one, but I’m still a
huge fan all the same.

But I always wondered, why is Eevee
so popular?

It gets all this special attention.

I know it’s cute and all, but take
this Z-Crystal for instance.

Why does Eevee get one?

Oh, well\."
entries.translation_source: Do you love the Pokémon Eevee? I sure do! I don’t have one, but I’m still a huge fan all the same. But I always wondered, why is Eevee so popular? It gets all this special attention. I know it’s cute and all, but take this Z-Crystal for instance. Why does Eevee get one? Oh, well\.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu mencintai Pokémon
Eevee? Tentu saja! Aku tidak\lmemilikinya, tapi aku tetap

penggemar beratnya. Tapi aku selalu
penasaran, kenapa Eevee begitu\lpopuler? Ia mendapatkan perhatian

khusus ini. Aku tahu ia imut dan
sebagainya, tapi lihatlah Z-Crystal\lini misalnya. Kenapa Eevee

mendapatkannya? Oh, well\.

entries.original:
"Now you have the Z-Crystal meant
for Eevee!

I can worry less now that it’s out
of my head\."
entries.translation_source: Now you have the Z-Crystal meant for Eevee! I can worry less now that it’s out of my head\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang kamu memiliki Z-Crystal
yang diperuntukkan bagi Eevee! Aku\ltidak perlu khawatir lagi sekarang

karena sudah keluar dari pikiranku\.

entries.original:
"Heya!

I don’t believe I’ve formally
introduced myself.

My name’s Catherine!
But most people call me Cathy.

I came here from Kanto with my
friend Mahina.

Prof. Oak wanted us to complete the
Pokédex, so every day we travel\laround Borrius searching for as\lmany rare Pokémon as we can.

It’s thanks to these travels that I
was able to unlock a hidden power\lliving within my Blastoise.

If you have a Blastoise too,
this’ll help you unlock your\lBlastoise’s hidden potential, too."
entries.translation_source: Heya! I don’t believe I’ve formally introduced myself. My name’s Catherine! But most people call me Cathy. I came here from Kanto with my friend Mahina. Prof. Oak wanted us to complete the Pokédex, so every day we travel around Borrius searching for as many rare Pokémon as we can. It’s thanks to these travels that I was able to unlock a hidden power living within my Blastoise. If you have a Blastoise too, this’ll help you unlock your Blastoise’s hidden potential, too.
entries.translated:
Hey! Sepertinya aku belum
memperkenalkan diri secara resmi.\lNamaku Catherine! Tapi kebanyakan

orang memanggilku Cathy. Aku datang
ke sini dari Kanto bersama temanku\lMahina. Prof. Oak ingin kami

melengkapi Pokédex, jadi setiap
hari kami berkeliling Borrius\lmencari Pokémon langka sebanyak

mungkin. Berkat perjalanan ini, aku
bisa membuka kekuatan tersembunyi\lyang ada di dalam Blastoise-ku.

Jika kamu juga memiliki Blastoise,
ini akan membantumu membuka potensi\ltersembunyi Blastoise-mu juga.

entries.original:
"I like battling in Hidden Grottos
with my Blastoise, so if you ever\lfind yourself in one, let’s team\lup and fight together!

We make a powerful team.

But I prefer to only use Blastoise
when absolutely necessary."
entries.translation_source: I like battling in Hidden Grottos with my Blastoise, so if you ever find yourself in one, let’s team up and fight together! We make a powerful team. But I prefer to only use Blastoise when absolutely necessary.
entries.translated:
Aku suka bertarung di Hidden
Grottos bersama Blastoise-ku, jadi\ljika kamu pernah berada di salah

satunya, mari kita bekerjasama dan
bertarung bersama! Kita adalah tim\lyang kuat. Tapi aku lebih suka

menggunakan Blastoise hanya jika
benar-benar diperlukan.

entries.original:
"Abimbola!
That’s my name!

What’s an Abimbola?
Beats me!

But my friends call me Abimbol
for short. I love it!

I think you should take this for
listening to me tell you all\labout my name!"
entries.translation_source: Abimbola! That’s my name! What’s an Abimbola? Beats me! But my friends call me Abimbol for short. I love it! I think you should take this for listening to me tell you all about my name!
entries.translated:
Abimbola! Itu namaku! Apa itu
Abimbola? Entahlah! Tapi\lteman-temanku memanggilku Abimbol

untuk singkatnya. Aku suka itu!
Kurasa kamu harus menerima ini\lkarena sudah mendengarkan aku

bercerita tentang namaku!

entries.original:
"You seem like a cool Trainer -
let’s team up sometime!

I like battling in Hidden Grottos,
so if you see I’m there, too, pick\lme to fight with!

I like to start by incapacitating
the opponent, and once that’s done,\lit’s no holds barred!

Yeah!"
entries.translation_source: You seem like a cool Trainer - let’s team up sometime! I like battling in Hidden Grottos, so if you see I’m there, too, pick me to fight with! I like to start by incapacitating the opponent, and once that’s done, it’s no holds barred! Yeah!
entries.translated:
Kamu tampak seperti Pelatih yang
keren - mari kita bekerjasama suatu\lsaat! Aku suka bertarung di Hidden

Grottos, jadi jika kamu melihat aku
juga di sana, pilihlah aku untuk\lbertarung! Aku suka memulai dengan

melumpuhkan lawan, dan setelah itu,
tidak ada aturan! Yeah!

entries.original:
"So, you have chosen to speak with I,
the great and regal Alford.

Because of your bravery, you
deserve something special."
entries.translation_source: So, you have chosen to speak with I, the great and regal Alford. Because of your bravery, you deserve something special.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu memilih untuk berbicara
dengan aku, Alford yang agung dan\lmegah. Karena keberanianmu, kamu

layak mendapatkan sesuatu yang
istimewa.

entries.original:
"I am a big lover of regal Pokémon.

These Pokémon I carry with me
define who I am.

If you are ever in need of
assistance, do not hesitate to\lcall on my regal Pokémon and me."
entries.translation_source: I am a big lover of regal Pokémon. These Pokémon I carry with me define who I am. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to call on my regal Pokémon and me.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat menyukai Pokémon yang
megah. Pokémon yang kubawa ini\lmendefinisikan siapa diriku. Jika

kamu pernah membutuhkan bantuan,
jangan ragu untuk memanggilku dan\lPokémon megahku.

entries.original:
"My friend, Cathy and I came here
together from the Kanto region.

We were given Pokémon by Prof.
Oak, and tasked with completing\la Pokédex.

During my travels, I deepened my
bond with my Venusaur, and now\lwe fight as one.

If you have a Venusaur such as
mine, you may find this helps\lstrengthen your bond with it."
entries.translation_source: My friend, Cathy and I came here together from the Kanto region. We were given Pokémon by Prof. Oak, and tasked with completing a Pokédex. During my travels, I deepened my bond with my Venusaur, and now we fight as one. If you have a Venusaur such as mine, you may find this helps strengthen your bond with it.
entries.translated:
Temanku, Cathy dan aku datang ke
sini bersama dari wilayah Kanto.\lKami diberi Pokémon oleh Prof. Oak,

dan ditugaskan untuk melengkapi
Pokédex. Selama perjalananku, aku\lmemperdalam ikatanku dengan

Venusaur-ku, dan sekarang kami
bertarung sebagai satu kesatuan.\lJika kamu memiliki Venusaur seperti

milikku, kamu mungkin menemukan ini
membantu memperkuat ikatanmu\ldengannya.

entries.original:
"If you ever wish for a powerful
partner in a Hidden Grotto,\lmy Venusaur and I are sure to be\la good pick."
entries.translation_source: If you ever wish for a powerful partner in a Hidden Grotto, my Venusaur and I are sure to be a good pick.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu pernah menginginkan
pasangan yang kuat di Hidden\lGrotto, Venusaur-ku dan aku pasti

menjadi pilihan yang baik.

entries.original:
"Oh, hey, [buffer3]\.

Nice of you to drop by\.

I was just drinkin’ this herbal tea,
and then you showed up.

\.

Uh, might sound odd, but\.\CC0818 could
you spot me a [green][buffer1][blue]?

I’ve got a [green][buffer2][blue] you might like
for it, if you wanna trade\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hey, [buffer3]\. Nice of you to drop by\. I was just drinkin’ this herbal tea, and then you showed up. \. Uh, might sound odd, but\.\CC0818 could you spot me a [green][buffer1][blue]? I’ve got a [green][buffer2][blue] you might like for it, if you wanna trade\.
entries.translated:
Oh, hei, [buffer3]\. Senang kamu
mampir\. Aku baru saja minum teh\lherbal ini, dan kemudian kamu

muncul. \. Uh, mungkin terdengar
aneh, tapi\.\CC0818 bisakah kamu memberiku\l[green][buffer1][blue]? Aku punya [green][buffer2][blue] yang

mungkin kamu suka untuk itu, jika
kamu ingin bertukar\.

entries.original:
"Aw, not cool, [buffer3]\.

Whelp, guess I’ll get back to
my tea\.

Calms the nerves, [buffer3]\."
entries.translation_source: Aw, not cool, [buffer3]\. Whelp, guess I’ll get back to my tea\. Calms the nerves, [buffer3]\.
entries.translated:
Ah, tidak keren, [buffer3]\. Wah,
kurasa aku akan kembali ke tehku\.\lMenenangkan saraf, [buffer3]\.

entries.original:
"That’s not a [buffer1]\. is it?

Hard to tell when you use so much\.\CC0818
uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense\.

\.Nah, pretty sure that’s the wrong
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: That’s not a [buffer1]\. is it? Hard to tell when you use so much\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense\. \.Nah, pretty sure that’s the wrong Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Itu bukan [buffer1]\. kan? Sulit untuk
tahu karena kamu banyak menggunakan\.\CC0818\luh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense\. \.Nah, yakin itu

Pokémon yang salah.

entries.original: "Aw, you’re the best, [buffer3]."
entries.translation_source: Aw, you’re the best, [buffer3].
entries.translated: Ah, kamu yang terbaik, [buffer3].

entries.original:
"I tell you, [buffer3]\. nothing beats a
deep, mellow herbal tea\.

Mmm\.

’Specially when all that fog coming
from inside my Gym makes you all\lwoozy\."
entries.translation_source: I tell you, [buffer3]\. nothing beats a deep, mellow herbal tea\. Mmm\. ’Specially when all that fog coming from inside my Gym makes you all woozy\.
entries.translated:
Aku bilang, [buffer3]\. tidak ada yang
bisa mengalahkan teh herbal yang\ldalam dan lembut\. Mmm\. Terutama saat

semua kabut yang datang dari dalam
Gymku membuatmu pusing\.

entries.original:
"Ah, hello, [player].

I’ve been enjoying the increase in
leisure time, lately\.

And the coffee here seems to draw
me back, time and again.

Ah, that reminds me\.

I’ve been recently looking for a
[green][buffer1][blue]\.

If you have one, are you willing
to trade it for my [green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, hello, [player]. I’ve been enjoying the increase in leisure time, lately\. And the coffee here seems to draw me back, time and again. Ah, that reminds me\. I’ve been recently looking for a [green][buffer1][blue]\. If you have one, are you willing to trade it for my [green][buffer2][blue]?
entries.translated:
Ah, halo, [player]. Aku menikmati
peningkatan waktu luang akhir-akhir\lini\. Dan kopi di sini sepertinya

selalu menarikku kembali, lagi dan
lagi. Ah, itu mengingatkanku\. Aku\lbaru-baru ini mencari [green][buffer1][blue]\. Jika

kamu punya, apakah kamu bersedia
menukarnya dengan [green][buffer2][blue] saya?

entries.original:
"Well, I suppose you have better
things to do with your evening."
entries.translation_source: Well, I suppose you have better things to do with your evening.
entries.translated:
Yah, kurasa kau punya hal yang
lebih baik untuk dilakukan pada\lmalam ini.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry\. if this is a joke, I’m
afraid I don’t find it amusing.

If you don’t have a [buffer1], then
there’s no shame in saying so."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry\. if this is a joke, I’m afraid I don’t find it amusing. If you don’t have a [buffer1], then there’s no shame in saying so.
entries.translated:
Maaf\. jika ini lelucon, aku khawatir
aku tidak menganggapnya lucu. Jika\lkau tidak punya [buffer1], maka

tidak perlu malu untuk
mengatakannya.

entries.original: "Many thanks, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Many thanks, [player].
entries.translated: Terima kasih banyak, [player].

entries.original:
"I’m an agent, a specialist in
uncovering information\.

And yet, shamefully, it took me this
long to discover the coffee here.

If only I’d known just how high the
quality was earlier\."
entries.translation_source: I’m an agent, a specialist in uncovering information\. And yet, shamefully, it took me this long to discover the coffee here. If only I’d known just how high the quality was earlier\.
entries.translated:
Aku seorang agen, spesialis dalam
mengungkap informasi\. Namun, dengan\lmemalukan, aku butuh waktu selama

ini untuk menemukan kopi di sini.
Seandainya saja aku tahu betapa\ltingginya kualitasnya sebelumnya\.

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Just resting my wings here before
I have to be elsewhere.

Actually, there’s something I need
to ask you.

If, perchance, you have a [green][buffer1][red]
on hand\.

Then would you part with it, in
exchange for my [green][buffer2][red]?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player]! Just resting my wings here before I have to be elsewhere. Actually, there’s something I need to ask you. If, perchance, you have a [green][buffer1][red] on hand\. Then would you part with it, in exchange for my [green][buffer2][red]?
entries.translated:
Hai, [player]! Hanya
mengistirahatkan sayapku di sini\lsebelum aku harus pergi ke tempat

lain. Sebenarnya, ada sesuatu yang
perlu kutanyakan padamu. Jika,\lkebetulan, kau memiliki [green][buffer1][red] di

tangan\. Lalu, maukah kau melepasnya,
sebagai imbalan untuk [green][buffer2][red]\lmilikku?

entries.original:
"Ah, well\. guess we can’t always be
so fortunate."
entries.translation_source: Ah, well\. guess we can’t always be so fortunate.
entries.translated:
Ah, yah\. sepertinya kita tidak
selalu bisa seberuntung itu.

entries.original:
"Um\. last I checked, a [buffer1]
didn’t look anything like that.

And unfortunately, I’m not looking
for anything else\."
entries.translation_source: Um\. last I checked, a [buffer1] didn’t look anything like that. And unfortunately, I’m not looking for anything else\.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. terakhir kuperiksa, [buffer1]
tidak terlihat seperti itu. Dan\lsayangnya, aku tidak mencari yang

lain\.

entries.original: "Fantastic! That really helps a lot!"
entries.translation_source: Fantastic! That really helps a lot!
entries.translated: Fantastis! Itu sangat membantu!

entries.original:
"It’s really warm out here\.

At least, compared to Blizzard City,
anyway, but that’s no surprise.

That’s why I almost always grab an
ice-coffee when I can."
entries.translation_source: It’s really warm out here\. At least, compared to Blizzard City, anyway, but that’s no surprise. That’s why I almost always grab an ice-coffee when I can.
entries.translated:
Di sini sangat panas\. Setidaknya,
dibandingkan dengan Blizzard City,\ltapi itu tidak mengejutkan. Itu

sebabnya aku hampir selalu
mengambil es kopi saat bisa.

entries.original:
"Well, howdy, [player]!

Guess yer like the rest of Magnolia
Town\. can’t stay away from ol’ Mel\lfor long, huh?

Well, now yer here, I got a lil’
favour to ask ya.

Ya got any of those [green][buffer1][blue]
in the party?

I gots my [green][buffer2][blue] here, if yer
interested in havin’ it."
entries.translation_source: Well, howdy, [player]! Guess yer like the rest of Magnolia Town\. can’t stay away from ol’ Mel for long, huh? Well, now yer here, I got a lil’ favour to ask ya. Ya got any of those [green][buffer1][blue] in the party? I gots my [green][buffer2][blue] here, if yer interested in havin’ it.
entries.translated:
Yah, halo, [player]! Kurasa kau
seperti penduduk Magnolia Town\.\ltidak bisa lama menjauh dari Mel

tua, ya? Nah, sekarang kau di sini,
aku minta sedikit bantuan. Kau\lpunya [green][buffer1][blue] di tim? Aku punya

[green][buffer2][blue] di sini, jika kau tertarik
mengambilnya.

entries.original:
"Not really yer kinda thing?
Ah well\."
entries.translation_source: Not really yer kinda thing? Ah well\.
entries.translated: Bukan barangmu? Ah yah\.

entries.original:
"Partner, I ain’t gettin’ so old that
I’m goin’ blind.

No matter how I look at it, that
sure ain’t a [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Partner, I ain’t gettin’ so old that I’m goin’ blind. No matter how I look at it, that sure ain’t a [green][buffer1][blue].
entries.translated:
Kawan, aku tidak setua itu sampai
aku buta. Bagaimanapun aku\lmelihatnya, itu pasti bukan

[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original: "Yee-haw! That’s how it’s done!"
entries.translation_source: Yee-haw! That’s how it’s done!
entries.translated: Yee-haw! Begitu caranya!

entries.original:
"I ain’t the type who’s into that
frou-frou coffee.

I prefer sumthin’ a lil’ stronger,
if ya get what I mean\."
entries.translation_source: I ain’t the type who’s into that frou-frou coffee. I prefer sumthin’ a lil’ stronger, if ya get what I mean\.
entries.translated:
Aku bukan tipe yang suka kopi
frou-frou itu. Aku lebih suka\lsesuatu yang sedikit lebih kuat,

jika kau mengerti maksudku\.

entries.original:
"Hey, howzzit goin’, [player]?

Building and tinkering’s thirsty
work, so I’m taking a quick break.

By the way, you wouldn’t do ol’
Galavan a solid, and\. well\.

Spare me your [green][buffer1][blue], if ya have
one, anyway?

I can give ya my [green][buffer2][blue], which
is pretty sweet deal, doncha think?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, howzzit goin’, [player]? Building and tinkering’s thirsty work, so I’m taking a quick break. By the way, you wouldn’t do ol’ Galavan a solid, and\. well\. Spare me your [green][buffer1][blue], if ya have one, anyway? I can give ya my [green][buffer2][blue], which is pretty sweet deal, doncha think?
entries.translated:
Hei, apa kabar, [player]? Membangun
dan memperbaiki adalah pekerjaan\lyang membuat haus, jadi aku

istirahat sebentar. Omong-omong,
maukah kau membantu Galavan tua,\ldan\. yah\. Beri aku [green][buffer1][blue]-mu, jika

kau punya, ya? Aku bisa memberimu
[green][buffer2][blue] milikku, yang merupakan\ltawaran yang cukup bagus, bukan?

entries.original:
"Gah! Why’s it always so hard to get
the last piece I need around here?"
entries.translation_source: Gah! Why’s it always so hard to get the last piece I need around here?
entries.translated:
Gah! Kenapa selalu begitu sulit
mendapatkan potongan terakhir yang\lkubutuhkan di sini?

entries.original:
"That’s not a [green][buffer1][blue] - what’s ol’
Galavan supposed to do with this?

There’s nuthin’ else that comes close
to the final part I need."
entries.translation_source: That’s not a [green][buffer1][blue] - what’s ol’ Galavan supposed to do with this? There’s nuthin’ else that comes close to the final part I need.
entries.translated:
Itu bukan [green][buffer1][blue] - apa yang harus
dilakukan Galavan tua dengan ini?\lTidak ada lagi yang mendekati

bagian akhir yang kubutuhkan.

entries.original:
"Ah, you’re such a lifesaver,
seriously!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, you’re such a lifesaver, seriously!
entries.translated:
Ah, kau benar-benar penyelamat,
serius!

entries.original:
"By the way, how do ya usually take
your coffee, anyway?

Mine’s straight black, no sugar.

I wanna FEEL it juice me up, gimme
the jolt to finish what I start."
entries.translation_source: By the way, how do ya usually take your coffee, anyway? Mine’s straight black, no sugar. I wanna FEEL it juice me up, gimme the jolt to finish what I start.
entries.translated:
Omong-omong, bagaimana biasanya kau
minum kopi? Aku langsung hitam,\ltanpa gula. Aku ingin MERASAKAN

efeknya mengisi energiku,
memberikan kejutan untuk\lmenyelesaikan apa yang kumulai.

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha ha! If it ain’t [player]!

I got word this was the best place
for coffee this side of Borrius, so\lhere I am.

Say, none of the other customers had
any, but\.

If you’re carryin’ a [green][buffer1][blue], are
ya willing to trade it off?

I was lookin’ to get rid of my [green]
[buffer2][blue], so if ya wanna do it\lfor that, then I’m down."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha ha! If it ain’t [player]! I got word this was the best place for coffee this side of Borrius, so here I am. Say, none of the other customers had any, but\. If you’re carryin’ a [green][buffer1][blue], are ya willing to trade it off? I was lookin’ to get rid of my [green] [buffer2][blue], so if ya wanna do it for that, then I’m down.
entries.translated:
Ha ha ha ha! Kalau bukan [player]!
Aku mendengar ini adalah tempat\lkopi terbaik di sisi Borrius ini,

jadi ini aku. Begini, tidak ada
pelanggan lain yang punya, tapi\.\lJika kau membawa [green][buffer1][blue], apakah

kau bersedia menukarnya? Aku ingin
menyingkirkan [green] [buffer2][blue] milikku,\ljadi jika kau mau menukar dengan

itu, aku setuju.

entries.original: "Grr\. well that’s\.\CC0818 fine\."
entries.translation_source: Grr\. well that’s\.\CC0818 fine\.
entries.translated: Grr\. baiklah itu\.\CC0818 tidak apa-apa\.

entries.original:
"Wha\. you tryin’ to make fun of me,
ya snot-nosed punk!?

That don’t look nuthin’ like a [green]
[buffer1][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Wha\. you tryin’ to make fun of me, ya snot-nosed punk!? That don’t look nuthin’ like a [green] [buffer1][blue]!
entries.translated:
Apa\. kamu berusaha mengejekku, ya
brondong ingusan!? Itu tidak mirip\lsama sekali dengan [green] [buffer1][blue]!

entries.original:
"Heh heh\. you enjoy that [green]
[buffer2][blue], awright?"
entries.translation_source: Heh heh\. you enjoy that [green] [buffer2][blue], awright?
entries.translated:
Heh heh\. kamu menikmati itu [green]
[buffer2][blue], kan?

entries.original:
"Really is good, this stuff - they
weren’t lyin’ about that\.

Ha! If any poor sucker like the
Terror Granbull tried takin’ this\ljoint\.

Well, personally\. they’d learn never
to do it again, if they knew what\lwas good for ’em."
entries.translation_source: Really is good, this stuff - they weren’t lyin’ about that\. Ha! If any poor sucker like the Terror Granbull tried takin’ this joint\. Well, personally\. they’d learn never to do it again, if they knew what was good for ’em.
entries.translated:
Benar-benar enak, barang ini -
mereka tidak berbohong soal itu\. Ha!\lJika ada orang bodoh seperti Terror

Granbull mencoba mengambil tempat
ini\. Yah, secara pribadi\. mereka akan\lbelajar untuk tidak melakukannya

lagi, jika mereka tahu apa yang
baik untuk mereka.

entries.original:
"Oh, howdy, [player]!

The best coffee in Borrius ain’t too
far from the swamp, so I figured\lI’d drop by to wet my whistle.

And, well, check if there’s any
customers willin’ to trade with ol’\lTessy\.

Have ya got a [green][buffer1][red] ya’d be
willin’ to trade?

Let’s see\. I got a [green][buffer2][red], if ya
don’t mind havin’ it fer that."
entries.translation_source: Oh, howdy, [player]! The best coffee in Borrius ain’t too far from the swamp, so I figured I’d drop by to wet my whistle. And, well, check if there’s any customers willin’ to trade with ol’ Tessy\. Have ya got a [green][buffer1][red] ya’d be willin’ to trade? Let’s see\. I got a [green][buffer2][red], if ya don’t mind havin’ it fer that.
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, [player]! Kopi terbaik di
Borrius tidak terlalu jauh dari\lrawa, jadi saya pikir saya akan

mampir untuk melepas dahaga. Dan,
yah, cek apakah ada pelanggan yang\lmau bertukar dengan Tessy tua\.

Apakah kamu punya [green][buffer1][red] yang mau
kamu tukarkan? Coba lihat\. Saya\lpunya [green][buffer2][red], jika kamu tidak

keberatan mengambilnya untuk itu.

entries.original:
"Nah? Whelp, guess that’s fair - not
like ya just happen to carry the\lright Pokémon, at the right time."
entries.translation_source: Nah? Whelp, guess that’s fair - not like ya just happen to carry the right Pokémon, at the right time.
entries.translated:
Tidak? Yah, kurasa itu wajar -
bukan seperti kamu kebetulan\lmembawa Pokémon yang tepat, pada

waktu yang tepat.

entries.original:
"Well\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 that’s nice, but that still
ain’t a [green][buffer1][red], sugah."
entries.translation_source: Well\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 that’s nice, but that still ain’t a [green][buffer1][red], sugah.
entries.translated:
Yah\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 itu bagus, tapi itu tetap
bukan [green][buffer1][red], sayang.

entries.original:
"Hoo\. that’s a relief - thanks,
[player]."
entries.translation_source: Hoo\. that’s a relief - thanks, [player].
entries.translated:
Wah\. itu lega - terima kasih,
[player].

entries.original:
"The swamp gets pretty humid, so ya
gotta pick up sumthin’ ice-cold,\lya know what I’m sayin’?

Oh, and I gotta pick up some sorta
lunch fer ol’ Swampert, too\."
entries.translation_source: The swamp gets pretty humid, so ya gotta pick up sumthin’ ice-cold, ya know what I’m sayin’? Oh, and I gotta pick up some sorta lunch fer ol’ Swampert, too\.
entries.translated:
Rawanya cukup lembab, jadi kamu
harus beli sesuatu yang sedingin\les, kamu tahu maksudku? Oh, dan

saya harus beli semacam makan siang
untuk Swampert tua juga\.

entries.original:
"Ah, [player]\. I didn’t see you
there.

I just thought I’d visit a few old
friends, here at this establishment,\land enjoy a coffee on the side.

Ah, yes\. I’ve been meaning to ask,
next time I saw you\.

Do you happen to have the Pokémon
known as [green][buffer1][blue] to trade me?

I can exchange it for a [green][buffer2][blue],
if that’s alright with you."
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player]\. I didn’t see you there. I just thought I’d visit a few old friends, here at this establishment, and enjoy a coffee on the side. Ah, yes\. I’ve been meaning to ask, next time I saw you\. Do you happen to have the Pokémon known as [green][buffer1][blue] to trade me? I can exchange it for a [green][buffer2][blue], if that’s alright with you.
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]\. Aku tidak melihatmu di
sana. Aku hanya pikir akan\lmengunjungi beberapa teman lama, di

sini di tempat ini, dan menikmati
kopi di samping. Ah, ya\. Aku sudah\lberniat bertanya, lain kali aku

melihatmu\. Apakah kamu kebetulan
memiliki Pokémon yang dikenal\lsebagai [green][buffer1][blue] untuk ditukar

denganku? Aku bisa menukarnya
dengan [green][buffer2][blue], jika itu tidak\lapa-apa denganmu.

entries.original: "I see\. perhaps another time, then?"
entries.translation_source: I see\. perhaps another time, then?
entries.translated: Begitu\. mungkin lain kali, ya?

entries.original:
"I’m afraid that’s not quite it\.
I was looking for [green][buffer1][blue]\.

I would prefer a straight yes
or no answer, if you don’t mind."
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid that’s not quite it\. I was looking for [green][buffer1][blue]\. I would prefer a straight yes or no answer, if you don’t mind.
entries.translated:
Aku khawatir itu bukan yang
dimaksud\. Aku mencari [green][buffer1][blue]\. Aku\llebih suka jawaban ya atau tidak

langsung, jika kamu tidak
keberatan.

entries.original: "Ah, that’s the ticket!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, that’s the ticket!
entries.translated: Ah, itu dia!

entries.original:
"I only visit the café before I have
to attend my duties as Gym Leader.

Last time, I regressed to a younger
age, and the staff wouldn’t let me\lin, you see.

They offered me a juice box, and
asked if I was separated from my\lparents.

Hmph! How rude of them."
entries.translation_source: I only visit the café before I have to attend my duties as Gym Leader. Last time, I regressed to a younger age, and the staff wouldn’t let me in, you see. They offered me a juice box, and asked if I was separated from my parents. Hmph! How rude of them.
entries.translated:
Aku hanya mengunjungi kafe sebelum
harus menjalankan tugas sebagai\lPemimpin Gym. Terakhir kali, aku

mundur ke usia yang lebih muda, dan
staf tidak mengizinkanku masuk,\lkamu lihat. Mereka menawarkanku

kotak jus, dan bertanya apakah aku
terpisah dari orang tuaku. Hmph!\lBetapa kasar mereka.

entries.original:
"Who dares intrude upon the coffee
break of the Mole-Man?

Oh, it’s you, surface dweller\.!

Hmph. I was instructed by the League
to give this rare item to the\lnewest Champion.

Take it, and leave me to my
solitude, surface dweller."
entries.translation_source: Who dares intrude upon the coffee break of the Mole-Man? Oh, it’s you, surface dweller\.! Hmph. I was instructed by the League to give this rare item to the newest Champion. Take it, and leave me to my solitude, surface dweller.
entries.translated:
Siapa yang berani mengganggu
istirahat kopi Manusia Mol? Oh, itu\lkamu, penghuni permukaan\.! Hmph. Aku

diperintahkan oleh Liga untuk
memberikan barang langka ini kepada\lJuara terbaru. Ambil, dan

tinggalkan aku dalam kesendirian,
penghuni permukaan.

entries.original:
"That is the [green]Groundium Z[blue], the prized
possession of the mole people.

It was our greatest weapon against
our oppressors, before they drove\lus underground\.

Tch\. but it shall not avail you,
surface dweller, for I and my\lfellow mole people shall surpass\lits great power.

This I swear, on behalf of all
mole people!"
entries.translation_source: That is the [green]Groundium Z[blue], the prized possession of the mole people. It was our greatest weapon against our oppressors, before they drove us underground\. Tch\. but it shall not avail you, surface dweller, for I and my fellow mole people shall surpass its great power. This I swear, on behalf of all mole people!
entries.translated:
Itu adalah [green]Groundium Z[blue], harta
berharga dari manusia mol. Itu\ladalah senjata terbesar kita

melawan para penindas kita, sebelum
mereka mendorong kita ke bawah\ltanah\. Tch\. tapi itu tidak akan

membantumu, penghuni permukaan,
karena aku dan sesama manusia mol\lakan melampaui kekuatan besarnya.

Ini aku sumpah, atas nama semua
manusia mol!

entries.original:
"I admit that the coffee here\.
is not something I dislike.

It reminds me very much of the
platefuls of dirt my mother made\lin my youth.

Perhaps I shall make it the sole
preserve of the surface world,\lonce our revenge is at hand\."
entries.translation_source: I admit that the coffee here\. is not something I dislike. It reminds me very much of the platefuls of dirt my mother made in my youth. Perhaps I shall make it the sole preserve of the surface world, once our revenge is at hand\.
entries.translated:
Aku akui bahwa kopi di sini\. bukan
sesuatu yang tidak aku sukai. Itu\lsangat mengingatkanku pada

piring-piring tanah yang ibuku buat
di masa mudaku. Mungkin aku akan\lmenjadikannya satu-satunya milik

dunia permukaan, begitu balas
dendam kita sudah dekat\.

entries.original:
"Oh, hey, [player]\. funny place to
meet up, huh?

So\. I was told - or rather,
the Pokémon inhabiting my body\lwas told\.

That I ought to pass this along, as
the prize for beating me last time.

\qoBetter late than never\qc, they said\.
hah\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hey, [player]\. funny place to meet up, huh? So\. I was told - or rather, the Pokémon inhabiting my body was told\. That I ought to pass this along, as the prize for beating me last time. \qoBetter late than never\qc, they said\. hah\.
entries.translated:
Oh, hei, [player]\. tempat lucu untuk
bertemu, ya? Jadi\. Aku diberi tahu -\latau lebih tepatnya, Pokémon yang

menghuni tubuhku diberi tahu\. Bahwa
aku harus menyampaikan ini, sebagai\lhadiah karena mengalahkanku

terakhir kali. \qoLebih baik
terlambat daripada tidak sama\lsekali\qc, mereka bilang\. hah\.

entries.original:
"That [green]Ghostium Z[blue]’s one spooky
customer, I’ll tell you that.

Any [green]Ghost[blue]-type move turns into an
attack so scary\.

It could almost scare the Pokémon
dragging this flesh prison around\loutta my skin\.

Almost\."
entries.translation_source: That [green]Ghostium Z[blue]’s one spooky customer, I’ll tell you that. Any [green]Ghost[blue]-type move turns into an attack so scary\. It could almost scare the Pokémon dragging this flesh prison around outta my skin\. Almost\.
entries.translated:
Itu [green]Ghostium Z[blue] adalah satu
pelanggan yang menyeramkan, akan\lkubilang padamu. Setiap [green]Ghost[blue]-tipe

gerakan berubah menjadi serangan
yang sangat menakutkan\. Itu hampir\lbisa menakut-nakuti Pokémon yang

menyeret penjara daging ini keluar
dari kulitku\. Hampir\.

entries.original:
"Did you know the League doesn’t pay
me for anything anymore?

I’m dead, so I don’t need food, and
I don’t get tired, so I don’t sleep,\lso I don’t need shelter, so I don’t\lneed rent money.

Gotta spend I dunno how long doing
whatever the League and this\lstupid thing wants\.

Which includes getting coffee\.

Which isn’t even for me\.

And was paid for by my host stealing
from the other customers."
entries.translation_source: Did you know the League doesn’t pay me for anything anymore? I’m dead, so I don’t need food, and I don’t get tired, so I don’t sleep, so I don’t need shelter, so I don’t need rent money. Gotta spend I dunno how long doing whatever the League and this stupid thing wants\. Which includes getting coffee\. Which isn’t even for me\. And was paid for by my host stealing from the other customers.
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa Liga tidak
membayarku untuk apa pun lagi? Aku\lsudah mati, jadi aku tidak butuh

makanan, dan aku tidak lelah, jadi
aku tidak tidur, jadi aku tidak\lbutuh tempat tinggal, jadi aku

tidak butuh uang sewa. Harus
menghabis entah berapa lama\lmelakukan apa pun yang diinginkan

Liga dan benda bodoh ini\. Yang
termasuk mendapatkan kopi\. Yang\lbahkan bukan untukku\. Dan dibayar

oleh inangku yang mencuri dari
pelanggan lain.

entries.original:
"[player]!

You came for our tea party!

Huh?

Where’s daddy?

Well\. he’s back home, looking for
another job.

But as long as I’m back before
dark, he doesn’t mind, I promise!

Here, I’ve got a present, for our
unexpected guest!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! You came for our tea party! Huh? Where’s daddy? Well\. he’s back home, looking for another job. But as long as I’m back before dark, he doesn’t mind, I promise! Here, I’ve got a present, for our unexpected guest!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu datang ke pesta teh
kami! Hah? Di mana ayah? Yah\. dia di\lrumah, mencari pekerjaan lain. Tapi

selama aku kembali sebelum gelap,
dia tidak keberatan, aku janji!\lIni, aku punya hadiah, untuk tamu

tak terduga kita!

entries.original:
"The [green]Fairium Z[red] has all the power
of my [green]Fairy[red] friends in it!

Pixie power will send your enemies
flying!"
entries.translation_source: The [green]Fairium Z[red] has all the power of my [green]Fairy[red] friends in it! Pixie power will send your enemies flying!
entries.translated:
The [green]Fairium Z[red] memiliki semua
kekuatan teman-teman [green]Peri[red]ku di\ldalamnya! Kekuatan Pixie akan

membuat musuhmu terbang!

entries.original:
"Huh? You want to know why I have
all this tea here?

Daddy said I shouldn’t bring any food
or drink I didn’t buy from the café\lhere, because it’s rude.

So I just bought all the different
tea here, and had a big tea party\lwith all my friends!

No coffee, though.

Daddy says I’m not old enough yet."
entries.translation_source: Huh? You want to know why I have all this tea here? Daddy said I shouldn’t bring any food or drink I didn’t buy from the café here, because it’s rude. So I just bought all the different tea here, and had a big tea party with all my friends! No coffee, though. Daddy says I’m not old enough yet.
entries.translated:
Hah? Kamu ingin tahu kenapa aku
punya semua teh ini di sini? Ayah\lbilang aku tidak boleh membawa

makanan atau minuman yang tidak
kubeli dari kafe sini, karena itu\ltidak sopan. Jadi aku beli semua

teh yang berbeda di sini, dan
mengadakan pesta teh besar dengan\lsemua temanku! Tapi tidak ada kopi.

Ayah bilang aku belum cukup umur.

entries.original:
"WROOOOOAR!

\.

Oh, sorry, [player] - I just got
back from DragonCon.

That’s what they said some newly
discovered Dragon called\l\qoEternatus\qc sounds like.

Real Nightmare Fuel if you ask me.
Doesn’t even look like a Dragon!

It’s a good thing you can’t find it
here in Borrius, then!

But I know something else you CAN
find, and that’s this!"
entries.translation_source: WROOOOOAR! \. Oh, sorry, [player] - I just got back from DragonCon. That’s what they said some newly discovered Dragon called \qoEternatus\qc sounds like. Real Nightmare Fuel if you ask me. Doesn’t even look like a Dragon! It’s a good thing you can’t find it here in Borrius, then! But I know something else you CAN find, and that’s this!
entries.translated:
WROOOOOAR! \. Oh, maaf, [player] -
aku baru saja kembali dari\lDragonCon. Itulah yang mereka

katakan seperti suara Naga yang
baru ditemukan bernama \qoEternatus\qc.\lBenar-benar Bahan Mimpi Buruk

menurutku. Bahkan tidak terlihat
seperti Naga! Untunglah kamu tidak\lbisa menemukannya di sini di

Borrius! Tapi aku tahu sesuatu yang
lain yang BISA kamu temukan, dan\litu ini!

entries.original:
"That [green]Dragonium Z[red] is more powerful
than any fake looking [green]Dragon[red]!

Who needs things that look like
that, when you can punch a hole\lthrough your opponents with this\lZ-Crystal!

I bet they don’t have those where
that fake Dragon comes from."
entries.translation_source: That [green]Dragonium Z[red] is more powerful than any fake looking [green]Dragon[red]! Who needs things that look like that, when you can punch a hole through your opponents with this Z-Crystal! I bet they don’t have those where that fake Dragon comes from.
entries.translated:
[green]Dragonium Z[red] lebih kuat daripada
[green]Naga[red] palsu mana pun! Siapa yang\lbutuh hal yang terlihat seperti

itu, ketika kamu bisa melubangi
lawanmu dengan Z-Crystal ini! Pasti\lmereka tidak punya itu di tempat

asal Naga palsu itu.

entries.original:
"Y’know, everyone who meets me for
the first time says the same thing\.

They were expecting a Dragon-type
Trainer to be more elegant and\lmature\.

Pfft! I’m totally mature - this tape
I got says it’s rated \qoMature\qc!"
entries.translation_source: Y’know, everyone who meets me for the first time says the same thing\. They were expecting a Dragon-type Trainer to be more elegant and mature\. Pfft! I’m totally mature - this tape I got says it’s rated \qoMature\qc!
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu, semua orang yang pertama
kali bertemu denganku mengatakan\lhal yang sama\. Mereka mengharapkan

Pelatih tipe Naga yang lebih elegan
dan dewasa\. Pfft! Aku sangat dewasa\l- kaset yang kubeli ini bilang itu

berperingkat \qoDewasa\qc!

entries.original:
"[black]You inspect the cover of the
video’s box\.

That\.\CC0818 is NOT a comfortable thing to
do to a Goomy."
entries.translation_source: [black]You inspect the cover of the video’s box\. That\.\CC0818 is NOT a comfortable thing to do to a Goomy.
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu memeriksa sampul kotak video
itu\. Itu\.\CC0818 BUKAN hal yang nyaman\ldilakukan pada Goomy.

entries.original:
"\.

[black]The boy is proposing a trade.

Would you like to trade a
[green][buffer1][black] for his [green][buffer2][black]?"
entries.translation_source: \. [black]The boy is proposing a trade. Would you like to trade a [green][buffer1][black] for his [green][buffer2][black]?
entries.translated:
\.[black]\. [black]Anak laki-laki itu mengusulkan
perdagangan. Apakah kamu ingin\lmenukar [green][buffer1][black] dengan [green][buffer2][black]

miliknya?

entries.original:
"[black]The boy is not looking for that
Pokémon.

He wants a [green][buffer1][black]."
entries.translation_source: [black]The boy is not looking for that Pokémon. He wants a [green][buffer1][black].
entries.translated:
[black]Anak laki-laki itu tidak mencari
Pokémon itu. Dia menginginkan\l[green][buffer1][black].

entries.original:
"[black]Huh?

Pikachu seems to be holding
some clothes."
entries.translation_source: [black]Huh? Pikachu seems to be holding some clothes.
entries.translated:
[black]Hah? Pikachu tampaknya memegang
beberapa pakaian.

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1]’s outfit is now available
in the Costume Box!"
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1]’s outfit is now available in the Costume Box!
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1]Pakaian [buffer1] sekarang
tersedia di Kotak Kostum!

entries.original:
"What’s this?
You have quite the intense aura.

What’s your name?

\.

Okay. I’ll remember that!
[player], nice to meet you.

I’m Cynthia.

I’m currently travelling the world,
studying the various mythology of\lthe world’s Pokémon.

And Borrius in particular\.\CC0818 well,
there’s no shortage of fascinating\lfinds here.

Old tombs, mysterious tablets\. not to
mention, a rich history concerning\lanother faraway region\.

Oh, but I’m rambling - was there
something else you wanted from me?"
entries.translation_source: What’s this? You have quite the intense aura. What’s your name? \. Okay. I’ll remember that! [player], nice to meet you. I’m Cynthia. I’m currently travelling the world, studying the various mythology of the world’s Pokémon. And Borrius in particular\.\CC0818 well, there’s no shortage of fascinating finds here. Old tombs, mysterious tablets\. not to mention, a rich history concerning another faraway region\. Oh, but I’m rambling - was there something else you wanted from me?
entries.translated:
Ada apa? Kamu memiliki aura yang
cukup kuat. Siapa namamu? \. Oke. Aku\lakan mengingatnya! [player], senang

bertemu denganmu. Aku Cynthia. Saat
ini aku sedang bepergian keliling\ldunia, mempelajari berbagai

mitologi Pokémon di dunia. Dan
Borrius khususnya\.\CC0818 yah, tidak ada\lkekurangan temuan menarik di sini.

Makam tua, tablet misterius\. belum
lagi, sejarah yang kaya tentang\ldaerah lain yang jauh\. Oh, tapi aku

ngelantur - apakah ada hal lain
yang kamu inginkan dariku?

entries.original:
"I’m sure you can tell - I’m also
a Trainer, myself.

And when two Trainers meet, it’s
customary to offer the chance to\lbattle.

If you’re willing, would you care to
be my opponent?"
entries.translation_source: I’m sure you can tell - I’m also a Trainer, myself. And when two Trainers meet, it’s customary to offer the chance to battle. If you’re willing, would you care to be my opponent?
entries.translated:
Aku yakin kamu bisa tahu - aku juga
seorang Pelatih. Dan ketika dua\lPelatih bertemu, sudah menjadi

kebiasaan untuk menawarkan
kesempatan bertarung. Jika kamu\lbersedia, maukah kamu menjadi

lawanku?

entries.original:
"No matter how many times I throw
my first Poké Ball, the anticipation\lis always so intense\.

Your eyes\. they burn with such
calm focus.

It’s like nothing else exists,
except this moment of battle\.

Then I, Cynthia, shall match your
passion with equal force!

There won’t be any letup from me!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how many times I throw my first Poké Ball, the anticipation is always so intense\. Your eyes\. they burn with such calm focus. It’s like nothing else exists, except this moment of battle\. Then I, Cynthia, shall match your passion with equal force! There won’t be any letup from me!
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli berapa kali aku
melempar Poké Ball pertamaku,\lantisipasinya selalu begitu kuat\.

Matamu\. mereka membara dengan fokus
yang tenang. Seolah tidak ada yang\llain, kecuali momen pertempuran ini\.

Maka aku, Cynthia, akan membalas
semangatmu dengan kekuatan yang\lsetara! Tidak akan ada kendur

dariku!

entries.original:
"That was quite the exceptional
strength you displayed.

And yet\.

Victory, defeat\.\CC0818 you don’t
seem to be focused on such things.

There’s something else that you
seek, some other answer\.

It would make me truly happy to
see such a fascinating Trainer\lagain sometime."
entries.translation_source: That was quite the exceptional strength you displayed. And yet\. Victory, defeat\.\CC0818 you don’t seem to be focused on such things. There’s something else that you seek, some other answer\. It would make me truly happy to see such a fascinating Trainer again sometime.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah kekuatan luar biasa yang
kamu tunjukkan. Namun\. Kemenangan,\lkekalahan\.\CC0818 kamu tampaknya tidak

fokus pada hal-hal itu. Ada sesuatu
yang lain yang kamu cari, jawaban\llain\. Akan sangat membuatku senang

bisa bertemu Pelatih yang menarik
seperti itu lagi suatu saat.

entries.original:
"Ah, I see\. it was a rather hasty
offer, wasn’t it? Ha ha\.

There’s no shame in taking it slowly
and rationally.

Come see me again when you’re ready."
entries.translation_source: Ah, I see\. it was a rather hasty offer, wasn’t it? Ha ha\. There’s no shame in taking it slowly and rationally. Come see me again when you’re ready.
entries.translated:
Ah, begitu\. itu tawaran yang agak
terburu-buru, bukan? Ha ha\. Tidak\lada salahnya untuk melakukannya

perlahan dan rasional. Temui aku
lagi saat kamu siap.

entries.original:
"What’s Magnolia Town known for?

Well, this here town is the ol’ home
of the Polder Town Gym Leader!

And if that ain’t enough, we got
the famous Moomoo farm, too!

We’re Borrius’ main supply of
Moomoo Milk.

You’re sure to find it cheaper
here than anywhere else!"
entries.translation_source: What’s Magnolia Town known for? Well, this here town is the ol’ home of the Polder Town Gym Leader! And if that ain’t enough, we got the famous Moomoo farm, too! We’re Borrius’ main supply of Moomoo Milk. You’re sure to find it cheaper here than anywhere else!
entries.translated:
Apa yang terkenal dari Kota
Magnolia? Yah, kota ini adalah\lrumah lama Pemimpin Gym Kota

Polder! Dan jika itu belum cukup,
kami punya peternakan Moomoo yang\lterkenal juga! Kami adalah pemasok

utama Susu Moomoo di Borrius. Kamu
pasti akan menemukannya lebih murah\ldi sini daripada di tempat lain!

entries.original:
"Our town is so tiny, it don’t even
got its own building for the Mart!

However\.

We have a Café!
It’s this here building.

Trainers come from all over to
eat here.

You’re sure to meet some cool
people every day if you eat\lhere, too."
entries.translation_source: Our town is so tiny, it don’t even got its own building for the Mart! However\. We have a Café! It’s this here building. Trainers come from all over to eat here. You’re sure to meet some cool people every day if you eat here, too.
entries.translated:
Kota kami sangat kecil, bahkan
tidak punya gedung sendiri untuk\lMart! Namun\. Kami punya Kafe! Ini

gedungnya. Pelatih datang dari
mana-mana untuk makan di sini. Kamu\lpasti akan bertemu orang-orang

keren setiap hari jika kamu makan
di sini juga.

entries.original:
"This here farm is the pride and joy
of Magnolia Town.

Without these Miltank, our town
wouldn’t be known as well!"
entries.translation_source: This here farm is the pride and joy of Magnolia Town. Without these Miltank, our town wouldn’t be known as well!
entries.translated:
Peternakan ini adalah kebanggaan
dan kegembiraan Kota Magnolia.\lTanpa Miltank ini, kota kita tidak

akan dikenal juga!

entries.original:
"Some hooligans up and nabbed our
Miltank!

I bet the Moomoo Misses is all up
in tears right about now\."
entries.translation_source: Some hooligans up and nabbed our Miltank! I bet the Moomoo Misses is all up in tears right about now\.
entries.translated:
Beberapa preman menculik Miltank
kami! Aku yakin Moomoo Misses\lmenangis sekarang\.

entries.original: "[green]Moooooo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Moooooo!
entries.translated: [green]Moooooo!

entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] is sleeping.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] sedang tidur.

entries.original: "Wye"
entries.translation_source: Wye
entries.translated: Wye

entries.original: "Aha"
entries.translation_source: Aha
entries.translated: Aha

entries.original: "Ditoh"
entries.translation_source: Ditoh
entries.translated: Ditoh

entries.original:
"[red]Hi!
This way, pleeeease!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Hi! This way, pleeeease!
entries.translated: [red]Hai! Lewat sini, kumohon!

entries.original:
"[red]Exciting! Thrilling! Zippy!
Chilling! It’s \qoPep Quiz\qc!

Today’s challenger is--this person!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Exciting! Thrilling! Zippy! Chilling! It’s \qoPep Quiz\qc! Today’s challenger is--this person!
entries.translated:
[red]Menyenangkan! Mendebarkan! Cepat!
Mengesankan! Ini \qoPep Quiz\qc!\lPenantang hari ini adalah--orang

ini!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hiya, welcome!

\qoPep Quiz\qc starts NOW!

Answer lots of quizzy questions,
and watch your brain get brainier!

Let’s start\. with\. a question!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hiya, welcome! \qoPep Quiz\qc starts NOW! Answer lots of quizzy questions, and watch your brain get brainier! Let’s start\. with\. a question!
entries.translated:
[blue]Halo, selamat datang! \qoPep Quiz\qc
dimulai SEKARANG! Jawab banyak\lpertanyaan kuis, dan lihat otakmu

semakin pintar! Mari kita mulai\.
dengan\. sebuah pertanyaan!

entries.original: "[red]Good luck!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Good luck!
entries.translated: [red]Semoga berhasil!

entries.original: "[blue]A question!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]A question!
entries.translated: [blue]Sebuah pertanyaan!

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, my!
It’s tremendously difficult!

Can the challenger answer this?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Oh, my! It’s tremendously difficult! Can the challenger answer this?
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, astaga! Ini sangat sulit!
Bisakah penantang menjawab ini?

entries.original: "[red]H-i-n-t! H-i-n-t!"
entries.translation_source: [red]H-i-n-t! H-i-n-t!
entries.translated: [red]P-e-t-u-n-j-u-k! P-e-t-u-n-j-u-k!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh-oh. The audience
is asking for a hint!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh-oh. The audience is asking for a hint!
entries.translated: [blue]Oh-oh. Penonton meminta petunjuk!

entries.original:
"[red]Okay.
I’ll give you a hint!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Okay. I’ll give you a hint!
entries.translated: [red]Oke. Aku akan memberimu petunjuk!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ha ha, this is a good hint!
Challenger, please answer!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Ha ha, this is a good hint! Challenger, please answer!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ha ha, ini petunjuk yang bagus!
Penantang, silakan jawab!

entries.original:
"[blue]Woo-hoo!
This is c-o-r-r-e-c-t!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Woo-hoo! This is c-o-r-r-e-c-t!
entries.translated: [blue]Woo-hoo! Ini b-e-n-a-r!

entries.original: "[red]You go! Yeah, you do!"
entries.translation_source: [red]You go! Yeah, you do!
entries.translated: [red]Ayo! Ya, kamu bisa!

entries.original: "[red]Yeah! Yeah! Good hustle!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Yeah! Yeah! Good hustle!
entries.translated: [red]Ya! Ya! Usaha bagus!

entries.original:
"[blue]Congratulations!

Now - THIS is a prize.
It’s a Big Nugget!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Congratulations! Now - THIS is a prize. It’s a Big Nugget!
entries.translated:
[blue]Selamat! Sekarang - INI adalah
hadiah. Ini adalah Nugget Besar!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, no. Too bad!

That’s not right, ’cause you are
wrong!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh, no. Too bad! That’s not right, ’cause you are wrong!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, tidak. Sayang sekali! Itu tidak
benar, karena kamu salah!

entries.original: "[red]Aww\. Sadness\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Aww\. Sadness\.
entries.translated: [red]Aww\. Sedih\.

entries.original:
"[red]Good hustle!
Gustle! Gustle!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Good hustle! Gustle! Gustle!
entries.translated: [red]Semangat! Gustle! Gustle!

entries.original:
"[blue]Yeah, you gustle!

Here ya go\. Take this memento.
It’s a Tiny Mushroom!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Yeah, you gustle! Here ya go\. Take this memento. It’s a Tiny Mushroom!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ya, kau gustle! Ini dia\. Ambil
kenang-kenangan ini. Itu Jamur\lKecil!

entries.original:
"[red]Exciting! Thrilling! Zippy!
Chilling! That’s \qoPep Quiz\qc!

See ya tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Exciting! Thrilling! Zippy! Chilling! That’s \qoPep Quiz\qc! See ya tomorrow!
entries.translated:
[red]Menyenangkan! Mendebarkan! Cepat!
Mendinginkan! Itu \qoPep Quiz\qc!\lSampai jumpa besok!

entries.original: "Do you like quiz shows?"
entries.translation_source: Do you like quiz shows?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu suka acara kuis?

entries.original: "I want to be on TV soon!"
entries.translation_source: I want to be on TV soon!
entries.translated: Aku ingin segera tampil di TV!

entries.original: "Gussssssssstle!"
entries.translation_source: Gussssssssstle!
entries.translated: Gussssssssstle!

entries.original:
"How’d you like my Moomoo Milk?

It’s my pride and joy, there.

Give it to a Pokémon to restore
HP!

I’ll give it to you for just $500."
entries.translation_source: How’d you like my Moomoo Milk? It’s my pride and joy, there. Give it to a Pokémon to restore HP! I’ll give it to you for just $500.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana dengan Susu Moomoo-ku?
Itu kebanggaan dan kegembiraanku.\lBerikan pada Pokémon untuk

memulihkan HP! Aku akan
memberikannya padamu hanya $500.

entries.original:
"Here ya go!
Drink up’n enjoy!"
entries.translation_source: Here ya go! Drink up’n enjoy!
entries.translated: Ini dia! Minum dan nikmati!

entries.original: "And that’ll be $500!"
entries.translation_source: And that’ll be $500!
entries.translated: Dan itu akan menjadi $500!

entries.original: "And that’ll be $6000!"
entries.translation_source: And that’ll be $6000!
entries.translated: Dan itu akan menjadi $6000!

entries.original:
"You don’t want it?
Come again, hear?"
entries.translation_source: You don’t want it? Come again, hear?
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak menginginkannya? Datang
lagi, ya?

entries.original:
"I reckon you don’t have enough
money for the Moomoo Milk."
entries.translation_source: I reckon you don’t have enough money for the Moomoo Milk.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak punya cukup
uang untuk Susu Moomoo.

entries.original: "1 Bottle"
entries.translation_source: 1 Bottle
entries.translated: 1 Botol

entries.original: "1 Dozen"
entries.translation_source: 1 Dozen
entries.translated: 1 Lusin

entries.original:
"An unfamiliar face!
This is a gift for such a person."
entries.translation_source: An unfamiliar face! This is a gift for such a person.
entries.translated:
Wajah yang asing! Ini hadiah untuk
orang seperti itu.

entries.original:
"No matter what my guests order,
I always serve them in the\lsame manner.

That is what I learned from my
father, who was a Pokémon Trainer."
entries.translation_source: No matter what my guests order, I always serve them in the same manner. That is what I learned from my father, who was a Pokémon Trainer.
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli apa yang dipesan
tamuku, aku selalu melayani mereka\ldengan cara yang sama. Itulah yang

aku pelajari dari ayahku, yang
adalah seorang Pelatih Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Mudbray is a great helper in this
fine establishment!

Not only does it help prepare the
meals, but it also excels in\ldelivering food to customers!

Don’t you wish you had a Mudbray
capable of doing all that?"
entries.translation_source: Mudbray is a great helper in this fine establishment! Not only does it help prepare the meals, but it also excels in delivering food to customers! Don’t you wish you had a Mudbray capable of doing all that?
entries.translated:
Mudbray adalah pembantu yang hebat
di tempat yang bagus ini! Tidak\lhanya membantu menyiapkan makanan,

tetapi juga unggul dalam
mengantarkan makanan ke pelanggan!\lTidakkah kamu berharap memiliki

Mudbray yang mampu melakukan semua
itu?

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon drinks a blend that
raises the same stat its nature\lboosts, that stat will go up more!

But if a Pokémon drinks a blend that
boosts the same stat its nature\llowers, that stat will go up less\."
entries.translation_source: If a Pokémon drinks a blend that raises the same stat its nature boosts, that stat will go up more! But if a Pokémon drinks a blend that boosts the same stat its nature lowers, that stat will go up less\.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon meminum campuran yang
meningkatkan stat yang sama dengan\lyang dinaikkan oleh nature-nya,

stat itu akan naik lebih banyak!
Tetapi jika Pokémon meminum\lcampuran yang meningkatkan stat

yang sama dengan yang diturunkan
oleh nature-nya, stat itu akan naik\llebih sedikit\.

entries.original: "The trash can is empty."
entries.translation_source: The trash can is empty.
entries.translated: Tempat sampah kosong.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Magnolia Café!

Are you interested in blending some
Pokémon juice for $[green][buffer2][red]?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Magnolia Café! Are you interested in blending some Pokémon juice for $[green][buffer2][red]?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Magnolia Café!
Apakah kamu tertarik membuat jus\lPokémon seharga $[green][buffer2][red]?

entries.original:
"Are you interested in blending some
Pokémon juice for $[green][buffer2][red]?"
entries.translation_source: Are you interested in blending some Pokémon juice for $[green][buffer2][red]?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tertarik membuat jus
Pokémon seharga $[green][buffer2][red]?

entries.original:
"Which of your Berries would you like
to blend?

Please choose three different kinds."
entries.translation_source: Which of your Berries would you like to blend? Please choose three different kinds.
entries.translated:
Berry mana yang ingin kamu campur?
Silakan pilih tiga jenis yang\lberbeda.

entries.original:
"You’ve already chosen to blend your
[buffer1].

Please choose a different one."
entries.translation_source: You’ve already chosen to blend your [buffer1]. Please choose a different one.
entries.translated:
Kamu sudah memilih untuk mencampur
[buffer1] milikmu. Silakan pilih\lyang lain.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, but I can’t blend the
[buffer1].

Please choose a different Berry."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, but I can’t blend the [buffer1]. Please choose a different Berry.
entries.translated:
Maaf, saya tidak bisa mencampur
[buffer1]. Silakan pilih Berry yang\llain.

entries.original:
"So you want to blend the
[green][buffer1][red], [green][buffer2][red],\land [green][buffer3][red], is that correct?"
entries.translation_source: So you want to blend the [green][buffer1][red], [green][buffer2][red], and [green][buffer3][red], is that correct?
entries.translated:
Jadi kamu ingin mencampur [green][buffer1][red],
[green][buffer2][red], dan [green][buffer3][red], apakah itu\lbenar?

entries.original: "Which Pokémon will the drink be for?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon will the drink be for?
entries.translated:
Minuman ini untuk Pokémon yang
mana?

entries.original:
"So, you want to blend the drink
for [green][buffer1][red], is that correct?"
entries.translation_source: So, you want to blend the drink for [green][buffer1][red], is that correct?
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu ingin mencampur minuman
untuk [green][buffer1][red], apakah itu benar?

entries.original: "That’ll be $[buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: That’ll be $[buffer2].
entries.translated: Itu akan menjadi $[buffer2].

entries.original:
"Please wait while I blend your
Berries."
entries.translation_source: Please wait while I blend your Berries.
entries.translated:
Harap tunggu sementara saya
mencampur Berry Anda.

entries.original:
"All done!
Order up!"
entries.translation_source: All done! Order up!
entries.translated: Selesai! Pesanan siap!

entries.original:
"[black][buffer2] happily drank the
Berry blend."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer2] happily drank the Berry blend.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer2] dengan senang meminum
campuran Berry itu.

entries.original: "Please, come again!"
entries.translation_source: Please, come again!
entries.translated: Silakan datang lagi!

entries.original:
"I’m so sorry!
You don’t have enough money."
entries.translation_source: I’m so sorry! You don’t have enough money.
entries.translated: Maaf sekali! Uangmu tidak cukup.

entries.original:
"Not interested?
Please, come again!"
entries.translation_source: Not interested? Please, come again!
entries.translated:
Tidak tertarik? Silakan datang
lagi!

entries.original:
"I’m so sorry!

I can’t blend Berries for an Egg.
It just wouldn’t work!

Please choose a different Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m so sorry! I can’t blend Berries for an Egg. It just wouldn’t work! Please choose a different Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Maaf sekali! Saya tidak bisa
mencampur Berry untuk Telur. Itu\ltidak akan berhasil! Silakan pilih

Pokémon lain.

entries.original:
"I’m so sorry!

The Berry blender is currently
broken.

Please, come again!"
entries.translation_source: I’m so sorry! The Berry blender is currently broken. Please, come again!
entries.translated:
Maaf sekali! Mesin pencampur Berry
sedang rusak. Silakan datang lagi!

entries.original:
"Listen here, Trainer.

[green]Moomoo Milk[blue] is the best healin’
remedy you could buy.

Not only does it restore a whoppin’
100 HP, it only costs $500!

What a deal!

You better hustle on over to [green]Moomoo
Farm[blue] and buy a whole bunch!

\.

What?

They’re not paying me to stand here
and say this, I swear!"
entries.translation_source: Listen here, Trainer. [green]Moomoo Milk[blue] is the best healin’ remedy you could buy. Not only does it restore a whoppin’ 100 HP, it only costs $500! What a deal! You better hustle on over to [green]Moomoo Farm[blue] and buy a whole bunch! \. What? They’re not paying me to stand here and say this, I swear!
entries.translated:
Dengar, Trainer. [green]Susu Moomoo[blue] adalah
obat penyembuh terbaik yang bisa\lkamu beli. Tidak hanya

mengembalikan 100 HP, harganya
hanya $500! Penawaran yang bagus!\lKamu harus bergegas ke [green]Peternakan

Moomoo[blue] dan beli banyak-banyak! \.
Apa? Mereka tidak membayar saya\luntuk berdiri di sini dan

mengatakan ini, sumpah!

entries.original:
"The [green]Magnolia Café[red] is a popular
spot for Trainers.

Like all cafés, it has its daily
regulars, but I’ve heard Borrius’\lGym Leaders like to dine there, too,\lon occasion."
entries.translation_source: The [green]Magnolia Café[red] is a popular spot for Trainers. Like all cafés, it has its daily regulars, but I’ve heard Borrius’ Gym Leaders like to dine there, too, on occasion.
entries.translated:
[green]Magnolia Café[red] adalah tempat populer
bagi para Trainer. Seperti semua\lkafe, ia memiliki pelanggan tetap

harian, tapi saya dengar Pemimpin
Gym Borrius juga suka makan di\lsana, sesekali.

entries.original:
"Trainer\.

If my Pokémon was with me, I
would have challenged you to\la battle.

Instead, please accept this."
entries.translation_source: Trainer\. If my Pokémon was with me, I would have challenged you to a battle. Instead, please accept this.
entries.translated:
Trainer\. Jika Pokémon saya ada
bersama saya, saya akan menantangmu\lbertarung. Sebagai gantinya, tolong

terima ini.

entries.original:
"It is\. a [green]Light Clay[blue]!

Have a Pokémon hold this, and the
screens set up will stay up longer!

That was the perfect item for my
Pokémon’s signature move\."
entries.translation_source: It is\. a [green]Light Clay[blue]! Have a Pokémon hold this, and the screens set up will stay up longer! That was the perfect item for my Pokémon’s signature move\.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah\. [green]Light Clay[blue]! Minta
Pokémon memegang ini, dan layar\lyang dipasang akan bertahan lebih

lama! Itu adalah item yang sempurna
untuk jurus unggulan Pokémon-ku\.

entries.original:
"This here’s Magnolia Town!

We’re on duty to make sure no nasty
critters come wanderin’ in from\lol’ Cootes Bog."
entries.translation_source: This here’s Magnolia Town! We’re on duty to make sure no nasty critters come wanderin’ in from ol’ Cootes Bog.
entries.translated:
Ini dia Kota Magnolia! Kami
bertugas memastikan tidak ada\lmakhluk jahat yang masuk dari Rawa

Cootes.

entries.original:
"We’re the guardians of Magnolia
Town!

\.Well, we ain’t really.

All us farmers got a rotation to
stand guard in this gate."
entries.translation_source: We’re the guardians of Magnolia Town! \.Well, we ain’t really. All us farmers got a rotation to stand guard in this gate.
entries.translated:
Kami adalah penjaga Kota Magnolia!
\.Yah, sebenarnya tidak. Kami semua\lpetani mendapat giliran untuk

berjaga di gerbang ini.

entries.translation_source: Prof. Log
entries.translated: Prof. Log
