entries.translation_source: Jax
entries.translated: Jax

entries.translation_source: Marlon
entries.translated: Marlon

entries.translation_source: Ivory
entries.translated: Ivory

entries.translated: Zeph

entries.translation_source: Aklove
entries.translated: Aklove

entries.translation_source: Scientist
entries.translated: Ilmuwan

entries.original: "Grunt"
entries.translation_source: Grunt
entries.translated: Preman

entries.original: "Grunts"
entries.translation_source: Grunts
entries.translated: Preman-Preman

entries.original: "Grunt A"
entries.translation_source: Grunt A
entries.translated: Preman A

entries.original: "Grunt B"
entries.translation_source: Grunt B
entries.translated: Preman B

entries.original: "Grunt C"
entries.translation_source: Grunt C
entries.translated: Preman C

entries.original: "Hoopa"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa
entries.translated: Hoopa

entries.original: "A Hero’s Journey"
entries.translation_source: A Hero’s Journey
entries.translated: Perjalanan Seorang Pahlawan

entries.original: "A Heroine’s Journey"
entries.translation_source: A Heroine’s Journey
entries.translated: Perjalanan Seorang Pahlawan Wanita

entries.original:
"What the\.?

How did you get in here?"
entries.translation_source: What the\.? How did you get in here?
entries.translated:
Apa apaan\.? Bagaimana kau bisa masuk
ke sini?

entries.original:
"Quick, scientist!
What are you standing around for?

Grab [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Quick, scientist! What are you standing around for? Grab [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
Cepat, ilmuwan! Apa yang kau
tunggu? Tangkap [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Now knock [buffer1] out and lock [buffer1]
up in the warehouse!

Zeph is going to freak out when he
hears about this\."
entries.translation_source: Now knock [buffer1] out and lock [buffer1] up in the warehouse! Zeph is going to freak out when he hears about this\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang pingsankan [buffer1] dan
kunci [buffer1] di gudang! Zeph akan\lpanik saat mendengar ini\.

entries.original: "[buffer3] is unconscious, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: [buffer3] is unconscious, Hoopa.
entries.translated:
[buffer3] tidak sadarkan diri,
Hoopa.

entries.original:
"Stop!

Have I not told you countless times
to stay out of my Cube Space\lunless you have express permission?

I am aware you cannot travel
through your rings anymore, but\lthat does not give you the right\lto disobey me!"
entries.translation_source: Stop! Have I not told you countless times to stay out of my Cube Space unless you have express permission? I am aware you cannot travel through your rings anymore, but that does not give you the right to disobey me!
entries.translated:
Berhenti! Bukankah aku sudah
berkali-kali bilang untuk tidak\lmasuk ke Cube Space-ku tanpa izin?

Aku tahu kau tidak bisa lagi
bepergian melalui cincinmu, tapi\litu tidak memberimu hak untuk tidak

menaati perintahku!

entries.original:
"And were you the one responsible
for bringing [buffer1] here?"
entries.translation_source: And were you the one responsible for bringing [buffer1] here?
entries.translated:
Dan apakah kau yang bertanggung
jawab membawa [buffer1] ke sini?

entries.original:
"I do not know what you wanted
[buffer1] for, but you have been a\lrepeated nuisance ever since I\lfound you on that beach last year!

I may not be your true \qoguardian\qc,
but I am your Trainer now!

And as your Trainer, I order you to
cease these immature antics of\lyours\.\CC0818 NOW!"
entries.translation_source: I do not know what you wanted [buffer1] for, but you have been a repeated nuisance ever since I found you on that beach last year! I may not be your true \qoguardian\qc, but I am your Trainer now! And as your Trainer, I order you to cease these immature antics of yours\.\CC0818 NOW!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu apa yang kau
inginkan dari [buffer1], tapi kau\lsudah menjadi gangguan berulang

sejak aku menemukanmu di pantai itu
tahun lalu! Aku mungkin bukan\l\qopenjaga sejatimu\qc, tapi aku

Pelatihmu sekarang! Dan sebagai
Pelatihmu, aku memerintahkanmu\luntuk menghentikan tingkah

kekanak-kanakan ini\.\CC0818 SEKARANG!

entries.original: "What a bother\."
entries.translation_source: What a bother\.
entries.translated: Sungguh merepotkan\.

entries.original: "Wait\."
entries.translation_source: Wait\.
entries.translated: Tunggu\.

entries.original:
"Now that I think about it,
I could work with this\."
entries.translation_source: Now that I think about it, I could work with this\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang setelah kupikir, aku bisa
bekerja dengan ini\.

entries.original:
"Where do you think you’re going,
kid?

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Where do you think you’re going, kid? I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Kau pikir mau ke mana, nak? Aku
diperintahkan untuk menguncimu di\lsini.

entries.original:
"[black]He’s unconscious.

What’s this?

There’s something written on his
shirt.

It’s his name!
It is\."
entries.translation_source: [black]He’s unconscious. What’s this? There’s something written on his shirt. It’s his name! It is\.
entries.translated:
[black]Dia tidak sadar. Apa ini? Ada
tulisan di bajunya. Itu namanya!\lBenar\.

entries.original: "[black]Is his name [rival]?"
entries.translation_source: [black]Is his name [rival]?
entries.translated: [black]Apakah namanya [rival]?

entries.original:
"Come on, [player].
Let’s find another way out of here."
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player]. Let’s find another way out of here.
entries.translated:
Ayo, [player]. Mari cari jalan
keluar lain.

entries.original:
"We need to find those Pokémon!
They could be our way out!"
entries.translation_source: We need to find those Pokémon! They could be our way out!
entries.translated:
Kita harus menemukan Pokémon itu!
Mereka bisa jadi jalan keluar kita!

entries.original:
"Hurry up, [player], choose a
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Hurry up, [player], choose a Pokémon.
entries.translated: Cepat, [player], pilih Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Let’s use our new Pokémon to break
out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s use our new Pokémon to break out of here!
entries.translated:
Ayo gunakan Pokémon baru kita untuk
kabur dari sini!

entries.original:
"Hey!
Who do you think you are?

Do you think you can get away with
keeping me locked up in here?

You’d better let me through right
now, or you’re gonna feel my wrath!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Who do you think you are? Do you think you can get away with keeping me locked up in here? You’d better let me through right now, or you’re gonna feel my wrath!
entries.translated:
Hei! Kau pikir kau siapa? Apa kau
pikir bisa seenaknya mengunciku di\lsini? Sebaiknya kau biarkan aku

lewat sekarang, atau kau akan
merasakan amarahku!

entries.original:
"Back off, kid.

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Back off, kid. I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Mundur, nak. Aku diperintahkan
untuk menguncimu di sini.

entries.original:
"So scram, unless you want
to\.\CC0820 feel my wrath."
entries.translation_source: So scram, unless you want to\.\CC0820 feel my wrath.
entries.translated:
Jadi pergi, kecuali kau ingin\.\CC0820
merasakan amarahku.

entries.original:
"Smart choice.

Keep far away from this door,
and you won’t regret it."
entries.translation_source: Smart choice. Keep far away from this door, and you won’t regret it.
entries.translated:
Pilihan cerdas. Jauhi pintu ini,
dan kau tidak akan menyesal.

entries.original:
"Huh? Who are you?

Pretty sure I was by myself
when they threw me in here.

\.

[player], huh?

And you’re saying you got sucked
in here by a magic portal?

That’s a pretty dramatic entrance."
entries.translation_source: Huh? Who are you? Pretty sure I was by myself when they threw me in here. \. [player], huh? And you’re saying you got sucked in here by a magic portal? That’s a pretty dramatic entrance.
entries.translated:
Hah? Siapa kau? Yakin aku sendirian
saat mereka melemparku ke sini. \.\l[player], ya? Dan kau bilang kau

tersedot ke sini oleh portal ajaib?
Itu masuk yang dramatis.

entries.original:
"Hey\. Those clothes\.
Do you live in Frozen Heights?

I just moved in, but I guess I
never stopped by to say hi."
entries.translation_source: Hey\. Those clothes\. Do you live in Frozen Heights? I just moved in, but I guess I never stopped by to say hi.
entries.translated:
Hei\. Pakaian itu\. Apakah kamu tinggal
di Frozen Heights? Aku baru saja\lpindah, tapi sepertinya aku tidak

pernah mampir untuk menyapa.

entries.original:
"Say\.\CC0818 how about we buddy up
and look for a way out together?

The door back there’s a bust with
that guard in the way.

Oh yeah, I guess I should introduce
myself, partner.

My name is\."
entries.translation_source: Say\.\CC0818 how about we buddy up and look for a way out together? The door back there’s a bust with that guard in the way. Oh yeah, I guess I should introduce myself, partner. My name is\.
entries.translated:
Katakan\.\CC0818 bagaimana kalau kita
berteman dan mencari jalan keluar\lbersama? Pintu di belakang sana

tidak berguna dengan penjaga itu
menghalangi. Oh ya, kurasa aku\lharus memperkenalkan diriku, mitra.

Namaku\.

entries.original:
"My name’s [rival].

I’m looking for my parents, and I
thought these people would have\la lead on them.

And, well\.\CC0818 you can see they hate
it when people go snooping.

Anyway, we’d better start looking
for another exit, so let’s move."
entries.translation_source: My name’s [rival]. I’m looking for my parents, and I thought these people would have a lead on them. And, well\.\CC0818 you can see they hate it when people go snooping. Anyway, we’d better start looking for another exit, so let’s move.
entries.translated:
Namaku [rival]. Aku mencari orang
tuaku, dan kupikir orang-orang ini\lpunya petunjuk tentang mereka. Dan,

yah\.\CC0818 kau bisa lihat mereka benci
kalau ada yang mengintip.\lBagaimanapun, sebaiknya kita mulai

mencari jalan keluar lain, jadi ayo
bergerak.

entries.original:
"Did you hear that, [player]?

It sounded like some Pokémon are
trapped in that cage over there!

Let’s go check it out."
entries.translation_source: Did you hear that, [player]? It sounded like some Pokémon are trapped in that cage over there! Let’s go check it out.
entries.translated:
Kau dengar itu, [player]?
Kedengarannya beberapa Pokémon\lterjebak di dalam kandang di sana!

Ayo kita periksa.

entries.original:
"There are many Pokémon locked
away in the cage\."
entries.translation_source: There are many Pokémon locked away in the cage\.
entries.translated:
Ada banyak Pokémon yang terkunci di
dalam kandang\.

entries.original:
"The cage door is unlocked.
The Pokémon are gone."
entries.translation_source: The cage door is unlocked. The Pokémon are gone.
entries.translated:
Pintu kandang tidak terkunci.
Pokémon-nya sudah pergi.

entries.original:
"The lock appears fragile.
Break it?"
entries.translation_source: The lock appears fragile. Break it?
entries.translated: Gemboknya tampak rapuh. Hancurkan?

entries.original: "The cage door swung open!"
entries.translation_source: The cage door swung open!
entries.translated: Pintu kandang terbuka lebar!

entries.original:
"It looks like these Pokémon are
grateful and want to join us!

If we each take one and put them in
these Poké Balls I picked up, we\lcan use them to attack the guard\land escape!

So, what are you waiting for?
Go ahead, choose a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It looks like these Pokémon are grateful and want to join us! If we each take one and put them in these Poké Balls I picked up, we can use them to attack the guard and escape! So, what are you waiting for? Go ahead, choose a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Pokémon ini berterima
kasih dan ingin bergabung dengan\lkita! Jika kita masing-masing

mengambil satu dan memasukkannya ke
dalam Poké Ball yang aku kumpulkan,\lkita bisa menggunakannya untuk

menyerang penjaga dan melarikan
diri! Jadi, tunggu apa lagi?\lSilakan, pilih satu Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Will you take the [green][buffer2][black] Pokémon,
[green][buffer1][black]?"
entries.translation_source: Will you take the [green][buffer2][black] Pokémon, [green][buffer1][black]?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu akan mengambil Pokémon
[green][buffer2][black], [green][buffer1][black]?

entries.original:
"The [green][buffer1][black] joined [player]’s party!
It has the [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: The [green][buffer1][black] joined [player]’s party! It has the [green][buffer2][black] nature.
entries.translated:
Pokémon [green][buffer1][black] bergabung dengan
party [player]! Ia memiliki sifat\l[green][buffer2][black].

entries.original: "[blue]I’ll take this one, then."
entries.translation_source: [blue]I’ll take this one, then.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku akan ambil yang ini, kalau
begitu.

entries.original: "[black]Disheartened, the [buffer1] left."
entries.translation_source: [black]Disheartened, the [buffer1] left.
entries.translated: [black]Kecewa, [buffer1] pergi.

entries.original:
"Now that we have our own Pokémon,
let’s head back to the exit.

We’ll force our way out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Now that we have our own Pokémon, let’s head back to the exit. We’ll force our way out of here!
entries.translated:
Sekarang kita punya Pokémon
sendiri, ayo kembali ke pintu\lkeluar. Kita akan memaksa keluar

dari sini!

entries.original:
"I told you before.

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: I told you before. I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Sudah kubilang sebelumnya. Aku
mendapat perintah ketat untuk\lmengurung kalian.

entries.original:
"Heh heh heh\.

You don’t really have a choice
anymore.

You’re gonna let us out, or get your
sorry butt handed to you."
entries.translation_source: Heh heh heh\. You don’t really have a choice anymore. You’re gonna let us out, or get your sorry butt handed to you.
entries.translated:
Heh heh heh\. Kalian tidak punya
pilihan lagi. Kalian akan\lmembiarkan kami keluar, atau pantat

malang kalian akan dihajar.

entries.original:
"Quit fooling yourself.

There’s nothing you can do to make
me let you through."
entries.translation_source: Quit fooling yourself. There’s nothing you can do to make me let you through.
entries.translated:
Berhentilah membodohi dirimu
sendiri. Tidak ada yang bisa kau\llakukan untuk membuatku

membiarkanmu lewat.

entries.original:
"[player], let’s team up and show
this guy what we can do!"
entries.translation_source: [player], let’s team up and show this guy what we can do!
entries.translated:
[player], ayo bekerja sama dan
tunjukkan pada orang ini apa yang\lbisa kita lakukan!

entries.original:
"You both are really starting
to get on my nerves!

Inkay! Skorupi!

Show them why you don’t mess
with the [black]Shadows[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: You both are really starting to get on my nerves! Inkay! Skorupi! Show them why you don’t mess with the [black]Shadows[blue]!
entries.translated:
Kalian berdua benar-benar mulai
membuatku kesal! Inkay! Skorupi!\lTunjukkan pada mereka kenapa kalian

tidak main-main dengan [black]Shadows[blue]!

entries.original:
"Not bad, [player]!
You and I make a pretty good team!

But I’ll take it from here.

Let me use these items on your
Pokémon to heal it from the fight."
entries.translation_source: Not bad, [player]! You and I make a pretty good team! But I’ll take it from here. Let me use these items on your Pokémon to heal it from the fight.
entries.translated:
Tidak buruk, [player]! Kau dan aku
jadi tim yang cukup bagus! Tapi\lbiarkan aku yang menangani dari

sini. Biarkan aku menggunakan
item-item ini pada Pokémonmu untuk\lmenyembuhkannya dari pertarungan.

entries.original:
"That’s a letdown.

I really thought you and I could
handle him together.

I guess I’ll deal with him myself.

Use this Potion on your Pokémon
to make it feel better."
entries.translation_source: That’s a letdown. I really thought you and I could handle him together. I guess I’ll deal with him myself. Use this Potion on your Pokémon to make it feel better.
entries.translated:
Mengecewakan. Aku benar-benar
mengira kau dan aku bisa\lmenghadapinya bersama. Sepertinya

aku akan menghadapinya sendiri.
Gunakan Potion ini pada Pokémon-mu\luntuk membuatnya merasa lebih baik.

entries.original:
"No!
My Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: No! My Pokémon!
entries.translated: Tidak! Pokémon-ku!

entries.original:
"No!
My Inkay!"
entries.translation_source: No! My Inkay!
entries.translated: Tidak! Inkay-ku!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]!
Move in and strike!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1]! Move in and strike!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Bergerak dan serang!

entries.original: "[buffer1]! Use [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1]! Use [buffer2]!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Gunakan [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Alright, alright, I give up!
I’ll let you through!

Please, have mercy on me!
Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, alright, I give up! I’ll let you through! Please, have mercy on me! Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, baiklah, aku menyerah! Aku
akan biarkan kau lewat! Tolong,\lkasihanilah aku! Jangan sakiti aku

lagi! Kumohon!

entries.original: "[buffer1]! Return!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1]! Return!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Kembali!

entries.original:
"I’m getting out of here now,
[player].

I’m sure you’re capable of taking
care of yourself from here on out.

If you run into any trouble, just
use your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m getting out of here now, [player]. I’m sure you’re capable of taking care of yourself from here on out. If you run into any trouble, just use your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku akan pergi dari sini sekarang,
[player]. Aku yakin kau bisa\lmenjaga dirimu sendiri mulai

sekarang. Jika kau mendapat
masalah, gunakan saja Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You impressed me when we battled
together, so I want to see how I’ll\lfare against you.

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You impressed me when we battled together, so I want to see how I’ll fare against you. Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
Oh, satu hal lagi. Begitu kau
sampai di rumah, kita akan\lbertarung. Kau membuatku terkesan

saat kita bertarung bersama, jadi
aku ingin melihat bagaimana aku\lmelawanmu. Sampai saat itu, jangan

terlalu memaksakan diri.

entries.original:
"Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You have a lot to learn about
battling, and I wouldn’t mind\lshowing you a thing or two.

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You have a lot to learn about battling, and I wouldn’t mind showing you a thing or two. Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
Oh, satu hal lagi. Begitu kau
sampai di rumah, kita akan\lbertarung. Kau masih banyak yang

harus dipelajari tentang bertarung,
dan aku tidak keberatan menunjukkan\lbeberapa hal. Sampai saat itu,

jangan terlalu memaksakan diri.

entries.original:
"Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You torchickened out earlier, but I
won’t let you skip out next time!

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You torchickened out earlier, but I won’t let you skip out next time! Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
Oh, satu hal lagi. Begitu kau
sampai di rumah, kita akan\lbertarung. Kau torchickened tadi,

tapi aku tidak akan membiarkanmu
lolos lain kali! Sampai saat itu,\ljangan terlalu memaksakan diri.

entries.original: "Now burn it."
entries.translation_source: Now burn it.
entries.translated: Sekarang bakar itu.

entries.original:
"[red]As you observed, these specimens
are completely immune to extreme\lcold and extreme heat."
entries.translation_source: [red]As you observed, these specimens are completely immune to extreme cold and extreme heat.
entries.translated:
[red]Seperti yang kau amati, spesimen
ini sepenuhnya kebal terhadap\ldingin ekstrem dan panas ekstrem.

entries.original:
"What about the immunity to
electricity?"
entries.translation_source: What about the immunity to electricity?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana dengan kekebalan terhadap
listrik?

entries.original:
"[red]We have yet to complete that, sir.

It is difficult to enhance the
specimens quickly when we have our\lexternal research as well."
entries.translation_source: [red]We have yet to complete that, sir. It is difficult to enhance the specimens quickly when we have our external research as well.
entries.translated:
[red]Kami belum menyelesaikannya, Tuan.
Sulit untuk meningkatkan spesimen\ldengan cepat ketika kami juga

memiliki penelitian eksternal.

entries.original:
"Very well.
This will do for now."
entries.translation_source: Very well. This will do for now.
entries.translated:
Baiklah. Ini sudah cukup untuk saat
ini.

entries.original:
"Ah, Marlon, perfect timing.

We’re moving up our timetable.

I’m unsure as to why, but our target
seems to have relocated to our\lvicinity earlier than anticipated.

With the Shadow Warriors enhanced
and the package we need arriving\ltoday, we can begin the operation."
entries.translation_source: Ah, Marlon, perfect timing. We’re moving up our timetable. I’m unsure as to why, but our target seems to have relocated to our vicinity earlier than anticipated. With the Shadow Warriors enhanced and the package we need arriving today, we can begin the operation.
entries.translated:
Ah, Marlon, waktu yang tepat. Kami
mempercepat jadwal kami. Aku tidak\lyakin mengapa, tetapi target kami

tampaknya telah pindah ke sekitar
kita lebih awal dari yang\ldiperkirakan. Dengan Shadow

Warriors yang ditingkatkan dan
paket yang kita butuhkan tiba hari\lini, kita bisa memulai operasi.

entries.original:
"Understood.

There’s just one more thing to
discuss before I head out.

The trespassers we locked up
in the warehouse have escaped."
entries.translation_source: Understood. There’s just one more thing to discuss before I head out. The trespassers we locked up in the warehouse have escaped.
entries.translated:
Dimengerti. Ada satu hal lagi yang
perlu dibahas sebelum aku\lberangkat. Para penyusup yang kita

kunci di gudang telah melarikan
diri.

entries.original:
"This grunt over here let them
get away."
entries.translation_source: This grunt over here let them get away.
entries.translated:
Grunt ini yang membiarkan mereka
lolos.

entries.original:
"How bad is it?
What did those two see?"
entries.translation_source: How bad is it? What did those two see?
entries.translated:
Seberapa parah? Apa yang mereka
berdua lihat?

entries.original:
"The first one, the boy with
red hair, saw nothing relevant.

The second one, however\.

If Fey finds out that [buffer2] was in
the lab, she will insist on\lrelocating in the middle of our\loperation.

You know that’s time and resources
we can’t afford\."
entries.translation_source: The first one, the boy with red hair, saw nothing relevant. The second one, however\. If Fey finds out that [buffer2] was in the lab, she will insist on relocating in the middle of our operation. You know that’s time and resources we can’t afford\.
entries.translated:
Yang pertama, anak laki-laki
berambut merah, tidak melihat apa\lpun yang relevan. Yang kedua, namun\.

Jika Fey tahu bahwa [buffer2] ada di
lab, dia akan bersikeras untuk\lpindah di tengah operasi kita. Anda

tahu itu waktu dan sumber daya yang
tidak bisa kita sia-siakan\.

entries.original:
"Then make sure Fey doesn’t find
out about what happened.

Our priority right now is obtaining
the package needed for the mission.

We’ll deal with that second one
who escaped at a later time."
entries.translation_source: Then make sure Fey doesn’t find out about what happened. Our priority right now is obtaining the package needed for the mission. We’ll deal with that second one who escaped at a later time.
entries.translated:
Maka pastikan Fey tidak tahu
tentang apa yang terjadi. Prioritas\lkita sekarang adalah mendapatkan

paket yang dibutuhkan untuk misi.
Kita akan berurusan dengan yang\lkedua yang melarikan diri nanti.

entries.original:
"Understood.

I have a plan to obtain that
package, and it’ll even allow this\lfailure of a grunt here to redeem\lhimself.

Once I have it, I’ll head straight
for the target."
entries.translation_source: Understood. I have a plan to obtain that package, and it’ll even allow this failure of a grunt here to redeem himself. Once I have it, I’ll head straight for the target.
entries.translated:
Dimengerti. Saya punya rencana
untuk mendapatkan paket itu, dan\litu bahkan akan memungkinkan

anggota gagal ini untuk menebus
dirinya. Setelah saya memilikinya,\lsaya akan langsung menuju sasaran.

entries.original: "Then good luck, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: Then good luck, Marlon.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, semoga berhasil,
Marlon.

entries.original:
"Close\.\CC0818 We’re getting so close\.

Soon, it won’t be long before that
power finally becomes ours\."
entries.translation_source: Close\.\CC0818 We’re getting so close\. Soon, it won’t be long before that power finally becomes ours\.
entries.translated:
Dekat\.\CC0818 Kita semakin dekat\. Segera,
tidak akan lama lagi sebelum\lkekuatan itu akhirnya menjadi milik

kita\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
You finally made it out!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! You finally made it out!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu akhirnya berhasil
keluar!

entries.original:
"Have you met old man Log yet?

He’s supposed to be an expert on
Pokémon’s stats, or whatever\.

I just filled him in on what
happened."
entries.translation_source: Have you met old man Log yet? He’s supposed to be an expert on Pokémon’s stats, or whatever\. I just filled him in on what happened.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah bertemu dengan
Pak Log? Dia seharusnya ahli dalam\lstatistik Pokémon, atau apa pun\. Aku

baru saja memberitahunya apa yang
terjadi.

entries.original:
"I study all aspects of Pokémon
stats and capture rates.

And my title is Professor,
not \qoold man\qc!

Anyway, that must have been quite
the ordeal you both went through.

I’m relieved to see both of you
are unharmed.

And it seems you’ve even managed to
acquire rare Pokémon!

I was planning on giving [rival]
a Pokémon of his own someday,\lbut now I don’t have to!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: I study all aspects of Pokémon stats and capture rates. And my title is Professor, not \qoold man\qc! Anyway, that must have been quite the ordeal you both went through. I’m relieved to see both of you are unharmed. And it seems you’ve even managed to acquire rare Pokémon! I was planning on giving [rival] a Pokémon of his own someday, but now I don’t have to! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Saya mempelajari semua aspek
statistik Pokémon dan tingkat\lpenangkapan. Dan gelar saya adalah

Profesor, bukan \qoorang tua\qc!
Bagaimanapun, itu pasti pengalaman\lyang cukup berat yang kalian berdua

alami. Saya lega melihat kalian
berdua tidak terluka. Dan\lsepertinya kalian bahkan berhasil

mendapatkan Pokémon langka! Saya
berencana memberikan [rival]\lPokémon miliknya suatu hari nanti,

tapi sekarang saya tidak perlu! Ho
ho ho!

entries.original:
"Someday?

I’ve been here a whole week,
and I was expecting one ASAP!"
entries.translation_source: Someday? I’ve been here a whole week, and I was expecting one ASAP!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari nanti? Aku sudah di sini
seminggu penuh, dan aku berharap\lmendapatkannya secepat mungkin!

entries.original:
"Well, of course I was always going
to give you one, [rival]!

There are plenty of errands I’m too
old to run myself, after all!

It’s just that\.\CC0818 you’re insistent
on looking for your parents.

I keep telling you, no one has
seen them in years!

Even if they are somehow still in
Borrius, finding them is much too\lbig a task for you alone.

I was hoping you’d accept that fact
before giving you a Pokémon,\lbut you refuse to listen!"
entries.translation_source: Well, of course I was always going to give you one, [rival]! There are plenty of errands I’m too old to run myself, after all! It’s just that\.\CC0818 you’re insistent on looking for your parents. I keep telling you, no one has seen them in years! Even if they are somehow still in Borrius, finding them is much too big a task for you alone. I was hoping you’d accept that fact before giving you a Pokémon, but you refuse to listen!
entries.translated:
Yah, tentu saja aku selalu akan
memberimu satu, [rival]! Ada\lbanyak tugas yang sudah terlalu tua

untuk aku lakukan sendiri! Hanya
saja\.\CC0818 kamu bersikeras mencari orang\ltuamu. Aku terus memberi tahu,

tidak ada yang melihat mereka
selama bertahun-tahun! Bahkan jika\lmereka entah bagaimana masih di

Borrius, menemukan mereka adalah
tugas yang terlalu besar untukmu\lsendirian. Aku berharap kamu

menerima kenyataan itu sebelum
memberimu Pokémon, tapi kamu\lmenolak untuk mendengarkan!

entries.original:
"You may be my \qolegal guardian\qc or
whatever in Borrius, but you sure\ldon’t know anything about me!

I’m strong!
Strong enough to fend for myself!

And when I see my parents, they’ll
see just how strong I really am!

Just like you’re about to!"
entries.translation_source: You may be my \qolegal guardian\qc or whatever in Borrius, but you sure don’t know anything about me! I’m strong! Strong enough to fend for myself! And when I see my parents, they’ll see just how strong I really am! Just like you’re about to!
entries.translated:
Kamu mungkin \qowali hukum\qc atau apa
pun di Borrius, tapi kamu pasti\ltidak tahu apa-apa tentang aku! Aku

kuat! Cukup kuat untuk menjaga
diriku sendiri! Dan ketika aku\lmelihat orang tuaku, mereka akan

melihat betapa kuatnya aku
sebenarnya! Sama seperti yang akan\lkamu lihat!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!

I said I owed you a battle before,
so lemme show you both how a real\lTrainer does it!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player]! I said I owed you a battle before, so lemme show you both how a real Trainer does it!
entries.translated:
Ayo, [player]! Aku bilang aku
berutang pertarungan padamu\lsebelumnya, jadi biarkan aku

menunjukkan kepada kalian berdua
bagaimana seorang Pelatih sejati\lmelakukannya!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!

I said I’d show you the ropes,
so lemme teach you both how a\lreal Trainer does it!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player]! I said I’d show you the ropes, so lemme teach you both how a real Trainer does it!
entries.translated:
Ayo, [player]! Aku bilang aku akan
menunjukkan dasar-dasarnya, jadi\lbiarkan aku mengajari kalian berdua

bagaimana seorang Pelatih sejati
melakukannya!

entries.original:
"That was a fine battle.

Very enthralling, if I do say so,
myself."
entries.translation_source: That was a fine battle. Very enthralling, if I do say so, myself.
entries.translated:
Itu pertarungan yang bagus. Sangat
memukau, kalau aku boleh mengatakan\lsendiri.

entries.original:
"Tch\.\CC0820 no one cares how it made
you feel, old man.

I only care about how strong it made
our Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Tch\.\CC0820 no one cares how it made you feel, old man. I only care about how strong it made our Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Cih\.\CC0820 tidak ada yang peduli bagaimana
perasaanmu, pak tua. Aku hanya\lpeduli seberapa kuat itu membuat

Pokémon kita.

entries.original:
"Well\.\CC0818 erm\.

From what I can see, your Pokémon
do have some nice stats\.

I see potential for them to become
strong Pokémon some day."
entries.translation_source: Well\.\CC0818 erm\. From what I can see, your Pokémon do have some nice stats\. I see potential for them to become strong Pokémon some day.
entries.translated:
Yah\.\CC0818 ehm\. Dari yang bisa kulihat,
Pokémonmu memiliki beberapa\lstatistik yang bagus\. Aku melihat

potensi bagi mereka untuk menjadi
Pokémon yang kuat suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Finally, the first useful thing
you’ve said all day.

And it’s gonna be the last, because
I’m outta here."
entries.translation_source: Finally, the first useful thing you’ve said all day. And it’s gonna be the last, because I’m outta here.
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, hal berguna pertama yang
kamu katakan sepanjang hari. Dan\litu akan menjadi yang terakhir,

karena aku pergi dari sini.

entries.original:
"Well, he’s certainly a handful,
isn’t he?

And now that he’s gone, who will
run my errands for me?"
entries.translation_source: Well, he’s certainly a handful, isn’t he? And now that he’s gone, who will run my errands for me?
entries.translated:
Yah, dia pasti sulit diatur, bukan?
Dan sekarang setelah dia pergi,\lsiapa yang akan menjalankan

tugas-tugasku?

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, [player].

You seem rather capable\.\CC0818 you should
assist me!

Ah, what a splendid idea, your
father was well known for helping\lothers, after all.

It’s only fitting that his [buffer2]
would follow in his footsteps.

As for the task, there’s a package in
[green]Bellin Town[blue] at the [green]Poké Mart[blue].

I would go get it myself, but my
assistants and I are much too busy\lwith our own research\.

Don’t fret, the clerk knows someone
will be picking it up in my stead.

Since you have your own Pokémon
with you, it should be easy!

But, just in case, this repellent will
make the journey easier for you."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, [player]. You seem rather capable\.\CC0818 you should assist me! Ah, what a splendid idea, your father was well known for helping others, after all. It’s only fitting that his [buffer2] would follow in his footsteps. As for the task, there’s a package in [green]Bellin Town[blue] at the [green]Poké Mart[blue]. I would go get it myself, but my assistants and I are much too busy with our own research\. Don’t fret, the clerk knows someone will be picking it up in my stead. Since you have your own Pokémon with you, it should be easy! But, just in case, this repellent will make the journey easier for you.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya, [player]. Kamu tampak cukup
mampu\.\CC0818 kamu harus membantu saya! Ah,\lide yang bagus, ayahmu terkenal

suka membantu orang lain,
bagaimanapun juga. Sudah\lsepantasnya [buffer2]-nya mengikuti

jejaknya. Untuk tugasnya, ada paket
di [green]Bellin Town[blue] di [green]Poké Mart[blue]. Saya\lakan mengambilnya sendiri, tetapi

asisten saya dan saya terlalu sibuk
dengan penelitian kami sendiri\.\lJangan khawatir, petugasnya tahu

seseorang akan mengambilnya untuk
saya. Karena kamu memiliki Pokémon\lsendiri, itu seharusnya mudah!

Tapi, untuk jaga-jaga, pengusir ini
akan membuat perjalanan lebih mudah\luntukmu.

entries.original:
"And while you’re at it, you could
assist me with another task!

A fellow Professor, Oak, asked me to
give these to two young Trainers.

It’s an encyclopedia for recording
the data of Pokémon.

Apparently, Borrius has plenty of
Pokémon his own region lacks."
entries.translation_source: And while you’re at it, you could assist me with another task! A fellow Professor, Oak, asked me to give these to two young Trainers. It’s an encyclopedia for recording the data of Pokémon. Apparently, Borrius has plenty of Pokémon his own region lacks.
entries.translated:
Dan selagi kamu melakukannya, kamu
bisa membantu saya dengan tugas\llain! Seorang sesama Profesor, Oak,

meminta saya untuk memberikan ini
kepada dua Pelatih muda. Ini adalah\lensiklopedia untuk merekam data

Pokémon. Ternyata, Borrius memiliki
banyak Pokémon yang tidak dimiliki\lwilayahnya sendiri.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Pokédex
from Prof. Log!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received the Pokédex from Prof. Log!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Pokédex dari
Prof. Log!

entries.original:
"Personally, I’m content with just
observing species for the Pokédex.

However, if you want complete data
on Pokémon, including their base\lstats, you’ll need to catch them.

So, here are some tools for
catching wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Personally, I’m content with just observing species for the Pokédex. However, if you want complete data on Pokémon, including their base stats, you’ll need to catch them. So, here are some tools for catching wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Secara pribadi, saya puas hanya
mengamati spesies untuk Pokédex.\lNamun, jika Anda ingin data lengkap

tentang Pokémon, termasuk stat
dasar mereka, Anda harus\lmenangkapnya. Jadi, berikut adalah

beberapa alat untuk menangkap
Pokémon liar.

entries.original:
"If you’re not in the mood for
catching Pokémon, use that Repel I\lgave you to keep them away.

If you need anything else from me,
I’ll be in my lab.

But before you depart, you should
head home and inform your mother.

She’s been very worried about you.

Good luck, [player].
My studies are depending on you!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re not in the mood for catching Pokémon, use that Repel I gave you to keep them away. If you need anything else from me, I’ll be in my lab. But before you depart, you should head home and inform your mother. She’s been very worried about you. Good luck, [player]. My studies are depending on you!
entries.translated:
Jika Anda tidak ingin menangkap
Pokémon, gunakan Penghalau yang\lsaya berikan untuk menjauhkan

mereka. Jika Anda membutuhkan hal
lain dari saya, saya akan berada di\llaboratorium saya. Namun sebelum

berangkat, sebaiknya pulang ke
rumah dan beri tahu ibumu. Dia\lsangat khawatir padamu. Semoga

berhasil, [player]. Studiku
bergantung padamu!

entries.original: "You!"
entries.translation_source: You!
entries.translated: Kamu!

entries.original: "Uh, I mean, excuse me."
entries.translation_source: Uh, I mean, excuse me.
entries.translated: Uh, maksud saya, permisi.

entries.original:
"Hi, there!
May I help you?

\.

Wait\.\CC0818 you’re telling me Prof. Log
sent you to get his package?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, there! May I help you? \. Wait\.\CC0818 you’re telling me Prof. Log sent you to get his package?
entries.translated:
Halo! Ada yang bisa saya bantu? \.
Tunggu\.\CC0818 Anda mengatakan Prof. Log\lmengirim Anda untuk mengambil

paketnya?

entries.original:
"Uh, oh.
I thought that guy smelled fishy\."
entries.translation_source: Uh, oh. I thought that guy smelled fishy\.
entries.translated:
Uh, oh. Saya pikir pria itu
mencurigakan\.

entries.original:
"Here’s the deal, kid.

I already gave the package to the
man who was just here.

But if you want to blame anyone for
this mix-up, blame Prof. Log.

I told him he needed to tell me
who he’d be sending, but he just\lkept saying \qosomeone will get it.\qc

There’s nothing I can do for you
at this point, but maybe if you\lchase after that man, you can\lcatch him before he gets too far!"
entries.translation_source: Here’s the deal, kid. I already gave the package to the man who was just here. But if you want to blame anyone for this mix-up, blame Prof. Log. I told him he needed to tell me who he’d be sending, but he just kept saying \qosomeone will get it.\qc There’s nothing I can do for you at this point, but maybe if you chase after that man, you can catch him before he gets too far!
entries.translated:
Begini, Nak. Saya sudah memberikan
paket itu kepada pria yang baru\lsaja di sini. Tapi jika Anda ingin

menyalahkan seseorang atas
kekacauan ini, salahkan Prof. Log.\lSaya sudah bilang dia harus

memberitahu saya siapa yang akan
dia kirim, tapi dia hanya terus\lberkata \qoseseorang akan

mengambilnya.\qc Tidak ada yang bisa
saya lakukan untuk Anda saat ini,\ltapi mungkin jika Anda mengejar

pria itu, Anda bisa menangkapnya
sebelum dia pergi terlalu jauh!

entries.original:
"Did you receive the package
from the Mart?"
entries.translation_source: Did you receive the package from the Mart?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda menerima paket dari
Pojok?

entries.original: "Yes, I did, sir."
entries.translation_source: Yes, I did, sir.
entries.translated: Ya, saya terima, Pak.

entries.original: "Were you discreet in doing so?"
entries.translation_source: Were you discreet in doing so?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda melakukannya dengan
hati-hati?

entries.original:
"I was, sir.

I even ran into one of the two I
let escape from the warehouse, but\lI chose to avoid a confrontation.

As far as I’m aware, I wasn’t
followed."
entries.translation_source: I was, sir. I even ran into one of the two I let escape from the warehouse, but I chose to avoid a confrontation. As far as I’m aware, I wasn’t followed.
entries.translated:
Ya, Pak. Saya bahkan bertemu dengan
salah satu dari dua orang yang saya\lbiarkan melarikan diri dari gudang,

tapi saya memilih untuk menghindari
konfrontasi. Sejauh yang saya tahu,\lsaya tidak diikuti.

entries.original:
"Good work.

I’d say you’re back on the road to
earning whatever you asked for\lwhen you joined us."
entries.translation_source: Good work. I’d say you’re back on the road to earning whatever you asked for when you joined us.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus. Saya rasa Anda kembali
pada jalan untuk mendapatkan apa\lpun yang Anda minta saat bergabung

dengan kami.

entries.original:
"It was a mechanical leg for my
mother, sir."
entries.translation_source: It was a mechanical leg for my mother, sir.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah kaki mekanik untuk
ibuku, Pak.

entries.original:
"Legs, arms, another head,
whatever.

As long as this package contains all
of the goods that we need for the\loperation, the scientists will build\las many limbs as your mother wants."
entries.translation_source: Legs, arms, another head, whatever. As long as this package contains all of the goods that we need for the operation, the scientists will build as many limbs as your mother wants.
entries.translated:
Kaki, lengan, kepala lain,
terserah. Selama paket ini berisi\lsemua barang yang kita butuhkan

untuk operasi, para ilmuwan akan
membuat sebanyak anggota tubuh yang\libumu inginkan.

entries.original:
"I’m heading [green]north of Frozen Heights[blue]
to capture the target.

Report back to Zeph and inform
him of my current status."
entries.translation_source: I’m heading [green]north of Frozen Heights[blue] to capture the target. Report back to Zeph and inform him of my current status.
entries.translated:
Saya menuju ke [green]utara Dataran Tinggi
Beku[blue] untuk menangkap target.\lLaporkan kembali ke Zeph dan beri

tahu dia status saya saat ini.

entries.original: "[blue]Cacnea, use Cut!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Cacnea, use Cut!
entries.translated: [blue]Cacnea, gunakan Potong!

entries.original: "[green]Cac!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Cac!
entries.translated: [green]Cac!

entries.original:
"No!
You need to recover the package!"
entries.translation_source: No! You need to recover the package!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Anda harus mengambil kembali
paketnya!

entries.original:
"One with the wind, one with the
snow\.

A heart that is frozen in absolute
zero!

Now, become the snow that drives the
harshest blizzard!

Sankren fimbulvetr!

Descend to me, Articuno!"
entries.translation_source: One with the wind, one with the snow\. A heart that is frozen in absolute zero! Now, become the snow that drives the harshest blizzard! Sankren fimbulvetr! Descend to me, Articuno!
entries.translated:
Satu dengan angin, satu dengan
salju\. Hati yang membeku pada nol\lmutlak! Sekarang, jadilah salju

yang mendorong badai salju paling
dahsyat! Sankren fimbulvetr!\lTurunlah kepadaku, Articuno!

entries.original:
"Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated: Prajurit Bayangan! Tahan dia!

entries.original:
"Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to
become ours."
entries.translation_source: Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to become ours.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, Articuno, saatnya kau
menjadi milik kami.

entries.original:
"The operation was a success.

Time to report back to Zeph."
entries.translation_source: The operation was a success. Time to report back to Zeph.
entries.translated:
Operasi berhasil. Saatnya melapor
kembali ke Zeph.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 I recognize you from the lab!

I’d have thought your imprisonment,
however brief, would have taught\lyou better\.

Do you just enjoy being locked up?
Or did someone\.\CC0818 send you?

\.\CC0818no. We don’t have time to deal
with you now.

But regardless, we can’t have you
pursuing us any further."
entries.translation_source: You\.\CC0820 I recognize you from the lab! I’d have thought your imprisonment, however brief, would have taught you better\. Do you just enjoy being locked up? Or did someone\.\CC0818 send you? \.\CC0818no. We don’t have time to deal with you now. But regardless, we can’t have you pursuing us any further.
entries.translated:
Kau\.\CC0820 Aku mengenalimu dari lab!
Kukira pemenjaraanmu, meski\lsingkat, akan membuatmu belajar

lebih baik\. Apakah kau memang suka
dikurung? Atau apakah seseorang\.\CC0818\lmengirimmu? \.\CC0818Tidak. Kami tidak punya

waktu untuk berurusan denganmu
sekarang. Tapi bagaimanapun, kami\ltidak bisa membiarkanmu mengejar

kami lebih jauh.

entries.original:
"Grunts!

One of you, stall [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Grunts! One of you, stall [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
Preman! Salah satu dari kalian,
tahan [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[red]Who do you think you are, huh?

Do you think you can just follow
us and get away with it?

Don’t expect any mercy from
the [black]Shadows[red]!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Who do you think you are, huh? Do you think you can just follow us and get away with it? Don’t expect any mercy from the [black]Shadows[red]!
entries.translated:
[red]Siapa kau pikir kau, ya? Kau pikir
kau bisa begitu saja mengikuti kami\ldan lolos? Jangan harap belas

kasihan dari [black]Bayangan[red]!

entries.original:
"[red]\.\CC0818Oh, you wanted this package.

Here, you can have it.
We’ve taken what we needed from it."
entries.translation_source: [red]\.\CC0818Oh, you wanted this package. Here, you can have it. We’ve taken what we needed from it.
entries.translated:
[red]\.\CC0818Oh, kau menginginkan paket ini.
Ini, ambillah. Kami sudah mengambil\lapa yang kami butuhkan darinya.

entries.original:
"[red]You’d be smart not to follow
us again."
entries.translation_source: [red]You’d be smart not to follow us again.
entries.translated:
[red]Kau akan lebih pintar jika tidak
mengikuti kami lagi.

entries.original:
"No!
You need to return Log’s package!"
entries.translation_source: No! You need to return Log’s package!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Kau harus mengembalikan
paket Log!

entries.original:
"Alright, grunts.

For our next operation, we’ll be
heading to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] and\lensuring Ivory obtains her target."
entries.translation_source: Alright, grunts. For our next operation, we’ll be heading to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] and ensuring Ivory obtains her target.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, preman. Untuk operasi kita
selanjutnya, kita akan menuju ke\l[green]Gunung Cinder[blue] dan memastikan Ivory

mendapatkan targetnya.

entries.original:
"I will tolerate no screw ups!

Last time we were followed, and I
can’t have that happening again.

We don’t have the luxury of dealing
with unwanted Trainers right now.

Keep a low profile at all costs,
and no matter what, do not get\lnoticed!

Do I make myself clear?"
entries.translation_source: I will tolerate no screw ups! Last time we were followed, and I can’t have that happening again. We don’t have the luxury of dealing with unwanted Trainers right now. Keep a low profile at all costs, and no matter what, do not get noticed! Do I make myself clear?
entries.translated:
Aku tidak akan mentolerir
kesalahan! Terakhir kali kita\ldiikuti, dan aku tidak bisa

membiarkan itu terjadi lagi. Kita
tidak punya kemewahan untuk\lberurusan dengan Pelatih yang tidak

diinginkan sekarang. Tetap tidak
mencolok dengan cara apa pun, dan\lapa pun yang terjadi, jangan sampai

diperhatikan! Apakah aku berbicara
dengan jelas?

entries.original: "Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Ya, Pak!

entries.original: "Move out."
entries.translation_source: Move out.
entries.translated: Bergerak.

entries.original: "Arthur"
entries.translation_source: Arthur
entries.translated: Arthur

entries.original:
"Hello there, young [buffer1]!

What can I do for you?

\.

Ah, so Prof. Euler Log sent you.

What you describe sounds troubling
indeed.

Well, I believe I can shed some
light on what those scoundrels are\ltrying to achieve.

Incidentally, are you well-versed in
Borrius’ history?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, young [buffer1]! What can I do for you? \. Ah, so Prof. Euler Log sent you. What you describe sounds troubling indeed. Well, I believe I can shed some light on what those scoundrels are trying to achieve. Incidentally, are you well-versed in Borrius’ history?
entries.translated:
Halo, [buffer1] muda! Ada yang bisa
saya bantu? \. Ah, jadi Prof. Euler\lLog yang mengirimmu. Apa yang kau

gambarkan terdengar memang
mengkhawatirkan. Yah, saya yakin\lsaya bisa memberi sedikit

pencerahan tentang apa yang coba
dicapai oleh para bajingan itu.\lNgomong-ngomong, apakah kau paham

tentang sejarah Borrius?

entries.original:
"Is that so?

Then you may use my [green]television[blue]
over there.

I recorded a program from last night
that may help you fill in the gaps."
entries.translation_source: Is that so? Then you may use my [green]television[blue] over there. I recorded a program from last night that may help you fill in the gaps.
entries.translated:
Begitu? Kalau begitu kau boleh
menggunakan [green]televisi[blue] saya di sana.\lSaya merekam acara tadi malam yang

mungkin membantu mengisi
celah-celah pengetahuanmu.

entries.original:
"Excellent.

Then, as you know, the dark force
of Borrius was sealed away, many,\lmany years ago.

However, it is said that if the
three legendary Pokémon used to\lseal it away are brought back\ltogether at a place called the\l[green]Ruins of Void[blue], the power can be\lreleased once again.

This must be what those thugs you
encountered are after - to engulf\lBorrius in darkness once again.

If what you say is accurate,
their next target will surely be\."
entries.translation_source: Excellent. Then, as you know, the dark force of Borrius was sealed away, many, many years ago. However, it is said that if the three legendary Pokémon used to seal it away are brought back together at a place called the [green]Ruins of Void[blue], the power can be released once again. This must be what those thugs you encountered are after - to engulf Borrius in darkness once again. If what you say is accurate, their next target will surely be\.
entries.translated:
Bagus. Lalu, seperti yang kau tahu,
kekuatan gelap Borrius telah\ldisegel, bertahun-tahun yang lalu.

Namun, dikatakan bahwa jika tiga
Pokémon legendaris yang digunakan\luntuk menyegelnya dikumpulkan

kembali di tempat yang disebut
[green]Reruntuhan Void[blue], kekuatan itu dapat\ldilepaskan kembali. Ini pasti yang

dikejar oleh para preman yang kau
temui - untuk menyelimuti Borrius\ldalam kegelapan sekali lagi. Jika

apa yang kau katakan akurat, target
mereka selanjutnya pasti akan\.

entries.original: "Grampa Arthur!"
entries.translation_source: Grampa Arthur!
entries.translated: Kakek Arthur!

entries.original: "What’s wrong, Jax?"
entries.translation_source: What’s wrong, Jax?
entries.translated: Ada apa, Jax?

entries.original:
"I just saw those guys in black
heading in the direction of\l[green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: I just saw those guys in black heading in the direction of [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!
entries.translated:
Aku baru saja melihat orang-orang
berbaju hitam itu menuju ke arah\l[green]Gunung Cinder[blue]!

entries.original:
"So it’s true\.

I was just telling [player] here
about their possible aims\.\lbut this confirms my suspicions.

Those thugs must be after the
legendary Pokémon, [green]Moltres[blue]."
entries.translation_source: So it’s true\. I was just telling [player] here about their possible aims\. but this confirms my suspicions. Those thugs must be after the legendary Pokémon, [green]Moltres[blue].
entries.translated:
Jadi benar\. Aku baru saja memberi
tahu [player] di sini tentang\lkemungkinan tujuan mereka\. tetapi

ini mengonfirmasi kecurigaanku.
Para preman itu pasti mengejar\lPokémon Legendaris, [green]Moltres[blue].

entries.original:
"[player]? Gah, no, what am I
talking about?

Grampa, we have to stop those guys,
right?"
entries.translation_source: [player]? Gah, no, what am I talking about? Grampa, we have to stop those guys, right?
entries.translated:
[player]? Gah, tidak, apa yang aku
bicarakan? Kakek, kita harus\lmenghentikan mereka, kan?

entries.original:
"Not yet, Jax.

First things first, I need you to
fly to Frozen Heights and bring\lProf. Log here.

He needs to be informed of what
has transpired."
entries.translation_source: Not yet, Jax. First things first, I need you to fly to Frozen Heights and bring Prof. Log here. He needs to be informed of what has transpired.
entries.translated:
Belum, Jax. Yang pertama, aku perlu
kau terbang ke Frozen Heights dan\lbawa Prof. Log ke sini. Dia perlu

diberi tahu tentang apa yang telah
terjadi.

entries.original: "Right away, Grampa!"
entries.translation_source: Right away, Grampa!
entries.translated: Segera, Kakek!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

So, it is as bad as I feared\.

What do you think should be done
about this, Arthur?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. So, it is as bad as I feared\. What do you think should be done about this, Arthur?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Jadi, ini seburuk yang aku
takutkan\. Menurutmu apa yang harus\ldilakukan tentang ini, Arthur?

entries.original:
"Jax will fly out to intercept these
\qoShadows\qc.

So far, he’s shown himself to be a
quite capable Trainer\.

And as you know, Euler, I’ve been
training him as my successor, so I\lbelieve he’s our best hope.

He’ll confront these \qoShadows\qc and
stop them before they reach\lMoltres."
entries.translation_source: Jax will fly out to intercept these \qoShadows\qc. So far, he’s shown himself to be a quite capable Trainer\. And as you know, Euler, I’ve been training him as my successor, so I believe he’s our best hope. He’ll confront these \qoShadows\qc and stop them before they reach Moltres.
entries.translated:
Jax akan terbang untuk mencegat
\qoShadows\qc. Sejauh ini, dia telah\lmenunjukkan dirinya sebagai Pelatih

yang cukup mampu\. Dan seperti yang
kau tahu, Euler, aku telah\lmelatihnya sebagai penerusku, jadi

aku percaya dia adalah harapan
terbaik kita. Dia akan menghadapi\l\qoShadows\qc dan menghentikan mereka

sebelum mereka mencapai Moltres.

entries.original:
"Of course.

That seems like a very reasonable
plan, Arthur."
entries.translation_source: Of course. That seems like a very reasonable plan, Arthur.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja. Itu tampaknya rencana
yang sangat masuk akal, Arthur.

entries.original:
"Understood, Grampa.

I’m heading out.

I’ll stop them and save Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Understood, Grampa. I’m heading out. I’ll stop them and save Moltres!
entries.translated:
Dimengerti, Kakek. Aku berangkat.
Aku akan menghentikan mereka dan\lmenyelamatkan Moltres!

entries.original:
"Well, [player], I think it’s time
for you to head home.

You’ve completed your errand, and
I’m sure your mother misses you.

But still, I’m surprised that you
managed to get here so easily\.

I’ll have to brag to your mother
about what a reliable errand [buffer1]\lyou’ve become!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: Well, [player], I think it’s time for you to head home. You’ve completed your errand, and I’m sure your mother misses you. But still, I’m surprised that you managed to get here so easily\. I’ll have to brag to your mother about what a reliable errand [buffer1] you’ve become! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Yah, [player], kurasa sudah
waktunya kau pulang. Kau telah\lmenyelesaikan tugasmu, dan aku

yakin ibumu merindukanmu. Tapi
tetap saja, aku terkejut kau bisa\lsampai di sini dengan begitu mudah\.

Aku harus memuji ibumu tentang
betapa andalnya tugas [buffer1]\ldirimu! Ho ho ho!

entries.original:
"Now, wait just a moment, Euler.

I know Jax is capable, but I believe
this young [buffer1] may be just as\luseful.

[player] has had prior experience
with these \qoShadows\qc, and Jax very\lwell might benefit from the extra\lassistance [player] could lend."
entries.translation_source: Now, wait just a moment, Euler. I know Jax is capable, but I believe this young [buffer1] may be just as useful. [player] has had prior experience with these \qoShadows\qc, and Jax very well might benefit from the extra assistance [player] could lend.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, tunggu sebentar, Euler.
Aku tahu Jax mampu, tapi aku\lpercaya [buffer1] muda ini mungkin

sama bergunanya. [player] memiliki
pengalaman sebelumnya dengan\l\qoShadows\qc, dan Jax mungkin akan

mendapat manfaat dari bantuan
tambahan yang bisa diberikan\l[player].

entries.original:
"Assistance?

Arthur, [player] only became a
Trainer very recently\."
entries.translation_source: Assistance? Arthur, [player] only became a Trainer very recently\.
entries.translated:
Bantuan? Arthur, [player] baru
menjadi Pelatih baru-baru ini\.

entries.original:
"Is that\.\CC0818 is that Dresco Town’s
Gym Badge?

To think that you’d make this much
progress so quickly\."
entries.translation_source: Is that\.\CC0818 is that Dresco Town’s Gym Badge? To think that you’d make this much progress so quickly\.
entries.translated:
Apakah itu\.\CC0818 apakah itu Lencana Gym
Dresco Town? Tak terpikir kau bisa\lmembuat kemajuan sebesar ini begitu

cepat\.

entries.original:
"You see, Euler?

I think that Badge shows that
[player]’s more than capable of\ltaking care of [buffer1]self.

Right now, the four of us are the
only ones who know the true aim of\lthe Shadows.

Having another Trainer capable of
fighting them\.\CC0818 surely you see\lmy point."
entries.translation_source: You see, Euler? I think that Badge shows that [player]’s more than capable of taking care of [buffer1]self. Right now, the four of us are the only ones who know the true aim of the Shadows. Having another Trainer capable of fighting them\.\CC0818 surely you see my point.
entries.translated:
Kau lihat, Euler? Kurasa Lencana
itu menunjukkan bahwa [player]\llebih dari mampu mengurus diri

[buffer1] sendiri. Saat ini, kita
berempat adalah satu-satunya yang\ltahu tujuan sebenarnya dari

Shadows. Memiliki Pelatih lain yang
mampu melawan mereka\.\CC0818 pasti kau\lmengerti maksudku.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

Maybe you’re right.

If this takes a turn for the worse,
we’ll need all the help we can get."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. Maybe you’re right. If this takes a turn for the worse, we’ll need all the help we can get.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Mungkin kau benar. Jika ini
berubah menjadi lebih buruk, kita\lakan membutuhkan semua bantuan yang

bisa kita dapatkan.

entries.original:
"Alright, [player], you may follow
after Jax.

I’ll\.\CC0820 tell your mother you finished
my errand, and you’ve left home to\ltake the Gym Leader challenge.

Yes, I think that will do it."
entries.translation_source: Alright, [player], you may follow after Jax. I’ll\.\CC0820 tell your mother you finished my errand, and you’ve left home to take the Gym Leader challenge. Yes, I think that will do it.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, [player], kau boleh
mengikuti Jax. Aku akan\.\CC0820 memberi\ltahu ibumu bahwa kau menyelesaikan

tugasku, dan kau telah meninggalkan
rumah untuk mengikuti tantangan\lPemimpin Gym. Ya, kurasa itu sudah

cukup.

entries.original:
"Don’t force yourself, [player].

If you feel you are too injured to
continue, then you must fall back.

Jax will help, if it comes to that.

Good luck, youngster."
entries.translation_source: Don’t force yourself, [player]. If you feel you are too injured to continue, then you must fall back. Jax will help, if it comes to that. Good luck, youngster.
entries.translated:
Jangan memaksakan diri, [player].
Jika kau merasa terlalu terluka\luntuk melanjutkan, maka kau harus

mundur. Jax akan membantu, jika
sampai pada itu. Semoga berhasil,\lanak muda.

entries.original:
"We’re running out of time, [player].

You need to hurry to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]
and save [green]Zapdos[blue]!

If it’s captured too, we’ll all be
doomed\."
entries.translation_source: We’re running out of time, [player]. You need to hurry to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] and save [green]Zapdos[blue]! If it’s captured too, we’ll all be doomed\.
entries.translated:
Kita kehabisan waktu, [player]. Kau
harus bergegas ke [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]\ldan selamatkan [green]Zapdos[blue]! Jika ia juga

tertangkap, kita semua akan hancur\.

entries.original:
"Jax told me the news.

A job well done saving Zapdos,
[player]!

All that remains now is retrieving
Moltres and Articuno from the\lShadows.

Jax is in [green]Dehara City[blue] waiting to
discuss the next move."
entries.translation_source: Jax told me the news. A job well done saving Zapdos, [player]! All that remains now is retrieving Moltres and Articuno from the Shadows. Jax is in [green]Dehara City[blue] waiting to discuss the next move.
entries.translated:
Jax memberitahuku berita itu.
Pekerjaan yang bagus menyelamatkan\lZapdos, [player]! Yang tersisa

sekarang adalah mengambil Moltres
dan Articuno dari Shadows. Jax ada\ldi [green]Dehara City[blue] menunggu untuk

mendiskusikan langkah selanjutnya.

entries.original:
"So, the dark force has been
released\.

If it isn’t stopped, it could be
used to destroy the whole region!

You must find Jax and seal it away
once more!"
entries.translation_source: So, the dark force has been released\. If it isn’t stopped, it could be used to destroy the whole region! You must find Jax and seal it away once more!
entries.translated:
Jadi, kekuatan gelap telah
dilepaskan\. Jika tidak dihentikan,\lia bisa digunakan untuk

menghancurkan seluruh wilayah! Kau
harus menemukan Jax dan menyegelnya\lkembali!

entries.original:
"You did it!

You defeated the Light of Ruin and
saved us!

You are a true Guardian of Borrius!

Your father would be proud."
entries.translation_source: You did it! You defeated the Light of Ruin and saved us! You are a true Guardian of Borrius! Your father would be proud.
entries.translated:
Kau berhasil! Kau mengalahkan Light
of Ruin dan menyelamatkan kami! Kau\ladalah Penjaga sejati Borrius!

Ayahmu pasti bangga.

entries.original:
"Now that everything is at peace
once more, why don’t you take on\lthe [green]Pokémon League[blue]?

I’m sure someone with your skill
could easily become the champion."
entries.translation_source: Now that everything is at peace once more, why don’t you take on the [green]Pokémon League[blue]? I’m sure someone with your skill could easily become the champion.
entries.translated:
Sekarang semuanya sudah damai
kembali, mengapa kamu tidak mencoba\l[green]Liga Pokémon[blue]? Saya yakin seseorang

dengan keahlianmu bisa dengan mudah
menjadi juara.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]! Welcome.

Thank you for assisting Jax
in my rescue.

He\.\CC0818 well, actually, he came to see
me just before.

He told me about how the pressure
of trying to live up to my legacy\lwas messing with his head\.

All the more so after the setbacks
against the Shadows and the Light\lof Ruin.

I admit, perhaps I was asking
too much of him\.

So I told him that he should
improve himself, for his own sake,\lnot mine.

Although\. I wouldn’t mind if
he became strong enough to take\lyour place as Champion, myself.

Ho ho ho!

Oh, yes.

As thanks for rescuing me,
I’d like you to have this."
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player]! Welcome. Thank you for assisting Jax in my rescue. He\.\CC0818 well, actually, he came to see me just before. He told me about how the pressure of trying to live up to my legacy was messing with his head\. All the more so after the setbacks against the Shadows and the Light of Ruin. I admit, perhaps I was asking too much of him\. So I told him that he should improve himself, for his own sake, not mine. Although\. I wouldn’t mind if he became strong enough to take your place as Champion, myself. Ho ho ho! Oh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me, I’d like you to have this.
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Selamat datang.
Terima kasih telah membantu Jax\ldalam penyelamatanku. Dia\.\CC0818

sebenarnya, dia datang menemuiku
sebelumnya. Dia bercerita tentang\lbagaimana tekanan mencoba memenuhi

warisanku mengacaukan pikirannya\.
Terlebih lagi setelah kemunduran\lmelawan Shadow dan Cahaya

Kehancuran. Saya akui, mungkin saya
terlalu banyak memintanya\. Jadi saya\lbilang dia harus memperbaiki

dirinya, demi dirinya sendiri,
bukan demi saya. Meskipun\. Saya\ltidak keberatan jika dia menjadi

cukup kuat untuk menggantikanmu
sebagai Juara. Ho ho ho! Oh, ya.\lSebagai tanda terima kasih karena

telah menyelamatkanku, aku ingin
kamu memiliki ini.

entries.original:
"Have a [green]Salamence[blue] hold that,
and it’ll be able to Mega Evolve.

Jax was training a Bagon, on the
side\.\CC0818 but he needed something to\lfly with in the meantime, so\lhe trained a Starly, as well.

Now though, he’s grown rather fond
of both of them!"
entries.translation_source: Have a [green]Salamence[blue] hold that, and it’ll be able to Mega Evolve. Jax was training a Bagon, on the side\.\CC0818 but he needed something to fly with in the meantime, so he trained a Starly, as well. Now though, he’s grown rather fond of both of them!
entries.translated:
Suruh [green]Salamence[blue] memegang itu, dan
ia akan bisa Mega Evolve. Jax\lsedang melatih Bagon, di samping\.\CC0818

tapi dia butuh sesuatu untuk
terbang sementara, jadi dia juga\lmelatih Starly. Sekarang, dia sudah

sangat menyayangi keduanya!

entries.original: "How go your travels, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: How go your travels, [player]?
entries.translated: Bagaimana perjalananmu, [player]?

entries.original:
"Get moving, [player], to Cinder
Volcano - and be quick.

I don’t think it’s anything Jax can’t
handle, but he may appreciate\lyour help."
entries.translation_source: Get moving, [player], to Cinder Volcano - and be quick. I don’t think it’s anything Jax can’t handle, but he may appreciate your help.
entries.translated:
Bergeraklah, [player], ke Gunung
Berapi Cinder - dan cepatlah. Saya\lrasa itu bukan sesuatu yang tidak

bisa ditangani Jax, tapi dia
mungkin menghargai bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"Looks like I’m here.

I’d better get moving, then."
entries.translation_source: Looks like I’m here. I’d better get moving, then.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku sudah sampai.
Sebaiknya aku bergerak sekarang.

entries.original:
"One with the wind, one with the
flames\.

The guard that keeps vigil over
the sacred torch!

Now, become the inferno that
scorches the wastelands!

Sankren bolganone!

Descend to me, Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: One with the wind, one with the flames\. The guard that keeps vigil over the sacred torch! Now, become the inferno that scorches the wastelands! Sankren bolganone! Descend to me, Moltres!
entries.translated:
Satu dengan angin, satu dengan api\.
Penjaga yang berjaga di atas obor\lsuci! Sekarang, jadilah api yang

membakar tanah tandus! Sankren
bolganone! Turunlah padaku,\lMoltres!

entries.original: "And now for the capture!"
entries.translation_source: And now for the capture!
entries.translated: Dan sekarang untuk penangkapan!

entries.original:
"Now, Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: Now, Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, Prajurit Shadow! Tahan
dia!

entries.original:
"That was about as routine as it
could get.

Mission complete.

Let’s move out."
entries.translation_source: That was about as routine as it could get. Mission complete. Let’s move out.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah yang paling rutin yang
bisa terjadi. Misi selesai. Ayo\lbergerak.

entries.original:
"[blue]Stop right there, Shadow!

Return Moltres back to where
it belongs!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Stop right there, Shadow! Return Moltres back to where it belongs!
entries.translated:
[blue]Berhenti di sana, Shadow!
Kembalikan Moltres ke tempat\lasalnya!

entries.original:
"[red]Unfortunately, I see no reason
to humor your foolish request.

Step aside, if you know what’s good
for you."
entries.translation_source: [red]Unfortunately, I see no reason to humor your foolish request. Step aside, if you know what’s good for you.
entries.translated:
[red]Sayangnya, saya tidak melihat
alasan untuk memenuhi permintaan\lbodohmu. Minggir, jika kamu tahu

apa yang baik untukmu.

entries.original:
"[blue]Sorry, but you’re not going anywhere
until Moltres is free.

If you won’t come quietly, then I’ll
have to use force."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Sorry, but you’re not going anywhere until Moltres is free. If you won’t come quietly, then I’ll have to use force.
entries.translated:
[blue]Maaf, tapi kamu tidak akan pergi
kemana-mana sampai Moltres bebas.\lJika kamu tidak mau datang dengan

tenang, maka aku harus menggunakan
kekerasan.

entries.original:
"[red]Sigh\.\CC0818 I had hoped it wouldn’t
come to this\.

My party was kept light for this
mission, but fortunately, I have\lother allies besides my Pokémon\.

Shadow Warriors\.\CC0820 if you would\.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: [red]Sigh\.\CC0818 I had hoped it wouldn’t come to this\. My party was kept light for this mission, but fortunately, I have other allies besides my Pokémon\. Shadow Warriors\.\CC0820 if you would\.[blue]
entries.translated:
[red]Mendesah\.\CC0818 Saya berharap tidak sampai
begini\. Tim saya sengaja dibuat\lringan untuk misi ini, tapi

untungnya, saya memiliki sekutu
lain selain Pokémon saya\. Prajurit\lShadow\.\CC0820 jika kamu mau\.[blue]

entries.original: "[blue]Ivory, wait!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Ivory, wait!
entries.translated: [blue]Ivory, tunggu!

entries.original:
"[blue]You don’t need to waste time over
this lone Trainer.

I’ll hold him off.
Just focus on the mission!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]You don’t need to waste time over this lone Trainer. I’ll hold him off. Just focus on the mission!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu tidak perlu membuang waktu
untuk Pelatih sendirian ini. Aku\lakan menahannya. Fokus saja pada

misi!

entries.original: "[red]Let’s go, Shadow Warriors\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Let’s go, Shadow Warriors\.
entries.translated: [red]Ayo pergi, Prajurit Shadow\.

entries.original:
"[blue]No\.\CC0818 they escaped with Moltres\.

Gah! This isn’t the time to feel
sorry for myself.

I gotta chase after them\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]No\.\CC0818 they escaped with Moltres\. Gah! This isn’t the time to feel sorry for myself. I gotta chase after them\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Tidak\.\CC0818 mereka kabur dengan Moltres\.
Gah! Ini bukan waktunya untuk\lmengasihani diri sendiri. Aku harus

mengejar mereka\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh? Wait, you’re\.\CC0820 [player],
I think?

Did Grampa Arthur send you here?

\.

Ah, so you were sent as backup.

Jeez, I got embarrassed in front
of you\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Huh? Wait, you’re\.\CC0820 [player], I think? Did Grampa Arthur send you here? \. Ah, so you were sent as backup. Jeez, I got embarrassed in front of you\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Hah? Tunggu, kamu\.\CC0820 [player], kurasa?
Apakah Kakek Arthur mengirimmu ke\lsini? \. Ah, jadi kamu dikirim

sebagai cadangan. Astaga, aku malu
di depanmu\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Well\.

Now that you’re here, why don’t you
and I team up?

You were sent to help, and I gotta
admit I could do with some right now\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Well\. Now that you’re here, why don’t you and I team up? You were sent to help, and I gotta admit I could do with some right now\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Baiklah\. Sekarang kamu di sini,
bagaimana kalau kita bekerja sama?\lKamu dikirim untuk membantu, dan

aku harus aku akui aku butuh
bantuan sekarang\.

entries.original: "[black][player] decided to go with Jax!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] decided to go with Jax!
entries.translated:
[black][player] memutuskan untuk pergi
bersama Jax!

entries.original:
"[blue]Alright!
I bet we’ll make a good team!

Your Pokémon are in better shape
than I am right now, so you lead.

I can hang back and support.

I’ll make sure to keep us both
healed up, too."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Alright! I bet we’ll make a good team! Your Pokémon are in better shape than I am right now, so you lead. I can hang back and support. I’ll make sure to keep us both healed up, too.
entries.translated:
[blue]Baiklah! Aku yakin kita akan
menjadi tim yang bagus! Pokémonmu\ldalam kondisi lebih baik daripada

aku sekarang, jadi kau yang
memimpin. Aku bisa di belakang dan\lmendukung. Aku juga akan memastikan

kita berdua tetap dipulihkan.

entries.original:
"[blue]In that case, Staravia.
Let’s cut them off at the exit."
entries.translation_source: [blue]In that case, Staravia. Let’s cut them off at the exit.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kalau begitu, Staravia. Mari kita
potong jalan mereka di pintu\lkeluar.

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with Jax, the
[green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle."
entries.translation_source: [black]While teamed up with Jax, the [green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle.
entries.translated:
[black]Saat bekerja sama dengan Jax, [green]3[black]
Pokémon pertama yang layak dalam\ltimmu akan dipilih untuk bertarung.

entries.original:
"Let’s get to the exit as quick as
possible and stop the Shadows from\lescaping with Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get to the exit as quick as possible and stop the Shadows from escaping with Moltres!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita ke pintu keluar secepat
mungkin dan hentikan para Bayangan\ldari melarikan diri bersama

Moltres!

entries.original:
"[blue]Where are you going, [player]?
The exit’s the other way!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Where are you going, [player]? The exit’s the other way!
entries.translated:
[blue]Mau ke mana, [player]? Pintu
keluarnya di arah sebaliknya!

entries.original:
"[blue]Looks like we’ve reached the
exit, [player].

I’ll go on ahead.
Don’t stay too far behind!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Looks like we’ve reached the exit, [player]. I’ll go on ahead. Don’t stay too far behind!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya kita sudah sampai di
pintu keluar, [player]. Aku akan\lmaju duluan. Jangan terlalu jauh di

belakang!

entries.original: "Staravia! Use Aerial Ace!"
entries.translation_source: Staravia! Use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated: Staravia! Gunakan Aerial Ace!

entries.original: "[green]Ravia!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Ravia!
entries.translated: [green]Ravia!

entries.original: "[green]Raptor!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Raptor!
entries.translated: [green]Raptor!

entries.original: "Duskull! Use Payback!"
entries.translation_source: Duskull! Use Payback!
entries.translated: Duskull! Gunakan Payback!

entries.original: "Cacnea! Use Feint Attack!"
entries.translation_source: Cacnea! Use Feint Attack!
entries.translated: Cacnea! Gunakan Feint Attack!

entries.original: "[green]Skull\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Skull\.
entries.translated: [green]Skull\.

entries.original:
"Your shadowy reign of terror
ends here and now!

I won’t let you escape from Cinder
Volcano with Moltres in hand!"
entries.translation_source: Your shadowy reign of terror ends here and now! I won’t let you escape from Cinder Volcano with Moltres in hand!
entries.translated:
Kekuasaan teror bayanganmu berakhir
di sini dan sekarang! Aku tidak\lakan membiarkanmu melarikan diri

dari Gunung Berapi Cinder dengan
Moltres di tangan!

entries.original:
"\qoShadowy reign of terror\qc?
Seriously?

We have Moltres, and we’re well
within our rights to keep it.

You may have some self-righteous
notion that what we’re doing is\l\qoevil\qc, but you’re wrong!

You simply don’t understand what’s
at stake here\."
entries.translation_source: \qoShadowy reign of terror\qc? Seriously? We have Moltres, and we’re well within our rights to keep it. You may have some self-righteous notion that what we’re doing is \qoevil\qc, but you’re wrong! You simply don’t understand what’s at stake here\.
entries.translated:
\qoKekuasaan teror bayangan\qc? Serius?
Kami memiliki Moltres, dan kami\lberhak menyimpannya. Mungkin kau

punya anggapan sok suci bahwa apa
yang kami lakukan adalah \qojahat\qc,\ltapi kau salah! Kau sama sekali

tidak mengerti apa yang
dipertaruhkan di sini\.

entries.original:
"[red]That’s it, Marlon.
Stall him for just a little longer.

These Shadow Warriors have been out
in the light for too long\.

They’ll revert to dust if they
remain here.

I need to return to base with
them now."
entries.translation_source: [red]That’s it, Marlon. Stall him for just a little longer. These Shadow Warriors have been out in the light for too long\. They’ll revert to dust if they remain here. I need to return to base with them now.
entries.translated:
[red]Itu dia, Marlon. Tunda dia sedikit
lebih lama. Para Prajurit Bayangan\lini sudah terlalu lama berada di

bawah cahaya\. Mereka akan kembali
menjadi debu jika tetap di sini.\lAku harus kembali ke markas bersama

mereka sekarang.

entries.original:
"Of course, Ivory.
I have this under control.

Take the Shadow Warriors and go.

I can hold off this boy until
you escape with Moltres."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Ivory. I have this under control. Take the Shadow Warriors and go. I can hold off this boy until you escape with Moltres.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Ivory. Aku
mengendalikan ini. Bawa para\lPrajurit Bayangan dan pergilah. Aku

bisa menahan anak ini sampai kau
melarikan diri bersama Moltres.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!
Help me out against him!

I don’t care what he claims is really
at stake here, we have to blast\lthrough him and chase after Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: [blue][player]! Help me out against him! I don’t care what he claims is really at stake here, we have to blast through him and chase after Moltres!
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Bantu aku melawannya! Aku
tidak peduli apa yang dia klaim\lsebagai taruhan di sini, kita harus

menerobosnya dan mengejar Moltres!

entries.original:
"So, we meet again, [player].

I take it, then, you’ve decided to
make it your business to interfere?

That’s unfortunate.

But two of you trying to get
past makes no difference to me."
entries.translation_source: So, we meet again, [player]. I take it, then, you’ve decided to make it your business to interfere? That’s unfortunate. But two of you trying to get past makes no difference to me.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kita bertemu lagi, [player].
Kurasa, kau telah memutuskan untuk\likut campur? Itu menyedihkan. Tapi

kalian berdua yang mencoba lewat
tidak ada bedanya bagiku.

entries.original:
"One of you grunts, give me a hand
over here!"
entries.translation_source: One of you grunts, give me a hand over here!
entries.translated:
Salah satu dari kalian prajurit,
bantu aku di sini!

entries.original:
"[red]I’ll assist you in your battle,
Marlon, sir!"
