entries.translation_source: [red]I’ll assist you in your battle, Marlon, sir!
entries.translated:
[red]Saya akan membantu Anda dalam
pertarungan, Tuan Marlon!

entries.original:
"[black]Choose up to three Pokémon to
battle with."
entries.translation_source: [black]Choose up to three Pokémon to battle with.
entries.translated:
[black]Pilih hingga tiga Pokémon untuk
bertarung.

entries.original:
"Well, I suppose that’s fine.
Our operation was a success.

Ivory is long gone by now."
entries.translation_source: Well, I suppose that’s fine. Our operation was a success. Ivory is long gone by now.
entries.translated:
Yah, saya kira itu baik-baik saja.
Operasi kami berhasil. Ivory sudah\llama pergi sekarang.

entries.original:
"You can follow me if you want, but
it won’t do you any good.

You already know I’ll never lead
you to Moltres\.

So I advise both of you to do the
smart thing, and leave us alone."
entries.translation_source: You can follow me if you want, but it won’t do you any good. You already know I’ll never lead you to Moltres\. So I advise both of you to do the smart thing, and leave us alone.
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa mengikutiku jika mau,
tapi itu tidak akan berguna. Kamu\lsudah tahu aku tidak akan pernah

membawamu ke Moltres\. Jadi aku
menyarankan kalian berdua melakukan\lhal yang cerdas, dan tinggalkan

kami sendiri.

entries.original: "Let’s move."
entries.translation_source: Let’s move.
entries.translated: Ayo bergerak.

entries.original:
"Grr\.\CC0818 He’s right\.\CC0818

It’s not even worth chasing him\.

That woman was the one who
took Moltres\."
entries.translation_source: Grr\.\CC0818 He’s right\.\CC0818 It’s not even worth chasing him\. That woman was the one who took Moltres\.
entries.translated:
Grr\.\CC0818 Dia benar\.\CC0818 Tidak ada gunanya
mengejarnya\. Wanita itu yang\lmengambil Moltres\.

entries.original:
"Anyway, thanks, [player] - he was a
lot tougher than I thought\.

Let’s head back to Grampa’s house,
and tell him what happened."
entries.translation_source: Anyway, thanks, [player] - he was a lot tougher than I thought\. Let’s head back to Grampa’s house, and tell him what happened.
entries.translated:
Bagaimanapun, terima kasih,
[player] - dia jauh lebih tangguh\ldari yang kukira\. Mari kita kembali

ke rumah Kakek, dan ceritakan apa
yang terjadi.

entries.original:
"I see\.\CC0820 this isn’t good.

At this point, there’s now only one
Legendary Pokémon left - [green]Zapdos[blue].

It’s imperative that it be rescued
before the Shadows can capture it."
entries.translation_source: I see\.\CC0820 this isn’t good. At this point, there’s now only one Legendary Pokémon left - [green]Zapdos[blue]. It’s imperative that it be rescued before the Shadows can capture it.
entries.translated:
Begitu\.\CC0820 ini tidak bagus. Pada titik
ini, hanya ada satu Pokémon\lLegendaris yang tersisa - [green]Zapdos[blue].

Sangat penting untuk
menyelamatkannya sebelum Shadows\lbisa menangkapnya.

entries.original:
"Zapdos\.

It lives in [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue], right?

I’ll head on out right away."
entries.translation_source: Zapdos\. It lives in [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue], right? I’ll head on out right away.
entries.translated:
Zapdos\. Ia tinggal di [green]Gunung
Thundercap[blue], kan? Aku akan segera\lberangkat.

entries.original:
"Actually, Jax, I have a different
task for you.

To the best of my knowledge,
the Shadows still lack the object\lused to seal the dark force.

Friends of mine that live on [green]Route 9[blue]
should know of its location.

Go to them and explain the
situation.

I’m sure they’ll be willing to help
us find it before the Shadows do."
entries.translation_source: Actually, Jax, I have a different task for you. To the best of my knowledge, the Shadows still lack the object used to seal the dark force. Friends of mine that live on [green]Route 9[blue] should know of its location. Go to them and explain the situation. I’m sure they’ll be willing to help us find it before the Shadows do.
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, Jax, aku punya tugas
lain untukmu. Sepengetahuanku,\lShadows masih kekurangan benda yang

digunakan untuk menyegel kekuatan
gelap. Teman-temanku yang tinggal\ldi [green]Rute 9[blue] seharusnya tahu

lokasinya. Temui mereka dan
jelaskan situasinya. Aku yakin\lmereka akan bersedia membantu kita

menemukannya sebelum Shadows
melakukannya.

entries.original: "You got it, Grampa."
entries.translation_source: You got it, Grampa.
entries.translated: Siap, Kakek.

entries.original:
"Good, good.

In the meantime, [player] will be
the one who will head to\l[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] and save [green]Zapdos[blue].

[player]\.\CC0818 you’ve proven yourself
by defending Jax back at Cinder\lVolcano, and I think you’re up to\lthe task.

You can head there by taking the
highway south-east from the next\ltown over, [green]Crater Town[blue].

You may need the Badge there in
order to travel to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue],\lso make sure that obtaining the\lBadge is your utmost priority."
entries.translation_source: Good, good. In the meantime, [player] will be the one who will head to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] and save [green]Zapdos[blue]. [player]\.\CC0818 you’ve proven yourself by defending Jax back at Cinder Volcano, and I think you’re up to the task. You can head there by taking the highway south-east from the next town over, [green]Crater Town[blue]. You may need the Badge there in order to travel to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue], so make sure that obtaining the Badge is your utmost priority.
entries.translated:
Bagus, bagus. Sementara itu,
[player] yang akan pergi ke [green]Gunung\lThundercap[blue] dan menyelamatkan

[green]Zapdos[blue]. [player]\.\CC0818 kamu telah
membuktikan diri dengan membela Jax\ldi Gunung Cinder, dan aku pikir

kamu mampu melakukan tugas itu.
Kamu bisa ke sana dengan mengambil\ljalan raya ke tenggara dari kota

berikutnya, [green]Kota Crater[blue]. Kamu
mungkin memerlukan Lencana di sana\luntuk bepergian ke [green]Gunung

Thundercap[blue], jadi pastikan
mendapatkan Lencana adalah\lprioritas utamamu.

entries.original:
"I’ll head back to Frozen Heights,
[player].

I’ll explain to your mother that
I’ve seen you off, and you’re on\lyour way to the next Gym Badge.

No sense in letting her worry,
after all."
entries.translation_source: I’ll head back to Frozen Heights, [player]. I’ll explain to your mother that I’ve seen you off, and you’re on your way to the next Gym Badge. No sense in letting her worry, after all.
entries.translated:
Aku akan kembali ke Frozen Heights,
[player]. Aku akan menjelaskan\lkepada ibumu bahwa aku telah

mengantarmu pergi, dan kamu sedang
dalam perjalanan menuju Lencana Gym\lberikutnya. Tidak ada gunanya

membuatnya khawatir, bagaimanapun
juga.

entries.original:
"My Staravia’s still tired from the
battle earlier, but I should still\lbe able to give you a lift back to\l[green]Cinder Volcano[blue].

Do you want me to do that?"
entries.translation_source: My Staravia’s still tired from the battle earlier, but I should still be able to give you a lift back to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]. Do you want me to do that?
entries.translated:
Staravia-ku masih lelah dari
pertarungan sebelumnya, tapi aku\lseharusnya masih bisa mengantarmu

kembali ke [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]. Apakah
kamu ingin aku melakukannya?

entries.original: "Let’s head out right away."
entries.translation_source: Let’s head out right away.
entries.translated: Ayo berangkat sekarang juga.

entries.original:
"In that case, these Repels should
help you get back through Grim\lWoods and Cinder Volcano quicker."
entries.translation_source: In that case, these Repels should help you get back through Grim Woods and Cinder Volcano quicker.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, Repel ini akan
membantu kamu kembali melalui Grim\lWoods dan Cinder Volcano lebih

cepat.

entries.original:
"The asset has sent word.

The target is on the move."
entries.translation_source: The asset has sent word. The target is on the move.
entries.translated:
Aset telah mengirim kabar. Target
sedang bergerak.

entries.original:
"Alright, then.

Let’s move into position."
entries.translation_source: Alright, then. Let’s move into position.
entries.translated:
Baiklah kalau begitu. Mari bergerak
ke posisi.

entries.original:
"Quick!

Grab [buffer1] now!"
entries.translation_source: Quick! Grab [buffer1] now!
entries.translated: Cepat! Ambil [buffer1] sekarang!

entries.original:
"Ah, right on schedule.

Tell me, [buffer1], what is your name?

\.

[player], was it?

At last, we finally meet.

I am Zeph, the man lurking in the
Shadows behind this organization."
entries.translation_source: Ah, right on schedule. Tell me, [buffer1], what is your name? \. [player], was it? At last, we finally meet. I am Zeph, the man lurking in the Shadows behind this organization.
entries.translated:
Ah, tepat waktu. Katakan padaku,
[buffer1], siapa namamu? \. [player],\lya? Akhirnya kita bertemu. Aku

Zeph, pria yang bersembunyi di
Shadows di balik organisasi ini.

entries.original:
"I shall get to the point - I’ve
been informed that not only have\lyou trespassed in our laboratory,\lbut you’ve tried to interfere with\ltwo of our operations as well.

That, make no mistake,
is unacceptable.

However, it does beg the question,
of who exactly you’re working for\.

\.

You work for no one?
Nonsense.

Surely you can craft a more
plausible lie than that.

You’re not even trying."
entries.translation_source: I shall get to the point - I’ve been informed that not only have you trespassed in our laboratory, but you’ve tried to interfere with two of our operations as well. That, make no mistake, is unacceptable. However, it does beg the question, of who exactly you’re working for\. \. You work for no one? Nonsense. Surely you can craft a more plausible lie than that. You’re not even trying.
entries.translated:
Saya akan langsung ke pokok
persoalan - Saya telah diberitahu\lbahwa Anda tidak hanya telah masuk

tanpa izin ke laboratorium kami,
tetapi Anda juga mencoba mengganggu\ldua operasi kami. Itu, jangan

salah, tidak dapat diterima. Namun,
hal itu menimbulkan pertanyaan,\ltentang siapa sebenarnya Anda

bekerja\. \. Anda bekerja untuk siapa
pun? Omong kosong. Pasti Anda bisa\lmembuat kebohongan yang lebih masuk

akal dari itu. Anda bahkan tidak
berusaha.

entries.original:
"Very well, if you will not talk,
then Ivory here will have to give\lyou a little\.\CC0818 incentive."
entries.translation_source: Very well, if you will not talk, then Ivory here will have to give you a little\.\CC0818 incentive.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, jika Anda tidak mau
bicara, maka Ivory di sini harus\lmemberi Anda sedikit\.\CC0818 insentif.

entries.original:
"[red]So, you’re the Trainer Marlon seems
to have a score to settle with\.

Try not to struggle so much - it’ll
only hurt all the more."
entries.translation_source: [red]So, you’re the Trainer Marlon seems to have a score to settle with\. Try not to struggle so much - it’ll only hurt all the more.
entries.translated:
[red]Jadi, Anda adalah Pelatih yang
sepertinya ingin Marlon tuntaskan\ldendamnya\. Cobalah untuk tidak

terlalu banyak meronta - itu hanya
akan semakin menyakitkan.

entries.original:
"Oh, Ivory\.

How are we supposed to scare [buffer1]
straight if you cannot even defeat\l[buffer1] in a simple battle?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Ivory\. How are we supposed to scare [buffer1] straight if you cannot even defeat [buffer1] in a simple battle?
entries.translated:
Oh, Ivory\. Bagaimana kita bisa
menakuti [buffer1] menjadi patuh\ljika kamu bahkan tidak bisa

mengalahkan [buffer1] dalam
pertarungan sederhana?

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph, I’m a scientist.

My best skills lie elsewhere."
entries.translation_source: [red]Zeph, I’m a scientist. My best skills lie elsewhere.
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph, saya seorang ilmuwan.
Keahlian terbaik saya ada di tempat\llain.

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0818 very well.

In the absence of anyone else,
Houndoom and I will personally\lshow you the meaning of pain."
entries.translation_source: Sigh\.\CC0818 very well. In the absence of anyone else, Houndoom and I will personally show you the meaning of pain.
entries.translated:
Helaan napas\.\CC0818 baiklah. Tanpa adanya
orang lain, Houndoom dan saya\lsecara pribadi akan menunjukkan

kepadamu arti dari rasa sakit.

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph, I’m not sure Houndoom alone
will be enough to beat [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Zeph, I’m not sure Houndoom alone will be enough to beat [buffer1]\.
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph, saya tidak yakin Houndoom
sendirian akan cukup untuk\lmengalahkan [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"You doubt me, Ivory?

Houndoom and I are more than
capable of finishing [buffer1] off."
entries.translation_source: You doubt me, Ivory? Houndoom and I are more than capable of finishing [buffer1] off.
entries.translated:
Kamu meragukanku, Ivory? Houndoom
dan saya lebih dari mampu untuk\lmenyelesaikan [buffer1].

entries.original:
"Now then, [player].

I’ve been quite patient with you,
but I’m afraid you’ve forced\lmy hand.

Time to suffer for your interference!"
entries.translation_source: Now then, [player]. I’ve been quite patient with you, but I’m afraid you’ve forced my hand. Time to suffer for your interference!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, [player]. Saya sudah
cukup sabar denganmu, tapi saya\lkhawatir kamu telah memaksaku.

Waktunya menderita karena campur
tanganmu!

entries.original:
"I’ve got to hand it to you.
You’re stronger than I anticipated.

I do like that about you, [buffer1].

That strength is something I wished
for my son, too\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got to hand it to you. You’re stronger than I anticipated. I do like that about you, [buffer1]. That strength is something I wished for my son, too\.
entries.translated:
Saya harus mengakuinya. Kamu lebih
kuat dari yang saya duga. Saya suka\litu tentangmu, [buffer1]. Kekuatan

itu adalah sesuatu yang saya
harapkan untuk anakku juga\.

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph! Marlon has just sent word.

He’s finished with his investigation
of the green-hatted boy.

You’ll want to hear this."
entries.translation_source: [red]Zeph! Marlon has just sent word. He’s finished with his investigation of the green-hatted boy. You’ll want to hear this.
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph! Marlon baru saja mengirim
kabar. Dia selesai dengan\lpenyelidikannya terhadap anak

laki-laki bertopi hijau. Kamu pasti
ingin mendengar ini.

entries.original:
"Yes, what is it?

\.

I see\."
entries.translation_source: Yes, what is it? \. I see\.
entries.translated: Ya, ada apa? \. Begitu ya\.

entries.original:
"I’m afraid, [player], that you’ve now
lost your leverage.

I’m told there was a boy with you
when you happened upon our last\loperation.

We have successfully identified him
as the grandson of a well-known\lhistorian named Arthur.

Was he involved in your appearance
there?

\.

Your reaction speaks volumes.
It was indeed his doing.

That old fool\.\CC0818 how long must he
interfere with us\.?"
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid, [player], that you’ve now lost your leverage. I’m told there was a boy with you when you happened upon our last operation. We have successfully identified him as the grandson of a well-known historian named Arthur. Was he involved in your appearance there? \. Your reaction speaks volumes. It was indeed his doing. That old fool\.\CC0818 how long must he interfere with us\.?
entries.translated:
Saya khawatir, [player], bahwa kamu
sekarang kehilangan pengaruhmu.\lSaya diberitahu ada seorang anak

laki-laki bersamamu saat kamu
kebetulan berada di operasi\lterakhir kami. Kami berhasil

mengidentifikasinya sebagai cucu
dari seorang sejarawan terkenal\lbernama Arthur. Apakah dia terlibat

dalam kemunculanmu di sana? \.
Reaksimu berbicara banyak. Itu\lmemang perbuatannya. Orang tua

bodoh itu\.\CC0818 berapa lama dia harus
mengganggu kami\.?

entries.original:
"[red]Sir!

A monster just appeared out of thin
air in the basement chamber!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Sir! A monster just appeared out of thin air in the basement chamber!
entries.translated:
[red]Pak! Seekor monster baru saja
muncul dari udara tipis di ruang\lbawah tanah!

entries.original:
"All grunts get down there NOW!

Stop whatever that monster is and
protect the Shadow Warriors!"
entries.translation_source: All grunts get down there NOW! Stop whatever that monster is and protect the Shadow Warriors!
entries.translated:
Semua preman turun ke sana
SEKARANG! Hentikan apa pun monster\litu dan lindungi Shadow Warriors!

entries.original:
"Ivory, we’ll heal our Pokémon and
join the containment efforts.

We cannot afford to lose even
a single Shadow Warrior right now.

If any are destroyed and Fey
finds out\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory, we’ll heal our Pokémon and join the containment efforts. We cannot afford to lose even a single Shadow Warrior right now. If any are destroyed and Fey finds out\.
entries.translated:
Ivory, kita akan menyembuhkan
Pokémon kita dan bergabung dalam\lupaya penahanan. Kita tidak boleh

kehilangan satu pun Shadow Warrior
saat ini. Jika ada yang hancur dan\lFey mengetahuinya\.

entries.original:
"[red]I understand, Zeph.

But what should we do about
the [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: [red]I understand, Zeph. But what should we do about the [buffer1]?
entries.translated:
[red]Saya mengerti, Zeph. Tapi apa yang
harus kita lakukan terhadap\l[buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Let [buffer1] go, for now.

As long as their public appearances
remain scarce, there is no reason\lfor Fey and Arthur to ever speak\lwith one another.

There is little chance he would ever
tell her."
entries.translation_source: Let [buffer1] go, for now. As long as their public appearances remain scarce, there is no reason for Fey and Arthur to ever speak with one another. There is little chance he would ever tell her.
entries.translated:
Biarkan [buffer1] pergi, untuk saat
ini. Selama penampilan publik\lmereka tetap jarang, tidak ada

alasan bagi Fey dan Arthur untuk
berbicara satu sama lain. Kecil\lkemungkinan dia akan pernah

memberitahunya.

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 I suspect you have
no intention of obeying, but I will\lonly warn you once.

Keep out of our business, or you
may find things will escalate\lbeyond your control\.

So for your sake, I hope we don’t
need to meet again, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [player]\.\CC0818 I suspect you have no intention of obeying, but I will only warn you once. Keep out of our business, or you may find things will escalate beyond your control\. So for your sake, I hope we don’t need to meet again, [buffer1].
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 Saya menduga kamu tidak
punya niat untuk patuh, tapi saya\lhanya akan memperingatkanmu sekali.

Jangan ikut campur urusan kami,
atau kamu mungkin akan menemukan\lhal-hal meningkat di luar kendalimu\.

Jadi demi kebaikanmu, saya harap
kita tidak perlu bertemu lagi,\l[buffer1].

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0830 pa\.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoo\.\CC0830 pa\.\CC0830
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0830 pa\.\CC0830

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

If that ain’t the darndest thing
I ever did see - a [buffer1] coming\loutta some magic portal!

Where’d ya come from, [buffer1]?

\.

What’s that?

Ya were tryin’ to get to
Thundercap Mt. when all of a\lsudden ya were kidnapped?

Hoooo weeee!
That sure sounds scary, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! If that ain’t the darndest thing I ever did see - a [buffer1] coming outta some magic portal! Where’d ya come from, [buffer1]? \. What’s that? Ya were tryin’ to get to Thundercap Mt. when all of a sudden ya were kidnapped? Hoooo weeee! That sure sounds scary, [buffer1].
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Kalau itu bukan hal
paling aneh yang pernah kulihat -\lada [buffer1] keluar dari portal

ajaib! Dari mana kau datang,
[buffer1]? \. Apa itu? Kau sedang\lmencoba pergi ke Gunung Thundercap

saat tiba-tiba kau diculik? Hoooo
weeee! Kedengarannya menakutkan,\l[buffer1].

entries.original:
"Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped,
ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble\lgettin’ to Thundercap Mt.

Ya see, part of the ceiling
collapsed not long ago and\lblocked off the road!

And unless ya have the HM for [green]Rock
Smash[blue], you’ll be in a bit of a\lpickle gettin’ through ’em.

But\.\CC0818 I’m guessin’ ya don’t, or ya
wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me.

In thatta case, a friend of mine in
[green]Blizzard City[blue] can help ya out by\lgivin’ ya Rock Smash.

So, take this HM to help yerself
get to him."
entries.translation_source: Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped, ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble gettin’ to Thundercap Mt. Ya see, part of the ceiling collapsed not long ago and blocked off the road! And unless ya have the HM for [green]Rock Smash[blue], you’ll be in a bit of a pickle gettin’ through ’em. But\.\CC0818 I’m guessin’ ya don’t, or ya wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me. In thatta case, a friend of mine in [green]Blizzard City[blue] can help ya out by givin’ ya Rock Smash. So, take this HM to help yerself get to him.
entries.translated:
Nah, jika kau tidak diculik, kau
akan mengalami lebih sedikit\lmasalah sampai ke Gunung

Thundercap. Kau lihat, sebagian
langit-langit runtuh belum lama ini\ldan memblokir jalan! Dan kecuali

kau punya HM untuk [green]Penghancur Batu[blue],
kau akan sedikit kesulitan\lmelewatinya. Tapi\.\CC0818 aku rasa kau

tidak punya, atau kau tidak akan
masih bicara padaku. Kalau begitu,\ltemanku di [green]Blizzard City[blue] bisa

membantumu dengan memberimu
Penghancur Batu. Jadi, ambil HM ini\luntuk membantumu sampai ke dia.

entries.original:
"What’s that?
Ya don’t know what an HM is?

Hoooo weeee!

Well, an [green]HM[blue] or Hidden Machine, is
a special type of move a Pokémon\lcan use to remove obstacles.

As long as an HM is in yer Cube,
and ya have a Pokémon in your\lparty capable of learning the HM,\lit can be used in the field, even\lif the Pokémon can’t battle!

In other words, [green]yer Pokémon don’t
need to know the HM to use it[blue].

Ain’t that convenient?

Anyway, ya can start by using that
HM for [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of the pesky\ltree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue].

Good luck to ya, [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Ya don’t know what an HM is? Hoooo weeee! Well, an [green]HM[blue] or Hidden Machine, is a special type of move a Pokémon can use to remove obstacles. As long as an HM is in yer Cube, and ya have a Pokémon in your party capable of learning the HM, it can be used in the field, even if the Pokémon can’t battle! In other words, [green]yer Pokémon don’t need to know the HM to use it[blue]. Ain’t that convenient? Anyway, ya can start by using that HM for [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of the pesky tree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue]. Good luck to ya, [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
Ada apa? Kau tidak tahu apa itu HM?
Hoooo weeee! Yah, [green]HM[blue] atau Mesin\lTersembunyi, adalah tipe gerakan

spesial yang bisa digunakan Pokémon
untuk menyingkirkan rintangan.\lSelama HM ada di Kubusmu, dan kau

memiliki Pokémon di tim yang bisa
mempelajari HM itu, HM bisa\ldigunakan di lapangan, bahkan jika

Pokémon tidak bisa bertarung!
Dengan kata lain, [green]Pokémon kamu\ltidak perlu tahu HM untuk

menggunakannya[blue]. Bukankah itu
praktis? Pokoknya, kau bisa mulai\ldengan menggunakan HM untuk [green]Potong[blue]

untuk menyingkirkan pohon yang
mengganggu di [green]Valley Cave[blue]. Semoga\lberuntung, [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"I’ve just received new directions
from Zeph.

We’ll be tightening security
on Route 9.

The green-hatted boy who tried to
interfere with our operation in\lCinder Volcano has been spotted\lflying overhead.

While you three stand guard at the
gate, I’m going to find a suitable\lplace to set up a psychic barrier\laround the route."
entries.translation_source: I’ve just received new directions from Zeph. We’ll be tightening security on Route 9. The green-hatted boy who tried to interfere with our operation in Cinder Volcano has been spotted flying overhead. While you three stand guard at the gate, I’m going to find a suitable place to set up a psychic barrier around the route.
entries.translated:
Saya baru saja menerima arahan baru
dari Zeph. Kami akan memperketat\lkeamanan di Rute 9. Anak laki-laki

bertopi hijau yang mencoba
mengganggu operasi kami di Cinder\lVolcano terlihat terbang di atas.

Sementara kalian bertiga berjaga di
gerbang, saya akan mencari tempat\lyang cocok untuk memasang

penghalang psikis di sekitar rute.

entries.original: "[blue]Yes, ma’am!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Yes, ma’am!
entries.translated: [blue]Ya, Bu!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

In order to set up a strong
barrier, I should head to the peak\lof [green]Frost Mountain[red]\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. In order to set up a strong barrier, I should head to the peak of [green]Frost Mountain[red]\.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Untuk memasang penghalang yang
kuat, saya harus menuju ke puncak\l[green]Frost Mountain[red]\.

entries.original:
"[blue]You! Hold it right there!

You’re one of those Shadow goons,
aren’t you?

I’d recognize the symbol on
your chest anywhere.

You’re going to tell me what I
want to know, or I’m going to do\lto you what I did to those dumb\lgoons back at your hideout."
entries.translation_source: [blue]You! Hold it right there! You’re one of those Shadow goons, aren’t you? I’d recognize the symbol on your chest anywhere. You’re going to tell me what I want to know, or I’m going to do to you what I did to those dumb goons back at your hideout.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kau! Berhenti di situ! Kau salah
satu antek Shadow, kan? Aku akan\lmengenali simbol di dadamu di mana

pun. Kau akan memberitahuku apa
yang ingin kuketahui, atau aku akan\lmelakukan padamu apa yang kulakukan

pada antek-antek bodoh itu di
markasmu.

entries.original:
"[red]Is that really any way to talk to
someone, [rival]?

Move aside. You should learn threats
are only effective if you can\lfollow through on them."
entries.translation_source: [red]Is that really any way to talk to someone, [rival]? Move aside. You should learn threats are only effective if you can follow through on them.
entries.translated:
[red]Apakah itu cara bicara pada
seseorang, [rival]? Minggir. Kau\lharus belajar bahwa ancaman hanya

efektif jika kau bisa
melaksanakannya.

entries.original:
"[blue]Wha\.

You can’t just pretend like you
know me and treat me like I’m\lsome kid!

My Pokémon will beat you to
a pulp!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Wha\. You can’t just pretend like you know me and treat me like I’m some kid! My Pokémon will beat you to a pulp!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa\. Kau tidak bisa berpura-pura
kenal aku dan memperlakukanku\lseperti anak kecil! Pokémonku akan

menghajarmu habis-habisan!

entries.original:
"[red]Sigh\.\CC0818 so much for that\.

I’m sorry about this, [rival]\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Sigh\.\CC0818 so much for that\. I’m sorry about this, [rival]\.
entries.translated:
[red]Huh\.\CC0818 sudahlah\. Maaf tentang ini,
[rival]\.

entries.original: "[red]Alakazam! Use Psychic!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Alakazam! Use Psychic!
entries.translated: [red]Alakazam! Gunakan Psikis!

entries.original: "[green]Shhhhzzz!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Shhhhzzz!
entries.translated: [green]Shhhhzzz!

entries.original:
"[red]That’s enough, Alakazam.

Return."
entries.translation_source: [red]That’s enough, Alakazam. Return.
entries.translated: [red]Cukup, Alakazam. Kembali.

entries.original:
"Oh\.

My whole body aches\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. My whole body aches\.
entries.translated: Oh\. Seluruh tubuhku sakit\.

entries.original:
"Mmm? [player]\.\CC0820 is that you?

What brings you all the way
out here?

Wait\.\CC0818 don’t tell me\.\CC0818 you came here
looking for even more Pokémon?

Well, that’s what I’ve been doing,
anyway.

As far as progress goes, I’ve
registered over 100 species, now.

Have you heard of Log’s sister?
She lives in [green]Blizzard City[blue].

And when she saw how my Pokédex
was coming along, she upgraded it\lwith the [green]DexNav[blue] function, so now\lfinding rare Pokémon has been\la cinch!

\.

I see\.\CC0818 you need the HM Rock Smash
up in Blizzard City\.

\.\CC0818and you’ve decided you have a bone
to pick with the Shadows, too, huh?

Well, while you’ve been running
around playing hero, I got a whole\llot stronger.

You don’t stand a chance against me
anymore, [player].

In fact, I’ll prove it, right here,
right now!"
entries.translation_source: Mmm? [player]\.\CC0820 is that you? What brings you all the way out here? Wait\.\CC0818 don’t tell me\.\CC0818 you came here looking for even more Pokémon? Well, that’s what I’ve been doing, anyway. As far as progress goes, I’ve registered over 100 species, now. Have you heard of Log’s sister? She lives in [green]Blizzard City[blue]. And when she saw how my Pokédex was coming along, she upgraded it with the [green]DexNav[blue] function, so now finding rare Pokémon has been a cinch! \. I see\.\CC0818 you need the HM Rock Smash up in Blizzard City\. \.\CC0818and you’ve decided you have a bone to pick with the Shadows, too, huh? Well, while you’ve been running around playing hero, I got a whole lot stronger. You don’t stand a chance against me anymore, [player]. In fact, I’ll prove it, right here, right now!
entries.translated:
Mmm? [player]\.\CC0820 apakah itu kamu? Apa
yang membawamu jauh-jauh ke sini?\lTunggu\.\CC0818 jangan bilang\.\CC0818 kau datang ke

sini mencari lebih banyak Pokémon?
Yah, itu yang sudah kulakukan.\lSejauh perkembangan, aku sudah

mendaftarkan lebih dari 100 spesies
sekarang. Pernah dengar tentang\lsaudara perempuan Log? Dia tinggal

di [green]Blizzard City[blue]. Dan saat dia
melihat perkembangan Pokédexku, dia\lmeningkatkannya dengan fungsi

[green]DexNav[blue], jadi sekarang menemukan
Pokémon langka jadi mudah! \. Aku\llihat\.\CC0818 kau butuh HM Penghancur Batu

di Blizzard City\. \.\CC0818 dan kau juga
memutuskan untuk menantang Shadows,\lya? Yah, sementara kau sibuk

berperan sebagai pahlawan, aku jadi
jauh lebih kuat. Kau tidak punya\lpeluang melawanku lagi, [player].

Bahkan, aku akan membuktikannya, di
sini, sekarang juga!

entries.original:
"Heh\.\CC0820 looks like I still can’t
stand up to you yet.

That’s\.\CC0818 fine.

It just means there’s still a level
of strength I can still reach.

But I’ll get there.

I’m gonna be strong.
Stronger than anyone!

Just wait until the next time we
meet, [player], because you’re\lgoing down for sure, then!

Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got
important stuff to do."
entries.translation_source: Heh\.\CC0820 looks like I still can’t stand up to you yet. That’s\.\CC0818 fine. It just means there’s still a level of strength I can still reach. But I’ll get there. I’m gonna be strong. Stronger than anyone! Just wait until the next time we meet, [player], because you’re going down for sure, then! Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got important stuff to do.
entries.translated:
Heh\.\CC0820 sepertinya aku masih belum bisa
mengalahkanmu. Itu\.\CC0818 tidak apa. Itu\lartinya masih ada tingkat kekuatan

yang bisa kucapai. Tapi aku akan
sampai di sana. Aku akan menjadi\lkuat. Lebih kuat dari siapa pun!

Tunggu saja sampai kita bertemu
lagi, [player], karena kali ini kau\lakan kalah! Sekarang, permisi, aku

ada urusan penting.

entries.original:
"Log’s words echoed in your head:
[blue]Go make sure [rival] is okay!"
entries.translation_source: Log’s words echoed in your head: [blue]Go make sure [rival] is okay!
entries.translated:
Kata-kata Log bergema di kepalamu:
[blue]Pergi pastikan [rival] baik-baik\lsaja!

entries.original:
"Zeph?

Yeah, it’s Ivory.

I’ve successfully set up a barrier
around Route 9 from Blizzard City.

\.

Roger that.

I’ll head back down right away."
entries.translation_source: Zeph? Yeah, it’s Ivory. I’ve successfully set up a barrier around Route 9 from Blizzard City. \. Roger that. I’ll head back down right away.
entries.translated:
Zeph? Ya, ini Ivory. Aku berhasil
memasang penghalang di sekitar Rute\l9 dari Blizzard City. \. Roger. Aku

akan segera turun kembali.

entries.original:
"And just in case [rival] is
following me\."
entries.translation_source: And just in case [rival] is following me\.
entries.translated:
Dan untuk jaga-jaga kalau [rival]
mengikutiku\.

entries.original:
"[player], I forgot to show
you something!

Please, come with me to
the KBT Expressway."
entries.translation_source: [player], I forgot to show you something! Please, come with me to the KBT Expressway.
entries.translated:
[player], aku lupa menunjukkan
sesuatu padamu! Silakan, ikut aku\lke KBT Expressway.

entries.original:
"For some reason, the entrance to
the KBT Expressway has frozen over.

As Gym Leader of this city, it’s
my job to take care of it.

Watch how I can use the move,
Rock Smash, to break the ice!"
entries.translation_source: For some reason, the entrance to the KBT Expressway has frozen over. As Gym Leader of this city, it’s my job to take care of it. Watch how I can use the move, Rock Smash, to break the ice!
entries.translated:
Untuk beberapa alasan, pintu masuk
ke KBT Expressway telah membeku.\lSebagai Pemimpin Gym kota ini,

tugasku untuk mengurusinya. Lihat
bagaimana aku bisa menggunakan\ljurus, Pukulan Batu, untuk

memecahkan es!

entries.original:
"Gliscor!
Use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Gliscor! Use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: Gliscor! Gunakan Pukulan Batu!

entries.original:
"Gliscor!
Return!"
entries.translation_source: Gliscor! Return!
entries.translated: Gliscor! Kembali!

entries.original:
"Just face a cracked rock with a
Pokémon that can learn Rock Smash,\land you’ll be able to break it by\lpressing \btn00.

And if you have [green]Quick HMs[red] turned
on, the rock will go instantly!

You won’t even be asked if you want
to break it first!

I hope you understand the basics of
using Rock Smash now!

I have to get back to the Gym, so
I’ll see you again another time!"
entries.translation_source: Just face a cracked rock with a Pokémon that can learn Rock Smash, and you’ll be able to break it by pressing \btn00. And if you have [green]Quick HMs[red] turned on, the rock will go instantly! You won’t even be asked if you want to break it first! I hope you understand the basics of using Rock Smash now! I have to get back to the Gym, so I’ll see you again another time!
entries.translated:
Hadapkan saja batu retak dengan
Pokémon yang bisa belajar Pukulan\lBatu, dan kamu akan bisa

memecahkannya dengan menekan \btn00. Dan
jika kamu mengaktifkan [green]Quick HMs[red],\lbatu itu akan hancur seketika! Kamu

bahkan tidak akan ditanya apakah
kamu ingin memecahkannya terlebih\ldahulu! Aku harap kamu mengerti

dasar-dasar penggunaan Pukulan Batu
sekarang! Aku harus kembali ke Gym,\ljadi sampai jumpa lagi lain waktu!

entries.original: "[blue]Staraptor! Use Aerial Ace!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Staraptor! Use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated: [blue]Staraptor! Gunakan Aerial Ace!

entries.original:
"[blue]Tell me how to get past the
barrier on Route 9!

I don’t have time to deal with
you Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Tell me how to get past the barrier on Route 9! I don’t have time to deal with you Shadows!
entries.translated:
[blue]Katakan padaku cara melewati
penghalang di Rute 9! Aku tidak\lpunya waktu untuk berurusan dengan

kalian Shadows!

entries.original:
"[red]And why should I?

If you think a simple surprise attack
on me is enough to remove it,\lyou’re sorely mistaken.

\.\CC0820Your silly attempts to play hero
are tiring."
entries.translation_source: [red]And why should I? If you think a simple surprise attack on me is enough to remove it, you’re sorely mistaken. \.\CC0820Your silly attempts to play hero are tiring.
entries.translated:
[red]Dan mengapa aku harus? Jika kamu
pikir serangan kejutan sederhana\lpadaku cukup untuk

menghilangkannya, kamu sangat
salah. \.\CC0820Usaha konyolmu untuk\lberlagak pahlawan itu melelahkan.

entries.original: "[red]Alakazam! Get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Alakazam! Get rid of him!
entries.translated: [red]Alakazam! Singkirkan dia!

entries.original:
"[blue]Gah!

My body\.\CC0820 won’t do\.\CC0820 as it’s told\.!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Gah! My body\.\CC0820 won’t do\.\CC0820 as it’s told\.!
entries.translated:
[blue]Gah! Tubuhku\.\CC0820 tidak mau menurut\.\CC0820
seperti yang diperintahkan\.!

entries.original:
"[red]Good work.
Return, Alakazam."
entries.translation_source: [red]Good work. Return, Alakazam.
entries.translated: [red]Kerja bagus. Kembali, Alakazam.

entries.original:
"[red]Now that that’s been taken care of,
I’d better get back to Route 9."
entries.translation_source: [red]Now that that’s been taken care of, I’d better get back to Route 9.
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang setelah itu ditangani,
sebaiknya aku kembali ke Rute 9.

entries.original:
"Gah! That Shadow Admin really
ticks me off!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! That Shadow Admin really ticks me off!
entries.translated:
Gah! Shadow Admin itu benar-benar
membuatku kesal!

entries.original:
"If you hadn’t saved me, Staraptor,
I’d be swimming with the fish\lright about now!

Argh\.

There has to be some way onto
Route 9\."
entries.translation_source: If you hadn’t saved me, Staraptor, I’d be swimming with the fish right about now! Argh\. There has to be some way onto Route 9\.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu tidak menyelamatkanku,
Staraptor, aku akan berenang\lbersama ikan saat ini! Argh\. Pasti

ada cara untuk masuk ke Rute 9\.

entries.original:
"Argh\.

There has to be some way onto
Route 9\."
entries.translation_source: Argh\. There has to be some way onto Route 9\.
entries.translated:
Argh\. Pasti ada cara untuk masuk ke
Rute 9\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

Uh\.\CC0818 I hope you didn’t\.\CC0818 you know\.\CC0818
see that\.

Well\.\CC0818 I was just\.\CC0818 caught
off guard\.

Ugh, never mind.

Listen, I need to ask you a favour.

I know my grampa asked you to
head to Thundercap Mt., but before\lyou do\.

Would you mind lending me
a hand first?

See, the Shadows put up some sort
of invisible barrier around the\lroute I was trying to fly to.

I need help either taking it down, or
finding another way onto [green]Route 9[blue].

Do you think you could spare
a moment to do that?"
entries.translation_source: [player]! Uh\.\CC0818 I hope you didn’t\.\CC0818 you know\.\CC0818 see that\. Well\.\CC0818 I was just\.\CC0818 caught off guard\. Ugh, never mind. Listen, I need to ask you a favour. I know my grampa asked you to head to Thundercap Mt., but before you do\. Would you mind lending me a hand first? See, the Shadows put up some sort of invisible barrier around the route I was trying to fly to. I need help either taking it down, or finding another way onto [green]Route 9[blue]. Do you think you could spare a moment to do that?
entries.translated:
[player]! Uh\.\CC0818 Aku harap kamu tidak\.\CC0818
kamu tahu\.\CC0818 melihat itu\. Nah\.\CC0818 aku baru\lsaja\.\CC0818 lengah\. Ugh, sudahlah. Dengar,

aku perlu meminta bantuanmu. Aku
tahu kakekku memintamu pergi ke\lGunung Thundercap, tapi sebelum

kamu melakukannya\. Maukah kamu
membantuku dulu? Lihat, Shadows\lmemasang semacam penghalang tak

terlihat di sekitar rute yang aku
coba terbangi. Aku butuh bantuan\luntuk menurunkannya, atau menemukan

cara lain masuk ke [green]Rute 9[blue]. Apakah
kamu bisa meluangkan waktu sebentar\luntuk melakukannya?

entries.original:
"Thanks, [player].
I really appreciate it.

I’m going to try to find some way
onto [green]Route 9[blue] from [green]Tehl Town[blue].

You should probably try
something similar."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, [player]. I really appreciate it. I’m going to try to find some way onto [green]Route 9[blue] from [green]Tehl Town[blue]. You should probably try something similar.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, [player]. Aku sangat
menghargainya. Aku akan mencoba\lmencari cara masuk ke [green]Rute 9[blue] dari

[green]Kota Tehl[blue]. Kamu sebaiknya mencoba
hal yang serupa.

entries.original:
"Oh!

You’ll need to take [green]Route 10[blue] to get
over to [green]Tehl Town[blue], so this could\lhelp you get there quickly."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You’ll need to take [green]Route 10[blue] to get over to [green]Tehl Town[blue], so this could help you get there quickly.
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu harus mengambil [green]Rute 10[blue]
untuk pergi ke [green]Kota Tehl[blue], jadi ini\lbisa membantumu sampai ke sana

dengan cepat.

entries.original: "Let’s go, Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: Let’s go, Staraptor.
entries.translated: Ayo, Staraptor.

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]\.

I tried everything, and nothing
works\.

I could really use some help\."
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player]\. I tried everything, and nothing works\. I could really use some help\.
entries.translated:
Ayolah, [player]\. Aku sudah mencoba
segalanya, dan tidak ada yang\lberhasil\. Aku benar-benar butuh

bantuan\.

entries.original: "LET ME IN!"
entries.translation_source: LET ME IN!
entries.translated: BIARKAN AKU MASUK!

entries.original:
"I swear, as soon as this
barrier is disengaged, I’m coming\lfor you grunts!"
entries.translation_source: I swear, as soon as this barrier is disengaged, I’m coming for you grunts!
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah, begitu penghalang
ini dilepaskan, aku akan datang\luntuk kalian para grunts!

entries.original:
"Good luck with that.

This barrier isn’t going down until
we’ve completed our operation.

There’s no way you’re getting in."
entries.translation_source: Good luck with that. This barrier isn’t going down until we’ve completed our operation. There’s no way you’re getting in.
entries.translated:
Semoga beruntung dengan itu.
Penghalang ini tidak akan runtuh\lsampai kami menyelesaikan operasi

kami. Tidak mungkin kau bisa masuk.

entries.original:
"ARGH!

Come on, Staraptor. There has to
be another way onto the route.

Maybe there’s a secret [green]underground
passage[blue] in town\.

Let’s go look around."
entries.translation_source: ARGH! Come on, Staraptor. There has to be another way onto the route. Maybe there’s a secret [green]underground passage[blue] in town\. Let’s go look around.
entries.translated:
ARGH! Ayo, Staraptor. Pasti ada
cara lain menuju rute itu. Mungkin\lada [green]lorong bawah tanah rahasia[blue] di

kota\. Ayo kita cari.

entries.original:
"[player]!

So you found the hidden passage
too, I see.

But it looks like we’ll have a ton
of Shadows to fight through just to\lget to my grampa’s friend.

Actually, why don’t we team up?
We could move quicker that way."
entries.translation_source: [player]! So you found the hidden passage too, I see. But it looks like we’ll have a ton of Shadows to fight through just to get to my grampa’s friend. Actually, why don’t we team up? We could move quicker that way.
entries.translated:
[player]! Jadi kau juga menemukan
lorong tersembunyi, aku lihat. Tapi\lsepertinya kita harus bertarung

melawan banyak Shadow hanya untuk
sampai ke teman kakekku.\lSebenarnya, kenapa kita tidak

bekerja sama? Kita bisa bergerak
lebih cepat dengan begitu.

entries.original:
"What?\CC0818 Are\.\CC0818 are you sure you can
make it on your own?

But I\.\CC0818 Sigh\. I understand,
[player].

If you’ve got other things to take
care of first, I’ll look for my\lgrampa’s friend on my own."
entries.translation_source: What?\CC0818 Are\.\CC0818 are you sure you can make it on your own? But I\.\CC0818 Sigh\. I understand, [player]. If you’ve got other things to take care of first, I’ll look for my grampa’s friend on my own.
entries.translated:
Apa?\CC0818 Apa\.\CC0818 apa kau yakin bisa
melakukannya sendiri? Tapi aku\.\CC0818 Huh\.\lAku mengerti, [player]. Jika kau

punya urusan lain yang harus
diselesaikan dulu, aku akan mencari\lteman kakekku sendiri.

entries.original:
"Great!

The route’s pretty big, so it looks
like a two-Trainer job.

Why don’t you take the lead?

I’ll support your Pokémon and keep
them healed.

Let’s do this thing, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Great! The route’s pretty big, so it looks like a two-Trainer job. Why don’t you take the lead? I’ll support your Pokémon and keep them healed. Let’s do this thing, [player]!
entries.translated:
Bagus! Rutenya cukup besar, jadi
sepertinya ini pekerjaan untuk dua\lPelatih. Kenapa kau tidak memimpin?

Aku akan mendukung Pokémon-mu dan
menjaga mereka tetap pulih. Ayo\llakukan ini, [player]!

entries.original:
"Let’s find my grampa’s friend,
[player]!

Before the Shadows do something
unspeakable\."
entries.translation_source: Let’s find my grampa’s friend, [player]! Before the Shadows do something unspeakable\.
entries.translated:
Ayo cari teman kakekku, [player]!
Sebelum Shadow melakukan sesuatu\lyang tak terkatakan\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
Where are you going?

We don’t have time to leave
Route 9.

Unless, you’re saying you no longer
want to team up with me?"
entries.translation_source: [player]! Where are you going? We don’t have time to leave Route 9. Unless, you’re saying you no longer want to team up with me?
entries.translated:
[player]! Mau ke mana? Kita tidak
punya waktu untuk meninggalkan\lRoute 9. Kecuali, kau bilang kau

tidak mau lagi bekerja sama
denganku?

entries.original:
"Looks like the path to the house is
on our right, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Looks like the path to the house is on our right, [player].
entries.translated:
Sepertinya jalan menuju rumah itu
ada di kanan kita, [player].

entries.original:
"Let’s hurry that way before it’s
too late!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s hurry that way before it’s too late!
entries.translated:
Ayo cepat ke sana sebelum
terlambat!

entries.original:
"[blue]It looks like we made it.
I’ll go on ahead.

Follow me inside quickly!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]It looks like we made it. I’ll go on ahead. Follow me inside quickly!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya kita berhasil. Aku akan
maju duluan. Ikuti aku ke dalam\ldengan cepat!

entries.original: "Dr. Harth"
entries.translation_source: Dr. Harth
entries.translated: Dr. Harth

entries.original:
"[blue]You think I’m gonna let you walk out
of here!?

You stole the Prison Stone\.
the very thing needed to seal\land unseal the dark force!

You couldn’t possibly want it for
anything, except evil!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]You think I’m gonna let you walk out of here!? You stole the Prison Stone\. the very thing needed to seal and unseal the dark force! You couldn’t possibly want it for anything, except evil!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kau pikir aku akan membiarkanmu
keluar dari sini!? Kau mencuri\lPrison Stone\. benda yang sangat

diperlukan untuk menyegel dan
membuka segel kekuatan gelap! Kau\lpasti menginginkannya untuk sesuatu

yang jahat!

entries.original:
"I’m afraid, as always, you are quite
mistaken, boy.

But I’ll humor you for a moment\.

What, exactly, do you think we
have planned?

Based on what you’ve seen of us?
Please, enlighten me."
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid, as always, you are quite mistaken, boy. But I’ll humor you for a moment\. What, exactly, do you think we have planned? Based on what you’ve seen of us? Please, enlighten me.
entries.translated:
Sayangnya, seperti biasa, kau
sangat keliru, Nak. Tapi aku akan\lmenuruti keinginanmu sejenak\. Apa,

sebenarnya, yang kau pikir kami
rencanakan? Berdasarkan apa yang\lkau lihat dari kami? Tolong,

jelaskan.

entries.original:
"[blue]What else?

Capturing the Legendary bird
Pokémon\.\CC0818 stealing the Prison Stone\.

You intend to plunge Borrius into war
and darkness!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]What else? Capturing the Legendary bird Pokémon\.\CC0818 stealing the Prison Stone\. You intend to plunge Borrius into war and darkness!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa lagi? Menangkap Pokémon
legendaris burung\.\CC0818 mencuri Prison\lStone\. Kau bermaksud menjerumuskan

Borrius ke dalam perang dan
kegelapan!

entries.original:
"[red]Interesting.

Then I ask you: why would we ever
do that?

Send our own region into chaos?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Interesting. Then I ask you: why would we ever do that? Send our own region into chaos?
entries.translated:
[red]Menarik. Lalu aku bertanya: mengapa
kami melakukan itu? Mengirim daerah\lkami sendiri ke dalam kekacauan?

entries.original:
"[blue]What?

Well\.\CC0820 rule the world?

The dark force is an incredible
power, and\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]What? Well\.\CC0820 rule the world? The dark force is an incredible power, and\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa? Yah\.\CC0820 menguasai dunia? Kekuatan
gelap adalah kekuatan luar biasa,\ldan\.

entries.original:
"[red]I knew it. You can only think of
simple, immature motives.

You think that the \qoforce we intend
to release\qc is only for destruction.

In fact, our intent is to save.

Save something that we unjustly lost,
and would sacrifice much to regain\."
entries.translation_source: [red]I knew it. You can only think of simple, immature motives. You think that the \qoforce we intend to release\qc is only for destruction. In fact, our intent is to save. Save something that we unjustly lost, and would sacrifice much to regain\.
entries.translated:
[red]Sudah kuduga. Kau hanya bisa
memikirkan motif sederhana dan\lkekanakan. Kau pikir bahwa

\qokekuatan yang akan kami lepaskan\qc
hanya untuk kehancuran. Sebenarnya,\lniat kami adalah menyelamatkan.

Menyelamatkan sesuatu yang kami
kehilangan secara tidak adil, dan\lakan mengorbankan banyak untuk

mendapatkannya kembali\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh? What are you talking about?

I don’t get what you’re saying
at all!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Huh? What are you talking about? I don’t get what you’re saying at all!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hah? Apa yang kau bicarakan? Aku
sama sekali tidak mengerti apa yang\lkau katakan!

entries.original:
"[red]I won’t waste any more time
explaining.

That time can be better spent making
sure you\.\CC0820 and your friend waiting\lby the door are dealt with."
entries.translation_source: [red]I won’t waste any more time explaining. That time can be better spent making sure you\.\CC0820 and your friend waiting by the door are dealt with.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku tidak akan membuang waktu lagi
untuk menjelaskan. Waktu itu bisa\ldigunakan lebih baik untuk

memastikan kau\.\CC0820 dan temanmu yang
menunggu di pintu dihadapi.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]! You’re right on time!

The Shadows have the Prison Stone,
the object needed to release the\ldark force!

You gotta help me get that thing
back!"
entries.translation_source: [blue][player]! You’re right on time! The Shadows have the Prison Stone, the object needed to release the dark force! You gotta help me get that thing back!
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Kamu tepat waktu! Shadows
memiliki Prison Stone, benda yang\ldiperlukan untuk melepaskan

kekuatan gelap! Kamu harus
membantuku mendapatkan benda itu\lkembali!

entries.original:
"I should have known they wouldn’t
go quietly.

You, grunt, assist me."
entries.translation_source: I should have known they wouldn’t go quietly. You, grunt, assist me.
entries.translated:
Aku seharusnya tahu mereka tidak
akan pergi dengan tenang. Kamu,\lprajurit, bantu aku.

entries.original:
"Scientists, prepare the backup plan
in case we’re defeated."
entries.translation_source: Scientists, prepare the backup plan in case we’re defeated.
entries.translated:
Para ilmuwan, siapkan rencana
cadangan jika kita dikalahkan.

entries.original:
"Right away.

We’ll activate the mobile creation
pods."
entries.translation_source: Right away. We’ll activate the mobile creation pods.
entries.translated:
Segera. Kami akan mengaktifkan pod
pembuatan bergerak.

entries.original:
"Please don’t take this personally,
but I’ll have to escort both of\lyou out\.\CC0818 the hard way."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t take this personally, but I’ll have to escort both of you out\.\CC0818 the hard way.
entries.translated:
Tolong jangan ambil hati, tapi aku
harus mengusir kalian berdua\.\CC0818 dengan\lcara keras.

entries.original:
"[blue]How’s that!

As long as I’ve got my Pokémon,
I’m unstoppable!

No\.\CC0818 we’re unstoppable!

Now, hand over the Prison Stone!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]How’s that! As long as I’ve got my Pokémon, I’m unstoppable! No\.\CC0818 we’re unstoppable! Now, hand over the Prison Stone!
entries.translated:
[blue]Bagaimana! Selama aku memiliki
Pokémon-ku, aku tak terkalahkan!\lTidak\.\CC0818 kita tak terkalahkan!

Sekarang, serahkan Prison Stone!

entries.original:
"Hmph\.

Funny thing to say, considering your
friend did most of the work\."
entries.translation_source: Hmph\. Funny thing to say, considering your friend did most of the work\.
entries.translated:
Hmph\. Lucu kau bilang begitu,
mengingat temanmu yang melakukan\lsebagian besar pekerjaan\.

entries.original: "[blue]W-what did you say!?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]W-what did you say!?
entries.translated: [blue]A-apa yang kau katakan!?

entries.original:
"No matter the numbers, we’re not
beaten yet\.\CC0818 assuming they’re ready.

And they should be functional by
now, I hope?"
entries.translation_source: No matter the numbers, we’re not beaten yet\.\CC0818 assuming they’re ready. And they should be functional by now, I hope?
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli jumlahnya, kita belum
dikalahkan\.\CC0818 dengan asumsi mereka\lsiap. Dan mereka seharusnya sudah

berfungsi sekarang, kuharap?

entries.original:
"Yes, ma’am.

They are not as powerful as the ones
we can synthesize in the lab\.

However, they should serve well
enough as a distraction."
entries.translation_source: Yes, ma’am. They are not as powerful as the ones we can synthesize in the lab\. However, they should serve well enough as a distraction.
entries.translated:
Ya, Nyonya. Mereka tidak sekuat
yang bisa kita sintesis di lab\.\lNamun, mereka seharusnya cukup baik

sebagai gangguan.

entries.original:
"[blue]What\.\CC0820 are those things?

Don’t tell me\.\CC0820 that’s the
old couple!?

What did you do to them!?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]What\.\CC0820 are those things? Don’t tell me\.\CC0820 that’s the old couple!? What did you do to them!?
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa\.\CC0820 benda-benda itu? Jangan bilang\.\CC0820
itu pasangan tua!? Apa yang kau\llakukan pada mereka!?

entries.original:
"They’ve been optimized, into
something more fit for our purpose.

And right now, their purpose\.\CC0818 is to
hold you off, as we retreat."
entries.translation_source: They’ve been optimized, into something more fit for our purpose. And right now, their purpose\.\CC0818 is to hold you off, as we retreat.
entries.translated:
Mereka telah dioptimalkan, menjadi
sesuatu yang lebih sesuai untuk\ltujuan kita. Dan saat ini, tujuan

mereka\.\CC0818 adalah menahan kalian,
sementara kita mundur.

entries.original:
"Dangit\.\CC0818 I don’t wanna let them
get away, but we have to help\lthose poor people!

Maybe we’re not too late!

If we can beat them quickly enough,
hopefully they’ll go back to the\lway they were!"
entries.translation_source: Dangit\.\CC0818 I don’t wanna let them get away, but we have to help those poor people! Maybe we’re not too late! If we can beat them quickly enough, hopefully they’ll go back to the way they were!
entries.translated:
Sial\.\CC0818 Aku tidak ingin membiarkan
mereka lolos, tapi kita harus\lmenolong orang-orang malang itu!

Mungkin kita belum terlambat! Jika
kita bisa mengalahkan mereka cukup\lcepat, semoga mereka kembali

seperti semula!

entries.original: "[red]Shadow Warriors, attack!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Shadow Warriors, attack!
entries.translated: [red]Shadow Warriors, serang!

entries.original:
"Ohh\.

What did I\.\CC0820 what was I doing\.?"
entries.translation_source: Ohh\. What did I\.\CC0820 what was I doing\.?
entries.translated:
Ohh\. Apa yang aku\.\CC0820 apa yang sedang
aku lakukan\.?

entries.original:
"We did it!
They’re okay!"
entries.translation_source: We did it! They’re okay!
entries.translated:
Kita berhasil! Mereka baik-baik
saja!

entries.original:
"Oh! Thank you, Jax\.\CC0820 and my thanks
to you too\.\CC0820 [player], was it?

Any longer, and our will would have
been overwritten entirely."
entries.translation_source: Oh! Thank you, Jax\.\CC0820 and my thanks to you too\.\CC0820 [player], was it? Any longer, and our will would have been overwritten entirely.
entries.translated:
Oh! Terima kasih, Jax\.\CC0820 dan terima
kasih juga untukmu\.\CC0820 [player], kan?\lLebih lama lagi, dan kehendak kami

akan ditimpa sepenuhnya.

entries.original:
"What matters is that you’re
safe now."
entries.translation_source: What matters is that you’re safe now.
entries.translated:
Yang penting adalah kamu aman
sekarang.

entries.original:
"But dangit\.\CC0820 they got away with the
Prison Stone\."
entries.translation_source: But dangit\.\CC0820 they got away with the Prison Stone\.
entries.translated:
Tapi sial\.\CC0820 mereka lolos dengan
Prison Stone\.

entries.original:
"So they managed to escape with it\.

Jax, you must give chase!

If they break the stone and use
the bottle inside, then the results\lcould be catastrophic!"
entries.translation_source: So they managed to escape with it\. Jax, you must give chase! If they break the stone and use the bottle inside, then the results could be catastrophic!
entries.translated:
Jadi mereka berhasil lolos dengan
itu\. Jax, kau harus mengejar! Jika\lmereka memecahkan batu itu dan

menggunakan botol di dalamnya, maka
hasilnya bisa menjadi bencana!

entries.original:
"I know\.\CC0818 do you know where they
could be headed, Dr. Harth?"
entries.translation_source: I know\.\CC0818 do you know where they could be headed, Dr. Harth?
entries.translated:
Aku tahu\.\CC0818 apakah kau tahu ke mana
mereka mungkin pergi, Dr. Harth?

entries.original:
"If they intend to release the seal
on the stone, they will be heading\lfor the [green]Ruins of Void[blue].

Only there can the bottle within
be obtained."
entries.translation_source: If they intend to release the seal on the stone, they will be heading for the [green]Ruins of Void[blue]. Only there can the bottle within be obtained.
entries.translated:
Jika mereka berniat melepaskan
segel pada batu, mereka akan menuju\lke [green]Ruins of Void[blue]. Hanya di sana

botol di dalamnya dapat diperoleh.

entries.original:
"The [green]Ruins of Void[blue], he said\.

[player], I’m heading back to brief
Grampa on what’s happened.

While I’m doing that, you should
head to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

As long as the Shadows don’t have
Zapdos, there’s still a chance to\lstop them!

Oh yeah\.\CC0818 since you need the HM
move [green]Strength[blue] to navigate the\lmountain path\.

You should probably head back to
[green]Fallshore City[blue], and get the Gym\lBadge there.

I think I last saw the Gym Leader,
back in [green]Tehl Town[blue], actually\.

Once you’ve done that and rescued
[green]Zapdos[blue], I’ll meet up with you in\l[green]Epidimy Town[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The [green]Ruins of Void[blue], he said\. [player], I’m heading back to brief Grampa on what’s happened. While I’m doing that, you should head to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] As long as the Shadows don’t have Zapdos, there’s still a chance to stop them! Oh yeah\.\CC0818 since you need the HM move [green]Strength[blue] to navigate the mountain path\. You should probably head back to [green]Fallshore City[blue], and get the Gym Badge there. I think I last saw the Gym Leader, back in [green]Tehl Town[blue], actually\. Once you’ve done that and rescued [green]Zapdos[blue], I’ll meet up with you in [green]Epidimy Town[blue].
entries.translated:
[green]Ruins of Void[blue], katanya\. [player],
aku akan kembali untuk memberi tahu\lGrampa tentang apa yang terjadi.

Sementara itu, kau harus pergi ke
[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] Selama Shadows tidak\lmemiliki Zapdos, masih ada

kesempatan untuk menghentikan
mereka! Oh ya\.\CC0818 karena kau butuh\lgerakan HM [green]Kekuatan[blue] untuk

menavigasi jalur gunung itu\. Kau
sebaiknya kembali ke [green]Fallshore\lCity[blue], dan dapatkan Lencana Gym di

sana. Kurasa aku terakhir melihat
Pemimpin Gym, di [green]Tehl Town[blue],\lsebenarnya\. Setelah kau melakukan

itu dan menyelamatkan [green]Zapdos[blue], aku
akan bertemu denganmu di [green]Epidimy\lTown[blue].

entries.original:
"Phew\.\CC0820 nothin’ beats gettin’ away
from the city life and comin’ back\lto Mother Nature.

I mean, how else are ya gonna get
a great natural tan like mine, huh?

Good looks are things ya gotta put
in effort to keep up, after all.

Beauty is the most important virtue,
ammirite?"
entries.translation_source: Phew\.\CC0820 nothin’ beats gettin’ away from the city life and comin’ back to Mother Nature. I mean, how else are ya gonna get a great natural tan like mine, huh? Good looks are things ya gotta put in effort to keep up, after all. Beauty is the most important virtue, ammirite?
entries.translated:
Fiuh\.\CC0820 tidak ada yang lebih baik dari
menjauh dari kehidupan kota dan\lkembali ke alam. Maksudku,

bagaimana lagi kau bisa mendapatkan
kulit kecokelatan alami seperti\lini, ya? Penampilan adalah hal yang

harus dipertahankan dengan usaha,
kan. Kecantikan adalah kebajikan\lyang paling penting, setuju?

entries.original:
"Right. Ya know what’s important
in life. I like that."
entries.translation_source: Right. Ya know what’s important in life. I like that.
entries.translated:
Benar. Kau tahu apa yang penting
dalam hidup. Aku suka itu.

entries.original:
"Partner, ya dunno what yer missin’,
then."
entries.translation_source: Partner, ya dunno what yer missin’, then.
entries.translated:
Partner, kau tidak tahu apa yang
kau lewatkan, kalau begitu.

entries.original:
"This place is perfect for my
routine.

Whenever I head back to the Gym,
the mist from the waterfalls\lcomplements my well-toned bod.

Wanna feel? All natural pecs,
right here."
entries.translation_source: This place is perfect for my routine. Whenever I head back to the Gym, the mist from the waterfalls complements my well-toned bod. Wanna feel? All natural pecs, right here.
entries.translated:
Tempat ini sempurna untuk
rutinitasku. Setiap kali aku\lkembali ke Gym, kabut dari air

terjun melengkapi tubuhku yang
terlatih. Mau merasakan? Otot dada\lalami, di sini.

entries.original:
"Oh, sorry, name’s Mel, the
[green]Fallshore City[blue] Gym Leader.

Sorry I wasn’t in when ya came
knockin’, but, well\.\CC0818 my workout\lwaits for no one.

It’s a lotta pressure, but the gals
back at the Gym don’t seem to\lmind\.

Anyway, I’m just about done for
the day, so if ya wanna battle,\lI got time for it.

See ya soon, partner."
entries.translation_source: Oh, sorry, name’s Mel, the [green]Fallshore City[blue] Gym Leader. Sorry I wasn’t in when ya came knockin’, but, well\.\CC0818 my workout waits for no one. It’s a lotta pressure, but the gals back at the Gym don’t seem to mind\. Anyway, I’m just about done for the day, so if ya wanna battle, I got time for it. See ya soon, partner.
entries.translated:
Oh, maaf, namaku Mel, Pemimpin Gym
[green]Fallshore City[blue]. Maaf aku tidak ada\lsaat kau datang mengetuk, tapi,

well\.\CC0818 latihanku tidak menunggu siapa
pun. Ini tekanan besar, tapi para\lgadis di Gym sepertinya tidak

keberatan\. Pokoknya, aku hampir
selesai untuk hari ini, jadi jika\lkau ingin bertarung, aku punya

waktu. Sampai jumpa, partner.

entries.original:
"Just wanna quick word with ya,
before ya hightail it."
entries.translation_source: Just wanna quick word with ya, before ya hightail it.
entries.translated:
Hanya ingin bicara sebentar
denganmu, sebelum kau pergi.

entries.original:
"Right ’fore ya arrived, I’d been
hearin’ some hubbub about some\lrascals stoppin’ the townsfolk\lin [green]Epidimy[blue] from explorin’ ol’\l[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

Now, I was thinkin’ ’bout layin’ down
the law on them outlaws.

’Cos not only do I look good,
I do good, too.

And I do it while lookin’ good!

Anyway, one of ’em said they were
guardin’ the mountain to keep\lya out.

Mentioned yer name an’ everythin’.

Now, I don’t rightly know what
kinda hullabaloo yer mixed up in,\lbut I’m gonna help ya fix it.

So, take this and get yer heinie to
Epidimy faster."
entries.translation_source: Right ’fore ya arrived, I’d been hearin’ some hubbub about some rascals stoppin’ the townsfolk in [green]Epidimy[blue] from explorin’ ol’ [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] Now, I was thinkin’ ’bout layin’ down the law on them outlaws. ’Cos not only do I look good, I do good, too. And I do it while lookin’ good! Anyway, one of ’em said they were guardin’ the mountain to keep ya out. Mentioned yer name an’ everythin’. Now, I don’t rightly know what kinda hullabaloo yer mixed up in, but I’m gonna help ya fix it. So, take this and get yer heinie to Epidimy faster.
entries.translated:
Tepat sebelum kau tiba, aku
mendengar keributan tentang\lbeberapa nakal yang menghalangi

penduduk di [green]Epidimy[blue] untuk
menjelajahi [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]\lSekarang, aku berpikir untuk

menegakkan hukum pada para penjahat
itu. Karena tidak hanya aku\lterlihat baik, aku juga berbuat

baik. Dan aku melakukannya sambil
terlihat baik! Pokoknya, salah satu\ldari mereka bilang mereka menjaga

gunung untuk menjauhkanmu. Menyebut
namamu dan segalanya. Sekarang, aku\ltidak tahu persis kekacauan apa

yang kau hadapi, tapi aku akan
membantumu menyelesaikannya. Jadi,\lambil ini dan cepat pergi ke

Epidimy.

entries.original:
"[blue]Just like the other HM’s, if ya
got a Pokémon that can learn it,\lit can use it.

Just choose a Pokémon that can
learn it, and as long as it ain’t\lgot four HM moves learned already,\lthat nifty doodad can take ya\lanywhere ya been before.

Anyway, don’t keep me waitin’ too
long, partner.

Ya don’t wanna miss my fine an’
dandy work!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Just like the other HM’s, if ya got a Pokémon that can learn it, it can use it. Just choose a Pokémon that can learn it, and as long as it ain’t got four HM moves learned already, that nifty doodad can take ya anywhere ya been before. Anyway, don’t keep me waitin’ too long, partner. Ya don’t wanna miss my fine an’ dandy work!
entries.translated:
[blue]Seperti HM lainnya, jika kau punya
Pokémon yang bisa mempelajarinya,\lia bisa menggunakannya. Pilih saja

Pokémon yang bisa mempelajarinya,
dan selama ia belum memiliki empat\lgerakan HM yang sudah dipelajari,

alat keren itu bisa membawamu ke
mana pun kau pernah pergi\lsebelumnya. Pokoknya, jangan buat

aku menunggu terlalu lama, partner.
Kau tidak ingin melewatkan karyaku\lyang bagus dan hebat!

entries.original:
"This is your final warning, rascal.
Move or be moved."
entries.translation_source: This is your final warning, rascal. Move or be moved.
entries.translated:
Ini peringatan terakhirmu, nakal.
Minggir atau digeser.

entries.original:
"I refuse to abandon my post.

I must prevent [player] from entering
Thundercap Mt. at all cost."
entries.translation_source: I refuse to abandon my post. I must prevent [player] from entering Thundercap Mt. at all cost.
entries.translated:
Aku menolak meninggalkan posku. Aku
harus mencegah [player] memasuki\lThundercap Mt. dengan segala cara.

entries.original: "[buffer1], hit ’em with a [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1], hit ’em with a [buffer2]!
entries.translated:
[buffer1], serang mereka dengan
[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Now, I don’t wanna hurt ya,
but I got a deep-tissue massage\llater today\.

And if I’m late ’cos yer holdin’ me
up, well, there’s gonna be trouble."
entries.translation_source: Now, I don’t wanna hurt ya, but I got a deep-tissue massage later today\. And if I’m late ’cos yer holdin’ me up, well, there’s gonna be trouble.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, aku tidak ingin
menyakitimu, tapi aku ada pijat\ljaringan dalam nanti hari ini\. Dan

jika aku terlambat karena kau
menahanku, ya, akan ada masalah.

entries.original:
"Urgh\.\CC0820 so why’d you\.\CC0820 hit me first,
then\.?"
entries.translation_source: Urgh\.\CC0820 so why’d you\.\CC0820 hit me first, then\.?
entries.translated:
Urgh\.\CC0820 jadi kenapa kau\.\CC0820 memukulku
duluan, lalu\.?

entries.original:
"Awright, I reckon ya got this from
here, partner.

As for me, I gotta run.

Whatever these rascals are up to,
they don’ want ya interferin’.

Go wild in there fer me, okay?"
entries.translation_source: Awright, I reckon ya got this from here, partner. As for me, I gotta run. Whatever these rascals are up to, they don’ want ya interferin’. Go wild in there fer me, okay?
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kurasa kau bisa mengatasi
ini dari sini, partner. Adapun aku,\laku harus lari. Apapun yang

dilakukan para nakal ini, mereka
tidak ingin kau ikut campur.\lBertindaklah sesukamu di sana

untukku, oke?

entries.original:
"Owww\.
My head\."
entries.translation_source: Owww\. My head\.
entries.translated: Owww\. Kepalaku\.

entries.original: "STOP!"
entries.translation_source: STOP!
entries.translated: BERHENTI!

entries.original:
"I can’t let you through!

\.

That look\.\CC0818 do you seriously not
remember me?

I’m the grunt you and your friend
disgraced back at our base!

I’ve gotten stronger since then,
so it’s time for a little payback!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t let you through! \. That look\.\CC0818 do you seriously not remember me? I’m the grunt you and your friend disgraced back at our base! I’ve gotten stronger since then, so it’s time for a little payback!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu lewat! \.
Tatapan itu\.\CC0818 apakah kau benar-benar\ltidak mengingatku? Aku adalah grunt

yang kau dan temanmu hina di markas
kita! Aku menjadi lebih kuat sejak\lsaat itu, jadi saatnya untuk

sedikit balas dendam!

entries.original:
"You’ve really done it now!

This was my last chance to get back
in good standing with the higher-\lups, and you ruined it!

I’ll never forget this!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve really done it now! This was my last chance to get back in good standing with the higher- ups, and you ruined it! I’ll never forget this!
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar telah melakukannya
sekarang! Ini adalah kesempatan\lterakhirku untuk mendapatkan

kembali kedudukan baik dengan para
atasan, dan kamu merusaknya! Aku\ltidak akan pernah melupakan ini!

entries.original:
"[red]Uh oh!

[player]’s hot on our tails!

I’d better go warn Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Uh oh! [player]’s hot on our tails! I’d better go warn Marlon!
entries.translated:
[red]Uh oh! [player] mengejar kita!
Sebaiknya aku pergi memperingatkan\lMarlon!

entries.original:
"I have the key to free
the Pokémon!

But you’re not getting it!"
entries.translation_source: I have the key to free the Pokémon! But you’re not getting it!
entries.translated:
Aku memiliki kunci untuk
membebaskan Pokémon! Tapi kamu\ltidak akan mendapatkannya!

entries.original:
"The other grunts are gonna be
peeved\."
entries.translation_source: The other grunts are gonna be peeved\.
entries.translated: Para grunt lainnya akan kesal\.

entries.original:
"[black]There appear to be some Pokémon
sealed behind an electric barrier."
entries.translation_source: [black]There appear to be some Pokémon sealed behind an electric barrier.
entries.translated:
[black]Tampaknya ada beberapa Pokémon yang
tersegel di balik penghalang\llistrik.

entries.original:
"[black]There appear to be some Pokémon
sealed behind an electric barrier.

Disengage the barrier to free them?"
entries.translation_source: [black]There appear to be some Pokémon sealed behind an electric barrier. Disengage the barrier to free them?
entries.translated:
[black]Tampaknya ada beberapa Pokémon yang
tersegel di balik penghalang\llistrik. Nonaktifkan penghalang

untuk membebaskan mereka?

entries.original: "[black][player] disengaged the barrier!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] disengaged the barrier!
entries.translated: [black][player] menonaktifkan penghalang!

entries.original:
"[black]The freed Pokémon appear to be
headed up the mountain."
entries.translation_source: [black]The freed Pokémon appear to be headed up the mountain.
entries.translated:
[black]Pokémon yang dibebaskan tampaknya
menuju ke atas gunung.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon you freed are
repairing the stairs!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon you freed are repairing the stairs!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang kamu bebaskan sedang
memperbaiki tangga!

entries.original:
"One with the wind, one with the
lightning\.

The all-seeing eye of the raging
thunderstorm!

Now, become the lightning that
smites all evil!

Sankren thoron!

Descend to me, Zapdos!
Shake the sky and let thunder roar!

Come forth from the stormy clouds
in which you dwell!"
entries.translation_source: One with the wind, one with the lightning\. The all-seeing eye of the raging thunderstorm! Now, become the lightning that smites all evil! Sankren thoron! Descend to me, Zapdos! Shake the sky and let thunder roar! Come forth from the stormy clouds in which you dwell!
entries.translated:
Yang satu dengan angin, yang satu
dengan kilat\. Mata yang melihat\lsegalanya dari badai petir yang

mengamuk! Sekarang, jadilah kilat
yang menghantam semua kejahatan!\lSankren thoron! Turunlah kepadaku,

Zapdos! Guncangkan langit dan
biarkan guntur mengaum! Muncullah\ldari awan badai tempatmu

bersemayam!

entries.original:
"Finally, the very last key appears in
front of us\.\CC0820 and now\."
entries.translation_source: Finally, the very last key appears in front of us\.\CC0820 and now\.
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, kunci terakhir muncul di
depan kami\.\CC0820 dan sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Wha - it knocked out that Shadow
Warrior in a single blow!?

So much for its \qoelectrical
resistance\qc\."
entries.translation_source: Wha - it knocked out that Shadow Warrior in a single blow!? So much for its \qoelectrical resistance\qc\.
entries.translated:
Wha - dia menjatuhkan Shadow
Warrior itu dalam satu pukulan!?\lJadi begitulah \qoresistensi listrik\qc

nya\.

entries.original:
"All remaining Shadow Warriors,
restrain Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: All remaining Shadow Warriors, restrain Zapdos!
entries.translated:
Semua Shadow Warrior yang tersisa,
tahan Zapdos!

entries.original: "Tch\.\CC0818 so that’s its Discharge attack\."
entries.translation_source: Tch\.\CC0818 so that’s its Discharge attack\.
entries.translated: Tch\.\CC0818 jadi itu serangan Lepasnya\.

entries.original:
"Well, Zapdos, you leave me
no choice\."
entries.translation_source: Well, Zapdos, you leave me no choice\.
entries.translated:
Yah, Zapdos, kamu tidak memberi
pilihan lain\.

entries.original:
"Heh\.
Nice try, Zapdos.

But I don’t make the same
mistake twice."
entries.translation_source: Heh\. Nice try, Zapdos. But I don’t make the same mistake twice.
entries.translated:
Heh\. Percobaan yang bagus, Zapdos.
Tapi aku tidak membuat kesalahan\lyang sama dua kali.

entries.original: "Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!"
entries.translation_source: Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!
entries.translated: Krookodile! Gunakan Batu Ujian!

entries.original: "[green]Dile!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Dile!
entries.translated: [green]Dile!

entries.original: "[lightgreen]A critical hit!"
entries.translation_source: [lightgreen]A critical hit!
entries.translated: [lightgreen]Serangan kritis!

entries.original:
"Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you\.\CC0818
to finally be ours!"
entries.translation_source: Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you\.\CC0818 to finally be ours!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, Zapdos, saatnya bagimu\.\CC0818
untuk akhirnya menjadi milik kita!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0818 that took a lot longer
than I expected\."
entries.translation_source: Sigh\.\CC0818 that took a lot longer than I expected\.
entries.translated:
Hah\.\CC0818 itu memakan waktu lebih lama
dari yang kukira\.

entries.original:
"Now, all that’s left is to rendezvous
at the [green]Ruins of Void[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Now, all that’s left is to rendezvous at the [green]Ruins of Void[blue]\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, yang tersisa hanyalah
bertemu di [green]Ruins of Void[blue]\.

entries.original:
"You again!

What were those guards doing?

I had them all stationed to prevent
you or that green-hatted boy from\linterfering!

I even destroyed the stairs behind
me\.\CC0818 and yet\.\CC0818 you’re here.

How did you manage to pull
it off\.?

It would take a monumental amount of
stubbornness to not realize it was\lsupposed to be impossible."
entries.translation_source: You again! What were those guards doing? I had them all stationed to prevent you or that green-hatted boy from interfering! I even destroyed the stairs behind me\.\CC0818 and yet\.\CC0818 you’re here. How did you manage to pull it off\.? It would take a monumental amount of stubbornness to not realize it was supposed to be impossible.
entries.translated:
Kamu lagi! Apa yang dilakukan para
penjaga itu? Aku sudah menempatkan\lmereka semua untuk mencegahmu atau

anak laki-laki bertopi hijau itu
mengganggu! Aku bahkan\lmenghancurkan tangga di belakangku\.\CC0818

dan namun\.\CC0818 kamu di sini. Bagaimana
caramu berhasil melakukannya\.? Butuh\ltingkat kekeraskepalaan yang luar

biasa untuk tidak menyadari bahwa
itu seharusnya mustahil.

entries.original:
"But\.\CC0818 no matter how it happened,
no matter that you’re here now\.

None of it changes the fact that
I have Zapdos in my possession.

With its power in my hands, there’s
no chance you’ll be able to stop\lme from leaving.

And if you think there is, then, I
will show you first-hand\.

The power of Zapdos!
The power of a Legendary Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: But\.\CC0818 no matter how it happened, no matter that you’re here now\. None of it changes the fact that I have Zapdos in my possession. With its power in my hands, there’s no chance you’ll be able to stop me from leaving. And if you think there is, then, I will show you first-hand\. The power of Zapdos! The power of a Legendary Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Tapi\.\CC0818 tidak peduli bagaimana itu
terjadi, tidak peduli bahwa kamu di\lsini sekarang\. Tidak ada yang

mengubah fakta bahwa aku memiliki
Zapdos. Dengan kekuatannya di\ltanganku, tidak ada kemungkinan

kamu bisa menghentikanku untuk
pergi. Dan jika kamu pikir ada,\lmaka, aku akan menunjukkan padamu

secara langsung\. Kekuatan Zapdos!
Kekuatan Pokémon Legendaris!

entries.original:
"I will show you first-hand\.

The power of Zapdos!
The power of a Legendary Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I will show you first-hand\. The power of Zapdos! The power of a Legendary Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menunjukkan padamu secara
langsung\. Kekuatan Zapdos! Kekuatan\lPokémon Legendaris!

entries.original:
"So\.\CC0818 it’s over for me.

Zapdos destroyed all of my Shadow
Warriors, and the Grunts I brought\lfor the mission have all been\ldefeated\.

I concede\.

I can’t stop you from taking Zapdos
from me by force.

Fine, then, I’ll release Zapdos back
into the wild.

I give you my word that I won’t
go after it again\."
entries.translation_source: So\.\CC0818 it’s over for me. Zapdos destroyed all of my Shadow Warriors, and the Grunts I brought for the mission have all been defeated\. I concede\. I can’t stop you from taking Zapdos from me by force. Fine, then, I’ll release Zapdos back into the wild. I give you my word that I won’t go after it again\.
entries.translated:
Jadi\.\CC0818 ini sudah berakhir untukku.
Zapdos menghancurkan semua Shadow\lWarriors-ku, dan para Grunts yang

kubawa untuk misi semuanya telah
dikalahkan\. Aku mengaku kalah\. Aku\ltidak bisa menghentikanmu mengambil

Zapdos dariku dengan paksa.
