Baiklah, kalau begitu, aku akan\lmelepaskan Zapdos kembali ke alam

liar. Aku memberikan kata-kataku
bahwa aku tidak akan mengejarnya\llagi\.

entries.original:
"Please tell me you have good news
for me.

Zapdos, is it\.?

\.

Really? That’s amazing news!

I thought for sure Marlon would
escape with Zapdos, even if you\ldefeated him.

And you say he just let it go?

Guess even he knew when to fold,
huh?"
entries.translation_source: Please tell me you have good news for me. Zapdos, is it\.? \. Really? That’s amazing news! I thought for sure Marlon would escape with Zapdos, even if you defeated him. And you say he just let it go? Guess even he knew when to fold, huh?
entries.translated:
Tolong katakan padaku kamu punya
kabar baik untukku. Zapdos, benar\.? \.\lBenarkah? Itu kabar yang

menakjubkan! Aku yakin Marlon akan
melarikan diri dengan Zapdos,\lbahkan jika kamu mengalahkannya.

Dan kamu bilang dia baru saja
melepaskannya? Sepertinya dia pun\ltahu kapan harus menyerah, ya?

entries.original:
"Well, if Zapdos is safe, we can take
a well-earned breather for the\ltime being.

Oh yeah\.\CC0818 you’re taking on
the Gym challenge, right?

In that case, you should probably
check out [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue].

It’s not exactly an official Gym,
but think of it like Gym 4.5!

I heard that if you can defeat
the Successor of the Mansion,\lyou’ll be able to wield an\lincredible new power!

What kind? Ha ha, that would be
spoiling the surprise!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if Zapdos is safe, we can take a well-earned breather for the time being. Oh yeah\.\CC0818 you’re taking on the Gym challenge, right? In that case, you should probably check out [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]. It’s not exactly an official Gym, but think of it like Gym 4.5! I heard that if you can defeat the Successor of the Mansion, you’ll be able to wield an incredible new power! What kind? Ha ha, that would be spoiling the surprise!
entries.translated:
Yah, jika Zapdos aman, kita bisa
beristirahat yang layak untuk\lsementara waktu. Oh ya\.\CC0818 kamu sedang

menjalani tantangan Gym, kan? Kalau
begitu, sebaiknya kamu periksa\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]. Ini bukan Gym

resmi, tapi anggap saja seperti Gym
4.5! Aku dengar jika kamu bisa\lmengalahkan Penerus Mansion, kamu

akan bisa menggunakan kekuatan baru
yang luar biasa! Jenis apa? Ha ha,\litu akan merusak kejutan!

entries.original:
"\.

\CC0600You’re really amazing, [player]\.
I mean\.\CC0818 all by yourself, you\."
entries.translation_source: \. \CC0600You’re really amazing, [player]\. I mean\.\CC0818 all by yourself, you\.
entries.translated:
\.\CC0600\. \CC0600Kamu benar-benar menakjubkan,
[player]\. Maksudku\.\CC0818 sendirian, kamu\.

entries.original:
"But, let’s not take too long of
a break.

We can’t forget the Shadows are still
out there, and they still have\lMoltres and Articuno.

Luckily, I finished talking with
Grampa, and I think I might know\lhow to get them back.

Once you’re finished with
[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue], head [green]north[blue]\ltowards [green]Route 12[blue].

I’ll meet up with you in
[green]Dehara City[blue].

We can go over the plan to
rescue them from the Shadows\lonce you arrive.

Alright, see you then!"
entries.translation_source: But, let’s not take too long of a break. We can’t forget the Shadows are still out there, and they still have Moltres and Articuno. Luckily, I finished talking with Grampa, and I think I might know how to get them back. Once you’re finished with [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue], head [green]north[blue] towards [green]Route 12[blue]. I’ll meet up with you in [green]Dehara City[blue]. We can go over the plan to rescue them from the Shadows once you arrive. Alright, see you then!
entries.translated:
Tapi, jangan terlalu lama
beristirahat. Kita tidak bisa lupa\lbahwa Shadows masih di luar sana,

dan mereka masih memiliki Moltres
dan Articuno. Untungnya, aku\lselesai berbicara dengan Grampa,

dan aku pikir aku mungkin tahu cara
mendapatkannya kembali. Setelah\lkamu selesai dengan [green]Tarmigan

Mansion[blue], pergilah ke [green]utara[blue] menuju
[green]Rute 12[blue]. Aku akan bertemu denganmu\ldi [green]Dehara City[blue]. Kita bisa membahas

rencana untuk menyelamatkan mereka
dari Shadows begitu kamu tiba.\lBaiklah, sampai jumpa!

entries.original:
"Staraptor!

Let’s go!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! Let’s go!
entries.translated: Staraptor! Ayo!

entries.original:
"Caught up to you at last!

I’d beaten Successor Maxima, but I
figured a bit more training at the\lMansion couldn’t hurt.

Let me guess, you also got the
power of Mega Evolution?

\.

What am I saying?
Of course you did.

Anyone who’s beaten me that many
times wouldn’t have been slowed\ldown by that.

Of course, I’m gonna be putting
an end to your record, right here,\lright now!

Come on then!
Lemme show you my new power!"
entries.translation_source: Caught up to you at last! I’d beaten Successor Maxima, but I figured a bit more training at the Mansion couldn’t hurt. Let me guess, you also got the power of Mega Evolution? \. What am I saying? Of course you did. Anyone who’s beaten me that many times wouldn’t have been slowed down by that. Of course, I’m gonna be putting an end to your record, right here, right now! Come on then! Lemme show you my new power!
entries.translated:
Akhirnya menyusulmu! Aku sudah
mengalahkan Successor Maxima, tapi\laku pikir sedikit latihan di

Mansion tidak akan ada salahnya.
Coba tebak, kamu juga mendapatkan\lkekuatan Mega Evolusi? \. Apa yang

aku katakan? Tentu saja kamu
mendapatkannya. Siapa pun yang\lsudah mengalahkanku berkali-kali

tidak akan terhambat oleh itu.
Tentu saja, aku akan mengakhiri\lrekormu, di sini, sekarang! Ayo!

Biarkan aku menunjukkan kekuatan
baruku!

entries.original:
"How do you keep doing it, [player]?

No matter how much I train, it’s
like you’re always two steps ahead\."
entries.translation_source: How do you keep doing it, [player]? No matter how much I train, it’s like you’re always two steps ahead\.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana caramu terus
melakukannya, [player]? Tidak\lpeduli seberapa banyak aku

berlatih, sepertinya kamu selalu
dua langkah di depan\.

entries.original:
"Huff\.\CC0820 huff\.

Good thing I was able to catch up
to you two."
entries.translation_source: Huff\.\CC0820 huff\. Good thing I was able to catch up to you two.
entries.translated:
Huff\.\CC0820 huff\. Untunglah aku bisa
menyusul kalian berdua.

entries.original:
"Old man Log?

Jeez, I’m surprised you can still run
that fast at your age."
entries.translation_source: Old man Log? Jeez, I’m surprised you can still run that fast at your age.
entries.translated:
Pak Tua Log? Astaga, aku terkejut
kau masih bisa berlari secepat itu\ldi usiamu.

entries.original:
"How rude, [rival]\.

I came all the way out here with
something for you, you know!

Well, I suppose it can’t be helped -
I was like that myself, in my\lyouth, truth be told.

Oh, those were the days, back
when Arthur and I were Trainers.

We were quite the fierce rivals\.

So fierce, our spars could last for
days without stopping!"
entries.translation_source: How rude, [rival]\. I came all the way out here with something for you, you know! Well, I suppose it can’t be helped - I was like that myself, in my youth, truth be told. Oh, those were the days, back when Arthur and I were Trainers. We were quite the fierce rivals\. So fierce, our spars could last for days without stopping!
entries.translated:
Sungguh tidak sopan, [rival]\. Aku
datang jauh-jauh ke sini dengan\lsesuatu untukmu, lho! Yah,

sepertinya tidak bisa dihindari -
aku juga seperti itu saat muda,\lsejujurnya. Oh, itu adalah

masa-masa indah, saat Arthur dan
aku menjadi Trainer. Kami adalah\lrival yang sangat sengit\. Begitu

sengit, pertarungan kami bisa
berlangsung berhari-hari tanpa\lhenti!

entries.original:
"I really don’t have time for your
trip down memory lane, old man.

Are you going to give us what you
brought along or not?"
entries.translation_source: I really don’t have time for your trip down memory lane, old man. Are you going to give us what you brought along or not?
entries.translated:
Aku benar-benar tidak punya waktu
untuk nostalgia-mu, pak tua. Apakah\lkau akan memberikan apa yang kau

bawa atau tidak?

entries.original:
"[player], this is for you.

If you’re going to keep at the
Gym Challenge, you’ll need this to\lcross the sea."
entries.translation_source: [player], this is for you. If you’re going to keep at the Gym Challenge, you’ll need this to cross the sea.
entries.translated:
[player], ini untukmu. Jika kau
akan terus mengikuti Tantangan Gym,\lkau akan membutuhkan ini untuk

menyeberangi lautan.

entries.original:
"And while your attitude certainly
needs an adjustment, [rival], you\lmay have one as well."
entries.translation_source: And while your attitude certainly needs an adjustment, [rival], you may have one as well.
entries.translated:
Dan sementara sikapmu jelas perlu
diperbaiki, [rival], kau boleh\lmemiliki satu juga.

entries.original:
"Surf, huh\.
Yeah, this’ll be useful.

I figured out the Shadows had
something to do with my parents’\ldisappearance, and I managed to\ltrack them to the Ruins of Void.

Once I get directions, I’ll Surf
there, and find out what happened\lto them once and for all!

So, thanks, I guess, Log."
entries.translation_source: Surf, huh\. Yeah, this’ll be useful. I figured out the Shadows had something to do with my parents’ disappearance, and I managed to track them to the Ruins of Void. Once I get directions, I’ll Surf there, and find out what happened to them once and for all! So, thanks, I guess, Log.
entries.translated:
Berkelana, ya\. Ya, ini akan berguna.
Aku sudah tahu bahwa Shadows ada\lhubungannya dengan hilangnya orang

tuaku, dan aku berhasil melacak
mereka ke Ruins of Void. Setelah\laku mendapat petunjuk arah, aku

akan Berkelana ke sana, dan mencari
tahu apa yang terjadi pada mereka\lsekali dan untuk selamanya! Jadi,

terima kasih, kurasa, Log.

entries.original:
"The Shadows, you say?

Ah, yes\. that reminds me what I
came here for."
entries.translation_source: The Shadows, you say? Ah, yes\. that reminds me what I came here for.
entries.translated:
Para Bayangan, katamu? Ah, ya\. itu
mengingatkanku untuk apa aku datang\lke sini.

entries.original:
"[player], Arthur has filled me in on
your recent escapades.

First, let me congratulate you on
rescuing Zapdos.

But of course, I never doubted you
for a moment, [player]!

Ho ho ho!

\.

Anyway, if you’re looking to head
in the same direction as the\lShadows\.

There’s an old colleague of mine
living in Dehara City, who is a\lfastidious researcher of the\lRuins of Void.

I’ve been told that Jax went on
ahead to look for him.

If needed, he can provide you with
the Surfing directions."
entries.translation_source: [player], Arthur has filled me in on your recent escapades. First, let me congratulate you on rescuing Zapdos. But of course, I never doubted you for a moment, [player]! Ho ho ho! \. Anyway, if you’re looking to head in the same direction as the Shadows\. There’s an old colleague of mine living in Dehara City, who is a fastidious researcher of the Ruins of Void. I’ve been told that Jax went on ahead to look for him. If needed, he can provide you with the Surfing directions.
entries.translated:
[player], Arthur sudah memberi
tahuku tentang petualanganmu\lbaru-baru ini. Pertama, izinkan aku

mengucapkan selamat atas
penyelamatan Zapdos. Tapi tentu\lsaja, aku tidak pernah meragukanmu,

[player]! Ho ho ho! \. Pokoknya, jika
kamu ingin pergi ke arah yang sama\ldengan para Bayangan\. Ada seorang

kolega lamaku yang tinggal di
Dehara City, seorang peneliti yang\lteliti tentang Ruins of Void. Aku

diberi tahu bahwa Jax sudah pergi
duluan untuk mencarinya. Jika\lperlu, dia bisa memberimu petunjuk

arah Surf.

entries.original:
"Some old guy in Dehara City knows
the way to the Ruins of Void?

Guess that takes care of where
I’ll be heading next.

Thanks, Log, for saying something
worth listening to for once."
entries.translation_source: Some old guy in Dehara City knows the way to the Ruins of Void? Guess that takes care of where I’ll be heading next. Thanks, Log, for saying something worth listening to for once.
entries.translated:
Seorang pria tua di Dehara City
tahu jalan ke Ruins of Void?\lSepertinya itu menentukan ke mana

aku akan pergi selanjutnya. Terima
kasih, Log, karena sekali saja\lmengatakan sesuatu yang layak

didengar.

entries.original:
"Catch you later, [player].

Next time, I swear I’ll close that
gap between us for sure!"
entries.translation_source: Catch you later, [player]. Next time, I swear I’ll close that gap between us for sure!
entries.translated:
Sampai jumpa lagi, [player]. Lain
kali, aku bersumpah akan menutup\ljarak di antara kita!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0820 looks like his journey
with Pokémon hasn’t mellowed him\lout at all.

\.\CC0820Well, good luck, [player].
I’ll be praying for your success."
entries.translation_source: Sigh\.\CC0820 looks like his journey with Pokémon hasn’t mellowed him out at all. \.\CC0820Well, good luck, [player]. I’ll be praying for your success.
entries.translated:
Huh\.\CC0820 sepertinya perjalanannya
bersama Pokémon tidak membuatnya\llebih tenang sama sekali. \.\CC0820Yah,

semoga beruntung, [player]. Aku
akan mendoakan kesuksesanmu.

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0820 now what am I supposed
to do\.?

I have nothing to show Zeph and
Ivory\.

The goal is no longer reachable
without Zapdos\.

Should we\.\CC0818 abandon our cause?

Truthfully, I’ve been having doubts
about the lengths we’ve gone to\.

I think it’s time I returned back
home, to my children."
entries.translation_source: Sigh\.\CC0820 now what am I supposed to do\.? I have nothing to show Zeph and Ivory\. The goal is no longer reachable without Zapdos\. Should we\.\CC0818 abandon our cause? Truthfully, I’ve been having doubts about the lengths we’ve gone to\. I think it’s time I returned back home, to my children.
entries.translated:
Huh\.\CC0820 sekarang apa yang harus aku
lakukan\.? Aku tidak punya apa-apa\luntuk ditunjukkan pada Zeph dan

Ivory\. Tujuannya tidak lagi bisa
dicapai tanpa Zapdos\. Haruskah kita\.\CC0818\lmeninggalkan tujuan kita?

Sejujurnya, aku mulai ragu dengan
sejauh mana kita telah melangkah\.\lAku pikir sudah waktunya aku pulang

ke rumah, ke anak-anakku.

entries.original:
"Incredible\.\CC0820 such a marvel of
modern technology!

To think that such a feat was even
possible\.

Oh, Marlon\.\CC0818 you had done so well,
up until that last blunder\.

But do not fret, for I can take
care of the rest from here.

In the meantime, I think you will
have all the time in the world for\lreflection\.\CC0818 and regret."
entries.translation_source: Incredible\.\CC0820 such a marvel of modern technology! To think that such a feat was even possible\. Oh, Marlon\.\CC0818 you had done so well, up until that last blunder\. But do not fret, for I can take care of the rest from here. In the meantime, I think you will have all the time in the world for reflection\.\CC0818 and regret.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa\.\CC0820 sungguh keajaiban
teknologi modern! Untuk berpikir\lbahwa hal seperti itu mungkin

terjadi\. Oh, Marlon\.\CC0818 kau melakukannya
dengan baik, sampai kesalahan\lterakhir itu\. Tapi jangan khawatir,

karena aku bisa mengurus sisanya
dari sini. Sementara itu, aku pikir\lkau akan punya banyak waktu untuk

merenung\.\CC0818 dan menyesal.

entries.original:
"What\.\CC0820 exactly is this, Hoopa?

I ask you to summon another Zapdos,
to make up for Marlon’s failure,\land you bring me this?

Pathetic!
This does not even resemble Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: What\.\CC0820 exactly is this, Hoopa? I ask you to summon another Zapdos, to make up for Marlon’s failure, and you bring me this? Pathetic! This does not even resemble Zapdos!
entries.translated:
Apa\.\CC0820 sebenarnya ini, Hoopa? Aku
memintamu memanggil Zapdos lain,\luntuk menebus kegagalan Marlon, dan

kau membawakanku ini? Menyedihkan!
Ini bahkan tidak menyerupai Zapdos!

entries.original:
"Such a useless creature\.\CC0818 it does
nothing but cower inside that\lold bag!"
entries.translation_source: Such a useless creature\.\CC0818 it does nothing but cower inside that old bag!
entries.translated:
Makhluk yang tidak berguna\.\CC0818 ia tidak
melakukan apa pun selain\lbersembunyi di dalam kantong tua

itu!

entries.original:
"Hoopa, I know it is difficult for
you, but get it right this time.

Summon forth a Zapdos.

I do not care where you must summon
it from.

Even if you have to expend every
last ounce of energy to summon one\lfrom another region\.

Just bring me a Zapdos.

UNDERSTOOD?"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, I know it is difficult for you, but get it right this time. Summon forth a Zapdos. I do not care where you must summon it from. Even if you have to expend every last ounce of energy to summon one from another region\. Just bring me a Zapdos. UNDERSTOOD?
entries.translated:
Hoopa, aku tahu itu sulit bagimu,
tapi lakukan dengan benar kali ini.\lPanggillah Zapdos. Aku tidak peduli

dari mana kau harus memanggilnya.
Bahkan jika kau harus mengeluarkan\lsemua energi terakhirmu untuk

memanggilnya dari wilayah lain\.
Bawakan aku Zapdos. DIMENGERTI?

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoo\.
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.

entries.original:
"That is more like it!
Much better, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: That is more like it! Much better, Hoopa.
entries.translated:
Itu baru lebih baik! Jauh lebih
baik, Hoopa.

entries.original: "[black]CHZKKK.\CC0815.\CC0815.\CC0815"
entries.translation_source: [black]CHZKKK.\CC0815.\CC0815.\CC0815
entries.translated: [black]CHZKKK.\CC0815.\CC0815.\CC0815

entries.original:
"Hello, have we connected?

\.\CC0820It is I, the grunt you met
with earlier.

I have just secured the final
necessary Pokémon.

I will be moving on to the Ruins of
Void, momentarily.

\.\CC0820Yes, of course.
So then, just as promised\.

I will be assuming command of
the branch?

\.\CC0820Certainly - as long as Hoopa is
relatively unharmed, you may\ldiscover whatever you like.

\.\CC0820Not to worry - the disposal of the
Shadow Warriors will be a quick and\lclean one.

There will be no trace\.

\.\CC0820Understood. We will speak later
when I report my progress."
entries.translation_source: Hello, have we connected? \.\CC0820It is I, the grunt you met with earlier. I have just secured the final necessary Pokémon. I will be moving on to the Ruins of Void, momentarily. \.\CC0820Yes, of course. So then, just as promised\. I will be assuming command of the branch? \.\CC0820Certainly - as long as Hoopa is relatively unharmed, you may discover whatever you like. \.\CC0820Not to worry - the disposal of the Shadow Warriors will be a quick and clean one. There will be no trace\. \.\CC0820Understood. We will speak later when I report my progress.
entries.translated:
Halo, apakah kita sudah terhubung?
\.\CC0820Ini aku, prajurit yang kau temui\lsebelumnya. Aku baru saja

mengamankan Pokémon terakhir yang
diperlukan. Aku akan segera menuju\lke Ruins of Void. \.\CC0820Ya, tentu saja.

Jadi, seperti yang dijanjikan\. Aku
akan mengambil alih komando cabang?\l\.\CC0820Tentu - selama Hoopa tidak terluka

parah, kau boleh menemukan apa pun
yang kau suka. \.\CC0820Jangan khawatir -\lpembuangan Shadow Warriors akan

cepat dan bersih. Tidak akan ada
jejak\. \.\CC0820{BE}imengerti. Kita akan bicara\llagi nanti saat aku melaporkan

perkembanganku.

entries.original:
"Now then\.\CC0818 we have no more time to
waste.

With Zapdos in my hands, Zeph
finally has the last piece needed\lto perform the unbinding.

Now\.\CC0818 open up a portal to the Ruins
of Void, Hoopa.

You surely still have energy left to
do that, even after summoning such\la powerful Pokémon\.

Of course, once you have regained
all your power, exhaustion will no\llonger be an issue\.

Recover your strength, and then
transport yourself over too.

You will find me by my Cube’s
signal.

And as a reminder\.\CC0820 remain
inconspicuous.

Zeph still has a loyal following
who may prove\.\CC0818 problematic.

He must not know.
It would ruin everything.

I am placing my faith in you this
one last time, Hoopa, so do not\lerr!"
entries.translation_source: Now then\.\CC0818 we have no more time to waste. With Zapdos in my hands, Zeph finally has the last piece needed to perform the unbinding. Now\.\CC0818 open up a portal to the Ruins of Void, Hoopa. You surely still have energy left to do that, even after summoning such a powerful Pokémon\. Of course, once you have regained all your power, exhaustion will no longer be an issue\. Recover your strength, and then transport yourself over too. You will find me by my Cube’s signal. And as a reminder\.\CC0820 remain inconspicuous. Zeph still has a loyal following who may prove\.\CC0818 problematic. He must not know. It would ruin everything. I am placing my faith in you this one last time, Hoopa, so do not err!
entries.translated:
Sekarang\.\CC0818 kita tidak punya waktu
lagi untuk disia-siakan. Dengan\lZapdos di tanganku, Zeph akhirnya

memiliki bagian terakhir yang
diperlukan untuk melakukan\lpelepasan. Sekarang\.\CC0818 bukalah portal

ke Ruins of Void, Hoopa. Kau pasti
masih punya energi untuk melakukan\litu, bahkan setelah memanggil

Pokémon yang begitu kuat\. Tentu
saja, begitu kau mendapatkan\lkembali semua kekuatanmu, kelelahan

tidak akan menjadi masalah lagi\.
Pulihkan kekuatanmu, lalu pindahkan\ldirimu juga. Kau akan menemukanku

melalui sinyal Cube-ku. Dan sebagai
pengingat\.\CC0820 tetap tidak mencolok.\lZeph masih memiliki pengikut setia

yang mungkin terbukti\.\CC0818 merepotkan.
Dia tidak boleh tahu. Itu akan\lmerusak segalanya. Aku menaruh

kepercayaan padamu untuk yang
terakhir kalinya, Hoopa, jadi\ljangan salah!

entries.original:
"[player]! You made it!

Sorry I didn’t see you - I was
killing time on these machines\.

This [green]Cloud Burst[blue] game’s really
addictive, and I guess I just\ltuned out.

In the process, though, I actually
earned enough Coins to buy not\lone, but two [green]Ability Capsules[blue]!

Have you heard of them?

If a Pokémon has two possible
Abilities, the Capsules change one\linto the other."
entries.translation_source: [player]! You made it! Sorry I didn’t see you - I was killing time on these machines\. This [green]Cloud Burst[blue] game’s really addictive, and I guess I just tuned out. In the process, though, I actually earned enough Coins to buy not one, but two [green]Ability Capsules[blue]! Have you heard of them? If a Pokémon has two possible Abilities, the Capsules change one into the other.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kau berhasil! Maaf aku
tidak melihatmu - aku menghabiskan\lwaktu di mesin-mesin ini\. Game [green]Cloud

Burst[blue] ini sangat adiktif, dan
sepertinya aku hanyut. Dalam\lprosesnya, aku benar-benar

mengumpulkan cukup Koin untuk
membeli bukan satu, tapi dua\l[green]Ability Capsule[blue]! Pernah dengar

tentang mereka? Jika Pokémon
memiliki dua Kemampuan yang\lmungkin, Capsule mengubah yang satu

menjadi yang lain.

entries.original:
"But, Cloud Burst can wait.

Let’s take this somewhere outside,
where it’s a bit less noisy."
entries.translation_source: But, Cloud Burst can wait. Let’s take this somewhere outside, where it’s a bit less noisy.
entries.translated:
Tapi, Cloud Burst bisa menunggu.
Ayo kita bicara di luar, yang agak\ltidak terlalu bising.

entries.original:
"Alright, I guess this’ll do.

Okay, listen up.

While I was waiting for you, I saw
a bunch of Shadow Grunts heading\lwest, towards the Ruins of Void.

According to Grampa, the only
reason for them to go there\.\CC0818 is if\lthey’ve gotten everything they\lneeded to perform the unbinding.

You know, the ritual needed to
release the dark force.

But, it shouldn’t be possible
without Zapdos\.

That’s why Grampa thinks they’re
going to try the unbinding anyway,\land hope the incomplete ritual is\lenough for their purposes.

This is our chance to head over
there too, and steal back Articuno\land Moltres!

It’s perfect.

They’ll be the only ones at the
ruins, so we won’t have to worry\labout them turning innocent people\linto those monsters!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, I guess this’ll do. Okay, listen up. While I was waiting for you, I saw a bunch of Shadow Grunts heading west, towards the Ruins of Void. According to Grampa, the only reason for them to go there\.\CC0818 is if they’ve gotten everything they needed to perform the unbinding. You know, the ritual needed to release the dark force. But, it shouldn’t be possible without Zapdos\. That’s why Grampa thinks they’re going to try the unbinding anyway, and hope the incomplete ritual is enough for their purposes. This is our chance to head over there too, and steal back Articuno and Moltres! It’s perfect. They’ll be the only ones at the ruins, so we won’t have to worry about them turning innocent people into those monsters!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kurasa ini cukup. Oke,
dengarkan. Saat aku menunggumu, aku\lmelihat sekelompok Shadow Grunts

menuju ke barat, menuju Ruins of
Void. Menurut Kakek, satu-satunya\lalasan mereka pergi ke sana\.\CC0818 adalah

jika mereka sudah mendapatkan semua
yang diperlukan untuk melakukan\lpelepasan. Kamu tahu, ritual yang

diperlukan untuk melepaskan
kekuatan gelap. Tapi, seharusnya\litu tidak mungkin tanpa Zapdos\. Itu

sebabnya Kakek berpikir mereka akan
tetap mencoba pelepasan, dan\lberharap ritual yang tidak lengkap

cukup untuk tujuan mereka. Ini
kesempatan kita untuk pergi ke sana\ljuga, dan mencuri kembali Articuno

dan Moltres! Sempurna. Mereka akan
menjadi satu-satunya di reruntuhan,\ljadi kita tidak perlu khawatir

mereka mengubah orang tak bersalah
menjadi monster-monster itu!

entries.original:
"But before we do that, first
things first, you ought to get\lDehara City’s Gym Badge.

You’ll need it in order to Surf to
the Ruins of Void with me, after\lall, since there’s no way to get\lthere on foot.

Alright - I’ll head home to prepare
my Pokémon.

In the meantime, you go get that
Badge."
entries.translation_source: But before we do that, first things first, you ought to get Dehara City’s Gym Badge. You’ll need it in order to Surf to the Ruins of Void with me, after all, since there’s no way to get there on foot. Alright - I’ll head home to prepare my Pokémon. In the meantime, you go get that Badge.
entries.translated:
Tapi sebelum kita melakukannya,
pertama-tama, kau harus mendapatkan\lGym Badge Dehara City. Kau akan

membutuhkannya untuk Surf ke Ruins
of Void bersamaku, lagipula, karena\ltidak ada jalan kaki ke sana.

Baiklah - aku akan pulang untuk
menyiapkan Pokémon-ku. Sementara\litu, kau dapatkan Badge itu.

entries.original:
"What the-?

[player], look out!"
entries.translation_source: What the-? [player], look out!
entries.translated: Apa-apaan-? [player], awas!

entries.original:
"Are you alright?
What happened?

All of a sudden a strange ring
appeared, and we got sucked here\.

I was afraid of losing you, so I
tried jumping in after you\."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright? What happened? All of a sudden a strange ring appeared, and we got sucked here\. I was afraid of losing you, so I tried jumping in after you\.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu baik-baik saja? Apa
yang terjadi? Tiba-tiba sebuah\lcincin aneh muncul, dan kita

tersedot ke sini\. Aku takut
kehilanganmu, jadi aku mencoba\lmelompat mengejarmu\.

entries.original:
"Where are we, anyway?

Wait\.\CC0820 is this\.\CC0820 the Ruins of Void?"
entries.translation_source: Where are we, anyway? Wait\.\CC0820 is this\.\CC0820 the Ruins of Void?
entries.translated:
Di mana kita sebenarnya? Tunggu\.\CC0820
apakah ini\.\CC0820 Reruntuhan Kekosongan?

entries.original:
"It has to be.

Look, those are Shadow Grunts at the
top of the stairs!"
entries.translation_source: It has to be. Look, those are Shadow Grunts at the top of the stairs!
entries.translated:
Pasti itu. Lihat, itu adalah Preman
Bayangan di atas tangga!

entries.original:
"Understood?

This is where you must make your
stand.

For the sake of the unbinding, those
two must not be allowed up here.

Demonstrate to them\.\CC0818 the power
of the Light of Ruin!"
entries.translation_source: Understood? This is where you must make your stand. For the sake of the unbinding, those two must not be allowed up here. Demonstrate to them\.\CC0818 the power of the Light of Ruin!
entries.translated:
Mengerti? Di sinilah kamu harus
bertahan. Demi pelepasan, mereka\lberdua tidak boleh diizinkan naik

ke sini. Tunjukkan kepada mereka\.\CC0818
kekuatan Cahaya Kehancuran!

entries.original:
"I can’t hear them from here,
but whatever they’re saying,\lit can’t be good!

Staraptor!

Take out those Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t hear them from here, but whatever they’re saying, it can’t be good! Staraptor! Take out those Shadows!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa mendengar mereka
dari sini, tapi apapun yang mereka\lkatakan, pasti tidak baik!

Staraptor! Hajar Bayangan-Bayangan
itu!

entries.original:
"Staraptor!

STARAPTOR!

NOOOOOO!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! STARAPTOR! NOOOOOO!
entries.translated: Staraptor! STARAPTOR! TIDAAAAAK!

entries.original:
"That blast\.\CC0820 it destroyed the
staircase!

And Staraptor was\.\CC0820 Staraptor was-!

\. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \.

Sniff\.

Guh\.\CC0820 sorry\.\CC0820 I’m finding it hard\.\CC0820 to
stay focused\."
entries.translation_source: That blast\.\CC0820 it destroyed the staircase! And Staraptor was\.\CC0820 Staraptor was-! \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. Sniff\. Guh\.\CC0820 sorry\.\CC0820 I’m finding it hard\.\CC0820 to stay focused\.
entries.translated:
Ledakan itu\.\CC0820 menghancurkan tangga!
Dan Staraptor\.\CC0820 Staraptor-! \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \.\lHiks\. Guh\.\CC0820 maaf\.\CC0820 Aku sulit\.\CC0820 untuk tetap

fokus\.

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0818 I think that blast just
uncovered an entrance into\lthe Ruins."
entries.translation_source: Wait\.\CC0818 I think that blast just uncovered an entrance into the Ruins.
entries.translated:
Tunggu\.\CC0818 Aku pikir ledakan itu baru
saja membuka pintu masuk ke\lReruntuhan.

entries.original:
"You should go in there and find a
way to the top.

I\.\CC0820 I only brought Staraptor with
me, so I can’t go with you.

I’ll\.\CC0818 stay here and heal up your
Pokémon, if you want."
entries.translation_source: You should go in there and find a way to the top. I\.\CC0820 I only brought Staraptor with me, so I can’t go with you. I’ll\.\CC0818 stay here and heal up your Pokémon, if you want.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus masuk ke sana dan
mencari jalan ke puncak. Aku\.\CC0820 Aku\lhanya membawa Staraptor bersamaku,

jadi aku tidak bisa pergi denganmu.
Aku akan\.\CC0818 tetap di sini dan\lmenyembuhkan Pokémon-mu, jika kamu

mau.

entries.original:
"And please\.\CC0818 find Staraptor for me.

That blast must’ve hurt it really
badly.

When you find it, shout down to me."
entries.translation_source: And please\.\CC0818 find Staraptor for me. That blast must’ve hurt it really badly. When you find it, shout down to me.
entries.translated:
Dan tolong\.\CC0818 temukan Staraptor
untukku. Ledakan itu pasti sangat\lmenyakitinya. Saat kamu

menemukannya, berteriaklah padaku.

entries.original: "Ethereal Voice"
entries.translation_source: Ethereal Voice
entries.translated: Suara Eteris

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO SEEK PASSAGE TO THE HEART
OF THE TEMPLE OF VOID\.

PROVE YOUR WORTH, AGAINST THE
GUARDIAN OF THIS SACRED GROUND!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]YOU WHO SEEK PASSAGE TO THE HEART OF THE TEMPLE OF VOID\. PROVE YOUR WORTH, AGAINST THE GUARDIAN OF THIS SACRED GROUND!
entries.translated:
[blue]KAMU YANG MENCARI JALAN KE JANTUNG
KUIL KEKOSONGAN\. BUKTIKAN NILAIMU,\lMELAWAN PENJAGA TANAH SUCI INI!

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF
PASSAGE\.

YOUR NEXT TRIAL AWAITS, FURTHER
WITHIN THESE HALLS\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF PASSAGE\. YOUR NEXT TRIAL AWAITS, FURTHER WITHIN THESE HALLS\.
entries.translated:
[blue]KAMU YANG SEKARANG MEMILIKI HAK
LINTAS\. UJIAN SELANJUTNYA MENANTI,\lLEBIH DALAM DI DALAM AULA INI\.

entries.original: "Uh oh."
entries.translation_source: Uh oh.
entries.translated: Uh oh.

entries.original:
"Sir, [player] is attempting to
make [buffer1] way up here by coming\lthrough the ruins!"
entries.translation_source: Sir, [player] is attempting to make [buffer1] way up here by coming through the ruins!
entries.translated:
Tuan, [player] mencoba membuat
jalan [buffer1] ke sini dengan\lmelewati reruntuhan!

entries.original:
"No matter.

By the time [player] ascends, Zeph
will be ready for the unbinding.

However, should the need arise, I
will require you to stall [player]\lfor as long as possible."
entries.translation_source: No matter. By the time [player] ascends, Zeph will be ready for the unbinding. However, should the need arise, I will require you to stall [player] for as long as possible.
entries.translated:
Tidak masalah. Pada saat [player]
naik, Zeph akan siap untuk\lpelepasan. Namun, jika diperlukan,

saya akan meminta Anda untuk
menahan [player] selama mungkin.

entries.original:
"If I did not need you, Hoopa,
I would throw your Poké Ball\lright back into the ocean for all\lof the trouble you have caused!"
entries.translation_source: If I did not need you, Hoopa, I would throw your Poké Ball right back into the ocean for all of the trouble you have caused!
entries.translated:
Jika aku tidak membutuhkanmu,
Hoopa, aku akan melempar Poké\lBall-mu kembali ke laut atas semua

masalah yang telah kamu timbulkan!

entries.original:
"I’ve got a bad feeling
about that Claydol\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got a bad feeling about that Claydol\.
entries.translated:
Aku punya firasat buruk tentang
Claydol itu\.

entries.original: "What the\.?"
entries.translation_source: What the\.?
entries.translated: Apa apaan\.?

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO SEEK TO VIOLATE THESE
SACRED GROUNDS\.

DEMONSTRATE YOUR WORTH, OR BE
SMOTE BY MY JUDGMENT!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]YOU WHO SEEK TO VIOLATE THESE SACRED GROUNDS\. DEMONSTRATE YOUR WORTH, OR BE SMOTE BY MY JUDGMENT!
entries.translated:
[blue]KAMU YANG BERUSAHA MELANGGAR TANAH
SUCI INI\. BUKTIKAN NILAIMU, ATAU\lDIHUKUM OLEH PENGHAKIMANKU!

entries.original:
"Huh? This Pokémon wants to fight?

We handle Shadow Warriors on
the daily!

One normal Pokémon’s nothing to us!
Let’s take it down!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? This Pokémon wants to fight? We handle Shadow Warriors on the daily! One normal Pokémon’s nothing to us! Let’s take it down!
entries.translated:
Hah? Pokémon ini ingin bertarung?
Kami menghadapi Shadow Warriors\lsetiap hari! Satu Pokémon normal

bukan apa-apa bagi kami! Ayo kita
kalahkan!

entries.original: "Groan\."
entries.translation_source: Groan\.
entries.translated: Mengerang\.

entries.original:
"YOU WHO LACK THE RIGHT\.

BEGONE FROM THIS PLACE, LEST YE BE
CAST INTO THE VOID!"
entries.translation_source: YOU WHO LACK THE RIGHT\. BEGONE FROM THIS PLACE, LEST YE BE CAST INTO THE VOID!
entries.translated:
KALIAN YANG TIDAK MEMILIKI HAK\.
PERGI DARI TEMPAT INI, AGAR KALIAN\lTIDAK DILEMPARKAN KE DALAM

KEKOSONGAN!

entries.original: "It’s Jax’s Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: It’s Jax’s Staraptor.
entries.translated: Itu Staraptor milik Jax.

entries.original:
"Thank goodness\.\CC0818 it looks like
Staraptor will make a full recovery."
entries.translation_source: Thank goodness\.\CC0818 it looks like Staraptor will make a full recovery.
entries.translated:
Syukurlah\.\CC0818 sepertinya Staraptor akan
pulih sepenuhnya.

entries.original:
"Thanks for finding Staraptor for
me\.

\.

I’m sorry\.\CC0820 I had to rely on you
yet again\.

Mmm? Ah, never mind me.

Anyway, great job on getting this
far up.

It looks like we’re nearly at the
top - just a little more and we’ll\lreach the Shadows.

Sorry I can’t be\.\CC0818 more useful\.

But, uh\.\CC0818 if you need healing,
I’ll be waiting right outside."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for finding Staraptor for me\. \. I’m sorry\.\CC0820 I had to rely on you yet again\. Mmm? Ah, never mind me. Anyway, great job on getting this far up. It looks like we’re nearly at the top - just a little more and we’ll reach the Shadows. Sorry I can’t be\.\CC0818 more useful\. But, uh\.\CC0818 if you need healing, I’ll be waiting right outside.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah menemukan
Staraptor untukku\. \. Maaf\.\CC0820 aku harus\lbergantung padamu lagi\. Mmm? Ah,

lupakan aku. Bagaimanapun, kerja
bagus sejauh ini. Sepertinya kita\lhampir sampai di puncak - sedikit

lagi dan kita akan mencapai
Shadows. Maaf aku tidak bisa\.\CC0818 lebih\lberguna\. Tapi, uh\.\CC0818 jika kamu perlu

penyembuhan, aku akan menunggu di
luar.

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO WOULD ENTER THE HEART OF
THE TEMPLE OF VOID\.

AGAINST THE THREE, DEMONSTRATE
YOUR STRENGTH OF BODY AND SOUL."
entries.translation_source: [blue]YOU WHO WOULD ENTER THE HEART OF THE TEMPLE OF VOID\. AGAINST THE THREE, DEMONSTRATE YOUR STRENGTH OF BODY AND SOUL.
entries.translated:
[blue]KALIAN YANG AKAN MEMASUKI JANTUNG
KUIL KEKOSONGAN\. MELAWAN TIGA,\lTUNJUKKAN KEKUATAN TUBUH DAN JIWA.

entries.original:
"You gaze into the portal\.

\.

Pokémon are attempting to cross
through from the other side!

Are you ready to face them?

Be aware, once the battles begin,
there will be no chance to recover."
entries.translation_source: You gaze into the portal\. \. Pokémon are attempting to cross through from the other side! Are you ready to face them? Be aware, once the battles begin, there will be no chance to recover.
entries.translated:
Kamu menatap portal\. \. Pokémon
berusaha menyeberang dari sisi\llain! Apakah kamu siap menghadapi

mereka? Ketahuilah, begitu
pertempuran dimulai, tidak akan ada\lkesempatan untuk pulih.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] ran back into
the portal."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] ran back into the portal.
entries.translated: [buffer1] berlari kembali ke portal.

entries.original:
"Another Pokémon is making its way
through the portal!"
entries.translation_source: Another Pokémon is making its way through the portal!
entries.translated:
Pokémon lain sedang melewati
portal!

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF
PASSAGE\.

WITH FORTIFIED BODY, AND RIGHTEOUS
SOUL, STEP FORTH!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF PASSAGE\. WITH FORTIFIED BODY, AND RIGHTEOUS SOUL, STEP FORTH!
entries.translated:
[blue]KALIAN YANG SEKARANG MEMILIKI HAK
LINTAS\. DENGAN TUBUH YANG DIPERKUAT,\lDAN JIWA YANG BENAR, MELANGKAH

MAJU!

entries.original:
"That Claydol may have knocked us
down before, but we’re still not\lgoing to let you through without\la fight!

We can’t let the unbinding be
disrupted!"
entries.translation_source: That Claydol may have knocked us down before, but we’re still not going to let you through without a fight! We can’t let the unbinding be disrupted!
entries.translated:
Claydol itu mungkin pernah
menjatuhkan kami sebelumnya, tapi\lkami tetap tidak akan membiarkanmu

lewat tanpa bertarung! Kami tidak
bisa membiarkan unbinding\lterganggu!

entries.original:
"We’re not done yet!

It’s my turn to take you down!"
entries.translation_source: We’re not done yet! It’s my turn to take you down!
entries.translated:
Kami belum selesai! Giliranku untuk
mengalahkanmu!

entries.original: "Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Wait!
entries.translated: Tunggu!

entries.original:
"[player] has more important things
to do than deal with you.

If you want to take someone on,
why don’t you try me on for size!"
entries.translation_source: [player] has more important things to do than deal with you. If you want to take someone on, why don’t you try me on for size!
entries.translated:
[player] punya hal yang lebih
penting daripada berurusan\ldenganmu. Jika kamu ingin melawan

seseorang, kenapa tidak coba aku!

entries.original:
"[player]!

I don’t know how it’s possible,
but from the way these guys have\lbeen talking, the Shadows must\lhave captured Zapdos!

I’ll take care of these goons.

In the meantime, you gotta stop the
Shadows from carrying out their\l\qounbinding\qc!

Hurry! There’s no time left!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! I don’t know how it’s possible, but from the way these guys have been talking, the Shadows must have captured Zapdos! I’ll take care of these goons. In the meantime, you gotta stop the Shadows from carrying out their \qounbinding\qc! Hurry! There’s no time left!
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku tidak tahu bagaimana
mungkin, tapi dari cara mereka\lbicara, pasti Shadows telah

menangkap Zapdos! Aku akan mengurus
para preman ini. Sementara itu,\lkamu harus menghentikan Shadows

melaksanakan \qounbinding\qc! Cepat!
Tidak ada waktu lagi!

entries.original:
"[red]Gotcha! You seriously never learn,
do you, kid?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Gotcha! You seriously never learn, do you, kid?
entries.translated:
[red]Kena kau! Kau benar-benar tidak
pernah belajar, ya, nak?

entries.original:
"Get moving.
You’re going to want to see this\."
entries.translation_source: Get moving. You’re going to want to see this\.
entries.translated:
Bergeraklah. Kamu pasti ingin
melihat ini\.

entries.original:
"[red]All preparations have been
completed, Zeph.

You can proceed with the unbinding
when ready."
entries.translation_source: [red]All preparations have been completed, Zeph. You can proceed with the unbinding when ready.
entries.translated:
[red]Semua persiapan telah selesai,
Zeph. Kamu bisa melanjutkan\lunbinding kapan saja.

entries.original:
"Thank you, Ivory.

Just\.\CC0818 one last thing, before we get
started.

Marlon\.\CC0818 where is he, exactly?"
entries.translation_source: Thank you, Ivory. Just\.\CC0818 one last thing, before we get started. Marlon\.\CC0818 where is he, exactly?
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, Ivory. Hanya\.\CC0818 satu hal
terakhir, sebelum kita mulai.\lMarlon\.\CC0818 dimana dia sebenarnya?

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry, Zeph, we still don’t know
where he is.

According to the Grunt who delivered
Zapdos to us, Marlon’s off dealing\lwith some unofficial business.

The Grunt said he wouldn’t clarify
any further, and I haven’t heard\lfrom him either."
entries.translation_source: [red]I’m sorry, Zeph, we still don’t know where he is. According to the Grunt who delivered Zapdos to us, Marlon’s off dealing with some unofficial business. The Grunt said he wouldn’t clarify any further, and I haven’t heard from him either.
entries.translated:
[red]Maaf, Zeph, kami masih belum tahu
di mana dia. Menurut Grunt yang\lmengantarkan Zapdos kepada kami,

Marlon sedang menangani urusan
tidak resmi. Grunt itu bilang dia\ltidak akan menjelaskan lebih

lanjut, dan aku juga belum
mendengar kabar darinya.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.\CC0820 he HAS been rather on edge,
lately\.

I hope he hasn’t gotten cold feet,
now of all times.

I would hate for him to miss
everything we have worked so\lhard for\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\.\CC0820 he HAS been rather on edge, lately\. I hope he hasn’t gotten cold feet, now of all times. I would hate for him to miss everything we have worked so hard for\.
entries.translated:
Hmm\.\CC0820 dia BELAKANGAN ini agak gelisah\.
Kuharap dia tidak mundur, apalagi\lsekarang. Aku benci jika dia

melewatkan semua yang telah kita
perjuangkan dengan susah payah\.

entries.original:
"But either way, with or without him,
the unbinding must proceed."
entries.translation_source: But either way, with or without him, the unbinding must proceed.
entries.translated:
Tapi bagaimanapun, dengan atau
tanpa dia, pelepasan harus\ldilanjutkan.

entries.original:
"Finally\.\CC0818 the time has come to make
our dream a reality.

Once the dark force is unbound,
I shall use its power to undo the\ltragedies of all those years ago\.

And then, at long last\.\CC0820 his smile will
finally return to me\."
entries.translation_source: Finally\.\CC0818 the time has come to make our dream a reality. Once the dark force is unbound, I shall use its power to undo the tragedies of all those years ago\. And then, at long last\.\CC0820 his smile will finally return to me\.
entries.translated:
Akhirnya\.\CC0818 saatnya telah tiba untuk
mewujudkan mimpi kita. Begitu\lkekuatan gelap dilepaskan, aku akan

menggunakan kekuatannya untuk
membatalkan tragedi-tragedi\ltahun-tahun itu\. Dan kemudian,

akhirnya\.\CC0820 senyumnya akan kembali
padaku\.

entries.original:
"The keeper of storms, Zapdos!
Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: The keeper of storms, Zapdos! Come forth!
entries.translated: Penjaga badai, Zapdos! Majulah!

entries.original:
"The sacred flame, Moltres!
Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: The sacred flame, Moltres! Come forth!
entries.translated: Api suci, Moltres! Majulah!

entries.original:
"The disciple of ice, Articuno!
Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: The disciple of ice, Articuno! Come forth!
entries.translated: Murid es, Articuno! Majulah!

entries.original:
"With these three legendary bird
Pokémon assembled here alongside\lthe Prison Stone, the seal can\lbe broken."
entries.translation_source: With these three legendary bird Pokémon assembled here alongside the Prison Stone, the seal can be broken.
entries.translated:
Dengan tiga Pokémon burung
legendaris ini berkumpul di sini\lbersama Batu Penjara, segelnya

dapat dipatahkan.

entries.original:
"One with the shadows, one with
the night\.

A dark hole traced by a ring
of fury!

With keys of ice, fire and lightning,
let the sealed force no longer\lbe caged!"
entries.translation_source: One with the shadows, one with the night\. A dark hole traced by a ring of fury! With keys of ice, fire and lightning, let the sealed force no longer be caged!
entries.translated:
Satu dengan bayangan, satu dengan
malam\. Sebuah lubang gelap yang\ldilacak oleh cincin amarah! Dengan

kunci es, api, dan petir, biarkan
kekuatan yang tersegel tidak lagi\lterkurung!

entries.original:
"At last, the bottle\.

With this, the dark force is mine
to command\."
entries.translation_source: At last, the bottle\. With this, the dark force is mine to command\.
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, botolnya\. Dengan ini,
kekuatan gelap ada di bawah\lperintahku\.

entries.original:
"What\.? Nothing is happening?

Why!? The bottle is open\.!"
entries.translation_source: What\.? Nothing is happening? Why!? The bottle is open\.!
entries.translated:
Apa\.? Tidak terjadi apa-apa?
Kenapa!? Botolnya terbuka\.!

entries.original: "Heh heh heh\."
entries.translation_source: Heh heh heh\.
entries.translated: Heh heh heh\.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 who do you think you are!?

Have you tampered with the
unbinding?

Answer me!"
entries.translation_source: You\.\CC0820 who do you think you are!? Have you tampered with the unbinding? Answer me!
entries.translated:
Kau\.\CC0820 siapa kau kira dirimu!? Apa kau
mengotak-atik pelepasan? Jawab aku!

entries.original:
"Who, me?

The name is Aklove.

I am just a lowly Grunt among the
Shadows, nothing more."
entries.translation_source: Who, me? The name is Aklove. I am just a lowly Grunt among the Shadows, nothing more.
entries.translated:
Siapa, aku? Namaku Aklove. Aku
hanya Grunt rendahan di antara\lShadows, tidak lebih.

entries.original:
"Answer my question, grunt!

What have you done!?"
entries.translation_source: Answer my question, grunt! What have you done!?
entries.translated:
Jawab pertanyaanku, grunt! Apa yang
kau lakukan!?

entries.original:
"What have I done\.?

Nothing.

The ritual itself went completely
uninterrupted.

In fact, I commend you on an
almost flawless execution.

However, there was one key
component you were missing."
entries.translation_source: What have I done\.? Nothing. The ritual itself went completely uninterrupted. In fact, I commend you on an almost flawless execution. However, there was one key component you were missing.
entries.translated:
Apa yang kulakukan\.? Tidak ada.
Ritualnya sendiri berjalan tanpa\lgangguan. Faktanya, aku memujimu

atas eksekusi yang hampir sempurna.
Namun, ada satu komponen kunci yang\lkurang.

entries.original:
"Missing\.?

And what, exactly, would that be?"
entries.translation_source: Missing\.? And what, exactly, would that be?
entries.translated: Kurang\.? Dan apa, tepatnya, itu?

entries.original:
"In order to release the dark force
from the Prison Bottle, naturally,\lthere needs to be somewhere for\lthat power to go.

To be exact, you need the Pokémon
that used to HOUSE the dark force\l- something, I notice, you are\lsorely lacking.

Of course, you would have known
that, had I not deleted that little\ldetail from your files.

Honestly, I hoped to manipulate you
by infiltrating your organization,\lbut I am almost disappointed - it\lwas laughably easy!

And now, you have played right into
my hands and released the Prison\lBottle for me!

All that is left is for you to
step aside.

I shall finish the unbinding myself!"
entries.translation_source: In order to release the dark force from the Prison Bottle, naturally, there needs to be somewhere for that power to go. To be exact, you need the Pokémon that used to HOUSE the dark force - something, I notice, you are sorely lacking. Of course, you would have known that, had I not deleted that little detail from your files. Honestly, I hoped to manipulate you by infiltrating your organization, but I am almost disappointed - it was laughably easy! And now, you have played right into my hands and released the Prison Bottle for me! All that is left is for you to step aside. I shall finish the unbinding myself!
entries.translated:
Untuk melepaskan kekuatan gelap
dari Botol Penjara, tentu saja,\lharus ada tempat untuk kekuatan itu

pergi. Tepatnya, kau membutuhkan
Pokémon yang dulu MENAMPUNG\lkekuatan gelap - sesuatu, yang

kusadari, sangat kurang kau miliki.
Tentu saja, kau akan tahu itu,\lseandainya aku tidak menghapus

detail kecil itu dari file-file-mu.
Sejujurnya, aku berharap bisa\lmemanipulasimu dengan menyusup ke

organisasimu, tapi aku hampir
kecewa - itu sangat mudah! Dan\lsekarang, kau telah jatuh ke dalam

perangkapku dan melepaskan Botol
Penjara untukku! Yang tersisa\lhanyalah kau minggir. Aku akan

menyelesaikan pelepasan sendiri!

entries.original:
"Wha-?
How dare you make a fool of me!

You will pay for this insult!"
entries.translation_source: Wha-? How dare you make a fool of me! You will pay for this insult!
entries.translated:
Apa-? Beraninya kau
mempermalukanku! Kau akan membayar\lpenghinaan ini!

entries.original:
"Houndoom!

Teach this fool a lesson!"
entries.translation_source: Houndoom! Teach this fool a lesson!
entries.translated: Houndoom! Ajari si bodoh ini!

entries.original:
"Hoopa!
Remove the threat!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Remove the threat!
entries.translated: Hoopa! Singkirkan ancaman!

entries.original:
"Impossible\.\CC0820 Houndoom was\.

That portal\.\CC0818 so it was you who
brought [player] into our base!"
entries.translation_source: Impossible\.\CC0820 Houndoom was\. That portal\.\CC0818 so it was you who brought [player] into our base!
entries.translated:
Mustahil\.\CC0820 Houndoom adalah\. Portal itu\.\CC0818
jadi kaulah yang membawa [player]\lke markas kami!

entries.original:
"Actually, that was Hoopa acting of
its own accord.

It knew we were about to begin
the process of releasing its power,\lso in a futile act of desperation,\lit summoned [player] to rescue it\lfrom me.

For you see\.\CC0818 for reasons I cannot
fathom, it is [player], not I, that\lHoopa prefers as its Trainer.

And so, naturally, I want to see
[player] eliminated.

Once [buffer2] is gone, Hoopa will have
to accept ME as its true Trainer\.

Only then will I finally be able to
use its true power, capable of\lmoving entire landmasses\."
entries.translation_source: Actually, that was Hoopa acting of its own accord. It knew we were about to begin the process of releasing its power, so in a futile act of desperation, it summoned [player] to rescue it from me. For you see\.\CC0818 for reasons I cannot fathom, it is [player], not I, that Hoopa prefers as its Trainer. And so, naturally, I want to see [player] eliminated. Once [buffer2] is gone, Hoopa will have to accept ME as its true Trainer\. Only then will I finally be able to use its true power, capable of moving entire landmasses\.
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, itu adalah tindakan
Hoopa sendiri. Ia tahu kami akan\lsegera memulai proses melepaskan

kekuatannya, jadi dalam tindakan
putus asa yang sia-sia, ia\lmemanggil [player] untuk

menyelamatkannya dariku. Lihatlah\.\CC0818
karena alasan yang tidak bisa\lkumengerti, [player]lah, bukan aku,

yang lebih disukai Hoopa sebagai
Pelatihnya. Dan tentu saja, aku\lingin melihat [player] dilenyapkan.

Begitu [buffer2] tidak ada, Hoopa
harus menerima AKU sebagai Pelatih\lsejatinya\. Hanya saat itulah aku

akhirnya bisa menggunakan kekuatan
sejatinya, yang mampu memindahkan\lseluruh daratan\.

entries.original:
"I\.\CC0820 concede\.

I cannot hope to fight a Pokémon
like that\."
entries.translation_source: I\.\CC0820 concede\. I cannot hope to fight a Pokémon like that\.
entries.translated:
Aku\.\CC0820 mengaku kalah\. Aku tidak bisa
berharap untuk melawan Pokémon\lseperti itu\.

entries.original:
"That is a wise decision.

Now, stand aside!"
entries.translation_source: That is a wise decision. Now, stand aside!
entries.translated:
Itu adalah keputusan yang bijak.
Sekarang, minggirlah!

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, Ivory\.

I couldn’t\.\CC0818 finish what we started\.

But this is not the end\.\CC0818 we will find
another way to bring them back\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, Ivory\. I couldn’t\.\CC0818 finish what we started\. But this is not the end\.\CC0818 we will find another way to bring them back\.
entries.translated:
Maafkan aku, Ivory\. Aku tidak bisa\.\CC0818
menyelesaikan apa yang kita mulai\.\lTapi ini bukan akhir\.\CC0818 kita akan

menemukan cara lain untuk membawa
mereka kembali\.

entries.original: "And now, let the main event begin."
entries.translation_source: And now, let the main event begin.
entries.translated:
Dan sekarang, mari mulai acara
utamanya.

entries.original:
"Hoopa! The time has come!

Your true power is about to be
released from the Prison Bottle!

And as your Trainer, I am fully
capable of controlling it!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! The time has come! Your true power is about to be released from the Prison Bottle! And as your Trainer, I am fully capable of controlling it!
entries.translated:
Hoopa! Saatnya telah tiba! Kekuatan
sejatimu akan segera dilepaskan\ldari Botol Penjara! Dan sebagai

Pelatihmu, aku sepenuhnya mampu
mengendalikannya!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0810 pa\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoo\.\CC0810 pa\.
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0810 pa\.

entries.original:
"At last\. I have waited so long for
this moment\.

Hoopa!

The seal on your power has finally
been broken!"
entries.translation_source: At last\. I have waited so long for this moment\. Hoopa! The seal on your power has finally been broken!
entries.translated:
Akhirnya\. Aku sudah menunggu begitu
lama untuk momen ini\. Hoopa! Segel\lpada kekuatanmu akhirnya telah

dipatahkan!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo hoo hoo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoo hoo hoo!
entries.translated: [green]Hoo hoo hoo!

entries.original:
"Aklove! Tell me!

What reason could you have for
doing any of this?

If we share a common goal, perhaps
we can work together!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove! Tell me! What reason could you have for doing any of this? If we share a common goal, perhaps we can work together!
entries.translated:
Aklove! Katakan padaku! Alasan apa
yang bisa kau miliki untuk\lmelakukan semua ini? Jika kita

memiliki tujuan yang sama, mungkin
kita bisa bekerja sama!

entries.original:
"Fool\.\CC0818 our goals are inevitably at
odds.

I am a descendant of the so-called
\qoforeign king\qc from the great war.

My goal is simply to finish what he
started - and win the war.

With Hoopa’s power now unbound, I
will bring the weapon he created,\land use it to rain fire and\ldestruction across Borrius!

Then, finally, his suffering can
be at its end\.

Now, tell me, Zeph.
What were your goals?"
entries.translation_source: Fool\.\CC0818 our goals are inevitably at odds. I am a descendant of the so-called \qoforeign king\qc from the great war. My goal is simply to finish what he started - and win the war. With Hoopa’s power now unbound, I will bring the weapon he created, and use it to rain fire and destruction across Borrius! Then, finally, his suffering can be at its end\. Now, tell me, Zeph. What were your goals?
entries.translated:
Bodoh\.\CC0818 tujuan kita pasti
bertentangan. Aku adalah keturunan\ldari yang disebut \qoraja asing\qc dari

perang besar. Tujuanku hanyalah
menyelesaikan apa yang dia mulai -\ldan memenangkan perang. Dengan

kekuatan Hoopa yang sekarang tidak
terikat, aku akan membawa senjata\lyang dia ciptakan, dan

menggunakannya untuk menghujani api
dan kehancuran di seluruh Borrius!\lLalu, akhirnya, penderitaannya bisa

berakhir\. Sekarang, katakan padaku,
Zeph. Apa tujuanmu?

entries.original:
"My goals?

There was only one\.\CC0820 one I always
kept at the forefront of my mind\.

It was\.\CC0820 to see him again\.

My little boy\."
entries.translation_source: My goals? There was only one\.\CC0820 one I always kept at the forefront of my mind\. It was\.\CC0820 to see him again\. My little boy\.
entries.translated:
Tujuanku? Hanya ada satu\.\CC0820 satu yang
selalu kujaga di garis depan\lpikiranku\. Itu adalah\.\CC0820 untuk

melihatnya lagi\. Anak kecilku\.

entries.original:
"Ah\.\CC0818 what a waste\.\CC0818 such great
power, for such a meagre wish\.

You lack ambition, Zeph!"
entries.translation_source: Ah\.\CC0818 what a waste\.\CC0818 such great power, for such a meagre wish\. You lack ambition, Zeph!
entries.translated:
Ah\.\CC0818 sungguh sia-sia\.\CC0818 kekuatan besar
seperti itu, untuk keinginan yang\lbegitu kecil\. Kau kurang ambisi,

Zeph!

entries.original:
"Enough of this!
Remove yourself from my presence.

The Shadows are finished.

It is time for Borrius to see
the light\.\CC0818 the Light of Ruin!

Ah, but first\.

I see that our guest of honour has
deigned to join us.

Grunts, bring [buffer1] to me."
entries.translation_source: Enough of this! Remove yourself from my presence. The Shadows are finished. It is time for Borrius to see the light\.\CC0818 the Light of Ruin! Ah, but first\. I see that our guest of honour has deigned to join us. Grunts, bring [buffer1] to me.
entries.translated:
Cukup! Enyahlah dari hadapanku.
Para Shadow sudah selesai. Saatnya\lBorrius melihat cahaya\.\CC0818 Cahaya

Kehancuran! Ah, tapi pertama\. Aku
lihat tamu kehormatan kita berkenan\lbergabung. Grunts, bawa [buffer1]

kepadaku.

entries.original: "My grunts\."
entries.translation_source: My grunts\.
entries.translated: Para gruntsku\.

entries.original:
"Is this truly so surprising, Zeph?

You and I both know that you are
not the ultimate authority here.

I have gone above you\.

I have spoken with Fey.

And she has agreed that as long as I
provide her with a small sample of\lHoopa’s power to study, I will be\lgranted control of her Shadow\lbranch to do with as I please."
entries.translation_source: Is this truly so surprising, Zeph? You and I both know that you are not the ultimate authority here. I have gone above you\. I have spoken with Fey. And she has agreed that as long as I provide her with a small sample of Hoopa’s power to study, I will be granted control of her Shadow branch to do with as I please.
entries.translated:
Apakah ini benar-benar mengejutkan,
Zeph? Kau dan aku sama-sama tahu\lbahwa kau bukan otoritas tertinggi

di sini. Aku telah melampauimu\. Aku
telah berbicara dengan Fey. Dan dia\lsetuju bahwa selama aku memberinya

sampel kecil kekuatan Hoopa untuk
dipelajari, aku akan diberi kendali\latas cabang Shadow miliknya untuk

kugunakan sesukaku.

entries.original:
"But this is\.

THIS IS MY ORGANIZATION!

I founded the company, and this
branch was only allowed to exist\lbecause I approved it!

I may have retired and handed over
the reins, but that does not mean\lI can simply be\.\CC0818 replaced!

She and I had a deal!"
entries.translation_source: But this is\. THIS IS MY ORGANIZATION! I founded the company, and this branch was only allowed to exist because I approved it! I may have retired and handed over the reins, but that does not mean I can simply be\.\CC0818 replaced! She and I had a deal!
entries.translated:
Tapi ini adalah\. INI ORGANISASIKU!
Aku mendirikan perusahaan, dan\lcabang ini hanya diizinkan ada

karena aku menyetujuinya! Aku
mungkin sudah pensiun dan\lmenyerahkan kendali, tapi itu tidak

berarti aku bisa begitu saja\.\CC0818
digantikan! Dia dan aku punya\lkesepakatan!

entries.original:
"A deal which, need I remind you,
you transgressed, Zeph.

And no one is irreplaceable in an
organization - not even you.

But enough of this.

Nothing you can say will change
the outcome of these events.

And now\."
entries.translation_source: A deal which, need I remind you, you transgressed, Zeph. And no one is irreplaceable in an organization - not even you. But enough of this. Nothing you can say will change the outcome of these events. And now\.
entries.translated:
Sebuah kesepakatan yang, perlu
kuingatkan, kau langgar, Zeph. Dan\ltidak ada yang tak tergantikan

dalam sebuah organisasi - bahkan
kau pun tidak. Tapi cukup. Tidak\lada yang bisa kau katakan akan

mengubah hasil dari peristiwa ini.
Dan sekarang\.

entries.original:
"[player]\.

I can finally have the satisfaction
of eliminating you once and\lfor all.

You have been a repeated nuisance
to the Shadows\.

And I cannot have you becoming
a nuisance to me as well."
entries.translation_source: [player]\. I can finally have the satisfaction of eliminating you once and for all. You have been a repeated nuisance to the Shadows\. And I cannot have you becoming a nuisance to me as well.
entries.translated:
[player]\. Akhirnya aku bisa
mendapatkan kepuasan\lmenyingkirkanmu sekali dan untuk

selamanya. Kamu telah menjadi
gangguan berulang bagi Shadows\. Dan\laku tidak bisa membiarkanmu menjadi

gangguan bagiku juga.

entries.original:
"Hoopa!

Summon a Pokémon to crush this fool!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Summon a Pokémon to crush this fool!
entries.translated:
Hoopa! Panggil Pokémon untuk
menghancurkan si bodoh ini!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] flew back into
the portal."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] flew back into the portal.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] terbang kembali ke portal.

entries.original:
"What\.?
You actually defeated it?"
entries.translation_source: What\.? You actually defeated it?
entries.translated:
Apa\.? Kamu benar-benar
mengalahkannya?

entries.original: "Summon another, Hoopa!"
entries.translation_source: Summon another, Hoopa!
entries.translated: Panggil yang lain, Hoopa!

entries.original:
"Is that truly your best, Hoopa?

Perhaps I should have simply done it
myself\."
entries.translation_source: Is that truly your best, Hoopa? Perhaps I should have simply done it myself\.
entries.translated:
Itukah yang terbaik darimu, Hoopa?
Mungkin aku seharusnya melakukannya\lsendiri\.

entries.original:
"[player]! You have been an eyesore
for too long!

However, no matter how strong you
may be, I still have my trump card."
entries.translation_source: [player]! You have been an eyesore for too long! However, no matter how strong you may be, I still have my trump card.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu sudah menjadi
pemandangan yang tidak sedap\ldipandang terlalu lama! Namun,

tidak peduli sekuat apa pun dirimu,
aku masih memiliki kartu trufku.

entries.original:
"When I was granted control of these
grunts, it came with a request.

My beneficiary seems to have taken
an interest in you, [player].

Which is why\.

\.I have been instructed to seal you
inside this very Cube!"
entries.translation_source: When I was granted control of these grunts, it came with a request. My beneficiary seems to have taken an interest in you, [player]. Which is why\. \.I have been instructed to seal you inside this very Cube!
entries.translated:
Ketika aku diberi kendali atas para
preman ini, itu datang dengan\lsebuah permintaan. Penerima

manfaatku tampaknya tertarik
padamu, [player]. Itulah sebabnya\.\l\.Aku diperintahkan untuk menyegelmu

di dalam Cube ini!

entries.original:
"No\. you can’t be serious\.

The Cube would never accept live
organic matter!

I would know\.\CC0818 I built in the security
measures, myself!"
entries.translation_source: No\. you can’t be serious\. The Cube would never accept live organic matter! I would know\.\CC0818 I built in the security measures, myself!
entries.translated:
Tidak\. kamu tidak mungkin serius\.
Cube tidak akan pernah menerima\lmateri organik hidup! Aku tahu\.\CC0818 Aku

sendiri yang memasang tindakan
pengamanannya!

entries.original:
"Heh\. you really have not kept
yourself up to speed since you\lretired, have you?

Fey has done marvelous work on this
special Cube of hers.

So watch carefully, Zeph - watch
just how far your invention has come!"
entries.translation_source: Heh\. you really have not kept yourself up to speed since you retired, have you? Fey has done marvelous work on this special Cube of hers. So watch carefully, Zeph - watch just how far your invention has come!
entries.translated:
Heh\. kamu benar-benar tidak
mengikuti perkembangan sejak\lpensiun, ya? Fey telah melakukan

pekerjaan luar biasa pada Cube
spesial miliknya ini. Jadi\lperhatikan baik-baik, Zeph - lihat

seberapa jauh penemuanmu telah
berkembang!

entries.original:
"Aklove, don’t proceed with this!

What you’re attempting\.\CC0818 could very
well end [player]’s life!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove, don’t proceed with this! What you’re attempting\.\CC0818 could very well end [player]’s life!
entries.translated:
Aklove, jangan lanjutkan ini! Apa
yang kamu coba lakukan\.\CC0818 bisa saja\lmengakhiri hidup [player]!

entries.original:
"If that truly is the case, whether
[buffer2] goes now or when the weapon is\lfired, makes no difference to me."
entries.translation_source: If that truly is the case, whether [buffer2] goes now or when the weapon is fired, makes no difference to me.
entries.translated:
Jika itu benar-benar masalahnya,
apakah [buffer2] pergi sekarang atau\lsaat senjata ditembakkan, tidak ada

bedanya bagiku.

entries.original:
"And before you think you can escape
this, [player]\.

Be aware\.\CC0820 I know where your
mother lives.

I cannot guarantee her safety should
you attack me or flee\."
entries.translation_source: And before you think you can escape this, [player]\. Be aware\.\CC0820 I know where your mother lives. I cannot guarantee her safety should you attack me or flee\.
entries.translated:
Dan sebelum kamu berpikir bisa
melarikan diri dari ini, [player]\.\lSadarilah\.\CC0820 Aku tahu di mana ibumu

tinggal. Aku tidak bisa menjamin
keselamatannya jika kamu\lmenyerangku atau melarikan diri\.

entries.original:
"Good, so you will be cooperative.

Then this is goodbye, [player].
May we never meet again."
entries.translation_source: Good, so you will be cooperative. Then this is goodbye, [player]. May we never meet again.
entries.translated:
Bagus, jadi kamu akan kooperatif.
Maka ini adalah perpisahan,\l[player]. Semoga kita tidak pernah

bertemu lagi.

entries.original:
"PAYLOAD RECEIVED.

PROCESSING.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: PAYLOAD RECEIVED. PROCESSING.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830
entries.translated: MUATAN DITERIMA. MEMPROSES.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830

entries.original:
"PROCESSING COMPLETE.

SENTIENT MATTER DETECTED.

COPYING.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: PROCESSING COMPLETE. SENTIENT MATTER DETECTED. COPYING.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830
entries.translated:
PEMROSESAN SELESAI. MATERI SADAR
TERDETEKSI. MENYALIN.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830

entries.original:
"ENTRY H005 HAS BEEN COPIED
SUCCESSFULLY.

THE DATA HAS BEEN UPLOADED TO
THE MAINFRAME."
entries.translation_source: ENTRY H005 HAS BEEN COPIED SUCCESSFULLY. THE DATA HAS BEEN UPLOADED TO THE MAINFRAME.
entries.translated:
ENTRI H005 TELAH DISALIN DENGAN
SUKSES. DATA TELAH DIUNGGAH KE\lSISTEM UTAMA.

entries.original:
"I can’t believe my eyes\.

You\.\CC0818 you’re\.\CC0818 you’re my [buffer3]\.

[player]\.

No matter how old you get, I’ll
always recognize you!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t believe my eyes\. You\.\CC0818 you’re\.\CC0818 you’re my [buffer3]\. [player]\. No matter how old you get, I’ll always recognize you!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak percaya dengan mataku\.
Kamu\.\CC0818 kamu\.\CC0818 kamu adalah [buffer3]ku\.\l[player]\. Tidak peduli seberapa tua

usiamu, aku akan selalu
mengenalimu!

entries.original: "Oh, they got to you too, huh?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, they got to you too, huh?
entries.translated: Oh, mereka juga mendapatimu, ya?

entries.original:
"Marlon, how do you know my
[buffer3]?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, how do you know my [buffer3]?
entries.translated:
Marlon, bagaimana kamu tahu
[buffer3]ku?

entries.original:
"We’ve run into each other a few
times now.

Your [buffer3] seems to have the
same sense of justice as you\.

Always running in blindly when
[buffer2]’s not wanted\."
entries.translation_source: We’ve run into each other a few times now. Your [buffer3] seems to have the same sense of justice as you\. Always running in blindly when [buffer2]’s not wanted\.
entries.translated:
Kita sudah sering bertemu sekarang.
[buffer3] Anda sepertinya memiliki\lrasa keadilan yang sama seperti

Anda\. Selalu berlari begitu saja
saat [buffer2] tidak diinginkan\.

entries.original:
"Then, I guess you turned out just
as I hoped you would, [player].

I’m so proud, I’m at a loss
for words\."
entries.translation_source: Then, I guess you turned out just as I hoped you would, [player]. I’m so proud, I’m at a loss for words\.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, kurasa kau tumbuh
seperti yang kuharapkan, [player].\lAku sangat bangga, sampai

kehilangan kata-kata\.

entries.original: "Whoa, watch out!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa, watch out!
entries.translated: Whoa, awas!

entries.original:
"You need to be mindful of your
surroundings in here, [player].

Items from many different Trainers
are constantly arriving, so you\lcan never know when one is going\lto come flying out of nowhere!"
entries.translation_source: You need to be mindful of your surroundings in here, [player]. Items from many different Trainers are constantly arriving, so you can never know when one is going to come flying out of nowhere!
entries.translated:
Kau harus waspada dengan
sekelilingmu di sini, [player].\lItem dari banyak Pelatih berbeda

terus berdatangan, jadi kau tidak
akan pernah tahu kapan salah\lsatunya akan terbang entah dari

mana!

entries.original:
"But for now, I think we’re in
the clear.

These platforms are usually safe
for us to stand on.

Not that they’re meant for us,
of course.

As I’m sure you guessed, this place
wasn’t designed for human life.

Sending people here is something
that shouldn’t even be possible\."
entries.translation_source: But for now, I think we’re in the clear. These platforms are usually safe for us to stand on. Not that they’re meant for us, of course. As I’m sure you guessed, this place wasn’t designed for human life. Sending people here is something that shouldn’t even be possible\.
entries.translated:
Tapi untuk saat ini, kupikir kita
aman. Platform ini biasanya aman\luntuk kita pijak. Bukan berarti

platform ini untuk kita, tentu
saja. Seperti yang kau duga, tempat\lini tidak dirancang untuk kehidupan

manusia. Mengirim orang ke sini
adalah sesuatu yang seharusnya\ltidak mungkin terjadi\.

entries.original:
"Oh, I forgot to ask.
How did you wind up in here, too?

And did Hoopa ever make contact
with you?

Marlon tells me it’s been 16 years
since I was trapped in here, so you\lmust have seen Hoopa by now.

\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I forgot to ask. How did you wind up in here, too? And did Hoopa ever make contact with you? Marlon tells me it’s been 16 years since I was trapped in here, so you must have seen Hoopa by now. \.
entries.translated:
Oh, aku lupa bertanya. Bagaimana
kau bisa berakhir di sini juga? Dan\lapakah Hoopa pernah menghubungimu?

Marlon bilang sudah 16 tahun sejak
aku terjebak di sini, jadi kau\lpasti sudah melihat Hoopa sekarang.

\.

entries.original:
"Oh\.\CC0818 poor Hoopa\.

I never intended for that to
happen to it\.

I was trying to protect it when I
threw it in the ocean, but it seems\lit ended up in danger anyway\.

\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\.\CC0818 poor Hoopa\. I never intended for that to happen to it\. I was trying to protect it when I threw it in the ocean, but it seems it ended up in danger anyway\. \.
entries.translated:
Oh\.\CC0818 Hoopa yang malang\. Aku tidak
pernah berniat hal itu terjadi\lpadanya\. Aku mencoba melindunginya

saat aku melemparkannya ke laut,
tapi sepertinya ia tetap dalam\lbahaya\. \.

entries.original:
"Marlon, from what I understand,
the Shadow Warrior project is\lstill ongoing\.?

16 years\.\CC0818 and you continued to
inflict such cruelty, on both\lpeople and Pokémon!?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, from what I understand, the Shadow Warrior project is still ongoing\.? 16 years\.\CC0818 and you continued to inflict such cruelty, on both people and Pokémon!?
entries.translated:
Marlon, sepengetahuanku, proyek
Shadow Warrior masih berlangsung\.?\l16 tahun\.\CC0818 dan kau terus melakukan

kekejaman seperti itu, pada manusia
dan Pokémon!?

entries.original:
"We were desperate, Aros!

And there was no denying the
improvements with each experiment.

We were getting so, so close\."
entries.translation_source: We were desperate, Aros! And there was no denying the improvements with each experiment. We were getting so, so close\.
entries.translated:
Kami putus asa, Aros! Dan tidak
bisa dipungkiri ada peningkatan di\lsetiap percobaan. Kami semakin

dekat, sangat dekat\.

entries.original:
"I know your intentions were good,
Marlon.

But even the worst of men had good
intentions at one point.

And unfortunately, the harm you
inflicted outweighs the good you\lthought you would bring about with\lyour actions!

Why can’t you see that?"
entries.translation_source: I know your intentions were good, Marlon. But even the worst of men had good intentions at one point. And unfortunately, the harm you inflicted outweighs the good you thought you would bring about with your actions! Why can’t you see that?
entries.translated:
Aku tahu niatmu baik, Marlon. Tapi
bahkan orang terburuk pun pernah\lmemiliki niat baik di suatu titik.

Dan sayangnya, kerugian yang kau
timbulkan lebih besar daripada\lkebaikan yang kau pikir akan kau

bawa dengan tindakanmu! Kenapa kau
tidak bisa melihat itu?

entries.original:
"Of course I’m aware of the harm
we caused!

Were it up to me, our research
would have been restricted to\lPokémon that wouldn’t have been\lhurt by the process.

But Fey\.\CC0818 she insisted we branch out,
use different species of Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: Of course I’m aware of the harm we caused! Were it up to me, our research would have been restricted to Pokémon that wouldn’t have been hurt by the process. But Fey\.\CC0818 she insisted we branch out, use different species of Pokémon\.
entries.translated:
Tentu aku sadar akan kerugian yang
kami timbulkan! Jika terserah\lpadaku, riset kami akan dibatasi

pada Pokémon yang tidak akan
terluka oleh prosesnya. Tapi Fey\.\CC0818\ldia bersikeras kami memperluas,

menggunakan spesies Pokémon yang
berbeda\.

entries.original:
"That witch!

She’s the reason I’m even in here
at all!

I knew, from the moment she saw
Hoopa, that she had a growing\lobsession with it.

That’s why I cast Hoopa’s Poké Ball
out to sea\.\CC0818 trying to put it\lout of her reach.

When I met with her on the bridge
that day, she asked about Hoopa.

I tried to play it cool, saying I no
longer had it\.

But when she heard that, she took a
Cube from her pocket, and\.\CC0818 well\.

\.

Wait\.\CC0818 was it because I opposed the
Shadow Warrior Project?

After I discovered its existence,
I secretly began sabotaging your\lwork night after night\.

But no, that can’t be\.\CC0818 I
shouldn’t even be alive were that\lthe case\."
entries.translation_source: That witch! She’s the reason I’m even in here at all! I knew, from the moment she saw Hoopa, that she had a growing obsession with it. That’s why I cast Hoopa’s Poké Ball out to sea\.\CC0818 trying to put it out of her reach. When I met with her on the bridge that day, she asked about Hoopa. I tried to play it cool, saying I no longer had it\. But when she heard that, she took a Cube from her pocket, and\.\CC0818 well\. \. Wait\.\CC0818 was it because I opposed the Shadow Warrior Project? After I discovered its existence, I secretly began sabotaging your work night after night\. But no, that can’t be\.\CC0818 I shouldn’t even be alive were that the case\.
entries.translated:
Penyihir itu! Dialah alasan aku ada
di sini! Aku tahu, sejak dia\lmelihat Hoopa, dia memiliki obsesi

yang terus tumbuh terhadapnya. Itu
sebabnya aku melemparkan Poké Ball\lHoopa ke laut\.\CC0818 berusaha

menjauhkannya dari jangkauannya.
Saat aku bertemu dengannya di\ljembatan hari itu, dia bertanya

tentang Hoopa. Aku mencoba bersikap
santai, bilang aku sudah tidak\lmemilikinya lagi\. Tapi saat dia

mendengar itu, dia mengeluarkan
Cube dari sakunya, dan\.\CC0818 yah\. \. Tunggu\.\CC0818\lapakah itu karena aku menentang

Proyek Shadow Warrior? Setelah aku
menemukan keberadaannya, aku\ldiam-diam mulai menyabotase

pekerjaanmu malam demi malam\. Tapi
tidak, itu tidak mungkin\.\CC0818 aku\lseharusnya tidak hidup jika itu

masalahnya\.

entries.original:
"Whatever her reasoning was, Aros,
she certainly didn’t tell us\lanything.

We weren’t even aware you were
alive at all."
entries.translation_source: Whatever her reasoning was, Aros, she certainly didn’t tell us anything. We weren’t even aware you were alive at all.
entries.translated:
Apa pun alasannya, Aros, dia pasti
tidak memberi tahu kami apa pun.\lKami bahkan tidak tahu kau masih

hidup sama sekali.

entries.original:
"If you can call this living.

We’re nothing but data right now,
so are we really alive?

How do we know we aren’t copies of
our real selves, and our physical\lbodies are gone forever\.?"
entries.translation_source: If you can call this living. We’re nothing but data right now, so are we really alive? How do we know we aren’t copies of our real selves, and our physical bodies are gone forever\.?
entries.translated:
Jika kau bisa menyebut ini hidup.
Kita tidak lebih dari data saat\lini, jadi apakah kita benar-benar

hidup? Bagaimana kita tahu kita
bukan salinan dari diri asli kita,\ldan tubuh fisik kita hilang

selamanya\.?

entries.original: "What’s going on?"
entries.translation_source: What’s going on?
entries.translated: Ada apa?

entries.original:
"Oh, that happens every so often.

It means the Cube is about to
begin the sorting process.

Soon, we’ll be whisked away to
some other Cube sector.

You’ll get used to it eventually."
entries.translation_source: Oh, that happens every so often. It means the Cube is about to begin the sorting process. Soon, we’ll be whisked away to some other Cube sector. You’ll get used to it eventually.
entries.translated:
Oh, itu terjadi sesekali. Itu
berarti Cube akan memulai proses\lpenyortiran. Sebentar lagi, kita

akan dibawa ke sektor Cube lain.
Kau akan terbiasa akhirnya.

entries.original:
"Eventually\.?
