Don’t tell me we’re trapped here!

Is there really no way out!?"
entries.translation_source: Eventually\.? Don’t tell me we’re trapped here! Is there really no way out!?
entries.translated:
Akhirnya\.? Jangan bilang kita
terjebak di sini! Apakah\lbenar-benar tidak ada jalan

keluar!?

entries.original:
"If there was, I’d have freed
myself ages ago, Marlon.

I’ve tried everything, so unless
you’ve thought of something I\lhaven’t, better get used to your\lnew digital life.

Sigh\.

It’s not all bad, though.

At least we don’t need to eat
or sleep!"
entries.translation_source: If there was, I’d have freed myself ages ago, Marlon. I’ve tried everything, so unless you’ve thought of something I haven’t, better get used to your new digital life. Sigh\. It’s not all bad, though. At least we don’t need to eat or sleep!
entries.translated:
Jika ada, aku pasti sudah
membebaskan diriku sejak lama,\lMarlon. Aku sudah mencoba

segalanya, jadi kecuali kau punya
ide yang belum aku pikirkan, lebih\lbaik terbiasa dengan kehidupan

digital barumu. Huh\. Tidak semuanya
buruk, sih. Setidaknya kita tidak\lperlu makan atau tidur!

entries.original:
"I really wish I could’ve gotten to
know you better, [player].

Maybe if we get lucky, we’ll wind
up together again someday\."
entries.translation_source: I really wish I could’ve gotten to know you better, [player]. Maybe if we get lucky, we’ll wind up together again someday\.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat berharap bisa mengenalmu
lebih baik, [player]. Mungkin jika\lkita beruntung, kita akan bertemu

lagi suatu hari nanti\.

entries.original:
"It can’t be\.
Is that\.\CC0818 a Cube V3?

\.

It is!"
entries.translation_source: It can’t be\. Is that\.\CC0818 a Cube V3? \. It is!
entries.translated:
Tidak mungkin\. Apakah itu\.\CC0818 sebuah
Cube V3? \. Iya benar!

entries.original: "Marlon, do you have one, too?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, do you have one, too?
entries.translated:
Marlon, apakah kamu juga punya
satu?

entries.original:
"I do, yes.

But what does that have to
do with\.?"
entries.translation_source: I do, yes. But what does that have to do with\.?
entries.translated:
Ya, aku punya. Tapi apa hubungannya
dengan itu\.?

entries.original:
"I think I know how to free you,
but only if I’m right about this\lplace being the third version\lcreated of Cube Space.

I’m pretty sure I am, though -
when I was first sent here,\lthe place was devoid of items.

The Cube V3 had only just been
revealed to the public, but no one\lhad access to it yet.

It didn’t take long to figure out
I’d been trapped in a more\ladvanced Cube Space.

I came up with a plan to free
myself, but my own Cube’s an\loutdated V2.

But as for you two\.\CC0818
I think this can work!"
entries.translation_source: I think I know how to free you, but only if I’m right about this place being the third version created of Cube Space. I’m pretty sure I am, though - when I was first sent here, the place was devoid of items. The Cube V3 had only just been revealed to the public, but no one had access to it yet. It didn’t take long to figure out I’d been trapped in a more advanced Cube Space. I came up with a plan to free myself, but my own Cube’s an outdated V2. But as for you two\.\CC0818 I think this can work!
entries.translated:
Aku pikir aku tahu cara
membebaskanmu, tapi hanya jika aku\lbenar tentang tempat ini yang

merupakan versi ketiga dari Cube
Space. Meski begitu, aku cukup\lyakin - saat pertama kali dikirim

ke sini, tempat itu kosong dari
benda. Cube V3 baru saja diungkap\lke publik, tapi belum ada yang bisa

mengaksesnya. Tak butuh waktu lama
untuk menyadari bahwa aku terjebak\ldi Cube Space yang lebih canggih.

Aku punya rencana untuk membebaskan
diriku, tapi Cube-ku adalah V2 yang\lusang. Tapi untuk kalian berdua\.\CC0818 aku

pikir ini bisa berhasil!

entries.original:
"What do we need to do, Aros?
Hurry, we can’t have much time left!"
entries.translation_source: What do we need to do, Aros? Hurry, we can’t have much time left!
entries.translated:
Apa yang harus kami lakukan, Aros?
Cepat, kita tidak punya banyak\lwaktu lagi!

entries.original:
"Hand me your Cubes.

I’ll make the necessary modifications
for your escape.

If I’m correct, opening your Cubes
in here will cause a chain reaction,\lone that’ll forcibly eject you from\lCube Space."
entries.translation_source: Hand me your Cubes. I’ll make the necessary modifications for your escape. If I’m correct, opening your Cubes in here will cause a chain reaction, one that’ll forcibly eject you from Cube Space.
entries.translated:
Serahkan Cube kalian padaku. Aku
akan melakukan modifikasi yang\ldiperlukan untuk pelarian kalian.

Jika aku benar, membuka Cube kalian
di sini akan menyebabkan reaksi\lberantai, yang akan memaksa kalian

keluar dari Cube Space.

entries.original:
"Are you sure about this, Aros?
Will this actually break us out?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure about this, Aros? Will this actually break us out?
entries.translated:
Apa kau yakin dengan ini, Aros?
Apakah ini benar-benar bisa\lmembebaskan kami?

entries.original:
"Either that, or your digital selves
will be destroyed forever.

No biggie.

Don’t worry - I rate your survival
odds as being higher than not."
entries.translation_source: Either that, or your digital selves will be destroyed forever. No biggie. Don’t worry - I rate your survival odds as being higher than not.
entries.translated:
Entah itu, atau diri digital kalian
akan hancur selamanya. Santai saja.\lJangan khawatir - menurutku peluang

bertahan hidup kalian lebih tinggi
daripada tidak.

entries.original: "Oh, THAT’S comforting\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, THAT’S comforting\.
entries.translated: Oh, ITU menghibur\.

entries.original:
"\.

If this works\.\CC0818 promise me something,
Marlon.

You’ll lay to rest the Pokémon that
you’ve turned into Shadow Warriors.

And you’ll end the Shadow Warrior
Project once and for all."
entries.translation_source: \. If this works\.\CC0818 promise me something, Marlon. You’ll lay to rest the Pokémon that you’ve turned into Shadow Warriors. And you’ll end the Shadow Warrior Project once and for all.
entries.translated:
\. Jika ini berhasil\.\CC0818 janjikan sesuatu
padaku, Marlon. Kau akan\lmengistirahatkan Pokémon yang telah

kau ubah menjadi Shadow Warriors.
Dan kau akan mengakhiri Shadow\lWarrior Project untuk selamanya.

entries.original:
"\.\CC0840Alright.

You have my word.

I doubt we’ll be making any more
as it is\.

The fact I’m trapped here clearly
shows the Science Society has\lterminated our partnership.

But, what about you?
Are you not coming with us?"
entries.translation_source: \.\CC0840Alright. You have my word. I doubt we’ll be making any more as it is\. The fact I’m trapped here clearly shows the Science Society has terminated our partnership. But, what about you? Are you not coming with us?
entries.translated:
\.\CC0840{BC}aiklah. Aku janji. Aku ragu kita
akan membuat lebih banyak lagi\.\lFakta bahwa aku terjebak di sini

jelas menunjukkan Science Society
telah mengakhiri kemitraan kita.\lTapi, bagaimana denganmu? Apakah

kau tidak ikut dengan kami?

entries.original:
"I can’t\.

At least not without a Cube V3 of
my own.

In order for me to escape, someone
on the outside has to let me out."
entries.translation_source: I can’t\. At least not without a Cube V3 of my own. In order for me to escape, someone on the outside has to let me out.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa\. Setidaknya tanpa
Cube V3 milikku sendiri. Agar aku\lbisa melarikan diri, seseorang di

luar harus membebaskanku.

entries.original:
"And [player]\.
I wish we had more time to talk.

If only we were meeting under
better circumstances\."
entries.translation_source: And [player]\. I wish we had more time to talk. If only we were meeting under better circumstances\.
entries.translated:
Dan [player]\. Kuharap kita punya
lebih banyak waktu untuk bicara.\lAndai saja kita bertemu dalam

keadaan yang lebih baik\.

entries.original:
"I’ll keep this brief - help Marlon
end the Shadow Warrior Project.

From what I remember, they’re highly
sensitive to light, so exposing them\lshould lay their souls to rest.

And above all else, save Hoopa.

The longer its power remains unbound,
the more it loses its sense of self.

Confine its power, and you can return
it to how it used to be."
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep this brief - help Marlon end the Shadow Warrior Project. From what I remember, they’re highly sensitive to light, so exposing them should lay their souls to rest. And above all else, save Hoopa. The longer its power remains unbound, the more it loses its sense of self. Confine its power, and you can return it to how it used to be.
entries.translated:
Aku akan singkat saja - bantu
Marlon mengakhiri Shadow Warrior\lProject. Seingatku, mereka sangat

sensitif terhadap cahaya, jadi
mengekspos mereka seharusnya bisa\lmengistirahatkan jiwa mereka. Dan

di atas segalanya, selamatkan
Hoopa. Semakin lama kekuatannya\ltidak terikat, semakin ia

kehilangan jati dirinya. Kekang
kekuatannya, dan kau bisa\lmengembalikannya seperti dulu.

entries.original:
"Alright, I’m done.

I’ve set your coordinates to
Cinder Volcano.

If you make it out, it shouldn’t
take long for you to reach the\lShadow Warriors.

And as thanks in advance, I took the
liberty of giving back what you\llost because of them, Marlon\."
entries.translation_source: Alright, I’m done. I’ve set your coordinates to Cinder Volcano. If you make it out, it shouldn’t take long for you to reach the Shadow Warriors. And as thanks in advance, I took the liberty of giving back what you lost because of them, Marlon\.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, aku selesai. Aku telah
mengatur koordinat kalian ke Cinder\lVolcano. Jika kalian berhasil

keluar, tidak akan lama sampai
kalian mencapai Shadow Warriors.\lDan sebagai ucapan terima kasih

sebelumnya, aku mengambil kebebasan
untuk mengembalikan apa yang hilang\lkarena mereka, Marlon\.

entries.original: "No\. that shouldn’t be possible\."
entries.translation_source: No\. that shouldn’t be possible\.
entries.translated: Tidak\. itu seharusnya tidak mungkin\.

entries.original:
"Never mind!

You’re running out of time!
You have to go, now!"
entries.translation_source: Never mind! You’re running out of time! You have to go, now!
entries.translated:
Sudahlah! Kalian kehabisan waktu!
Kalian harus pergi, sekarang!

entries.original:
"Aros\.\CC0818 I promise I’ll end this\.

And when I do, I swear I’ll return
for you.

I swear!"
entries.translation_source: Aros\.\CC0818 I promise I’ll end this\. And when I do, I swear I’ll return for you. I swear!
entries.translated:
Aros\.\CC0818 Aku akan mengakhiri ini\. Dan
ketika aku melakukannya, aku\lbersumpah akan kembali untukmu. Aku

bersumpah!

entries.original:
"Goodbye, Marlon, [player]\.

Don’t forget what you promised me!"
entries.translation_source: Goodbye, Marlon, [player]\. Don’t forget what you promised me!
entries.translated:
Selamat tinggal, Marlon, [player]\.
Jangan lupa apa yang kau janjikan\lpadaku!

entries.original:
"I don’t know who you are, but
you’re not getting past me, too!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t know who you are, but you’re not getting past me, too!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu siapa kau, tapi kau
tidak akan melewatiku juga!

entries.original:
"\.[player]?

But\.\CC0818 but\.\CC0818 but you’re supposed to
be out of the picture!

How is this possible?

I need to warn the others!"
entries.translation_source: \.[player]? But\.\CC0818 but\.\CC0818 but you’re supposed to be out of the picture! How is this possible? I need to warn the others!
entries.translated:
\.[player]? Tapi\.\CC0818 tapi\.\CC0818 tapi kau
seharusnya sudah tidak ada!\lBagaimana ini mungkin? Aku harus

memperingatkan yang lain!

entries.original: "[red]Ughhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Ughhhhh\.
entries.translated: [red]Ughhhhh\.

entries.original: "[red]Oh no no no no!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Oh no no no no!
entries.translated: [red]Oh tidak tidak tidak!

entries.original: "[red]Véga, sir!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Véga, sir!
entries.translated: [red]Véga, Tuan!

entries.original:
"Véga!

What’s the meaning of this?"
entries.translation_source: Véga! What’s the meaning of this?
entries.translated: Véga! Apa maksud dari semua ini?

entries.original:
"Marlon?

I was informed that you’d been
disposed of\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon? I was informed that you’d been disposed of\.
entries.translated:
Marlon? Saya diberitahu bahwa Anda
telah disingkirkan\.

entries.original:
"I don’t care what you were told!

The rest of the Shadow Warriors\.\CC0818
what have you done with them!?"
entries.translation_source: I don’t care what you were told! The rest of the Shadow Warriors\.\CC0818 what have you done with them!?
entries.translated:
Saya tidak peduli apa yang Anda
diberitahu! Prajurit Bayangan\llainnya\.\CC0818 apa yang telah Anda lakukan

terhadap mereka!?

entries.original:
"The Shadow Warriors?

Fey deemed this place unsafe for
them after the previous incident.

Most of them have already been
moved somewhere more secure."
entries.translation_source: The Shadow Warriors? Fey deemed this place unsafe for them after the previous incident. Most of them have already been moved somewhere more secure.
entries.translated:
Prajurit Bayangan? Fey menganggap
tempat ini tidak aman bagi mereka\lsetelah insiden sebelumnya.

Sebagian besar dari mereka sudah
dipindahkan ke tempat yang lebih\laman.

entries.original: "[red]Um\.\CC0818 sir\.?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Um\.\CC0818 sir\.?
entries.translated: [red]Um\.\CC0818 Tuan\.?

entries.original:
"Tell me where they are, Véga!

Or so help me, I’ll turn you into
one of them myself!"
entries.translation_source: Tell me where they are, Véga! Or so help me, I’ll turn you into one of them myself!
entries.translated:
Katakan di mana mereka, Véga! Atau
sumpah, saya akan mengubahmu\lmenjadi salah satu dari mereka

sendiri!

entries.original:
"Please. Do you really believe you
can still order me about?

I am Agent Véga of the
Science Society.

My loyalties are with Fey\.\CC0818
and you lost your authority over\lme when you broke your contract\lwith her.

Openly bringing Shadow Warriors out
into the public?

Trying to release a dark force known
for its destructive nature, without\lfirst trying to understand it?

The Rangers are already determined
to find something to catch us on,\lso we should consider ourselves\lfortunate that no one else\ldiscovered that we were creating\lliving weapons.

You must have had some idea of the
potential consequences, were Fey\lto ever find out, yes?

Especially now, when she is close to
achieving perfection\."
entries.translation_source: Please. Do you really believe you can still order me about? I am Agent Véga of the Science Society. My loyalties are with Fey\.\CC0818 and you lost your authority over me when you broke your contract with her. Openly bringing Shadow Warriors out into the public? Trying to release a dark force known for its destructive nature, without first trying to understand it? The Rangers are already determined to find something to catch us on, so we should consider ourselves fortunate that no one else discovered that we were creating living weapons. You must have had some idea of the potential consequences, were Fey to ever find out, yes? Especially now, when she is close to achieving perfection\.
entries.translated:
Tolong. Apa kau benar-benar percaya
kau masih bisa memerintahku? Aku\lAgen Véga dari Masyarakat Ilmu

Pengetahuan. Kesetiaanku bersama
Fey\.\CC0818 dan kau kehilangan otoritasmu\latasku saat kau melanggar kontrakmu

dengannya. Membawa Prajurit
Bayangan secara terbuka ke hadapan\lpublik? Mencoba melepaskan kekuatan

gelap yang dikenal karena sifat
destruktifnya, tanpa terlebih\ldahulu berusaha memahaminya? Para

Ranger sudah bertekad untuk
menemukan sesuatu untuk menangkap\lkita, jadi kita harus menganggap

diri kita beruntung bahwa tidak ada
orang lain yang menemukan bahwa\lkita menciptakan senjata hidup. Kau

pasti sudah punya gambaran tentang
kemungkinan konsekuensinya, jika\lFey sampai mengetahuinya, ya?

Terutama sekarang, ketika dia sudah
dekat untuk mencapai kesempurnaan\.

entries.original: "[red]Sir\.\CC0818 um\.\CC0818 excuse me, sir\.?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Sir\.\CC0818 um\.\CC0818 excuse me, sir\.?
entries.translated: [red]Tuan\.\CC0818 um\.\CC0818 permisi, Tuan\.?

entries.original:
"We knew\.\CC0818 we knew she would
never approve.

But even then, we still had to try.

All we had to show was failure
after failure\.

Tell me, what would you have done,
Véga?"
entries.translation_source: We knew\.\CC0818 we knew she would never approve. But even then, we still had to try. All we had to show was failure after failure\. Tell me, what would you have done, Véga?
entries.translated:
Kami tahu\.\CC0818 kami tahu dia tidak akan
pernah menyetujuinya. Tapi meskipun\lbegitu, kami tetap harus mencoba.

Yang kami tunjukkan hanyalah
kegagalan demi kegagalan\. Katakan\lpadaku, apa yang akan kau lakukan,

Véga?

entries.original:
"I would have continued waiting
patiently.

The last experiment alone should
have made it clear that practical\lapplication was well within reach.

Fey certainly has not given up\.

But then, that is how YOU should
have acted, according to YOUR\lwishes\."
entries.translation_source: I would have continued waiting patiently. The last experiment alone should have made it clear that practical application was well within reach. Fey certainly has not given up\. But then, that is how YOU should have acted, according to YOUR wishes\.
entries.translated:
Saya akan terus menunggu dengan
sabar. Eksperimen terakhir saja\lseharusnya sudah memperjelas bahwa

aplikasi praktis sudah dalam
jangkauan. Fey tentu saja tidak\lmenyerah\. Tapi, begitulah seharusnya

KAMU bertindak, sesuai dengan
keinginanMU\.

entries.original:
"What are you implying?

What do you know about what Fey
truly wants?"
entries.translation_source: What are you implying? What do you know about what Fey truly wants?
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau maksud? Apa yang kau
ketahui tentang apa yang sebenarnya\ldiinginkan Fey?

entries.original:
"Who knows\.

She won’t even tell me, and I’m her
right-hand man.

She’s always been the type to keep
her cards close to her chest\."
entries.translation_source: Who knows\. She won’t even tell me, and I’m her right-hand man. She’s always been the type to keep her cards close to her chest\.
entries.translated:
Siapa yang tahu\. Dia bahkan tidak
akan memberitahuku, dan aku adalah\ltangan kanannya. Dia selalu tipe

orang yang menyimpan kartu rapat di
dadanya\.

entries.original:
"Just to clear up any
misunderstandings\.

\.The Shadow Warriors, what do you
plan to do with them now?"
entries.translation_source: Just to clear up any misunderstandings\. \.The Shadow Warriors, what do you plan to do with them now?
entries.translated:
Hanya untuk meluruskan
kesalahpahaman\. \.Prajurit Bayangan,\lapa yang akan kau lakukan dengan

mereka sekarang?

entries.original: "[red]Please don’t ignore me, sir\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Please don’t ignore me, sir\.
entries.translated: [red]Tolong jangan abaikan saya, Tuan\.

entries.original:
"Destroy them - the whole wretched
lot of them.

I’ve had time to reflect on what
we did to all those poor Pokémon\.

It was wrong - all of it!

None of them deserved to be
experimented on\.\CC0818 especially not in\lthat way!

I can’t change what we did, but I
can certainly end their pain now."
entries.translation_source: Destroy them - the whole wretched lot of them. I’ve had time to reflect on what we did to all those poor Pokémon\. It was wrong - all of it! None of them deserved to be experimented on\.\CC0818 especially not in that way! I can’t change what we did, but I can certainly end their pain now.
entries.translated:
Hancurkan mereka - seluruh mereka
yang menyedihkan. Aku punya waktu\luntuk merenungkan apa yang kami

lakukan terhadap semua Pokémon
malang itu\. Itu salah - semuanya!\lTak satu pun dari mereka yang

pantas dijadikan eksperimen\.\CC0818
terutama tidak dengan cara itu! Aku\ltidak bisa mengubah apa yang kami

lakukan, tapi aku pasti bisa
mengakhiri penderitaan mereka\lsekarang.

entries.original:
"And I cannot let you do that.

Aklove still has need of them,
and as per our contract, Fey is\lproviding him with both Grunts and\lShadow Warriors - all for his new\lorganization, the Light of Ruin.

But if you refuse to stand aside and
let us leave\."
entries.translation_source: And I cannot let you do that. Aklove still has need of them, and as per our contract, Fey is providing him with both Grunts and Shadow Warriors - all for his new organization, the Light of Ruin. But if you refuse to stand aside and let us leave\.
entries.translated:
Dan aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu
melakukan itu. Aklove masih\lmembutuhkan mereka, dan sesuai

kontrak kami, Fey menyediakan
untuknya baik Prajurit Biasa maupun\lPrajurit Bayangan - semuanya untuk

organisasi barunya, Cahaya
Kehancuran. Tapi jika kau menolak\luntuk minggir dan membiarkan kami

pergi\.

entries.original:
"One of you!

Help me get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: One of you! Help me get rid of him!
entries.translated:
Salah satu dari kalian! Bantu aku
menyingkirkannya!

entries.original: "I hope it was worth it, Marlon\."
entries.translation_source: I hope it was worth it, Marlon\.
entries.translated: Aku harap itu sepadan, Marlon\.

entries.original: "[red]SIIIIIIIR!"
entries.translation_source: [red]SIIIIIIIR!
entries.translated: [red]TUANNNNNN!

entries.original:
"[red]It’s [player], sir!

[buffer3]’s here too!"
entries.translation_source: [red]It’s [player], sir! [buffer3]’s here too!
entries.translated:
[red]Ini [player], Tuan! [buffer3] juga
ada di sini!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0820 so much for the most secure
item storage in the world\."
entries.translation_source: Sigh\.\CC0820 so much for the most secure item storage in the world\.
entries.translated:
Hela napas\.\CC0820 begitulah penyimpanan
item paling aman di dunia\.

entries.original:
"You had one job\.\CC0818 keep out any
and all intruders!

But since you have so obviously
failed at that task, I suppose\lthat old adage must be true.

If you want anything done properly,
you must do it yourself."
entries.translation_source: You had one job\.\CC0818 keep out any and all intruders! But since you have so obviously failed at that task, I suppose that old adage must be true. If you want anything done properly, you must do it yourself.
entries.translated:
Kamu punya satu tugas\.\CC0818 jauhkan semua
penyusup! Tapi karena kamu jelas\lgagal dalam tugas itu, sepertinya

pepatah lama itu benar. Jika ingin
sesuatu dilakukan dengan benar,\lkamu harus melakukannya sendiri.

entries.original:
"[player]! So you survived the trip
back, too.

Quickly - we need to deal with Véga
and his cronies!

Your Pokémon can still fight, can’t
they? Great!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! So you survived the trip back, too. Quickly - we need to deal with Véga and his cronies! Your Pokémon can still fight, can’t they? Great!
entries.translated:
[player]! Jadi kamu selamat dalam
perjalanan kembali juga. Cepat -\lkita harus menghadapi Véga dan

kroni-kroninya! Pokémonmu masih
bisa bertarung, kan? Bagus!

entries.original:
"There’s no time to back out of
this fight, [player]!

We need to work together to deal
with Véga and his cronies!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no time to back out of this fight, [player]! We need to work together to deal with Véga and his cronies!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada waktu untuk mundur dari
pertarungan ini, [player]! Kita\lharus bekerja sama untuk menghadapi

Véga dan kroni-kroninya!

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 it is truly unfortunate that
you had to find out this way.

But I will not hesitate.

You are no longer a mere opponent\.\CC0818
you are an enemy!"
entries.translation_source: [player]\.\CC0818 it is truly unfortunate that you had to find out this way. But I will not hesitate. You are no longer a mere opponent\.\CC0818 you are an enemy!
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 sungguh disayangkan kamu
harus mengetahuinya dengan cara\lini. Tapi aku tidak akan ragu. Kamu

bukan lagi sekadar lawan\.\CC0818 kamu
adalah musuh!

entries.original:
"All Grunts, retreat back to your
new base!

We’ve mostly finished what we
came for - there is no need to\lremain here!"
entries.translation_source: All Grunts, retreat back to your new base! We’ve mostly finished what we came for - there is no need to remain here!
entries.translated:
Semua Grunts, mundur kembali ke
markas baru kalian! Kita hampir\lselesai dengan apa yang kita cari -

tidak perlu tinggal di sini!

entries.original:
"No you don’t!

You’re not getting away that easily!"
entries.translation_source: No you don’t! You’re not getting away that easily!
entries.translated:
Tidak, jangan! Kamu tidak akan
lolos semudah itu!

entries.original: "You can’t restrain me!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t restrain me!
entries.translated: Kamu tidak bisa menahanku!

entries.original:
"There’s nowhere for you to run,
Véga!

Now, tell me where you’re keeping
the Shadow Warriors!"
entries.translation_source: There’s nowhere for you to run, Véga! Now, tell me where you’re keeping the Shadow Warriors!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada tempat untukmu kabur,
Véga! Sekarang, katakan di mana\lkamu menyembunyikan Shadow

Warriors!

entries.original:
"You think you have me cornered,
do you, Marlon?

Quite the opposite - it is you
who will soon be pinned down."
entries.translation_source: You think you have me cornered, do you, Marlon? Quite the opposite - it is you who will soon be pinned down.
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir kamu sudah menjepitku,
Marlon? Justru sebaliknya - kamulah\lyang akan segera terdesak.

entries.original: "What’s that supposed to mean, Véga?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that supposed to mean, Véga?
entries.translated: Apa maksudmu, Véga?

entries.original:
"I’m sure you’re aware of the
incident that took place here, yes?"
entries.translation_source: I’m sure you’re aware of the incident that took place here, yes?
entries.translated:
Aku yakin kamu tahu tentang insiden
yang terjadi di sini, ya?

entries.original: "Of course\.\CC0818 what’s your point?"
entries.translation_source: Of course\.\CC0818 what’s your point?
entries.translated: Tentu saja\.\CC0818 apa maksudmu?

entries.original:
"The monster that appeared from
the lava\.\CC0818 those fools unfortunate\lenough to be present fought tooth\land nail to subdue it.

It only sleeps now, having been
overwhelmed by sheer numbers.

But supposing one had the means to
reawaken and control it\."
entries.translation_source: The monster that appeared from the lava\.\CC0818 those fools unfortunate enough to be present fought tooth and nail to subdue it. It only sleeps now, having been overwhelmed by sheer numbers. But supposing one had the means to reawaken and control it\.
entries.translated:
Monster yang muncul dari lava\.\CC0818
orang-orang bodoh yang cukup sial\luntuk hadir bertempur mati-matian

untuk menaklukkannya. Ia hanya
tidur sekarang, setelah dikalahkan\loleh jumlah yang banyak. Tapi

bayangkan jika seseorang memiliki
cara untuk membangunkannya kembali\ldan mengendalikannya\.

entries.original: "No\.\CC0820 surely you’re not planning\.!?"
entries.translation_source: No\.\CC0820 surely you’re not planning\.!?
entries.translated: Tidak\.\CC0820 pasti kamu tidak berencana\.!?

entries.original:
"Oh yes, Marlon.

Fey had Aklove pass me a certain
artifact, capable of controlling\lthe monster that slumbers beneath\lthe magma.

And now\."
entries.translation_source: Oh yes, Marlon. Fey had Aklove pass me a certain artifact, capable of controlling the monster that slumbers beneath the magma. And now\.
entries.translated:
Oh ya, Marlon. Fey menyuruh Aklove
memberiku sebuah artefak tertentu,\lyang mampu mengendalikan monster

yang tidur di bawah magma. Dan
sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Groudon!
Respond to my Red Orb!

Awaken, and revert to your
primordial state!"
entries.translation_source: Groudon! Respond to my Red Orb! Awaken, and revert to your primordial state!
entries.translated:
Groudon! Respon terhadap Red
Orb-ku! Bangunlah, dan kembalilah\lke wujud primordiumu!

entries.original:
"What now, Marlon?

You cannot keep holding me here -
the cave will soon collapse, and\lwe will both be trapped.

You cannot hope to find the Shadow
Warriors whilst buried under rubble."
entries.translation_source: What now, Marlon? You cannot keep holding me here - the cave will soon collapse, and we will both be trapped. You cannot hope to find the Shadow Warriors whilst buried under rubble.
entries.translated:
Apa sekarang, Marlon? Kamu tidak
bisa terus menahanku di sini - gua\lini akan segera runtuh, dan kita

berdua akan terperangkap. Kamu
tidak bisa berharap menemukan\lShadow Warriors saat terkubur di

bawah puing-puing.

entries.original:
"It’s simple.

If that happens, I’ll use Krookodile
to dig my way out.

Even if you must remain trapped,
Véga, I know Fey.

There are only so many places in
Borrius she’d consider secure\lenough to store the Shadow\lWarriors.

Once I rejoin Zeph in Frozen
Heights, we’ll scour every possible\llocation until we find them!"
entries.translation_source: It’s simple. If that happens, I’ll use Krookodile to dig my way out. Even if you must remain trapped, Véga, I know Fey. There are only so many places in Borrius she’d consider secure enough to store the Shadow Warriors. Once I rejoin Zeph in Frozen Heights, we’ll scour every possible location until we find them!
entries.translated:
Ini sederhana. Jika itu terjadi,
aku akan menggunakan Krookodile\luntuk menggali jalan keluar.

Meskipun kamu harus tetap
terperangkap, Véga, aku kenal Fey.\lHanya ada beberapa tempat di

Borrius yang dia anggap cukup aman
untuk menyimpan Shadow Warriors.\lBegitu aku bergabung kembali dengan

Zeph di Frozen Heights, kami akan
mencari setiap lokasi yang mungkin\lsampai kami menemukan mereka!

entries.original:
"I thought you’d continue to be
stubborn, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: I thought you’d continue to be stubborn, Marlon.
entries.translated:
Kukira kamu akan terus keras
kepala, Marlon.

entries.original:
"Groudon!

The earth trembles with your
every step!

Now, subdue them!"
entries.translation_source: Groudon! The earth trembles with your every step! Now, subdue them!
entries.translated:
Groudon! Bumi bergetar dengan
setiap langkahmu! Sekarang,\ltundukkan mereka!

entries.original:
"Can’t keep your footing, Marlon?

Then, I shall take that as my cue
to leave."
entries.translation_source: Can’t keep your footing, Marlon? Then, I shall take that as my cue to leave.
entries.translated:
Tidak bisa menjaga pijakanmu,
Marlon? Kalau begitu, itu kujadikan\lisyarat untuk pergi.

entries.original: "Curses\.\CC0818 he escaped\."
entries.translation_source: Curses\.\CC0818 he escaped\.
entries.translated: Sial\.\CC0818 dia melarikan diri\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

You have to stop Groudon’s
rampage!

If not, the cave will collapse and
we’ll both be trapped here!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! You have to stop Groudon’s rampage! If not, the cave will collapse and we’ll both be trapped here!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu harus menghentikan
amukan Groudon! Jika tidak, gua ini\lakan runtuh dan kita berdua akan

terperangkap di sini!

entries.original:
"Ngh\.\CC0818 [player], are you alright?

\.\CC0818No! We’ve been separated!"
entries.translation_source: Ngh\.\CC0818 [player], are you alright? \.\CC0818No! We’ve been separated!
entries.translated:
Ngh\.\CC0818 [player], apakah kamu baik-baik
saja? \.\CC0818Tidak! Kita terpisah!

entries.original:
"Wait, these Poké Balls on my side\.\CC0818
aren’t they [player]’s Pokémon?

They must have been dropped when
Groudon used that attack\.

What now\.\CC0818 my own Pokémon are too
badly hurt to take that thing on\.!"
entries.translation_source: Wait, these Poké Balls on my side\.\CC0818 aren’t they [player]’s Pokémon? They must have been dropped when Groudon used that attack\. What now\.\CC0818 my own Pokémon are too badly hurt to take that thing on\.!
entries.translated:
Tunggu, Poké Ball di sisiku\.\CC0818
bukankah itu Pokémon milik\l[player]? Pasti itu jatuh saat

Groudon menggunakan serangan itu\.
Sekarang bagaimana\.\CC0818 Pokémonku\lsendiri terlalu terluka untuk

menghadapi makhluk itu\.!

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0818 [player]!

Let me use your Poké Balls!
I’ll command your Pokémon!

Just direct me on whether you want
to fight or switch!"
entries.translation_source: Wait\.\CC0818 [player]! Let me use your Poké Balls! I’ll command your Pokémon! Just direct me on whether you want to fight or switch!
entries.translated:
Tunggu\.\CC0818 [player]! Biarkan aku
menggunakan Poké Ball-mu! Aku akan\lmemerintahkan Pokémon-mu! Arahkan

aku apakah kamu ingin bertarung
atau berganti!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] sank into the lava and
fell into a deep slumber once more."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] sank into the lava and fell into a deep slumber once more.
entries.translated:
[black] [buffer1] tenggelam ke dalam lava
dan tertidur lelap sekali lagi.

entries.original: "Phew\.\CC0818 we survived\.\CC0818 somehow\."
entries.translation_source: Phew\.\CC0818 we survived\.\CC0818 somehow\.
entries.translated: Fiuh\.\CC0818 kita selamat\.\CC0818 entah bagaimana\.

entries.original:
"Krookodile! Destroy the rocks!
Use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Krookodile! Destroy the rocks! Use Rock Smash!
entries.translated:
Krookodile! Hancurkan batu-batu
itu! Gunakan Rock Smash!

entries.original:
"Thank you for your help,
[player].

I honestly don’t know what I would
have done without you.

Here - I suppose you’ll want your
Pokémon back."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for your help, [player]. I honestly don’t know what I would have done without you. Here - I suppose you’ll want your Pokémon back.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih atas bantuanmu,
[player]. Sejujurnya aku tidak tahu\lapa yang akan kulakukan tanpamu.

Ini - kurasa kamu ingin Pokémon-mu
kembali.

entries.original:
"How about you\.\CC0818 no, on second
thought, that’s not a good idea\."
entries.translation_source: How about you\.\CC0818 no, on second thought, that’s not a good idea\.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana denganmu\.\CC0818 tidak, setelah
dipikir-pikir, itu bukan ide yang\lbagus\.

entries.original:
"Look, I’m grateful for your help.

Truly, I am.

However, this next task\.\CC0818 is
something I need to handle alone.

Right now, I need to secure Zeph’s
aid in finding the Light of Ruin’s\lnew base.

If you followed me to our base in
[green]Frozen Heights[blue], Zeph would never\lagree to help.

So please, [player], for both our
sakes - stay away from our base."
entries.translation_source: Look, I’m grateful for your help. Truly, I am. However, this next task\.\CC0818 is something I need to handle alone. Right now, I need to secure Zeph’s aid in finding the Light of Ruin’s new base. If you followed me to our base in [green]Frozen Heights[blue], Zeph would never agree to help. So please, [player], for both our sakes - stay away from our base.
entries.translated:
Dengar, aku bersyukur atas
bantuanmu. Sungguh, aku bersyukur.\lNamun, tugas berikutnya\.\CC0818 adalah

sesuatu yang harus aku tangani
sendiri. Saat ini, aku perlu\lmemastikan bantuan Zeph untuk

menemukan markas baru Light of
Ruin. Jika kamu mengikutiku ke\lmarkas kami di [green]Frozen Heights[blue], Zeph

tidak akan pernah setuju untuk
membantu. Jadi tolong, [player],\ldemi kita berdua - jauhi markas

kami.

entries.original:
"It looks like someone left their
uniform on the floor.

Put it on?"
entries.translation_source: It looks like someone left their uniform on the floor. Put it on?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya seseorang meninggalkan
seragam mereka di lantai. Pakai?

entries.original: "You put on the clothes."
entries.translation_source: You put on the clothes.
entries.translated: Kamu mengenakan pakaian itu.

entries.original:
"Your clothes are on the ground.
Put them on?"
entries.translation_source: Your clothes are on the ground. Put them on?
entries.translated: Pakaianmu ada di tanah. Pakai?

entries.original:
"Marlon’s Uniform is now available
in the Costume Box!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon’s Uniform is now available in the Costume Box!
entries.translated:
Seragam Marlon sekarang tersedia di
Kotak Kostum!

entries.original: "Aros"
entries.translation_source: Aros
entries.translated: Aros

entries.original:
"\.and so Fey ordered the grunts
to join Aklove’s \qoLight of Ruin\qc.

You understand now, Marlon?

Frankly, the fact any grunts and
scientists were allowed to remain\lis a miracle\."
entries.translation_source: \.and so Fey ordered the grunts to join Aklove’s \qoLight of Ruin\qc. You understand now, Marlon? Frankly, the fact any grunts and scientists were allowed to remain is a miracle\.
entries.translated:
\.dan Fey memerintahkan para anggota
untuk bergabung dengan \qoLight of\lRuin\qc milik Aklove. Kau mengerti

sekarang, Marlon? Sejujurnya, fakta
bahwa ada anggota dan ilmuwan yang\ldiizinkan tetap tinggal adalah

sebuah keajaiban\.

entries.original:
"I see\.\CC0818 I had no idea things had
gotten this bad\.

But I think I know how to make up
the difference.

And I know this may not sound like
the most agreeable idea, but\."
entries.translation_source: I see\.\CC0818 I had no idea things had gotten this bad\. But I think I know how to make up the difference. And I know this may not sound like the most agreeable idea, but\.
entries.translated:
Saya lihat\.\CC0818 Saya tidak tahu keadaan
sudah seburuk ini\. Tapi saya pikir\lsaya tahu cara untuk menebusnya.

Dan saya tahu ini mungkin bukan ide
yang paling menyenangkan, tapi\.

entries.original:
"What the\.

That’s my uniform!

[player]\.\CC0818 is that you?"
entries.translation_source: What the\. That’s my uniform! [player]\.\CC0818 is that you?
entries.translated:
Apa-apaan\. Itu seragamku! [player]\.\CC0818
apakah itu kau?

entries.original:
"What!?
You\.\CC0820 you’re\.

No! It cannot possibly be you!

You’re\.\CC0818 you must be some
sort of spy!

Aklove\.\CC0818 how long must you
torment me\.?"
entries.translation_source: What!? You\.\CC0820 you’re\. No! It cannot possibly be you! You’re\.\CC0818 you must be some sort of spy! Aklove\.\CC0818 how long must you torment me\.?
entries.translated:
Apa!? Kau\.\CC0820 kau\. Tidak! Tidak mungkin
itu kau! Kau\.\CC0818 kau pasti semacam\lmata-mata! Aklove\.\CC0818 berapa lama lagi

kau harus menyiksaku\.?

entries.original:
"You thought you could fool me
again, faker? Like he did?

Even though I see that you wear
[player]’s face under the mask\.

You are still a far cry from the
real deal!

Once I’ve sent you running back to
Aklove, deliver a message to him\lfor me!

Tell him\.\CC0820 that you’ll all suffer for
your irredeemable sins!"
entries.translation_source: You thought you could fool me again, faker? Like he did? Even though I see that you wear [player]’s face under the mask\. You are still a far cry from the real deal! Once I’ve sent you running back to Aklove, deliver a message to him for me! Tell him\.\CC0820 that you’ll all suffer for your irredeemable sins!
entries.translated:
Kau pikir kau bisa membodohiku
lagi, penipu? Seperti yang dia\llakukan? Meskipun aku melihat bahwa

kau memakai wajah [player] di bawah
topeng\. Kau masih jauh dari yang\lasli! Setelah aku mengirimmu

kembali ke Aklove, sampaikan pesan
untuknya untukku! Katakan padanya\.\CC0820\lbahwa kalian semua akan menderita

karena dosa-dosa kalian yang tak
termaafkan!

entries.original:
"This battle style\.\CC0818 this aura\.\CC0818
it cannot be\.\CC0818 are you really\l[player]\.!?

No, this can’t be true!"
entries.translation_source: This battle style\.\CC0818 this aura\.\CC0818 it cannot be\.\CC0818 are you really [player]\.!? No, this can’t be true!
entries.translated:
Gaya bertarung ini\.\CC0818 aura ini\.\CC0818 tidak
mungkin\.\CC0818 apakah kau benar-benar\l[player]\.!? Tidak, ini tidak mungkin

benar!

entries.original:
"Zeph!
Enough!

We don’t have time for infighting
right now!

[player] isn’t the enemy - the
Light of Ruin is!

And you can either accept that fact,
or else I’ll be assuming command\lof what remains of the Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Zeph! Enough! We don’t have time for infighting right now! [player] isn’t the enemy - the Light of Ruin is! And you can either accept that fact, or else I’ll be assuming command of what remains of the Shadows.
entries.translated:
Zeph! Cukup! Kita tidak punya waktu
untuk pertengkaran internal\lsekarang! [player] bukan musuh -

Light of Ruin-lah musuhnya! Dan kau
bisa menerima fakta itu, atau aku\lakan mengambil alih komando dari

apa yang tersisa dari Shadows.

entries.original:
"Thank you.
Now then\.

What have you been planning, Zeph?

From what I gathered, we’ll be
staging an attack on the Light of\lRuin’s new base?"
entries.translation_source: Thank you. Now then\. What have you been planning, Zeph? From what I gathered, we’ll be staging an attack on the Light of Ruin’s new base?
entries.translated:
Terima kasih. Sekarang\. Apa yang
sudah kau rencanakan, Zeph? Dari\lyang aku kumpulkan, kita akan

melakukan serangan ke markas baru
Light of Ruin?

entries.original:
"That’s right\.

I’m having our remaining scientists
locate their base.

Once they’ve managed to find it,
we’ll take the Light of Ruin by\lsurprise and destroy it.

With their main force left reeling,
we’ll steal back the Prison Bottle\land what remaining Shadow Warriors\lthey have left.

However, I’m still unsure as to how
long it will take to locate them\.

And unfortunately, we’re pressed for
time.

Right now, Aklove is with Fey as
she studies Hoopa.

When she finishes, Aklove intends to
turn its power on Borrius\.

If we can take out his base while
he’s gone, we can catch him off\lguard when he returns, and seal\lHoopa’s power away once again.

Without it, Aklove’s power will be
greatly diminished."
entries.translation_source: That’s right\. I’m having our remaining scientists locate their base. Once they’ve managed to find it, we’ll take the Light of Ruin by surprise and destroy it. With their main force left reeling, we’ll steal back the Prison Bottle and what remaining Shadow Warriors they have left. However, I’m still unsure as to how long it will take to locate them\. And unfortunately, we’re pressed for time. Right now, Aklove is with Fey as she studies Hoopa. When she finishes, Aklove intends to turn its power on Borrius\. If we can take out his base while he’s gone, we can catch him off guard when he returns, and seal Hoopa’s power away once again. Without it, Aklove’s power will be greatly diminished.
entries.translated:
Benar\. Aku menyuruh ilmuwan kita
yang tersisa untuk menemukan markas\lmereka. Setelah mereka berhasil

menemukannya, kita akan menyerbu
Light of Ruin secara mendadak dan\lmenghancurkannya. Dengan pasukan

utama mereka yang terpukul, kita
akan mencuri kembali Prison Bottle\ldan Shadow Warriors yang tersisa.

Namun, aku masih tidak yakin berapa
lama waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk\lmenemukan mereka\. Dan sayangnya,

kita dikejar waktu. Saat ini,
Aklove bersama Fey saat dia\lmempelajari Hoopa. Ketika dia

selesai, Aklove berniat menggunakan
kekuatannya di Borrius\. Jika kita\lbisa menghancurkan markasnya saat

dia pergi, kita bisa mengejutkannya
saat dia kembali, dan menyegel\lkekuatan Hoopa lagi. Tanpa itu,

kekuatan Aklove akan sangat
berkurang.

entries.original:
"Roger that, Zeph.

And I take it you’re certain Fey
won’t retaliate against us if we\ltake action?"
entries.translation_source: Roger that, Zeph. And I take it you’re certain Fey won’t retaliate against us if we take action?
entries.translated:
Dimengerti, Zeph. Dan aku kira kau
yakin Fey tidak akan membalas\ldendam pada kita jika kita

bertindak?

entries.original:
"I’m certain, Marlon.

From talking with some of our
scientists, Fey could not care\lless about Aklove’s goals.

All she wants is to study that
Pokémon’s power.

She’ll give him her support, of
course, but for the most part,\lit is up to Aklove as to whether\lor not he succeeds.

Of course, we shouldn’t make light of
how dangerous he is alone\."
entries.translation_source: I’m certain, Marlon. From talking with some of our scientists, Fey could not care less about Aklove’s goals. All she wants is to study that Pokémon’s power. She’ll give him her support, of course, but for the most part, it is up to Aklove as to whether or not he succeeds. Of course, we shouldn’t make light of how dangerous he is alone\.
entries.translated:
Aku yakin, Marlon. Dari berbicara
dengan beberapa ilmuwan kita, Fey\ltidak peduli sama sekali tentang

tujuan Aklove. Yang dia inginkan
hanyalah mempelajari kekuatan\lPokémon itu. Dia akan memberinya

dukungan, tentu saja, tetapi
sebagian besar, terserah Aklove\lapakah dia berhasil atau tidak.

Tentu saja, kita tidak boleh
meremehkan betapa berbahayanya dia\lsendirian\.

entries.original:
"Then it seems to me that in order
for our plan to go off without a\lhitch, we’ll need all the manpower\lwe can muster.

So, I suggest we bring [player]
along, as well."
entries.translation_source: Then it seems to me that in order for our plan to go off without a hitch, we’ll need all the manpower we can muster. So, I suggest we bring [player] along, as well.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu menurutku, agar
rencana kita berjalan lancar, kita\lperlu mengerahkan semua tenaga yang

kita bisa. Jadi, aku sarankan kita
mengajak [player] juga.

entries.original:
"Marlon, I don’t understand\.

Why would you put so much faith
in [buffer1]?

[player] has only tried to interfere
with us before.

What makes you think [buffer2] would even
be willing to help us?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, I don’t understand\. Why would you put so much faith in [buffer1]? [player] has only tried to interfere with us before. What makes you think [buffer2] would even be willing to help us?
entries.translated:
Marlon, aku tidak mengerti\. Kenapa
kau begitu percaya pada [buffer1]?\l[player] hanya pernah mencoba

mengganggu kita sebelumnya. Apa
yang membuatmu berpikir [buffer2]\lakan bersedia membantu kita?

entries.original:
"We were imprisoned together in the
Cube Space, Zeph.

And while we were there, we made a
promise to someone.

We promised we would destroy the
remaining Shadow Warriors and set\ltheir souls free.

And [player] knows that as long as
the Light of Ruin is holding onto\lthe Shadow Warriors, their souls\lwill remain trapped."
entries.translation_source: We were imprisoned together in the Cube Space, Zeph. And while we were there, we made a promise to someone. We promised we would destroy the remaining Shadow Warriors and set their souls free. And [player] knows that as long as the Light of Ruin is holding onto the Shadow Warriors, their souls will remain trapped.
entries.translated:
Kami dipenjara bersama di Cube
Space, Zeph. Dan selama di sana,\lkami membuat janji pada seseorang.

Kami berjanji akan menghancurkan
Shadow Warriors yang tersisa dan\lmembebaskan jiwa mereka. Dan

[player] tahu bahwa selama Light of
Ruin masih memegang Shadow\lWarriors, jiwa mereka akan tetap

terperangkap.

entries.original:
"Are you saying that not only did
both of you survive a trip inside\lthe Cube, but someone else was\lthere, too?

Someone who knew about the existence
of the Shadow Warriors?"
entries.translation_source: Are you saying that not only did both of you survive a trip inside the Cube, but someone else was there, too? Someone who knew about the existence of the Shadow Warriors?
entries.translated:
Apakah kau mengatakan bahwa tidak
hanya kalian berdua selamat dari\lperjalanan ke dalam Cube, tetapi

ada orang lain juga di sana?
Seseorang yang tahu tentang\lkeberadaan Shadow Warriors?

entries.original:
"It was Aros, Zeph.

Fey imprisoned him in there sixteen
years ago.

And not only that, it turns out Aros
is [player]’s father, too."
entries.translation_source: It was Aros, Zeph. Fey imprisoned him in there sixteen years ago. And not only that, it turns out Aros is [player]’s father, too.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah Aros, Zeph. Fey
memenjarakannya di sana enam belas\ltahun yang lalu. Dan bukan hanya

itu, ternyata Aros adalah ayah
[player] juga.

entries.original:
"Aros!? I see\.\CC0818 so that’s what became
of him\.

Well, I’m not surprised then.

He was always quick to identify bugs
in any system.

If anyone could figure out a way
out, no matter how flawed, it\lwould surely be him\."
entries.translation_source: Aros!? I see\.\CC0818 so that’s what became of him\. Well, I’m not surprised then. He was always quick to identify bugs in any system. If anyone could figure out a way out, no matter how flawed, it would surely be him\.
entries.translated:
Aros!? Aku lihat\.\CC0818 jadi begitulah
nasibnya\. Yah, aku tidak kaget. Dia\lselalu cepat menemukan celah dalam

sistem apa pun. Jika ada yang bisa
menemukan jalan keluar, tidak\lpeduli seberapa cacatnya, pastilah

dia\.

entries.original:
"So, [player]\. would you be willing
to lend us your aid?

We intend to gather what resources
we can, and go for the Light of\lRuin directly.

\.

Yes, I’m aware - you and the
Shadows\.\CC0818 we haven’t always seen\leye-to-eye, have we?

Then, if I trusted you with our
most important secrets, would that\lbe enough?

In that case, let me explain what
our true purpose was\.

The true purpose of the Shadows\."
entries.translation_source: So, [player]\. would you be willing to lend us your aid? We intend to gather what resources we can, and go for the Light of Ruin directly. \. Yes, I’m aware - you and the Shadows\.\CC0818 we haven’t always seen eye-to-eye, have we? Then, if I trusted you with our most important secrets, would that be enough? In that case, let me explain what our true purpose was\. The true purpose of the Shadows\.
entries.translated:
Jadi, [player]\. maukah kau
memberikan bantuanmu? Kami berniat\lmengumpulkan sumber daya yang bisa

kami dapatkan, dan langsung
menyerang Light of Ruin. \. Ya, aku\lsadar - kau dan Shadows\.\CC0818 kita tidak

selalu sepaham, bukan? Kalau
begitu, jika aku mempercayakan\lrahasia terpenting kami padamu,

apakah itu cukup? Dalam hal ini,
biarkan aku menjelaskan apa tujuan\lsebenarnya kami\. Tujuan sebenarnya

dari Shadows\.

entries.original:
"It all began, seventeen years ago\.

Zeph’s son had just passed away.

As his old friends, we came to visit
him from our home region of Hoenn\."
entries.translation_source: It all began, seventeen years ago\. Zeph’s son had just passed away. As his old friends, we came to visit him from our home region of Hoenn\.
entries.translated:
Semuanya dimulai, tujuh belas tahun
yang lalu\. Putra Zeph baru saja\lmeninggal. Sebagai teman lamanya,

kami datang mengunjunginya dari
daerah asal kami, Hoenn\.

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph\.\CC0818 how are you holding up?

I’m so sorry\.\CC0818 Marlon and I just
heard\.\CC0820 about your son\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Zeph\.\CC0818 how are you holding up? I’m so sorry\.\CC0818 Marlon and I just heard\.\CC0820 about your son\.
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph\.\CC0818 bagaimana kabarmu? Aku sangat
menyesal\.\CC0818 Aku dan Marlon baru saja\lmendengar\.\CC0820 tentang putramu\.

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0818 Marlon\.\CC0818 thank you for
your condolences.

It’s good to see you again after all
these years\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory\.\CC0818 Marlon\.\CC0818 thank you for your condolences. It’s good to see you again after all these years\.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0818 Marlon\.\CC0818 terima kasih atas
belasungkawanya. Senang bertemu\lkalian lagi setelah sekian lama\.

entries.original:
"I take it you travelled by boat to
get here?

How was the journey?"
entries.translation_source: I take it you travelled by boat to get here? How was the journey?
entries.translated:
Kurasa kalian naik kapal untuk
sampai ke sini? Bagaimana\lperjalanannya?

entries.original:
"[red]Very pleasant.

It took a few days to arrive here,
but the journey was lovely."
entries.translation_source: [red]Very pleasant. It took a few days to arrive here, but the journey was lovely.
entries.translated:
[red]Sangat menyenangkan. Butuh beberapa
hari untuk sampai ke sini, tapi\lperjalanannya indah.

entries.original:
"If I remember correctly, you
have a son, too\. right?"
entries.translation_source: If I remember correctly, you have a son, too\. right?
entries.translated:
Kalau tidak salah, kalian juga
punya seorang putra\. kan?

entries.original:
"We did\.

Unfortunately, he\.\CC0820 he succumbed to
illness much too young."
entries.translation_source: We did\. Unfortunately, he\.\CC0820 he succumbed to illness much too young.
entries.translated:
Kami pernah punya\. Sayangnya, dia\.\CC0820
dia meninggal karena penyakit\lterlalu muda.

entries.original:
"You are knowledgable scientists\.\CC0818
have you ever thought about trying\lto bring him back?"
entries.translation_source: You are knowledgable scientists\.\CC0818 have you ever thought about trying to bring him back?
entries.translated:
Kalian adalah ilmuwan yang
berpengetahuan\.\CC0818 pernahkah kalian\lberpikir untuk mencoba membawanya

kembali?

entries.original:
"Of course\.

As scientists, we thought that if
anyone could find a way, it would\lbe us.

Sadly, there are no known methods
to truly revive the dead.

We had no choice but to try and
move on.

Then, a year ago, Ivory gave birth
to twins\.

It was one of the happiest moments
of our lives.

Of course we miss our first child,
but our new ones have done much\lto fill the voids in our hearts\."
entries.translation_source: Of course\. As scientists, we thought that if anyone could find a way, it would be us. Sadly, there are no known methods to truly revive the dead. We had no choice but to try and move on. Then, a year ago, Ivory gave birth to twins\. It was one of the happiest moments of our lives. Of course we miss our first child, but our new ones have done much to fill the voids in our hearts\.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja\. Sebagai ilmuwan, kami
berpikir jika ada yang bisa\lmenemukan cara, itu pasti kami.

Sayangnya, tidak ada metode yang
diketahui untuk benar-benar\lmenghidupkan orang mati. Kami tidak

punya pilihan selain mencoba dan
melanjutkan hidup. Lalu, setahun\lyang lalu, Ivory melahirkan anak

kembar\. Itu adalah salah satu momen
paling bahagia dalam hidup kami.\lTentu kami merindukan anak pertama

kami, tapi anak-anak baru kami
telah banyak mengisi kekosongan di\lhati kami\.

entries.original:
"Is that so\.

Where are they now, if I may ask?"
entries.translation_source: Is that so\. Where are they now, if I may ask?
entries.translated:
Begitu ya\. Di mana mereka sekarang,
jika boleh aku bertanya?

entries.original:
"[red]Euler Log, a friend of ours, agreed
to babysit for the time being.

They’re with him now, back in
Frozen Heights."
entries.translation_source: [red]Euler Log, a friend of ours, agreed to babysit for the time being. They’re with him now, back in Frozen Heights.
entries.translated:
[red]Euler Log, seorang teman kami,
setuju untuk menjaga anak-anak\luntuk sementara. Mereka bersamanya

sekarang, kembali di Frozen
Heights.

entries.original:
"Frozen Heights\.\CC0820 a friend of mine
lives there as well.

He’s my old partner\.\CC0818 the one who
helped me found my own company\.

But around here, he’s simply known
as the \qoGuardian of Borrius\qc.

He’s even managed to befriend a
so-called \qomythical\qc Pokémon!

I think his wife recently gave
birth to their own child, actually\.

However, I don’t quite remember the
child’s name\."
entries.translation_source: Frozen Heights\.\CC0820 a friend of mine lives there as well. He’s my old partner\.\CC0818 the one who helped me found my own company\. But around here, he’s simply known as the \qoGuardian of Borrius\qc. He’s even managed to befriend a so-called \qomythical\qc Pokémon! I think his wife recently gave birth to their own child, actually\. However, I don’t quite remember the child’s name\.
entries.translated:
Frozen Heights\.\CC0820 seorang temanku juga
tinggal di sana. Dia adalah mantan\lmitraku\.\CC0818 orang yang membantuku

mendirikan perusahaanku sendiri\.
Tapi di sini, dia hanya dikenal\lsebagai \qoGuardian of Borrius\qc. Dia

bahkan berhasil berteman dengan
seekor Pokémon yang disebut\l\qomythical\qc! Aku pikir istrinya baru

saja melahirkan anak mereka
sendiri, sebenarnya\. Namun, aku\ltidak begitu ingat nama anak itu\.

entries.original:
"What about your new twins?
What are their names?"
entries.translation_source: What about your new twins? What are their names?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana dengan anak kembarmu yang
baru? Siapa nama mereka?

entries.original:
"[red]Their names are [rival]
and Melony.

They’re the most beautiful children
in the world."
entries.translation_source: [red]Their names are [rival] and Melony. They’re the most beautiful children in the world.
entries.translated:
[red]Nama mereka adalah [rival] dan
Melony. Mereka adalah anak-anak\ltercantik di dunia.

entries.original:
"Yes, that’s right\.\CC0818 Ivory and I are
[rival] and Melony’s parents.

[rival]\.\CC0818 ever since he arrived,
he’s been looking for us, hasn’t he?

I always regretted leaving them
both, but after spending so much\ltime away, I had really hoped they\lcould meet their old brother\.

Ah\.\CC0820 how stupid I was\."
entries.translation_source: Yes, that’s right\.\CC0818 Ivory and I are [rival] and Melony’s parents. [rival]\.\CC0818 ever since he arrived, he’s been looking for us, hasn’t he? I always regretted leaving them both, but after spending so much time away, I had really hoped they could meet their old brother\. Ah\.\CC0820 how stupid I was\.
entries.translated:
Ya, benar\.\CC0818 Ivory dan aku adalah
orang tua [rival] dan Melony.\l[rival]\.\CC0818 sejak dia tiba, dia sudah

mencari kami, {B3}kan? Aku selalu
menyesal meninggalkan mereka\lberdua, tapi setelah menghabiskan

begitu lama pergi, aku sangat
berharap mereka bisa bertemu kakak\llaki-laki mereka\. Ah\.\CC0820 betapa bodohnya

aku\.

entries.original:
"Perhaps I should take it from
here\.

When I learned that we had both
experienced the pain of losing our\lown children, I made an offer.

Our combined scientific knowledge\.\CC0818
united together under one common\lgoal\.

I felt with that resolve, we could
achieve the impossible."
entries.translation_source: Perhaps I should take it from here\. When I learned that we had both experienced the pain of losing our own children, I made an offer. Our combined scientific knowledge\.\CC0818 united together under one common goal\. I felt with that resolve, we could achieve the impossible.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku yang harus melanjutkan
dari sini\. Ketika aku tahu bahwa\lkita sama-sama mengalami kehilangan

anak sendiri, aku membuat tawaran.
Pengetahuan ilmiah kita yang\ldigabungkan\.\CC0818 bersatu dalam satu

tujuan bersama\. Aku merasa dengan
tekad itu, kita bisa mencapai yang\lmustahil.

entries.original:
"Of course, Marlon and Ivory were
most skeptical, but after many\lattempts, I convinced them."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Marlon and Ivory were most skeptical, but after many attempts, I convinced them.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Marlon dan Ivory sangat
skeptis, tapi setelah banyak usaha,\laku berhasil meyakinkan mereka.

entries.original:
"They agreed to return their children
to their home in Hoenn and then\lmove to Borrius without them.

With no distractions, I was certain
we would succeed."
entries.translation_source: They agreed to return their children to their home in Hoenn and then move to Borrius without them. With no distractions, I was certain we would succeed.
entries.translated:
Mereka setuju untuk mengembalikan
anak-anak mereka ke rumah mereka di\lHoenn dan kemudian pindah ke

Borrius tanpa mereka. Tanpa
gangguan, aku yakin kami akan\lberhasil.

entries.original:
"However, as we soon discovered, the
three of us could only do so much\lon our own.

And so, we partnered with an
independent organization, known as\l\qoThe Science Society\qc."
entries.translation_source: However, as we soon discovered, the three of us could only do so much on our own. And so, we partnered with an independent organization, known as \qoThe Science Society\qc.
entries.translated:
Namun, seperti yang segera kami
temukan, kami bertiga hanya bisa\lmelakukan banyak hal sendiri. Maka

dari itu, kami bermitra dengan
organisasi independen, yang dikenal\lsebagai \qoThe Science Society\qc.

entries.original:
"Together with their help, our
research suddenly gained speed.

However, this research required my
undivided attention.

And so, realizing that I simply could
not oversee so many projects at\lonce, I stepped down from my\lposition as CEO of Cube Corp."
entries.translation_source: Together with their help, our research suddenly gained speed. However, this research required my undivided attention. And so, realizing that I simply could not oversee so many projects at once, I stepped down from my position as CEO of Cube Corp.
entries.translated:
Dengan bantuan mereka, penelitian
kami tiba-tiba memperoleh\lkecepatan. Namun, penelitian ini

membutuhkan perhatian penuhku. Maka
dari itu, menyadari bahwa aku tidak\lbisa mengawasi begitu banyak proyek

sekaligus, aku mundur dari posisiku
sebagai CEO Cube Corp.

entries.original:
"In my place, I left it to a young
woman\.\CC0818 Fey, the leader of the\lScience Society."
entries.translation_source: In my place, I left it to a young woman\.\CC0818 Fey, the leader of the Science Society.
entries.translated:
Sebagai penggantiku, aku
menyerahkannya kepada seorang\lwanita muda\.\CC0818 Fey, pemimpin Science

Society.

entries.original:
"Yes\.\CC0818 Zeph is the inventor of the
Super Cube.

The first Cube, meant for simple
storage, was a collaborative effort\lbetween him, your father and Fey.

It’s what allowed Cube Corp. to
take off, and become the major\linfluence in Borrius it is today."
entries.translation_source: Yes\.\CC0818 Zeph is the inventor of the Super Cube. The first Cube, meant for simple storage, was a collaborative effort between him, your father and Fey. It’s what allowed Cube Corp. to take off, and become the major influence in Borrius it is today.
entries.translated:
Ya\.\CC0818 Zeph adalah penemu Super Cube.
Cube pertama, yang dimaksudkan\luntuk penyimpanan sederhana, adalah

hasil kerja sama antara dia,
ayahmu, dan Fey. Itulah yang\lmembuat Cube Corp. lepas landas dan

menjadi pengaruh besar di Borrius
seperti sekarang ini.

entries.original:
"And this is how she repays me,
after all this\.!

She practically stole Cube Corp.,
the company I founded with my\lown two hands\.

And she allows Aklove to steal my
Shadows from me, too\.!"
entries.translation_source: And this is how she repays me, after all this\.! She practically stole Cube Corp., the company I founded with my own two hands\. And she allows Aklove to steal my Shadows from me, too\.!
entries.translated:
Dan beginilah cara dia membalas
saya, setelah semua ini\.! Dia\lpraktis mencuri Cube Corp.,

perusahaan yang saya dirikan dengan
tangan saya sendiri\. Dan dia juga\lmembiarkan Aklove mencuri Shadows

saya dari saya\.!

entries.original:
"Phoo\.

I shouldn’t dwell on that now.

Anyway\.\CC0820 Fey was the one who gave
us the template for the project,\las you have likely guessed."
entries.translation_source: Phoo\. I shouldn’t dwell on that now. Anyway\.\CC0820 Fey was the one who gave us the template for the project, as you have likely guessed.
entries.translated:
Phoo\. Saya tidak boleh memikirkan
itu sekarang. Anyway\.\CC0820 Fey-lah yang\lmemberi kami templat untuk proyek

ini, seperti yang mungkin sudah
kamu duga.

entries.original:
"Thus, before I stepped down as CEO,
I established a new branch at Cube\lCorp. entirely dedicated to the\lrevival efforts.

I called it the Shadow branch.
Or as you know it, the \qoShadows\qc.

To avoid tarnishing Cube Corp’s
reputation, I had to ensure our\lexperiments had no ties to the\lcompany whatsoever.

And with that out of the way, we
were able to experiment worry-free."
entries.translation_source: Thus, before I stepped down as CEO, I established a new branch at Cube Corp. entirely dedicated to the revival efforts. I called it the Shadow branch. Or as you know it, the \qoShadows\qc. To avoid tarnishing Cube Corp’s reputation, I had to ensure our experiments had no ties to the company whatsoever. And with that out of the way, we were able to experiment worry-free.
entries.translated:
Oleh karena itu, sebelum saya turun
sebagai CEO, saya mendirikan cabang\lbaru di Cube Corp. yang sepenuhnya

didedikasikan untuk upaya
kebangkitan. Saya menyebutnya\lcabang Shadow. Atau seperti yang

kamu kenal, \qoShadows\qc. Untuk
menghindari mencoreng reputasi Cube\lCorp., saya harus memastikan

eksperimen kami tidak memiliki
hubungan apa pun dengan perusahaan\ltersebut. Dan dengan itu selesai,

kami bisa bereksperimen tanpa
khawatir.

entries.original: "Ivory, status report. "
entries.translation_source: Ivory, status report.
entries.translated: Ivory, laporan status.

entries.original:
"[red]We’re ready to begin the first trial,
Zeph.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: [red]We’re ready to begin the first trial, Zeph.[blue]
entries.translated:
[red]Kita siap memulai uji coba pertama,
Zeph.[blue]

entries.original:
"Then let’s begin, shall we?

Everyone, take your positions."
entries.translation_source: Then let’s begin, shall we? Everyone, take your positions.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu mari kita mulai, ya?
Semua orang, ambil posisi kalian.

entries.original:
"Zeph, are you certain that this
will work?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph, are you certain that this will work?
entries.translated:
Zeph, apakah kamu yakin ini akan
berhasil?

entries.original:
"Of course nothing is certain,
Marlon.

It is merely the first of many
prototypes.

I don’t expect perfect results on
the first try.

However, we can worry about the
finer points later.

For now\.\CC0818 let’s find out if this is
merely a hypothesis, or not."
entries.translation_source: Of course nothing is certain, Marlon. It is merely the first of many prototypes. I don’t expect perfect results on the first try. However, we can worry about the finer points later. For now\.\CC0818 let’s find out if this is merely a hypothesis, or not.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja tidak ada yang pasti,
Marlon. Ini hanyalah prototipe\lpertama dari sekian banyak. Saya

tidak mengharapkan hasil sempurna
pada percobaan pertama. Namun, kita\lbisa mengkhawatirkan

detail-detailnya nanti. Untuk saat
ini\.\CC0818 mari kita cari tahu apakah ini\lhanya hipotesis, atau bukan.

entries.original:
"To start with, I just place this
Pokémon here\."
entries.translation_source: To start with, I just place this Pokémon here\.
entries.translated:
Untuk memulainya, saya tinggal
menempatkan Pokémon ini di sini\.

entries.original:
"Then, place the sample remains
next to it\."
entries.translation_source: Then, place the sample remains next to it\.
entries.translated:
Kemudian, letakkan sisa sampel di
sebelahnya\.

entries.original:
"And finally, turn on the molecular
fusion device!"
entries.translation_source: And finally, turn on the molecular fusion device!
entries.translated:
Dan akhirnya, nyalakan perangkat
fusi molekuler!

entries.original:
"Now, once this cloak is on to shield
it from the light, it should become\lmobile\."
entries.translation_source: Now, once this cloak is on to shield it from the light, it should become mobile\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, setelah jubah ini
dipasang untuk melindunginya dari\lcahaya, ia seharusnya bisa bergerak\.

entries.original:
"It\.\CC0820 worked!

Now, let’s see if it can actually
move its body\."
entries.translation_source: It\.\CC0820 worked! Now, let’s see if it can actually move its body\.
entries.translated:
Itu\.\CC0820 berhasil! Sekarang, mari kita
lihat apakah ia benar-benar bisa\lmenggerakkan tubuhnya\.

entries.original: "Whoa!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa!
entries.translated: Whoa!

entries.original:
"Quick, Marlon!

Hand me that control gauntlet!"
entries.translation_source: Quick, Marlon! Hand me that control gauntlet!
entries.translated:
Cepat, Marlon! Berikan aku sarung
tangan kendali itu!

entries.original:
"Stay, creature!

You must obey!"
entries.translation_source: Stay, creature! You must obey!
entries.translated: Diam, makhluk! Kamu harus patuh!

entries.original: "Hmm\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\.
entries.translated: Hmm\.

entries.original:
"I’ll admit this is not what I was
originally hoping for.

However, this certainly is a step in
the right direction.

Given time, we should\.\CC0820 we should be
able to bring them back\."
entries.translation_source: I’ll admit this is not what I was originally hoping for. However, this certainly is a step in the right direction. Given time, we should\.\CC0820 we should be able to bring them back\.
entries.translated:
Saya akui ini bukan yang saya
harapkan sebelumnya. Namun, ini\lpasti langkah ke arah yang benar.

Seiring waktu, kita seharusnya\.\CC0820 kita
seharusnya bisa membawa mereka\lkembali\.

entries.original:
"All things considered, though, the
first test went rather smoothly."
entries.translation_source: All things considered, though, the first test went rather smoothly.
entries.translated:
Meskipun demikian, semua hal
dipertimbangkan, uji coba pertama\lberjalan cukup lancar.

entries.original:
"Fey said we had to continue the
research, not to let this setback\ltrip us up.

Her words\.\CC0818 spurred on by her,
we continued to work on the\lShadow Warriors.

However, even with the control
gauntlet, some proved difficult\lto control.

One lashed out at my face, leaving
this scar you see today.

Another lashed out at Marlon,
severing his arm.

And yet, despite our injuries, we
pressed on\."
entries.translation_source: Fey said we had to continue the research, not to let this setback trip us up. Her words\.\CC0818 spurred on by her, we continued to work on the Shadow Warriors. However, even with the control gauntlet, some proved difficult to control. One lashed out at my face, leaving this scar you see today. Another lashed out at Marlon, severing his arm. And yet, despite our injuries, we pressed on\.
entries.translated:
Fey berkata kami harus melanjutkan
penelitian, jangan sampai\lkemunduran ini menghentikan kami.

Kata-katanya\.\CC0818 terdorong olehnya,
kami terus mengerjakan Shadow\lWarriors. Namun, bahkan dengan

sarung tangan kendali, beberapa
terbukti sulit dikendalikan. Satu\lmenerjang wajahku, meninggalkan

bekas luka ini yang kau lihat
sekarang. Yang lain menerjang\lMarlon, memotong lengannya. Namun,

meskipun terluka, kami terus maju\.

entries.original:
"Over the course of several years,
the Science Society helped us\lcapture more Pokémon, and combine\lthem with more test subjects.

Some were living - as per Fey’s
request - and others were not."
entries.translation_source: Over the course of several years, the Science Society helped us capture more Pokémon, and combine them with more test subjects. Some were living - as per Fey’s request - and others were not.
entries.translated:
Selama beberapa tahun, Science
Society membantu kami menangkap\llebih banyak Pokémon, dan

menggabungkannya dengan lebih
banyak subjek uji. Beberapa masih\lhidup - sesuai permintaan Fey - dan

yang lainnya tidak.

entries.original:
"That is not to say we turned anyone
against their will, of course.

All grunts that became Shadow
Warriors did so willingly for the\lchance to gain great power\.

But Fey\.\CC0818 she was like a demoness,
driving us to crueller and crueller\lextremes, in order to revive our\lchildren.

Of course, I suspect she had
absolutely no interest in them\lat all.

It was always the Shadow Warriors
she was invested in."
entries.translation_source: That is not to say we turned anyone against their will, of course. All grunts that became Shadow Warriors did so willingly for the chance to gain great power\. But Fey\.\CC0818 she was like a demoness, driving us to crueller and crueller extremes, in order to revive our children. Of course, I suspect she had absolutely no interest in them at all. It was always the Shadow Warriors she was invested in.
entries.translated:
Itu bukan berarti kami memaksa
siapa pun, tentu saja. Semua grunt\lyang menjadi Shadow Warriors

melakukannya dengan sukarela demi
kesempatan mendapatkan kekuatan\lbesar\. Tapi Fey\.\CC0818 dia seperti iblis

betina, mendorong kami ke ekstrem
yang semakin kejam, untuk\lmenghidupkan kembali anak-anak

kami. Tentu saja, saya curiga dia
sama sekali tidak tertarik pada\lmereka. Yang selalu dia

investasikan adalah Shadow
Warriors.

entries.original:
"Eventually, we concluded we would
not be able to bring back our\lchildren using the Shadow Warriors.

Despite coming close with our last
trial, the cost to our children\lwould have been too great had\lwe continued in that same direction.

And so, we were forced to try a
new approach.

One that was extreme, yet plausible,
if recent events are anything to\lgo by\."
entries.translation_source: Eventually, we concluded we would not be able to bring back our children using the Shadow Warriors. Despite coming close with our last trial, the cost to our children would have been too great had we continued in that same direction. And so, we were forced to try a new approach. One that was extreme, yet plausible, if recent events are anything to go by\.
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, kami menyimpulkan bahwa
kami tidak akan bisa mengembalikan\lanak-anak kami menggunakan Shadow

Warriors. Meskipun hampir berhasil
dengan percobaan terakhir kami,\lbiaya bagi anak-anak kami akan

terlalu besar jika kami melanjutkan
ke arah yang sama. Jadi, kami\lterpaksa mencoba pendekatan baru.

Pendekatan yang ekstrem, namun
masuk akal, jika peristiwa\lbaru-baru ini bisa dijadikan acuan\.

entries.original:
"The plan was to bring the Ultimate
Weapon - the one mentioned in the\lold legends - here to Borrius.

But while that weapon may be
capable of mass destruction, it\lwas also the same device used to\lrestore the foreign king’s Pokémon.

And if the weapon could bring a
Pokémon back to life\.

\.it stands to reason it could
bring our children back as well\.

But how much of it was our idea\.?

And how much of it was Aklove’s
machinations\.?"
entries.translation_source: The plan was to bring the Ultimate Weapon - the one mentioned in the old legends - here to Borrius. But while that weapon may be capable of mass destruction, it was also the same device used to restore the foreign king’s Pokémon. And if the weapon could bring a Pokémon back to life\. \.it stands to reason it could bring our children back as well\. But how much of it was our idea\.? And how much of it was Aklove’s machinations\.?
entries.translated:
Rencananya adalah membawa Ultimate
Weapon - yang disebutkan dalam\llegenda kuno - ke sini, ke Borrius.

Tapi meskipun senjata itu mungkin
mampu menghancurkan massal, itu\ljuga perangkat yang sama yang

digunakan untuk memulihkan Pokémon
raja asing. Dan jika senjata itu\lbisa menghidupkan kembali Pokémon\.

\.masuk akal jika itu juga bisa
mengembalikan anak-anak kami\. Tapi\lseberapa banyak itu ide kami\.? Dan

seberapa banyak itu intrik Aklove\.?

entries.original:
"Yes\.\CC0818 under Zeph’s instructions, we
began researching the dark force\lof Borrius.

At the time, we hoped to use its
power to bring us the Ultimate\lWeapon.

Of course, we had no idea the dark
force was, in fact, Aros’s old\lpartner, Hoopa.

And from there\.\CC0818 you know the rest.

\. \. \. \.

Phew\.\CC0820 well, that was an explanation
and a half.

Take it all in, [player].

\.

Okay, now that you know what’s
really been going on, you should\lhave no hesitation about working\lwith us."
entries.translation_source: Yes\.\CC0818 under Zeph’s instructions, we began researching the dark force of Borrius. At the time, we hoped to use its power to bring us the Ultimate Weapon. Of course, we had no idea the dark force was, in fact, Aros’s old partner, Hoopa. And from there\.\CC0818 you know the rest. \. \. \. \. Phew\.\CC0820 well, that was an explanation and a half. Take it all in, [player]. \. Okay, now that you know what’s really been going on, you should have no hesitation about working with us.
entries.translated:
Ya\.\CC0818 di bawah instruksi Zeph, kami
mulai meneliti kekuatan gelap\lBorrius. Saat itu, kami berharap

menggunakan kekuatannya untuk
membawa Ultimate Weapon. Tentu\lsaja, kami tidak tahu bahwa

kekuatan gelap itu sebenarnya
adalah rekan lama Aros, Hoopa. Dan\ldari sana\.\CC0818 kau tahu sisanya. \. \. \. \.

Fiuh\.\CC0820 nah, itu penjelasan yang
panjang. Cerna semuanya, [player]. \.\lOke, sekarang setelah kau tahu apa

yang sebenarnya terjadi, kau
seharusnya tidak ragu untuk bekerja\lsama dengan kami.

entries.original:
"I should apologize, [player]\.

I believed you to be some sort of
spy, sent by Aklove.

If I’d known you were the real deal
all along, I would have reacted\lless\.\CC0818 violently."
entries.translation_source: I should apologize, [player]\. I believed you to be some sort of spy, sent by Aklove. If I’d known you were the real deal all along, I would have reacted less\.\CC0818 violently.
entries.translated:
Saya harus meminta maaf, [player]\.
Saya pikir kamu semacam mata-mata\lyang dikirim oleh Aklove. Jika saya

tahu kamu yang asli sejak awal,
saya akan bereaksi tidak terlalu\.\CC0818\lkasar.

entries.original:
"Sir!

We’ve detected remnants of Hoopa’s
portal energy in Vivill Town!

It’s quite likely the Light of Ruin’s
base!"
entries.translation_source: Sir! We’ve detected remnants of Hoopa’s portal energy in Vivill Town! It’s quite likely the Light of Ruin’s base!
entries.translated:
Tuan! Kami mendeteksi sisa-sisa
energi portal Hoopa di Vivill Town!\lKemungkinan besar itu markas Light

of Ruin!

entries.original:
"Vivill Town\.

So\.\CC0820 the old base used by the
Science Society, now serves as the\lLight of Ruin’s\.

I should have known\."
entries.translation_source: Vivill Town\. So\.\CC0820 the old base used by the Science Society, now serves as the Light of Ruin’s\. I should have known\.
entries.translated:
Vivill Town\. Jadi\.\CC0820 markas lama yang
digunakan oleh Science Society,\lsekarang menjadi milik Light of

Ruin\. Seharusnya aku tahu\.

entries.original:
"Marlon\.\CC0818 we cannot remain here
any longer.

Now that Aklove is distracted,
we must strike quickly!

It’s time to rally our fighting
force and depart for Vivill Town.

Prepare the Shadow!
We move out at once!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon\.\CC0818 we cannot remain here any longer. Now that Aklove is distracted, we must strike quickly! It’s time to rally our fighting force and depart for Vivill Town. Prepare the Shadow! We move out at once!
entries.translated:
Marlon\.\CC0818 kita tidak bisa tinggal di
sini lebih lama lagi. Sekarang\lAklove sedang terganggu, kita harus

menyerang cepat! Saatnya
mengumpulkan pasukan tempur kita\ldan berangkat ke Vivill Town.

Siapkan Shadow! Kita bergerak
segera!

entries.original:
"Of course, Zeph.

I doubt we have much time until
Aklove returns."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Zeph. I doubt we have much time until Aklove returns.
entries.translated:
Tentu, Zeph. Saya ragu kita punya
banyak waktu sampai Aklove kembali.

entries.original:
"And [player]\.\CC0818 please, don’t tell
[rival] about Ivory and me.

At least\.\CC0818 not until the time is
truly right.

That we neglected our children
in favour of another\.\CC0818 the thought\lwould sicken him."
