entries.translation_source: And [player]\.\CC0818 please, don’t tell [rival] about Ivory and me. At least\.\CC0818 not until the time is truly right. That we neglected our children in favour of another\.\CC0818 the thought would sicken him.
entries.translated:
Dan [player]\.\CC0818 tolong, jangan beri
tahu [rival] tentang Ivory dan\laku. Setidaknya\.\CC0818 sampai waktu yang

benar-benar tepat. Bahwa kami
menelantarkan anak-anak kami demi\lyang lain\.\CC0818 pikiran itu akan

membuatnya muak.

entries.original:
"Oh, before I forget, keep the
outfit.

I think it looks rather good on
you.

Who knows\.\CC0818 it may come in handy
someday."
entries.translation_source: Oh, before I forget, keep the outfit. I think it looks rather good on you. Who knows\.\CC0818 it may come in handy someday.
entries.translated:
Oh, sebelum aku lupa, simpan saja
pakaiannya. Menurutku itu terlihat\lcukup bagus padamu. Siapa tahu\.\CC0818

mungkin berguna suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Have you the means to cross water -
the HM for Surf?

If you cannot use it, then you
should first obtain [green]Dehara City[blue]’s\lGym Badge, before you regroup\lwith us.

We must reach [green]Vivill Town[blue] as soon
as possible, so please hurry.

It’s [green]northeast[blue] of [green]Dehara City[blue],
when you are ready."
entries.translation_source: Have you the means to cross water - the HM for Surf? If you cannot use it, then you should first obtain [green]Dehara City[blue]’s Gym Badge, before you regroup with us. We must reach [green]Vivill Town[blue] as soon as possible, so please hurry. It’s [green]northeast[blue] of [green]Dehara City[blue], when you are ready.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu memiliki cara untuk
menyeberangi air - HM Surf? Jika\lkamu tidak bisa menggunakannya,

maka kamu harus terlebih dahulu
mendapatkan Gym Badge [green]Dehara City[blue],\lsebelum bergabung kembali dengan

kami. Kita harus mencapai [green]Vivill
Town[blue] secepat mungkin, jadi tolong\lcepat. Letaknya di [green]timur laut[blue] dari

[green]Dehara City[blue], saat kamu siap.

entries.original:
"You’re seriously only leaving
Dehara now?

Man, you sure are slow!

Well, while you were loitering
around, I figured out how to get\lto the Ruins of Void.

Of course, by the time I got there,
it was too late to do anything\."
entries.translation_source: You’re seriously only leaving Dehara now? Man, you sure are slow! Well, while you were loitering around, I figured out how to get to the Ruins of Void. Of course, by the time I got there, it was too late to do anything\.
entries.translated:
Kamu serius baru berangkat dari
Dehara sekarang? Bung, kamu\lbenar-benar lambat! Yah, selagi

kamu berkeliaran, aku sudah tahu
cara menuju Ruins of Void. Tentu\lsaja, saat aku sampai di sana,

sudah terlambat untuk melakukan apa
pun\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
Just the [buffer1] I was looking for!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! Just the [buffer1] I was looking for!
entries.translated:
[player]! Tepat [buffer1] yang saya
cari!

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0818 who the heck are you
supposed to be?"
entries.translation_source: Wait\.\CC0818 who the heck are you supposed to be?
entries.translated: Tunggu\.\CC0818 siapa sebenarnya kamu ini?

entries.original:
"[player], have you seen Jax?

Last I heard, he was planning to
travel to the Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: [player], have you seen Jax? Last I heard, he was planning to travel to the Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
[player], apakah kamu melihat Jax?
Terakhir kudengar, dia berencana\lbepergian ke Ruins of Void.

entries.original:
"Whatever the Shadows were planning,
they’d already done it by the time\lI got there.

I saw signs of a battle, but nobody
was around\.\CC0818 and that includes\lanyone named Jax."
entries.translation_source: Whatever the Shadows were planning, they’d already done it by the time I got there. I saw signs of a battle, but nobody was around\.\CC0818 and that includes anyone named Jax.
entries.translated:
Apa pun yang direncanakan Shadows,
mereka sudah melakukannya saat saya\ltiba. Saya melihat tanda-tanda

pertempuran, tetapi tidak ada siapa
pun di sekitar\.\CC0818 dan itu termasuk\lsiapa pun yang bernama Jax.

entries.original:
"[player], you were the last one to
see him!

What happened in there?

\.

Aklove?
I’ve never heard of him before\.

And it’s just as I feared - the dark
force has been released at last\.

\.

What!? Aros has been trapped
inside a Cube, you say?

Utter madness!

\.

Oh no\.

If I know Zeph, there’s only one
thing he could have possibly done\lwith Jax\.

\.

Oh?
You say Jax wasn’t with Zeph?

That gives me hope\.\CC0818 he must still
be out there\.

I’m surprised Zeph agreed to work
with you, but you know the saying\.

\qoThe enemy of my enemy is my
friend.\qc"
entries.translation_source: [player], you were the last one to see him! What happened in there? \. Aklove? I’ve never heard of him before\. And it’s just as I feared - the dark force has been released at last\. \. What!? Aros has been trapped inside a Cube, you say? Utter madness! \. Oh no\. If I know Zeph, there’s only one thing he could have possibly done with Jax\. \. Oh? You say Jax wasn’t with Zeph? That gives me hope\.\CC0818 he must still be out there\. I’m surprised Zeph agreed to work with you, but you know the saying\. \qoThe enemy of my enemy is my friend.\qc
entries.translated:
[player], kamu yang terakhir
melihatnya! Apa yang terjadi di\lsana? \. Aklove? Aku belum pernah

mendengar namanya sebelumnya\. Dan
persis seperti yang aku takutkan -\lkekuatan gelap akhirnya dilepaskan\. \.

Apa!? Aros terperangkap di dalam
Cube, katamu? Benar-benar gila! \. Oh\ltidak\. Jika aku tahu Zeph, hanya ada

satu hal yang mungkin dia lakukan
dengan Jax\. \. Oh? Kamu bilang Jax\ltidak bersama Zeph? Itu memberiku

harapan\.\CC0818 dia pasti masih di luar
sana\. Aku terkejut Zeph setuju\lbekerja sama denganmu, tapi kau

tahu pepatah\. \qoMusuh dari musuhku
adalah temanku.\qc

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 I don’t like the sound of
what you told me.

If this Aklove, the one who controls
Hoopa, is working with Fey, then\lthey pose an even larger threat\lthan I suspected.

And if the Light of Ruin is another
branch like the Shadows, then that\lmeans only one thing\.

A recruitment drive\.\CC0818 to find more
people to turn into those\labominations!

How Hoopa fits into things, however,
I have no idea\."
entries.translation_source: [player]\.\CC0818 I don’t like the sound of what you told me. If this Aklove, the one who controls Hoopa, is working with Fey, then they pose an even larger threat than I suspected. And if the Light of Ruin is another branch like the Shadows, then that means only one thing\. A recruitment drive\.\CC0818 to find more people to turn into those abominations! How Hoopa fits into things, however, I have no idea\.
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 Aku tidak suka dengan apa
yang kau katakan. Jika Aklove, yang\lmengendalikan Hoopa, bekerja sama

dengan Fey, maka mereka menjadi
ancaman yang lebih besar dari yang\lkuduga. Dan jika Cahaya Kehancuran

adalah cabang lain seperti
Bayang-Bayang, maka itu berarti\lhanya satu hal\. Rekrutmen

besar-besaran\.\CC0818 untuk mencari lebih
banyak orang yang akan diubah\lmenjadi makhluk mengerikan itu!

Namun, bagaimana peran Hoopa dalam
semua ini, aku tidak tahu\.

entries.original:
"If they have taken Jax\.\CC0818 no,
I’ll try to stay optimistic.

Jax is a resourceful boy\.

But lately, he seems to be
contacting me less and less\.\land with less pep, every time.

[player], head over to Vivill Town.

Stop the Light of Ruin, and try to
find Jax.

Whether he’s there of his own free
will or not, I suspect he will be\lwith them."
entries.translation_source: If they have taken Jax\.\CC0818 no, I’ll try to stay optimistic. Jax is a resourceful boy\. But lately, he seems to be contacting me less and less\. and with less pep, every time. [player], head over to Vivill Town. Stop the Light of Ruin, and try to find Jax. Whether he’s there of his own free will or not, I suspect he will be with them.
entries.translated:
Jika mereka telah menangkap Jax\.\CC0818
tidak, aku akan berusaha tetap\loptimis. Jax adalah anak yang

cerdik\. Namun akhir-akhir ini, dia
sepertinya semakin jarang\lmenghubungiku\. dan dengan semangat

yang semakin berkurang, setiap
kali. [player], pergilah ke Vivill\lTown. Hentikan Light of Ruin, dan

coba temukan Jax. Entah dia ada di
sana atas kemauannya sendiri atau\ltidak, aku menduga dia akan bersama

mereka.

entries.original:
"Okay, that’s it!
I’ve had it!

I kept my yap shut all this time,
but I’m not just gonna be ignored\lanymore!

Listen, old man\.\CC0818 I have no idea
who you are, or what’s happening\.

But if whatever is going on has to
do with the Shadows, then I want in!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, that’s it! I’ve had it! I kept my yap shut all this time, but I’m not just gonna be ignored anymore! Listen, old man\.\CC0818 I have no idea who you are, or what’s happening\. But if whatever is going on has to do with the Shadows, then I want in!
entries.translated:
Oke, cukup! Aku sudah muak! Selama
ini aku menutup mulutku, tapi aku\ltidak akan diabaikan lagi! Dengar,

pak tua\.\CC0818 Aku tidak tahu siapa kamu,
atau apa yang terjadi\. Tapi jika\lsemua ini ada hubungannya dengan

Shadows, maka aku ikut!

entries.original:
"Oh! My apologies!
I didn’t mean to be rude.

Who might you be?"
entries.translation_source: Oh! My apologies! I didn’t mean to be rude. Who might you be?
entries.translated:
Oh! Maaf! Aku tidak bermaksud
bersikap kasar. Siapa kamu?

entries.original:
"I’m mad as all else!

I don’t care about this Light of
Ruin or whatever\.

I came this close to finding the
Shadows and finding my parents,\land they got away from me again!

So if I hear they’re heading to
Vivill Town, then that’s where\lI’m going!"
entries.translation_source: I’m mad as all else! I don’t care about this Light of Ruin or whatever\. I came this close to finding the Shadows and finding my parents, and they got away from me again! So if I hear they’re heading to Vivill Town, then that’s where I’m going!
entries.translated:
Aku sangat marah! Aku tidak peduli
dengan Light of Ruin atau apalah\.\lAku hampir saja menemukan Shadows

dan orang tuaku, tapi mereka lolos
lagi! Jadi jika aku dengar mereka\lmenuju ke Vivill Town, maka di

situlah aku akan pergi!

entries.original:
"Please, I urge you to wait!

As of now, the Shadows are our
pawns to fix a greater problem!

At least hold off on your act of
vengeance until this ordeal is\lover, understood?"
entries.translation_source: Please, I urge you to wait! As of now, the Shadows are our pawns to fix a greater problem! At least hold off on your act of vengeance until this ordeal is over, understood?
entries.translated:
Tolong, aku mohon kau tunggu! Saat
ini, Shadows adalah pion kita untuk\lmenyelesaikan masalah yang lebih

besar! Setidaknya tahanlah niat
balas dendammu sampai cobaan ini\lselesai, mengerti?

entries.original:
"They’re YOUR pawns, old man.
They’re MY only lead to my parents.

I’m not stupid.
I know what’s at stake.

But the second this is all over,
I won’t hesitate to shake ’em down\lfor what I want to know."
entries.translation_source: They’re YOUR pawns, old man. They’re MY only lead to my parents. I’m not stupid. I know what’s at stake. But the second this is all over, I won’t hesitate to shake ’em down for what I want to know.
entries.translated:
Mereka pionMU, pak tua. Mereka
satu-satunya petunjukku untuk\lmenemukan orang tuaku. Aku tidak

bodoh. Aku tahu apa yang
dipertaruhkan. Tapi begitu semua\lini selesai, aku tidak akan ragu

untuk menginterogasi mereka untuk
mendapatkan informasi yang\lkuinginkan.

entries.original:
"[player], since this is officially
your \qomission\qc, I’ll be waiting for\lyou in [green]Vivill Town[blue].

And for your sake, I’ll even
play nice with the Shadows until\lwe’re done.

Don’t be late, [player]."
entries.translation_source: [player], since this is officially your \qomission\qc, I’ll be waiting for you in [green]Vivill Town[blue]. And for your sake, I’ll even play nice with the Shadows until we’re done. Don’t be late, [player].
entries.translated:
[player], karena ini secara resmi
adalah \qomisi\qc-mu, aku akan\lmenunggumu di [green]Vivill Town[blue]. Dan demi

dirimu, aku akan bersikap baik
dengan Shadows sampai semuanya\lselesai. Jangan terlambat,

[player].

entries.original:
"That boy\.\CC0818 he’s got quite the mouth
to him\.

Well, I wish you luck in
Vivill Town, [player].

Let me know how it went, as soon
as you’ve returned."
entries.translation_source: That boy\.\CC0818 he’s got quite the mouth to him\. Well, I wish you luck in Vivill Town, [player]. Let me know how it went, as soon as you’ve returned.
entries.translated:
Anak itu\.\CC0818 dia cukup bicaranya\. Yah,
semoga beruntung di Vivill Town,\l[player]. Beri tahu aku bagaimana

hasilnya, segera setelah kau
kembali.

entries.original:
"Sheesh, about time you got here,
[player]."
entries.translation_source: Sheesh, about time you got here, [player].
entries.translated:
Sheesh, akhirnya kau sampai,
[player].

entries.original:
"Sorry\.\CC0818 I’m just a little on edge.

I’m getting close\.\CC0818 so close to
finding out what happened to\lmy parents\.

I guess it’s making me lose my cool
somehow."
entries.translation_source: Sorry\.\CC0818 I’m just a little on edge. I’m getting close\.\CC0818 so close to finding out what happened to my parents\. I guess it’s making me lose my cool somehow.
entries.translated:
Maaf\.\CC0818 Aku agak tegang. Aku semakin
dekat\.\CC0818 begitu dekat untuk mengetahui\lapa yang terjadi pada orang tuaku\.

Sepertinya itu membuatku kehilangan
ketenangan.

entries.original:
"While you were making your way
over, I tried scouting the area to\llook for the Shadows, but\. so far\lI’ve seen no sign of them."
entries.translation_source: While you were making your way over, I tried scouting the area to look for the Shadows, but\. so far I’ve seen no sign of them.
entries.translated:
Sementara kau dalam perjalanan, aku
mencoba mengintai area untuk\lmencari Shadows, tapi\. sejauh ini

aku tidak melihat tanda-tanda
mereka.

entries.original:
"It’s weird\.\CC0818 it’s like the entire town
is deserted.

The only person I saw was this guy
with a weird symbol on his outfit,\lhanging around the warehouse,\lnorth of town.

Is that the base of these
\qoLight of Ruin\qc guys?"
entries.translation_source: It’s weird\.\CC0818 it’s like the entire town is deserted. The only person I saw was this guy with a weird symbol on his outfit, hanging around the warehouse, north of town. Is that the base of these \qoLight of Ruin\qc guys?
entries.translated:
Aneh\.\CC0818 sepertinya seluruh kota sepi.
Satu-satunya orang yang kulihat\ladalah pria dengan simbol aneh di

pakaiannya, berkeliaran di gudang,
utara kota. Apakah itu markas para\l\qoLight of Ruin\qc itu?

entries.original:
"Well, only one way to find out.
I’m going on ahead.

If that is their base, then the
Shadows aren’t going to be far\lbehind."
entries.translation_source: Well, only one way to find out. I’m going on ahead. If that is their base, then the Shadows aren’t going to be far behind.
entries.translated:
Yah, hanya satu cara untuk
mengetahuinya. Aku akan maju\lduluan. Jika itu markas mereka,

maka Shadows tidak akan jauh di
belakang.

entries.original:
"You’re one of those Light of Ruin
thugs, aren’t you?

What’re you doing in this miserable
place, anyway?"
entries.translation_source: You’re one of those Light of Ruin thugs, aren’t you? What’re you doing in this miserable place, anyway?
entries.translated:
Kau salah satu preman Light of
Ruin, kan? Lagipula, apa yang kau\llakukan di tempat menyedihkan ini?

entries.original:
"What I’m doing here isn’t any of
your business, kid.

You’ll leave if you know what’s
good for you."
entries.translation_source: What I’m doing here isn’t any of your business, kid. You’ll leave if you know what’s good for you.
entries.translated:
Apa yang kulakukan di sini bukan
urusanmu, nak. Pergilah jika kau\ltahu yang terbaik untukmu.

entries.original:
"I think we’ve got the right place,
[player]!

He absolutely screams \qosuspicious\qc."
entries.translation_source: I think we’ve got the right place, [player]! He absolutely screams \qosuspicious\qc.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kita sudah sampai di
tempat yang tepat, [player]! Dia\lbenar-benar \qomencurigakan\qc.

entries.original:
"You’re not fooling anyone, pal.

We know this is your headquarters,
and we’re gonna be busting in\lwhether you like it or not!"
entries.translation_source: You’re not fooling anyone, pal. We know this is your headquarters, and we’re gonna be busting in whether you like it or not!
entries.translated:
Kau tidak membodohi siapa pun,
sobat. Kami tahu ini markasmu, dan\lkami akan masuk baik kau suka atau

tidak!

entries.original:
"CHZKKK\.

\.\CC0820Ma’am\.\CC0818 it looks like they came
after all.

But, I thought you said they would
have a small army with them\.

No, it’s just two Trainers\.

Understood.

No need for backup - I can deal
with them."
entries.translation_source: CHZKKK\. \.\CC0820Ma’am\.\CC0818 it looks like they came after all. But, I thought you said they would have a small army with them\. No, it’s just two Trainers\. Understood. No need for backup - I can deal with them.
entries.translated:
CHZKKK\. \.\CC0820Nyonya\.\CC0818 sepertinya mereka
tetap datang. Tapi, kupikir kau\lbilang mereka akan membawa pasukan

kecil\. Tidak, hanya dua Pelatih\.
Mengerti. Tidak perlu bantuan - aku\lbisa menangani mereka.

entries.original:
"You made a huge mistake,
coming here alone."
entries.translation_source: You made a huge mistake, coming here alone.
entries.translated:
Kau membuat kesalahan besar, datang
ke sini sendirian.

entries.original:
"You think we’re alone?
Keep dreaming.

When our backup arrives,
you’ll eat those words!"
entries.translation_source: You think we’re alone? Keep dreaming. When our backup arrives, you’ll eat those words!
entries.translated:
Kau pikir kita sendirian? Terus
bermimpi. Saat bala bantuan kami\ltiba, kau akan menelan kata-kata

itu!

entries.original:
"Ha ha\.\CC0818 well, thank you for
confirming our suspicions\.

\.\CC0818not that any of it matters.

Do you think there’ll be a welcome
mat for you behind these doors?

I’ll spare you from guessing - it’s
our entire Light of Ruin branch!

There isn’t a force in Borrius large
enough to take us on!

You arrogant little fools have no
idea what you’ve stepped into!"
entries.translation_source: Ha ha\.\CC0818 well, thank you for confirming our suspicions\. \.\CC0818not that any of it matters. Do you think there’ll be a welcome mat for you behind these doors? I’ll spare you from guessing - it’s our entire Light of Ruin branch! There isn’t a force in Borrius large enough to take us on! You arrogant little fools have no idea what you’ve stepped into!
entries.translated:
Ha ha\.\CC0818 baiklah, terima kasih telah
memastikan kecurigaan kami\. \.\CC0818{D6}ukan\litu masalahnya. Apakah kau pikir

akan ada keset sambutan untukmu di
balik pintu-pintu ini? Aku akan\lmengampuni tebakanmu - itu adalah

seluruh cabang Light of Ruin kami!
Tidak ada kekuatan di Borrius yang\lcukup besar untuk melawan kami!

Kalian orang-orang bodoh yang
sombong tidak tahu apa yang telah\lkalian hadapi!

entries.original:
"Sorry, but nothing is gonna stop me
from getting what I want.

Not you and not your entire branch!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry, but nothing is gonna stop me from getting what I want. Not you and not your entire branch!
entries.translated:
Maaf, tapi tidak ada yang akan
menghentikanku untuk mendapatkan\lapa yang kuinginkan. Bukan kau dan

bukan seluruh cabangmu!

entries.original: "Now’s my chance!"
entries.translation_source: Now’s my chance!
entries.translated: Ini kesempatanku!

entries.original:
"\.\CC0818What?

C’mon, he was being obnoxious.
He totally had it coming."
entries.translation_source: \.\CC0818What? C’mon, he was being obnoxious. He totally had it coming.
entries.translated:
\.\CC0818{BB}pa? Ayolah, dia bersikap
menyebalkan. Dia memang pantas\lmendapatkannya.

entries.original:
"Quick, let’s head inside while he’s
still unconcious."
entries.translation_source: Quick, let’s head inside while he’s still unconcious.
entries.translated:
Cepat, ayo masuk ke dalam selagi
dia masih pingsan.

entries.original:
"Man, those Shadow guys sure know
how to make an entrance\."
entries.translation_source: Man, those Shadow guys sure know how to make an entrance\.
entries.translated:
Wah, orang-orang Shadow itu memang
tahu cara membuat masuk yang\lspektakuler\.

entries.original:
"We don’t have much time, [player].

That grunt I knocked out could
wake up any minute now, so we\lreally need to get moving.

The only thing is\."
entries.translation_source: We don’t have much time, [player]. That grunt I knocked out could wake up any minute now, so we really need to get moving. The only thing is\.
entries.translated:
Kita tidak punya banyak waktu,
[player]. Anggota rendahan yang aku\lpingsankan bisa bangun kapan saja,

jadi kita benar-benar harus
bergerak. Satu-satunya masalah\ladalah\.

entries.original:
"That door up ahead looks like our
only way through\.

And there’s probably plenty more
grunts on the other side.

So, do we sneak past ’em, or try to
fight our way through\.?"
entries.translation_source: That door up ahead looks like our only way through\. And there’s probably plenty more grunts on the other side. So, do we sneak past ’em, or try to fight our way through\.?
entries.translated:
Pintu di depan itu sepertinya
satu-satunya jalan kita\. Dan mungkin\lada banyak anggota rendahan di sisi

lain. Jadi, apakah kita menyelinap
melewati mereka, atau mencoba\lbertarung melewati\.?

entries.original:
"What the\.\CC0820
How did a Shadow Warrior get here?"
entries.translation_source: What the\.\CC0820 How did a Shadow Warrior get here?
entries.translated:
Apa apaan\.\CC0820 Bagaimana Shadow Warrior
bisa sampai di sini?

entries.original:
"We aren’t equipped to deal with
these anymore!

Let’s get out of here!"
entries.translation_source: We aren’t equipped to deal with these anymore! Let’s get out of here!
entries.translated:
Kita tidak lagi dilengkapi untuk
menghadapi mereka! Ayo keluar dari\lsini!

entries.original: "Come on\.\CC0810 open up\.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: Come on\.\CC0810 open up\.\CC0830
entries.translated: Ayolah\.\CC0810 buka\.\CC0830

entries.original: "Got it! We’re safe now!\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: Got it! We’re safe now!\CC0830
entries.translated: Berhasil! Kita aman sekarang!\CC0830

entries.original: "What the\.\CC0820 who’s this guy, anyway?"
entries.translation_source: What the\.\CC0820 who’s this guy, anyway?
entries.translated: Apa apaan\.\CC0820 siapa sih orang ini?

entries.original: "W-what? This isn’t a person at all!"
entries.translation_source: W-what? This isn’t a person at all!
entries.translated:
A-apa? Ini sama sekali bukan
manusia!

entries.original:
"Hey, [player]!

This one of your Shadow buddies?
Call it off!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player]! This one of your Shadow buddies? Call it off!
entries.translated:
Hei, [player]! Ini salah satu teman
Shadow-mu? Hentikan!

entries.original:
"Geez\. that was close\.

What on earth was that thing,
anyway?

A few more seconds, and it could’ve
burnt us to a crisp!

\.

What’s that?

It’s called a Shadow Warrior?

That’s\.\CC0818 uh, a pretty unimaginative
name, honestly."
entries.translation_source: Geez\. that was close\. What on earth was that thing, anyway? A few more seconds, and it could’ve burnt us to a crisp! \. What’s that? It’s called a Shadow Warrior? That’s\.\CC0818 uh, a pretty unimaginative name, honestly.
entries.translated:
Ya ampun\. itu tadi dekat\. Apa
sebenarnya benda itu? Beberapa\ldetik lagi, dan itu bisa membakar

kita hangus! \. Apa itu? Namanya
Shadow Warrior? Itu\.\CC0818 uh, nama yang\lcukup tidak imajinatif, sejujurnya.

entries.original:
"But hey, at least it did us
a favour and cleared the path.

Let’s just hope there aren’t too many
more of them\."
entries.translation_source: But hey, at least it did us a favour and cleared the path. Let’s just hope there aren’t too many more of them\.
entries.translated:
Tapi hei, setidaknya itu membantu
kita dan membersihkan jalan. Mari\lkita berharap tidak ada terlalu

banyak dari mereka\.

entries.original: "Stop\.\CC0820 stop\.\CC0820 right there![pause]"
entries.translation_source: Stop\.\CC0820 stop\.\CC0820 right there![pause]
entries.translated: Berhenti\.\CC0820 berhenti\.\CC0820 di situ![pause]

entries.original:
"I don’t care if you’ve already made
it inside\.

I can still drag you right back
out!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t care if you’ve already made it inside\. I can still drag you right back out!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak peduli jika kalian sudah
berhasil masuk\. Aku masih bisa\lmenyeret kalian keluar!

entries.original:
"CHZKKK\.

Hello\.\CC0818 can anyone hear me?

Darn!

That brat must have damaged my
communicator\."
entries.translation_source: CHZKKK\. Hello\.\CC0818 can anyone hear me? Darn! That brat must have damaged my communicator\.
entries.translated:
CHZKKK\. Halo\.\CC0818 adakah yang bisa
mendengarku? Sial! Bocah itu pasti\lmerusak komunikatorku\.

entries.original:
"Fine - I’ll have to alert everyone
else in person!"
entries.translation_source: Fine - I’ll have to alert everyone else in person!
entries.translated:
Baik - aku harus memberitahu semua
yang lain secara langsung!

entries.original:
"And you call yourself a guard?

Attacking someone with a weakened
Pokémon is a sure way to lose!"
entries.translation_source: And you call yourself a guard? Attacking someone with a weakened Pokémon is a sure way to lose!
entries.translated:
Dan kau menyebut dirimu penjaga?
Menyerang seseorang dengan Pokémon\lyang lemah adalah cara pasti untuk

kalah!

entries.original:
"Why you\.

I’ll be back!

Once I get reinforcements, it’ll
be all over for you two!"
entries.translation_source: Why you\. I’ll be back! Once I get reinforcements, it’ll be all over for you two!
entries.translated:
Dasar kau\. Aku akan kembali! Begitu
aku mendapatkan bala bantuan,\lkalian berdua akan selesai!

entries.original:
"If that’s all the Light of Ruin
has, this’ll be a breeze!

So much for his \qobranch\qc of
grunts\.

I wonder where they are, anyway?"
entries.translation_source: If that’s all the Light of Ruin has, this’ll be a breeze! So much for his \qobranch\qc of grunts\. I wonder where they are, anyway?
entries.translated:
Jika itu saja yang dimiliki Light
of Ruin, ini akan mudah! Begitulah\l\qocabang\qc para grunt\. Aku penasaran

di mana mereka sebenarnya?

entries.original: "The shaking is over\.\CC0820"
entries.translation_source: The shaking is over\.\CC0820
entries.translated: Guncangan sudah berakhir\.\CC0820

entries.original: "[red]Did they make it in?\CC0820"
entries.translation_source: [red]Did they make it in?\CC0820
entries.translated: [red]Apakah mereka berhasil masuk?\CC0820

entries.original:
"Get ready everyone, they’re coming
down the stairs!\CC0820"
entries.translation_source: Get ready everyone, they’re coming down the stairs!\CC0820
entries.translated:
Bersiaplah semuanya, mereka turun
dari tangga!\CC0820

entries.original:
"[red]Ahh!
They’re behind us!\CC0820"
entries.translation_source: [red]Ahh! They’re behind us!\CC0820
entries.translated: [red]Ahh! Mereka di belakang kita!\CC0820

entries.original: "[blue]Everybody run!\CC0810"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Everybody run!\CC0810
entries.translated: [blue]Semua lari!\CC0810

entries.original:
"I guess it doesn’t really
matter.

One less hurdle for us!"
entries.translation_source: I guess it doesn’t really matter. One less hurdle for us!
entries.translated:
Kurasa itu tidak masalah. Satu
rintangan berkurang untuk kita!

entries.original:
"Let’s find the Shadows so we can
end this thing.

The sooner we do that, the sooner I
can get what I want from them!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s find the Shadows so we can end this thing. The sooner we do that, the sooner I can get what I want from them!
entries.translated:
Ayo cari Shadow agar kita bisa
mengakhiri ini. Semakin cepat kita\lmelakukannya, semakin cepat aku

mendapatkan apa yang kuinginkan
dari mereka!

entries.original:
"What?
You want to help?

I need 6 letters to open this door.

I already have one of them, so I
just need [green]5[blue] more.

Do you know the other letters?"
entries.translation_source: What? You want to help? I need 6 letters to open this door. I already have one of them, so I just need [green]5[blue] more. Do you know the other letters?
entries.translated:
Apa? Kau ingin membantu? Aku butuh
6 huruf untuk membuka pintu ini.\lAku sudah punya satu, jadi aku

hanya perlu [green]5[blue] lagi. Apakah kau tahu
huruf lainnya?

entries.original:
"You’ve only learned [green][buffer1][blue] of the
letters so far.

Come back here once you’ve learned
all [green]5[blue]."
entries.translation_source: You’ve only learned [green][buffer1][blue] of the letters so far. Come back here once you’ve learned all [green]5[blue].
entries.translated:
Kau baru belajar [green][buffer1][blue] huruf
sejauh ini. Kembali ke sini setelah\lkau belajar semua [green]5[blue].

entries.original:
"You haven’t learned any of the
other letters yet\.

Come back here once you’ve learned
all [green]5[blue]."
entries.translation_source: You haven’t learned any of the other letters yet\. Come back here once you’ve learned all [green]5[blue].
entries.translated:
Kau belum belajar huruf lainnya
sama sekali\. Kembali ke sini setelah\lkau belajar semua [green]5[blue].

entries.original:
"Come back here once you’ve learned
all [green]5[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Come back here once you’ve learned all [green]5[blue].
entries.translated:
Kembali ke sini setelah kau belajar
semua [green]5[blue].

entries.original: "Please enter the other [green]5[blue] letters."
entries.translation_source: Please enter the other [green]5[blue] letters.
entries.translated: Silakan masukkan [green]5[blue] huruf lainnya.

entries.original: "aklov"
entries.translation_source: aklov
entries.translated: aklov

entries.original:
"That doesn’t look like the correct
password\."
entries.translation_source: That doesn’t look like the correct password\.
entries.translated:
Itu tidak terlihat seperti kata
sandi yang benar\.

entries.original: "And the last letter is E\."
entries.translation_source: And the last letter is E\.
entries.translated: Dan huruf terakhir adalah E\.

entries.original: "The door is open for you, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: The door is open for you, Zeph.
entries.translated: Pintu terbuka untukmu, Zeph.

entries.original:
"Good work, scientist.

I should have known that arrogant
fool would make the password his\lown name\."
entries.translation_source: Good work, scientist. I should have known that arrogant fool would make the password his own name\.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, ilmuwan. Aku
seharusnya tahu bahwa si bodoh\lsombong itu akan membuat kata

sandinya menjadi namanya sendiri\.

entries.original:
"Marlon, has that boy returned with
the bottle yet?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, has that boy returned with the bottle yet?
entries.translated:
Marlon, apakah anak itu sudah
kembali dengan botolnya?

entries.original:
"No, he hasn’t.
He must still be searching for it."
entries.translation_source: No, he hasn’t. He must still be searching for it.
entries.translated:
Tidak, dia belum. Dia pasti masih
mencarinya.

entries.original:
"We’ll have to proceed without
him, then.

Aklove still appears to be with
Fey, so with luck, we won’t need\lthe bottle."
entries.translation_source: We’ll have to proceed without him, then. Aklove still appears to be with Fey, so with luck, we won’t need the bottle.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, kita harus
melanjutkan tanpa dia. Aklove\lsepertinya masih bersama Fey, jadi

semoga beruntung, kita tidak akan
membutuhkan botol itu.

entries.original:
"Ivory!

So my suspicions were correct -
you HAVE betrayed us."
entries.translation_source: Ivory! So my suspicions were correct - you HAVE betrayed us.
entries.translated:
Ivory! Jadi kecurigaanku benar -
kamu TELAH mengkhianati kami.

entries.original:
"[red]I betrayed you?
That’s simply untrue, Zeph.

My position\.\CC0818 my goals\.\CC0818 they haven’t
changed one bit.

It was you, who betrayed us\.\CC0818
when you refused to accept\lAklove as your replacement."
entries.translation_source: [red]I betrayed you? That’s simply untrue, Zeph. My position\.\CC0818 my goals\.\CC0818 they haven’t changed one bit. It was you, who betrayed us\.\CC0818 when you refused to accept Aklove as your replacement.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku mengkhianatimu? Itu tidak
benar, Zeph. Posisiku\.\CC0818 tujuanku\.\CC0818\ltidak berubah sedikit pun. Kaulah

yang mengkhianati kami\.\CC0818 ketika kau
menolak menerima Aklove sebagai\lpenggantimu.

entries.original:
"[red]After Aklove took over the
leadership at the Ruins of Void, he\lgave me an offer I couldn’t refuse.

If I assist in his grand plan, then
he’ll grant me the power to finish\lwhat we started.

So don’t you see, Zeph?
This was the best course of action\."
entries.translation_source: [red]After Aklove took over the leadership at the Ruins of Void, he gave me an offer I couldn’t refuse. If I assist in his grand plan, then he’ll grant me the power to finish what we started. So don’t you see, Zeph? This was the best course of action\.
entries.translated:
[red]Setelah Aklove mengambil alih
kepemimpinan di Reruntuhan\lKekosongan, dia memberiku tawaran

yang tidak bisa kutolak. Jika aku
membantu rencana besarnya, maka dia\lakan memberiku kekuatan untuk

menyelesaikan apa yang kita mulai.
Jadi, tidakkah kau lihat, Zeph? Ini\ladalah tindakan terbaik\.

entries.original:
"Grand plan?
You fool, Ivory!

He made it no secret to us that he
intends to destroy Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Grand plan? You fool, Ivory! He made it no secret to us that he intends to destroy Borrius!
entries.translated:
Rencana besar? Kau bodoh, Ivory!
Dia tidak merahasiakan dari kita\lbahwa dia berniat menghancurkan

Borrius!

entries.original: "[red]Grunts\.\CC0820 leave us, for now."
entries.translation_source: [red]Grunts\.\CC0820 leave us, for now.
entries.translated:
[red]Para prajurit\.\CC0820 tinggalkan kami,
untuk saat ini.

entries.original:
"[red]Perhaps that’s his aim\.\CC0818 but his
aim aligns with ours.

Like us, he intends to use Hoopa’s
power to bring the Ultimate Weapon\lto Borrius.

And then, using the Shadow Warriors
as fuel\.\CC0818 he’ll engage it."
entries.translation_source: [red]Perhaps that’s his aim\.\CC0818 but his aim aligns with ours. Like us, he intends to use Hoopa’s power to bring the Ultimate Weapon to Borrius. And then, using the Shadow Warriors as fuel\.\CC0818 he’ll engage it.
entries.translated:
[red]Mungkin itu tujuannya\.\CC0818 tapi
tujuannya selaras dengan kita.\lSeperti kita, dia berniat

menggunakan kekuatan Hoopa untuk
membawa Senjata Pamungkas ke\lBorrius. Dan kemudian, menggunakan

Shadow Warriors sebagai bahan bakar\.\CC0818
dia akan mengaktifkannya.

entries.original:
"[red]When the dust settles, I’ll be
granted use of the weapon to\lrestore my son\."
entries.translation_source: [red]When the dust settles, I’ll be granted use of the weapon to restore my son\.
entries.translated:
[red]Saat semuanya reda, aku akan
diberikan izin menggunakan senjata\litu untuk memulihkan anakku\.

entries.original:
"What\.\CC0818 how can you do this?

What’s the point in helping him, when
it leaves us without a home to\lreturn to!?

It’ll destroy everything!

And that includes the children we
still have living here!"
entries.translation_source: What\.\CC0818 how can you do this? What’s the point in helping him, when it leaves us without a home to return to!? It’ll destroy everything! And that includes the children we still have living here!
entries.translated:
Apa\.\CC0818 bagaimana kau bisa melakukan
ini? Apa gunanya membantu dia, jika\litu membuat kita tanpa rumah untuk

kembali!? Itu akan menghancurkan
segalanya! Dan itu termasuk\lanak-anak yang masih kita miliki

yang tinggal di sini!

entries.original:
"[red]Marlon\.\CC0818 of course I’ve prepared
for that inevitable outcome.

Aklove has agreed to safeguard our
children until this whole ordeal\lhas passed.

At the end of it all, yes, Borrius
may be gone\.

But, our entire family will be
reunited once again\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Marlon\.\CC0818 of course I’ve prepared for that inevitable outcome. Aklove has agreed to safeguard our children until this whole ordeal has passed. At the end of it all, yes, Borrius may be gone\. But, our entire family will be reunited once again\.
entries.translated:
[red]Marlon\.\CC0818 tentu saja aku sudah bersiap
untuk hasil yang tak terhindarkan\litu. Aklove setuju untuk melindungi

anak-anak kita sampai semua cobaan
ini berlalu. Pada akhirnya, ya,\lBorrius mungkin akan lenyap\. Tapi,

seluruh keluarga kita akan bersatu
kembali lagi\.

entries.original:
"Listen to yourself, Ivory!

You’re claiming our entire plan\.\CC0818 is
worth sacrificing an entire region!

It was always one thing to use the
lives of willing grunts to create\lthe Shadow Warriors\.

But these are countless innocent
lives you’d be wiping out!"
entries.translation_source: Listen to yourself, Ivory! You’re claiming our entire plan\.\CC0818 is worth sacrificing an entire region! It was always one thing to use the lives of willing grunts to create the Shadow Warriors\. But these are countless innocent lives you’d be wiping out!
entries.translated:
Dengarkan dirimu sendiri, Ivory!
Kau mengklaim seluruh rencana kita\.\CC0818\llayak mengorbankan seluruh wilayah!

Itu selalu satu hal untuk
menggunakan nyawa prajurit yang\lrela untuk menciptakan Shadow

Warriors\. Tapi ini adalah nyawa tak
berdosa yang tak terhitung\ljumlahnya yang akan kau musnahkan!

entries.original:
"I agree with Marlon, Ivory.

I’ve crossed many lines, but this is
one I refuse to overstep\.

And I cannot allow you to do
the same.

Borrius is my home\.\CC0818 no, our home!

And that includes my own son\.\CC0818
he still needs a home to return to!

Shadow Warrior!
Seize her!

I’m sorry, but this is necessary,
Ivory\."
entries.translation_source: I agree with Marlon, Ivory. I’ve crossed many lines, but this is one I refuse to overstep\. And I cannot allow you to do the same. Borrius is my home\.\CC0818 no, our home! And that includes my own son\.\CC0818 he still needs a home to return to! Shadow Warrior! Seize her! I’m sorry, but this is necessary, Ivory\.
entries.translated:
Aku setuju dengan Marlon, Ivory.
Aku sudah melewati banyak batas,\ltapi ini adalah satu yang aku tolak

untuk dilampaui\. Dan aku tidak bisa
membiarkanmu melakukan hal yang\lsama. Borrius adalah rumahku\.\CC0818 bukan,

rumah kita! Dan itu termasuk anakku
sendiri\.\CC0818 dia masih perlu rumah untuk\lkembali! Shadow Warrior! Tangkap

dia! Maaf, tapi ini perlu, Ivory\.

entries.original:
"[red]What now, Marlon?

Are you really going to let Zeph
do this?

Will you truly allow him to sacrifice
everything we’ve worked so hard\lfor, all these years\.?"
entries.translation_source: [red]What now, Marlon? Are you really going to let Zeph do this? Will you truly allow him to sacrifice everything we’ve worked so hard for, all these years\.?
entries.translated:
[red]Apa sekarang, Marlon? Apakah kau
benar-benar akan membiarkan Zeph\lmelakukan ini? Apakah kau sungguh

akan mengizinkannya mengorbankan
semua yang telah kita perjuangkan\ldengan susah payah, selama ini\.?

entries.original:
"Without a doubt in my mind, Ivory.

I have no hesitation, anymore.

You can ask a thousand times,
and I wouldn’t change my answer."
entries.translation_source: Without a doubt in my mind, Ivory. I have no hesitation, anymore. You can ask a thousand times, and I wouldn’t change my answer.
entries.translated:
Tanpa keraguan sedikit pun di
pikiranku, Ivory. Aku tidak ragu\llagi. Kau bisa bertanya seribu

kali, dan aku tidak akan mengubah
jawabanku.

entries.original:
"[red]Suit yourself.

Even if you lock me up, it will only
delay the inevitable.

Aklove will find the Ultimate
Weapon, and when he does\.

At last, he will keep his promise
to me\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Suit yourself. Even if you lock me up, it will only delay the inevitable. Aklove will find the Ultimate Weapon, and when he does\. At last, he will keep his promise to me\.
entries.translated:
[red]Terserah kau. Bahkan jika kau
mengunciku, itu hanya akan menunda\lyang tak terhindarkan. Aklove akan

menemukan Senjata Pamungkas, dan
ketika dia melakukannya\. Akhirnya,\ldia akan menepati janjinya padaku\.

entries.original:
"Oh, we have no intention of holding
you for long.

We just need you out of the way
so we can disrupt your plans.

Once we discover where you’re
keeping the rest of the Shadow\lWarriors, Aklove’s big scheme will\lbe over.

You said it yourself, Ivory.

Without them, you have nothing to
power the weapon."
entries.translation_source: Oh, we have no intention of holding you for long. We just need you out of the way so we can disrupt your plans. Once we discover where you’re keeping the rest of the Shadow Warriors, Aklove’s big scheme will be over. You said it yourself, Ivory. Without them, you have nothing to power the weapon.
entries.translated:
Oh, kami tidak berniat menahanmu
lama-lama. Kami hanya perlu kamu\lkeluar dari jalan agar kami bisa

mengacaukan rencanamu. Setelah kami
menemukan di mana kamu menyimpan\lsisa Shadow Warriors, rencana besar

Aklove akan berakhir. Kau sendiri
yang mengatakannya, Ivory. Tanpa\lmereka, kau tidak punya apa-apa

untuk memberi daya pada senjata
itu.

entries.original: "[red]Right on cue\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Right on cue\.
entries.translated: [red]Tepat pada waktunya\.

entries.original:
"No, no, no!
It’s too soon for him to return!"
entries.translation_source: No, no, no! It’s too soon for him to return!
entries.translated:
Tidak, tidak, tidak! Masih terlalu
dini baginya untuk kembali!

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0818 why have I stopped receiving
the pertinent information needed to\llocate the Ultimate Weapon?"
entries.translation_source: Ivory\.\CC0818 why have I stopped receiving the pertinent information needed to locate the Ultimate Weapon?
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0818 mengapa aku berhenti menerima
informasi yang diperlukan untuk\lmenemukan Senjata Pamungkas?

entries.original:
"[red]I apologize, Aklove.

The Shadows have proven more
troublesome than we anticipated.

Unfortunately, the Pokémon you
summoned to patrol the waters\lfailed to repel them.

The Shadows were able to bombard
the cliffside, shattering the wall\land flooding the Research Lab."
entries.translation_source: [red]I apologize, Aklove. The Shadows have proven more troublesome than we anticipated. Unfortunately, the Pokémon you summoned to patrol the waters failed to repel them. The Shadows were able to bombard the cliffside, shattering the wall and flooding the Research Lab.
entries.translated:
[red]Saya minta maaf, Aklove. Para
Bayangan ternyata lebih merepotkan\ldari yang kami perkirakan.

Sayangnya, Pokémon yang Anda
panggil untuk berpatroli di\lperairan gagal mengusir mereka.

Para Bayangan berhasil mengebom
tebing, menghancurkan dinding, dan\lmembanjiri Lab Penelitian.

entries.original:
"WHAT!?

My data on the Ultimate Weapon has
been destroyed!?"
entries.translation_source: WHAT!? My data on the Ultimate Weapon has been destroyed!?
entries.translated:
APA!? Data saya tentang Senjata
Pamungkas telah hancur!?

entries.original:
"[red]Most of it is too corrupted to be
recovered.

But we did learn something vital
before the attack.

The Ultimate Weapon is no longer in
your home region\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Most of it is too corrupted to be recovered. But we did learn something vital before the attack. The Ultimate Weapon is no longer in your home region\.
entries.translated:
[red]Sebagian besar terlalu rusak untuk
dipulihkan. Tapi kami mempelajari\lsesuatu yang vital sebelum

serangan. Senjata Pamungkas sudah
tidak berada di wilayah asal Anda\.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.\CC0818 we will discuss this
further, once I have dealt with\lthe intruders."
entries.translation_source: Interesting\.\CC0818 we will discuss this further, once I have dealt with the intruders.
entries.translated:
Menarik\.\CC0818 kita akan membahas ini
lebih lanjut, setelah aku menangani\lpara penyusup.

entries.original:
"Zeph\.\CC0818 did you really think you would
be able to stop me?

What you have accomplished is no
more than an inconvenience.

No one will stop me, Zeph!
Not even you!

I WILL find the weapon!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph\.\CC0818 did you really think you would be able to stop me? What you have accomplished is no more than an inconvenience. No one will stop me, Zeph! Not even you! I WILL find the weapon!
entries.translated:
Zeph\.\CC0818 apakah kamu benar-benar
mengira kamu bisa menghentikanku?\lApa yang telah kamu capai tidak

lebih dari ketidaknyamanan. Tidak
ada yang akan menghentikanku, Zeph!\lBahkan kamu pun tidak! AKU AKAN

menemukan senjata itu!

entries.original:
"Alright, I held up my end of
the deal, you goon.

I’m pretty sure I found what you’re
looking for\.

But you’re not getting it just yet.

Tell me what I want to know,
and I’ll hand it over. Got it?"
entries.translation_source: Alright, I held up my end of the deal, you goon. I’m pretty sure I found what you’re looking for\. But you’re not getting it just yet. Tell me what I want to know, and I’ll hand it over. Got it?
entries.translated:
Baiklah, aku menepati bagianku dari
kesepakatan, dasar preman. Aku\lcukup yakin aku menemukan apa yang

kamu cari\. Tapi kamu belum bisa
mendapatkannya sekarang. Katakan\lapa yang ingin aku ketahui, dan aku

akan menyerahkannya. Mengerti?

entries.original:
"I have no time for your games,
boy!

Give it to me!"
entries.translation_source: I have no time for your games, boy! Give it to me!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak punya waktu untuk
permainanmu, nak! Berikan padaku!

entries.original:
"No way, old man.

Tell me what you did to my parents,
and it’s all yours."
entries.translation_source: No way, old man. Tell me what you did to my parents, and it’s all yours.
entries.translated:
Tidak mungkin, pak tua. Katakan apa
yang kau lakukan pada orang tuaku,\ldan ini semua milikmu.

entries.original: "Now’s really not the time for\."
entries.translation_source: Now’s really not the time for\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang benar-benar bukan waktunya
untuk\.

entries.original: "ENOUGH! Do you mind?"
entries.translation_source: ENOUGH! Do you mind?
entries.translated: CUKUP! Apa kau keberatan?

entries.original:
"Oh, you must be the big-wig
everyone’s talking about.

Aklove, I’m guessing.

Shut your trap, pal.
I’m not here for you."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you must be the big-wig everyone’s talking about. Aklove, I’m guessing. Shut your trap, pal. I’m not here for you.
entries.translated:
Oh, kau pasti orang penting yang
dibicarakan semua orang. Aklove,\laku tebak. Tutup mulutmu, teman.

Aku di sini bukan untukmu.

entries.original: "How dare you\."
entries.translation_source: How dare you\.
entries.translated: Beraninya kau\.

entries.original:
"HOW DARE YOU!

I am a patient man, but I have no
tolerance for your disrespect,\lyou little brat!"
entries.translation_source: HOW DARE YOU! I am a patient man, but I have no tolerance for your disrespect, you little brat!
entries.translated:
BERANINYA KAU! Aku adalah pria yang
sabar, tapi aku tidak punya\ltoleransi untuk ketidakhormatanmu,

dasar anak nakal!

entries.original:
"Hoopa!
Send him to\."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Send him to\.
entries.translated: Hoopa! Kirim dia ke\.

entries.original: "[red]Aklove, wait!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Aklove, wait!
entries.translated: [red]Aklove, tunggu!

entries.original:
"[red]Our deal\.\CC0820 don’t forget what you
promised me!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Our deal\.\CC0820 don’t forget what you promised me!
entries.translated:
[red]Kesepakatan kita\.\CC0820 jangan lupa apa
yang kau janjikan padaku!

entries.original:
"Our deal\.?

Ha\.\CC0820 ha ha ha ha\.\CC0818 you mean to
tell me THIS is your son?"
entries.translation_source: Our deal\.? Ha\.\CC0820 ha ha ha ha\.\CC0818 you mean to tell me THIS is your son?
entries.translated:
Kesepakatan kita\.? Ha\.\CC0820 ha ha ha ha\.\CC0818
maksudmu, INI anakmu?

entries.original:
"Your son\.?

No\.\CC0820 no, it can’t be\.\CC0818 it has to be
a lie\.!

My parents\.\CC0820 they’d never do such
horrible things\.

They can’t be members of
the Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Your son\.? No\.\CC0820 no, it can’t be\.\CC0818 it has to be a lie\.! My parents\.\CC0820 they’d never do such horrible things\. They can’t be members of the Shadows!
entries.translated:
Putramu\.? Tidak\.\CC0820 tidak, tidak mungkin\.\CC0818
pasti ini bohong\.! Orang tuaku\.\CC0820\lmereka tidak akan pernah melakukan

hal mengerikan seperti itu\. Mereka
tidak mungkin anggota Shadows!

entries.original: "Oh, this is just rich, Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, this is just rich, Ivory!
entries.translated: Oh, ini keterlaluan, Ivory!

entries.original:
"It is exactly as you heard, boy!

Your own parents are villains!"
entries.translation_source: It is exactly as you heard, boy! Your own parents are villains!
entries.translated:
Persis seperti yang kau dengar,
nak! Orang tuamu sendiri adalah\lpenjahat!

entries.original: "Aklove, that’s enough!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove, that’s enough!
entries.translated: Aklove, cukup!

entries.original:
"[rival], we wanted to come home\.

We really did\."
entries.translation_source: [rival], we wanted to come home\. We really did\.
entries.translated: [rival], kami ingin pulang\. Sungguh\.

entries.original:
"\qoJust one more day.\qc

That’s the lie we told ourselves,
over and over.

But after my injury\.\CC0818 I knew the only
way to justify it, was to come\lhome with your brother.

We had to keep going\.\CC0818 so our family
could be whole again\."
entries.translation_source: \qoJust one more day.\qc That’s the lie we told ourselves, over and over. But after my injury\.\CC0818 I knew the only way to justify it, was to come home with your brother. We had to keep going\.\CC0818 so our family could be whole again\.
entries.translated:
\qoSatu hari lagi.\qc Itu kebohongan
yang kita katakan pada diri\lsendiri, berulang kali. Tapi

setelah lukaku\.\CC0818 aku tahu
satu-satunya cara untuk\lmembenarkannya, adalah pulang

bersama saudaramu. Kami harus terus
berjalan\.\CC0818 agar keluarga kita bisa\lutuh kembali\.

entries.original:
"What kind of stupid logic is that!?
My brother is dead and gone!

What about me?
What about Melony?

Did the lives we had to live matter
to you?

And even all those times I was so
close by\.

You never even reached out to
to say you were okay!"
entries.translation_source: What kind of stupid logic is that!? My brother is dead and gone! What about me? What about Melony? Did the lives we had to live matter to you? And even all those times I was so close by\. You never even reached out to to say you were okay!
entries.translated:
Logika bodoh macam apa itu!?
Saudaraku sudah mati! Bagaimana\ldenganku? Bagaimana dengan Melony?

Apakah kehidupan yang harus kami
jalani berarti bagimu? Dan bahkan\lsemua saat aku begitu dekat\. Kau

bahkan tidak pernah menghubungi
untuk mengatakan kau baik-baik\lsaja!

entries.original:
"ENOUGH!

Your incessant blathering is
beginning to irk me."
entries.translation_source: ENOUGH! Your incessant blathering is beginning to irk me.
entries.translated:
CUKUP! Omonganmu yang tak
henti-hentinya mulai menggangguku.

entries.original:
"Hoopa, you know what to do
with the boy."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, you know what to do with the boy.
entries.translated:
Hoopa, kau tahu apa yang harus
dilakukan dengan anak itu.

entries.original: "Him as well, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: Him as well, Hoopa.
entries.translated: Dia juga, Hoopa.

entries.original:
"As per your request, Ivory, they
have been sent to a safe location.

They will be out of harm’s way
during the coming ordeal."
entries.translation_source: As per your request, Ivory, they have been sent to a safe location. They will be out of harm’s way during the coming ordeal.
entries.translated:
Sesuai permintaanmu, Ivory, mereka
telah dikirim ke lokasi yang aman.\lMereka akan terlindung dari bahaya

selama cobaan yang akan datang.

entries.original:
"And where do you think you are
going, Zeph?"
entries.translation_source: And where do you think you are going, Zeph?
entries.translated:
Dan ke mana kau pikir kau akan
pergi, Zeph?

entries.original:
"I know when to cut my losses.

With Marlon and that boy gone,
we’re outmatched."
entries.translation_source: I know when to cut my losses. With Marlon and that boy gone, we’re outmatched.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu kapan harus menghentikan
kerugian. Dengan perginya Marlon\ldan anak itu, kita kalah.

entries.original:
"Hoopa, he wants to be rid of us,
so we ought to return in kind.

Send him to join that Houndoom
of his!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, he wants to be rid of us, so we ought to return in kind. Send him to join that Houndoom of his!
entries.translated:
Hoopa, dia ingin menyingkirkan
kita, jadi kita harus membalas\ldengan setimpal. Kirim dia untuk

bergabung dengan Houndoom miliknya!

entries.original:
"As for you, [player]\.

You have been a constant source of
trouble\.\CC0818 a real thorn in my side.

Hoopa’s Trainer\.\CC0818 and the one who
wishes to seize the title\.

I will crush you here, and in doing
so\.

I will prove Hoopa’s power belongs
only to me!"
entries.translation_source: As for you, [player]\. You have been a constant source of trouble\.\CC0818 a real thorn in my side. Hoopa’s Trainer\.\CC0818 and the one who wishes to seize the title\. I will crush you here, and in doing so\. I will prove Hoopa’s power belongs only to me!
entries.translated:
Adapun kau, [player]\. Kau terus
menjadi sumber masalah\.\CC0818 duri yang\lnyata di sisiku. Pelatih Hoopa\.\CC0818 dan

orang yang ingin merebut gelar itu\.
Aku akan menghancurkanmu di sini,\ldan dengan melakukannya\. Aku akan

membuktikan kekuatan Hoopa hanya
milikku!

entries.original:
"Hoopa, you useless creature!

The only thing you are fit for
is scientific research!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, you useless creature! The only thing you are fit for is scientific research!
entries.translated:
Hoopa, makhluk tidak berguna!
Satu-satunya hal yang kau cocok\ladalah penelitian ilmiah!

entries.original:
"[player]!

Your escape from the Cube was my
oversight!

I should have been more thorough
and followed my directions to the\lletter\."
entries.translation_source: [player]! Your escape from the Cube was my oversight! I should have been more thorough and followed my directions to the letter\.
entries.translated:
[player]! Pelarianmu dari Kubus
adalah kelalaianku! Aku seharusnya\llebih teliti dan mengikuti arahan

dengan tepat\.

entries.original:
"But I guess it does not matter.
What is done is done.

And unfortunately, I am out of
Pokémon.

So, let us cut a deal.

I have something you may be
greatly invested in\.

Yes\.\CC0818 I am, of course, talking about
your friend - the boy with the\lgreen hat.

I expect you are wondering what
happened to him, are you not?"
entries.translation_source: But I guess it does not matter. What is done is done. And unfortunately, I am out of Pokémon. So, let us cut a deal. I have something you may be greatly invested in\. Yes\.\CC0818 I am, of course, talking about your friend - the boy with the green hat. I expect you are wondering what happened to him, are you not?
entries.translated:
Tapi kurasa itu tidak masalah. Apa
yang sudah terjadi biarlah terjadi.\lDan sayangnya, aku kehabisan

Pokémon. Jadi, mari kita buat
kesepakatan. Aku punya sesuatu yang\lmungkin sangat kau minati\. Ya\.\CC0818 Tentu

saja, aku bicara tentang temanmu -
anak laki-laki bertopi hijau. Aku\lyakin kau penasaran apa yang

terjadi padanya, bukan?

entries.original:
"Oh yes\.\CC0818 I know exactly where
he is.

Would you like to meet him?"
entries.translation_source: Oh yes\.\CC0818 I know exactly where he is. Would you like to meet him?
entries.translated:
Oh ya\.\CC0818 Aku tahu persis di mana dia.
Apakah kau ingin bertemu dengannya?

entries.original: "Then, in that case\."
entries.translation_source: Then, in that case\.
entries.translated: Kalau begitu, dalam hal ini\.

entries.original: "Hoopa, take this for your wounds."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, take this for your wounds.
entries.translated: Hoopa, ambil ini untuk luka-lukamu.

entries.original: "Now, send [player] to join [buffer1] friend!"
entries.translation_source: Now, send [player] to join [buffer1] friend!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, kirim [player] untuk
bergabung dengan teman [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[player]! Is that really you?

I didn’t think I’d see a friendly
face in here.

I don’t know how long I’ve been
here, but it feels like forever\."
entries.translation_source: [player]! Is that really you? I didn’t think I’d see a friendly face in here. I don’t know how long I’ve been here, but it feels like forever\.
entries.translated:
[player]! Benarkah itu kamu? Aku
tidak menyangka akan melihat wajah\lramah di sini. Aku tidak tahu

berapa lama aku di sini, tapi
rasanya seperti selamanya\.

entries.original:
"Huh? How did I get here?

I\.\CC0820 well, it’s\.

When you didn’t come back out of
the ruins, I ran inside to find you.

Next thing I knew, a portal opened
up under me, and I wound up here.

I can’t believe I could have been
so stupid\.

So stupid\.\CC0818 what’s Grampa been
training me for, if I mess up so\leasily when it matters most\.?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? How did I get here? I\.\CC0820 well, it’s\. When you didn’t come back out of the ruins, I ran inside to find you. Next thing I knew, a portal opened up under me, and I wound up here. I can’t believe I could have been so stupid\. So stupid\.\CC0818 what’s Grampa been training me for, if I mess up so easily when it matters most\.?
entries.translated:
Huh? Bagaimana aku bisa sampai di
sini? Aku\.\CC0820 ya, ini\. Saat kamu tidak\lkembali dari reruntuhan, aku lari

ke dalam untuk mencarimu.
Selanjutnya, sebuah portal terbuka\ldi bawahku, dan aku berakhir di

sini. Aku tidak percaya aku bisa
sebodoh itu\. Sangat bodoh\.\CC0818 apa yang\lKakek latih untukku, jika aku

begitu mudah gagal saat paling
penting\.?

entries.original:
"Hey\.\CC0818 tell me we won against
the Shadows, at least.

Did we save Articuno and Moltres?"
entries.translation_source: Hey\.\CC0818 tell me we won against the Shadows, at least. Did we save Articuno and Moltres?
entries.translated:
Hei\.\CC0818 katakan padaku setidaknya kita
menang melawan Shadows. Apa kita\lmenyelamatkan Articuno dan Moltres?

entries.original:
"Ahh, who am I kidding?

If you’re stuck in here with me,
things obviously went south."
entries.translation_source: Ahh, who am I kidding? If you’re stuck in here with me, things obviously went south.
entries.translated:
Ahh, siapa yang aku bodohi? Jika
kamu terjebak di sini bersamaku,\ljelas semuanya menjadi buruk.

entries.original:
"You know what?

You can fill me in on the details
once we find a way out.

For now, let’s just focus on getting
back home.

This place is really confusing, but
I’ve managed to figure out some of\lthe rules here."
entries.translation_source: You know what? You can fill me in on the details once we find a way out. For now, let’s just focus on getting back home. This place is really confusing, but I’ve managed to figure out some of the rules here.
entries.translated:
Kau tahu? Kau bisa memberi tahuku
detailnya begitu kita menemukan\ljalan keluar. Untuk sekarang, mari

fokus untuk pulang. Tempat ini
sangat membingungkan, tapi aku\lberhasil memahami beberapa aturan

di sini.

entries.original:
"These rock slabs\.

I’ve noticed they move when you
step on a certain spot."
entries.translation_source: These rock slabs\. I’ve noticed they move when you step on a certain spot.
entries.translated:
Batu-batu ini\. Aku perhatikan mereka
bergerak saat kamu menginjak tempat\ltertentu.

entries.original: "Quick, follow me."
entries.translation_source: Quick, follow me.
entries.translated: Cepat, ikuti aku.

entries.original:
"The laws of our world clearly don’t
apply here, so stay sharp.

What you see might not always
be real\."
entries.translation_source: The laws of our world clearly don’t apply here, so stay sharp. What you see might not always be real\.
entries.translated:
Hukum dunia kita jelas tidak
berlaku di sini, jadi waspada. Apa\lyang kamu lihat mungkin tidak

selalu nyata\.

entries.original: "Now, do we go this way\.?"
entries.translation_source: Now, do we go this way\.?
entries.translated: Sekarang, apa kita lewat sini\.?

entries.original: "No, I think it was that way\."
entries.translation_source: No, I think it was that way\.
entries.translated: Tidak, kurasa itu lewat sana\.

entries.original:
"Gah! Let’s just split up.

We’ll have better luck finding
the exit apart."
entries.translation_source: Gah! Let’s just split up. We’ll have better luck finding the exit apart.
entries.translated:
Gah! Mari kita pisah. Kita akan
lebih beruntung menemukan jalan\lkeluar secara terpisah.

entries.original:
"Let’s split up.

We’ll have better luck finding
the exit apart."
entries.translation_source: Let’s split up. We’ll have better luck finding the exit apart.
entries.translated:
Mari kita pisah. Kita akan lebih
beruntung menemukan jalan keluar\lsecara terpisah.

entries.original:
"I’ve never been here before,
so this must be the right way!

Let’s continue on, [player]."
entries.translation_source: I’ve never been here before, so this must be the right way! Let’s continue on, [player].
entries.translated:
Aku belum pernah ke sini
sebelumnya, jadi ini pasti jalan\lyang benar! Mari kita lanjutkan,

[player].

entries.original:
"This has to be it\.

I can feel it!"
entries.translation_source: This has to be it\. I can feel it!
entries.translated:
Pasti ini dia\. Aku bisa
merasakannya!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
Something feels off.

This platform seems different than
the other ones.

It didn’t move when I stepped on
the centre spot.

Could we have missed something?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. Something feels off. This platform seems different than the other ones. It didn’t move when I stepped on the centre spot. Could we have missed something?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Ada yang terasa aneh. Platform
ini tampak berbeda dari yang lain.\lIa tidak bergerak saat aku

menginjak titik tengah. Mungkin
kita melewatkan sesuatu?

entries.original:
"I passed by plenty of boulders on
my way down here.

When I pushed one, another moved at
the same time!

But I noticed that not every
boulder I pushed moved another\.

Could those be the key to moving
this rock slab?"
entries.translation_source: I passed by plenty of boulders on my way down here. When I pushed one, another moved at the same time! But I noticed that not every boulder I pushed moved another\. Could those be the key to moving this rock slab?
entries.translated:
Aku melewati banyak batu besar
dalam perjalananku ke sini. Saat\laku mendorong satu, yang lain

bergerak bersamaan! Tapi aku
perhatikan tidak setiap batu yang\lkudorong memindahkan yang lain\.

Mungkin itu kunci untuk memindahkan
lempengan batu ini?

entries.original:
"This looks like\.\CC0818 the very bottom of
this world.

Well, if you can even call it that\.

But what now?
This place looks like a dead end."
entries.translation_source: This looks like\.\CC0818 the very bottom of this world. Well, if you can even call it that\. But what now? This place looks like a dead end.
entries.translated:
Ini terlihat seperti\.\CC0818 dasar dari
dunia ini. Yah, kalau bisa disebut\lbegitu\. Tapi sekarang apa? Tempat

ini terlihat seperti jalan buntu.

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0820 I’m starting to remember now\.

Grampa Arthur told me stories about
a place like this\.

About a world where the laws of
nature have no bounds\.

About a world opposite ours\.

And if what Grampa told me is true,
then there’s only one thing that’s\lliving here\."
entries.translation_source: Wait\.\CC0820 I’m starting to remember now\. Grampa Arthur told me stories about a place like this\. About a world where the laws of nature have no bounds\. About a world opposite ours\. And if what Grampa told me is true, then there’s only one thing that’s living here\.
entries.translated:
Tunggu\.\CC0820 Aku mulai ingat sekarang\.
Kakek Arthur bercerita tentang\ltempat seperti ini\. Tentang dunia di

mana hukum alam tidak terbatas\.
Tentang dunia yang berlawanan\ldengan kita\. Dan jika apa yang

dikatakan Kakek benar, maka hanya
ada satu hal yang hidup di sini\.

entries.original:
"That cry!
Did you hear that?

That must have been the Pokémon
Grampa Arthur was talking about!

If anything knows the way out of
here, it’d be that Pokémon!

Let’s go take a closer look!"
entries.translation_source: That cry! Did you hear that? That must have been the Pokémon Grampa Arthur was talking about! If anything knows the way out of here, it’d be that Pokémon! Let’s go take a closer look!
entries.translated:
Teriakan itu! Apakah kamu
mendengarnya? Itu pasti Pokémon\lyang dibicarakan Kakek Arthur! Jika

ada yang tahu jalan keluar dari
sini, pasti Pokémon itu! Ayo kita\llihat lebih dekat!

entries.original:
"[player], this is our chance!

I think that Pokémon is up ahead!"
entries.translation_source: [player], this is our chance! I think that Pokémon is up ahead!
entries.translated:
[player], ini kesempatan kita! Aku
rasa Pokémon itu ada di depan!

entries.original:
"No\.\CC0820 this is a mistake.

What am I thinking?"
entries.translation_source: No\.\CC0820 this is a mistake. What am I thinking?
entries.translated:
Tidak\.\CC0820 ini sebuah kesalahan. Apa
yang aku pikirkan?

entries.original:
"If that Pokémon attacks us,
I’ll just get in the way.

But I still have items with me, so
let me heal your Pokémon first."
entries.translation_source: If that Pokémon attacks us, I’ll just get in the way. But I still have items with me, so let me heal your Pokémon first.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon itu menyerang kita,
aku hanya akan menghalangi. Tapi\laku masih punya item bersamaku,

jadi biarkan aku menyembuhkan
Pokémon-mu terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Be careful, [player].

There’s no telling what that
Pokémon’s capable of."
entries.translation_source: Be careful, [player]. There’s no telling what that Pokémon’s capable of.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati, [player]. Tidak ada yang
tahu apa yang mampu dilakukan\lPokémon itu.

entries.original:
"Are you alright, [player]?

That Pokémon did a real number
on you\.

Here, let me heal your Pokémon
for you."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright, [player]? That Pokémon did a real number on you\. Here, let me heal your Pokémon for you.
entries.translated:
Apa kamu baik-baik saja, [player]?
Pokémon itu benar-benar membuatmu\lkewalahan\. Ini, biarkan aku

menyembuhkan Pokémon-mu untukmu.

entries.original:
"That power, that presence\.\CC0820 that was
definitely the ruler of this world!

There’s no doubt about it!
Look ahead!"
entries.translation_source: That power, that presence\.\CC0820 that was definitely the ruler of this world! There’s no doubt about it! Look ahead!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan itu, kehadiran itu\.\CC0820 itu
pasti penguasa dunia ini! Tidak ada\lkeraguan tentang itu! Lihat ke

depan!

entries.original:
"Look at that\.\CC0818 it must have decided
to set us free.

That battle must have made a real
impression, somehow.

Now, I don’t know about you, but
I’ve definitely spent way too long\linside here.

I’m taking my chances on that
portal.

Let’s go home, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Look at that\.\CC0818 it must have decided to set us free. That battle must have made a real impression, somehow. Now, I don’t know about you, but I’ve definitely spent way too long inside here. I’m taking my chances on that portal. Let’s go home, [player]!
entries.translated:
Lihat itu\.\CC0818 pasti dia memutuskan
untuk membebaskan kita. Pertarungan\litu pasti meninggalkan kesan yang

mendalam, entah bagaimana.
Sekarang, aku tidak tahu tentangmu,\ltapi aku sudah terlalu lama di

sini. Aku akan mengambil risiko
melalui portal itu. Ayo pulang,\l[player]!

entries.original: "Wait\.\CC0820 isn’t this\.?"
entries.translation_source: Wait\.\CC0820 isn’t this\.?
entries.translated: Tunggu\.\CC0820 bukankah ini\.?

entries.original:
"It’s Rift Cave\.\CC0818 then that means\.!

We must be back in our world!

But, why\.?

\.

Ah, right. Rift Cave is also said to
disobey the laws of reality."
entries.translation_source: It’s Rift Cave\.\CC0818 then that means\.! We must be back in our world! But, why\.? \. Ah, right. Rift Cave is also said to disobey the laws of reality.
entries.translated:
Ini Rift Cave\.\CC0818 maka itu berarti\.!
Kita pasti sudah kembali ke dunia\lkita! Tapi, kenapa\.? \. Ah, benar.

Rift Cave juga dikatakan melanggar
hukum realitas.

entries.original:
"Anyway, now that we made it,
let’s get back to it.

[player]\.\CC0818 what happened back at the
Ruins of Void?

\.

Aklove\.

Then that means we don’t have
a second to spare!"
entries.translation_source: Anyway, now that we made it, let’s get back to it. [player]\.\CC0818 what happened back at the Ruins of Void? \. Aklove\. Then that means we don’t have a second to spare!
entries.translated:
Bagaimanapun, sekarang kita
berhasil, mari kita kembali ke\lsana. [player]\.\CC0818 apa yang terjadi di

Ruins of Void? \. Aklove\. Maka itu
berarti kita tidak punya waktu\lsekejap pun!

entries.original: "No\. not this time\."
entries.translation_source: No\. not this time\.
entries.translated: Tidak\. bukan kali ini\.?

entries.original:
"[player], being trapped in there
taught me a lot of things\.

But most importantly, it’s taught me
I’m nothing without my Pokémon.

I never want to find myself being
so useless to anyone again.

Meet me in Vivill Town.

I promise both my Pokémon and I
will be ready this time."
entries.translation_source: [player], being trapped in there taught me a lot of things\. But most importantly, it’s taught me I’m nothing without my Pokémon. I never want to find myself being so useless to anyone again. Meet me in Vivill Town. I promise both my Pokémon and I will be ready this time.
entries.translated:
[player], terperangkap di sana
mengajarkan banyak hal padaku\. Tapi\lyang terpenting, itu mengajarkan

bahwa aku bukan apa-apa tanpa
Pokémon-ku. Aku tidak ingin lagi\lmerasa begitu tidak berguna bagi

siapa pun. Temui aku di Vivill
Town. Aku berjanji baik Pokémon-ku\ldan aku akan siap kali ini.

entries.original:
"[player]! You made it!

I picked up my grandfather on the
way here.

He said he wanted to speak to both
of us."
entries.translation_source: [player]! You made it! I picked up my grandfather on the way here. He said he wanted to speak to both of us.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu berhasil! Aku
menjemput kakekku dalam perjalanan\lke sini. Dia bilang ingin berbicara

dengan kita berdua.

entries.original:
"Yes, [player], I’m relieved to
see both you and Jax are safe.

You two had me very worried!

While it may not have seemed very
long to you, much time has passed\lhere while you both were in the\lDistortion World."
entries.translation_source: Yes, [player], I’m relieved to see both you and Jax are safe. You two had me very worried! While it may not have seemed very long to you, much time has passed here while you both were in the Distortion World.
entries.translated:
Ya, [player], aku lega melihat kamu
dan Jax selamat. Kalian berdua\lmembuatku sangat khawatir! Meskipun

mungkin tidak terasa lama bagimu,
banyak waktu telah berlalu di sini\lsaat kalian berdua berada di Dunia

Distorsi.

entries.original:
"That explains why I hadn’t been
there that long before [player]\lshowed up."
entries.translation_source: That explains why I hadn’t been there that long before [player] showed up.
entries.translated:
Itu menjelaskan kenapa aku tidak
terlalu lama di sana sebelum\l[player] muncul.

entries.original:
"And as I’m sure you’ve already
guessed, the Light of Ruin is\llong gone.

I witnessed them leave myself,
in fact.

I was keeping a close eye on your
status from Route 2, when I saw.

Hoopa appeared in front of this
warehouse with who I presume to\lbe the Light of Ruin’s leader.

When you didn’t emerge as well,
I feared the worst.

However, I was not given much time
to sail over and see for myself\lbefore their leader and all of his\lunderlings vanished!

Gone!

In the blink of an eye!

With Hoopa already under their
control, I’m at a loss for what\lthis Aklove character could\lbe planning next\."
entries.translation_source: And as I’m sure you’ve already guessed, the Light of Ruin is long gone. I witnessed them leave myself, in fact. I was keeping a close eye on your status from Route 2, when I saw. Hoopa appeared in front of this warehouse with who I presume to be the Light of Ruin’s leader. When you didn’t emerge as well, I feared the worst. However, I was not given much time to sail over and see for myself before their leader and all of his underlings vanished! Gone! In the blink of an eye! With Hoopa already under their control, I’m at a loss for what this Aklove character could be planning next\.
entries.translated:
Dan seperti yang aku yakin sudah
kamu duga, Light of Ruin sudah lama\lpergi. Aku sendiri menyaksikan

mereka pergi. Aku terus memantau
statusmu dari Route 2, ketika aku\lmelihat. Hoopa muncul di depan

gudang ini bersama dengan yang aku
duga sebagai pemimpin Light of\lRuin. Saat kamu juga tidak muncul,

aku khawatir yang terburuk. Namun,
aku tidak punya banyak waktu untuk\lberlayar dan melihat sendiri

sebelum pemimpin mereka dan semua
bawahannya lenyap! Hilang! Dalam\lsekejap mata! Dengan Hoopa sudah di

bawah kendali mereka, aku bingung
apa yang akan direncanakan oleh\lAklove selanjutnya\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

I’ve been looking everywhere
for you!

Aklove\.\CC0818 he’s\."
entries.translation_source: [player]! I’ve been looking everywhere for you! Aklove\.\CC0818 he’s\.
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku sudah mencarimu ke
mana-mana! Aklove\.\CC0818 dia\.?

entries.original:
"Young man, what do you know of
the Light of Ruin’s whereabouts?"
entries.translation_source: Young man, what do you know of the Light of Ruin’s whereabouts?
entries.translated:
Anak muda, apa yang kamu ketahui
tentang keberadaan Light of Ruin?

entries.original:
"More than you all, apparently.

When we confronted them, I was sent
to a holding cell in some building\lalong with\.

Along with my dad\.\CC0820 Marlon."
entries.translation_source: More than you all, apparently. When we confronted them, I was sent to a holding cell in some building along with\. Along with my dad\.\CC0820 Marlon.
entries.translated:
Lebih dari yang kalian tahu,
rupanya. Saat kita menghadapi\lmereka, aku dikirim ke sel tahanan

di suatu gedung bersama dengan\.
Bersama dengan ayahku\.\CC0820 Marlon.

entries.original: "Marlon is your father!?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon is your father!?
entries.translated: Marlon adalah ayahmu!?

entries.original:
"I don’t know what concern it is to
you, old man, but yeah.

We were locked up for a pretty
long time.

I wouldn’t say anything to him,
though.

I couldn’t.

But when they started moving us
somewhere, I took the opportunity\lto escape.

My dad wasn’t so lucky.

He got shuffled into this big
mountain covered in crystals."
entries.translation_source: I don’t know what concern it is to you, old man, but yeah. We were locked up for a pretty long time. I wouldn’t say anything to him, though. I couldn’t. But when they started moving us somewhere, I took the opportunity to escape. My dad wasn’t so lucky. He got shuffled into this big mountain covered in crystals.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu apa urusanmu, pak
tua, tapi ya. Kami dikurung cukup\llama. Namun, aku tidak akan

mengatakan apa pun padanya. Aku
tidak bisa. Tapi saat mereka mulai\lmemindahkan kami ke suatu tempat,

aku mengambil kesempatan untuk
melarikan diri. Ayahku tidak\lseberuntung itu. Dia dipindahkan ke

gunung besar yang dipenuhi kristal.

entries.original:
"Crystal Peak\.

Could that be what they’re after?

No\.\CC0818 no\.\CC0818 there’s little
possibility they know it’s there\."
entries.translation_source: Crystal Peak\. Could that be what they’re after? No\.\CC0818 no\.\CC0818 there’s little possibility they know it’s there\.
entries.translated:
Crystal Peak\. Mungkinkah itu yang
mereka cari? Tidak\.\CC0818 tidak\.\CC0818 kecil\lkemungkinan mereka tahu itu ada di

sana\.

entries.original:
"What?

What’s at Crystal Peak?"
entries.translation_source: What? What’s at Crystal Peak?
entries.translated: Apa? Apa yang ada di Crystal Peak?

entries.original:
"We have little time, Jax.

I’ll arrange passage for us to East
Borrius from Seaport City."
entries.translation_source: We have little time, Jax. I’ll arrange passage for us to East Borrius from Seaport City.
entries.translated:
Kita punya sedikit waktu, Jax. Aku
akan mengatur perjalanan untuk kita\lke East Borrius dari Seaport City.

entries.original:
"I don’t need passage!

Tell me what’s at Crystal Peak!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t need passage! Tell me what’s at Crystal Peak!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak butuh perjalanan! Katakan
apa yang ada di Crystal Peak!

entries.original:
"I could be wrong, of course, but
if Aklove’s goal is to cause mass\ldestruction, then he’ll be going\lafter something hidden atop the\lmountain."
entries.translation_source: I could be wrong, of course, but if Aklove’s goal is to cause mass destruction, then he’ll be going after something hidden atop the mountain.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja aku bisa salah, tapi
jika tujuan Aklove adalah\lmenyebabkan kehancuran massal, maka

dia akan mengejar sesuatu yang
tersembunyi di puncak gunung.

entries.original:
"What, like the weapon they keep
blabbing on about?"
entries.translation_source: What, like the weapon they keep blabbing on about?
entries.translated:
Apa, seperti senjata yang terus
mereka bicarakan?

entries.original: "So I’m correct, after all\."
entries.translation_source: So I’m correct, after all\.
entries.translated: Jadi, aku benar, ternyata\.

entries.original:
"I have kept this information secret
for many years\.

But I see no choice other than
to reveal it now.

The weapon Aklove has been
searching for\.

The weapon I presume Aklove hoped
Hoopa would bring him\.

It was already brought to Borrius
3000 years ago."
entries.translation_source: I have kept this information secret for many years\. But I see no choice other than to reveal it now. The weapon Aklove has been searching for\. The weapon I presume Aklove hoped Hoopa would bring him\. It was already brought to Borrius 3000 years ago.
entries.translated:
Aku telah merahasiakan informasi
ini selama bertahun-tahun\. Tapi aku\ltidak punya pilihan selain

mengungkapkannya sekarang. Senjata
yang selama ini dicari Aklove\.\lSenjata yang aku duga Aklove

berharap Hoopa akan membawakannya\.
Senjata itu sudah dibawa ke Borrius\l3000 tahun yang lalu.

entries.original:
"Young man, what do you plan to
do now?"
entries.translation_source: Young man, what do you plan to do now?
entries.translated:
Anak muda, apa yang kau rencanakan
sekarang?

entries.original:
"Well\.\CC0818 I haven’t really thought
about it.
