I finally found what I was looking
for, and it was the last thing I\lcould’ve wanted\.

All I can say is if Aklove plans
to destroy Borrius with some\lweapon, he’s gotta go through\lme, first.

I haven’t decided if I want to be
with my parents, but if I do, I’d\lwant to be with them here.

I’ve really started to take a
liking to Borrius, you know?

And no one, and I mean NO ONE, will
ever take my parents from me again."
entries.translation_source: Well\.\CC0818 I haven’t really thought about it. I finally found what I was looking for, and it was the last thing I could’ve wanted\. All I can say is if Aklove plans to destroy Borrius with some weapon, he’s gotta go through me, first. I haven’t decided if I want to be with my parents, but if I do, I’d want to be with them here. I’ve really started to take a liking to Borrius, you know? And no one, and I mean NO ONE, will ever take my parents from me again.
entries.translated:
Yah\.\CC0818 Aku belum benar-benar
memikirkannya. Akhirnya aku\lmenemukan apa yang aku cari, dan

itu adalah hal terakhir yang aku
inginkan\. Yang bisa aku katakan\ladalah jika Aklove berencana

menghancurkan Borrius dengan suatu
senjata, dia harus melewati aku\ldulu. Aku belum memutuskan apakah

aku ingin bersama orang tuaku, tapi
jika ya, aku ingin bersama mereka\ldi sini. Aku benar-benar mulai

menyukai Borrius, kau tahu? Dan
tidak ada seorang pun, dan maksudku\lTIDAK ADA SEORANGPUN, yang akan

mengambil orang tuaku dariku lagi.

entries.original: "Toucannon! Let’s get a move on!"
entries.translation_source: Toucannon! Let’s get a move on!
entries.translated: Toucannon! Ayo kita berangkat!

entries.original: "Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Wait!
entries.translated: Tunggu!

entries.original:
"There’s no point in rushing in
there without a plan.

We need everyone ready.

We’re going to hit them with
everything we’ve got."
entries.translation_source: There’s no point in rushing in there without a plan. We need everyone ready. We’re going to hit them with everything we’ve got.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada gunanya bergegas ke sana
tanpa rencana. Kita perlu semuanya\lsiap. Kita akan menyerang mereka

dengan segala yang kita miliki.

entries.original: "Yeah, yeah, I got that."
entries.translation_source: Yeah, yeah, I got that.
entries.translated: Ya, ya, aku mengerti.

entries.original:
"So [player], get to [green]Seaport City[blue]
ASAP!

If you can’t fly yet, the quickest
way there would be to earn the\l[green]Antisis City[blue] Gym Badge, and then\lhead east along [green]Route 17[blue].

While you’re making your way over,
Grampa Arthur and I will see what\lwe can come up with."
entries.translation_source: So [player], get to [green]Seaport City[blue] ASAP! If you can’t fly yet, the quickest way there would be to earn the [green]Antisis City[blue] Gym Badge, and then head east along [green]Route 17[blue]. While you’re making your way over, Grampa Arthur and I will see what we can come up with.
entries.translated:
Jadi [player], pergilah ke [green]Seaport
City[blue] secepatnya! Jika kau belum\lbisa terbang, cara tercepat ke sana

adalah dengan mendapatkan [green]Antisis
City[blue] Gym Badge, lalu pergi ke timur\lmenyusuri [green]Route 17[blue]. Sementara kau

dalam perjalanan, Kakek Arthur dan
aku akan melihat apa yang bisa kami\lrencanakan.

entries.original: "Alright, Grampa Arthur, you ready?"
entries.translation_source: Alright, Grampa Arthur, you ready?
entries.translated: Baiklah, Kakek Arthur, kau siap?

entries.original:
"As ready as I’ll ever be!

This sure brings me back!"
entries.translation_source: As ready as I’ll ever be! This sure brings me back!
entries.translated:
Sesiap yang aku bisa! Ini
benar-benar mengingatkanku pada\lmasa lalu!

entries.original: "Staraptor! Take us to [green]Seaport City[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! Take us to [green]Seaport City[blue]!
entries.translated:
Staraptor! Bawa kami ke [green]Seaport
City[blue]!

entries.original: "Clerk"
entries.translation_source: Clerk
entries.translated: Petugas

entries.original:
"What do you mean, the ship’s not
running?

We need to get to Polder Town
ASAP!

The fate of Borrius depends on it!"
entries.translation_source: What do you mean, the ship’s not running? We need to get to Polder Town ASAP! The fate of Borrius depends on it!
entries.translated:
Apa maksudmu, kapalnya tidak
beroperasi? Kami harus sampai ke\lPolder Town secepatnya! Nasib

Borrius tergantung pada ini!

entries.original:
"Look, mate.

I told you already, I’m sorry, but
it can’t be helped.

The ship’s having engine troubles,
and there’s not a thing I can do.

But a friend of mine who owes me
a favor can take you to Polder\lTown, if it’s that urgent.

He can be found on the docks north
of here.

Show him one of these S.S. Tickets,
tell him I sent you, and he should\ltake you there."
entries.translation_source: Look, mate. I told you already, I’m sorry, but it can’t be helped. The ship’s having engine troubles, and there’s not a thing I can do. But a friend of mine who owes me a favor can take you to Polder Town, if it’s that urgent. He can be found on the docks north of here. Show him one of these S.S. Tickets, tell him I sent you, and he should take you there.
entries.translated:
Dengar, kawan. Sudah kubilang,
maaf, tapi tidak bisa dibantu.\lKapal ini mengalami masalah mesin,

dan aku tidak bisa berbuat apa-apa.
Tapi seorang temanku yang berutang\lbudi padaku bisa mengantarmu ke

Polder Town, jika memang mendesak.
Dia bisa ditemukan di dermaga\lsebelah utara sini. Tunjukkan salah

satu Tiket S.S. ini, katakan aku
yang mengirimmu, dan dia akan\lmengantarmu ke sana.

entries.original:
"If that’ll get us there quickly,
let’s do that."
entries.translation_source: If that’ll get us there quickly, let’s do that.
entries.translated:
Kalau itu bisa membuat kita cepat
sampai, lakukan saja.

entries.original:
"You got that, [player]?

Meet us at the boat on the docks
[green]north[blue] of here.

We’ll go on ahead and board without
you, so there’s no delay.

Oh, right - take this ticket so you
can get on the boat, too."
entries.translation_source: You got that, [player]? Meet us at the boat on the docks [green]north[blue] of here. We’ll go on ahead and board without you, so there’s no delay. Oh, right - take this ticket so you can get on the boat, too.
entries.translated:
Kau mengerti, [player]? Temui kami
di perahu di dermaga [green]utara[blue] sini.\lKami akan pergi duluan dan naik

tanpa menunggumu, jadi tidak ada
penundaan. Oh, benar—bawa tiket ini\lagar kau juga bisa naik perahu.

entries.original: "We’ve made it\.\CC0818 it’s East Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: We’ve made it\.\CC0818 it’s East Borrius!
entries.translated:
Kita sudah sampai\.\CC0818 ini Borrius
Timur!

entries.original: "Huh? Up there\.\CC0818 above Crystal Peak\.!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? Up there\.\CC0818 above Crystal Peak\.!
entries.translated:
Hah? Di atas sana\.\CC0818 di atas Crystal
Peak\.!

entries.original:
"Grampa Arthur, we need to head for
Crystal Peak.

That’s no ordinary storm brewing
above the mountain.

They must be getting the Ultimate
Weapon ready to destroy Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Grampa Arthur, we need to head for Crystal Peak. That’s no ordinary storm brewing above the mountain. They must be getting the Ultimate Weapon ready to destroy Borrius!
entries.translated:
Kakek Arthur, kita harus menuju ke
Crystal Peak. Itu bukan badai biasa\lyang berkumpul di atas gunung.

Mereka pasti sedang menyiapkan
Senjata Pamungkas untuk\lmenghancurkan Borrius!

entries.original:
"I concur, Jax.

Let’s make haste towards the
mountain.

We have to put an end to the Light
of Ruin’s schemes and save Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: I concur, Jax. Let’s make haste towards the mountain. We have to put an end to the Light of Ruin’s schemes and save Borrius!
entries.translated:
Aku setuju, Jax. Mari kita bergegas
menuju gunung. Kita harus\lmengakhiri rencana Cahaya

Kehancuran dan menyelamatkan
Borrius!

entries.original:
"Grampa and I will go on ahead to
the top of Crystal Peak, [player].

We can’t run in blind on this one,
so we’ll come up with a plan to\lstop their big scheme.

Follow us up as fast as you can,
okay?

In order to reach the top of
Crystal Peak, you’ll need the\lability to climb waterfalls\.

\.

Yeah\.\CC0818 that look on your face says
you know\.\CC0818 it’s the story of your\lentire Gym Challenge\.

That’s right\.\CC0818 you need [green]Polder Town[blue]’s
Gym Badge, and the HM for it.

But anyway, once you’ve done that,
make a beeline for [green]Crystal Peak[blue].

Got it?
See you there, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Grampa and I will go on ahead to the top of Crystal Peak, [player]. We can’t run in blind on this one, so we’ll come up with a plan to stop their big scheme. Follow us up as fast as you can, okay? In order to reach the top of Crystal Peak, you’ll need the ability to climb waterfalls\. \. Yeah\.\CC0818 that look on your face says you know\.\CC0818 it’s the story of your entire Gym Challenge\. That’s right\.\CC0818 you need [green]Polder Town[blue]’s Gym Badge, and the HM for it. But anyway, once you’ve done that, make a beeline for [green]Crystal Peak[blue]. Got it? See you there, [player].
entries.translated:
Kakek dan aku akan pergi duluan ke
puncak Crystal Peak, [player]. Kami\ltidak bisa gegabah kali ini, jadi

kami akan menyusun rencana untuk
menghentikan rencana besar mereka.\lIkuti kami secepat mungkin, oke?

Untuk mencapai puncak Crystal Peak,
kau perlu kemampuan untuk memanjat\lair terjun\. \. Ya\.\CC0818 ekspresi wajahmu itu

menunjukkan kau tahu\.\CC0818 ini adalah
kisah seluruh Tantangan Gymmu\. Benar\.\CC0818\lkau perlu [green]Polder Town[blue]{B4}s Gym Badge,

dan HM untuk itu. Tapi
bagaimanapun, setelah kau\lmelakukannya, langsung menuju

[green]Crystal Peak[blue]. Mengerti? Sampai
jumpa di sana, [player].

entries.original:
"[player]!
What took you so long?

That Jax guy and his grandpa ran
into me on my way up.

They told me to wait here for you,
saying it shouldn’t take too long\lfor you to join the fight.

Well, I figured I’d have an easier
time getting up the mountain with\lyou, anyway, so here I am.

The place is crawling with Light of
Ruin goons after all, so it’s not so\leasy to climb solo right now.

But before we go\.\CC0818 battle me.

Just a quick check to make sure
you’re ready.

I’ll know if you’re strong enough
to be my climbing buddy!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! What took you so long? That Jax guy and his grandpa ran into me on my way up. They told me to wait here for you, saying it shouldn’t take too long for you to join the fight. Well, I figured I’d have an easier time getting up the mountain with you, anyway, so here I am. The place is crawling with Light of Ruin goons after all, so it’s not so easy to climb solo right now. But before we go\.\CC0818 battle me. Just a quick check to make sure you’re ready. I’ll know if you’re strong enough to be my climbing buddy!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kenapa lama sekali? Orang
bernama Jax dan kakeknya itu\lberpapasan denganku saat naik ke

sini. Mereka menyuruhku menunggumu
di sini, bilangnya kau tidak akan\llama untuk bergabung dalam

pertarungan. Yah, kupikir akan
lebih mudah mendaki gunung\lbersamamu, jadi di sinilah aku.

Tempat ini penuh dengan antek
Cahaya Kehancuran, jadi tidak mudah\lmendaki sendirian sekarang. Tapi

sebelum kita pergi\.\CC0818 bertarunglah
denganku. Hanya pemeriksaan cepat\luntuk memastikan kau siap. Aku akan

tahu apakah kau cukup kuat untuk
menjadi teman mendakiku!

entries.original:
"You might be ready to climb the
mountain, but I guess I’m not.

Let me grab some different Pokémon
from the PC real quick."
entries.translation_source: You might be ready to climb the mountain, but I guess I’m not. Let me grab some different Pokémon from the PC real quick.
entries.translated:
Mungkin kau siap mendaki gunung,
tapi sepertinya aku belum siap.\lBiarkan aku mengambil beberapa

Pokémon lain dari PC sebentar.

entries.original: "Alright, I’m back."
entries.translation_source: Alright, I’m back.
entries.translated: Oke, aku kembali.

entries.original:
"Let’s make our way to the top as
quick as possible.

I’ll keep your Pokémon healed up
on the way."
entries.translation_source: Let’s make our way to the top as quick as possible. I’ll keep your Pokémon healed up on the way.
entries.translated:
Ayo kita menuju puncak secepat
mungkin. Aku akan menjaga Pokémonmu\ltetap pulih di sepanjang jalan.

entries.original:
"You ready to keep going up the
mountain, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: You ready to keep going up the mountain, [player]?
entries.translated:
Kau siap melanjutkan pendakian,
[player]?

entries.original:
"[black][player] decided to go with
[rival]!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] decided to go with [rival]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] memutuskan untuk pergi
bersama [rival]!

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with [rival], the
[green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle.

[rival] is also capable of using
Surf and Rock Climb."
entries.translation_source: [black]While teamed up with [rival], the [green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle. [rival] is also capable of using Surf and Rock Climb.
entries.translated:
[black]Saat bekerja sama dengan [rival],
[green]3 Pokémon pertama[black] yang layak dalam\ltimmu akan dipilih untuk bertarung.

[rival] juga bisa menggunakan Surf
dan Rock Climb.

entries.original:
"Hurry up, [player].
There’s no time to waste!"
entries.translation_source: Hurry up, [player]. There’s no time to waste!
entries.translated:
Cepat, [player]. Tidak ada waktu
untuk disia-siakan!

entries.original:
"Let’s make our way to the top as
quick as possible.

Those Light of Ruin guys don’t
stand a chance against both of us!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s make our way to the top as quick as possible. Those Light of Ruin guys don’t stand a chance against both of us!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita menuju puncak secepat
mungkin. Orang-orang Cahaya\lKehancuran itu tidak akan bisa

melawan kita berdua!

entries.original:
"Man\.\CC0818 Ivory is REALLY starting to
get on my nerves\.

I couldn’t wait to meet my parents
just a short while ago, but it’s\llike she doesn’t even care about\lme or my sister one bit!

What’s her problem?"
entries.translation_source: Man\.\CC0818 Ivory is REALLY starting to get on my nerves\. I couldn’t wait to meet my parents just a short while ago, but it’s like she doesn’t even care about me or my sister one bit! What’s her problem?
entries.translated:
Huh\.\CC0818 Ivory benar-benar mulai
membuatku kesal\. Aku tidak sabar\luntuk bertemu orang tuaku beberapa

waktu lalu, tapi sepertinya dia
tidak peduli sedikit pun padaku\latau adikku! Ada apa dengannya?

entries.original:
"We’ve almost made it to the top,
[player]!

We just need to figure out a way to
get past those goons without being\lspotted by them.

If only we could somehow push
something in front of them to block\ltheir view\."
entries.translation_source: We’ve almost made it to the top, [player]! We just need to figure out a way to get past those goons without being spotted by them. If only we could somehow push something in front of them to block their view\.
entries.translated:
Kita hampir sampai di puncak,
[player]! Kita hanya perlu mencari\lcara untuk melewati para preman itu

tanpa terlihat oleh mereka. Andai
saja kita bisa mendorong sesuatu di\ldepan mereka untuk menghalangi

pandangan mereka\.

entries.original:
"This seems like the top of the
mountain, [player]!

Just a little more and we can stop
Aklove!"
entries.translation_source: This seems like the top of the mountain, [player]! Just a little more and we can stop Aklove!
entries.translated:
Ini sepertinya puncak gunung,
[player]! Sedikit lagi dan kita\lbisa menghentikan Aklove!

entries.original:
"Where are you going, [player]?

Do you need to head back to town to
get supplies or something?"
entries.translation_source: Where are you going, [player]? Do you need to head back to town to get supplies or something?
entries.translated:
Mau ke mana, [player]? Apakah kamu
perlu kembali ke kota untuk\lmengambil perbekalan atau sesuatu?

entries.original:
"Hurry back, [player].
There’s no time to waste!"
entries.translation_source: Hurry back, [player]. There’s no time to waste!
entries.translated:
Cepat kembali, [player]. Tidak ada
waktu untuk disia-siakan!

entries.original:
"Wha-? These Pokémon\.

That Aklove guy must have had Hoopa
set this trap to slow us down!

But we can’t stop moving now!

C’mon, [player]! Let’s blast through
these things and get to the summit!"
entries.translation_source: Wha-? These Pokémon\. That Aklove guy must have had Hoopa set this trap to slow us down! But we can’t stop moving now! C’mon, [player]! Let’s blast through these things and get to the summit!
entries.translated:
Apa-? Pokémon ini\. Orang Aklove itu
pasti menyuruh Hoopa memasang\ljebakan ini untuk memperlambat

kita! Tapi kita tidak bisa berhenti
sekarang! Ayo, [player]! Mari kita\lmenerobos makhluk-makhluk ini dan

sampai ke puncak!

entries.original:
"How’s that!
As if that was ever gonna stop us!"
entries.translation_source: How’s that! As if that was ever gonna stop us!
entries.translated:
Gimana rasanya! Seolah itu bisa
menghentikan kita!

entries.original:
"You! You’re still here!?

Why? Why would you ever do any
of this!?

There’s no point helping out that
Aklove goon!"
entries.translation_source: You! You’re still here!? Why? Why would you ever do any of this!? There’s no point helping out that Aklove goon!
entries.translated:
Kau! Kau masih di sini!? Kenapa?
Kenapa kau melakukan semua ini!?\lTidak ada gunanya membantu preman

Aklove itu!

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry, [rival]\.

I\.\CC0820 I can’t go back on our
deal now.

When the dust finally clears, you’ll
see that it was worth it\.

In the meantime, I\.\CC0820 I’m just
glad to know that you returned.

Stay here, where you’ll be safe from
the fallout."
entries.translation_source: [red]I’m sorry, [rival]\. I\.\CC0820 I can’t go back on our deal now. When the dust finally clears, you’ll see that it was worth it\. In the meantime, I\.\CC0820 I’m just glad to know that you returned. Stay here, where you’ll be safe from the fallout.
entries.translated:
[red]Maaf, [rival]\. Aku\.\CC0820 Aku tidak bisa
mengingkari kesepakatan kita\lsekarang. Saat debu akhirnya reda,

kau akan melihat bahwa itu sepadan\.
Sementara itu, aku\.\CC0820 Aku hanya senang\lmengetahui kau kembali. Tetaplah di

sini, di mana kau akan aman dari
dampaknya.

entries.original:
"I didn’t come back because I wanted
to be safe!

I came back to stop the destruction
you’re planning!

This whole time, I wanted you and
dad to come back, so we could be\la family again.

And now, as soon as I find you,
you think you can get away with\lsomething like this!?

No way!

You’ve already destroyed one home
when you left us.

I won’t let you destroy another!"
entries.translation_source: I didn’t come back because I wanted to be safe! I came back to stop the destruction you’re planning! This whole time, I wanted you and dad to come back, so we could be a family again. And now, as soon as I find you, you think you can get away with something like this!? No way! You’ve already destroyed one home when you left us. I won’t let you destroy another!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak kembali karena ingin
aman! Aku kembali untuk\lmenghentikan kehancuran yang kau

rencanakan! Selama ini, aku ingin
kau dan ayah kembali, agar kita\lbisa menjadi keluarga lagi. Dan

sekarang, begitu aku menemukanmu,
kau pikir kau bisa lolos dengan hal\lseperti ini!? Tidak mungkin! Kau

sudah menghancurkan satu rumah saat
kau meninggalkan kami. Aku tidak\lakan membiarkanmu menghancurkan

yang lain!

entries.original:
"[red]If it were up to me, we wouldn’t
be destroying anything, [rival].

But this is the only way\."
entries.translation_source: [red]If it were up to me, we wouldn’t be destroying anything, [rival]. But this is the only way\.
entries.translated:
[red]Jika menurutku, kita tidak akan
menghancurkan apa pun, [rival].\lTapi ini satu-satunya cara\.

entries.original:
"[red]Alakazam!
Immobilize him!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Alakazam! Immobilize him!
entries.translated: [red]Alakazam! Lumpuhkan dia!

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry, [rival]\.\CC0818 but this is for
your own good.

Stay here and out of harm’s way,
until we’re finished at the summit."
entries.translation_source: [red]I’m sorry, [rival]\.\CC0818 but this is for your own good. Stay here and out of harm’s way, until we’re finished at the summit.
entries.translated:
[red]Maaf, [rival]\.\CC0818 tapi ini demi
kebaikanmu sendiri. Tetaplah di\lsini dan jauhi bahaya, sampai kami

selesai di puncak.

entries.original:
"[red]What about you, [player]?

I suppose it’s too much to hope
you’ll turn back?"
entries.translation_source: [red]What about you, [player]? I suppose it’s too much to hope you’ll turn back?
entries.translated:
[red]Bagaimana denganmu, [player]?
Kurasa terlalu berharap kau akan\lmundur?

entries.original:
"Ngh\.\CC0818 [player]\.\CC0818 take\.\CC0818 my Pokémon\.

I can’t fight\.\CC0818 but\.\CC0818 they’ll back
you up\."
entries.translation_source: Ngh\.\CC0818 [player]\.\CC0818 take\.\CC0818 my Pokémon\. I can’t fight\.\CC0818 but\.\CC0818 they’ll back you up\.
entries.translated:
Ngh\.\CC0818 [player]\.\CC0818 ambil\.\CC0818 Pokémon-ku\. Aku
tidak bisa bertarung\.\CC0818 tapi\.\CC0818 mereka\lakan mendukungmu\.

entries.original:
"[black][rival] is lending you his
Toucannon, Vaporeon, and Mamoswine\lfor your fight with Ivory!

When the battle starts, they will
automatically join your team."
entries.translation_source: [black][rival] is lending you his Toucannon, Vaporeon, and Mamoswine for your fight with Ivory! When the battle starts, they will automatically join your team.
entries.translated:
[black][rival] meminjamkanmu Toucannon,
Vaporeon, dan Mamoswine miliknya\luntuk pertarunganmu dengan Ivory!

Saat pertarungan dimulai, mereka
akan otomatis bergabung dengan\ltimmu.

entries.original:
"[red]So, I suppose you’ll follow this
path no matter what\.

Very well, then\. I only need to
hold you off just long enough\.

Until Aklove is finished, you shall
not pass!"
entries.translation_source: [red]So, I suppose you’ll follow this path no matter what\. Very well, then\. I only need to hold you off just long enough\. Until Aklove is finished, you shall not pass!
entries.translated:
[red]Jadi, kurasa kau akan mengikuti
jalan ini apa pun yang terjadi\.\lBaiklah, kalau begitu\. Aku hanya

perlu menahanmu cukup lama\. Sampai
Aklove selesai, kau tidak akan\llewat!

entries.original:
"[red]As I thought\.\CC0818 this was all I could
do to stall you.

However, the preparations must be
almost complete by now.

All I can do is hope the remaining
Grunts above us can hold you off\lfor just long enough.

Farewell\.\CC0818 [player], [rival]."
entries.translation_source: [red]As I thought\.\CC0818 this was all I could do to stall you. However, the preparations must be almost complete by now. All I can do is hope the remaining Grunts above us can hold you off for just long enough. Farewell\.\CC0818 [player], [rival].
entries.translated:
[red]Seperti yang kuduga\.\CC0818 ini yang bisa
kulakukan untuk memperlambatmu.\lNamun, persiapan pasti hampir

selesai sekarang. Yang bisa
kulakukan hanyalah berharap para\lpreman yang tersisa di atas bisa

menahanmu cukup lama. Selamat
tinggal\.\CC0818 [player], [rival].

entries.original:
"Alright, I’m good.

Let’s keep going, and finish this
once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, I’m good. Let’s keep going, and finish this once and for all!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, aku siap. Ayo lanjutkan,
dan selesaikan ini sekali untuk\lselamanya!

entries.original:
"Come on, Krookodile\.

Just pick up that boulder and move
it to the side."
entries.translation_source: Come on, Krookodile\. Just pick up that boulder and move it to the side.
entries.translated:
Ayo, Krookodile\. Angkat saja batu
besar itu dan pindahkan ke samping.

entries.original:
"No, Krookodile!
You can’t push it!

There’s a rock in the way!

Argh\.\CC0818 if only one of my Pokémon
knew Dig\."
entries.translation_source: No, Krookodile! You can’t push it! There’s a rock in the way! Argh\.\CC0818 if only one of my Pokémon knew Dig\.
entries.translated:
Tidak, Krookodile! Kau tidak bisa
mendorongnya! Ada batu di jalan!\lArgh\.\CC0818 andai saja salah satu

Pokémon-ku tahu Gali\.

entries.original: "Hey! I told you I’d come back!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! I told you I’d come back!
entries.translated: Hei! Aku bilang aku akan kembali!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]! Use [buffer2]!
Help him out of there!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1]! Use [buffer2]! Help him out of there!
entries.translated:
[buffer1]! Gunakan [buffer2]! Bantu
dia keluar dari sana!

entries.original:
"It’s good to see you again, [rival].

Have you given any thought on what
I told you, at all?"
entries.translation_source: It’s good to see you again, [rival]. Have you given any thought on what I told you, at all?
entries.translated:
Senang bertemu lagi, [rival].
Apakah kamu sudah memikirkan apa\lyang aku katakan padamu?

entries.original:
"Yeah, and I believe you.

But that doesn’t mean I’ve forgiven
you for leaving us behind in Hoenn."
entries.translation_source: Yeah, and I believe you. But that doesn’t mean I’ve forgiven you for leaving us behind in Hoenn.
entries.translated:
Ya, dan aku percaya padamu. Tapi
itu tidak berarti aku memaafkanmu\lkarena meninggalkan kami di Hoenn.

entries.original:
"I can’t apologize enough for that,
[rival]\.

And I don’t expect you to ever
forgive us for what we did\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t apologize enough for that, [rival]\. And I don’t expect you to ever forgive us for what we did\.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa cukup meminta maaf
untuk itu, [rival]\. Dan aku tidak\lberharap kamu akan memaafkan kami

atas apa yang kami lakukan\.

entries.original:
"Still\.\CC0820 I’m willing to give it
another shot.

At least you’re not trying to blow
everything up, like Ivory."
entries.translation_source: Still\.\CC0820 I’m willing to give it another shot. At least you’re not trying to blow everything up, like Ivory.
entries.translated:
Meski begitu\.\CC0820 aku bersedia
mencobanya lagi. Setidaknya kamu\ltidak mencoba meledakkan semuanya,

seperti Ivory.

entries.original:
"Ha ha\.\CC0818 appreciated, [rival],
despite the low-hanging fruit.

I swear I will do everything I can
to atone, for as long as I live.

And speaking of your mother, she
informed me that Aklove is almost\lready to fire the Ultimate Weapon.

Thankfully, we’re not too far from
the summit.

However, getting to the top is a bit
less simple\."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha\.\CC0818 appreciated, [rival], despite the low-hanging fruit. I swear I will do everything I can to atone, for as long as I live. And speaking of your mother, she informed me that Aklove is almost ready to fire the Ultimate Weapon. Thankfully, we’re not too far from the summit. However, getting to the top is a bit less simple\.
entries.translated:
Ha ha\.\CC0818 dihargai, [rival], meskipun
itu lelucon murahan. Aku bersumpah\lakan melakukan segalanya untuk

menebus kesalahan, selama aku
hidup. Dan berbicara tentang ibumu,\ldia memberitahuku bahwa Aklove

hampir siap menembakkan Senjata
Pamungkas. Untungnya, kita tidak\lterlalu jauh dari puncak. Namun,

mencapai puncak sedikit lebih rumit\.

entries.original:
"Why? There can’t be any more than a
couple of goons left."
entries.translation_source: Why? There can’t be any more than a couple of goons left.
entries.translated:
Kenapa? Pasti tidak ada lebih dari
beberapa preman yang tersisa.

entries.original:
"Those grunts are exactly the
problem\.

I’m not sure how, but whenever
they locked eyes with me\.

\.my body froze up, and they just
threw me back in the cell.

Unless you can sneak past them
somehow\."
entries.translation_source: Those grunts are exactly the problem\. I’m not sure how, but whenever they locked eyes with me\. \.my body froze up, and they just threw me back in the cell. Unless you can sneak past them somehow\.
entries.translated:
Para preman itulah masalahnya\. Aku
tidak tahu bagaimana, tapi setiap\lkali mata mereka bertemu denganku\.

\.tubuhku membeku, dan mereka
melemparkanku kembali ke sel.\lKecuali jika kamu bisa menyelinap

melewati mereka entah bagaimana\.

entries.original:
"And we’ll find that \qosomehow\qc.

[player] and I got this far up on
our own, didn’t we?

Even if we can’t just fight our way
past, we’ll find an answer!"
entries.translation_source: And we’ll find that \qosomehow\qc. [player] and I got this far up on our own, didn’t we? Even if we can’t just fight our way past, we’ll find an answer!
entries.translated:
Dan kita akan menemukan \qosesuatu\qc.
[player] dan aku berhasil sampai\lsejauh ini sendirian, kan? Bahkan

jika kita tidak bisa bertarung
melewati mereka, kita akan\lmenemukan jawabannya!

entries.original:
"Just be careful, [rival].

I’ll wait here with Melony until
you figure out a way past.

Oh, and give the item we asked
you to find in the warehouse to\l[player], will you?

It should help you deal with Aklove
if he tries anything at the summit."
entries.translation_source: Just be careful, [rival]. I’ll wait here with Melony until you figure out a way past. Oh, and give the item we asked you to find in the warehouse to [player], will you? It should help you deal with Aklove if he tries anything at the summit.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati saja, [rival]. Aku akan
menunggu di sini bersama Melony\lsampai kamu menemukan cara untuk

melewatinya. Oh, dan berikan barang
yang kami minta untuk kamu cari di\lgudang kepada [player], mau? Itu

akan membantu kamu menghadapi
Aklove jika dia mencoba sesuatu di\lpuncak.

entries.original:
"Here, [player].
You’ll need this."
entries.translation_source: Here, [player]. You’ll need this.
entries.translated:
Ini, [player]. Kamu akan
membutuhkan ini.

entries.original:
"Apparently, that’s the only thing
that can seal the dark force away\lagain, so don’t drop it.

Let’s go, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Apparently, that’s the only thing that can seal the dark force away again, so don’t drop it. Let’s go, [player]!
entries.translated:
Rupanya, hanya itu yang bisa
menyegel kekuatan gelap itu lagi,\ljadi jangan menjatuhkannya. Ayo

pergi, [player]!

entries.original:
"If you can find something to
obscure that grunt’s vision,\lthere’s a chance he won’t notice\lif you try to sneak past."
entries.translation_source: If you can find something to obscure that grunt’s vision, there’s a chance he won’t notice if you try to sneak past.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa menemukan sesuatu
untuk menghalangi penglihatan\lpreman itu, ada kemungkinan dia

tidak akan menyadari jika kamu
mencoba menyelinap.

entries.original:
"This weird guy keeps trying to
convince me he’s my dad.

[rival] wasn’t happy about it,
but he still bought it.

I’m not falling for it, though!

Why would my dad just appear out
of the blue after 16 years?"
entries.translation_source: This weird guy keeps trying to convince me he’s my dad. [rival] wasn’t happy about it, but he still bought it. I’m not falling for it, though! Why would my dad just appear out of the blue after 16 years?
entries.translated:
Orang aneh ini terus mencoba
meyakinkanku bahwa dia adalah\layahku. [rival] tidak senang

dengan itu, tapi dia tetap
mempercayainya. Tapi aku tidak akan\lpercaya! Kenapa ayahku muncul

begitu saja setelah 16 tahun?

entries.original:
"That weird guy ran to the summit
to join the fight.

I really hope we make it out of
this in one piece\."
entries.translation_source: That weird guy ran to the summit to join the fight. I really hope we make it out of this in one piece\.
entries.translated:
Orang aneh itu berlari ke puncak
untuk bergabung dalam pertarungan.\lAku benar-benar berharap kita bisa

keluar dari ini dengan selamat\.

entries.original:
"\CC0600Psst\CC0601\.\CC0600

You two! Get over here!"
entries.translation_source: \CC0600Psst\CC0601\.\CC0600 You two! Get over here!
entries.translated: \CC0600Pssst\CC0601\.\CC0600 Kalian berdua! Kemarilah!

entries.original:
"\CC0600There’s no sense rushing in and
getting captured!

Don’t worry, Grampa and I thought
of a plan.

Now listen up\CC0601\."
entries.translation_source: \CC0600There’s no sense rushing in and getting captured! Don’t worry, Grampa and I thought of a plan. Now listen up\CC0601\.
entries.translated:
\CC0600Tidak ada gunanya terburu-buru dan
tertangkap! Jangan khawatir, Kakek\ldan aku sudah memikirkan rencana.

Sekarang dengarkan\CC0601\.

entries.original:
"[red]All preparations have been
completed, Aklove.

The Shadow Warriors have been
successfully integrated into\lthe weapon.

Along with power absorbed from the
mountain, it’s now fully charged.

You may proceed with the activation
when ready."
entries.translation_source: [red]All preparations have been completed, Aklove. The Shadow Warriors have been successfully integrated into the weapon. Along with power absorbed from the mountain, it’s now fully charged. You may proceed with the activation when ready.
entries.translated:
[red]Semua persiapan telah selesai,
Aklove. Para Shadow Warriors telah\lberhasil diintegrasikan ke dalam

senjata. Bersama dengan kekuatan
yang diserap dari gunung, sekarang\lterisi penuh. Kamu dapat

melanjutkan aktivasi kapan pun
siap.

entries.original: "The Ultimate Weapon\."
entries.translation_source: The Ultimate Weapon\.
entries.translated: Senjata Pamungkas\.

entries.original:
"I still cannot believe it was hidden
in plain sight, all this time.

The crystal atop the mountain\.\CC0818
the Borrian insurgents must have\lbrought it here 3000 years ago\lusing Hoopa’s power.

The history books never mentioned
that little detail\.

To think that I wasted countless
hours searching for it!

But no matter - I have my chance to
activate it now."
entries.translation_source: I still cannot believe it was hidden in plain sight, all this time. The crystal atop the mountain\.\CC0818 the Borrian insurgents must have brought it here 3000 years ago using Hoopa’s power. The history books never mentioned that little detail\. To think that I wasted countless hours searching for it! But no matter - I have my chance to activate it now.
entries.translated:
Aku masih tidak percaya bahwa itu
tersembunyi di depan mata selama\lini. Kristal di puncak gunung\.\CC0818 para

pemberontak Borrian pasti
membawanya ke sini 3000 tahun yang\llalu menggunakan kekuatan Hoopa.

Buku sejarah tidak pernah
menyebutkan detail kecil itu\. Untuk\lberpikir bahwa aku membuang-buang

waktu berjam-jam mencarinya! Tapi
tidak masalah - aku punya\lkesempatan untuk mengaktifkannya

sekarang.

entries.original:
"All systems have been engaged.

And with the push of this button\."
entries.translation_source: All systems have been engaged. And with the push of this button\.
entries.translated:
Semua sistem telah diaktifkan. Dan
dengan menekan tombol ini\.

entries.original: "Gastrodon, now! Use Earth Power!"
entries.translation_source: Gastrodon, now! Use Earth Power!
entries.translated:
Gastrodon, sekarang! Gunakan
Kekuatan Bumi!

entries.original:
"What!? You\.\CC0820 how can this be
possible!

It cannot be that\.\CC0818 Hoopa!"
entries.translation_source: What!? You\.\CC0820 how can this be possible! It cannot be that\.\CC0818 Hoopa!
entries.translated:
Apa!? Kamu\.\CC0820 bagaimana ini mungkin!
Tidak mungkin itu\.\CC0818 Hoopa!

entries.original:
"Yup. Guess the world you sent me
to wasn’t as deadly as you hoped!"
entries.translation_source: Yup. Guess the world you sent me to wasn’t as deadly as you hoped!
entries.translated:
Yup. Sepertinya dunia tempat kau
kirim aku tidak semenakutkan yang\lkau harapkan!

entries.original:
"Hoopa! You useless Pokémon!

You could not even be rid of him
properly!?"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! You useless Pokémon! You could not even be rid of him properly!?
entries.translated:
Hoopa! Pokémon tidak berguna! Kau
bahkan tidak bisa menyingkirkannya\ldengan benar!?

entries.original:
"Hold on\.

If you were not present for the
attack on our base, then it is\lclear you could not have escaped\lon your own\.

Then, there is nothing to stop me
from sending you right back!"
entries.translation_source: Hold on\. If you were not present for the attack on our base, then it is clear you could not have escaped on your own\. Then, there is nothing to stop me from sending you right back!
entries.translated:
Tunggu\. Jika kau tidak hadir dalam
serangan ke markas kami, maka jelas\lkau tidak mungkin melarikan diri

sendiri\. Maka, tidak ada yang bisa
menghentikanku untuk mengirimmu\lkembali!

entries.original: "Hoopa! Get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Get rid of him!
entries.translated: Hoopa! Singkirkan dia!

entries.original:
"Gastrodon! Keep me locked down with
your Sticky Hold!"
entries.translation_source: Gastrodon! Keep me locked down with your Sticky Hold!
entries.translated:
Gastrodon! Pertahankan aku dengan
Lengket-mu!

entries.original:
"Tch\.\CC0818 have it your way.

I only need you incapacitated for
long enough.

Hoopa! Prepare to\."
entries.translation_source: Tch\.\CC0818 have it your way. I only need you incapacitated for long enough. Hoopa! Prepare to\.
entries.translated:
Tch\.\CC0818 terserah kau. Aku hanya perlu
membuatmu tidak berdaya cukup lama.\lHoopa! Bersiaplah untuk\.

entries.original: "[player]! Now’s your chance!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! Now’s your chance!
entries.translated: [player]! Ini kesempatanmu!

entries.original:
"Gah\.\CC0820 I should have known.

So it was you who aided the escape\.!"
entries.translation_source: Gah\.\CC0820 I should have known. So it was you who aided the escape\.!
entries.translated:
Gah\.\CC0820 Seharusnya aku tahu. Jadi kau
yang membantu pelarian itu\.!

entries.original:
"Fine! Hoopa! You handle [player]!
I will deal with this other pest."
entries.translation_source: Fine! Hoopa! You handle [player]! I will deal with this other pest.
entries.translated:
Baik! Hoopa! Kau urus [player]! Aku
akan berurusan dengan hama lainnya.

entries.original:
"As for you, Ivory, activate the
weapon in my stead!"
entries.translation_source: As for you, Ivory, activate the weapon in my stead!
entries.translated:
Sedangkan kau, Ivory, aktifkan
senjata itu untukku!

entries.original:
"I don’t think so!
You’re not going anywhere, Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t think so! You’re not going anywhere, Ivory!
entries.translated:
Jangan harap! Kau tidak pergi ke
mana pun, Ivory!

entries.original:
"You may have gotten the better of
me before, but this time, I’m taking\lyou down a peg!

I’m gonna stop you and save us all!"
entries.translation_source: You may have gotten the better of me before, but this time, I’m taking you down a peg! I’m gonna stop you and save us all!
entries.translated:
Kau mungkin pernah mengalahkanku
sebelumnya, tapi kali ini, aku akan\lmerendahkanmu! Aku akan

menghentikanmu dan menyelamatkan
kita semua!

entries.original:
"Arrrrgh!

Why do all these annoyances keep
popping up out of the woodwork!?

\.

Fine, ’tis only a matter of time
now before you are all defeated.

I am a patient man\.

I have waited a year for this day,
so what is a few more moments?"
entries.translation_source: Arrrrgh! Why do all these annoyances keep popping up out of the woodwork!? \. Fine, ’tis only a matter of time now before you are all defeated. I am a patient man\. I have waited a year for this day, so what is a few more moments?
entries.translated:
Arrrrgh! Kenapa semua gangguan ini
terus bermunculan!? \. Baiklah, ini\lhanya masalah waktu sebelum kalian

semua dikalahkan. Aku adalah orang
yang sabar\. Aku sudah menunggu\lsetahun untuk hari ini, jadi apa

artinya beberapa saat lagi?

entries.original:
"Hold the line, Hoopa and Ivory!

Do not allow them near the weapon!

Once I’m done dealing with this
\qohero\qc, I’ll fire the Weapon\land be done with it."
entries.translation_source: Hold the line, Hoopa and Ivory! Do not allow them near the weapon! Once I’m done dealing with this \qohero\qc, I’ll fire the Weapon and be done with it.
entries.translated:
Pertahankan garis, Hoopa dan Ivory!
Jangan biarkan mereka mendekati\lsenjata! Setelah aku selesai

berurusan dengan \qohero\qc ini, aku
akan menembakkan Senjata dan\lmenyelesaikannya.

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry\.\CC0820 Marlon\.\CC0830 [rival]\.\CC0830
This is the only way\."
entries.translation_source: [red]I’m sorry\.\CC0820 Marlon\.\CC0830 [rival]\.\CC0830 This is the only way\.
entries.translated:
[red]Maafkan aku\.\CC0820 Marlon\.\CC0830 [rival]\.\CC0830 Ini
satu-satunya cara\.

entries.original:
"[player]! Take down Hoopa, and turn
off that weapon!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! Take down Hoopa, and turn off that weapon!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kalahkan Hoopa, dan
matikan senjata itu!

entries.original: "[black]Rayquaza flew away!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Rayquaza flew away!
entries.translated: [black]Rayquaza terbang pergi!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0820 Hooooo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoo\.\CC0820 Hooooo!
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0820 Hooooo!

entries.original:
"[black]Hoopa summoned a mysterious power
and increased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Hoopa summoned a mysterious power and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Hoopa memanggil kekuatan misterius
dan memperbesar ukurannya!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoo\.
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.

entries.original:
"Quick, [player]!
Seal its power while it’s weakened!"
entries.translation_source: Quick, [player]! Seal its power while it’s weakened!
entries.translated:
Cepat, [player]! Segel kekuatannya
selagi lemah!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0820 pa?"
entries.translation_source: [green]Hoo\.\CC0820 pa?
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0820 pa?

entries.original:
"You\.! You truly are the most
useless, pathetic Pokémon!

Too many times now have you failed
at the simplest tasks!"
entries.translation_source: You\.! You truly are the most useless, pathetic Pokémon! Too many times now have you failed at the simplest tasks!
entries.translated:
Kamu\.! Kamu benar-benar Pokémon yang
paling tidak berguna dan\lmenyedihkan! Sudah terlalu sering

kamu gagal dalam tugas yang paling
sederhana!

entries.original:
"Begone, Hoopa!
Leave my sight!

With your power sealed, I will just
have to\."
entries.translation_source: Begone, Hoopa! Leave my sight! With your power sealed, I will just have to\.
entries.translated:
Pergi, Hoopa! Jauh dari
pandanganku! Dengan kekuatanmu\ltersegel, aku hanya perlu\.

entries.original:
"Gotcha!

Not so tough without that Pokémon,
are you?"
entries.translation_source: Gotcha! Not so tough without that Pokémon, are you?
entries.translated:
Dapat! Tidak begitu tangguh tanpa
Pokémon itu, kan?

entries.original: "Unhand me, you uncouth brute!"
entries.translation_source: Unhand me, you uncouth brute!
entries.translated: Lepaskan aku, kamu orang kasar!

entries.original: "Not on your life, Aklove!"
entries.translation_source: Not on your life, Aklove!
entries.translated: Tidak akan, Aklove!

entries.original:
"[player]!
I got him! Now’s your chance!

Turn off the Ultimate Weapon!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! I got him! Now’s your chance! Turn off the Ultimate Weapon!
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku dapat dia! Ini
kesempatanmu! Matikan Senjata\lUtama!

entries.original:
"Out of my way!

The weapon must be activated,
no matter the cost!

But if you will not stand aside
and allow me to pass, then with\lor without Hoopa, I will bring you\lto your knees!"
entries.translation_source: Out of my way! The weapon must be activated, no matter the cost! But if you will not stand aside and allow me to pass, then with or without Hoopa, I will bring you to your knees!
entries.translated:
Minggir! Senjata itu harus
diaktifkan, berapa pun harganya!\lTapi jika kamu tidak mau menyingkir

dan membiarkanku lewat, maka dengan
atau tanpa Hoopa, aku akan\lmembuatmu berlutut!

entries.original: "You take it from here, okay?"
entries.translation_source: You take it from here, okay?
entries.translated: Kamu lanjutkan dari sini, oke?

entries.original:
"[player]! You didn’t think I’d let you
handle this alone, right?

We fought our way up here together,
so let’s take him down together!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! You didn’t think I’d let you handle this alone, right? We fought our way up here together, so let’s take him down together!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu pikir aku akan
membiarkanmu menangani ini\lsendirian, kan? Kita bertarung

bersama untuk sampai ke sini, jadi
mari kita kalahkan dia bersama!

entries.original:
"No\.\CC0818 No\.\CC0818 No!

This cannot be happening!

THIS CANNOT BE HAPPENING!"
entries.translation_source: No\.\CC0818 No\.\CC0818 No! This cannot be happening! THIS CANNOT BE HAPPENING!
entries.translated:
Tidak\.\CC0818 Tidak\.\CC0818 Tidak! Ini tidak
mungkin terjadi! INI TIDAK MUNGKIN\lTERJADI!

entries.original:
"It’s over, Aklove.
Time to turn yourself in."
entries.translation_source: It’s over, Aklove. Time to turn yourself in.
entries.translated:
Sudah berakhir, Aklove. Saatnya
menyerahkan diri.

entries.original:
"I REFUSE!

NO! THIS IS NOT OVER!"
entries.translation_source: I REFUSE! NO! THIS IS NOT OVER!
entries.translated:
AKU MENOLAK! TIDAK! INI BELUM
BERAKHIR!

entries.original:
"What!? The Weapon\.\CC0818 it started up
somehow!"
entries.translation_source: What!? The Weapon\.\CC0818 it started up somehow!
entries.translated:
Apa!? Senjata\.\CC0818 entah bagaimana
menyala!

entries.original: "It’s not possible\."
entries.translation_source: It’s not possible\.
entries.translated: Itu tidak mungkin\.

entries.original:
"Dresco Town\.\CC0820 my home\.\CC0820
No!"
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town\.\CC0820 my home\.\CC0820 No!
entries.translated: Dresco Town\.\CC0820 rumahku\.\CC0820 Tidak!

entries.original:
"Ha ha\.\CC0820 hahahahaha\.

Despite your interference, it appears
I have triumphed!

The 3000-year-old war\.\CC0818 has reached
its proper conclusion.

No longer will the great king have
to suffer for all eternity.

When he learns I have accomplished
what he failed to do, his Pokémon\lwill finally return to him\."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha\.\CC0820 hahahahaha\. Despite your interference, it appears I have triumphed! The 3000-year-old war\.\CC0818 has reached its proper conclusion. No longer will the great king have to suffer for all eternity. When he learns I have accomplished what he failed to do, his Pokémon will finally return to him\.
entries.translated:
Ha ha\.\CC0820 hahahahaha\. Meskipun campur
tanganmu, tampaknya aku telah\lberjaya! Perang berusia 3000 tahun\.\CC0818

telah mencapai kesimpulan yang
tepat. Tidak lagi raja besar harus\lmenderita selamanya. Ketika dia

tahu aku telah mencapai apa yang
gagal dia lakukan, Pokémon-nya\lakhirnya akan kembali kepadanya\.

entries.original:
"No\.\CC0820 it cannot be\.

The colour of the cannon\.
it is all wrong!"
entries.translation_source: No\.\CC0820 it cannot be\. The colour of the cannon\. it is all wrong!
entries.translated:
Tidak\.\CC0820 tidak mungkin\. Warna meriam\.
semuanya salah!

entries.original:
"Wha\.

How are you here!?"
entries.translation_source: Wha\. How are you here!?
entries.translated: Apa\. Bagaimana kau di sini!?

entries.original:
"It’s simple, really.

That Hoopa of yours had sent
Houndoom to an empty cavern in\lCinder Volcano - a place that was\lof no danger to it at all.

You then sent me there as well.
Together, we managed to escape.

Once I was out, I made contact with
Fey and she had Agent Véga direct\lme here.

It seems she never fully intended
to allow you to rain destruction\."
entries.translation_source: It’s simple, really. That Hoopa of yours had sent Houndoom to an empty cavern in Cinder Volcano - a place that was of no danger to it at all. You then sent me there as well. Together, we managed to escape. Once I was out, I made contact with Fey and she had Agent Véga direct me here. It seems she never fully intended to allow you to rain destruction\.
entries.translated:
Ini sederhana, sungguh. Hoopa
milikmu telah mengirim Houndoom ke\lgua kosong di Gunung Berapi Cinder

- tempat yang sama sekali tidak
berbahaya baginya. Kau lalu\lmengirimku ke sana juga.

Bersama-sama, kami berhasil
melarikan diri. Setelah aku keluar,\laku menghubungi Fey dan dia

menyuruh Agen Véga mengarahkanku ke
sini. Sepertinya dia tidak pernah\lsepenuhnya berniat membiarkanmu

menghancurkan\.

entries.original:
"That deceitful wench!

I should have known she could
not be trusted\."
entries.translation_source: That deceitful wench! I should have known she could not be trusted\.
entries.translated:
Wanita penipu itu! Seharusnya aku
tahu dia tidak bisa dipercaya\.

entries.original:
"Argh, forget her!

Just tell me, what have you done!?"
entries.translation_source: Argh, forget her! Just tell me, what have you done!?
entries.translated:
Argh, lupakan dia! Katakan padaku,
apa yang telah kau lakukan!?

entries.original:
"I modified the weapon’s settings
before firing it, boy.

I restored it to its original
purpose.

To give life, not take it."
entries.translation_source: I modified the weapon’s settings before firing it, boy. I restored it to its original purpose. To give life, not take it.
entries.translated:
Aku memodifikasi pengaturan senjata
sebelum menembakkannya, nak. Aku\lmengembalikannya ke tujuan aslinya.

Untuk memberi kehidupan, bukan
mengambilnya.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 you utter, utter fool!

We only extracted enough power from
the Shadow Warriors for a single\lblast before they all fell apart!"
entries.translation_source: You\.\CC0820 you utter, utter fool! We only extracted enough power from the Shadow Warriors for a single blast before they all fell apart!
entries.translated:
Kau\.\CC0820 kau benar-benar bodoh! Kami
hanya mengekstrak kekuatan yang\lcukup dari Shadow Warriors untuk

satu ledakan sebelum mereka semua
hancur!

entries.original:
"[red]But\.\CC0820 you promised you would use
the weapon to restore my lost son!

Were you planning to betray me,
this entire time?"
entries.translation_source: [red]But\.\CC0820 you promised you would use the weapon to restore my lost son! Were you planning to betray me, this entire time?
entries.translated:
[red]Tapi\.\CC0820 kau berjanji akan menggunakan
senjata itu untuk memulihkan anakku\lyang hilang! Apakah kau berencana

mengkhianatiku selama ini?

entries.original:
"Of course I was!

I had no intention of ever
helping you!

If all had gone according to plan,
I would have just left you as the\lscapegoat, and flown off!

Like so!"
entries.translation_source: Of course I was! I had no intention of ever helping you! If all had gone according to plan, I would have just left you as the scapegoat, and flown off! Like so!
entries.translated:
Tentu saja! Aku tidak pernah
berniat membantumu! Jika semuanya\lberjalan sesuai rencana, aku hanya

akan meninggalkanmu sebagai kambing
hitam, dan terbang pergi! Seperti\lini!

entries.original:
"Staraptor! After him!
Let’s go!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! After him! Let’s go!
entries.translated: Staraptor! Kejar dia! Ayo!

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph\.\CC0820 my son’s remains\.\CC0820 I had
them with me\.

Why didn’t you\.\CC0820 why didn’t you
come for them!?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Zeph\.\CC0820 my son’s remains\.\CC0820 I had them with me\. Why didn’t you\.\CC0820 why didn’t you come for them!?
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph\.\CC0820 sisa-sisa anakku\.\CC0820 aku
membawanya bersamaku\. Mengapa kau\ltidak\.\CC0820 mengapa kau tidak

mengambilnya!?

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0820 I’m sorry\.\CC0820 truly\.\CC0820 I\.\CC0820
I wish I could have\.

But there was only a sliver of time
available for me to slip in after\l[player] sealed Hoopa’s power.

And at that point\.\CC0818 I couldn’t take
the chance I’d be noticed!

I’m so sorry, Ivory."
entries.translation_source: Ivory\.\CC0820 I’m sorry\.\CC0820 truly\.\CC0820 I\.\CC0820 I wish I could have\. But there was only a sliver of time available for me to slip in after [player] sealed Hoopa’s power. And at that point\.\CC0818 I couldn’t take the chance I’d be noticed! I’m so sorry, Ivory.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0820 Maafkan aku\.\CC0820 sungguh\.\CC0820 Aku\.\CC0820 Aku
berharap bisa melakukannya\. Tapi\lhanya ada sedikit waktu bagiku

untuk masuk setelah [player]
menyegel kekuatan Hoopa. Dan pada\lsaat itu\.\CC0818 aku tidak bisa mengambil

risiko ketahuan! Maafkan aku,
Ivory.

entries.original:
"[red]Marlon\.\CC0820 [rival]\.\CC0820 all I ever wanted
was\.\CC0820 was\.

It was all for him\.\CC0820 always for him\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Marlon\.\CC0820 [rival]\.\CC0820 all I ever wanted was\.\CC0820 was\. It was all for him\.\CC0820 always for him\.
entries.translated:
[red]Marlon\.\CC0820 [rival]\.\CC0820 yang kuinginkan
selama ini hanyalah\.\CC0820 adalah\. Semua\ldemi dia\.\CC0820 selalu demi dia\.

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0820 you still don’t get it.

Yes, we lost one child, but we
gained two more.

After I met [rival]\.\CC0820 I’ve come to
understand what we’ve lost by\labandoning them all those years\lago.

But it’s not too late for us!

We can start again\.\CC0820 build a new
relationship with them!

We can never truly make up for all
the years we lost, but we can at\lleast start somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Ivory\.\CC0820 you still don’t get it. Yes, we lost one child, but we gained two more. After I met [rival]\.\CC0820 I’ve come to understand what we’ve lost by abandoning them all those years ago. But it’s not too late for us! We can start again\.\CC0820 build a new relationship with them! We can never truly make up for all the years we lost, but we can at least start somewhere.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0820 kau masih belum mengerti. Ya,
kita kehilangan satu anak, tapi\lkita mendapat dua lagi. Setelah aku

bertemu [rival]\.\CC0820 aku mulai mengerti
apa yang kita hilangkan dengan\lmeninggalkan mereka bertahun-tahun

lalu. Tapi belum terlambat bagi
kita! Kita bisa memulai lagi\.\CC0820\lmembangun hubungan baru dengan

mereka! Kita tidak akan pernah bisa
benar-benar menebus semua tahun\lyang hilang, tapi setidaknya kita

bisa memulai di suatu tempat.

entries.original:
"[red]I\.\CC0820 I need time to think - alone.

Don’t come looking for me."
entries.translation_source: [red]I\.\CC0820 I need time to think - alone. Don’t come looking for me.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku\.\CC0820 aku butuh waktu untuk berpikir
- sendirian. Jangan cari aku.

entries.original: "Is\.\CC0818 is it over?"
entries.translation_source: Is\.\CC0818 is it over?
entries.translated: Apakah\.\CC0818 sudah berakhir?

entries.original:
"Zeph, Marlon, you’re under arrest.

I should not need to spell out
your crimes.

You are both fully aware of what
you’ve done."
entries.translation_source: Zeph, Marlon, you’re under arrest. I should not need to spell out your crimes. You are both fully aware of what you’ve done.
entries.translated:
Zeph, Marlon, kalian ditahan. Aku
seharusnya tidak perlu menjelaskan\lkejahatan kalian. Kalian berdua

sepenuhnya sadar apa yang telah
kalian lakukan.

entries.original:
"Please, Arthur.

Take me in, but let Marlon be.

He’s suffered enough through
all this\."
entries.translation_source: Please, Arthur. Take me in, but let Marlon be. He’s suffered enough through all this\.
entries.translated:
Kumohon, Arthur. Tangkap aku, tapi
biarkan Marlon. Dia sudah cukup\lmenderita melalui semua ini\.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You were key in draining the power
supply of the Ultimate Weapon\.

I suppose we can work something
out.

Marlon is free to go for now.

As for you, please come with us.
We have a lot to discuss."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. You were key in draining the power supply of the Ultimate Weapon\. I suppose we can work something out. Marlon is free to go for now. As for you, please come with us. We have a lot to discuss.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Anda adalah kunci dalam
menguras pasokan daya Senjata\lPamungkas\. Saya kira kita bisa

mencari jalan tengah. Marlon bebas
pergi untuk saat ini. Sedangkan\lAnda, silakan ikut kami. Ada banyak

yang perlu kita diskusikan.

entries.original:
"Marlon, please, watch over my son
while I’m gone."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, please, watch over my son while I’m gone.
entries.translated:
Marlon, tolong, jaga anakku selama
aku pergi.

entries.original:
"Of course, Zeph.

I’ll take him back to my home until
you’re released."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Zeph. I’ll take him back to my home until you’re released.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Zeph. Aku akan
membawanya kembali ke rumahku\lsampai kau dibebaskan.

entries.original:
"Then, I guess this is it,
[player]?

No\.\CC0818 there’s one more thing I
need to do."
entries.translation_source: Then, I guess this is it, [player]? No\.\CC0818 there’s one more thing I need to do.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, kurasa ini saja,
[player]? Tidak\.\CC0818 ada satu hal lagi\lyang perlu kulakukan.

entries.original:
"Listen up, old man!

I didn’t spend the last who knows
how many days searching for you\lonly to be happy when I found you!

I’m gonna show you what you’ve been
missing out on all these years!

I’m gonna show you how strong
I’ve become!"
entries.translation_source: Listen up, old man! I didn’t spend the last who knows how many days searching for you only to be happy when I found you! I’m gonna show you what you’ve been missing out on all these years! I’m gonna show you how strong I’ve become!
entries.translated:
Dengar, pak tua! Aku tidak
menghabiskan entah berapa hari\lterakhir mencarimu hanya untuk

bahagia saat menemukanmu! Aku akan
menunjukkan apa yang selama ini\lkamu lewatkan! Aku akan menunjukkan

seberapa kuat diriku sekarang!

entries.original:
"[rival], I already know you’re
strong\."
entries.translation_source: [rival], I already know you’re strong\.
entries.translated:
[rival], aku sudah tahu bahwa kau
kuat\.

entries.original:
"No, no, no.
You don’t understand, old man.

Seeing me fight is one thing, but
you haven’t really experienced it."
entries.translation_source: No, no, no. You don’t understand, old man. Seeing me fight is one thing, but you haven’t really experienced it.
entries.translated:
Tidak, tidak, tidak. Kamu tidak
mengerti, pak tua. Melihatku\lbertarung itu satu hal, tapi kamu

belum benar-benar mengalaminya.

entries.original:
"[player]!

For one last time, I want you to
fight by my side!

You’re gonna help me prove to him
how strong I am!

Beating him down alone isn’t enough,
I need to show him that I’m just\las strong, if not stronger than\lsomeone who could take down Hoopa!

And then he’ll really know how far
I’ve come!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! For one last time, I want you to fight by my side! You’re gonna help me prove to him how strong I am! Beating him down alone isn’t enough, I need to show him that I’m just as strong, if not stronger than someone who could take down Hoopa! And then he’ll really know how far I’ve come!
entries.translated:
[player]! Untuk terakhir kalinya,
aku ingin kamu bertarung di sisiku!\lKamu akan membantuku membuktikan

padanya betapa kuatnya aku!
Mengalahkannya sendirian tidak\lcukup, aku harus menunjukkan bahwa

aku sama kuatnya, jika tidak lebih
kuat dari seseorang yang bisa\lmenjatuhkan Hoopa! Dan kemudian dia

akan benar-benar tahu sejauh mana
aku telah berkembang!

entries.original:
"Let’s do this, old man!

I’ve been saving this one,
just for you!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s do this, old man! I’ve been saving this one, just for you!
entries.translated:
Ayo lakukan ini, pak tua! Aku sudah
menyimpan yang ini, khusus untukmu!

entries.original:
"Is that right\.\CC0820 but I still have
my pride as a Trainer, [rival].

I’m afraid I won’t just let you win
that easily!"
entries.translation_source: Is that right\.\CC0820 but I still have my pride as a Trainer, [rival]. I’m afraid I won’t just let you win that easily!
entries.translated:
Benarkah itu\.\CC0820 tapi aku masih
memiliki harga diriku sebagai\lPelatih, [rival]. Aku khawatir aku

tidak akan membiarkanmu menang
semudah itu!

entries.original:
"You know, [rival], I already knew
how far you’d come.

But your strength in battle isn’t how
I know that.

Your prideful, yet good heart was
what helped save us all from\ldisaster.

That’s what truly makes you a
strong Trainer.

I couldn’t be more proud of you."
entries.translation_source: You know, [rival], I already knew how far you’d come. But your strength in battle isn’t how I know that. Your prideful, yet good heart was what helped save us all from disaster. That’s what truly makes you a strong Trainer. I couldn’t be more proud of you.
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, [rival], aku sudah tahu
sejauh mana kau telah berkembang.\lTapi kekuatanmu dalam pertarungan

bukanlah cara aku mengetahuinya.
Hati bangga namun baikmu itulah\lyang membantu menyelamatkan kita

semua dari bencana. Itulah yang
benar-benar membuatmu menjadi\lPelatih yang kuat. Aku tidak bisa

lebih bangga padamu.

entries.original:
"Old man\.\CC0820 no\.\CC0820 Dad\.

Took you long enough\.\CC0818 to finally
say that\."
entries.translation_source: Old man\.\CC0820 no\.\CC0820 Dad\. Took you long enough\.\CC0818 to finally say that\.
entries.translated:
Pak tua\.\CC0820 tidak\.\CC0820 Ayah\. Butuh waktu lama
bagimu\.\CC0818 untuk akhirnya mengatakan\litu\.

entries.original:
"[rival], let’s get Melony and go
home to Frozen Heights.

I want to get to know you both."
entries.translation_source: [rival], let’s get Melony and go home to Frozen Heights. I want to get to know you both.
entries.translated:
[rival], ayo jemput Melony dan
pulang ke Frozen Heights. Aku ingin\lmengenal kalian berdua.

entries.original: "What about\.\CC0820 you know\.\CC0820 her?"
entries.translation_source: What about\.\CC0820 you know\.\CC0820 her?
entries.translated: Bagaimana dengan\.\CC0820 kau tahu\.\CC0820 dia?

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0820 needs time to herself.

She sacrificed so much, for nothing,
in the end.

I think she needs to process that.

When she’s ready, we can always
find her."
entries.translation_source: Ivory\.\CC0820 needs time to herself. She sacrificed so much, for nothing, in the end. I think she needs to process that. When she’s ready, we can always find her.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0820 butuh waktu untuk dirinya
sendiri. Dia mengorbankan begitu\lbanyak, untuk apa-apa, pada

akhirnya. Aku pikir dia perlu
memproses itu. Saat dia siap, kita\lselalu bisa menemukannya.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player]\.\CC0818
I want you to have this.

I picked it up, back when we were
first trapped in the Shadows’ base."
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player]\.\CC0818 I want you to have this. I picked it up, back when we were first trapped in the Shadows’ base.
entries.translated:
Hei, [player]\.\CC0818 Aku ingin kamu
memiliki ini. Aku mengambilnya,\ldulu saat kita pertama kali

terperangkap di markas Shadows.

entries.original:
"[player], it’s no secret that you got
as strong as I did\.\CC0818 no, maybe even\lstronger.

Man, you’ve sure come a long way
since we teamed up together back\lin the Shadows’ base.

Whether it was fate or Hoopa that
brought us together\.

I’m glad we got to be friends.

If you’re not busy with anything
else, why don’t you finish off the\lrest of the Gym Challenge?

The Champion’s seat in Borrius is
currently vacant\.

And I can’t think of anyone better
to have the title than you.

The final Gym is east of Magnolia
Town, in [green]Redwood Village[blue].

Good luck, [player].

I’ll come and congratulate you
once you become the Champ!"
entries.translation_source: [player], it’s no secret that you got as strong as I did\.\CC0818 no, maybe even stronger. Man, you’ve sure come a long way since we teamed up together back in the Shadows’ base. Whether it was fate or Hoopa that brought us together\. I’m glad we got to be friends. If you’re not busy with anything else, why don’t you finish off the rest of the Gym Challenge? The Champion’s seat in Borrius is currently vacant\. And I can’t think of anyone better to have the title than you. The final Gym is east of Magnolia Town, in [green]Redwood Village[blue]. Good luck, [player]. I’ll come and congratulate you once you become the Champ!
entries.translated:
[player], bukan rahasia lagi bahwa
kau menjadi sekuat diriku\.\CC0818 tidak,\lmungkin bahkan lebih kuat. Wah, kau

pasti sudah menempuh perjalanan
panjang sejak kita bekerja sama di\lmarkas Shadows. Apakah itu takdir

atau Hoopa yang mempertemukan kita\.
Aku senang kita bisa berteman. Jika\lkau tidak sibuk dengan hal lain,

kenapa tidak kau selesaikan sisa
Tantangan Gym? Kursi Juara di\lBorrius saat ini kosong\. Dan aku

tidak bisa memikirkan orang yang
lebih pantas mendapatkan gelar itu\lselain dirimu. Gym terakhir ada di

timur Magnolia Town, di [green]Redwood
Village[blue]. Semoga berhasil, [player].\lAku akan datang dan memberi selamat

begitu kau menjadi Juara!

entries.original:
"[player]!

Arthur just relayed the good news
to me!

Thank goodness you’re still in one
piece!

And of course, thank you!

You, Jax, [rival]\.\CC0818 you all gave
everything you had to save Borrius.

Of course, I’ve been told not all
has been resolved with this\l\qoAklove\qc, but that’s something you\lcan worry about later, I suppose.

For now, you just worry about that
empty seat, meant for the Champion!

So here, I think these may be
useful to you."
entries.translation_source: [player]! Arthur just relayed the good news to me! Thank goodness you’re still in one piece! And of course, thank you! You, Jax, [rival]\.\CC0818 you all gave everything you had to save Borrius. Of course, I’ve been told not all has been resolved with this \qoAklove\qc, but that’s something you can worry about later, I suppose. For now, you just worry about that empty seat, meant for the Champion! So here, I think these may be useful to you.
entries.translated:
[player]! Arthur baru saja
menyampaikan kabar baik itu padaku!\lSyukurlah kau masih utuh! Dan tentu

saja, terima kasih! Kau, Jax,
[rival]\.\CC0818 kalian semua memberikan\lsegalanya untuk menyelamatkan

Borrius. Tentu saja, aku diberi
tahu bahwa belum semuanya\lterselesaikan dengan \qoAklove\qc ini,

tapi itu urusan yang bisa kau
pikirkan nanti, kurasa. Untuk saat\lini, kau pikirkan saja kursi kosong

yang diperuntukkan bagi Juara itu!
Jadi ini, aku pikir ini mungkin\lberguna bagimu.

entries.original:
"I’ve heard there are Shard maniacs
around Borrius, who are also quite\lthe move masters.

They collect Shards, so if you think
they can teach your Pokémon any\luseful tricks for the Pokémon\lLeague, don’t hesitate to search\lthem out.

Well, I really should get back to
my research.

And in the meantime, I’ll see if
Arthur’s had any more luck finding\lthat escapee\.

Best of luck, [player]!
I hope you excel!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve heard there are Shard maniacs around Borrius, who are also quite the move masters. They collect Shards, so if you think they can teach your Pokémon any useful tricks for the Pokémon League, don’t hesitate to search them out. Well, I really should get back to my research. And in the meantime, I’ll see if Arthur’s had any more luck finding that escapee\. Best of luck, [player]! I hope you excel!
entries.translated:
Aku dengar ada penggila Serpihan di
sekitar Borrius, yang juga cukup\lahli dalam jurus. Mereka

mengumpulkan Serpihan, jadi jika
kau pikir mereka bisa mengajari\lPokémon-mu trik berguna untuk Liga

Pokémon, jangan ragu untuk mencari
mereka. Yah, aku benar-benar harus\lkembali ke penelitianku. Dan

sementara itu, aku akan lihat
apakah Arthur mendapat lebih banyak\lkeberuntungan menemukan pelarian

itu\. Semoga berhasil, [player]! Aku
harap kau unggul!

entries.original: "Hold it!"
entries.translation_source: Hold it!
entries.translated: Tahan!

entries.original:
"Finally, I managed to catch up
with you, [player]!

I was feeling down after Aklove
got away from me, but catching up\lto you perked me right up again!

\.

Huh? Why am I here?

Well, funny story\.\CC0818 actually, it
was Grampa Arthur who used to be\lthe Champion of Borrius.

But ever since he retired, the
Champion’s title has been open\lfor the taking!

This whole time, Grampa Arthur
had been training me as his\lreplacement - by having me fight\lagainst threats to the region.

I’m sure that’s why Prof. Log had
you run these errands too\.

He and Grampa always did have a
bit of a rivalry, ha ha!

But now that a worthy challenger
has appeared, someone I respect,\lthis is going to be a fun battle!"
entries.translation_source: Finally, I managed to catch up with you, [player]! I was feeling down after Aklove got away from me, but catching up to you perked me right up again! \. Huh? Why am I here? Well, funny story\.\CC0818 actually, it was Grampa Arthur who used to be the Champion of Borrius. But ever since he retired, the Champion’s title has been open for the taking! This whole time, Grampa Arthur had been training me as his replacement - by having me fight against threats to the region. I’m sure that’s why Prof. Log had you run these errands too\. He and Grampa always did have a bit of a rivalry, ha ha! But now that a worthy challenger has appeared, someone I respect, this is going to be a fun battle!
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, aku berhasil mengejarmu,
[player]! Aku sedih karena Aklove\llolos dariku, tapi mengejarmu

membuatku bersemangat lagi! \. Hah?
Kenapa aku di sini? Ya, cerita lucu\.\CC0818\lsebenarnya, Kakek Arthur dulunya

adalah Juara Borrius. Tapi sejak
dia pensiun, gelar Juara sudah\lterbuka untuk diambil! Selama ini,

Kakek Arthur melatihku sebagai
penggantinya – dengan membuatku\lbertarung melawan ancaman-ancaman

di wilayah ini. Aku yakin itu
sebabnya Prof. Log menyuruhmu\lmelakukan tugas-tugas ini juga\. Dia

dan Kakek selalu punya sedikit
persaingan, ha ha! Tapi sekarang\lpenantang yang layak telah muncul,

seseorang yang kuhormati, ini akan
menjadi pertarungan yang\lmenyenangkan!

entries.original:
"Now, it’s just you and me.

You ready?
Let’s go!"
entries.translation_source: Now, it’s just you and me. You ready? Let’s go!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, hanya kau dan aku. Siap?
Ayo!

entries.original:
"Come to think of it, we always
battled side-by-side, right?

So, I think that the best way to
battle for the Champion’s Seat is\lwith two Pokémon side-by-side!

That’s right! We’re making this a
Double Battle!

Are you ready? I put my best team
together just for this!

Here I come, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Come to think of it, we always battled side-by-side, right? So, I think that the best way to battle for the Champion’s Seat is with two Pokémon side-by-side! That’s right! We’re making this a Double Battle! Are you ready? I put my best team together just for this! Here I come, [player]!
entries.translated:
Ngomong-ngomong, kita selalu
bertarung berdampingan, kan? Jadi,\lkupikir cara terbaik untuk

bertarung memperebutkan Kursi Juara
adalah dengan dua Pokémon\lberdampingan! Benar! Kita akan

membuat ini menjadi Pertarungan
Ganda! Apa kau siap? Aku menyusun\ltim terbaikku hanya untuk ini! Aku

datang, [player]!

entries.original:
"\.

\.so\.\CC0818 that’s that.

\.

I see. I guess that makes sense,
after all.

I always knew you were the stronger
Trainer out of the both of us, even\lafter I got a head-start over you\."
entries.translation_source: \. \.so\.\CC0818 that’s that. \. I see. I guess that makes sense, after all. I always knew you were the stronger Trainer out of the both of us, even after I got a head-start over you\.
entries.translated:
\.\.\. \.jadi\.\CC0818 begitulah. \. Begitu. Kurasa
itu masuk akal, setelah semua ini.\lAku selalu tahu kau adalah Pelatih

yang lebih kuat di antara kita
berdua, bahkan setelah aku mendapat\lkeunggulan lebih dulu darimu\.

entries.original:
"You know, before we began our
fight, I kept thinking\.

\.about all the times I rushed in,
and then you helped bail me out.

Even at Crystal Peak, when I
thought I prepared my Pokémon\lwell enough, we wouldn’t have\lwon without you.

And even though we won, I got
complacent and Aklove got away.

That’s when I realized\.

Even if my Pokémon grow stronger,
what use is it if I don’t grow\lstronger with them?

I guess that’s the difference that
ended up deciding the winner.

So, I’m going to get stronger.

Not just my Pokémon.

Me.

And when I do, let’s do this again!

I’ll take your crown with my own
two hands!

But for now, let’s get you
officially recognized as Borrius’\lnew Champion!

Come on!
The register’s just up ahead.

Follow me!"
entries.translation_source: You know, before we began our fight, I kept thinking\. \.about all the times I rushed in, and then you helped bail me out. Even at Crystal Peak, when I thought I prepared my Pokémon well enough, we wouldn’t have won without you. And even though we won, I got complacent and Aklove got away. That’s when I realized\. Even if my Pokémon grow stronger, what use is it if I don’t grow stronger with them? I guess that’s the difference that ended up deciding the winner. So, I’m going to get stronger. Not just my Pokémon. Me. And when I do, let’s do this again! I’ll take your crown with my own two hands! But for now, let’s get you officially recognized as Borrius’ new Champion! Come on! The register’s just up ahead. Follow me!
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, sebelum kita memulai
pertarungan, aku terus berpikir\.\l\.tentang semua waktu aku bergegas

masuk, dan kemudian kau membantu
menyelamatkanku. Bahkan di Crystal\lPeak, ketika kupikir aku sudah

mempersiapkan Pokémon-ku dengan
cukup baik, kami tidak akan menang\ltanpamu. Dan meskipun kami menang,

aku menjadi lengah dan Aklove
lolos. Saat itulah aku sadar\. Bahkan\ljika Pokémon-ku menjadi lebih kuat,

apa gunanya jika aku tidak ikut
menjadi lebih kuat bersama mereka?\lKurasa itulah perbedaan yang

akhirnya menentukan pemenang. Jadi,
aku akan menjadi lebih kuat. Bukan\lhanya Pokémon-ku. Diriku. Dan

ketika itu terjadi, mari kita
lakukan ini lagi! Aku akan\lmengambil mahkotamu dengan tanganku

sendiri! Tapi untuk saat ini, mari
kita buat kau diakui secara resmi\lsebagai Juara Borrius yang baru!

Ayo! Daftarnya ada di depan. Ikuti
aku!

entries.original:
"This room is the Hall of Fame\.

It’s been a long time since I
last entered this room\.

Grampa Arthur brought me here
when I was younger, but I haven’t\lbeen since.

Anyway, [player]!
Welcome to the Hall of Fame!

This machine will make a permanent
record of your achievement.

Just place your Pokémon on it
and you’ll be good to go!

And once again, [player],
CONGRATULATIONS!"
entries.translation_source: This room is the Hall of Fame\. It’s been a long time since I last entered this room\. Grampa Arthur brought me here when I was younger, but I haven’t been since. Anyway, [player]! Welcome to the Hall of Fame! This machine will make a permanent record of your achievement. Just place your Pokémon on it and you’ll be good to go! And once again, [player], CONGRATULATIONS!
entries.translated:
Ruang ini adalah Hall of Fame\. Sudah
lama sejak terakhir kali aku\lmemasuki ruangan ini\. Kakek Arthur

membawaku ke sini ketika aku masih
muda, tapi sejak itu aku belum\lpernah ke sini. Bagaimanapun,

[player]! Selamat datang di Hall of
Fame! Mesin ini akan membuat\lcatatan permanen pencapaianmu.

Cukup letakkan Pokémon-mu di
atasnya dan kau siap! Dan sekali\llagi, [player], SELAMAT!

entries.original:
"Congratulations on completing the
main campaign of Pokémon Unbound!

In recognition of your achievement,
all Battle Difficulties have been\lunlocked!"
entries.translation_source: Congratulations on completing the main campaign of Pokémon Unbound! In recognition of your achievement, all Battle Difficulties have been unlocked!
entries.translated:
Selamat telah menyelesaikan
kampanye utama Pokémon Unbound!\lSebagai pengakuan atas

pencapaianmu, semua Kesulitan
Pertarungan telah terbuka!

entries.original:
"Additionally, a new outfit has been
added to the Costume Box!"
entries.translation_source: Additionally, a new outfit has been added to the Costume Box!
entries.translated:
Selain itu, pakaian baru telah
ditambahkan ke Kotak Kostum!

entries.original:
"There’s plenty more to do now that
you’ve become Champion, so don’t go\laway just yet!

Keep enjoying Pokémon Unbound,
and thank you for playing!"
entries.translation_source: There’s plenty more to do now that you’ve become Champion, so don’t go away just yet! Keep enjoying Pokémon Unbound, and thank you for playing!
entries.translated:
Masih banyak yang bisa dilakukan
sekarang setelah kau menjadi Juara,\ljadi jangan pergi dulu! Terus

nikmati Pokémon Unbound, dan terima
kasih telah bermain!

entries.original:
"[player]!

Congratulations!

I told you I’d come by after you
became the Champion, didn’t I?

Well, here I am!

So, what are your plans now that
you’re the strongest Trainer in\lBorrius?

\.

You don’t have any, huh?

Well, I hear renovations on the
Battle Frontier have finally been\lcompleted.

My dad and I planned on heading
over soon to check it out."
entries.translation_source: [player]! Congratulations! I told you I’d come by after you became the Champion, didn’t I? Well, here I am! So, what are your plans now that you’re the strongest Trainer in Borrius? \. You don’t have any, huh? Well, I hear renovations on the Battle Frontier have finally been completed. My dad and I planned on heading over soon to check it out.
entries.translated:
[player]! Selamat! Aku bilang aku
akan datang setelah kau menjadi\lJuara, kan? Ya, ini aku! Jadi, apa

rencanamu sekarang setelah kau
menjadi Pelatih terkuat di Borrius?\l\. Kau tidak punya, ya? Yah, kudengar

renovasi Battle Frontier akhirnya
selesai. Ayahku dan aku berencana\luntuk pergi ke sana segera untuk

memeriksanya.

entries.original:
"Yes, congratulations, [player]!

I was hoping I’d get the chance to
see you in person when you\lreturned home.

Are you surprised to see me back
in the old black and red?

That outfit I let you keep wasn’t
my only one, you know!

But even after all that happened,
I felt I needed to wear it again.

Ivory’s still missing, so I hope
that it will be easier to find her\lif I look just like her.

If you happen to hear anything,
[player], don’t hesitate to let\lme know.

And of course, don’t think I’ve
forgotten about your father.

I’ve been looking into freeing him
from the Cube, but so far, I\lhaven’t had much luck.

When I find something useful, I’ll
be sure to have a Mission for you."
entries.translation_source: Yes, congratulations, [player]! I was hoping I’d get the chance to see you in person when you returned home. Are you surprised to see me back in the old black and red? That outfit I let you keep wasn’t my only one, you know! But even after all that happened, I felt I needed to wear it again. Ivory’s still missing, so I hope that it will be easier to find her if I look just like her. If you happen to hear anything, [player], don’t hesitate to let me know. And of course, don’t think I’ve forgotten about your father. I’ve been looking into freeing him from the Cube, but so far, I haven’t had much luck. When I find something useful, I’ll be sure to have a Mission for you.
entries.translated:
Ya, selamat, [player]! Aku berharap
bisa bertemu langsung denganmu saat\lkau pulang. Apa kau terkejut

melihatku kembali dengan warna
