hitam dan merah lama? Pakaian yang\lkubiarankan kausimpan itu bukan

satu-satunya milikku, lho! Tapi
meski semua itu terjadi, aku merasa\lperlu memakainya lagi. Ivory masih

hilang, jadi kuharap akan lebih
mudah menemukannya jika aku\lterlihat persis seperti dia. Jika

kau kebetulan mendengar sesuatu,
[player], jangan ragu untuk\lmemberitahuku. Dan tentu saja,

jangan kira aku melupakan ayahmu.
Aku sudah mencari cara untuk\lmembebaskannya dari Cube, tapi

sejauh ini, aku belum beruntung.
Saat aku menemukan sesuatu yang\lberguna, aku pasti akan memberikan

Misi untukmu.

entries.original:
"Anyway, we’re gonna go check out
the [green]Battle Frontier[blue].

It’s just [green]north[blue] of [green]Seaport City[blue],
and the best of best from all\laround the world are said to\lgather there.

Since it just reopened and all,
there’s sure to be swarms of\lTrainers itching for a fight!

My dad and I are gonna show them
how real Trainers battle!

See you later, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Anyway, we’re gonna go check out the [green]Battle Frontier[blue]. It’s just [green]north[blue] of [green]Seaport City[blue], and the best of best from all around the world are said to gather there. Since it just reopened and all, there’s sure to be swarms of Trainers itching for a fight! My dad and I are gonna show them how real Trainers battle! See you later, [player]!
entries.translated:
Bagaimanapun, kami akan pergi
memeriksa [green]Battle Frontier[blue]. Letaknya\l[green]utara[blue] dari [green]Kota Seaport[blue], dan yang

terbaik dari yang terbaik dari
seluruh dunia dikatakan berkumpul\ldi sana. Karena baru dibuka

kembali, pasti ada banyak sekali
Pelatih yang ingin bertarung!\lAyahku dan aku akan menunjukkan

kepada mereka bagaimana Pelatih
sejati bertarung! Sampai jumpa,\l[player]!

entries.original:
"[player], my [buffer1], a hearty
congratulations to you!

I heard the news!

To think, after all this time, I
have finally bested old Arthur!

Ho ho ho!

Erm\. excuse me.

Now, my [buffer1], the reason for
my visit.

I have yet another errand for
you to run!

You thought you were done with
those, didn’t you?

Ho ho ho!

Erm\. anyway, following your
defeat of Hoopa atop Crystal Peak,\lmysterious portals have begun\lappearing around Borrius.

When approached, powerful Pokémon
are said to leap forth.

As the Guardian of Borrius in both
name and standing, it is your\lresponsibility to take care of\lthese Pokémon.

I assume that in most cases, if you
capture the Pokémon, the portals\lwill disappear permanently.

Although, it is doubtful that they
will all stay gone forever\.

In any case!

Capture the Pokémon found in these
mysterious portals.

Some portals may only appear if you
bring specific Pokémon, but the\lPokémon in those portals must be\lcaptured regardless.

And if a portal refuses to disappear
permanently after catching the\lPokémon, simply registering it in\lyour Pokédex will be enough."
entries.translation_source: [player], my [buffer1], a hearty congratulations to you! I heard the news! To think, after all this time, I have finally bested old Arthur! Ho ho ho! Erm\. excuse me. Now, my [buffer1], the reason for my visit. I have yet another errand for you to run! You thought you were done with those, didn’t you? Ho ho ho! Erm\. anyway, following your defeat of Hoopa atop Crystal Peak, mysterious portals have begun appearing around Borrius. When approached, powerful Pokémon are said to leap forth. As the Guardian of Borrius in both name and standing, it is your responsibility to take care of these Pokémon. I assume that in most cases, if you capture the Pokémon, the portals will disappear permanently. Although, it is doubtful that they will all stay gone forever\. In any case! Capture the Pokémon found in these mysterious portals. Some portals may only appear if you bring specific Pokémon, but the Pokémon in those portals must be captured regardless. And if a portal refuses to disappear permanently after catching the Pokémon, simply registering it in your Pokédex will be enough.
entries.translated:
[player], [buffer1]-ku, selamat yang
sebesar-besarnya untukmu! Aku\lmendengar beritanya! Bayangkan,

setelah sekian lama, akhirnya aku
mengalahkan Arthur tua! Ho ho ho!\lErm\. permisi. Sekarang, [buffer1]-ku,

alasan kunjunganku. Aku punya tugas
lain untukmu! Kau pikir kau sudah\lselesai dengan tugas-tugas itu,

bukan? Ho ho ho! Erm\. bagaimanapun,
setelah kekalahanmu atas Hoopa di\lpuncak Crystal Peak, portal-portal

misterius mulai muncul di sekitar
Borrius. Saat didekati, Pokémon\lkuat dikatakan melompat keluar.

Sebagai Pelindung Borrius baik
dalam nama maupun kedudukan, adalah\ltanggung jawabmu untuk mengurus

Pokémon ini. Aku berasumsi bahwa
dalam banyak kasus, jika kau\lmenangkap Pokémon itu,

portal-portal itu akan menghilang
selamanya. Meskipun, diragukan\lbahwa semuanya akan tetap hilang

selamanya\. Bagaimanapun! Tangkap
Pokémon yang ditemukan di\lportal-portal misterius ini.

Beberapa portal mungkin hanya
muncul jika kau membawa Pokémon\ltertentu, tetapi Pokémon di portal

itu harus ditangkap bagaimanapun
juga. Dan jika sebuah portal\lmenolak untuk menghilang selamanya

setelah menangkap Pokémon, cukup
mendaftarkannya di Pokédex-mu sudah\lcukup.

entries.original:
"And with that, I’m off!

Do say hi to your mother for me,
will you, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: And with that, I’m off! Do say hi to your mother for me, will you, [player]?
entries.translated:
Dan dengan itu, aku pergi!
Sampaikan salamku pada ibumu, ya,\l[player]?

entries.original:
"So, you have come\.

Ha ha ha ha\. not that you had much
of a choice in the matter\."
entries.translation_source: So, you have come\. Ha ha ha ha\. not that you had much of a choice in the matter\.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau datang\. Ha ha ha ha\. bukan
berarti kau punya banyak pilihan\ldalam masalah ini\.

entries.original:
"Aklove!

I came alone like you asked\.\CC0818 now
give back Grampa Arthur!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove! I came alone like you asked\.\CC0818 now give back Grampa Arthur!
entries.translated:
Aklove! Aku datang sendiri seperti
yang kau minta\.\CC0818 sekarang kembalikan\lKakek Arthur!

entries.original:
"Oh! [player]!
He did this to you too!?

That sneak\.\CC0818 he’s in for it now!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! [player]! He did this to you too!? That sneak\.\CC0818 he’s in for it now!
entries.translated:
Oh! [player]! Dia melakukan ini
padamu juga!? Liciknya\.\CC0818 dia akan\lmendapatkannya sekarang!

entries.original:
"Are you angry?
Does rage consume your soul?

That\.\CC0818 is exactly how I felt,
when you robbed me of everything\.

All I had worked so hard to achieve,
gone in the blink of an eye\.

I could have finally achieved what
I knew I was destined to do\.

Fey abandoned and betrayed me\.\CC0818
but there is still time!

I will start again!

I will start from scratch, without
having to rely on anyone\.

Like that fool Zeph!
Or that treasonous Fey!

They never came with you, but I can
still have my revenge on you both!"
entries.translation_source: Are you angry? Does rage consume your soul? That\.\CC0818 is exactly how I felt, when you robbed me of everything\. All I had worked so hard to achieve, gone in the blink of an eye\. I could have finally achieved what I knew I was destined to do\. Fey abandoned and betrayed me\.\CC0818 but there is still time! I will start again! I will start from scratch, without having to rely on anyone\. Like that fool Zeph! Or that treasonous Fey! They never came with you, but I can still have my revenge on you both!
entries.translated:
Apakah kau marah? Apakah amarah
menguasai jiwamu? Itu\.\CC0818 persis\lseperti yang kurasakan, ketika kau

merampas segalanya dariku\. Semua
yang telah kukerjakan dengan susah\lpayah, lenyap dalam sekejap mata\.

Aku akhirnya bisa mencapai apa yang
aku tahu aku ditakdirkan untuk\llakukan\. Fey meninggalkan dan

mengkhianatiku\.\CC0818 tapi masih ada
waktu! Aku akan memulai lagi! Aku\lakan memulai dari awal, tanpa harus

bergantung pada siapa pun\. Seperti
si bodoh Zeph! Atau Fey yang\lberkhianat itu! Mereka tidak pernah

datang bersamamu, tapi aku masih
bisa membalas dendam pada kalian\lberdua!

entries.original:
"He’s insane\.\CC0818 he really thinks
he can try again\.

Careful, [player].
He’s still serious about this.

Team up with me, and let’s put this
guy and his plans down for good!

Time to end this once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: He’s insane\.\CC0818 he really thinks he can try again\. Careful, [player]. He’s still serious about this. Team up with me, and let’s put this guy and his plans down for good! Time to end this once and for all!
entries.translated:
Dia gila\.\CC0818 dia benar-benar berpikir
dia bisa mencoba lagi\. Hati-hati,\l[player]. Dia masih serius tentang

ini. Bergabunglah denganku, dan
mari kita hancurkan orang ini dan\lrencananya untuk selamanya! Saatnya

mengakhiri ini sekali dan untuk
selamanya!

entries.original:
"Why\.\CC0818 why must you rob me of
everything\.

My dreams\.\CC0818 my possessions\.\CC0818
my\.\CC0818 victory\."
entries.translation_source: Why\.\CC0818 why must you rob me of everything\. My dreams\.\CC0818 my possessions\.\CC0818 my\.\CC0818 victory\.
entries.translated:
Mengapa\.\CC0818 mengapa kau harus merampas
segalanya dariku\. Mimpi-mimpiku\.\CC0818\lharta bendaku\.\CC0818 milikku\.\CC0818 kemenanganku\.

entries.original:
"It’s over, Aklove.
Your destructive plans end here.

Just tell me\.\CC0818 the destruction
of Borrius\.

What was it for!?
What was the point of any of it!?

All that destruction, all that loss
of life\.\CC0818 what would it have\lachieved!?"
entries.translation_source: It’s over, Aklove. Your destructive plans end here. Just tell me\.\CC0818 the destruction of Borrius\. What was it for!? What was the point of any of it!? All that destruction, all that loss of life\.\CC0818 what would it have achieved!?
entries.translated:
Sudah berakhir, Aklove. Rencana
destruktifmu berhenti di sini.\lKatakan saja padaku\.\CC0818 kehancuran

Borrius\. Untuk apa semua itu!? Apa
gunanya semua itu!? Semua\lkehancuran itu, semua kehilangan

nyawa\.\CC0818 apa yang akan dicapai!?

entries.original:
"Fine\.\CC0820 I will tell you\.

My ancestor, the one the legends
refer to as \qothe foreign king\qc\lfrom the Great War\.

Even now, 3000 years later, he still
walks the earth to this day.

Once I finished what he started\.\CC0818
once I had brought that war to its\lproper conclusion\.

Then he could rest in peace.

The subjugation of Borrius\.\CC0818 would
have finally seen his last wish\lfulfilled.

But now\.\CC0818 it is no longer possible\."
entries.translation_source: Fine\.\CC0820 I will tell you\. My ancestor, the one the legends refer to as \qothe foreign king\qc from the Great War\. Even now, 3000 years later, he still walks the earth to this day. Once I finished what he started\.\CC0818 once I had brought that war to its proper conclusion\. Then he could rest in peace. The subjugation of Borrius\.\CC0818 would have finally seen his last wish fulfilled. But now\.\CC0818 it is no longer possible\.
entries.translated:
Baik\.\CC0820 Aku akan memberitahumu\. Nenek
moyangku, yang legenda sebut\lsebagai \qoraja asing\qc dari Perang

Besar\. Bahkan sekarang, 3000 tahun
kemudian, dia masih berjalan di\lbumi hingga hari ini. Setelah aku

menyelesaikan apa yang dia mulai\.\CC0818
setelah aku membawa perang itu ke\lkesimpulan yang tepat\. Maka dia bisa

beristirahat dengan tenang.
Penaklukan Borrius\.\CC0818 akhirnya akan\lmelihat keinginan terakhirnya

terpenuhi. Tapi sekarang\.\CC0818 itu tidak
mungkin lagi\.

entries.original: "That’s so pathetic."
entries.translation_source: That’s so pathetic.
entries.translated: Itu sangat menyedihkan.

entries.original: "W-what did you say!?"
entries.translation_source: W-what did you say!?
entries.translated: A-apa katamu!?

entries.original:
"Let’s say you’re right.

Let’s say the legend’s true and the
king’s still alive.

But 3000 years\.

Do you really think not a second
of that was spent on reflection?

On regret?

Isn’t it possible he no longer
wants war?

How would you know?

You just projected your desires
onto a myth and nearly destroyed\lour region because of it!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s say you’re right. Let’s say the legend’s true and the king’s still alive. But 3000 years\. Do you really think not a second of that was spent on reflection? On regret? Isn’t it possible he no longer wants war? How would you know? You just projected your desires onto a myth and nearly destroyed our region because of it!
entries.translated:
Katakanlah kau benar. Katakanlah
legenda itu benar dan raja masih\lhidup. Tapi 3000 tahun\. Apakah kau

benar-benar berpikir tidak ada satu
detik pun yang dihabiskan untuk\lrefleksi? Penyesalan? Bukankah

mungkin dia tidak lagi menginginkan
perang? Bagaimana kau tahu? Kau\lhanya memproyeksikan keinginanmu ke

sebuah mitos dan hampir
menghancurkan wilayah kita\lkarenanya!

entries.original: "Nngh\."
entries.translation_source: Nngh\.
entries.translated: Nngh\.

entries.original:
"Hmm? What are those sounds coming
from below?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm? What are those sounds coming from below?
entries.translated:
Hmm? Suara apa itu yang datang dari
bawah?

entries.original:
"So, this is where you took him,
Aklove!"
entries.translation_source: So, this is where you took him, Aklove!
entries.translated:
Jadi, di sinilah kau membawanya,
Aklove!

entries.original: "Marlon! You’re here too?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon! You’re here too?
entries.translated: Marlon! Kau di sini juga?

entries.original:
"That’s right\. that’s Zeph’s son back
there, isn’t it?

It was my responsiblity to watch
him, and I\.\CC0818 I shirked that\lresponsibility to spend time with my\lown son.

But that is a mistake I’ve come to
rectify."
entries.translation_source: That’s right\. that’s Zeph’s son back there, isn’t it? It was my responsiblity to watch him, and I\.\CC0818 I shirked that responsibility to spend time with my own son. But that is a mistake I’ve come to rectify.
entries.translated:
Benar\. itu putra Zeph di belakang
sana, bukan? Tanggung jawabku untuk\lmenjaganya, dan aku\.\CC0818 aku mengabaikan

tanggung jawab itu untuk
menghabiskan waktu dengan putraku\lsendiri. Tapi itu adalah kesalahan

yang datang untuk kuperbaiki.

entries.original:
"You know, you could have had your
revenge so easily.

[player]’s mother\.\CC0818 Jax’s grandfather\.\CC0818
Zeph’s son\.

You could have just ended them
once they were in your grasp.

Yet you couldn’t lose the desire to
lord over how superior you were,\land you left them alive, choosing\lto battle [player] and Jax instead.

It’s like I always suspected\.\CC0818
your own worst instincts would be\lwhy you’d never win!"
entries.translation_source: You know, you could have had your revenge so easily. [player]’s mother\.\CC0818 Jax’s grandfather\.\CC0818 Zeph’s son\. You could have just ended them once they were in your grasp. Yet you couldn’t lose the desire to lord over how superior you were, and you left them alive, choosing to battle [player] and Jax instead. It’s like I always suspected\.\CC0818 your own worst instincts would be why you’d never win!
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, kau bisa dengan mudah
mendapatkan balas dendammu. Ibu\l[player]\.\CC0818 kakek Jax\.\CC0818 putra Zeph\. Kau

bisa saja mengakhiri mereka begitu
mereka dalam genggamanmu. Namun kau\ltidak bisa kehilangan keinginan

untuk merasa lebih unggul, dan kau
membiarkan mereka hidup, memilih\luntuk bertarung melawan [player]

dan Jax. Seperti yang selalu kuduga\.\CC0818
naluri terburukmu sendiri akan\lmenjadi alasan mengapa kau tidak

akan pernah menang!

entries.original:
"Now Aklove, you’re going with these
officers.

It’s time to face the justice you’re
long overdue."
entries.translation_source: Now Aklove, you’re going with these officers. It’s time to face the justice you’re long overdue.
entries.translated:
Sekarang Aklove, kau akan pergi
bersama para petugas ini. Sudah\lwaktunya menghadapi keadilan yang

sudah lama kau tunggu.

entries.original:
"Let’s get you home, Zeph Jr.

Now that the bad man is behind bars,
your father will be released soon\."
entries.translation_source: Let’s get you home, Zeph Jr. Now that the bad man is behind bars, your father will be released soon\.
entries.translated:
Ayo antar kau pulang, Zeph Jr.
Sekarang orang jahat itu di balik\ljeruji besi, ayahmu akan segera

dibebaskan\.

entries.original:
"Grampa Arthur!
I was really worried about you!

Are you okay?
He didn’t hurt you, did he?"
entries.translation_source: Grampa Arthur! I was really worried about you! Are you okay? He didn’t hurt you, did he?
entries.translated:
Kakek Arthur! Aku sangat khawatir
padamu! Apa kau baik-baik saja? Dia\ltidak menyakitimu, kan?

entries.original:
"Oh no, Jax, I’m perfectly alright,
as you can see.

As Marlon says, he mostly left us
alone.

It seems his only interest was in
drawing you here.

Just be thankful his ego outweighed
his common sense."
entries.translation_source: Oh no, Jax, I’m perfectly alright, as you can see. As Marlon says, he mostly left us alone. It seems his only interest was in drawing you here. Just be thankful his ego outweighed his common sense.
entries.translated:
Oh tidak, Jax, aku baik-baik saja,
seperti yang kau lihat. Seperti\lkata Marlon, dia kebanyakan

meninggalkan kita sendirian.
Sepertinya satu-satunya minatnya\ladalah menarikmu ke sini.

Bersyukurlah egonya melebihi akal

entries.translation_source: Let me explain how the Pokémon Wireless Club works. On this, the top floor, there are two rooms. First, the room on the left. It’s the Union Room. Second, the room on the right is the Direct Corner. You may battle Pokémon with your friends in this room, but trading is no longer available. Please use Unbound Cloud if you wish to trade Pokémon. Sometimes, you may not be able to find your friends in the Union Room or the Direct Corner. In that case, please move closer to your friends. entries.translation_source: Each member of the Elite Four likes to set up certain conditions on the field before battle. First, there’s [green]Moleman[blue]. He likes to set up a vicious Sandstorm, a kind of Sandstorm that does more damage than a regular Sandstorm. This kind of Sandstorm also boosts Ground-type Pokémon’s Sp. Def, and won’t go away if you try to get rid of it. Next, there’s [green]Elias[blue]. When you fight him, all Ghost-type Pokémon will take half damage and be immune to entry hazards when they’re at full health. Safeguard and Substitute will also fail unless used by a Ghost-type. Third, comes [green]Arabella[blue]. Her room is filled with a Misty Terrain. And not only that, but any Fairy- types sent out will have their lowest defensive stat boosted. Lastly, comes [green]Penny[blue]. There’s a rainbow in her room that raises the chance of secondary move effects used by Dragon-types. Make sure you’re prepared for these conditions before you fight them!
