dari Pokémon League. Kamu bisa\lmenantang mereka dalam urutan apa

pun, tetapi jika kamu kalah dari
salah satu dari mereka, kamu harus\lmemulai tantangan dari awal.

entries.original: "You Are My Only"
entries.translation_source: You Are My Only
entries.translated: You Are My Only

entries.original:
"My only friend is my Pokémon.

I don’t need any more friends
than him.

The bond between a Trainer and
their best friend is unbreakable,\ldon’t you think?

A Trainer and their best friend
can beat any challenge!

Even the Pokémon League!

Do you think you can beat it with
only one Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: My only friend is my Pokémon. I don’t need any more friends than him. The bond between a Trainer and their best friend is unbreakable, don’t you think? A Trainer and their best friend can beat any challenge! Even the Pokémon League! Do you think you can beat it with only one Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Satu-satunya temanku adalah
Pokémon-ku. Aku tidak butuh teman\llain selain dia. Ikatan antara

Pelatih dan sahabat terbaiknya
tidak bisa dipatahkan, bukan?\lSeorang Pelatih dan sahabat

terbaiknya bisa mengalahkan
tantangan apa pun! Bahkan Pokémon\lLeague! Apakah kamu pikir kamu bisa

mengalahkannya hanya dengan satu
Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Good luck, and never forget the
bond between you and your Pokémon\lfills you with strength!"
entries.translation_source: Good luck, and never forget the bond between you and your Pokémon fills you with strength!
entries.translated:
Semoga beruntung, dan jangan pernah
lupa ikatan antara kamu dan\lPokémon-mu memberimu kekuatan!

entries.original:
"I guess you’re one of those people
that needs more than one friend."
entries.translation_source: I guess you’re one of those people that needs more than one friend.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu adalah salah satu
dari orang-orang yang membutuhkan\llebih dari satu teman.

entries.original:
"You can do it!

All you need to do is beat the
Pokémon League with just one\lPokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You can do it! All you need to do is beat the Pokémon League with just one Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa melakukannya! Yang perlu
kamu lakukan adalah mengalahkan\lPokémon League hanya dengan satu

Pokémon!

entries.original:
"You did it!

I definitely never doubted you!

You’ve proven the bond with your
Pokémon is most important to you.

Well, take this, in case you want
an even stronger friend."
entries.translation_source: You did it! I definitely never doubted you! You’ve proven the bond with your Pokémon is most important to you. Well, take this, in case you want an even stronger friend.
entries.translated:
Kamu berhasil! Aku pasti tidak
pernah meragukanmu! Kamu telah\lmembuktikan bahwa ikatan dengan

Pokémon-mu adalah yang terpenting
bagimu. Nah, ambil ini, kalau-kalau\lkamu ingin teman yang lebih kuat

lagi.

entries.original:
"Never underestimate the power of
friendship!

It is definitely the most important
stat!"
entries.translation_source: Never underestimate the power of friendship! It is definitely the most important stat!
entries.translated:
Jangan pernah meremehkan kekuatan
persahabatan! Itu pasti stat yang\lpaling penting!

entries.original: "Moleman"
entries.translation_source: Moleman
entries.translated: Moleman

entries.original:
"Who dares enter the domain of the
Mole-Man?

Surface-dweller!

For years, my fellow mole-people
and I have lived below ground with\lonly Ground-type Pokémon and the\lEarth itself.

In that world without sunlight, we
tempered our spirits and grew\lstrong!

And yet, you try to establish
dominance over us, as your\lancestors did so many years ago!?

Very well! Learn of the wrath of
the mole-people and the very Earth!"
entries.translation_source: Who dares enter the domain of the Mole-Man? Surface-dweller! For years, my fellow mole-people and I have lived below ground with only Ground-type Pokémon and the Earth itself. In that world without sunlight, we tempered our spirits and grew strong! And yet, you try to establish dominance over us, as your ancestors did so many years ago!? Very well! Learn of the wrath of the mole-people and the very Earth!
entries.translated:
Siapa yang berani memasuki wilayah
Mole-Man? Penghuni permukaan!\lSelama bertahun-tahun, sesama

manusia-mole dan aku telah tinggal
di bawah tanah hanya dengan Pokémon\ltipe Tanah dan Bumi itu sendiri. Di

dunia tanpa sinar matahari itu,
kami menguatkan jiwa kami dan\lmenjadi kuat! Namun, kamu mencoba

mendominasi kami, seperti yang
dilakukan leluhurmu bertahun-tahun\llalu!? Baiklah! Rasakan murka

manusia-mole dan Bumi itu sendiri!

entries.original:
"I cannot leave the clutches of this
so-called \qoElite Four\qc for now.

But when the time is right\. hmph.

Very well.

Test your mettle against the rest
of them.

Until we meet again\."
entries.translation_source: I cannot leave the clutches of this so-called \qoElite Four\qc for now. But when the time is right\. hmph. Very well. Test your mettle against the rest of them. Until we meet again\.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa lepas dari
cengkeraman yang disebut \qoElite\lFour\qc ini untuk saat ini. Tapi saat

waktunya tiba\. hmph. Baiklah. Uji
kemampuanmu melawan yang lainnya.\lSampai kita bertemu lagi\.

entries.original:
"So, you have bested the greatest
of man and mole-man.

It is time for you to take the
throne of Champion.

Enter through the door in the
centre of the room outside.

Until the day we mole-people take
it for our own\."
entries.translation_source: So, you have bested the greatest of man and mole-man. It is time for you to take the throne of Champion. Enter through the door in the centre of the room outside. Until the day we mole-people take it for our own\.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu telah mengalahkan yang
terhebat dari manusia dan\lmanusia-mole. Saatnya kamu

mengambil takhta Juara. Masuk
melalui pintu di tengah ruangan di\lluar. Sampai hari ketika kami

manusia-mole mengambilnya untuk
kami sendiri\.

entries.original:
"Surface-dweller!
You dare show yourself again?

I warn you, the mole-people do not
suffer an insult twice!

I have toiled underground,
reaffirming my connection\lto the Earth itself\.

All in preparation for this day!

And now, I shall exact my
vengeance on all surface-dwellers\.

Starting with you!"
entries.translation_source: Surface-dweller! You dare show yourself again? I warn you, the mole-people do not suffer an insult twice! I have toiled underground, reaffirming my connection to the Earth itself\. All in preparation for this day! And now, I shall exact my vengeance on all surface-dwellers\. Starting with you!
entries.translated:
Penghuni permukaan! Kamu berani
muncul lagi? Aku peringatkan,\lmanusia-mole tidak menahan

penghinaan dua kali! Aku telah
bekerja keras di bawah tanah,\lmemperkuat kembali hubunganku

dengan Bumi itu sendiri\. Semua
sebagai persiapan untuk hari ini!\lDan sekarang, aku akan membalas

dendam pada semua penghuni
permukaan\. Dimulai denganmu!

entries.original:
"Gah\. so my revenge must be
postponed for another day\.

Leave. And do not return, for I
shall surely triumph next time!"
entries.translation_source: Gah\. so my revenge must be postponed for another day\. Leave. And do not return, for I shall surely triumph next time!
entries.translated:
Gah\. jadi balas dendamku harus
ditunda untuk lain hari\. Pergilah.\lDan jangan kembali, karena aku

pasti akan menang lain kali!

entries.original:
"So, you have bested the greatest
of man and mole-man.

It is time for you to defend your
title of Champion.

Until the day we mole-people take
it for our own\."
entries.translation_source: So, you have bested the greatest of man and mole-man. It is time for you to defend your title of Champion. Until the day we mole-people take it for our own\.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu telah mengalahkan yang
terhebat dari manusia dan\lmanusia-mole. Saatnya kamu

mempertahankan gelar Juaramu.
Sampai hari ketika kami\lmanusia-mole mengambilnya untuk

kami sendiri\.

entries.original: "Elias"
entries.translation_source: Elias
entries.translated: Elias

entries.original:
"Howdy. I’m Elias.

Or rather, I’m the corpse formerly
known as Elias.

Guess being dead doesn’t get me
out of my duties as a member of\lthe Elite Four, huh?

Lousy economy\.

Yup. Served as a member for years
while I was alive.

Then those jerks dug up my body
after I croaked, and shoved a\lGhost Pokémon along with my spirit\lright back inside.

Oh, don’t get me wrong.

Still got my wits, and my Pokémon
haven’t gotten any less strong.

In fact, I think they might have
only gotten stronger, if anything\.

Sigh, I suppose we should battle
before this stupid flesh prison\lfalls apart."
entries.translation_source: Howdy. I’m Elias. Or rather, I’m the corpse formerly known as Elias. Guess being dead doesn’t get me out of my duties as a member of the Elite Four, huh? Lousy economy\. Yup. Served as a member for years while I was alive. Then those jerks dug up my body after I croaked, and shoved a Ghost Pokémon along with my spirit right back inside. Oh, don’t get me wrong. Still got my wits, and my Pokémon haven’t gotten any less strong. In fact, I think they might have only gotten stronger, if anything\. Sigh, I suppose we should battle before this stupid flesh prison falls apart.
entries.translated:
Halo. Aku Elias. Atau lebih
tepatnya, aku mayat yang dulu\ldikenal sebagai Elias. Kurasa mati

tidak membebaskanku dari tugasku
sebagai anggota Elite Four, ya?\lEkonomi yang buruk\. Yup. Bertugas

sebagai anggota selama
bertahun-tahun saat aku masih\lhidup. Lalu para brengsek itu

menggali tubuhku setelah aku mati,
dan memasukkan Pokémon Ghost\lbersama rohku kembali ke dalam. Oh,

jangan salah paham. Pikiranku masih
tajam, dan Pokémon-ku tidak menjadi\llebih lemah. Faktanya, menurutku

mereka malah semakin kuat, kalau
dipikir-pikir\. Hah, kurasa kita\lharus bertarung sebelum penjara

daging bodoh ini hancur.

entries.original:
"Well, can’t blame a loss on the
lousy job market, so I guess we’re\ldone here.

Go face the rest of the Elite Four.

And kid\. try not to let yourself
be dug up and experimented on\lafter you pass, okay?

Take it from me.
It’s really inconvenient."
entries.translation_source: Well, can’t blame a loss on the lousy job market, so I guess we’re done here. Go face the rest of the Elite Four. And kid\. try not to let yourself be dug up and experimented on after you pass, okay? Take it from me. It’s really inconvenient.
entries.translated:
Yah, tidak bisa menyalahkan
kekalahan pada pasar kerja yang\lburuk, jadi kurasa kita selesai di

sini. Hadapi anggota Elite Four
lainnya. Dan nak\. cobalah jangan\lsampai tubuhmu digali dan

dieksperimen setelah kau mati, oke?
Percayalah padaku. Itu sangat\lmerepotkan.

entries.original:
"Huh, would you look at that?

That’s all four of us down
for the count.

Take your rightful throne as
Champion.

It’s the centre door outside.
You can’t miss it."
entries.translation_source: Huh, would you look at that? That’s all four of us down for the count. Take your rightful throne as Champion. It’s the centre door outside. You can’t miss it.
entries.translated:
Hah, lihat itu? Kami berempat
semuanya kalah. Ambil takhta yang\lsah sebagai Champion. Itu pintu

tengah di luar. Kau tidak akan
salah.

entries.original:
"Hey.
Surprised to see me again?

Don’t be.
I sorta knew this would happen.

They keep telling me that they’ll
find my replacement eventually,\lbut that day never comes\.

But you didn’t come here to listen
to dead air. Or a dead man.

Sigh\. Let’s just get this battle
over with."
entries.translation_source: Hey. Surprised to see me again? Don’t be. I sorta knew this would happen. They keep telling me that they’ll find my replacement eventually, but that day never comes\. But you didn’t come here to listen to dead air. Or a dead man. Sigh\. Let’s just get this battle over with.
entries.translated:
Hei. Terkejut melihatku lagi?
Jangan kaget. Aku agak tahu ini\lakan terjadi. Mereka terus

mengatakan bahwa mereka akan
menemukan penggantiku suatu hari\lnanti, tapi hari itu tidak pernah

tiba\. Tapi kau tidak datang ke sini
untuk mendengarkan udara mati. Atau\lorang mati. Hah\. Ayo selesaikan

pertarungan ini.

entries.original:
"As much as I wanna pass on\.

I have a good mind to stick around
long enough to beat you first\.

\.I mean, whether it’s life or
death, I’m getting no respect as\lit is.

Anyway, move it.

There’s still some members of the
Elite Four to beat."
entries.translation_source: As much as I wanna pass on\. I have a good mind to stick around long enough to beat you first\. \.I mean, whether it’s life or death, I’m getting no respect as it is. Anyway, move it. There’s still some members of the Elite Four to beat.
entries.translated:
Seberapa pun aku ingin mati\. Aku
berniat untuk bertahan cukup lama\luntuk mengalahkanmu dulu\. \.Maksudku,

baik hidup atau mati, aku tidak
mendapat rasa hormat. Bagaimanapun,\llanjutkan. Masih ada beberapa

anggota Elite Four yang harus
dikalahkan.

entries.original:
"Huh, would you look at that?

That’s all four of us down
for the count.

Go defend your title of Champion."
entries.translation_source: Huh, would you look at that? That’s all four of us down for the count. Go defend your title of Champion.
entries.translated:
Hah, lihat itu? Kami berempat
semuanya kalah. Pergi pertahankan\lgelar Champion-mu.

entries.original: "Arabella"
entries.translation_source: Arabella
entries.translated: Arabella

entries.original:
"Hi there, friend!

Oh no, I’m not a lost kid!

I’m the Fairy Princess Arabella!
I’m one of the Elite Four!

Daddy used to be a member, but
then he got fired.

So, I volunteered, and now I’m in
the Elite Four!

It’s great! I get given lots of
money to battle Trainers!

\.even if I have to share some
with Daddy.

And I get to invite people to my
tea parties when I win!

Okay, friend!

Let’s battle! I’m gonna show you
how a fairy princess does it!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, friend! Oh no, I’m not a lost kid! I’m the Fairy Princess Arabella! I’m one of the Elite Four! Daddy used to be a member, but then he got fired. So, I volunteered, and now I’m in the Elite Four! It’s great! I get given lots of money to battle Trainers! \.even if I have to share some with Daddy. And I get to invite people to my tea parties when I win! Okay, friend! Let’s battle! I’m gonna show you how a fairy princess does it!
entries.translated:
Halo, teman! Oh tidak, aku bukan
anak hilang! Aku Putri Peri\lArabella! Aku salah satu Elite

Four! Ayah dulu anggota, tapi dia
dipecat. Jadi, aku mengajukan diri,\ldan sekarang aku di Elite Four!

Bagus! Aku diberi banyak uang untuk
bertarung melawan Trainer! \.bahkan\ljika aku harus berbagi dengan Ayah.

Dan aku bisa mengundang orang ke
pesta tehku saat menang! Oke,\lteman! Ayo bertarung! Aku akan

menunjukkan bagaimana putri peri
melakukannya!

entries.original:
"When you’re done with the rest of
the Elite Four, will you still join\lone of my tea parties?

It’s going to be so much fun!

If not\. can I ask: do you know
what \qodeadbeat\qc means?

That’s what people call Daddy now."
entries.translation_source: When you’re done with the rest of the Elite Four, will you still join one of my tea parties? It’s going to be so much fun! If not\. can I ask: do you know what \qodeadbeat\qc means? That’s what people call Daddy now.
entries.translated:
Setelah selesai dengan anggota
Elite Four lainnya, maukah kau\ltetap bergabung dengan salah satu

pesta tehku? Ini akan sangat
menyenangkan! Jika tidak\. boleh aku\lbertanya: apakah kau tahu apa arti

\qodeadbeat\qc? Itulah yang orang
panggil Ayah sekarang.

entries.original:
"Wow. You beat all of us!
You’re really super strong!

There’s a big door in the centre
of the hall outside.

That’s where the Champion room is!
You should go and see it!"
entries.translation_source: Wow. You beat all of us! You’re really super strong! There’s a big door in the centre of the hall outside. That’s where the Champion room is! You should go and see it!
entries.translated:
Wow. Kau mengalahkan kami semua!
Kau benar-benar sangat kuat! Ada\lpintu besar di tengah aula luar.

Itu adalah ruang Champion! Kau
harus pergi dan melihatnya!

entries.original:
"Hi there, [player]!
Did you miss me?

I just finished a tea party with
my friends just now.

Sorry, you’ll have to wait for the
next one\.

Oh! You’re here for a battle
instead, aren’t you\.?

Yay! I wanna show you how much
stronger I got! Really!

Okay! For my fairy friends, and
for Daddy\.

Arabella the fairy princess!
Transform!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, [player]! Did you miss me? I just finished a tea party with my friends just now. Sorry, you’ll have to wait for the next one\. Oh! You’re here for a battle instead, aren’t you\.? Yay! I wanna show you how much stronger I got! Really! Okay! For my fairy friends, and for Daddy\. Arabella the fairy princess! Transform!
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]! Apa kau
merindukanku? Aku baru saja selesai\lpesta teh dengan teman-temanku.

Maaf, kau harus menunggu yang
berikutnya\. Oh! Kau di sini untuk\lbertarung, bukan\.? Yay! Aku ingin

menunjukkan betapa kuatnya aku!
Sungguh! Oke! Untuk teman-teman\lperi-ku, dan untuk Ayah\. Arabella

putri peri! Berubah!

entries.original:
"Thanks for battling me again!

Daddy hardly battles anymore since
he quit.

But it’s okay!

I’ll keep working at the Elite Four
until Daddy gets a new job!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks for battling me again! Daddy hardly battles anymore since he quit. But it’s okay! I’ll keep working at the Elite Four until Daddy gets a new job!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih sudah bertarung lagi!
Ayah jarang bertarung lagi sejak\ldia berhenti. Tapi tidak apa-apa!

Aku akan terus bekerja di Elite
Four sampai Ayah mendapat pekerjaan\lbaru!

entries.original:
"Wow. You beat all of us!
You’re really super strong!

You should go defend your title of
Champion now!"
entries.translation_source: Wow. You beat all of us! You’re really super strong! You should go defend your title of Champion now!
entries.translated:
Wow. Kau mengalahkan kami semua!
Kau benar-benar sangat kuat! Kau\lharus pergi mempertahankan gelar

Champion-mu sekarang!

entries.original: "Penny"
entries.translation_source: Penny
entries.translated: Penny

entries.original:
"Hi, I’m Penny!

\.what?
This thing I’m wearing?

These aren’t clothes, they’re my
patented Goodra bottoms!

I’ve always been a huge fan of
Dragon-type Pokémon, so I love\llooking just like them!

There isn’t anything I don’t know
about them, and there isn’t a\lsingle piece of Dragon merchandise\lI haven’t bought!

Dragons are the best!

With their tails and their wings
and their FIRE BREATHING!

A filthy casual like you doesn’t
stand a chance against me!

I’ll prove it to you right now!

GRAWR!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, I’m Penny! \.what? This thing I’m wearing? These aren’t clothes, they’re my patented Goodra bottoms! I’ve always been a huge fan of Dragon-type Pokémon, so I love looking just like them! There isn’t anything I don’t know about them, and there isn’t a single piece of Dragon merchandise I haven’t bought! Dragons are the best! With their tails and their wings and their FIRE BREATHING! A filthy casual like you doesn’t stand a chance against me! I’ll prove it to you right now! GRAWR!
entries.translated:
Halo, aku Penny! \. apa? Benda yang
kupakai ini? Ini bukan pakaian, ini\lcelana Goodra patenku! Aku selalu

menjadi penggemar berat Pokémon
Tipe Dragon, jadi aku suka terlihat\lseperti mereka! Tidak ada yang

tidak aku ketahui tentang mereka,
dan tidak ada satu pun barang\ldagangan Dragon yang belum kubeli!

Dragon adalah yang terbaik! Dengan
ekor mereka, sayap mereka, dan\lNAPAS API mereka! Orang amatiran

seperti kau tidak punya kesempatan
melawanku! Akan kubuktikan\lsekarang! GRAWR!

entries.original:
"You’re still not done yet, right?
Go battle the rest of the Elite Four!

Me? I’m gonna go pick up my
Haxorus edition Unova coffee mug\land mouse pad.

You should get it soon, it’s only
on sale for the next three days!"
entries.translation_source: You’re still not done yet, right? Go battle the rest of the Elite Four! Me? I’m gonna go pick up my Haxorus edition Unova coffee mug and mouse pad. You should get it soon, it’s only on sale for the next three days!
entries.translated:
Kau belum selesai, kan? Hadapi
anggota Elite Four lainnya! Aku?\lAku akan mengambil cangkir kopi dan

mouse pad Unova edisi Haxorus-ku.
Kau harus segera mendapatkannya,\lhanya diskon selama tiga hari ke

depan!

entries.original:
"Wowee!
Even I lost!

And now you get to be
Borrius’ Champion!

It’s time for you to take the
centre door right outside.

As for me, I’m heading off to
Dragon-con.

You want me to pick you up anything
while I’m there?

No? Ah, suit yourself.
More merch for me!"
entries.translation_source: Wowee! Even I lost! And now you get to be Borrius’ Champion! It’s time for you to take the centre door right outside. As for me, I’m heading off to Dragon-con. You want me to pick you up anything while I’m there? No? Ah, suit yourself. More merch for me!
entries.translated:
Wowee! Bahkan aku kalah! Dan
sekarang kau menjadi Champion\lBorrius! Saatnya kau mengambil

pintu tengah di luar. Sedangkan
aku, aku akan pergi ke Dragon-con.\lKau ingin aku membelikan sesuatu

saat di sana? Tidak? Ah, terserah
kau. Lebih banyak barang untukku!

entries.original:
"Oh hey, it’s you again!

I’ve been levelling up my Dragons
since we last battled!

And now, thanks to my harsh
training, non-stop studying of\lDragon’s Monthly, and a king’s\lransom of Dragon memorabilia\.

I’m the greatest expert on all
things Dragon you ever saw!

Dukes up! My Dragons and I are
itching to throw down!

GRAWR!"
entries.translation_source: Oh hey, it’s you again! I’ve been levelling up my Dragons since we last battled! And now, thanks to my harsh training, non-stop studying of Dragon’s Monthly, and a king’s ransom of Dragon memorabilia\. I’m the greatest expert on all things Dragon you ever saw! Dukes up! My Dragons and I are itching to throw down! GRAWR!
entries.translated:
Oh hei, kau lagi! Aku sudah
menaikkan level Dragon-ku sejak\lpertarungan terakhir! Dan sekarang,

berkat latihan keras, belajar tanpa
henti dari Dragon{B4}s Monthly, dan\ltebusan kerajaan memorabilia Dragon\.

Aku adalah ahli terhebat tentang
semua hal Dragon yang pernah kau\llihat! Angkat tinju! Dragon-ku dan

aku tidak sabar untuk bertarung!
GRAWR!

entries.original:
"Nooo\. that magazine was a non-
cancellable subscription\. and\lI still couldn’t beat you\.

I’m picking up a Noivern tracksuit
to cheer myself up.

And no, you can’t have one.

The title of Borrius’ repeat
Champion is good enough, don’t\lyou think?

Now don’t lose to the others\.
until I beat you myself!"
entries.translation_source: Nooo\. that magazine was a non- cancellable subscription\. and I still couldn’t beat you\. I’m picking up a Noivern tracksuit to cheer myself up. And no, you can’t have one. The title of Borrius’ repeat Champion is good enough, don’t you think? Now don’t lose to the others\. until I beat you myself!
entries.translated:
Tidaaak\. majalah itu adalah
langganan yang tidak bisa\ldibatalkan\. dan aku tetap tidak bisa

mengalahkanmu\. Aku akan membeli
tracksuit Noivern untuk menghibur\ldiri. Dan tidak, kau tidak bisa

mendapatkannya. Gelar Champion
berulang Borrius sudah cukup baik,\lbukan? Sekarang jangan kalah pada

yang lain\. sampai aku mengalahkanmu
sendiri!

entries.original:
"Wowee!
Even I lost!

And now you get to defend your
title of Champion!

As for me, I’m heading off to
Dragon-con.

You want me to pick you up anything
while I’m there?

No? Ah, suit yourself.
More merch for me!"
entries.translation_source: Wowee! Even I lost! And now you get to defend your title of Champion! As for me, I’m heading off to Dragon-con. You want me to pick you up anything while I’m there? No? Ah, suit yourself. More merch for me!
entries.translated:
Wowee! Aku saja kalah! Dan sekarang
kamu bisa mempertahankan gelar\lJuara! Kalau aku, aku akan pergi ke

Dragon-con. Kamu mau aku bawain
sesuatu? Tidak? Ah, terserah kamu.\lLebih banyak barang untukku!

entries.original: "Solenk"
entries.translation_source: Solenk
entries.translated: Solenk

entries.original:
"[black]You defended your title!
Congratulations!"
entries.translation_source: [black]You defended your title! Congratulations!
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu berhasil mempertahankan
gelarmu! Selamat!

entries.original:
"Hey, [player]! I finally caught up
to you!

So funny story - I had to put my
Gym Challenge on the backburner,\lthanks to my dad\.

But now that we’re done catching
up, I clawed my way through the\lElite Four, just to see you.

So let’s get back to what’s really
important.

Me\.\CC0820 taking your Champion’s title!

I’ve put together the best of
the best in this lineup\.

And that includes a super rare
Pokémon I found at Cinder Volcano!

Ready, [player]?
Because you’re going down!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player]! I finally caught up to you! So funny story - I had to put my Gym Challenge on the backburner, thanks to my dad\. But now that we’re done catching up, I clawed my way through the Elite Four, just to see you. So let’s get back to what’s really important. Me\.\CC0820 taking your Champion’s title! I’ve put together the best of the best in this lineup\. And that includes a super rare Pokémon I found at Cinder Volcano! Ready, [player]? Because you’re going down!
entries.translated:
Hei, [player]! Akhirnya aku bisa
menyusulmu! Cerita lucu - aku harus\lmenunda tantangan Gym-ku karena

ayahku\. Tapi sekarang setelah kita
selesai berbincang, aku berhasil\lmelewati Elite Four hanya untuk

menemuimu. Jadi, mari kembali ke
hal yang paling penting. Aku\.\CC0820\lmengambil gelar Juara darimu! Aku

sudah menyusun yang terbaik dari
yang terbaik di tim ini\. Dan itu\ltermasuk Pokémon super langka yang

kutemukan di Cinder Volcano! Siap,
[player]? Karena kamu akan kalah!

entries.original:
"[player]!

I can’t let you pass through there,
without another round with me!

After all, how can I show my face
to Dad if I can’t even beat one\lmeasly Trainer?

Let’s go! I’m taking your spot at the
top for sure!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! I can’t let you pass through there, without another round with me! After all, how can I show my face to Dad if I can’t even beat one measly Trainer? Let’s go! I’m taking your spot at the top for sure!
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku tidak bisa
membiarkanmu lewat tanpa bertarung\llagi denganku! Lagipula, bagaimana

aku bisa menunjukkan wajahku pada
Ayah jika aku bahkan tidak bisa\lmengalahkan satu Pelatih kecil?

Ayo! Aku pasti akan mengambil
posisimu di puncak!

entries.original:
"Wait one moment, [player]!

Are you surprised to see me out
here?

Well, I thought I heard a familiar
cry calling out to me\.

That was the moment when I
encountered Zapdos.

No, not the one from Thundercap Mt.\.\CC0818
the one Aklove used for the\lunbinding at the Ruins of Void.

I still don’t know why it came to me,
why it chose me as its Trainer\.

But I knew it was a sign - that I
had to find you and battle you\lonce again!

To be honest, defeating you is
[rival]’s goal, first and foremost\.

But I’m his father - I can’t sit
around and let my own skills\lstagnate, can I?

So, no matter how long a shot
this is, I’d like to try my hand\lat defeating you!"
entries.translation_source: Wait one moment, [player]! Are you surprised to see me out here? Well, I thought I heard a familiar cry calling out to me\. That was the moment when I encountered Zapdos. No, not the one from Thundercap Mt.\.\CC0818 the one Aklove used for the unbinding at the Ruins of Void. I still don’t know why it came to me, why it chose me as its Trainer\. But I knew it was a sign - that I had to find you and battle you once again! To be honest, defeating you is [rival]’s goal, first and foremost\. But I’m his father - I can’t sit around and let my own skills stagnate, can I? So, no matter how long a shot this is, I’d like to try my hand at defeating you!
entries.translated:
[player]! Apakah kamu terkejut
melihatku di sini? Yah, aku pikir\laku mendengar teriakan familiar

memanggilku\. Saat itulah aku bertemu
Zapdos. Bukan, bukan yang dari\lThundercap Mt.\.\CC0818 yang digunakan

Aklove untuk melepaskan ikatan di
Ruins of Void. Aku masih tidak tahu\lmengapa ia datang kepadaku, mengapa

ia memilihku sebagai Pelatihnya\.
Tapi aku tahu itu adalah pertanda -\lbahwa aku harus menemukanmu dan

bertarung lagi! Sejujurnya,
mengalahkanmu adalah tujuan\l[rival], yang terutama\. Tapi aku

ayahnya - aku tidak bisa duduk diam
dan membiarkan kemampuanku sendiri\lmandek, kan? Jadi, tidak peduli

seberapa kecil kemungkinannya, aku
ingin mencoba mengalahkanmu!

entries.original:
"One moment, [player].

I’m afraid that [rival] and I have
a bit of a rivalry brewing at home\.

Who can be the first to claim your
title of Champion - myself, or\l[rival]?

And as a Trainer, I have my pride.

I can’t allow myself to lose to
[rival] that easily.

And so, I have to put everything I
have on the line to take you down!"
entries.translation_source: One moment, [player]. I’m afraid that [rival] and I have a bit of a rivalry brewing at home\. Who can be the first to claim your title of Champion - myself, or [rival]? And as a Trainer, I have my pride. I can’t allow myself to lose to [rival] that easily. And so, I have to put everything I have on the line to take you down!
entries.translated:
Sebentar, [player]. Aku khawatir
bahwa [rival] dan aku memiliki\lsedikit persaingan di rumah\. Siapa

yang pertama bisa merebut gelar
Juara kamu - aku sendiri, atau\l[rival]? Dan sebagai Pelatih, aku

punya harga diri. Aku tidak bisa
membiarkan diriku kalah dari\l[rival] semudah itu. Dan karena

itu, aku harus mempertaruhkan
segalanya untuk mengalahkanmu!

entries.original:
"There you are, [player].

I\.\CC0818 well, when I heard that you had
returned to the Pokémon League\.

I thought that this would be my
biggest chance to battle you again.

I don’t quite know why, myself.

Is it simply to try and impress
Marlon, or even [rival]?

Or does it stem from something
else entirely\.?

I actually don’t quite remember, and
yet, here I am.

But either way, you cannot refuse my
challenge, so get ready!"
entries.translation_source: There you are, [player]. I\.\CC0818 well, when I heard that you had returned to the Pokémon League\. I thought that this would be my biggest chance to battle you again. I don’t quite know why, myself. Is it simply to try and impress Marlon, or even [rival]? Or does it stem from something else entirely\.? I actually don’t quite remember, and yet, here I am. But either way, you cannot refuse my challenge, so get ready!
entries.translated:
Ini dia, [player]. Aku\.\CC0818 yah, ketika
kudengar kamu telah kembali ke Liga\lPokémon\. Aku pikir ini akan menjadi

kesempatan terbesarku untuk
bertarung lagi denganmu. Aku\lsendiri tidak begitu tahu

alasannya. Apakah hanya untuk
mencoba mengesankan Marlon, atau\lbahkan [rival]? Atau berasal dari

sesuatu yang lain sama sekali\.? Aku
sebenarnya tidak terlalu ingat,\lnamun, di sinilah aku. Tapi

bagaimanapun, kamu tidak bisa
menolak tantanganku, jadi\lbersiaplah!

entries.original:
"Yes, [player] it’s me - I’ve returned
for another battle with you.

Something stirs within me\. almost like
I have to defeat you, no matter\lwhat it takes\.

Is this my pride as a Trainer?
Or maybe something else\.

Either way, I don’t think I’ll settle
down without one more try!"
entries.translation_source: Yes, [player] it’s me - I’ve returned for another battle with you. Something stirs within me\. almost like I have to defeat you, no matter what it takes\. Is this my pride as a Trainer? Or maybe something else\. Either way, I don’t think I’ll settle down without one more try!
entries.translated:
Ya, [player] ini aku - aku kembali
untuk bertarung lagi denganmu.\lSesuatu bergolak di dalam diriku\.

hampir seperti aku harus
mengalahkanmu, apa pun yang\ldiperlukan\. Apakah ini harga diriku

sebagai Pelatih? Atau mungkin
sesuatu yang lain\. Bagaimanapun, aku\lrasa aku tidak akan tenang tanpa

satu percobaan lagi!

entries.original:
"I’m afraid I cannot let you pass
through those doors so easily.

You see, my son was pestering me to
find you and record a victory.

And as his father, I ought to do my
very best for him!

Ah, but of course, I don’t expect
you to just hand me a victory out\lof pity.

Let me test myself against the true
strength of Borrius’s Champion!"
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid I cannot let you pass through those doors so easily. You see, my son was pestering me to find you and record a victory. And as his father, I ought to do my very best for him! Ah, but of course, I don’t expect you to just hand me a victory out of pity. Let me test myself against the true strength of Borrius’s Champion!
entries.translated:
Aku khawatir aku tidak bisa
membiarkanmu melewati pintu-pintu\litu dengan mudah. Soalnya, anakku

terus mendesakku untuk mencarimu
dan meraih kemenangan. Dan sebagai\layahnya, aku harus melakukan yang

terbaik untuknya! Ah, tapi tentu
saja, aku tidak berharap kamu\lmemberiku kemenangan begitu saja

karena iba. Biarkan aku menguji
diriku melawan kekuatan sejati\lJuara Borrius!

entries.original:
"[player]!
So you finally came back, huh?

Ever since I lost to you, I’ve been
thinking long and hard about what\lI’ve been lacking\.

And especially about my Grampa
Arthur’s legacy\.

But right now, this isn’t about
Grampa. Or even about me.

This is about knowing there’s a strong
Trainer in front of me, ripe to be\lchallenged!

And that’s what gets my heart
racing, no matter when or where!

It’s on, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! So you finally came back, huh? Ever since I lost to you, I’ve been thinking long and hard about what I’ve been lacking\. And especially about my Grampa Arthur’s legacy\. But right now, this isn’t about Grampa. Or even about me. This is about knowing there’s a strong Trainer in front of me, ripe to be challenged! And that’s what gets my heart racing, no matter when or where! It’s on, [player]!
entries.translated:
[player]! Jadi kamu akhirnya
kembali, ya? Sejak aku kalah\ldarimu, aku sudah berpikir keras

tentang apa yang kurang dariku\. Dan
terutama tentang warisan Kakek\lArthur\. Tapi sekarang, ini bukan

tentang Kakek. Atau bahkan
tentangku. Ini tentang mengetahui\lada seorang Pelatih kuat di

depanku, siap untuk ditantang! Dan
itulah yang membuat jantungku\lberdebar, kapan pun dan di mana

pun! Ayo, [player]!

entries.original:
"Back again, [player]?
Well, so am I.

No matter how often I lose,
I can’t help it!

Every battle, I get to measure just
how much of a gap I have to close\lto catch up to you!

So, let’s see the level of strength I
have to surpass, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Back again, [player]? Well, so am I. No matter how often I lose, I can’t help it! Every battle, I get to measure just how much of a gap I have to close to catch up to you! So, let’s see the level of strength I have to surpass, [player]!
entries.translated:
Kembali lagi, [player]? Yah, aku
juga. Tidak peduli seberapa sering\laku kalah, aku tidak bisa

menahannya! Setiap pertempuran, aku
bisa mengukur seberapa besar jarak\lyang harus aku tutup untuk

menyusulmu! Jadi, mari kita lihat
tingkat kekuatan yang harus aku\llampaui, [player]!

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Remember me? It’s Milo!
From Thundercap Mt.!

I came all this way just to see
you again!

Say, let’s have a battle!

I bet it’ll be super fun with a
strong Trainer like you!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player]! Remember me? It’s Milo! From Thundercap Mt.! I came all this way just to see you again! Say, let’s have a battle! I bet it’ll be super fun with a strong Trainer like you!
entries.translated:
Hai, [player]! Ingat aku? Ini Milo!
Dari Thundercap Mt.! Aku datang\lsejauh ini hanya untuk menemuimu

lagi! Ayo, kita bertarung! Aku
yakin ini akan sangat menyenangkan\ldengan Pelatih kuat sepertimu!

entries.original:
"Hey, Champion!

I made it through the Elite Four
just so I could battle with you!

Me and my shorts won’t lose this
fight!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Champion! I made it through the Elite Four just so I could battle with you! Me and my shorts won’t lose this fight!
entries.translated:
Hei, Juara! Aku berhasil melewati
Elite Four hanya agar aku bisa\lbertarung denganmu! Aku dan celana

pendekku tidak akan kalah dalam
pertarungan ini!

entries.original: "Polder Town"
entries.translation_source: Polder Town
entries.translated: Polder Town

entries.original:
"Welcome to East Borrius!

Polder Town is a far cry from
any place in West Borrius, don’t\lyou think?

Like, I doubt West Borrians would
willingly live in a swamp."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to East Borrius! Polder Town is a far cry from any place in West Borrius, don’t you think? Like, I doubt West Borrians would willingly live in a swamp.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di East Borrius!
Polder Town sangat berbeda dari\ltempat mana pun di West Borrius,

bukankah begitu? Kayaknya, aku ragu
orang West Borrian mau tinggal di\lrawa.

entries.original:
"You might think the muddy ground
makes it hard to live here, but\lguess again!

The mud is actually very good for
the skin."
entries.translation_source: You might think the muddy ground makes it hard to live here, but guess again! The mud is actually very good for the skin.
entries.translated:
Kamu mungkin berpikir tanah
berlumpur membuat sulit tinggal di\lsini, tapi tebak lagi! Lumpur itu

sebenarnya sangat baik untuk kulit.

entries.original:
"Tessy’s Pokémon may not all look
like [green]Water[red]-type Pokémon, but I\lguarantee you, most will be when\lyou fight them!"
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s Pokémon may not all look like [green]Water[red]-type Pokémon, but I guarantee you, most will be when you fight them!
entries.translated:
Pokémon milik Tessy mungkin tidak
semuanya terlihat seperti [green]Air[red]-type\lPokémon, tapi aku jamin, sebagian

besar akan menjadi seperti itu saat
kamu melawan mereka!

entries.original:
"Tessy’s so smart!

She figured out a way to make her
Pokémon the same type as their\lmoves!

I bet she learned how at the
[green]Battle Circus[red]."
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s so smart! She figured out a way to make her Pokémon the same type as their moves! I bet she learned how at the [green]Battle Circus[red].
entries.translated:
Tessy sangat pintar! Dia menemukan
cara untuk membuat Pokémon-nya\lmemiliki tipe yang sama dengan

gerakan mereka! Aku yakin dia
belajar caranya di [green]Battle Circus[red].

entries.original:
"Today, we’re dancing for a reason.

When we fulfill our purpose, we’ll
disappear for a reason."
entries.translation_source: Today, we’re dancing for a reason. When we fulfill our purpose, we’ll disappear for a reason.
entries.translated:
Hari ini, kita menari untuk suatu
alasan. Saat kita memenuhi tujuan\lkita, kita akan menghilang untuk

suatu alasan.

entries.original:
"We dance to worship our goddess!
The one and only Meloetta!

Who needs Arceus?"
entries.translation_source: We dance to worship our goddess! The one and only Meloetta! Who needs Arceus?
entries.translated:
Kami menari untuk memuja dewi kami!
Satu-satunya Meloetta! Siapa yang\lbutuh Arceus?

entries.original:
"Legend has it that Meloetta will
appear if you dance hard enough.

We dance for the chance to one day
witness a true dancer."
entries.translation_source: Legend has it that Meloetta will appear if you dance hard enough. We dance for the chance to one day witness a true dancer.
entries.translated:
Legenda mengatakan bahwa Meloetta
akan muncul jika kamu menari dengan\lcukup keras. Kami menari untuk

kesempatan suatu hari menyaksikan
penari sejati.

entries.original:
"The night I see Meloetta is the
night I resume my normal life.

But until then\.
I dance!"
entries.translation_source: The night I see Meloetta is the night I resume my normal life. But until then\. I dance!
entries.translated:
Malam saat aku melihat Meloetta
adalah malam aku kembali ke\lkehidupan normal. Tapi sampai saat

itu\. Aku menari!

entries.original:
"Meloetta!
We love you!"
entries.translation_source: Meloetta! We love you!
entries.translated: Meloetta! Kami mencintaimu!

entries.original:
"[black]Meloetta is challenging you to a
dance off for the right to battle!

Do you accept the challenge?"
entries.translation_source: [black]Meloetta is challenging you to a dance off for the right to battle! Do you accept the challenge?
entries.translated:
[black]Meloetta menantangmu dalam dance
off untuk hak bertarung! Apakah\lkamu menerima tantangan ini?

entries.original:
"[black]During the course of the dance off,
keys will appear on the screen.

To win, press all corresponding
keys before they disappear."
entries.translation_source: [black]During the course of the dance off, keys will appear on the screen. To win, press all corresponding keys before they disappear.
entries.translated:
[black]Selama dance off berlangsung,
tombol-tombol akan muncul di layar.\lUntuk menang, tekan semua tombol

yang sesuai sebelum mereka
menghilang.

entries.original:
"[black]Meloetta is pleased with your
performance.

It acknowledges your right to
battle it!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Meloetta is pleased with your performance. It acknowledges your right to battle it!
entries.translated:
[black]Meloetta senang dengan
penampilanmu. Ia mengakui hakmu\luntuk bertarung dengannya!

entries.original:
"[black]Meloetta is displeased you could
not defeat it in a dance off."
entries.translation_source: [black]Meloetta is displeased you could not defeat it in a dance off.
entries.translated:
[black]Meloetta tidak senang karena kamu
tidak bisa mengalahkannya dalam\ldance off.

entries.original: "Lalalala!"
entries.translation_source: Lalalala!
entries.translated: Lalalala!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] took off in the
moonlight."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] took off in the moonlight.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] lepas landas di bawah
sinar bulan.

entries.original:
"Will you come see Polder Town’s
famous Croagunk show?"
entries.translation_source: Will you come see Polder Town’s famous Croagunk show?
entries.translated:
Maukah kamu datang melihat
pertunjukan Croagunk terkenal di\lPolder Town?

entries.original:
"Okay!
I’m going to get all fired up!"
entries.translation_source: Okay! I’m going to get all fired up!
entries.translated: Oke! Aku akan bersemangat!

entries.original:
"Ready all Croagunk!
Everyone, gather up!"
entries.translation_source: Ready all Croagunk! Everyone, gather up!
entries.translated:
Siap semua Croagunk! Semuanya,
berkumpul!

entries.original:
"The Croagunk that I will have you
follow today is\."
entries.translation_source: The Croagunk that I will have you follow today is\.
entries.translated:
Croagunk yang akan aku minta kamu
ikuti hari ini adalah\.

entries.original:
"This--the Croagunk with the
[buffer2]!

It’s holding a [buffer1]!
Ready, set, go!"
entries.translation_source: This--the Croagunk with the [buffer2]! It’s holding a [buffer1]! Ready, set, go!
entries.translated:
Ini--Croagunk dengan [buffer2]! Ia
membawa [buffer1]! Siap, siap,\lmulai!

entries.original:
"Okay! Find the Croagunk that
I asked you to follow!"
entries.translation_source: Okay! Find the Croagunk that I asked you to follow!
entries.translated:
Oke! Temukan Croagunk yang aku
minta kamu ikuti!

entries.original:
"[red]That Croagunk is holding a
[buffer1], right?"
entries.translation_source: [red]That Croagunk is holding a [buffer1], right?
entries.translated: [red]Croagunk itu membawa [buffer1], kan?

entries.original:
"[red]You are\.
\.\ltotally correct!

Receive the prize, a [buffer1],
from that Croagunk!"
entries.translation_source: [red]You are\. \. totally correct! Receive the prize, a [buffer1], from that Croagunk!
entries.translated:
[red]Kamu\. \. sepenuhnya benar! Terima
hadiahnya, sebuah [buffer1], dari\lCroagunk itu!

entries.original:
"[red]You are\.
\.\linconceivably incorrect!

I’m sorry\."
entries.translation_source: [red]You are\. \. inconceivably incorrect! I’m sorry\.
entries.translated:
[red]Kamu\. \. benar-benar salah! Aku minta
maaf\.

entries.original:
"[red]That marks the grand finale of our
Croagunk show!

Thank you, one and all!"
entries.translation_source: [red]That marks the grand finale of our Croagunk show! Thank you, one and all!
entries.translated:
[red]Itu menandai grand finale
pertunjukan Croagunk kami! Terima\lkasih, satu dan semua!

entries.original:
"That’s too bad\.
I guarantee it’s great, though."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad\. I guarantee it’s great, though.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali\. Tapi aku jamin ini
bagus.

entries.original:
"You want to see the Croagunk
again?

There are a lot of preparations
and such to make, so come back\ltomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: You want to see the Croagunk again? There are a lot of preparations and such to make, so come back tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Kamu ingin melihat Croagunk lagi?
Ada banyak persiapan dan sebagainya\lyang harus dilakukan, jadi

kembalilah besok!

entries.original: "[green]Croak\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Croak\.
entries.translated: [green]Croak\.

entries.original:
"Operating a ship every day can wear
you out! It’s not running today.

It leaves for Seaport City on
[green]Sundays[blue] and [green]Wednesdays[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Operating a ship every day can wear you out! It’s not running today. It leaves for Seaport City on [green]Sundays[blue] and [green]Wednesdays[blue]!
entries.translated:
Mengoperasikan kapal setiap hari
bisa melelahkan! Hari ini tidak\lberoperasi. Kapal ini berangkat ke

Seaport City pada hari [green]Minggu[blue] dan
[green]Rabu[blue]!

entries.original:
"When it’s working, the S.S. Marine
sets sail to West Borrius on\lSundays and Wednesdays."
entries.translation_source: When it’s working, the S.S. Marine sets sail to West Borrius on Sundays and Wednesdays.
entries.translated:
Saat beroperasi, S.S. Marine
berlayar ke West Borrius pada hari\lMinggu dan Rabu.

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine sets sail to West
Borrius every [green]Sunday[blue] and [green]Wednesday[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine sets sail to West Borrius every [green]Sunday[blue] and [green]Wednesday[blue].
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine berlayar ke West
Borrius setiap hari [green]Minggu[blue] dan\l[green]Rabu[blue].

entries.original: "Average Angler"
entries.translation_source: Average Angler
entries.translated: Pemancing Rata-rata

entries.original: "Great Piscator"
entries.translation_source: Great Piscator
entries.translated: Piscator Hebat

entries.original: "Fisher Master"
entries.translation_source: Fisher Master
entries.translated: Master Pemancing

entries.original:
"Hey, Trainer!

Remember me?
I certainly remember you.

I’m the guy you met in Gurun Town!

My hope was to strike it big here
in East Borrius, but the only gig\lI could find involves fishing\.

Anyway, I was hired as a sporting
goods promoter by Cube Corp.

They wanted me to encourage
Trainers to fish more, and\lthereby promote their signature\lfishing rod band.

So, here’s my encouragement
to you!

If you fish for at least [green][buffer1][blue]
Pokémon using fishing rods you\lobtain yourself, you’ll be eligible\lfor a reward!

How does that sound?
Great, right?

Come back to me if you’ve fished at
least [green][buffer1][blue] times!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Trainer! Remember me? I certainly remember you. I’m the guy you met in Gurun Town! My hope was to strike it big here in East Borrius, but the only gig I could find involves fishing\. Anyway, I was hired as a sporting goods promoter by Cube Corp. They wanted me to encourage Trainers to fish more, and thereby promote their signature fishing rod band. So, here’s my encouragement to you! If you fish for at least [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon using fishing rods you obtain yourself, you’ll be eligible for a reward! How does that sound? Great, right? Come back to me if you’ve fished at least [green][buffer1][blue] times!
entries.translated:
Hei, Trainer! Ingat aku? Aku pasti
ingat kamu. Aku orang yang kamu\ltemui di Gurun Town! Harapanku

adalah sukses besar di East Borrius
ini, tapi satu-satunya pekerjaan\lyang bisa kudapatkan adalah

memancing\. Pokoknya, aku direkrut
sebagai promotor perlengkapan\lolahraga oleh Cube Corp. Mereka

ingin aku mendorong para Trainer
untuk lebih banyak memancing, dan\ldengan begitu mempromosikan joran

khas mereka. Jadi, inilah
dukunganku untukmu! Jika kamu\lmemancing setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]

Pokémon menggunakan joran yang kamu
dapatkan sendiri, kamu akan\lmemenuhi syarat untuk mendapatkan

hadiah! Bagaimana menurutmu? Hebat,
bukan? Kembalilah padaku jika kamu\lsudah memancing setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]

kali!

entries.original:
"After your great showing, I now
have another task for you.

Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even
further by fishing for Pokémon\lat least [green][buffer1][blue] times."
entries.translation_source: After your great showing, I now have another task for you. Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even further by fishing for Pokémon at least [green][buffer1][blue] times.
entries.translated:
Setelah pertunjukan hebatmu,
sekarang aku punya tugas lain\luntukmu. Promosikan joran Cube

Corp. lebih jauh lagi dengan
memancing Pokémon setidaknya\l[green][buffer1][blue] kali.

entries.original:
"After your great showing, I now
have one last task for you.

Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even
further by fishing for Pokémon\lat least 50 more times, for a\lgrand total of [green][buffer1][blue] times!

This should be easy for a great
piscator such as yourself."
entries.translation_source: After your great showing, I now have one last task for you. Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even further by fishing for Pokémon at least 50 more times, for a grand total of [green][buffer1][blue] times! This should be easy for a great piscator such as yourself.
entries.translated:
Setelah pertunjukan hebatmu,
sekarang aku punya satu tugas\lterakhir untukmu. Promosikan joran

Cube Corp. lebih jauh lagi dengan
memancing Pokémon setidaknya 50\lkali lagi, sehingga total menjadi

[green][buffer1][blue] kali! Ini pasti mudah bagi
seorang piscator hebat seperti\ldirimu.

entries.original:
"Great job, Trainer!

I’ve received word from Cube Corp.
that you’ve promoted their brand\la total of [green][buffer2][blue] times!

Here’s your reward!"
entries.translation_source: Great job, Trainer! I’ve received word from Cube Corp. that you’ve promoted their brand a total of [green][buffer2][blue] times! Here’s your reward!
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, Trainer! Aku mendapat
kabar dari Cube Corp. bahwa kamu\ltelah mempromosikan merek mereka

sebanyak [green][buffer2][blue] kali! Ini
hadiahmu!

entries.original:
"Thanks to your fishing efforts,
I’ve been promoted!

I’m now the assistant to the
regional manager of Cube Corp.’s\lfishing branch!

Some day soon, I’ll be running
that joint!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks to your fishing efforts, I’ve been promoted! I’m now the assistant to the regional manager of Cube Corp.’s fishing branch! Some day soon, I’ll be running that joint!
entries.translated:
Berkat usahamu memancing, aku
dipromosikan! Aku sekarang menjadi\lasisten manajer regional cabang

perikanan Cube Corp! Suatu hari
nanti, aku akan memimpin tempat\litu!

entries.original:
"My sources at Cube Corp. tell me
that you’ve only fished for [green][buffer2][blue]\lPokémon so far.

You need to fish for at least [green][buffer1][blue]
if you want the reward."
entries.translation_source: My sources at Cube Corp. tell me that you’ve only fished for [green][buffer2][blue] Pokémon so far. You need to fish for at least [green][buffer1][blue] if you want the reward.
entries.translated:
Sumberku di Cube Corp. memberi tahu
bahwa kamu baru memancing [green][buffer2][blue]\lPokémon sejauh ini. Kamu perlu

memancing setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] jika
ingin hadiahnya.

entries.original:
"Or at least, I’d like to give you
one, but you have no space in your\lparty for it."
entries.translation_source: Or at least, I’d like to give you one, but you have no space in your party for it.
entries.translated:
Atau setidaknya, aku ingin
memberimu satu, tapi tidak ada\lruang di timmu untuknya.

entries.original:
"A terrific Trainer!

Let me share a training tip with
you.

During a battle with a Trainer,
even if your Pokémon’s items are\ltaken away, don’t worry.

They will be returned to you
safely after the battle.

\.But disposable items seem
to disappear."
entries.translation_source: A terrific Trainer! Let me share a training tip with you. During a battle with a Trainer, even if your Pokémon’s items are taken away, don’t worry. They will be returned to you safely after the battle. \.But disposable items seem to disappear.
entries.translated:
Trainer yang hebat! Biarkan aku
berbagi tips latihan denganmu.\lSelama pertarungan dengan Trainer,

meskipun item Pokémonmu diambil,
jangan khawatir. Item-item itu akan\ldikembalikan dengan aman setelah

pertarungan. \.Tapi item sekali pakai
sepertinya hilang.

entries.original:
"I caught my precious partner in
the [green]Safari Zone[blue].

It’s just to the [green]east[blue] of town."
entries.translation_source: I caught my precious partner in the [green]Safari Zone[blue]. It’s just to the [green]east[blue] of town.
entries.translated:
Aku menangkap partner berhargaku di
[green]Safari Zone[blue]. Letaknya di [green]timur[blue]\lkota.

entries.original:
"We can live unchanged,
because we keep changing.

I mean, Pokémon also evolve,
but their Natures stay the same.

At least they’re supposed to\."
entries.translation_source: We can live unchanged, because we keep changing. I mean, Pokémon also evolve, but their Natures stay the same. At least they’re supposed to\.
entries.translated:
Kita bisa hidup tidak berubah,
karena kita terus berubah.\lMaksudku, Pokémon juga berevolusi,

tapi Nature mereka tetap sama.
Setidaknya seharusnya begitu\.

entries.original:
"Only the lowest kind of employee
will tell you to not buy a\lparticular item.

Such as that woman stocking the
shelves, for instance.

She has no business sense.

I, on the other hand, will tell
you this.

Buy as many [green]Max Repels[blue] as you can!

They have the best value out of
all repellants!"
entries.translation_source: Only the lowest kind of employee will tell you to not buy a particular item. Such as that woman stocking the shelves, for instance. She has no business sense. I, on the other hand, will tell you this. Buy as many [green]Max Repels[blue] as you can! They have the best value out of all repellants!
entries.translated:
Hanya karyawan paling rendah yang
akan menyuruhmu untuk tidak membeli\lbarang tertentu. Seperti wanita

yang mengisi rak itu, misalnya. Dia
tidak punya naluri bisnis. Aku,\lsebaliknya, akan memberitahumu ini.

Belilah sebanyak mungkin [green]Max Repel[blue]!
Mereka memiliki nilai terbaik dari\lsemua pengusir Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Let me give you a Trainer’s tip:
don’t buy Ultra Balls.

They’re not worth your money.

Instead, try to buy specialty
Poké Balls such as the [green]Quick Ball[red]\lor [green]Net Ball[red].

They’re cheaper and they tend to
have a better chance at a capture.

Unfortunately none are available
here, but many other Marts in\lBorrius sell such Poké Balls."
entries.translation_source: Let me give you a Trainer’s tip: don’t buy Ultra Balls. They’re not worth your money. Instead, try to buy specialty Poké Balls such as the [green]Quick Ball[red] or [green]Net Ball[red]. They’re cheaper and they tend to have a better chance at a capture. Unfortunately none are available here, but many other Marts in Borrius sell such Poké Balls.
entries.translated:
Izinkan saya memberi Anda tips
Pelatih: jangan membeli Ultra Ball.\lMereka tidak sebanding dengan uang

Anda. Sebaliknya, cobalah membeli
Poké Ball khusus seperti [green]Quick Ball[red]\latau [green]Net Ball[red]. Mereka lebih murah

dan cenderung memiliki peluang
lebih baik untuk menangkap.\lSayangnya tidak ada yang tersedia

di sini, tetapi banyak Mart lain di
Borrius yang menjual Poké Ball\lsemacam itu.

entries.original:
"For a swamp, [green]Cootes Bog[blue]
surprisingly doesn’t have many\lBug-type Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: For a swamp, [green]Cootes Bog[blue] surprisingly doesn’t have many Bug-type Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Untuk rawa, [green]Cootes Bog[blue] ternyata
tidak memiliki banyak Pokémon tipe\lSerangga.

entries.original:
"I am grateful that you came all
this way!

Are you a Trainer?

Ooh, you have a Pokédex!
It’s so marvelous!

I wonder if you’d please do me a
favour."
entries.translation_source: I am grateful that you came all this way! Are you a Trainer? Ooh, you have a Pokédex! It’s so marvelous! I wonder if you’d please do me a favour.
entries.translated:
Saya bersyukur Anda datang sejauh
ini! Apakah Anda seorang Pelatih?\lOoh, Anda memiliki Pokédex! Sungguh

menakjubkan! Saya ingin tahu apakah
Anda bersedia membantu saya.

entries.original:
"Oh, Trainer. I’m so pleased that
you came all the way here!

I’m wondering if you would do me a
favour today, too."
entries.translation_source: Oh, Trainer. I’m so pleased that you came all the way here! I’m wondering if you would do me a favour today, too.
entries.translated:
Oh, Pelatih. Saya sangat senang
Anda datang sejauh ini! Saya\lbertanya-tanya apakah Anda akan

membantu saya hari ini juga.

entries.original:
"I’m touched that you came here,
yet you are being so unkind."
entries.translation_source: I’m touched that you came here, yet you are being so unkind.
entries.translated:
Saya tersentuh Anda datang ke sini,
namun Anda bersikap tidak baik.

entries.original:
"To be clear, I would like to see a
Pokémon that knows [green][buffer1][red].

Thank you."
entries.translation_source: To be clear, I would like to see a Pokémon that knows [green][buffer1][red]. Thank you.
entries.translated:
Untuk lebih jelasnya, saya ingin
melihat Pokémon yang tahu [green][buffer1][red].\lTerima kasih.

entries.original:
"Oh, my goodness. Your [buffer2]
can use [buffer1]!

You went to all the trouble of
teaching it to your Pokémon?

That’s so touching!

This is a small token of my
appreciation.

Please don’t hesitate to accept
this."
entries.translation_source: Oh, my goodness. Your [buffer2] can use [buffer1]! You went to all the trouble of teaching it to your Pokémon? That’s so touching! This is a small token of my appreciation. Please don’t hesitate to accept this.
entries.translated:
Ya ampun. [buffer2] Anda dapat
menggunakan [buffer1]! Anda\lrepot-repot mengajarkannya ke

Pokémon Anda? Sungguh menyentuh!
Ini adalah tanda kecil penghargaan\lsaya. Silakan terima ini tanpa

ragu.

entries.original:
"I wonder what [buffer1] looks
like when it is actually used.

I’m sure you can use it skillfully!"
entries.translation_source: I wonder what [buffer1] looks like when it is actually used. I’m sure you can use it skillfully!
entries.translated:
Saya penasaran seperti apa [buffer1]
saat benar-benar digunakan. Saya\lyakin Anda dapat menggunakannya

dengan terampil!

entries.original: "All the Right Moves"
entries.translation_source: All the Right Moves
entries.translated: Semua Gerakan yang Tepat

entries.original:
"I’ll give you something great when
you collect a lot of [green]TMs[red]!

Do you think you can find them all?"
entries.translation_source: I’ll give you something great when you collect a lot of [green]TMs[red]! Do you think you can find them all?
entries.translated:
Saya akan memberikan sesuatu yang
hebat ketika Anda mengumpulkan\lbanyak [green]TM[red]! Apakah Anda pikir Anda

bisa menemukan semuanya?

entries.original:
"There are [green][buffer1][red] TMs in total, and
they can be found all around\lBorrius.

For example, some kind people will
give TMs.

So don’t be shy! Talk to everyone!"
entries.translation_source: There are [green][buffer1][red] TMs in total, and they can be found all around Borrius. For example, some kind people will give TMs. So don’t be shy! Talk to everyone!
entries.translated:
Ada total [green][buffer1][red] TM, dan dapat
ditemukan di seluruh Borrius.\lMisalnya, beberapa orang baik akan

memberikan TM. Jadi jangan malu!
Bicaralah dengan semua orang!

entries.original:
"Those TMs aren’t going to just
find themselves!"
entries.translation_source: Those TMs aren’t going to just find themselves!
entries.translated:
TM-TM itu tidak akan menemukan
dirinya sendiri!

entries.original:
"There are still more TMs!

[green][buffer3][red] more in total!

If you collect all of them, I’ll
give you a great gift!"
entries.translation_source: There are still more TMs! [green][buffer3][red] more in total! If you collect all of them, I’ll give you a great gift!
entries.translated:
Masih ada lebih banyak TM! [green][buffer3][red]
lagi totalnya! Jika Anda\lmengumpulkan semuanya, saya akan

memberikan hadiah yang hebat!

entries.original:
"Wow! Great job!
You’ve got great technical points!

I didn’t know all these moves were
TMs!

Thanks to you, I realized
the true depth of TMs.

You are a TM Master!

Thank you!
I was thrilled to see them!

As a reward, please accept this
as a gift!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Great job! You’ve got great technical points! I didn’t know all these moves were TMs! Thanks to you, I realized the true depth of TMs. You are a TM Master! Thank you! I was thrilled to see them! As a reward, please accept this as a gift!
entries.translated:
Wow! Kerja bagus! Anda memiliki
poin teknis yang hebat! Saya tidak\ltahu semua gerakan ini adalah TM!

Berkat Anda, saya menyadari
kedalaman sebenarnya dari TM. Anda\ladalah Master TM! Terima kasih!

Saya sangat senang melihatnya!
Sebagai hadiah, silakan terima ini!

entries.original:
"Oh! You’re a TM Master!

Thank you for showing me
a lot of TMs.

Use lots of different moves, and
bring out your Pokémon’s power!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! You’re a TM Master! Thank you for showing me a lot of TMs. Use lots of different moves, and bring out your Pokémon’s power!
entries.translated:
Oh! Anda seorang Master TM! Terima
kasih telah menunjukkan banyak TM\lkepada saya. Gunakan banyak gerakan

berbeda, dan keluarkan kekuatan
Pokémon Anda!

entries.original:
"There appears to be a Pokémon
in the den!"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be a Pokémon in the den!
entries.translated: Tampaknya ada Pokémon di sarang!

entries.original: "The den is empty."
entries.translation_source: The den is empty.
entries.translated: Sarangnya kosong.

entries.original:
"Choose up to 3 Pokémon to use in
the fight against [buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: Choose up to 3 Pokémon to use in the fight against [buffer2].
entries.translated:
Pilih hingga 3 Pokémon untuk
digunakan dalam pertarungan melawan\l[buffer2].

entries.original:
"\\07 joined you to take
on \\08!"
entries.translation_source: \\07 joined you to take on \\08!
entries.translated:
\\07 bergabung denganmu untuk melawan
\\08!

entries.original:
"Would you like to throw in a
Wishing Piece?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to throw in a Wishing Piece?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda ingin melemparkan
Wishing Piece?

entries.original: "You threw in a Wishing Piece."
entries.translation_source: You threw in a Wishing Piece.
entries.translated: Kamu melemparkan Wishing Piece.

entries.original:
"Ooh!

Another Trainer has discovered
one of these hidden areas!

I’m Ginger, by the way.
I’m a Trainer, like you!

Is this your first time here?

I can explain about these areas
if it is!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh! Another Trainer has discovered one of these hidden areas! I’m Ginger, by the way. I’m a Trainer, like you! Is this your first time here? I can explain about these areas if it is!
entries.translated:
Ooh! Pelatih lain telah menemukan
salah satu area tersembunyi ini!\lNgomong-ngomong, aku Ginger. Aku

seorang Pelatih, sepertimu! Apakah
ini pertama kalinya kamu di sini?\lAku bisa menjelaskan tentang

area-area ini jika ini pertama
kalinya!

entries.original: "What should I explain?"
entries.translation_source: What should I explain?
entries.translated: Apa yang harus aku jelaskan?

entries.original:
"Since you discovered this den, I’ll
leave this area to you.

Good luck in your fight!

I’m looking forward to teaming up
with you sometime!"
entries.translation_source: Since you discovered this den, I’ll leave this area to you. Good luck in your fight! I’m looking forward to teaming up with you sometime!
entries.translated:
Karena kamu menemukan sarang ini,
aku akan meninggalkan area ini\luntukmu. Semoga berhasil dalam

pertarunganmu! Aku berharap bisa
bekerja sama denganmu suatu saat\lnanti!

entries.original:
"This hole you see here is what’s
known as a Raid Den.

Powerful Pokémon inhabit these
dens, and once a day, you can fight\lfor a chance to capture one in\leach den found around Borrius!

These Pokémon are scary strong, so
it’s a good idea to pick the right\lpartner to fight alongside you.

When you start the battle, you’ll
notice that the Pokémon you’re\lfighting looks very big.

This is because of the phenomenon
known as [green]Dynamax[red].

It will stay this way throughout
the battle and can only be caught\lonce it is defeated and returned to\lnormal size."
entries.translation_source: This hole you see here is what’s known as a Raid Den. Powerful Pokémon inhabit these dens, and once a day, you can fight for a chance to capture one in each den found around Borrius! These Pokémon are scary strong, so it’s a good idea to pick the right partner to fight alongside you. When you start the battle, you’ll notice that the Pokémon you’re fighting looks very big. This is because of the phenomenon known as [green]Dynamax[red]. It will stay this way throughout the battle and can only be caught once it is defeated and returned to normal size.
entries.translated:
Lubang yang kamu lihat ini dikenal
sebagai Raid Den. Pokémon kuat\lmendiami sarang-sarang ini, dan

sekali sehari, kamu bisa bertarung
untuk mendapatkan kesempatan\lmenangkap satu di setiap sarang

yang ditemukan di sekitar Borrius!
Pokémon ini sangat kuat, jadi\lsebaiknya pilih rekan yang tepat

untuk bertarung bersamamu. Saat
memulai pertempuran, kamu akan\lmelihat bahwa Pokémon yang kamu

lawan terlihat sangat besar. Ini
karena fenomena yang dikenal\lsebagai [green]Dynamax[red]. Pokémon akan tetap

seperti ini sepanjang pertempuran
dan hanya bisa ditangkap setelah\ldikalahkan dan kembali ke ukuran

normal.

entries.original:
"Dynamax is a unique phenomenon
that can only be used in special\lareas, like this one.

If you have mastered the power of
Mega Evolution, you’ll be able to\lDynamax your Pokémon as well.

Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax,
but if a Pokémon holds a Mega\lStone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be\lable to.

To Dynamax a Pokémon, press \btn04
when you see the red Dynamax\lsymbol appear.

If you choose to Dynamax your
Pokémon, the effect will last\lfor three turns.

During this time period, each of
your Pokémon’s moves will be\lpowered up into special variants\lknown as [green]Max Moves[red].

These Max Moves are much more
powerful than regular attacks,\lso make sure you use them to full\leffect while Dynamaxed!"
entries.translation_source: Dynamax is a unique phenomenon that can only be used in special areas, like this one. If you have mastered the power of Mega Evolution, you’ll be able to Dynamax your Pokémon as well. Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax, but if a Pokémon holds a Mega Stone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be able to. To Dynamax a Pokémon, press \btn04 when you see the red Dynamax symbol appear. If you choose to Dynamax your Pokémon, the effect will last for three turns. During this time period, each of your Pokémon’s moves will be powered up into special variants known as [green]Max Moves[red]. These Max Moves are much more powerful than regular attacks, so make sure you use them to full effect while Dynamaxed!
entries.translated:
Dynamax adalah fenomena unik yang
hanya bisa digunakan di area\lkhusus, seperti ini. Jika kamu

telah menguasai kekuatan Mega
Evolution, kamu juga bisa melakukan\lDynamax pada Pokémon-mu. Hampir

semua Pokémon bisa melakukan
Dynamax, tetapi jika Pokémon\lmemegang Mega Stone atau Z-Crystal,

ia tidak akan bisa. Untuk melakukan
Dynamax pada Pokémon, tekan \btn04 saat\lsimbol Dynamax merah muncul. Jika

kamu memilih untuk melakukan
Dynamax pada Pokémon-mu, efeknya\lakan berlangsung selama tiga

giliran. Selama periode waktu ini,
setiap jurus Pokémon-mu akan\lditingkatkan menjadi varian khusus

yang dikenal sebagai [green]Max Moves[red]. Max
Moves ini jauh lebih kuat daripada\lserangan biasa, jadi pastikan kamu

menggunakannya secara maksimal saat
dalam keadaan Dynamax!

entries.original:
"Sometimes when the Pokémon you’re
fighting is desperate, it’ll throw\lup shields to defend itself.

These shields will severely reduce
the damage you can inflict until\lthey’re destroyed.

Any attack will destroy at least
one shield, but if you use a move\llike [green]Brick Break[red], you can destroy\ltwo shields at a time!"
entries.translation_source: Sometimes when the Pokémon you’re fighting is desperate, it’ll throw up shields to defend itself. These shields will severely reduce the damage you can inflict until they’re destroyed. Any attack will destroy at least one shield, but if you use a move like [green]Brick Break[red], you can destroy two shields at a time!
entries.translated:
Kadang-kadang saat Pokémon yang
kamu lawan dalam keadaan putus asa,\lia akan mengeluarkan perisai untuk

melindungi dirinya. Perisai ini
akan sangat mengurangi damage yang\lbisa kamu berikan sampai perisai

tersebut hancur. Serangan apa pun
akan menghancurkan setidaknya satu\lperisai, tetapi jika kamu

menggunakan jurus seperti [green]Brick
Break[red], kamu bisa menghancurkan dua\lperisai sekaligus!

entries.original:
"If you have Pokémon stored in box
\qo[buffer1]\qc, they may be used\lin place of your party Pokémon.

Each row in the box is treated as
its own team, so this will allow\lyou to save up to 5 different\lpreset teams."
entries.translation_source: If you have Pokémon stored in box \qo[buffer1]\qc, they may be used in place of your party Pokémon. Each row in the box is treated as its own team, so this will allow you to save up to 5 different preset teams.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memiliki Pokémon yang
disimpan di kotak \qo[buffer1]\qc,\lmereka dapat digunakan sebagai

pengganti Pokémon timmu. Setiap
baris di dalam kotak diperlakukan\lsebagai timnya sendiri, sehingga

ini akan memungkinkanmu menyimpan
hingga 5 tim prasetel yang berbeda.

entries.original: "Dynamax"
entries.translation_source: Dynamax
entries.translated: Dynamax

entries.original: "Shields"
entries.translation_source: Shields
entries.translated: Perisai

entries.original: "Preset Teams"
entries.translation_source: Preset Teams
entries.translated: Tim Prasetel

entries.original:
"Dang it!

It won’t budge!

This Pokémon hasn’t moved in
weeks\.

Do you hear me Snorlax?
I need to see my boyfriend!

You can’t stop true love!"

\.

[green]\Lv 70[red] or higher."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Please make sure your party consists of only [green]4 Kangaskhan[red] before we can begin filming the [green]Double Battle[red]. They should ideally be levelled [green]\Lv 70[red] or higher.

Luar biasa! Pastikan timmu hanya
terdiri dari [green]4 Kangaskhan[red] sebelum\lkita mulai syuting [green]Double Battle[red].

lebih tinggi.

menantikan untuk melihatmu di\lpemutaran perdana karpet merah!

Dikatakan bahwa film tersebut\lmendapat skor kritik kurang dari

30% di Rotten Tamato Berries\. Oh,
yah, tidak ada salahnya membantu!

entries.translated: [green]Krawwr!

entries.translated:
Jadi saya mendengar wanita di sana
berbicara\. Kadang-kadang jika Anda\lmundur, Anda maju!

Saya memperhatikan Pokémon yang

penampilannya menjadi sama dengan
saya! Tidak\.\CC0818 itu bukan Ditto.\lSetidaknya saya bisa tahu sebanyak

itu.

"This is Redwood Forest?

Ini Hutan Redwood? Sangat

Nincada yang berkerumun di sini,

[red]Aku bisa merasakan kamu mencari

dibersihkan dari jiwaku\.

"Did you know that the trees in this

entries.translation_source: Did you know that the trees in this village actually produce red wood? Bet you didn’t! You must’ve thought that these trees look like every other plain old forest tree. Well, I’ll have you know that although they may look like ordinary forest trees, they’re actually very special! Their red wood attracts many different species of Pokémon. Don’t believe me? Have a Pokémon use the move [green]Headbutt[red] on one, and see for yourself!

Tahukah kamu bahwa pohon-pohon di
desa ini benar-benar menghasilkan\lkayu merah? Pasti kamu tidak tahu!

Kamu pasti mengira pohon-pohon ini
terlihat seperti pohon hutan biasa\llainnya. Yah, aku akan

memberitahumu bahwa meskipun mereka
terlihat seperti pohon hutan biasa,\lmereka sebenarnya sangat istimewa!

Kayu merah mereka menarik banyak
spesies Pokémon. Tidak percaya?\lSuruh Pokémon menggunakan jurus

[green]Headbutt[red] pada salah satunya, dan
lihat sendiri!

Benjamin’s is always meant to be\lchallenged last.

Well, if you hadn’t explored the
rest of Borrius first, you wouldn’t\lbe able to solve his puzzle\."

Dari semua Gym Borrius, Gym
Benjamin selalu dimaksudkan untuk\lditantang terakhir. Kenapa? Yah,

jika kamu belum menjelajahi sisa
Borrius terlebih dahulu, kamu tidak\lakan bisa memecahkan teka-tekinya\.

Benjamin’s puzzle is based on the
caves you should have travelled\lthrough last!"

Sekarang kamu lihat? Teka-teki
Benjamin didasarkan pada gua-gua\lyang seharusnya kamu lalui

terakhir!

just like he does!"

Benjamin adalah Pemimpin Gym kami!

aku kecil lagi, seperti dia!

friend of the Forest Guardian, it\lwill reveal itself once more."

Kota kecil kami dilindungi oleh
Penjaga Hutan. Namun, Penjaga Hutan\lsudah tidak terlihat selama

bertahun-tahun. Dikatakan bahwa
jika kamu membawa teman lama\lPenjaga Hutan, ia akan menampakkan

dirinya sekali lagi.

"Astounding\.

The Forest Guardian has revealed
itself unto you.

It must have sensed an old friend
among the members of your party.

And not only that, it appears to
be challenging you to a battle.

You have my blessing to battle it
and capture it, if you so please."

Menakjubkan\. Penjaga Hutan telah
menampakkan dirinya kepadamu. Pasti\lia merasakan teman lama di antara

anggota timmu. Dan bukan hanya itu,
ia tampak menantangmu untuk\lbertarung. Kamu mendapat restuku

untuk melawannya dan menangkapnya,
jika kamu mau.

"Congratulations on your capture of
the Forest Guardian.

it, as it protected and watched\lover us."

entries.translated:
Selamat atas penangkapanmu terhadap
Penjaga Hutan. Tolong jaga dan\llindungi dia, sebagaimana dia

melindungi dan menjaga kami.

\.

What am I even asking you, of course you do! Who doesn’t know of the famed Pokémon? I want you to place [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em in a [green]single Box[blue]. Sebagai anggota terhormat Hip
Waders, ini seharusnya mudah\lbagimu!

I can’t believe you actually

serious dedication.

the Hip Waders.

for you.

Wah wah, Pelatih Pokémon! Aku tidak

satu Box! Maksudku, tugas seperti\litu membutuhkan dedikasi serius.

anggota Hip Waders. Jadi biarkan\laku mengambilnya dari tanganmu. Dan

aku ingin kamu memiliki ini.

West Borrius?"

Hai, Pelatih Pokémon. Pada saat

mendapatkan [green][buffer2][blue] dari\lmakhluk-makhluk itu di sana.

Oh, astaga. Putriku meninggalkanku
dengan bayi laki-lakinya, tapi aku\lterlalu sibuk hari ini untuk

merawatnya dengan baik. Maukah kamu
menjaganya sementara aku\lmenyelesaikan pekerjaanku?

entries.original:
"Splendid.

Please walk around with him until I
finish my work today."
entries.translation_source: Splendid. Please walk around with him until I finish my work today.
entries.translated:
Bagus. Tolong jalan-jalan
bersamanya sampai aku selesai\lbekerja hari ini.

entries.original:
"Ah, so you’ve returned with my
grandson.

I have finished my work for today,
so I am able to take care of him\lfor the remainder of the day.

Here is the payment for your
services."
entries.translation_source: Ah, so you’ve returned with my grandson. I have finished my work for today, so I am able to take care of him for the remainder of the day. Here is the payment for your services.
entries.translated:
Ah, jadi kamu kembali bersama
cucuku. Aku sudah selesai bekerja\lhari ini, jadi aku bisa merawatnya

untuk sisa hari ini. Ini pembayaran
untuk jasamu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received $[buffer1] from
the woman!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received $[buffer1] from the woman!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima $[buffer1] dari
wanita itu!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me.

I have no choice but to continue to
neglect him today."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me. I have no choice but to continue to neglect him today.
entries.translated:
Oh, astaga. Aku tidak punya pilihan
selain terus mengabaikannya hari\lini.

entries.original:
"Please walk around with my grandson
until I finish my work today."
entries.translation_source: Please walk around with my grandson until I finish my work today.
entries.translated:
Tolong jalan-jalan bersama cucuku
sampai aku selesai bekerja hari\lini.

entries.original:
"My daughter leaves her son with me
every day, so your services will be\lrequired again, tomorrow."
entries.translation_source: My daughter leaves her son with me every day, so your services will be required again, tomorrow.
entries.translated:
Putriku meninggalkan putranya
bersamaku setiap hari, jadi jasamu\lakan dibutuhkan lagi besok.

entries.original:
"My daughter leaves her son with me
every day while she goes to work.

I’m unable to give him my full
attention, so each day I try to\lhire a part-time babysitter.

Come back between [green]7 AM[red] and [green]7 PM[red],
and I will pay you to babysit."
entries.translation_source: My daughter leaves her son with me every day while she goes to work. I’m unable to give him my full attention, so each day I try to hire a part-time babysitter. Come back between [green]7 AM[red] and [green]7 PM[red], and I will pay you to babysit.
entries.translated:
Putriku meninggalkan putranya
bersamaku setiap hari saat dia\lpergi bekerja. Aku tidak bisa

memberikan perhatian penuh padanya,
jadi setiap hari aku mencoba\lmenyewa pengasuh paruh waktu.

Kembalilah antara [green]7 AM[red] dan [green]7 PM[red],
dan aku akan membayarmu untuk\lmenjaga bayi.

entries.original: "[black]The baby is sleeping peacefully."
entries.translation_source: [black]The baby is sleeping peacefully.
entries.translated: [black]Bayi itu tidur dengan tenang.

entries.original:
"[black]The baby started following behind
you!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The baby started following behind you!
entries.translated:
[black]Bayi itu mulai mengikutimu dari
belakang!

entries.original:
"[black]Take the baby for a walk around
town until his grandmother has\lfinished her work."
entries.translation_source: [black]Take the baby for a walk around town until his grandmother has finished her work.
entries.translated:
[black]Ajak bayi jalan-jalan keliling kota
sampai neneknya selesai bekerja.

entries.original:
"[black]The baby is bouncing around happily
in his stroller."
entries.translation_source: [black]The baby is bouncing around happily in his stroller.
entries.translated:
[black]Bayi itu melonjak kegirangan di
kereta dorongnya.

entries.original:
"[black]Oh? There’s something in the
baby’s mouth.

Oh, no!
It’s a choking hazard!

Quick, get it out!"
