entries.translation_source: [black]Oh? There’s something in the baby’s mouth. Oh, no! It’s a choking hazard! Quick, get it out!
entries.translated:
[black]Oh? Ada sesuatu di mulut bayi. Oh,
tidak! Itu bahaya tersedak! Cepat,\lkeluarkan!

entries.original:
"[black]The baby is looking at you
disapprovingly.

It doesn’t seem to want to go
this way."
entries.translation_source: [black]The baby is looking at you disapprovingly. It doesn’t seem to want to go this way.
entries.translated:
[black]Bayi itu menatapmu dengan tidak
setuju. Sepertinya dia tidak ingin\lpergi ke arah ini.

entries.original:
"Hi, Trainer!

I’m training to open up my very
own Pokémon nursery.

I still have a ways to go, but I
can still offer you something good!

If you pay me $[green][buffer1][red], I can
significantly speed up the hatching\ltime of all the Eggs in your party!

What do you say?

Sounds like a pretty good deal,
am I right?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, Trainer! I’m training to open up my very own Pokémon nursery. I still have a ways to go, but I can still offer you something good! If you pay me $[green][buffer1][red], I can significantly speed up the hatching time of all the Eggs in your party! What do you say? Sounds like a pretty good deal, am I right?
entries.translated:
Hai, Pelatih! Aku sedang berlatih
untuk membuka pembibitan Pokémonku\lsendiri. Masih ada jalan panjang,

tapi aku masih bisa menawarkan
sesuatu yang bagus! Jika kamu\lmembayarku $[green][buffer1][red], aku bisa

mempercepat waktu penetasan semua
Telur di timmu! Bagaimana?\lKedengarannya seperti tawaran yang

cukup bagus, kan?

entries.original:
"Sweet!

Please pass me all the Eggs in
your party."
entries.translation_source: Sweet! Please pass me all the Eggs in your party.
entries.translated:
Mantap! Tolong berikan aku semua
Telur di timmu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over all Eggs
on hand."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over all Eggs on hand.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan semua Telur
yang ada.

entries.original:
"All done!
Here are your Eggs.

I hope to see you again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: All done! Here are your Eggs. I hope to see you again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Ini Telurmu. Semoga
bertemu lagi besok!

entries.original:
"It’s okay!

You’d prefer to wait until you have
more Eggs, am I right?"
entries.translation_source: It’s okay! You’d prefer to wait until you have more Eggs, am I right?
entries.translated:
Tidak apa-apa! Kamu lebih suka
menunggu sampai punya lebih banyak\lTelur, kan?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You didn’t realize how much this
cost before you spoke to me, am\lI right?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. You didn’t realize how much this cost before you spoke to me, am I right?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Anda tidak menyadari berapa
biayanya sebelum berbicara dengan\lsaya, benar kan?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

Why would you want to spend money
when you have no Eggs?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. Why would you want to spend money when you have no Eggs?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Kenapa Anda ingin mengeluarkan
uang jika tidak memiliki Telur?

entries.original:
"You’re going to be here again
tomorrow, am I right?

I’m looking forward to working with
your Eggs again!"
entries.translation_source: You’re going to be here again tomorrow, am I right? I’m looking forward to working with your Eggs again!
entries.translated:
Anda akan datang lagi besok, benar
kan? Saya tidak sabar untuk bekerja\ldengan Telur Anda lagi!

entries.original:
"Ever come across an Egg you just
didn’t want?

Then have no fear!

I buy Eggs like those at $[green][buffer1][blue]
a pop.

Do you have any Eggs you want to
sell to me?"
entries.translation_source: Ever come across an Egg you just didn’t want? Then have no fear! I buy Eggs like those at $[green][buffer1][blue] a pop. Do you have any Eggs you want to sell to me?
entries.translated:
Pernah menemukan Telur yang tidak
Anda inginkan? Jangan khawatir!\lSaya membeli Telur seperti itu

seharga $[green][buffer1][blue] per buah. Apakah
Anda punya Telur yang ingin dijual\lkepada saya?

entries.original:
"Do you have any Eggs you want to
sell to me?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have any Eggs you want to sell to me?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda punya Telur yang ingin
dijual kepada saya?

entries.original:
"Which Egg do you want to sell
to me?"
entries.translation_source: Which Egg do you want to sell to me?
entries.translated:
Telur mana yang ingin Anda jual
kepada saya?

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to sell me
this Egg?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to sell me this Egg?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda yakin ingin menjual
Telur ini kepada saya?

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to sell me
all of the Eggs in your party?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to sell me all of the Eggs in your party?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda yakin ingin menjual
semua Telur di tim Anda kepada\lsaya?

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to sell me
all of the Eggs in Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to sell me all of the Eggs in Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda yakin ingin menjual
semua Telur di Kotak \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?

entries.original: "[black][player] sold the Egg for $[buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] sold the Egg for $[buffer1]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menjual Telur seharga
$[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] sold [buffer1] Egg[buffer3] in the party
for $[buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] sold [buffer1] Egg[buffer3] in the party for $[buffer2]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menjual [buffer1]
Telur[buffer3] di tim seharga\l$[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] sold [buffer1] Egg[buffer3] in the Box
for $[buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] sold [buffer1] Egg[buffer3] in the Box for $[buffer2]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menjual [buffer1]
Telur[buffer3] di Kotak seharga\l$[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Pleasure doing business with you!

Come see me again if you have more
Eggs to sell."
entries.translation_source: Pleasure doing business with you! Come see me again if you have more Eggs to sell.
entries.translated:
Senang berbisnis dengan Anda!
Datang lagi jika Anda punya lebih\lbanyak Telur untuk dijual.

entries.original:
"Keep me in mind if you ever come
across an Egg you don’t want."
entries.translation_source: Keep me in mind if you ever come across an Egg you don’t want.
entries.translated:
Pertimbangkan saya jika Anda
menemukan Telur yang tidak Anda\linginkan.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Eggs in
your party\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Eggs in your party\.
entries.translated:
Anda tidak memiliki Telur di tim
Anda\.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Eggs in
Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Eggs in Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\.
entries.translated:
Anda tidak memiliki Telur di Kotak
\qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\.

entries.original:
"I can’t buy that Pokémon from you.
It’s not in an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t buy that Pokémon from you. It’s not in an Egg!
entries.translated:
Saya tidak bisa membeli Pokémon itu
dari Anda. Itu bukan telur!

entries.original:
"Despite our town being known for
its export of Charcoal, I have yet\lto actually see a Pokémon hold\lthe item.

Can you help me by showing me a
Pokémon [green]holding[red] a [green]Charcoal[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Despite our town being known for its export of Charcoal, I have yet to actually see a Pokémon hold the item. Can you help me by showing me a Pokémon [green]holding[red] a [green]Charcoal[red]?
entries.translated:
Meskipun kota kami terkenal karena
ekspor Arang, saya belum pernah\lmelihat Pokémon memegang item

tersebut. Bisakah Anda membantu
saya dengan menunjukkan Pokémon\l[green]memegang[red] [green]Arang[red]?

entries.original:
"Huh, so that’s why I haven’t seen
it around here.

Charcoal is made out of black wood,
not red wood!

Okay, thank you!
You’ve made my day!

Now, let me show you something!"
entries.translation_source: Huh, so that’s why I haven’t seen it around here. Charcoal is made out of black wood, not red wood! Okay, thank you! You’ve made my day! Now, let me show you something!
entries.translated:
Hah, jadi itu sebabnya saya belum
melihatnya di sini. Arang terbuat\ldari kayu hitam, bukan kayu merah!

Oke, terima kasih! Anda membuat
hari saya menyenangkan! Sekarang,\lbiarkan saya menunjukkan sesuatu!

entries.original:
"Huh?

That’s an Egg."
entries.translation_source: Huh? That’s an Egg.
entries.translated: Hah? Itu adalah Telur.

entries.original:
"Huh?

That Pokémon’s not holding
a Charcoal."
entries.translation_source: Huh? That Pokémon’s not holding a Charcoal.
entries.translated:
Hah? Pokémon itu tidak sedang
membawa Arang.

entries.original:
"Have a Pokémon hold the [green]Luck
Incense[red] like Charcoal, and it’ll\l[green]double[red] the amount of [green]prize money[red]\lreceived from battles!"
entries.translation_source: Have a Pokémon hold the [green]Luck Incense[red] like Charcoal, and it’ll [green]double[red] the amount of [green]prize money[red] received from battles!
entries.translated:
Minta Pokémon memegang [green]Dupa
Keberuntungan[red] seperti Arang, dan\litu akan [green]menggandakan[red] jumlah [green]uang

hadiah[red] yang diterima dari
pertempuran!

entries.original: "So you don’t know either\."
entries.translation_source: So you don’t know either\.
entries.translated: Jadi kamu juga tidak tahu\.

entries.original:
"Benjamin is a master of [green]Bug[blue]-type
Pokémon!

And he’s a huge fan of battling
backwards, too!

Even his Gym puzzle is inspired by
his [green]backwards[blue] way of thinking.

What does this all mean?
You’ll see in due time\."
entries.translation_source: Benjamin is a master of [green]Bug[blue]-type Pokémon! And he’s a huge fan of battling backwards, too! Even his Gym puzzle is inspired by his [green]backwards[blue] way of thinking. What does this all mean? You’ll see in due time\.
entries.translated:
Benjamin adalah master Pokémon [green]Tipe
Serangga[blue]! Dan dia juga penggemar\lberat bertarung secara terbalik!

Bahkan teka-teki Gym-nya
terinspirasi dari cara berpikirnya\lyang [green]terbalik[blue]. Apa artinya semua

ini? Kamu akan lihat pada waktunya\.

entries.original:
"Benjamin’s backwards way of
thinking has nothing on your way,\lit seems!"
entries.translation_source: Benjamin’s backwards way of thinking has nothing on your way, it seems!
entries.translated:
Cara berpikir terbalik Benjamin
tidak ada apa-apanya dibandingkan\lcaramu, sepertinya!

entries.original:
"I’ll trade you my super special
[green][buffer2][blue] if you can catch me a\l[green][buffer1][blue]!

I’ve been trying really hard to
find one, but it’s so difficult!

Do you have one to trade me?"
entries.translation_source: I’ll trade you my super special [green][buffer2][blue] if you can catch me a [green][buffer1][blue]! I’ve been trying really hard to find one, but it’s so difficult! Do you have one to trade me?
entries.translated:
Aku akan menukarkan [green][buffer2][blue] super
spesial milikku jika kamu bisa\lmenangkapkan untukku seekor

[green][buffer1][blue]! Aku sudah berusaha keras
untuk menemukannya, tapi sangat\lsulit! Apakah kamu punya satu untuk

ditukar denganku?

entries.original:
"But it’s been so hard for me to
find one\."
entries.translation_source: But it’s been so hard for me to find one\.
entries.translated:
Tapi sangat sulit bagiku untuk
menemukannya\.

entries.original:
"Does that look a [buffer1] to you?
I asked for a [buffer1], not that."
entries.translation_source: Does that look a [buffer1] to you? I asked for a [buffer1], not that.
entries.translated:
Apakah itu terlihat seperti
[buffer1] bagimu? Aku meminta\l[buffer1], bukan itu.

entries.original:
"Alright!
I scored myself a great Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! I scored myself a great Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Baiklah! Aku mendapatkan Pokémon
yang hebat!

entries.original:
"Have you been playing with my old
[buffer2]?

I’ve been playing with the
[buffer1] you gave me.

I even evolved it!"
entries.translation_source: Have you been playing with my old [buffer2]? I’ve been playing with the [buffer1] you gave me. I even evolved it!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah bermain dengan
[buffer2] lamaku? Aku sudah bermain\ldengan [buffer1] yang kamu berikan

padaku. Aku bahkan membuatnya
berevolusi!

entries.original:
"Use [green]Soak[blue] on a Pokémon you’re
fighting!

Then, throw a [green]Net Ball[blue] at it for
super easy catch!"
entries.translation_source: Use [green]Soak[blue] on a Pokémon you’re fighting! Then, throw a [green]Net Ball[blue] at it for super easy catch!
entries.translated:
Gunakan [green]Basah[blue] pada Pokémon yang
kamu lawan! Kemudian, lempar [green]Bola\lNet[blue] ke arahnya untuk tangkapan yang

sangat mudah!

entries.original:
"BEGIN FROM
THE CENTRE.
CREATE WHAT
YOU SEEK."
entries.translation_source: BEGIN FROM THE CENTRE. CREATE WHAT YOU SEEK.
entries.translated:
MULAI DARI TENGAH. CIPTAKAN APA
YANG KAMU CARI.

entries.original: "There is a big hole in the wall."
entries.translation_source: There is a big hole in the wall.
entries.translated: Ada lubang besar di dinding.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the
power of rock started moving!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the power of rock started moving!
entries.translated:
[black]Patung Pokémon yang memancarkan
kekuatan batu mulai bergerak!

entries.original: "[green]Zaza zari za\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Zaza zari za\.
entries.translated: [green]Zaza zari za\.

entries.original:
"CRACK THE
ICE. LEAVE
PURE WHAT
YOU SEEK."
entries.translation_source: CRACK THE ICE. LEAVE PURE WHAT YOU SEEK.
entries.translated:
PECAHKAN ES. BIARKAN MURNI APA YANG
KAMU CARI.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the
power of ice started moving!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the power of ice started moving!
entries.translated:
[black]Patung Pokémon yang memancarkan
kekuatan es mulai bergerak!

entries.original: "[green]Jakiih!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Jakiih!
entries.translated: [green]Jakiih!

entries.original:
"NATURE MOLDS
TO OUR WILL.
TURN THE
CRYSTALS TO
WHAT YOU SEEK."
entries.translation_source: NATURE MOLDS TO OUR WILL. TURN THE CRYSTALS TO WHAT YOU SEEK.
entries.translated:
ALAM MEMBENTUK SESUAI KEINGINAN
KITA. UBAH KRISTAL MENJADI APA YANG\lKAMU CARI.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the
power of steel started moving!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the power of steel started moving!
entries.translated:
[black]Patung Pokémon yang memancarkan
kekuatan baja mulai bergerak!

entries.original: "[green]Ji-ji-ze-ji-zoh\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Ji-ji-ze-ji-zoh\.
entries.translated: [green]Ji-ji-ze-ji-zoh\.

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] disappeared.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] menghilang.

entries.original:
"[black]A large pile of snow is blocking
the road.

Better go another way for now."
entries.translation_source: [black]A large pile of snow is blocking the road. Better go another way for now.
entries.translated:
[black]Tumpukan salju besar menghalangi
jalan. Sebaiknya cari jalan lain\luntuk saat ini.

entries.original:
"Sorry, fella.

An avalanche caused some snow piles
to gather up on the road.

If you wanna go to Bellin, you’ll
have to take the ol’ mountain road\lfor now.

Here, come with me and I’ll show you
the way."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, fella. An avalanche caused some snow piles to gather up on the road. If you wanna go to Bellin, you’ll have to take the ol’ mountain road for now. Here, come with me and I’ll show you the way.
entries.translated:
Maaf, kawan. Longsor salju
menyebabkan beberapa tumpukan salju\lmenumpuk di jalan. Jika kamu ingin

pergi ke Bellin, kamu harus melalui
jalan pegunungan tua untuk saat\lini. Kemarilah, ikut aku dan aku

akan menunjukkan jalannya.

entries.original:
"Some scary lookin’ fella came along
and melted the snow piles blockin’\lthe road.

I sure was happy and all, but
somethin’ seemed up with him.

If you care, I watched him head
[green]north of Frozen Heights[blue].

Wonder what he’s doin’ up there?"
entries.translation_source: Some scary lookin’ fella came along and melted the snow piles blockin’ the road. I sure was happy and all, but somethin’ seemed up with him. If you care, I watched him head [green]north of Frozen Heights[blue]. Wonder what he’s doin’ up there?
entries.translated:
Beberapa orang yang tampak
menakutkan datang dan mencairkan\ltumpukan salju yang menghalangi

jalan. Aku pasti senang dan
sebagainya, tapi ada yang tidak\lberes dengannya. Jika kamu peduli,

aku melihat dia pergi ke [green]utara
Frozen Heights[blue]. Entah apa yang dia\llakukan di sana?

entries.original:
"Ah, you must be [player].

Prof. Log phoned ahead and told me
to guide you if you got lost.

Bellin Town is just over that way."
entries.translation_source: Ah, you must be [player]. Prof. Log phoned ahead and told me to guide you if you got lost. Bellin Town is just over that way.
entries.translated:
Ah, kamu pasti [player]. Prof. Log
menelepon sebelumnya dan menyuruhku\luntuk membimbingmu jika kamu

tersesat. Kota Bellin ada di
sebelah sana.

entries.original:
"If you’d like me to show you how to
capture a Pokémon, prove you’re\lcapable by delivering [green]Prof. Log’s\lpackage[blue] to him."
entries.translation_source: If you’d like me to show you how to capture a Pokémon, prove you’re capable by delivering [green]Prof. Log’s package[blue] to him.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin aku menunjukkan
cara menangkap Pokémon, buktikan\lkemampuannya dengan mengantarkan

[green]paket Prof. Log[blue] kepadanya.

entries.original:
"Ah, from the Badge on your Trainer
Card, I see that you’ve become a\lrather skilled Trainer.

You’ve far surpassed the role of
Prof. Log’s errand [buffer1].

However, in my book, you’re never
too experienced to watch an expert\lcatch Pokémon!

So, what do you say?

I could show you a thing or two
about capturing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Ah, from the Badge on your Trainer Card, I see that you’ve become a rather skilled Trainer. You’ve far surpassed the role of Prof. Log’s errand [buffer1]. However, in my book, you’re never too experienced to watch an expert catch Pokémon! So, what do you say? I could show you a thing or two about capturing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ah, dari Lencana di Kartu
Pelatihmu, aku lihat kamu sudah\lmenjadi Pelatih yang cukup

terampil. Kamu sudah jauh melampaui
peran sebagai kurir Prof. Log\l[buffer1]. Namun, menurutku, kamu

tidak akan pernah terlalu
berpengalaman untuk melihat seorang\lahli menangkap Pokémon! Jadi,

bagaimana? Aku bisa menunjukkan
beberapa hal tentang menangkap\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"I heard from Prof. Log that you did
well delivering his package to him.

And I even heard from him that he’s
sending you on more errands as a\lfully fledged Pokémon Trainer!

You know, I used to be something of
a Trainer myself, back in my day.

I could show you a thing or two
about capturing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I heard from Prof. Log that you did well delivering his package to him. And I even heard from him that he’s sending you on more errands as a fully fledged Pokémon Trainer! You know, I used to be something of a Trainer myself, back in my day. I could show you a thing or two about capturing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku dengar dari Prof. Log bahwa
kamu berhasil mengantarkan paketnya\lkepadanya. Dan aku juga dengar

darinya bahwa dia mengirimmu untuk
tugas-tugas lain sebagai Pelatih\lPokémon yang sepenuhnya! Kamu tahu,

dulu aku juga semacam Pelatih, di
zamanku. Aku bisa menunjukkan\lbeberapa hal tentang menangkap

Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Alrighty!
Here we go!"
entries.translation_source: Alrighty! Here we go!
entries.translated: Baiklah! Ayo kita mulai!

entries.original:
"Phew\.

That one was too close for
comfort\."
entries.translation_source: Phew\. That one was too close for comfort\.
entries.translated:
Phew\. Yang itu terlalu dekat untuk
kenyamanan\.

entries.original:
"As you witnessed, I successfully
captured that Pokémon by throwing\la [green]Poké Ball[blue].

However, this won’t always work.

Many times, Pokémon must be
weakened before you’ll be able\lto capture them."
entries.translation_source: As you witnessed, I successfully captured that Pokémon by throwing a [green]Poké Ball[blue]. However, this won’t always work. Many times, Pokémon must be weakened before you’ll be able to capture them.
entries.translated:
Seperti yang kamu saksikan, aku
berhasil menangkap Pokémon itu\ldengan melempar [green]Poké Ball[blue]. Namun,

ini tidak selalu berhasil.
Seringkali, Pokémon harus\ldilemahkan sebelum kamu bisa

menangkapnya.

entries.original:
"And as my thanks for allowing me to
stretch my legs today, please take\lthis Poké Ball I acquired back in\lmy younger days."
entries.translation_source: And as my thanks for allowing me to stretch my legs today, please take this Poké Ball I acquired back in my younger days.
entries.translated:
Dan sebagai terima kasih karena
telah mengizinkanku meregangkan\lkaki hari ini, tolong ambil Poké

Ball ini yang aku dapatkan di masa
mudaku.

entries.original:
"If you would ever like to see my
skills again, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you would ever like to see my skills again, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin melihat kemampuanku
lagi, silakan mampir.

entries.original:
"If you ever would like to see me in
action, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you ever would like to see me in action, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin melihatku beraksi,
silakan mampir.

entries.original:
"Huah, fellow Trainer!

I am training my body and soul by
staring at this tree intently!

Take this so you can train too!"
entries.translation_source: Huah, fellow Trainer! I am training my body and soul by staring at this tree intently! Take this so you can train too!
entries.translated:
Huah, sesama Pelatih! Aku melatih
tubuh dan jiwaku dengan menatap\lpohon ini dengan saksama! Ambil ini

agar kamu bisa berlatih juga!

entries.original:
"Huah, fellow Trainer!

I can [green]upgrade[blue] the [green]Macho Brace[blue] to
make training more efficient!

Right now it is only a measly \Lv [buffer3],
but I can upgrade it to [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue] in\lexchange for [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Huah, fellow Trainer! I can [green]upgrade[blue] the [green]Macho Brace[blue] to make training more efficient! Right now it is only a measly \Lv [buffer3], but I can upgrade it to [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue] in exchange for [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!
entries.translated:
Huah, sesama Pelatih! Aku dapat
[green]meningkatkan[blue] [green]Macho Brace[blue] untuk\lmembuat pelatihan lebih efisien!

Saat ini hanya \Lv [buffer3] yang
menyedihkan, tapi aku bisa\lmeningkatkannya menjadi [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue]

dengan imbalan [green][buffer2] [buffer1][blue]!

entries.original:
"Fine, settle for an inferior
product!"
entries.translation_source: Fine, settle for an inferior product!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, puaslah dengan produk yang
inferior!

entries.original:
"You do not have enough [buffer1]s
for me to upgrade your Macho Brace!"
entries.translation_source: You do not have enough [buffer1]s for me to upgrade your Macho Brace!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup [buffer1]
untukku meningkatkan Macho\lBrace-mu!

entries.original:
"[black]The Macho Brace level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

Pokémon will now gain [green][buffer2]*[black] the
amount of Effort Values when held."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Macho Brace level has been increased to \Lv [buffer2]! Pokémon will now gain [green][buffer2]*[black] the amount of Effort Values when held.
entries.translated:
[black]Level Macho Brace telah
ditingkatkan menjadi \Lv [buffer2]!\lPokémon sekarang akan mendapatkan

[green][buffer2]*[black] jumlah Nilai Usaha saat
dibawa.

entries.original:
"Your Macho Brace is as powerful
as it can get!

In its current state, you will
receive [green][buffer1]*[blue] the amount of effort\lvalues when training with it!"
entries.translation_source: Your Macho Brace is as powerful as it can get! In its current state, you will receive [green][buffer1]*[blue] the amount of effort values when training with it!
entries.translated:
Macho Brace-mu sudah sekuat
mungkin! Dalam kondisi saat ini,\lkamu akan menerima [green][buffer1]*[blue] jumlah

Effort Values saat berlatih
dengannya!

entries.original:
"The sea\.

Full of fury one moment, calm as a
Pokémon’s nature the next\."
entries.translation_source: The sea\. Full of fury one moment, calm as a Pokémon’s nature the next\.
entries.translated:
Laut\. Penuh amarah sesaat, tenang
seperti Nature Pokémon di saat\lberikutnya\.

entries.original:
"Battle me.

Show me you too, can be as furious
as the sea."
entries.translation_source: Battle me. Show me you too, can be as furious as the sea.
entries.translated:
Bertarunglah denganku. Tunjukkan
bahwa kamu juga bisa menjadi\lseganas laut.

entries.original:
"You have done well.
Take this item."
entries.translation_source: You have done well. Take this item.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah melakukannya dengan
baik. Ambillah item ini.

entries.original:
"That [green]Medichamite[blue] is for Mega
Evolving the Pokémon, [green]Medicham[blue].

With the right Trainer, it too can
battle as furiously as the sea."
entries.translation_source: That [green]Medichamite[blue] is for Mega Evolving the Pokémon, [green]Medicham[blue]. With the right Trainer, it too can battle as furiously as the sea.
entries.translated:
Itu [green]Medichamite[blue] digunakan untuk
Mega Evolve Pokémon, [green]Medicham[blue].\lDengan Trainer yang tepat, ia juga

bisa bertarung seganas laut.

entries.original:
"If you can defeat all the Trainers
here and on the Auburn Waterway,\lI’d like to see your fury, too."
entries.translation_source: If you can defeat all the Trainers here and on the Auburn Waterway, I’d like to see your fury, too.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa mengalahkan semua
Trainer di sini dan di Auburn\lWaterway, aku ingin melihat

kemarahanmu juga.

entries.original:
"I don’t think it’s such a good
idea to paint in the rain.

Everything I paint gets
washed away\."
entries.translation_source: I don’t think it’s such a good idea to paint in the rain. Everything I paint gets washed away\.
entries.translated:
Aku rasa bukan ide yang bagus untuk
melukis di tengah hujan. Semua yang\lkulukis akan terhapus\.

entries.original:
"Only the uncool kids actually go
to school\."
entries.translation_source: Only the uncool kids actually go to school\.
entries.translated:
Hanya anak-anak yang tidak keren
yang benar-benar pergi ke sekolah\.

entries.original:
"Word around these parts is that the
cave is called the [green]Cave of Being[blue].

People say it bears a resemblance
to the lake caves of Sinnoh."
entries.translation_source: Word around these parts is that the cave is called the [green]Cave of Being[blue]. People say it bears a resemblance to the lake caves of Sinnoh.
entries.translated:
Kabar di daerah ini menyebutkan
bahwa gua itu bernama [green]Cave of\lBeing[blue]. Orang-orang bilang bentuknya

mirip dengan gua-gua danau di
Sinnoh.

entries.original:
"In other places like Fallshore
City, it only rains sometimes.

So why is it always raining on
Route 10?"
entries.translation_source: In other places like Fallshore City, it only rains sometimes. So why is it always raining on Route 10?
entries.translated:
Di tempat lain seperti Fallshore
City, hujan hanya turun\lkadang-kadang. Jadi mengapa di

Route 10 selalu hujan?

entries.original:
"Beyond the boundary of rocks lies
a vast ocean.

It’s somewhere in this ocean
wherein lies the peaceful\lAlola region.

The people there have a tradition
that each of their islands is\lprotected by a guardian deity.

Do you ever wonder what it would
be like if each of the islands that\lmake up Borrius had, too?

That thought may not cross your
mind, but it certainly does mine."
entries.translation_source: Beyond the boundary of rocks lies a vast ocean. It’s somewhere in this ocean wherein lies the peaceful Alola region. The people there have a tradition that each of their islands is protected by a guardian deity. Do you ever wonder what it would be like if each of the islands that make up Borrius had, too? That thought may not cross your mind, but it certainly does mine.
entries.translated:
Di balik batas bebatuan terbentang
lautan luas. Di suatu tempat di\llautan ini terletak wilayah Alola

yang damai. Penduduk di sana
memiliki tradisi bahwa setiap pulau\lmereka dilindungi oleh dewa

pelindung. Apakah kamu pernah
bertanya-tanya bagaimana jadinya\ljika setiap pulau yang membentuk

Borrius juga memiliki dewa
pelindung? Pikiran itu mungkin\ltidak terlintas di benakmu, tapi

pasti terlintas di benakku.

entries.original:
"That Pokémon in your party\.

It certainly bears resemblance to
the guardian deities of Alola\."
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon in your party\. It certainly bears resemblance to the guardian deities of Alola\.
entries.translated:
Pokémon di timmu itu\. Ia memang
mirip dengan dewa-dewa pelindung\lAlola\.

entries.original:
"Reports from the Alola region
indicate their guardian deities\lare still present, which must mean\lyours is not of this world.

Regardless, this item rightfully
belongs with it, not with me."
entries.translation_source: Reports from the Alola region indicate their guardian deities are still present, which must mean yours is not of this world. Regardless, this item rightfully belongs with it, not with me.
entries.translated:
Laporan dari wilayah Alola
menunjukkan bahwa dewa pelindung\lmereka masih ada, yang berarti

milikmu bukan dari dunia ini.
Bagaimanapun juga, item ini adalah\lhak miliknya, bukan milikku.

entries.original:
"The [green]Tapunium Z[red] can power up any
of the Alolan guardian deities\l[green]Nature’s Madness[red], into a more\lpowerful, one-time use Z-Move."
entries.translation_source: The [green]Tapunium Z[red] can power up any of the Alolan guardian deities [green]Nature’s Madness[red], into a more powerful, one-time use Z-Move.
entries.translated:
[green]Tapunium Z[red] dapat meningkatkan
kekuatan salah satu dewa pelindung\lAlola, [green]Nature{B4}s Madness[red], menjadi

Z-Move yang lebih kuat dan hanya
bisa digunakan sekali.

entries.original:
"Upon this rocky face I see, yet
another Trainer, yearning to be.

The very best, I say, the very
best.

Then, I shall put this Trainer to
the test!"
entries.translation_source: Upon this rocky face I see, yet another Trainer, yearning to be. The very best, I say, the very best. Then, I shall put this Trainer to the test!
entries.translated:
Di atas wajah berbatu ini kulihat,
seorang Trainer lain, yang\lbercita-cita menjadi. Yang terbaik,

kataku, yang terbaik. Lalu, akan
kuuji Trainer ini!

entries.original:
"And as this Trainer did pass the
test, I said to them, they are\lthe very best."
entries.translation_source: And as this Trainer did pass the test, I said to them, they are the very best.
entries.translated:
Dan saat Trainer ini lulus ujian,
aku berkata kepada mereka, mereka\ladalah yang terbaik.

entries.original:
"An [green]Alakazite[blue] is full of might.

For [green]Alakazam[blue], it will shine
bright."
entries.translation_source: An [green]Alakazite[blue] is full of might. For [green]Alakazam[blue], it will shine bright.
entries.translated:
Sebuah [green]Alakazite[blue] penuh dengan
kekuatan. Untuk [green]Alakazam[blue], ia akan\lbersinar terang.

entries.original:
"Upon this rocky face I see, yet
another Trainer, yearning to be.

The very best, I say, the very
best.

But only one who has defeated all
of the Trainers on Route 11, can\lbe put to the test."
entries.translation_source: Upon this rocky face I see, yet another Trainer, yearning to be. The very best, I say, the very best. But only one who has defeated all of the Trainers on Route 11, can be put to the test.
entries.translated:
Di atas wajah berbatu ini kulihat,
seorang Trainer lain, yang\lbercita-cita menjadi. Yang terbaik,

kataku, yang terbaik. Tapi hanya
mereka yang telah mengalahkan semua\lTrainer di Route 11, yang bisa

diuji.

entries.original:
"I work to protect the environment.
In turn, nature protects me!"
entries.translation_source: I work to protect the environment. In turn, nature protects me!
entries.translated:
Aku bekerja untuk melindungi
lingkungan. Sebagai imbalannya,\lalam melindungiku!

entries.original:
"The mountain here has a whole
network of caves running\lthrough it.

Together, we protect the Pokémon
of the cliff’s caves."
entries.translation_source: The mountain here has a whole network of caves running through it. Together, we protect the Pokémon of the cliff’s caves.
entries.translated:
Gunung di sini memiliki seluruh
jaringan gua yang membelahnya.\lBersama-sama, kami melindungi

Pokémon di gua-gua tebing.

entries.original:
"Tentacool don’t belong in ponds,
they belong in the sea!"
entries.translation_source: Tentacool don’t belong in ponds, they belong in the sea!
entries.translated:
Tentacool bukan milik kolam, mereka
milik laut!

entries.original:
"With a better rod, I could catch
better Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: With a better rod, I could catch better Pokémon\.
entries.translated:
Dengan kail yang lebih baik, aku
bisa menangkap Pokemon yang lebih\lbaik\.

entries.original:
"It’s all right.
Losing doesn’t bug me anymore."
entries.translation_source: It’s all right. Losing doesn’t bug me anymore.
entries.translated:
Tidak apa-apa. Kalah tidak lagi
menggangguku.

entries.original:
"I guess you get to be good at
what you like.

Well, you beat me at Pokémon,
but you can’t top me at fishing."
entries.translation_source: I guess you get to be good at what you like. Well, you beat me at Pokémon, but you can’t top me at fishing.
entries.translated:
Kurasa kamu bisa menjadi ahli dalam
hal yang kamu suka. Yah, kamu\lmengalahkanku di Pokemon, tapi kamu

tidak bisa mengalahkanku dalam
memancing.

entries.original: "It’s always important to stay warm."
entries.translation_source: It’s always important to stay warm.
entries.translated: Penting untuk selalu tetap hangat.

entries.original:
"This place reminds me of the Cliff
Caves from the Johto region.

Huh? I could’ve thought of something
different?

Like what? Cliff Caves Remastered?
Original Recipe Cliff Caves?"
entries.translation_source: This place reminds me of the Cliff Caves from the Johto region. Huh? I could’ve thought of something different? Like what? Cliff Caves Remastered? Original Recipe Cliff Caves?
entries.translated:
Tempat ini mengingatkanku pada
Cliff Caves dari wilayah Johto.\lHah? Aku bisa memikirkan sesuatu

yang berbeda? Seperti apa? Cliff
Caves Remastered? Original Recipe\lCliff Caves?

entries.original:
"I like to pretend I can fly like
my birds.

Being grounded sucks."
entries.translation_source: I like to pretend I can fly like my birds. Being grounded sucks.
entries.translated:
Aku suka berpura-pura bisa terbang
seperti burung-burungku. Tidak bisa\lterbang itu menyebalkan.

entries.original:
"Talonflame has a Hidden Ability
called [green]Gale Wings[blue].

It can use its Flying-type moves
faster!"
entries.translation_source: Talonflame has a Hidden Ability called [green]Gale Wings[blue]. It can use its Flying-type moves faster!
entries.translated:
Talonflame memiliki Ability
Tersembunyi yang disebut [green]Gale\lWings[blue]. Ia dapat menggunakan jurus

Tipe Terbangnya lebih cepat!

entries.original:
"Did you know that your [buffer1]
is able to power moves up\linto [green]Z-Moves[blue]?

Those are super powerful moves that
can only be used once per battle!

Just equip your Pokémon with a
[green]Z-Crystal[blue] matching one of its\lmove Types, and press \btn04 when\lselecting the move to unleash a\ldevastating attack!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that your [buffer1] is able to power moves up into [green]Z-Moves[blue]? Those are super powerful moves that can only be used once per battle! Just equip your Pokémon with a [green]Z-Crystal[blue] matching one of its move Types, and press \btn04 when selecting the move to unleash a devastating attack!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa [buffer1] milikmu
dapat mengubah jurus menjadi\l[green]Z-Moves[blue]? Itu adalah jurus yang

sangat kuat yang hanya bisa
digunakan sekali per pertarungan!\lCukup lengkapi Pokemon-mu dengan

[green]Z-Crystal[blue] yang cocok dengan salah
satu Tipe jurusnya, dan tekan \btn04\lsaat memilih jurus untuk

melancarkan serangan dahsyat!

entries.original:
"There’s a Pokémon in the bag!
Take it?"
entries.translation_source: There’s a Pokémon in the bag! Take it?
entries.translated:
Ada seekor Pokemon di dalam tas!
Ambil?

entries.original:
"[player] found a [buffer1]!
It has a [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: [player] found a [buffer1]! It has a [green][buffer2][black] nature.
entries.translated:
[player] menemukan [buffer1]! Ia
memiliki sifat [green][buffer2][black].

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough space for
this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough space for this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup ruang
untuk Pokemon ini.

entries.original:
"There’s a Pokémon in the bag!

But it doesn’t seem like it wants
to come out right now\."
entries.translation_source: There’s a Pokémon in the bag! But it doesn’t seem like it wants to come out right now\.
entries.translated:
Ada seekor Pokemon di dalam tas!
Tapi sepertinya ia tidak ingin\lkeluar sekarang\.

entries.original: "I love showing off my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I love showing off my Pokémon!
entries.translated: Aku suka memamerkan Pokemon-ku!

entries.original:
"This mountain pass has a very
unique layout.

You’re not going to find any other
route in Borrius with stairs built\linto the side of a mountain like\lthis one!"
entries.translation_source: This mountain pass has a very unique layout. You’re not going to find any other route in Borrius with stairs built into the side of a mountain like this one!
entries.translated:
Jalur gunung ini memiliki tata
letak yang sangat unik. Kamu tidak\lakan menemukan rute lain di Borrius

yang memiliki tangga yang dibangun
di sisi gunung seperti ini!

entries.original:
"To go between Tarmigan Town and
Dehara City, you must first go\ldown the mountain."
entries.translation_source: To go between Tarmigan Town and Dehara City, you must first go down the mountain.
entries.translated:
Untuk pergi antara Kota Tarmigan
dan Kota Dehara, kamu harus turun\lgunung terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"A beautiful Trainer can’t lose
her way!

It’s simply not possible!"
entries.translation_source: A beautiful Trainer can’t lose her way! It’s simply not possible!
entries.translated:
Seorang Trainer cantik tidak bisa
tersesat! Itu sungguh tidak\lmungkin!

entries.original:
"I must hone my psychic senses
further.

Next time, I will not be wrong."
entries.translation_source: I must hone my psychic senses further. Next time, I will not be wrong.
entries.translated:
Aku harus mengasah indra psikisku
lebih jauh. Lain kali, aku tidak\lakan salah.

entries.original:
"The warmer the weather, the
stronger I get!"
entries.translation_source: The warmer the weather, the stronger I get!
entries.translated:
Semakin hangat cuaca, semakin kuat
aku!

entries.original:
"I think some Pokémon can take
you underwater."
entries.translation_source: I think some Pokémon can take you underwater.
entries.translated:
Kurasa beberapa Pokemon bisa
membawamu ke bawah air.

entries.original:
"You can’t see from on land, but
the water here is very deep!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t see from on land, but the water here is very deep!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak bisa melihat dari darat,
tapi air di sini sangat dalam!

entries.original:
"[buffer1] soared upwards out
of sight."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] soared upwards out of sight.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] melesat naik ke atas
hingga tidak terlihat.

entries.original:
"With my fists, I am trying to
smash this rock that continuously\lreappears under my umbrella.

Aiyah!

But it is not working\."
entries.translation_source: With my fists, I am trying to smash this rock that continuously reappears under my umbrella. Aiyah! But it is not working\.
entries.translated:
Dengan tinjuku, aku mencoba
menghancurkan batu ini yang terus\lmuncul kembali di bawah payungku.

Aiyah! Tapi tidak berhasil\.

entries.original:
"Aiyah! 
You smashed it!"
entries.translation_source: Aiyah! You smashed it!
entries.translated: Aiyah! Kamu menghancurkannya!

entries.original:
"They call me the Ocean Master.

Why?

Because I am the master of the
ocean.

I command the Pokémon of the sea,
and none can defeat me.

Allow me to show you."
entries.translation_source: They call me the Ocean Master. Why? Because I am the master of the ocean. I command the Pokémon of the sea, and none can defeat me. Allow me to show you.
entries.translated:
Mereka memanggilku Penguasa Laut.
Kenapa? Karena aku adalah penguasa\llautan. Aku memerintah Pokémon

laut, dan tidak ada yang bisa
mengalahkanku. Izinkan aku\lmenunjukkan padamu.

entries.original:
"In truth, I was called the Ocean
Master because of my name.

It was a cruel joke my classmates
played on me.

I vowed revenge, so I became an
Ace Trainer.

That is all in the past now, so I
would like you to have this."
entries.translation_source: In truth, I was called the Ocean Master because of my name. It was a cruel joke my classmates played on me. I vowed revenge, so I became an Ace Trainer. That is all in the past now, so I would like you to have this.
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, aku dipanggil Penguasa
Laut karena namaku. Itu adalah\llelucon kejam yang dilakukan teman

sekelasku padaku. Aku bersumpah
untuk balas dendam, jadi aku\lmenjadi Pelatih Ace. Semua itu

sudah masa lalu sekarang, jadi aku
ingin kamu memiliki ini.

entries.original:
"Only the Ocean Master can tame a
Mega Gyarados.

As you are one, allow your [green]Gyarados[blue]
to hold the [green]Gyaradosite[blue].

It will make for an explosive
battle."
entries.translation_source: Only the Ocean Master can tame a Mega Gyarados. As you are one, allow your [green]Gyarados[blue] to hold the [green]Gyaradosite[blue]. It will make for an explosive battle.
entries.translated:
Hanya Penguasa Laut yang bisa
menjinakkan Mega Gyarados. Karena\lkamu adalah salah satunya, biarkan

[green]Gyarados[blue] milikmu memegang
[green]Gyaradosit[blue]. Itu akan membuat\lpertempuran yang eksplosif.

entries.original:
"They call me the Ocean Master.

Why?

Because I am the master of the
ocean.

I command the Pokémon of the sea,
and none can defeat me.

Especially not someone who has not
even defeated all of the Trainers\lon Route 13 and Route 14."
entries.translation_source: They call me the Ocean Master. Why? Because I am the master of the ocean. I command the Pokémon of the sea, and none can defeat me. Especially not someone who has not even defeated all of the Trainers on Route 13 and Route 14.
entries.translated:
Mereka memanggilku Penguasa Laut.
Kenapa? Karena aku adalah penguasa\llautan. Aku memerintah Pokémon

laut, dan tidak ada yang bisa
mengalahkanku. Terutama bukan\lseseorang yang bahkan belum

mengalahkan semua Pelatih di Rute
13 dan Rute 14.

entries.original:
"This dude thinks you’re a big one.
No, you’re a big-one-to-be!"
entries.translation_source: This dude thinks you’re a big one. No, you’re a big-one-to-be!
entries.translated:
Orang ini mengira kamu adalah ikan
besar. Tidak, kamu adalah calon\likan besar!

entries.original:
"Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll
hook a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll hook a big one!
entries.translated:
Oh, tidak! Aku punya firasat aku
akan memancing ikan besar!

entries.original:
"I’m looking at the sea to forget
the bad thing that happened!"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking at the sea to forget the bad thing that happened!
entries.translated:
Aku melihat laut untuk melupakan
hal buruk yang terjadi!

entries.original:
"You can only Dive where the sea
is dark."
entries.translation_source: You can only Dive where the sea is dark.
entries.translated:
Kamu hanya bisa Menyelam di tempat
laut yang gelap.

entries.original:
"I see the Ruins of Void over
yonder!"
entries.translation_source: I see the Ruins of Void over yonder!
entries.translated:
Aku melihat Reruntuhan Void di
sana!

entries.original:
"I can beat even marine Pokémon
at swimming."
entries.translation_source: I can beat even marine Pokémon at swimming.
entries.translated:
Aku bisa mengalahkan bahkan Pokémon
laut dalam berenang.

entries.original:
"My friend wanted to swim to
the Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: My friend wanted to swim to the Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
Temanku ingin berenang ke
Reruntuhan Void.

entries.original:
"If I were to ride a Pokémon on
the sea, I’d like a Lapras.

Lapras is so big, I bet it
would keep me dry on water."
entries.translation_source: If I were to ride a Pokémon on the sea, I’d like a Lapras. Lapras is so big, I bet it would keep me dry on water.
entries.translated:
Jika aku naik Pokémon di laut, aku
ingin Lapras. Lapras sangat besar,\laku yakin itu akan membuatku tetap

kering di air.

entries.original:
"It’s still a long way to
the Ruins of Void.

I want to go back to Dresco Town."
entries.translation_source: It’s still a long way to the Ruins of Void. I want to go back to Dresco Town.
entries.translated:
Masih jauh perjalanan menuju
Reruntuhan Void. Aku ingin kembali\lke Kota Dresco.

entries.original:
"Please don’t splash my face!
You’ll ruin the makeup."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t splash my face! You’ll ruin the makeup.
entries.translated:
Tolong jangan percikkan wajahku!
Kamu akan merusak makeup.

entries.original:
"I collect sea Pokémon on weekends
because the sea is so close."
entries.translation_source: I collect sea Pokémon on weekends because the sea is so close.
entries.translated:
Aku mengoleksi Pokémon laut di
akhir pekan karena laut sangat\ldekat.

entries.original:
"You need sun to sunbathe!

I very well couldn’t do it on
Route 10!"
entries.translation_source: You need sun to sunbathe! I very well couldn’t do it on Route 10!
entries.translated:
Kamu butuh sinar matahari untuk
berjemur! Aku tidak bisa\lmelakukannya di Rute 10!

entries.original:
"I must refine the art of concealment.
I bid thee farewell."
entries.translation_source: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
entries.translated:
Aku harus mengasah seni
penyembunyian. Aku berpamitan.

entries.original:
"This year, I’m going to finally
learn how to swim!"
entries.translation_source: This year, I’m going to finally learn how to swim!
entries.translated:
Tahun ini, aku akhirnya akan
belajar berenang!

entries.original:
"Did I just win?
Or did I lose?"
entries.translation_source: Did I just win? Or did I lose?
entries.translated:
Apakah aku baru saja menang? Atau
kalah?

entries.original:
"M-my legs! They cramped up!
Glub, glub\."
entries.translation_source: M-my legs! They cramped up! Glub, glub\.
entries.translated: K-kakiku! Kram! Glub, glub\.

entries.original:
"I wish I could ride my Pokémon.
I bet you’re not tired."
entries.translation_source: I wish I could ride my Pokémon. I bet you’re not tired.
entries.translated:
Aku berharap bisa menaiki
Pokémon-ku. Aku yakin kau tidak\llelah.

entries.original: "Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!"
entries.translation_source: Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!
entries.translated:
Menaiki Pokémon pasti terlihat
menyenangkan!

entries.original:
"I should’ve been buffing up my
Pokémon, not me!"
entries.translation_source: I should’ve been buffing up my Pokémon, not me!
entries.translated:
Seharusnya aku memperkuat
Pokémon-ku, bukan diriku!

entries.original:
"I’m beat! But, I still have the
bike race and marathon left!"
entries.translation_source: I’m beat! But, I still have the bike race and marathon left!
entries.translated:
Aku kelelahan! Tapi, aku masih
punya balapan sepeda dan maraton!

entries.original:
"Will my pearls grow bigger inside
Cloyster?"
entries.translation_source: Will my pearls grow bigger inside Cloyster?
entries.translated:
Akankah mutiaraku tumbuh lebih
besar di dalam Cloyster?

entries.original:
"When I can’t be with my boyfriend,
I spend time with the Pokémon he\lgave me."
entries.translation_source: When I can’t be with my boyfriend, I spend time with the Pokémon he gave me.
entries.translated:
Saat aku tidak bisa bersama
pacarku, aku menghabiskan waktu\ldengan Pokémon yang dia berikan

padaku.

entries.original:
"If only there was someone to have a
picnic with\."
entries.translation_source: If only there was someone to have a picnic with\.
entries.translated:
Andai saja ada seseorang untuk
piknik bersama\.

entries.original:
"You got those Badges from Gym
Leaders. I know!"
entries.translation_source: You got those Badges from Gym Leaders. I know!
entries.translated:
Kau mendapatkan Lencana-lencana itu
dari Pemimpin Gym. Aku tahu!

entries.original: "Even rough housers need a break."
entries.translation_source: Even rough housers need a break.
entries.translated:
Bahkan orang kasar pun butuh
istirahat.

entries.original:
"Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call
myself an Expert now, can I?"
entries.translation_source: Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call myself an Expert now, can I?
entries.translated:
Nah, nah, aku kalah. Aku tidak bisa
menyebut diriku seorang Pakar\lsekarang, kan?

entries.original:
"It’d be a handful if I hooked
your tough Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: It’d be a handful if I hooked your tough Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Akan merepotkan jika aku mengait
Pokémon tangguhmu!

entries.original:
"Perhaps that reek is your sweaty
Pokémon’s body odor\."
entries.translation_source: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty Pokémon’s body odor\.
entries.translated:
Mungkin bau itu adalah bau badan
Pokémonmu yang berkeringat\.

entries.original:
"This section of the KBT Expressway
runs from Crater Town to Tehl Town."
entries.translation_source: This section of the KBT Expressway runs from Crater Town to Tehl Town.
entries.translated:
Bagian dari Jalan Tol KBT ini
membentang dari Crater Town ke Tehl\lTown.

entries.original:
"If 100 people as big as me stood
here, do you think the ground\lcould support the weight?"
entries.translation_source: If 100 people as big as me stood here, do you think the ground could support the weight?
entries.translated:
Jika 100 orang sebesar aku berdiri
di sini, menurutmu tanah bisa\lmenahan beratnya?

entries.original:
"Are you crazy!?

Don’t you know it’s dangerous to
swim in a thunderstorm?

\.\CC0820Us?

We’re part Ground-type!
We can’t be shocked!"
entries.translation_source: Are you crazy!? Don’t you know it’s dangerous to swim in a thunderstorm? \.\CC0820Us? We’re part Ground-type! We can’t be shocked!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu gila!? Tidakkah kamu
tahu berenang saat badai petir itu\lberbahaya? \.\CC0820Kami? Kami tipe Ground!

Kami tidak bisa tersetrum!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear\.

You’d best be careful swimming in
this weather!

This is no natural thunderstorm,
you see.

Something ominous is causing
the downpour."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear\. You’d best be careful swimming in this weather! This is no natural thunderstorm, you see. Something ominous is causing the downpour.
entries.translated:
Oh, sayang\. Kamu sebaiknya
berhati-hati berenang dalam cuaca\lini! Ini bukan badai petir alami,

kamu tahu. Sesuatu yang tidak
menyenangkan menyebabkan hujan\llebat.

entries.original:
"What could have caused a
thunderstorm that powerful?

I know of the Ability [green]Drizzle[red], but
that was something else.

The rain was almost\.\CC0820 primordial\."
entries.translation_source: What could have caused a thunderstorm that powerful? I know of the Ability [green]Drizzle[red], but that was something else. The rain was almost\.\CC0820 primordial\.
entries.translated:
Apa yang bisa menyebabkan badai
petir sekuat itu? Saya tahu tentang\lAbility [green]Hujan[red], tapi itu sesuatu

yang lain. Hujannya hampir\.\CC0820
primordial\.

entries.original:
"Thunderstorms don’t actually have
an effect on fishing.

But [green]Sweet Scent[blue]\.

That can’t be used if the weather
isn’t clear."
entries.translation_source: Thunderstorms don’t actually have an effect on fishing. But [green]Sweet Scent[blue]\. That can’t be used if the weather isn’t clear.
entries.translated:
Badai petir sebenarnya tidak
memengaruhi memancing. Tapi [green]Aroma\lManis[blue]\. Itu tidak bisa digunakan jika

cuaca tidak cerah.

entries.original: "[black]Something unseeable is in the way."
entries.translation_source: [black]Something unseeable is in the way.
entries.translated:
[black]Ada sesuatu yang tidak terlihat
menghalangi jalan.

entries.original:
"Move, kid!

You’re blockin’ the road!"
entries.translation_source: Move, kid! You’re blockin’ the road!
entries.translated:
Pindah, nak! Kamu menghalangi
jalan!

entries.original:
"Huh?

There’s somethin’ in the way?

It better not be that pesky
Pokémon, again\."
entries.translation_source: Huh? There’s somethin’ in the way? It better not be that pesky Pokémon, again\.
entries.translated:
Hah? Ada sesuatu yang menghalangi?
Lebih baik bukan Pokémon\lmenyebalkan itu, lagi\.

entries.original:
"Take this.

If my hunch is right, it’ll get rid
of whatever’s blockin’ the road."
entries.translation_source: Take this. If my hunch is right, it’ll get rid of whatever’s blockin’ the road.
entries.translated:
Ambil ini. Jika firasatku benar,
ini akan menyingkirkan apa pun yang\lmenghalangi jalan.

entries.original:
"

If my hunch is right, it’ll get rid
of whatever’s blockin’ the road."
entries.translation_source: If my hunch is right, it’ll get rid of whatever’s blockin’ the road.
entries.translated:
Jika firasatku benar, ini akan
menyingkirkan apa pun yang\lmenghalangi jalan.

entries.original:
"If my hunch is right, that item
should show you exactly what’s\lblockin’ the road."
entries.translation_source: If my hunch is right, that item should show you exactly what’s blockin’ the road.
entries.translated:
Jika firasatku benar, item itu akan
menunjukkan dengan tepat apa yang\lmenghalangi jalan.

entries.original:
"[black]Something unseeable is in the way.

Use the Devon Scope?"
entries.translation_source: [black]Something unseeable is in the way. Use the Devon Scope?
entries.translated:
[black]Ada sesuatu yang tidak terlihat
menghalangi jalan. Gunakan Lensa\lDevon?

entries.original: "[black][player] used the Devon Scope."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] used the Devon Scope.
entries.translated: [black][player] menggunakan Lensa Devon.

entries.original:
"[black]An invisible Pokémon became
completely visible!"
entries.translation_source: [black]An invisible Pokémon became completely visible!
entries.translated:
[black]Seekor Pokémon tak terlihat menjadi
sepenuhnya terlihat!

entries.original: "[black]The startled Pokémon took off!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The startled Pokémon took off!
entries.translated: [black]Pokémon yang terkejut itu kabur!

entries.original:
"Hmph.

Seems like you’re a more
intimidatin’ Trainer than you let on\.

Say\. you should take on the Antisis
Gym with your Pokémon.

I hear the Gym Leader there has
been pretty bored lately."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. Seems like you’re a more intimidatin’ Trainer than you let on\. Say\. you should take on the Antisis Gym with your Pokémon. I hear the Gym Leader there has been pretty bored lately.
entries.translated:
Hmph. Sepertinya kamu adalah
Pelatih yang lebih mengintimidasi\ldaripada yang kamu tunjukkan\.

Katakan\. kamu harus menantang Gym
Antisis dengan Pokémon-mu. Kudengar\lPemimpin Gym di sana akhir-akhir

ini cukup bosan.

entries.original: "[black]The startled Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The startled Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
[black]Pokémon yang terkejut itu
menyerang!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] took off!"
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] took off!
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] kabur!

entries.original:
"Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun,
please shine down on me\."
entries.translation_source: Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, please shine down on me\.
entries.translated:
Oh Tuan Matahari, Matahari, Tuan
Matahari Emas, tolong bersinarlah\lpadaku\.

entries.original:
"Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun,
has shone down on me\."
entries.translation_source: Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, has shone down on me\.
entries.translated:
Oh Tuan Matahari, Matahari, Tuan
Matahari Emas, telah bersinar\lpadaku\.

entries.original:
"Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun,
it’s now time to leave\."
entries.translation_source: Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, it’s now time to leave\.
entries.translated:
Oh Tuan Matahari, Matahari, Tuan
Matahari Emas, sekarang waktunya\lpergi\.

entries.original:
"I get my kicks by harassing people
with my stinking Pokémon.

They’re great for startling people.
And, they bite, too."
entries.translation_source: I get my kicks by harassing people with my stinking Pokémon. They’re great for startling people. And, they bite, too.
entries.translated:
Aku mendapatkan kesenanganku dengan
melecehkan orang dengan Pokémon\lbauku. Mereka hebat untuk

mengejutkan orang. Dan, mereka juga
menggigit.

entries.original:
"Forget it!
I don’t need your money!"
entries.translation_source: Forget it! I don’t need your money!
entries.translated: Lupakan! Aku tidak butuh uangmu!

entries.original:
"If you don’t know how, I’m willing
to show you how to swim."
entries.translation_source: If you don’t know how, I’m willing to show you how to swim.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu tidak tahu caranya, aku
bersedia menunjukkan cara berenang.

entries.original:
"Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if
I don’t like mountain men.

But, you know, my favourite kind of
guy looks great with Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if I don’t like mountain men. But, you know, my favourite kind of guy looks great with Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Jangan salah paham, bukan berarti
aku tidak suka pria gunung. Tapi,\ltahukah kamu, tipe pria favoritku

tampak hebat dengan Pokémon!

entries.original:
"The bad men in Antisis City like to
harass people who get too close\lthe city."
entries.translation_source: The bad men in Antisis City like to harass people who get too close the city.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang jahat di Antisis City
suka mengganggu orang yang terlalu\ldekat dengan kota.

entries.original:
"Listen, you! Whatever happens,
never lose sight of your dream!"
entries.translation_source: Listen, you! Whatever happens, never lose sight of your dream!
entries.translated:
Dengar, kamu! Apa pun yang terjadi,
jangan pernah kehilangan pandangan\lterhadap mimpimu!

entries.original:
"Oh right\.
I was fishing, wasn’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Oh right\. I was fishing, wasn’t I?
entries.translated: Oh right\. Aku sedang memancing, kan?

entries.original:
"Is it possible to become more
powerful by understanding Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Is it possible to become more powerful by understanding Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah mungkin menjadi lebih kuat
dengan memahami Pokémon?

entries.original:
"My body isn’t naturally this good
looking!

My Pokémon and I exercise every
day to keep our bodies fit."
entries.translation_source: My body isn’t naturally this good looking! My Pokémon and I exercise every day to keep our bodies fit.
entries.translated:
Tubuhku tidak secara alami setampan
ini! Aku dan Pokémon-ku berolahraga\lsetiap hari untuk menjaga kebugaran

tubuh.

entries.original:
"Did you know that one of my bird
Pokémon can mimic speech?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that one of my bird Pokémon can mimic speech?
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa salah satu
Pokémon burungku bisa meniru\lucapan?

entries.original:
"I came here in hopes of bringing
new life into the area."
entries.translation_source: I came here in hopes of bringing new life into the area.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini dengan harapan
membawa kehidupan baru ke daerah\lini.

entries.original:
"Oh, geez\.
Another Trainer\.

Well, here you go."
entries.translation_source: Oh, geez\. Another Trainer\. Well, here you go.
entries.translated:
Oh, geez\. Pelatih lain\. Baiklah, ini
dia.

entries.original:
"I’ve been instructed by my
superiors to hand out that HM to\lany Trainers coming this way.

Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll
need to use that HM for [green]Rock Climb[blue]\lif you want to go to [green]Seaport City[blue].

Just face that rock wall over
there to use it."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been instructed by my superiors to hand out that HM to any Trainers coming this way. Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll need to use that HM for [green]Rock Climb[blue] if you want to go to [green]Seaport City[blue]. Just face that rock wall over there to use it.
entries.translated:
Aku telah diinstruksikan oleh
atasanku untuk membagikan HM itu\lkepada Pelatih mana pun yang datang

ke sini. Sampai jembatan
diperbaiki, kamu perlu menggunakan\lHM itu untuk [green]Rock Climb[blue] jika kamu

ingin pergi ke [green]Seaport City[blue].
Hadapilah dinding batu di sana\luntuk menggunakannya.

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid!

A fight between some Zangoose and
Seviper took out the bridge.

It’ll take some time before we get
it fixed.

You should talk to our boss about
finding an alternative way to\lSeaport City in the meantime."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid! A fight between some Zangoose and Seviper took out the bridge. It’ll take some time before we get it fixed. You should talk to our boss about finding an alternative way to Seaport City in the meantime.
entries.translated:
Maaf, nak! Pertarungan antara
beberapa Zangoose dan Seviper\lmenghancurkan jembatan. Butuh

beberapa waktu sebelum kami
memperbaikinya. Kamu sebaiknya\lbicara dengan bos kami tentang

mencari jalan alternatif ke Seaport
City sementara itu.

entries.original: "It’s a seashell."
entries.translation_source: It’s a seashell.
entries.translated: Itu adalah kerang.

entries.original: "[green]Derrrr!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Derrrr!
entries.translated: [green]Derrrr!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] receded into the
sand."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] receded into the sand.
entries.translated: [buffer1] mundur ke dalam pasir.

entries.original:
"He ho!
You thaved me!

I wath looking for Berrieth on behalf
of Tropiuth Berrieth Inc., when all\lof a thudden theth boulderth fell\ldown around me!

But you rethcued me, tho now I can
go home for the day!

Becauth of your heroic efforth, I
want you to take thome Berrieth!"
entries.translation_source: He ho! You thaved me! I wath looking for Berrieth on behalf of Tropiuth Berrieth Inc., when all of a thudden theth boulderth fell down around me! But you rethcued me, tho now I can go home for the day! Becauth of your heroic efforth, I want you to take thome Berrieth!
entries.translated:
He ho! Kamu menyelamatkanku! Aku
thedang mencari Berrieth untuk\lTropiuth Berrieth Inc., ketika

tiba-tiba boulder-boulder ini jatuh
di thekitarku! Tapi kamu\lmenyelamatkanku, jadi thekarang aku

thaya bitha pulang untuk hari ini!
Becauth dari upaya heroikmu, thaya\lingin kamu mengambil thome

Berrieth!

entries.original:
"He ho!

I’ll be back tomorrow to look for
more Berrieth!"
entries.translation_source: He ho! I’ll be back tomorrow to look for more Berrieth!
entries.translated:
He ho! Aku akan kembali besok untuk
mencari lebih banyak Berrieth!

entries.original:
"I am an eloquent Bird Keeper.

I only partake in the finest of
aerial battles.

As such, I refuse to partake in
battles where Pokémon on the\lground are utilized.

Hearing that, would you care for a
[green]Sky Battle[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: I am an eloquent Bird Keeper. I only partake in the finest of aerial battles. As such, I refuse to partake in battles where Pokémon on the ground are utilized. Hearing that, would you care for a [green]Sky Battle[blue]?
entries.translated:
Aku adalah Bird Keeper yang fasih.
Aku hanya berpartisipasi dalam\lpertempuran udara terbaik.

Karenanya, aku menolak
berpartisipasi dalam pertempuran di\lmana Pokémon di darat digunakan.

Mendengar itu, apakah kamu tertarik
untuk [green]Sky Battle[blue]?

entries.original:
"Unfortunately for you, I also require
the defeat of all Trainers on this\lroute before I will battle you.

Please return once you have done so,
and then we can begin our eloquent\laerial battle!"
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately for you, I also require the defeat of all Trainers on this route before I will battle you. Please return once you have done so, and then we can begin our eloquent aerial battle!
entries.translated:
Sayangnya bagimu, aku juga
membutuhkan kekalahan semua Pelatih\ldi rute ini sebelum aku akan

bertarung denganmu. Silakan kembali
setelah kamu melakukannya, dan\lkemudian kita bisa memulai

pertempuran udara kita yang fasih!

entries.original:
"Today appears to be my lucky day.
Let us battle!"
entries.translation_source: Today appears to be my lucky day. Let us battle!
entries.translated:
Hari ini tampaknya adalah hari
keberuntunganku. Ayo bertarung!

entries.original:
"A shame.
That is indeed unfortunate."
entries.translation_source: A shame. That is indeed unfortunate.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali. Itu memang tidak
beruntung.

entries.original:
"You have no Pokémon I would be
willing to fight.

Only [green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon or
Pokémon with the [green]Levitate[blue] ability\lmay battle with my Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You have no Pokémon I would be willing to fight. Only [green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon or Pokémon with the [green]Levitate[blue] ability may battle with my Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki Pokémon yang
mau saya lawan. Hanya Pokémon [green]tipe\lTerbang[blue] atau Pokémon dengan

kemampuan [green]Levitate[blue] yang boleh
bertarung dengan Pokémon saya.

entries.original:
"Our aerial battle brought such joy
to my heart.

Please, take this Mega Stone for the
Pokémon [green]Pidgeot[blue] as a show of my\lgratitude!"
entries.translation_source: Our aerial battle brought such joy to my heart. Please, take this Mega Stone for the Pokémon [green]Pidgeot[blue] as a show of my gratitude!
entries.translated:
Pertarungan udara kita memberikan
begitu banyak kegembiraan di\lhatiku. Tolong, ambil Batu Mega

untuk Pokémon [green]Pidgeot[blue] ini sebagai
tanda terima kasihku!

entries.original:
"Our aerial battle brought such joy
to my heart.

Please, take these Wings as a show
of my gratitude!"
entries.translation_source: Our aerial battle brought such joy to my heart. Please, take these Wings as a show of my gratitude!
entries.translated:
Pertarungan udara kita memberikan
begitu banyak kegembiraan di\lhatiku. Tolong, ambil Sayap ini

sebagai tanda terima kasihku!

entries.original:
"A shame.
You don’t have space for any wings."
entries.translation_source: A shame. You don’t have space for any wings.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali. Kamu tidak punya
ruang untuk sayap apa pun.

entries.original:
"Our aerial battle filled me with
so much joy!

Let us do it again tomorrow."
entries.translation_source: Our aerial battle filled me with so much joy! Let us do it again tomorrow.
entries.translated:
Pertarungan udara kita memenuhi
saya dengan begitu banyak sukacita!\lMari kita lakukan lagi besok.

entries.original:
"I try not to leave the area so my
fishing chain will grow as long as\lpossible."
entries.translation_source: I try not to leave the area so my fishing chain will grow as long as possible.
entries.translated:
Saya mencoba untuk tidak
meninggalkan area agar rantai\lpancing saya bisa bertambah panjang

sebaik mungkin.

entries.original:
"Actually, that guy over there is my
only friend now\."
entries.translation_source: Actually, that guy over there is my only friend now\.
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, pria di sana itu adalah
satu-satunya temanku sekarang\.

entries.original:
"I should go back home.

There was much more variety in
watery areas where I came from."
entries.translation_source: I should go back home. There was much more variety in watery areas where I came from.
entries.translated:
Saya harus pulang. Ada lebih banyak
variasi di daerah perairan tempat\lsaya berasal.

entries.original:
"When I climb down the bluffs, I
find very interesting things hidden\lin the seashells on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: When I climb down the bluffs, I find very interesting things hidden in the seashells on the beach!
entries.translated:
Saat saya turun dari tebing, saya
menemukan hal-hal yang sangat\lmenarik tersembunyi di dalam kerang

di pantai!

entries.original:
"Finding rare Pokémon is much
easier if you have a DexNav.

As long as you’ve seen the
Pokémon, it’s very easy to\lencounter it again!"
entries.translation_source: Finding rare Pokémon is much easier if you have a DexNav. As long as you’ve seen the Pokémon, it’s very easy to encounter it again!
entries.translated:
Menemukan Pokémon langka jauh lebih
mudah jika kamu memiliki DexNav.\lSelama kamu sudah melihat Pokémon

itu, sangat mudah untuk menemuinya
lagi!

entries.original:
"Huff\. Puff\.

Jogging and battling make a tiring
combo!"
entries.translation_source: Huff\. Puff\. Jogging and battling make a tiring combo!
entries.translated:
Huff\. Puff\. Berlari dan bertarung
adalah kombinasi yang melelahkan!

entries.original:
"I trained my Zangoose and Seviper
to play together nicely!"
entries.translation_source: I trained my Zangoose and Seviper to play together nicely!
entries.translated:
Saya melatih Zangoose dan Seviper
saya untuk bermain bersama dengan\lbaik!

entries.original:
"I know there are bug Pokémon
around here!

There was one day I saw a huge
[green]swarm[blue] of them flying around!"
entries.translation_source: I know there are bug Pokémon around here! There was one day I saw a huge [green]swarm[blue] of them flying around!
entries.translated:
Saya tahu ada Pokémon serangga di
sekitar sini! Suatu hari saya\lmelihat [green]kawanan[blue] besar mereka

terbang!

entries.original:
"One day, my babies will use a
powerful Return and beat you up\lfor what you did to them!"
entries.translation_source: One day, my babies will use a powerful Return and beat you up for what you did to them!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, anak-anakku akan
menggunakan Return yang kuat dan\lmengalahkanmu atas apa yang kamu

lakukan pada mereka!

entries.original:
"Let’s have a race!

Let’s see who can get to the
Pokémon League first!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s have a race! Let’s see who can get to the Pokémon League first!
entries.translated:
Ayo balapan! Mari lihat siapa yang
bisa sampai ke Liga Pokémon\lterlebih dahulu!

entries.original:
"Despite swimming since I was a wee
tot, I had never seen a Trainer\lriding on the back of a Pokémon\lbefore I battled you.

Which Pokémon is that you’re
Surfing on, anyway?

Is that a Wailmer?
It sure looks like one!"
entries.translation_source: Despite swimming since I was a wee tot, I had never seen a Trainer riding on the back of a Pokémon before I battled you. Which Pokémon is that you’re Surfing on, anyway? Is that a Wailmer? It sure looks like one!
entries.translated:
Meskipun berenang sejak saya masih
kecil, saya belum pernah melihat\lPelatih naik di atas punggung

Pokémon sebelum saya bertarung
denganmu. Pokémon apa yang kamu\lnaiki dengan Surf itu? Apakah itu

Wailmer? Pasti mirip sekali!

entries.original:
"I keep my Poké Balls in the
pockets of my swim trunks.

\.

What?
Expecting a different answer?"
entries.translation_source: I keep my Poké Balls in the pockets of my swim trunks. \. What? Expecting a different answer?
entries.translated:
Saya menyimpan Poké Ball di saku
celana renang saya. \. Apa?\lMengharapkan jawaban yang berbeda?

entries.original:
"It defeats the purpose of swimming
across a long watery stretch if\lyour Pokémon does it for you!"
entries.translation_source: It defeats the purpose of swimming across a long watery stretch if your Pokémon does it for you!
entries.translated:
Itu mengalahkan tujuan berenang
melintasi perairan panjang jika\lPokémonmu yang melakukannya

untukmu!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon doesn’t know Sand-
Attack, but I can always help\lout using my psychic abilities!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon doesn’t know Sand- Attack, but I can always help out using my psychic abilities!
entries.translated:
Pokémon saya tidak tahu
Sand-Attack, tapi saya selalu bisa\lmembantu menggunakan kemampuan

psikis saya!

entries.original:
"Maybe someday I, the brawn, will
reunite with my old friend, the\lbrain."
entries.translation_source: Maybe someday I, the brawn, will reunite with my old friend, the brain.
entries.translated:
Mungkin suatu hari nanti aku, si
otot, akan bersatu kembali dengan\lteman lamaku, si otak.

entries.original:
"Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader
in East Borrius.

If you defeat her, your Pokémon
gain the skill to scale waterfalls."
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader in East Borrius. If you defeat her, your Pokémon gain the skill to scale waterfalls.
entries.translated:
Tessy adalah Pemimpin Gym Tipe Air
di Borrius Timur. Jika kamu\lmengalahkannya, Pokémon-mu

mendapatkan kemampuan untuk mendaki
air terjun.

entries.original:
"Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader
in East Borrius.

If you defeat her, your Pokémon
gain the skill to scale waterfalls.

But you already knew that,
didn’t you?"
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader in East Borrius. If you defeat her, your Pokémon gain the skill to scale waterfalls. But you already knew that, didn’t you?
entries.translated:
Tessy adalah Pemimpin Gym Tipe Air
di Borrius Timur. Jika kamu\lmengalahkannya, Pokémon-mu

mendapatkan kemampuan untuk mendaki
air terjun. Tapi kamu sudah tahu\litu, kan?

entries.original:
"Both of my friends call me crazy
for standing all the way out here.

But what do they know?

They stare at each other outside
of Cinder Volcano all day\."
entries.translation_source: Both of my friends call me crazy for standing all the way out here. But what do they know? They stare at each other outside of Cinder Volcano all day\.
entries.translated:
Kedua temanku bilang aku gila
karena berdiri di sini sepanjang\lhari. Tapi apa yang mereka tahu?

Mereka saling menatap di luar
Cinder Volcano sepanjang hari\.

entries.original:
"Looks like I’ll need more than my
trusty Rod to become the Champion\lof Borrius\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like I’ll need more than my trusty Rod to become the Champion of Borrius\.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku butuh lebih dari
Pancing andalanku untuk menjadi\lJuara Borrius\.

entries.original:
"By hiding in sand all day, I’m
learning new techniques to defeat\lthe Elite Four!"
entries.translation_source: By hiding in sand all day, I’m learning new techniques to defeat the Elite Four!
entries.translated:
Dengan bersembunyi di pasir
sepanjang hari, aku mempelajari\lteknik baru untuk mengalahkan Elite

Four!

entries.original:
"Only I should be allowed to
challenge the Elite Four.

That’s right, me, and me alone!"
entries.translation_source: Only I should be allowed to challenge the Elite Four. That’s right, me, and me alone!
entries.translated:
Hanya aku yang seharusnya diizinkan
menantang Elite Four. Benar, aku,\ldan aku sendiri!

entries.original:
"Victory Road is not for the faint
of heart.

Those who enter must overcome the
famed torturous\. ice puzzle\."
entries.translation_source: Victory Road is not for the faint of heart. Those who enter must overcome the famed torturous\. ice puzzle\.
entries.translated:
Victory Road bukan untuk yang lemah
hati. Mereka yang masuk harus\lmengatasi teka-teki es yang

terkenal menyiksa\. teka-teki es\.

entries.original:
"Like true royalty, you’ve done it!

You’ve defeated all of the Trainers
here on Route 18!

And as royalty, too, I’ve just got
to challenge you, myself!"
entries.translation_source: Like true royalty, you’ve done it! You’ve defeated all of the Trainers here on Route 18! And as royalty, too, I’ve just got to challenge you, myself!
entries.translated:
Seperti bangsawan sejati, kamu
berhasil! Kamu telah mengalahkan\lsemua Pelatih di sini di Route 18!

Dan sebagai bangsawan juga, aku
harus menantangmu, sendiri!

entries.original: "And the reward for your efforts is\."
entries.translation_source: And the reward for your efforts is\.
entries.translated: Dan hadiah atas usahamu adalah\.

entries.original:
"That is a Mega Stone for the
Pokémon known as [green]Sableye[red].

If you share a strong bond with
one, give it that, and your bond\lwill bounce back status attacks!"
entries.translation_source: That is a Mega Stone for the Pokémon known as [green]Sableye[red]. If you share a strong bond with one, give it that, and your bond will bounce back status attacks!
entries.translated:
Itu adalah Mega Stone untuk Pokémon
yang dikenal sebagai [green]Sableye[red]. Jika\lkamu memiliki ikatan kuat dengan

satu, berikan itu padanya, dan
ikatanmu akan memantulkan kembali\lserangan status!

entries.original:
"I’m the queen of Route 18!

What does that mean?

Defeat all the Trainers on this
route to find out!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the queen of Route 18! What does that mean? Defeat all the Trainers on this route to find out!
entries.translated:
Aku adalah ratu Route 18! Apa
artinya itu? Kalahkan semua Pelatih\ldi rute ini untuk mengetahuinya!

entries.original:
"This plateau marks the beginning of
the long climb up Victory Road to\lthe Pokémon League.

It is there where Trainers compete
against the Elite Four for a chance\lto become Borrius’ Champion.

Are you one of those Trainers?"
entries.translation_source: This plateau marks the beginning of the long climb up Victory Road to the Pokémon League. It is there where Trainers compete against the Elite Four for a chance to become Borrius’ Champion. Are you one of those Trainers?
entries.translated:
Dataran tinggi ini menandai awal
pendakian panjang menuju Victory\lRoad ke Pokémon League. Di sanalah

para Pelatih bertanding melawan
Elite Four untuk kesempatan menjadi\lJuara Borrius. Apakah kamu salah

satu dari Pelatih itu?

entries.original:
"Then my suspicions are confirmed\.

\.

Take these!"
entries.translation_source: Then my suspicions are confirmed\. \. Take these!
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu kecurigaanku terbukti\. \.
Ambil ini!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
I am not usually wrong\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. I am not usually wrong\.
entries.translated: Hmm\. Aku biasanya tidak salah\.

entries.original:
"The climb up to Victory Road is
long and arduous.

Those [green]Max Repels[blue] should keep the
wild Pokémon away while you climb."
entries.translation_source: The climb up to Victory Road is long and arduous. Those [green]Max Repels[blue] should keep the wild Pokémon away while you climb.
entries.translated:
Pendakian menuju Victory Road
panjang dan berat. [green]Max Repel[blue] itu\lseharusnya menjauhkan Pokémon liar

saat kamu mendaki.
