entries.original:
"Did ya know that money grows
on trees?"
entries.translation_source: Did ya know that money grows on trees?
entries.translated:
Apa kamu tahu kalau uang tumbuh di
pohon?

entries.original:
"Well, yer absolutely wrong!

I just picked this here money right
off this here tree!"
entries.translation_source: Well, yer absolutely wrong! I just picked this here money right off this here tree!
entries.translated:
Yah, kamu benar-benar salah! Aku
baru saja memetik uang ini langsung\ldari pohon ini!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received $[buffer1] from
the organic alchemist!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received $[buffer1] from the organic alchemist!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima $[buffer1] dari
alkemis organik!

entries.original:
"This here tree only grows money
once a day.

I know, inconvenient, amaright?"
entries.translation_source: This here tree only grows money once a day. I know, inconvenient, amaright?
entries.translated:
Pohon ini hanya menumbuhkan uang
sekali sehari. Aku tahu, tidak\lpraktis, kan?

entries.original:
"Oh\.
Ya already knew\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. Ya already knew\.
entries.translated: Oh\. Kamu sudah tahu\.

entries.original:
"Only those who have acquired all
eight of Borrius’ Gym Badges may\lpass through this point."
entries.translation_source: Only those who have acquired all eight of Borrius’ Gym Badges may pass through this point.
entries.translated:
Hanya mereka yang telah memperoleh
kedelapan Lencana Gym Borrius yang\lboleh melewati titik ini.

entries.original:
"\.

You may pass."
entries.translation_source: \. You may pass.
entries.translated: \. Kamu boleh lewat.

entries.original:
"Past this point lies the entrance
to Victory Road.

It is the final hurdle Trainers
must overcome if they wish to\lchallenge the Elite Four for a\lchance to become Borrius’ Champion."
entries.translation_source: Past this point lies the entrance to Victory Road. It is the final hurdle Trainers must overcome if they wish to challenge the Elite Four for a chance to become Borrius’ Champion.
entries.translated:
Di balik titik ini terdapat pintu
masuk ke Victory Road. Ini adalah\lrintangan terakhir yang harus

dilalui Trainer jika mereka ingin
menantang Elite Four untuk\lmendapatkan kesempatan menjadi

Juara Borrius.

entries.original: "Hero of the Hall"
entries.translation_source: Hero of the Hall
entries.translated: Pahlawan Aula

entries.original:
"Do you know about the
Hall of Fame?

It’s the place where you go if you
defeat the Pokémon League!

At one point, the old Champion,
Artie had been there so many times,\lhe decided to set a goal of going\lthere with every team consisting\lof a common type.

Sadly, he never did reach his goal,
and only ever entered with monotype\lteams for 17 out of the 18 types.

Maybe you want to take up the
challenge instead?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know about the Hall of Fame? It’s the place where you go if you defeat the Pokémon League! At one point, the old Champion, Artie had been there so many times, he decided to set a goal of going there with every team consisting of a common type. Sadly, he never did reach his goal, and only ever entered with monotype teams for 17 out of the 18 types. Maybe you want to take up the challenge instead?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tahu tentang Hall of
Fame? Itu adalah tempat yang kamu\lkunjungi jika kamu mengalahkan

Pokémon League! Suatu ketika, Juara
lama, Artie telah ke sana\lberkali-kali, dia memutuskan untuk

menetapkan tujuan pergi ke sana
dengan setiap tim yang terdiri dari\lsatu tipe yang umum. Sayangnya, dia

tidak pernah mencapai tujuannya,
dan hanya pernah masuk dengan tim\lmonotipe untuk 17 dari 18 tipe.

Mungkin kamu ingin menerima
tantangan itu sebagai gantinya?

entries.original:
"You’re taking up the challenge?
Sweet!

Bring on those victories!

There are [green]18[blue] types in total, and
you’ll need to enter the Hall of\lFame with teams for each one.

Oh, and keep this in mind: if you
Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the\lbase species and Mega species will\lcount towards the team type.

So, let’s say you want to use a
Mega Gyarados.

In addition to a Water-type team,
you could use it on both Flying-\land Dark-type teams!"
entries.translation_source: You’re taking up the challenge? Sweet! Bring on those victories! There are [green]18[blue] types in total, and you’ll need to enter the Hall of Fame with teams for each one. Oh, and keep this in mind: if you Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the base species and Mega species will count towards the team type. So, let’s say you want to use a Mega Gyarados. In addition to a Water-type team, you could use it on both Flying- and Dark-type teams!
entries.translated:
Kamu menerima tantangan itu? Keren!
Datangkan kemenangan-kemenangan\litu! Ada [green]18[blue] tipe secara total, dan

kamu harus masuk ke Hall of Fame
dengan tim untuk masing-masing\ltipe. Oh, dan ingat ini: jika kamu

Mega Evolve Pokémon, baik spesies
dasar maupun spesies Mega akan\ldihitung sebagai tipe tim. Jadi,

misalnya kamu ingin menggunakan
Mega Gyarados. Selain tim Tipe Air,\lkamu bisa menggunakannya di tim

Tipe Terbang dan Tipe Gelap!

entries.original:
"Then I guess Artie will always
reign as the ultimate Champion!"
entries.translation_source: Then I guess Artie will always reign as the ultimate Champion!
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, saya kira Artie akan
selalu berkuasa sebagai Juara\ltertinggi!

entries.original:
"It looks like the number of your
monotype Hall of Fame entries is\lonly [green][buffer2][blue].

You still need to get in there with
[green][buffer3][blue] more type\\08 to pass Artie’s\lrecord, so get battling!

Oh, and keep this in mind: if you
Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the\lbase species and Mega species will\lcount towards the team type.

So, let’s say you want to use a
Mega Gyarados.

In addition to a Water-type team,
you could use it on both Flying-\land Dark-type teams!"
entries.translation_source: It looks like the number of your monotype Hall of Fame entries is only [green][buffer2][blue]. You still need to get in there with [green][buffer3][blue] more type\\08 to pass Artie’s record, so get battling! Oh, and keep this in mind: if you Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the base species and Mega species will count towards the team type. So, let’s say you want to use a Mega Gyarados. In addition to a Water-type team, you could use it on both Flying- and Dark-type teams!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya jumlah entri Hall of
Fame monotipe kamu hanya [green][buffer2][blue].\lKamu masih harus masuk ke sana

dengan [green][buffer3][blue] tipe\\08 lagi untuk
melewati rekor Artie, jadi\lbertarunglah! Oh, dan ingat ini:

jika kamu Mega Evolve Pokémon, baik
spesies dasar maupun spesies Mega\lakan dihitung sebagai tipe tim.

Jadi, misalnya kamu ingin
menggunakan Mega Gyarados. Selain\ltim Tipe Air, kamu bisa

menggunakannya di tim Tipe Terbang
dan Tipe Gelap!

entries.original:
"\.What!?

You’ve surpassed Artie’s record!?
Wow! Amazing!

Take this humble offering, oh
mighty Champion."
entries.translation_source: \.What!? You’ve surpassed Artie’s record!? Wow! Amazing! Take this humble offering, oh mighty Champion.
entries.translated:
\.Apa!? Kamu melampaui rekor Artie!?
Wow! Luar biasa! Terimalah\lpersembahan sederhana ini, oh Juara

yang perkasa.

entries.original:
"All hail [player], the greatest
Champion Borrius has ever seen!"
entries.translation_source: All hail [player], the greatest Champion Borrius has ever seen!
entries.translated:
Semua hormat kepada [player], Juara
terbesar yang pernah dilihat\lBorrius!

entries.original:
"What’s that?

A Youngster just isn’t the kind
of guy who’d challenge the\lPokémon League?

I’ll take that bet!

You’ll be seeing me in the
Champion’s room someday!

I guarantee it!"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? A Youngster just isn’t the kind of guy who’d challenge the Pokémon League? I’ll take that bet! You’ll be seeing me in the Champion’s room someday! I guarantee it!
entries.translated:
Apa itu? Seorang Youngster bukanlah
tipe orang yang akan menantang\lPokémon League? Aku terima taruhan

itu! Suatu hari nanti kamu akan
melihatku di Kamar Juara! Aku\ljamin!

entries.original:
"You came down from the mountain?
You must be exhausted.

Let me take care of your Pokémon
for you."
entries.translation_source: You came down from the mountain? You must be exhausted. Let me take care of your Pokémon for you.
entries.translated:
Kamu turun dari gunung? Kamu pasti
kelelahan. Biarkan aku merawat\lPokémonmu untukmu.

entries.original:
"If you’re in a hurry, the Psychic
over there can teleport you to\lDresco Town - the next town over.

Even if you decide to take him up
on his offer, it’s never a bad idea\lto be fully healed!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re in a hurry, the Psychic over there can teleport you to Dresco Town - the next town over. Even if you decide to take him up on his offer, it’s never a bad idea to be fully healed!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu terburu-buru, Psychic di
sana bisa teleport kamu ke Dresco\lTown - kota berikutnya. Bahkan jika

kamu memutuskan untuk menerima
tawarannya, tidak ada salahnya\luntuk pulih sepenuhnya!

entries.original: "[green]Cleeeeewoo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Cleeeeewoo!
entries.translated: [green]Cleeeeewoo!

entries.original:
"Hey, kid!
Listen up.

The road up ahead is fraught with
Trainers wanting to battle.

Some people have even dubbed it
\qoChallenge Road\qc.

But hey, I understand if you don’t
want to battle them.

So, using my amazing psychic
powers, I can teleport you to the\lother side for free!

What do you say, are you in?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, kid! Listen up. The road up ahead is fraught with Trainers wanting to battle. Some people have even dubbed it \qoChallenge Road\qc. But hey, I understand if you don’t want to battle them. So, using my amazing psychic powers, I can teleport you to the other side for free! What do you say, are you in?
entries.translated:
Hei, nak! Dengar. Jalan di depan
penuh dengan Trainer yang ingin\lbertarung. Beberapa orang bahkan

menyebutnya \qoChallenge Road\qc. Tapi
hei, aku mengerti jika kamu tidak\lingin bertarung dengan mereka.

Jadi, menggunakan kekuatan psikisku
yang luar biasa, aku bisa teleport\lkamu ke sisi lain secara gratis!

Bagaimana, apakah kamu ikut?

entries.original:
"What do you say, should I teleport
you to Dresco Town?"
entries.translation_source: What do you say, should I teleport you to Dresco Town?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana menurutmu, haruskah aku
teleport kamu ke Dresco Town?

entries.original:
"Here we go!

Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!"
entries.translation_source: Here we go! Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita mulai! Abra, Kadabra,
Reuniclus!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind let
me know."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind let me know.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berubah pikiran, beri
tahu aku.

entries.original:
"Listen, pal, you’re on Challenge
Road to train, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: Listen, pal, you’re on Challenge Road to train, yeah?
entries.translated:
Dengar, kawan, kamu di Challenge
Road untuk berlatih, ya?

entries.original: "Oh, my bad, just ignore me then."
entries.translation_source: Oh, my bad, just ignore me then.
entries.translated: Oh, maaf, abaikan aku saja.

entries.original:
"I thought so!

I can tell you’re a Trainer burning
with fiery passion.

Well, I have this Pokémon here.

It’d be perfect for a Trainer
like you.

Why don’t you defeat all of the
Trainers on Challenge Road and\lthen come back here?

I’ll give it to you then, so make
sure you have space in your party!"
entries.translation_source: I thought so! I can tell you’re a Trainer burning with fiery passion. Well, I have this Pokémon here. It’d be perfect for a Trainer like you. Why don’t you defeat all of the Trainers on Challenge Road and then come back here? I’ll give it to you then, so make sure you have space in your party!
entries.translated:
Kupikir begitu! Aku bisa tahu kamu
adalah Pelatih yang terbakar dengan\lsemangat membara. Nah, aku punya

Pokémon ini di sini. Ini akan
sempurna untuk Pelatih sepertimu.\lMengapa kamu tidak mengalahkan

semua Pelatih di Challenge Road dan
kembali ke sini? Aku akan\lmemberikannya padamu saat itu, jadi

pastikan ada ruang di timmu!

entries.original:
"I thought so!

I can tell you’re a Trainer burning
with fiery passion.

Well, since you’ve defeated all of
the Trainers on this road, I’d say\lyou earned this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I thought so! I can tell you’re a Trainer burning with fiery passion. Well, since you’ve defeated all of the Trainers on this road, I’d say you earned this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kupikir begitu! Aku bisa tahu kamu
adalah Pelatih yang terbakar dengan\lsemangat membara. Nah, karena kamu

telah mengalahkan semua Pelatih di
jalan ini, aku rasa kamu pantas\lmendapatkan Pokémon ini.

entries.original:
"But make space in your party for it
first, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: But make space in your party for it first, yeah?
entries.translated:
Tapi buat ruang di timmu dulu
untuknya, ya?

entries.original:
"Take care of that [buffer1],
yeah?

If you treat it well, it’ll keep
that fiery passion of yours alive\lfor sure!"
entries.translation_source: Take care of that [buffer1], yeah? If you treat it well, it’ll keep that fiery passion of yours alive for sure!
entries.translated:
Jaga [buffer1] itu, ya? Jika kamu
merawatnya dengan baik, itu akan\lmenjaga semangat membaramu tetap

hidup pasti!

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s the Trainer burning with
fiery passion!

I bet the [buffer1] I gave you
before is doing great, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s the Trainer burning with fiery passion! I bet the [buffer1] I gave you before is doing great, yeah?
entries.translated:
Oh, Pelatih dengan semangat
membara! Aku yakin [buffer1] yang\lkuberikan sebelumnya baik-baik

saja, ya?

entries.original:
"[black]A mysterious ring is floating in
the air.

Something is visible deep in the
hole\.

Would you like to put your hand
deep in the hole?"
entries.translation_source: [black]A mysterious ring is floating in the air. Something is visible deep in the hole\. Would you like to put your hand deep in the hole?
entries.translated:
[black]Sebuah cincin misterius melayang di
udara. Sesuatu terlihat jauh di\ldalam lubang\. Apakah kamu ingin

memasukkan tanganmu ke dalam
lubang?

entries.original: "[black]The mysterious ring disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [black]The mysterious ring disappeared.
entries.translated: [black]Cincin misterius itu menghilang.

entries.original:
"Challenge Road is a place where
many Trainers come to practice."
entries.translation_source: Challenge Road is a place where many Trainers come to practice.
entries.translated:
Challenge Road adalah tempat di
mana banyak Pelatih datang untuk\lberlatih.

entries.original:
"All Pokémon have weaknesses.
Even the strongest ones.

That’s why it’s best to raise
Pokémon of different types."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon have weaknesses. Even the strongest ones. That’s why it’s best to raise Pokémon of different types.
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon memiliki kelemahan.
Bahkan yang terkuat sekalipun.\lItulah mengapa lebih baik

membesarkan Pokémon dari berbagai
tipe.

entries.original:
"Them [green]Yellow Poké Balls[blue] hold
items called Technical Machines.

These [green]TM[blue]s can be used to teach
your Pokémon moves as many times\las you want!"
entries.translation_source: Them [green]Yellow Poké Balls[blue] hold items called Technical Machines. These [green]TM[blue]s can be used to teach your Pokémon moves as many times as you want!
entries.translated:
[green]Poké Ball Kuning[blue] berisi item yang
disebut Mesin Teknis. [green]TM[blue]s ini dapat\ldigunakan untuk mengajari gerakan

pada Pokémonmu sebanyak yang kamu
mau!

entries.original:
"A Pokémon’s moves can be physical
moves or special moves.

A high Attack stat makes physical
moves deal more damage, and a high\lSp. Atk stat makes special moves\ldeal more damage!"
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon’s moves can be physical moves or special moves. A high Attack stat makes physical moves deal more damage, and a high Sp. Atk stat makes special moves deal more damage!
entries.translated:
Serangan Pokémon dapat berupa
serangan fisik atau serangan\lspesial. Statistik Serangan yang

tinggi membuat serangan fisik
memberikan lebih banyak kerusakan,\ldan statistik Sp. Serangan yang

tinggi membuat serangan spesial
memberikan lebih banyak kerusakan!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon you send out in a
Double Battle will be the Pokémon\lin the top row of your Party List.

If one of those two Pokémon has
fainted, the second Pokémon to\lbe sent out will come from the\lsecond row and so on!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon you send out in a Double Battle will be the Pokémon in the top row of your Party List. If one of those two Pokémon has fainted, the second Pokémon to be sent out will come from the second row and so on!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang kamu kirim dalam
Pertarungan Ganda adalah Pokémon di\lbaris atas Daftar Timmu. Jika salah

satu dari dua Pokémon itu pingsan,
Pokémon kedua yang dikirim akan\lberasal dari baris kedua, dan

seterusnya!

entries.original:
"A Pokémon that’s [green]Paralyzed[red] is
slower and might not be able to\lattack."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon that’s [green]Paralyzed[red] is slower and might not be able to attack.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang [green]Lumpuh[red] menjadi lebih
lambat dan mungkin tidak bisa\lmenyerang.

entries.original:
"Pokémon with the Ability [green]Keen Eye[red]
can’t have their accuracy lowered.

They also ignore all changes to an
opponent’s evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon with the Ability [green]Keen Eye[red] can’t have their accuracy lowered. They also ignore all changes to an opponent’s evasiveness.
entries.translated:
Pokémon dengan Ability [green]Mata Tajam[red]
tidak dapat diturunkan akurasinya.\lMereka juga mengabaikan semua

perubahan pada evasivitas lawan.

entries.original:
"In some other regions, you can
buy a Bicycle that lets you hop up\lledges or move across water.

Unfortunately, the best you can
hope for with Borrius Bikes is to\lspeed your way up slippery slopes."
entries.translation_source: In some other regions, you can buy a Bicycle that lets you hop up ledges or move across water. Unfortunately, the best you can hope for with Borrius Bikes is to speed your way up slippery slopes.
entries.translated:
Di beberapa daerah lain, kamu bisa
membeli Sepeda yang memungkinkanmu\lmelompati tebing atau bergerak di

atas air. Sayangnya, yang terbaik
yang bisa kamu harapkan dari Sepeda\lBorrius adalah mempercepat laju di

lereng licin.

entries.original:
"We are the Crush Kin of Route 2!

We want to fight only the strongest
of Trainers!

If you defeat all of the Trainers
on Route 2 and Route 15, we will\lrecognize your strength, and then\lbattle you!"
entries.translation_source: We are the Crush Kin of Route 2! We want to fight only the strongest of Trainers! If you defeat all of the Trainers on Route 2 and Route 15, we will recognize your strength, and then battle you!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin dari Rute 2!
Kami hanya ingin bertarung dengan\lPelatih terkuat! Jika kamu

mengalahkan semua Pelatih di Rute 2
dan Rute 15, kami akan mengakui\lkekuatanmu, dan kemudian bertarung

denganmu!

entries.original:
"We are the Crush Kin of Route 2!

We want to fight only the strongest
of Trainers!

Show us what you’re made of!"
entries.translation_source: We are the Crush Kin of Route 2! We want to fight only the strongest of Trainers! Show us what you’re made of!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin dari Rute 2!
Kami hanya ingin bertarung dengan\lPelatih terkuat! Tunjukkan

kemampuanmu!

entries.original: "You have proven your strength!"
entries.translation_source: You have proven your strength!
entries.translated: Kamu telah membuktikan kekuatanmu!

entries.original:
"The strongest of Trainers deserve
items like this!"
entries.translation_source: The strongest of Trainers deserve items like this!
entries.translated:
Pelatih terkuat berhak mendapatkan
item seperti ini!

entries.original:
"That Mega Stone is for [green]Lopunny[blue]!

When it Mega Evolves, it embraces
its true nature and becomes part\lFighting-type!"
entries.translation_source: That Mega Stone is for [green]Lopunny[blue]! When it Mega Evolves, it embraces its true nature and becomes part Fighting-type!
entries.translated:
Batu Mega itu untuk [green]Lopunny[blue]! Saat
Mega Berevolusi, ia merangkul sifat\laslinya dan menjadi bagian tipe

Petarung!

entries.original:
"We are the Crush Kin of Route 2!

We want to fight only the strongest
of Trainers!

And the strongest of Trainers have
at least two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We are the Crush Kin of Route 2! We want to fight only the strongest of Trainers! And the strongest of Trainers have at least two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin dari Rute 2!
Kami hanya ingin bertarung melawan\lPelatih terkuat! Dan Pelatih

terkuat memiliki setidaknya dua
Pokémon!

entries.original:
"We’re the Crush Kin that dominates
Route 2!

We only fight the best of Trainers!

If you can beat all of the Trainers
on Route 2 and Route 15, we’ll\lchallenge you!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Crush Kin that dominates Route 2! We only fight the best of Trainers! If you can beat all of the Trainers on Route 2 and Route 15, we’ll challenge you!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin yang
mendominasi Rute 2! Kami hanya\lbertarung melawan Pelatih terbaik!

Jika kamu bisa mengalahkan semua
Pelatih di Rute 2 dan Rute 15, kami\lakan menantangmu!

entries.original:
"We’re the Crush Kin that dominates
Route 2!

We only fight the best of Trainers!

Show us what you’re made of!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Crush Kin that dominates Route 2! We only fight the best of Trainers! Show us what you’re made of!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin yang
mendominasi Rute 2! Kami hanya\lbertarung melawan Pelatih terbaik!

Tunjukkan kemampuanmu!

entries.original: "You’ve shown that you’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve shown that you’re the best!
entries.translated:
Kamu telah menunjukkan bahwa kamu
yang terbaik!

entries.original:
"The best of Trainers deserve
items like this!"
entries.translation_source: The best of Trainers deserve items like this!
entries.translated:
Pelatih terbaik berhak mendapatkan
item seperti ini!

entries.original:
"Give that Mega Stone to [green]Lopunny[red]!

If you Mega Evolve it, it’ll
embrace its true nature and\lFighting-type power!"
entries.translation_source: Give that Mega Stone to [green]Lopunny[red]! If you Mega Evolve it, it’ll embrace its true nature and Fighting-type power!
entries.translated:
Berikan Batu Mega itu kepada
[green]Lopunny[red]! Jika kamu Mega Evolusi, ia\lakan merangkul sifat aslinya dan

kekuatan tipe Petarung!

entries.original:
"We’re the Crush Kin that dominates
Route 2!

We only fight the best of Trainers!

And the best of Trainers have
at least two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Crush Kin that dominates Route 2! We only fight the best of Trainers! And the best of Trainers have at least two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin yang
mendominasi Rute 2! Kami hanya\lbertarung melawan Pelatih terbaik!

Dan Pelatih terbaik memiliki
setidaknya dua Pokémon!

entries.original:
"[black]The sand castle came alive
and attacked!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The sand castle came alive and attacked!
entries.translated:
[black]Kastil pasir itu hidup dan
menyerang!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] receded into
the sand."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] receded into the sand.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] mundur ke dalam pasir.

entries.original:
"Do you prefer to avoid Trainers by
cutting through the tall grass?

The fact that you battled me means
you don’t!"
entries.translation_source: Do you prefer to avoid Trainers by cutting through the tall grass? The fact that you battled me means you don’t!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu lebih suka menghindari
Pelatih dengan memotong rumput\ltinggi? Fakta bahwa kamu bertarung

denganku berarti kamu tidak!

entries.original:
"Please don’t Cut the grass on
this island.

If you do, it won’t be a grassy
island anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Please don’t Cut the grass on this island. If you do, it won’t be a grassy island anymore!
entries.translated:
Tolong jangan memotong rumput di
pulau ini. Jika kamu melakukannya,\lpulau ini tidak akan menjadi pulau

berumput lagi!

entries.original:
"I wish I could live just by
inhaling the fresh air.

It smells good, so it must be
tasty, too, right?"
entries.translation_source: I wish I could live just by inhaling the fresh air. It smells good, so it must be tasty, too, right?
entries.translated:
Aku berharap bisa hidup hanya
dengan menghirup udara segar.\lBaunya enak, jadi pasti enak juga,

kan?

entries.original:
"No matter how many times I lose,
nothing will stop me from running\laround on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how many times I lose, nothing will stop me from running around on the beach!
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli berapa kali aku kalah,
tidak ada yang akan menghentikanku\luntuk berlarian di pantai!

entries.original:
"Fishing by the coast whilst
reminiscing about my past is\lalways pleasurable."
entries.translation_source: Fishing by the coast whilst reminiscing about my past is always pleasurable.
entries.translated:
Memancing di tepi pantai sambil
mengenang masa laluku selalu\lmenyenangkan.

entries.original: "Patience is a virtue not many have."
entries.translation_source: Patience is a virtue not many have.
entries.translated:
Kesabaran adalah kebajikan yang
tidak dimiliki banyak orang.

entries.original:
"If you hook the same Pokémon many
times in a row, odds are you’ll\lencounter one that looks different\lthan other Pokémon of its species."
entries.translation_source: If you hook the same Pokémon many times in a row, odds are you’ll encounter one that looks different than other Pokémon of its species.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu menangkap Pokémon yang
sama berkali-kali berturut-turut,\lkemungkinan besar kamu akan bertemu

dengan satu yang terlihat berbeda
dari Pokémon lain dari spesiesnya.

entries.original:
"If your lead Pokémon has the
ability [green]Suction Cups[blue] or [green]Sticky\lHold[blue], it’ll be much easier for you\lto land a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: If your lead Pokémon has the ability [green]Suction Cups[blue] or [green]Sticky Hold[blue], it’ll be much easier for you to land a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon pemimpinmu memiliki
kemampuan [green]Penghisap[blue] atau [green]Lengket[blue],\lakan lebih mudah bagimu untuk

mendapatkan Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Go away, bozo.
Can’t you see we’re thinkin’ here?"
entries.translation_source: Go away, bozo. Can’t you see we’re thinkin’ here?
entries.translated:
Pergi, bodoh. Apa kau tidak lihat
kami sedang berpikir di sini?

entries.original:
"Go away, bozo.
Can’t you see we’re plottin’ here?"
entries.translation_source: Go away, bozo. Can’t you see we’re plottin’ here?
entries.translated:
Pergi, bodoh. Apa kau tidak lihat
kami sedang merencanakan sesuatu di\lsini?

entries.original: "Here, take some Potions."
entries.translation_source: Here, take some Potions.
entries.translated: Ini, ambil beberapa Ramuan.

entries.original:
"Cinder Volcano is dangerous, and
temperatures are extreme.

If you don’t have your Pokémon to
protect you, you could faint."
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano is dangerous, and temperatures are extreme. If you don’t have your Pokémon to protect you, you could faint.
entries.translated:
Gunung Berapi Cinder berbahaya, dan
suhu di sana ekstrem. Jika kamu\ltidak memiliki Pokémon untuk

melindungimu, kamu bisa pingsan.

entries.original: "Time to heal up!"
entries.translation_source: Time to heal up!
entries.translated: Waktunya pulih!

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated:
Semua siap! Tetap aman di luar
sana!

entries.original:
"That ledge will take you right back
to Dresco Town!

I’d think carefully about using it,
though.

Once you hop it, the only way back
here is through Grim Woods!"
entries.translation_source: That ledge will take you right back to Dresco Town! I’d think carefully about using it, though. Once you hop it, the only way back here is through Grim Woods!
entries.translated:
Tebing itu akan membawamu kembali
ke Kota Dresco! Tapi, pikirkan\lbaik-baik sebelum menggunakannya.

Setelah kamu melompat, satu-satunya
jalan kembali ke sini adalah\lmelalui Hutan Grim!

entries.original:
"\.

Go away."
entries.translation_source: \. Go away.
entries.translated: \. Pergilah.

entries.original: "[black]Ride on Lapras?"
entries.translation_source: [black]Ride on Lapras?
entries.translated: [black]Naik Lapras?

entries.original: "[green]Prassss!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Prassss!
entries.translated: [green]Prassss!

entries.original:
"Mirskle has had a huge impact on
the way I live my life.

Most people say he’s a bad
influence on children, but I\lcouldn’t be happier!"
entries.translation_source: Mirskle has had a huge impact on the way I live my life. Most people say he’s a bad influence on children, but I couldn’t be happier!
entries.translated:
Mirskle memiliki dampak besar pada
cara saya menjalani hidup.\lKebanyakan orang bilang dia

pengaruh buruk untuk anak-anak,
tapi saya tidak bisa lebih bahagia\llagi!

entries.original:
"I’ll catch something good
eventually.

You just go have fun."
entries.translation_source: I’ll catch something good eventually. You just go have fun.
entries.translated:
Saya akan menangkap sesuatu yang
bagus pada akhirnya. Kamu saja\lbersenang-senang.

entries.original:
"To be honest, I’ve been here for
days, too."
entries.translation_source: To be honest, I’ve been here for days, too.
entries.translated:
Sejujurnya, saya sudah di sini
selama berhari-hari juga.

entries.original:
"Whew\. I better take a rest\.

Groan\.

That volcano takes a lot out
of you!

Let me heal your Pokémon so you
don’t get tired like me."
entries.translation_source: Whew\. I better take a rest\. Groan\. That volcano takes a lot out of you! Let me heal your Pokémon so you don’t get tired like me.
entries.translated:
Fiuh\. Sebaiknya saya istirahat\. Erang\.
Gunung berapi itu menguras tenaga!\lBiarkan saya menyembuhkan Pokémonmu

agar kamu tidak lelah seperti saya.

entries.original: "Take care of yourself."
entries.translation_source: Take care of yourself.
entries.translated: Jaga dirimu.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer.

I moved here recently with my three
Pokémon from the Unova region.

I’ve been raising them on my own up
until this point, but lately,\lthey’ve been craving adventure.

I don’t really want to leave my
home, so I’ve been searching for\lsomeone to take them off my hands.

How would you like to take care of
one for me?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer. I moved here recently with my three Pokémon from the Unova region. I’ve been raising them on my own up until this point, but lately, they’ve been craving adventure. I don’t really want to leave my home, so I’ve been searching for someone to take them off my hands. How would you like to take care of one for me?
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, Pelatih Borrius. Saya
baru pindah ke sini dengan tiga\lPokémon saya dari wilayah Unova.

Saya membesarkan mereka sendiri
sampai saat ini, tapi akhir-akhir\lini mereka ingin bertualang. Saya

tidak benar-benar ingin
meninggalkan rumah, jadi saya\lmencari seseorang untuk mengambil

alih mereka. Bagaimana jika kamu
merawat salah satunya untuk saya?

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer.

Which adventurous Pokémon will
you take now?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer. Which adventurous Pokémon will you take now?
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, Pelatih Borrius. Pokémon
petualang mana yang akan kamu ambil\lsekarang?

entries.original: "You’d like [buffer1][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You’d like [buffer1][red]?
entries.translated: Kamu ingin [buffer1][red]?

entries.original: "Which one will you take?"
entries.translation_source: Which one will you take?
entries.translated: Yang mana yang akan kamu ambil?

entries.original:
"Oh, okay then.

I guess I’ll have to keep searching
for a Trainer."
entries.translation_source: Oh, okay then. I guess I’ll have to keep searching for a Trainer.
entries.translated:
Oh, baiklah. Sepertinya saya harus
terus mencari Pelatih.

entries.original:
"I have adventurous Pokémon to give
away, but you can’t do anything\lwith a full party of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I have adventurous Pokémon to give away, but you can’t do anything with a full party of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Saya punya Pokémon petualang untuk
diberikan, tapi kamu tidak bisa\lmelakukan apa pun dengan tim

Pokémon yang penuh.

entries.original:
"When you have at least [green][buffer1] Badges[red],
come back so I can give you more!"
entries.translation_source: When you have at least [green][buffer1] Badges[red], come back so I can give you more!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memiliki setidaknya
[green][buffer1] Lencana[red], kembalilah agar\lsaya bisa memberikan lebih!

entries.original:
"Hello again!

How are my old friends doing?"
entries.translation_source: Hello again! How are my old friends doing?
entries.translated:
Halo lagi! Bagaimana kabar
teman-teman lamaku?

entries.original: "Leg Day"
entries.translation_source: Leg Day
entries.translated: Hari Latihan Kaki

entries.original:
"Today is leg day.

It’s the most important day of
the week.

Some people skip leg day, but those
people are wrong.

Walking is the best way to work
out your legs.

If you walk enough, I will give you
a reward in celebration of leg day."
entries.translation_source: Today is leg day. It’s the most important day of the week. Some people skip leg day, but those people are wrong. Walking is the best way to work out your legs. If you walk enough, I will give you a reward in celebration of leg day.
entries.translated:
Hari ini adalah hari latihan kaki.
Ini adalah hari terpenting dalam\lseminggu. Beberapa orang melewatkan

hari latihan kaki, tetapi
orang-orang itu salah. Berjalan\ladalah cara terbaik untuk melatih

kaki. Jika kamu berjalan cukup, aku
akan memberikanmu hadiah untuk\lmerayakan hari latihan kaki.

entries.original:
"Awesome!

Now walk at least [green][buffer1][blue] steps to
really work those calves."
entries.translation_source: Awesome! Now walk at least [green][buffer1][blue] steps to really work those calves.
entries.translated:
Hebat! Sekarang berjalanlah
setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] langkah untuk\lbenar-benar melatih betismu.

entries.original:
"Okay, then go back to the gym and
lift some dumbbells, flabby calves!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, then go back to the gym and lift some dumbbells, flabby calves!
entries.translated:
Oke, kalau begitu kembali ke gym
dan angkat beberapa dumbbell, betis\llembek!

entries.original:
"You still have [green][buffer3][blue] step\\08 to go
before reaching [green][buffer1][blue].

Come on now, feel the burn!"
entries.translation_source: You still have [green][buffer3][blue] step\\08 to go before reaching [green][buffer1][blue]. Come on now, feel the burn!
entries.translated:
Kamu masih memiliki [green][buffer3][blue]
langkah\\08 sebelum mencapai [green][buffer1][blue].\lAyolah, rasakan panasnya!

entries.original:
"Whoa, I’m sure your legs are tired
after that workout.

Here, take this small snack to heal
your muscles."
entries.translation_source: Whoa, I’m sure your legs are tired after that workout. Here, take this small snack to heal your muscles.
entries.translated:
Wow, aku yakin kakimu lelah setelah
latihan itu. Ini, ambil camilan\lkecil ini untuk menyembuhkan

ototmu.

entries.original:
"Leg day should really be a
national holiday."
entries.translation_source: Leg day should really be a national holiday.
entries.translated:
Hari latihan kaki seharusnya
menjadi hari libur nasional.

entries.original:
"There are too many trees for this
to be a route.

We must be in a forest!

It’s times like these I wish I had
a Town Map\."
entries.translation_source: There are too many trees for this to be a route. We must be in a forest! It’s times like these I wish I had a Town Map\.
entries.translated:
Ada terlalu banyak pohon untuk ini
menjadi rute. Kita pasti di hutan!\lSaat-saat seperti ini aku berharap

aku punya Town Map\.

entries.original:
"Why does that guy keep looking
at me like that?"
entries.translation_source: Why does that guy keep looking at me like that?
entries.translated:
Kenapa orang itu terus menatapku
seperti itu?

entries.original:
"Pokémon left in the Day Care get
stronger as you travel."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon left in the Day Care get stronger as you travel.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang ditinggalkan di Day
Care akan semakin kuat saat kamu\lbepergian.

entries.original:
"Keep an eye out for dark patches
between trees.

Those indicate that there is a
hidden pathway there."
entries.translation_source: Keep an eye out for dark patches between trees. Those indicate that there is a hidden pathway there.
entries.translated:
Perhatikan bercak gelap di antara
pohon-pohon. Itu menandakan ada\ljalan tersembunyi di sana.

entries.original:
"Do you know about [green]Terrains[blue]?

For the most part, they’re special
battlefield effects that boost the\lpower of certain moves used by\lPokémon on the ground."
entries.translation_source: Do you know about [green]Terrains[blue]? For the most part, they’re special battlefield effects that boost the power of certain moves used by Pokémon on the ground.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tahu tentang [green]Terrains[blue]?
Pada dasarnya, itu adalah efek\lmedan pertempuran khusus yang

meningkatkan kekuatan gerakan
tertentu yang digunakan oleh\lPokémon yang berada di tanah.

entries.original:
"Whenever I hear a Trainer run by,
I immediately look and catch them!

It’s those silent Trainers who walk
by that give me difficulty\."
entries.translation_source: Whenever I hear a Trainer run by, I immediately look and catch them! It’s those silent Trainers who walk by that give me difficulty\.
entries.translated:
Setiap kali aku mendengar seorang
Pelatih berlari, aku segera melihat\ldan menangkap mereka! Pelatih yang

berjalan dengan diam itulah yang
menyulitkanku\.

entries.original:
"When a Pokémon with [green]Synchronize[red]
leads the party, all Pokémon you\lfind will have the same [green]nature[red] as it!"
entries.translation_source: When a Pokémon with [green]Synchronize[red] leads the party, all Pokémon you find will have the same [green]nature[red] as it!
entries.translated:
Ketika Pokémon dengan [green]Synchronize[red]
memimpin party, semua Pokémon yang\lkamu temukan akan memiliki [green]nature[red]

yang sama dengannya!

entries.original:
"There is no room in my heart for
anything but my bugs.

Say, do you also notice a bug
hiding in that girl’s hair?"
entries.translation_source: There is no room in my heart for anything but my bugs. Say, do you also notice a bug hiding in that girl’s hair?
entries.translated:
Tidak ada ruang di hatiku untuk apa
pun selain serangga-seranggaku.\lHei, apa kamu juga melihat serangga

bersembunyi di rambut gadis itu?

entries.original:
"The fact that you battled me means
you’re going the right way."
entries.translation_source: The fact that you battled me means you’re going the right way.
entries.translated:
Fakta bahwa kamu bertarung denganku
berarti kamu berada di jalan yang\lbenar.

entries.original:
"Unless you can Surf, going this
way just leads to a dead end."
entries.translation_source: Unless you can Surf, going this way just leads to a dead end.
entries.translated:
Kecuali kamu bisa Surf, lewat sini
hanya akan menemui jalan buntu.

entries.original:
"Kricketot must stay awake longer
than other nocturnal Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Kricketot must stay awake longer than other nocturnal Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kricketot harus tetap terjaga lebih
lama daripada Pokémon nokturnal\llainnya.

entries.original:
"Like bird Pokémon, bug Pokémon
generally change when the sun sets."
entries.translation_source: Like bird Pokémon, bug Pokémon generally change when the sun sets.
entries.translated:
Seperti Pokémon burung, Pokémon
serangga umumnya berubah saat\lmatahari terbenam.

entries.original:
"My Smeargle learned its moves from
the Pokémon atop Frost Mountain.

Except for Spore.

That it learned from a Shroomish
on Route 9."
entries.translation_source: My Smeargle learned its moves from the Pokémon atop Frost Mountain. Except for Spore. That it learned from a Shroomish on Route 9.
entries.translated:
Smeargle milikku mempelajari
jurus-jurusnya dari Pokémon di\lpuncak Frost Mountain. Kecuali

Spore. Jurus itu ia pelajari dari
Shroomish di Route 9.

entries.original:
"Before letting your Pokémon hold a
[green]Figy Berry[blue], make sure it doesn’t\lhave a conflicting [green]Nature[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Before letting your Pokémon hold a [green]Figy Berry[blue], make sure it doesn’t have a conflicting [green]Nature[blue].
entries.translated:
Sebelum membiarkan Pokémonmu
memegang [green]Figy Berry[blue], pastikan\lPokémon itu tidak memiliki [green]Nature[blue]

yang bertentangan.

entries.original:
"I’m the newest member of the
Sun Trio.

That’s why they have me stand
at the back."
entries.translation_source: I’m the newest member of the Sun Trio. That’s why they have me stand at the back.
entries.translated:
Aku anggota terbaru dari Sun Trio.
Itu sebabnya mereka menyuruhku\lberdiri di belakang.

entries.original:
"If the sun ever were to stop
shining, we’d all freeze solid!

But if it were to ever get any
hotter, we’d roast!

It’s amazing that the ball of fire
in the sky keeping us alive could\lalso end all life in an instant."
entries.translation_source: If the sun ever were to stop shining, we’d all freeze solid! But if it were to ever get any hotter, we’d roast! It’s amazing that the ball of fire in the sky keeping us alive could also end all life in an instant.
entries.translated:
Jika matahari suatu saat berhenti
bersinar, kita semua akan membeku!\lTapi jika suhunya semakin panas,

kita akan hangus! Sungguh
menakjubkan bahwa bola api di\llangit yang membuat kita tetap

hidup juga dapat mengakhiri semua
kehidupan dalam sekejap.

entries.original: "And for your prize, it’s a\."
entries.translation_source: And for your prize, it’s a\.
entries.translated: Dan untuk hadiahmu, itu adalah\.

entries.original:
"We love the sun!

Day or night, our source of light
is always because of the sun!"
entries.translation_source: We love the sun! Day or night, our source of light is always because of the sun!
entries.translated:
Kami cinta matahari! Siang atau
malam, sumber cahaya kami selalu\lkarena matahari!

entries.original:
"Arright, boys!

I know times have been tough ever
since those Ferrothorns kicked us\lout of Antisis.

But soon we’re gonna head on over
to Route 10 and start fresh!

We’re gonna make it our new base,
and any Trainers wantin’ to pass\lthrough are gonna have to pay a\lpretty toll!

Hahaha!"
entries.translation_source: Arright, boys! I know times have been tough ever since those Ferrothorns kicked us out of Antisis. But soon we’re gonna head on over to Route 10 and start fresh! We’re gonna make it our new base, and any Trainers wantin’ to pass through are gonna have to pay a pretty toll! Hahaha!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, teman-teman! Aku tahu
waktu-waktu sulit sejak Ferrothorn\litu mengusir kita dari Antisis.

Tapi sebentar lagi kita akan pergi
ke Route 10 dan memulai awal baru!\lKita akan menjadikannya basis baru

kita, dan Pelatih mana pun yang
ingin lewat harus membayar tol yang\lmahal! Hahaha!

entries.original: "Yeah, yeah!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, yeah!
entries.translated: Ya, ya!

entries.original:
"We’re gonna rough ’em up and steal
their cash!"
entries.translation_source: We’re gonna rough ’em up and steal their cash!
entries.translated:
Kita akan menghajar mereka dan
mencuri uang mereka!

entries.original:
"They’re all gonna cry for
their mommies!"
entries.translation_source: They’re all gonna cry for their mommies!
entries.translated:
Mereka semua akan menangis
memanggil ibu mereka!

entries.original:
"Whad’ya want, bozo?

Can’t you see we’re discussin’
important things here?

Scram!"
entries.translation_source: Whad’ya want, bozo? Can’t you see we’re discussin’ important things here? Scram!
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau mau, bodoh? Tidak
bisakah kau lihat kami sedang\lmembahas hal penting di sini?

Pergi!

entries.original:
"Heading south takes you towards
the Auburn Waterway, a route that\lconnects Route 6 to Route 10.

You’ll need [green]Surf[red] if you want to
get there, though."
entries.translation_source: Heading south takes you towards the Auburn Waterway, a route that connects Route 6 to Route 10. You’ll need [green]Surf[red] if you want to get there, though.
entries.translated:
Menuju ke selatan membawamu ke
Auburn Waterway, sebuah rute yang\lmenghubungkan Route 6 ke Route 10.

Tapi kau akan membutuhkan [green]Surf[red]
untuk sampai ke sana.

entries.original:
"The strange Rattata only come out
at night, so I don’t blame you if\lyou haven’t noticed them."
entries.translation_source: The strange Rattata only come out at night, so I don’t blame you if you haven’t noticed them.
entries.translated:
Rattata aneh hanya muncul di malam
hari, jadi aku tidak menyalahkanmu\ljika kau tidak memperhatikannya.

entries.original:
"When you cross the bridges, keep
an eye out on your right.

There’s a split path there that’ll
either take you back to Route 6 or\lto a house where a nice couple\lwill heal your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: When you cross the bridges, keep an eye out on your right. There’s a split path there that’ll either take you back to Route 6 or to a house where a nice couple will heal your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Saat menyeberangi jembatan,
perhatikan ke kanan. Ada jalur\lbercabang di sana yang bisa

membawamu kembali ke Route 6 atau
ke sebuah rumah di mana pasangan\lbaik hati akan menyembuhkan

Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"When a Pokémon’s move can hit
more than one target in a Double\lBattle, it does less damage.

That’s something to keep in mind
when you’re fighting two on two!"
entries.translation_source: When a Pokémon’s move can hit more than one target in a Double Battle, it does less damage. That’s something to keep in mind when you’re fighting two on two!
entries.translated:
Saat jurus Pokémon bisa mengenai
lebih dari satu target dalam\lPertarungan Ganda, kerusakannya

berkurang. Itu hal yang perlu
diingat saat bertarung dua lawan\ldua!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon has the ability [green]Static[red].

Pokémon that hit it with direct
contact might get Paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon has the ability [green]Static[red]. Pokémon that hit it with direct contact might get Paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Pokémonku memiliki Ability [green]Static[red].
Pokémon yang mengenainya dengan\lkontak langsung mungkin akan

Lumpuh.

entries.original:
"[red]I often imagine there is a Trainer
somewhere who could imitate anyone\lwell enough to best them, even with\ltheir own Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: [red]I often imagine there is a Trainer somewhere who could imitate anyone well enough to best them, even with their own Pokémon!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku sering membayangkan ada Pelatih
di suatu tempat yang bisa meniru\lsiapa pun dengan cukup baik untuk

mengalahkan mereka, bahkan dengan
Pokémon mereka sendiri!

entries.original:
"Hoo hoo\. sure is humid\. like
a sauna\."
entries.translation_source: Hoo hoo\. sure is humid\. like a sauna\.
entries.translated: Hoo hoo\. pasti lembab\. seperti sauna\.

entries.original:
"My Pokémon likes to hypnotize
children and eat their dreams.

I hide behind this tree because
kids are easier to catch off guard\lwhen they’re startled.

And once off guard, it’s easier to
lull them into a deep sleep\."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon likes to hypnotize children and eat their dreams. I hide behind this tree because kids are easier to catch off guard when they’re startled. And once off guard, it’s easier to lull them into a deep sleep\.
entries.translated:
Pokémonku suka menghipnotis
anak-anak dan memakan mimpi mereka.\lAku bersembunyi di balik pohon ini

karena anak-anak lebih mudah
terkejut saat mereka terkejut. Dan\lbegitu lengah, lebih mudah membuat

mereka tertidur lelap\.

entries.original:
"If I had a Pokémon with [green]Flame Body[blue]
or [green]Magma Armor[blue] in my party, my\lEggs would hatch much faster!"
entries.translation_source: If I had a Pokémon with [green]Flame Body[blue] or [green]Magma Armor[blue] in my party, my Eggs would hatch much faster!
entries.translated:
Jika aku memiliki Pokémon dengan
[green]Flame Body[blue] atau [green]Magma Armor[blue] di\ltimku, Telur-telurku akan menetas

lebih cepat!

entries.original:
"Doduo and Dodrio are supposed to be
flightless birds.

Yet those flightless birds can
still learn Fly!

How in the world is that even
possible?"
entries.translation_source: Doduo and Dodrio are supposed to be flightless birds. Yet those flightless birds can still learn Fly! How in the world is that even possible?
entries.translated:
Doduo dan Dodrio seharusnya adalah
burung yang tidak bisa terbang.\lNamun burung yang tidak bisa

terbang itu masih bisa mempelajari
Fly! Bagaimana hal itu mungkin\lterjadi?

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Dude!

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Dude! I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Aku adalah Fishing Dude! Aku sangat
suka memancing! Aku tidak tahan\ltanpanya. Katakan, apakah kamu suka

memancing?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Aku suka gayamu. Kupikir
kita bisa berteman. Ambil ini dan\lpancinglah, teman muda!

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

From the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, my friend.
entries.translated:
Memancing adalah gaya hidup! Ini
seperti puisi terbaik. Dari laut\lhingga sungai, pergilah dan tangkap

yang besar, temanku.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. That’s so disappointing\.
entries.translated: Oh\. Itu sangat mengecewakan\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!

How are the fish biting?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player]! How are the fish biting?
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]! Bagaimana gigitan
ikannya?

entries.original:
"Hi there, young traveller.
Your Pokémon look tired.

Let me heal them for you."
entries.translation_source: Hi there, young traveller. Your Pokémon look tired. Let me heal them for you.
entries.translated:
Halo, pengelana muda. Pokémon-mu
terlihat lelah. Biarkan aku\lmenyembuhkan mereka untukmu.

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated:
Semua siap! Tetap aman di luar
sana!

entries.original:
"This area is sealed off to anyone
who isn’t a member of the Shadows.

Since you’re not one of us,
scram, kid!"
entries.translation_source: This area is sealed off to anyone who isn’t a member of the Shadows. Since you’re not one of us, scram, kid!
entries.translated:
Area ini dilarang masuk untuk siapa
pun yang bukan anggota Shadows.\lKarena kamu bukan salah satu dari

kami, pergi, nak!

entries.original:
"What the\.

How’d you get onto Route 9?

However it was, you’re still not
getting through here."
entries.translation_source: What the\. How’d you get onto Route 9? However it was, you’re still not getting through here.
entries.translated:
Apa apaan\. Bagaimana kamu bisa
sampai ke Route 9? Bagaimanapun\lcaranya, kamu tetap tidak bisa

lewat sini.

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe in the blizzard!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe in the blizzard!
entries.translated:
Semua siap! Tetap aman di dalam
badai salju!

entries.original: "No Fall Damage"
entries.translation_source: No Fall Damage
entries.translated: Tidak Ada Kerusakan Jatuh

entries.original:
"Ah, Trainer, did you know that
there is a secret martial art to\lavoid fall damage from moderate\lheights?

You just go to the edge of a ledge
or rock, jump, and land peacefully.

But this technique requires much
practice.

Are you ready to practice with
[green][buffer1][blue] jumps?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, Trainer, did you know that there is a secret martial art to avoid fall damage from moderate heights? You just go to the edge of a ledge or rock, jump, and land peacefully. But this technique requires much practice. Are you ready to practice with [green][buffer1][blue] jumps?
entries.translated:
Ah, Pelatih, tahukah kamu bahwa ada
seni bela diri rahasia untuk\lmenghindari kerusakan jatuh dari

ketinggian sedang? Kamu cukup pergi
ke tepi tebing atau batu, lompat,\ldan mendarat dengan damai. Tapi

teknik ini membutuhkan banyak
latihan. Apakah kamu siap untuk\lberlatih dengan [green][buffer1][blue] lompatan?

entries.original:
"Before you start, you should do
some stretches.

And don’t be disappointed if you
take some fall damage on your\lfirst few tries.

It happens to the best jumpers."
entries.translation_source: Before you start, you should do some stretches. And don’t be disappointed if you take some fall damage on your first few tries. It happens to the best jumpers.
entries.translated:
Sebelum kamu mulai, kamu harus
melakukan peregangan. Dan jangan\lkecewa jika kamu mendapatkan

kerusakan jatuh pada beberapa
percobaan pertamamu. Itu terjadi\lpada pelompat terbaik sekalipun.

entries.original:
"I hope one day you will want to
master this super secret skill."
entries.translation_source: I hope one day you will want to master this super secret skill.
entries.translated:
Aku harap suatu hari nanti kamu
ingin menguasai keterampilan super\lrahasia ini.

entries.original:
"You have only done [green][buffer2][blue] jump\\07 with
no fall damage.

You still need at least [green][buffer3][blue] more
to become a master."
entries.translation_source: You have only done [green][buffer2][blue] jump\\07 with no fall damage. You still need at least [green][buffer3][blue] more to become a master.
entries.translated:
Kamu baru saja melakukan [green][buffer2][blue]
lompatan\\07 tanpa kerusakan jatuh.\lKamu masih membutuhkan setidaknya

[green][buffer3][blue] lagi untuk menjadi master.

entries.original:
"Wow, you are now a master of
jumping off moderate heights\lwithout fall damage!

You’d be surprised how many
Trainers get slightly injured on\lthose things.

Anyway, here is some Protein for a
post-workout snack."
entries.translation_source: Wow, you are now a master of jumping off moderate heights without fall damage! You’d be surprised how many Trainers get slightly injured on those things. Anyway, here is some Protein for a post-workout snack.
entries.translated:
Wow, kamu sekarang adalah master
lompat dari ketinggian sedang tanpa\lkerusakan jatuh! Kamu akan terkejut

berapa banyak Pelatih yang terluka
sedikit karena hal-hal itu.\lPokoknya, ini ada beberapa Protein

untuk camilan setelah latihan.

entries.original:
"Jumping from moderate heights is
a skill.

Don’t let anyone tell you
otherwise."
entries.translation_source: Jumping from moderate heights is a skill. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.
entries.translated:
Melompat dari ketinggian sedang
adalah sebuah keterampilan. Jangan\lbiarkan siapa pun mengatakan

sebaliknya.

entries.original:
"If you’re going to get stronger,
I’ll get stronger too."
entries.translation_source: If you’re going to get stronger, I’ll get stronger too.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu akan menjadi lebih kuat,
aku juga akan menjadi lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"No matter what, my Pokémon will
stick with me until the end!"
entries.translation_source: No matter what, my Pokémon will stick with me until the end!
entries.translated:
Apa pun yang terjadi, Pokémon-ku
akan tetap bersamaku sampai akhir!

entries.original:
"Even when I lose, I still get some
enjoyment out of it."
entries.translation_source: Even when I lose, I still get some enjoyment out of it.
entries.translated:
Bahkan saat aku kalah, aku tetap
mendapatkan kesenangan darinya.

entries.original:
"If I had a Bike, it would be much
easier to climb.

But where can you even get a Bike
around here?"
entries.translation_source: If I had a Bike, it would be much easier to climb. But where can you even get a Bike around here?
entries.translated:
Jika aku punya Sepeda, akan lebih
mudah untuk mendaki. Tapi di mana\lkamu bisa mendapatkan Sepeda di

sekitar sini?

entries.original:
"If you run and run, you’ll become
one with the wind."
entries.translation_source: If you run and run, you’ll become one with the wind.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berlari dan berlari, kamu
akan menyatu dengan angin.

entries.original:
"[red]I’ll forget about losing and just
enjoy this snowy hike."
entries.translation_source: [red]I’ll forget about losing and just enjoy this snowy hike.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku akan melupakan kekalahan dan
menikmati pendakian bersalju ini.

entries.original:
"No one knows the mountains better
than me, I tells ya."
entries.translation_source: No one knows the mountains better than me, I tells ya.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang tahu gunung lebih
baik dariku, begitulah.

entries.original:
"You have set me free\.

I am truly grateful from the bottom
of my heart\."
entries.translation_source: You have set me free\. I am truly grateful from the bottom of my heart\.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah membebaskanku\. Aku
benar-benar bersyukur dari lubuk\lhatiku yang paling dalam\.

entries.original:
"I love my daughter very much.

I can’t stand not seeing her for
even a single day.

I would even commit terrible crimes
for my daughter’s sake!

That’s how much I love her."
entries.translation_source: I love my daughter very much. I can’t stand not seeing her for even a single day. I would even commit terrible crimes for my daughter’s sake! That’s how much I love her.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat mencintai putriku. Aku
tidak tahan tidak melihatnya\lmeskipun hanya sehari. Aku bahkan

akan melakukan kejahatan mengerikan
demi putriku! Begitulah betapa aku\lmencintainya.

entries.original:
"Borrius is doomed\.

But now that nothing is anchoring
us down, we’re catching the next\lboat to Hoenn!"
entries.translation_source: Borrius is doomed\. But now that nothing is anchoring us down, we’re catching the next boat to Hoenn!
entries.translated:
Borrius telah hancur\. Tapi sekarang
tidak ada yang menahan kita, kita\lakan naik kapal berikutnya ke

Hoenn!

entries.original:
"You know, it might have been
just me\.

But I could swear Jax seemed a
little put-off by something.

And I don’t think it was just because
those thugs got away with the\lPrison Stone, either\."
entries.translation_source: You know, it might have been just me\. But I could swear Jax seemed a little put-off by something. And I don’t think it was just because those thugs got away with the Prison Stone, either\.
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, mungkin hanya aku\. Tapi
aku bersumpah Jax tampak sedikit\ltersinggung oleh sesuatu. Dan

menurutku itu bukan hanya karena
para preman itu kabur membawa\lPrison Stone\.

entries.original:
"[red]Those thugs just waltzed on in
here and ransacked our home!

They pinned us to the wall, and
we were forced to watch helplessly\lwhile they scoured our home for\lthe Prison Stone."
entries.translation_source: [red]Those thugs just waltzed on in here and ransacked our home! They pinned us to the wall, and we were forced to watch helplessly while they scoured our home for the Prison Stone.
entries.translated:
[red]Para preman itu masuk begitu saja
dan menjarah rumah kami! Mereka\lmenjepit kami ke dinding, dan kami

dipaksa menonton tanpa daya saat
mereka menggeledah rumah kami untuk\lPrison Stone.

entries.original:
"Mystical chants, kwaah!

You want Pokémon learn [green]Hex[red], skree?
[green]1 Blue Shard[red] and [green]1 Red Shard[red] it be."
entries.translation_source: Mystical chants, kwaah! You want Pokémon learn [green]Hex[red], skree? [green]1 Blue Shard[red] and [green]1 Red Shard[red] it be.
entries.translated:
Nyanyian mistis, kwaah! Kamu ingin
Pokémon belajar [green]Hex[red], skree? [green]1\lPecahan Biru[red] dan [green]1 Pecahan Merah[red]

begitu.

entries.original: "Which Pokémon it be?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon it be?
entries.translated: Pokémon mana itu?

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over 1 Blue Shard
and 1 Red Shard."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over 1 Blue Shard and 1 Red Shard.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan 1 Pecahan Biru
dan 1 Pecahan Merah.

entries.original: "Hwa!"
entries.translation_source: Hwa!
entries.translated: Hwa!

entries.original:
"Huhu\. Graa\.
Not enough [buffer1]s\."
entries.translation_source: Huhu\. Graa\. Not enough [buffer1]s\.
entries.translated: Huhu\. Graa\. Tidak cukup [buffer1]s\.

entries.original:
"Did you know humans have internal
clocks that tell them how many\ltimes they’ve been rained on?

Here, yours says\.

[buffer1]!

You’ve been rained on
[buffer1] times!

I personally have been rained on
16777215 times!

No one’ll ever be rained on more
than me!

NO ONE!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know humans have internal clocks that tell them how many times they’ve been rained on? Here, yours says\. [buffer1]! You’ve been rained on [buffer1] times! I personally have been rained on 16777215 times! No one’ll ever be rained on more than me! NO ONE!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa manusia memiliki
jam internal yang memberi tahu\lmereka berapa kali mereka terkena

hujan? Ini, milikmu berkata\.
[buffer1]! Kamu terkena hujan\l[buffer1] kali! Aku pribadi terkena

hujan 16777215 kali! Tidak akan ada
yang terkena hujan lebih dari aku!\lTIDAK ADA!

entries.original:
"Me?
No, I’m not a Trainer.

I just find fishing in the rain
a relaxing sport.

Say\.

Now that I’ve been staring at it
for a while, how do you suppose\lI could get to that island in the\lmiddle of the lake?

What, you don’t see it?

It’s right there, just look out
onto the lake!

You still don’t see it?

Sorry, I’m a Fisherman, not an
eye doctor.

You’re on your own here, pal."
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not a Trainer. I just find fishing in the rain a relaxing sport. Say\. Now that I’ve been staring at it for a while, how do you suppose I could get to that island in the middle of the lake? What, you don’t see it? It’s right there, just look out onto the lake! You still don’t see it? Sorry, I’m a Fisherman, not an eye doctor. You’re on your own here, pal.
entries.translated:
Aku? Tidak, aku bukan seorang
Pelatih. Aku hanya menganggap\lmemancing di tengah hujan sebagai

olahraga yang santai. Say\. Sekarang
setelah aku menatapnya sebentar,\lbagaimana menurutmu aku bisa

mencapai pulau di tengah danau itu?
Apa, kamu tidak melihatnya? Itu ada\ldi sana, lihat saja ke danau! Kamu

masih tidak melihatnya? Maaf, aku
seorang Nelayan, bukan dokter mata.\lKamu sendiri di sini, kawan.

entries.original:
"Me?

No, I’m not a Trainer.

I just find fishing in the rain
a relaxing sport.

Say\.

Now that I’ve been staring at it
for a while, how do you suppose\lI could get to that island in the\lmiddle of the lake?

What do you mean you don’t
see it?

I saw you pick up the yellow Poké
Ball that was resting on it!

Are you trying to tell me you won’t
share your secret with me?

In that case, leave me to fish!"
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not a Trainer. I just find fishing in the rain a relaxing sport. Say\. Now that I’ve been staring at it for a while, how do you suppose I could get to that island in the middle of the lake? What do you mean you don’t see it? I saw you pick up the yellow Poké Ball that was resting on it! Are you trying to tell me you won’t share your secret with me? In that case, leave me to fish!
entries.translated:
Aku? Tidak, aku bukan seorang
Pelatih. Aku hanya menganggap\lmemancing di tengah hujan sebagai

olahraga yang santai. Say\. Sekarang
setelah aku menatapnya sebentar,\lbagaimana menurutmu aku bisa

mencapai pulau di tengah danau itu?
Apa maksudmu kamu tidak melihatnya?\lAku melihatmu mengambil Poké Ball

kuning yang ada di atasnya! Apakah
kamu mencoba mengatakan bahwa kamu\ltidak akan berbagi rahasiamu

denganku? Kalau begitu, biarkan aku
memancing!

entries.original:
"Ahh\.
Camping out in the leaves is great!"
entries.translation_source: Ahh\. Camping out in the leaves is great!
entries.translated:
Ahh\. Berkemah di dedaunan itu
menyenangkan!

entries.original:
"Who needs seasons when you have
areas like Route 9 that are\lperpetually stuck in one!"
entries.translation_source: Who needs seasons when you have areas like Route 9 that are perpetually stuck in one!
entries.translated:
Siapa yang butuh musim ketika kamu
memiliki area seperti Route 9 yang\lterus-menerus terjebak dalam satu!

entries.original:
"It’s so freeing being able to run
again!  "
entries.translation_source: It’s so freeing being able to run again!
entries.translated:
Rasanya sangat membebaskan bisa
berlari lagi!

entries.original:
"My grandparents used to live in
Antisis City, so I know a thing\lor two about thugs.

But the thugs that were on this
route\.

Not even my grandparents had ever
seen anyone like them before!

I wonder who they were?"
entries.translation_source: My grandparents used to live in Antisis City, so I know a thing or two about thugs. But the thugs that were on this route\. Not even my grandparents had ever seen anyone like them before! I wonder who they were?
entries.translated:
Kakek-nenekku dulu tinggal di
Antisis City, jadi aku tahu sedikit\ltentang preman. Tapi para preman

yang ada di rute ini\. Bahkan
kakek-nenekku pun belum pernah\lmelihat orang seperti mereka

sebelumnya! Aku penasaran siapa
mereka?

entries.original:
"Life’s not all about waiting for
the storm to pass.

It’s about learning to dance in
the rain."
entries.translation_source: Life’s not all about waiting for the storm to pass. It’s about learning to dance in the rain.
entries.translated:
Hidup bukan hanya tentang menunggu
badai berlalu. Ini tentang belajar\lmenari di tengah hujan.

entries.original:
"In other regions, [green]Karrablast[blue] and
[green]Shelmet[blue] evolve when they’re traded\lwith each other.

But in Borrius, you just have to
use a [green]Link Stone[blue] on them!

The other one doesn’t even need
to be in the party!"
entries.translation_source: In other regions, [green]Karrablast[blue] and [green]Shelmet[blue] evolve when they’re traded with each other. But in Borrius, you just have to use a [green]Link Stone[blue] on them! The other one doesn’t even need to be in the party!
entries.translated:
Di daerah lain, [green]Karrablast[blue] dan
[green]Shelmet[blue] berevolusi saat\ldiperdagangkan satu sama lain. Tapi

di Borrius, kamu hanya perlu
menggunakan [green]Batu Koneksi[blue] pada\lmereka! Yang lainnya bahkan tidak

perlu berada di dalam party!

entries.original:
"I only train my birds when
it rains.

And if they get zapped by lightning
while they’re flying\. that only\lmakes them stronger!"
entries.translation_source: I only train my birds when it rains. And if they get zapped by lightning while they’re flying\. that only makes them stronger!
entries.translated:
Aku hanya melatih burung-burungku
saat hujan. Dan jika mereka\ltersambar petir saat terbang\. itu

hanya membuat mereka semakin kuat!

entries.original:
"No\. it couldn’t be\.
But it’s the only explanation!

Did you suddenly gain the ability to
walk through walls?"
entries.translation_source: No\. it couldn’t be\. But it’s the only explanation! Did you suddenly gain the ability to walk through walls?
entries.translated:
Tidak\. tidak mungkin\. Tapi itu
satu-satunya penjelasan! Apakah\lkamu tiba-tiba mendapatkan

kemampuan untuk menembus dinding?

entries.original:
"Well, sure, it’s a bit of a grind
dealing with those monsters all the\ltime, but hey, at least it’s better\lthan retail."
entries.translation_source: Well, sure, it’s a bit of a grind dealing with those monsters all the time, but hey, at least it’s better than retail.
entries.translated:
Yah, tentu, agak melelahkan
berurusan dengan monster-monster\litu sepanjang waktu, tapi hei,

setidaknya itu lebih baik daripada
pekerjaan ritel.

entries.original:
"Geez\.

Brats like you make me wonder why
anyone would even have ’em, least\lof all Zeph\."
entries.translation_source: Geez\. Brats like you make me wonder why anyone would even have ’em, least of all Zeph\.
entries.translated:
Ya ampun\. Anak nakal seperti kamu
membuatku bertanya-tanya kenapa ada\lorang yang mau punya mereka,

apalagi Zeph\.

entries.original:
"Hey, I just follow orders.
They don’t tell me anything."
entries.translation_source: Hey, I just follow orders. They don’t tell me anything.
entries.translated:
Hei, aku hanya mengikuti perintah.
Mereka tidak memberitahuku apa pun.

entries.original:
"Gah\. That was painful\.

But I guess I’ll think of it as giving
Lady Ivory a chance to beat you\ldown herself!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Gah\. That was painful\. But I guess I’ll think of it as giving Lady Ivory a chance to beat you down herself! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Gah\. Itu menyakitkan\. Tapi kurasa aku
akan menganggapnya sebagai memberi\lLady Ivory kesempatan untuk

mengalahkanmu sendiri! Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"I mean, it’s called \qothe dark
force\qc, so\.

Not exactly gonna use it for anything
other than to ruin someone’s day,\ldon’t you think?"
entries.translation_source: I mean, it’s called \qothe dark force\qc, so\. Not exactly gonna use it for anything other than to ruin someone’s day, don’t you think?
entries.translated:
Maksudku, ini disebut \qokekuatan
gelap\qc, jadi\. Tidak benar-benar akan\lmenggunakannya untuk hal lain

selain merusak hari seseorang,
bukankah begitu?

entries.original:
"Ha! Not like you’ll ever beat all of
us, anyway!

We’ve got all the pull we need to
get back up, again and again!"
entries.translation_source: Ha! Not like you’ll ever beat all of us, anyway! We’ve got all the pull we need to get back up, again and again!
entries.translated:
Ha! Bukan berarti kamu akan pernah
mengalahkan kami semua! Kami punya\lsemua pengaruh yang kami butuhkan

untuk bangkit kembali, lagi dan
lagi!

entries.original:
"Whatever. Don’t mind me.

I’ll just watch for anyone else out
here, in this miserable damp\lplace\. not that you’d care what\lsomeone from the Shadows thinks\."
entries.translation_source: Whatever. Don’t mind me. I’ll just watch for anyone else out here, in this miserable damp place\. not that you’d care what someone from the Shadows thinks\.
entries.translated:
Terserah. Jangan pedulikan aku. Aku
akan mengawasi siapa pun di sini,\ldi tempat lembab yang menyedihkan\.

bukan berarti kamu peduli apa yang
dipikirkan seseorang dari Shadows\.

entries.original:
"You’re in for a real shocker, kid.

I’ve just called back all grunts
standing guard at the barrier, so\lnow we’re all over this route!"
entries.translation_source: You’re in for a real shocker, kid. I’ve just called back all grunts standing guard at the barrier, so now we’re all over this route!
entries.translated:
Kamu akan kaget sekali, nak. Aku
baru saja memanggil kembali semua\lgrunts yang berjaga di penghalang,

jadi sekarang kita ada di mana-mana
di rute ini!

entries.original:
"Well, even if you find your way
somehow, you’ll have to deal with\lLady Ivory.

So I’d do the smart thing, and turn
around and go home."
entries.translation_source: Well, even if you find your way somehow, you’ll have to deal with Lady Ivory. So I’d do the smart thing, and turn around and go home.
entries.translated:
Yah, meskipun kamu berhasil
menemukan jalan, kamu harus\lberurusan dengan Lady Ivory. Jadi

aku akan melakukan hal yang cerdas,
dan berbalik dan pulang.

entries.original:
"Erk\. This is getting way too close!

Fine! I guess I’ll just let Ivory
deal with you kids herself!\lY-yeah, that’s it!"
entries.translation_source: Erk\. This is getting way too close! Fine! I guess I’ll just let Ivory deal with you kids herself! Y-yeah, that’s it!
entries.translated:
Erk\. Ini semakin terlalu dekat!
Baiklah! Kurasa aku akan membiarkan\lIvory berurusan dengan kalian

anak-anak sendiri! Y-yah, itu dia!

entries.original: "Need healing, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: Need healing, [player]?
entries.translated: Butuh penyembuhan, [player]?

entries.original:
"Okay, you’re all set, [player].

I’ll be here if you need to heal
your Pokémon again."
entries.translation_source: Okay, you’re all set, [player]. I’ll be here if you need to heal your Pokémon again.
entries.translated:
Oke, kamu sudah siap, [player]. Aku
akan di sini jika kamu perlu\lmenyembuhkan Pokémon-mu lagi.

entries.original:
"[player]!

I’m trying to battle these grunts,
but I can heal you quickly!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! I’m trying to battle these grunts, but I can heal you quickly!
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku mencoba bertarung
dengan grunts ini, tapi aku bisa\lmenyembuhkanmu dengan cepat!

entries.original: "Ughhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: Ughhhhh\.
entries.translated: Ughhhhh\.

entries.original:
"Once we take care of you, we’re
going to finish [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Once we take care of you, we’re going to finish [player]!
entries.translated:
Setelah kami mengurusimu, kami akan
menghabisi [player]!

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient switch.
Flip it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient switch. Flip it?
entries.translated: Ini saklar kuno. Aktifkan?

entries.original:
"This ancient switch has already
been flipped."
entries.translation_source: This ancient switch has already been flipped.
entries.translated: Saklar kuno ini sudah diaktifkan.

entries.original: "[black]Return to [green]Dehara City[black]?"
entries.translation_source: [black]Return to [green]Dehara City[black]?
entries.translated: [black]Kembali ke [green]Dehara City[black]?

entries.original: "[green]Clopppps!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Clopppps!
entries.translated: [green]Clopppps!

entries.original: "[green]Zong\. zong\. zong\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Zong\. zong\. zong\.
entries.translated: [green]Zong\. zong\. zong\.

entries.original:
"SWITCH BELOW
THEN AVOIDING
THE DUSCLOPS
IS THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: SWITCH BELOW THEN AVOIDING THE DUSCLOPS IS THE KEY.
entries.translated:
SAKLAR DI BAWAH LALU MENGHINDARI
DUSCLOPS ADALAH KUNCINYA.

entries.original: "It’s a sliding tile puzzle!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a sliding tile puzzle!
entries.translated: Ini teka-teki ubin geser!

entries.original: "It’s a tile puzzle!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a tile puzzle!
entries.translated: Ini teka-teki ubin!

entries.original: "You have already solved the puzzle."
entries.translation_source: You have already solved the puzzle.
entries.translated:
Kamu sudah memecahkan teka-teki
ini.

entries.original: "[green]Dollllll!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Dollllll!
entries.translated: [green]Dollllll!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] came through the portal!"
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] came through the portal!
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] datang melalui portal!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] ran off\."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] ran off\.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] lari\.

entries.original: "[green]Susuiiiii!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Susuiiiii!
entries.translated: [green]Susuiiiii!

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Safari Zone!

For just $500, you can play the
Safari Game.

Would you like to play?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just $500, you can play the Safari Game. Would you like to play?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Zona Safari!
Hanya dengan $500, kamu bisa\lbermain Permainan Safari. Apakah

kamu ingin bermain?

entries.original:
"Okay.
Please come again!"
entries.translation_source: Okay. Please come again!
entries.translated: Oke. Silakan datang lagi!

entries.original: "That’ll be $500, please!"
entries.translation_source: That’ll be $500, please!
entries.translated: Itu $500, ya!

entries.original:
"We only use a special kind of 
Poké Ball here."
entries.translation_source: We only use a special kind of Poké Ball here.
entries.translated:
Kami hanya menggunakan jenis Poké
Ball khusus di sini.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received [buffer1] Safari Balls
from the attendant."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received [buffer1] Safari Balls from the attendant.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima [buffer1] Bola
Safari dari petugas.

entries.original:
"There are different difficulty
modes available in the Safari Zone.

Which would you like to play?"
entries.translation_source: There are different difficulty modes available in the Safari Zone. Which would you like to play?
entries.translated:
Ada berbagai mode kesulitan yang
tersedia di Zona Safari. Mode mana\lyang ingin kamu mainkan?

entries.original:
"We’ll call you on the PA when you
run out of Safari Balls.

You can also leave whenever you’d
like by pressing \btn01.

If at any point you’d like to run
only from the current Pokémon,\lit’ll cost you some Safari Balls.

Well, I’ll wish you the best
of luck!"
entries.translation_source: We’ll call you on the PA when you run out of Safari Balls. You can also leave whenever you’d like by pressing \btn01. If at any point you’d like to run only from the current Pokémon, it’ll cost you some Safari Balls. Well, I’ll wish you the best of luck!
entries.translated:
Kami akan memanggil Anda melalui PA
saat Anda kehabisan Safari Ball.\lAnda juga bisa pergi kapan pun Anda

mau dengan menekan \btn01. Jika suatu
saat Anda ingin lari hanya dari\lPokémon saat ini, itu akan

menghabiskan beberapa Safari Ball.
Baiklah, semoga berhasil!

entries.original:
"Did you catch your fair share?
Come again!"
entries.translation_source: Did you catch your fair share? Come again!
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda mendapatkan tangkapan
yang cukup? Datang lagi!

entries.original:
"Excuse me!
Your PC Boxes are full."
entries.translation_source: Excuse me! Your PC Boxes are full.
entries.translated: Permisi! Kotak PC Anda penuh.

entries.original:
"Sorry!
You don’t have enough money."
entries.translation_source: Sorry! You don’t have enough money.
entries.translated: Maaf! Uang Anda tidak cukup.

entries.original:
"Your current high score for the
Safari Game is [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon caught."
entries.translation_source: Your current high score for the Safari Game is [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon caught.
entries.translated:
Skor tertinggi Anda saat ini untuk
Safari Game adalah [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon\lyang tertangkap.
