entries.original:
"You currently have no high score
for the Safari Game."
entries.translation_source: You currently have no high score for the Safari Game.
entries.translated:
Anda saat ini tidak memiliki skor
tertinggi untuk Safari Game.

entries.original: "Enter"
entries.translation_source: Enter
entries.translated: Masuk

entries.original: "Medium"
entries.translation_source: Medium
entries.translated: Sedang

entries.original: "High Score"
entries.translation_source: High Score
entries.translated: Skor Tertinggi

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Safari Zone!

For just [green][buffer1][blue] BP, you can play
the Safari Game.

Would you like to play?
You currently have [green][buffer2][blue] BP."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just [green][buffer1][blue] BP, you can play the Safari Game. Would you like to play? You currently have [green][buffer2][blue] BP.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Safari Zone!
Hanya dengan [green][buffer1][blue] BP, Anda bisa\lbermain Safari Game. Apakah Anda

ingin bermain? Anda saat ini
memiliki [green][buffer2][blue] BP.

entries.original: "That’ll be [buffer1] BP, please!"
entries.translation_source: That’ll be [buffer1] BP, please!
entries.translated:
Itu akan menjadi [buffer1] BP,
silakan!

entries.original:
"Please be aware that future visits
to the Safari Zone today will cost\l[green][buffer2][blue] BP, as opposed to [green][buffer1][blue] BP."
entries.translation_source: Please be aware that future visits to the Safari Zone today will cost [green][buffer2][blue] BP, as opposed to [green][buffer1][blue] BP.
entries.translated:
Harap diketahui bahwa kunjungan
berikutnya ke Safari Zone hari ini\lakan dikenakan biaya [green][buffer2][blue] BP,

berbeda dengan [green][buffer1][blue] BP.

entries.original:
"We only use a special kind of 
Poké Ball here."
entries.translation_source: We only use a special kind of Poké Ball here.
entries.translated:
Kami hanya menggunakan jenis Poké
Ball khusus di sini.

entries.original:
"Sorry!
You don’t have enough BP."
entries.translation_source: Sorry! You don’t have enough BP.
entries.translated: Maaf! BP Anda tidak cukup.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry!

You didn’t save before you quit
your challenge last time.

Because of that, if you want to
play the Safari Game today, it\lwill cost you the same price as\lif you had already played.

Please come again!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! You didn’t save before you quit your challenge last time. Because of that, if you want to play the Safari Game today, it will cost you the same price as if you had already played. Please come again!
entries.translated:
Maaf! Anda tidak menyimpan sebelum
menghentikan tantangan Anda\lterakhir kali. Karena itu, jika

Anda ingin bermain Safari Game hari
ini, biayanya akan sama seperti\ljika Anda sudah bermain. Silakan

datang lagi!

entries.original: "What would you like to know about?"
entries.translation_source: What would you like to know about?
entries.translated: Apa yang ingin Anda ketahui?

entries.original:
"The Safari Game is an opportunity
for you to capture as many Pokémon\las you can.

To start off, you’re given special
Safari Balls.

While playing, the Pokémon you are
attempting to capture will appear\lin front of you.

Try your best to aim and hit it
with a Safari Ball.

If you manage to land a hit, and
the Pokémon stays in the Safari\lBall, it’s yours to keep!

Once you run out of Safari Balls or
choose to quit, the game is over."
entries.translation_source: The Safari Game is an opportunity for you to capture as many Pokémon as you can. To start off, you’re given special Safari Balls. While playing, the Pokémon you are attempting to capture will appear in front of you. Try your best to aim and hit it with a Safari Ball. If you manage to land a hit, and the Pokémon stays in the Safari Ball, it’s yours to keep! Once you run out of Safari Balls or choose to quit, the game is over.
entries.translated:
Safari Game adalah kesempatan bagi
Anda untuk menangkap sebanyak\lmungkin Pokémon. Untuk memulai,

Anda diberikan Safari Ball khusus.
Saat bermain, Pokémon yang Anda\lcoba tangkap akan muncul di depan

Anda. Cobalah yang terbaik untuk
membidik dan mengenainya dengan\lSafari Ball. Jika Anda berhasil

mengenai, dan Pokémon itu tetap di
dalam Safari Ball, itu menjadi\lmilik Anda! Setelah Anda kehabisan

Safari Ball atau memilih untuk
berhenti, permainan berakhir.

entries.original:
"There are different difficulty modes
for the Safari Game.

The higher the difficulty mode, the
faster the Pokémon you are trying\lto capture will move around.

The higher difficulty modes are
still beneficial, however.

They offer the chance for you to
encounter much rarer Pokémon than\lthose that can be found in the\llower difficulty modes."
entries.translation_source: There are different difficulty modes for the Safari Game. The higher the difficulty mode, the faster the Pokémon you are trying to capture will move around. The higher difficulty modes are still beneficial, however. They offer the chance for you to encounter much rarer Pokémon than those that can be found in the lower difficulty modes.
entries.translated:
Ada berbagai mode kesulitan untuk
Safari Game. Semakin tinggi mode\lkesulitan, semakin cepat Pokémon

yang Anda coba tangkap akan
bergerak. Namun, mode kesulitan\lyang lebih tinggi tetap

menguntungkan. Mereka menawarkan
kesempatan bagi Anda untuk\lmenemukan Pokémon yang jauh lebih

langka daripada yang dapat
ditemukan di mode kesulitan yang\llebih rendah.

entries.original:
"In the Safari Game, Berries can be
used to aid you in your capture.

Different Berries have different
effects, and at most three Berries\lcan be fed to a Pokémon a time.

If a Pokémon has already eaten
three Berries, any new Berries will\lreplace the effects of the oldest\lused Berry.

Which Berry would you like to know
about?"
entries.translation_source: In the Safari Game, Berries can be used to aid you in your capture. Different Berries have different effects, and at most three Berries can be fed to a Pokémon a time. If a Pokémon has already eaten three Berries, any new Berries will replace the effects of the oldest used Berry. Which Berry would you like to know about?
entries.translated:
Di Safari Game, Beri dapat
digunakan untuk membantu Anda dalam\lmenangkap. Beri yang berbeda

memiliki efek yang berbeda, dan
maksimal tiga Beri dapat diberikan\lkepada seekor Pokémon dalam satu

waktu. Jika seekor Pokémon sudah
memakan tiga Beri, Beri baru akan\lmenggantikan efek Beri tertua yang

digunakan. Beri mana yang ingin
Anda ketahui?

entries.original:
"Which Berry would you like to know
about?"
entries.translation_source: Which Berry would you like to know about?
entries.translated: Beri mana yang ingin Anda ketahui?

entries.original: "Berries"
entries.translation_source: Berries
entries.translated: Beri

entries.original: "Difficulty Modes"
entries.translation_source: Difficulty Modes
entries.translated: Mode Kesulitan

entries.original: "Razz Berry"
entries.translation_source: Razz Berry
entries.translated: Beri Razz

entries.original: "Nanab Berry"
entries.translation_source: Nanab Berry
entries.translated: Beri Nanab

entries.original: "Bluk Berry"
entries.translation_source: Bluk Berry
entries.translated: Beri Bluk

entries.original: "Wepear Berry"
entries.translation_source: Wepear Berry
entries.translated: Beri Wepear

entries.original: "Pinap Berry"
entries.translation_source: Pinap Berry
entries.translated: Beri Pinap

entries.original:
"The higher your catching streak is
in the Safari Game, the higher the\lchance you’ll catch something with\lgood stats!

I even heard a Shiny Pokémon will
appear every [green]30th[red] encounter\."
entries.translation_source: The higher your catching streak is in the Safari Game, the higher the chance you’ll catch something with good stats! I even heard a Shiny Pokémon will appear every [green]30th[red] encounter\.
entries.translated:
Semakin tinggi rekor tangkapanmu di
Safari Game, semakin besar\lkemungkinan kamu menangkap Pokémon

dengan stat bagus! Aku bahkan
dengar seekor Pokémon Shiny akan\lmuncul setiap [green]ke-30[red] pertemuan\.

entries.original: "Seaport City"
entries.translation_source: Seaport City
entries.translated: Seaport City

entries.original:
"I remember many years ago when
Seaport City was just beginning\lto blossom!

It was back then when the legend,
Aros, arrived and helped construct\lthe Battle Frontier."
entries.translation_source: I remember many years ago when Seaport City was just beginning to blossom! It was back then when the legend, Aros, arrived and helped construct the Battle Frontier.
entries.translated:
Aku ingat bertahun-tahun lalu saat
Seaport City baru mulai berkembang!\lSaat itulah sang legenda, Aros,

tiba dan membantu membangun Battle
Frontier.

entries.original:
"Some of my former colleagues can
occasionally be found performing\lunethical experiments in the\lwarehouses around here.

Where did I used to work?

Cube Corp., of course."
entries.translation_source: Some of my former colleagues can occasionally be found performing unethical experiments in the warehouses around here. Where did I used to work? Cube Corp., of course.
entries.translated:
Beberapa mantan rekanku kadang bisa
ditemukan melakukan eksperimen\ltidak etis di gudang-gudang sekitar

sini. Di mana dulu aku bekerja?
Cube Corp., tentu saja.

entries.original:
"I thought I noticed one of my
former colleagues heading towards\lthe warehouse on the docks.

I can only imagine what sort of
unethical experiments she’s\lconducting there\.

I only hope that someone with some
authority finds which crate the\lpasscode is hidden under\."
entries.translation_source: I thought I noticed one of my former colleagues heading towards the warehouse on the docks. I can only imagine what sort of unethical experiments she’s conducting there\. I only hope that someone with some authority finds which crate the passcode is hidden under\.
entries.translated:
Kukira aku melihat salah satu
mantan rekanku menuju ke gudang di\ldermaga. Aku hanya bisa

membayangkan eksperimen tidak etis
apa yang dia lakukan di sana\. Aku\lhanya berharap seseorang yang

berwenang menemukan peti mana yang
menyembunyikan kode akses di\lbawahnya\.

entries.original:
"How’s it goin’, fella?

I came all the way here from
[green]Magnolia Town[red] in East Borrius to\lcheck out this here [green]Battle\lFrontier[red]!

I heard you can spend hours just
battlin’ nonstop!"
entries.translation_source: How’s it goin’, fella? I came all the way here from [green]Magnolia Town[red] in East Borrius to check out this here [green]Battle Frontier[red]! I heard you can spend hours just battlin’ nonstop!
entries.translated:
Apa kabar, kawan? Aku datang
jauh-jauh ke sini dari [green]Magnolia\lTown[red] di East Borrius untuk melihat

[green]Battle Frontier[red] ini! Aku dengar
kamu bisa menghabiskan berjam-jam\lbertarung tanpa henti!

entries.original:
"Seaport City is home to the one and
only [green]Breeder’s School[red].

If you like breeding Pokémon, you
should head there and study up!"
entries.translation_source: Seaport City is home to the one and only [green]Breeder’s School[red]. If you like breeding Pokémon, you should head there and study up!
entries.translated:
Seaport City adalah rumah bagi
satu-satunya [green]Breeder{B4}s School[red]. Jika\lkamu suka mengembangbiakkan

Pokémon, kamu harus pergi ke sana
dan belajar!

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, but only members are
allowed into the Battleground."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, but only members are allowed into the Battleground.
entries.translated:
Maaf, tapi hanya anggota yang
diizinkan masuk ke Battleground.

entries.original:
"Am I from Antisis City?
No way, José!

Don’t clump me in with those chumps
from down there.

I used ta work at the port there,
but times were tough so I came\lhere for a better life.

And whaddya know, the air’s cleaner
up here, and everyone’s friendly!

But I still see my fair share of
shady stuff going down here\.

Better watch your back if you know
what’s good for you\."
entries.translation_source: Am I from Antisis City? No way, José! Don’t clump me in with those chumps from down there. I used ta work at the port there, but times were tough so I came here for a better life. And whaddya know, the air’s cleaner up here, and everyone’s friendly! But I still see my fair share of shady stuff going down here\. Better watch your back if you know what’s good for you\.
entries.translated:
Apa aku dari Antisis City? Tidak
mungkin, José! Jangan samakan aku\ldengan orang-orang bodoh dari sana.

Dulu aku bekerja di pelabuhan sana,
tapi keadaan sulit jadi aku datang\lke sini untuk kehidupan yang lebih

baik. Dan coba tebak, udaranya
lebih bersih di sini, dan semuanya\lramah! Tapi aku masih melihat

banyak hal mencurigakan terjadi di
sini\. Lebih baik waspada jika kamu\ltahu yang terbaik untukmu\.

entries.original:
"We make all kinds of ships here at
Captain Davy’s Shipyard.

Need a high speed boat?
Come to us.

Need an advanced underground
digging mechanism? Come to us, too.

We make it all.

Heck, I even hear the captain has
started working on a top secret\lspace ship\."
entries.translation_source: We make all kinds of ships here at Captain Davy’s Shipyard. Need a high speed boat? Come to us. Need an advanced underground digging mechanism? Come to us, too. We make it all. Heck, I even hear the captain has started working on a top secret space ship\.
entries.translated:
Kami membuat berbagai jenis kapal
di sini di Captain Davy{B4}s Shipyard.\lButuh perahu kecepatan tinggi?

Datang ke kami. Butuh mekanisme
penggalian bawah tanah yang\lcanggih? Datang ke kami juga. Kami

membuat semuanya. Hei, aku bahkan
dengar kapten sudah mulai\lmengerjakan pesawat luar angkasa

super rahasia\.

entries.original:
"Ever since Antisis City closed its
port to passengers, this port has\lbeen booming!

Not only do we sail passengers to
various locations in East Borrius,\lbut we also transport cargo to\ldifferent places around Borrius.

It’s a great gig!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since Antisis City closed its port to passengers, this port has been booming! Not only do we sail passengers to various locations in East Borrius, but we also transport cargo to different places around Borrius. It’s a great gig!
entries.translated:
Sejak Antisis City menutup
pelabuhannya untuk penumpang,\lpelabuhan ini berkembang pesat!

Kami tidak hanya mengangkut
penumpang ke berbagai lokasi di\lEast Borrius, tetapi juga

mengangkut kargo ke berbagai tempat
di sekitar Borrius. Ini pekerjaan\lyang bagus!

entries.original:
"Someone should really put up an
official sign for the KBT\lExpressway here.

The only thing written about it is
scrawled on those steel beams."
entries.translation_source: Someone should really put up an official sign for the KBT Expressway here. The only thing written about it is scrawled on those steel beams.
entries.translated:
Seseorang seharusnya benar-benar
memasang papan resmi untuk KBT\lExpressway di sini. Satu-satunya

yang tertulis tentangnya adalah
coretan di balok-balok baja itu.

entries.original:
"Hi, dear.
Would you like some exotic berries?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, dear. Would you like some exotic berries?
entries.translated:
Halo, sayang. Apakah kamu ingin
beberapa beri eksotis?

entries.original:
"I’m sorry!

I won’t bring my Shedinja again!

I promise!

Just please, let me back in!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! I won’t bring my Shedinja again! I promise! Just please, let me back in!
entries.translated:
Maaf! Aku tidak akan membawa
Shedinja-ku lagi! Aku janji!\lTolong, biarkan aku masuk kembali!

entries.original:
"What are exotic berries useful
for?

Only one thing comes to mind:
[green]Natural Gift[red]!

Take it, and you’ll see!"
entries.translation_source: What are exotic berries useful for? Only one thing comes to mind: [green]Natural Gift[red]! Take it, and you’ll see!
entries.translated:
Untuk apa buah berry eksotis
berguna? Hanya satu hal yang\lterlintas: [green]Natural Gift[red]! Ambil, dan

kau akan lihat!

entries.original:
"Do you have any Berries you’d like
to know the [green]Natural Gift[red] of?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have any Berries you’d like to know the [green]Natural Gift[red] of?
entries.translated:
Apakah kau memiliki Berry yang
ingin kau ketahui [green]Natural Gift[red]\l-nya?

entries.original:
"Which Berry should I tell you
about?"
entries.translation_source: Which Berry should I tell you about?
entries.translated:
Berry mana yang harus aku
ceritakan?

entries.original:
"That’s not a Berry!

Natural Gift can only be used with
Berries!"
entries.translation_source: That’s not a Berry! Natural Gift can only be used with Berries!
entries.translated:
Itu bukan Berry! Natural Gift hanya
bisa digunakan dengan Berry!

entries.original:
"If [green]Natural Gift[red] were to consume the
[green][buffer1][red], the move’s type\lwould be [green][buffer2][red], and it would have\la base power of [green][buffer3][red]!"
entries.translation_source: If [green]Natural Gift[red] were to consume the [green][buffer1][red], the move’s type would be [green][buffer2][red], and it would have a base power of [green][buffer3][red]!
entries.translated:
Jika [green]Natural Gift[red] memakan [green][buffer1][red],
tipe jurusnya akan menjadi\l[green][buffer2][red], dan kekuatan dasarnya

menjadi [green][buffer3][red]!

entries.original:
"Exotic berries like the [green]Durin
Berry[red] turn [green]Natural Gift[red] into a\lsomewhat powerful one-use attack!"
entries.translation_source: Exotic berries like the [green]Durin Berry[red] turn [green]Natural Gift[red] into a somewhat powerful one-use attack!
entries.translated:
Berry eksotis seperti [green]Durin Berry[red]
mengubah [green]Natural Gift[red] menjadi\lserangan sekali pakai yang cukup

kuat!

entries.original:
"After many, many, many years of
fishing, my time has come to\lretire from being the greatest\lFishing Guru in existence.

But I cannot leave without passing
on my legacy.

Will you inherit this [green]Super Rod[blue]
from me?

It is my last wish\."
entries.translation_source: After many, many, many years of fishing, my time has come to retire from being the greatest Fishing Guru in existence. But I cannot leave without passing on my legacy. Will you inherit this [green]Super Rod[blue] from me? It is my last wish\.
entries.translated:
Setelah bertahun-tahun,
bertahun-tahun, bertahun-tahun\lmemancing, waktuku telah tiba untuk

pensiun sebagai Guru Memancing
terhebat yang pernah ada. Tapi aku\ltidak bisa pergi tanpa mewariskan

warisanku. Maukah kau mewarisi
[green]Super Rod[blue] ini dariku? Itu adalah\lpermintaan terakhirku\.

entries.original: "Take it, then."
entries.translation_source: Take it, then.
entries.translated: Ambil saja.

entries.original:
"Thank you\. truly\.

My legacy will live on within you."
entries.translation_source: Thank you\. truly\. My legacy will live on within you.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih\. sungguh\. Warisanku akan
hidup di dalam dirimu.

entries.original:
"You are not the one I was waiting
for, then\."
entries.translation_source: You are not the one I was waiting for, then\.
entries.translated:
Kau bukan orang yang kutunggu,
ternyata\.

entries.original:
"Ahoy, there!

If you want to set sail to [green]Polder
Town[blue], you’ll need an [green]S.S. Ticket[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Ahoy, there! If you want to set sail to [green]Polder Town[blue], you’ll need an [green]S.S. Ticket[blue].
entries.translated:
Ahoy! Jika kau ingin berlayar ke
[green]Polder Town[blue], kau memerlukan [green]S.S.\lTicket[blue].

entries.original:
"Ahoy, there!

If you want to set sail, both you
and the person with you will need\lan [green]S.S. Ticket[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Ahoy, there! If you want to set sail, both you and the person with you will need an [green]S.S. Ticket[blue].
entries.translated:
Ahoy! Jika kau ingin berlayar, baik
kau maupun orang yang bersamamu\lakan memerlukan [green]S.S. Ticket[blue].

entries.original:
"Ahoy, there!
Where do you want to sail?"
entries.translation_source: Ahoy, there! Where do you want to sail?
entries.translated: Ahoy! Ke mana kau ingin berlayar?

entries.original:
"All right!
All aboard Seagallop Hi-Speed [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: All right! All aboard Seagallop Hi-Speed [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
Baiklah! Semua naik ke Seagallop
Hi-Speed [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Ahoy, there!
You must be [player].

Your friends have already boarded
the boat to Polder Town.

You’re the last passenger, so we’ll
set sail right way."
entries.translation_source: Ahoy, there! You must be [player]. Your friends have already boarded the boat to Polder Town. You’re the last passenger, so we’ll set sail right way.
entries.translated:
Ahoy! Kau pasti [player].
Teman-temanmu sudah naik ke kapal\lmenuju Polder Town. Kau penumpang

terakhir, jadi kita akan berlayar
sekarang.

entries.original: "Shark Bait"
entries.translation_source: Shark Bait
entries.translated: Umpan Hiu

entries.original:
"Champion, it’s good to see you
again!

Do you not remember me?

You helped me out with the Terror
Granbull way back on Route 10!

If only our meeting now could be
under better circumstances.

You see, the local police force
is in desperate need of your\lassistance once again.

Something has caused the Sharpedo
living on the ocean floor of [green]Route\l17[blue] to become highly agitated.

I was informed you recently bought
a diving machine, so, if you would\llend it, we would like your help\lwith calming down the [green]Sharpedo[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Champion, it’s good to see you again! Do you not remember me? You helped me out with the Terror Granbull way back on Route 10! If only our meeting now could be under better circumstances. You see, the local police force is in desperate need of your assistance once again. Something has caused the Sharpedo living on the ocean floor of [green]Route 17[blue] to become highly agitated. I was informed you recently bought a diving machine, so, if you would lend it, we would like your help with calming down the [green]Sharpedo[blue].
entries.translated:
Juara, senang bertemu lagi! Apa kau
tidak ingat aku? Kau membantuku\ldengan Terror Granbull di Route 10

dulu! Andai saja pertemuan kita
sekarang bisa dalam keadaan yang\llebih baik. Beginilah, kepolisian

setempat sangat membutuhkan
bantuanmu lagi. Sesuatu telah\lmenyebabkan Sharpedo yang hidup di

dasar laut [green]Route 17[blue] menjadi sangat
gelisah. Aku diberi tahu bahwa kau\lbaru saja membeli mesin menyelam,

jadi, jika kau mau meminjamkannya,
kami ingin bantuanmu untuk\lmenenangkan [green]Sharpedo[blue].

entries.original:
"Our forces cannot do this without
you, Champion.

If you decide later on to lend a
hand, it will be much appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Our forces cannot do this without you, Champion. If you decide later on to lend a hand, it will be much appreciated.
entries.translated:
Pasukan kami tidak bisa melakukan
ini tanpamu, Juara. Jika nanti kau\lmemutuskan untuk membantu, itu akan

sangat dihargai.

entries.original:
"I knew we could count on you once
again, Champion!"
entries.translation_source: I knew we could count on you once again, Champion!
entries.translated:
Aku tahu kami bisa mengandalkanmu
lagi, Juara!

entries.original:
"The [green]Sharpedo[blue] are swimming around
[green]underwater[blue] on [green]Route 17[blue].

The boys back at HQ have informed
me there are about [green][buffer1][blue] of them that\lhave been agitated.

Oh, and I should warn you, any
Sharpedo calmed down will likely\lbecome agitated once more if you\lresurface.

Make sure you do not emerge from
the water until you have taken\lcare of them all.

If you’re smart, which I know you
are, you’ll stock up on healing\litems before heading down there."
entries.translation_source: The [green]Sharpedo[blue] are swimming around [green]underwater[blue] on [green]Route 17[blue]. The boys back at HQ have informed me there are about [green][buffer1][blue] of them that have been agitated. Oh, and I should warn you, any Sharpedo calmed down will likely become agitated once more if you resurface. Make sure you do not emerge from the water until you have taken care of them all. If you’re smart, which I know you are, you’ll stock up on healing items before heading down there.
entries.translated:
Sharpedo[green]Sharpedo[blue] berenang di [green]bawah
air[blue] di [green]Rute 17[blue]. Orang-orang di HQ\lmemberi tahu saya bahwa ada sekitar

[green][buffer1][blue] dari mereka yang telah
gelisah. Oh, dan saya harus\lmemperingatkan Anda, Sharpedo yang

sudah ditenangkan kemungkinan akan
menjadi gelisah lagi jika Anda\lmuncul ke permukaan. Pastikan Anda

tidak keluar dari air sampai Anda
menangani semuanya. Jika Anda\lpintar, yang saya tahu Anda pintar,

Anda akan menyetok item penyembuhan
sebelum pergi ke sana.

entries.original:
"There’s no doubt in my mind
that you’re the Champion!

Please, accept this payment for
your services to the police force."
entries.translation_source: There’s no doubt in my mind that you’re the Champion! Please, accept this payment for your services to the police force.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada keraguan dalam pikiran
saya bahwa Anda adalah Sang Juara!\lSilakan, terima pembayaran ini

untuk layanan Anda kepada
kepolisian.

entries.original:
"\qoAsk not what your region can do
for you, but what you can do for\lyour region.\qc

I have never met anyone who
embodied those words more,\lChampion.

Until we meet again, farewell."
entries.translation_source: \qoAsk not what your region can do for you, but what you can do for your region.\qc I have never met anyone who embodied those words more, Champion. Until we meet again, farewell.
entries.translated:
\qoJangan tanya apa yang bisa
daerahmu lakukan untukmu, tapi apa\lyang bisa kamu lakukan untuk

daerahmu.\qc Saya belum pernah
bertemu orang yang lebih mewujudkan\lkata-kata itu, Sang Juara. Sampai

kita bertemu lagi, selamat tinggal.

entries.original:
"Hey there, Pokémon Trainer!

I’m a member of the Hip Waders!

Just as the name suggests, we’re a
fishing club!

Why don’t you join up and enjoy
some fishing?"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, Pokémon Trainer! I’m a member of the Hip Waders! Just as the name suggests, we’re a fishing club! Why don’t you join up and enjoy some fishing?
entries.translated:
Halo, Pelatih Pokémon! Saya adalah
anggota dari Hip Waders! Seperti\lnamanya, kami adalah klub

memancing! Kenapa kamu tidak
bergabung dan menikmati memancing?

entries.original:
"That’s the way the tide turns, huh?

But, I won’t give up. If you change
your mind, come see me again!"
entries.translation_source: That’s the way the tide turns, huh? But, I won’t give up. If you change your mind, come see me again!
entries.translated:
Begitulah putaran pasang surut, ya?
Tapi, saya tidak akan menyerah.\lJika kamu berubah pikiran,

datanglah menemuiku lagi!

entries.original:
"Awesome! Now you are the third
member of the Hip Waders!

Here we go!

I’ll announce the Official Hip
Waders Catch of the Day!

The Pokémon we’re fishing for
today is [green][buffer1][blue]!

If you catch one, please show it
to me!"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! Now you are the third member of the Hip Waders! Here we go! I’ll announce the Official Hip Waders Catch of the Day! The Pokémon we’re fishing for today is [green][buffer1][blue]! If you catch one, please show it to me!
entries.translated:
Keren! Sekarang kamu adalah anggota
ketiga dari Hip Waders! Ayo! Saya\lakan mengumumkan Tangkapan Resmi

Hip Waders Hari Ini! Pokémon yang
kita pancing hari ini adalah\l[green][buffer1][blue]! Jika kamu menangkap satu,

tolong tunjukkan padaku!

entries.original:
"The Official Hip Waders Catch of
the Day is [green][buffer1][blue]!

Have you caught one already?"
entries.translation_source: The Official Hip Waders Catch of the Day is [green][buffer1][blue]! Have you caught one already?
entries.translated:
Tangkapan Resmi Hip Waders Hari Ini
adalah [green][buffer1][blue]! Apakah kamu sudah\lmenangkap satu?

entries.original:
"The Official Hip Waders Catch of
the Day is [green][buffer1][blue]!

I’m counting on you, Member No. 3!"
entries.translation_source: The Official Hip Waders Catch of the Day is [green][buffer1][blue]! I’m counting on you, Member No. 3!
entries.translated:
Tangkapan Resmi Hip Waders Hari Ini
adalah [green][buffer1][blue]! Saya\lmengandalkanmu, Anggota No. 3!

entries.original:
"Oh! This is an Egg!

I can’t tell if it’s the Offical
Hip Waders Catch of the Day! Sorry!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! This is an Egg! I can’t tell if it’s the Offical Hip Waders Catch of the Day! Sorry!
entries.translated:
Oh! Ini adalah Telur! Saya tidak
bisa mengatakan apakah itu\lTangkapan Resmi Hip Waders Hari

Ini! Maaf!

entries.original:
"Oh! This is a great [buffer1]!

But it’s not the Official Hip
Waders Catch of the Day. Sorry!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! This is a great [buffer1]! But it’s not the Official Hip Waders Catch of the Day. Sorry!
entries.translated:
Oh! Ini adalah [buffer1] yang bagus!
Tapi itu bukan Tangkapan Resmi Hip\lWaders Hari Ini. Maaf!

entries.original:
"Oh! This is a great [buffer1]!

That’s why you’re the third member
of the Hip Waders!

Cool! Take these with you!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! This is a great [buffer1]! That’s why you’re the third member of the Hip Waders! Cool! Take these with you!
entries.translated:
Oh! Ini adalah [buffer1] yang bagus!
Itulah kenapa kamu adalah anggota\lketiga dari Hip Waders! Keren!

Ambil ini bersamamu!

entries.original:
"The appeal of fishing\.

That’s something you have to
discover through experience, rather\lthan listening to me explaining\labout it!

Right, Member No. 3?"
entries.translation_source: The appeal of fishing\. That’s something you have to discover through experience, rather than listening to me explaining about it! Right, Member No. 3?
entries.translated:
Daya tarik memancing\. Itu adalah
sesuatu yang harus kamu temukan\lmelalui pengalaman, daripada

mendengarkan saya menjelaskannya!
Benar, Anggota No. 3?

entries.original: "Will you show me a tiny Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Will you show me a tiny Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Maukah kamu menunjukkan Pokémon
kecil padaku?

entries.original:
"Hm\.

You don’t have the teensiest bit of
an urge to show me a tiny Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Hm\. You don’t have the teensiest bit of an urge to show me a tiny Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Hm\. Kamu tidak memiliki sedikit pun
keinginan untuk menunjukkan Pokémon\lkecil padaku.

entries.original:
"Hm\.
That Pokémon isn’t small enough.

I’d sure like to see a Pokémon
that’s 20 centimetres high or\lsmaller\."
entries.translation_source: Hm\. That Pokémon isn’t small enough. I’d sure like to see a Pokémon that’s 20 centimetres high or smaller\.
entries.translated:
Hm\. Pokémon itu tidak cukup kecil.
Saya pasti ingin melihat Pokémon\lyang tingginya 20 sentimeter atau

lebih kecil\.

entries.original:
"Hm\.

I can’t see how small the Pokémon
is while it’s in an Egg."
entries.translation_source: Hm\. I can’t see how small the Pokémon is while it’s in an Egg.
entries.translated:
Hm\. Saya tidak bisa melihat seberapa
kecil Pokémon itu saat berada di\ldalam Telur.

entries.original:
"Wow! Amazing!
[buffer1] is so tiny!

I wonder what it would feel like to
become [buffer1]\.

I bet I’d get a way different
outlook on life\.

Just imagining it gets me excited!
Tiny things are super interesting!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Amazing! [buffer1] is so tiny! I wonder what it would feel like to become [buffer1]\. I bet I’d get a way different outlook on life\. Just imagining it gets me excited! Tiny things are super interesting!
entries.translated:
Wow! Luar biasa! [buffer1] sangat
kecil! Saya bertanya-tanya\lbagaimana rasanya menjadi [buffer1]\.

Saya yakin saya akan mendapatkan
pandangan hidup yang sangat berbeda\.\lMembayangkannya saja membuat saya

bersemangat! Hal-hal kecil sangat
menarik!

entries.original:
"Thanks for showing me a tiny
Pokémon!

It was super interesting!

I’d sure like it if you’d show me
one again tomorrow\."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for showing me a tiny Pokémon! It was super interesting! I’d sure like it if you’d show me one again tomorrow\.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah menunjukkan
Pokémon kecil padaku! Itu sangat\lmenarik! Saya pasti ingin jika kamu

menunjukkannya lagi besok\.

entries.original:
"Have you come to show me a big
Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Have you come to show me a big Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu datang untuk
menunjukkan Pokémon besar padaku?

entries.original:
"What!?
I wanna see a big Pokémon!

I wanna see a Pokémon bigger than
7 metres!"
entries.translation_source: What!? I wanna see a big Pokémon! I wanna see a Pokémon bigger than 7 metres!
entries.translated:
Apa!? Saya ingin melihat Pokémon
besar! Saya ingin melihat Pokémon\lyang lebih besar dari 7 meter!

entries.original:
"What!?
That’s not a big Pokémon!

I wanna see a Pokémon bigger than
7 metres!"
entries.translation_source: What!? That’s not a big Pokémon! I wanna see a Pokémon bigger than 7 metres!
entries.translated:
Apa!? Itu bukan Pokémon besar! Aku
ingin melihat Pokémon yang lebih\lbesar dari 7 meter!

entries.original:
"What!?

I can’t see how tall it is when
it’s in an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: What!? I can’t see how tall it is when it’s in an Egg!
entries.translated:
Apa!? Aku tidak bisa melihat
tingginya saat di dalam Telur!

entries.original:
"Wow! Amazing!
[buffer1] is sooooo big!

Riding on top of [buffer1]
would be so much fun!

When you look from high places, you
can see rooftops and faraway\lmountains and other things you\lusually can’t see.

That’s why I like big things so
much!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Amazing! [buffer1] is sooooo big! Riding on top of [buffer1] would be so much fun! When you look from high places, you can see rooftops and faraway mountains and other things you usually can’t see. That’s why I like big things so much!
entries.translated:
Wow! Luar biasa! [buffer1] sangat
besaaar! Naik di atas [buffer1]\lpasti sangat menyenangkan! Saat

melihat dari tempat tinggi, kamu
bisa melihat atap rumah dan gunung\ljauh serta hal-hal lain yang

biasanya tidak bisa kamu lihat.
Itulah kenapa aku sangat suka\lhal-hal besar!

entries.original:
"Big thanks for showing me a big
Pokémon!

I’d be even more happy if you’d
show me one tomorrow, too!"
entries.translation_source: Big thanks for showing me a big Pokémon! I’d be even more happy if you’d show me one tomorrow, too!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih banyak sudah
menunjukkan Pokémon besar! Aku akan\llebih senang lagi jika kamu

tunjukkan satu lagi besok!

entries.original: "Pangs of Hunger"
entries.translation_source: Pangs of Hunger
entries.translated: Rasa Lapar

entries.original:
"I haven’t been up to eating much
lately\.

Maybe what I need is to hear a cry
that sounds like mastication.

That might get my hunger up.

Do you know about this?

A Pokémon resembling a [green]sea
cucumber[red] has a cry that sounds\llike it’s gobbling something up!

I’d sure like to hear it sometime."
entries.translation_source: I haven’t been up to eating much lately\. Maybe what I need is to hear a cry that sounds like mastication. That might get my hunger up. Do you know about this? A Pokémon resembling a [green]sea cucumber[red] has a cry that sounds like it’s gobbling something up! I’d sure like to hear it sometime.
entries.translated:
Akhir-akhir ini aku kurang nafsu
makan\\. Mungkin yang kubutuhkan\ladalah mendengar teriakan yang

terdengar seperti suara kunyahan.
Itu bisa meningkatkan nafsu\lmakanku. Apa kamu tahu tentang ini?

Seekor Pokémon yang mirip [green]mentimun
laut[red] memiliki teriakan yang\lterdengar seperti sedang melahap

sesuatu! Aku pasti ingin
mendengarnya suatu saat nanti.

entries.original:
"The cry of the Pyukumuku with
you\.

Gobble gobble gobble!
It sounds just like its eating!"
entries.translation_source: The cry of the Pyukumuku with you\. Gobble gobble gobble! It sounds just like its eating!
entries.translated:
Teriakan Pyukumuku bersamamu\\.
Gobble gobble gobble! Kedengarannya\lseperti sedang makan!

entries.original:
"If I could hear just one more cry,
my heart would flutter and my\lmouth would chomp on so much food!

I hear there’s a Pokémon with a
really [green]big nose and moustache[red] that\lhas a cry that sounds just like a\lman sneezing.

If I knew what it sounded like, I
could forget my nose and focus\lsolely on my mouth!"
entries.translation_source: If I could hear just one more cry, my heart would flutter and my mouth would chomp on so much food! I hear there’s a Pokémon with a really [green]big nose and moustache[red] that has a cry that sounds just like a man sneezing. If I knew what it sounded like, I could forget my nose and focus solely on my mouth!
entries.translated:
Jika aku bisa mendengar satu kali
teriakan lagi, hatiku akan berdebar\ldan mulutku akan mengunyah begitu

banyak makanan! Kudengar ada seekor
Pokémon dengan [green]hidung besar dan\lkumis[red] yang teriakannya terdengar

seperti pria bersin. Jika aku tahu
bagaimana suaranya, aku bisa\lmelupakan hidungku dan fokus hanya

pada mulutku!

entries.original:
"The cry of the Probopass with
you\.

It sounds just like it’s sneezing!

It makes me giggle from the bottom
up!"
entries.translation_source: The cry of the Probopass with you\. It sounds just like it’s sneezing! It makes me giggle from the bottom up!
entries.translated:
Teriakan Probopass bersamamu\\.
Kedengarannya seperti sedang\lbersin! Itu membuatku tertawa

terpingkal-pingkal!

entries.original:
"Thanks to you and your Pokémon, my
stomach is rumbling!

I feel like I could eat a truck!

This is a token of my appreciation
for getting me to eat again.

Thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks to you and your Pokémon, my stomach is rumbling! I feel like I could eat a truck! This is a token of my appreciation for getting me to eat again. Thanks!
entries.translated:
Berkat dirimu dan Pokémon-mu,
perutku keroncongan! Aku merasa\lbisa memakan satu truk! Ini adalah

tanda terima kasihku karena
membuatku makan lagi. Terima kasih!

entries.original:
"Oh\.
I’m so full\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. I’m so full\.
entries.translated: Oh\\. Aku sangat kenyang\\.

entries.original:
"My work always keeps me very busy,
so I’m thrilled if I can go home at\lnight.

I’m sorry to leave my wife lonely,
but that’s the life of a powerful\lexecutive.

Oh, this is a souvenir from a
business trip.

She does not seem to need it,
so I will give it to you."
entries.translation_source: My work always keeps me very busy, so I’m thrilled if I can go home at night. I’m sorry to leave my wife lonely, but that’s the life of a powerful executive. Oh, this is a souvenir from a business trip. She does not seem to need it, so I will give it to you.
entries.translated:
Pekerjaanku selalu membuatku sangat
sibuk, jadi aku senang jika bisa\lpulang ke rumah di malam hari. Aku

minta maaf meninggalkan istriku
sendirian, tapi itulah kehidupan\lseorang eksekutif berkuasa. Oh, ini

adalah oleh-oleh dari perjalanan
bisnis. Dia sepertinya tidak\lmembutuhkannya, jadi aku akan

memberikannya padamu.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow it’s work as always!

I’m a super businessman, aren’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow it’s work as always! I’m a super businessman, aren’t I?
entries.translated:
Besok kerja seperti biasa! Aku
seorang super businessman, bukan?

entries.original:
"My husband is a very well known
businessman from Cube Corp.

We recently moved here from the
Alola region so he could be closer\lto work and would be able to\lcome home each night.

I brought along three Pokémon with
me that used to keep me company\lat night when I was lonely, but\lnow that my husband returns home\learlier, I’ve begun to neglect\lthem.

I want them to be happy, and the
best way for me to do that is to\lentrust them to a caring Trainer.

You seem the type, would you like
one of these Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: My husband is a very well known businessman from Cube Corp. We recently moved here from the Alola region so he could be closer to work and would be able to come home each night. I brought along three Pokémon with me that used to keep me company at night when I was lonely, but now that my husband returns home earlier, I’ve begun to neglect them. I want them to be happy, and the best way for me to do that is to entrust them to a caring Trainer. You seem the type, would you like one of these Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Suamiku adalah seorang pengusaha
terkenal dari Cube Corp. Kami baru\lsaja pindah ke sini dari wilayah

Alola agar dia bisa lebih dekat
dengan tempat kerja dan bisa pulang\lsetiap malam. Aku membawa tiga

Pokémon yang dulu menemaniku di
malam hari saat aku kesepian, tapi\lsekarang suamiku pulang lebih awal,

aku mulai mengabaikan mereka. Aku
ingin mereka bahagia, dan cara\lterbaik untuk melakukannya adalah

dengan mempercayakan mereka kepada
Pelatih yang peduli. Kamu tampaknya\ltipe seperti itu, apakah kamu mau

salah satu dari Pokémon ini?

entries.original:
"You came back! I’m so glad\.

Which of my Pokémon would you like
today?"
entries.translation_source: You came back! I’m so glad\. Which of my Pokémon would you like today?
entries.translated:
Kamu kembali! Aku sangat senang\\.
Pokémon mana yang kamu inginkan\lhari ini?

entries.original:
"Maybe you’re not as caring as I
thought."
entries.translation_source: Maybe you’re not as caring as I thought.
entries.translated:
Mungkin kamu tidak sepeduli yang
kukira.

entries.original:
"Before you hear my spiel, make some
room in your party for a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Before you hear my spiel, make some room in your party for a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sebelum kamu mendengar ceramahku,
sediakan ruang di timmu untuk satu\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"I don’t want to give each away too
fast\.

Come again when you have [green][buffer1] Badges[red],
and I will give you another one."
entries.translation_source: I don’t want to give each away too fast\. Come again when you have [green][buffer1] Badges[red], and I will give you another one.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak ingin memberikan semuanya
terlalu cepat\\. Datang lagi setelah\lkamu memiliki [green][buffer1] Lencana[red], dan

aku akan memberimu satu lagi.

entries.original:
"I hope you care well for those
Pokémon I entrusted to you!"
entries.translation_source: I hope you care well for those Pokémon I entrusted to you!
entries.translated:
Aku harap kamu merawat dengan baik
Pokémon yang kupercayakan padamu!

entries.original:
"My dream has always been to see the
ultimate Pumpkaboo.

Yes\.
One whose size rivals all others!

Do you have such a [green]Pumpkaboo[red]?"
entries.translation_source: My dream has always been to see the ultimate Pumpkaboo. Yes\. One whose size rivals all others! Do you have such a [green]Pumpkaboo[red]?
entries.translated:
Impianku selalu melihat Pumpkaboo
yang terunggul. Ya\\. Satu yang\lukurannya melampaui yang lain!

Apakah kamu memiliki [green]Pumpkaboo[red]
seperti itu?

entries.original:
"I knew you would not be able to
show me such a Pumpkaboo\."
entries.translation_source: I knew you would not be able to show me such a Pumpkaboo\.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu kamu tidak akan bisa
menunjukkan Pumpkaboo seperti itu\lpadaku\.

entries.original:
"That won’t do.

Does that look like a Pumpkaboo
to you?"
entries.translation_source: That won’t do. Does that look like a Pumpkaboo to you?
entries.translated:
Itu tidak akan berhasil. Apakah itu
terlihat seperti Pumpkaboo bagimu?

entries.original:
"Hmph.
It’s just [buffer2] inches.

The Pumpkaboo before was bigger.

It was [green][buffer3][red] inches, the
biggest Pumpkaboo you brought me."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. It’s just [buffer2] inches. The Pumpkaboo before was bigger. It was [green][buffer3][red] inches, the biggest Pumpkaboo you brought me.
entries.translated:
Hmph. Ini hanya [buffer2] inci.
Pumpkaboo sebelumnya lebih besar.\lTingginya [green][buffer3][red] inci, Pumpkaboo

terbesar yang kamu bawa untukku.

entries.original:
"Woah!
It’s [buffer2] inches!

I’ve never seen anything like this!
You deserve a reward!"
entries.translation_source: Woah! It’s [buffer2] inches! I’ve never seen anything like this! You deserve a reward!
entries.translated:
Woah! Tingginya [buffer2] inci! Aku
belum pernah melihat yang seperti\lini! Kamu pantas mendapatkan

hadiah!

entries.original:
"I still want to see a much [green]larger[red]
Pumpkaboo than that one.

I hope to someday fulfill my dream
of seeing the ultimate Pumpkaboo."
entries.translation_source: I still want to see a much [green]larger[red] Pumpkaboo than that one. I hope to someday fulfill my dream of seeing the ultimate Pumpkaboo.
entries.translated:
Aku masih ingin melihat Pumpkaboo
yang jauh [green]lebih besar[red] dari yang\litu. Aku berharap suatu hari bisa

mewujudkan mimpiku melihat
Pumpkaboo yang paling besar.

entries.original:
"Huh? This [buffer2] measurement\.

It’s not anything new.
It’s the same as before."
entries.translation_source: Huh? This [buffer2] measurement\. It’s not anything new. It’s the same as before.
entries.translated:
Huh? Pengukuran [buffer2] ini\. Ini
bukan hal baru. Sama seperti\lsebelumnya.

entries.original:
"I bought an [green]ADM[blue] from [green]Captain
Davy’s Shipyard[blue].

It was a little pricey, but I used
it to dig through walls in the [green]KBT\lExpressway[blue] and found one of these!"
entries.translation_source: I bought an [green]ADM[blue] from [green]Captain Davy’s Shipyard[blue]. It was a little pricey, but I used it to dig through walls in the [green]KBT Expressway[blue] and found one of these!
entries.translated:
Aku membeli [green]ADM[blue] dari [green]Captain Davy{B4}s
Shipyard[blue]. Harganya agak mahal, tapi\laku menggunakannya untuk menggali

tembok di [green]KBT Expressway[blue] dan
menemukan salah satu dari ini!

entries.original:
"Getting an [green]ADM[blue] from [green]Captain Davy[blue]
will let you smash through\lcollapsed doorways in the [green]KBT\lExpressway[blue].

Sometimes, you’ll even find rare
Pokémon behind them."
entries.translation_source: Getting an [green]ADM[blue] from [green]Captain Davy[blue] will let you smash through collapsed doorways in the [green]KBT Expressway[blue]. Sometimes, you’ll even find rare Pokémon behind them.
entries.translated:
Mendapatkan [green]ADM[blue] dari [green]Captain Davy[blue]
akan memungkinkanmu menerobos pintu\lyang runtuh di [green]KBT Expressway[blue].

Terkadang, kamu bahkan akan
menemukan Pokémon langka di\lbaliknya.

entries.original:
"Owners of residences like these
can’t often be found easily.

But in this building’s case, the
owner likes to sit downstairs.

He may even be willing to let you
rent an apartment if you ask."
entries.translation_source: Owners of residences like these can’t often be found easily. But in this building’s case, the owner likes to sit downstairs. He may even be willing to let you rent an apartment if you ask.
entries.translated:
Pemilik tempat tinggal seperti ini
jarang bisa ditemukan dengan mudah.\lTapi dalam kasus gedung ini,

pemiliknya suka duduk di lantai
bawah. Dia bahkan mungkin bersedia\lmenyewakan apartemen jika kamu

memintanya.

entries.original:
"The owner of this residence likes
to sit downstairs.

He’s been quite chipper since a new
resident moved in."
entries.translation_source: The owner of this residence likes to sit downstairs. He’s been quite chipper since a new resident moved in.
entries.translated:
Pemilik tempat tinggal ini suka
duduk di lantai bawah. Dia cukup\lceria sejak penghuni baru pindah.

entries.original:
"[black]Her brain appears to be as
gelatinous as pudding."
entries.translation_source: [black]Her brain appears to be as gelatinous as pudding.
entries.translated: [black]Otaknya tampak sekenyal puding.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.
I love pudding!

My favourite is chocolate!"
entries.translation_source: Mmm\. I love pudding! My favourite is chocolate!
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Aku suka puding! Favoritku
adalah cokelat!

entries.original:
"There is a tradition that when
two Pokémon from two different\lTrainers are bred together, the\loffspring has a higher chance of\lbeing born shiny.

This tradition has been passed down
for decades, and is said to have\lroots in the far eastern regions."
entries.translation_source: There is a tradition that when two Pokémon from two different Trainers are bred together, the offspring has a higher chance of being born shiny. This tradition has been passed down for decades, and is said to have roots in the far eastern regions.
entries.translated:
Ada tradisi bahwa ketika dua
Pokémon dari dua Pelatih yang\lberbeda dikawinkan, keturunannya

memiliki peluang lebih tinggi untuk
lahir Shiny. Tradisi ini telah\ldiwariskan selama puluhan tahun,

dan dikatakan berakar di daerah
timur jauh.

entries.original:
"Teehee\. did you know the [green]Destiny
Knot[red] can be used during breeding?

Betcha didn’t!

But s’okay, if you show me a [green]girly[red]
Pokémon that knows Attract, I’ll\lgive you one to use!

Do you have a Pokémon you wanna
share with me?"
entries.translation_source: Teehee\. did you know the [green]Destiny Knot[red] can be used during breeding? Betcha didn’t! But s’okay, if you show me a [green]girly[red] Pokémon that knows Attract, I’ll give you one to use! Do you have a Pokémon you wanna share with me?
entries.translated:
Teehee\. tahukah kamu bahwa [green]Simpul
Takdir[red] bisa digunakan saat\lbreeding? Pasti kamu tidak tahu!

Tapi tidak apa-apa, jika kamu
menunjukkan padaku Pokémon [green]girly[red]\lyang tahu Menawan, aku akan

memberimu satu untuk digunakan!
Apakah kamu punya Pokémon yang\lingin kamu tunjukkan padaku?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon is it?
I’m all excited now!"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is it? I’m all excited now!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang mana itu? Aku sangat
bersemangat sekarang!

entries.original:
"Yay! That’s exactly what I was
looking for!

Take a [green]Destiny Knot[red] now!"
entries.translation_source: Yay! That’s exactly what I was looking for! Take a [green]Destiny Knot[red] now!
entries.translated:
Yay! Itulah yang aku cari! Ambil
[green]Simpul Takdir[red] sekarang!

entries.original:
"When a Pokémon holds the [green]Destiny
Knot[red] while breeding, five\l[green]Individual Values[red] will be passed\ldown from the parents, instead\lof the usual three."
entries.translation_source: When a Pokémon holds the [green]Destiny Knot[red] while breeding, five [green]Individual Values[red] will be passed down from the parents, instead of the usual three.
entries.translated:
Ketika sebuah Pokémon memegang
[green]Simpul Takdir[red] saat breeding, lima\l[green]Nilai Individu (IV)[red] akan diturunkan

dari induknya, bukan tiga seperti
biasanya.

entries.original:
"Oh, boo.
I just wanted you to show me\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, boo. I just wanted you to show me\.
entries.translated:
Oh, boo. Aku hanya ingin kamu
menunjukkannya padaku\.

entries.original:
"Teehee\. you silly Zangoose.
I’m not looking for an Egg!

I want to see a [green]girly[red] Pokémon that
knows [green]Attract[red]."
entries.translation_source: Teehee\. you silly Zangoose. I’m not looking for an Egg! I want to see a [green]girly[red] Pokémon that knows [green]Attract[red].
entries.translated:
Teehee\. kamu Zangoose yang konyol.
Aku tidak mencari Telur! Aku ingin\lmelihat Pokémon [green]girly[red] yang tahu

[green]Menawan[red].

entries.original:
"Teehee\. you silly Zangoose.
That’s not what I’m looking for!

I want to see a [green]girly[red] Pokémon that
knows [green]Attract[red]."
entries.translation_source: Teehee\. you silly Zangoose. That’s not what I’m looking for! I want to see a [green]girly[red] Pokémon that knows [green]Attract[red].
entries.translated:
Teehee\. kamu Zangoose yang konyol.
Itu bukan yang aku cari! Aku ingin\lmelihat Pokémon [green]girly[red] yang tahu

[green]Menawan[red].

entries.original:
"You know that adorable electric
mouse Pokémon that everyone loves?

Yeah, you guessed it, I’m talking
about [green]Pichu[blue]!

Do you have one I could pet?"
entries.translation_source: You know that adorable electric mouse Pokémon that everyone loves? Yeah, you guessed it, I’m talking about [green]Pichu[blue]! Do you have one I could pet?
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu Pokémon tikus listrik
yang menggemaskan yang disukai\lsemua orang? Ya, kamu tebak, aku

sedang berbicara tentang [green]Pichu[blue]!
Apakah kamu punya satu yang bisa\laku elus?

entries.original:
"Oh, that’s great!
Can I see it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, that’s great! Can I see it?
entries.translated: Oh, itu bagus! Bisa aku lihat?

entries.original:
"It’s so soft and adorable!

Just like the one I picked up the
other day!

Although its ear is slightly
different\.

Say, you seem to be good with
Pichu.

Why don’t you take the one I found,
too?"
entries.translation_source: It’s so soft and adorable! Just like the one I picked up the other day! Although its ear is slightly different\. Say, you seem to be good with Pichu. Why don’t you take the one I found, too?
entries.translated:
Ini sangat lembut dan menggemaskan!
Sama seperti yang aku ambil\lbeberapa hari yang lalu! Meskipun

telinganya sedikit berbeda\. Hei,
kamu sepertinya pandai dengan\lPichu. Kenapa kamu tidak mengambil

yang aku temukan juga?

entries.original:
"Your Pichu and my Pichu seem to be
getting along great!

I can tell you’re going to make a
great Trainer for it!"
entries.translation_source: Your Pichu and my Pichu seem to be getting along great! I can tell you’re going to make a great Trainer for it!
entries.translated:
Pichu-mu dan Pichu-ku tampaknya
akur dengan baik! Aku bisa tahu\lkamu akan menjadi Pelatih yang

hebat untuknya!

entries.original:
"When you breed a [green]Pikachu[blue] while its
holding a [green]Light Ball[blue], the baby\lborn will know [green]Volt Tackle[blue]."
entries.translation_source: When you breed a [green]Pikachu[blue] while its holding a [green]Light Ball[blue], the baby born will know [green]Volt Tackle[blue].
entries.translated:
Ketika kamu mengembangbiakkan
[green]Pikachu[blue] sambil memegang [green]Light Ball[blue],\lbayi yang lahir akan tahu [green]Volt

Tackle[blue].

entries.original:
"I get it. Not everyone carries a
Pichu around with them."
entries.translation_source: I get it. Not everyone carries a Pichu around with them.
entries.translated:
Aku mengerti. Tidak semua orang
membawa Pichu bersama mereka.

entries.original:
"I’m confused\.
Is that supposed to be a [green]Pichu[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: I’m confused\. Is that supposed to be a [green]Pichu[blue]?
entries.translated:
Aku bingung\. Apakah itu seharusnya
[green]Pichu[blue]?

entries.original:
"Oh, never mind!
You need space in your party first!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, never mind! You need space in your party first!
entries.translated:
Oh, sudahlah! Kamu perlu ruang di
timmu dulu!

entries.original:
"Pokémon can learn special moves
called [green]Egg Moves[red] through breeding!

When either parent knows one of
these moves, be it the mother or\lthe father, the baby born will also\lknow the move!"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon can learn special moves called [green]Egg Moves[red] through breeding! When either parent knows one of these moves, be it the mother or the father, the baby born will also know the move!
entries.translated:
Pokémon bisa mempelajari jurusan
khusus yang disebut [green]Egg Moves[red]\lmelalui perkembangbiakan! Ketika

salah satu induk tahu salah satu
jurusan ini, baik ibu maupun ayah,\lbayi yang lahir juga akan tahu

jurusan tersebut!

entries.original:
"This is the [green]Pokémon Breeder’s
School[red].

A place where fledgling young
Trainers like yourself can learn\lto become great Pokémon Breeders."
entries.translation_source: This is the [green]Pokémon Breeder’s School[red]. A place where fledgling young Trainers like yourself can learn to become great Pokémon Breeders.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah [green]Sekolah Peternak
Pokémon[red]. Tempat di mana Pelatih\lmuda pemula seperti kamu bisa

belajar menjadi Peternak Pokémon
yang hebat.

entries.original:
"Hi! I run a nursery service!

Would you like to me to raise one
of your Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I run a nursery service! Would you like to me to raise one of your Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Hai! Aku menjalankan layanan
penitipan! Apakah kamu ingin aku\lmerawat salah satu Pokémon-mu?

entries.original: "Which Pokémon should I raise?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should I raise?
entries.translated: Pokémon mana yang harus aku rawat?

entries.original:
"Sure thing! I’ll look after your
[green][buffer1][red] for a while."
entries.translation_source: Sure thing! I’ll look after your [green][buffer1][red] for a while.
entries.translated:
Tentu! Aku akan menjaga [green][buffer1][red]
kamu untuk sementara waktu.

entries.original:
"Come see me in a while to check on
how your Pokémon has grown!"
entries.translation_source: Come see me in a while to check on how your Pokémon has grown!
entries.translated:
Datang temui aku sebentar lagi
untuk memeriksa bagaimana\lPokémon-mu telah tumbuh!

entries.original:
"I’m sorry! I can’t take a Pokémon
if you only have one with you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! I can’t take a Pokémon if you only have one with you!
entries.translated:
Maaf! Aku tidak bisa mengambil
Pokémon jika kamu hanya punya satu\lbersamamu!

entries.original:
"If you left me that Pokémon, what
would you battle with?"
entries.translation_source: If you left me that Pokémon, what would you battle with?
entries.translated:
Jika kamu meninggalkan Pokémon itu
padaku, dengan apa kamu akan\lbertarung?

entries.original:
"You owe [green]$[buffer2][red] for the
return of this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You owe [green]$[buffer2][red] for the return of this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu berutang [green]$[buffer2][red] untuk
pengembalian Pokémon ini.

entries.original:
"Thank you!
Here’s your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Thank you! Here’s your Pokémon.
entries.translated: Terima kasih! Ini Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] got [green][buffer1][black] back
from the Nursery Lady."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] got [green][buffer1][black] back from the Nursery Lady.
entries.translated:
[black][player] mendapatkan [green][buffer1][black]
kembali dari Ibu Penitipan.

entries.original:
"You’re back already?

Your [green][buffer1][red] needs to spend some
more time with me."
entries.translation_source: You’re back already? Your [green][buffer1][red] needs to spend some more time with me.
entries.translated:
Kamu sudah kembali? [green][buffer1][red] mu
perlu menghabiskan lebih banyak\lwaktu denganku.

entries.original:
"Your [green][buffer1][red] has grown a lot!

Let’s see\.
By level, it’s grown by [green][buffer2][red]!

Aren’t I great at this?"
entries.translation_source: Your [green][buffer1][red] has grown a lot! Let’s see\. By level, it’s grown by [green][buffer2][red]! Aren’t I great at this?
entries.translated:
Si [green][buffer1][red] telah tumbuh pesat!
Mari kita lihat\. Berdasarkan level,\lia tumbuh sebesar [green][buffer2][red]!

Bukankah aku hebat dalam hal ini?

entries.original:
"You can’t take your Pokémon if you
don’t have room for it."
entries.translation_source: You can’t take your Pokémon if you don’t have room for it.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak bisa mengambil
Pokémon-mu jika tidak ada ruang\luntuknya.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry!
You don’t have enough money!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! You don’t have enough money!
entries.translated:
Maaf! Kamu tidak memiliki cukup
uang!

entries.original: "Come back anytime you’d like!"
entries.translation_source: Come back anytime you’d like!
entries.translated: Datang lagi kapan saja kamu mau!

entries.original: "Have a wonderful day!"
entries.translation_source: Have a wonderful day!
entries.translated: Semoga harimu menyenangkan!

entries.original: "[green]Polololol."
entries.translation_source: [green]Polololol.
entries.translated: [green]Polololol.

entries.original: "Flaming Body"
entries.translation_source: Flaming Body
entries.translated: Flaming Body

entries.original: "Armoured Magma"
entries.translation_source: Armoured Magma
entries.translated: Armoured Magma

entries.original: "Master Incubator"
entries.translation_source: Master Incubator
entries.translated: Master Incubator

entries.original:
"Hatching Eggs and helping others
hatch them is my one purpose!

So, I’m going to give you a little
incentive to start hatching.

If you hatch at least [green][buffer1][blue] Eggs,
I’ll give you something nice.

Get out there and start hatching!"
entries.translation_source: Hatching Eggs and helping others hatch them is my one purpose! So, I’m going to give you a little incentive to start hatching. If you hatch at least [green][buffer1][blue] Eggs, I’ll give you something nice. Get out there and start hatching!
entries.translated:
Menetaskan Telur dan membantu orang
lain menetaskannya adalah\lsatu-satunya tujuanku! Jadi, aku

akan memberimu sedikit insentif
untuk mulai menetaskan. Jika kamu\lmenetaskan setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]

Telur, aku akan memberimu sesuatu
yang bagus. Pergilah dan mulailah\lmenetaskan!

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ve hatched a total
of [green][buffer2][blue] Eggs.

Seems good to me.
Take your reward!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ve hatched a total of [green][buffer2][blue] Eggs. Seems good to me. Take your reward!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu telah menetaskan
total [green][buffer2][blue] Telur. Tampaknya\lbaik bagiku. Ambil hadiahmu!

entries.original:
"Since you did so great last time,
I’m going up the ante!

This time I want you to hatch at
least [green][buffer1][blue] Eggs!

Get hatching!"
entries.translation_source: Since you did so great last time, I’m going up the ante! This time I want you to hatch at least [green][buffer1][blue] Eggs! Get hatching!
entries.translated:
Karena kamu melakukannya dengan
baik terakhir kali, aku akan\lmenaikkan taruhannya! Kali ini aku

ingin kamu menetaskan setidaknya
[green][buffer1][blue] Telur! Mulailah\lmenetaskan!

entries.original:
"This is it!
The final stretch!

Attempt to hatch [green][buffer1][blue] Eggs!

If you do that, the reward I give
you will be priceless."
entries.translation_source: This is it! The final stretch! Attempt to hatch [green][buffer1][blue] Eggs! If you do that, the reward I give you will be priceless.
entries.translated:
Ini dia! Babak terakhir! Cobalah
menetaskan [green][buffer1][blue] Telur! Jika\lkamu melakukannya, hadiah yang akan

kuberikan akan tak ternilai.

entries.original:
"Of all the people I met, you
truly shine out among them as\lthe Master Incubator."
entries.translation_source: Of all the people I met, you truly shine out among them as the Master Incubator.
entries.translated:
Dari semua orang yang kutemui, kamu
benar-benar menonjol di antara\lmereka sebagai Master Incubator.

entries.original:
"You’ve hatched a total of [green][buffer2][blue]
Eggs out of the [green][buffer1][blue] I requested.

Keep up the hatching!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve hatched a total of [green][buffer2][blue] Eggs out of the [green][buffer1][blue] I requested. Keep up the hatching!
entries.translated:
Kamu telah menetaskan total
[green][buffer2][blue] Telur dari [green][buffer1][blue] yang\lkuminta. Teruslah menetaskan!

entries.original:
"Looks like you need to get room in
your party if you want the reward."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you need to get room in your party if you want the reward.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu perlu mengosongkan
ruang di timmu jika kamu\lmenginginkan hadiahnya.

entries.original:
"Aye!
Me name’s Cappin Davy!

Me boys here finished workin’ on an
advanced diggin’ an’ divin’ machine.

Only the highest members of society
can afford to purchase one, so I\lwon’t waste my time offerin’ it to\lye until ye prove yerself, first."
entries.translation_source: Aye! Me name’s Cappin Davy! Me boys here finished workin’ on an advanced diggin’ an’ divin’ machine. Only the highest members of society can afford to purchase one, so I won’t waste my time offerin’ it to ye until ye prove yerself, first.
entries.translated:
Aye! Namaku Cappin Davy! Anak
buahku di sini baru saja\lmenyelesaikan pembuatan mesin

penggali dan penyelam canggih.
Hanya anggota masyarakat tertinggi\lyang mampu membelinya, jadi aku

tidak akan membuang waktu untuk
menawarkannya kepadamu sampai kamu\lmembuktikan dirimu terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Aye!
Me name’s Cappin Davy!

Me boys here finished workin’ on an
advanced diggin’ an’ divin’ machine.

It’s a special item ye can strap on
to yer Pokémon to let ’em use any\lHM move, and it can even provide\lye with oxygen if ye get a Pokémon\lto take ye underwater!

Ye interested in buyin’?
It’ll cost ye $[green]250000[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Aye! Me name’s Cappin Davy! Me boys here finished workin’ on an advanced diggin’ an’ divin’ machine. It’s a special item ye can strap on to yer Pokémon to let ’em use any HM move, and it can even provide ye with oxygen if ye get a Pokémon to take ye underwater! Ye interested in buyin’? It’ll cost ye $[green]250000[blue].
entries.translated:
Aye! Namaku Cappin Davy! Anak
buahku di sini baru saja\lmenyelesaikan pembuatan mesin

penggali dan penyelam canggih. Ini
adalah item khusus yang bisa kamu\lpasangkan pada Pokémon-mu untuk

membuat mereka bisa menggunakan
gerakan HM apa pun, dan bahkan bisa\lmemberimu oksigen jika kamu

menyuruh Pokémon untuk membawamu ke
bawah air! Kamu tertarik untuk\lmembeli? Harganya $[green]250000[blue].

entries.original:
"And to go along with it, lemme give
ye this, too."
entries.translation_source: And to go along with it, lemme give ye this, too.
entries.translated:
Dan sebagai tambahan, biarkan aku
memberimu ini juga.

entries.original:
"Pleasure doin’ business with ye.

Now, listen here."
entries.translation_source: Pleasure doin’ business with ye. Now, listen here.
entries.translated:
Senang berbisnis denganmu.
Sekarang, dengarkan ini.

entries.original:
"Not only can ye use the [green]ADM[blue] instead
of HMs, ye can also use it to mine\lfor treasure!

The walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue] and
[green]seafloor[blue] are lined with goodies\ljust waitin’ for ye to dig ’em out!

If yer in either of those places,
set yer [green]R-Button Mode[blue] to [green]Mining\lScan[blue] in the [green]Options Menu[blue], and\lpress \btn03.

If there are any spots around ye
where ye can dig for treasure,\lthe ADM will light ’em up!

Just hit \btn00 next to one of those
spots to start diggin’."
entries.translation_source: Not only can ye use the [green]ADM[blue] instead of HMs, ye can also use it to mine for treasure! The walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue] and [green]seafloor[blue] are lined with goodies just waitin’ for ye to dig ’em out! If yer in either of those places, set yer [green]R-Button Mode[blue] to [green]Mining Scan[blue] in the [green]Options Menu[blue], and press \btn03. If there are any spots around ye where ye can dig for treasure, the ADM will light ’em up! Just hit \btn00 next to one of those spots to start diggin’.
entries.translated:
Tak hanya kau bisa menggunakan [green]ADM[blue]
sebagai pengganti HM, kau juga bisa\lmenggunakannya untuk menggali harta

karun! Dinding [green]Jalan Tol KBT[blue] dan
[green]dasar laut[blue] dipenuhi barang-barang\lberharga yang menunggu untuk kau

gali! Jika kau berada di salah satu
tempat itu, atur [green]Mode Tombol R[blue]-mu\lke [green]Pemindaian Tambang[blue] di [green]Menu Opsi[blue],

dan tekan \btn03. Jika ada titik di
sekitarmu yang bisa digali untuk\lharta karun, ADM akan menandainya!

Cukup tekan \btn00 di samping salah satu
titik itu untuk mulai menggali.

entries.original:
"Arr\.
Not within yer price range?"
entries.translation_source: Arr\. Not within yer price range?
entries.translated: Arr\. Di luar jangkauan anggaranmu?

entries.original:
"Arr\.
Ye don’t have enough money."
entries.translation_source: Arr\. Ye don’t have enough money.
entries.translated: Arr\. Uangmu tidak cukup.

entries.original:
"This tree looks like it can be cut
down!

Would you like to use the ADM?"
entries.translation_source: This tree looks like it can be cut down! Would you like to use the ADM?
entries.translated:
Pohon ini tampaknya bisa ditebang!
Apakah kamu ingin menggunakan ADM?

entries.original:
"This tree looks like it can be cut
down!

Would you like to cut it?"
entries.translation_source: This tree looks like it can be cut down! Would you like to cut it?
entries.translated:
Pohon ini tampaknya bisa ditebang!
Apakah kamu ingin menebangnya?

entries.original:
"This rock appears to be breakable.
Would you like to use the ADM?"
entries.translation_source: This rock appears to be breakable. Would you like to use the ADM?
entries.translated:
Batu ini tampaknya bisa
dihancurkan. Apakah kamu ingin\lmenggunakan ADM?

entries.original:
"This rock appears to be breakable.
Would you like to smash it?"
entries.translation_source: This rock appears to be breakable. Would you like to smash it?
entries.translated:
Batu ini tampaknya bisa
dihancurkan. Apakah kamu ingin\lmenghancurkannya?

entries.original:
"It’s a big boulder, but something
may be able to push it aside.

Would you like to use the ADM?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a big boulder, but something may be able to push it aside. Would you like to use the ADM?
entries.translated:
Ini batu besar, tetapi sesuatu
mungkin bisa mendorongnya ke\lsamping. Apakah kamu ingin

menggunakan ADM?

entries.original:
"It’s a big boulder, but something
may be able to push it aside.

Would you like to push it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a big boulder, but something may be able to push it aside. Would you like to push it?
entries.translated:
Ini batu besar, tetapi sesuatu
mungkin bisa mendorongnya ke\lsamping. Apakah kamu ingin

mendorongnya?

entries.original:
"The ADM made it possible to move
boulders around!"
entries.translation_source: The ADM made it possible to move boulders around!
entries.translated:
ADM memungkinkan untuk memindahkan
batu-batu besar!

entries.original:
"It is now possible to move
boulders around!"
entries.translation_source: It is now possible to move boulders around!
entries.translated:
Sekarang mungkin untuk memindahkan
batu-batu besar.

entries.original:
"The ADM made it possible to move
boulders around."
entries.translation_source: The ADM made it possible to move boulders around.
entries.translated:
ADM memungkinkan untuk memindahkan
batu-batu besar.

entries.original:
"It is already possible to move
boulders around."
entries.translation_source: It is already possible to move boulders around.
entries.translated:
Sudah mungkin untuk memindahkan
batu-batu besar.

entries.original:
"You see that big black ship?

That’s the prototype for a boat
called \qoThe Shadow\qc.

It was designed to be able to
traverse the ocean silently in\lthe dead of night.

A mysterious man who called himself
\qoZ\qc funded its construction."
entries.translation_source: You see that big black ship? That’s the prototype for a boat called \qoThe Shadow\qc. It was designed to be able to traverse the ocean silently in the dead of night. A mysterious man who called himself \qoZ\qc funded its construction.
entries.translated:
Kau lihat kapal hitam besar itu?
Itu adalah prototipe perahu bernama\l\qoThe Shadow\qc. Perahu itu dirancang

untuk dapat melintasi lautan dengan
hening di malam yang gelap. Seorang\lpria misterius yang menyebut

dirinya \qoZ\qc mendanai
pembangunannya.

entries.original:
"These ships are part of the
Seagallop Hi-Speed series.

They may be small, but they can
move over the ocean faster than\lany big ship!"
entries.translation_source: These ships are part of the Seagallop Hi-Speed series. They may be small, but they can move over the ocean faster than any big ship!
entries.translated:
Kapal-kapal ini adalah bagian dari
seri Seagallop Hi-Speed. Meskipun\lkecil, mereka bisa bergerak di

lautan lebih cepat dari kapal besar
mana pun!

entries.original:
"Don’t you hate it when you’ve gotta
carry around one Pokémon to smash\lrocks, another to push boulders,\land another to cut down trees?

That’s where the [green]ADM[blue] comes in!

Not only can it do all those things
for you, you can even strap it to\lyour Pokémon like a jetpack, and\lit’ll become capable of using Fly!

Heck, you can even attach it like a
drill to your Pokémon, and use it\lto escape from caves!

Someday it’ll be available cheap on
the market, but for now, it’s still\la little expensive to buy."
entries.translation_source: Don’t you hate it when you’ve gotta carry around one Pokémon to smash rocks, another to push boulders, and another to cut down trees? That’s where the [green]ADM[blue] comes in! Not only can it do all those things for you, you can even strap it to your Pokémon like a jetpack, and it’ll become capable of using Fly! Heck, you can even attach it like a drill to your Pokémon, and use it to escape from caves! Someday it’ll be available cheap on the market, but for now, it’s still a little expensive to buy.
entries.translated:
Apa kau tidak benci saat harus
membawa satu Pokémon untuk\lmenghancurkan batu, yang lain untuk

mendorong batu besar, dan yang lain
lagi untuk menebang pohon? Di\lsitulah [green]ADM[blue] berperan! Tidak hanya

bisa melakukan semua hal itu
untukmu, kau bahkan bisa\lmemasangkannya ke Pokémon-mu

seperti jetpack, dan ia akan bisa
menggunakan Terbang! Bahkan, kau\lbisa memasangnya seperti bor ke

Pokémon-mu, dan menggunakannya
untuk keluar dari gua! Suatu hari\lnanti akan tersedia dengan harga

murah di pasaran, tetapi untuk saat
ini, masih sedikit mahal untuk\ldibeli.

entries.original:
"If you have an ADM, you can use it
to mine for treasure!

There are three different places
you can mine in Borrius: the KBT\lExpressway, Underwater, or in a\lsingle room of Crystal Peak.

Mining in the KBT Expressway will
yield a good variety of items,\lwhile mining underwater will be\lmore likely to yield Fossils, and\lmining in Crystal Peak will be more\llikely to yield Gems."
entries.translation_source: If you have an ADM, you can use it to mine for treasure! There are three different places you can mine in Borrius: the KBT Expressway, Underwater, or in a single room of Crystal Peak. Mining in the KBT Expressway will yield a good variety of items, while mining underwater will be more likely to yield Fossils, and mining in Crystal Peak will be more likely to yield Gems.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memiliki ADM, kamu bisa
menggunakannya untuk menggali harta\lkarun! Ada tiga tempat berbeda yang

bisa kamu gali di Borrius: Jalan
Tol KBT, Bawah Air, atau di satu\lruangan di Crystal Peak. Menggali

di Jalan Tol KBT akan menghasilkan
berbagai macam item, sementara\lmenggali di bawah air lebih mungkin

menghasilkan Fosil, dan menggali di
Crystal Peak lebih mungkin\lmenghasilkan Permata.

entries.original:
"Oh! You found some of the shells
and salts that litter the ocean\lfloor!

Allow me to convert them into a
rare item for you."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You found some of the shells and salts that litter the ocean floor! Allow me to convert them into a rare item for you.
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu menemukan beberapa
cangkang dan garam yang berserakan\ldi dasar laut! Izinkan aku

mengubahnya menjadi item langka
untukmu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over
4 [buffer1]s and 4 [buffer2]s."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over 4 [buffer1]s and 4 [buffer2]s.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan 4 [buffer1] dan
4 [buffer2].

entries.original:
"Each day, rare shells and salts
appear on the ocean floor.

If you can bring me [green]4[blue] of these [green]Sea
Shells[blue] and [green]4[blue] of these [green]Sea Salts[blue],\lI can convert them into a rare item\lfor you."
entries.translation_source: Each day, rare shells and salts appear on the ocean floor. If you can bring me [green]4[blue] of these [green]Sea Shells[blue] and [green]4[blue] of these [green]Sea Salts[blue], I can convert them into a rare item for you.
entries.translated:
Setiap hari, cangkang dan garam
langka muncul di dasar laut. Jika\lkamu bisa membawakanku [green]4[blue] dari

[green]Cangkang Laut[blue] ini dan [green]4[blue] dari [green]Garam
Laut[blue] ini, aku bisa mengubahnya\lmenjadi item langka untukmu.

entries.original:
"Do you know of the Creation Plates?

They’re said to have a strong
connection to the Pokémon known\las Arceus.

Many believe these plates can only
be found by digging them up, but I\lbelieve otherwise.

The different Shards that litter
the region bear a strong connection\lto the Creation Plates.

I wonder if I can form new
Creation Plates from Shards\."
entries.translation_source: Do you know of the Creation Plates? They’re said to have a strong connection to the Pokémon known as Arceus. Many believe these plates can only be found by digging them up, but I believe otherwise. The different Shards that litter the region bear a strong connection to the Creation Plates. I wonder if I can form new Creation Plates from Shards\.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tahu tentang Plat
Penciptaan? Mereka dikatakan\lmemiliki hubungan kuat dengan

Pokémon yang dikenal sebagai
Arceus. Banyak yang percaya bahwa\lplat ini hanya bisa ditemukan

dengan menggali, tapi aku percaya
sebaliknya. Berbagai Pecahan yang\ltersebar di wilayah ini memiliki

hubungan kuat dengan Plat
Penciptaan. Aku penasaran apakah\laku bisa membentuk Plat Penciptaan

baru dari Pecahan\.

entries.original:
"I have recently developed a
mechanism for converting Shards\linto copies of Creation Plates.

Would you like to trade some of
your Shards for these Plates?"
entries.translation_source: I have recently developed a mechanism for converting Shards into copies of Creation Plates. Would you like to trade some of your Shards for these Plates?
entries.translated:
Aku baru saja mengembangkan
mekanisme untuk mengubah Pecahan\lmenjadi salinan Plat Penciptaan.

Apakah kamu ingin menukar beberapa
Pecahanmu dengan Plat-Plat ini?

entries.original:
"Would you like to trade more of
your Shards for these Plates?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to trade more of your Shards for these Plates?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin menukar lebih
banyak Pecahanmu dengan Plat-Plat\lini?

entries.original:
"Would you like to trade some of
your Shards for these Plates?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to trade some of your Shards for these Plates?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin menukar beberapa
Pecahanmu dengan Plat-Plat ini?

entries.original: "You would like a [green][buffer2][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You would like a [green][buffer2][red]?
entries.translated: Kamu ingin [green][buffer2][red]?

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over:
\\0C"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over: \\0C
entries.translated: [black][player] menyerahkan: \\0C

entries.original:
"Shards can easily be found by
smashing rocks in the [green]Great Desert[red],\lor by using the [green]ADM[red] to dig them up."
entries.translation_source: Shards can easily be found by smashing rocks in the [green]Great Desert[red], or by using the [green]ADM[red] to dig them up.
entries.translated:
Pecahan dapat dengan mudah
ditemukan dengan menghancurkan batu\ldi [green]Great Desert[red], atau dengan
