menggunakan [green]ADM[red] untuk menggali
mereka.

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough Shards for
the [green][buffer2][red].

You will need:
[green]\\0C"
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough Shards for the [green][buffer2][red]. You will need: [green]\\0C
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup Pecahan
untuk [green][buffer2][red]. Kamu perlu: [green]\\0C

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine is currently having
engine trouble.

We are not currently boarding
passengers."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine is currently having engine trouble. We are not currently boarding passengers.
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine saat ini mengalami
masalah mesin. Kami saat ini tidak\lmenerima penumpang naik.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the S.S. Marine!

Your ticket is\. right there.
Do you want to board?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the S.S. Marine! Your ticket is\. right there. Do you want to board?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di S.S. Marine!
Tiketmu ada\. di sana. Apakah kamu\lingin naik?

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine leaves once a day
for a voyage between Seaport City\land Polder Town.

When the whistle blows five times,
it means the ship has arrived at\lits destination.

On the ship, the passenger cabins
are full of Trainers who love to\lbattle.

Items can’t be used in battles
against those Trainers, but if you\ldefeat all of the Trainers on board\lbefore the ship reaches its final\ldestination, we’ll give you a prize."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine leaves once a day for a voyage between Seaport City and Polder Town. When the whistle blows five times, it means the ship has arrived at its destination. On the ship, the passenger cabins are full of Trainers who love to battle. Items can’t be used in battles against those Trainers, but if you defeat all of the Trainers on board before the ship reaches its final destination, we’ll give you a prize.
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine berlayar sekali sehari
untuk perjalanan antara Seaport\lCity dan Polder Town. Ketika peluit

berbunyi lima kali, itu berarti
kapal telah tiba di tujuannya. Di\lkapal, kabin penumpang penuh dengan

Pelatih yang suka bertarung. Item
tidak bisa digunakan dalam\lpertarungan melawan Pelatih-Pelatih

itu, tapi jika kamu mengalahkan
semua Pelatih di kapal sebelum\lkapal mencapai tujuan akhir, kami

akan memberimu hadiah.

entries.original: "Please board the ship."
entries.translation_source: Please board the ship.
entries.translated: Silakan naik ke kapal.

entries.original:
"[blue]Congrats on beating all of the
Trainers on board!

Here’s what you get for winning."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Congrats on beating all of the Trainers on board! Here’s what you get for winning.
entries.translated:
[blue]Selamat telah mengalahkan semua
Pelatih di kapal! Inilah yang kamu\ldapatkan karena menang.

entries.original:
"Operating a ship every day can wear
you out! It’s not running today.

It leaves for Polder Town on
[green]Mondays[blue] and [green]Fridays[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Operating a ship every day can wear you out! It’s not running today. It leaves for Polder Town on [green]Mondays[blue] and [green]Fridays[blue]!
entries.translated:
Mengoperasikan kapal setiap hari
bisa melelahkan! Hari ini tidak\lberoperasi. Kapal berlayar ke

Polder Town setiap [green]Senin[blue] dan [green]Jumat[blue]!

entries.original:
"Operating a ship more than once a
day can wear you out!

It already sailed today."
entries.translation_source: Operating a ship more than once a day can wear you out! It already sailed today.
entries.translated:
Mengoperasikan kapal lebih dari
sekali sehari bisa melelahkan!\lKapal sudah berlayar hari ini.

entries.original: "Board"
entries.translation_source: Board
entries.translated: Naik

entries.original:
"Okay!
You must be the last passenger."
entries.translation_source: Okay! You must be the last passenger.
entries.translated: Oke! Kamu pasti penumpang terakhir.

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine usually sets sail
on Mondays and Fridays to East\lBorrius.

But right now I hear it’s having
engine trouble."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine usually sets sail on Mondays and Fridays to East Borrius. But right now I hear it’s having engine trouble.
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine biasanya berlayar pada
hari Senin dan Jumat menuju East\lBorrius. Tapi saat ini aku dengar

sedang mengalami masalah mesin.

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine sets sail to East
Borrius every [green]Monday[blue] and [green]Friday[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine sets sail to East Borrius every [green]Monday[blue] and [green]Friday[blue].
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine berlayar ke East
Borrius setiap [green]Senin[blue] dan [green]Jumat[blue].

entries.original:
"What!?
Engine trouble!?

Sniff\. I just want to go back home
to Magnolia Town\."
entries.translation_source: What!? Engine trouble!? Sniff\. I just want to go back home to Magnolia Town\.
entries.translated:
Apa!? Masalah mesin!? Hiks\. Aku
hanya ingin pulang ke Magnolia Town\.

entries.original:
"I came from overseas to learn more
about the legendary Pokémon\lrumoured to live in the [green]Cave of\lBeing[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I came from overseas to learn more about the legendary Pokémon rumoured to live in the [green]Cave of Being[blue].
entries.translated:
Saya datang dari luar negeri untuk
mempelajari lebih lanjut tentang\lPokémon legendaris yang dikabarkan

tinggal di [green]Gua Keberadaan[blue].

entries.original:
"I have plans to explore the
[green]Tomb of Borrius[blue] while I am here.

I hear many riches await those who
are brave enough to descend into\lits depths."
entries.translation_source: I have plans to explore the [green]Tomb of Borrius[blue] while I am here. I hear many riches await those who are brave enough to descend into its depths.
entries.translated:
Saya punya rencana untuk
menjelajahi [green]Makam Borrius[blue] selama\lsaya di sini. Saya dengar banyak

kekayaan menanti mereka yang cukup
berani turun ke kedalamannya.

entries.original:
"Psst\.

Listen up, Sparky.
I’ve got a sweet deal fo’ you.

In my hand is a ticket to a
special place.

Folks know it as [green]Glimmer Isle[blue].

I can sell it to ya, but it’s
gonna cost ya $[green]999999999[blue].

Whatcha say, Sparky?

You in on the deal of a lifetime?"
entries.translation_source: Psst\. Listen up, Sparky. I’ve got a sweet deal fo’ you. In my hand is a ticket to a special place. Folks know it as [green]Glimmer Isle[blue]. I can sell it to ya, but it’s gonna cost ya $[green]999999999[blue]. Whatcha say, Sparky? You in on the deal of a lifetime?
entries.translated:
Psst\. Dengar, Sparky. Aku punya
tawaran bagus untukmu. Di tanganku\lada tiket ke tempat spesial.

Orang-orang mengenalnya sebagai
[green]Pulau Gemerlap[blue]. Aku bisa menjualnya\lpadamu, tapi harganya $[green]999999999[blue].

Bagaimana, Sparky? Kau tertarik
dengan tawaran seumur hidup?

entries.original:
"Come on, Sparky.
Don’t be pulling my leg.

I see you don’t have enough cash."
entries.translation_source: Come on, Sparky. Don’t be pulling my leg. I see you don’t have enough cash.
entries.translated:
Ayolah, Sparky. Jangan bercanda.
Aku lihat kau tidak punya cukup\luang.

entries.original: "See you around, Sparky\."
entries.translation_source: See you around, Sparky\.
entries.translated: Sampai jumpa, Sparky\.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

To weather, or not to weather\.
What does this truly mean?

Only the weather will tell!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! To weather, or not to weather\. What does this truly mean? Only the weather will tell!
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Untuk cuaca, atau
tidak untuk cuaca\. Apa artinya ini\lsebenarnya? Hanya cuaca yang akan

memberi tahu!

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!
You found all us clowns!

To think, someone has found all of
us\. you must truly be a master\lof weather!

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! You found all us clowns! To think, someone has found all of us\. you must truly be a master of weather! For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Kamu menemukan
kami semua badut! Bayangkan,\lseseorang telah menemukan kita

semua\. kamu pasti benar-benar ahli
cuaca! Untuk itu, kamu mendapat\lrasa terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

That [green]Castform[blue] is a rare Pokémon
indeed!

And like you, it is both master of
weather and friendship!

’Til your travels bringeth us
together again, I bid you adieu."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! That [green]Castform[blue] is a rare Pokémon indeed! And like you, it is both master of weather and friendship! ’Til your travels bringeth us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! [green]Castform[blue] itu
memang Pokémon langka! Dan\lsepertimu, ia adalah ahli cuaca dan

persahabatan! Sampai perjalananmu
mempertemukan kita lagi, aku pamit.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

But first, make space in your
party."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! But first, make space in your party.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Tapi pertama,
buatlah ruang di timmu.

entries.original:
"Good day.

Welcome to the Camomons Battle
House.

In this house, all Pokémon become
the same types as their first two\lmoves.

Feel free to battle any of the
Trainers here as many times as\lyou wish.

If you need an explanation of the
battle type here, please come and\lspeak with me."
entries.translation_source: Good day. Welcome to the Camomons Battle House. In this house, all Pokémon become the same types as their first two moves. Feel free to battle any of the Trainers here as many times as you wish. If you need an explanation of the battle type here, please come and speak with me.
entries.translated:
Selamat siang. Selamat datang di
Rumah Pertarungan Camomons. Di\lrumah ini, semua Pokémon menjadi

tipe yang sama dengan dua jurus
pertama mereka. Jangan ragu untuk\lbertarung dengan Pelatih mana pun

di sini sebanyak yang kamu mau.
Jika kamu membutuhkan penjelasan\ltentang tipe pertarungan di sini,

silakan datang dan bicara denganku.

entries.original:
"Battles here are fought utilizing
the [green]Camomons[red] battle format.

In a Camomons battle, all Pokémon
become the same types as their\lfirst two moves.

For instance, if a Pokémon’s first
two moves are Ember and Water Gun,\lthen it will become a Fire- and\lWater-type."
entries.translation_source: Battles here are fought utilizing the [green]Camomons[red] battle format. In a Camomons battle, all Pokémon become the same types as their first two moves. For instance, if a Pokémon’s first two moves are Ember and Water Gun, then it will become a Fire- and Water-type.
entries.translated:
Pertarungan di sini dilakukan
dengan format pertarungan [green]Camomons[red].\lDalam pertarungan Camomons, semua

Pokémon menjadi tipe yang sama
dengan dua jurus pertama mereka.\lMisalnya, jika dua jurus pertama

Pokémon adalah Bara Api dan Pistol
Air, maka ia akan menjadi tipe Api\ldan Air.

entries.original:
"The [green]Timer Ball[red] may not be useful at
the start of battle, but it’s\lgreat for long, drawn out battles\lwith legendary Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The [green]Timer Ball[red] may not be useful at the start of battle, but it’s great for long, drawn out battles with legendary Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Bola Timer ([green]Timer Ball[red]) mungkin
tidak berguna di awal pertarungan,\ltapi bagus untuk pertarungan

panjang yang berlarut-larut dengan
Pokémon legendaris.

entries.original:
"Forget Timer Balls, the [green]Heavy Ball[blue]
is the ideal Ball for capturing\llegendary Pokémon!

Many of them are super heavy, and
the Heavy Ball winds up having a\lbetter chance to capture any of\lthem than a maxed Timer Ball.

Don’t believe me?

Just set your [green]Last Used Ball[blue] to
[green]Always Best Ball[blue] in the [green]Options\lMenu[blue] and see for yourself!

You can buy Heavy Balls out in the
[green]marketplace[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Forget Timer Balls, the [green]Heavy Ball[blue] is the ideal Ball for capturing legendary Pokémon! Many of them are super heavy, and the Heavy Ball winds up having a better chance to capture any of them than a maxed Timer Ball. Don’t believe me? Just set your [green]Last Used Ball[blue] to [green]Always Best Ball[blue] in the [green]Options Menu[blue] and see for yourself! You can buy Heavy Balls out in the [green]marketplace[blue].
entries.translated:
Lupakan Bola Timer, Bola Berat
([green]Heavy Ball[blue]) adalah Bola ideal\luntuk menangkap Pokémon legendaris!

Banyak dari mereka sangat berat,
dan Bola Berat memiliki peluang\llebih baik untuk menangkap salah

satu dari mereka daripada Bola
Timer yang maksimal. Tidak percaya?\lAtur saja [green]Bola Terakhir Digunakan[blue]

menjadi [green]Selalu Bola Terbaik[blue] di [green]Menu
Opsi[blue] dan lihat sendiri! Kamu bisa\lmembeli Bola Berat di [green]pasar[blue].

entries.original:
"Battling in the [green]Camomons
Battle House[blue] is a great way to\ltrain your Pokémon quickly.

But don’t forget to set the order
of your Pokémon’s moves before\lbattling there!"
entries.translation_source: Battling in the [green]Camomons Battle House[blue] is a great way to train your Pokémon quickly. But don’t forget to set the order of your Pokémon’s moves before battling there!
entries.translated:
Bertarung di [green]Rumah Pertarungan
Camomons[blue] adalah cara yang bagus\luntuk melatih Pokémonmu dengan

cepat. Tapi jangan lupa mengatur
urutan jurus Pokémonmu sebelum\lbertarung di sana!

entries.original:
"I hear one of the vendors in the
market sells special Poké Balls\limported all the way from Johto!"
entries.translation_source: I hear one of the vendors in the market sells special Poké Balls imported all the way from Johto!
entries.translated:
Kudengar salah satu pedagang di
pasar menjual Bola Poké khusus yang\ldiimpor langsung dari Johto!

entries.original:
"Some days I can hear a sad cry
reverberating across the crates."
entries.translation_source: Some days I can hear a sad cry reverberating across the crates.
entries.translated:
Beberapa hari aku bisa mendengar
tangisan sedih yang bergema di\lseluruh peti-peti.

entries.original:
"Do you hear that?

I’ve been hearing that Pokémon’s
cry all day.

It sounds very sad and lonely,
don’t you think?"
entries.translation_source: Do you hear that? I’ve been hearing that Pokémon’s cry all day. It sounds very sad and lonely, don’t you think?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu mendengar itu? Aku
sudah mendengar tangisan Pokémon\litu sepanjang hari. Kedengarannya

sangat sedih dan kesepian, bukan?

entries.original: "[green]Kyu! Kyu!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Kyu! Kyu!
entries.translated: [green]Kyu! Kyu!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] ran off into the
warehouse."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] ran off into the warehouse.
entries.translated: The [buffer1] lari ke gudang.

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened."
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened.
entries.translated:
Pintu membutuhkan Kartu Kunci
dengan Level Izin: [green][buffer1][black], untuk\ldibuka.

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened.

Open it?"
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened. Open it?
entries.translated:
Pintu memerlukan Kartu Kunci dengan
Level Akses: [green][buffer1][black], untuk\ldibuka. Bukakan?

entries.original:
"Bingo!
The Key Card opened the door!"
entries.translation_source: Bingo! The Key Card opened the door!
entries.translated: Bingo! Kartu Kunci membuka pintu!

entries.original: "The door is open\."
entries.translation_source: The door is open\.
entries.translated: Pintu terbuka\.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] seems lonely.
Accept it onto your team?"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] seems lonely. Accept it onto your team?
entries.translated:
[buffer1] tampak kesepian. Terima
dia ke dalam timmu?

entries.original: "The [buffer1] is sad."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1] is sad.
entries.translated: [buffer1] sedih.

entries.original:
"Huh?

It looks like [green][buffer1][black] wants to
come out of its Poké Ball and walk\laround with you!

Let [green][buffer1][black] out?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? It looks like [green][buffer1][black] wants to come out of its Poké Ball and walk around with you! Let [green][buffer1][black] out?
entries.translated:
Hah? Sepertinya [green][buffer1][black] ingin
keluar dari Poké Ball-nya dan\lberjalan-jalan denganmu! Biarkan

[green][buffer1][black] keluar?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] started walking behind
you!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] started walking behind you!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] mulai berjalan di
belakangmu!

entries.original:
"[buffer1] will return to its
Poké Ball if you leave the room."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] will return to its Poké Ball if you leave the room.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] akan kembali ke Poké
Ball-nya jika kamu meninggalkan\lruangan.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] is happily following
behind you."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] is happily following behind you.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] dengan gembira mengikuti
di belakangmu.

entries.original:
"Oh? It looks like [buffer1] wants
you to have something it found."
entries.translation_source: Oh? It looks like [buffer1] wants you to have something it found.
entries.translated:
Oh? Sepertinya [buffer1] ingin kamu
memiliki sesuatu yang ditemukannya.

entries.original:
"That guy\. he just came out of
nowhere\."
entries.translation_source: That guy\. he just came out of nowhere\.
entries.translated: Orang itu\. dia muncul begitu saja\.

entries.original: "Wiped out in an instant\."
entries.translation_source: Wiped out in an instant\.
entries.translated: Lenyap dalam sekejap\.

entries.original:
"This guy with red hair just came
out of nowhere and knocked out all\lof my Pokémon before I even had a\lchance to react!

Now I can’t even stop you
from escaping\."
entries.translation_source: This guy with red hair just came out of nowhere and knocked out all of my Pokémon before I even had a chance to react! Now I can’t even stop you from escaping\.
entries.translated:
Orang berambut merah ini muncul
begitu saja dan melumpuhkan semua\lPokémon-ku sebelum aku sempat

bereaksi! Sekarang aku bahkan tidak
bisa menghentikanmu melarikan diri\.

entries.original:
"The door appears to have been
blown apart."
entries.translation_source: The door appears to have been blown apart.
entries.translated: Pintu tampaknya telah diledakkan.

entries.original:
"Oh, sir!

Some guy with red hair blasted his
way in here!

I tried to stop him, but he just
shoved me aside."
entries.translation_source: Oh, sir! Some guy with red hair blasted his way in here! I tried to stop him, but he just shoved me aside.
entries.translated:
Oh, Tuan! Sesosok pria berambut
merah menerobos masuk ke sini! Aku\lmencoba menghentikannya, tapi dia

hanya mendorongku ke samping.

entries.original: "Which floor would you like, sir?"
entries.translation_source: Which floor would you like, sir?
entries.translated:
Lantai berapa yang Anda inginkan,
Tuan?

entries.original: "Which floor do you want?"
entries.translation_source: Which floor do you want?
entries.translated: Kamu ingin lantai berapa?

entries.original: "You’re already on this floor\."
entries.translation_source: You’re already on this floor\.
entries.translated: Kamu sudah di lantai ini\.

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I know what it looks like, but I
promise, I’m not slacking off!

Zeph told me to watch the news and
keep an eye out for anyone who\llooks like they might belong to\lthe Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I know what it looks like, but I promise, I’m not slacking off! Zeph told me to watch the news and keep an eye out for anyone who looks like they might belong to the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Marlon, Tuan! Saya tahu ini
kelihatannya, tapi saya janji, saya\ltidak bermalas-malasan! Zeph

menyuruh saya untuk menonton berita
dan mewaspadai siapa pun yang\lterlihat seperti anggota Light of

Ruin.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry about the huge mess in
the base, sir.

When most of the grunts left to
join the Light of Ruin, they just\ldropped all of their things on\lthe floor.

I’m sure some of them even left
their [green]clearance cards[red] behind\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry about the huge mess in the base, sir. When most of the grunts left to join the Light of Ruin, they just dropped all of their things on the floor. I’m sure some of them even left their [green]clearance cards[red] behind\.
entries.translated:
Saya minta maaf atas kekacauan yang
besar di markas, Tuan. Ketika\lsebagian besar prajurit pergi untuk

bergabung dengan Light of Ruin,
mereka menjatuhkan semua barang\lmereka ke lantai. Saya yakin

beberapa dari mereka bahkan
meninggalkan kartu akses [green]mereka[red] di\lbelakang\.

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I heard rumours that you joined
the Light of Ruin, too.

I’m glad you’re still here.

Maybe now that you’re back, someone
will finally be able to keep Zeph\lfrom doing anything too rash\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I heard rumours that you joined the Light of Ruin, too. I’m glad you’re still here. Maybe now that you’re back, someone will finally be able to keep Zeph from doing anything too rash\.
entries.translated:
Marlon, Tuan! Saya mendengar rumor
bahwa Anda juga bergabung dengan\lLight of Ruin. Saya senang Anda

masih di sini. Mungkin sekarang
setelah Anda kembali, seseorang\lakhirnya bisa mencegah Zeph

melakukan sesuatu yang terlalu
gegabah\.

entries.original:
"The base has been so quiet ever
since most of the grunts were\lordered to join the Light of Ruin.

To be honest, sir, I was ordered to
go, too, but I refused.

I didn’t join this organization
because I wanted money.

I joined because I believed in what
Zeph was trying to achieve\."
entries.translation_source: The base has been so quiet ever since most of the grunts were ordered to join the Light of Ruin. To be honest, sir, I was ordered to go, too, but I refused. I didn’t join this organization because I wanted money. I joined because I believed in what Zeph was trying to achieve\.
entries.translated:
Markas menjadi sangat sepi sejak
sebagian besar prajurit\ldiperintahkan untuk bergabung

dengan Light of Ruin. Sejujurnya,
Tuan, saya juga diperintahkan untuk\lpergi, tetapi saya menolak. Saya

tidak bergabung dengan organisasi
ini karena saya menginginkan uang.\lSaya bergabung karena saya percaya

pada apa yang Zeph coba capai\.

entries.original:
"With most of the other grunts gone,
our manpower has become very\llimited.

So, it is essential that each of us
become as strong as possible.

Would you allow me the privilege of
battling with you, sir?"
entries.translation_source: With most of the other grunts gone, our manpower has become very limited. So, it is essential that each of us become as strong as possible. Would you allow me the privilege of battling with you, sir?
entries.translated:
Dengan perginya sebagian besar
prajurit lainnya, tenaga kami\lmenjadi sangat terbatas. Jadi,

penting bagi kita masing-masing
untuk menjadi sekuat mungkin.\lMaukah Anda mengizinkan saya

keistimewaan untuk bertarung dengan
Anda, Tuan?

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me,
sir.

Now, we’re both more prepared for
the inevitable confrontation with\lthe Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me, sir. Now, we’re both more prepared for the inevitable confrontation with the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah bertarung dengan
saya, Tuan. Sekarang, kita berdua\llebih siap untuk konfrontasi yang

tak terhindarkan dengan Light of
Ruin.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I wouldn’t expect you to waste your
time on a grunt such as myself."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I wouldn’t expect you to waste your time on a grunt such as myself.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Tuan. Saya tidak akan
mengharapkan Anda membuang waktu\luntuk seorang prajurit seperti

saya.

entries.original:
"An obnoxiously loud episode of a
Unova Pokémon Musical is on.

Watch for too long and it might
fry your brain."
entries.translation_source: An obnoxiously loud episode of a Unova Pokémon Musical is on. Watch for too long and it might fry your brain.
entries.translated:
Sebuah episode Unova Pokémon
Musical yang sangat berisik sedang\ldiputar. Menonton terlalu lama bisa

menggoreng otak Anda.

entries.original:
"Sir!

Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone
without the proper clearance from\lentering the lab.

However, I’m sure it’s fine if I
allow you in."
entries.translation_source: Sir! Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone without the proper clearance from entering the lab. However, I’m sure it’s fine if I allow you in.
entries.translated:
Tuan! Zeph memerintahkan saya untuk
menghentikan siapa pun yang tidak\lmemiliki izin yang tepat untuk

memasuki laboratorium. Namun, saya
yakin tidak masalah jika saya\lmengizinkan Anda masuk.

entries.original:
"Please feel free to enter the
lab, sir."
entries.translation_source: Please feel free to enter the lab, sir.
entries.translated:
Silakan masuk ke laboratorium,
Tuan.

entries.original:
"I’m using a complicated algorithm
to determine the approximate\llocation of the Light of Ruin HQ.

Once I have the results, Zeph plans
on using the information to take\lhis revenge on the Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: I’m using a complicated algorithm to determine the approximate location of the Light of Ruin HQ. Once I have the results, Zeph plans on using the information to take his revenge on the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Saya menggunakan algoritma rumit
untuk menentukan perkiraan lokasi\lmarkas Light of Ruin. Setelah saya

mendapatkan hasilnya, Zeph
berencana menggunakan informasi itu\luntuk membalas dendam pada Light of

Ruin.

entries.original:
"Oh, Marlon, sir!

I spent some time back at HQ with
the Science Society, and learned\labout a new way to make our\lPokémon stronger in battles!

Would you like to see it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Marlon, sir! I spent some time back at HQ with the Science Society, and learned about a new way to make our Pokémon stronger in battles! Would you like to see it?
entries.translated:
Oh, Marlon, Tuan! Saya menghabiskan
waktu di markas bersama Science\lSociety, dan belajar cara baru

untuk membuat Pokémon kita lebih
kuat dalam pertempuran! Apakah Anda\lingin melihatnya?

entries.original:
"For spending your valuable time
battling me, I’d like to thank you\lby healing your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: For spending your valuable time battling me, I’d like to thank you by healing your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Karena telah meluangkan waktu
berharga Anda untuk bertarung\ldengan saya, saya ingin berterima

kasih dengan menyembuhkan Pokémon
Anda.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I’m sure you have much more
important business to attend to."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I’m sure you have much more important business to attend to.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Tuan. Saya yakin Anda
memiliki urusan yang jauh lebih\lpenting untuk diurus.

entries.original:
"Great care is being taken in
synthesizing this next batch of\lShadow Warriors.

These Shadow Warriors will be the
strongest we’ve ever created!

They’ll be invincible!

And the Light of Ruin will stand no
chance against them!"
entries.translation_source: Great care is being taken in synthesizing this next batch of Shadow Warriors. These Shadow Warriors will be the strongest we’ve ever created! They’ll be invincible! And the Light of Ruin will stand no chance against them!
entries.translated:
Perhatian besar diberikan dalam
mensintesis kumpulan Shadow\lWarriors berikutnya. Shadow

Warriors ini akan menjadi yang
terkuat yang pernah kita ciptakan!\lMereka akan tak terkalahkan! Dan

Light of Ruin tidak akan memiliki
kesempatan melawan mereka!

entries.original:
"They wanted us to go back to HQ
and stop making Shadow Warriors.

STOP MAKING SHADOW WARRIORS!?

ARE YOU KIDDING ME!?

Creating Shadow Warriors is all I
live for!

I’m fortunate that Zeph still had a
use for more and allowed me to\lcontinue synthesizing them."
entries.translation_source: They wanted us to go back to HQ and stop making Shadow Warriors. STOP MAKING SHADOW WARRIORS!? ARE YOU KIDDING ME!? Creating Shadow Warriors is all I live for! I’m fortunate that Zeph still had a use for more and allowed me to continue synthesizing them.
entries.translated:
Mereka ingin kita kembali ke markas
dan berhenti membuat Shadow\lWarriors. BERHENTI MEMBUAT SHADOW

WARRIORS!? APA KAMU BERCANDA!?
Menciptakan Shadow Warriors adalah\lsemua yang saya jalani! Saya

beruntung Zeph masih membutuhkan
lebih banyak dan mengizinkan saya\luntuk terus mensintesis mereka.

entries.original:
"Something grotesque is being
synthesized in the tube."
entries.translation_source: Something grotesque is being synthesized in the tube.
entries.translated:
Sesuatu yang mengerikan sedang
disintesis di dalam tabung.

entries.original: "The tube is empty."
entries.translation_source: The tube is empty.
entries.translated: Tabung itu kosong.

entries.original: "The cage is empty."
entries.translation_source: The cage is empty.
entries.translated: Kandangnya kosong.

entries.original:
"Someone has been experimenting
today\."
entries.translation_source: Someone has been experimenting today\.
entries.translated:
Seseorang telah bereksperimen hari
ini\.

entries.original:
"Ah, [player]\. it is good of you to
visit us.

I have been trying to live a more
honourable life since I was\lreleased from prison.

I owe my son, of course, every
effort to make sure this second\lchance does not go to waste.

Having toiled for years to see him
return to me, I plan to let the\lyounger generation guide the future\lfrom now on.

As for me, my only desire is to spend
what time I have with Zeph Jr.

Ah, yes\. would you care to spar with
me, if you have time?

My son seems to have grown rather
fond of Pokémon battles, after all."
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player]\. it is good of you to visit us. I have been trying to live a more honourable life since I was released from prison. I owe my son, of course, every effort to make sure this second chance does not go to waste. Having toiled for years to see him return to me, I plan to let the younger generation guide the future from now on. As for me, my only desire is to spend what time I have with Zeph Jr. Ah, yes\. would you care to spar with me, if you have time? My son seems to have grown rather fond of Pokémon battles, after all.
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]\. senang Anda
mengunjungi kami. Saya telah\lberusaha hidup lebih terhormat

sejak dibebaskan dari penjara.
Tentu saja, saya berutang pada\lputra saya, setiap upaya untuk

memastikan kesempatan kedua ini
tidak sia-sia. Setelah bekerja\lkeras selama bertahun-tahun untuk

melihatnya kembali kepada saya,
saya berencana membiarkan generasi\lmuda memandu masa depan mulai

sekarang. Adapun saya, satu-satunya
keinginan saya adalah menghabiskan\lwaktu yang saya miliki bersama Zeph

Jr. Ah, ya\. maukah Anda berlatih
dengan saya, jika Anda punya waktu?\lPutra saya tampaknya sudah cukup

menyukai pertarungan Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes\. would you care to spar with
me, if you have time?

My son seems to have grown rather
fond of Pokémon battles, after all."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes\. would you care to spar with me, if you have time? My son seems to have grown rather fond of Pokémon battles, after all.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya\. maukah Anda berlatih dengan
saya, jika Anda punya waktu? Putra\lsaya tampaknya sudah cukup menyukai

pertarungan Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I see\. yes, I suppose there’s not
much reason for us to be at each\lother’s throats\.

Peace may have returned to us, but
it needn’t be anything more than a\lfriendly competition.

If you change your mind, I would be
willing to take you on, anytime."
entries.translation_source: I see\. yes, I suppose there’s not much reason for us to be at each other’s throats\. Peace may have returned to us, but it needn’t be anything more than a friendly competition. If you change your mind, I would be willing to take you on, anytime.
entries.translated:
Begitu\. ya, kurasa tidak banyak
alasan bagi kita untuk saling\lbermusuhan\. Perdamaian mungkin telah

kembali kepada kita, tapi itu tidak
perlu lebih dari sekadar kompetisi\lpersahabatan. Jika Anda berubah

pikiran, saya bersedia melawan
Anda, kapan saja.

entries.original:
"Finally, a chance presents itself, to
fight with a clear conscience\.

Well, [player], don’t expect me to
hold back.

I have to put on a good showing for
my son, after all!"
entries.translation_source: Finally, a chance presents itself, to fight with a clear conscience\. Well, [player], don’t expect me to hold back. I have to put on a good showing for my son, after all!
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, kesempatan muncul, untuk
bertarung dengan hati nurani yang\lbersih\. Baiklah, [player], jangan

harap saya menahan diri. Saya harus
memberikan pertunjukan yang bagus\luntuk putra saya!

entries.original:
"I don’t think I’ve felt so satisfied
after a loss, in a good long time.

I should really thank you,
[player].

Your actions not only brought my son
back to me\.

But I should also be grateful you
took time from your busy life to\lkeep him amused.

Please, accept this gift from me."
entries.translation_source: I don’t think I’ve felt so satisfied after a loss, in a good long time. I should really thank you, [player]. Your actions not only brought my son back to me\. But I should also be grateful you took time from your busy life to keep him amused. Please, accept this gift from me.
entries.translated:
Kurasa aku tidak pernah merasa
begitu puas setelah kalah, untuk\lwaktu yang lama. Aku benar-benar

harus berterima kasih, [player].
Tindakanmu tidak hanya membawa\lputraku kembali kepadaku\. Tapi aku

juga harus bersyukur kamu
meluangkan waktu dari kehidupan\lsibukmu untuk menghiburnya. Tolong,

terima hadiah ini dariku.

entries.original:
"The Z-Crystal is for the Pokémon
[green]Decidueye[blue].

If it knows [green][buffer1][blue], it can power
it up into a devastating Z-Move."
entries.translation_source: The Z-Crystal is for the Pokémon [green]Decidueye[blue]. If it knows [green][buffer1][blue], it can power it up into a devastating Z-Move.
entries.translated:
Z-Crystal ini untuk Pokémon
[green]Decidueye[blue]. Jika ia tahu [green][buffer1][blue],\lia dapat meningkatkannya menjadi

Z-Move yang dahsyat.

entries.original:
"Thank you again for that battle.

Even if I lost again, as long as it
makes my son happy, then that’s all\lthat really matters to me.

Feel free to come another day if you
wish to spar again, sometime."
entries.translation_source: Thank you again for that battle. Even if I lost again, as long as it makes my son happy, then that’s all that really matters to me. Feel free to come another day if you wish to spar again, sometime.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih lagi untuk pertarungan
itu. Meskipun saya kalah lagi,\lselama itu membuat putra saya

bahagia, maka itulah yang
terpenting bagi saya. Silakan\ldatang di lain hari jika kamu ingin

berlatih lagi, kapan-kapan.

entries.original:
"Whoa!

You’re the Trainer that helped my
daddy bring me back from the dark\lplace!

You’re so cool!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa! You’re the Trainer that helped my daddy bring me back from the dark place! You’re so cool!
entries.translated:
Whoa! Kamu adalah Pelatih yang
membantu ayahku membawaku kembali\ldari tempat gelap! Kamu keren!

entries.original:
"Whoa!

Your battle with my daddy was so
fun to watch.

I wanna be a Pokémon Trainer when
I grow up, too!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa! Your battle with my daddy was so fun to watch. I wanna be a Pokémon Trainer when I grow up, too!
entries.translated:
Whoa! Pertarunganmu dengan ayahku
sangat menyenangkan untuk ditonton.\lAku ingin menjadi Pelatih Pokémon

ketika aku besar nanti!

A quiet town nestled deep in the
mountains."
entries.translation_source: Bellin Town A quiet town nestled deep in the mountains.
entries.translated:
Bellin Town Sebuah kota tenang yang
terletak jauh di pegunungan.

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Ice-type Pokémon, Articuno.

It says here that Articuno was once
used to reinforce a seal on a great\ldarkness, but now it likes to\ltravel between Frost Mountain\land Frozen Heights."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Ice-type Pokémon, Articuno. It says here that Articuno was once used to reinforce a seal on a great darkness, but now it likes to travel between Frost Mountain and Frozen Heights.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah patung Pokémon
Legendaris tipe Es, Articuno. Di\lsini tertulis bahwa Articuno pernah

digunakan untuk memperkuat segel
pada kegelapan besar, tetapi\lsekarang ia suka bepergian antara

Frost Mountain dan Frozen Heights.

entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Fire-type Pokémon, Moltres. It says here that Moltres was once used to reinforce a seal on a great darkness, but now it resides in Cinder Volcano.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah patung Pokémon
Legendaris Tipe Api, Moltres.\lTertulis di sini bahwa Moltres

pernah digunakan untuk memperkuat
segel pada kegelapan besar, tetapi\lsekarang ia tinggal di Gunung Api

Cinder.

entries.original:

"[black]It’s a news report:

The Terror Granbull, the notorious
gang known for helping establish\lAntisis City as a hotbed of crime,\lhas disappeared!

Will this usher in a new age of
peace and prosperity for the city?

Citizens are encouraged to leave
their homes and restore Antisis\lCity to its former glory."
entries.translation_source: [black]It’s a news report: The Terror Granbull, the notorious gang known for helping establish Antisis City as a hotbed of crime, has disappeared! Will this usher in a new age of peace and prosperity for the city? Citizens are encouraged to leave their homes and restore Antisis City to its former glory.
entries.translated:
[black]Ini adalah laporan berita: The
Terror Granbull, geng terkenal yang\ldikenal karena membantu menjadikan

Antisis City sebagai sarang
kejahatan, telah menghilang!\lAkankah ini membawa era baru

perdamaian dan kemakmuran bagi
kota? Warga didorong untuk\lmeninggalkan rumah mereka dan

mengembalikan Antisis City ke
kejayaannya semula.

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

Don’t walk away from these signs
until you’ve read them completely!

Every single one contains important
information that will help you out\lduring your adventure.

Skipping text on these signs will
likely cost you!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Trainer Tips! Don’t walk away from these signs until you’ve read them completely! Every single one contains important information that will help you out during your adventure. Skipping text on these signs will likely cost you!
entries.translated:
[black]Tips Pelatih! Jangan menjauh dari
papan-papan ini sampai kamu\lmembacanya sepenuhnya! Setiap papan

berisi informasi penting yang akan
membantumu selama petualangan.\lMelewatkan teks di papan-papan ini

kemungkinan besar akan merugikanmu!

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

Hold \btn01 to change the default
movement speed!

Press \btn02 to toggle auto-run!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Trainer Tips! Hold \btn01 to change the default movement speed! Press \btn02 to toggle auto-run!
entries.translated:
[black]Tips Pelatih! Tahan \btn01 untuk
mengubah kecepatan gerak default!\lTekan \btn02 untuk mengaktifkan

auto-run!

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

Open the [green]Options[black] Menu to enable
Save Prompts and Quick HMs!

If [green]Save Prompts[black] are turned on, you
will be asked if you’d like to save\lbefore or after important events!

If [green]Quick HMs[black] are turned on, Field
Moves can be used without needing\lconfirmation each use!

Additionally, \btn02 and \btn03 can be used
to scroll between pages of options!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Trainer Tips! Open the [green]Options[black] Menu to enable Save Prompts and Quick HMs! If [green]Save Prompts[black] are turned on, you will be asked if you’d like to save before or after important events! If [green]Quick HMs[black] are turned on, Field Moves can be used without needing confirmation each use! Additionally, \btn02 and \btn03 can be used to scroll between pages of options!
entries.translated:
[black]Tips Pelatih! Buka Menu [green]Opsi[black] untuk
mengaktifkan Konfirmasi Simpan dan\lHM Cepat! Jika [green]Konfirmasi Simpan[black]

diaktifkan, kamu akan ditanya
apakah ingin menyimpan sebelum atau\lsetelah kejadian penting! Jika [green]HM

Cepat[black] diaktifkan, Gerakan Lapangan
dapat digunakan tanpa perlu\lkonfirmasi setiap kali! Selain itu,

\btn02 dan \btn03 dapat digunakan untuk
menggulir antar halaman opsi!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Pokémon can gain Exp. Points by
battling other Pokémon.

Exp. Points help them grow
stronger.

And your Pokémon will still get
Exp. Points even if you catch a\lPokémon you are battling against!

But keep in mind, if your Pokémon
level up too much, other Trainers\lwill get stronger as well.

In order to prevent issues from
arising due to overleveling such\las increased difficulty, a hard\llevel cap may be enabled from the\l[green]Options Menu[black] by setting [green]Exp. Gain[black]\lto [green]Capped Exp. Share[black]."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Pokémon can gain Exp. Points by battling other Pokémon. Exp. Points help them grow stronger. And your Pokémon will still get Exp. Points even if you catch a Pokémon you are battling against! But keep in mind, if your Pokémon level up too much, other Trainers will get stronger as well. In order to prevent issues from arising due to overleveling such as increased difficulty, a hard level cap may be enabled from the [green]Options Menu[black] by setting [green]Exp. Gain[black] to [green]Capped Exp. Share[black].
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Pokémon bisa
mendapatkan Poin Exp. dengan\lbertarung melawan Pokémon lain.

Poin Exp. membantu mereka tumbuh
lebih kuat. Dan Pokémon-mu tetap\lakan mendapatkan Poin Exp. bahkan

jika kamu menangkap Pokémon yang
sedang kamu lawan! Namun perlu\ldiingat, jika Pokémon-mu naik level

terlalu banyak, Pelatih lain juga
akan menjadi lebih kuat. Untuk\lmencegah masalah akibat level

berlebih seperti meningkatnya
kesulitan, batas level keras dapat\ldiaktifkan dari [green]Menu Opsi[black] dengan

mengatur [green]Perolehan Exp.[black] menjadi
[green]Pembagi Exp. Terbatas[black].

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

If you talk to this Chansey, your
Pokémon will be fully healed!

Whenever you lose a battle, you’ll
be returned to this point as well!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! If you talk to this Chansey, your Pokémon will be fully healed! Whenever you lose a battle, you’ll be returned to this point as well!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Jika kamu berbicara
dengan Chansey ini, Pokémon-mu akan\ldipulihkan sepenuhnya! Setiap kali

kamu kalah dalam pertarungan, kamu
akan dikembalikan ke titik ini\ljuga!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Any Pokémon that participates in
battle receives full Exp. Points.

If the [green]Exp. Share[black] is enabled in
the [green]Options[black] Menu, any Pokémon\lthat didn’t participate will still\lreceive a portion of the Exp.\lPoints earned in battle."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Any Pokémon that participates in battle receives full Exp. Points. If the [green]Exp. Share[black] is enabled in the [green]Options[black] Menu, any Pokémon that didn’t participate will still receive a portion of the Exp. Points earned in battle.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Pokémon mana pun yang
berpartisipasi dalam pertarungan\lmenerima Poin Exp. penuh. Jika

[green]Pembagi Exp.[black] diaktifkan di Menu
[green]Opsi[black], Pokémon yang tidak\lberpartisipasi tetap akan menerima

sebagian Poin Exp. yang diperoleh
dalam pertarungan.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

When selecting an attack in battle,
certain symbols may appear.

This is based on the move’s
effectiveness against the target.

A green [green]\au[black] indicates that the move
is super effective.

A yellow [orange]\ad[black] indicates the move is
not very effective.

A red [lightgreen]*[black] indicates that the move
doesn’t affect the target at all.

And a \+ symbol indicates the move
has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! When selecting an attack in battle, certain symbols may appear. This is based on the move’s effectiveness against the target. A green [green]\au[black] indicates that the move is super effective. A yellow [orange]\ad[black] indicates the move is not very effective. A red [lightgreen]*[black] indicates that the move doesn’t affect the target at all. And a \+ symbol indicates the move has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Saat memilih serangan
dalam pertarungan, simbol tertentu\lmungkin muncul. Ini didasarkan pada

efektivitas gerakan terhadap
target. [green]\au[black] hijau menandakan gerakan\lsangat efektif. [orange]\ad[black] kuning menandakan

gerakan kurang efektif. [lightgreen]*[black] merah
menandakan gerakan tidak\lberpengaruh sama sekali pada

target. Dan simbol \+ menandakan
gerakan memiliki Bonus Serangan\lTipe Sama.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

The [green]Item Restrictions[black] option lets
you choose how many items you can\luse in battle!

If you choose [green]No Items[black], then no
Trainers will be able to use any\leither!

At minimum, [green]4 Items Only[black] must be
set for [green]Expert[black], and [green]No Items[black] must\lbe set for [green]Insane[black].

If you’re feeling extra ambitious,
setting it to [green]Enemy Trainer Only[black]\lwill allow your opponents to use\litems while preventing you!

This last choice works for any
difficulty."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! The [green]Item Restrictions[black] option lets you choose how many items you can use in battle! If you choose [green]No Items[black], then no Trainers will be able to use any either! At minimum, [green]4 Items Only[black] must be set for [green]Expert[black], and [green]No Items[black] must be set for [green]Insane[black]. If you’re feeling extra ambitious, setting it to [green]Enemy Trainer Only[black] will allow your opponents to use items while preventing you! This last choice works for any difficulty.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Opsi [green]Batasan Item[black]
memungkinkan kamu memilih berapa\lbanyak item yang bisa digunakan

dalam pertarungan! Jika kamu
memilih [green]Tanpa Item[black], maka tidak ada\lPelatih yang bisa menggunakan item

juga! Minimal, [green]Hanya 4 Item[black] harus
diatur untuk [green]Ahli[black], dan [green]Tanpa Item[black]\lharus diatur untuk [green]Gila[black]. Jika kamu

merasa sangat ambisius, mengaturnya
ke [green]Hanya Pelatih Musuh[black] akan\lmengizinkan lawanmu menggunakan

item sambil mencegahmu! Pilihan
terakhir ini berlaku untuk semua\ltingkat kesulitan.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

\btn02 and \btn05 can be used to quick-
switch Pokémon in the Party List!

\btn02 will auto-select a Pokémon for
switching, and \btn05 will make the\lcurrent Pokémon the party lead!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! \btn02 and \btn05 can be used to quick- switch Pokémon in the Party List! \btn02 will auto-select a Pokémon for switching, and \btn05 will make the current Pokémon the party lead!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! \btn02 dan \btn05 dapat
digunakan untuk mengganti Pokémon\ldengan cepat di Daftar Tim! \btn02 akan

memilih Pokémon secara otomatis
untuk ditukar, dan \btn05 akan\lmenjadikan Pokémon saat ini sebagai

pemimpin tim!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

In a battle, you can check your
Pokémon’s moves for details like\lpower and accuracy ratings.

Just press \btn02 before selecting
a move!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! In a battle, you can check your Pokémon’s moves for details like power and accuracy ratings. Just press \btn02 before selecting a move!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Dalam pertempuran,
kamu bisa memeriksa jurus Pokémonmu\luntuk detail seperti kekuatan dan

akurasi. Cukup tekan \btn02 sebelum
memilih jurus!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Talk to Lapras to ride it down
the waterfall!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Talk to Lapras to ride it down the waterfall!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Bicaralah dengan
Lapras untuk menaikinya turun dari\lair terjun!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

One-time use items are returned to
you after important battles, such\las against Gym Leaders.

Use them to help strengthen your
team and give yourself an edge!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! One-time use items are returned to you after important battles, such as against Gym Leaders. Use them to help strengthen your team and give yourself an edge!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Item sekali pakai
dikembalikan kepadamu setelah\lpertempuran penting, seperti

melawan Pemimpin Gym. Gunakan untuk
memperkuat timmu dan memberimu\lkeunggulan!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Keep an eye out for trees with
a shady area between them!

These indicate [green]Hidden Grottos[black] can
be found there!

These special areas have been
appearing en masse ever since the\lmeteorite strike.

Simply interact with the trees and
prepare to face a tough Pokémon!

And in fact, if you use [green]Cut[black], you’ll
even find one on this route!

So earn the Vision Badge from the
Crater Town Gym, and then come\lback here to find it!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Keep an eye out for trees with a shady area between them! These indicate [green]Hidden Grottos[black] can be found there! These special areas have been appearing en masse ever since the meteorite strike. Simply interact with the trees and prepare to face a tough Pokémon! And in fact, if you use [green]Cut[black], you’ll even find one on this route! So earn the Vision Badge from the Crater Town Gym, and then come back here to find it!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Perhatikan
pohon-pohon dengan area teduh di\lantaranya! Itu menandakan [green]Gua

Tersembunyi[black] bisa ditemukan di sana!
Area khusus ini mulai bermunculan\lsecara massal sejak hantaman

meteorit. Cukup berinteraksi dengan
pohon-pohon itu dan bersiaplah\lmenghadapi Pokémon yang kuat! Dan

faktanya, jika kamu menggunakan
[green]Potong[black], kamu akan menemukan satu di\lrute ini! Jadi dapatkan Lencana

Visi dari Gym Crater Town, lalu
kembali ke sini untuk menemukannya!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

The button combination for running
quickly from wild battles can be\lset from the [green]Options Menu[black]!

By default, you can run quickly from
wild battles with \btn03!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! The button combination for running quickly from wild battles can be set from the [green]Options Menu[black]! By default, you can run quickly from wild battles with \btn03!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Kombinasi tombol
untuk lari cepat dari pertempuran\lliar dapat diatur dari [green]Menu Opsi[black]!

Secara default, kamu bisa lari
cepat dari pertempuran liar dengan\l\btn03!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Pressing \btn04 while viewing items
in the Cube lets you sort them!

Setting the [green]Auto Item Sort[black] option
in the [green]Options Menu[black] will sort the\lCube automatically each time you\lopen it!

Pressing \btn02 and \btn03 lets you scroll
through items in the Cube faster!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Pressing \btn04 while viewing items in the Cube lets you sort them! Setting the [green]Auto Item Sort[black] option in the [green]Options Menu[black] will sort the Cube automatically each time you open it! Pressing \btn02 and \btn03 lets you scroll through items in the Cube faster!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Menekan \btn04 saat
melihat item di Kubus\lmemungkinkanmu mengurutkannya!

Mengatur opsi [green]Urut Item Otomatis[black] di
[green]Menu Opsi[black] akan mengurutkan Kubus\lsecara otomatis setiap kali kamu

membukanya! Menekan \btn02 dan \btn03
memungkinkanmu menggulir item di\lKubus lebih cepat!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Different Pokémon appear at night
than during the day!

Visit the same places throughout
the day to catch more Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Different Pokémon appear at night than during the day! Visit the same places throughout the day to catch more Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Pokémon yang berbeda
muncul di malam hari dibandingkan\lsiang hari! Kunjungi tempat yang

sama sepanjang hari untuk menangkap
lebih banyak Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Wild Pokémon are less likely to
appear while riding a Motorcycle.

If you’re old enough to drive one,
it’s time to hop on!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Wild Pokémon are less likely to appear while riding a Motorcycle. If you’re old enough to drive one, it’s time to hop on!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Pokémon liar
cenderung lebih jarang muncul saat\lmengendarai Sepeda Motor. Jika kamu

cukup umur untuk mengendarainya,
saatnya naik!

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

The number of Exp. Points you get
after a battle is based on levels.

When your Pokémon is weaker than
its opponent, it will get more.

But if your Pokémon is stronger,
it won’t get as many."
entries.translation_source: [black]Trainer Tips! The number of Exp. Points you get after a battle is based on levels. When your Pokémon is weaker than its opponent, it will get more. But if your Pokémon is stronger, it won’t get as many.
entries.translated:
[black]Tips Pelatih! Jumlah Poin Exp. yang
kamu dapatkan setelah pertempuran\ldidasarkan pada level. Saat

Pokémonmu lebih lemah dari
lawannya, ia akan mendapat lebih\lbanyak. Tapi jika Pokémonmu lebih

kuat, ia tidak akan mendapat
sebanyak itu.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Electric-type Pokémon are immune
to paralysis!

Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected
by powder and spore moves!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Electric-type Pokémon are immune to paralysis! Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected by powder and spore moves!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Pokémon tipe Listrik
kebal terhadap kelumpuhan! Pokémon\ltipe Rumput tidak terpengaruh oleh

jurus serbuk dan spora!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Pressing \btn05 will let you use
one of up to six registered items!

To register an item, select it in
the Key Items sector of your Cube,\land then choose [green]Register[black].

The item registered second can be
used quickly by pressing \btn02 when\lthe [green]L-Button Mode[black] option is set to\l[green]Reg Item 2[black]."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Pressing \btn05 will let you use one of up to six registered items! To register an item, select it in the Key Items sector of your Cube, and then choose [green]Register[black]. The item registered second can be used quickly by pressing \btn02 when the [green]L-Button Mode[black] option is set to [green]Reg Item 2[black].
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Menekan \btn05 akan
memungkinkanmu menggunakan salah\lsatu dari hingga enam item

terdaftar! Untuk mendaftarkan item,
pilih di sektor Item Kunci di\lKubusmu, lalu pilih [green]Daftarkan[black]. Item

yang didaftarkan kedua dapat
digunakan dengan cepat dengan\lmenekan \btn02 saat opsi [green]Mode Tombol L[black]

diatur ke [green]Reg Item 2[black].

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Hop on the rocks to cross over
the water!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Hop on the rocks to cross over the water!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Lompatlah ke bebatuan
untuk menyeberangi air!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

When catching a Pokémon, sometimes
the Poké Ball you throw will rock\lonly once.

This is called a \qocritical capture\qc
and the more Pokémon you catch,\lthe more likely it will occur."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! When catching a Pokémon, sometimes the Poké Ball you throw will rock only once. This is called a \qocritical capture\qc and the more Pokémon you catch, the more likely it will occur.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Saat menangkap
Pokémon, terkadang Poké Ball yang\lkamu lempar hanya akan bergoyang

sekali. Ini disebut \qotangkap
kritis\qc dan semakin banyak Pokémon\lyang kamu tangkap, semakin besar

kemungkinan itu terjadi.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Never change the date on your
device to access more daily events!

If you do, all daily events may
cease to function properly,\lregardless of whether or not you\lattempted to access them more\lthan once.

If you’ve already done this
accidentally, hope is not lost.

If you can wait until the date you
changed to, it is recommended to\lwait, otherwise talk with a man in\lFrozen Heights.

Just once, he can reset your clock
to allow daily events to function\lonce more."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Never change the date on your device to access more daily events! If you do, all daily events may cease to function properly, regardless of whether or not you attempted to access them more than once. If you’ve already done this accidentally, hope is not lost. If you can wait until the date you changed to, it is recommended to wait, otherwise talk with a man in Frozen Heights. Just once, he can reset your clock to allow daily events to function once more.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Jangan pernah
mengubah tanggal di perangkatmu\luntuk mengakses lebih banyak acara

harian! Jika kamu melakukannya,
semua acara harian mungkin berhenti\lberfungsi dengan baik, terlepas

dari apakah kamu mencoba
mengaksesnya lebih dari sekali atau\ltidak. Jika kamu sudah tidak

sengaja melakukannya, jangan
khawatir. Jika kamu bisa menunggu\lhingga tanggal yang kamu ubah,

disarankan untuk menunggu, jika
tidak bicaralah dengan seorang pria\ldi Frozen Heights. Hanya sekali,

dia bisa mengatur ulang jam untuk
mengaktifkan acara harian kembali.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Use Strength to push the boulders
onto the pressure plates!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Use Strength to push the boulders onto the pressure plates!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Gunakan Kekuatan
untuk mendorong batu-batu besar ke\lpelat tekanan!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

If you notice a heart symbol while
checking your Pokémon’s summary,\lthat means you’ve started bonding\lwith it!

The closer you are, the more full
the heart will become.

And a Pokémon with nearly a full
heart is ready to evolve if it\lrequires a [green]friendship Evolution[black]!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! If you notice a heart symbol while checking your Pokémon’s summary, that means you’ve started bonding with it! The closer you are, the more full the heart will become. And a Pokémon with nearly a full heart is ready to evolve if it requires a [green]friendship Evolution[black]!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Jika kamu melihat
simbol hati saat memeriksa\lringkasan Pokémonmu, itu berarti

kamu sudah mulai menjalin ikatan
dengannya! Semakin dekat kamu, hati\lakan semakin penuh. Dan Pokémon

dengan hati yang hampir penuh siap
berevolusi jika membutuhkan [green]Evolusi\lPersahabatan[black]!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

There’s [green]no limit[black] to how many times
you can use items such as [green]Protein[black]\land [green]Carbos[black] on your Pokémon!

Buy these vitamins in bulk at the
[green]Dehara Department Store[black]!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! There’s [green]no limit[black] to how many times you can use items such as [green]Protein[black] and [green]Carbos[black] on your Pokémon! Buy these vitamins in bulk at the [green]Dehara Department Store[black]!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Tidak ada [green]batasan[black]
berapa kali kamu bisa menggunakan\litem seperti [green]Protein[black] dan [green]Karbos[black]

pada Pokémonmu! Beli vitamin ini
dalam jumlah besar di [green]Department\lStore Dehara[black]!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Some Trainers may only battle you
after you’ve defeated every other\lTrainer in the area.

If you can defeat these Trainers,
you’ll be sure to earn a great\lreward!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Some Trainers may only battle you after you’ve defeated every other Trainer in the area. If you can defeat these Trainers, you’ll be sure to earn a great reward!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Beberapa Pelatih
mungkin hanya akan bertarung\ldenganmu setelah kamu mengalahkan

semua Pelatih lain di area
tersebut. Jika kamu bisa\lmengalahkan Pelatih-pelatih ini,

kamu pasti akan mendapatkan hadiah
besar!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Dark spots in the ocean indicate
that a Pokémon can go underwater!

If you’ve purchased an [green]ADM[black] from
[green]Captain Davy’s Shipyard[black] in [green]Seaport\lCity[black], press \btn00 over the dark spot\lto submerge.

While underwater, if you find a
lighter area of the ground,\lpress \btn01 there to resurface."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Dark spots in the ocean indicate that a Pokémon can go underwater! If you’ve purchased an [green]ADM[black] from [green]Captain Davy’s Shipyard[black] in [green]Seaport City[black], press \btn00 over the dark spot to submerge. While underwater, if you find a lighter area of the ground, press \btn01 there to resurface.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Titik gelap di lautan
menandakan bahwa Pokémon bisa\lmenyelam! Jika kamu telah membeli

[green]ADM[black] dari [green]Galangan Kapal Kapten Davy[black]
di [green]Kota Seaport[black], tekan \btn00 di atas\ltitik gelap untuk menyelam. Saat di

bawah air, jika kamu menemukan area
tanah yang lebih terang, tekan \btn01 di\lsana untuk muncul kembali.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Certain Pokémon may only visit an
area on certain days of the week.

Be sure to search Borrius every
day for Pokémon like these."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Certain Pokémon may only visit an area on certain days of the week. Be sure to search Borrius every day for Pokémon like these.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Pokémon tertentu
mungkin hanya mengunjungi suatu\larea pada hari-hari tertentu dalam

seminggu. Pastikan untuk mencari
Borrius setiap hari untuk Pokémon\lseperti ini.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Certain kinds of Hidden Items like
food items and Shards can be found\lmore than once!

The more often you visit areas with
Hidden Items like these, the higher\lthe chance of finding the Hidden\lItems again."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Certain kinds of Hidden Items like food items and Shards can be found more than once! The more often you visit areas with Hidden Items like these, the higher the chance of finding the Hidden Items again.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Beberapa jenis Item
Tersembunyi seperti item makanan\ldan Shard dapat ditemukan lebih

dari sekali! Semakin sering kamu
mengunjungi area dengan Item\lTersembunyi seperti ini, semakin

tinggi peluang untuk menemukan Item
Tersembunyi lagi.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

If your Pokémon knows the move
[green]Sweet Scent[black], you can use it to\lencounter two wild Pokémon at once\lif the weather is clear!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! If your Pokémon knows the move [green]Sweet Scent[black], you can use it to encounter two wild Pokémon at once if the weather is clear!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Jika Pokémonmu
mengetahui jurus [green]Aroma Manis[black], kamu\ldapat menggunakannya untuk bertemu

dua Pokémon liar sekaligus jika
cuaca cerah!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Hold \btn01 to Surf faster!

And when the [green]L-Button Mode[black] is set to
[green]Auto-Run[black], press \btn02 to toggle\lTurbo Surf!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Hold \btn01 to Surf faster! And when the [green]L-Button Mode[black] is set to [green]Auto-Run[black], press \btn02 to toggle Turbo Surf!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Tahan \btn01 untuk
Berselancar lebih cepat! Dan saat\l[green]Mode Tombol L[black] diatur ke [green]Lari

Otomatis[black], tekan \btn02 untuk
mengaktifkan/menonaktifkan Turbo\lBerselancar!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Press \btn05 when moving Pokémon
in the PC to activate multi-select.

This lets you move multiple
Pokémon at once by holding \btn00!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Press \btn05 when moving Pokémon in the PC to activate multi-select. This lets you move multiple Pokémon at once by holding \btn00!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Tekan \btn05 saat
memindahkan Pokémon di PC untuk\lmengaktifkan multi-pilih. Ini

memungkinkan kamu memindahkan
beberapa Pokémon sekaligus dengan\lmenahan \btn00!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Have a lot of requests recorded in
your Mission Log?

Use \btn0B to quickly scroll through
the list!

Or, try pressing \btn04 to sort
it alphabetically!

You can even press \btn05 to pin
Missions to the top of the list!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Have a lot of requests recorded in your Mission Log? Use \btn0B to quickly scroll through the list! Or, try pressing \btn04 to sort it alphabetically! You can even press \btn05 to pin Missions to the top of the list!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Punya banyak
permintaan tercatat di Log Misi?\lGunakan \btn0B untuk menggulir daftar

dengan cepat! Atau, coba tekan \btn04
untuk mengurutkannya secara\lalfabet! Kamu bahkan bisa tekan \btn05

untuk menyematkan Misi ke atas
daftar!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

There are minimal places to heal
once you begin your ascent up\lVictory Road!

Don’t get caught off guard!

Buy healing items!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! There are minimal places to heal once you begin your ascent up Victory Road! Don’t get caught off guard! Buy healing items!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Ada sedikit tempat
untuk memulihkan diri begitu kamu\lmulai mendaki Victory Road! Jangan

lengah! Belilah item penyembuh!

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

Even on the [green]Vanilla[black] difficulty, the
Elite Four get stronger as you do!

Don’t be caught off guard and be
prepared for intense fights!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Trainer Tips! Even on the [green]Vanilla[black] difficulty, the Elite Four get stronger as you do! Don’t be caught off guard and be prepared for intense fights!
entries.translated:
[black]Tips Pelatih! Bahkan pada tingkat
kesulitan [green]Vanilla[black], Elite Four\lmenjadi lebih kuat seiring kamu!

Jangan lengah dan bersiaplah untuk
pertarungan sengit!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Press \btn00 to climb up the ladder!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Press \btn00 to climb up the ladder!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Tekan \btn00 untuk naik
tangga!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Press \btn00 on the tree to the left of
the sign to enter a Hidden Grotto!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Press \btn00 on the tree to the left of the sign to enter a Hidden Grotto!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Tekan \btn00 pada pohon di
sebelah kiri papan tanda untuk\lmasuk ke Gua Tersembunyi!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Press \btn04 in a Double Battle to
view your Pokémon’s HP as digits!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Press \btn04 in a Double Battle to view your Pokémon’s HP as digits!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Tekan \btn04 dalam
Pertarungan Ganda untuk melihat HP\lPokémonmu dalam bentuk angka!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Traveling together makes your
Pokémon grow friendlier!

Pokémon may even evolve when they
grow friendly enough!

And if you’ve entered into the
[green]Hall of Fame[black], these Pokémon may\lgain [green]extra Exp.[black] as well!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Traveling together makes your Pokémon grow friendlier! Pokémon may even evolve when they grow friendly enough! And if you’ve entered into the [green]Hall of Fame[black], these Pokémon may gain [green]extra Exp.[black] as well!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Bepergian bersama
membuat Pokémonmu menjadi lebih\lbersahabat! Pokémon bahkan dapat

berevolusi saat mereka cukup
bersahabat! Dan jika kamu sudah\lmasuk ke [green]Hall of Fame[black], Pokémon ini

mungkin mendapatkan [green]Exp. tambahan[black]
juga!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Once you enter the Hall of Fame,
you unlock the ability to [green]scroll\ltext automatically[black] by holding \btn03!

This feature also carries over to
New Game\+ and Sandbox Mode.

But please, never hold \btn03 when
reading Trainer Tips signs!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Once you enter the Hall of Fame, you unlock the ability to [green]scroll text automatically[black] by holding \btn03! This feature also carries over to New Game\+ and Sandbox Mode. But please, never hold \btn03 when reading Trainer Tips signs!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Begitu kamu memasuki
Hall of Fame, kamu membuka\lkemampuan untuk [green]menggulir teks

secara otomatis[black] dengan menahan \btn03!
Fitur ini juga berlaku untuk New\lGame\+ dan Sandbox Mode. Tapi

tolong, jangan pernah menahan \btn03
saat membaca papan Tips Pelatih!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

After the great Portal Boom, many
rare and powerful Pokémon have\lbegun to appear in Borrius!

If you accidentally defeat or run
away from one instead of capturing\lit, it will return if you re-enter\lthe Hall of Fame."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! After the great Portal Boom, many rare and powerful Pokémon have begun to appear in Borrius! If you accidentally defeat or run away from one instead of capturing it, it will return if you re-enter the Hall of Fame.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Setelah Ledakan
Portal yang besar, banyak Pokémon\llangka dan kuat mulai muncul di

Borrius! Jika kamu secara tidak
sengaja mengalahkan atau melarikan\ldiri dari salah satunya alih-alih

menangkapnya, ia akan kembali jika
kamu memasuki kembali Hall of Fame.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Avoid using standard Balls such as
Ultra Balls when attempting to\lcapture powerful Pokémon!

If you’re facing a very [green]heavy[black]
Pokémon, the [green]Heavy Ball[black] will be\lthe ideal Ball.

Otherwise if the battle has been
drawn out for over [green]10 turns[black],\lconsider using a [green]Timer Ball[black].

If the battle has been short, but
the opposing Pokémon has a [green]base\lSpeed stat[black] over [green]100[black], then consider\lusing a [green]Fast Ball[black].

But if the battle has been short and
the opposing Pokémon is slow, then\lattempt to catch the Pokémon at\l[green]night[black] using a [green]Dusk Ball[black].

These four Balls will be key in
capturing powerful Pokémon quickly!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Avoid using standard Balls such as Ultra Balls when attempting to capture powerful Pokémon! If you’re facing a very [green]heavy[black] Pokémon, the [green]Heavy Ball[black] will be the ideal Ball. Otherwise if the battle has been drawn out for over [green]10 turns[black], consider using a [green]Timer Ball[black]. If the battle has been short, but the opposing Pokémon has a [green]base Speed stat[black] over [green]100[black], then consider using a [green]Fast Ball[black]. But if the battle has been short and the opposing Pokémon is slow, then attempt to catch the Pokémon at [green]night[black] using a [green]Dusk Ball[black]. These four Balls will be key in capturing powerful Pokémon quickly!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Hindari menggunakan
Bola standar seperti Bola Ultra\lsaat mencoba menangkap Pokémon

kuat! Jika kamu menghadapi Pokémon
yang sangat [green]berat[black], [green]Bola Berat[black] akan\lmenjadi Bola yang ideal. Jika

tidak, jika pertarungan berlangsung
lebih dari [green]10 giliran[black],\lpertimbangkan menggunakan [green]Bola

Timer[black]. Jika pertarungan singkat,
tetapi Pokémon lawan memiliki [green]stat\lKecepatan dasar[black] di atas [green]100[black], maka

pertimbangkan menggunakan [green]Bola
Cepat[black]. Tetapi jika pertarungan\lsingkat dan Pokémon lawan lambat,

maka cobalah menangkap Pokémon pada
[green]malam hari[black] menggunakan [green]Bola Senja[black].\lKeempat Bola ini akan menjadi kunci

untuk menangkap Pokémon kuat dengan
cepat!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Thanks to the advancements of modern
science, you can start a brand new\ladventure on [green]Sandbox Mode[black]!

While there will be no post-game
content, you’ll have the freedom to\lcapture and train any Pokémon you\lwish, in addition to being able to\lmodify all of their stats with ease!

Pokémon are nothing more than
numbers, after all!

\.

This tip is sponsored by Cube Corp."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Thanks to the advancements of modern science, you can start a brand new adventure on [green]Sandbox Mode[black]! While there will be no post-game content, you’ll have the freedom to capture and train any Pokémon you wish, in addition to being able to modify all of their stats with ease! Pokémon are nothing more than numbers, after all! \. This tip is sponsored by Cube Corp.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Berkat kemajuan ilmu
pengetahuan modern, kamu dapat\lmemulai petualangan baru di [green]Sandbox

Mode[black]! Meskipun tidak akan ada
konten pasca-permainan, kamu akan\lmemiliki kebebasan untuk menangkap

dan melatih Pokémon apa pun yang
kamu inginkan, selain dapat\lmemodifikasi semua stat mereka

dengan mudah! Pokémon hanyalah
angka, bagaimanapun juga! \. Tips ini\ldisponsori oleh Cube Corp.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

You can customize the music tracks
that play when exploring and\lwhile in battle from the [green]Audio\lOptions[black] page in the [green]Options Menu[black]!

You can even press \btn04 to quickly
reset the music to the default track!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! You can customize the music tracks that play when exploring and while in battle from the [green]Audio Options[black] page in the [green]Options Menu[black]! You can even press \btn04 to quickly reset the music to the default track!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Kamu dapat
menyesuaikan trek musik yang\ldiputar saat menjelajah dan saat

bertarung dari halaman [green]Opsi Audio[black]
di [green]Menu Opsi[black]! Kamu bahkan bisa\ltekan \btn04 untuk dengan cepat mengatur

ulang musik ke trek default!

entries.original:
"Welcome aboard the S.S. Marine.

The number of Trainers aboard the
S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue].

Would you like to turn over your
Cube while you’re aboard in order\lto win five times the prizes?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome aboard the S.S. Marine. The number of Trainers aboard the S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue]. Would you like to turn over your Cube while you’re aboard in order to win five times the prizes?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di S.S. Marine.
Jumlah Pelatih di atas kapal S.S.\lMarine hari ini adalah [green][buffer1][blue].

Apakah kamu ingin menyerahkan
Cube-mu selama di atas kapal untuk\lmemenangkan hadiah lima kali lipat?

entries.original:
"Got it, we’ll hold onto your Cube
then while you’re aboard."
entries.translation_source: Got it, we’ll hold onto your Cube then while you’re aboard.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kami akan menyimpan
Cube-mu selama kamu di atas kapal.

entries.original: "Please enjoy yourself."
entries.translation_source: Please enjoy yourself.
entries.translated: Silakan nikmati waktumu.

entries.original:
"[blue]Thanks for sailing with us.

The ship’s about to arrive in
Polder Town."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Thanks for sailing with us. The ship’s about to arrive in Polder Town.
entries.translated:
[blue]Terima kasih telah berlayar bersama
kami. Kapal akan segera tiba di\lPolder Town.

entries.original:
"[blue]Thanks for sailing with us.

The ship’s about to arrive in
Seaport City."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Thanks for sailing with us. The ship’s about to arrive in Seaport City.
entries.translated:
[blue]Terima kasih telah berlayar bersama
kami. Kapal akan segera tiba di\lSeaport City.

entries.original:
"The number of Trainers on the
S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue].

The ship is nearing the port.
Do you want to get off the ship?"
entries.translation_source: The number of Trainers on the S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue]. The ship is nearing the port. Do you want to get off the ship?
entries.translated:
Jumlah Pelatih di S.S. Marine hari
ini adalah [green][buffer1][blue]. Kapal\lmendekati pelabuhan. Apakah kamu

ingin turun dari kapal?

entries.original:
"The number of Trainers on the
S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue].\lAnd you’ve won against [green][buffer2][blue].

The ship is nearing the port.
Do you want to get off the ship?"
entries.translation_source: The number of Trainers on the S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue]. And you’ve won against [green][buffer2][blue]. The ship is nearing the port. Do you want to get off the ship?
entries.translated:
Jumlah Pelatih di S.S. Marine hari
ini adalah [green][buffer1][blue]. Dan kamu telah\lmengalahkan [green][buffer2][blue]. Kapal

mendekati pelabuhan. Apakah kamu
ingin turun dari kapal?

entries.original:
"The number of Trainers on the
S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue].\lYou\. Congratulations!

You’ve won against every Trainer
on the ship!

The ship is nearing the port.
Do you want to get off the ship?"
entries.translation_source: The number of Trainers on the S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue]. You\. Congratulations! You’ve won against every Trainer on the ship! The ship is nearing the port. Do you want to get off the ship?
entries.translated:
Jumlah Pelatih di S.S. Marine hari
ini adalah [green][buffer1][blue]. Kamu\. Selamat!\lKamu telah mengalahkan semua

Pelatih di kapal! Kapal mendekati
pelabuhan. Apakah kamu ingin turun\ldari kapal?

entries.original: "Sure. Just wait a sec, please."
entries.translation_source: Sure. Just wait a sec, please.
entries.translated: Tentu. Tunggu sebentar, ya.

entries.original:
"Sure.
Please continue to enjoy the trip!"
entries.translation_source: Sure. Please continue to enjoy the trip!
entries.translated:
Tentu. Silakan nikmati
perjalanannya!

entries.original:
"Whaddya think of the S.S. Marine?
Big old thing, ain’t she?

She’s so huge, you might be having a
spot of trouble finding other\lTrainers to battle!

If you want, fancy a hint as to
where you can find ’em?"
entries.translation_source: Whaddya think of the S.S. Marine? Big old thing, ain’t she? She’s so huge, you might be having a spot of trouble finding other Trainers to battle! If you want, fancy a hint as to where you can find ’em?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana pendapatmu tentang S.S.
Marine? Kapal besar sekali, ya?\lKapal ini sangat besar, kamu

mungkin sedikit kesulitan menemukan
Pelatih lain untuk bertarung! Jika\lkamu mau, mau petunjuk di mana kamu

bisa menemukan mereka?

entries.original:
"You want a tip about the Trainers
still on board the S.S. Marine?"
entries.translation_source: You want a tip about the Trainers still on board the S.S. Marine?
entries.translated:
Kamu ingin petunjuk tentang Pelatih
yang masih di atas S.S. Marine?

entries.original:
"Today\.

Uh, in terms of people, we have
[green][buffer1][blue] on the port side, and\l[green][buffer2][blue] on the starboard side."
