entries.translation_source: Today\. Uh, in terms of people, we have [green][buffer1][blue] on the port side, and [green][buffer2][blue] on the starboard side.
entries.translated:
Hari ini\. Uh, dalam hal jumlah
orang, ada [green][buffer1][blue] di sisi kiri,\ldan [green][buffer2][blue] di sisi kanan.

entries.original:
"Oh, well - I’ll be right here, if
ya change your mind.

Have fun exploring the S.S. Marine!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, well - I’ll be right here, if ya change your mind. Have fun exploring the S.S. Marine!
entries.translated:
Oh, baiklah - aku akan di sini,
jika kamu berubah pikiran. Selamat\lmenjelajahi S.S. Marine!

entries.original:
"So, I reckon the number of Trainers
in the cabins with [green][buffer2][blue] doors\ltoday is [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: So, I reckon the number of Trainers in the cabins with [green][buffer2][blue] doors today is [green][buffer1][blue].
entries.translated:
Jadi, kukira jumlah Pelatih di
kabin dengan pintu [green][buffer2][blue] hari\lini adalah [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Some of the guests joined the
cruise looking for company\.

But you’re in it for the battles,
aren’t ya?

Careful - they’ll talk your ear off
given half a chance, and they’ll\lonly stop when a whistle blows!"
entries.translation_source: Some of the guests joined the cruise looking for company\. But you’re in it for the battles, aren’t ya? Careful - they’ll talk your ear off given half a chance, and they’ll only stop when a whistle blows!
entries.translated:
Beberapa tamu bergabung dalam
pelayaran mencari teman\. Tapi kamu\likut untuk bertarung, kan?

Hati-hati - mereka akan berbicara
tanpa henti jika diberi kesempatan,\ldan mereka hanya akan berhenti saat

peluit berbunyi!

entries.original:
"[black]All Trainers on board have been
defeated!"
entries.translation_source: [black]All Trainers on board have been defeated!
entries.translated:
[black]Semua Pelatih di atas kapal telah
dikalahkan!

entries.original:
"I’m the captain of the S.S. Marine.
Captain Oppenheimer’s me name.

I moved from Alola, where I hoped
me ferry services could be put to\lbetter use.

An’ when I did, I took these
strange discs I got from some\lresearchers I knew with me.

They’re nothing I can use, so you
can have one, if ye want."
entries.translation_source: I’m the captain of the S.S. Marine. Captain Oppenheimer’s me name. I moved from Alola, where I hoped me ferry services could be put to better use. An’ when I did, I took these strange discs I got from some researchers I knew with me. They’re nothing I can use, so you can have one, if ye want.
entries.translated:
Aku kapten S.S. Marine. Nama saya
Kapten Oppenheimer. Aku pindah dari\lAlola, tempat aku berharap layanan

feriku bisa digunakan lebih baik.
Dan saat itu, aku membawa cakram\laneh ini yang kudapat dari beberapa

peneliti yang kukenal. Itu tidak
ada gunanya bagiku, jadi kamu bisa\lpunya satu, jika kamu mau.

entries.original:
"I have to tell ye, the S.S. Marine’s
a lot smoother than the one I\lsailed with in Alola!

And I know that’s not just because
of the calmer water, either!"
entries.translation_source: I have to tell ye, the S.S. Marine’s a lot smoother than the one I sailed with in Alola! And I know that’s not just because of the calmer water, either!
entries.translated:
Harus kuakui, S.S. Marine jauh
lebih mulus daripada yang kunaiki\ldi Alola! Dan aku tahu itu bukan

hanya karena air yang lebih tenang!

entries.original:
"AAAAAAAH! I’m terrified of ships!
Lemme off! Lemme off!"
entries.translation_source: AAAAAAAH! I’m terrified of ships! Lemme off! Lemme off!
entries.translated:
AAAAAAAH! Aku takut kapal! Turunkan
aku! Turunkan aku!

entries.original:
"I wanna nap in my room, but if I do,
I might miss my chance to battle\lall the other Trainers\."
entries.translation_source: I wanna nap in my room, but if I do, I might miss my chance to battle all the other Trainers\.
entries.translated:
Aku ingin tidur siang di kamarku,
tapi jika kulakukan, aku mungkin\lmelewatkan kesempatan untuk

bertarung dengan semua Pelatih lain\.

entries.original:
"What should I do - nap, or breach
yet another person’s privacy?"
entries.translation_source: What should I do - nap, or breach yet another person’s privacy?
entries.translated:
Apa yang harus kulakukan - tidur
siang, atau melanggar privasi orang\llain lagi?

entries.original:
"Well, battling or taking a nap are
both pretty nice\.

But where can I get a bite to eat?"
entries.translation_source: Well, battling or taking a nap are both pretty nice\. But where can I get a bite to eat?
entries.translated:
Yah, bertarung atau tidur siang
sama-sama menyenangkan\. Tapi di mana\laku bisa mendapat makanan ringan?

entries.original:
"I’m trying to see how many laps I
can manage before we arrive!"
entries.translation_source: I’m trying to see how many laps I can manage before we arrive!
entries.translated:
Aku mencoba melihat berapa putaran
yang bisa aku capai sebelum kita\ltiba!

entries.original:
"Aha! You’re not getting away that
easily, you fool!

I have all sorts of stories!

\. Nah, it’s fine!
I actually AM here to battle!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! You’re not getting away that easily, you fool! I have all sorts of stories! \. Nah, it’s fine! I actually AM here to battle!
entries.translated:
Aha! Kamu tidak akan lolos semudah
itu, bodoh! Aku punya banyak\lcerita! \. Ah, tidak apa-apa! Aku

sebenarnya ADA di sini untuk
bertarung!

entries.original:
"I moved to Borrius, to try and
escape the crime back home\.

But guess what - I waltz right
into somewhere MORE crime-ridden\lthan before!

So, I’m gonna take out my
frustrations on you!"
entries.translation_source: I moved to Borrius, to try and escape the crime back home\. But guess what - I waltz right into somewhere MORE crime-ridden than before! So, I’m gonna take out my frustrations on you!
entries.translated:
Aku pindah ke Borrius untuk mencoba
melarikan diri dari kejahatan di\lkampung halaman\. Tapi coba tebak -

aku malah berjalan langsung ke
tempat yang LEBIH penuh kejahatan\ldari sebelumnya! Jadi, aku akan

melampiaskan frustrasiku padamu!

entries.original:
"No matter where I go, there seem
to be Trainers who’ve found an\laltogether new - and perhaps\lunfair - way to battle.

Let me take you on, fair and square!"
entries.translation_source: No matter where I go, there seem to be Trainers who’ve found an altogether new - and perhaps unfair - way to battle. Let me take you on, fair and square!
entries.translated:
Di mana pun aku pergi, sepertinya
selalu ada Pelatih yang menemukan\lcara bertarung yang sama sekali

baru - dan mungkin tidak adil.
Biarkan aku menghadapimu secara\ladil!

entries.original:
"You want a battle? Sure, why not.

I’ve beaten everyone else on the
ship, and you’re all that’s left!"
entries.translation_source: You want a battle? Sure, why not. I’ve beaten everyone else on the ship, and you’re all that’s left!
entries.translated:
Kamu ingin bertarung? Tentu, kenapa
tidak. Aku sudah mengalahkan semua\lorang di kapal, dan hanya kamu yang

tersisa!

entries.original:
"Alright - this is a stick-up!
Fork over all your money!"
entries.translation_source: Alright - this is a stick-up! Fork over all your money!
entries.translated:
Baiklah - ini perampokan! Serahkan
semua uangmu!

entries.original:
"Ditto!

Oops\. I mean: Goodness me!
Were you looking for a battle?

In that case, I certainly won’t hold
back, Ditto!"
entries.translation_source: Ditto! Oops\. I mean: Goodness me! Were you looking for a battle? In that case, I certainly won’t hold back, Ditto!
entries.translated:
Ditto! Ups\. Maksudku: Astaga! Apakah
kamu mencari pertarungan? Kalau\lbegitu, aku pasti tidak akan

menahan diri, Ditto!

entries.original:
"So, you’ve come to challenge me
too, have you?

I give you due warning - I’m still
active at my age, because I’ve got\la solid strength to prop me up!"
entries.translation_source: So, you’ve come to challenge me too, have you? I give you due warning - I’m still active at my age, because I’ve got a solid strength to prop me up!
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu datang untuk menantangku
juga, ya? Aku beri peringatan - aku\lmasih aktif di usiaku ini, karena

aku punya kekuatan kokoh yang
menopangku!

entries.original:
"WHAT DID YOU SAY?
BATON? BATTER?

OH, \qoBATTLE\qc!
SORRY! I’M A BIT DEAF!

OF COURSE I’LL TAKE YOU ON!"
entries.translation_source: WHAT DID YOU SAY? BATON? BATTER? OH, \qoBATTLE\qc! SORRY! I’M A BIT DEAF! OF COURSE I’LL TAKE YOU ON!
entries.translated:
APA KAU BILANG? BAGONG? BAKAR? OH,
\qoPERTARUNGAN\qc! MAAF! AKU AGAK TULI!\lTENTU SAJA AKU AKAN MENGHADAPIMU!

entries.original:
"Huh!? I didn’t do nuthin’!
I ain’t carryin’ nuthin’ illegal!"
entries.translation_source: Huh!? I didn’t do nuthin’! I ain’t carryin’ nuthin’ illegal!
entries.translated:
Hah!? Aku nggak ngapa-ngapain! Aku
nggak bawa barang ilegal!

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is located on the
\qoThundercap Highland\qc.

But if you came to see the
lightning storms, you’re out\lof luck.

Those only happen to the east of
here, by Epidimy Town."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is located on the \qoThundercap Highland\qc. But if you came to see the lightning storms, you’re out of luck. Those only happen to the east of here, by Epidimy Town.
entries.translated:
Kota Tarmigan terletak di \qoDataran
Tinggi Thundercap\qc. Tapi jika kamu\ldatang untuk melihat badai petir,

kamu kurang beruntung. Itu hanya
terjadi di sebelah timur sini,\ldekat Kota Epidimy.

entries.original:
"I work at the facility over here
called the Dream Research Lab.

We do exactly as it sounds, we
research dreams.

My line of work is related to
harvesting a special kind of\lmist from the Pokémon Musharna.

Unfortunately, it isn’t going
so well.

So far, I’ve only managed to get
one capsule’s worth of mist.

Since a single capsule is useless
to me, you can have it."
entries.translation_source: I work at the facility over here called the Dream Research Lab. We do exactly as it sounds, we research dreams. My line of work is related to harvesting a special kind of mist from the Pokémon Musharna. Unfortunately, it isn’t going so well. So far, I’ve only managed to get one capsule’s worth of mist. Since a single capsule is useless to me, you can have it.
entries.translated:
Aku bekerja di fasilitas di sini
yang disebut Laboratorium Riset\lMimpi. Kami melakukan persis

seperti namanya, meneliti mimpi.
Pekerjaanku berkaitan dengan\lmemanen kabut khusus dari Pokémon

Musharna. Sayangnya, hasilnya tidak
begitu baik. Sejauh ini, aku hanya\lberhasil mendapatkan satu kapsul

kabut. Karena satu kapsul tidak
berguna bagiku, kamu boleh\lmengambilnya.

entries.original:
"The [green]Dream Mist[blue] can be used to give
a Pokémon its Hidden Ability.

There is no going back once this
change is made.

I’d give you more if I could, but
our Musharna doesn’t seem to be\lproducing much anymore.

If you can find your own Musharna
to fight, it may release some Dream\lMist if you can defeat it."
entries.translation_source: The [green]Dream Mist[blue] can be used to give a Pokémon its Hidden Ability. There is no going back once this change is made. I’d give you more if I could, but our Musharna doesn’t seem to be producing much anymore. If you can find your own Musharna to fight, it may release some Dream Mist if you can defeat it.
entries.translated:
[green]Kabut Mimpi[blue] dapat digunakan untuk
memberikan Pokémon Kemampuan\lTersembunyi. Tidak ada jalan

kembali setelah perubahan ini
dilakukan. Aku akan memberimu lebih\ljika bisa, tapi Musharna kami

sepertinya tidak banyak
memproduksinya lagi. Jika kamu bisa\lmenemukan Musharna sendiri untuk

bertarung, mungkin ia akan
melepaskan Kabut Mimpi jika kamu\lbisa mengalahkannya.

entries.original:
"Ever since ancient times, the
mythical Pokémon Darkrai has\lhaunted this town.

If you look hard enough, you can
even see the spirits of the poor\lsouls haunted by Darkrai.

Be wary, child!
Don’t fall into the dark void!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since ancient times, the mythical Pokémon Darkrai has haunted this town. If you look hard enough, you can even see the spirits of the poor souls haunted by Darkrai. Be wary, child! Don’t fall into the dark void!
entries.translated:
Sejak zaman kuno, Pokémon mistis
Darkrai telah menghantui kota ini.\lJika kamu mencari dengan saksama,

kamu bahkan bisa melihat roh-roh
malang yang dihantui oleh Darkrai.\lHati-hati, anak muda! Jangan jatuh

ke dalam kekosongan gelap!

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is so secluded in
the mountains; it doesn’t have its\lown entrance to the [green]KBT Expressway[red]!

If you wanna go down the mountain,
you’ll have to walk or ask the\lteleporter to send you down."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is so secluded in the mountains; it doesn’t have its own entrance to the [green]KBT Expressway[red]! If you wanna go down the mountain, you’ll have to walk or ask the teleporter to send you down.
entries.translated:
Kota Tarmigan sangat terpencil di
pegunungan; kota ini tidak memiliki\lpintu masuk sendiri ke [green]Jalan Tol

KBT[red]! Jika kamu ingin turun gunung,
kamu harus berjalan kaki atau\lmeminta teleporter untuk mengirimmu

turun.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, a very thorough cleaning
of the mansion is being undertaken\lat the moment.

If you wish to challenge the
Successor, please come back later."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, a very thorough cleaning of the mansion is being undertaken at the moment. If you wish to challenge the Successor, please come back later.
entries.translated:
Maaf, sedang dilakukan pembersihan
menyeluruh di mansion saat ini.\lJika kamu ingin menantang Penerus,

silakan kembali nanti.

entries.original:
"My family has owned Tarmigan
Mansion for generations.

In fact, my ancestors were
responsible for the formation of\lTarmigan Town itself!

As such, I like to sit out here and
watch the town every now and then.

Don’t just sit around like me,
youngster.

Carpe diem, child!
Seize the day!"
entries.translation_source: My family has owned Tarmigan Mansion for generations. In fact, my ancestors were responsible for the formation of Tarmigan Town itself! As such, I like to sit out here and watch the town every now and then. Don’t just sit around like me, youngster. Carpe diem, child! Seize the day!
entries.translated:
Keluargaku telah memiliki Mansion
Tarmigan selama beberapa generasi.\lBahkan, nenek moyangku bertanggung

jawab atas pembentukan Kota
Tarmigan sendiri! Karena itu, aku\lsuka duduk di sini dan melihat kota

dari waktu ke waktu. Jangan hanya
duduk diam sepertiku, anak muda.\lCarpe diem, Nak! Raihlah hari ini!

entries.original:
"[black]The little girl vanished.

Was she even there to begin with?"
entries.translation_source: [black]The little girl vanished. Was she even there to begin with?
entries.translated:
[black]Gadis kecil itu menghilang. Apakah
dia benar-benar ada di sana sejak\lawal?

entries.original:
"Did you come up here to obtain the
power of [green]Mega Evolution[blue] from\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]?

Most people who come here are
usually after it.

This town doesn’t have much to
offer otherwise, other than the\lhorrific nightmares, of course."
entries.translation_source: Did you come up here to obtain the power of [green]Mega Evolution[blue] from [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]? Most people who come here are usually after it. This town doesn’t have much to offer otherwise, other than the horrific nightmares, of course.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu datang ke sini untuk
mendapatkan kekuatan [green]Evolusi Mega[blue]\ldari [green]Mansion Tarmigan[blue]? Kebanyakan

orang yang datang ke sini biasanya
mencarinya. Kota ini tidak punya\lbanyak hal lain untuk ditawarkan,

selain mimpi buruk yang mengerikan,
tentu saja.

entries.original:
"So you got what you came for, eh?

Now that the power of Mega
Evolution is yours, what’s next?

Z-Moves?

I hear they like to use those a
lot in East Borrius.

But why wait until you get there?

Your [buffer1] can easily
activate Z-Moves as well!

So what are you waiting for?

Start collecting Z-Crystals
already!"
entries.translation_source: So you got what you came for, eh? Now that the power of Mega Evolution is yours, what’s next? Z-Moves? I hear they like to use those a lot in East Borrius. But why wait until you get there? Your [buffer1] can easily activate Z-Moves as well! So what are you waiting for? Start collecting Z-Crystals already!
entries.translated:
Jadi kamu mendapatkan apa yang kamu
cari, ya? Sekarang setelah kekuatan\lEvolusi Mega menjadi milikmu, apa

selanjutnya? Gerakan Z? Kudengar
mereka sering menggunakannya di\lBorrius Timur. Tapi kenapa menunggu

sampai kamu sampai di sana?
[buffer1]-mu juga bisa dengan mudah\lmengaktifkan Gerakan Z! Jadi tunggu

apa lagi? Mulailah mengumpulkan
Kristal Z sekarang juga!

entries.original:
"You’ll never be able to beat my
super, rare, awesome, Sandslash!

I got it all the way up in this
hidden section of Icicle Cave!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll never be able to beat my super, rare, awesome, Sandslash! I got it all the way up in this hidden section of Icicle Cave!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak akan pernah bisa
mengalahkan Sandslash-ku yang\lsuper, langka, dan keren! Aku

mendapatkannya di bagian
tersembunyi Gua Icicle!

entries.original:
"Oh yeah?

Well, my Miltank is super powerful,
too!

I got it in the Magnolia Fields!
You’re going down!"
entries.translation_source: Oh yeah? Well, my Miltank is super powerful, too! I got it in the Magnolia Fields! You’re going down!
entries.translated:
Oh ya? Nah, Miltank-ku juga sangat
kuat! Aku mendapatkannya di Padang\lMagnolia! Kamu akan kalah!

entries.original:
"There’s been this locked house
near [green]Tarmigan Mansion[red] for a\lreally long time.

I think it was once a small inn
for visitors of this town.

But it closed down after the
guests started suffering from\lhorrendous nightmares."
entries.translation_source: There’s been this locked house near [green]Tarmigan Mansion[red] for a really long time. I think it was once a small inn for visitors of this town. But it closed down after the guests started suffering from horrendous nightmares.
entries.translated:
Sudah lama ada rumah terkunci di
dekat [green]Tarmigan Mansion[red]. Saya pikir\litu dulunya adalah penginapan kecil

untuk pengunjung kota ini. Tapi
tutup setelah para tamu mulai\lmenderita mimpi buruk yang

mengerikan.

entries.original:
"There’s been this locked house
near Tarmigan Mansion for a\lreally long time.

But for some reason it’s open now\."
entries.translation_source: There’s been this locked house near Tarmigan Mansion for a really long time. But for some reason it’s open now\.
entries.translated:
Sudah lama ada rumah terkunci di
dekat Tarmigan Mansion. Tapi untuk\lbeberapa alasan sekarang terbuka\.

entries.original:
"Hi!
Do you have a [green][buffer1][blue]?

Want to trade it for my
[green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Do you have a [green][buffer1][blue]? Want to trade it for my [green][buffer2][blue]?
entries.translated:
Hai! Apakah kamu punya [green][buffer1][blue]?
Ingin menukarnya dengan [green][buffer2][blue]\lmilikku?

entries.original:
"Sister, I’ve been rejected, yet
again."
entries.translation_source: Sister, I’ve been rejected, yet again.
entries.translated: Kakak, aku ditolak, lagi.

entries.original:
"You should have just said no.

That’s very much not a [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: You should have just said no. That’s very much not a [buffer1].
entries.translated:
Kamu seharusnya bilang tidak. Itu
sama sekali bukan [buffer1].

entries.original:
"Thanks! Anyone ever tell you that
you’re a real pal?"
entries.translation_source: Thanks! Anyone ever tell you that you’re a real pal?
entries.translated:
Terima kasih! Apakah ada yang
pernah bilang kamu teman sejati?

entries.original:
"How is my old [buffer2]?
My [buffer1] is doing great!

I’ve been feeding it lots and lots
of sweet Berries."
entries.translation_source: How is my old [buffer2]? My [buffer1] is doing great! I’ve been feeding it lots and lots of sweet Berries.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana [buffer2]-ku yang lama?
[buffer1]-ku baik-baik saja! Aku\lmemberinya banyak Beri manis.

entries.original:
"Listen up, youngster.

That swindler over there is
constantly extorting [green]Red Shards[blue]\lfrom youngsters, like yourself.

Here, I stole a couple from his
collection for you to enjoy."
entries.translation_source: Listen up, youngster. That swindler over there is constantly extorting [green]Red Shards[blue] from youngsters, like yourself. Here, I stole a couple from his collection for you to enjoy.
entries.translated:
Dengarkan, anak muda. Penipu di
sana terus-menerus memeras [green]Pecahan\lMerah[blue] dari anak-anak muda, seperti

dirimu. Ini, aku mencuri beberapa
dari koleksinya untukmu nikmati.

entries.original:
"I hold by the principle that it is
permitted to steal from thieves."
entries.translation_source: I hold by the principle that it is permitted to steal from thieves.
entries.translated:
Saya berpegang pada prinsip bahwa
diperbolehkan mencuri dari pencuri.

entries.original:
"Those are some hot hands ya got
there, fella!

You wannem to burn up with
fiery power?

I can teach your Pokémon [green]Fire
Punch[blue] for just [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Those are some hot hands ya got there, fella! You wannem to burn up with fiery power? I can teach your Pokémon [green]Fire Punch[blue] for just [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!
entries.translated:
Tangannya panas, kawan! Kamu ingin
tangannya terbakar dengan kekuatan\lapi? Aku bisa mengajari Pokémon-mu

[green]Pukulan Api[blue] hanya dengan [green][buffer2]
[buffer1]s[blue]!

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon is raring to fire up
their hands with [green]Fire Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is raring to fire up their hands with [green]Fire Punch[blue]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang siap untuk
membakar tangannya dengan [green]Pukulan\lApi[blue]?

entries.original: "Fire power!"
entries.translation_source: Fire power!
entries.translated: Kekuatan api!

entries.original:
"Fizzle\.
You don’t have enough [green][buffer1]s[blue].

I can’t burn up those hands
for nothing\."
entries.translation_source: Fizzle\. You don’t have enough [green][buffer1]s[blue]. I can’t burn up those hands for nothing\.
entries.translated:
Gagal\. Kamu tidak punya cukup
[green][buffer1]s[blue]. Aku tidak bisa membakar\ltangan itu dengan gratis\.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over
[buffer2] [buffer1][buffer3]."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over [buffer2] [buffer1][buffer3].
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2]
[buffer1][buffer3].

entries.original:
"[blue]\.Welcome\.

\.
\.Kekeke\.

We’ve had a reservation for you.
We’ve held it for a long time\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]\.Welcome\. \. \.Kekeke\. We’ve had a reservation for you. We’ve held it for a long time\.
entries.translated:
[blue]\.Selamat datang\. \. \.Kekeke\. Kami sudah
memiliki reservasi untukmu. Kami\lsudah menahannya untuk waktu yang

lama\.

entries.original:
"[player] lay down on the bed as if
bidden there."
entries.translation_source: [player] lay down on the bed as if bidden there.
entries.translated:
[player] berbaring di tempat tidur
seolah diperintahkan.

entries.original: "[player] awakened!"
entries.translation_source: [player] awakened!
entries.translated: [player] terbangun!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon walking around this
lab all assist in the research.

They’re all special Pokémon known
for their connection to dreams."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon walking around this lab all assist in the research. They’re all special Pokémon known for their connection to dreams.
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon yang berjalan di lab
ini membantu penelitian. Mereka\lsemua adalah Pokémon spesial yang

dikenal karena hubungannya dengan
mimpi.

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s the Champion!

We’re developing a special Poké
Ball, here at the Dream Research\lLab, and we’d be honoured if you’d\ltest it out for us!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s the Champion! We’re developing a special Poké Ball, here at the Dream Research Lab, and we’d be honoured if you’d test it out for us!
entries.translated:
Oh, ini Sang Juara! Kami sedang
mengembangkan Bola Pokémon khusus\ldi Laboratorium Riset Mimpi, dan

kami akan merasa terhormat jika
Anda mau mengujinya untuk kami!

entries.original:
"Those are [green]Dream Balls[blue].

They’re better for capturing
Pokémon that are [green]asleep[blue].

Any Pokémon caught with them will
also have its [green]Hidden Ability[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Those are [green]Dream Balls[blue]. They’re better for capturing Pokémon that are [green]asleep[blue]. Any Pokémon caught with them will also have its [green]Hidden Ability[blue].
entries.translated:
Itu adalah [green]Dream Balls[blue]. Mereka
lebih baik untuk menangkap Pokémon\lyang [green]tertidur[blue]. Setiap Pokémon yang

ditangkap dengannya juga akan
memiliki [green]Hidden Ability[blue].

entries.original:
"In the Unova region, a scientist
named Fennel created a device that\lallows people to enter the dreams\lof their Pokémon.

We’re working on our own version of
the device for humans.

The goal is to allow people to go
back and relive their worst\lnightmare."
entries.translation_source: In the Unova region, a scientist named Fennel created a device that allows people to enter the dreams of their Pokémon. We’re working on our own version of the device for humans. The goal is to allow people to go back and relive their worst nightmare.
entries.translated:
Di wilayah Unova, seorang ilmuwan
bernama Fennel menciptakan alat\lyang memungkinkan orang memasuki

mimpi Pokémon mereka. Kami sedang
mengerjakan versi kami sendiri dari\lalat untuk manusia. Tujuannya

adalah untuk memungkinkan orang
kembali dan menghidupkan kembali\lmimpi buruk terburuk mereka.

entries.original:
"I’ve done it!

I’ve managed to create a device
capable of sending people back\linto their worst nightmare!

And I can tell\.

You were sent to a nightmarish
world of nothingness, where you\lencountered illusions of your\lfriends and family, yes?

And then you fought a giant Pokémon
that loved plunging your Pokémon\linto a deep sleep, over and again,\lyes?

\.It’s all in your eyes.

My machine can use that trauma
to send you there again!

\.Why would you want to go
back there?

Well, they say that confronting
your worst nightmare a second\ltime can show you a path to the\lheavens itself!

However, you will needs relics
connected to the heavens for this\lto work.

I believe people can dig such
relics up with the ADM\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve done it! I’ve managed to create a device capable of sending people back into their worst nightmare! And I can tell\. You were sent to a nightmarish world of nothingness, where you encountered illusions of your friends and family, yes? And then you fought a giant Pokémon that loved plunging your Pokémon into a deep sleep, over and again, yes? \.It’s all in your eyes. My machine can use that trauma to send you there again! \.Why would you want to go back there? Well, they say that confronting your worst nightmare a second time can show you a path to the heavens itself! However, you will needs relics connected to the heavens for this to work. I believe people can dig such relics up with the ADM\.
entries.translated:
Aku berhasil! Aku berhasil
menciptakan alat yang mampu\lmengirim orang kembali ke mimpi

buruk terburuk mereka! Dan aku bisa
tahu\. Kamu dikirim ke dunia hampa\lyang mengerikan, di mana kamu

bertemu ilusi teman dan keluargamu,
ya? Dan kemudian kamu melawan\lPokémon raksasa yang suka

menjerumuskan Pokémon-mu ke dalam
tidur nyenyak, berulang kali, ya?\l\.Semua itu ada di matamu. Mesinku

bisa menggunakan trauma itu untuk
mengirimmu ke sana lagi! \.Kenapa\lkamu ingin kembali ke sana? Yah,

mereka bilang bahwa menghadapi
mimpi buruk terburukmu untuk kedua\lkalinya bisa menunjukkan jalan

menuju surga itu sendiri! Namun,
kamu akan membutuhkan peninggalan\lyang terhubung ke surga agar ini

berhasil. Aku percaya orang bisa
menggali peninggalan seperti itu\ldengan ADM\.

entries.original:
"Huh?

It seems my machine is reacting to
those Plates in your Cube!

Would you like me to activate my
machine and send you back into\lyour worst nightmare?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? It seems my machine is reacting to those Plates in your Cube! Would you like me to activate my machine and send you back into your worst nightmare?
entries.translated:
Hah? Sepertinya mesinku bereaksi
terhadap Plat-Plat di Kubusmu!\lApakah kamu ingin aku mengaktifkan

mesinku dan mengirimmu kembali ke
mimpi buruk terburukmu?

entries.original:
"It seems my machine is reacting to
those Plates in your Cube!

Would you like me to activate my
machine and send you back into\lyour worst nightmare?"
entries.translation_source: It seems my machine is reacting to those Plates in your Cube! Would you like me to activate my machine and send you back into your worst nightmare?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya mesinku bereaksi
terhadap Plat-Plat di Kubusmu!\lApakah kamu ingin aku mengaktifkan

mesinku dan mengirimmu kembali ke
mimpi buruk terburukmu?

entries.original:
"B-but science!

Think of all the possibilities!"
entries.translation_source: B-but science! Think of all the possibilities!
entries.translated:
T-tapi ilmu pengetahuan! Pikirkan
semua kemungkinan!

entries.original:
"Okay, let me just flip this switch,
and\."
entries.translation_source: Okay, let me just flip this switch, and\.
entries.translated:
Oke, biarkan aku membalik saklar
ini, dan\.

entries.original:
"The machine has been activated!

You’ll be entering a dream-like
state, any moment now.

I’ll try to hijack someone found
in your memory so I can keep tabs\lon you while you’re under.

Just come find me whenever you’re
ready to leave."
entries.translation_source: The machine has been activated! You’ll be entering a dream-like state, any moment now. I’ll try to hijack someone found in your memory so I can keep tabs on you while you’re under. Just come find me whenever you’re ready to leave.
entries.translated:
Mesin telah diaktifkan! Kamu akan
memasuki kondisi seperti mimpi,\lkapan saja sekarang. Aku akan

mencoba membajak seseorang yang
ditemukan di ingatanmu sehingga aku\lbisa mengawasimu saat kamu di

bawah. Datang saja temui aku kapan
pun kamu siap untuk pergi.

entries.original:
"Are you ready to wake up and return
to Tarmigan Town?"
entries.translation_source: Are you ready to wake up and return to Tarmigan Town?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu siap untuk bangun dan
kembali ke Tarmigan Town?

entries.original:
"I’ll be using this body to keep
tabs on you.

Speak to it when you’re ready
to leave."
entries.translation_source: I’ll be using this body to keep tabs on you. Speak to it when you’re ready to leave.
entries.translated:
Aku akan menggunakan tubuh ini
untuk mengawasimu. Bicara padanya\lsaat kamu siap untuk pergi.

entries.original:
"Did you enjoy reliving your
worst nightmare?

As long as you bring those Plates,
I can send you there, again!"
entries.translation_source: Did you enjoy reliving your worst nightmare? As long as you bring those Plates, I can send you there, again!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu menikmati menghidupkan
kembali mimpi buruk terburukmu?\lSelama kamu membawa Plat-Plat itu,

aku bisa mengirimmu ke sana lagi!

entries.original:
"Huh?

My machine isn’t reacting to your
Cube anymore.

Did you take those Plates out
of it?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? My machine isn’t reacting to your Cube anymore. Did you take those Plates out of it?
entries.translated:
Hah? Mesinku tidak lagi bereaksi
terhadap Kubusmu. Apakah kamu\lmengeluarkan Plat-Plat itu darinya?

entries.original:
"All of the Pokémon found in this
laboratory eat dreams.

They do this using the unique
[green]Dream Eater[red] move.

Your Pokémon are capable of
learning it, too!"
entries.translation_source: All of the Pokémon found in this laboratory eat dreams. They do this using the unique [green]Dream Eater[red] move. Your Pokémon are capable of learning it, too!
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon yang ditemukan di
laboratorium ini memakan mimpi.\lMereka melakukan ini menggunakan

jurus unik [green]Dream Eater[red]. Pokémonmu
juga bisa mempelajarinya!

entries.original:
"[green]Dream Eater[red] allows you to do damage
and restore HP at the same time!

But it only works if the target
is sleeping\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Dream Eater[red] allows you to do damage and restore HP at the same time! But it only works if the target is sleeping\.
entries.translated:
[green]Dream Eater[red] memungkinkanmu untuk
memberikan damage dan memulihkan HP\lpada saat yang sama! Tapi itu hanya

berfungsi jika target sedang tidur\.

entries.original: "[green]Naaa!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Naaa!
entries.translated: [green]Naaa!

entries.original: "[green]Mmm\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Mmm\.
entries.translated: [green]Mmm\.

entries.original: "[green]Gar!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Gar!
entries.translated: [green]Gar!

entries.original: "[green]Hyyyyyyyyypno\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Hyyyyyyyyypno\.
entries.translated: [green]Hyyyyyyyyypno\.

entries.original:
"Somewhere in this house resides
Successor Maxima.

If you find her, she’ll give you
something special."
entries.translation_source: Somewhere in this house resides Successor Maxima. If you find her, she’ll give you something special.
entries.translated:
Di suatu tempat di rumah ini
tinggal Successor Maxima. Jika kamu\lmenemukannya, dia akan memberimu

sesuatu yang istimewa.

entries.original:
"A switch is hidden in one of the
statues in the mansion.

If you manage to find it, it will
open up a new passageway."
entries.translation_source: A switch is hidden in one of the statues in the mansion. If you manage to find it, it will open up a new passageway.
entries.translated:
Sebuah sakelar tersembunyi di salah
satu patung di mansion. Jika kamu\lberhasil menemukannya, itu akan

membuka jalan baru.

entries.original:
"There are plenty of different
healing methods available to you\lin the mansion.

It’s honestly a little redundant\."
entries.translation_source: There are plenty of different healing methods available to you in the mansion. It’s honestly a little redundant\.
entries.translated:
Ada banyak metode penyembuhan
berbeda yang tersedia untukmu di\lmansion. Sejujurnya itu agak

berlebihan\.

entries.original:
"As chefs, it is our sworn duty to
prepare the finest quality food for\lthe master of this mansion.

That being Successor Maxima,
of course."
entries.translation_source: As chefs, it is our sworn duty to prepare the finest quality food for the master of this mansion. That being Successor Maxima, of course.
entries.translated:
Sebagai koki, sudah menjadi tugas
suci kami untuk menyiapkan makanan\lberkualitas terbaik untuk tuan

mansion ini. Tentu saja, yaitu
Penerus Maxima.

entries.original:
"Some Berries like the [green]Occa Berry[blue]
and [green]Passho Berry[blue] reduce the amount\lof damage Pokémon receive from\l[green]super-effective[blue] moves.

Like all Berries, they’re [green]one-time
use[blue] only in regular battles.

But I hear stronger Pokémon in
[green]Hidden Grottos[blue] tend to drop them\lfrequently after battles\."
entries.translation_source: Some Berries like the [green]Occa Berry[blue] and [green]Passho Berry[blue] reduce the amount of damage Pokémon receive from [green]super-effective[blue] moves. Like all Berries, they’re [green]one-time use[blue] only in regular battles. But I hear stronger Pokémon in [green]Hidden Grottos[blue] tend to drop them frequently after battles\.
entries.translated:
Beberapa Bual seperti [green]Occa Berry[blue]
dan [green]Passho Berry[blue] mengurangi jumlah\lkerusakan yang diterima Pokémon

dari serangan [green]super efektif[blue].
Seperti semua Bual, mereka hanya\l[green]sekali pakai[blue] dalam pertarungan

biasa. Tapi kudengar Pokémon yang
lebih kuat di [green]Gua Tersembunyi[blue]\lcenderung menjatuhkannya sering

setelah pertarungan\.

entries.original:
"There are some Berries like the
[green]Kee Berry[blue] and [green]Maranga Berry[blue] that\lare really hard to come by.

Whenever our master ingredient
gatherer happens to come across\lone, we make sure to cook it\linto a delectable meal."
entries.translation_source: There are some Berries like the [green]Kee Berry[blue] and [green]Maranga Berry[blue] that are really hard to come by. Whenever our master ingredient gatherer happens to come across one, we make sure to cook it into a delectable meal.
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Bual seperti [green]Kee Berry[blue]
dan [green]Maranga Berry[blue] yang sangat sulit\ldidapat. Setiap kali pengumpul

bahan utama kami kebetulan
menemukannya, kami pasti memasaknya\lmenjadi hidangan lezat.

entries.original:
"Berries like the [green]Liechi Berry[blue] and
[green]Salac Berry[blue] are only eaten by\lPokémon in a [green]pinch[blue]!

What’s a pinch?

That’s simple!

A [green]pinch[blue] is whenever the health bar
shows [lightgreen]red[blue].

But for Pokémon with the ability
[green]Gluttony[blue], a pinch is whenever the\lhealth bar shows [orange]yellow[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Berries like the [green]Liechi Berry[blue] and [green]Salac Berry[blue] are only eaten by Pokémon in a [green]pinch[blue]! What’s a pinch? That’s simple! A [green]pinch[blue] is whenever the health bar shows [lightgreen]red[blue]. But for Pokémon with the ability [green]Gluttony[blue], a pinch is whenever the health bar shows [orange]yellow[blue].
entries.translated:
Bual seperti [green]Liechi Berry[blue] dan [green]Salac
Berry[blue] hanya dimakan oleh Pokémon\lsaat [green]kritis[blue]! Apa itu kritis?

Sederhana! [green]Kritis[blue] adalah saat bilah
kesehatan menunjukkan [lightgreen]merah[blue]. Tapi\luntuk Pokémon dengan kemampuan

[green]Kerakusan[blue], kritis adalah saat bilah
kesehatan menunjukkan [orange]kuning[blue].

entries.original:
"I got stuck on dishes duty\.
What a drag\.

Everyone else gets to cook and
talk about Berries\."
entries.translation_source: I got stuck on dishes duty\. What a drag\. Everyone else gets to cook and talk about Berries\.
entries.translated:
Aku terjebak tugas cuci piring\.
Membosankan sekali\. Yang lain bisa\lmemasak dan berbicara tentang

Bual-bual\.

entries.original:
"Here, enjoy these fresh handpicked
ingredients from the garden."
entries.translation_source: Here, enjoy these fresh handpicked ingredients from the garden.
entries.translated:
Ini, nikmati bahan-bahan segar yang
dipetik langsung dari kebun.

entries.original:
"I’m responsible for gathering the
daily ingredients."
entries.translation_source: I’m responsible for gathering the daily ingredients.
entries.translated:
Aku bertanggung jawab mengumpulkan
bahan harian.

entries.original: "Maxima"
entries.translation_source: Maxima
entries.translated: Maxima

entries.original:
"There’s a switch somewhere that
opens up a path to Maxima."
entries.translation_source: There’s a switch somewhere that opens up a path to Maxima.
entries.translated:
Ada sakelar di suatu tempat yang
membuka jalan menuju Maxima.

entries.original:
"I probably won’t get anywhere if I
keep standing here."
entries.translation_source: I probably won’t get anywhere if I keep standing here.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku tidak akan kemana-mana
jika terus berdiri di sini.

entries.original:
"I need to grow even stronger to
surpass the others."
entries.translation_source: I need to grow even stronger to surpass the others.
entries.translated:
Aku harus menjadi lebih kuat untuk
melampaui yang lain.

entries.original:
"I’d say this point in the challenge
is around the mid-point."
entries.translation_source: I’d say this point in the challenge is around the mid-point.
entries.translated:
Menurutku, titik dalam tantangan
ini sekitar pertengahan.

entries.original:
"A statue with a switch?
Never heard of it."
entries.translation_source: A statue with a switch? Never heard of it.
entries.translated:
Patung dengan sakelar? Tidak pernah
dengar.

entries.original: "Super-de-duper-de-doo!"
entries.translation_source: Super-de-duper-de-doo!
entries.translated: Super-duper-de-doo!

entries.original:
"Unlike the other experts, I’m still
young and free!"
entries.translation_source: Unlike the other experts, I’m still young and free!
entries.translated:
Tidak seperti para ahli lainnya,
aku masih muda dan bebas!

entries.original:
"One day, my dragons will soar high
in their Mega Evolved forms!"
entries.translation_source: One day, my dragons will soar high in their Mega Evolved forms!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, naga-nagaku akan
terbang tinggi dalam bentuk Mega\lEvolusi mereka!

entries.original:
"If you can fight your way through
this mansion, you can learn the\lsacred art of Mega Evolution."
entries.translation_source: If you can fight your way through this mansion, you can learn the sacred art of Mega Evolution.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa bertarung melewati
mansion ini, kamu bisa mempelajari\lseni suci Mega Evolusi.

entries.original:
"You’d better hope you have enough
healing items."
entries.translation_source: You’d better hope you have enough healing items.
entries.translated:
Semoga kamu punya cukup item
penyembuh.

entries.original: "The end is nigh."
entries.translation_source: The end is nigh.
entries.translated: Akhir sudah dekat.

entries.original:
"Remember this: power corrupts, and
absolute power corrupts absolutely.

The same can be said about
Mega Evolution.

Be careful."
entries.translation_source: Remember this: power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely. The same can be said about Mega Evolution. Be careful.
entries.translated:
Ingat ini: kekuasaan mengkorup, dan
kekuasaan mutlak mengkorup secara\lmutlak. Hal yang sama dapat

dikatakan tentang Mega Evolution.
Hati-hati.

entries.original:
"Whenever you’re ready to face
Maxima, just walk off the ledge.

Don’t worry, it won’t hurt."
entries.translation_source: Whenever you’re ready to face Maxima, just walk off the ledge. Don’t worry, it won’t hurt.
entries.translated:
Kapan pun kamu siap menghadapi
Maxima, berjalanlah dari tepian.\lJangan khawatir, itu tidak akan

sakit.

entries.original:
"Hello there, Trainer.

I am the Mansion’s Successor,
Maxima.

If you’re here, then I should
congratulate you for navigating\lyour way to me.

I presume, like many others, you
have come here seeking the power\lof [green]Mega Evolution[red]?

\.

As I thought.

However, it is one thing to \qowant\qc.
It is quite another to \qodeserve\qc.

You see, Mega Evolution is only
possible when both Trainer and\lPokémon share a deep bond.

Yet, there are those who visit me,
focused only on what perceived\lpower can be achieved with\lMega Evolution.

And the bonds that make Mega
Evolution possible\.\CC0818 are not always\lbonds of friendship and love.

So, if I am to pass on such a
technique to someone, it must be\lsomeone of both skill, and a\lnatural love for Pokémon.

This shall be my final test."
entries.translation_source: Hello there, Trainer. I am the Mansion’s Successor, Maxima. If you’re here, then I should congratulate you for navigating your way to me. I presume, like many others, you have come here seeking the power of [green]Mega Evolution[red]? \. As I thought. However, it is one thing to \qowant\qc. It is quite another to \qodeserve\qc. You see, Mega Evolution is only possible when both Trainer and Pokémon share a deep bond. Yet, there are those who visit me, focused only on what perceived power can be achieved with Mega Evolution. And the bonds that make Mega Evolution possible\.\CC0818 are not always bonds of friendship and love. So, if I am to pass on such a technique to someone, it must be someone of both skill, and a natural love for Pokémon. This shall be my final test.
entries.translated:
Halo, Trainer. Saya adalah Penerus
Mansion, Maxima. Jika kamu di sini,\lmaka saya harus mengucapkan selamat

karena telah menemukan jalan ke
saya. Saya kira, seperti banyak\llainnya, kamu datang ke sini

mencari kekuatan [green]Mega Evolution[red]? \.
Seperti yang saya duga. Namun, satu\lhal untuk \qowant\qc. Hal lain untuk

\qodeserve\qc. Anda lihat, Mega
Evolution hanya mungkin ketika\lTrainer dan Pokémon memiliki ikatan

yang dalam. Namun, ada yang
mengunjungi saya, hanya fokus pada\lkekuatan yang dirasakan dapat

dicapai dengan Mega Evolution. Dan
ikatan yang membuat Mega Evolution\lmungkin\.\CC0818 tidak selalu ikatan

persahabatan dan cinta. Jadi, jika
saya akan menurunkan teknik seperti\litu kepada seseorang, itu harus

seseorang yang memiliki
keterampilan dan cinta alami untuk\lPokémon. Ini akan menjadi ujian

terakhir saya.

entries.original:
"Triumph over me, and show me you are
worthy of wielding my greatest gift!"
entries.translation_source: Triumph over me, and show me you are worthy of wielding my greatest gift!
entries.translated:
Kalahkan aku, dan tunjukkan bahwa
kamu layak menggunakan hadiah\lterbesarku!

entries.original:
"How amazing\.\CC0818 truly, you have shown
that you can be trusted to use\lthis power, responsibly and without\lreckless abandon.

I bestow upon you, then, your very
own Mega Keystone.

Yet before I do\.\CC0818 I’d like you to
choose a suitable vessel for it.

Fu fu fu\.\CC0818 not to worry.
They are functionally identical.

Just\.\CC0818 choose the one that
suits you best."
entries.translation_source: How amazing\.\CC0818 truly, you have shown that you can be trusted to use this power, responsibly and without reckless abandon. I bestow upon you, then, your very own Mega Keystone. Yet before I do\.\CC0818 I’d like you to choose a suitable vessel for it. Fu fu fu\.\CC0818 not to worry. They are functionally identical. Just\.\CC0818 choose the one that suits you best.
entries.translated:
Sungguh menakjubkan\.\CC0818 benar-benar,
kamu telah menunjukkan bahwa kamu\ldapat dipercaya untuk menggunakan

kekuatan ini, secara bertanggung
jawab dan tanpa kecerobohan. Maka\lsaya berikan kepadamu, Batu Kunci

Mega milikmu sendiri. Namun sebelum
saya lakukan\.\CC0818 Saya ingin kamu\lmemilih wadah yang cocok untuknya.

Fu fu fu\.\CC0818 jangan khawatir. Mereka
secara fungsional identik. Hanya\.\CC0818\lpilih yang paling cocok untukmu.

entries.original:
"Just\.\CC0818 choose the one that
suits you best."
entries.translation_source: Just\.\CC0818 choose the one that suits you best.
entries.translated:
Hanya\.\CC0818 pilih yang paling cocok
untukmu.

entries.original:
"You would like the
[green][buffer1][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You would like the [green][buffer1][red]?
entries.translated: Kamu ingin [green][buffer1][red]?

entries.original:
"I see.

Yes, I think you do carry that
[buffer1] very well, myself.

Anyway, you now have the power to
[green]Mega Evolve[red] your Pokémon.

For a Pokémon to be capable of
Mega Evolving in battle, it must\lbe holding its unique [green]Mega Stone[red].

You should see if that Pokémon can
Mega Evolve by the [green]Mega Symbol[red] in\lthe battle menu.

Should it appear, press \btn04
before you select your next\lattack.

Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve
and become more powerful.

Keep in mind, however, you can
only Mega Evolve a Pokémon [green]once[red]\lper battle, and it wears off if the\lbattle ends, or the Mega Evolved\lPokémon faints.

Now, take that power\.\CC0818 and use it
for the good of humanity.

I shall be counting on you to change
the world\.\CC0818 and make a real impact\."
entries.translation_source: I see. Yes, I think you do carry that [buffer1] very well, myself. Anyway, you now have the power to [green]Mega Evolve[red] your Pokémon. For a Pokémon to be capable of Mega Evolving in battle, it must be holding its unique [green]Mega Stone[red]. You should see if that Pokémon can Mega Evolve by the [green]Mega Symbol[red] in the battle menu. Should it appear, press \btn04 before you select your next attack. Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve and become more powerful. Keep in mind, however, you can only Mega Evolve a Pokémon [green]once[red] per battle, and it wears off if the battle ends, or the Mega Evolved Pokémon faints. Now, take that power\.\CC0818 and use it for the good of humanity. I shall be counting on you to change the world\.\CC0818 and make a real impact\.
entries.translated:
Begitu. Ya, saya pikir kamu memang
membawa [buffer1] itu dengan sangat\lbaik, menurut saya. Bagaimanapun,

kamu sekarang memiliki kekuatan
untuk [green]Mega Evolve[red] Pokémon-mu. Agar\lPokémon dapat Mega Evolve dalam

pertempuran, ia harus memegang [green]Batu
Mega[red] yang unik. Kamu harus melihat\lapakah Pokémon itu dapat Mega

Evolve melalui [green]Simbol Mega[red] di menu
pertempuran. Jika muncul, tekan \btn04\lsebelum kamu memilih serangan

berikutnya. Pokémon-mu kemudian
akan Mega Evolve dan menjadi lebih\lkuat. Namun perlu diingat, kamu

hanya dapat Mega Evolve Pokémon
[green]sekali[red] per pertempuran, dan efeknya\lhilang jika pertempuran berakhir,

atau Pokémon yang Mega Evolve
pingsan. Sekarang, ambil kekuatan\litu\.\CC0818 dan gunakan untuk kebaikan umat

manusia. Saya akan mengandalkanmu
untuk mengubah dunia\.\CC0818 dan membuat\ldampak nyata\.

entries.original:
"For a Pokémon to be capable of
Mega Evolving in battle, it must\lbe holding its unique [green]Mega Stone[red].

You should see if that Pokémon can
Mega Evolve by the [green]Mega Symbol[red] in\lthe battle menu.

Should it appear, press \btn04
before you select your next\lattack.

Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve
and become more powerful.

Keep in mind, however, you can
only Mega Evolve a Pokémon [green]once[red]\lper battle, and it wears off if the\lbattle ends, or the Mega Evolved\lPokémon faints.

Now, take that power\.\CC0818 and use it
for the good of humanity.

I shall be counting on you to change
the world\.\CC0818 and make a real impact\."
entries.translation_source: For a Pokémon to be capable of Mega Evolving in battle, it must be holding its unique [green]Mega Stone[red]. You should see if that Pokémon can Mega Evolve by the [green]Mega Symbol[red] in the battle menu. Should it appear, press \btn04 before you select your next attack. Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve and become more powerful. Keep in mind, however, you can only Mega Evolve a Pokémon [green]once[red] per battle, and it wears off if the battle ends, or the Mega Evolved Pokémon faints. Now, take that power\.\CC0818 and use it for the good of humanity. I shall be counting on you to change the world\.\CC0818 and make a real impact\.
entries.translated:
Agar Pokémon dapat Mega Evolve
dalam pertempuran, ia harus\lmemegang [green]Batu Mega[red] yang unik. Kamu

harus melihat apakah Pokémon itu
dapat Mega Evolve melalui [green]Simbol\lMega[red] di menu pertempuran. Jika

muncul, tekan \btn04 sebelum kamu
memilih serangan berikutnya.\lPokémon-mu kemudian akan Mega

Evolve dan menjadi lebih kuat.
Namun perlu diingat, kamu hanya\ldapat Mega Evolve Pokémon [green]sekali[red]

per pertempuran, dan efeknya hilang
jika pertempuran berakhir, atau\lPokémon yang Mega Evolve pingsan.

Sekarang, ambil kekuatan itu\.\CC0818 dan
gunakan untuk kebaikan umat\lmanusia. Saya akan mengandalkanmu

untuk mengubah dunia\.\CC0818 dan membuat
dampak nyata\.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes. Of course.
It almost slipped my mind.

Take this Mega Stone, the same one
I use - for the Pokémon Altaria."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes. Of course. It almost slipped my mind. Take this Mega Stone, the same one I use - for the Pokémon Altaria.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya. Tentu saja. Hampir terlewat
dari pikiranku. Ambil Batu Mega\lini, yang sama yang saya gunakan -

untuk Pokémon Altaria.

entries.original: "Mega Ring"
entries.translation_source: Mega Ring
entries.translated: Mega Ring

entries.original: "Mega Bracelet"
entries.translation_source: Mega Bracelet
entries.translated: Mega Bracelet

entries.original: "Mega Cuff"
entries.translation_source: Mega Cuff
entries.translated: Mega Cuff

entries.original: "Mega Charm"
entries.translation_source: Mega Charm
entries.translated: Mega Charm

entries.original: "It’s an ordinary statue."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ordinary statue.
entries.translated: Itu patung biasa.

entries.original:
"A secret switch!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: A secret switch! Press it?
entries.translated: Saklar rahasia! Tekan?

entries.original: "Who wouldn’t?"
entries.translation_source: Who wouldn’t?
entries.translated: Siapa yang tidak?

entries.original: "Not quite yet!"
entries.translation_source: Not quite yet!
entries.translated: Belum sekarang!

entries.original:
"Mega Evolution was first discovered
in the Kalos Region by the renowned\lProfessor Sycamore.

Thanks to his research, Pokémon
are now able to Mega Evolve\lduring battle.

However, a large part of Mega
Evolution still remains a mystery."
entries.translation_source: Mega Evolution was first discovered in the Kalos Region by the renowned Professor Sycamore. Thanks to his research, Pokémon are now able to Mega Evolve during battle. However, a large part of Mega Evolution still remains a mystery.
entries.translated:
Mega Evolution pertama kali
ditemukan di Region Kalos oleh\lProfesor Sycamore yang terkenal.

Berkat penelitiannya, Pokémon
sekarang dapat Mega Evolve selama\lpertempuran. Namun, sebagian besar

dari Mega Evolution masih tetap
menjadi misteri.

entries.original:
"It’s a book on Mega Evolution
by Prof. Log!

It says Pokémon that Mega Evolve
during battle are granted higher\lstats for the rest of the battle.

The remainder of the book is empty.
Prof. Log only researches stats."
entries.translation_source: It’s a book on Mega Evolution by Prof. Log! It says Pokémon that Mega Evolve during battle are granted higher stats for the rest of the battle. The remainder of the book is empty. Prof. Log only researches stats.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah buku tentang Mega
Evolusi oleh Prof. Log! Dikatakan\lbahwa Pokémon yang melakukan Mega

Evolusi selama pertempuran
mendapatkan statistik yang lebih\ltinggi untuk sisa pertempuran. Sisa

buku ini kosong. Prof. Log hanya
meneliti statistik.

entries.original:
"The town has had a problem with
nightmares for the longest time.

I wish somebody would do something
about it already\."
entries.translation_source: The town has had a problem with nightmares for the longest time. I wish somebody would do something about it already\.
entries.translated:
Kota ini telah memiliki masalah
dengan mimpi buruk sejak lama. Aku\lberharap seseorang sudah melakukan

sesuatu tentang itu\.

entries.original:
"Is it true?

Has Tarmigan’s nightmare
really ended?

I’m ecstatic!
This is amazing!

I can finally sleep well again
at night!"
entries.translation_source: Is it true? Has Tarmigan’s nightmare really ended? I’m ecstatic! This is amazing! I can finally sleep well again at night!
entries.translated:
Apakah benar? Apakah mimpi buruk
Tarmigan benar-benar berakhir? Aku\lsangat gembira! Ini luar biasa! Aku

akhirnya bisa tidur nyenyak lagi di
malam hari!

entries.original:
"Do you need a way back down
the mountain?

My Abra and I will be more than
happy to teleport you down.

What do you say?
Do you want to be teleported?"
entries.translation_source: Do you need a way back down the mountain? My Abra and I will be more than happy to teleport you down. What do you say? Do you want to be teleported?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu butuh cara untuk turun
dari gunung? Abra-ku dan aku akan\lsangat senang untuk memindahkanmu

ke bawah. Bagaimana menurutmu?
Apakah kamu ingin dipindahkan?

entries.original:
"Okay, then!

Abra, use Teleport!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, then! Abra, use Teleport!
entries.translated: Baiklah! Abra, gunakan Teleport!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind,
come back.

We’ll be sitting here."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind, come back. We’ll be sitting here.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berubah pikiran,
kembalilah. Kami akan duduk di\lsini.

entries.original: "[green]Braaaaa!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Braaaaa!
entries.translated: [green]Braaaaa!

entries.original:
"Items like [green]Mega Stones[red] and
[green]Z-Crystals[red] can’t be purchased.

The only way you can get them is by
finding them lying around, or by\lreceiving them as gifts."
entries.translation_source: Items like [green]Mega Stones[red] and [green]Z-Crystals[red] can’t be purchased. The only way you can get them is by finding them lying around, or by receiving them as gifts.
entries.translated:
Barang seperti [green]Mega Stones[red] dan
[green]Z-Crystals[red] tidak dapat dibeli.\lSatu-satunya cara untuk

mendapatkannya adalah dengan
menemukannya tergeletak di sekitar,\latau menerimanya sebagai hadiah.

entries.original:
"If only there were some way to give
a Pokémon a stat boost at the\lbeginning of battle without needing\lto use an item\.

I’m sure someone out there is
trying to figure that out.

Perhaps someone from the renowned
Science Society?"
entries.translation_source: If only there were some way to give a Pokémon a stat boost at the beginning of battle without needing to use an item\. I’m sure someone out there is trying to figure that out. Perhaps someone from the renowned Science Society?
entries.translated:
Andai saja ada cara untuk
memberikan Pokémon peningkatan stat\ldi awal pertempuran tanpa perlu

menggunakan item\. Aku yakin
seseorang di luar sana sedang\lmencoba mencari tahu itu. Mungkin

seseorang dari Perkumpulan Sains
yang terkenal?

entries.original:
"[green]Route 10 [blue]has a cave that resembles
the [green]Lake Caves [blue]of [green]Sinnoh[blue].

I’ve never been in it myself, but
I’ve heard things\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Route 10 [blue]has a cave that resembles the [green]Lake Caves [blue]of [green]Sinnoh[blue]. I’ve never been in it myself, but I’ve heard things\.
entries.translated:
[green]Route 10 [blue]memiliki sebuah gua yang
mirip dengan [green]Lake Caves [blue]di [green]Sinnoh[blue].\lAku sendiri belum pernah masuk ke

dalamnya, tapi aku pernah mendengar
hal-hal\.

entries.original:
"One day, I’m gunna put Tehl Town
on t’ map.

If yeh ever see me statues aroun’
Borrius, yeh’ll know they’re good.

But I promise yeh, I’ll build t’
biggest, bestest one right here!"
entries.translation_source: One day, I’m gunna put Tehl Town on t’ map. If yeh ever see me statues aroun’ Borrius, yeh’ll know they’re good. But I promise yeh, I’ll build t’ biggest, bestest one right here!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, aku akan menempatkan
Tehl Town di peta. Jika kamu pernah\lmelihat patung-patungku di sekitar

Borrius, kamu akan tahu bahwa
patung-patung itu bagus. Tapi aku\lberjanji padamu, aku akan membangun

yang terbesar dan terbaik di sini!

entries.original:
"I swear\.

Those weird guys have been blocking
off [green]Route 9[blue] for days\.

I wonder what they’re up to?"
entries.translation_source: I swear\. Those weird guys have been blocking off [green]Route 9[blue] for days\. I wonder what they’re up to?
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah\. Orang-orang aneh itu
telah memblokir [green]Route 9[blue] selama\lbeberapa hari\. Aku penasaran apa

yang mereka rencanakan?

entries.original: "Here, take these!"
entries.translation_source: Here, take these!
entries.translated: Ini, ambillah!

entries.original:
"One of Professor Log’s Aides who
lives in Tehl Town will give you\la gift if you’ve captured\lenough Pokémon.

I hope those help you fill up
your Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: One of Professor Log’s Aides who lives in Tehl Town will give you a gift if you’ve captured enough Pokémon. I hope those help you fill up your Pokédex!
entries.translated:
Salah satu Asisten Profesor Log
yang tinggal di Tehl Town akan\lmemberimu hadiah jika kamu telah

menangkap cukup banyak Pokémon. Aku
harap itu membantumu mengisi\lPokédex-mu!

entries.original: "Statue of Regi"
entries.translation_source: Statue of Regi
entries.translated: Patung Regi

entries.original:
"’Scuse me, yeh couldn’ spare a
moment, could yeh?

Listen\. I was one o’ the best
statue builder’s ’n Borrius.

But lately, m’ skills got stagnant
- the ol’ muse dried up ’n all.

Thing is, aye\. heard stories
’bout an ancient king - a king\lstrong enough t’ tow countries\lw’ ropes.

Eons an’ eons old, it is.

Would yeh believe me if I said I
found it?

Under m’ home in Bellin.
Right there?

Would bring the big lump here
m’self, but it won’ budge.

No idea how t’ wake it up, either.

But, eh\. yeh look handy - couldn’
bring it here, could yeh?"
entries.translation_source: ’Scuse me, yeh couldn’ spare a moment, could yeh? Listen\. I was one o’ the best statue builder’s ’n Borrius. But lately, m’ skills got stagnant - the ol’ muse dried up ’n all. Thing is, aye\. heard stories ’bout an ancient king - a king strong enough t’ tow countries w’ ropes. Eons an’ eons old, it is. Would yeh believe me if I said I found it? Under m’ home in Bellin. Right there? Would bring the big lump here m’self, but it won’ budge. No idea how t’ wake it up, either. But, eh\. yeh look handy - couldn’ bring it here, could yeh?
entries.translated:
Maaf, bisakah kamu meluangkan waktu
sebentar? Dengar\. Aku adalah salah\lsatu pembangun patung terbaik di

Borrius. Tapi akhir-akhir ini,
kemampuanku mandek - inspirasi\llamaku mengering. Masalahnya, ya\.

aku mendengar cerita tentang
seorang raja kuno - seorang raja\lyang cukup kuat untuk menyeret

negara dengan tali. Usianya
berabad-abad. Apakah kamu percaya\ljika aku mengatakan aku

menemukannya? Di bawah rumahku di
Bellin. Di sana? Aku akan membawa\lbongkahan besar itu sendiri, tapi

tidak mau bergerak. Juga tidak tahu
cara membangunkannya. Tapi, eh\. kamu\ltampak berguna - tidak bisa

membawanya ke sini, bisa?

entries.original:
"Ne’er mind, then.

Didn’ expect yeh t’ know how,
anyway."
entries.translation_source: Ne’er mind, then. Didn’ expect yeh t’ know how, anyway.
entries.translated:
Tidak apa-apa. Lagipula aku tidak
berharap kamu tahu caranya.

entries.original:
"A’righ, yer a real champ.

So, yeh ever been into the bottom
o’ Bellin Town?

Yeh’ll see it there.

As I said, it jus’ sits there. It
don’ move, don’ attack, nuthin’.

Real myst’ry.

Sorry I can’ help yeh figurin’ out
how t’ get it movin’, but if yeh\lmanage, bring it here."
entries.translation_source: A’righ, yer a real champ. So, yeh ever been into the bottom o’ Bellin Town? Yeh’ll see it there. As I said, it jus’ sits there. It don’ move, don’ attack, nuthin’. Real myst’ry. Sorry I can’ help yeh figurin’ out how t’ get it movin’, but if yeh manage, bring it here.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kamu benar-benar juara.
Jadi, apakah kamu pernah ke bagian\lbawah Bellin Town? Kamu akan

melihatnya di sana. Seperti yang
kukatakan, ia hanya duduk di sana.\lIa tidak bergerak, tidak menyerang,

tidak melakukan apa pun. Misteri
nyata. Maaf aku tidak bisa\lmembantumu mencari cara untuk

membuatnya bergerak, tapi jika kamu
berhasil, bawa ke sini.

entries.original:
"That’s\.

Yeh did it! The livin’ statue\.
yeh really got it t’ move!

Awright, jus’ hold it nice an’
still - I’ll get t’ old hammer\land chisel out\."
entries.translation_source: That’s\. Yeh did it! The livin’ statue\. yeh really got it t’ move! Awright, jus’ hold it nice an’ still - I’ll get t’ old hammer and chisel out\.
entries.translated:
Itu\. Kamu berhasil! Patung hidup\.
kamu benar-benar membuatnya\lbergerak! Baiklah, pegang saja

dengan baik dan diam - aku akan
mengambil palu dan pahat tua itu\.

entries.original:
"Whew\. well, that’s some o’ t’
best work I ever done."
entries.translation_source: Whew\. well, that’s some o’ t’ best work I ever done.
entries.translated:
Fiuh\. yah, itu adalah salah satu
karya terbaik yang pernah\lkulakukan.

entries.original:
"An’ w’ that\. I think it’s ’bout
time I pack it in.

Nuthin’ toppin’ this, I tell
yeh that.

Thank yeh kindly, [buffer1].
As a token o’ gratitude\.

Well, on t’ side,
I’m a pretty good blacksmith.

Was jus’ thinkin’ ’bout takin’ it
up as a proper job, actually\. not\lmuch call fer this statue business\lanymore.

Tell yeh what, yeh can be me first
customer! How ’bout it?

Now what could I do fer yeh?
Let’s see\.

Yeh got any o’ them Amulet Coins?

Jus’ as thanks, I’ll give it a
free upgrade."
entries.translation_source: An’ w’ that\. I think it’s ’bout time I pack it in. Nuthin’ toppin’ this, I tell yeh that. Thank yeh kindly, [buffer1]. As a token o’ gratitude\. Well, on t’ side, I’m a pretty good blacksmith. Was jus’ thinkin’ ’bout takin’ it up as a proper job, actually\. not much call fer this statue business anymore. Tell yeh what, yeh can be me first customer! How ’bout it? Now what could I do fer yeh? Let’s see\. Yeh got any o’ them Amulet Coins? Jus’ as thanks, I’ll give it a free upgrade.
entries.translated:
Ya, begitu\. Kupikir udah waktunya
aku berhenti. Nggak ada yang bisa\lngalahin ini, percaya deh. Makasih

banyak, [buffer1]. Sebagai tanda
terima kasih\. Eh, ngomong-ngomong,\laku ini pandai besi yang lumayan.

Tadinya aku mikir mau bener-bener
jadi pandai besi, lho\. soalnya\lbisnis patung ini udah nggak laku

lagi. Denger ya, kamu bisa jadi
pelanggan pertamaku! Gimana? Ada\lyang bisa kubuat untukmu? Coba

lihat\. Kamu punya Koin Jimat?
Sebagai ucapan terima kasih, akan\lku-upgrade gratis.

entries.original:
"Yeh got any o’ them Amulet Coins?

Jus’ as thanks, I’ll give it a
free upgrade."
entries.translation_source: Yeh got any o’ them Amulet Coins? Jus’ as thanks, I’ll give it a free upgrade.
entries.translated:
Kamu punya Koin Jimat? Sebagai
terima kasih, akan ku-upgrade\lgratis.

entries.original:
"Don’ have nuthin’ like that?

Well, yeh go get one first, and
stuff it into yer fancy Cube thing.

Then come talk t’ me."
entries.translation_source: Don’ have nuthin’ like that? Well, yeh go get one first, and stuff it into yer fancy Cube thing. Then come talk t’ me.
entries.translated:
Nggak punya barang kayak gitu? Ya,
kamu ambil dulu satu, dan masukkan\lke Kubus kerenmu. Lalu bicara lagi

sama aku.

entries.original:
"[black]The Amulet Coin level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

[green][buffer2]*[black] the amount of prize money will
be earned when brought into battle."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Amulet Coin level has been increased to \Lv [buffer2]! [green][buffer2]*[black] the amount of prize money will be earned when brought into battle.
entries.translated:
[black]Level Koin Jimat telah naik ke \Lv
[buffer2]! [green][buffer2]*[black] jumlah hadiah\luang akan diperoleh saat dibawa ke

pertempuran.

entries.original:
"[black]The Amulet Coin level has already
been maxed out!

Instead\."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Amulet Coin level has already been maxed out! Instead\.
entries.translated:
[black]Level Koin Jimat sudah maksimal!
Sebagai gantinya\.

entries.original:
"So, d’yeh like it?

Now when a Pokémon holdin’ tha’
gets sent out, yeh’ll get more\lcash than before!

’Course, it’s possible t’ get it
t’ give yeh more, but it’s not\lall tha’ cheap.

If yeh can get [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], I
can give it ’nuther upgrade, alrigh’?"
entries.translation_source: So, d’yeh like it? Now when a Pokémon holdin’ tha’ gets sent out, yeh’ll get more cash than before! ’Course, it’s possible t’ get it t’ give yeh more, but it’s not all tha’ cheap. If yeh can get [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], I can give it ’nuther upgrade, alrigh’?
entries.translated:
Jadi, suka? Sekarang saat Pokémon
yang memegang itu dikeluarkan, kamu\ldapat uang lebih banyak dari

sebelumnya! Tentu, bisa juga dapat
lebih banyak, tapi nggak murah.\lKalau kamu bisa dapat [green][buffer2]

[buffer1]s[blue], aku bisa upgrade lagi,
oke?

entries.original:
"’Ello, again!
Yer Amulet Coin’s \Lv [buffer3].

If it’s an upgrade yeh wan’,
I’m gunna need [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: ’Ello, again! Yer Amulet Coin’s \Lv [buffer3]. If it’s an upgrade yeh wan’, I’m gunna need [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Halo, lagi! Koin Jimatmu \Lv
[buffer3]. Kalau mau upgrade, aku\lbutuh [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue].

entries.original:
"Not today?
Awrigh’.

Bring ’em later if yeh go changin’
yer mind."
entries.translation_source: Not today? Awrigh’. Bring ’em later if yeh go changin’ yer mind.
entries.translated:
Nggak hari ini? Oke. Bawa nanti
kalau kamu berubah pikiran.

entries.original:
"Think yer a bit short on
[buffer1]s.

Go get some more, then talk t’
me again."
entries.translation_source: Think yer a bit short on [buffer1]s. Go get some more, then talk t’ me again.
entries.translated:
Kayaknya kamu kekurangan [buffer1]s.
Ambil lagi, lalu bicara lagi.

entries.original:
"How’s tha’ Amulet Coin treatin’
yeh?

Highest level I could make it, so
I’m hopin’ it’s doin’ yeh good."
entries.translation_source: How’s tha’ Amulet Coin treatin’ yeh? Highest level I could make it, so I’m hopin’ it’s doin’ yeh good.
entries.translated:
Gimana Koin Jimatnya? Level
tertinggi yang bisa kubuat, jadi\lkuharap berguna buatmu.

entries.original:
"My mother suffers from horrible
separation anxiety.

So much so, that when I moved away,
she forced me to install a path\lbetween our houses.

You’re welcome to use it, if
you’d like.

My mother lives on [green]Route 9[red]."
entries.translation_source: My mother suffers from horrible separation anxiety. So much so, that when I moved away, she forced me to install a path between our houses. You’re welcome to use it, if you’d like. My mother lives on [green]Route 9[red].
entries.translated:
Ibuku menderita kecemasan
perpisahan yang parah.\lSampai-sampai, saat aku pindah, dia

memaksaku memasang jalan antara
rumah kami. Silakan pakai jalannya,\lkalau mau. Ibuku tinggal di [green]Rute 9[red].

entries.original:
"Despite it being private property,
some people have decided to camp\lout in our underground passageway,\land hold a contest daily.

I’m pretty sure it’s rigged though,
since I’ve never heard of anyone\lwithout a super fast [green]Motorbike[blue]\lcompleting it."
entries.translation_source: Despite it being private property, some people have decided to camp out in our underground passageway, and hold a contest daily. I’m pretty sure it’s rigged though, since I’ve never heard of anyone without a super fast [green]Motorbike[blue] completing it.
entries.translated:
Meskipun itu properti pribadi,
beberapa orang memutuskan untuk\lberkemah di lorong bawah tanah

kami, dan mengadakan kontes setiap
hari. Tapi aku yakin itu curang,\lkarena aku belum pernah dengar ada

yang tanpa [green]Motor[blue] super cepat bisa
menyelesaikannya.

entries.original:
"Yo, yo!
I am the official [green]Name Rater[blue]!

Want me to rate the nicknames of
your Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Yo, yo! I am the official [green]Name Rater[blue]! Want me to rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Yo, yo! Aku adalah [green]Penilai Nama[blue]
resmi! Mau aku menilai nama\lpanggilan Pokémon-mu?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon’s nickname should
I see?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon’s nickname should I see?
entries.translated:
Nama panggilan Pokémon mana yang
harus kulihat?

entries.original:
"[buffer1], is it?
That is a gucci nickname!

But, would you like me to give it
a swag name?

How about it?"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1], is it? That is a gucci nickname! But, would you like me to give it a swag name? How about it?
entries.translated:
[buffer1], ya? Itu nama panggilan
yang keren! Tapi, mau aku beri nama\lyang kece? Gimana?

entries.original:
"Really?
That’s an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: Really? That’s an Egg!
entries.translated: Sungguh? Itu Telur!

entries.original:
"Uh huh.
Come back again."
entries.translation_source: Uh huh. Come back again.
entries.translated: Uh huh. Datang lagi ya.

entries.original:
"Cool. Then, what should the new
nickname be?"
entries.translation_source: Cool. Then, what should the new nickname be?
entries.translated:
Keren. Lalu, nama panggilan barunya
apa?

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It looks the same as before, but
still feels ten times cooler!

You’re so lucky!"
entries.translation_source: Done! From now on, this Pokémon will be called [buffer1]! It looks the same as before, but still feels ten times cooler! You’re so lucky!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Mulai sekarang, Pokémon
ini akan dipanggil [buffer1]!\lTampilannya sama seperti

sebelumnya, tapi terasa sepuluh
kali lebih keren! Kamu beruntung!

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It’s a way better name than before!
You’re so swag!"
entries.translation_source: Done! From now on, this Pokémon will be called [buffer1]! It’s a way better name than before! You’re so swag!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Mulai sekarang, Pokémon
ini akan dipanggil [buffer1]! Nama\lini jauh lebih baik dari

sebelumnya! Kamu kece banget!

entries.original:
"Hi! 
I’m one of Prof. Log’s Aides.

If your Pokédex has complete data
on [green][buffer1][red] species, I’m supposed to\lgive you a reward.

So, [player], let me ask you.

Have you gathered data on at least[green]
[buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I’m one of Prof. Log’s Aides. If your Pokédex has complete data on [green][buffer1][red] species, I’m supposed to give you a reward. So, [player], let me ask you. Have you gathered data on at least[green] [buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Hai! Aku salah satu Asisten Prof.
Log. Jika Pokédex-mu memiliki data\llengkap tentang [green][buffer1][red] spesies,

aku seharusnya memberimu hadiah.
Jadi, [player], biar kutanya.\lApakah kamu sudah mengumpulkan data

setidaknya[green] [buffer1][red] jenis Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Great! You have caught [green][buffer3][red]
kinds of Pokémon!

Congratulations!
Here you go!"
entries.translation_source: Great! You have caught [green][buffer3][red] kinds of Pokémon! Congratulations! Here you go!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Kamu telah menangkap
[green][buffer3][red] jenis Pokémon! Selamat!\lIni dia!

entries.original:
"Use the [green]Dowsing Machine[red] to detect
any hidden items close to you.

When you use it, keep a close eye
on the top left corner of your\lscreen.

If there is a hidden item close by,
the little symbol there will point\lin the direction of the item.

If there is no item close by,
you’ll see a small white circle."
entries.translation_source: Use the [green]Dowsing Machine[red] to detect any hidden items close to you. When you use it, keep a close eye on the top left corner of your screen. If there is a hidden item close by, the little symbol there will point in the direction of the item. If there is no item close by, you’ll see a small white circle.
entries.translated:
Gunakan [green]Dowsing Machine[red] untuk
mendeteksi item tersembunyi di\ldekatmu. Saat menggunakannya,

perhatikan baik-baik sudut kiri
atas layarmu. Jika ada item\ltersembunyi di dekatnya, simbol

kecil di sana akan menunjuk ke arah
item tersebut. Jika tidak ada item\ldi dekatnya, kamu akan melihat

lingkaran putih kecil.

entries.original:
"\.Oh. I see.

When you get [green][buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon,
come back."
entries.translation_source: \.Oh. I see. When you get [green][buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon, come back.
entries.translated:
\.Oh. Begitu. Saat kamu mendapatkan
[green][buffer1][red] jenis Pokémon, kembalilah.

entries.original:
"Let’s see\.

Uh-oh! You have caught only
[green][buffer3][red] kinds of Pokémon!

You need [green][buffer1][red] kinds.

Did you get the [green]DexNav[red] from [green]Nat Log[red]
in [green]Blizzard City[red]?

It’s a very handy tool for finding
new species of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Let’s see\. Uh-oh! You have caught only [green][buffer3][red] kinds of Pokémon! You need [green][buffer1][red] kinds. Did you get the [green]DexNav[red] from [green]Nat Log[red] in [green]Blizzard City[red]? It’s a very handy tool for finding new species of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Coba lihat\. Uh-oh! Kamu hanya
menangkap [green][buffer3][red] jenis Pokémon!\lKamu butuh [green][buffer1][red] jenis. Apakah

kamu mendapatkan [green]DexNav[red] dari [green]Nat
Log[red] di [green]Kota Blizzard[red]? Itu alat yang\lsangat berguna untuk menemukan

spesies Pokémon baru.

entries.original: "Seasonal Research"
entries.translation_source: Seasonal Research
entries.translated: Penelitian Musiman

entries.original:
"Greetings, [player].

I am a researcher studying seasonal
form changes of Pokémon.

Since the seasons do not change in
Borrius, I am very interested in\llearning how certain Pokémon\lchange form in this region.

Would you like to help me with
my research?"
entries.translation_source: Greetings, [player]. I am a researcher studying seasonal form changes of Pokémon. Since the seasons do not change in Borrius, I am very interested in learning how certain Pokémon change form in this region. Would you like to help me with my research?
entries.translated:
Salam, [player]. Aku seorang
peneliti yang mempelajari perubahan\lbentuk musiman Pokémon. Karena

musim tidak berubah di Borrius, aku
sangat tertarik mempelajari\lbagaimana Pokémon tertentu berubah

bentuk di wilayah ini. Apakah kamu
mau membantu penelitianku?

entries.original:
"Splendid!

I am currently researching the
Pokémon known as [green][buffer1][blue].

To start off the research, I would
like to study a [green][buffer1][blue] in\lits [green][buffer2][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Splendid! I am currently researching the Pokémon known as [green][buffer1][blue]. To start off the research, I would like to study a [green][buffer1][blue] in its [green][buffer2][blue] form.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Saat ini aku sedang
meneliti Pokémon yang dikenal\lsebagai [green][buffer1][blue]. Untuk memulai

penelitian, aku ingin mempelajari
[green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue]-nya.

entries.original:
"No?

If you change your mind, your help
would still be invaluable."
entries.translation_source: No? If you change your mind, your help would still be invaluable.
entries.translated:
Tidak? Jika kamu berubah pikiran,
bantuanmu tetap sangat berharga.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a [green][buffer1][blue] in
its [green][buffer2][blue] form to study?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a [green][buffer1][blue] in its [green][buffer2][blue] form to study? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu membawakanku [green][buffer1][blue]
dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue]-nya untuk\ldipelajari? *Mengendus* *Mengendus*

entries.original:
"Ah, it does not appear you have
brought one.

I would like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in
its [green][buffer2][blue] form, please."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it does not appear you have brought one. I would like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in its [green][buffer2][blue] form, please.
entries.translated:
Ah, sepertinya kamu tidak membawa
satu pun. Aku ingin melihat\l[green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue]-nya,

tolong.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, you have.

Please wait a moment while I
study it."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, you have. Please wait a moment while I study it.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya, kamu membawanya. Mohon
tunggu sebentar sementara aku\lmempelajarinya.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.

I have added invaluable data
to my research.

Next, I would like to see a [green][buffer1][blue]
in its [green][buffer3][blue] form."
