entries.translation_source: Interesting\. I have added invaluable data to my research. Next, I would like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in its [green][buffer3][blue] form.
entries.translated:
Menarik\. Aku telah menambahkan data
yang sangat berharga untuk\lpenelitianku. Selanjutnya, aku

ingin melihat [green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk
[green][buffer3][blue]-nya.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.

It appears that for some reason the
Pokémon appearing in the area are\lnot what they are supposed to be\.

Was this your doing?

\.

In that case, this is more than
sufficient!

Who needs Deerling?

This phenomenon is far better for
me to study!"
entries.translation_source: Interesting\. It appears that for some reason the Pokémon appearing in the area are not what they are supposed to be\. Was this your doing? \. In that case, this is more than sufficient! Who needs Deerling? This phenomenon is far better for me to study!
entries.translated:
Menarik\. Tampaknya untuk suatu
alasan, Pokémon yang muncul di area\lini bukanlah yang seharusnya\. Apakah

ini perbuatanmu? \. Kalau begitu, ini
lebih dari cukup! Siapa yang butuh\lDeerling? Fenomena ini jauh lebih

baik untuk kupelajari!

entries.original:
"Thank you so much!

You’ve been a great asset to my
research!

So, although Borrius’s climate
remains stable, Deerling and\lSawsbuck have different forms,\ldepending on their environment,\lrather than season\.

Ah yes, your reward."
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much! You’ve been a great asset to my research! So, although Borrius’s climate remains stable, Deerling and Sawsbuck have different forms, depending on their environment, rather than season\. Ah yes, your reward.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih banyak! Kamu telah
menjadi aset besar bagi\lpenelitianku! Jadi, meskipun iklim

Borrius tetap stabil, Deerling dan
Sawsbuck memiliki bentuk yang\lberbeda, tergantung pada lingkungan

mereka, bukan musim\. Ah ya,
hadiahmu.

entries.original:
"As my way of thanks, how about I
do something\.\CC0818 beneficial, for your\lPokémon?

You see, I have a device that can
change the [green]Nature[blue] of a Pokémon -\lchange how it grows.

I can perform the procedure on
your Pokémon, for free, just this\lone time.

Just be aware\.\CC0818 your Pokémon may not
enjoy it very much, and will come\lto hate you afterwards\."
entries.translation_source: As my way of thanks, how about I do something\.\CC0818 beneficial, for your Pokémon? You see, I have a device that can change the [green]Nature[blue] of a Pokémon - change how it grows. I can perform the procedure on your Pokémon, for free, just this one time. Just be aware\.\CC0818 your Pokémon may not enjoy it very much, and will come to hate you afterwards\.
entries.translated:
Sebagai ucapan terima kasihku,
bagaimana jika aku melakukan\lsesuatu\.\CC0818 yang bermanfaat, untuk

Pokémon-mu? Begini, aku memiliki
perangkat yang dapat mengubah\l[green]Nature[blue] Pokémon - mengubah cara ia

tumbuh. Aku bisa melakukan prosedur
pada Pokémon-mu, secara gratis,\lhanya sekali ini. Sadarilah saja\.\CC0818

Pokémon-mu mungkin tidak akan
menyukainya, dan akan membencimu\lsetelahnya\.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon’s Nature should
I change?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon’s Nature should I change?
entries.translated:
Nature Pokémon mana yang harus aku
ubah?

entries.original:
"Which Nature should I give
[buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Nature should I give [buffer1]?
entries.translated:
Nature mana yang harus aku berikan
pada [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Should I give [green][buffer1][blue]
the [green][buffer2][blue] Nature?"
entries.translation_source: Should I give [green][buffer1][blue] the [green][buffer2][blue] Nature?
entries.translated:
Haruskah aku memberikan [green][buffer1][blue]
Nature [green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Then, hold still, [buffer1]\.

It’s just a simple procedure\.
You won’t remember a thing\."
entries.translation_source: Then, hold still, [buffer1]\. It’s just a simple procedure\. You won’t remember a thing\.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, diamlah, [buffer1]\. Ini
hanya prosedur sederhana\. Kamu tidak\lakan ingat apa pun\.

entries.original:
"Ah, we’ve finished.

I’ve restructured your [buffer1]’s
heart to the more optimal Nature.

Now it’s as if it’s an entirely
different Pokémon!

And fortunately, it seems to
remember nothing about what just\lhappened.

Thank you again for your
assistance!

And although I cannot continuously
afford to change Natures for you,\lif you are able to foot the bill,\lI will happy to change more."
entries.translation_source: Ah, we’ve finished. I’ve restructured your [buffer1]’s heart to the more optimal Nature. Now it’s as if it’s an entirely different Pokémon! And fortunately, it seems to remember nothing about what just happened. Thank you again for your assistance! And although I cannot continuously afford to change Natures for you, if you are able to foot the bill, I will happy to change more.
entries.translated:
Ah, kita selesai. Aku telah
merestrukturisasi hati [buffer1]\lmenjadi Sifat yang lebih optimal.

Sekarang seolah-olah itu adalah
Pokémon yang sama sekali berbeda!\lDan untungnya, tampaknya tidak

mengingat apa pun yang baru saja
terjadi. Terima kasih lagi atas\lbantuanmu! Dan meskipun aku tidak

bisa terus-menerus mengganti Sifat
untukmu, jika kamu mampu membayar\lbiayanya, aku akan senang mengubah

lebih banyak.

entries.original:
"Of course, I can wait while you
decide on a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Of course, I can wait while you decide on a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, aku bisa menunggu
sementara kamu memutuskan Pokémon.

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][blue] already has that
Nature\."
entries.translation_source: [green][buffer1][blue] already has that Nature\.
entries.translated: [green][buffer1][blue] sudah memiliki Sifat itu\.

entries.original: "I cannot change an Egg’s Nature."
entries.translation_source: I cannot change an Egg’s Nature.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa mengubah Sifat
Telur.

entries.original:
"Have you come for more Nature
changes?

Well\. as long as you can foot the
bill of $[green]50000[blue], I can do another."
entries.translation_source: Have you come for more Nature changes? Well\. as long as you can foot the bill of $[green]50000[blue], I can do another.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu datang untuk perubahan
Sifat lagi? Baik\. selama kamu mampu\lmembayar biaya sebesar $[green]50000[blue], aku

bisa melakukan satu lagi.

entries.original:
"For $[green]50000[blue], should I give
[green][buffer1][blue] the [green][buffer2][blue] Nature?"
entries.translation_source: For $[green]50000[blue], should I give [green][buffer1][blue] the [green][buffer2][blue] Nature?
entries.translated:
Untuk $[green]50000[blue], haruskah aku
memberikan [green][buffer1][blue] Sifat [green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Ah, we’ve finished.

I’ve restructured your [buffer1]’s
heart to the more optimal Nature.

And fortunately, it seems to
remember nothing about what just\lhappened.

And now, the payment, if you would."
entries.translation_source: Ah, we’ve finished. I’ve restructured your [buffer1]’s heart to the more optimal Nature. And fortunately, it seems to remember nothing about what just happened. And now, the payment, if you would.
entries.translated:
Ah, kita selesai. Aku telah
merestrukturisasi hati [buffer1]\lmenjadi Sifat yang lebih optimal.

Dan untungnya, tampaknya tidak
mengingat apa pun yang baru saja\lterjadi. Dan sekarang,

pembayarannya, jika kamu mau.

entries.original:
"If you are able to foot the bill
again, I will be happy to change\lmore."
entries.translation_source: If you are able to foot the bill again, I will be happy to change more.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mampu membayar biayanya
lagi, aku akan senang mengubah\llebih banyak.

entries.original:
"I am afraid neither you or I are
able to afford a Nature change."
entries.translation_source: I am afraid neither you or I are able to afford a Nature change.
entries.translated:
Aku khawatir baik kamu maupun aku
tidak mampu membayar perubahan\lSifat.

entries.original:
"My mommy says lots of times items
like to hide in rocks!

Talk to rocks!"
entries.translation_source: My mommy says lots of times items like to hide in rocks! Talk to rocks!
entries.translated:
Ibuku bilang sering kali barang
suka bersembunyi di batu! Bicaralah\ldengan batu!

entries.original:
"Up until recently, this town has
been fairly quiet.

That is, until those guys showed
up and started swarming Route 9."
entries.translation_source: Up until recently, this town has been fairly quiet. That is, until those guys showed up and started swarming Route 9.
entries.translated:
Sampai baru-baru ini, kota ini
cukup tenang. Maksudku, sampai\lorang-orang itu muncul dan mulai

membanjiri Rute 9.

entries.original:
"This town is fairly quiet.

Not many are incentivized to hang
around in a small forest town."
entries.translation_source: This town is fairly quiet. Not many are incentivized to hang around in a small forest town.
entries.translated:
Kota ini cukup tenang. Tidak banyak
yang termotivasi untuk berkeliaran\ldi kota hutan kecil.

entries.original:
"I’m looking for Battle Items like
[green]X-Attack[blue] and [green]X-Speed[blue].

They raise a Pokémon’s stats in
battle by [green]2[blue] whole stat stages.

And they ignore abilities like
Contrary!

But no matter how hard I look, I
can’t seem to find any here\."
entries.translation_source: I’m looking for Battle Items like [green]X-Attack[blue] and [green]X-Speed[blue]. They raise a Pokémon’s stats in battle by [green]2[blue] whole stat stages. And they ignore abilities like Contrary! But no matter how hard I look, I can’t seem to find any here\.
entries.translated:
Aku mencari Item Pertarungan
seperti [green]X-Attack[blue] dan [green]X-Speed[blue].\lMereka meningkatkan stat Pokémon

dalam pertarungan sebanyak [green]2[blue] tahap
stat. Dan mereka mengabaikan\lkemampuan seperti Kebalikan! Tapi

tidak peduli sekeras apa pun aku
mencari, sepertinya aku tidak bisa\lmenemukannya di sini\.

entries.original:
"You should stock up on [green]Revives[red]!

They heal a fainted Pokémon back
to half health!"
entries.translation_source: You should stock up on [green]Revives[red]! They heal a fainted Pokémon back to half health!
entries.translated:
Kamu harus menimbun [green]Revive[red]! Mereka
memulihkan Pokémon yang pingsan\lkembali ke setengah kesehatan!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!

Please, enjoy this gift!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! Please, enjoy this gift!
entries.translated:
Hei, halo! Silakan, nikmati hadiah
ini!

entries.original:
"There are a few Pokémon in this
area that only evolve via a\l[green]Water Stone[blue]."
entries.translation_source: There are a few Pokémon in this area that only evolve via a [green]Water Stone[blue].
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Pokémon di area ini
yang hanya berevolusi melalui [green]Batu\lAir[blue].

entries.original:
"The path up this mountain is
exhausting, isn’t it?

Let me heal you up so you can
continue on, worry free!"
entries.translation_source: The path up this mountain is exhausting, isn’t it? Let me heal you up so you can continue on, worry free!
entries.translated:
Jalan menaiki gunung ini
melelahkan, bukan? Biarkan aku\lmenyembuhkanmu sehingga kamu bisa

melanjutkan, tanpa khawatir!

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated:
Siap semua! Tetap aman di luar
sana!

entries.original:
"The power of evolution\.
It compels me to give this to you!"
entries.translation_source: The power of evolution\. It compels me to give this to you!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan evolusi\. Itu mendorongku
untuk memberikan ini padamu!

entries.original:
"I may feel compelled to give you
something tomorrow, as well."
entries.translation_source: I may feel compelled to give you something tomorrow, as well.
entries.translated:
Aku mungkin merasa terdorong untuk
memberimu sesuatu besok juga.

entries.original: "The Wayward Kid"
entries.translation_source: The Wayward Kid
entries.translated: Anak yang Tersesat

entries.original: "Milo"
entries.translation_source: Milo
entries.translated: Milo

entries.original:
"I’m Milo\.

I was catching Pokémon, and then
I got lost\.

I’m so scared\.

Please!
Please take me to the exit!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Milo\. I was catching Pokémon, and then I got lost\. I’m so scared\. Please! Please take me to the exit!
entries.translated:
Aku Milo\. Aku sedang menangkap
Pokémon, lalu aku tersesat\. Aku\lsangat takut\. Tolong! Tolong antar

aku ke pintu keluar!

entries.original:
"Oh\.
I’m so scared\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. I’m so scared\.
entries.translated: Oh\. Aku sangat takut\.

entries.original: "[black][player] decided to go with Milo!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] decided to go with Milo!
entries.translated:
[black][player] memutuskan untuk pergi
bersama Milo!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy
all the time!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy all the time!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menjaga Pokémonmu tetap
sehat sepanjang waktu!

entries.original:
"I like useful moves like Growl and
Tail Whip.

Those are my favourites."
entries.translation_source: I like useful moves like Growl and Tail Whip. Those are my favourites.
entries.translated:
Aku suka jurus berguna seperti
Growl dan Tail Whip. Itu favoritku.

entries.original:
"The mountain\.
It’s so easy to get confused.

Do you know where we are?"
entries.translation_source: The mountain\. It’s so easy to get confused. Do you know where we are?
entries.translated:
Gunung\. Sangat mudah bingung di
sini. Apakah kamu tahu di mana\lkita?

entries.original:
"[player], did you get to be
so good because you’re always\lwith your Pokémon?

Yes! That has to be it!
Milo will try like you!"
entries.translation_source: [player], did you get to be so good because you’re always with your Pokémon? Yes! That has to be it! Milo will try like you!
entries.translated:
[player], apakah kamu menjadi
begitu hebat karena selalu bersama\lPokémonmu? Ya! Pasti itu dia! Milo

akan mencoba sepertimu!

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with Milo, the
[green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle."
entries.translation_source: [black]While teamed up with Milo, the [green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle.
entries.translated:
[black]Saat bekerja sama dengan Milo, [green]3[black]
Pokémon pertama yang layak di timmu\lakan dipilih untuk bertarung.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh! There’s the ladder!

I want to get tougher so I
won’t be such a scaredy-cat.

[player], bye-bye!
Thank you!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Oh! There’s the ladder! I want to get tougher so I won’t be such a scaredy-cat. [player], bye-bye! Thank you!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh! Itu tangganya! Aku ingin
menjadi lebih kuat agar tidak\lmenjadi penakut. [player], sampai

jumpa! Terima kasih!

entries.original:
"It appears Milo has left
something behind\."
entries.translation_source: It appears Milo has left something behind\.
entries.translated: Tampaknya Milo meninggalkan sesuatu\.

entries.original: "[green]Gyaoo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Gyaoo!
entries.translated: [green]Gyaoo!

entries.original: "Sankren thoron!"
entries.translation_source: Sankren thoron!
entries.translated: Sankren thoron!

entries.original:
"I was standing outside, by Antisis
City, when I saw it\.

A yellow Pokémon I’d never seen
before, standing on a ledge,\lstaring down at me.

All my friends didn’t believe me
when I told them, so I came here\lto take a picture of it.

And I’m pretty sure if I dig
straight through this wall, I’ll\lreach that ledge where I saw\lthe Pokémon.

The only thing is, I don’t know how
long it’ll take to break through.

If only I had some sort of machine
that could do the digging for me\."
entries.translation_source: I was standing outside, by Antisis City, when I saw it\. A yellow Pokémon I’d never seen before, standing on a ledge, staring down at me. All my friends didn’t believe me when I told them, so I came here to take a picture of it. And I’m pretty sure if I dig straight through this wall, I’ll reach that ledge where I saw the Pokémon. The only thing is, I don’t know how long it’ll take to break through. If only I had some sort of machine that could do the digging for me\.
entries.translated:
Aku berdiri di luar, dekat Antisis
City, ketika aku melihatnya\. Seekor\lPokémon kuning yang belum pernah

kulihat sebelumnya, berdiri di
tebing, menatapku ke bawah. Semua\ltemanku tidak percaya saat aku

memberi tahu mereka, jadi aku
datang ke sini untuk memotretnya.\lDan aku cukup yakin jika aku

menggali lurus tembok ini, aku akan
mencapai tebing tempat aku melihat\lPokémon itu. Satu-satunya masalah

adalah, aku tidak tahu berapa lama
waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk\lmenembusnya. Andai saja aku punya

mesin yang bisa menggali untukku\.

entries.original:
"That digging machine in your Cube\.

It’s just what I need to dig
through the wall!

Please, let me borrow it for a sec."
entries.translation_source: That digging machine in your Cube\. It’s just what I need to dig through the wall! Please, let me borrow it for a sec.
entries.translated:
Mesin penggali di Cube-mu\. Itu yang
kubutuhkan untuk menggali tembok!\lTolong, pinjamkan sebentar.

entries.original: "Alright, just gimme a sec\."
entries.translation_source: Alright, just gimme a sec\.
entries.translated: Baiklah, tunggu sebentar\.

entries.original:
"I did it!
I broke through the wall!

I knew there was a ledge on the
other side!

Now, if you’ll excuse me for just a
sec\."
entries.translation_source: I did it! I broke through the wall! I knew there was a ledge on the other side! Now, if you’ll excuse me for just a sec\.
entries.translated:
Aku berhasil! Aku menembus tembok!
Aku tahu ada tebing di sisi lain!\lSekarang, permisi sebentar\.

entries.original:
"Well, that yellow Pokémon is
there, just as I thought.

I took the picture I wanted, and
now that I’ve done that, I’ll let\lyou go right ahead and capture it.

Thanks again for your help!"
entries.translation_source: Well, that yellow Pokémon is there, just as I thought. I took the picture I wanted, and now that I’ve done that, I’ll let you go right ahead and capture it. Thanks again for your help!
entries.translated:
Yah, Pokémon kuning itu ada di
sana, seperti yang kuduga. Aku\lsudah mengambil foto yang

kuinginkan, dan sekarang setelah
itu, aku akan membiarkanmu langsung\lmenangkapnya. Terima kasih lagi

atas bantuanmu!

entries.original:
"But how will I break through the
wall without it?"
entries.translation_source: But how will I break through the wall without it?
entries.translated:
Tapi bagaimana aku akan menembus
tembok tanpanya?

entries.original: "[green]Raaaaaa!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Raaaaaa!
entries.translated: [green]Raaaaaa!

entries.original:
"[buffer1] disappeared into
the mountain range."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] disappeared into the mountain range.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] menghilang ke dalam
barisan pegunungan.

entries.original:
"[black]The item is sealed behind the
electric barrier."
entries.translation_source: [black]The item is sealed behind the electric barrier.
entries.translated:
[black]Item tersebut tersegel di balik
penghalang listrik.

entries.original:
"The electric barrier blocks you
from passing through."
entries.translation_source: The electric barrier blocks you from passing through.
entries.translated:
Penghalang listrik menghalangi Anda
untuk melewatinya.

entries.original:
"The electric barrier has
been disengaged."
entries.translation_source: The electric barrier has been disengaged.
entries.translated:
Penghalang listrik telah
dinonaktifkan.

entries.original:
"PRESSURE
ELSEWHERE
IS THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: PRESSURE ELSEWHERE IS THE KEY.
entries.translated:
TEKANAN DI TEMPAT LAIN ADALAH
KUNCI.

entries.original:
"It’s a challenge rock.

Have [buffer1] smash the rock?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a challenge rock. Have [buffer1] smash the rock?
entries.translated:
Ini batu tantangan. Suruh [buffer1]
menghancurkan batunya?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] tried to smash the
challenge rock.

A piece of the rock broke away!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] tried to smash the challenge rock. A piece of the rock broke away!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] mencoba menghancurkan batu
tantangan. Sepotong batu terlepas!

entries.original: "It’s a challenge rock."
entries.translation_source: It’s a challenge rock.
entries.translated: Ini batu tantangan.

entries.original:
"For many years I have isolated
myself in this cave.

After all this time, I am now the
most powerful Trainer here.

Can you even hope to take the title
from me?"
entries.translation_source: For many years I have isolated myself in this cave. After all this time, I am now the most powerful Trainer here. Can you even hope to take the title from me?
entries.translated:
Selama bertahun-tahun saya
mengisolasi diri di gua ini.\lSetelah sekian waktu, saya sekarang

Pelatih paling kuat di sini.
Dapatkah Anda berharap merebut\lgelar dari saya?

entries.original:
"What’s done is done.

I will never get those years of my
life back.

All I can hope to do now is move
forward.

I won’t be needing this anymore."
entries.translation_source: What’s done is done. I will never get those years of my life back. All I can hope to do now is move forward. I won’t be needing this anymore.
entries.translated:
Apa yang terjadi sudah terjadi.
Saya tidak akan pernah mendapatkan\lkembali tahun-tahun hidup saya.

Yang bisa saya harapkan sekarang
adalah bergerak maju. Saya tidak\lakan membutuhkan ini lagi.

entries.original:
"That’s a Mega Stone for the
Pokémon [green]Ampharos[blue].

Only the strongest Trainers can
hope to use it well.

Farewell, Trainer."
entries.translation_source: That’s a Mega Stone for the Pokémon [green]Ampharos[blue]. Only the strongest Trainers can hope to use it well. Farewell, Trainer.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah Batu Mega untuk Pokémon
[green]Ampharos[blue]. Hanya Pelatih terkuat\lyang bisa menggunakannya dengan

baik. Selamat tinggal, Pelatih.

entries.original:
"For many years I have isolated
myself in this cave.

After all this time, I am now the
most powerful Trainer here.

If you wish to challenge me for
this title, defeat all of the other\lTrainers first."
entries.translation_source: For many years I have isolated myself in this cave. After all this time, I am now the most powerful Trainer here. If you wish to challenge me for this title, defeat all of the other Trainers first.
entries.translated:
Selama bertahun-tahun saya
mengisolasi diri di gua ini.\lSetelah sekian waktu, saya sekarang

Pelatih paling kuat di sini. Jika
Anda ingin menantang saya untuk\lgelar ini, kalahkan semua Pelatih

lainnya terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"allenge me for
this title, defeat all of the other\lTrainers first."
entries.translation_source: allenge me for this title, defeat all of the other Trainers first.
entries.translated:
allenge saya untuk gelar ini,
kalahkan semua Pelatih lainnya\lterlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"lenge me for
this title, defeat all of the other\lTrainers first."
entries.translation_source: lenge me for this title, defeat all of the other Trainers first.
entries.translated:
lenge saya untuk gelar ini,
kalahkan semua Pelatih lainnya\lterlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Zzzz\.

[black]She appears to have fallen asleep
at her post.

Better go a different way."
entries.translation_source: Zzzz\. [black]She appears to have fallen asleep at her post. Better go a different way.
entries.translated:
Zzzz\. [black]Dia tampaknya tertidur di
posnya. Sebaiknya lewat jalan lain.

entries.original:
"No matter how fast you run, there
are plenty of us to slow you down!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how fast you run, there are plenty of us to slow you down!
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli seberapa cepat Anda
berlari, ada banyak dari kami yang\lakan memperlambat Anda!

entries.original:
"Why are we after Zapdos?

\.

Beats me.
I just get paid to follow orders."
entries.translation_source: Why are we after Zapdos? \. Beats me. I just get paid to follow orders.
entries.translated:
Kenapa kita mengejar Zapdos? \.
Entahlah. Saya hanya dibayar untuk\lmengikuti perintah.

entries.original:
"Well, if I can’t slow you down, at
least this room will."
entries.translation_source: Well, if I can’t slow you down, at least this room will.
entries.translated:
Nah, jika saya tidak bisa
memperlambat Anda, setidaknya\lruangan ini akan.

entries.original:
"I hope none of the other grunts
fell off the mountain\."
entries.translation_source: I hope none of the other grunts fell off the mountain\.
entries.translated:
Saya harap tidak ada anggota lain
yang jatuh dari gunung\.

entries.original:
"You’d better hurry it up, kid.

Because if those tremors mean what I
think they mean\."
entries.translation_source: You’d better hurry it up, kid. Because if those tremors mean what I think they mean\.
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya kau cepat, nak. Karena
jika getaran itu berarti seperti\lyang kukira\.

entries.original:
"I can only imagine what the
higher-ups will do to him\.

\.

Wait, I failed too, didn’t I?

Ack! I’m sorry, Marlon, sir!

Don’t put me on Shadow Warrior
feeding duty! Please!"
entries.translation_source: I can only imagine what the higher-ups will do to him\. \. Wait, I failed too, didn’t I? Ack! I’m sorry, Marlon, sir! Don’t put me on Shadow Warrior feeding duty! Please!
entries.translated:
Aku hanya bisa membayangkan apa
yang akan dilakukan atasan padanya\. \.\lTunggu, aku juga gagal, kan? Aduh!

Maaf, Tuan Marlon! Jangan tugaskan
aku memberi makan Shadow Warrior!\lKumohon!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon living here were getting
in the way, so we rounded ’em up\lan locked ’em in an electric cage.

How can you unlock it?

Hah! Like I’ll ever tell you!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon living here were getting in the way, so we rounded ’em up an locked ’em in an electric cage. How can you unlock it? Hah! Like I’ll ever tell you!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang tinggal di sini
menghalangi, jadi kami kumpulkan\ldan kunci dalam sangkar listrik.

Bagaimana cara membukanya? Hah!
Seolah aku akan memberitahumu!

entries.original:
"Even if you keep going, I’ll never
tell you which of the Grunts has\lthe key to release the Pokémon!

\.Oh, shoot. I just blabbed about
the key\."
entries.translation_source: Even if you keep going, I’ll never tell you which of the Grunts has the key to release the Pokémon! \.Oh, shoot. I just blabbed about the key\.
entries.translated:
Bahkan jika kau terus maju, aku
tidak akan pernah memberitahumu\lGrunt mana yang memiliki kunci

untuk melepaskan Pokémon! \.Oh, sial.
Aku baru saja bocorkan tentang\lkunci\.

entries.original:
"The stairs have been destroyed, so
nothing can interrupt Marlon while\lhe prepares to capture Zapdos."
entries.translation_source: The stairs have been destroyed, so nothing can interrupt Marlon while he prepares to capture Zapdos.
entries.translated:
Tangga telah dihancurkan, jadi
tidak ada yang bisa mengganggu\lMarlon saat dia bersiap menangkap

Zapdos.

entries.original:
"Maybe I should go back to
Antisis City.

I’m out of my depth in here."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should go back to Antisis City. I’m out of my depth in here.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku harus kembali ke
Antisis City. Aku tidak sanggup di\lsini.

entries.original:
"I guess I need to train more to
match that Gym Leader."
entries.translation_source: I guess I need to train more to match that Gym Leader.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku perlu berlatih lebih
keras untuk menyamai Pemimpin Gym\litu.

entries.original:
"My top speed went down when I got
trapped in that electric web!"
entries.translation_source: My top speed went down when I got trapped in that electric web!
entries.translated:
Kecepatan tertinggiku menurun saat
aku terperangkap dalam jaring\llistrik itu!

entries.original:
"Hahhh!
I have no need for HM slaves!

I will keep smashing rocks with
my bare hands!"
entries.translation_source: Hahhh! I have no need for HM slaves! I will keep smashing rocks with my bare hands!
entries.translated:
Hahhh! Aku tidak butuh budak HM!
Aku akan terus menghancurkan batu\ldengan tangan kosong!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon evolved from the energy
in this cave!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon evolved from the energy in this cave!
entries.translated:
Pokémonku berevolusi dari energi di
gua ini!

entries.original:
"Youngsters like you\.
No respect for their elders."
entries.translation_source: Youngsters like you\. No respect for their elders.
entries.translated:
Anak muda sepertimu\.. Tidak
menghormati yang lebih tua.

entries.original:
"Your skill makes my rubber gear
seem useless.

Maybe I should invest in a more
expensive brand."
entries.translation_source: Your skill makes my rubber gear seem useless. Maybe I should invest in a more expensive brand.
entries.translated:
Keahlianmu membuat perlengkapan
karetku tampak tidak berguna.\lMungkin aku harus berinvestasi pada

merek yang lebih mahal.

entries.original:
"It appears I need to spend more
time honing my clairvoyance."
entries.translation_source: It appears I need to spend more time honing my clairvoyance.
entries.translated:
Tampaknya aku perlu menghabiskan
lebih banyak waktu untuk mengasah\lkewaskitaanku.

entries.original:
"Even though I lost, I’m still
very happy!

The cavern is glowing with the
fires of passion!"
entries.translation_source: Even though I lost, I’m still very happy! The cavern is glowing with the fires of passion!
entries.translated:
Meskipun aku kalah, aku masih
sangat senang! Gua ini bercahaya\ldengan api semangat!

entries.original:
"Be careful when climbing the rock
walls, the fall can be treacherous."
entries.translation_source: Be careful when climbing the rock walls, the fall can be treacherous.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati saat memanjat dinding
batu, jatuhnya bisa berbahaya.

entries.original:
"In order to disengage the electric
barrier in this room, you should\lstart with the boulders on the\lright side of this room.

You’ll need Surf to get over there,
though."
entries.translation_source: In order to disengage the electric barrier in this room, you should start with the boulders on the right side of this room. You’ll need Surf to get over there, though.
entries.translated:
Untuk menonaktifkan penghalang
listrik di ruangan ini, kamu harus\lmulai dengan batu besar di sisi

kanan ruangan ini. Namun, kamu
perlu Surf untuk sampai ke sana.

entries.original:
"Surprisingly, you can’t catch any
[green]Voltorb[blue] here.

They’re only found daily in one of
the Gyms."
entries.translation_source: Surprisingly, you can’t catch any [green]Voltorb[blue] here. They’re only found daily in one of the Gyms.
entries.translated:
Yang mengejutkan, kamu tidak bisa
menangkap [green]Voltorb[blue] di sini. Mereka\lhanya ditemukan setiap hari di

salah satu Gym.

entries.original:
"Now I can’t get back up the ladder,
no matter how hard I try."
entries.translation_source: Now I can’t get back up the ladder, no matter how hard I try.
entries.translated:
Sekarang aku tidak bisa naik
kembali ke tangga, tidak peduli\lseberapa keras aku mencoba.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn my Electric-types
were acting funny until they were\lknocked out\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn my Electric-types were acting funny until they were knocked out\.
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah tipe Listrikku
bertingkah aneh sampai mereka KO\.

entries.original:
"People assume just because I’m a
Super Nerd, I’m required to do\lnerdy things.

I can study rocks if I want to!

Nobody can tell me who I have
to be!"
entries.translation_source: People assume just because I’m a Super Nerd, I’m required to do nerdy things. I can study rocks if I want to! Nobody can tell me who I have to be!
entries.translated:
Orang-orang menganggap hanya karena
aku Super Nerd, aku harus melakukan\lhal-hal kutu buku. Aku bisa

mempelajari batu jika aku mau!
Tidak ada yang bisa memberi tahu\laku harus menjadi siapa!

entries.original:
"Me? No, I’m not lost.
I live here!"
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not lost. I live here!
entries.translated:
Saya? Tidak, saya tidak tersesat.
Saya tinggal di sini!

entries.original:
"I hear there’s a Pokémon that has
mushrooms growing on its back.

Not around here, though.
I wonder if they taste any good?"
entries.translation_source: I hear there’s a Pokémon that has mushrooms growing on its back. Not around here, though. I wonder if they taste any good?
entries.translated:
Saya dengar ada Pokémon yang
memiliki jamur tumbuh di\lpunggungnya. Tapi tidak di sekitar

sini. Saya ingin tahu apakah
rasanya enak?

entries.original:
"I got separated from my friends\.

I’ve got my Pokémon with me so
I’m okay, but\."
entries.translation_source: I got separated from my friends\. I’ve got my Pokémon with me so I’m okay, but\.
entries.translated:
Saya terpisah dari teman-teman saya\.
Saya membawa Pokémon saya jadi saya\lbaik-baik saja, tetapi\.

entries.original:
"I’m not lost, I tell you!
I’m camping! That’s my story!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not lost, I tell you! I’m camping! That’s my story!
entries.translated:
Saya tidak tersesat, saya bilang!
Saya berkemah! Itu cerita saya!

entries.original:
"I just wanted to have a picnic in
Thundercap Mt.

I didn’t think I would get lost
in a place like this\."
entries.translation_source: I just wanted to have a picnic in Thundercap Mt. I didn’t think I would get lost in a place like this\.
entries.translated:
Saya hanya ingin piknik di Gunung
Thundercap. Saya tidak menyangka\lakan tersesat di tempat seperti ini\.

entries.original:
"Why have a picnic here?
I don’t know.

There’s no deep meaning to it."
entries.translation_source: Why have a picnic here? I don’t know. There’s no deep meaning to it.
entries.translated:
Kenapa piknik di sini? Saya tidak
tahu. Tidak ada makna mendalam di\lbaliknya.

entries.original:
"c here?
I don’t know.

There’s no deep meaning to it."
entries.translation_source: c here? I don’t know. There’s no deep meaning to it.
entries.translated:
c di sini? Saya tidak tahu. Tidak
ada makna mendalam di baliknya.

entries.original:
"I’m playing hide-and-seek here.
I like some underground tag, too."
entries.translation_source: I’m playing hide-and-seek here. I like some underground tag, too.
entries.translated:
Saya sedang bermain petak umpet di
sini. Saya juga suka main\lkejar-kejaran bawah tanah.

entries.original:
"Speaking of crying, I’m positive I
heard before\."
entries.translation_source: Speaking of crying, I’m positive I heard before\.
entries.translated:
Bicara soal menangis, saya yakin
saya pernah mendengarnya sebelumnya\.

entries.original:
"Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy
Town and terrorize ’em for fun.

But then that white-haired Gym
Leader always chases me away.

I hope I give him such a headache\."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy Town and terrorize ’em for fun. But then that white-haired Gym Leader always chases me away. I hope I give him such a headache\.
entries.translated:
Kadang-kadang saya jalan ke Epidimy
Town dan meneror mereka untuk\lbersenang-senang. Tapi kemudian

Pemimpin Gym berambut putih itu
selalu mengusir saya. Saya harap\lsaya membuatnya sakit kepala\.

entries.original:
"For someone as mad as you, your
training has clearly paid off!

And madness born from a drive for
strength must be rewarded!

Trainer!

Have you any of those [green]Power Items[blue]?

They may not look it, but my hands
are both for crafting and punching!

So, allow me to improve all of your
Power Items so they may strengthen\lyour Pokémon even quicker!

All I need are stars - [green][buffer1]s[blue]
to be exact!

You can collect one [buffer1] per
day by smashing the [green]Challenge Rock[blue].

This imposing rock, right here.

Bring a [green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon and
smash your way through!"
entries.translation_source: For someone as mad as you, your training has clearly paid off! And madness born from a drive for strength must be rewarded! Trainer! Have you any of those [green]Power Items[blue]? They may not look it, but my hands are both for crafting and punching! So, allow me to improve all of your Power Items so they may strengthen your Pokémon even quicker! All I need are stars - [green][buffer1]s[blue] to be exact! You can collect one [buffer1] per day by smashing the [green]Challenge Rock[blue]. This imposing rock, right here. Bring a [green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon and smash your way through!
entries.translated:
Untuk seseorang yang segila kamu,
latihanmu jelas membuahkan hasil!\lDan kegilaan yang lahir dari

dorongan untuk kekuatan harus
dihargai! Pelatih! Apakah kamu\lmemiliki [green]Item Kekuatan[blue]? Mungkin

tidak terlihat, tapi tanganku bisa
untuk kerajinan dan pukulan! Jadi,\lizinkan aku meningkatkan semua Item

Kekuatanmu agar mereka dapat
memperkuat Pokémon-mu lebih cepat!\lYang aku butuhkan hanyalah bintang

- tepatnya [green][buffer1]s[blue]! Kamu bisa
mengumpulkan satu [buffer1] per hari\ldengan menghancurkan [green]Batu

Tantangan[blue]. Batu yang mengesankan
ini, di sini. Bawalah Pokémon [green]Tipe\lPetarung[blue] dan hancurkan jalanmu!

entries.original:
"Greetings, mad one among madmen!

If you wish, pay me [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue]
and I will upgrade all of your\l[green]Power Items[blue] to [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Greetings, mad one among madmen! If you wish, pay me [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue] and I will upgrade all of your [green]Power Items[blue] to [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue]!
entries.translated:
Salam, yang gila di antara orang
gila! Jika kamu mau, bayar aku\l[green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue] dan aku akan

meningkatkan semua [green]Item Kekuatan[blue]
milikmu ke [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over
[buffer2] [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over [buffer2] [buffer1].
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2]
[buffer1].

entries.original:
"[black]The Power Item level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

Pokémon will now gain an additional
[green]\\0C[black] Effort Values when one is held."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Power Item level has been increased to \Lv [buffer2]! Pokémon will now gain an additional [green]\\0C[black] Effort Values when one is held.
entries.translated:
[black]Level Item Kekuatan telah
ditingkatkan menjadi \Lv [buffer2]!\lPokémon sekarang akan mendapatkan

tambahan [green]\\0C[black] Nilai Usaha saat salah
satu dipegang.

entries.original:
"Gather the stars around Borrius
and come again!"
entries.translation_source: Gather the stars around Borrius and come again!
entries.translated:
Kumpulkan bintang-bintang di
sekitar Borrius dan datang lagi!

entries.original:
"Alas, you lack the [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue]
to upgrade your Power Items.

Obtain more stars to your name
and come again!"
entries.translation_source: Alas, you lack the [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue] to upgrade your Power Items. Obtain more stars to your name and come again!
entries.translated:
Sayang, kamu kekurangan [green][buffer3]
[buffer1][blue] untuk meningkatkan Item\lKekuatanmu. Dapatkan lebih banyak

bintang atas namamu dan datang
lagi!

entries.original:
"With your Power Items at their max
level, your Pokémon will gain an\ladditional [green]\\0C[blue] Effort Values when\lone is held!

Tell me that’s not mad, mad one
among madmen!"
entries.translation_source: With your Power Items at their max level, your Pokémon will gain an additional [green]\\0C[blue] Effort Values when one is held! Tell me that’s not mad, mad one among madmen!
entries.translated:
Dengan Item Kekuatanmu di level
maksimal, Pokémon-mu akan\lmendapatkan tambahan [green]\\0C[blue] Nilai Usaha

saat salah satu dipegang! Katakan
itu tidak gila, yang gila di antara\lorang gila!

entries.original: "Tomb Raider"
entries.translation_source: Tomb Raider
entries.translated: Tomb Raider

entries.original: "Fred"
entries.translation_source: Fred
entries.translated: Fred

entries.original:
"This piece goes here\.

And that piece goes there\."
entries.translation_source: This piece goes here\. And that piece goes there\.
entries.translated:
Potongan ini diletakkan di sini\. Dan
potongan itu diletakkan di sana\.

entries.original:
"Oh, a Trainer!

The name’s Fred.

My colleagues and I have been here
for weeks trying to learn more\labout this ancient tomb.

Unfortunately, this puzzle here has
us stumped.

If you think you’ll have a better
chance at solving it than we did,\lthen be my guest."
entries.translation_source: Oh, a Trainer! The name’s Fred. My colleagues and I have been here for weeks trying to learn more about this ancient tomb. Unfortunately, this puzzle here has us stumped. If you think you’ll have a better chance at solving it than we did, then be my guest.
entries.translated:
Oh, seorang Pelatih! Namaku Fred.
Rekan-rekanku dan aku sudah berada\ldi sini selama berminggu-minggu

mencoba mempelajari lebih lanjut
tentang makam kuno ini. Sayangnya,\lteka-teki ini membuat kami buntu.

Jika kamu pikir kamu punya peluang
lebih baik untuk memecahkannya\ldaripada kami, silakan saja.

entries.original:
"This puzzle here has had us stumped
for weeks!

It’s simply too hard to complete\."
entries.translation_source: This puzzle here has had us stumped for weeks! It’s simply too hard to complete\.
entries.translated:
Teka-teki ini sudah membuat kami
buntu selama berminggu-minggu!\lTeka-teki ini terlalu sulit untuk

diselesaikan\.

entries.original:
"Come on, Fred!
You can do it!

\.Wait, what are you doing!?

That piece doesn’t go there!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, Fred! You can do it! \.Wait, what are you doing!? That piece doesn’t go there!
entries.translated:
Ayo, Fred! Kamu pasti bisa! \.Tunggu,
apa yang kamu lakukan!? Potongan\litu tidak di situ!

entries.original:
"This tomb was designed by the
ancient people of Borrius to keep\lout intruders like us.

The puzzle on this floor must only
be the first in a series of traps\lbefore the burial chamber\."
entries.translation_source: This tomb was designed by the ancient people of Borrius to keep out intruders like us. The puzzle on this floor must only be the first in a series of traps before the burial chamber\.
entries.translated:
Makam ini dirancang oleh
orang-orang kuno Borrius untuk\lmenghalau penyusup seperti kita.

Teka-teki di lantai ini pasti hanya
yang pertama dari serangkaian\ljebakan sebelum ruang pemakaman\.

entries.original:
"This tomb was designed by the
ancient people of Borrius to keep\lout intruders like us.

The puzzle on this floor must only
be the first in a series of traps\lbefore the burial chamber\.

Best of luck down there."
entries.translation_source: This tomb was designed by the ancient people of Borrius to keep out intruders like us. The puzzle on this floor must only be the first in a series of traps before the burial chamber\. Best of luck down there.
entries.translated:
Makam ini dirancang oleh
orang-orang kuno Borrius untuk\lmenghalau penyusup seperti kita.

Teka-teki di lantai ini pasti hanya
yang pertama dari serangkaian\ljebakan sebelum ruang pemakaman\.

Semoga beruntung di sana.

entries.original:
"This door is the passageway to the
burial chamber!

I can feel it in my bones!"
entries.translation_source: This door is the passageway to the burial chamber! I can feel it in my bones!
entries.translated:
Pintu ini adalah jalan menuju ruang
pemakaman! Aku bisa merasakannya di\ltulangku!

entries.original:
"This door is the passageway to the
burial chamber!

I can feel it in my bones!

Maybe something you’ll discover
down below will provide the key\lto unlocking it\."
entries.translation_source: This door is the passageway to the burial chamber! I can feel it in my bones! Maybe something you’ll discover down below will provide the key to unlocking it\.
entries.translated:
Pintu ini adalah jalan menuju ruang
pemakaman! Aku bisa merasakannya di\ltulangku! Mungkin sesuatu yang akan

kamu temukan di bawah akan
memberikan kunci untuk membukanya\.

entries.original:
"Hey, kid!

You okay down there?

That looked like a nasty fall!

\.

\.I’m sure you’ll shrug it off!

Hang on\.
Let me throw down a ladder."
entries.translation_source: Hey, kid! You okay down there? That looked like a nasty fall! \. \.I’m sure you’ll shrug it off! Hang on\. Let me throw down a ladder.
entries.translated:
Hei, nak! Kamu tidak apa-apa di
bawah sana? Itu tampak seperti\ljatuh yang parah! \. \.Aku yakin kamu

akan mengabaikannya! Tunggu\. Biarkan
aku menurunkan tangga.

entries.original:
"Wow, kid, looks like you found a
way into the tomb!

I’m impressed!

Not even the greatest minds in the
Archeology Society could crack\lthat puzzle!

You’re a natural archeologist, kid!

In fact, why don’t you take the
lead on exploring this place?

They say great riches are waiting
for anyone who can find the burial\lchamber.

A whiz like you should have no
problem finding it."
entries.translation_source: Wow, kid, looks like you found a way into the tomb! I’m impressed! Not even the greatest minds in the Archeology Society could crack that puzzle! You’re a natural archeologist, kid! In fact, why don’t you take the lead on exploring this place? They say great riches are waiting for anyone who can find the burial chamber. A whiz like you should have no problem finding it.
entries.translated:
Wow, nak, sepertinya kamu menemukan
jalan masuk ke makam! Aku terkesan!\lBahkan pemikir terhebat di

Perhimpunan Arkeologi pun tidak
bisa memecahkan teka-teki itu! Kamu\larkeolog alami, nak! Faktanya,

kenapa kamu tidak memimpin
menjelajahi tempat ini? Mereka\lmengatakan kekayaan besar menunggu

siapa pun yang bisa menemukan ruang
pemakaman. Jenius sepertimu\lseharusnya tidak kesulitan

menemukannya.

entries.original:
"Keep your eye out for hidden
treasure as you explore the tomb.

I doubt the ancient civilization
left much treasure just lying\laround\."
entries.translation_source: Keep your eye out for hidden treasure as you explore the tomb. I doubt the ancient civilization left much treasure just lying around\.
entries.translated:
Perhatikan harta karun tersembunyi
saat kamu menjelajahi makam. Aku\lragu peradaban kuno meninggalkan

banyak harta hanya berserakan\.

entries.original: "[green]Booooooooo!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Booooooooo!
entries.translated: [green]Booooooooo!

entries.original:
"\.A volcano\.?

How in the world did they get a
volcano in this tomb\.?

\.Oh, well.
No point in dwelling on it.

It looks like we’re too high up to
ride on a Pokémon across the lava,\lso you just keep finding us a way\lthrough the tomb."
entries.translation_source: \.A volcano\.? How in the world did they get a volcano in this tomb\.? \.Oh, well. No point in dwelling on it. It looks like we’re too high up to ride on a Pokémon across the lava, so you just keep finding us a way through the tomb.
entries.translated:
\.Sebuah gunung berapi\.? Bagaimana
mereka bisa menaruh gunung berapi\ldi makam ini\.? \.Oh, well. Tidak ada

gunanya memikirkannya. Sepertinya
kita terlalu tinggi untuk menaiki\lPokémon melewati lava, jadi kamu

terus saja mencari jalan bagi kita
melewati makam.

entries.original:
"Be careful when hopping on those
rocks!

One wrong step and you’ll fall to
a fiery doom\.

So stay safe, and keep an eye out
for any hidden switches that might\llead us to the next floor."
entries.translation_source: Be careful when hopping on those rocks! One wrong step and you’ll fall to a fiery doom\. So stay safe, and keep an eye out for any hidden switches that might lead us to the next floor.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati saat melompat di atas
batu-batu itu! Satu langkah salah\ldan kamu akan jatuh ke api neraka\.

Jadi tetap aman, dan perhatikan
sakelar tersembunyi yang mungkin\lmembawa kita ke lantai berikutnya.

entries.original: "The rock reacted to your touch!"
entries.translation_source: The rock reacted to your touch!
entries.translated:
Batu itu bereaksi terhadap
sentuhanmu!

entries.original:
"Ohhh\. Trainer\.
I don’t feel so good\.

The Dusknoir must be messing with
the space in our dimension\.

The more I move, the fuzzier
it gets\.

So be careful\.
And don’t let them spot youuuu\."
entries.translation_source: Ohhh\. Trainer\. I don’t feel so good\. The Dusknoir must be messing with the space in our dimension\. The more I move, the fuzzier it gets\. So be careful\. And don’t let them spot youuuu\.
entries.translated:
Ohhh\. Pelatih\. Aku tidak enak badan\.
Dusknoir pasti mengacaukan ruang di\ldimensi kita\. Semakin aku bergerak,

semakin kabur jadinya\. Jadi
berhati-hatilah\. Dan jangan biarkan\lmereka melihatmuuuu\.

entries.original:
"The Dusknoir must be messing with
the space in our dimension\.

Be careful\.
And don’t let them spot youuuu\."
entries.translation_source: The Dusknoir must be messing with the space in our dimension\. Be careful\. And don’t let them spot youuuu\.
entries.translated:
Dusknoir pasti mengacaukan ruang di
dimensi kita\. Berhati-hatilah\. Dan\ljangan biarkan mereka melihatmuuuu\.

entries.original:
"Phew\.

Am I ever glad I got through that
in one piece!"
entries.translation_source: Phew\. Am I ever glad I got through that in one piece!
entries.translated:
Fiuh\. Aku sangat senang berhasil
melewatinya dengan utuh!

entries.original:
"Uh oh.

Looks like one wrong step on this
floor and you’ll plummet back down\lto the floor below.

But there has to be some way to get
across the floor, right?

Maybe if you can reach a certain
speed?"
entries.translation_source: Uh oh. Looks like one wrong step on this floor and you’ll plummet back down to the floor below. But there has to be some way to get across the floor, right? Maybe if you can reach a certain speed?
entries.translated:
Uh oh. Sepertinya satu langkah
salah di lantai ini dan kamu akan\ljatuh kembali ke lantai di bawah.

Tapi pasti ada cara untuk
menyeberangi lantai, kan? Mungkin\ljika kamu bisa mencapai kecepatan

tertentu?

entries.original:
"I’d wager that if you can find a
way to move quickly across the\lfloor, you’ll be able to avoid\lfalling through the holes."
entries.translation_source: I’d wager that if you can find a way to move quickly across the floor, you’ll be able to avoid falling through the holes.
entries.translated:
Aku bertaruh jika kamu bisa
menemukan cara bergerak cepat di\llantai, kamu akan bisa menghindari

jatuh ke dalam lubang.

entries.original:
"This is it\.
The burial chamber!

And look!

That must be where the ancient king
of Borrius is buried.

Now that we’ve made it, let’s
gather up as much treasure as we\lcan, then get out of here.

And just in case there are still
traps waiting to be sprung, let me\luse the last of my healing items on\lyour Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: This is it\. The burial chamber! And look! That must be where the ancient king of Borrius is buried. Now that we’ve made it, let’s gather up as much treasure as we can, then get out of here. And just in case there are still traps waiting to be sprung, let me use the last of my healing items on your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ini dia\. Ruang pemakaman! Dan lihat!
Itu pasti tempat raja kuno Borrius\ldimakamkan. Sekarang kita sudah

sampai, mari kumpulkan sebanyak
mungkin harta, lalu keluar dari\lsini. Dan untuk berjaga-jaga masih

ada jebakan yang menanti, biarkan
aku menggunakan item penyembuhan\lterakhirku pada Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"Gather up as much treasure as
you can.

When you’ve done that, I’d wager
there’s even more hiding inside\lthat coffin\."
entries.translation_source: Gather up as much treasure as you can. When you’ve done that, I’d wager there’s even more hiding inside that coffin\.
entries.translated:
Kumpulkan sebanyak mungkin harta
karun. Setelah itu, saya yakin\lmasih ada lebih banyak lagi yang

tersembunyi di dalam peti mati itu\.

entries.original: "The coffin feels cold to the touch\."
entries.translation_source: The coffin feels cold to the touch\.
entries.translated:
Peti mati itu terasa dingin saat
disentuh\.

entries.original:
"[red]WARNING! WARNING! WARNING!

INTRUDER DETECTED!

THE AUTOMATED DEFENSE SYSTEM HAS
BEEN ENGAGED!"
entries.translation_source: [red]WARNING! WARNING! WARNING! INTRUDER DETECTED! THE AUTOMATED DEFENSE SYSTEM HAS BEEN ENGAGED!
entries.translated:
[red]PERINGATAN! PERINGATAN! PERINGATAN!
PENYUSUP TERDETEKSI! SISTEM\lPERTAHANAN OTOMATIS TELAH

DIAKTIFKAN!

entries.original:
"I knew there’d be some other trap!

I was smart to keep my distance
from this coffin until now.

It’s a good thing I let you take
the lead on the exploration!"
entries.translation_source: I knew there’d be some other trap! I was smart to keep my distance from this coffin until now. It’s a good thing I let you take the lead on the exploration!
entries.translated:
Aku tahu pasti ada jebakan lain!
Aku pintar menjaga jarak dari peti\lmati ini sampai sekarang. Untung

aku membiarkanmu memimpin
eksplorasi!

entries.original:
"It seems your fight with that
ancient Pokémon unlocked the\lseal on the door.

Looks like my colleague was right
about that door leading to the\lburial chamber, after all.

Well, I’d best report back to the
Archeology Society with the\ltreasure and knowledge I gathered.

But before I go, I picked this up
while we were making our way\lthrough the tomb.

At first glance, I thought it was
ancient treasure, but it’s just one\lof those Z-Crystals all the kids\lare into these days.

Here, you can have it."
entries.translation_source: It seems your fight with that ancient Pokémon unlocked the seal on the door. Looks like my colleague was right about that door leading to the burial chamber, after all. Well, I’d best report back to the Archeology Society with the treasure and knowledge I gathered. But before I go, I picked this up while we were making our way through the tomb. At first glance, I thought it was ancient treasure, but it’s just one of those Z-Crystals all the kids are into these days. Here, you can have it.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya pertarunganmu dengan
Pokémon kuno itu membuka segel di\lpintu. Ternyata rekan saya benar

tentang pintu itu mengarah ke ruang
pemakaman. Baiklah, sebaiknya aku\lmelapor kembali ke Perkumpulan

Arkeologi dengan harta karun dan
pengetahuan yang kukumpulkan. Tapi\lsebelum pergi, aku mengambil ini

saat kita melewati makam. Sekilas
kupikir ini harta kuno, tapi\lternyata hanya salah satu Kristal Z

yang disukai anak-anak sekarang.
Ini, ambillah.

entries.original: "[green]Kriiikrookriii!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Kriiikrookriii!
entries.translated: [green]Kriiikrookriii!

entries.original: "[green][buffer1] disappeared into the tomb."
entries.translation_source: [green][buffer1] disappeared into the tomb.
entries.translated: [green][buffer1] menghilang ke dalam makam.

entries.original:
"Will you be the latest entrant
in our daily challenge?

Get to the other end of the tunnel
in less than 15 seconds to win a\lfantastic prize!"
entries.translation_source: Will you be the latest entrant in our daily challenge? Get to the other end of the tunnel in less than 15 seconds to win a fantastic prize!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu akan menjadi peserta
terbaru dalam tantangan harian\lkami? Capai ujung lain terowongan

dalam waktu kurang dari 15 detik
untuk memenangkan hadiah fantastis!

entries.original:
"Back for another attempt at our
daily challenge?"
entries.translation_source: Back for another attempt at our daily challenge?
entries.translated:
Kembali untuk mencoba lagi
tantangan harian kami?

entries.original: "Can’t hack it, eh?"
entries.translation_source: Can’t hack it, eh?
entries.translated: Tidak sanggup, ya?

entries.original:
"The rules are simple.

To win a prize, talk to my brother
at the other end of the tunnel in\l[green]less than 15 seconds[blue] from when I\lsay go.

If you make it there in [green]10 seconds
or less[blue], you’ll win a big prize!

We’ll let you know when time is up."
entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. To win a prize, talk to my brother at the other end of the tunnel in [green]less than 15 seconds[blue] from when I say go. If you make it there in [green]10 seconds or less[blue], you’ll win a big prize! We’ll let you know when time is up.
entries.translated:
Aturannya sederhana. Untuk
memenangkan hadiah, bicaralah\ldengan kakakku di ujung lain

terowongan dalam waktu [green]kurang dari
15 detik[blue] sejak aku bilang mulai.\lJika kamu sampai di sana dalam [green]10

detik atau kurang[blue], kamu akan
memenangkan hadiah besar! Kami akan\lmemberitahumu saat waktu habis.

entries.original:
"On your marks\.
Get set\.

GO! GO! GO!"
entries.translation_source: On your marks\. Get set\. GO! GO! GO!
entries.translated:
Bersiaplah\. Siap\. MULAI! MULAI!
MULAI!

entries.original:
"What are you waiting for?
GO, GO, GO!"
entries.translation_source: What are you waiting for? GO, GO, GO!
entries.translated:
Tunggu apa lagi? MULAI, MULAI,
MULAI!

entries.original:
"CONGRATULATIONS!

You made it to me in [buffer1]
seconds!

Would you like to claim your prize
now, or hold off and try again in\l10 seconds or less to win an even\lbigger prize?"
entries.translation_source: CONGRATULATIONS! You made it to me in [buffer1] seconds! Would you like to claim your prize now, or hold off and try again in 10 seconds or less to win an even bigger prize?
entries.translated:
SELAMAT! Kamu sampai padaku dalam
[buffer1] detik! Apakah kamu ingin\lmengambil hadiahmu sekarang, atau

menunda dan mencoba lagi dalam 10
detik atau kurang untuk memenangkan\lhadiah yang lebih besar?

entries.original: "Here’s your prize!"
entries.translation_source: Here’s your prize!
entries.translated: Ini hadiahmu!

entries.original:
"CONGRATULATIONS!

You made it to me in [buffer1]
seconds!

Extraordinary!

Here’s your prize!"
entries.translation_source: CONGRATULATIONS! You made it to me in [buffer1] seconds! Extraordinary! Here’s your prize!
entries.translated:
SELAMAT! Kamu sampai padaku dalam
[buffer1] detik! Luar biasa! Ini\lhadiahmu!

entries.original:
"CONGRATULATIONS!

You made it to me in [buffer1]
seconds!

Extraordinary!

I didn’t even think that was
possible!

Here’s your prize!"
entries.translation_source: CONGRATULATIONS! You made it to me in [buffer1] seconds! Extraordinary! I didn’t even think that was possible! Here’s your prize!
entries.translated:
SELAMAT! Kamu sampai padaku dalam
[buffer1] detik! Luar biasa! Aku\lbahkan tidak menyangka itu mungkin!

Ini hadiahmu!

entries.original:
"Speak to my brother or me whenever
you’re ready to try again."
entries.translation_source: Speak to my brother or me whenever you’re ready to try again.
entries.translated:
Bicaralah dengan kakakku atau aku
kapan pun kamu siap mencoba lagi.

entries.original:
"[blue]Time’s up!

Sorry, fella, but you didn’t
make it!

Better luck next time!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Time’s up! Sorry, fella, but you didn’t make it! Better luck next time!
entries.translated:
[blue]Waktu habis! Maaf, sobat, kamu
tidak berhasil! Semoga beruntung\llain kali!

entries.original:
"Come back tomorrow for another
chance to win a fantastic prize!"
entries.translation_source: Come back tomorrow for another chance to win a fantastic prize!
entries.translated:
Kembalilah besok untuk kesempatan
lain memenangkan hadiah fantastis!

entries.original: "Claim Prize"
entries.translation_source: Claim Prize
entries.translated: Klaim Hadiah

entries.original: "Try Again"
entries.translation_source: Try Again
entries.translated: Coba Lagi

entries.original: "Dowsing Wizard"
entries.translation_source: Dowsing Wizard
entries.translated: Penyihir Pendeteksi

entries.original:
"You can find so much cool stuff in
the most random of places.

Take this Great Ball I found in my
neighbour’s mailbox, for example\.

Or even this half-eaten hot dog I
found in my garbage can.

You want to find some hidden items,
and then compare?"
entries.translation_source: You can find so much cool stuff in the most random of places. Take this Great Ball I found in my neighbour’s mailbox, for example\. Or even this half-eaten hot dog I found in my garbage can. You want to find some hidden items, and then compare?
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa menemukan banyak barang
keren di tempat yang paling tidak\lterduga. Ambil contoh Bola Hebat

yang kutemukan di kotak surat
tetanggaku\. Atau bahkan hot dog\lsetengah dimakan yang kutemukan di

tempat sampahku. Kamu ingin mencari
beberapa item tersembunyi, lalu\lmembandingkannya?

entries.original:
"Awesome!

Once you find [green][buffer1][blue] discarded items,
come back and we’ll compare.

I bet you can’t find anything as
sweet as my haul here!"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! Once you find [green][buffer1][blue] discarded items, come back and we’ll compare. I bet you can’t find anything as sweet as my haul here!
entries.translated:
Keren! Setelah kamu menemukan
[green][buffer1][blue] item yang dibuang, kembali\llagi dan kita akan membandingkan.

Aku yakin kamu tidak bisa menemukan
sesuatu yang sekeren hasil\lkumpulanku di sini!

entries.original:
"That’s cool, I’ll find other people
to compare with."
entries.translation_source: That’s cool, I’ll find other people to compare with.
entries.translated:
Itu keren, aku akan mencari orang
lain untuk membandingkan.

entries.original:
"So far you’ve found [green][buffer2][blue] hidden
item\\07.

I think you can find some more
in this tunnel.

Come back when you’ve found [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: So far you’ve found [green][buffer2][blue] hidden item\\07. I think you can find some more in this tunnel. Come back when you’ve found [green][buffer1][blue].
entries.translated:
Sejauh ini kamu telah menemukan
[green][buffer2][blue] item tersembunyi\\07. Aku\lpikir kamu bisa menemukan lebih

banyak di terowongan ini.
Kembalilah setelah kamu menemukan\l[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Okay, let’s see what you got\.

Wow!

Where did you find this mint
condition barbecue chip shaped\llike a Ditto?

Or that limited edition Nanab
Berry peel - that’s vintage!

Hold on, I’ll trade you for ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, let’s see what you got\. Wow! Where did you find this mint condition barbecue chip shaped like a Ditto? Or that limited edition Nanab Berry peel - that’s vintage! Hold on, I’ll trade you for ’em!
entries.translated:
Oke, mari kita lihat apa yang kamu
dapatkan\. Wow! Di mana kamu\lmenemukan keripik barbekyu kondisi

sempurna berbentuk Ditto ini? Atau
kulit Beri Nanab edisi terbatas itu\l- itu klasik! Tunggu, aku akan

menukarnya denganmu!

entries.original:
"Remember to check between couch
cushions for secret treasures."
entries.translation_source: Remember to check between couch cushions for secret treasures.
entries.translated:
Ingatlah untuk memeriksa di antara
bantalan sofa untuk harta karun\lrahasia.

entries.original:
"[black]Toxapex pumped itself full of
poisonous fluids to increase\lits size!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Toxapex pumped itself full of poisonous fluids to increase its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Toxapex memompa dirinya penuh
dengan cairan beracun untuk\lmembesarkan ukurannya!

entries.original: "[black]Toxapex receded into the sand."
entries.translation_source: [black]Toxapex receded into the sand.
entries.translated: [black]Toxapex mundur ke dalam pasir.

entries.original:
"DEFEATING
THE TOXAPEX
IS THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: DEFEATING THE TOXAPEX IS THE KEY.
entries.translated: MENGALAHKAN TOXAPEX ADALAH KUNCI.

entries.original: "[black][player] found a rare Egg!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] found a rare Egg!
entries.translated: [black][player] menemukan Telur langka!

entries.original: "The Sharpedo is angry!"
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo is angry!
entries.translated: Sharpedo sedang marah!

entries.original: "The Sharpedo are angry!"
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo are angry!
entries.translated: Para Sharpedo sedang marah!

entries.original: "The Sharpedo attacked!"
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo attacked!
entries.translated: Sharpedo menyerang!

entries.original:
"The Sharpedo is eyeing you
curiously."
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo is eyeing you curiously.
entries.translated:
Sharpedo menatapmu dengan rasa
ingin tahu.

entries.original:
"The inscription on the tablet
appears to have eroded away."
entries.translation_source: The inscription on the tablet appears to have eroded away.
entries.translated:
Tulisan pada lempengan batu
tampaknya telah terkikis.

entries.original:
"There appears to be an ancient
button embedded in the rock!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be an ancient button embedded in the rock! Press it?
entries.translated:
Tampaknya ada tombol kuno yang
tertanam di batu! Tekan?

entries.original: "Nothing happened\."
entries.translation_source: Nothing happened\.
entries.translated: Tidak terjadi apa-apa\.

entries.original:
"A life of gambling is a life of
no regrets."
entries.translation_source: A life of gambling is a life of no regrets.
entries.translated:
Hidup berjudi adalah hidup tanpa
penyesalan.

entries.original:
"I train myself every day by running
barefoot across these stones."
entries.translation_source: I train myself every day by running barefoot across these stones.
entries.translated:
Aku melatih diriku setiap hari
dengan berlari tanpa alas kaki di\latas batu-batu ini.

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon eats one of the
rare herbs that grow here, its\laffection for you will decrease."
entries.translation_source: If a Pokémon eats one of the rare herbs that grow here, its affection for you will decrease.
entries.translated:
Jika seekor Pokémon memakan salah
satu ramuan langka yang tumbuh di\lsini, kasih sayangnya padamu akan

berkurang.

entries.original:
"Long ago, there was a readable
inscription on the tablet below.

However, it appears it has long
since eroded away.

From what I remember, I believe it
said something along the lines of:

PRESSING THE SWITCH WITH INSECT
IS THE KEY.

What ever could that mean?"
entries.translation_source: Long ago, there was a readable inscription on the tablet below. However, it appears it has long since eroded away. From what I remember, I believe it said something along the lines of: PRESSING THE SWITCH WITH INSECT IS THE KEY. What ever could that mean?
entries.translated:
Dahulu kala, ada tulisan yang bisa
dibaca di tablet di bawah. Namun,\ltampaknya tulisan itu sudah lama

terkikis. Dari apa yang kuingat,
saya yakin tulisan itu mengatakan\lsesuatu seperti: MENekAN SAKLAR

DENGAN SERANGGA ADALAH KUNCINYA.
Apa maksudnya itu?

entries.original:
"It seems that the long-standing
tablet has finally been destroyed.

Were you responsible for removing
that piece of history?"
entries.translation_source: It seems that the long-standing tablet has finally been destroyed. Were you responsible for removing that piece of history?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya tablet yang sudah lama
berdiri itu akhirnya hancur. Apakah\lkamu yang bertanggung jawab

menghilangkan bagian sejarah itu?

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Welcome, Trainer.

This final area of Victory Road is
known as the \qotorture chamber\qc.

All that remains between here and
the Pokémon League is this one\licy area.

But hey, I get it.

Not everyone wants to spend their
time sliding around looking for\lthe exit.

So, let’s cut a deal.

If you pay me $[green]200000[blue], I’ll send
you to the other side.

You won’t even have to get your
feet wet.

What do you say?
It’s only a measly $[green]200000[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh\. Welcome, Trainer. This final area of Victory Road is known as the \qotorture chamber\qc. All that remains between here and the Pokémon League is this one icy area. But hey, I get it. Not everyone wants to spend their time sliding around looking for the exit. So, let’s cut a deal. If you pay me $[green]200000[blue], I’ll send you to the other side. You won’t even have to get your feet wet. What do you say? It’s only a measly $[green]200000[blue]\.
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, heh\. Selamat datang,
Pelatih. Area terakhir Victory Road\lini dikenal sebagai \qotorture

chamber\qc. Yang tersisa di antara
sini dan Pokémon League adalah satu\larea es ini. Tapi hei, aku

mengerti. Tidak semua orang ingin
menghabiskan waktu berseluncur\lmencari pintu keluar. Jadi, mari

kita buat kesepakatan. Jika kamu
membayarku $[green]200000[blue], aku akan\lmengirimmu ke sisi lain. Kamu

bahkan tidak perlu membuat kakimu
basah. Bagaimana? Hanya $[green]200000[blue]\lyang murah\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Welcome, Trainer.

This final area of Victory Road is
known as the \qotorture chamber\qc.

All that remains between here and
the Pokémon League is this one\licy area.

But hey, I get it.

Not everyone wants to spend their
time sliding around looking for\lthe exit.

So, let’s cut a deal.

If you pay me $[green]45000[blue], I’ll send
you to the other side.

You won’t even have to get your
feet wet.

What do you say?
It’s only a measly $[green]45000[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh\. Welcome, Trainer. This final area of Victory Road is known as the \qotorture chamber\qc. All that remains between here and the Pokémon League is this one icy area. But hey, I get it. Not everyone wants to spend their time sliding around looking for the exit. So, let’s cut a deal. If you pay me $[green]45000[blue], I’ll send you to the other side. You won’t even have to get your feet wet. What do you say? It’s only a measly $[green]45000[blue]\.
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, heh\. Selamat datang,
Pelatih. Area terakhir Victory Road\lini dikenal sebagai \qotorture

chamber\qc. Yang tersisa di antara
sini dan Pokémon League adalah satu\larea es ini. Tapi hei, aku

mengerti. Tidak semua orang ingin
menghabiskan waktu berseluncur\lmencari pintu keluar. Jadi, mari

kita buat kesepakatan. Jika kamu
membayarku $[green]45000[blue], aku akan\lmengirimmu ke sisi lain. Kamu

bahkan tidak perlu membuat kakimu
basah. Bagaimana? Hanya $[green]45000[blue] yang\lmurah\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Pleasure doing business with you,
Trainer\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh\. Pleasure doing business with you, Trainer\.
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, heh\. Senang berbisnis
denganmu, Pelatih\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Good luck on the ice, Trainer\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh\. Good luck on the ice, Trainer\.
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, heh\. Semoga berhasil di
atas es, Pelatih\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, huh?

You don’t have enough coin to
employ my services\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, huh? You don’t have enough coin to employ my services\.
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, huh? Kamu tidak punya
cukup koin untuk menggunakan jasaku\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

If you’ve made it this far, Insane
Trainer, then you can make it a\llittle farther on your own.

Just slide onto the ice and dive
deep into insanity\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh\. If you’ve made it this far, Insane Trainer, then you can make it a little farther on your own. Just slide onto the ice and dive deep into insanity\.
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, heh\. Jika kamu sudah
sampai sejauh ini, Pelatih Gila,\lmaka kamu bisa melangkah lebih jauh

sendiri. Geser saja ke atas es dan
selami kegilaan\.

entries.original:
"It’s an ingenious design, really.

To test Trainers’ strength, the
designers of Victory Road set up\la puzzle that must be solved in\lorder to progress any further.

That way, those lacking conviction
are forced to turn back."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ingenious design, really. To test Trainers’ strength, the designers of Victory Road set up a puzzle that must be solved in order to progress any further. That way, those lacking conviction are forced to turn back.
entries.translated:
Ini desain yang cerdik, sungguh.
Untuk menguji kekuatan Pelatih,\lpara perancang Victory Road membuat

teka-teki yang harus dipecahkan
untuk melanjutkan. Dengan begitu,\lmereka yang kurang tekad terpaksa

kembali.

entries.original:
"If you can’t overcome a hurdle, you
can always just go around it.

Keep going, and you’ll find the
greatest hurdle for Trainers:\lthe Pokémon League."
entries.translation_source: If you can’t overcome a hurdle, you can always just go around it. Keep going, and you’ll find the greatest hurdle for Trainers: the Pokémon League.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu tidak bisa melewati
rintangan, kamu selalu bisa\lmengitarinya. Teruslah maju, dan

kamu akan menemukan rintangan
terbesar bagi Pelatih: Pokémon\lLeague.

entries.original:
"There actually wasn’t any need to
prove how strong we are.

I already know how capable my
Pokémon and I are!"
entries.translation_source: There actually wasn’t any need to prove how strong we are. I already know how capable my Pokémon and I are!
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya tidak perlu membuktikan
seberapa kuat kami. Aku sudah tahu\lbetapa mampunya aku dan Pokémon-ku!

entries.original:
"You know what I think?

All people know what they can do
alone, but\.

There are a lot of things you can
only do with Pokémon, too!"
entries.translation_source: You know what I think? All people know what they can do alone, but\. There are a lot of things you can only do with Pokémon, too!
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu apa yang kupikir? Semua
orang tahu apa yang bisa mereka\llakukan sendiri, tapi\. Ada banyak

hal yang hanya bisa kamu lakukan
dengan Pokémon juga!

entries.original:
"Do you aim to be the very best?

The very best Trainers know how to
use their Pokémon’s muscles to\lmove boulders around!"
entries.translation_source: Do you aim to be the very best? The very best Trainers know how to use their Pokémon’s muscles to move boulders around!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu bercita-cita menjadi
yang terbaik? Pelatih terbaik tahu\lcara menggunakan otot Pokémon

mereka untuk memindahkan batu-batu
besar!

entries.original:
"How do you stop me from fighting
you?

Push that boulder onto the pressure
plate, and I will no longer have a\lreason to fight."
entries.translation_source: How do you stop me from fighting you? Push that boulder onto the pressure plate, and I will no longer have a reason to fight.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana cara menghentikanku
bertarung denganmu? Dorong batu\lbesar itu ke pelat tekanan, dan aku

tidak akan punya alasan lagi untuk
bertarung.

entries.original:
"The puzzle in this room isn’t part
of the Victory Road puzzle.

It has been around for much, much
longer.

Who could have set it up, I wonder?"
entries.translation_source: The puzzle in this room isn’t part of the Victory Road puzzle. It has been around for much, much longer. Who could have set it up, I wonder?
entries.translated:
Teka-teki di ruangan ini bukan
bagian dari teka-teki Victory Road.\lIni sudah ada jauh, jauh lebih

lama. Siapa yang bisa memasangnya,
ya?

entries.original:
"I’d love to brag about my Pokémon,
but nature’s calling!"
entries.translation_source: I’d love to brag about my Pokémon, but nature’s calling!
entries.translated:
Aku ingin memamerkan Pokémon-ku,
tapi alam memanggil!

entries.original:
"I teamed up with this Dragon Tamer
to help gain clarity into what\lexactly I tame."
entries.translation_source: I teamed up with this Dragon Tamer to help gain clarity into what exactly I tame.
entries.translated:
Aku bekerja sama dengan Dragon
Tamer ini untuk membantu\lmendapatkan kejelasan tentang apa

sebenarnya yang aku jinakkan.

entries.original:
"Gabite is also known as the Cave
Pokémon, but unlike Gabite,\lDruddigon is a pure Dragon-type."
entries.translation_source: Gabite is also known as the Cave Pokémon, but unlike Gabite, Druddigon is a pure Dragon-type.
entries.translated:
Gabite juga dikenal sebagai Pokémon
Gua, tetapi tidak seperti Gabite,\lDruddigon adalah tipe Naga murni.

entries.original:
"I convinced my cousin that the
best Bug-type could be found in\lthis area of Victory Road.

I didn’t realize the only Bug-type
around here is Durant."
entries.translation_source: I convinced my cousin that the best Bug-type could be found in this area of Victory Road. I didn’t realize the only Bug-type around here is Durant.
entries.translated:
Saya meyakinkan sepupu saya bahwa
tipe Serangga terbaik bisa\lditemukan di area Victory Road ini.

Saya tidak menyadari satu-satunya
tipe Serangga di sekitar sini\ladalah Durant.

entries.original:
"My cousin’s Heatmor is always
trying to eat the Durant I caught."
entries.translation_source: My cousin’s Heatmor is always trying to eat the Durant I caught.
entries.translated:
Heatmor milik sepupu saya selalu
mencoba memakan Durant yang saya\ltangkap.

entries.original:
"My daughter looks up to Arabella
of the Elite Four.

Ever since she could speak, all she
could talk about was Arabella."
entries.translation_source: My daughter looks up to Arabella of the Elite Four. Ever since she could speak, all she could talk about was Arabella.
entries.translated:
Putri saya mengagumi Arabella dari
Elite Four. Sejak dia bisa\lberbicara, yang dia bicarakan

hanyalah Arabella.

entries.original:
"I wanna be just like Arabella!

Super adorable and super powerful!"
entries.translation_source: I wanna be just like Arabella! Super adorable and super powerful!
entries.translated:
Aku ingin menjadi seperti Arabella!
Sangat menggemaskan dan sangat\lkuat!

entries.original:
"I aim to be the best Pokémon
Ranger in the world!

But my first step is to take care
of these hedges."
entries.translation_source: I aim to be the best Pokémon Ranger in the world! But my first step is to take care of these hedges.
entries.translated:
Saya bercita-cita menjadi Pokémon
Ranger terbaik di dunia! Tapi\llangkah pertama saya adalah merawat

pagar tanaman ini.

entries.original:
"It’s not enough for me just to be
together with Pokémon!

I want to win!

But I do know that some people feel
at ease just by being with their\lPokémon."
entries.translation_source: It’s not enough for me just to be together with Pokémon! I want to win! But I do know that some people feel at ease just by being with their Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Tidak cukup bagi saya hanya bersama
dengan Pokémon! Saya ingin menang!\lTapi saya tahu bahwa beberapa orang

merasa tenang hanya dengan bersama
Pokémon mereka.

entries.original:
"My Pokémon was once injured badly
in a fight.

I’m just so grateful that we’re
still together after all that."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon was once injured badly in a fight. I’m just so grateful that we’re still together after all that.
entries.translated:
Pokémon saya pernah terluka parah
dalam pertarungan. Saya sangat\lbersyukur kami masih bersama

setelah semua itu.

entries.original:
"You are the wind.

A supple and comforting wind
blowing through Victory Road!"
entries.translation_source: You are the wind. A supple and comforting wind blowing through Victory Road!
entries.translated:
Kamu adalah angin. Angin yang
lembut dan menenangkan yang\lberembus melalui Victory Road!

entries.original:
"Burning competitiveness and cool
logic\.

You’ll need both if you’re going to
go up against the Pokémon League."
entries.translation_source: Burning competitiveness and cool logic\. You’ll need both if you’re going to go up against the Pokémon League.
entries.translated:
Semangat bersaing yang membara dan
logika dingin\. Kamu akan membutuhkan\lkeduanya jika kamu akan melawan

Pokémon League.

entries.original:
