"A fighting style overflowing with
power or a strategy that excels\ltechnically\.

It depends on the Pokémon, see!"
entries.translation_source: A fighting style overflowing with power or a strategy that excels technically\. It depends on the Pokémon, see!
entries.translated:
Gaya bertarung yang melimpah dengan
kekuatan atau strategi yang unggul\lsecara teknis\. Tergantung pada

Pokémon-nya, lihat!

entries.original:
"All I want are powerful Pokémon!

Only a Pokémon that understands
that can become one of my partners!"
entries.translation_source: All I want are powerful Pokémon! Only a Pokémon that understands that can become one of my partners!
entries.translated:
Yang saya inginkan hanyalah Pokémon
yang kuat! Hanya Pokémon yang\lmengerti itu yang bisa menjadi

salah satu partner saya!

entries.original:
"I battle seriously because I am
after serious strength.

There’s nothing worse than a
halfhearted opponent."
entries.translation_source: I battle seriously because I am after serious strength. There’s nothing worse than a halfhearted opponent.
entries.translated:
Saya bertarung dengan serius karena
saya mengejar kekuatan yang serius.\lTidak ada yang lebih buruk dari

lawan yang setengah hati.

entries.original:
"Not wanting to admit my own limits,
I am continuing to battle on\.

That is right!
At least I am persistent!"
entries.translation_source: Not wanting to admit my own limits, I am continuing to battle on\. That is right! At least I am persistent!
entries.translated:
Tidak mau mengakui batas saya
sendiri, saya terus bertarung\.\lBenar! Setidaknya saya gigih!

entries.original:
"Your Pokémon was in a really good
mood the moment that you won!

However\.

Your mood will worsen as you see
what is on the other side of this\lentryway\."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon was in a really good mood the moment that you won! However\. Your mood will worsen as you see what is on the other side of this entryway\.
entries.translated:
Pokémon Anda dalam suasana hati
yang sangat baik saat Anda menang!\lNamun\. Suasana hati Anda akan

memburuk saat Anda melihat apa yang
ada di sisi lain dari pintu masuk\lini\.

entries.original: "[green]Haaahraaan!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Haaahraaan!
entries.translated: [green]Haaahraaan!

entries.original: "[green]Kawbraa!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Kawbraa!
entries.translated: [green]Kawbraa!

entries.original: "[green]Aeepraaa!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Aeepraaa!
entries.translated: [green]Aeepraaa!

entries.original: "[green]Gurooooohhh!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Gurooooohhh!
entries.translated: [green]Gurooooohhh!

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] ran off somewhere
close by."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] ran off somewhere close by.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] lari ke suatu tempat di
dekat sini.

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] ran off."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] ran off.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] melarikan diri.

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] faded away into a veil
of ice."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] faded away into a veil of ice.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] menghilang menjadi
selubung es.

entries.original:
"MOVE LIKE A
CLOCK. FINISH
IN THE CENTRE."
entries.translation_source: MOVE LIKE A CLOCK. FINISH IN THE CENTRE.
entries.translated:
BERGERAKLAH SEPERTI JAM. SELESAIKAN
DI TENGAH.

entries.original: "The tablet has been destroyed."
entries.translation_source: The tablet has been destroyed.
entries.translated: Tabletnya telah dihancurkan.

entries.original: "Ughhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: Ughhhhh\.
entries.translated: Ughhhhh\.

entries.original:
"People around here used to be
afraid to leave their homes because\lof some cloaked gang that invaded\lour town."
entries.translation_source: People around here used to be afraid to leave their homes because of some cloaked gang that invaded our town.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang di sini dulu takut
meninggalkan rumah mereka karena\lgeng berjubah yang menyerbu kota

kami.

entries.original:
"When the cloaked gang left town,
the sun started shining, and the\lflowers started blooming again!

I’m so happy, I want to share my
joy with you!"
entries.translation_source: When the cloaked gang left town, the sun started shining, and the flowers started blooming again! I’m so happy, I want to share my joy with you!
entries.translated:
Ketika geng berjubah itu
meninggalkan kota, matahari mulai\lbersinar, dan bunga-bunga mulai

mekar lagi! Aku sangat senang, aku
ingin berbagi kegembiraanku\ldenganmu!

entries.original:
"It still rains here every now and
again, but at least it’s never an\leternal rain like when that cloaked\lgang was here.

What did they do to get the weather
to act like that?"
entries.translation_source: It still rains here every now and again, but at least it’s never an eternal rain like when that cloaked gang was here. What did they do to get the weather to act like that?
entries.translated:
Di sini masih turun hujan sesekali,
tapi setidaknya tidak pernah hujan\labadi seperti saat geng berjubah

itu ada di sini. Apa yang mereka
lakukan agar cuaca menjadi seperti\litu?

entries.original:
"[player]’s Blue Orb suddenly
began glowing!"
entries.translation_source: [player]’s Blue Orb suddenly began glowing!
entries.translated:
[player]{B4}s Bola Biru tiba-tiba
mulai bersinar!

entries.original: "[green]Grrgggrrrrah!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Grrgggrrrrah!
entries.translated: [green]Grrgggrrrrah!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] swam deeper into the ocean."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] swam deeper into the ocean.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] berenang lebih dalam ke
lautan.

entries.original:
"Munch munch\.

You like chewing on seeds, pal?

Chew ’em hard enough, and you can
garner some explosive fire power!

I’d even be willing to teach a
Pokémon how to do this with\lthe move [green]Seed Bomb[blue] for a measly\l[green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Munch munch\. You like chewing on seeds, pal? Chew ’em hard enough, and you can garner some explosive fire power! I’d even be willing to teach a Pokémon how to do this with the move [green]Seed Bomb[blue] for a measly [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue].
entries.translated:
Kunyah kunyah\. Kamu suka mengunyah
biji, kawan? Kunyah cukup keras,\ldan kamu bisa mendapatkan kekuatan

api yang eksplosif! Aku bahkan
bersedia mengajari Pokémon cara\lmelakukannya dengan jurus [green]Bom Biji[blue]

hanya dengan [green][buffer2] [buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon wants to learn how
to shoot explosive seeds from their\lmouth with [green]Seed Bomb[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon wants to learn how to shoot explosive seeds from their mouth with [green]Seed Bomb[blue]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang ingin belajar
cara menembak biji eksplosif dari\lmulutnya dengan [green]Bom Biji[blue]?

entries.original: "Kaboom!"
entries.translation_source: Kaboom!
entries.translated: Kaboom!

entries.original:
"You can chew on seeds, but that’s
about all you can do with the\lamount of [green][buffer1]s[blue] you have\."
entries.translation_source: You can chew on seeds, but that’s about all you can do with the amount of [green][buffer1]s[blue] you have\.
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa mengunyah biji, tapi itu
saja yang bisa kamu lakukan dengan\ljumlah [green][buffer1][blue] yang kamu miliki\.

entries.original:
"I’m looking for the mushroom
Pokémon [green][buffer1][blue]!

But no matter where I look, all I
can find are [buffer2]!

Have you found a [green][buffer1][blue]?
Wanna trade for an [green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking for the mushroom Pokémon [green][buffer1][blue]! But no matter where I look, all I can find are [buffer2]! Have you found a [green][buffer1][blue]? Wanna trade for an [green][buffer2][blue]?
entries.translated:
Aku mencari Pokémon jamur [green][buffer1][blue]!
Tapi ke mana pun aku mencari, yang\lkudapat hanya [buffer2]! Apakah kamu

menemukan [green][buffer1][blue]? Mau bertukar
dengan [green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"I’m looking for the mushroom
Pokémon [green][buffer1][blue]!

But no matter where I look, all I
can find are [buffer2]!

Have you found an [green][buffer1][blue]?
Wanna trade for a [green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking for the mushroom Pokémon [green][buffer1][blue]! But no matter where I look, all I can find are [buffer2]! Have you found an [green][buffer1][blue]? Wanna trade for a [green][buffer2][blue]?
entries.translated:
Aku mencari Pokémon jamur [green][buffer1][blue]!
Tapi ke mana pun aku mencari, yang\lkudapat hanya [buffer2]! Apakah kamu

menemukan [green][buffer1][blue]? Mau bertukar
dengan [green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original: "No luck either, eh?"
entries.translation_source: No luck either, eh?
entries.translated: Tidak ada keberuntungan juga, ya?

entries.original:
"I’m looking for the mushroom
Pokémon [buffer1]!

Not that!"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking for the mushroom Pokémon [buffer1]! Not that!
entries.translated:
Aku mencari Pokémon jamur [buffer1]!
Bukan itu!

entries.original:
"Aww, sweet!
Fungus is now among you!"
entries.translation_source: Aww, sweet! Fungus is now among you!
entries.translated:
Aww, manis! Jamur kini ada di
antara kalian!

entries.original:
"Aww, sweet!
Fungus is now among us!"
entries.translation_source: Aww, sweet! Fungus is now among us!
entries.translated:
Aww, keren! Fungus sekarang ada di
antara kita!

entries.original:
"How do you like your new mushroom
Pokémon?

I know mushrooms are delicious,
but try to hold yourself back\lfrom eating it!"
entries.translation_source: How do you like your new mushroom Pokémon? I know mushrooms are delicious, but try to hold yourself back from eating it!
entries.translated:
Bagaimana pendapatmu tentang
Pokémon jamur barumu? Aku tahu\ljamur itu lezat, tapi cobalah

menahan diri untuk tidak
memakannya!

entries.original: "Trader Traitor"
entries.translation_source: Trader Traitor
entries.translated: Pedagang Pengkhianat

entries.original:
"My sister Mindy and I have
recently been engaged in a heated\ldebate on whether Pokémon are\lcompanions or property.

On one hand, they have feelings,
but on the other hand, they can be\ltraded or sold.

Can you help me make my point by
trading many Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: My sister Mindy and I have recently been engaged in a heated debate on whether Pokémon are companions or property. On one hand, they have feelings, but on the other hand, they can be traded or sold. Can you help me make my point by trading many Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Kakak perempuanku, Mindy, dan aku
baru-baru ini terlibat dalam\lperdebatan sengit tentang apakah

Pokémon adalah teman atau properti.
Di satu sisi, mereka punya\lperasaan, tapi di sisi lain, mereka

bisa diperdagangkan atau dijual.
Bisakah kamu membantu aku\lmemperkuat argumenku dengan

bertukar banyak Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Thank you.

To make my point, I will need you
to trade with every person in\lBorrius that is willing."
entries.translation_source: Thank you. To make my point, I will need you to trade with every person in Borrius that is willing.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih. Untuk memperkuat
argumenku, aku perlu kamu berdagang\ldengan setiap orang di Borrius yang

bersedia.

entries.original:
"Great work.

By trading Pokémon, you have
proven they are just property that\lcan be reduced to a series of\lnumbers and sent over a cable.

For helping me prove my point,
take this."
entries.translation_source: Great work. By trading Pokémon, you have proven they are just property that can be reduced to a series of numbers and sent over a cable. For helping me prove my point, take this.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus. Dengan memperdagangkan
Pokémon, kamu telah membuktikan\lbahwa mereka hanyalah properti yang

dapat direduksi menjadi serangkaian
angka dan dikirim melalui kabel.\lSebagai hadiah karena membantu

membuktikan argumenku, ambillah
ini.

entries.original:
"It looks like there are still
residents of Borrius that are\lwilling to trade.

Trade with all of them, and then
I’ll give you a nice reward."
entries.translation_source: It looks like there are still residents of Borrius that are willing to trade. Trade with all of them, and then I’ll give you a nice reward.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya masih ada penduduk
Borrius yang mau berdagang.\lBerdaganglah dengan mereka semua,

dan aku akan memberimu hadiah yang
bagus.

entries.original:
"So, you think Pokémon are just
companions, huh?

Well, I’m sure if someone offered
you a good enough trade you would\loblige them."
entries.translation_source: So, you think Pokémon are just companions, huh? Well, I’m sure if someone offered you a good enough trade you would oblige them.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu pikir Pokémon hanyalah
teman, ya? Yah, aku yakin jika\lseseorang menawarkan perdagangan

yang cukup baik, kamu akan
menyetujuinya.

entries.original:
"When you catch a Pokémon, it’s
yours to sell and trade as you\lplease."
entries.translation_source: When you catch a Pokémon, it’s yours to sell and trade as you please.
entries.translated:
Saat kamu menangkap Pokémon, itu
milikmu untuk dijual dan\ldiperdagangkan sesukamu.

entries.original:
"I’m very particular about the
[green][buffer1][blue] of Pokémon!

That’s why I’m wondering if you
have any Pokémon with a [green][buffer1][blue]\lof [green][buffer2][blue] or greater with you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m very particular about the [green][buffer1][blue] of Pokémon! That’s why I’m wondering if you have any Pokémon with a [green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue] or greater with you!
entries.translated:
Aku sangat memperhatikan [green][buffer1][blue]
Pokémon! Itulah mengapa aku\lbertanya-tanya apakah kamu memiliki

Pokémon dengan [green][buffer1][blue] [green][buffer2][blue]
atau lebih tinggi!

entries.original:
"Well, which of your Pokémon has a
[green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue] or greater?"
entries.translation_source: Well, which of your Pokémon has a [green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue] or greater?
entries.translated:
Nah, Pokémon mana yang memiliki
[green][buffer1][blue] [green][buffer2][blue] atau lebih\ltinggi?

entries.original:
"Your [buffer1] is [buffer2]!
Just like I like them!

That makes me really happy,
so I’ll give you this!"
entries.translation_source: Your [buffer1] is [buffer2]! Just like I like them! That makes me really happy, so I’ll give you this!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] milikmu adalah [buffer2]!
Sama seperti yang kusukai! Itu\lmembuatku sangat senang, jadi aku

akan memberimu ini!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry! There’s more to
Pokémon than [buffer1].

But, today, I’d sure like to see a
Pokémon with [green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue]\lor greater!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry! There’s more to Pokémon than [buffer1]. But, today, I’d sure like to see a Pokémon with [green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue] or greater!
entries.translated:
Jangan khawatir! Ada lebih banyak
hal tentang Pokémon selain\l[buffer1]. Tapi, hari ini, aku pasti

ingin melihat Pokémon dengan
[green][buffer1][blue] [green][buffer2][blue] atau lebih\ltinggi!

entries.original:
"That Pokémon’s [buffer1] isn’t
high enough!

Today, I’d sure like to see a
Pokémon with [green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue]\lor greater!"
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon’s [buffer1] isn’t high enough! Today, I’d sure like to see a Pokémon with [green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue] or greater!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] Pokémon itu tidak cukup
tinggi! Hari ini, aku pasti ingin\lmelihat Pokémon dengan [green][buffer1][blue]

[green][buffer2][blue] atau lebih tinggi!

entries.original:
"There are many different Pokémon
with many different stats!

If you’d like, please come visit me
again tomorrow, okay?"
entries.translation_source: There are many different Pokémon with many different stats! If you’d like, please come visit me again tomorrow, okay?
entries.translated:
Ada banyak Pokémon berbeda dengan
berbagai stat! Jika kamu mau,\lsilakan datang mengunjungiku lagi

besok, oke?

entries.original:
"My brother caught his Pokémon by
talking to a Poké Ball hidden\lunder a tree top in Vivill Woods.

Different Trainers encounter
different Pokémon by doing that,\lI’ve heard."
entries.translation_source: My brother caught his Pokémon by talking to a Poké Ball hidden under a tree top in Vivill Woods. Different Trainers encounter different Pokémon by doing that, I’ve heard.
entries.translated:
Kakak laki-lakiku menangkap
Pokémonnya dengan berbicara ke Poké\lBall yang tersembunyi di bawah

puncak pohon di Hutan Vivill.
Berbagai Pelatih menemukan Pokémon\lyang berbeda dengan melakukan itu,

aku dengar.

entries.original:
"Ever since the warehouse on the
hill was abandoned by the cloaked\lgang, I’ve heard a sad cry\lemanating from deep beneath the\locean waves.

It almost sounds prehistoric\."
entries.translation_source: Ever since the warehouse on the hill was abandoned by the cloaked gang, I’ve heard a sad cry emanating from deep beneath the ocean waves. It almost sounds prehistoric\.
entries.translated:
Sejak gudang di bukit itu
ditinggalkan oleh geng berjubah,\laku mendengar tangisan sedih yang

berasal dari jauh di bawah ombak
lautan. Kedengarannya hampir\lseperti prasejarah\.

entries.original:
"The sad cry I was hearing from the
warehouse has stopped.

I wonder, was the cry of a Pokémon
who was taken from its home by\lthe cloaked gang?

I suppose we will never know for
sure, now."
entries.translation_source: The sad cry I was hearing from the warehouse has stopped. I wonder, was the cry of a Pokémon who was taken from its home by the cloaked gang? I suppose we will never know for sure, now.
entries.translated:
Tangisan sedih yang kudengar dari
gudang telah berhenti. Aku\lbertanya-tanya, apakah tangisan itu

berasal dari Pokémon yang diambil
dari rumahnya oleh geng berjubah?\lAku rasa kita tidak akan pernah

tahu pasti, sekarang.

entries.original:
"When those strange thugs marched
into town not too long ago, we were\lall sure to lock our doors quickly.

If we hadn’t, I bet they would have
barged in here just like you and\ltaken all our valuables for\lwhatever their nefarious plot was."
entries.translation_source: When those strange thugs marched into town not too long ago, we were all sure to lock our doors quickly. If we hadn’t, I bet they would have barged in here just like you and taken all our valuables for whatever their nefarious plot was.
entries.translated:
Saat preman-preman aneh itu masuk
ke kota belum lama ini, kami semua\lpasti mengunci pintu dengan cepat.

Jika tidak, aku yakin mereka akan
masuk ke sini seperti dirimu dan\lmengambil semua barang berharga

kami untuk rencana jahat mereka apa
pun itu.

entries.original:
"[black]Yowch!
That’s hot!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Yowch! That’s hot!
entries.translated: [black]Aduh! Itu panas!

entries.original:
"[blue]How could you betray us,
Billy?

The Shadows made you into the man
you are!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]How could you betray us, Billy? The Shadows made you into the man you are!
entries.translated:
[blue]Bagaimana kau bisa mengkhianati
kami, Billy? Bayangan telah\lmembuatmu menjadi pria sepertimu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Me!?

You’re the one who betrayed us!

We got paid to follow orders,
not ask questions, Ronald!

And since Aklove’s our new leader,
you should be on our side!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Me!? You’re the one who betrayed us! We got paid to follow orders, not ask questions, Ronald! And since Aklove’s our new leader, you should be on our side!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku!? Kaulah yang mengkhianati
kami! Kami dibayar untuk mengikuti\lperintah, bukan bertanya, Ronald!

Dan karena Aklove adalah pemimpin
baru kami, kau seharusnya berada di\lpihak kami!

entries.original:
"[red]Just join us!

What’s the point in still working
for Zeph?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Just join us! What’s the point in still working for Zeph?
entries.translated:
[red]Bergabunglah dengan kami! Apa
gunanya masih bekerja untuk Zeph?

entries.original:
"[red]He hired me himself!

I don’t care what the Science Society
tells you to do\.

I’m sticking with him!"
entries.translation_source: [red]He hired me himself! I don’t care what the Science Society tells you to do\. I’m sticking with him!
entries.translated:
[red]Dia sendiri yang mempekerjakanku!
Aku tidak peduli apa yang dikatakan\lPerkumpulan Sains padamu untuk

dilakukan\. Aku akan tetap
bersamanya!

entries.original:
"It’s dangerous for a little Trainer
to be wandering around right now.

Don’t you know?

Those creatures roaming around lash
out at anything they see."
entries.translation_source: It’s dangerous for a little Trainer to be wandering around right now. Don’t you know? Those creatures roaming around lash out at anything they see.
entries.translated:
Berbahaya bagi seorang Trainer
kecil untuk berkeliaran saat ini.\lTidak tahukah kau? Makhluk-makhluk

yang berkeliaran itu menyerang apa
pun yang mereka lihat.

entries.original: "Floette"
entries.translation_source: Floette
entries.translated: Floette

entries.original: "Floette! Use Dazzle Gleam!"
entries.translation_source: Floette! Use Dazzle Gleam!
entries.translated:
Floette! Gunakan Pancaran
Menyilaukan!

entries.original: "[blue]Flo!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Flo!
entries.translated: [blue]Flo!

entries.original: "[lightgreen]Flo!"
entries.translation_source: [lightgreen]Flo!
entries.translated: [lightgreen]Flo!

entries.original: "[orange]Flo!"
entries.translation_source: [orange]Flo!
entries.translated: [orange]Flo!

entries.original:
"[black]The Shadow Warrior is currently in
battle with a Floette.

Remove its cloak?"
entries.translation_source: [black]The Shadow Warrior is currently in battle with a Floette. Remove its cloak?
entries.translated:
[black]Prajurit Bayangan saat ini sedang
bertarung dengan Floette. Lepaskan\ljubahnya?

entries.original: "[black][player] tugged on the cloak."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] tugged on the cloak.
entries.translated: [black][player] menarik jubahnya.

entries.original: "[black]The Shadow Warrior is furious!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The Shadow Warrior is furious!
entries.translated: [black]Prajurit Bayangan sangat marah!

entries.original:
"If I can’t beat you, there’s no way
I could beat a Shadow Warrior!

But maybe our Admin could\.

If only I could get to her\.

Unfortunately, I only know that one
of the letters of the Command\lCentre’s password is [green]A[blue].

I’ll need more than that to get
in there, though."
entries.translation_source: If I can’t beat you, there’s no way I could beat a Shadow Warrior! But maybe our Admin could\. If only I could get to her\. Unfortunately, I only know that one of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [green]A[blue]. I’ll need more than that to get in there, though.
entries.translated:
Jika aku tidak bisa mengalahkanmu,
tidak mungkin aku bisa mengalahkan\lPrajurit Bayangan! Tapi mungkin

Admin kami bisa\. Andai saja aku bisa
menemuinya\. Sayangnya, aku hanya\ltahu bahwa salah satu huruf dari

kata sandi Pusat Komando adalah [green]A[blue].
Tapi aku butuh lebih dari itu untuk\lbisa masuk ke sana.

entries.original:
"If I can’t beat you, there’s no way
I could beat a Shadow Warrior!

But maybe our Admin could\.

If only I could get to her\.

Unfortunately, I only know that the
Command Centre’s password starts\lwith [green]A[blue].

I’ll need more than that to get
in there, though."
entries.translation_source: If I can’t beat you, there’s no way I could beat a Shadow Warrior! But maybe our Admin could\. If only I could get to her\. Unfortunately, I only know that the Command Centre’s password starts with [green]A[blue]. I’ll need more than that to get in there, though.
entries.translated:
Jika aku tidak bisa mengalahkanmu,
tidak mungkin aku bisa mengalahkan\lPrajurit Bayangan! Tapi mungkin

Admin kami bisa\. Andai saja aku bisa
menemuinya\. Sayangnya, aku hanya\ltahu bahwa kata sandi Pusat Komando

diawali dengan [green]A[blue]. Tapi aku butuh
lebih dari itu untuk bisa masuk ke\lsana.

entries.original:
"[blue]I just saw you tug on that Shadow
Warrior’s cloak!

The only way you could know they’re
weak to light is if you’re in\lleague with the traitor Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]I just saw you tug on that Shadow Warrior’s cloak! The only way you could know they’re weak to light is if you’re in league with the traitor Shadows!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku baru saja melihatmu menarik
jubah Prajurit Bayangan itu!\lSatu-satunya cara kau tahu mereka

lemah terhadap cahaya adalah jika
kau bersekutu dengan Bayangan\lpengkhianat!

entries.original:
"[blue]And if you’re in league with the
Shadows, then I must defeat you!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]And if you’re in league with the Shadows, then I must defeat you!
entries.translated:
[blue]Dan jika kau bersekutu dengan
Bayangan, maka aku harus\lmengalahkanmu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Why don’t you do what you came to
do then, huh?

Go fight our Admin, but just leave
the rest of us alone!

One of the letters for the password
to the Command Centre is [green]K[blue]!

That’s where she is, so go!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Why don’t you do what you came to do then, huh? Go fight our Admin, but just leave the rest of us alone! One of the letters for the password to the Command Centre is [green]K[blue]! That’s where she is, so go!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kenapa tidak kau lakukan apa yang
kau datang untuk lakukan, ya? Pergi\llawan Admin kami, tapi biarkan kami

yang lain sendiri! Salah satu huruf
kata sandi untuk Pusat Komando\ladalah [green]K[blue]! Di situlah dia berada,

jadi pergilah!

entries.original:
"[red]You’re one of them, aren’t you?

You came to attack our base!"
entries.translation_source: [red]You’re one of them, aren’t you? You came to attack our base!
entries.translated:
[red]Kau salah satu dari mereka, bukan?
Kau datang untuk menyerang markas\lkami!

entries.original: "[red]I won’t let you destroy it!"
entries.translation_source: [red]I won’t let you destroy it!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu
menghancurkannya!

entries.original:
"[red]Fine! I’ll tell you one of the
letters of the Command Centre’s\lpassword!

One of the letters is [green]L[red]!

Just please, stop attacking
our base!

If you refuse to leave, then at
least leave the power grid alone!

If it goes down, we’ll all be
trapped forever\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Fine! I’ll tell you one of the letters of the Command Centre’s password! One of the letters is [green]L[red]! Just please, stop attacking our base! If you refuse to leave, then at least leave the power grid alone! If it goes down, we’ll all be trapped forever\.
entries.translated:
[red]Baik! Aku akan memberitahumu salah
satu huruf dari kata sandi Pusat\lKomando! Salah satu hurufnya adalah

[green]L[red]! Tolong, hentikan serangan ke
basis kami! Jika kamu menolak\lpergi, setidaknya biarkan jaringan

listrik saja! Jika mati, kita semua
akan terjebak selamanya\.

entries.original:
"Oh!

You just saved me from that
Shadow Warrior!

How did you know how to do that?"
entries.translation_source: Oh! You just saved me from that Shadow Warrior! How did you know how to do that?
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu baru saja menyelamatkanku
dari Shadow Warrior itu! Bagaimana\lkamu tahu cara melakukannya?

entries.original:
"Oh, you must be with the Shadows.

But it’s alright, I won’t attack
you.

You can’t be all bad if you got
rid of one of your own.

Besides, I’m grateful for your
help."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you must be with the Shadows. But it’s alright, I won’t attack you. You can’t be all bad if you got rid of one of your own. Besides, I’m grateful for your help.
entries.translated:
Oh, pasti kamu bersama Shadows.
Tapi tidak apa-apa, aku tidak akan\lmenyerangmu. Kamu tidak mungkin

jahat total jika menyingkirkan
salah satu dari mereka. Lagipula,\laku berterima kasih atas bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"I assume you’re trying to reach our
Admin in the Command Centre?

I can’t help much with that, but I
can at least let you know that one\lof the letters of the Command\lCentre’s password is [green]O[red].

If you need anything else from me,
please feel free to ask."
entries.translation_source: I assume you’re trying to reach our Admin in the Command Centre? I can’t help much with that, but I can at least let you know that one of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [green]O[red]. If you need anything else from me, please feel free to ask.
entries.translated:
Kurasa kamu mencoba menemui Admin
kami di Pusat Komando? Aku tidak\lbisa banyak membantu, tapi

setidaknya aku bisa memberitahumu
bahwa salah satu huruf dari kata\lsandi Pusat Komando adalah [green]O[red]. Jika

kamu butuh hal lain dariku, silakan
tanya saja.

entries.original:
"If you need anything from me,
please feel free to ask."
entries.translation_source: If you need anything from me, please feel free to ask.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu butuh sesuatu dariku,
silakan tanya saja.

entries.original:
"Sure, I can heal your Pokémon.

Please lie down on one of these
beds, first."
entries.translation_source: Sure, I can heal your Pokémon. Please lie down on one of these beds, first.
entries.translated:
Tentu, aku bisa menyembuhkan
Pokémonmu. Silakan berbaring di\lsalah satu tempat tidur ini

terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Did your Pokémon get hurt?

Please, lie down on one of these
beds so I can heal them."
entries.translation_source: Did your Pokémon get hurt? Please, lie down on one of these beds so I can heal them.
entries.translated:
Apakah Pokémonmu terluka? Silakan
berbaring di salah satu tempat\ltidur ini agar aku bisa

menyembuhkan mereka.

entries.original:
"All set!

You and your Pokémon are
all rested up."
entries.translation_source: All set! You and your Pokémon are all rested up.
entries.translated:
Selesai! Kamu dan Pokémonmu sudah
beristirahat penuh.

entries.original:
"Oh, did you forget which letter
I gave you?

One of the letters of the Command
Centre’s password is [green]O[red]."
entries.translation_source: Oh, did you forget which letter I gave you? One of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [green]O[red].
entries.translated:
Oh, apakah kamu lupa huruf mana
yang aku berikan? Salah satu huruf\ldari kata sandi Pusat Komando

adalah [green]O[red].

entries.original:
"The base is split into eight
different sections.

The main areas are the Power Grid,
Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room,\land Research Lab.

Other smaller areas include the
storage areas, the living spaces,\land the Command Centre.

The living spaces and the Command
Centre can only be accessed via\lthe Research Lab.

But with the Research Lab now
underwater, the living spaces, as\lwell as some storage areas have\lbeen completely cut off.

However, for some reason, the
Command Centre is still accessible."
entries.translation_source: The base is split into eight different sections. The main areas are the Power Grid, Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room, and Research Lab. Other smaller areas include the storage areas, the living spaces, and the Command Centre. The living spaces and the Command Centre can only be accessed via the Research Lab. But with the Research Lab now underwater, the living spaces, as well as some storage areas have been completely cut off. However, for some reason, the Command Centre is still accessible.
entries.translated:
Basis ini terbagi menjadi delapan
bagian berbeda. Area utamanya\ladalah Jaringan Listrik, Ruang

Istirahat, Kafetaria, Ruang Santai,
dan Laboratorium Penelitian. Area\llebih kecil lainnya termasuk area

penyimpanan, ruang hunian, dan
Pusat Komando. Ruang hunian dan\lPusat Komando hanya bisa diakses

melalui Laboratorium Penelitian.
Namun dengan Laboratorium\lPenelitian sekarang terendam air,

ruang hunian dan beberapa area
penyimpanan telah terputus total.\lNamun, untuk beberapa alasan, Pusat

Komando masih dapat diakses.

entries.original: "Heal Pokémon"
entries.translation_source: Heal Pokémon
entries.translated: Sembuhkan Pokémon

entries.original: "Password"
entries.translation_source: Password
entries.translated: Kata Sandi

entries.original:
"Oh, non, non, non!

If ze Shadow Warrior gets to ze
food, it’s all over for my belly!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, non, non, non! If ze Shadow Warrior gets to ze food, it’s all over for my belly!
entries.translated:
Oh, non, non, non! Jika si Shadow
Warrior sampai ke makanan, perutku\lhancur!

entries.original:
"When I was a chef for ze Shadows,
they made me feed every single one\lof ze Shadow Warriors.

Zey have quite the appetite!

Who knew undead creatures needed
so much energy to survive?"
entries.translation_source: When I was a chef for ze Shadows, they made me feed every single one of ze Shadow Warriors. Zey have quite the appetite! Who knew undead creatures needed so much energy to survive?
entries.translated:
Saat aku menjadi koki untuk para
Shadows, mereka menyuruhku memberi\lmakan setiap Shadow Warrior. Mereka

punya nafsu makan yang besar! Siapa
sangka makhluk undead butuh begitu\lbanyak energi untuk bertahan hidup?

entries.original:
"This warehouse used to be our
Science Society headquarters\lbefore we moved out east.

So naturally, only we know how to
maintain the power grid.

If it were to go offline, all of
the warp panels would stop working."
entries.translation_source: This warehouse used to be our Science Society headquarters before we moved out east. So naturally, only we know how to maintain the power grid. If it were to go offline, all of the warp panels would stop working.
entries.translated:
Gudang ini dulunya adalah markas
Perkumpulan Sains kami sebelum kami\lpindah ke timur. Jadi wajar saja,

hanya kami yang tahu cara merawat
jaringan listrik. Jika mati, semua\lpanel warp akan berhenti bekerja.

entries.original:
"I just don’t understand!

I thought we ended the Shadow
Warrior project when we became\lthe Light of Ruin!

We achieved our Chief Scientist’s
goal and everything!

So why\.\CC0820 why are there more of
them!?"
entries.translation_source: I just don’t understand! I thought we ended the Shadow Warrior project when we became the Light of Ruin! We achieved our Chief Scientist’s goal and everything! So why\.\CC0820 why are there more of them!?
entries.translated:
Aku tidak mengerti! Kupikir kita
sudah menghentikan proyek Shadow\lWarrior saat kita menjadi Light of

Ruin! Kita sudah mencapai tujuan
Kepala Ilmuwan kita dan semuanya!\lLalu kenapa\.\CC0820 kenapa masih ada lebih

banyak dari mereka!?

entries.original:
"If you’re looking for our Admin,
she’s in the [green]Command Centre[blue].

You can get there by taking the
warp panel in the [green]Research Lab[blue]."
entries.translation_source: If you’re looking for our Admin, she’s in the [green]Command Centre[blue]. You can get there by taking the warp panel in the [green]Research Lab[blue].
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mencari Admin kami, dia
ada di [green]Pusat Komando[blue]. Kamu bisa\lsampai di sana dengan menggunakan

panel warp di [green]Laboratorium
Penelitian[blue].

entries.original: "No\.\CC0818 get away from me!"
entries.translation_source: No\.\CC0818 get away from me!
entries.translated: Tidak\.\CC0818 menjauh dariku!

entries.original:
"You! This is your fault!

If you and your friend hadn’t wiped
out my Granbull, I’d be able to\ldefend myself!"
entries.translation_source: You! This is your fault! If you and your friend hadn’t wiped out my Granbull, I’d be able to defend myself!
entries.translated:
Kamu! Ini salahmu! Jika kamu dan
temanmu tidak mengalahkan\lGranbullku, aku pasti bisa membela

diri!

entries.original:
"Serves you right.

But I guess I do actually owe you
and your friend.

If he hadn’t knocked me out
earlier, I could’ve been attacked\llike all those other grunts\."
entries.translation_source: Serves you right. But I guess I do actually owe you and your friend. If he hadn’t knocked me out earlier, I could’ve been attacked like all those other grunts\.
entries.translated:
Pantas saja. Tapi kurasa aku memang
berhutang budi padamu dan temanmu.\lJika dia tidak membuatku pingsan

tadi, aku bisa saja diserang
seperti semua preman lainnya\.

entries.original:
"I don’t know much, but I can tell
you that one of the letters of\lthe Command Centre’s password is [green]V[blue].

Now we’re even."
entries.translation_source: I don’t know much, but I can tell you that one of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [green]V[blue]. Now we’re even.
entries.translated:
Saya tidak tahu banyak, tapi saya
bisa memberitahu Anda bahwa salah\lsatu huruf dari kata sandi Command

Centre adalah [green]V[blue]. Sekarang kita
imbang.

entries.original:
"[player], I’m glad you followed
through and made it out here.

Keep an eye out for the new Shadow
Warriors we sent to keep the Light\lof Ruin distracted.

They’ll attack you on the spot if
you’re not careful.

But don’t feel bad about taking
any out.

We did promise your father we’d
destroy them eventually."
entries.translation_source: [player], I’m glad you followed through and made it out here. Keep an eye out for the new Shadow Warriors we sent to keep the Light of Ruin distracted. They’ll attack you on the spot if you’re not careful. But don’t feel bad about taking any out. We did promise your father we’d destroy them eventually.
entries.translated:
[player], Saya senang Anda
menindaklanjuti dan berhasil sampai\lke sini. Waspadalah terhadap Shadow

Warriors baru yang kami kirim untuk
mengalihkan perhatian Light of\lRuin. Mereka akan menyerang Anda di

tempat jika Anda tidak
berhati-hati. Tapi jangan merasa\lbersalah jika mengalahkan mereka.

Kami sudah berjanji pada ayah Anda
untuk menghancurkan mereka pada\lakhirnya.

entries.original:
"Get that door open, scientist!

I’m not paying you to just
stand around!"
entries.translation_source: Get that door open, scientist! I’m not paying you to just stand around!
entries.translated:
Buka pintu itu, ilmuwan! Saya tidak
membayar Anda untuk hanya berdiri\lsaja!

entries.original:
"So, you made it after all, [buffer1].

If you’re here to help, assist that
scientist with opening the door.

At least one of [green]Aklove[blue]’s cronies
must know the password."
entries.translation_source: So, you made it after all, [buffer1]. If you’re here to help, assist that scientist with opening the door. At least one of [green]Aklove[blue]’s cronies must know the password.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu berhasil juga, [buffer1].
Jika kamu di sini untuk membantu,\lbantu ilmuwan itu membuka pintu.

Setidaknya salah satu antek [green]Aklove[blue]
pasti tahu kata sandinya.

entries.original:
"[black]The Shadow Warrior is standing
motionless."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Shadow Warrior is standing motionless.
entries.translated:
[black]Shadow Warrior berdiri tanpa
bergerak.

entries.original: "[green]Meep!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Meep!
entries.translated: [green]Meep!

entries.original: "[green]Owowow!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Owowow!
entries.translated: [green]Owowow!

entries.original: "[green]Prass!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Prass!
entries.translated: [green]Prass!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] scurried off into
the forest."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] scurried off into the forest.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] berlari cepat ke dalam
hutan.

entries.original:
"I came from Vivill Town.

For some reason, it has been
raining a lot lately."
entries.translation_source: I came from Vivill Town. For some reason, it has been raining a lot lately.
entries.translated:
Saya datang dari Vivill Town. Untuk
beberapa alasan, akhir-akhir ini\lsering hujan.

entries.original: "How do I get out of here?"
entries.translation_source: How do I get out of here?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana cara saya keluar dari
sini?

entries.original:
"Both Pokémon and items can be found
in the mushrooms on the ground."
entries.translation_source: Both Pokémon and items can be found in the mushrooms on the ground.
entries.translated:
Baik Pokémon maupun item dapat
ditemukan di jamur di tanah.

entries.original:
"Why are there no Ghost Pokémon
in these woods?"
entries.translation_source: Why are there no Ghost Pokémon in these woods?
entries.translated:
Kenapa tidak ada Pokémon Hantu di
hutan ini?

entries.original:
"I thought I had the ultimate
swarm\."
entries.translation_source: I thought I had the ultimate swarm\.
entries.translated:
Saya pikir saya memiliki gerombolan
terhebat\.

entries.original: "The Powerhouse of the Cell"
entries.translation_source: The Powerhouse of the Cell
entries.translated: Pembangkit Tenaga Sel

entries.original:
"Thank you for coming with me.

\.

What’s that?

It’s not like you really had a
choice?

Such nonsense.

I don’t know what you’re talking
about.

Let’s get down to business."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for coming with me. \. What’s that? It’s not like you really had a choice? Such nonsense. I don’t know what you’re talking about. Let’s get down to business.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah datang
bersamaku. \. Apa itu? Bukannya kau\lbenar-benar punya pilihan? Omong

kosong. Aku tidak tahu apa yang kau
bicarakan. Mari kita mulai bekerja.

entries.original:
"[red]Recently, pieces of a Pokémon known
as Zygarde have been appearing all\lover Borrius.

However, these pieces can only be
seen if you have a Super Cube with\la special component installed."
entries.translation_source: [red]Recently, pieces of a Pokémon known as Zygarde have been appearing all over Borrius. However, these pieces can only be seen if you have a Super Cube with a special component installed.
entries.translated:
[red]Akhir-akhir ini, potongan-potongan
dari Pokémon yang dikenal sebagai\lZygarde telah muncul di seluruh

Borrius. Namun, potongan-potongan
ini hanya bisa dilihat jika Anda\lmemiliki Super Cube dengan komponen

khusus terpasang.

entries.original:
"Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos
that appears when the ecosystem is\lin danger.

Why it’s appearing here and now
is a mystery to us.

We’re trying to find the answer to
this, but we need someone to go\land collect all of the individual\l\qocells\qc and \qocores\qc of Zygarde."
entries.translation_source: Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos that appears when the ecosystem is in danger. Why it’s appearing here and now is a mystery to us. We’re trying to find the answer to this, but we need someone to go and collect all of the individual \qocells\qc and \qocores\qc of Zygarde.
entries.translated:
Zygarde adalah Pokémon dari Kalos
yang muncul ketika ekosistem dalam\lbahaya. Mengapa ia muncul di sini

dan sekarang adalah misteri bagi
kami. Kami sedang mencoba mencari\ljawabannya, tetapi kami membutuhkan

seseorang untuk pergi dan
mengumpulkan semua \qosel\qc dan \qointi\qc\lZygarde.

entries.original:
"[red]Do you think you’d be able to help
us with our research?

We need a Trainer who plans on
travelling to several different\llocations within Borrius."
entries.translation_source: [red]Do you think you’d be able to help us with our research? We need a Trainer who plans on travelling to several different locations within Borrius.
entries.translated:
[red]Apakah Anda pikir Anda bisa
membantu kami dengan penelitian\lkami? Kami membutuhkan seorang

Pelatih yang berencana untuk
bepergian ke beberapa lokasi\lberbeda di dalam Borrius.

entries.original:
"[red]That’s a shame, but we can’t force
you to do it, unfortunately."
entries.translation_source: [red]That’s a shame, but we can’t force you to do it, unfortunately.
entries.translated:
[red]Sayang sekali, tapi kami tidak bisa
memaksa Anda untuk melakukannya,\lsayangnya.

entries.original:
"Great!

Thank you for agreeing to help!

If you could please give me your
Cube for a second\.

\.

Okay!

Your Super Cube has been updated to
allow you to see and collect the\lZygarde Cells that litter both West\land East Borrius.

Once you’ve collected at least [green]10[blue]
percent, please come see my wife.

For now, good luck!"
entries.translation_source: Great! Thank you for agreeing to help! If you could please give me your Cube for a second\. \. Okay! Your Super Cube has been updated to allow you to see and collect the Zygarde Cells that litter both West and East Borrius. Once you’ve collected at least [green]10[blue] percent, please come see my wife. For now, good luck!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Terima kasih telah setuju
membantu! Jika Anda bisa memberikan\lCube Anda sebentar\. \. Oke! Super Cube

Anda telah diperbarui sehingga Anda
bisa melihat dan mengumpulkan Sel\lZygarde yang tersebar di Borrius

Barat dan Timur. Setelah Anda
mengumpulkan setidaknya [green]10[blue] persen,\lsilakan temui istri saya. Untuk

sekarang, semoga berhasil!

entries.original: "Zygfried"
entries.translation_source: Zygfried
entries.translated: Zygfried

entries.original:
"A Trainer!

Thank you so much for coming to
our home!

My name is Zygfried.

My wife, Zygardia, and I would like
to discuss something very important."
entries.translation_source: A Trainer! Thank you so much for coming to our home! My name is Zygfried. My wife, Zygardia, and I would like to discuss something very important.
entries.translated:
Seorang Pelatih! Terima kasih
banyak telah datang ke rumah kami!\lNama saya Zygfried. Istri saya,

Zygardia, dan saya ingin
membicarakan sesuatu yang sangat\lpenting.

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
[green]10[blue] percent of the cells, please\lreport back to my wife."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least [green]10[blue] percent of the cells, please report back to my wife.
entries.translated:
Saat Anda telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya [green]10[blue] persen dari sel-sel\ltersebut, silakan laporkan kembali

kepada istri saya.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least [green]10[blue] percent of the cells.

Good work!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my wife."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least [green]10[blue] percent of the cells. Good work! If you haven’t already, please talk to my wife.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya [green]10[blue] persen dari sel-sel\ltersebut. Kerja bagus! Jika Anda

belum melakukannya, silakan bicara
dengan istri saya.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least [green]50[blue] percent of the cells.

You’re half way there!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my wife."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least [green]50[blue] percent of the cells. You’re half way there! If you haven’t already, please talk to my wife.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya [green]50[blue] persen dari sel-sel\ltersebut. Anda sudah setengah

jalan! Jika Anda belum
melakukannya, silakan bicara dengan\listri saya.

entries.original:
"You’ve collected all of the cells!

This is a major help to our
research!

Thank you so much!

Please speak to my wife to assemble
your permanent Zygarde."
entries.translation_source: You’ve collected all of the cells! This is a major help to our research! Thank you so much! Please speak to my wife to assemble your permanent Zygarde.
entries.translated:
Anda telah mengumpulkan semua sel!
Ini sangat membantu penelitian\lkami! Terima kasih banyak! Silakan

bicara dengan istri saya untuk
merakit Zygarde permanen Anda.

entries.original:
"Now that you have a permanent
Zygarde, I can teach it special\lmoves or even change its Ability!

What would you like to do?"
entries.translation_source: Now that you have a permanent Zygarde, I can teach it special moves or even change its Ability! What would you like to do?
entries.translated:
Sekarang setelah Anda memiliki
Zygarde permanen, saya bisa\lmengajarinya jurus spesial atau

bahkan mengubah Ability-nya! Apa
yang ingin Anda lakukan?

entries.original: "What would you like to do?"
entries.translation_source: What would you like to do?
entries.translated: Apa yang ingin Anda lakukan?

entries.original:
"Oh, you’re happy as is?

If you’d ever like to add
enhancements to your Zygarde,\lplease let me know!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you’re happy as is? If you’d ever like to add enhancements to your Zygarde, please let me know!
entries.translated:
Oh, Anda puas dengan yang sekarang?
Jika suatu saat Anda ingin\lmenambahkan peningkatan pada

Zygarde Anda, beri tahu saya!

entries.original:
"If you’d ever like to add more
enhancements to your Zygarde,\lplease let me know!"
entries.translation_source: If you’d ever like to add more enhancements to your Zygarde, please let me know!
entries.translated:
Jika suatu saat Anda ingin
menambahkan lebih banyak\lpeningkatan pada Zygarde Anda, beri

tahu saya!

entries.original: "Which move should I teach?"
entries.translation_source: Which move should I teach?
entries.translated: Jurus mana yang harus saya ajarkan?

entries.original: "Which Zygarde should I teach it to?"
entries.translation_source: Which Zygarde should I teach it to?
entries.translated: Zygarde mana yang harus saya ajari?

entries.original:
"Which Zygarde’s Ability should
I change?"
entries.translation_source: Which Zygarde’s Ability should I change?
entries.translated:
Ability Zygarde mana yang harus
saya ubah?

entries.original:
"Should I change [green][buffer1][blue]’s
Ability to [green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Should I change [green][buffer1][blue]’s Ability to [green][buffer2][blue]?
entries.translated:
Haruskah saya mengubah Ability
[green][buffer1][blue] menjadi [green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original: "That Pokémon’s not a Zygarde\."
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon’s not a Zygarde\.
entries.translated: Pokémon itu bukan Zygarde\.

entries.original: "That’s an Egg, not a Zygarde!"
entries.translation_source: That’s an Egg, not a Zygarde!
entries.translated: Itu Telur, bukan Zygarde!

entries.original:
"Done! [buffer1]’s Ability has
changed to [buffer2].

If you’d ever like to add more
enhancements to your Zygarde,\lplease let me know!"
entries.translation_source: Done! [buffer1]’s Ability has changed to [buffer2]. If you’d ever like to add more enhancements to your Zygarde, please let me know!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Ability [buffer1] telah
berubah menjadi [buffer2]. Jika\lsuatu saat Anda ingin menambahkan

lebih banyak peningkatan pada
Zygarde Anda, beri tahu saya!

entries.original: "Teach Zygarde Moves"
entries.translation_source: Teach Zygarde Moves
entries.translated: Ajarkan Jurus Zygarde

entries.original: "Change Zygarde Ability"
entries.translation_source: Change Zygarde Ability
entries.translated: Ubah Ability Zygarde

entries.original: "1000 Arrows"
entries.translation_source: 1000 Arrows
entries.translated: 1000 Arrows

entries.original: "1000 Waves"
entries.translation_source: 1000 Waves
entries.translated: 1000 Waves

entries.original: "Core Enforce"
entries.translation_source: Core Enforce
entries.translated: Core Enforce

entries.original: "Zygardia"
entries.translation_source: Zygardia
entries.translated: Zygardia

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

There have been numerous reports of
cells being spotted, lately\.

What could this mean\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm\. There have been numerous reports of cells being spotted, lately\. What could this mean\.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Ada banyak laporan tentang
sel-sel yang terlihat akhir-akhir\lini\. Apa artinya ini\.

entries.original:
"Please report back to me when
you’ve collected at least\l[green]10[red] percent of the cells."
entries.translation_source: Please report back to me when you’ve collected at least [green]10[red] percent of the cells.
entries.translated:
Tolong laporkan kembali kepada saya
ketika Anda telah mengumpulkan\lsetidaknya [green]10[red] persen dari sel-sel

tersebut.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected
[green][buffer1][red] cells so far.

Would you like to assemble these
cells into a [green]temporary[red] construct?"
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected [green][buffer1][red] cells so far. Would you like to assemble these cells into a [green]temporary[red] construct?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda telah mengumpulkan
[green][buffer1][red] sel sejauh ini. Apakah\lAnda ingin merakit sel-sel ini

menjadi konstruksi [green]sementara[red]?

entries.original:
"You’ve collected all of the
Zygarde cells!

Amazing!

Would you like to assemble these
cells into a [green]permanent[red] construct?"
entries.translation_source: You’ve collected all of the Zygarde cells! Amazing! Would you like to assemble these cells into a [green]permanent[red] construct?
entries.translated:
Anda telah mengumpulkan semua sel
Zygarde! Luar biasa! Apakah Anda\lingin merakit sel-sel ini menjadi

konstruksi [green]permanen[red]?

entries.original:
"Would you like to disassemble your
temporary Zygarde construct?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to disassemble your temporary Zygarde construct?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda ingin membongkar
konstruksi Zygarde sementara Anda?

entries.original:
"I can only assemble the cells if
you have space for it.

Come back once you’ve made space."
entries.translation_source: I can only assemble the cells if you have space for it. Come back once you’ve made space.
entries.translated:
Saya hanya dapat merakit sel-sel
tersebut jika Anda memiliki ruang\luntuknya. Kembalilah setelah Anda

membuat ruang.

entries.original:
"Please be aware that this Zygarde
is only a temporary construct, and\lany stat changes will be lost when\lit is disassembled."
entries.translation_source: Please be aware that this Zygarde is only a temporary construct, and any stat changes will be lost when it is disassembled.
entries.translated:
Harap diketahui bahwa Zygarde ini
hanyalah konstruksi sementara, dan\lsetiap perubahan stat akan hilang

saat dibongkar.

entries.original:
"That’s it!
The final version of Zygarde!

From here on out, disassembly is
no longer possible.

However, the form of this Zygarde
can easily be changed at will.

Simply speak to me and I will
change it for you.

You may also speak with my husband
in order to enhance your Zygarde\lin other ways.

Enjoy your new Zygarde!"
entries.translation_source: That’s it! The final version of Zygarde! From here on out, disassembly is no longer possible. However, the form of this Zygarde can easily be changed at will. Simply speak to me and I will change it for you. You may also speak with my husband in order to enhance your Zygarde in other ways. Enjoy your new Zygarde!
entries.translated:
Itu dia! Versi final Zygarde! Mulai
sekarang, pembongkaran tidak lagi\lmemungkinkan. Namun, bentuk Zygarde

ini dapat dengan mudah diubah
sesuka hati. Cukup bicara dengan\lsaya dan saya akan mengubahnya

untuk Anda. Anda juga dapat
berbicara dengan suami saya untuk\lmeningkatkan Zygarde Anda dengan

cara lain. Nikmati Zygarde baru
Anda!

entries.original:
"this Zygarde
can easily be changed at will.

Simply speak to me and I will
change it for you.

You may also speak with my husband
in order to enhance your Zygarde\lin other ways.

Enjoy your new Zygarde!"
entries.translation_source: this Zygarde can easily be changed at will. Simply speak to me and I will change it for you. You may also speak with my husband in order to enhance your Zygarde in other ways. Enjoy your new Zygarde!
entries.translated:
Zygarde ini dapat dengan mudah
diubah sesuka hati. Cukup bicara\ldengan saya dan saya akan

mengubahnya untuk Anda. Anda juga
dapat berbicara dengan suami saya\luntuk meningkatkan Zygarde Anda

dengan cara lain. Nikmati Zygarde
baru Anda!

entries.original:
"I can’t disassemble that Zygarde if
it’s your only living Pokémon!

What would you fight with?"
entries.translation_source: I can’t disassemble that Zygarde if it’s your only living Pokémon! What would you fight with?
entries.translated:
Saya tidak dapat membongkar Zygarde
itu jika itu adalah satu-satunya\lPokémon hidup Anda! Dengan apa Anda

akan bertarung?

entries.original:
"I can only disassemble the [green]Zygarde[red]
I assembled for you with the [green]cells\lyou gathered[red].

That Pokémon is, unfortunately,
not what I am referring to."
entries.translation_source: I can only disassemble the [green]Zygarde[red] I assembled for you with the [green]cells you gathered[red]. That Pokémon is, unfortunately, not what I am referring to.
entries.translated:
Saya hanya dapat membongkar [green]Zygarde[red]
yang saya rakit untuk Anda dengan\l[green]sel yang Anda kumpulkan[red]. Pokémon

itu, sayangnya, bukan yang saya
maksud.

entries.original:
"Zygarde has been disassembled into
its cells.

If it was holding an item, it will
now be back in your Cube."
entries.translation_source: Zygarde has been disassembled into its cells. If it was holding an item, it will now be back in your Cube.
entries.translated:
Zygarde telah dibongkar menjadi
sel-selnya. Jika ia membawa item,\litem tersebut sekarang akan kembali

ke Cube Anda.

entries.original:
"Best of luck collecting the
remaining cells."
entries.translation_source: Best of luck collecting the remaining cells.
entries.translated:
Semoga berhasil mengumpulkan
sel-sel yang tersisa.

entries.original:
"Hurry back!

You’ll want to assemble your
permanent construct as soon\las possible!"
entries.translation_source: Hurry back! You’ll want to assemble your permanent construct as soon as possible!
entries.translated:
Cepat kembali! Anda pasti ingin
merakit konstruksi permanen Anda\lsesegera mungkin!

entries.original:
"Would you like to change the form
of your Zygarde?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to change the form of your Zygarde?
entries.translated:

entries.translation_source: The Battle Circus is a facility for Single, Double, and Multi Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Circus Ringmaster, or you choose to rest. In Single Battle format, you have a choice of entering with three or six Pokémon. In Double Battle format, you have a choice of entering with four or six Pokémon. The battles are held in the main arena. Before each battle, the Ringmaster will activate a random effect for the duration of the battle. This effect is permanent and cannot be removed or overridden. These effects may also increase in intensity and begin to stack the higher your streak becomes. For every Trainer you defeat, you will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!

entries.translation_source: The Battle Circus is a facility for Single, Double, and Multi Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Circus Ringmaster, or you choose to rest. The Battle Circus’ Multi Battle show is for Multi Battles with a partner. To enter, join another Trainer and compete with two or three Pokémon each. Underneath the circus is a room named the Battle Salon where you can meet other Trainers. There you can find a Trainer to act as your partner in the Multi Battles. You can also partner up with a friend using a Link Cable. Once you have partnered up, you will be shown to the main arena. In the arena, tag teams will challenge you. Before each battle, the Ringmaster will activate a random effect for the duration of the battle. This effect is permanent and cannot be removed or overridden. These effects may also increase in intensity and begin to stack the higher your streak becomes. If you manage to defeat each team, you will earn Battle Points (BP). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Also, if you are in a tag team with a friend, you may not interrupt your challenge. Please be aware of that!

Trainer menunggu Anda. Format yang\lAnda pilih menentukan tier apa yang

bisa mereka lawan, dan kedalaman
Anda menentukan pengaturan\lpertarungan lainnya, seperti Single

atau Double, level, ukuran tim,
Inverse Battles, dan Dynamax. Untuk\ldaftar tier, silakan lihat bagian

\qo[green]Battle Tiers[blue]\qc saya. Untuk setiap
Trainer yang Anda kalahkan, Anda\lakan mendapatkan [green]Battle Points[blue]

([green]BP[blue]). Selain itu, saat dikalahkan,
beberapa Trainer mungkin\lmenjatuhkan item yang mereka

tambang, untuk Anda kumpulkan. Jika
Anda ingin menghentikan tantangan\lAnda, kemajuan Anda akan disimpan

untuk saat Anda ingin melanjutkan.
Jika pada titik mana pun Anda pergi\ltanpa menyimpan, Anda akan

didiskualifikasi dari tantangan
Anda. Harap perhatikan itu!

entries.original: "Pablo"
entries.translation_source: Pablo
entries.translated: Pablo

entries.original:
"So, you made it down here.

I heard all the ruckus upstairs,
so I got some idea of what sort\lof battle style you have.

I toil, day in and day out,
digging in this mine\.

Waiting for someone good enough to
make it down here\.

And for what?

No one ever leaves a lasting
impression.

But judging by what I heard, I
think you got something good to\lshow me.

Let’s go.
See if you can’t ease my boredom."
entries.translation_source: So, you made it down here. I heard all the ruckus upstairs, so I got some idea of what sort of battle style you have. I toil, day in and day out, digging in this mine\. Waiting for someone good enough to make it down here\. And for what? No one ever leaves a lasting impression. But judging by what I heard, I think you got something good to show me. Let’s go. See if you can’t ease my boredom.
entries.translated:
Jadi, Anda berhasil sampai ke sini.
Saya mendengar semua keributan di\latas, jadi saya punya gambaran

tentang gaya bertarung Anda. Saya
bekerja keras, hari demi hari,\lmenggali di tambang ini\. Menunggu

seseorang yang cukup baik untuk
mencapai sini\. Dan untuk apa? Tidak\lada yang pernah meninggalkan kesan

yang bertahan. Tapi dilihat dari
apa yang saya dengar, saya pikir\lAnda punya sesuatu yang bagus untuk

ditunjukkan kepada saya. Ayo. Coba
lihat apakah Anda tidak bisa\lmengurangi kebosanan saya.

entries.original:
"So, you’ve found me again.

And if who I heard upstairs was
you, you’ve really honed that\ledge of yours.

Alright, this should be good!

I’ve been waiting all this time\.

\.for the Trainer who can really
pull out all their inner strength\lagainst me!

Hit me with all that you’ve got!"
entries.translation_source: So, you’ve found me again. And if who I heard upstairs was you, you’ve really honed that edge of yours. Alright, this should be good! I’ve been waiting all this time\. \.for the Trainer who can really pull out all their inner strength against me! Hit me with all that you’ve got!
entries.translated:
Jadi, Anda menemukan saya lagi. Dan
jika yang saya dengar di atas\ladalah Anda, Anda benar-benar

mengasah keunggulan Anda. Baiklah,
ini pasti bagus! Saya sudah\lmenunggu selama ini\. \.untuk Trainer

yang benar-benar bisa mengeluarkan
semua kekuatan batin mereka melawan\lsaya! Hajar saya dengan semua yang

Anda punya!

entries.original:
"I guess I can’t call today a total
waste, if someone as good as\lyou showed up.

Catch me again when I put my more
serious team together.

And when that happens, I wanna see
a REAL impression from you.

One that can only be reached when
both Trainers go all out.

In the meantime, good luck getting
deeper into the mine.

It’s only gonna get tougher from
here.

See you later\.\CC0818 maybe\."
entries.translation_source: I guess I can’t call today a total waste, if someone as good as you showed up. Catch me again when I put my more serious team together. And when that happens, I wanna see a REAL impression from you. One that can only be reached when both Trainers go all out. In the meantime, good luck getting deeper into the mine. It’s only gonna get tougher from here. See you later\.\CC0818 maybe\.
entries.translated:
Saya rasa saya tidak bisa menyebut
hari ini benar-benar sia-sia, jika\lseseorang sehebat Anda muncul.

Temui saya lagi ketika saya
menyusun tim yang lebih serius. Dan\lketika itu terjadi, saya ingin

melihat kesan yang NYATA dari Anda.
Kesan yang hanya bisa dicapai\lketika kedua Trainer mengerahkan

segalanya. Sementara itu, semoga
berhasil masuk lebih dalam ke\ltambang. Ini akan semakin sulit

dari sini. Sampai jumpa lagi\.\CC0818
mungkin\.

entries.original:
"So, you really do understand what
sort of Trainer I look for.

Battles are how Trainers can
understand each other.

Strategies, moves, Pokémon\.
there is much that can be learned\lfrom others.

But what’s important is that a
Trainer puts their heart into it.

And that was quite the battle that
you showed me today!

Keep on going further into the
mine, and show the rest of ’em\lyour brilliance!"
entries.translation_source: So, you really do understand what sort of Trainer I look for. Battles are how Trainers can understand each other. Strategies, moves, Pokémon\. there is much that can be learned from others. But what’s important is that a Trainer puts their heart into it. And that was quite the battle that you showed me today! Keep on going further into the mine, and show the rest of ’em your brilliance!
entries.translated:
Jadi, Anda benar-benar mengerti
jenis Trainer seperti apa yang saya\lcari. Pertarungan adalah cara

Trainer saling memahami. Strategi,
jurus, Pokémon\. ada banyak yang bisa\ldipelajari dari orang lain. Tapi

yang penting adalah seorang Trainer
menaruh hati mereka dalam\lpertarungan. Dan itu adalah

pertarungan yang cukup hebat yang
Anda tunjukkan kepada saya hari\lini! Teruslah maju lebih dalam ke

tambang, dan tunjukkan kepada yang
lain kecemerlangan Anda!

entries.translation_source: Some type matchups in the Battle Mine can be mighty difficult to keep track of. This Pokémon’s this type, and that Pokémon’s weak to that move\. it can be a real doozy. That’s when its time to utilize the highlighting on the move menu, I’d say.

itu\. itu bisa sangat rumit. Saat\litulah waktunya memanfaatkan

penyorotan pada menu jurus, menurut
saya.

entries.translated: [player] menerima [green][buffer1][black] BP!

entries.original: "Palmer"
entries.translation_source: Palmer
entries.translated: Palmer

entries.original:
"Hi!
My name’s Palmer.

I heard a lot about you.

You’re [player] from Frozen
Heights, right?

You’re much younger than I thought.
So, I’d like you to show me.

Show me the bond you’ve built with
your Pokémon.

Show me what you’ve learned through
battles with Trainers!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! My name’s Palmer. I heard a lot about you. You’re [player] from Frozen Heights, right? You’re much younger than I thought. So, I’d like you to show me. Show me the bond you’ve built with your Pokémon. Show me what you’ve learned through battles with Trainers!
entries.translated:
Hai! Namaku Palmer. Aku dengar
banyak tentangmu. Kamu [player]\ldari Frozen Heights, kan? Kamu jauh

lebih muda dari yang kukira. Jadi,
aku ingin kamu tunjukkan padaku.\lTunjukkan ikatan yang telah kamu

bangun dengan Pokémon-mu. Tunjukkan
apa yang telah kamu pelajari\lmelalui pertarungan dengan para

Pelatih!

entries.original:
"Bravo!

I imagine many Trainers will come
to challenge me as you just did.

That’s something I look forward to
a great deal.

You will become even more skilled.

Keep battling Trainers from around
the world and keep growing greater\lin stature!"
entries.translation_source: Bravo! I imagine many Trainers will come to challenge me as you just did. That’s something I look forward to a great deal. You will become even more skilled. Keep battling Trainers from around the world and keep growing greater in stature!
entries.translated:
Bravo! Aku bayangkan banyak Pelatih
akan datang untuk menantangku\lseperti yang baru saja kamu

lakukan. Itu sesuatu yang sangat
kunantikan. Kamu akan menjadi\lsemakin terampil. Teruslah

bertarung dengan Pelatih dari
seluruh dunia dan teruslah tumbuh\ldalam keagungan!

entries.original:
"So, you’ve come this far!

As the Tower Tycoon, I’ll have to
give you my best effort.

That’s how the best Trainers show
respect to each other.

By battling all out as dedicated
students of Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: So, you’ve come this far! As the Tower Tycoon, I’ll have to give you my best effort. That’s how the best Trainers show respect to each other. By battling all out as dedicated students of Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu telah sampai sejauh ini!
Sebagai Taipan Menara, aku harus\lmemberikan yang terbaik. Itulah

cara Pelatih terbaik menunjukkan
rasa hormat satu sama lain. Dengan\lbertarung habis-habisan sebagai

siswa Pokémon yang berdedikasi!

entries.original:
"Bravo!
I feel inspired in my heart!

My young friend, the world and your
future hold infinite promise.

The spirits of people and Pokémon
call for each other in resonance.

The resulting bond is infinitely
strong!

Go on, you can be all the you
desire!

There is no limit to where you can
go!"
entries.translation_source: Bravo! I feel inspired in my heart! My young friend, the world and your future hold infinite promise. The spirits of people and Pokémon call for each other in resonance. The resulting bond is infinitely strong! Go on, you can be all the you desire! There is no limit to where you can go!
entries.translated:
Bravo! Hatiku terinspirasi! Teman
mudaku, dunia dan masa depanmu\lmenyimpan janji tak terbatas. Jiwa

manusia dan Pokémon saling
memanggil dalam resonansi. Ikatan\lyang dihasilkan sangat kuat!

Lanjutkan, kamu bisa menjadi apa
pun yang kamu inginkan! Tidak ada\lbatasan ke mana kamu bisa pergi!

entries.original:
"Congratulations!

Your victory over the [buffer1]
was an inspiration!

To pay tribute to your talent, we
present you BP!"
entries.translation_source: Congratulations! Your victory over the [buffer1] was an inspiration! To pay tribute to your talent, we present you BP!
entries.translated:
Selamat! Kemenangan Anda atas
[buffer1] sangat menginspirasi!\lSebagai penghargaan atas bakat

Anda, kami berikan BP!

menyimpan yang lain?

"The Battle Sands is a facility for

You may choose to stop the battles

Whether the Trainer loses a battle
or you decide to retire, you will\lreceive the BP acrued as winnings.

Additionally, leaving at any point
without saving will cause any BP\lacrued to be lost.

Just be aware of that.

Oh, I forgot to mention that one
Pokémon on each side of the field\lwill gain a random stat boost at\lthe beginning of the battle.

Keep that in mind when choosing
your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The Battle Sands is a facility for Single and Double Battles. In Single Battles, two Pokémon must be entered. In Double Battles, three Pokémon must be entered. Here’s the catch for this facility: you’re not actually battling. Pokémon you enter in this facility will be taken by a volunteer and used to fight for you. You’ll be given the choice of whether you want your Pokémon to attack or switch out, but the final decision will be up to the Trainer controlling your Pokémon. As this Trainer wins battles, [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]) will be acrued. You may choose to stop the battles at any point, but know that once you do, that’s it for the streak. Whether the Trainer loses a battle or you decide to retire, you will receive the BP acrued as winnings. Additionally, leaving at any point without saving will cause any BP acrued to be lost. Just be aware of that. Oh, I forgot to mention that one Pokémon on each side of the field will gain a random stat boost at the beginning of the battle. Keep that in mind when choosing your Pokémon.

Battle Sands adalah fasilitas untuk

akhir dari rekor beruntun. Baik

kamu akan menerima BP yang
terkumpul sebagai kemenangan.\lSelain itu, pergi kapan saja tanpa

menyimpan akan menyebabkan BP yang
terkumpul hilang. Hati-hati dengan\litu. Oh, saya lupa menyebutkan

bahwa satu Pokémon di setiap sisi
lapangan akan mendapatkan\lpeningkatan stat acak di awal

pertempuran. Ingatlah itu saat
memilih Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"The Battle Tower is a facility for
Single, Double, Multi, and\lMetronome Battle challenges.

Once begun, your challenge lasts
until you defeat the Tower Tycoon,\lor you choose to rest.

In Single Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with three or\lsix Pokémon.

In Double Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with four or\lsix Pokémon.

The battles are held in Battle
Rooms of which there are many in\lthe tower.

In each of the Battle Rooms,
Trainers await your challenge.

For every Trainer you defeat, you
will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]).

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be\lrecorded for when you wish to\lcontinue.

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: The Battle Tower is a facility for Single, Double, Multi, and Metronome Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Tower Tycoon, or you choose to rest. In Single Battle format, you have a choice of entering with three or six Pokémon. In Double Battle format, you have a choice of entering with four or six Pokémon. The battles are held in Battle Rooms of which there are many in the tower. In each of the Battle Rooms, Trainers await your challenge. For every Trainer you defeat, you will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!

Pokémon. Pertarungan diadakan di
Battle Rooms yang banyak terdapat\ldi menara ini. Di setiap Battle

Room, para Trainer menunggu
tantangan Anda. Untuk setiap\lTrainer yang Anda kalahkan, Anda

akan mendapatkan [green]Battle Points[blue]
([green]BP[blue]). Jika Anda ingin menghentikan\ltantangan, kemajuan Anda akan

dicatat untuk dilanjutkan nanti.
Jika suatu saat Anda pergi tanpa\lmenyimpan, Anda akan

didiskualifikasi dari tantangan
Anda. Harap perhatikan itu!

entries.original:
"The Battle Tower is a facility for
Single, Double, Multi, and\lMetronome Battle challenges.

Once begun, your challenge lasts
until you defeat the Tower Tycoon,\lor you choose to rest.

The Battle Tower’s Multi Battle
Rooms are for Multi Battles with a\lpartner.

To enter, join another Trainer
and compete with two or three\lPokémon each.

Inside the tower is a room named
the Battle Salon where you can\lmeet other Trainers.

There, you can find a Trainer to
act as your partner in the Multi\lBattles.

You can also partner up with a
friend using a Link Cable.

Once you have partnered up, you
will be shown to a battle room.

In the Multi Battle Room, tag
teams await your challenge.

If you manage to defeat each team,
you will earn [green]Battle Points[red] ([green]BP[red]).

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be\lrecorded for when you wish to\lcontinue.

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Also, if you are in a tag team
with a friend, you may not\linterrupt your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: The Battle Tower is a facility for Single, Double, Multi, and Metronome Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Tower Tycoon, or you choose to rest. The Battle Tower’s Multi Battle Rooms are for Multi Battles with a partner. To enter, join another Trainer and compete with two or three Pokémon each. Inside the tower is a room named the Battle Salon where you can meet other Trainers. There, you can find a Trainer to act as your partner in the Multi Battles. You can also partner up with a friend using a Link Cable. Once you have partnered up, you will be shown to a battle room. In the Multi Battle Room, tag teams await your challenge. If you manage to defeat each team, you will earn [green]Battle Points[red] ([green]BP[red]). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Also, if you are in a tag team with a friend, you may not interrupt your challenge. Please be aware of that!

If you choose to battle with 4 or
less Pokémon on your team and are\lparticipating in a Random Battle,\lyou will be allowed to choose\lwhich random Pokémon you would\llike to battle with.

Each battle for 10 battles this
random Pokémon selection will be\lcomprised of your previous team\land your opponent’s previous team."
entries.translation_source: In Single Battles, you may battle with 3 or 6 Pokémon on your team. In Double Battles, you may battle with 4 or 6 Pokémon on your team. In Multi Battles, you may battle with 2 or 3 Pokémon on your team. If you choose to battle with 6 Pokémon and are not participating in a Random Battle, you will be shown the opposing team before battles and will be allowed to choose a lead. If you choose to battle with 4 or less Pokémon on your team and are participating in a Random Battle, you will be allowed to choose which random Pokémon you would like to battle with. Each battle for 10 battles this random Pokémon selection will be comprised of your previous team and your opponent’s previous team.

entries.original:
"Smogon Benjamin Butterfree is a
format where defeating a Pokémon\lcauses it to devolve into a\lpre-evolved form instead of\lfainting.

Pokémon can only faint once they
can devolve no more.

Upon devolution, any stat changes
will be reset, and any non-volatile\lstatus conditions will be cured.

Additionally, Pokémon will forget
all moves they cannot naturally\llearn.

Benjamin Butterfree uses standard
Smogon OU clauses.

For more information, please see:
[green]smogon.com/forums/threads/\lbenjamin-butterfree.3605680/"
entries.translation_source: Smogon Benjamin Butterfree is a format where defeating a Pokémon causes it to devolve into a pre-evolved form instead of fainting. Pokémon can only faint once they can devolve no more. Upon devolution, any stat changes will be reset, and any non-volatile status conditions will be cured. Additionally, Pokémon will forget all moves they cannot naturally learn. Benjamin Butterfree uses standard Smogon OU clauses. For more information, please see: [green]smogon.com/forums/threads/ benjamin-butterfree.3605680/

lanjut, silakan lihat:
