entries.original:
"The Battle Frontier has four
facilities dedicated to battling.

At the Battle Tower, the objective
is to beat many Trainers in a row.

At the Battle Sands, other Trainers
battle with your Pokémon.

At the Battle Circus, random
effects are present every battle.

And finally, at the Battle Mine,
you must use a team of six Pokémon\lthat can handle many different\lbattle formats."
entries.translation_source: The Battle Frontier has four facilities dedicated to battling. At the Battle Tower, the objective is to beat many Trainers in a row. At the Battle Sands, other Trainers battle with your Pokémon. At the Battle Circus, random effects are present every battle. And finally, at the Battle Mine, you must use a team of six Pokémon that can handle many different battle formats.
entries.translated:
Battle Frontier memiliki empat
fasilitas yang didedikasikan untuk\lbertarung. Di Battle Tower,

tujuannya adalah mengalahkan banyak
Trainer berturut-turut. Di Battle\lSands, Trainer lain bertarung

dengan Pokémon Anda. Di Battle
Circus, efek acak hadir di setiap\lpertarungan. Dan terakhir, di

Battle Mine, Anda harus menggunakan
tim yang terdiri dari enam Pokémon\lyang dapat menangani banyak format

pertarungan yang berbeda.

entries.original:
"The battles at the four Battle
Frontier facilities are held under\lspecial rules.

First and foremost, no Exp. Points
can be earned.

Consequently, the Pokémon battling
here will not level up.

When choosing a level to battle at,
all Pokémon on your team will be\ladjusted to that level for the\lduration of the battles."
entries.translation_source: The battles at the four Battle Frontier facilities are held under special rules. First and foremost, no Exp. Points can be earned. Consequently, the Pokémon battling here will not level up. When choosing a level to battle at, all Pokémon on your team will be adjusted to that level for the duration of the battles.
entries.translated:
Pertarungan di empat fasilitas
Battle Frontier diadakan di bawah\laturan khusus. Pertama dan

terutama, tidak ada Poin Exp. yang
dapat diperoleh. Akibatnya, Pokémon\lyang bertarung di sini tidak akan

naik level. Saat memilih level
untuk bertarung, semua Pokémon di\ltim Anda akan disesuaikan dengan

level tersebut selama pertarungan.

entries.original:
"Battle Points are usually referred
to as BP.

BP are points that are used only in
the Battle Frontier.

BP are awarded for meeting certain
performance goals at the various\lBattle Frontier facilities.

BP can be exchanged for prizes at
Exchange Service Corners."
entries.translation_source: Battle Points are usually referred to as BP. BP are points that are used only in the Battle Frontier. BP are awarded for meeting certain performance goals at the various Battle Frontier facilities. BP can be exchanged for prizes at Exchange Service Corners.
entries.translated:
Battle Points biasanya disebut
sebagai BP. BP adalah poin yang\lhanya digunakan di Battle Frontier.

BP diberikan karena mencapai target
kinerja tertentu di berbagai\lfasilitas Battle Frontier. BP dapat

ditukarkan dengan hadiah di
Exchange Service Corners.

entries.original:
"Exchange Service Corners can be
found in booths dotted around the\lBattle Frontier, or in the Battle\lTower itself.

There, you may exchange your BP for
a wide variety of services and\lprizes.

Please do visit them!"
entries.translation_source: Exchange Service Corners can be found in booths dotted around the Battle Frontier, or in the Battle Tower itself. There, you may exchange your BP for a wide variety of services and prizes. Please do visit them!
entries.translated:
Exchange Service Corners dapat
ditemukan di stan yang tersebar di\lsekitar Battle Frontier, atau di

Battle Tower itu sendiri. Di sana,
Anda dapat menukarkan BP Anda\ldengan berbagai layanan dan hadiah.

Silakan kunjungi mereka!

entries.original:

Trainer data, such as the current\lrecords and the best records to\ldate.

You will find one near the
reception counter in each facility."
entries.translation_source: The Performance Monitor shows Trainer data, such as the current records and the best records to date. You will find one near the reception counter in each facility.

dekat meja penerimaan di setiap\lfasilitas.

entries.original:
"[green]Mega Evolution[black] is a temporary
evolution that can be initiated in\lbattle if a Pokémon is holding a\l[green]Mega Stone[black] for their species.

To activate Mega Evolution, press
\btn04 while selecting an attack\lto use.

Only one Pokémon per team can Mega
Evolve, and after the battle is\lover, Mega Pokémon return to their\loriginal forms."
entries.translation_source: [green]Mega Evolution[black] is a temporary evolution that can be initiated in battle if a Pokémon is holding a [green]Mega Stone[black] for their species. To activate Mega Evolution, press \btn04 while selecting an attack to use. Only one Pokémon per team can Mega Evolve, and after the battle is over, Mega Pokémon return to their original forms.
entries.translated:
[green]Mega Evolusi[black] adalah evolusi
sementara yang dapat dimulai dalam\lpertarungan jika Pokémon memegang

[green]Batu Mega[black] untuk spesiesnya. Untuk
mengaktifkan Mega Evolusi, tekan \btn04\lsaat memilih serangan yang akan

digunakan. Hanya satu Pokémon per
tim yang bisa melakukan Mega\lEvolusi, dan setelah pertarungan

selesai, Mega Pokémon kembali ke
bentuk aslinya.

entries.original:
"A [green]Z-Move[black] is a special type of move
in which a Trainer and their\lPokémon’s wishes combine to\lunleash a very powerful attack\lonce per battle.

If one of these moves are
available, it can be activated by\lpressing \btn04 and then \btn00 while\lselecting an attack to use.

In order for a Pokémon to use a
Z-Move, it must hold a special type\lof item called a [green]Z-Crystal[black].

Most Z-Crystals correspond to a
certain type of move, but some are\lalso species specific."
entries.translation_source: A [green]Z-Move[black] is a special type of move in which a Trainer and their Pokémon’s wishes combine to unleash a very powerful attack once per battle. If one of these moves are available, it can be activated by pressing \btn04 and then \btn00 while selecting an attack to use. In order for a Pokémon to use a Z-Move, it must hold a special type of item called a [green]Z-Crystal[black]. Most Z-Crystals correspond to a certain type of move, but some are also species specific.
entries.translated:
[green]Gerakan Z[black] adalah jenis gerakan
khusus di mana keinginan Pelatih\ldan Pokémon mereka bergabung untuk

melepaskan serangan yang sangat
kuat sekali per pertarungan. Jika\lsalah satu gerakan ini tersedia,

dapat diaktifkan dengan menekan \btn04
lalu \btn00 saat memilih serangan yang\lakan digunakan. Agar Pokémon dapat

menggunakan Gerakan Z, ia harus
memegang jenis item khusus yang\ldisebut [green]Kristal Z[black]. Sebagian besar

Kristal Z sesuai dengan tipe
gerakan tertentu, tetapi beberapa\ljuga spesifik untuk spesies.

entries.original:
"[green]Dynamax[black] is a temporary
transformation where a Pokémon\ldistorts space to change its size.

When a Pokémon Dynamaxes, for
three turns its HP is increased and\lall of its moves are powered up\linto special [green]Max Moves[black].

Each Max Move has a unique effect,
that varies based on the type of\lthe original move.

If a Pokémon has the Gigantamax
Factor, it can undergo Gigantamax.

This is a special kind of Dynamax
that results in a different\lappearance to its regular form, in\laddition to being larger.

Each Gigantamax Pokémon has an
exclusive Max Move known as a\lG-Max Move.

To activate Dynamax, press
\btn04 while selecting an attack\lto use."
entries.translation_source: [green]Dynamax[black] is a temporary transformation where a Pokémon distorts space to change its size. When a Pokémon Dynamaxes, for three turns its HP is increased and all of its moves are powered up into special [green]Max Moves[black]. Each Max Move has a unique effect, that varies based on the type of the original move. If a Pokémon has the Gigantamax Factor, it can undergo Gigantamax. This is a special kind of Dynamax that results in a different appearance to its regular form, in addition to being larger. Each Gigantamax Pokémon has an exclusive Max Move known as a G-Max Move. To activate Dynamax, press \btn04 while selecting an attack to use.
entries.translated:
[green]Dynamax[black] adalah transformasi
sementara di mana Pokémon mengubah\lruang untuk mengubah ukurannya.

Saat Pokémon melakukan Dynamax,
selama tiga giliran HP-nya\lmeningkat dan semua gerakannya

ditingkatkan menjadi [green]Gerakan Max[black]
khusus. Setiap Gerakan Max memiliki\lefek unik, yang bervariasi

berdasarkan tipe gerakan aslinya.
Jika Pokémon memiliki Faktor\lGigantamax, ia bisa melakukan

Gigantamax. Ini adalah jenis
Dynamax khusus yang menghasilkan\lpenampilan berbeda dari bentuk

biasanya, selain lebih besar.
Setiap Pokémon Gigantamax memiliki\lGerakan Max eksklusif yang dikenal

sebagai Gerakan G-Max. Untuk
mengaktifkan Dynamax, tekan \btn04 saat\lmemilih serangan yang akan

digunakan.

entries.original:
"When selecting an attack in battle,
certain symbols may appear.

This is based on the move’s
effectiveness against the target.

A green [green]\au[black] indicates that the move
is super effective.

A yellow [orange]\ad[black] indicates the move is
not very effective.

A red [lightgreen]*[black] indicates that the move
doesn’t affect the target at all.

And a \+ symbol indicates the move
has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus."
entries.translation_source: When selecting an attack in battle, certain symbols may appear. This is based on the move’s effectiveness against the target. A green [green]\au[black] indicates that the move is super effective. A yellow [orange]\ad[black] indicates the move is not very effective. A red [lightgreen]*[black] indicates that the move doesn’t affect the target at all. And a \+ symbol indicates the move has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus.
entries.translated:
Saat memilih serangan dalam
pertarungan, simbol tertentu\lmungkin muncul. Ini didasarkan pada

efektivitas gerakan terhadap

"If you’re fighting a random battle

however.

entries.translation_source: If you’re fighting a random battle with a team of 3 or 4 Pokémon, you’ll be given a choice of which random Pokémon you want to fight with before each battle. And if you win a battle, you’ll be able to pick from a mix of your and your opponent’s previous teams! This’ll only last each 10 battles, however. After that point you’ll be offered a brand new random team. entries.original:
"I’m the Pokémon Move Maniac’s
older brother.

I know every single move that
Pokémon learn growing up.

For a [green]Heart Scale[blue], I’ll teach a
move your Pokémon can learn at\lany point while leveling up."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Pokémon Move Maniac’s older brother. I know every single move that Pokémon learn growing up. For a [green]Heart Scale[blue], I’ll teach a move your Pokémon can learn at any point while leveling up.
entries.translated:
Saya adalah kakak laki-laki dari
Pokémon Move Maniac. Saya tahu\lsetiap jurusan yang dipelajari

Pokémon saat bertumbuh. Dengan
[green]Sisik Hati[blue], saya akan mengajarkan\ljurusan yang bisa dipelajari

Pokémon Anda kapan saja saat naik
level.

entries.original:
"I’m the Pokémon Move Maniac’s
little sister.

I know every single move that
Pokémon can learn through\lbreeding.

For only [green][buffer1][red] BP, I’ll teach an
Egg Move to one Pokémon.

Let me guess, you want me to teach
a move, right?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Pokémon Move Maniac’s little sister. I know every single move that Pokémon can learn through breeding. For only [green][buffer1][red] BP, I’ll teach an Egg Move to one Pokémon. Let me guess, you want me to teach a move, right?
entries.translated:
Saya adalah adik perempuan dari
Pokémon Move Maniac. Saya tahu\lsetiap jurusan yang bisa dipelajari

Pokémon melalui pembiakan. Hanya
dengan [green][buffer1][red] BP, saya akan\lmengajarkan Jurusan Telur kepada

satu Pokémon. Biar saya tebak, Anda
ingin saya mengajarkan jurusan,\lkan?

entries.original:
"For only [green][buffer1][red] BP, I’ll teach an
Egg Move to one Pokémon.

Let me guess, you want me to teach
a move, right?"
entries.translation_source: For only [green][buffer1][red] BP, I’ll teach an Egg Move to one Pokémon. Let me guess, you want me to teach a move, right?
entries.translated:
Hanya dengan [green][buffer1][red] BP, saya akan
mengajarkan Jurusan Telur kepada\lsatu Pokémon. Biar saya tebak, Anda

ingin saya mengajarkan jurusan,
kan?

entries.original: "Should I teach an Egg Move?"
entries.translation_source: Should I teach an Egg Move?
entries.translated:
Haruskah saya mengajarkan Jurusan
Telur?

entries.original:
"Hunh?

It doesn’t look like you have
enough BP."
entries.translation_source: Hunh? It doesn’t look like you have enough BP.
entries.translated:
Hah? Sepertinya Anda tidak memiliki
cukup BP.

entries.original:
"Which move should I teach?
You have [green][buffer1][red] BP."
entries.translation_source: Which move should I teach? You have [green][buffer1][red] BP.
entries.translated:
Jurusan mana yang harus saya
ajarkan? Anda memiliki [green][buffer1][red] BP.

entries.original:
"If your Pokémon need to learn an
Egg Move, I need [green][buffer1][red] BP."
entries.translation_source: If your Pokémon need to learn an Egg Move, I need [green][buffer1][red] BP.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon Anda perlu mempelajari
Jurusan Telur, saya membutuhkan\l[green][buffer1][red] BP.

entries.original:
"If your Pokémon need to learn an
Egg Move, I’m your girl!"
entries.translation_source: If your Pokémon need to learn an Egg Move, I’m your girl!
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon Anda perlu mempelajari
Jurusan Telur, akulah orangnya!

entries.original:
"[black][player] paid [green][buffer1][black] BP
in exchange."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] paid [green][buffer1][black] BP in exchange.
entries.translated:
[black][player] membayar [green][buffer1][black] BP
sebagai gantinya.

entries.original:
"I see\.

I see your Hidden Power\.

And it appears changeable\.

Would you like to change your
Pokémon’s [green]Hidden Power[red]\.?

It will only cost you [green][buffer1][red] BP\.
You have [green][buffer2][red] BP\."
entries.translation_source: I see\. I see your Hidden Power\. And it appears changeable\. Would you like to change your Pokémon’s [green]Hidden Power[red]\.? It will only cost you [green][buffer1][red] BP\. You have [green][buffer2][red] BP\.
entries.translated:
Saya lihat\. Saya melihat Kekuatan
Tersembunyi Anda\. Dan itu tampak\ldapat diubah\. Apakah Anda ingin

mengubah [green]Kekuatan Tersembunyi[red]
Pokémon Anda\.? Itu hanya akan\ldikenakan biaya [green][buffer1][red] BP\. Anda

memiliki [green][buffer2][red] BP\.

entries.original: "Which Pokémon needs changing\.?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon needs changing\.?
entries.translated: Pokémon mana yang perlu diubah\.?

entries.original:
"Which type should [green][buffer1][red]’s
Hidden Power become\.?"
entries.translation_source: Which type should [green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power become\.?
entries.translated:
Tipe apa yang harus menjadi
Kekuatan Tersembunyi [green][buffer1][red]\.?

"[green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power is
currently the [green][buffer3][red]-type\.

Should I change [green][buffer1][red]’s
Hidden Power to [green][buffer2][red]\.?"
entries.translation_source: [green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power is currently the [green][buffer3][red]-type\. Should I change [green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power to [green][buffer2][red]\.?
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red]Kekuatan Tersembunyi
[green][buffer1][red] saat ini adalah tipe\l[green][buffer3][red]\. Haruskah saya mengubah

Kekuatan Tersembunyi [green][buffer1][red]
menjadi [green][buffer2][red]\.?

"[green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power has
been changed to [green][buffer2][red]\."
entries.translation_source: [green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power has been changed to [green][buffer2][red]\.
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red]Kekuatan Tersembunyi
[green][buffer1][red] telah diubah menjadi\l[green][buffer2][red]\.

"What\.

You don’t have enough BP\."

[green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power is already
the [green][buffer2][red]-type\."
entries.translation_source: What\. [green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power is already the [green][buffer2][red]-type\.
entries.translated:
Apa\. Kekuatan Tersembunyi [green][buffer1][red]
sudah merupakan tipe [green][buffer2][red]\.

"Sure\.

Which Pokémon’s Hidden Power would
you like to view\.?"

Tentu\. Kekuatan Tersembunyi Pokémon
mana yang ingin Anda lihat\.?

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power is
currently the [green][buffer3][red]-type\."
entries.translation_source: [green][buffer1][red]’s Hidden Power is currently the [green][buffer3][red]-type\.
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red] saat ini adalah tipe
[green][buffer3][red]\.

entries.original:
"Aww\.
Too bad\."
entries.translation_source: Aww\. Too bad\.
entries.translated: Aduh\. Sayang sekali\.

entries.translation_source: View Hidden Power

entries.original:
"Take a look, at the Science
Society’s latest breakthrough\.\l[green]Nature changing[red]!

They called us mad, said we were
\qoharming Pokémon\qc\.

Fools! Fools, I say, deserving to
rot at the bottom of the earth!

Ahem\. anyway\.

Were you, perchance, looking to have
a Pokémon’s [green]Nature[red] changed?

It will cost you [green][buffer1][red] BP.
You currently have [green][buffer2][red] BP."
entries.translation_source: Take a look, at the Science Society’s latest breakthrough\. [green]Nature changing[red]! They called us mad, said we were \qoharming Pokémon\qc\. Fools! Fools, I say, deserving to rot at the bottom of the earth! Ahem\. anyway\. Were you, perchance, looking to have a Pokémon’s [green]Nature[red] changed? It will cost you [green][buffer1][red] BP. You currently have [green][buffer2][red] BP.
entries.translated:
Lihatlah, terobosan terbaru dari
Perkumpulan Sains\. [green]Perubahan Sifat[red]!\lMereka bilang kami gila, kata

mereka kami \qomenyakiti Pokémon\qc\.
Bodoh! Bodoh, kataku, pantas\lmembusuk di dasar bumi! Ahem\.

bagaimanapun\. Apakah Anda,
kebetulan, ingin mengubah [green]Sifat[red]\lPokémon? Biayanya [green][buffer1][red] BP. Kamu

saat ini memiliki [green][buffer2][red] BP.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon’s [green]Nature[red] would you
like to change?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon’s [green]Nature[red] would you like to change?
entries.translated:
Anda ingin mengubah [green]Sifat[red] Pokémon
yang mana?

entries.original:
"Which [green]Nature[red] would you like to give
[buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Which [green]Nature[red] would you like to give [buffer1]?
entries.translated:
[green]Sifat[red] apa yang ingin Anda berikan
kepada [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Would you like to give [green][buffer1][red]
the [green][buffer2][red] Nature?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to give [green][buffer1][red] the [green][buffer2][red] Nature?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda ingin memberi [green][buffer1][red]
[green][buffer2][red] Sifat?

entries.original:
"Then, let the grand experiment on
[buffer1] begin!

Let me see into your heart\.\CC0818 ah, this
looks like a painful memory\."
entries.translation_source: Then, let the grand experiment on [buffer1] begin! Let me see into your heart\.\CC0818 ah, this looks like a painful memory\.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, mari mulai eksperimen
besar pada [buffer1]! Biarkan aku\lmelihat ke dalam hatimu\.\CC0818 ah, ini

terlihat seperti kenangan yang
menyakitkan\.

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1]’s eyes look blank.

It’s as if it no longer recognizes
you\."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1]’s eyes look blank. It’s as if it no longer recognizes you\.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1]{B4}s mata terlihat kosong.
Seolah-olah ia tidak lagi\lmengenalimu\.

entries.original:
"And we’re done!

Your [buffer1]’s heart was rebuilt to
have a more suitable Nature.

Fortunately, it seems to remember
nothing about the procedure."
entries.translation_source: And we’re done! Your [buffer1]’s heart was rebuilt to have a more suitable Nature. Fortunately, it seems to remember nothing about the procedure.
entries.translated:
Dan selesai! Hati [buffer1] telah
dibangun kembali agar memiliki\lSifat yang lebih sesuai. Untungnya,

ia tampaknya tidak ingat apa pun
tentang prosedur tersebut.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry!

You don’t have enough BP for your
Pokémon to undergo the procedure!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! You don’t have enough BP for your Pokémon to undergo the procedure!
entries.translated:
Maaf! Anda tidak memiliki cukup BP
untuk Pokémon Anda menjalani\lprosedur ini!

entries.original:
"I wouldn’t get on my bad side, if I
were you!

You wouldn’t want to make an enemy
of the Science Society\."
entries.translation_source: I wouldn’t get on my bad side, if I were you! You wouldn’t want to make an enemy of the Science Society\.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak akan membuatmu menjadi
musuhku, jika aku jadi kamu! Kamu\ltidak ingin bermusuhan dengan

Perkumpulan Sains\.

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][red] already has that
Nature\."
entries.translation_source: [green][buffer1][red] already has that Nature\.
entries.translated: [green][buffer1][red] sudah memiliki Sifat itu\.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry!
Eggs can’t undergo the procedure!

Would you please choose a different
Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! Eggs can’t undergo the procedure! Would you please choose a different Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Maaf! Telur tidak bisa menjalani
prosedur ini! Tolong pilih Pokémon\lyang lain?

I’m the catching expert!

I have access to every single Poké
Ball in existeeeeeeence!

And I can place any Poké Ball on
any Pokémon!

What do you say!?
Can I do that for you!?

It’ll cost you [green][buffer1][blue] BP!
You currently have [green][buffer2][blue] BP!"
entries.translation_source: Look at me! I’m the catching expert! I have access to every single Poké Ball in existeeeeeeence! And I can place any Poké Ball on any Pokémon! What do you say!? Can I do that for you!? It’ll cost you [green][buffer1][blue] BP! You currently have [green][buffer2][blue] BP!

menangkap! Aku memiliki akses ke\lsetiap Bola Pokémon yang ada di

Bola Pokémon apa pun pada Pokémon\lapa pun! Bagaimana!? Boleh aku

lakukan itu untukmu!? Biayanya
[green][buffer1][blue] BP! Kamu saat ini memiliki\l[green][buffer2][blue] BP!

"Fwip fwoop!

entries.translated:
Milikmu [green][buffer1][blue] adalah yang

"What!

[green][buffer1][blue] is already in that ball!"
entries.translation_source: No, no! [green][buffer1][blue] is already in that ball!
entries.translated:

Bola itu!

"No, no!
I can’t change an Egg’s Ball!

entries.translation_source: No, no! I can’t change an Egg’s Ball! Choose a different Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Tidak, tidak! Aku tidak bisa
mengganti Bola Telur! Pilih Pokémon\llain!

"No, no!
Not enough BP!"

entries.translated:

semacamnya!

Wouldn’t you liiiiike to change

It cosssssts [green][buffer1][blue] BP for
regular Abilitieeeees, [green][buffer2][blue] BP\lfor Hidden Abilitieeees, and you\lhaaaaave [green][buffer3][blue] BP."
entries.translation_source: Hoo hoo hoo hoo hoo! Abilities, aren’t they fuuuuun? Wouldn’t you liiiiike to change onnnnne? It cosssssts [green][buffer1][blue] BP for regular Abilitieeeees, [green][buffer2][blue] BP for Hidden Abilitieeees, and you haaaaave [green][buffer3][blue] BP.
entries.translated:

Harganya [green][buffer1][blue] BP untuk
Kemampuan biaaasaaa, [green][buffer2][blue] BP\luntuk Kemampuan Tersembunyiiii, dan

entries.translated:
Oooooh\. Bukankah itu sudaaaah
kemampuaaaan [buffer1]?

[buffer1] has no second

entries.translated:
Oooooh\. [buffer1] tidak punya

"Oooooh\.

[buffer1] has no hidden

entries.translation_source: Oooooh\. [buffer1] has no hidden abilityyyyy\.

entries.translated:
Oooooh\. Telur tidak memiliki
kemampuaaaan\. Pilih Pokémonnnnn yang\llebih baaik\.

entries.original: "Oooooh\."
entries.translation_source: Oooooh\.
entries.translated: Oooooh\.

entries.translation_source: Hoo hoo hoo hoo hoo! Abilities, aren’t they fuuuuun? You can change them for freeeeeee in the [green]Stat Scannerrrrrrr[blue].
entries.translated:
Hoo hoo hoo hoo hoo! Kemampuan,
menyenangkaaaan, bukan? Kamu bisa\lmengubahnya secara graaaatis di

[green]Stat Scannerrrrrrr[blue].

entries.original:
"I’m a bit of a connoisseuse when it
comes to battling here.

If you can win a total of [green][buffer1][red]
battles today in the [green]Battle\lTower[red], [green]Battle Mine[red], and [green]Battle\lCircus[red] combined, I’ll grant you\lBP for your hard work."
entries.translation_source: I’m a bit of a connoisseuse when it comes to battling here. If you can win a total of [green][buffer1][red] battles today in the [green]Battle Tower[red], [green]Battle Mine[red], and [green]Battle Circus[red] combined, I’ll grant you BP for your hard work.
entries.translated:
Saya agak seorang penikmat dalam
hal bertarung di sini. Jika Anda\lbisa memenangkan total [green][buffer1][red]

pertarungan hari ini di [green]Battle
Tower[red], [green]Battle Mine[red], dan [green]Battle\lCircus[red] digabungkan, saya akan

memberi Anda BP atas kerja keras
Anda.

entries.original:
"So far, it seems you’ve won [green][buffer2][red]
battle\\07 today.

Keep it up!

You only have [green][buffer3][red] more battle\\08
to go!"
entries.translation_source: So far, it seems you’ve won [green][buffer2][red] battle\\07 today. Keep it up! You only have [green][buffer3][red] more battle\\08 to go!
entries.translated:
Sejauh ini, sepertinya Anda telah
memenangkan [green][buffer2][red] pertarungan\\07\lhari ini. Teruskan! Anda hanya

memiliki [green][buffer3][red] pertarungan\\08
lagi!

entries.original:
"Ooh, I see you have won [green][buffer2][red]
battle\\07 today.

Please, accept this BP for your
efforts!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh, I see you have won [green][buffer2][red] battle\\07 today. Please, accept this BP for your efforts!
entries.translated:
Ooh, saya lihat Anda telah
memenangkan [green][buffer2][red] pertarungan\\07\lhari ini. Silakan, terimalah BP ini

untuk usaha Anda!

entries.original:
"Every day I hope to see more lovely
win counts, just like the one you\lshowed me today."
entries.translation_source: Every day I hope to see more lovely win counts, just like the one you showed me today.
entries.translated:
Setiap hari saya berharap melihat
lebih banyak jumlah kemenangan yang\lindah, seperti yang Anda tunjukkan

kepada saya hari ini.

entries.original:
"I’ve noticed this shady guy has
been lurking outside the [green]Battle\lTower[blue] very late at night.

Word is he offers great deals, but
then swindles you.

I’d be on your guard around him."
entries.translation_source: I’ve noticed this shady guy has been lurking outside the [green]Battle Tower[blue] very late at night. Word is he offers great deals, but then swindles you. I’d be on your guard around him.
entries.translated:
Saya perhatikan orang mencurigakan
ini sering berkeliaran di luar\l[green]Battle Tower[blue] larut malam. Katanya

dia menawarkan penawaran bagus,
tetapi kemudian menipu Anda. Saya\lsarankan waspada di sekitarnya.

entries.original:
"I just love the [green]Battle Sands[red]!

Watching as others battle with your
prized Pokémon is so entertaining!

entries.translation_source: The Antisis Gym is a unique battle facility only for Single Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you choose to rest. To begin your challenge, you must enter with three Pokémon. Each Pokémon will be set to Level 50 for the challenge. Duplicate species or items may not be used. Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax, Focus Sashes, exploding moves, Destiny Bond, and Perish Song may not be used. Regigigas with the Ability Stall in addition to Pokémon banned in the [green]Standard[blue] tier may not be used.

Spesies atau item duplikat tidak

gerakan meledak, Ikatan Nasib, dan
Lagu Kematian tidak boleh\ldigunakan. Regigigas dengan Ability

Stall selain Pokémon yang dilarang
di tingkat [green]Standar[blue] tidak boleh\ldigunakan.

entries.original:
"Before each battle, your opponent’s
team will be revealed to you.

Additionally, in each battle, a
certain move type may not be used.

This will be revealed as well.

Regarding moves that change types,
the type they change into is taken\linto account.

It is at that point you must choose
a single Pokémon to fight against\lone of theirs.

For every Trainer you defeat, you
will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]).

However, do note that since this
battle facility is not part of the\lBattle Frontier, you will not earn\lany prints for your Frontier Card.

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be\lrecorded for when you wish to\lcontinue.

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: Before each battle, your opponent’s team will be revealed to you. Additionally, in each battle, a certain move type may not be used. This will be revealed as well. Regarding moves that change types, the type they change into is taken into account. It is at that point you must choose a single Pokémon to fight against one of theirs. For every Trainer you defeat, you will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]). However, do note that since this battle facility is not part of the Battle Frontier, you will not earn any prints for your Frontier Card. If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!

menyimpan, Anda akan\ldidiskualifikasi dari tantangan

Anda. Harap sadari itu!

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha ha!

So, you’re the challenger on a
hot streak in the Ring Challenge?

Should’ve known it was gonna be
you, [player]!

I revamped the whole Gym, hopin’
some of the strongest in Borrius\lwould show up\.

And now, here ya are, starin’ down
the kingpin one more time.

But make no mistake - I don’t
intend to give an inch now!

This is my turf - I’m just lettin’
ya stay here!

So, let’s see if ya still got the
mettle to take on the kingpin!"
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha ha! So, you’re the challenger on a hot streak in the Ring Challenge? Should’ve known it was gonna be you, [player]! I revamped the whole Gym, hopin’ some of the strongest in Borrius would show up\. And now, here ya are, starin’ down the kingpin one more time. But make no mistake - I don’t intend to give an inch now! This is my turf - I’m just lettin’ ya stay here! So, let’s see if ya still got the mettle to take on the kingpin!
entries.translated:
Ha ha ha ha! Jadi, kamu adalah
penantang yang sedang panas dalam\lRing Challenge? Seharusnya aku tahu

itu akan jadi kamu, [player]! Aku
merombak seluruh Gym, berharap\lbeberapa yang terkuat di Borrius

akan muncul\\. Dan sekarang, kau di
sini, menatap kingpin sekali lagi.\lTapi jangan salah - aku tidak

berniat memberi satu inci pun
sekarang! Ini wilayahku - aku hanya\lmembiarkanmu tinggal di sini! Jadi,

mari kita lihat apakah kamu masih
punya nyali untuk menghadapi\lkingpin!

entries.original:
"So, ya got this far, didja,
[player]?

Ha ha ha ha!
Must be pretty devoted, huh?

I like that - all it means is that
you’re just like me\.

Ya ain’t the type who’s gonna be
happy until you’ve proven yerself\lto be the king!

Well, that just means I gotta double
down twice as hard this time!

So come on, [player]!

The kingpin’s ending your run of
glory, right here, right now!"
entries.translation_source: So, ya got this far, didja, [player]? Ha ha ha ha! Must be pretty devoted, huh? I like that - all it means is that you’re just like me\. Ya ain’t the type who’s gonna be happy until you’ve proven yerself to be the king! Well, that just means I gotta double down twice as hard this time! So come on, [player]! The kingpin’s ending your run of glory, right here, right now!
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau sampai sejauh ini, ya,
[player]? Ha ha ha ha! Pasti sangat\lsetia, ya? Aku suka itu - itu

artinya kau sama sepertiku\\. Kau
bukan tipe orang yang akan bahagia\lsampai kau membuktikan dirimu

sebagai raja! Nah, itu berarti aku
harus berusaha dua kali lebih keras\lkali ini! Jadi ayo, [player]!

Kingpin akan mengakhiri rekor
kejayaanmu, di sini, sekarang!

entries.original:
"Well, look who just managed to put
[buffer3] money where [buffer3] mouth was.

Ha ha ha ha!
Alright, a deal’s a deal!

I’ll take ya on, mano-a-mano, one
more time, with my best Pokémon!

Don’t go thinkin’ it’s gonna go the
same way as last time, though!

I watched all your battles so far,
and I think I got ya all figured\lout by now.

So if ya think my expectations can
be blown away that easy\.

Then gimme your best shot!
Let the kingpin measure ya up!"
entries.translation_source: Well, look who just managed to put [buffer3] money where [buffer3] mouth was. Ha ha ha ha! Alright, a deal’s a deal! I’ll take ya on, mano-a-mano, one more time, with my best Pokémon! Don’t go thinkin’ it’s gonna go the same way as last time, though! I watched all your battles so far, and I think I got ya all figured out by now. So if ya think my expectations can be blown away that easy\. Then gimme your best shot! Let the kingpin measure ya up!
entries.translated:
Nah, lihat siapa yang baru saja
berhasil menempatkan [buffer3] uang\ldi mana [buffer3] bicara. Ha ha ha

ha! Oke, deal is deal! Aku akan
menghadapimu, satu lawan satu,\lsekali lagi, dengan Pokémon

terbaikku! Jangan berpikir itu akan
sama seperti terakhir kali, ya! Aku\lsudah melihat semua pertarunganmu

sejauh ini, dan kurasa aku sudah
tahu semua tentangmu sekarang. Jadi\ljika kau pikir ekspektasiku bisa

dihancurkan semudah itu\\. Maka
berikan yang terbaik! Biarkan\lkingpin mengukurmu!

entries.original:
"Gah, dangit!
I picked the wrong Pokémon\.

Or maybe ya saw it comin’ and had a
backup plan in place\.

Fine! Guess I’ll just have to hang
back and rematch ya again!

Keep that fightin’ spirit alive, and
reach for the top, [player]!

Once I know ya got [green]99 wins in a
row[blue], well then\.

Ha ha ha ha!
Well, you’re just gonna hafta see.

Catch ya later\. [player]."
entries.translation_source: Gah, dangit! I picked the wrong Pokémon\. Or maybe ya saw it comin’ and had a backup plan in place\. Fine! Guess I’ll just have to hang back and rematch ya again! Keep that fightin’ spirit alive, and reach for the top, [player]! Once I know ya got [green]99 wins in a row[blue], well then\. Ha ha ha ha! Well, you’re just gonna hafta see. Catch ya later\. [player].
entries.translated:
Gah, sial! Aku salah memilih
Pokémon\\. Atau mungkin kau sudah\lmelihatnya datang dan punya rencana

cadangan\\. Baik! Sepertinya aku
harus mundur dan bertarung lagi\ldenganmu! Jaga semangat juang itu,

dan raih puncak, [player]! Setelah
aku tahu kau punya [green]99 kemenangan\lberuntun[blue], maka\\. Ha ha ha ha! Yah,

kau harus lihat saja. Sampai jumpa
nanti\\. [player].

entries.original:
"Gah! Can’t believe ya keep on beatin’
me down!

But, don’t go thinkin’ that the next
time’s gonna go so smoothly.

There’s still plenty of time to get
cocky and screw up on one of the\llittle fish here.

But, I figure that as long as you
keep that focus\.

Then that fatty 100-win streak ya
promised me is still in your grasp!

I’m outta here.

I’ll be seein’ ya on the 100th
battle, [player]!

And next time, Big Mo’s really gonna
pull out all the stops!

I got my title of kingpin to defend,
after all! Ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! Can’t believe ya keep on beatin’ me down! But, don’t go thinkin’ that the next time’s gonna go so smoothly. There’s still plenty of time to get cocky and screw up on one of the little fish here. But, I figure that as long as you keep that focus\. Then that fatty 100-win streak ya promised me is still in your grasp! I’m outta here. I’ll be seein’ ya on the 100th battle, [player]! And next time, Big Mo’s really gonna pull out all the stops! I got my title of kingpin to defend, after all! Ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Gah! Tidak percaya kau terus
mengalahkanku! Tapi, jangan\lberpikir lain kali akan berjalan

mulus. Masih banyak waktu untuk
menjadi sombong dan gagal melawan\likan kecil di sini. Tapi, aku rasa

selama kau tetap fokus\\. Maka rekor
kemenangan 100 yang kau janjikan\litu masih dalam genggamanmu! Aku

pergi. Sampai jumpa di pertarungan
ke-100, [player]! Dan lain kali,\lBig Mo benar-benar akan mengerahkan

segalanya! Aku punya gelar kingpin
untuk dipertahankan! Ha ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Heh\. not too shabby, [player].

Never thought anyone would actually
get through the whole Ring\lChallenge, ya know?

But I guess if anyone was gonna do
it, it woulda been you.

Hey\. if ya haven’t gotten bored of
beatin’ all these weaklings\.

Then why not see just how far ya
can take that streak of yours?

If nuthin’ else, it’ll remind these
chumps just how far they gotta go!

Ha ha ha ha!
Well, catch ya later, [player]!

Next time we meet, I ain’t gonna lose
to ya again!"
entries.translation_source: Heh\. not too shabby, [player]. Never thought anyone would actually get through the whole Ring Challenge, ya know? But I guess if anyone was gonna do it, it woulda been you. Hey\. if ya haven’t gotten bored of beatin’ all these weaklings\. Then why not see just how far ya can take that streak of yours? If nuthin’ else, it’ll remind these chumps just how far they gotta go! Ha ha ha ha! Well, catch ya later, [player]! Next time we meet, I ain’t gonna lose to ya again!
entries.translated:
Heh\\. lumayan, [player]. Tidak
pernah kukira ada yang benar-benar\lmenyelesaikan seluruh Ring

Challenge, kau tahu? Tapi kurasa
jika ada yang bisa melakukannya,\litu pasti kamu. Hei\\. jika kau belum

bosan mengalahkan semua orang lemah
ini\\. Maka mengapa tidak lihat\lseberapa jauh kau bisa membawa

rekor itu? Setidaknya, itu akan
mengingatkan para pecundang ini\lseberapa jauh mereka harus pergi!

Ha ha ha ha! Yah, sampai jumpa
nanti, [player]! Lain kali kita\lbertemu, aku tidak akan kalah lagi

darimu!

entries.translation_source: Mother
entries.translated: Ibu

entries.original:
"Oh heavens\.

My daughter, I can’t find her!

We were on holiday at the [green]beach[red]
when all of a sudden, she vanished!

Please, [buffer1], search for her!"
entries.translation_source: Oh heavens\. My daughter, I can’t find her! We were on holiday at the [green]beach[red] when all of a sudden, she vanished! Please, [buffer1], search for her!
entries.translated:
Oh surga\\. Putriku, aku tidak bisa
menemukannya! Kami sedang liburan\ldi [green]pantai[red] ketika tiba-tiba, dia

menghilang! Tolong, [buffer1],
carilah dia!

entries.original:
"Thank you, [buffer1]!

As appearances go, she resembles
any ordinary [green]female Tuber[red]."
entries.translation_source: Thank you, [buffer1]! As appearances go, she resembles any ordinary [green]female Tuber[red].
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, [buffer1]! Dari
penampilannya, dia mirip [green]Tuber[red]\lwanita biasa.

entries.original:
"Oh, dear\.

What will I do now\.?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear\. What will I do now\.?
entries.translated:
Oh, sayang\\. Apa yang akan aku
lakukan sekarang\\.?

entries.original:
"Pardon me?

You say my daughter was blown away
by a strong wind?

She cannot have been blown far!

Strong winds like those aren’t
powerful enough to carry a child\loutside of the city limits.

Please, continue to search for her!"
entries.translation_source: Pardon me? You say my daughter was blown away by a strong wind? She cannot have been blown far! Strong winds like those aren’t powerful enough to carry a child outside of the city limits. Please, continue to search for her!
entries.translated:
Maaf? Kamu bilang putriku tertiup
angin kencang? Dia tidak mungkin\ltertiup jauh! Angin kencang seperti

itu tidak cukup kuat untuk membawa
seorang anak keluar dari batas\lkota. Tolong, lanjutkan mencarinya!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

My mommy left me out here
all alone\.

I don’t think she cares about
me anymore\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. My mommy left me out here all alone\. I don’t think she cares about me anymore\.
entries.translated:
Hiks\\. Ibuku meninggalkanku di sini
sendirian\\. Kupikir dia tidak peduli\llagi padaku\\.{B4}

entries.original:
"What’s that?

Did you say my mommy sent you to
find me?

Sniff\.

Maybe she really does care
about me\."
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Did you say my mommy sent you to find me? Sniff\. Maybe she really does care about me\.

entries.original:
"Okay\.

Please take me back to my mommy."
entries.translation_source: Okay\. Please take me back to my mommy.
entries.translated:
Oke\\. Tolong antar aku kembali ke
ibuku.

entries.original:
"[black]The little girl appears to have
been blown away."
entries.translation_source: [black]The little girl appears to have been blown away.
entries.translated:
[black]Gadis kecil itu sepertinya tertiup
angin.

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

This big wind blew me all the way
out here!

Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow
away again!"
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! This big wind blew me all the way out here! Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow away again!
entries.translated:
Waaaah! Angin besar ini
menerbangkanku sampai ke sini!\lBiarkan aku berpegangan padamu agar

tidak terbang lagi!

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

That big wind blew me away again!

I’m scared now\.
I wanna go home\."
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! That big wind blew me away again! I’m scared now\. I wanna go home\.
entries.translated:
Waaaah! Angin besar itu
menerbangkanku lagi! Aku takut\lsekarang\. Aku ingin pulang\.

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I hate the wind\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. I hate the wind\.
entries.translated: Hiks\. Aku benci angin\.

entries.original:
"Huh?

I’m not being blown away anymore\.

Yay!

It’s over!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? I’m not being blown away anymore\. Yay! It’s over!
entries.translated:
Hah? Aku tidak diterbangkan lagi\.
Yay! Sudah selesai!

entries.original: "I’m\. so\. dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I’m\. so\. dizzy\.
entries.translated: Aku\. sangat\. pusing\.

entries.original:
"Mommy!
You found me!

I missed you so much!
I was so scared\.

This big bad wind kept blowing me
all over!

But I’m okay now, thanks to
this person!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy! You found me! I missed you so much! I was so scared\. This big bad wind kept blowing me all over! But I’m okay now, thanks to this person!
entries.translated:
Ibu! Ibu menemukanku! Aku sangat
merindukanmu! Aku sangat takut\.\lAngin jahat besar ini terus

menerbangkanku ke mana-mana! Tapi
aku baik-baik saja sekarang, berkat\lorang ini!

entries.original:
"I wanna go home now, Mommy.
I’m really dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I wanna go home now, Mommy. I’m really dizzy\.
entries.translated:
Aku ingin pulang sekarang, Ibu. Aku
benar-benar pusing\.

entries.original: "Mommy, wait!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy, wait!
entries.translated: Ibu, tunggu!

entries.original:
"We forgot to give a gift to the
[buffer1] who helped me!"
entries.translation_source: We forgot to give a gift to the [buffer1] who helped me!
entries.translated:
Kami lupa memberikan hadiah kepada
[buffer1] yang membantuku!

entries.original: "[black][player] received $4000!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] received $4000!
entries.translated: [black][player] menerima $4000!

entries.original:
"Mommy\.

What happened to you\.?"
entries.translation_source: Mommy\. What happened to you\.?
entries.translated: Ibu\. Apa yang terjadi denganmu\.?

entries.original: "Bad Babysitter"
entries.translation_source: Bad Babysitter
entries.translated: Pengasuh yang Buruk

entries.original:
"My brother!

Please, help me!

I was babysitting him when he ran
away down the mountain!

Please, help me find him!"
entries.translation_source: My brother! Please, help me! I was babysitting him when he ran away down the mountain! Please, help me find him!
entries.translated:
Adikku! Tolong, bantu aku! Aku
sedang menjaganya ketika dia lari\lmenuruni gunung! Tolong, bantu aku

menemukannya!

entries.original:
"I can’t thank you enough!

My brother’s small, so there’s no
way he could have gone far.

My bet is he’s somewhere on
[green]Route 8[red] right about now.

And last I saw, he was wearing his
favourite [green]Pikachu costume[red]."
entries.translation_source: I can’t thank you enough! My brother’s small, so there’s no way he could have gone far. My bet is he’s somewhere on [green]Route 8[red] right about now. And last I saw, he was wearing his favourite [green]Pikachu costume[red].
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa cukup berterima
kasih! Adikku kecil, jadi tidak\lmungkin dia pergi jauh. Dugaanku

dia ada di suatu tempat di [green]Rute 8[red]
sekarang. Dan terakhir kulihat, dia\lmengenakan [green]kostum Pikachu[red]

kesayangannya.

entries.original: "My parents are going to kill me!"
entries.translation_source: My parents are going to kill me!
entries.translated: Orang tuaku akan membunuhku!

entries.original:
"My brother told me all about his
journey back up here!

You’re amazing!"
entries.translation_source: My brother told me all about his journey back up here! You’re amazing!
entries.translated:
Adikku bercerita tentang
perjalanannya kembali ke sini! Kamu\lluar biasa!

entries.original:
"That TM is my thanks for your help!
It contains [green]Return[red]!

It’s a move that gets stronger the
more your Pokémon likes you.

It’s the perfect TM for such a nice
person like you!"
entries.translation_source: That TM is my thanks for your help! It contains [green]Return[red]! It’s a move that gets stronger the more your Pokémon likes you. It’s the perfect TM for such a nice person like you!
entries.translated:
TM itu adalah ucapan terima kasihku
atas bantuanmu! Isinya [green]Return[red]! Itu\ladalah jurus yang semakin kuat

semakin Pokémonmu menyukaimu. TM
yang sempurna untuk orang baik\lsepertimu!

entries.original:
"It’s the amazing person who saved
my brother!

Thank you again!"
entries.translation_source: It’s the amazing person who saved my brother! Thank you again!
entries.translated:
Itu orang luar biasa yang
menyelamatkan adikku! Terima kasih\llagi!

entries.original: "Willy"
entries.translation_source: Willy
entries.translated: Willy

entries.original:
"Ahhh!
Please don’t eat me!"
entries.translation_source: Ahhh! Please don’t eat me!
entries.translated: Ahhh! Tolong jangan memakanku!

"Sniff\.

You’re not a Pokémon.

I thought a Pokémon was going
to eat me."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. You’re not a Pokémon. I thought a Pokémon was going to eat me.
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Kamu bukan Pokémon. Kupikir
seekor Pokémon akan memakanku.

entries.original:
"I want to go home.

I ran away from my mean sister, but
I really miss her now\."
entries.translation_source: I want to go home. I ran away from my mean sister, but I really miss her now\.
entries.translated:
Aku ingin pulang. Aku kabur dari
kakakku yang jahat, tapi sekarang\laku sangat merindukannya\.

entries.original:
"Please, take me back up to
[green]Blizzard City[blue].

I’ll follow you there."

entries.translated:

[green]Blizzard City[blue]. Aku akan mengikutimu\lke sana.

bersama Willy!

pertama[black] Pokémon yang layak dalam\ltimmu akan dipilih untuk bertarung.

I don’t think this is the right way
home\."

entries.translated:

pulang yang benar\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Sniff\.

I know the way home from here.

I had fun walking with you!
You’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Sniff\. I know the way home from here. I had fun walking with you! You’re the best!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hiks\. Aku tahu jalan pulang dari
sini. Aku senang berjalan\lbersamamu! Kamu yang terbaik!

entries.original:
"It’s you!
The big Trainer who saved me!

You’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you! The big Trainer who saved me! You’re the best!
entries.translated:
Itu kamu! Pelatih hebat yang
menyelamatkanku! Kamu yang terbaik!

entries.original: "The Black Emboar"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar
entries.translated: The Black Emboar

entries.original: "Brother"
entries.translation_source: Brother
entries.translated: Kakak

entries.original: "James"
entries.translation_source: James
entries.translated: James

entries.original: "Black Emboar Boss"
entries.translation_source: Black Emboar Boss
entries.translated: Boss Black Emboar

entries.original:
"Hey, Trainer.

\.

What? You want me to say something
interesting?

Fine, then\.

Lately, I’ve been having trouble
with my brother.

He’s gotten himself in deep with
this gang calling themselves\lthe \qoBlack Emboar\qc.

I don’t really know what it’s all
about, but I’m really worried\lfor his safety.

I haven’t spoken with him in days,
so I’m afraid something bad has\lhappened to him.

\.

What’s that?

You’d be willing to check up on
him for me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Trainer. \. What? You want me to say something interesting? Fine, then\. Lately, I’ve been having trouble with my brother. He’s gotten himself in deep with this gang calling themselves the \qoBlack Emboar\qc. I don’t really know what it’s all about, but I’m really worried for his safety. I haven’t spoken with him in days, so I’m afraid something bad has happened to him. \. What’s that? You’d be willing to check up on him for me?
entries.translated:
Hei, Pelatih. \. Apa? Kau ingin aku
mengatakan sesuatu yang menarik?\lBaiklah\. Akhir-akhir ini, aku punya

masalah dengan kakakku. Dia
terlibat dalam geng yang menyebut\ldiri mereka \qoBlack Emboar\qc. Aku

tidak begitu tahu tentang semua
itu, tapi aku sangat khawatir akan\lkeselamatannya. Aku belum berbicara

dengannya selama berhari-hari, jadi
aku takut sesuatu yang buruk telah\lterjadi padanya. \. Apa itu? Kau

bersedia mengecek keadaannya
untukku?

entries.original:
"You’re the one who barged into my
home and asked."
entries.translation_source: You’re the one who barged into my home and asked.
entries.translated:
Kaulah yang menerobos masuk ke
rumahku dan bertanya.

entries.original:
"Thank you!

You can probably find my brother
in the northern KBT Expressway.

I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of
a Trainer.

They say these Black Emboar are
insanely vicious."
entries.translation_source: Thank you! You can probably find my brother in the northern KBT Expressway. I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of a Trainer. They say these Black Emboar are insanely vicious.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih! Kau mungkin bisa
menemukan kakakku di jalan tol KBT\lbagian utara. Aku akan pergi

sendiri, tapi aku Pelatih yang
terlalu lemah. Mereka bilang Black\lEmboar ini sangat kejam.

entries.original:
"If you ever see my brother again,
please let him know that I’m still\lworried about him."
entries.translation_source: If you ever see my brother again, please let him know that I’m still worried about him.
entries.translated:
Jika kau bertemu kakakku lagi,
tolong beri tahu dia bahwa aku\lmasih khawatir padanya.

entries.original:
"What do you think you’re
up to, brat?

This is the Black Emboar’s
ultimate paradise\.

A little pest like you has no
business here\.

It couldn’t be that you think you
can stand up to me, the head of\lthe Black Emboar?"
entries.translation_source: What do you think you’re up to, brat? This is the Black Emboar’s ultimate paradise\. A little pest like you has no business here\. It couldn’t be that you think you can stand up to me, the head of the Black Emboar?
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau pikirkan, bocah? Ini
adalah surga utama Black Emboar\.\lHama kecil sepertimu tidak ada

urusan di sini\. Jangan-jangan kau
pikir kau bisa melawanku, kepala\lBlack Emboar?

entries.original:
"That all you got?

Nah, you got one option
left--get lost!

This is our place, the
Black Emboar.

We got no place else to go, and we
don’t want nobody gettin’ in our way."
entries.translation_source: That all you got? Nah, you got one option left--get lost! This is our place, the Black Emboar. We got no place else to go, and we don’t want nobody gettin’ in our way.
entries.translated:
Hanya itu yang kau punya? Tidak,
kau hanya punya satu pilihan—pergi!\lIni tempat kami, Black Emboar. Kami

tidak punya tempat lain untuk
pergi, dan kami tidak ingin ada\lyang menghalangi kami.

entries.original:
"Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it!
You’ve got your share of guts, kid!

I’ll show you what the guy who
holds the Black Emboar together\lcan really do!"
entries.translation_source: Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it! You’ve got your share of guts, kid! I’ll show you what the guy who holds the Black Emboar together can really do!
entries.translated:
Gwa ha ha ha! Ayo! Kau punya nyali,
nak! Akan kutunjukkan apa yang bisa\ldilakukan oleh orang yang

menyatukan Black Emboar!

entries.original:
"You ain’t half bad, kid\.
I like ya.

Get a loaf of this\.

From now on, our team’s name is
gonna be the Black [player]!

Yeah! We’re takin’ on your
rough and tough name!

It’s a wilder name for a
wilder team!

The Black [player]!
Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!"
entries.translation_source: You ain’t half bad, kid\. I like ya. Get a loaf of this\. From now on, our team’s name is gonna be the Black [player]! Yeah! We’re takin’ on your rough and tough name! It’s a wilder name for a wilder team! The Black [player]! Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!
entries.translated:
Kau lumayan juga, nak\. Aku suka kau.
Coba lihat ini\. Mulai sekarang, nama\ltim kami akan menjadi Black

[player]! Yeah! Kami memakai namamu
yang keras dan tangguh! Nama yang\llebih liar untuk tim yang lebih

liar! Black [player]! Gwa ha ha ha!
Itu keren!

entries.original:
"What, you want somethin’ else, kid?

\.

My bro?

Geez, that punk never quits.

Alright, as a favour to you for
beatin’ me, I’ll go with you."
entries.translation_source: What, you want somethin’ else, kid? \. My bro? Geez, that punk never quits. Alright, as a favour to you for beatin’ me, I’ll go with you.
entries.translated:
Apa, kau mau yang lain, nak? \.
Kakakku? Ya ampun, bocah itu tidak\lpernah menyerah. Baiklah, sebagai

bantuan untukmu karena
mengalahkanku, aku akan pergi\lbersamamu.

entries.original:
"I’ve told you time and time again,
bro, quit tryin’ to mess with\lthe Black Emboar!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve told you time and time again, bro, quit tryin’ to mess with the Black Emboar!
entries.translated:
Aku sudah bilang berkali-kali, bro,
berhenti coba-coba main-main dengan\lBlack Emboar!

entries.original:
"I can’t, James.
You’re my brother.

You mean everything to me.

And I can’t let you go down this
path any longer!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t, James. You’re my brother. You mean everything to me. And I can’t let you go down this path any longer!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa, James. Kau adalah
saudaraku. Kau berarti segalanya\lbagiku. Dan aku tidak bisa

membiarkanmu terus di jalan ini!

entries.original:
"You claim you care about me, but
you really ain’t got no guts, bro.

You keep sendin’ these Trainers to
harass me ’cause you’re too scared\lto get your own hands dirty."
entries.translation_source: You claim you care about me, but you really ain’t got no guts, bro. You keep sendin’ these Trainers to harass me ’cause you’re too scared to get your own hands dirty.
entries.translated:
Kau mengaku peduli padaku, tapi kau
benar-benar tidak punya nyali, bro.\lKau terus mengirim Pelatih-Pelatih

ini untuk menggangguku karena kau
terlalu takut untuk mengotori\ltanganmu sendiri.

entries.original: "This kid, [player]’s got guts!"
entries.translation_source: This kid, [player]’s got guts!
entries.translated: Anak ini, [player] punya nyali!

entries.original:
"Let me tell ya!

No one has ever wrecked me as good
as [buffer2] did!

I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar
to the Black [player], after [buffer1]!

So it’s time for a fresh start.

The Black [player] and I are movin’
to Antisis City!

I hear the old gang that used to
run that joint got ran outta town.

Terror Granbull, somethin’
or other\.

Now that city is ripe for the
pickin’ by the Black [player]!

Gwa ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Let me tell ya! No one has ever wrecked me as good as [buffer2] did! I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar to the Black [player], after [buffer1]! So it’s time for a fresh start. The Black [player] and I are movin’ to Antisis City! I hear the old gang that used to run that joint got ran outta town. Terror Granbull, somethin’ or other\. Now that city is ripe for the pickin’ by the Black [player]! Gwa ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Biarkan kuberitahu! Tidak ada yang
pernah menghancurkanku sebaik\l[buffer2]! Aku bahkan telah

mengganti nama Black Emboar menjadi
Black [player], setelah [buffer1]!\lJadi saatnya untuk awal yang baru.

Black [player] dan aku pindah ke
Kota Antisis! Kudengar geng lama\lyang dulu menguasai tempat itu

sudah diusir dari kota. Terror
Granbull, atau sesuatu\. Sekarang\lkota itu siap untuk dipetik oleh

Black [player]! Gwa ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"But James, you can’t just
leave me all alone!"
entries.translation_source: But James, you can’t just leave me all alone!
entries.translated:
Tapi James, kau tidak bisa
meninggalkanku sendirian!

entries.original:
"I thought about makin’ you one of
us too, but I can’t have someone\lwho’s so weak in my squad!

Instead, I’ve decided to let [player]
join our ranks."
entries.translation_source: I thought about makin’ you one of us too, but I can’t have someone who’s so weak in my squad! Instead, I’ve decided to let [player] join our ranks.
entries.translated:
Aku sempat berpikir untuk
menjadikanmu salah satu dari kami\ljuga, tapi aku tidak bisa menerima

seseorang yang begitu lemah di
skuadku! Sebaliknya, aku memutuskan\luntuk membiarkan [player] bergabung

dengan barisan kami.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Black [player], kid!

All members gotta have a Bike,
so take this."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Black [player], kid! All members gotta have a Bike, so take this.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Black [player],
nak! Semua anggota harus punya\lSepeda, jadi ambil ini.

entries.original:
"That’s a powerful Motorbike all
members of the Black [player] own!

You can press \btn02 to activate the
turbo boost, or you can take it\leasy and pedal.

Look us up if you ever come
by Antisis City.

We’ll welcome you with open arms."
entries.translation_source: That’s a powerful Motorbike all members of the Black [player] own! You can press \btn02 to activate the turbo boost, or you can take it easy and pedal. Look us up if you ever come by Antisis City. We’ll welcome you with open arms.
entries.translated:
Itu Motor yang kuat milik semua
anggota Black [player]! Kau bisa\ltekan \btn02 untuk mengaktifkan turbo

boost, atau kau bisa santai dan
mengayuh. Cari kami jika kau pernah\ldatang ke Kota Antisis. Kami akan

menyambutmu dengan tangan terbuka.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Black [player], kid!

Look us up if you ever come
by Antisis City.

We’ll welcome you with open arms."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Black [player], kid! Look us up if you ever come by Antisis City. We’ll welcome you with open arms.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Black [player],
nak! Cari kami jika kau pernah\ldatang ke Kota Antisis. Kami akan

menyambutmu dengan tangan terbuka.

entries.original:
"Sorry you got caught up in
all of that.

I may have lied when I told you I
hadn’t heard from my brother.

In truth, I knew he was the leader
of the Black Emboar.

I just thought you wouldn’t have
wanted to help if you knew you’d\lbe going up against their leader.

But now he’s gone for good, and
I’m left all alone\.

I feel so sheepish about this\.

Anyway, thank you for helping me.

Please take this TM for your time."
entries.translation_source: Sorry you got caught up in all of that. I may have lied when I told you I hadn’t heard from my brother. In truth, I knew he was the leader of the Black Emboar. I just thought you wouldn’t have wanted to help if you knew you’d be going up against their leader. But now he’s gone for good, and I’m left all alone\. I feel so sheepish about this\. Anyway, thank you for helping me. Please take this TM for your time.
entries.translated:
Maaf kau terlibat dalam semua itu.
Mungkin aku berbohong ketika\lmengatakan aku tidak mendengar

kabar dari saudaraku. Sebenarnya,
aku tahu dia adalah pemimpin Black\lEmboar. Aku hanya berpikir kau

tidak akan mau membantu jika tahu
kau akan melawan pemimpin mereka.\lTapi sekarang dia sudah pergi

selamanya, dan aku ditinggalkan
sendirian\. Aku merasa sangat malu\ltentang ini\. Bagaimanapun, terima

kasih telah membantuku. Silakan
ambil TM ini sebagai imbalan atas\lwaktumu.

entries.original:
"Hey!
Yeah, you, the little brat there!

Get over here!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Yeah, you, the little brat there! Get over here!
entries.translated:
Hei! Ya, kau, bocah kecil di sana!
Kemari!

entries.original:
"Hey!
Who said ya can pass through here?

This place belongs to us, the
Black Emboar!

It’s like our Gym, kid!

So scram! Toddle off home to your
ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This place belongs to us, the Black Emboar! It’s like our Gym, kid! So scram! Toddle off home to your ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!
entries.translated:
Hei! Siapa bilang kau bisa lewat
sini? Tempat ini milik kami, Black\lEmboar! Ini seperti Gym kami, nak!

Jadi pergilah! Pulang ke ibumu, kau
bocah culun!

entries.original:
"Ha! Fine!

Brats like you with a future
so bright\.

Just go on back home, and be nice
to your parents.

Don’t forget your baby bottle!"
entries.translation_source: Ha! Fine! Brats like you with a future so bright\. Just go on back home, and be nice to your parents. Don’t forget your baby bottle!
entries.translated:
Ha! Baik! Bocah sepertimu dengan
masa depan yang cerah\. Pulang saja\lke rumah, dan bersikap baik pada

orang tuamu. Jangan lupa botol
bayimu!

entries.original:
"What didja say, ya little creep?

I’ll teach ya to take the Black
Emboar seriously!

I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon
right down to the ground!

With relish!"
entries.translation_source: What didja say, ya little creep? I’ll teach ya to take the Black Emboar seriously! I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon right down to the ground! With relish!
entries.translated:
Apa katamu, kau bocah menjijikkan?
Aku akan mengajarimu untuk\lmenganggap serius Black Emboar! Aku

akan menghajar Pokémon cantikmu
sampai jatuh ke tanah! Dengan\lsenang hati!

entries.original:
"Don’t get all high and mighty
because you beat me!

If you really want to pick a fight
with the Black Emboar, go duke\lit out with our leader!

He’s somewhere in this tunnel!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t get all high and mighty because you beat me! If you really want to pick a fight with the Black Emboar, go duke it out with our leader! He’s somewhere in this tunnel!
entries.translated:
Jangan sombong hanya karena kau
mengalahkanku! Jika kau benar-benar\lingin bertarung dengan Black

Emboar, hadapilah pemimpin kami!
Dia ada di suatu tempat di\lterowongan ini!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass
through here?

This is Black Emboar territory!

Go back to where you came from!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This is Black Emboar territory! Go back to where you came from!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hei! Siapa bilang kau bisa lewat
sini? Ini wilayah Black Emboar!\lKembali ke asalmu!

entries.original: "Get lost, punk."
entries.translation_source: Get lost, punk.
entries.translated: Pergi, punk.

entries.original: "We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Emboar, kau
brengsek!

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar won’t fall
so easily!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar won’t fall so easily!
entries.translated:
Black Emboar tidak akan jatuh
semudah itu!

entries.original:
"Hey, hey, kid!
It’s dangerous!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, hey, kid! It’s dangerous!
entries.translated: Hei, hei, nak! Berbahaya!

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar!
Never stop, and never look back!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar! Never stop, and never look back!
entries.translated:
Black Emboar! Jangan pernah
berhenti, dan jangan pernah menoleh\lke belakang!

entries.original:
"Whad’ya want kid?

We’re busy!"
entries.translation_source: Whad’ya want kid? We’re busy!
entries.translated: Mau apa, nak? Kami sibuk!

entries.original:
"[player]!

You made it!
Welcome to the Black [player] HQ!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! You made it! Welcome to the Black [player] HQ!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kau berhasil! Selamat
datang di Markas Black [player]!

entries.original:
"It don’t look like much right now,
but I’m tellin’ you, once we take\lout those Black Ferrothorns, we’ll\lfix the place right up.

Of course, we’d be happy if you
stuck around and helped us deal\lwith those losers.

I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof
strategy for our attack, so in the\lmeantime, why don’t you help your\lfellow Black [player] out?"
entries.translation_source: It don’t look like much right now, but I’m tellin’ you, once we take out those Black Ferrothorns, we’ll fix the place right up. Of course, we’d be happy if you stuck around and helped us deal with those losers. I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof strategy for our attack, so in the meantime, why don’t you help your fellow Black [player] out?
entries.translated:
Saat ini kelihatannya memang belum
seberapa, tapi percaya deh, begitu\lkita singkirkan Black Ferrothorn

itu, kita akan membenahi tempat ini
dengan baik. Tentu saja, kami akan\lsenang jika kau tetap di sini dan

membantu kami menghadapi para
pecundang itu. Aku sibuk menyusun\lstrategi yang anti-gagal untuk

serangan kita, jadi sementara itu,
kenapa kau tidak membantu sesama\langgota Black [player]?

entries.original:
"You’re just in time, [player].

We figured out how we’re gonna take
down those Black Ferrothorns.

We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and
attack from the sewers.

Gwa ha ha ha!

Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t
know what hit em’!"
entries.translation_source: You’re just in time, [player]. We figured out how we’re gonna take down those Black Ferrothorns. We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and attack from the sewers. Gwa ha ha ha! Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t know what hit em’!
entries.translated:
Kau datang tepat waktu, [player].
Kami sudah tahu cara menjatuhkan\lBlack Ferrothorn itu. Kami akan

melakukan aksi berani dan menyerang
dari saluran pembuangan. Gwa ha ha\lha! Potongan daging sombong itu

tidak akan tahu apa yang menimpa
mereka!

entries.original:
"Boys! Mount your bikes!
We’re goin’ to the sewers!"
entries.translation_source: Boys! Mount your bikes! We’re goin’ to the sewers!
entries.translated:
Anak-anak! Naik sepeda kalian! Kita
pergi ke saluran pembuangan!

entries.original:
"I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof
strategy for our attack against the\lBlack Ferrothorns.

In the meantime, why don’t you
help your fellow Black [player]\lout?"
entries.translation_source: I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof strategy for our attack against the Black Ferrothorns. In the meantime, why don’t you help your fellow Black [player] out?
entries.translated:
Aku sibuk menyusun strategi
anti-gagal untuk serangan kita\lterhadap Black Ferrothorn.

Sementara itu, kenapa kau tidak
membantu sesama anggota Black\l[player]?

entries.original:
"Before we moved in, this base
belonged to the old gang that used\lto run Antisis City.

After the Black Ferrothorn kicked
’em out, they left this base\lripe for the takin’.

We fixed it up real nice since we
got here, and we even replaced the\lplugged up hole to the sewers with\lactual stairs!"
entries.translation_source: Before we moved in, this base belonged to the old gang that used to run Antisis City. After the Black Ferrothorn kicked ’em out, they left this base ripe for the takin’. We fixed it up real nice since we got here, and we even replaced the plugged up hole to the sewers with actual stairs!
entries.translated:
Sebelum kami pindah, markas ini
milik geng lama yang dulu menguasai\lAntisis City. Setelah Black

Ferrothorn mengusir mereka, mereka
meninggalkan markas ini begitu saja\luntuk diambil. Kami memperbaikinya

dengan sangat bagus sejak kami
tiba, dan kami bahkan mengganti\llubang yang tersumbat ke saluran

pembuangan dengan tangga asli!

entries.original:
"We’re comin’ up with a strategy to
take down the Black Ferrothorn."
entries.translation_source: We’re comin’ up with a strategy to take down the Black Ferrothorn.
entries.translated:
Kami sedang menyusun strategi untuk
menjatuhkan Black Ferrothorn.

entries.original:
"When we get rid of those Black
Ferrothorns, I’m gonna take one of\ltheir couches for myself.

I bet they have a boatload in that
fancy base of theirs!"
entries.translation_source: When we get rid of those Black Ferrothorns, I’m gonna take one of their couches for myself. I bet they have a boatload in that fancy base of theirs!
entries.translated:
Begitu kita menyingkirkan Black
Ferrothorn itu, aku akan mengambil\lsalah satu sofa mereka untukku

sendiri. Pasti mereka punya banyak
di markas mewah mereka!

entries.original: "Flushed Away"
entries.translation_source: Flushed Away
entries.translated: Terhanyut

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], buddy, how’s
it hangin’?

Listen, [player], the other day
I\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 accidentally flushed my\lfavourite pair of socks down the\ldrain.

I went down to the sewers to go
look for ’em, but I just couldn’t\lfind ’em for the life of me.

Now, I know what you must be
thinkin’.

Why were my socks in the toilet
in the first place?

Well\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 that doesn’t really
matter so much\.

So, I was thinkin’, maybe you could
have a go at searchin’ for me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player], buddy, how’s it hangin’? Listen, [player], the other day I\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 accidentally flushed my favourite pair of socks down the drain. I went down to the sewers to go look for ’em, but I just couldn’t find ’em for the life of me. Now, I know what you must be thinkin’. Why were my socks in the toilet in the first place? Well\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 that doesn’t really matter so much\. So, I was thinkin’, maybe you could have a go at searchin’ for me?
entries.translated:
Hei, [player], sobat, gimana
kabarnya? Dengar, [player],\lbeberapa hari yang lalu aku\.\CC0818 eh\.\CC0818

tidak sengaja menyiram kaus kaki
favoritku ke saluran pembuangan.\lAku turun ke saluran pembuangan

untuk mencarinya, tapi aku
benar-benar tidak bisa\lmenemukannya. Nah, aku tahu apa

yang mungkin kau pikirkan. Kenapa
kaus kakiku ada di toilet? Yah\.\CC0818 eh\.\CC0818\litu tidak terlalu penting\. Jadi, aku

berpikir, mungkin kau bisa mencoba
mencarikannya untukku?

entries.original:
"Thanks, [player].
I knew I could count on you.

You can use the staircase that leads
down in the corner, or you can just\luse the main entrance outside."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, [player]. I knew I could count on you. You can use the staircase that leads down in the corner, or you can just use the main entrance outside.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, [player]. Aku tahu
aku bisa mengandalkanmu. Kau bisa\lmenggunakan tangga yang turun di

sudut, atau kau bisa menggunakan
pintu masuk utama di luar.

entries.original:
"You found ’em!

But oh man, do they reek!"
entries.translation_source: You found ’em! But oh man, do they reek!
entries.translated:
Kau menemukannya! Tapi ya ampun,
baunya busuk sekali!

entries.original:
"Uh\.\CC0818 oh, yeah\.

I should probably give you
somethin’ for your trouble.

I wiped that grime off of my socks,
but I don’t know where to get rid\lof it.

I’m sure you can find a better
place for it than I could."
entries.translation_source: Uh\.\CC0818 oh, yeah\. I should probably give you somethin’ for your trouble. I wiped that grime off of my socks, but I don’t know where to get rid of it. I’m sure you can find a better place for it than I could.
entries.translated:
Uh\.\CC0818 oh, ya\. Aku sebaiknya memberimu
sesuatu sebagai imbalan. Aku sudah\lmembersihkan kotoran dari kaus

kakiku, tapi aku tidak tahu harus
membuangnya ke mana. Aku yakin kau\lbisa menemukan tempat yang lebih

baik daripada aku.

entries.original:
"I need you to find my socks,
[player]!

They’re probably covered in grime
’cause you know, they’re in the\lsewers.

I betcha they won’t be easy to spot
just by lookin’.

You can use the staircase that
leads down to the sewers in the\lcorner, or you can just use the\lmain entrance outside."
entries.translation_source: I need you to find my socks, [player]! They’re probably covered in grime ’cause you know, they’re in the sewers. I betcha they won’t be easy to spot just by lookin’. You can use the staircase that leads down to the sewers in the corner, or you can just use the main entrance outside.
entries.translated:
Aku perlu kau menemukan kaus
kakiku, [player]! Mungkin kaus itu\lpenuh dengan kotoran karena, tahu

kan, mereka ada di saluran
pembuangan. Aku yakin tidak akan\lmudah ditemukan hanya dengan

melihat. Kau bisa menggunakan
tangga yang turun ke saluran\lpembuangan di sudut, atau kau bisa

menggunakan pintu masuk utama di
luar.

entries.original:
"I don’t blame you, [player].
No hard feelin’s.

I’ll just have to live without
my favourite pair of socks from\lnow on\.

Sniff\."
entries.translation_source: I don’t blame you, [player]. No hard feelin’s. I’ll just have to live without my favourite pair of socks from now on\. Sniff\.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak menyalahkanmu, [player].
Tidak ada sakit hati. Aku harus\lhidup tanpa kaus kaki favoritku

mulai sekarang\. Hiks\.

entries.original:
"ut
my favourite pair of socks from\lnow on\.

Sniff\."
entries.translation_source: ut my favourite pair of socks from now on\. Sniff\.
entries.translated:
ut kaus kaki favoritku mulai
sekarang\. Hiks\.

entries.original:
"I put my socks right on without
even washin’ ’em!

That’s how excited I am to have
’em back."
entries.translation_source: I put my socks right on without even washin’ ’em! That’s how excited I am to have ’em back.
entries.translated:
Aku langsung memakai kaus kakiku
tanpa mencucinya! Itulah betapa\lsenangnya aku mendapatkannya

kembali.

entries.original: "A Minor Scrap"
entries.translation_source: A Minor Scrap
entries.translated: Perkelahian Kecil

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], you wanna help out
with a little problem I’m havin’\lwith them Black Ferrothorn?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player], you wanna help out with a little problem I’m havin’ with them Black Ferrothorn?
entries.translated:
Hei, [player], kamu mau bantu aku
dengan masalah kecil yang aku\lhadapi dengan Black Ferrothorn itu?

entries.original:
"Here’s the low down.

I was fightin’ these goons to
expand our turf a while back,\lbut they totally wrecked me.

I dunno how they pulled it off, but
I was beatin’ ’em the whole time\.\luntil suddenly, I wasn’t.

I really wanna put ’em in their
place and expand our turf, but I\ljust ain’t strong enough.

You think you can take ’em both
out for me?"
entries.translation_source: Here’s the low down. I was fightin’ these goons to expand our turf a while back, but they totally wrecked me. I dunno how they pulled it off, but I was beatin’ ’em the whole time\. until suddenly, I wasn’t. I really wanna put ’em in their place and expand our turf, but I just ain’t strong enough. You think you can take ’em both out for me?
entries.translated:
Ini ceritanya. Aku sedang melawan
para brengsek itu untuk memperluas\lwilayah kami beberapa waktu lalu,

tapi mereka benar-benar
menghancurkan aku. Aku tidak tahu\lbagaimana mereka melakukannya, tapi

aku mengalahkan mereka sepanjang
waktu \. sampai tiba-tiba aku kalah.\lAku benar-benar ingin membuat

mereka jera dan memperluas wilayah
kami, tapi aku tidak cukup kuat.\lMenurutmu kamu bisa mengalahkan

mereka berdua untukku?

entries.original:
"You’re gutsy, [player].

I’ll take you to ’em now.

Hope you’re ready!"
entries.translation_source: You’re gutsy, [player]. I’ll take you to ’em now. Hope you’re ready!
entries.translated:
Kamu pemberani, [player]. Aku akan
membawamu ke mereka sekarang.\lSemoga kamu siap!

entries.original:
"Hmph.

Where’s those \qoguts\qc James keeps
goin’ on about?"
entries.translation_source: Hmph. Where’s those \qoguts\qc James keeps goin’ on about?
entries.translated:
Hmph. Di mana \qonyali\qc yang selalu
dibicarakan James?

entries.original:
"Bein’ the lowlives they are,
they’re probably gonna team up\lon you.

You should get a least two Pokémon
ready to fight, just in case they\ldo."
entries.translation_source: Bein’ the lowlives they are, they’re probably gonna team up on you. You should get a least two Pokémon ready to fight, just in case they do.
entries.translated:
Menjadi sampah seperti mereka,
mereka mungkin akan bekerja sama\lmelawanmu. Kamu harus menyiapkan

setidaknya dua Pokémon untuk
bertarung, untuk berjaga-jaga.

entries.original:
"You ready to give it another shot,
[player]?

Those goons need to be put in
their place."
entries.translation_source: You ready to give it another shot, [player]? Those goons need to be put in their place.
entries.translated:
Kamu siap mencoba lagi, [player]?
Para brengsek itu perlu dibuat\ljera.

entries.original:
"You really showed those Black
Ferrothorn goons, [player].

The bridge outside our base is now
totally under our control.

You’ve done it, [player].

Thanks to you, I’ve expanded our
turf just a little more.

You really are the gutsiest Trainer
I know."
entries.translation_source: You really showed those Black Ferrothorn goons, [player]. The bridge outside our base is now totally under our control. You’ve done it, [player]. Thanks to you, I’ve expanded our turf just a little more. You really are the gutsiest Trainer I know.
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar menunjukkan
kehebatanmu pada para brengsek\lBlack Ferrothorn, [player].

Jembatan di luar markas kami
sekarang sepenuhnya di bawah\lkendali kami. Kamu berhasil,

[player]. Berkatmu, aku bisa
memperluas wilayah kami sedikit\llagi. Kamu benar-benar Pelatih

paling pemberani yang aku kenal.

entries.original:
"[green]Power Items[blue] are essential for any
gutsy Trainer.

They make trainin’ your Pokémon to
be strong a lot easier."
entries.translation_source: [green]Power Items[blue] are essential for any gutsy Trainer. They make trainin’ your Pokémon to be strong a lot easier.
entries.translated:
[green]Item Kekuatan[blue] sangat penting bagi
Pelatih yang pemberani. Mereka\lmembuat melatih Pokémonmu menjadi

lebih kuat jadi lebih mudah.

entries.original:
"Those goons’ll be leavin’ that
bridge alone for a while now.

Thanks, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Those goons’ll be leavin’ that bridge alone for a while now. Thanks, [player].
entries.translated:
Para brengsek itu akan meninggalkan
jembatan itu untuk sementara.\lTerima kasih, [player].

entries.original: "Rory"
entries.translation_source: Rory
entries.translated: Rory

entries.original: "Chad"
entries.translation_source: Chad
entries.translated: Chad

entries.original:
"Hey, Black Ferrothorn bozos!
I’m here for a rematch!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Black Ferrothorn bozos! I’m here for a rematch!
entries.translated:
Hei, para bodoh Black Ferrothorn!
Aku di sini untuk tanding ulang!

entries.original:
"You hear that, Chad?

This weak punk honestly thinks he
can beat us!

Does he not remember the beatin’
we gave him last time?"
