entries.translation_source: You hear that, Chad? This weak punk honestly thinks he can beat us! Does he not remember the beatin’ we gave him last time?
entries.translated:
Kau dengar itu, Chad? Pengecut
lemah ini benar-benar mengira dia\lbisa mengalahkan kita! Apa dia

tidak ingat kekalahan yang kita
berikan padanya terakhir kali?

entries.original:
"Oh, I aint gonna be doin’ any
fightin’.

My pal, [player], here, is gonna
destroy youse guys for me!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I aint gonna be doin’ any fightin’. My pal, [player], here, is gonna destroy youse guys for me!
entries.translated:
Oh, aku tidak akan bertarung.
Temanku, [player], di sini, akan\lmenghancurkan kalian untukku!

entries.original:
"Is that so?

Well, then we’re just gonna have to
pummel [buffer1] into the ground!"
entries.translation_source: Is that so? Well, then we’re just gonna have to pummel [buffer1] into the ground!
entries.translated:
Begitu ya? Kalau begitu, kami harus
menghajar [buffer1] sampai babak\lbelur!

entries.original:
"Chad! Gimme your Pokémon!

I’m gonna take [buffer1] down with our
combined might!"
entries.translation_source: Chad! Gimme your Pokémon! I’m gonna take [buffer1] down with our combined might!
entries.translated:
Chad! Berikan Pokémonmu! Aku akan
menjatuhkan [buffer1] dengan\lkekuatan gabungan kita!

entries.original:
"Go do this, man!

Rock their socks off, and toss ’em
down the drain!"
entries.translation_source: Go do this, man! Rock their socks off, and toss ’em down the drain!
entries.translated:
Ayo lakukan ini, bung! Buat mereka
terkesan, dan buang mereka ke\lsaluran pembuangan!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!

You think you got what it takes to
mess with both our Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! You think you got what it takes to mess with both our Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Ferrothorn! Kamu
pikir kamu mampu melawan kedua\lPokémon kami?

entries.original:
"Come on, man!
How could this happen?"
entries.translation_source: Come on, man! How could this happen?
entries.translated:
Ayolah, bung! Bagaimana ini bisa
terjadi?

entries.original:
"Wha\.\CC0820 you shouldn’t be able
to beat the Black Ferrothorn!

Our hides are iron thick!"
entries.translation_source: Wha\.\CC0820 you shouldn’t be able to beat the Black Ferrothorn! Our hides are iron thick!
entries.translated:
Wha\.\CC0820 seharusnya kau tidak bisa
mengalahkan Black Ferrothorn! Kulit\lkami setebal besi!

entries.original:
"Chad! Take your dumb Pokémon
back!

We’re gonna use those enhancers we
got off those dumb scientists."
entries.translation_source: Chad! Take your dumb Pokémon back! We’re gonna use those enhancers we got off those dumb scientists.
entries.translated:
Chad! Ambil kembali Pokémon
bodohmu! Kami akan menggunakan\lpenguat yang kami dapat dari para

ilmuwan bodoh itu.

entries.original:
"You didn’t stand a chance before,
so you definitely don’t stand a\lchance now!

We’re gonna teach you what Pokémon
belongin’ to us Black Ferrothorn\lare really capable of!"
entries.translation_source: You didn’t stand a chance before, so you definitely don’t stand a chance now! We’re gonna teach you what Pokémon belongin’ to us Black Ferrothorn are really capable of!
entries.translated:
Kau tidak punya peluang sebelumnya,
jadi pasti tidak punya peluang\lsekarang! Kami akan mengajarimu apa

yang bisa dilakukan Pokémon milik
kami Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"Now you see who’s the real toughest
gang around here!

Your hides aren’t thick, they’re as
soft as a Smoochum!

Now, get out of here before I sic
[player] on you, again!"
entries.translation_source: Now you see who’s the real toughest gang around here! Your hides aren’t thick, they’re as soft as a Smoochum! Now, get out of here before I sic [player] on you, again!
entries.translated:
Sekarang kau lihat siapa geng
terkuat di sini! Kulitmu tidak\ltebal, mereka selembut Smoochum!

Sekarang, pergi dari sini sebelum
kusuruh [player] menyerangmu lagi!

entries.original: "Barbs’ll make you all pay for this!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs’ll make you all pay for this!
entries.translated:
Barbs akan membuat kalian semua
membayar untuk ini!

entries.original:
"You’re one gutsy Trainer,
[player]!

I dunno anyone else who woulda had
the guts to take on two Trainers\lwith pumped up Pokémon at once!

Ya know what\. come back to the
base an’ I’ll give you a little\lsomethin’ for your help."
entries.translation_source: You’re one gutsy Trainer, [player]! I dunno anyone else who woulda had the guts to take on two Trainers with pumped up Pokémon at once! Ya know what\. come back to the base an’ I’ll give you a little somethin’ for your help.
entries.translated:
Kau pelatih yang pemberani,
[player]! Aku tidak tahu siapa lagi\lyang berani melawan dua Pelatih

dengan Pokémon yang dikuatkan
sekaligus! Kau tahu\. kembali ke\lmarkas dan aku akan memberimu

sesuatu kecil untuk bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"Back for more, wimps?

Then, let’s pummel you into the
ground another time!"
entries.translation_source: Back for more, wimps? Then, let’s pummel you into the ground another time!
entries.translated:
Kembali untuk lebih, pengecut?
Kalau begitu, mari kita hancurkan\lkalian lagi!

entries.original: "Odd Odd Docks"
entries.translation_source: Odd Odd Docks
entries.translated: Dermaga Odd Odd

entries.original:
"[player], my [buffer1]!

I got a shipment of uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense
comin’ in to the [green]Antisis Port[blue] one\lof these nights.

But it’s too hard for me to sneak
’em off the port on my own.

That’s where you come in.

You’re gonna meet me at the docks,
pick up the shipment, and smuggle\lit back to the base.

Capisce?"
entries.translation_source: [player], my [buffer1]! I got a shipment of uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense comin’ in to the [green]Antisis Port[blue] one of these nights. But it’s too hard for me to sneak ’em off the port on my own. That’s where you come in. You’re gonna meet me at the docks, pick up the shipment, and smuggle it back to the base. Capisce?
entries.translated:
[player], [buffer1]ku! Aku punya
kiriman uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense yang akan\ltiba di [green]Pelabuhan Antisis[blue] suatu

malam. Tapi terlalu sulit bagiku
untuk menyelundupkannya sendiri. Di\lsitulah kau masuk. Kau akan

menemuiku di dermaga, mengambil
kiriman itu, dan menyelundupkannya\lkembali ke markas. Mengerti?

entries.original:
"Aww\.

Why you gotta be like that,
[player]?

I thought we’re like family now!"
entries.translation_source: Aww\. Why you gotta be like that, [player]? I thought we’re like family now!
entries.translated:
Aww\. Kenapa kau harus seperti itu,
[player]? Kupikir kita seperti\lkeluarga sekarang!

entries.original:
"Perfecto.

Meet me down at the docks sometime
between [green]8 PM[blue] and [green]12 AM[blue] tonight.

Come any later than midnight, and
my shipment will be sold elsewhere.

Can’t have that, can we?"
entries.translation_source: Perfecto. Meet me down at the docks sometime between [green]8 PM[blue] and [green]12 AM[blue] tonight. Come any later than midnight, and my shipment will be sold elsewhere. Can’t have that, can we?
entries.translated:
Sempurna. Temui aku di dermaga
antara [green]8 malam[blue] dan [green]12 tengah malam[blue]\lnanti. Datang lebih dari tengah

malam, dan kirimanku akan dijual di
tempat lain. Tidak bisa begitu,\lkan?

entries.original:
"\.What?

You don’t wanna wait until tonight?

Then just change your clock’s hour
or somethin’, my [buffer1].

I won’t tell if you won’t.

But make sure you don’t change
the date!

Just the hour, otherwise who knows
what’d get messed up."
entries.translation_source: \.What? You don’t wanna wait until tonight? Then just change your clock’s hour or somethin’, my [buffer1]. I won’t tell if you won’t. But make sure you don’t change the date! Just the hour, otherwise who knows what’d get messed up.
entries.translated:
\.Apa? Kau tidak mau menunggu sampai
malam? Kalau begitu, ubah saja jam\ljam tanganmu atau sesuatu,

[buffer1]ku. Aku tidak akan bilang
jika kau tidak. Tapi pastikan kau\ltidak mengubah tanggal! Hanya

jamnya, entah apa yang bisa kacau.

entries.original:
"What are we still doing here,
[player]?

We better get going to the [green]docks[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: What are we still doing here, [player]? We better get going to the [green]docks[blue]!
entries.translated:
Apa yang masih kita lakukan di
sini, [player]? Lebih baik kita\lpergi ke [green]dermaga[blue]!

entries.original:
"I stashed the Oddish Leaves in
between some crates on the [green]west[blue]\lside of the port.

Use one of dem fancy [green]Dowsing
Machines[blue] or somethin’ to find ’em.

Oh, and the spot I hid ’em in ain’t
ever gonna be blocked off by a\lbarrier, so don’t bother lookin’\lanywhere that can be blocked off.

Capisce?"
entries.translation_source: I stashed the Oddish Leaves in between some crates on the [green]west[blue] side of the port. Use one of dem fancy [green]Dowsing Machines[blue] or somethin’ to find ’em. Oh, and the spot I hid ’em in ain’t ever gonna be blocked off by a barrier, so don’t bother lookin’ anywhere that can be blocked off. Capisce?
entries.translated:
Aku menyembunyikan Daun Oddish di
antara beberapa peti di sisi [green]barat[blue]\lpelabuhan. Gunakan salah satu [green]Mesin

Dowsing[blue] mewah atau sesuatu untuk
menemukannya. Oh, dan tempat aku\lmenyembunyikannya tidak akan pernah

terhalang oleh penghalang, jadi
jangan repot-repot mencari di\ltempat yang bisa terhalang.

Mengerti?

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha!

I knew if anyone could do it,
you could!

Now hand over dem Oddish Leaves."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha! I knew if anyone could do it, you could! Now hand over dem Oddish Leaves.
entries.translated:
Ha ha ha! Aku tahu jika ada yang
bisa melakukannya, kau bisa!\lSekarang serahkan Daun Oddish itu.

entries.original:
"Whoa\.

Sniffin’ on those leaves really
clears the mind\."
entries.translation_source: Whoa\. Sniffin’ on those leaves really clears the mind\.
entries.translated:
Whoa\. Menghirup daun itu benar-benar
menjernihkan pikiran\.

entries.original: "[black]The goon is feeling tougher!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The goon is feeling tougher!
entries.translated: [black]Preman itu merasa lebih kuat!

entries.original:
"You know what?
I know a guy up in Dresco Town.

He’s able to turn these Oddish
Leaves into a fine kind of mist.

Hows about I share some with you
for your effort?"
entries.translation_source: You know what? I know a guy up in Dresco Town. He’s able to turn these Oddish Leaves into a fine kind of mist. Hows about I share some with you for your effort?
entries.translated:
Kau tahu? Aku kenal seseorang di
Dresco Town. Dia bisa mengubah Daun\lOddish ini menjadi semacam kabut

halus. Bagaimana kalau aku berbagi
sedikit denganmu sebagai imbalan\latas usahamu?

entries.original:
"My guy up in [green]Dresco Town[blue] can turn
Oddish Leaves into more of that\l[green]Dream Mist[blue].

Bring him some [green]Oddish[blue], and he’ll
happily do it for ya."
entries.translation_source: My guy up in [green]Dresco Town[blue] can turn Oddish Leaves into more of that [green]Dream Mist[blue]. Bring him some [green]Oddish[blue], and he’ll happily do it for ya.
entries.translated:
Orangku di [green]Kota Dresco[blue] bisa
mengubah Daun Oddish menjadi lebih\lbanyak [green]Dream Mist[blue]. Bawakan dia

beberapa [green]Oddish[blue], dan dia akan
dengan senang hati melakukannya\luntukmu.

entries.original: "Goon C"
entries.translation_source: Goon C
entries.translated: Preman C

entries.original: "Black [player] Goon"
entries.translation_source: Black [player] Goon
entries.translated: Preman Hitam [player]

entries.original:
"Right on time, [player].

The shipment just arrived."
entries.translation_source: Right on time, [player]. The shipment just arrived.
entries.translated:
Tepat waktu, [player]. Pengiriman
baru saja tiba.

entries.original:
"Hey, duuuuuuude\.

How’z it hangin’?

I’ve gotta special shipment of
uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense, here\.

Are you the dude that ordered
these?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, duuuuuuude\. How’z it hangin’? I’ve gotta special shipment of uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense, here\. Are you the dude that ordered these?
entries.translated:
Hei, duuuuuuude\. Apa kabar? Aku
punya kiriman spesial dari uh\.\CC0818 Rose\lIncense, di sini\. Apakah kau orang

yang memesan ini?

entries.original:
"Yup. That’d be me.
Lemme take ’em off your hands."
entries.translation_source: Yup. That’d be me. Lemme take ’em off your hands.
entries.translated:
Ya. Itu aku. Biar aku ambil dari
tanganmu.

entries.original: "Enjoy ’em, duuuuuuude\."
entries.translation_source: Enjoy ’em, duuuuuuude\.
entries.translated: Nikmati mereka, duuuuuuude\.

entries.original:
"Now all you need to do is smuggle
’em back to the base, and then\."
entries.translation_source: Now all you need to do is smuggle ’em back to the base, and then\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang yang perlu kau lakukan
adalah menyelundupkannya kembali ke\lmarkas, lalu\.

entries.original: "Haw haw haw!"
entries.translation_source: Haw haw haw!
entries.translated: Haw haw haw!

entries.original: "Did someone mention Rose Incense?"
entries.translation_source: Did someone mention Rose Incense?
entries.translated:
Apakah seseorang menyebut Rose
Incense?

entries.original:
"Haw haw haw!
We ain’t dumb!

We know das jus’ a codename fo’
Oddish Leaves!

Now fork ’em over or we’ll have ta
tell dem police\.

Haw haw haw!"
entries.translation_source: Haw haw haw! We ain’t dumb! We know das jus’ a codename fo’ Oddish Leaves! Now fork ’em over or we’ll have ta tell dem police\. Haw haw haw!
entries.translated:
Haw haw haw! Kami tidak bodoh! Kami
tahu itu hanya nama kode untuk Daun\lOddish! Sekarang serahkan atau kami

harus memberi tahu polisi\. Haw haw
haw!

entries.original:
"Tauros waste.

We’ll have to deal with these Black
Ferrothorn goons before we can get\loff the port.

You keep ’em busy while I stash the
Oddish Leaves somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Tauros waste. We’ll have to deal with these Black Ferrothorn goons before we can get off the port. You keep ’em busy while I stash the Oddish Leaves somewhere.
entries.translated:
Sampah Tauros. Kita harus berurusan
dengan preman-preman Ferrothorn\lHitam ini sebelum kita bisa keluar

dari pelabuhan. Kau buat mereka
sibuk sementara aku menyembunyikan\lDaun Oddish di suatu tempat.

entries.original:
"He ain’t gonna get far!

Dem coppers are gonna squash ’im
’cause of dem Oddish Leaves!

Like we gonna squash you!"
entries.translation_source: He ain’t gonna get far! Dem coppers are gonna squash ’im ’cause of dem Oddish Leaves! Like we gonna squash you!
entries.translated:
Dia tidak akan pergi jauh! Polisi
itu akan menghancurkannya karena\lDaun Oddish itu! Seperti kami akan

menghancurkanmu!

entries.original:
"You don’t stand a chance
against me!

I’m an elite member of the
Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: You don’t stand a chance against me! I’m an elite member of the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Kau tidak punya kesempatan
melawanku! Aku anggota elit\lFerrothorn Hitam!

entries.original:
"I knews we shoulda gone
after dat other guy\."
entries.translation_source: I knews we shoulda gone after dat other guy\.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu kita seharusnya mengejar
orang lain itu\.

entries.original: "Over there, officer!"
entries.translation_source: Over there, officer!
entries.translated: Di sana, petugas!

entries.original:
"This distinguished citizen has
informed me that you two are\lattempting to smuggle Oddish\lLeaves off of the port.

What do you have to say
for yourselves?"
entries.translation_source: This distinguished citizen has informed me that you two are attempting to smuggle Oddish Leaves off of the port. What do you have to say for yourselves?
entries.translated:
Warga terhormat ini telah memberi
tahu saya bahwa kalian berdua\lmencoba menyelundupkan Daun Oddish

dari pelabuhan. Apa yang bisa
kalian katakan untuk membela diri?

entries.original:
"Us!?

It’s these two who are trying to
do that!

We just came to stop ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Us!? It’s these two who are trying to do that! We just came to stop ’em!
entries.translated:
Kami!? Kedua orang inilah yang
mencoba melakukan itu! Kami hanya\ldatang untuk menghentikan mereka!

entries.original:
"Nonsense.

If that were the case, you would
have called for me immediately.

However, as I see it, since you
did not request my help, then you\ltwo are the most obvious suspects.

You’re both under arrest.

It’s time for you to come with me."
entries.translation_source: Nonsense. If that were the case, you would have called for me immediately. However, as I see it, since you did not request my help, then you two are the most obvious suspects. You’re both under arrest. It’s time for you to come with me.
entries.translated:
Omong kosong. Jika itu masalahnya,
kalian pasti sudah memanggil saya\lsegera. Namun, menurut saya, karena

kalian tidak meminta bantuan saya,
maka kalian berdua adalah tersangka\lyang paling jelas. Kalian berdua

ditahan. Saatnya kalian ikut dengan
saya.

entries.original:
"That was a close one.

Now all that’s left is for you to
find the [green]Oddish Leaves[blue] I stashed\laway, and bring ’em back to our\lbase."
entries.translation_source: That was a close one. Now all that’s left is for you to find the [green]Oddish Leaves[blue] I stashed away, and bring ’em back to our base.
entries.translated:
Itu tadi hampir saja. Sekarang yang
tersisa adalah kau menemukan [green]Daun\lOddish[blue] yang kusembunyikan, dan

membawanya kembali ke markas kita.

entries.original:
"Where are they?

I dunno, I stashed ’em in between
some crates on the [green]west[blue] side of\lthe port.

Use one of them fancy [green]Dowsing
Machines[blue] or somethin’ to find ’em.

Meet me back at the [green]base[blue] when
you’ve found ’em."
entries.translation_source: Where are they? I dunno, I stashed ’em in between some crates on the [green]west[blue] side of the port. Use one of them fancy [green]Dowsing Machines[blue] or somethin’ to find ’em. Meet me back at the [green]base[blue] when you’ve found ’em.
entries.translated:
Di mana mereka? Entahlah,
kusembunyikan di antara beberapa\lpeti di sisi [green]barat[blue] pelabuhan.

Gunakan salah satu [green]Dowsing Machines[blue]
mewah itu atau sesuatu untuk\lmenemukannya. Temui aku kembali di

[green]markas[blue] setelah kau menemukannya.

entries.original:
"Come on, [buffer1]!

I said between [green]8 PM[blue] and [green]12 AM[blue]!
Ya missed the shipment!

We’ll just have to try again
another night."
entries.translation_source: Come on, [buffer1]! I said between [green]8 PM[blue] and [green]12 AM[blue]! Ya missed the shipment! We’ll just have to try again another night.
entries.translated:
Ayolah, [buffer1]! Aku bilang antara
[green]jam 8 malam[blue] dan [green]jam 12 malam[blue]! Kau\lmelewatkan pengiriman! Kita harus

mencoba lagi malam lain.

entries.original:
"Halt!

Are you carrying any illegal
merchandise?

Any Slowpoke Tails or Oddish
Leaves?

\.

Nope, you appear to be clean.
Proceed."
entries.translation_source: Halt! Are you carrying any illegal merchandise? Any Slowpoke Tails or Oddish Leaves? \. Nope, you appear to be clean. Proceed.
entries.translated:
Berhenti! Apakah kamu membawa
barang ilegal? Ada Ekor Slowpoke\latau Daun Oddish? \. Tidak, kamu

tampaknya bersih. Silakan lanjut.

entries.original:
"Halt!

Show some valid identification if
you wish to pass."
entries.translation_source: Halt! Show some valid identification if you wish to pass.
entries.translated:
Berhenti! Tunjukkan identifikasi
yang valid jika kamu ingin lewat.

entries.original:
"[black]You flashed your Trainer Card for
the guard."
entries.translation_source: [black]You flashed your Trainer Card for the guard.
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu menunjukkan Kartu Pelatihmu
kepada penjaga.

entries.original:
"Your ID checks out.
Proceed."
entries.translation_source: Your ID checks out. Proceed.
entries.translated: ID kamu cocok. Silakan lanjut.

entries.original:
"Oh! You’re a very high ranking
Trainer.

[player], is it?

I’ll remember that from now on.

Feel free to come and go as
you please."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You’re a very high ranking Trainer. [player], is it? I’ll remember that from now on. Feel free to come and go as you please.
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu adalah Pelatih peringkat
sangat tinggi. [player], kan? Aku\lakan mengingat itu mulai sekarang.

Silakan datang dan pergi sesukamu.

entries.original:
"Halt!

Are you carrying any illegal
merchandise?

Any Slowpoke Tails or Oddish
Leaves?

\.

Hmm\.

You reek of Oddish Leaves\."
entries.translation_source: Halt! Are you carrying any illegal merchandise? Any Slowpoke Tails or Oddish Leaves? \. Hmm\. You reek of Oddish Leaves\.
entries.translated:
Berhenti! Apakah kamu membawa
barang ilegal? Ada Ekor Slowpoke\latau Daun Oddish? \. Hmm\. Kamu bau

Daun Oddish\.

entries.original:
"It is most likely nothing\.
You are just a kid, after all.

I would hope someone as young as
you would not be involved with\lhorrible contraband like that\.

You are good to go.
Proceed."
entries.translation_source: It is most likely nothing\. You are just a kid, after all. I would hope someone as young as you would not be involved with horrible contraband like that\. You are good to go. Proceed.
entries.translated:
Kemungkinan besar tidak apa-apa\.
Lagipula, kamu hanya seorang anak.\lAku harap seseorang semuda kamu

tidak akan terlibat dengan barang
selundupan mengerikan seperti itu\.\lKamu boleh pergi. Silakan lanjut.

entries.original: "Supply and Demand"
entries.translation_source: Supply and Demand
entries.translated: Penawaran dan Permintaan

entries.original:
"[player]! My [buffer1]!

Come ’ere and ’elp me, why doncha?

Listen ’ere, pal.

Those Black Ferrothorns, see, they
gots all this good stuff.

They gots all the connections in
high places to get their Pokémon\lpumped up big an’ strong.

If we’re gonna take ’em out, we’re
gonna need to cut off their supply,\lya ’ear?

Good news is, I know where exactly
they’re gettin’ their goods from.

Ya see, there’s this scientist -
she lives not too far from ’ere.

She’s been gettin’ them all the
latest in enhancers the Science\lSociety ’as been puttin’ out on\lthe black market.

I’m too chicken to take ’er on
alone, but with you\.

That’d be a whole ’nother story,
ya ’ear?

So whaddya say, you in, my [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: [player]! My [buffer1]! Come ’ere and ’elp me, why doncha? Listen ’ere, pal. Those Black Ferrothorns, see, they gots all this good stuff. They gots all the connections in high places to get their Pokémon pumped up big an’ strong. If we’re gonna take ’em out, we’re gonna need to cut off their supply, ya ’ear? Good news is, I know where exactly they’re gettin’ their goods from. Ya see, there’s this scientist - she lives not too far from ’ere. She’s been gettin’ them all the latest in enhancers the Science Society ’as been puttin’ out on the black market. I’m too chicken to take ’er on alone, but with you\. That’d be a whole ’nother story, ya ’ear? So whaddya say, you in, my [buffer1]?
entries.translated:
[player]! [buffer1]ku! Kemari dan
bantu aku, kenapa tidak? Dengar,\lkawan. Lihat, Black Ferrothorns itu

punya barang bagus. Mereka punya
koneksi di tempat tinggi untuk\lmembuat Pokémon mereka besar dan

kuat. Kalau kita mau mengalahkan
mereka, kita harus memotong pasokan\lmereka, mengerti? Kabar baiknya,

aku tahu persis dari mana mereka
mendapatkan barang-barang itu.\lBegini, ada seorang ilmuwan - dia

tinggal tidak jauh dari sini. Dia
telah memberi mereka enhancer\lterbaru yang dikeluarkan Science

Society di pasar gelap. Aku terlalu
takut untuk menghadapinya\lsendirian, tetapi denganmu\. Itu akan

menjadi cerita lain, mengerti? Jadi
bagaimana, kamu ikut, [buffer1]ku?

entries.original:
"Really, my [buffer1]?

I can’t believe what I’m ’earin’!"
entries.translation_source: Really, my [buffer1]? I can’t believe what I’m ’earin’!
entries.translated:
Sungguh, [buffer1]ku? Aku tidak
percaya apa yang kudengar!

entries.original:
"Sweet, my [buffer1]!

We’re gonna gets our Pokémon
pumped up all big and strong,\lya ’ear?

Let’s do this thing!

That scientist lives in the ’ouse
right next to the Pokémon Center.

I’ll go on ahead and meet you
there, my [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Sweet, my [buffer1]! We’re gonna gets our Pokémon pumped up all big and strong, ya ’ear? Let’s do this thing! That scientist lives in the ’ouse right next to the Pokémon Center. I’ll go on ahead and meet you there, my [buffer1]!
entries.translated:
Mantap, [buffer1]ku! Kita akan
membuat Pokémon kita besar dan\lkuat, mengerti? Ayo lakukan ini!

Ilmuwan itu tinggal di rumah tepat
di samping Pokémon Center. Aku akan\lpergi duluan dan menemuimu di sana,

[buffer1]ku!

entries.original:
"’ey! My [buffer1]!

Thanks to your ’elp, we’ve now
got a great way to pump up our\lPokémon before we fight them\lBlack Ferrothorns!

That Pokémon I nabbed from that
scientist was what she was usin’\lto create the serum that them\lBlack Ferrothorns ’ave been usin’,\lya ’ear?

No idea ’ow she was doin’ it,
though.

It must’ve been some weird power
of alchemy.

That don’t really matter, though,
since James knows ’ow to do it for\lus, too, ya ’ear?

Oh, yeah, I almost forgot, my [buffer1].
James wanted you to ’ave this."
entries.translation_source: ’ey! My [buffer1]! Thanks to your ’elp, we’ve now got a great way to pump up our Pokémon before we fight them Black Ferrothorns! That Pokémon I nabbed from that scientist was what she was usin’ to create the serum that them Black Ferrothorns ’ave been usin’, ya ’ear? No idea ’ow she was doin’ it, though. It must’ve been some weird power of alchemy. That don’t really matter, though, since James knows ’ow to do it for us, too, ya ’ear? Oh, yeah, I almost forgot, my [buffer1]. James wanted you to ’ave this.
entries.translated:
Hei! [buffer1]ku! Berkat bantuanmu,
kami sekarang punya cara hebat\luntuk meningkatkan Pokémon kita

sebelum melawan Black Ferrothorns
itu! Pokémon yang kuambil dari\lilmuwan itu adalah apa yang dia

gunakan untuk membuat serum yang
digunakan Black Ferrothorns itu,\lmengerti? Entah bagaimana dia

melakukannya. Pasti itu semacam
kekuatan alkimia yang aneh. Tapi\litu tidak masalah, karena James

juga tahu cara melakukannya untuk
kita, mengerti? Oh, ya, aku hampir\llupa, [buffer1]ku. James ingin kamu

punya ini.

entries.original: "You received an Egg from the goon!"
entries.translation_source: You received an Egg from the goon!
entries.translated:
Kamu menerima Telur dari preman
itu!

entries.original:
"[player]! My [buffer1]!

I ’ave something from James to give
you, but you need more space in\lyour party if you want me to fork\lit over, ya ’ear?"
entries.translation_source: [player]! My [buffer1]! I ’ave something from James to give you, but you need more space in your party if you want me to fork it over, ya ’ear?
entries.translated:
[player]! [buffer1]ku! Aku punya
sesuatu dari James untuk diberikan\lkepadamu, tetapi kamu perlu ruang

lebih di timmu jika kamu ingin aku
memberikannya, mengerti?

entries.original:
"[player]! My [buffer1]!

Can you feel it?

It’s almost time to take down them
Black Ferrothorns, ya ’ear?

Now that they ain’t got any more
supply of that stat pumper, they\lain’t gonna stand a chance against\lus Black [player]!"
entries.translation_source: [player]! My [buffer1]! Can you feel it? It’s almost time to take down them Black Ferrothorns, ya ’ear? Now that they ain’t got any more supply of that stat pumper, they ain’t gonna stand a chance against us Black [player]!
entries.translated:
[player]! [buffer1]ku! Dapatkah kamu
merasakannya? Hampir waktunya untuk\lmengalahkan Black Ferrothorns itu,

mengerti? Sekarang mereka tidak
punya lagi pasokan stat pumper itu,\lmereka tidak akan punya peluang

melawan kita Black [player]!

entries.original: "’ey, you, scientist lady!"
entries.translation_source: ’ey, you, scientist lady!
entries.translated: Hei, kamu, nyonya ilmuwan!

entries.original:
"Yeah, you!
Listen, ’ere!

I’m a proud member of the Black
[player], ya ’ear?

And we Black [player] know you’ve
been givin’ those lousy Black\lFerrothorns some good deals on\lsome ’igh end products.

So, I’m gonna say this only once!

’and over the product, ya ’ear?

And maybe we’ll let you get away
with the rest of your belongin’s\."
entries.translation_source: Yeah, you! Listen, ’ere! I’m a proud member of the Black [player], ya ’ear? And we Black [player] know you’ve been givin’ those lousy Black Ferrothorns some good deals on some ’igh end products. So, I’m gonna say this only once! ’and over the product, ya ’ear? And maybe we’ll let you get away with the rest of your belongin’s\.
entries.translated:
Ya, kamu! Dengar, sini! Aku adalah
anggota bangga dari Black [player],\lmengerti? Dan kami Black [player]

tahu kamu telah memberikan
penawaran bagus pada produk kelas\latas kepada Black Ferrothorns yang

menyebalkan itu. Jadi, aku akan
mengatakan ini hanya sekali!\lSerahkan produknya, mengerti? Dan

mungkin kami akan membiarkanmu
lolos dengan sisa barang-barangmu\.

entries.original:
"[red]You think I’m afraid of you scum?

The Science Society has given me
all the tools I need to defend\lmyself from thugs like you.

Home security system!

Activate all defenses!"
entries.translation_source: [red]You think I’m afraid of you scum? The Science Society has given me all the tools I need to defend myself from thugs like you. Home security system! Activate all defenses!
entries.translated:
[red]Kamu pikir aku takut pada sampah
seperti kalian? Science Society\ltelah memberikan semua alat yang

aku butuhkan untuk membela diri
dari preman sepertimu. Sistem\lkeamanan rumah! Aktifkan semua

pertahanan!

entries.original: "Why, you, I oughta\."
entries.translation_source: Why, you, I oughta\.
entries.translated: Kenapa, kamu, seharusnya aku\.

entries.original: "Ugh\."
entries.translation_source: Ugh\.
entries.translated: Ugh\.

entries.original:
"[red]I’d advise you to stay away from
me, young [buffer1]!

I’ve been forced to take drastic
measures to defend my home!

And I’m not above hurting scum
to defend my property!

So, leave this instant if you know
what’s good for you!"
entries.translation_source: [red]I’d advise you to stay away from me, young [buffer1]! I’ve been forced to take drastic measures to defend my home! And I’m not above hurting scum to defend my property! So, leave this instant if you know what’s good for you!
entries.translated:
[red]Saya sarankan Anda menjauh dari
saya, [buffer1] muda! Saya terpaksa\lmengambil tindakan drastis untuk

mempertahankan rumah saya! Dan saya
tidak segan menyakiti sampah untuk\lmempertahankan properti saya! Jadi,

pergilah sekarang juga jika Anda
tahu apa yang baik untuk Anda!

entries.original:
"Oh, no!
There’s an Electrode underfoot!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! There’s an Electrode underfoot!
entries.translated:
Oh, tidak! Ada Electrode di bawah
kaki!

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 you\.

How did you make it through
my trap?

No matter!

You may have avoided all of the
explosions on the floor, but can\lyou avoid all of these?"
entries.translation_source: You\.\CC0820 you\. How did you make it through my trap? No matter! You may have avoided all of the explosions on the floor, but can you avoid all of these?
entries.translated:
Anda\.\CC0820 Anda\. Bagaimana Anda bisa
melewati jebakan saya? Tidak\lmasalah! Anda mungkin telah

menghindari semua ledakan di
lantai, tetapi bisakah Anda\lmenghindari semua ini?

entries.original:
"You\. you\.

You just wait!

I have plenty more Electrode on
the floor to use against you!"
entries.translation_source: You\. you\. You just wait! I have plenty more Electrode on the floor to use against you!
entries.translated:
Anda\. Anda\. Tunggu saja! Saya masih
punya banyak Electrode di lantai\luntuk digunakan melawan Anda!

entries.original: "Serves you right, you mug."
entries.translation_source: Serves you right, you mug.
entries.translated: Pantas saja, kamu bodoh.

entries.original:
"Looks like she’s out cold,
my [buffer1].

Let’s get searchin’ and find out
where she ’id all of them stat\lenhancers she used to power up\lall them Electrode."
entries.translation_source: Looks like she’s out cold, my [buffer1]. Let’s get searchin’ and find out where she ’id all of them stat enhancers she used to power up all them Electrode.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya dia pingsan, [buffer1]
saya. Ayo cari dan cari tahu di\lmana dia menyembunyikan semua

penguat stat yang dia gunakan untuk
memperkuat semua Electrode itu.

entries.original:
"Let’s get searchin’ and find out
where that scientist ’id those\lstat enhancers she used to power\lup all them Electrode."
entries.translation_source: Let’s get searchin’ and find out where that scientist ’id those stat enhancers she used to power up all them Electrode.
entries.translated:
Ayo cari dan cari tahu di mana
ilmuwan itu menyembunyikan penguat\lstat yang dia gunakan untuk

memperkuat semua Electrode itu.

entries.original:
"I was stationed here by the Science
Society to help sell our\. er\.\lproducts in this decrepit part of\lthe region.

Unfortunately for you, I’m carrying
highly volatile goods, too unstable\lfor children to handle.

I’m sorry, but I cannot sell any
to you."
entries.translation_source: I was stationed here by the Science Society to help sell our\. er\. products in this decrepit part of the region. Unfortunately for you, I’m carrying highly volatile goods, too unstable for children to handle. I’m sorry, but I cannot sell any to you.
entries.translated:
Saya ditempatkan di sini oleh
Perhimpunan Sains untuk membantu\lmenjual produk kami\. er\. di bagian

wilayah yang bobrok ini. Sayangnya
untuk Anda, saya membawa barang\lyang sangat mudah meledak, terlalu

tidak stabil untuk ditangani
anak-anak. Maaf, tetapi saya tidak\lbisa menjual apa pun kepada Anda.

entries.original: "[black]The scientist is out cold."
entries.translation_source: [black]The scientist is out cold.
entries.translated: [black]Ilmuwan itu pingsan.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 you fiend!

Not only did you get away with the
goods I was supposed to supply to\lthe Black Ferrothorn, you also got\laway with the Pokémon I need to\lproduce those goods quickly!

Get out of my house this instant,
or I will let loose the Electrode\lon you!"
entries.translation_source: You\.\CC0820 you fiend! Not only did you get away with the goods I was supposed to supply to the Black Ferrothorn, you also got away with the Pokémon I need to produce those goods quickly! Get out of my house this instant, or I will let loose the Electrode on you!
entries.translated:
Anda\.\CC0820 Anda iblis! Tidak hanya Anda
lolos dengan barang yang seharusnya\lsaya pasok ke Black Ferrothorn,

Anda juga lolos dengan Pokémon yang
saya butuhkan untuk memproduksi\lbarang-barang itu dengan cepat!

Keluar dari rumah saya sekarang
juga, atau saya akan melepaskan\lElectrode pada Anda!

entries.original:
"[black]It’s a Poké Ball belonging to
the scientist.

Which Pokémon could it contain?"
entries.translation_source: [black]It’s a Poké Ball belonging to the scientist. Which Pokémon could it contain?
entries.translated:
[black]Ini adalah Poké Ball milik ilmuwan
itu. Pokémon apa yang mungkin ada\ldi dalamnya?

entries.original:
"[black]Something is balanced carefully on
the windowsill."
entries.translation_source: [black]Something is balanced carefully on the windowsill.
entries.translated:
[black]Sesuatu diletakkan dengan hati-hati
di ambang jendela.

entries.original:
"You found ’em!

Them stat enhancers!

Good find, my [buffer1]!

Now, ’and ’em over so I can get ’em
back to James pronto."
entries.translation_source: You found ’em! Them stat enhancers! Good find, my [buffer1]! Now, ’and ’em over so I can get ’em back to James pronto.
entries.translated:
Anda menemukannya! Penguat stat
itu! Temuan bagus, [buffer1] saya!\lSekarang, serahkan agar saya bisa

mengembalikannya ke James
secepatnya.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the stat
enhancers."
entries.translation_source: [black][player] handed over the stat enhancers.
entries.translated: [black][player] menyerahkan penguat stat.

entries.original:
"And since that scientist lady is
out, let me just grab ’er Pokémon,\ltoo, ya ’ear?"
entries.translation_source: And since that scientist lady is out, let me just grab ’er Pokémon, too, ya ’ear?
entries.translated:
Dan karena wanita ilmuwan itu
pingsan, biarkan saya mengambil\lPokémon-nya juga, ya?

entries.original:
"Ya see now, my [buffer1]?

We got them stat enhancers, and we
can use this Pokémon ’ere to ’elp\lmake some more of our own!

It’s a win-win!

I’ll see you back at the base once
I’ve got this all sorted out with\lJames, ya ’ear?"
entries.translation_source: Ya see now, my [buffer1]? We got them stat enhancers, and we can use this Pokémon ’ere to ’elp make some more of our own! It’s a win-win! I’ll see you back at the base once I’ve got this all sorted out with James, ya ’ear?
entries.translated:
Anda lihat sekarang, [buffer1] saya?
Kami mendapatkan penguat stat itu,\ldan kita bisa menggunakan Pokémon

ini untuk membantu membuat lebih
banyak milik kita sendiri! Ini\lwin-win! Saya akan menemui Anda

kembali di markas setelah saya
menyelesaikan semua ini dengan\lJames, ya?

entries.original: "Barbs"
entries.translation_source: Barbs
entries.translated: Barbs

entries.original: "The Battle of Antisis"
entries.translation_source: The Battle of Antisis
entries.translated: Pertempuran Antisis

entries.original:
"Alright, boys!
It’s game time!

As soon as the bomb goes off, let
those Black Ferrothorns have it!

Make ’em so scared, they start
callin’ us the Terror [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, boys! It’s game time! As soon as the bomb goes off, let those Black Ferrothorns have it! Make ’em so scared, they start callin’ us the Terror [player]!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, semuanya! Waktunya
bermain! Begitu bom meledak,\lberikan pada Black Ferrothorn itu!

Buat mereka sangat takut, sehingga
mereka mulai memanggil kita Teror\l[player]!

entries.original:
"The bomb’s ready to blow!

Cover your freakin’ ears, unless ya
wanna lose em!"
entries.translation_source: The bomb’s ready to blow! Cover your freakin’ ears, unless ya wanna lose em!
entries.translated:
Bomnya siap meledak! Tutup telinga
kalian, kecuali kalian ingin\lkehilangan telinga!

entries.original:
"Let’s go, boys!
Jump up through the hole!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s go, boys! Jump up through the hole!
entries.translated:
Ayo, teman-teman! Lompat ke atas
melalui lubang itu!

entries.original: "Jump up through the hole?"
entries.translation_source: Jump up through the hole?
entries.translated: Lompat ke atas melalui lubang itu?

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!
Let ’em have it!

While James is busy dealin’ with
their leader on the [green]top floor[blue], we\lgotta wreak havoc!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player]! Let ’em have it! While James is busy dealin’ with their leader on the [green]top floor[blue], we gotta wreak havoc!
entries.translated:
Ayo, [player]! Hajar mereka! Selagi
James sibuk berurusan dengan\lpemimpin mereka di [green]lantai atas[blue],

kita harus membuat kekacauan!

entries.original:
"It’s over for you bozos, ya ’ear?

We ain’t gonna let any of you bozos
escape until you Black Ferrothorns\lare through and through!"
entries.translation_source: It’s over for you bozos, ya ’ear? We ain’t gonna let any of you bozos escape until you Black Ferrothorns are through and through!
entries.translated:
Sudah berakhir untuk kalian,
dengar? Kami tidak akan membiarkan\lsatu pun dari kalian melarikan diri

sampai kalian benar-benar hancur,
hai Ferrothorns Hitam!

entries.original:
"What’s your problem, man?

I’m just tryin’ to watch some TV
in peace, here!"
entries.translation_source: What’s your problem, man? I’m just tryin’ to watch some TV in peace, here!
entries.translated:
Ada apa denganmu, bung? Aku hanya
ingin menonton TV dengan tenang di\lsini!

entries.original:
"Hey, man, I was here first!

This is my couch!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, man, I was here first! This is my couch!
entries.translated:
Hei, bung, aku yang pertama di
sini! Ini sofaku!

entries.original:
"Hey, man, quit shovin’!

Or they’ll notice we’re fightin’
amongst ourselves!

There’s more than enough room for
the both of us!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, man, quit shovin’! Or they’ll notice we’re fightin’ amongst ourselves! There’s more than enough room for the both of us!
entries.translated:
Hei, bung, berhenti mendorong! Atau
mereka akan sadar kita bertengkar!\lMasih ada cukup ruang untuk kita

berdua!

entries.original:
"I remember you!

You’re one of them knuckleheads who
threw my socks down the drain!

Get a whiff of ’em now!"
entries.translation_source: I remember you! You’re one of them knuckleheads who threw my socks down the drain! Get a whiff of ’em now!
entries.translated:
Aku ingat kamu! Kamu salah satu
dari orang tolol yang membuang kaus\lkakiku ke saluran air! Cium

sekarang!

entries.original:
"Ugh\. geez, man!

Get those out of my face!
They reek!"
entries.translation_source: Ugh\. geez, man! Get those out of my face! They reek!
entries.translated:
Ugh\. astaga, bung! Jauhkan itu dari
wajahku! Bau banget!

entries.original:
"Remember me?

You and your pal tried to interfere
with my business down at the docks!

Not so tough without your buddy,
are you, now?"
entries.translation_source: Remember me? You and your pal tried to interfere with my business down at the docks! Not so tough without your buddy, are you, now?
entries.translated:
Ingat aku? Kamu dan temanmu mencoba
mengganggu bisnisku di dermaga!\lTidak sekuat itu tanpa temanmu, ya?

entries.original:
"You’re comin’ at me on a bike!

What do you want me to say?

That I’m tough enough to go toe to
toe with someone on a motorcycle?

Well, I am!"
entries.translation_source: You’re comin’ at me on a bike! What do you want me to say? That I’m tough enough to go toe to toe with someone on a motorcycle? Well, I am!
entries.translated:
Kamu menghadapiku dengan sepeda
motor! Apa yang kamu ingin aku\lkatakan? Bahwa aku cukup tangguh

untuk bertarung satu lawan satu
dengan orang di atas motor? Yah,\laku memang tangguh!

entries.original:
"I couldn’t imagine life without
the Shadows.

But when the Boss found us and gave
us a new purpose, we joined right\laway!"
entries.translation_source: I couldn’t imagine life without the Shadows. But when the Boss found us and gave us a new purpose, we joined right away!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa membayangkan hidup
tanpa Shadows. Tapi ketika Bos\lmenemukan kami dan memberi tujuan

baru, kami langsung bergabung!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Horizon!

The Terror Granbull joined forces
with the Black [player], so now our\lgang’s bigger an’ better!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Horizon! The Terror Granbull joined forces with the Black [player], so now our gang’s bigger an’ better!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Horizon! Terror
Granbull bergabung dengan [player]\lHitam, jadi geng kami lebih besar

dan lebih baik!

entries.original: "Get out of here, punk!"
entries.translation_source: Get out of here, punk!
entries.translated: Pergi dari sini, anak nakal!

entries.original:
"Maybe this is a good time for me to
be done with this whole Light of\lRuin thing\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe this is a good time for me to be done with this whole Light of Ruin thing\.
entries.translated:
Mungkin ini saat yang tepat bagiku
untuk mengakhiri urusan dengan\lLight of Ruin ini\.

entries.original: "View the sequence again?"
entries.translation_source: View the sequence again?
entries.translated: Lihat urutannya lagi?

entries.original:
"Green lights are flashing on
and off."
entries.translation_source: Green lights are flashing on and off.
entries.translated:
Lampu hijau berkedip menyala dan
mati.

entries.original:
"Good luck invadin’ more than just
the lower floors!

We have a top of the line security
system installed by none another\lthan a bunch of nerds!

Can’t get any better than that!

Those nerds really know what
they’re doin’, I tell ya!

Bwa ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Good luck invadin’ more than just the lower floors! We have a top of the line security system installed by none another than a bunch of nerds! Can’t get any better than that! Those nerds really know what they’re doin’, I tell ya! Bwa ha ha!
entries.translated:
Semoga berhasil menyerbu lebih dari
sekadar lantai bawah! Kami punya\lsistem keamanan kelas atas yang

dipasang oleh sekelompok kutu buku!
Tidak bisa lebih baik dari itu!\lKutu buku itu benar-benar tahu apa

yang mereka lakukan, kataku! Bwa ha
ha!

entries.original:
"How did a kid Trainer get past our
top of the line security system?

Eh, it don’t matter.

We still have the old fashioned
brute force security system, too!"
entries.translation_source: How did a kid Trainer get past our top of the line security system? Eh, it don’t matter. We still have the old fashioned brute force security system, too!
entries.translated:
Bagaimana seorang Pelatih anak-anak
bisa melewati sistem keamanan kelas\latas kami? Eh, tidak masalah. Kami

masih punya sistem keamanan paksa
kuno!

entries.original:
"Our top of the line security system
only gets harder to crack once you\lgo higher up!

You think your puny brain is big
enough to handle it?"
entries.translation_source: Our top of the line security system only gets harder to crack once you go higher up! You think your puny brain is big enough to handle it?
entries.translated:
Sistem keamanan kelas atas kami
hanya akan semakin sulit ditembus\lsaat kamu naik ke atas! Kamu pikir

otak mungilmu cukup besar untuk
menghadapinya?

entries.original:
"You think you’re so smart crackin’
those codes below, doncha?

But are you smart enough to crack
the code to this door?

Chaw ha, I doubt it!

Those Science Society nerds who
built the security system, made\lthis one extra tough to crack!"
entries.translation_source: You think you’re so smart crackin’ those codes below, doncha? But are you smart enough to crack the code to this door? Chaw ha, I doubt it! Those Science Society nerds who built the security system, made this one extra tough to crack!
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir kamu pintar memecahkan
kode-kode di bawah, kan? Tapi apa\lkamu cukup pintar untuk memecahkan

kode pintu ini? Chaw ha, aku ragu!
Ilmuwan-ilmuwan Science Society\lyang membangun sistem keamanan ini

membuat yang satu ini sangat sulit
dipecahkan!

entries.original:
"Chaw ha!

You think I’m goin’ to let a little
punk like you actually crack the\lcode?

Just ’cause you’re smart enough to
get this far in, it don’t mean it’s\lgonna be all easy gettin’ to Barbs!

I’m gonna keep you so busy, you’re
gonna forget the code and have to\lstart all over again!"
entries.translation_source: Chaw ha! You think I’m goin’ to let a little punk like you actually crack the code? Just ’cause you’re smart enough to get this far in, it don’t mean it’s gonna be all easy gettin’ to Barbs! I’m gonna keep you so busy, you’re gonna forget the code and have to start all over again!
entries.translated:
Chaw ha! Kamu pikir aku akan
membiarkan bocah kecil sepertimu\lbenar-benar memecahkan kode? Hanya

karena kamu cukup pintar sampai
sejauh ini, bukan berarti akan\lmudah untuk sampai ke Barbs! Aku

akan membuatmu sibuk sehingga kamu
akan lupa kodenya dan harus mulai\ldari awal lagi!

entries.original:
"Next, go left!

No, go up!

Now, go right!

Actually, go left!

Now, spin around!

Chaw ha ha!

Good luck gettin’ to Barbs now!"
entries.translation_source: Next, go left! No, go up! Now, go right! Actually, go left! Now, spin around! Chaw ha ha! Good luck gettin’ to Barbs now!
entries.translated:
Selanjutnya, ke kiri! Tidak, ke
atas! Sekarang, ke kanan!\lSebenarnya, ke kiri! Sekarang,

berputar! Chaw ha ha! Semoga
berhasil sampai ke Barbs sekarang!

entries.original: "Urgh\.\CC0818 no\.\CC0818 way\."
entries.translation_source: Urgh\.\CC0818 no\.\CC0818 way\.
entries.translated: Urgh\.\CC0818 tidak\.\CC0818 mungkin\.

entries.original:
"Chaw ha ha ha!

Wait, was that serious?

I didn’t think the brains behind
the Black [player] was so wimpy!

\.wait. You WERE serious.

You really thought ya’d actually
beat Barbs.

Well, lemme tell ya somethin’,
ya stupid nobody.

I lead the Black Ferrothorn.

I AM the Black Ferrothorn.

And I got a reputation to uphold,
see?

So if ya seriously thought ya
could just steal our turf and\lsupplies, trash our digs, and\lbeat down my boys\.

Well, that would just give other
gangs the same stupid idea, ya\lget me?

So, now that you’re finished,
know what I’m gonna do?

By now, my boys have already
crushed yours and taken their\lPokémon.

So\.\CC0818 I’m gonna take your worthless
carcass, string ya up with the\lrest of ’em\.

And you’re gonna see that a
Ferrothorn’s spikes aren’t just\lfor show!"
entries.translation_source: Chaw ha ha ha! Wait, was that serious? I didn’t think the brains behind the Black [player] was so wimpy! \.wait. You WERE serious. You really thought ya’d actually beat Barbs. Well, lemme tell ya somethin’, ya stupid nobody. I lead the Black Ferrothorn. I AM the Black Ferrothorn. And I got a reputation to uphold, see? So if ya seriously thought ya could just steal our turf and supplies, trash our digs, and beat down my boys\. Well, that would just give other gangs the same stupid idea, ya get me? So, now that you’re finished, know what I’m gonna do? By now, my boys have already crushed yours and taken their Pokémon. So\.\CC0818 I’m gonna take your worthless carcass, string ya up with the rest of ’em\. And you’re gonna see that a Ferrothorn’s spikes aren’t just for show!
entries.translated:
Chaw ha ha ha! Tunggu, apa itu
serius? Aku tidak mengira otak di\lbalik Black [player] lemah seperti

itu! \.tunggu. Kamu SERIUS. Kamu
benar-benar mengira akan\lmengalahkan Barbs. Baiklah, biarkan

aku memberitahumu sesuatu, dasar
orang tidak berguna. Aku memimpin\lBlack Ferrothorn. AKULAH Black

Ferrothorn. Dan aku punya reputasi
untuk dijaga, mengerti? Jadi jika\lkamu benar-benar mengira bisa

mencuri wilayah dan persediaan
kami, menghancurkan tempat kami,\ldan mengalahkan anak buahku\. Nah,

itu akan memberikan ide bodoh yang
sama ke geng lain, kamu mengerti?\lJadi, sekarang setelah kamu

selesai, tahu apa yang akan aku
lakukan? Sekarang, anak buahku\lsudah menghancurkan anak buahmu dan

mengambil Pokemon mereka. Jadi\.\CC0818 aku
akan mengambil bangkai tak\lberhargamu, menggantungmu bersama

yang lainnya\. Dan kamu akan melihat
bahwa duri Ferrothorn bukan untuk\lhiasan!

entries.original:
"Urgh!

[player]\.!"
entries.translation_source: Urgh! [player]\.!
entries.translated: Urgh! [player]\.!

entries.original:
"What, [player]?

The guy you stooges are named
after?"
entries.translation_source: What, [player]? The guy you stooges are named after?
entries.translated:
Apa, [player]? Orang yang menjadi
nama kalian para antek?

entries.original:
"That’s right! You’d\.\CC0818 better run!

Cos there’s no one bigger\.\CC0818 badder\.

Or\.\CC0818 urgh\.\CC0818 stronger than [player]!

[buffer3]’s gonna mop the floor with
all of ya!"
entries.translation_source: That’s right! You’d\.\CC0818 better run! Cos there’s no one bigger\.\CC0818 badder\. Or\.\CC0818 urgh\.\CC0818 stronger than [player]! [buffer3]’s gonna mop the floor with all of ya!
entries.translated:
Betul sekali! Kamu lebih baik\.\CC0818 lari!
Karena tidak ada yang lebih besar\.\CC0818\llebih jahat\. Atau\.\CC0818 ugh\.\CC0818 lebih kuat

dari [player]! [buffer3] akan
menghajar kalian semua!

entries.original:
"Chaw ha ha ha! In the flesh, huh?
What an honour!

C’mon, this kid?

[buffer3] don’t look like a rough n’
tough gangster at all!

Listen, [player].

I know ya might have been part of
this failure of a raid\.

But I’m pretty sure you’re just
some dumb kid who got in the gang\llife \qobecause it looked cool\qc.

So I’ll do ya a favour, and give
ya a chance.

I’ll take ya, one on one.

You win, I’ll let these chumps
go\.\CC0818 if they swear never to come\lback here again.

You lose, and sure, you get to go
free, but as for the rest of ’em\.

I’ll even be nice, and I won’t
totally wreck ya with the best\lPokémon I’ve got.

Whaddya say?"
entries.translation_source: Chaw ha ha ha! In the flesh, huh? What an honour! C’mon, this kid? [buffer3] don’t look like a rough n’ tough gangster at all! Listen, [player]. I know ya might have been part of this failure of a raid\. But I’m pretty sure you’re just some dumb kid who got in the gang life \qobecause it looked cool\qc. So I’ll do ya a favour, and give ya a chance. I’ll take ya, one on one. You win, I’ll let these chumps go\.\CC0818 if they swear never to come back here again. You lose, and sure, you get to go free, but as for the rest of ’em\. I’ll even be nice, and I won’t totally wreck ya with the best Pokémon I’ve got. Whaddya say?
entries.translated:
Chaw ha ha ha! Benar-benar langsung
bertemu, ya? Suatu kehormatan! Ayo,\lanak ini? [buffer3] tidak terlihat

seperti gangster kasar dan tangguh
sama sekali! Dengar, [player]\. Aku\ltahu kamu mungkin bagian dari

penggerebekan yang gagal ini. Tapi
aku yakin kamu hanyalah anak bodoh\lyang masuk ke kehidupan geng

\qokarena kelihatan keren\qc. Jadi aku
akan memberi kamu bantuan, dan\lmemberimu kesempatan. Aku akan

menghadapimu satu lawan satu. Kamu
menang, aku akan membiarkan mereka\lpergi\.\CC0818 jika mereka bersumpah tidak

akan kembali lagi. Kamu kalah, dan
tentu saja, kamu bebas pergi, tapi\luntuk sisanya\. Aku bahkan akan

bersikap baik, dan tidak akan
menghancurkanmu dengan Pokemon\lterbaik yang kupunya. Bagaimana

menurutmu?

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 careful\.\CC0818 Barbs ain’t
above cheatin’\.

Here.

He was usin’ this weird stuff on
his Pokémon when I fought him, but\.

He ain’t the only one\.\CC0818 so lemme\.\CC0818
jazz up your Pokémon a bit\."
entries.translation_source: [player]\.\CC0818 careful\.\CC0818 Barbs ain’t above cheatin’\. Here. He was usin’ this weird stuff on his Pokémon when I fought him, but\. He ain’t the only one\.\CC0818 so lemme\.\CC0818 jazz up your Pokémon a bit\.
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 hati-hati\.\CC0818 Barbs tidak
segan curang\. Di sini. Dia\lmenggunakan benda aneh ini pada

Pokemon-nya saat aku melawannya,
tapi\. Dia bukan satu-satunya\.\CC0818 jadi\lbiar aku\.\CC0818 semangati Pokemon kamu

sedikit\.

entries.original:
"Enough posturin’!

Prepare for a real beatin’, from
the realest gang in Antisis!"
entries.translation_source: Enough posturin’! Prepare for a real beatin’, from the realest gang in Antisis!
entries.translated:
Cukup berpose! Bersiaplah untuk
pukulan sungguhan, dari geng paling\lnyata di Antisis!

entries.original:
"Well, ain’t that somethin’.

You’re actually not bad at all,
[player].

But yer still only one kid.

By now, the rest of my boys
downstairs\."
entries.translation_source: Well, ain’t that somethin’. You’re actually not bad at all, [player]. But yer still only one kid. By now, the rest of my boys downstairs\.
entries.translated:
Nah, bukankah itu sesuatu. Kamu
sebenarnya tidak buruk sama sekali,\l[player]. Tapi kamu masih hanya

satu anak. Sekarang, sisa anak
buahku di bawah\.

entries.original:
"’Ey boss!

We utterly totalled those
Black Bozos!

Ain’t nothin’ left from ’em ’cept
a pile of broken dreams!"
entries.translation_source: ’Ey boss! We utterly totalled those Black Bozos! Ain’t nothin’ left from ’em ’cept a pile of broken dreams!
entries.translated:
{B4}Ey bos! Kami benar-benar
menghancurkan Black Bozos itu!\lTidak ada yang tersisa dari mereka

kecuali tumpukan mimpi yang hancur!

entries.original:
"Chaw ha ha ha!

Ya see, James?
Ya never stood a chance!

All that plannin’ meant jack,
cos ya didn’t have the manpower\lfor the job!"
entries.translation_source: Chaw ha ha ha! Ya see, James? Ya never stood a chance! All that plannin’ meant jack, cos ya didn’t have the manpower for the job!
entries.translated:
Chaw ha ha ha! Kamu lihat, James?
Kamu tidak punya kesempatan! Semua\lperencanaan itu tidak berarti,

karena kamu tidak memiliki cukup
orang untuk pekerjaan itu!

entries.original:
"Good job, man.

Now throw ’em out on their rears.

No need to be gentle with ’em."
entries.translation_source: Good job, man. Now throw ’em out on their rears. No need to be gentle with ’em.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, kawan. Sekarang buang
mereka keluar. Tidak perlu lembut\ldengan mereka.

entries.original:
"Wha\.\CC0818 we’re just lettin’ ’em go,
boss!?"
entries.translation_source: Wha\.\CC0818 we’re just lettin’ ’em go, boss!?
entries.translated:
Apa\.\CC0818 kita hanya membiarkan mereka
pergi, bos!?

entries.original:
"We got better things to do today.
’Sides, they won’t come back."
entries.translation_source: We got better things to do today. ’Sides, they won’t come back.
entries.translated:
Kita punya hal yang lebih penting
untuk dilakukan hari ini. Lagipula,\lmereka tidak akan kembali.

entries.original:
"Well, [player], looks like this
is it for us.

Ya put up a good fight, kid.
Ya made us proud ’til the end.

But it’s time for the Black
[player] to move on.

We ain’t got no place in this town
anymore."
entries.translation_source: Well, [player], looks like this is it for us. Ya put up a good fight, kid. Ya made us proud ’til the end. But it’s time for the Black [player] to move on. We ain’t got no place in this town anymore.
entries.translated:
Yah, [player], sepertinya ini akhir
bagi kita. Kamu bertarung dengan\lbaik, nak. Kamu membuat kami bangga

sampai akhir. Tapi sudah waktunya
bagi Black [player] untuk pergi.\lKami tidak punya tempat di kota ini

lagi.

entries.original:
"[blue]Maybe we’ll run into each other
somewhere down the line, kid.

I look forward to that day."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Maybe we’ll run into each other somewhere down the line, kid. I look forward to that day.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mungkin kita akan bertemu lagi di
lain waktu, nak. Aku menantikan\lhari itu.

entries.original:
"Now, then, [player], I’ve been real
nice to ya, but I think you’ve\loverstayed yer welcome.

I don’t care what ya do around
Antisis anymore, but don’t let me\lcatch ya around our turf again.

Now get out.

OUT!"
entries.translation_source: Now, then, [player], I’ve been real nice to ya, but I think you’ve overstayed yer welcome. I don’t care what ya do around Antisis anymore, but don’t let me catch ya around our turf again. Now get out. OUT!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, [player], aku sudah cukup
baik padamu, tapi aku pikir kamu\lsudah terlalu lama di sini. Aku

tidak peduli apa yang kamu lakukan
di sekitar Antisis lagi, tapi\ljangan sampai aku menangkapmu di

wilayah kami lagi. Sekarang keluar.
KELUAR!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!
Show him how tough you are!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player]! Show him how tough you are!
entries.translated:
Ayo, [player]! Tunjukkan betapa
kuatnya dirimu!

entries.original:
"[black]There’s a note attached!

[blue]\qo[player], you did good, kid.

You fought hard, but looks like the
rest of us weren’t tough enough to\ltake down those bozos.

You’re now all that’s left of the
Black [player].

Be strong, and keep your fightin’
spirit alive!

-James\qc"
entries.translation_source: [black]There’s a note attached! [blue]\qo[player], you did good, kid. You fought hard, but looks like the rest of us weren’t tough enough to take down those bozos. You’re now all that’s left of the Black [player]. Be strong, and keep your fightin’ spirit alive! -James\qc
entries.translated:
[black]Ada catatan yang menempel!
[blue]\qo[player], kamu melakukannya dengan\lbaik, nak. Kamu bertarung keras,

tapi sepertinya kami yang lain
tidak cukup kuat untuk mengalahkan\lpara bozo itu. Kamu sekarang

satu-satunya yang tersisa dari
Black [player]. Tetap kuat, dan\ljaga semangat bertarungmu! -James\qc

entries.original: " The Endless Nightmare"
entries.translation_source: The Endless Nightmare
entries.translated: Mimpi Buruk Tanpa Akhir

entries.original: "The Endless Nightmare"
entries.translation_source: The Endless Nightmare
entries.translated: Mimpi Buruk Tanpa Akhir

entries.original: "Eldon"
entries.translation_source: Eldon
entries.translated: Eldon

entries.original:
"I’ve lost my love of sailing since
my son fell into this horrid\lnightmare\.

If only there was someone who knew
how to heal him.

Maybe a scientist at the [green]Dream
Research Lab[blue] would know\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve lost my love of sailing since my son fell into this horrid nightmare\. If only there was someone who knew how to heal him. Maybe a scientist at the [green]Dream Research Lab[blue] would know\.
entries.translated:
Saya kehilangan kecintaan saya pada
berlayar sejak putra saya jatuh ke\ldalam mimpi buruk yang mengerikan

ini\. Seandainya ada seseorang yang
tahu cara menyembuhkannya. Mungkin\lseorang ilmuwan di [green]Laboratorium

Penelitian Mimpi[blue] akan tahu\.

entries.original:
"That scientist said we need the
[green]Lunar Wing[blue] from [green]Fullmoon Island[blue]\lto heal my son.

Would you go to [green]Fullmoon Island[blue]
for me?

If not for me, then for my son?"
entries.translation_source: That scientist said we need the [green]Lunar Wing[blue] from [green]Fullmoon Island[blue] to heal my son. Would you go to [green]Fullmoon Island[blue] for me? If not for me, then for my son?
entries.translated:
Ilmuwan itu mengatakan kita
membutuhkan [green]Lunar Wing[blue] dari\l[green]Fullmoon Island[blue] untuk menyembuhkan

putraku. Maukah kamu pergi ke
[green]Fullmoon Island[blue] untukku? Jika bukan\luntukku, maka untuk putraku?

entries.original:
"Great, thanks!
We’re both counting on you!

Only you can awaken my son from his
awful nightmare\.

Please, I need the Lunar Wing from
Fullmoon Island to awaken him!

When you’re ready to go, I have a
boat in Fallshore City that can\ltake us there."
entries.translation_source: Great, thanks! We’re both counting on you! Only you can awaken my son from his awful nightmare\. Please, I need the Lunar Wing from Fullmoon Island to awaken him! When you’re ready to go, I have a boat in Fallshore City that can take us there.
entries.translated:
Bagus, terima kasih! Kami berdua
mengandalkanmu! Hanya kamu yang\lbisa membangunkan putraku dari

mimpi buruknya yang mengerikan\.
Tolong, aku butuh Lunar Wing dari\lFullmoon Island untuk

membangunkannya! Saat kamu siap
berangkat, aku punya perahu di\lFallshore City yang bisa membawa

kita ke sana.

entries.original:
"Please, I need the Lunar Wing from
Fullmoon Island to awaken him!"
entries.translation_source: Please, I need the Lunar Wing from Fullmoon Island to awaken him!
entries.translated:
Tolong, aku butuh Lunar Wing dari
Fullmoon Island untuk\lmembangunkannya!

entries.original: "Do you wanna set sail?"
entries.translation_source: Do you wanna set sail?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu ingin berlayar?

entries.original:
"\.You\.

You’re ready to go to Fullmoon
Island for us?"
entries.translation_source: \.You\. You’re ready to go to Fullmoon Island for us?
entries.translated:
\.Kamu\. Kamu siap pergi ke Fullmoon
Island untuk kami?

entries.original: "Anchors aweigh!"
entries.translation_source: Anchors aweigh!
entries.translated: Jangkar terangkat!

entries.original:
"That Pokémon you met was the
Lunar Pokémon\.

I’ve heard tales of it flying from
place to place throughout Borrius.

Oh! That sparkle\.
So that’s the Lunar Wing\.

Thank you\. That should wake my son
from the nightmare\."
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon you met was the Lunar Pokémon\. I’ve heard tales of it flying from place to place throughout Borrius. Oh! That sparkle\. So that’s the Lunar Wing\. Thank you\. That should wake my son from the nightmare\.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang kamu temui adalah
Pokémon Lunar\. Aku pernah mendengar\lcerita tentangnya terbang dari satu

tempat ke tempat lain di seluruh
Borrius. Oh! Kilauan itu\. Jadi\litulah Lunar Wing\. Terima kasih\. Itu

seharusnya bisa membangunkan
putraku dari mimpi buruk\.

entries.original: "Should we sail back to Fallshore?"
entries.translation_source: Should we sail back to Fallshore?
entries.translated:
Haruskah kita berlayar kembali ke
Fallshore?

entries.original:
"[blue]Now that we have the Lunar Wing,
I’m going to return to Tarmigan.

Please hurry and meet me at
my home."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Now that we have the Lunar Wing, I’m going to return to Tarmigan. Please hurry and meet me at my home.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang setelah kita memiliki
Lunar Wing, aku akan kembali ke\lTarmigan. Tolong cepat dan temui

aku di rumahku.

entries.original:
"Please bring the Lunar Wing to
my son."
entries.translation_source: Please bring the Lunar Wing to my son.
entries.translated:
Tolong bawakan Lunar Wing untuk
putraku.

entries.original: "You’re awake!"
entries.translation_source: You’re awake!
entries.translated: Kamu bangun!

entries.original:
"As soon as you came near my son,
the Lunar Wing began to glow.

He woke up not long after, but it
seemed like you fell into a trance.

Now, seeing you and my son back to
normal makes me feel great!

I don’t have much that I can give
you in the way of thanks, but\lmaybe this can serve you more\lpurpose than it does me."
entries.translation_source: As soon as you came near my son, the Lunar Wing began to glow. He woke up not long after, but it seemed like you fell into a trance. Now, seeing you and my son back to normal makes me feel great! I don’t have much that I can give you in the way of thanks, but maybe this can serve you more purpose than it does me.
entries.translated:
Begitu kamu mendekati putraku,
Lunar Wing mulai bersinar. Dia\lterbangun tidak lama setelah itu,

tapi sepertinya kamu jatuh ke dalam
trans. Sekarang, melihat kamu dan\lputraku kembali normal membuatku

merasa senang! Aku tidak punya
banyak yang bisa kuberikan sebagai\lucapan terima kasih, tapi mungkin

ini bisa lebih berguna bagimu
daripada bagiku.

entries.original:
"Thank you!
We’ll never forget you!

I’ll be by the docks in Fallshore
City if you ever need to set sail."
entries.translation_source: Thank you! We’ll never forget you! I’ll be by the docks in Fallshore City if you ever need to set sail.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih! Kami tidak akan
pernah melupakanmu! Aku akan berada\ldi dermaga di Fallshore City jika

kamu perlu berlayar.

entries.original:
"I’m currently researching new ways
of waking Pokémon up from the\lSleep status condition.

These could have many applications
in modern-day life, so please,\ldo not disturb me."
entries.translation_source: I’m currently researching new ways of waking Pokémon up from the Sleep status condition. These could have many applications in modern-day life, so please, do not disturb me.
entries.translated:
Saat ini aku sedang meneliti cara
baru untuk membangunkan Pokémon\ldari kondisi status Tidur. Ini bisa

memiliki banyak aplikasi dalam
kehidupan modern, jadi tolong,\ljangan ganggu aku.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there.
Do you need something?

\.

\.

A small boy won’t wake up from a
horrible nightmare?

And the father is in need of some
assistance to cure him?

This seems to be close enough to my
area of research.

I’ll go take a look."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there. Do you need something? \. \. A small boy won’t wake up from a horrible nightmare? And the father is in need of some assistance to cure him? This seems to be close enough to my area of research. I’ll go take a look.
entries.translated:
Oh, halo. Apakah kamu perlu
sesuatu? \. \. Seorang anak kecil tidak\lbangun dari mimpi buruk yang

mengerikan? Dan sang ayah
membutuhkan bantuan untuk\lmenyembuhkannya? Ini tampaknya

cukup dekat dengan bidang
penelitian saya. Saya akan pergi\lmelihat.

entries.original:
"I don’t know how much good it did,
but I hope I was able to help\lin some way. "
entries.translation_source: I don’t know how much good it did, but I hope I was able to help in some way.
entries.translated:
Saya tidak tahu seberapa besar
manfaatnya, tapi saya harap saya\lbisa membantu dengan cara tertentu.

entries.original:
"I heard you were able to heal that
boy after all!

I’m glad I was able to help."
entries.translation_source: I heard you were able to heal that boy after all! I’m glad I was able to help.
entries.translated:
Saya dengar kamu akhirnya bisa
menyembuhkan anak itu! Saya senang\lbisa membantu.

entries.original:
"[black]The little boy is thrashing about
in his sleep.

He appears to be in torment\.
He is muttering something\.

\qo[blue]Dar\.
Dark\. is watching\. me\. [black]\qc"
entries.translation_source: [black]The little boy is thrashing about in his sleep. He appears to be in torment\. He is muttering something\. \qo[blue]Dar\. Dark\. is watching\. me\. [black]\qc
entries.translated:
[black]Anak kecil itu menggeliat dalam
tidurnya. Dia tampak tersiksa\. Dia\lmenggumamkan sesuatu\. \qo[blue]Dar\. Dark\.

sedang mengawasi\. aku\. [black]\qc

entries.original:
"I’m going to be a Sailor like
my daddy!

He’s a real man among men!
Even the sea doesn’t scare him!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to be a Sailor like my daddy! He’s a real man among men! Even the sea doesn’t scare him!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menjadi seorang Pelaut
seperti ayahku! Dia pria sejati di\lantara pria! Bahkan laut tidak

menakutinya!

entries.original:
"[black]The little boy is thrashing about
in his sleep.

[player]’s Lunar Wing began to
glow\.

The boy’s sleeping face became
untroubled and serene!

The little boy woke up!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The little boy is thrashing about in his sleep. [player]’s Lunar Wing began to glow\. The boy’s sleeping face became untroubled and serene! The little boy woke up!
entries.translated:
[black]Anak kecil itu menggeliat dalam
tidurnya. [player]{B4}s Lunar Wing\lmulai bersinar\. Wajah tidur anak itu

menjadi tenang dan damai! Anak
kecil itu bangun!

entries.original:
"I never thought our boy would fall
into this endless nightmare\.

It’s happened in the past
in Tarmigan\.

There were people who never woke up
from their nightmares\."
entries.translation_source: I never thought our boy would fall into this endless nightmare\. It’s happened in the past in Tarmigan\. There were people who never woke up from their nightmares\.
entries.translated:
Saya tidak pernah berpikir anak
kami akan jatuh ke dalam mimpi\lburuk tanpa akhir ini\. Ini pernah

terjadi di masa lalu di Tarmigan\.
Ada orang yang tidak pernah bangun\ldari mimpi buruk mereka\.

entries.original:
"Our boy has too much energy!
\.That’s the best way to be!"
entries.translation_source: Our boy has too much energy! \.That’s the best way to be!
entries.translated:
Anak kami memiliki terlalu banyak
energi! \.Itulah cara terbaik untuk\lmenjadi!

entries.original: "[red]Hmm\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Hmm\.
entries.translated: [red]Hmm\.

entries.original:
"[red]From what I can gather, a horrible
Pokémon has locked him in an\lendless nightmare.

I’m uncertain if he’ll ever be able
to wake up from it\."
entries.translation_source: [red]From what I can gather, a horrible Pokémon has locked him in an endless nightmare. I’m uncertain if he’ll ever be able to wake up from it\.
entries.translated:
[red]Dari apa yang bisa saya kumpulkan,
Pokémon yang mengerikan telah\lmenguncinya dalam mimpi buruk tanpa

akhir. Saya tidak yakin apakah dia
akan pernah bisa bangun darinya\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Please!

There has to be something you
can do.

Don’t you scientists get funding
for this kind of thing?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Please! There has to be something you can do. Don’t you scientists get funding for this kind of thing?
entries.translated:
[blue]Tolong! Pasti ada sesuatu yang bisa
kamu lakukan. Bukankah kalian\lilmuwan mendapatkan dana untuk hal

semacam ini?

entries.original:
"[red]Hmm\.

Upon closer examination, there may
be a way to heal him after all.

We don’t get funding for situations
like these, but there is something\lyou can do that might help.

Go to Fullmoon Island.

It is there you’ll find a Pokémon
that can heal your son\.

But that’s all I can say.
Best of luck."
entries.translation_source: [red]Hmm\. Upon closer examination, there may be a way to heal him after all. We don’t get funding for situations like these, but there is something you can do that might help. Go to Fullmoon Island. It is there you’ll find a Pokémon that can heal your son\. But that’s all I can say. Best of luck.
entries.translated:
[red]Hmm\. Setelah pemeriksaan lebih
dekat, mungkin ada cara untuk\lmenyembuhkannya setelah semua. Kami

tidak mendapatkan dana untuk
situasi seperti ini, tetapi ada\lsesuatu yang bisa kamu lakukan yang

mungkin membantu. Pergi ke Fullmoon
Island. Di sanalah kamu akan\lmenemukan Pokémon yang bisa

menyembuhkan anakmu\. Tapi hanya itu
yang bisa saya katakan. Semoga\lberuntung.

entries.original: "[blue]What a waste of my tax money\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]What a waste of my tax money\.
entries.translated: [blue]Sia-sia sekali uang pajak saya\.

entries.original:
"[black]He’s unconscious.
Better leave him alone for now."
entries.translation_source: [black]He’s unconscious. Better leave him alone for now.
entries.translated:
[black]Dia tidak sadarkan diri. Lebih baik
tinggalkan dia sendiri untuk saat\lini.

entries.original:
"Staraptor!

Let’s get out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! Let’s get out of here!
entries.translated: Staraptor! Ayo keluar dari sini!

entries.original:
"Ho ho ho!

Where’s my package?"
entries.translation_source: Ho ho ho! Where’s my package?
entries.translated: Ho ho ho! Di mana paket saya?

entries.original:
"Why\.?

Why would you do this to me\.?

Take away the one thing I have left
to live for\.

My children\.

Now, I’ll make sure you pay for
all eternity\."
entries.translation_source: Why\.? Why would you do this to me\.? Take away the one thing I have left to live for\. My children\. Now, I’ll make sure you pay for all eternity\.
entries.translated:
Mengapa\.? Mengapa kamu melakukan ini
padaku\.? Ambil satu-satunya hal yang\lkumiliki untuk hidup\. Anak-anakku\.

Sekarang, aku akan memastikan kamu
membayar selamanya\.

entries.original:
"Welcome home, dear!

Welcome home, dear!

Welcome home, dear!

Welcome home, dear!

Welcome home, dear!

Welcome to your new home, dear!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome home, dear! Welcome home, dear! Welcome home, dear! Welcome home, dear! Welcome home, dear! Welcome to your new home, dear!
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di rumah, sayang!
Selamat datang di rumah, sayang!\lSelamat datang di rumah, sayang!

Selamat datang di rumah, sayang!
Selamat datang di rumah, sayang!\lSelamat datang di rumah barumu,

sayang!

entries.original:
"[black]The little boy is thrashing about
in his sleep.

He appears to be in torment\.
He is muttering something\.

\qo[blue]You\.
You’re doomed\.[black]\qc"
entries.translation_source: [black]The little boy is thrashing about in his sleep. He appears to be in torment\. He is muttering something\. \qo[blue]You\. You’re doomed\.[black]\qc
entries.translated:
[black]Anak kecil itu menggeliat dalam
tidurnya. Dia tampak tersiksa\. Dia\lmenggumamkan sesuatu\. \qo[blue]Kamu\. Kamu

akan binasa\. [black]\qc

entries.original:
"It’s all your fault\.

My son\.

He’ll never wake up now\.

What have you done\.

WHAT HAVE YOU DONE!?"
entries.translation_source: It’s all your fault\. My son\. He’ll never wake up now\. What have you done\. WHAT HAVE YOU DONE!?
entries.translated:
Ini semua salahmu\. Anakku\. Dia tidak
akan pernah bangun sekarang\. Apa\lyang telah kamu lakukan\. APA YANG

TELAH KAMU LAKUKAN!?

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon stares at you with
cold dead eyes\."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Pokémon stares at you with cold dead eyes\.
entries.translated:
[black]Pokémon itu menatapmu dengan mata
dingin dan kosong\.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon used the power of the
nightmare to increase its size!"
entries.translation_source: [black]The Pokémon used the power of the nightmare to increase its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Pokémon itu menggunakan kekuatan
mimpi buruk untuk memperbesar\lukurannya!

entries.original: "The Food Thief"
entries.translation_source: The Food Thief
entries.translated: Pencuri Makanan

entries.original:
"I just don’t know what to do.

Every few days, this horrible
Pokémon has been coming into my\lhouse and stealing my food.

If I had a [green]Pokédex[blue], I could know
what it was and how to stop it\.

If you get a [green]Pokédex[blue], would you
come back and help me?"
entries.translation_source: I just don’t know what to do. Every few days, this horrible Pokémon has been coming into my house and stealing my food. If I had a [green]Pokédex[blue], I could know what it was and how to stop it\. If you get a [green]Pokédex[blue], would you come back and help me?
entries.translated:
Aku benar-benar tidak tahu harus
berbuat apa. Setiap beberapa hari,\lPokémon mengerikan ini masuk ke

rumahku dan mencuri makananku. Jika
aku punya [green]Pokédex[blue], aku bisa tahu\lapa itu dan cara menghentikannya\.

Jika kamu mendapat [green]Pokédex[blue], maukah
kamu kembali dan membantuku?

entries.original:
"I just don’t know what to do.

Every few days, this horrible
Pokémon has been coming into my\lhouse and stealing my food.

I could stop it if I had a Pokémon
of my own, but unfortunately I\lhave none.

Oh!
I just had an idea!

Would you be able to\."
entries.translation_source: I just don’t know what to do. Every few days, this horrible Pokémon has been coming into my house and stealing my food. I could stop it if I had a Pokémon of my own, but unfortunately I have none. Oh! I just had an idea! Would you be able to\.
entries.translated:
Aku benar-benar tidak tahu harus
berbuat apa. Setiap beberapa hari,\lPokémon mengerikan ini masuk ke

rumahku dan mencuri makananku. Aku
bisa menghentikannya jika aku\lmemiliki Pokémon sendiri, tapi

sayangnya aku tidak punya. Oh! Aku
baru saja punya ide! Maukah kamu\.

entries.original:
"Ahh!

There it is again!

It’s come to steal more food!"
entries.translation_source: Ahh! There it is again! It’s come to steal more food!
entries.translated:
Ahh! Itu lagi! Dia datang untuk
mencuri lebih banyak makanan!

entries.original: "No! Get away from my fridge!"
entries.translation_source: No! Get away from my fridge!
entries.translated: Tidak! Jauhi kulkasku!

entries.original: "[red]I’ll stop it from leaving, Daddy!"
entries.translation_source: [red]I’ll stop it from leaving, Daddy!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku akan menghentikannya pergi,
Ayah!

entries.original:
"[red]Waaaah!

Daddy! It hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Waaaah! Daddy! It hurt me!
entries.translated: [red]Waaaah! Ayah! Itu menyakitiku!

entries.original:
"It’s alright sweetie\.

Daddy’s not going to let that
Pokémon hurt you anymore."
entries.translation_source: It’s alright sweetie\. Daddy’s not going to let that Pokémon hurt you anymore.
entries.translated:
Tidak apa-apa sayang\. Ayah tidak
akan membiarkan Pokémon itu\lmenyakitimu lagi.

entries.original:
"If you can help me out and get my
food back from that Pokémon, I’d\lbe extremely grateful!

There might be a little something
in it for you as well\."
entries.translation_source: If you can help me out and get my food back from that Pokémon, I’d be extremely grateful! There might be a little something in it for you as well\.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa membantuku dan
mendapatkan kembali makananku dari\lPokémon itu, aku akan sangat

bersyukur! Mungkin ada sedikit
sesuatu untukmu juga\.
