entries.original:
"I’m extremely grateful for your
help!

I’m going to train my new Pokémon,
and if you’re lucky, maybe you’ll\lbe able to battle me someday."
entries.translation_source: I’m extremely grateful for your help! I’m going to train my new Pokémon, and if you’re lucky, maybe you’ll be able to battle me someday.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat bersyukur atas
bantuanmu! Aku akan melatih Pokémon\lbaruku, dan jika kamu beruntung,

mungkin kamu bisa bertarung
denganku suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Hey! It’s you again! Thanks again
for your help!

Now, how would you like to battle
my Pokémon and me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! It’s you again! Thanks again for your help! Now, how would you like to battle my Pokémon and me?
entries.translated:
Hei! Kamu lagi! Terima kasih lagi
atas bantuanmu! Sekarang, bagaimana\ljika kamu bertarung dengan

Pokémonku dan aku?

entries.original:
"Alright!

Just wait and see how strong my
Sandslash has become!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! Just wait and see how strong my Sandslash has become!
entries.translated:
Baiklah! Tunggu saja dan lihat
seberapa kuat Sandslash-ku\lsekarang!

entries.original:
"Thanks for the battle!

Feel free to come back tomorrow and
battle me again."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for the battle! Feel free to come back tomorrow and battle me again.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih untuk pertarungannya!
Silakan kembali besok dan bertarung\ldenganku lagi.

entries.original:
"Feel free to come back anytime for
a battle."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to come back anytime for a battle.
entries.translated:
Silakan kembali kapan saja untuk
bertarung.

entries.original:
"I wish we had our own Pokémon.

I’m always so bored at home."
entries.translation_source: I wish we had our own Pokémon. I’m always so bored at home.
entries.translated:
Aku berharap kami memiliki Pokémon
sendiri. Aku selalu bosan di rumah.

entries.original:
"My daddy trained our Pokémon a lot!
It’s really strong now!"
entries.translation_source: My daddy trained our Pokémon a lot! It’s really strong now!
entries.translated:
Ayahku melatih Pokémon kami dengan
keras! Dia sangat kuat sekarang!

entries.original:
"Wahh!

Daddy! That Pokémon hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: Wahh! Daddy! That Pokémon hurt me!
entries.translated:
Wahh! Ayah! Pokémon itu
menyakitiku!

entries.original:
"It should be packed with all kinds
of delicious things to eat\.

But it’s empty now!"
entries.translation_source: It should be packed with all kinds of delicious things to eat\. But it’s empty now!
entries.translated:
Seharusnya penuh dengan berbagai
macam makanan lezat untuk dimakan\.\lTapi sekarang kosong!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon appears to be heading
towards [green]Icicle Cave[black]."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon appears to be heading towards [green]Icicle Cave[black].
entries.translated:
Pokémon itu tampaknya menuju ke
[green]Icicle Cave[black].

entries.original: "Would you look at that\."
entries.translation_source: Would you look at that\.
entries.translated: Lihatlah itu\.

entries.original: "[green]Slash!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Slash!
entries.translated: [green]Slash!

entries.original:
"Aha!

I’ve cornered you!

After that battle, you’re too weak
to escape!

Now, return the food you stole!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! I’ve cornered you! After that battle, you’re too weak to escape! Now, return the food you stole!
entries.translated:
Aha! Aku sudah menjebakmu! Setelah
pertarungan itu, kamu terlalu lemah\luntuk melarikan diri! Sekarang,

kembalikan makanan yang kau curi!

entries.original:
"Huh, what’s this?

Have you been stealing my food for
your friends and family?"
entries.translation_source: Huh, what’s this? Have you been stealing my food for your friends and family?
entries.translated:
Hah, apa ini? Apakah kamu selama
ini mencuri makananku untuk teman\ldan keluargamu?

entries.original:
"That cry\.

I’ve heard it somewhere before\.

Ah!

You must be one of those rare Ice-
type Sandslash that live up here!

Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped
coming to feed you?

Now that I mention it, I haven’t
seen them around in a while\."
entries.translation_source: That cry\. I’ve heard it somewhere before\. Ah! You must be one of those rare Ice- type Sandslash that live up here! Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped coming to feed you? Now that I mention it, I haven’t seen them around in a while\.
entries.translated:
Tangisan itu\. Aku pernah
mendengarnya di suatu tempat\lsebelumnya\. Ah! Kamu pasti salah

satu dari Sandslash tipe Es langka
yang tinggal di sini! Apakah\lPokémon Rangers berhenti datang

untuk memberimu makan? Sekarang
setelah kusebut, aku sudah lama\ltidak melihat mereka di sini\.

entries.original:
"Then I was right.

You’ve been hungry because your
food supply stopped coming.

Let me make you a deal then,
Sandslash.

If you become my Pokémon and help
me make an income through battling,\lI will support you, your friends,\land your family through the money\lwe make.

Does that work for you?"
entries.translation_source: Then I was right. You’ve been hungry because your food supply stopped coming. Let me make you a deal then, Sandslash. If you become my Pokémon and help me make an income through battling, I will support you, your friends, and your family through the money we make. Does that work for you?
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu aku benar. Kamu sudah
kelaparan karena pasokan makananmu\lberhenti datang. Biarkan aku

menawarkan kesepakatan, Sandslash.
Jika kamu menjadi Pokémonku dan\lmembantuku menghasilkan uang

melalui pertarungan, aku akan
mendukungmu, teman-temanmu, dan\lkeluargamu dengan uang yang kita

hasilkan. Apakah itu cocok untukmu?

entries.original: "Then it’s settled, let’s go."
entries.translation_source: Then it’s settled, let’s go.
entries.translated: Kalau begitu sudah diputuskan, ayo.

entries.original:
"Thanks for helping track down the
food thief!

As promised, here’s your little
something."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for helping track down the food thief! As promised, here’s your little something.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah membantu melacak
pencuri makanan! Sesuai janji, ini\lsedikit sesuatu untukmu.

entries.original:
"That TM contains [green]Hone Claws[blue].

If you plan on challenging the
[green]Dresco Gym[blue], it’ll help you a lot.

It’s very foggy and hard to see in
there\."
entries.translation_source: That TM contains [green]Hone Claws[blue]. If you plan on challenging the [green]Dresco Gym[blue], it’ll help you a lot. It’s very foggy and hard to see in there\.
entries.translated:
TM itu berisi [green]Hone Claws[blue]. Jika kamu
berencana menantang [green]Dresco Gym[blue], itu\lakan sangat membantumu. Di dalam

sana sangat berkabut dan sulit
melihat\.

entries.original: "Guardians of the Lake"
entries.translation_source: Guardians of the Lake
entries.translated: Penjaga Danau

entries.original: "Researcher"
entries.translation_source: Researcher
entries.translated: Peneliti

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of the
great lakes of Sinnoh?

Rumour is they’re associated with
some powerful Pokémon.

My research is centred around
these Pokémon.

I’m looking for a research
assistant, but someone a little\lstronger than yourself."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of the great lakes of Sinnoh? Rumour is they’re associated with some powerful Pokémon. My research is centred around these Pokémon. I’m looking for a research assistant, but someone a little stronger than yourself.
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang
danau-danau besar Sinnoh? Konon\lmereka terkait dengan beberapa

Pokémon yang kuat. Penelitianku
berfokus pada Pokémon-pokémon ini.\lAku sedang mencari asisten

penelitian, tapi seseorang yang
sedikit lebih kuat darimu.

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of the
great lakes of Sinnoh?

Rumour is they’re associated with
some powerful Pokémon.

My research is centred around
these Pokémon.

I’m looking for a research
assistant to aid me.

Would you be willing to assist me
in my research?"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of the great lakes of Sinnoh? Rumour is they’re associated with some powerful Pokémon. My research is centred around these Pokémon. I’m looking for a research assistant to aid me. Would you be willing to assist me in my research?
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang
danau-danau besar Sinnoh? Konon\lmereka terkait dengan beberapa

Pokémon yang kuat. Penelitianku
berfokus pada Pokémon-pokémon ini.\lAku mencari asisten penelitian

untuk membantuku. Apakah kamu
bersedia membantuku dalam\lpenelitianku?

entries.original:
"Where’s that Trainer curiousity you
should have?"
entries.translation_source: Where’s that Trainer curiousity you should have?
entries.translated:
Di mana rasa ingin tahu seorang
Trainer yang seharusnya kamu\lmiliki?

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

Please meet me in the [green]Cave of Being[red]
on [green]Route 10[red].

We will start our research by
scanning the area to find any clues\lof Pokémon that might inhabit the\lCave of Being."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Please meet me in the [green]Cave of Being[red] on [green]Route 10[red]. We will start our research by scanning the area to find any clues of Pokémon that might inhabit the Cave of Being.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Silakan temui aku di
[green]Cave of Being[red] di [green]Route 10[red]. Kita\lakan memulai penelitian dengan

memindai area untuk mencari
petunjuk tentang Pokémon yang\lmungkin menghuni Cave of Being.

entries.original:
"This space\.

It’s hard to put into words, but it
feels full of something\.

And something feels odd about the
centre of that puddle\."
entries.translation_source: This space\. It’s hard to put into words, but it feels full of something\. And something feels odd about the centre of that puddle\.
entries.translated:
Ruang ini\. Sulit diungkapkan dengan
kata-kata, tapi terasa penuh dengan\lsesuatu\. Dan ada yang terasa aneh di

tengah genangan air itu\.

entries.original: "A mysterious presence can be felt!"
entries.translation_source: A mysterious presence can be felt!
entries.translated:
Ada kehadiran misterius yang dapat
dirasakan!

entries.original: "[red]Uxie!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Uxie!
entries.translated: [red]Uxie!

entries.original: "[red]Mesprit\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Mesprit\.
entries.translated: [red]Mesprit\.

entries.original: "[red]And Azelf!"
entries.translation_source: [red]And Azelf!
entries.translated: [red]Dan Azelf!

entries.original: "[buffer1] went flying off somewhere\."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1] went flying off somewhere\.
entries.translated: [buffer1] terbang entah ke mana\.

entries.original:
"[red]Those three are Uxie, Mesprit,
and Azelf.

They’re thought to be the Pokémon
that gave us knowledge, emotion,\land willpower.

Still, I wonder where those three
went\.

Hey, assistant!

Look all over the Borrius region,
and try to find them!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Those three are Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf. They’re thought to be the Pokémon that gave us knowledge, emotion, and willpower. Still, I wonder where those three went\. Hey, assistant! Look all over the Borrius region, and try to find them!
entries.translated:
[red]Ketiganya adalah Uxie, Mesprit, dan
Azelf. Mereka diyakini sebagai\lPokémon yang memberikan kita

pengetahuan, emosi, dan tekad.
Namun, aku penasaran ke mana mereka\lpergi\. Hei, asisten! Telusuri

seluruh wilayah Borrius, dan
cobalah temukan mereka!

entries.original:
"I wonder where those three
Pokémon flew off to?

Uxie is a Pokémon that symbolizes
knowledge\.

If you mention a place in Borrius
where knowledge is gathered, the\lfirst thing that comes to mind is\lthe [green]Dream Research Lab[red]\.

Mesprit is a Pokémon that presides
over emotion, right?

Maybe someplace where you [green]heard[red]
something that stirred your\lemotions?

And Azelf is willpower\.

The desire to [green]see something
through[red]\.

What place could represent that?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder where those three Pokémon flew off to? Uxie is a Pokémon that symbolizes knowledge\. If you mention a place in Borrius where knowledge is gathered, the first thing that comes to mind is the [green]Dream Research Lab[red]\. Mesprit is a Pokémon that presides over emotion, right? Maybe someplace where you [green]heard[red] something that stirred your emotions? And Azelf is willpower\. The desire to [green]see something through[red]\. What place could represent that?
entries.translated:
Aku penasaran ke mana ketiga
Pokémon itu terbang? Uxie adalah\lPokémon yang melambangkan

pengetahuan\. Jika kamu menyebut
tempat di Borrius yang mengumpulkan\lpengetahuan, hal pertama yang

terlintas adalah [green]Dream Research Lab[red]\.
Mesprit adalah Pokémon yang\lmenguasai emosi, kan? Mungkin suatu

tempat di mana kamu [green]mendengar[red]
sesuatu yang menggugah emosimu? Dan\lAzelf adalah tekad\. Keinginan untuk

[green]menyelesaikan sesuatu[red]\. Tempat apa
yang bisa mewakili itu?

entries.original:
"I have this feeling that you caught
the three Pokémon that flew off.

Can you bring them here for me
to see?"
entries.translation_source: I have this feeling that you caught the three Pokémon that flew off. Can you bring them here for me to see?
entries.translated:
Aku merasa kamu telah menangkap
ketiga Pokémon yang terbang.\lBisakah kamu membawa mereka ke sini

untuk kulihat?

entries.original:
"Good work on the capture of the
three Pokémon, assistant.

Now, do you feel it?

The space\.
It feels full again\."
entries.translation_source: Good work on the capture of the three Pokémon, assistant. Now, do you feel it? The space\. It feels full again\.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus dalam menangkap ketiga
Pokémon, asisten. Sekarang, apakah\lkamu merasakannya? Ruang itu\. Terasa

penuh lagi\.

entries.original:
"Astounding!
Simply astounding!

It appears your three Pokémon have
allowed Dialga, the master of time\lto begin crossing over into our\ldimension!

It is well known that these
Pokémon share a unique bond, but\lI did not expect this to happen!

Although, take note that Dialga
lacks a reflection.

That must mean it is waiting for
you to capture it before it can\lcompletely enter our dimension.

My colleagues at the Science
Society will be most pleased with\lmy findings\.

And as a reward for your assistance,
please take this rare orb that\lseems to resonate with Dialga."
entries.translation_source: Astounding! Simply astounding! It appears your three Pokémon have allowed Dialga, the master of time to begin crossing over into our dimension! It is well known that these Pokémon share a unique bond, but I did not expect this to happen! Although, take note that Dialga lacks a reflection. That must mean it is waiting for you to capture it before it can completely enter our dimension. My colleagues at the Science Society will be most pleased with my findings\. And as a reward for your assistance, please take this rare orb that seems to resonate with Dialga.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Sungguh luar biasa!
Tampaknya ketiga Pokémon-mu telah\lmemungkinkan Dialga, penguasa

waktu, untuk mulai menyeberang ke
dimensi kita! Sudah diketahui bahwa\lPokémon ini memiliki ikatan unik,

tetapi aku tidak menduga ini akan
terjadi! Meskipun, perhatikan bahwa\lDialga tidak memiliki bayangan. Itu

pasti berarti ia menunggumu untuk
menangkapnya sebelum ia dapat\lsepenuhnya memasuki dimensi kita.

Rekan-rekanku di Science Society
akan sangat senang dengan temuanku\.\lDan sebagai hadiah atas bantuanmu,

tolong ambil bola langka ini yang
tampaknya beresonansi dengan\lDialga.

entries.original: "May we meet again, assistant."
entries.translation_source: May we meet again, assistant.
entries.translated: Semoga kita bertemu lagi, asisten.

entries.original:
"A mysterious presence can be felt
here! Check the surrounding area?"
entries.translation_source: A mysterious presence can be felt here! Check the surrounding area?
entries.translated:
Kehadiran misterius terasa di sini!
Periksa area sekitarnya?

entries.original: "[green]Kyouuun!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Kyouuun!
entries.translated: [green]Kyouuun!

entries.original: "[green]Kyuun!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Kyuun!
entries.translated: [green]Kyuun!

entries.original: "[green]Kyauun!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Kyauun!
entries.translated: [green]Kyauun!

entries.original: "[green]Gugyugubah!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Gugyugubah!
entries.translated: [green]Gugyugubah!

entries.original: "Dialga disappeared into time."
entries.translation_source: Dialga disappeared into time.
entries.translated: Dialga menghilang ke dalam waktu.

entries.original: "Herd But Not Seen"
entries.translation_source: Herd But Not Seen
entries.translated: Kawanan Tak Terlihat

entries.original:
"Our Miltank are our pride and joy!

It’d be an awful shame if something
happened to them.

There’d go our livelihood!"
entries.translation_source: Our Miltank are our pride and joy! It’d be an awful shame if something happened to them. There’d go our livelihood!
entries.translated:
Miltank kami adalah kebanggaan dan
kegembiraan kami! Akan sangat\ldisayangkan jika sesuatu terjadi

pada mereka. Itu akan menghancurkan
mata pencaharian kami!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me!

The Miltank, our pride and joy\.
They’ve been stolen!

Some thugs callin’ themselves the
\qoTerror Granbull\qc or somethin’ or\lother came and nabbed our Miltank!

How are we gonna survive without
’em?

\.

That’s it!

You’re Borrius’ new Champion,
aren’t you?

Won’t you help us get our Miltank
back?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me! The Miltank, our pride and joy\. They’ve been stolen! Some thugs callin’ themselves the \qoTerror Granbull\qc or somethin’ or other came and nabbed our Miltank! How are we gonna survive without ’em? \. That’s it! You’re Borrius’ new Champion, aren’t you? Won’t you help us get our Miltank back?
entries.translated:
Oh, astaga! Miltank, kebanggaan dan
kegembiraan kami\. Mereka telah\ldicuri! Beberapa preman yang

menyebut diri mereka \qoTerror
Granbull\qc atau semacamnya datang\ldan menculik Miltank kami!

Bagaimana kami bisa bertahan tanpa
mereka? \. Itu dia! Kamu adalah Juara\lbaru Borrius, kan? Maukah kamu

membantu kami mendapatkan kembali
Miltank kami?

entries.original:
"Thanks, hon, you’re a real
life saver.

Those thugs can’t have gotten far.

I’d wager they’re in the [green]Magnolia
Fields[red] as we speak."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, hon, you’re a real life saver. Those thugs can’t have gotten far. I’d wager they’re in the [green]Magnolia Fields[red] as we speak.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, sayang, kamu
benar-benar penyelamat. Para preman\litu pasti tidak pergi jauh. Aku

yakin mereka ada di [green]Magnolia Fields[red]
saat ini.

entries.original:
"Our Miltank ain’t the brightest
of cattle.

If you approach any in the [green]Magnolia
Fields[red], they’ll prolly run away\lfrom you until they hit a wall.

If you can get ’em to run back to
town, then we’ll take it from there."
entries.translation_source: Our Miltank ain’t the brightest of cattle. If you approach any in the [green]Magnolia Fields[red], they’ll prolly run away from you until they hit a wall. If you can get ’em to run back to town, then we’ll take it from there.
entries.translated:
Miltank kami bukanlah sapi yang
paling pintar. Jika kamu mendekati\lsalah satu di [green]Magnolia Fields[red],

mereka mungkin akan lari darimu
sampai menabrak tembok. Jika kamu\lbisa membuat mereka lari kembali ke

kota, maka kami akan mengurus
sisanya.

entries.original:
"Some of our pride and joy, the
Miltank have returned to the farm!

But there are still some out in the
[green]Magnolia Fields[red], I reckon."
entries.translation_source: Some of our pride and joy, the Miltank have returned to the farm! But there are still some out in the [green]Magnolia Fields[red], I reckon.
entries.translated:
Beberapa dari kebanggaan dan
kegembiraan kami, Miltank, telah\lkembali ke peternakan! Tapi masih

ada beberapa di [green]Magnolia Fields[red],
kurasa.

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me!

If the Champion can’t help me,
then who can?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me! If the Champion can’t help me, then who can?
entries.translated:
Oh, ya ampun! Jika Juara tidak bisa
membantu saya, lalu siapa yang\lbisa?

entries.original:
"Our pride and joy, the Miltank
have returned to the farm!

I can’t thank you enough for
this, hon.

You gotta take this year’s supply
of Moomoo Milk as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: Our pride and joy, the Miltank have returned to the farm! I can’t thank you enough for this, hon. You gotta take this year’s supply of Moomoo Milk as my thanks.
entries.translated:
Kebanggaan dan kegembiraan kami,
Miltank telah kembali ke\lpeternakan! Saya tidak bisa cukup

berterima kasih untuk ini, sayang.
Kamu harus mengambil persediaan\lSusu Moomoo tahun ini sebagai

ucapan terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"Thanks to you, we have our
livelihood back.

And business ain’t never been
better!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks to you, we have our livelihood back. And business ain’t never been better!
entries.translated:
Berkat kamu, kami mendapatkan
kembali mata pencaharian kami. Dan\lbisnis tidak pernah sebaik ini!

entries.original: "Miltank"
entries.translation_source: Miltank
entries.translated: Miltank

entries.original:
"Arright, boys!

You all messed up big time in
Cootes Bog, but this here is our\lbig score!

Hahaha!

These Miltank are gonna make us
rich!

We’re gonna milk ’em dry for
everything they have!"
entries.translation_source: Arright, boys! You all messed up big time in Cootes Bog, but this here is our big score! Hahaha! These Miltank are gonna make us rich! We’re gonna milk ’em dry for everything they have!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, teman-teman! Kalian semua
mengacau besar di Cootes Bog, tapi\lini adalah kesempatan besar kita!

Hahaha! Miltank ini akan membuat
kita kaya! Kita akan memerah mereka\lsampai kering untuk semua yang

mereka miliki!

entries.original:
"Come on, you stupid cow!

Give milk!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, you stupid cow! Give milk!
entries.translated: Ayolah, sapi bodoh! Beri susu!

entries.original: "[green]Mooooo\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Mooooo\.
entries.translated: [green]Mooooo\.

entries.original:
"I know you stupid cows produce over
five gallons of milk a day, so come\lon, fork it over!"
entries.translation_source: I know you stupid cows produce over five gallons of milk a day, so come on, fork it over!
entries.translated:
Aku tahu kalian sapi-sapi bodoh
menghasilkan lebih dari lima galon\lsusu sehari, jadi ayolah, serahkan!

entries.original:
"This just ain’t workin’ like I’d
hoped, boys.

Any of you got any bright ideas?"
entries.translation_source: This just ain’t workin’ like I’d hoped, boys. Any of you got any bright ideas?
entries.translated:
Ini tidak berjalan seperti yang
kuharapkan, teman-teman. Ada yang\lpunya ide bagus?

entries.original:
"Get back here you stupid cows!
I wasn’t done milkin’ ya!"
entries.translation_source: Get back here you stupid cows! I wasn’t done milkin’ ya!
entries.translated:
Kembali ke sini kalian sapi-sapi
bodoh! Aku belum selesai memerah\lsusu kalian!

entries.original:
"Huh?

It’s some punk kid!

Let’s rough [buffer2] up and snatch\."
entries.translation_source: Huh? It’s some punk kid! Let’s rough [buffer2] up and snatch\.
entries.translated:
Hah? Itu anak nakal! Ayo kita
kasarin [buffer2] up dan rebut\.

entries.original:
"Hold up, boys!
That kid looks awfully familiar\.

Wait, I know you\.\CC0820 you’re that little
punk who got all up in our business\lback at Route 10!

And from what I heard, you went
and messed with my boys back in\lCootes Bog too, didn’t ya?

And here ya are again.

Seriously, what’s the deal with
ya, punk!?

Boys! Watch yourself around
that punk kid!

Don’t underestimate [buffer2], or your
butts’ll be handed to ya faster\lthan you can say \qoGranbull\qc!"
entries.translation_source: Hold up, boys! That kid looks awfully familiar\. Wait, I know you\.\CC0820 you’re that little punk who got all up in our business back at Route 10! And from what I heard, you went and messed with my boys back in Cootes Bog too, didn’t ya? And here ya are again. Seriously, what’s the deal with ya, punk!? Boys! Watch yourself around that punk kid! Don’t underestimate [buffer2], or your butts’ll be handed to ya faster than you can say \qoGranbull\qc!
entries.translated:
Tahan, teman-teman! Anak itu
kelihatan sangat familiar\. Tunggu,\laku tahu kamu\.\CC0820 kamu adalah anak

nakal yang ikut campur urusan kami
di Route 10! Dan dari yang\lkudengar, kamu juga mengacau dengan

anak buahku di Cootes Bog, kan? Dan
sekarang kamu di sini lagi. Serius,\lada apa denganmu, bocah!?

Teman-teman! Hati-hati dengan anak
nakal itu! Jangan meremehkan\l[buffer2], atau pantat kalian akan

dihajar lebih cepat dari kamu
bilang \qoGranbull\qc!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry about a thing, Boss!

I’m gonna beat [buffer1] so hard, [buffer2]’s
gonna cry for [buffer3] momma!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry about a thing, Boss! I’m gonna beat [buffer1] so hard, [buffer2]’s gonna cry for [buffer3] momma!
entries.translated:
Jangan khawatir soal apa pun, Bos!
Aku akan menghajar [buffer1] begitu\lkeras, [buffer2] akan menangis

memanggil mama [buffer3]!

entries.original:
"You dumbo!

You can’t use your Granbull like
that!

Move over, and lemme show you how
to really use Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: You dumbo! You can’t use your Granbull like that! Move over, and lemme show you how to really use Granbull!
entries.translated:
Dasar gajah! Kamu tidak bisa
menggunakan Granbullmu seperti itu!\lMinggir, dan biarkan aku

menunjukkan cara menggunakan
Granbull yang sebenarnya!

entries.original:
"Gah! Ya stupid ding dongs!

I told ya NOT to underestimate
[buffer1]!

But what didja go ahead and do?
You underestimated [buffer1]!

Seriously, of all the goons, why’d
I get stuck with the dumbest ones?

I could throw schmuck after schmuck
at this kid, but I’m pretty sure\leven a thousand wouldn’t make a\ldifference!

Does that mean the Terror Granbull’s
stuck bein’ the losers forever\.?"
entries.translation_source: Gah! Ya stupid ding dongs! I told ya NOT to underestimate [buffer1]! But what didja go ahead and do? You underestimated [buffer1]! Seriously, of all the goons, why’d I get stuck with the dumbest ones? I could throw schmuck after schmuck at this kid, but I’m pretty sure even a thousand wouldn’t make a difference! Does that mean the Terror Granbull’s stuck bein’ the losers forever\.?
entries.translated:
Gah! Dasar bodoh! Aku sudah bilang
JANGAN meremehkan [buffer1]! Tapi\lapa yang kalian lakukan? Kalian

meremehkan [buffer1]! Serius, dari
semua preman, kenapa aku harus\lterjebak dengan yang paling bodoh?

Aku bisa melemparkan orang bodoh
demi orang bodoh ke anak ini, tapi\laku yakin bahkan seribu pun tidak

akan membuat perbedaan! Apakah itu
berarti Terror Granbull akan\lterjebak menjadi pecundang

selamanya\.?

entries.original:
"It doesn’t have to be that way,
Gruff."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t have to be that way, Gruff.
entries.translated: Tidak harus seperti itu, Gruff.

entries.original: "And who do ya think you are?"
entries.translation_source: And who do ya think you are?
entries.translated: Dan menurutmu kamu siapa?

entries.original:
"The name’s James.

I used to be in charge of the
roughest and toughest gang around,\lthe Black [player]!

But those Black Ferrothorns did the
same thing they did to you, to us.

They kicked us right outta
Antisis City!

Me and the Black [player] were
lost until the Boss found us.

She gave us a new purpose.

We’re now proudly known as the
Black Horizon.

You and your boys should join us,
Gruff.

We got enough goons now to take
down an entire army!

The Black Ferrothorn don’t stand
a chance anymore!"
entries.translation_source: The name’s James. I used to be in charge of the roughest and toughest gang around, the Black [player]! But those Black Ferrothorns did the same thing they did to you, to us. They kicked us right outta Antisis City! Me and the Black [player] were lost until the Boss found us. She gave us a new purpose. We’re now proudly known as the Black Horizon. You and your boys should join us, Gruff. We got enough goons now to take down an entire army! The Black Ferrothorn don’t stand a chance anymore!
entries.translated:
Namaku James. Aku dulu bertanggung
jawab atas geng paling kasar dan\lpaling tangguh di sekitar, Black

[player]! Tapi Black Ferrothorn itu
melakukan hal yang sama seperti\lyang mereka lakukan padamu, pada

kami. Mereka mengusir kami keluar
dari Antisis City! Aku dan Black\l[player] tersesat sampai Bos

menemukan kami. Dia memberi kami
tujuan baru. Kami sekarang dengan\lbangga dikenal sebagai Black

Horizon. Kamu dan anak buahmu harus
bergabung dengan kami, Gruff. Kami\lpunya cukup preman sekarang untuk

menjatuhkan seluruh pasukan! Black
Ferrothorn tidak akan punya\lkesempatan lagi!

entries.original:
"The Black Horizon, huh?

I kinda like the sound of that\.

But say we join up with you chumps,
what happens to our Granbull?

None of us could imagine our lives
without ’em."
entries.translation_source: The Black Horizon, huh? I kinda like the sound of that\. But say we join up with you chumps, what happens to our Granbull? None of us could imagine our lives without ’em.
entries.translated:
Black Horizon, ya? Aku agak suka
kedengarannya\. Tapi katakanlah kami\lbergabung dengan kalian, apa yang

terjadi dengan Granbull kami? Tidak
ada di antara kami yang bisa\lmembayangkan hidup tanpa mereka.

entries.original:
"The Boss isn’t too big on forcin’
everyone to use the same kind of\lPokémon.

So you can keep ’em."
entries.translation_source: The Boss isn’t too big on forcin’ everyone to use the same kind of Pokémon. So you can keep ’em.
entries.translated:
Bos tidak terlalu suka memaksa
semua orang untuk menggunakan jenis\lPokémon yang sama. Jadi kalian bisa

menyimpannya.

entries.original: "Then we’re sold."
entries.translation_source: Then we’re sold.
entries.translated: Kalau begitu, kami setuju.

entries.original:
"Come on, boys!
We’re goin’ to the Black Horizon!

Those Black Ferrothorns are gonna
feel terror that not even the\lTerror Granbull alone could whip up!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, boys! We’re goin’ to the Black Horizon! Those Black Ferrothorns are gonna feel terror that not even the Terror Granbull alone could whip up!
entries.translated:
Ayo, kawan-kawan! Kita akan pergi
ke Black Horizon! Para Black\lFerrothorn itu akan merasakan teror

yang bahkan Terror Granbull sendiri
tidak bisa ciptakan!

entries.original:
"It’s been a minute, [player].

How’ve ya been without the Black
[player] keepin’ ya on the\lstraight and narrow?

\.

So you became Champion, huh?

I always knew I had the eye for
great talent!

You sure got your share of guts,
kid.

It’s a shame the Boss doesn’t want
you joinin’ the Black Horizon.

Something about having \qospecial
plans\qc for you.

Anyway, [player], keep on bein’
the gutsiest Trainer I know!"
entries.translation_source: It’s been a minute, [player]. How’ve ya been without the Black [player] keepin’ ya on the straight and narrow? \. So you became Champion, huh? I always knew I had the eye for great talent! You sure got your share of guts, kid. It’s a shame the Boss doesn’t want you joinin’ the Black Horizon. Something about having \qospecial plans\qc for you. Anyway, [player], keep on bein’ the gutsiest Trainer I know!
entries.translated:
Sudah lama tidak bertemu, [player].
Bagaimana kabarmu tanpa [player]\lHitam yang menjagamu tetap di jalan

yang lurus? \. Jadi kamu menjadi
Juara, ya? Aku selalu tahu aku\lpunya mata untuk bakat besar! Kamu

pasti punya nyali, nak. Sayang Bos
tidak ingin kamu bergabung dengan\lBlack Horizon. Ada sesuatu tentang

\qospecial plans\qc untukmu.
Bagaimanapun, [player], tetaplah\lmenjadi Pelatih paling berani yang

aku kenal!

entries.original:
"[black]The Miltank returned home to
Moomoo Farm."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Miltank returned home to Moomoo Farm.
entries.translated:
[black]Miltank kembali ke rumah di Moomoo
Farm.

entries.original: "Home for a Hobo"
entries.translation_source: Home for a Hobo
entries.translated: Rumah bagi Gelandangan

entries.original: "Rich Man"
entries.translation_source: Rich Man
entries.translated: Orang Kaya

entries.original: "Biker"
entries.translation_source: Biker
entries.translated: Biker

entries.original: "Swizer"
entries.translation_source: Swizer
entries.translated: Swizer

entries.original:
"He’s sleeping peacefully on
the bench.

Better leave him alone."
entries.translation_source: He’s sleeping peacefully on the bench. Better leave him alone.
entries.translated:
Dia tidur dengan damai di bangku.
Lebih baik biarkan dia sendiri.

entries.original:
"Hello, child.

In my later years of life, I
managed to gamble away all of my\lmoney and belongings.

As such, every night, rain or
shine, I sleep on a bench.

It would be nice to have a place to
call home once again\.

Say\.

You seem full of spunk.

Would you like to find me a home?
It looks great on a résumé."
entries.translation_source: Hello, child. In my later years of life, I managed to gamble away all of my money and belongings. As such, every night, rain or shine, I sleep on a bench. It would be nice to have a place to call home once again\. Say\. You seem full of spunk. Would you like to find me a home? It looks great on a résumé.
entries.translated:
Halo, anak muda. Di masa tuaku, aku
berhasil mempertaruhkan semua uang\ldan barang milikku. Karena itu,

setiap malam, hujan atau cerah, aku
tidur di bangku. Akan menyenangkan\lmemiliki tempat untuk kusebut rumah

lagi\. Katakanlah\. Kamu tampak penuh
semangat. Apakah kamu ingin\lmencarikan aku rumah? Itu terlihat

bagus di résumé.

entries.original:
"You are a blessed child.

I shall await your return."
entries.translation_source: You are a blessed child. I shall await your return.
entries.translated:
Kamu adalah anak yang diberkati.
Aku akan menunggu kepulanganmu.

entries.original:
"Clearly, I misjudged you.

No caring child would turn down
such a request from an old man."
entries.translation_source: Clearly, I misjudged you. No caring child would turn down such a request from an old man.
entries.translated:
Jelas, aku salah menilaimu. Tidak
ada anak yang peduli akan menolak\lpermintaan seperti itu dari seorang

pria tua.

entries.original:
"Where should you look for a home?

Anywhere will do, as long as
it is indoors."
entries.translation_source: Where should you look for a home? Anywhere will do, as long as it is indoors.
entries.translated:
Di mana kamu harus mencari rumah?
Di mana saja boleh, asalkan di\ldalam ruangan.

entries.original:
"That look on your face\.

You’ve found a home, haven’t you?

Where is it located?

Seaport City?

I’ll head there right away.

Meet me there to make sure I get
settled in alright."
entries.translation_source: That look on your face\. You’ve found a home, haven’t you? Where is it located? Seaport City? I’ll head there right away. Meet me there to make sure I get settled in alright.
entries.translated:
Ekspresi di wajahmu\. Kamu sudah
menemukan rumah, bukan? Di mana\llokasinya? Seaport City? Aku akan

ke sana sekarang. Temui aku di sana
untuk memastikan aku bisa menetap\ldengan baik.

entries.original:
"Hello again, child.

I have settled in quite nicely,
thanks to your efforts.

Please, I want you to take this
rare crystal as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: Hello again, child. I have settled in quite nicely, thanks to your efforts. Please, I want you to take this rare crystal as my thanks.
entries.translated:
Halo lagi, anak muda. Aku sudah
menetap dengan cukup baik, berkat\lusahamu. Silakan, aku ingin kamu

menerima kristal langka ini sebagai
tanda terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"Hello again, child.

You are very kind coming to visit
this kindly old man."
entries.translation_source: Hello again, child. You are very kind coming to visit this kindly old man.
entries.translated:
Halo lagi, anak muda. Kamu sangat
baik datang mengunjungi pria tua\lyang baik hati ini.

entries.original:
"I own many residences in Seaport
City.

My Skitty and I are known around
here as the king and queen of real\lestate!"
entries.translation_source: I own many residences in Seaport City. My Skitty and I are known around here as the king and queen of real estate!
entries.translated:
Aku memiliki banyak tempat tinggal
di Seaport City. Skitty-ku dan aku\ldikenal di sini sebagai raja dan

ratu properti!

entries.original:
"What’s that, young [buffer1]?

You’re looking for a place to put
up a kindly older gentleman?

Unfortunately, I am not in the mood
to discuss business at the present\lmoment.

You see\. my dear real estate queen
ran away from me!

We had a horrible fight, and she
just took off to the streets!

Oh\. what am I to do\.?
I cannot think without her!"
entries.translation_source: What’s that, young [buffer1]? You’re looking for a place to put up a kindly older gentleman? Unfortunately, I am not in the mood to discuss business at the present moment. You see\. my dear real estate queen ran away from me! We had a horrible fight, and she just took off to the streets! Oh\. what am I to do\.? I cannot think without her!
entries.translated:
Apa itu, [buffer1] muda? Kamu
mencari tempat untuk menampung\lseorang pria tua yang baik hati?

Sayangnya, aku sedang tidak ingin
membicarakan bisnis saat ini.\lBegini\. ratu properti kesayanganku

kabur dariku! Kami bertengkar
hebat, dan dia langsung lari ke\ljalan! Oh\. apa yang harus aku

lakukan\.? Aku tidak bisa berpikir
tanpanya!

entries.original:
"Aha! An idea has firmly taken
root in my cranium!

Would you allow me to accompany you
in an attempt to locate my queen?

Knowing her, there is little chance
she ran far."
entries.translation_source: Aha! An idea has firmly taken root in my cranium! Would you allow me to accompany you in an attempt to locate my queen? Knowing her, there is little chance she ran far.
entries.translated:
Aha! Sebuah ide telah tertanam kuat
di kepalaku! Maukah kamu\lmengizinkanku menemanimu dalam

upaya menemukan ratuku? Mengetahui
dia, kecil kemungkinan dia lari\ljauh.

entries.original:
"Splendid!
Let us begin our search.

She must be somewhere in Seaport
City.

She’s small and pink\. you can’t
miss her!"
entries.translation_source: Splendid! Let us begin our search. She must be somewhere in Seaport City. She’s small and pink\. you can’t miss her!
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Mari kita mulai
pencarian. Dia pasti ada di suatu\ltempat di Seaport City. Dia kecil

dan merah muda\. kamu tidak akan
melewatkannya!

entries.original:
"Well, then.

I have no further business to
discuss with you.

Hrmph."
entries.translation_source: Well, then. I have no further business to discuss with you. Hrmph.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kalau begitu. Saya tidak
ada urusan lebih lanjut untuk\ldibicarakan denganmu. Hrmph.

entries.original:
"My queen must be somewhere in
Seaport City.

If you see something small and
pink\. well\. that’s my queen!"
entries.translation_source: My queen must be somewhere in Seaport City. If you see something small and pink\. well\. that’s my queen!
entries.translated:
Ratu saya pasti ada di suatu tempat
di Seaport City. Jika kamu melihat\lsesuatu yang kecil dan merah muda\.

yah\. itu ratu saya!

entries.original:
"A job well done, young [buffer1].

Now, let us return to my place of
residence so I may confer upon you\la handsome reward."
entries.translation_source: A job well done, young [buffer1]. Now, let us return to my place of residence so I may confer upon you a handsome reward.
entries.translated:
Pekerjaan yang bagus, anak muda
[buffer1]. Sekarang, mari kita\lkembali ke tempat tinggalku supaya

aku bisa memberimu hadiah yang
menarik.

entries.original:
"Ohhhh\.
You found me\.

Those ruffians, no, those hooligans
just abducted us out of nowhere!

And now I have no idea where we
are\.

My queen and I are so scared\.

Let’s go home\.
But truly this time\."
entries.translation_source: Ohhhh\. You found me\. Those ruffians, no, those hooligans just abducted us out of nowhere! And now I have no idea where we are\. My queen and I are so scared\. Let’s go home\. But truly this time\.
entries.translated:
Ohhhh\. Kamu menemukanku\. Para
penjahat itu, bukan, para hooligan\litu baru saja menculik kami entah

dari mana! Dan sekarang aku tidak
tahu dimana kami berada\. Ratu dan\laku sangat ketakutan\. Ayo pulang\.

Tapi sungguh kali ini\.

entries.original:
"Please take my queen and me home
safely\."
entries.translation_source: Please take my queen and me home safely\.
entries.translated:
Tolong antar ratu dan aku pulang
dengan selamat\.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes.

I believe you mentioned something
earlier about needing a home for\lan older gentleman?

In that case, to thank you, feel
free to let him know he may move\lin upstairs, free of charge."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes. I believe you mentioned something earlier about needing a home for an older gentleman? In that case, to thank you, feel free to let him know he may move in upstairs, free of charge.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya. Saya percaya kamu
menyebutkan sesuatu tadi tentang\lmembutuhkan rumah untuk seorang

pria yang lebih tua? Kalau begitu,
sebagai ucapan terima kasih,\lsilakan beri tahu dia bahwa dia

boleh pindah ke lantai atas,
gratis.

entries.original:
"Feel free to let your friend know
he may move in upstairs, free of\lcharge."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to let your friend know he may move in upstairs, free of charge.
entries.translated:
Silakan beri tahu temanmu bahwa dia
boleh pindah ke lantai atas,\lgratis.

entries.original:
"The fellow who moved in at your
request is quite the likable\ltenant.

He causes no disturbances
whatsoever, and has even agreed to\lkeep an eye on my queen whenever I\lgo away!

What a gentleman!"
entries.translation_source: The fellow who moved in at your request is quite the likable tenant. He causes no disturbances whatsoever, and has even agreed to keep an eye on my queen whenever I go away! What a gentleman!
entries.translated:
Orang yang pindah atas permintaanmu
adalah penyewa yang cukup\lmenyenangkan. Dia tidak menyebabkan

gangguan sama sekali, dan bahkan
setuju untuk menjaga ratuku setiap\lkali aku pergi! Sungguh seorang

pria sejati!

entries.original:
"I do not believe my queen would
have wandered in that direction.

Let us try searching somewhere
else."
entries.translation_source: I do not believe my queen would have wandered in that direction. Let us try searching somewhere else.
entries.translated:
Saya tidak percaya ratuku akan
berkeliaran ke arah itu. Mari kita\lcoba mencari di tempat lain.

entries.original:
"[blue]Heh, heh, heh\.
Seems we’ve found quite a catch!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Heh, heh, heh\. Seems we’ve found quite a catch!
entries.translated:
[blue]Heh, heh, heh\. Sepertinya kita
menemukan tangkapan yang bagus!

entries.original:
"[blue]Come on, man\.
Hurry up and catch it already!

A Skitty like that’ll go for big
bucks on the Black Market!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Come on, man\. Hurry up and catch it already! A Skitty like that’ll go for big bucks on the Black Market!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ayo, bung\. Cepat tangkap sudah!
Skitty seperti itu akan laku mahal\ldi Pasar Gelap!

entries.original:
"[blue]Nooooooooo!
You ruffians! Leave my queen alone!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Nooooooooo! You ruffians! Leave my queen alone!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tidaaaaaak! Kalian para penjahat!
Tinggalkan ratuku sendiri!

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh? Wazzat you kid?

You think you can interfere with
our business?"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Huh? Wazzat you kid? You think you can interfere with our business?
entries.translated:
[blue]Hah? Ada apa, nak? Kamu pikir kamu
bisa ikut campur dengan urusan\lkami?

entries.original:
"[blue]Somebody ought to teach a kid
like you to mind your manners!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Somebody ought to teach a kid like you to mind your manners!
entries.translated:
[blue]Seseorang harus mengajari anak
sepertimu sopan santun!

entries.original:
"Wait\.
That shout didn’t come from you\."
entries.translation_source: Wait\. That shout didn’t come from you\.
entries.translated: Tunggu\. Teriakan itu bukan dari kamu\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Bullo, you oaf!
Quit messing around!

Just lemee ’em take out for you."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Bullo, you oaf! Quit messing around! Just lemee ’em take out for you.
entries.translated:
[blue]Bullo, dasar bodoh! Berhenti
main-main! Biarkan aku mengeluarkan\lmereka untukmu.

entries.original:
"[blue]We ain’t gonna let you get away
with this, fat man!

Just you wait\. you and your Skitty
will regret this!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]We ain’t gonna let you get away with this, fat man! Just you wait\. you and your Skitty will regret this!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kami tidak akan membiarkanmu lolos
begitu saja, pria gemuk! Tunggu\lsaja\. kau dan Skitty-mu akan

menyesali ini!

entries.original:
"[blue]There, there, Queenie\.
It’s okay now\.

Those bad men are gone\.
I’m sorry we fought earlier\.

Kingy promises to be better to you
from now on\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]There, there, Queenie\. It’s okay now\. Those bad men are gone\. I’m sorry we fought earlier\. Kingy promises to be better to you from now on\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Nah, nah, Queenie\. Sekarang semuanya
baik-baik saja\. Pria-pria jahat itu\lsudah pergi\. Maafkan aku karena

bertengkar sebelumnya\. Kingy
berjanji akan lebih baik padamu\lmulai sekarang\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Thank you for your assistance in
locating my queen!

I’ll be willing to talk business
with you once I arrive home safely."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Thank you for your assistance in locating my queen! I’ll be willing to talk business with you once I arrive home safely.
entries.translated:
[blue]Terima kasih atas bantuanmu dalam
menemukan ratuku! Aku akan bersedia\lberbicara bisnis denganmu begitu

aku tiba di rumah dengan selamat.

entries.original:
"It appears we have returned home
without further incident.

Now, let us\."
entries.translation_source: It appears we have returned home without further incident. Now, let us\.
entries.translated:
Tampaknya kita telah kembali ke
rumah tanpa insiden lebih lanjut.\lSekarang, mari kita\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Serves you and him right.

If you ever wanna see that snobby
man again, come alone to the\l[green]western warehouse[blue].

And don’t bring any Pokémon that
aren’t [green]Ice[blue]- or [green]Fairy[blue]-types!

We’re gonna teach you a lesson you
won’t forget!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Serves you and him right. If you ever wanna see that snobby man again, come alone to the [green]western warehouse[blue]. And don’t bring any Pokémon that aren’t [green]Ice[blue]- or [green]Fairy[blue]-types! We’re gonna teach you a lesson you won’t forget!
entries.translated:
[blue]Pantaskah untukmu dan dia. Jika
kamu ingin melihat pria sombong itu\llagi, datanglah sendirian ke [green]gudang

barat[blue]. Dan jangan bawa Pokémon apa
pun yang bukan tipe [green]Es[blue] atau [green]Peri[blue]!\lKami akan memberimu pelajaran yang

tak akan kamu lupakan!

entries.original:
"That is not the way to my home.
Let us go in a different direction."
entries.translation_source: That is not the way to my home. Let us go in a different direction.
entries.translated:
Itu bukan jalan menuju rumahku. Ayo
pergi ke arah yang berbeda.

entries.original:
"You decided to take me up on my
offer, huh?

Did you come with only Ice- and
Fairy-types like I said?

\."
entries.translation_source: You decided to take me up on my offer, huh? Did you come with only Ice- and Fairy-types like I said? \.
entries.translated:
Kamu memutuskan untuk menerima
tawaranku, ya? Apakah kamu datang\lhanya dengan tipe Es dan Peri

seperti yang kukatakan? \.

entries.original:
"Looks like you did.
Alright, then.

You can head down the stairs behind
me to try to rescue the fat man.

Good luck.
You’re going to need it\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you did. Alright, then. You can head down the stairs behind me to try to rescue the fat man. Good luck. You’re going to need it\.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu melakukannya.
Baiklah, kalau begitu. Kamu bisa\lturun ke tangga di belakangku untuk

mencoba menyelamatkan pria gemuk
itu. Semoga berhasil. Kamu akan\lmembutuhkannya\.

entries.original:
"Done already?
This is no joke, kid.

That fat man is gonna stay down
there until someone rescues him."
entries.translation_source: Done already? This is no joke, kid. That fat man is gonna stay down there until someone rescues him.
entries.translated:
Sudah selesai? Ini bukan lelucon,
nak. Pria gemuk itu akan tetap di\lsana sampai seseorang

menyelamatkannya.

entries.original:
"You think this is a joke, kid?

I said only bring [green]Ice[blue]- and [green]Fairy[blue]-
types!

If you wanna rescue the fat man,
you’ll need to do as I say."
entries.translation_source: You think this is a joke, kid? I said only bring [green]Ice[blue]- and [green]Fairy[blue]- types! If you wanna rescue the fat man, you’ll need to do as I say.
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir ini lelucon, nak? Aku
bilang hanya bawa tipe [green]Es[blue] dan [green]Peri[blue]!\lJika kamu ingin menyelamatkan pria

gemuk itu, kamu harus melakukan apa
yang kukatakan.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hmph.

I thought the limitations placed on
you would mean the fat man would\lstay our prisoner forever.

Guess we have no choice, then.

Time for you to face our new
and improved teams!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Hmph. I thought the limitations placed on you would mean the fat man would stay our prisoner forever. Guess we have no choice, then. Time for you to face our new and improved teams!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hmph. Kupikir batasan yang
dikenakan padamu akan membuat pria\lgemuk itu tetap menjadi tahanan

kita selamanya. Sepertinya kita
tidak punya pilihan, kalau begitu.\lSaatnya kamu menghadapi tim baru

kami yang lebih baik!

entries.original:
"Gah\.

I knew nabbin’ that Skitty was a
bad idea."
entries.translation_source: Gah\. I knew nabbin’ that Skitty was a bad idea.
entries.translated:
Gah\. Aku tahu menangkap Skitty itu
adalah ide yang buruk.

entries.original:
"Bullo, you oaf!
Quit messing around!

Just let my team handle it."
entries.translation_source: Bullo, you oaf! Quit messing around! Just let my team handle it.
entries.translated:
Bullo, kau bodoh! Berhenti
main-main! Biarkan timku yang\lmenanganinya.

entries.original:
"I give, kid.
You win again.

But the fat man sure learned his
lesson for mouthing off.

And as long as being at a
disadvantage was difficult for\lyou, you did too\."
entries.translation_source: I give, kid. You win again. But the fat man sure learned his lesson for mouthing off. And as long as being at a disadvantage was difficult for you, you did too\.
entries.translated:
Aku menyerah, nak. Kamu menang
lagi. Tapi pria gemuk itu pasti\lbelajar pelajarannya karena bicara

seenaknya. Dan selama berada dalam
posisi tidak menguntungkan itu\lsulit bagimu, kamu juga belajar\.

entries.original:
"Ah\.
My queen and I have returned home.

And this time, there does not appear
to be a hooligan in sight!

Thank you very much, young [buffer1].

Please meet me inside to discuss
your reward."
entries.translation_source: Ah\. My queen and I have returned home. And this time, there does not appear to be a hooligan in sight! Thank you very much, young [buffer1]. Please meet me inside to discuss your reward.
entries.translated:
Ah\. Ratu saya dan saya telah kembali
ke rumah. Dan kali ini, tidak ada\lpreman yang terlihat! Terima kasih

banyak, [buffer1] muda. Silakan
temui saya di dalam untuk membahas\lhadiahmu.

entries.original:
"Swizer’s prepared for this!
You won’t outsmart him!"
entries.translation_source: Swizer’s prepared for this! You won’t outsmart him!
entries.translated:
Swizer sudah siap untuk ini! Kamu
tidak akan bisa mengakalinya!

entries.original:
"The Seaport Burglar Society controls
crime in Seaport City."
entries.translation_source: The Seaport Burglar Society controls crime in Seaport City.
entries.translated:
Perkumpulan Pencuri Seaport
mengendalikan kejahatan di Kota\lSeaport.

entries.original:
"One of these days the Seaport
Burglar Society will be known to all!"
entries.translation_source: One of these days the Seaport Burglar Society will be known to all!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari nanti Perkumpulan
Pencuri Seaport akan dikenal semua\lorang!

entries.original:
"El-Scamo is a master thief.

No one knows what he truly looks
like!"
entries.translation_source: El-Scamo is a master thief. No one knows what he truly looks like!
entries.translated:
El-Scamo adalah pencuri ulung.
Tidak ada yang tahu seperti apa\lrupa aslinya!

entries.original:
"We’ll slow you down!
The Black Ferrothorn rule!"
entries.translation_source: We’ll slow you down! The Black Ferrothorn rule!
entries.translated:
Kami akan memperlambatmu! Kekuasaan
Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
We’ll rule the Seaport underworld!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! We’ll rule the Seaport underworld!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Ferrothorn! Kami
akan menguasai dunia bawah tanah\lSeaport!

entries.original:
"We control crime here, now!
Us, the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: We control crime here, now! Us, the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Kami mengendalikan kejahatan di
sini, sekarang! Kami, Black\lFerrothorn!

entries.original:
"Barbs rules the Black Ferrothorn
with an iron fist!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs rules the Black Ferrothorn with an iron fist!
entries.translated:
Barbs memimpin Black Ferrothorn
dengan tangan besi!

entries.original: "Island Saviour"
entries.translation_source: Island Saviour
entries.translated: Penyelamat Pulau

entries.original:
"Hoo boy, Trainer!

I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m
wondering if you can help me out.

I got to this island by digging
up from a hidden tunnel, but my\lGraveler forgot Dig when it\llearned a new move.

Now I’m stuck here with no way off
this island.

Can you help me get back home?"
entries.translation_source: Hoo boy, Trainer! I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m wondering if you can help me out. I got to this island by digging up from a hidden tunnel, but my Graveler forgot Dig when it learned a new move. Now I’m stuck here with no way off this island. Can you help me get back home?
entries.translated:
Wah, Trainer! Aku dalam sedikit
masalah, dan aku bertanya-tanya\lapakah kamu bisa membantuku. Aku

sampai di pulau ini dengan menggali
dari terowongan tersembunyi, tapi\lGraveler-ku lupa Dig saat

mempelajari jurus baru. Sekarang
aku terjebak di sini tanpa cara\lkeluar dari pulau ini. Bisakah kamu

membantuku pulang?

entries.original:
"Awesome!

All you need is a Pokémon that
knows [green]Dig[blue].

Do you have one with you?"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! All you need is a Pokémon that knows [green]Dig[blue]. Do you have one with you?
entries.translated:
Mantap! Semua yang kamu butuhkan
adalah Pokémon yang tahu [green]Dig[blue].\lApakah kamu memilikinya?

entries.original:
"Amazing!

The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re
ready to go into the tunnel.

There is no going back until you
reach the other exit."
entries.translation_source: Amazing! The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re ready to go into the tunnel. There is no going back until you reach the other exit.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Pertanyaan terakhirku
adalah apakah kamu siap masuk ke\lterowongan. Tidak ada jalan kembali

sampai kamu mencapai pintu keluar
lainnya.

entries.original:
"I’m going to challenge you to a
battle before we go.

I need to be sure you’re strong
enough to survive down there."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to challenge you to a battle before we go. I need to be sure you’re strong enough to survive down there.
entries.translated:
Aku akan menantangmu bertarung
sebelum kita pergi. Aku perlu\lmemastikan kamu cukup kuat untuk

bertahan di sana.

entries.original:
"Alrighty, let’s go!
Use Dig!"
entries.translation_source: Alrighty, let’s go! Use Dig!
entries.translated: Baiklah, ayo pergi! Gunakan Dig!

entries.original:
"What are you getting at?
None of your Pokémon know [green]Dig[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: What are you getting at? None of your Pokémon know [green]Dig[blue]!
entries.translated:
Apa maksudmu? Tidak ada Pokémon-mu
yang tahu [green]Dig[blue]!

entries.original:
"No?

Well I hope the rising tide won’t
drown me\."
entries.translation_source: No? Well I hope the rising tide won’t drown me\.
entries.translated:
Tidak? Yah, kuharap air pasang
tidak akan menenggelamkanku\.

entries.original:
"No?

[green]Sandshrew[blue] and [green]Sandslash[blue] in the
[green]Great Desert[blue] usually know Dig."
entries.translation_source: No? [green]Sandshrew[blue] and [green]Sandslash[blue] in the [green]Great Desert[blue] usually know Dig.
entries.translated:
Tidak? [green]Sandshrew[blue] dan [green]Sandslash[blue] di
[green]Great Desert[blue] biasanya tahu Dig.

entries.original:
"It’s just a tunnel, what’s there
to be scared about?"
entries.translation_source: It’s just a tunnel, what’s there to be scared about?
entries.translated:
Itu hanya terowongan, apa yang
perlu ditakutkan?

entries.original:
"Well, we’re here!
The Lost Tunnel\.

It’s rather dank in here\.
It’s also really dark.

I don’t think even a Pokémon could
light it up.

Well, we’d better get going!

There’s a ladder up, somewhere
around here."
entries.translation_source: Well, we’re here! The Lost Tunnel\. It’s rather dank in here\. It’s also really dark. I don’t think even a Pokémon could light it up. Well, we’d better get going! There’s a ladder up, somewhere around here.
entries.translated:
Yah, kita sampai! The Lost Tunnel\.
Agak lembap di sini\. Juga sangat\lgelap. Kurasa bahkan Pokémon pun

tidak bisa meneranginya. Yah,
sebaiknya kita berangkat! Ada\ltangga ke atas, di suatu tempat di

sekitar sini.

entries.original:
"I’m sure there is a ladder
somewhere around here\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure there is a ladder somewhere around here\.
entries.translated:
Aku yakin ada tangga di suatu
tempat di sekitar sini\.

entries.original:
"Whew, I’m lost already!

I hope you know where you’re
going."
entries.translation_source: Whew, I’m lost already! I hope you know where you’re going.
entries.translated:
Wah, aku sudah tersesat! Kuharap
kamu tahu ke mana tujuanmu.

entries.original:
"Have I ever mentioned how much I
hate Diglett?"
entries.translation_source: Have I ever mentioned how much I hate Diglett?
entries.translated:
Pernahkah aku menyebutkan betapa
aku membenci Diglett?

entries.original:
"What was that!?

Oh\. just a shadow\."
entries.translation_source: What was that!? Oh\. just a shadow\.
entries.translated: Apa itu tadi!? Oh\. hanya bayangan\.

entries.original:
"You’re surprisingly brave for a
young Trainer, you know?"
entries.translation_source: You’re surprisingly brave for a young Trainer, you know?
entries.translated:
Kamu ternyata berani untuk seorang
Trainer muda, kamu tahu?

entries.original:
"What?
An earthquake? Now?"
entries.translation_source: What? An earthquake? Now?
entries.translated: Apa? Gempa? Sekarang?

entries.original:
"Wow, you wiped the floor with
that Diglett!

Have you ever wondered what a
Diglett’s feet look like?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you wiped the floor with that Diglett! Have you ever wondered what a Diglett’s feet look like?
entries.translated:
Wow, kamu mengalahkan Diglett itu
dengan mudah! Pernahkah kamu\lbertanya-tanya seperti apa kaki

Diglett?

entries.original:
"Again?
I hope no rocks fall on me\."
entries.translation_source: Again? I hope no rocks fall on me\.
entries.translated:
Lagi? Kuharap tidak ada batu yang
jatuh menimpaku\.

entries.original:
"That was a tough Golem!

I wonder if it would get along
with my Graveler\."
entries.translation_source: That was a tough Golem! I wonder if it would get along with my Graveler\.
entries.translated:
Itu Golem yang tangguh! Aku
penasaran apakah dia akan akur\ldengan Graveler-ku\.

entries.original:
"A third time?
This can’t be a coincidence!"
entries.translation_source: A third time? This can’t be a coincidence!
entries.translated:
Ketiga kalinya? Ini pasti bukan
kebetulan!

entries.original:
"Phew, that was a tough battle!
I’m tired just from watching!

But now that you took out that
Dugtrio, the tremors should stop."
entries.translation_source: Phew, that was a tough battle! I’m tired just from watching! But now that you took out that Dugtrio, the tremors should stop.
entries.translated:
Fiuh, pertarungan yang berat! Aku
saja lelah hanya dengan menonton!\lTapi sekarang setelah kamu

mengalahkan Dugtrio itu, getaran
seharusnya berhenti.

entries.original:
"There’s the ladder!

I thought we would be stuck here
forever\.

Let’s get out of here."
entries.translation_source: There’s the ladder! I thought we would be stuck here forever\. Let’s get out of here.
entries.translated:
Itu tangganya! Kupikir kita akan
terjebak di sini selamanya\. Ayo\lkeluar dari sini.

entries.original:
"What? A dead end!

I’m sure there’s a way out of
here\."
entries.translation_source: What? A dead end! I’m sure there’s a way out of here\.
entries.translated:
Apa? Jalan buntu! Aku yakin ada
jalan keluar dari sini\.

entries.original: "Let me see\."
entries.translation_source: Let me see\.
entries.translated: Biarkan aku lihat\.

entries.original:
"Aha! Found it!

A weak spot in the wall, right
here."
entries.translation_source: Aha! Found it! A weak spot in the wall, right here.
entries.translated:
Aha! Ketemu! Titik lemah di
dinding, tepat di sini.

entries.original: "Graveler, use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Graveler, use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: Graveler, gunakan Penghancur Batu!

entries.original: "[green]Rarrrarrr!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Rarrrarrr!
entries.translated: [green]Rarrrarrr!

entries.original:
"Thanks for all your help!
Here, take this TM.

I forgot I had it this whole time."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for all your help! Here, take this TM. I forgot I had it this whole time.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih atas semua bantuanmu!
Ini, ambil TM ini. Aku lupa aku\lmenyimpannya selama ini.

entries.original:
"TM28 contains [green]Dig[blue].

We should have just used it right
away, eh?"
entries.translation_source: TM28 contains [green]Dig[blue]. We should have just used it right away, eh?
entries.translated:
TM28 berisi [green]Menggali[blue]. Kita
seharusnya langsung menggunakannya,\lya?

entries.original: "Nine Tails of Snow"
entries.translation_source: Nine Tails of Snow
entries.translated: Nine Tails of Snow

entries.original: "Burglar"
entries.translation_source: Burglar
entries.translated: Pencuri

entries.original:
"Whatever will I do\.

My beloved baby was taken from me
by some\. some\. crook!

How can I perform on stage
without her?

Please, help me get my baby back!"
entries.translation_source: Whatever will I do\. My beloved baby was taken from me by some\. some\. crook! How can I perform on stage without her? Please, help me get my baby back!
entries.translated:
Apa yang harus kulakukan\. Bayi
kesayanganku diambil oleh seorang\.\lseorang\. penjahat! Bagaimana aku

bisa tampil di panggung tanpanya?
Tolong, bantu aku mendapatkan\lbayiku kembali!

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you!

Thank you, thank you!

I know that my baby was taken by a
man dressed in gray.

But that’s all I know\.
I wish I knew where he went\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you! Thank you, thank you! I know that my baby was taken by a man dressed in gray. But that’s all I know\. I wish I knew where he went\.
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih! Terima kasih,
terima kasih! Aku tahu bayiku\ldiambil oleh seorang pria

berpakaian abu-abu. Tapi hanya itu
yang kuk tahu\. Kuharap aku tahu ke\lmana dia pergi\.

entries.original:
"I know that my baby was taken by a
man dressed in gray.

But that’s all I know\.
I wish I knew where he went\."
entries.translation_source: I know that my baby was taken by a man dressed in gray. But that’s all I know\. I wish I knew where he went\.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu bayiku diambil oleh
seorang pria berpakaian abu-abu.\lTapi hanya itu yang kuk tahu\.

Kuharap aku tahu ke mana dia pergi\.

entries.original:
"Oh no, no, no\.

I hope I can find someone to help
me before it’s too late\."
entries.translation_source: Oh no, no, no\. I hope I can find someone to help me before it’s too late\.
entries.translated:
Oh tidak, tidak, tidak\. Kuharap aku
bisa menemukan seseorang untuk\lmembantuku sebelum terlambat\.

entries.original:
"It’s you again!

The burglar who stole my baby came
back and returned her to me!

I can now perform again!
Thank you, thank you, thank you!

Please, take this [green]Egg[red] she laid!
It’s the least I can do."
entries.translation_source: It’s you again! The burglar who stole my baby came back and returned her to me! I can now perform again! Thank you, thank you, thank you! Please, take this [green]Egg[red] she laid! It’s the least I can do.
entries.translated:
Kamu lagi! Pencuri yang mencuri
bayiku kembali dan\lmengembalikannya! Aku bisa tampil

lagi! Terima kasih, terima kasih,
terima kasih! Silakan, ambil [green]Telur[red]\lyang dia tetaskan! Itu yang paling

bisa aku lakukan.

entries.original:
"Oh\.

You don’t have space in your party
for the Egg\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. You don’t have space in your party for the Egg\.
entries.translated:
Oh\. Kamu tidak punya ruang di timmu
untuk Telur\.

entries.original: "You received an Egg from the Idol!"
entries.translation_source: You received an Egg from the Idol!
entries.translated:
Kamu menerima sebuah Telur dari
Idola!

entries.original: "Take care of my baby’s baby!"
entries.translation_source: Take care of my baby’s baby!
entries.translated: Jaga bayi dari bayiku!

entries.original:
"Huh? Who are you?
What are you doing back here?

This is my quiet spot for training
my precious Pokémon.

I don’t like it when other people
come here uninvited.

\.

So you’ve come to take my Pokémon
away from me, is that it?

I won’t let you take her from me!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? Who are you? What are you doing back here? This is my quiet spot for training my precious Pokémon. I don’t like it when other people come here uninvited. \. So you’ve come to take my Pokémon away from me, is that it? I won’t let you take her from me!
entries.translated:
Hah? Siapa kamu? Apa yang kamu
lakukan di sini? Ini tempat\ltenangku untuk melatih Pokémon

kesayanganku. Aku tidak suka jika
orang lain datang ke sini tanpa\ldiundang. \. Jadi kamu datang untuk

mengambil Pokémonku dariku, begitu?
Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu\lmengambilnya dariku!

entries.original:
"Alright\.

Truth be told, this Ninetales
doesn’t really belong to me\.

I sort of\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 borrowed it!
Yeah, that’s right\.\CC0818 for training!

It was just so lonely, I figured
I’d do that lady a favour.

I was about to head back when\."
entries.translation_source: Alright\. Truth be told, this Ninetales doesn’t really belong to me\. I sort of\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 borrowed it! Yeah, that’s right\.\CC0818 for training! It was just so lonely, I figured I’d do that lady a favour. I was about to head back when\.
entries.translated:
Baiklah\. Sejujurnya, Ninetales ini
bukan milikku\. Aku agak\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818\lmeminjamnya! Ya, benar\.\CC0818 untuk

latihan! Dia begitu kesepian,
kupikir aku akan membantu wanita\litu. Aku hendak kembali ketika\.

entries.original:
"What was that!

Could it be\.?

No, it couldn’t be\."
entries.translation_source: What was that! Could it be\.? No, it couldn’t be\.
entries.translated:
Apa itu! Mungkinkah\.? Tidak, tidak
mungkin\.

entries.original: "Oh, it was nothing after all\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it was nothing after all\.
entries.translated: Oh, ternyata tidak ada apa-apa\.

entries.original: "Now, as I was saying\."
entries.translation_source: Now, as I was saying\.
entries.translated: Nah, seperti yang kukatakan\.

entries.original:
"Wahhhh! It’s the monster that
lives in the forest!

The Crabminble Snowman!

Run for your lives!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! It’s the monster that lives in the forest! The Crabminble Snowman! Run for your lives!
entries.translated:
Wahhhh! Itu monster yang tinggal di
hutan! Manusia Salju Crabminble!\lLari selamatkan diri kalian!

entries.original: "Oof!"
entries.translation_source: Oof!
entries.translated: Oof!

entries.original: "[green]Crah rah rah rah rah!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Crah rah rah rah rah!
entries.translated: [green]Crah rah rah rah rah!

entries.original:
"That monster was terrifying!

We must’ve woken it up during our
battle earlier.

\.

So, I uh\. guess I’m done training
this Ninetales now\.

It’s time for me to return her
to her owner."
entries.translation_source: That monster was terrifying! We must’ve woken it up during our battle earlier. \. So, I uh\. guess I’m done training this Ninetales now\. It’s time for me to return her to her owner.
entries.translated:
Monster itu menakutkan! Pasti kita
membangunkannya saat pertarungan\lkita tadi. \. Jadi, aku uh\. sepertinya

selesai melatih Ninetales ini
sekarang\. Saatnya aku\lmengembalikannya ke pemiliknya.

entries.original: "[black]The [buffer1] is fast asleep\."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] is fast asleep\.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] tertidur lelap\.

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] burrowed into
the snow."
entries.translation_source: [black]The [buffer1] burrowed into the snow.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] menggali ke dalam salju.

entries.original: "[green]Taaaaales!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Taaaaales!
entries.translated: [green]Taaaaales!

entries.original: "Portal Purge"
entries.translation_source: Portal Purge
entries.translated: Portal Purge

entries.original:
"What’s that, [player]?

You’ve captured all of the Pokémon
found in the mysterious portals?

Well done!

\.

What’s that?

You want a reward for your efforts?

I assumed those Pokémon themselves
would be reward enough, but I must\lhave been mistaken.

In that case, take this."
entries.translation_source: What’s that, [player]? You’ve captured all of the Pokémon found in the mysterious portals? Well done! \. What’s that? You want a reward for your efforts? I assumed those Pokémon themselves would be reward enough, but I must have been mistaken. In that case, take this.
entries.translated:
Apa itu, [player]? Kau sudah
menangkap semua Pokémon yang\lditemukan di portal misterius?

Bagus! \. Ada apa? Kau ingin hadiah
atas usahamu? Kukira Pokémon itu\lsendiri sudah cukup menjadi hadiah,

tapi ternyata aku salah. Kalau
begitu, ambil ini.

entries.original:
"A whole shipment of those special
Balls just arrived in the mail.

The Poké Mart finally started a
delivery service, so I will never\lagain need to send people to pick\lup my packages for me!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: A whole shipment of those special Balls just arrived in the mail. The Poké Mart finally started a delivery service, so I will never again need to send people to pick up my packages for me! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Satu kiriman penuh Bola khusus itu
baru saja tiba melalui pos. Poké\lMart akhirnya memulai layanan

pengiriman, jadi aku tidak perlu
lagi mengirim orang untuk mengambil\lpaketku! Ho ho ho!

entries.original:
"Oh!

My memory really must be going in
my old age\.

Those items on my table are for you
as well.

I’m sure you’ll find them most
useful."
entries.translation_source: Oh! My memory really must be going in my old age\. Those items on my table are for you as well. I’m sure you’ll find them most useful.
entries.translated:
Oh! Ingatanku benar-benar menurun
di usia tuaku\. Barang-barang di\lmejaku itu juga untukmu. Aku yakin

kau akan menemukannya sangat
berguna.

entries.original:
"You can have those items on my
table as well.

I’m sure you’ll find them most
useful."
entries.translation_source: You can have those items on my table as well. I’m sure you’ll find them most useful.
entries.translated:
Kau bisa mengambil barang-barang di
mejaku juga. Aku yakin kau akan\lmenemukannya sangat berguna.

entries.original:
"It feels like it was only yesterday
I sent you out into the world\.

Time sure does go by!"
entries.translation_source: It feels like it was only yesterday I sent you out into the world\. Time sure does go by!
entries.translated:
Rasanya baru kemarin aku mengirimmu
ke dunia\. Waktu benar-benar berlalu!

entries.original:
"[black]It’s some rare item belonging to
Prof. Log."
entries.translation_source: [black]It’s some rare item belonging to Prof. Log.
entries.translated: [black]Ini barang langka milik Prof. Log.

entries.original: "Protector of the Swamp"
entries.translation_source: Protector of the Swamp
entries.translated: Pelindung Rawa

entries.original:
"[player], come here, darlin’.
I need your help with a problem.

Ya see, some goons are causin’
quite a ruckus, right here in\lCootes Bog.

And my Swampert, who is the
protector of this here bog, is as\lgone as a vegan at a hog fry!

Swampert is supposed to keep the
delicate balance of this unique\lecosytem, but without it, there’s\lnothin’ settlin’ down these goons!

I need to stop their shenanigans
and find my Swampert, so balance\lcan be restored to the swamp.

But, you see, I can’t take out all
these goons alone.

So, what do ya say, down for an
adventure with ol’ Tessy?"
entries.translation_source: [player], come here, darlin’. I need your help with a problem. Ya see, some goons are causin’ quite a ruckus, right here in Cootes Bog. And my Swampert, who is the protector of this here bog, is as gone as a vegan at a hog fry! Swampert is supposed to keep the delicate balance of this unique ecosytem, but without it, there’s nothin’ settlin’ down these goons! I need to stop their shenanigans and find my Swampert, so balance can be restored to the swamp. But, you see, I can’t take out all these goons alone. So, what do ya say, down for an adventure with ol’ Tessy?
entries.translated:
[player], kemari, sayang. Aku butuh
bantuanmu dengan suatu masalah.\lBegini, beberapa preman membuat

keributan, tepat di sini di Cootes
Bog. Dan Swampert-ku, yang\lmerupakan pelindung rawa ini, sudah

pergi seperti vegan di pesta babi
panggang! Swampert seharusnya\lmenjaga keseimbangan ekosistem unik

ini, tapi tanpanya, tidak ada yang
bisa menenangkan para preman ini!\lAku harus menghentikan ulah mereka

dan menemukan Swampert-ku, agar
keseimbangan dapat dipulihkan di\lrawa. Tapi, kau tahu, aku tidak

bisa melawan semua preman ini
sendirian. Jadi, bagaimana\lmenurutmu, mau petualangan dengan

Tessy tua?

entries.original: "[black][player] decided to go with Tessy!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] decided to go with Tessy!
entries.translated:
[black][player] memutuskan untuk pergi
bersama Tessy!

entries.original:
"Great! I am as happy as a Snorlax
at suppertime.

Let’s go kick some Granbull heiny
and save the swamp!

I’ll keep your Pokémon healed
up, too."
entries.translation_source: Great! I am as happy as a Snorlax at suppertime. Let’s go kick some Granbull heiny and save the swamp! I’ll keep your Pokémon healed up, too.
entries.translated:
Hebat! Aku sebahagia Snorlax saat
makan malam. Ayo kita tendang\lpantat Granbull itu dan selamatkan

rawa! Aku juga akan menjaga
Pokémonmu tetap pulih.

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with Tessy, the
[green]first 3[black] Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle."
entries.translation_source: [black]While teamed up with Tessy, the [green]first 3[black] Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle.
entries.translated:
[black]Saat bekerja sama dengan Tessy, [green]3[black]
Pokémon pertama di timmu akan\ldipilih untuk bertarung.

entries.original:
"Well, gosh darn’ it!
But I know ya’re busy.

Just get back to me as soon as
ya can.

I’ll just be waitin’ here."
entries.translation_source: Well, gosh darn’ it! But I know ya’re busy. Just get back to me as soon as ya can. I’ll just be waitin’ here.
entries.translated:
Yah, sial! Tapi aku tahu kau sibuk.
Kembalilah padaku secepatnya. Aku\lakan menunggu di sini.

entries.original:
"My Swampert is the top dog in this
swamp, so when it’s here, all the\lother Pokémon fall in line.

Let’s find out what happened to
’ol Swampert!"
entries.translation_source: My Swampert is the top dog in this swamp, so when it’s here, all the other Pokémon fall in line. Let’s find out what happened to ’ol Swampert!
entries.translated:
Swampertku adalah yang terkuat di
rawa ini, jadi saat dia di sini,\lsemua Pokémon lain patuh. Ayo cari

tahu apa yang terjadi pada Swampert
tua itu!

entries.original:
"Hustle on up, [player], we gotta
get back to Cootes Bog and stop\lthe Terror Granbull."
entries.translation_source: Hustle on up, [player], we gotta get back to Cootes Bog and stop the Terror Granbull.
entries.translated:
Ayo cepat, [player], kita harus
kembali ke Cootes Bog dan\lmenghentikan Terror Granbull.

entries.original:
"[red]Where do ya think you’re goin’,
silly?

The trouble is that way."
entries.translation_source: [red]Where do ya think you’re goin’, silly? The trouble is that way.
entries.translated:
[red]Kau pikir kau mau ke mana, bodoh?
Masalahnya di arah sana.

entries.original:
"[red]Where do ya think you’re goin’,
silly?

Back to town or somethin’?"
entries.translation_source: [red]Where do ya think you’re goin’, silly? Back to town or somethin’?
entries.translated:
[red]Kau pikir kau mau ke mana, bodoh?
Kembali ke kota atau apa?

entries.original:
"[red]Just get back to me as soon as
ya can.

I’ll just be waitin’ here."
entries.translation_source: [red]Just get back to me as soon as ya can. I’ll just be waitin’ here.
entries.translated:
[red]Kembalilah padaku secepatnya. Aku
akan menunggu di sini.

entries.original:
"[red]Hurry! We need to stop these big
ol’ critters before they cause\lanymore trouble in the bog!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Hurry! We need to stop these big ol’ critters before they cause anymore trouble in the bog!
entries.translated:
[red]Cepat! Kita harus menghentikan
makhluk besar ini sebelum mereka\lmenimbulkan masalah lagi di rawa!

entries.original:
"[red]Looks like they’re comin’ straight
for us!

This about to get as hot as a
fryin’ pan in a July sun!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Looks like they’re comin’ straight for us! This about to get as hot as a fryin’ pan in a July sun!
entries.translated:
[red]Sepertinya mereka langsung menuju
kita! Ini akan sepanas wajan di\lbawah sinar matahari Juli!

entries.original:
"[red]Wowy, we did it!

Both these Pokémon aren’t goin’ to
be much trouble from here on out."
entries.translation_source: [red]Wowy, we did it! Both these Pokémon aren’t goin’ to be much trouble from here on out.
entries.translated:
[red]Wow, kita berhasil! Kedua Pokémon
ini tidak akan menjadi masalah\lbesar mulai sekarang.

entries.original:
"[blue]Haha, you’ve fallen right into
our trap!

Thanks to this gizmo the Science
Society let us test out for ’em,\lwe’ll be able to turn this Pokémon\linto an unstoppable force!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Haha, you’ve fallen right into our trap! Thanks to this gizmo the Science Society let us test out for ’em, we’ll be able to turn this Pokémon into an unstoppable force!
entries.translated:
