[blue]Haha, kau jatuh tepat ke dalam
perangkap kami! Berkat alat ini\lyang diizinkan Science Society

untuk kami uji coba, kami akan bisa
mengubah Pokémon ini menjadi\lkekuatan yang tak terhentikan!

entries.original:
"[red]Uh oh!

That goon there just injected that
Feraligatr with that science-y\llookin’ thing.

And now Feraligatr’s gettin’
bigger, an’ bigger, an’ bigger!

Looks like we’re goin’ to need to
settle it down again."
entries.translation_source: [red]Uh oh! That goon there just injected that Feraligatr with that science-y lookin’ thing. And now Feraligatr’s gettin’ bigger, an’ bigger, an’ bigger! Looks like we’re goin’ to need to settle it down again.
entries.translated:
[red]Uh oh! Preman itu baru saja
menyuntikkan benda berbau sains itu\lke Feraligatr. Dan sekarang

Feraligatr semakin besar, dan
besar, dan besar! Sepertinya kita\lperlu menenangkannya lagi.

entries.original:
"[blue]Once these two finish gettin’
quashed by our ultimate Feraligatr,\lno one’ll be able to stand in our\lway as we claim a new home for\lus Terror Granbull!

We’re gonna march unopposed into
Polder Town and make it the seat\lof our new enterprise!

Who needs Antisis City?

Gruff’ll be so proud of all
us Terror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Once these two finish gettin’ quashed by our ultimate Feraligatr, no one’ll be able to stand in our way as we claim a new home for us Terror Granbull! We’re gonna march unopposed into Polder Town and make it the seat of our new enterprise! Who needs Antisis City? Gruff’ll be so proud of all us Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
[blue]Setelah keduanya selesai
dihancurkan oleh Feraligatr utama\lkami, tidak ada yang bisa

menghalangi kami saat kami
mengklaim rumah baru untuk kami\lTerror Granbull! Kami akan berbaris

tanpa perlawanan ke Polder Town dan
menjadikannya pusat perusahaan baru\lkami! Siapa yang butuh Antisis

City? Gruff akan sangat bangga
dengan kami semua Terror Granbull!

entries.original: "[green]Gaaaaatoooor\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Gaaaaatoooor\.
entries.translated: [green]Gaaaaatoooor\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Grrr\.
Arr\.

You may have defeated Feraligatr,
but without Swampert, the swamp is\lstill in chaos.

More contenders will arise, and
we’ll take the strong ones for\lourselves.

Soon we’ll be able to call Polder
Town our home, and there’s nothin’\lyou’ll be able to do to stop us!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Grrr\. Arr\. You may have defeated Feraligatr, but without Swampert, the swamp is still in chaos. More contenders will arise, and we’ll take the strong ones for ourselves. Soon we’ll be able to call Polder Town our home, and there’s nothin’ you’ll be able to do to stop us!
entries.translated:
[blue]Grrr\. Arr\. Kau mungkin telah
mengalahkan Feraligatr, tetapi\ltanpa Swampert, rawa masih dalam

kekacauan. Lebih banyak penantang
akan muncul, dan kami akan\lmengambil yang kuat untuk diri kami

sendiri. Segera kami akan bisa
menyebut Polder Town sebagai rumah\lkami, dan tidak ada yang bisa kau

lakukan untuk menghentikan kami!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ahhh!
Swampert escaped!

I knew we shouldn’t have bought
those discount Poké-restraints!

Scatter, boys!

SCATTER!"
entries.translation_source: [blue]Ahhh! Swampert escaped! I knew we shouldn’t have bought those discount Poké-restraints! Scatter, boys! SCATTER!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ahhh! Swampert kabur! Aku tahu kita
seharusnya tidak membeli\lPoké-restraints diskon itu!

Berserak, boys! BERSERAK!

entries.original:
"[red]Ah, Swampert, dear, it’s nice to
have ya back.

I hope them Terror Granbull didn’t
hurt ya too badly.

\.

Yes, I know those hoodlums need to
be punished, but I need ya to\lstay here in the bog so ya can\lrestore the balance.

Don’t ya worry, I’ll keep a
closer eye on the swamp from\lnow on.

If those hoodlums set one foot in
here, I’ll let ’em have it!"
entries.translation_source: [red]Ah, Swampert, dear, it’s nice to have ya back. I hope them Terror Granbull didn’t hurt ya too badly. \. Yes, I know those hoodlums need to be punished, but I need ya to stay here in the bog so ya can restore the balance. Don’t ya worry, I’ll keep a closer eye on the swamp from now on. If those hoodlums set one foot in here, I’ll let ’em have it!
entries.translated:
[red]Ah, Swampert, sayang, senang kau
kembali. Kuhope Terror Granbull\ltidak menyakitimu terlalu parah. \.

Ya, aku tahu para preman itu perlu
dihukum, tapi aku perlu kau tetap\ldi sini di rawa agar kau bisa

mengembalikan keseimbangan. Jangan
khawatir, aku akan lebih mengawasi\lrawa mulai sekarang. Jika

preman-preman itu menginjakkan kaki
di sini, akan kuberi mereka\lpelajaran!

entries.original:
"[red]Thank you, [player], for your help
in fixin’ the swamp and beatin’\lthose nasty varmints.

I am truly indebted to ya.

Here’s a little parcel of my
gratitude for ya service."
entries.translation_source: [red]Thank you, [player], for your help in fixin’ the swamp and beatin’ those nasty varmints. I am truly indebted to ya. Here’s a little parcel of my gratitude for ya service.
entries.translated:
[red]Terima kasih, [player], atas
bantuanmu dalam memperbaiki rawa\ldan mengalahkan hama-hama jahat

itu. Aku benar-benar berhutang budi
padamu. Ini sedikit bingkisan rasa\lterima kasihku atas jasamu.

entries.original:
"[red]Thanks again, [player].

Me, Swampert, and the swamp are
obliged to ya."
entries.translation_source: [red]Thanks again, [player]. Me, Swampert, and the swamp are obliged to ya.
entries.translated:
[red]Terima kasih lagi, [player]. Aku,
Swampert, dan rawa ini berterima\lkasih padamu.

entries.original:
"If you wanna find the strong, you
gotta first weed out the weak."
entries.translation_source: If you wanna find the strong, you gotta first weed out the weak.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin menemukan yang
kuat, kamu harus menyingkirkan yang\llemah terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Betcha believed me!

Haw haw!"
entries.translation_source: Betcha believed me! Haw haw!
entries.translated: Pasti kamu percaya padaku! Ha ha!

entries.original:
"Would you mind beatin’ the other
guys quickly so we can spring our\ltrap?"
entries.translation_source: Would you mind beatin’ the other guys quickly so we can spring our trap?
entries.translated:
Maukah kamu mengalahkan yang lain
dengan cepat agar kita bisa\lmenjalankan jebakan kita?

entries.original:
"With Swampert gone, the Pokémon
here are all tryin’ to gain power."
entries.translation_source: With Swampert gone, the Pokémon here are all tryin’ to gain power.
entries.translated:
Dengan perginya Swampert, semua
Pokémon di sini berusaha\lmendapatkan kekuatan.

entries.original:
"My job is to hold our box here, and
not lick it\.

Well\. I tried."
entries.translation_source: My job is to hold our box here, and not lick it\. Well\. I tried.
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah memegang kotak kami
di sini, dan tidak menjilatnya\. Yah\.\lAku sudah mencoba.

entries.original:
"The strongest Pokémon is necessary
for our plan to get a new home."
entries.translation_source: The strongest Pokémon is necessary for our plan to get a new home.
entries.translated:
Pokémon terkuat diperlukan untuk
rencana kami mendapatkan rumah\lbaru.

entries.original:
"Ain’t there somethin’ tranquil
about watchin’ two Pokémon thrash\lat each other until one faints?"
entries.translation_source: Ain’t there somethin’ tranquil about watchin’ two Pokémon thrash at each other until one faints?
entries.translated:
Bukankah ada sesuatu yang tenang
tentang menonton dua Pokémon saling\lmenghajar sampai salah satu

pingsan?

entries.original:
"I hope the Feraligatr wins, I have
a $10000 bet on it."
entries.translation_source: I hope the Feraligatr wins, I have a $10000 bet on it.
entries.translated:
Aku harap Feraligatr menang, aku
bertaruh $10000 padanya.

entries.original: "A Rift in Space"
entries.translation_source: A Rift in Space
entries.translated: Celah di Ruang

entries.original:
"My daughter tried venturing into
Rift Cave all by herself.

She was very lucky that someone
stopped her.

If she had gone in there\.

I shudder every time I think of
what could have happened!"
entries.translation_source: My daughter tried venturing into Rift Cave all by herself. She was very lucky that someone stopped her. If she had gone in there\. I shudder every time I think of what could have happened!
entries.translated:
Putriku mencoba menjelajahi Gua
Rift sendirian. Dia sangat\lberuntung seseorang

menghentikannya. Jika dia masuk ke
sana\. Aku bergidik setiap kali\lmemikirkan apa yang bisa terjadi!

entries.original:
"Good heavens!
My daughter!

She ran off to [green]Rift Cave[blue]!

I’ve told her time and time again
to stay away from that dangerous\lplace, but she never listens to me!

Please, Champion!
Bring her home!"
entries.translation_source: Good heavens! My daughter! She ran off to [green]Rift Cave[blue]! I’ve told her time and time again to stay away from that dangerous place, but she never listens to me! Please, Champion! Bring her home!
entries.translated:
Ya ampun! Putriku! Dia lari ke [green]Gua
Rift[blue]! Aku sudah berkali-kali\lmemberi tahu dia untuk menjauh dari

tempat berbahaya itu, tapi dia
tidak pernah mendengarkanku!\lTolong, Juara! Bawa dia pulang!

entries.original:
"Thank you, Champion!

Take great care while searching
for her\.

[green]Rift Cave[blue] is known for not always
obeying the laws of our world\."
entries.translation_source: Thank you, Champion! Take great care while searching for her\. [green]Rift Cave[blue] is known for not always obeying the laws of our world\.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, Juara!
Berhati-hatilah saat mencarinya\. [green]Gua\lRift[blue] dikenal karena tidak selalu

mematuhi hukum dunia kita\.

entries.original:
"Oh, heavens\.

If the Champion is too afraid to do
it, who would?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, heavens\. If the Champion is too afraid to do it, who would?
entries.translated:
Oh, astaga\. Jika sang Juara terlalu
takut untuk melakukannya, siapa\lyang akan?

entries.original:
"Take great care while searching
[green]Rift Cave[blue] for my daughter.

It is known for not always obeying
the natural laws of our world\."
entries.translation_source: Take great care while searching [green]Rift Cave[blue] for my daughter. It is known for not always obeying the natural laws of our world\.
entries.translated:
Berhati-hatilah saat mencari [green]Gua
Rift[blue] untuk putriku. Tempat itu\ldikenal karena tidak selalu

mematuhi hukum alam dunia kita\.

entries.original:
"Champion!

My daughter arrived home without a
scratch on her!

I am in your debt!

Please, accept this rare gem stone
from my collection."
entries.translation_source: Champion! My daughter arrived home without a scratch on her! I am in your debt! Please, accept this rare gem stone from my collection.
entries.translated:
Juara! Putriku pulang tanpa luka
sedikit pun! Aku berhutang budi\lpadamu! Tolong, terima batu permata

langka ini dari koleksiku.

entries.original:
"My daughter has been severely
punished for inconveniencing you\lby running off to Rift Cave.

I will make sure that she never
leaves the corner again."
entries.translation_source: My daughter has been severely punished for inconveniencing you by running off to Rift Cave. I will make sure that she never leaves the corner again.
entries.translated:
Putriku telah dihukum berat karena
merepotkanmu dengan lari ke Gua\lRift. Aku akan memastikan dia tidak

pernah meninggalkan sudut itu lagi.

entries.original:
"My parents put me in the corner
because I tried to go to Rift Cave."
entries.translation_source: My parents put me in the corner because I tried to go to Rift Cave.
entries.translated:
Orang tuaku menempatkanku di sudut
karena aku mencoba pergi ke Gua\lRift.

entries.original:
"Ohhh\.

I ran away from home to play in
Rift Cave, but every time I try to\lleave, I end up back in this room\.

Please, nice Trainer!
Take me home!"
entries.translation_source: Ohhh\. I ran away from home to play in Rift Cave, but every time I try to leave, I end up back in this room\. Please, nice Trainer! Take me home!
entries.translated:
Ohhh\. Aku kabur dari rumah untuk
bermain di Gua Rift, tapi setiap\lkali aku mencoba pergi, aku kembali

lagi ke ruangan ini\. Tolong, Pelatih
yang baik! Bawa aku pulang!

entries.original:
"Wahhhh!
That Pokémon is scary!

Trainer!
Protect me!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! That Pokémon is scary! Trainer! Protect me!
entries.translated:
Wahhhh! Pokémon itu menakutkan!
Pelatih! Lindungi aku!

entries.original: "[black]The little girl disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [black]The little girl disappeared.
entries.translated: [black]Gadis kecil itu menghilang.

entries.original:
"Ohhh\.

That scary Pokémon dragged me
down here\.

I’m so scared\.

Wahhh!
I wanna go home!"
entries.translation_source: Ohhh\. That scary Pokémon dragged me down here\. I’m so scared\. Wahhh! I wanna go home!
entries.translated:
Ohhh\. Pokémon menakutkan itu
menyeretku ke sini\. Aku sangat takut\.\lWahhh! Aku ingin pulang!

entries.original:
"Wahhhh!
The scary Pokémon came back!

Trainer, please don’t let it
hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! The scary Pokémon came back! Trainer, please don’t let it hurt me!
entries.translated:
Wahhh! Pokémon menakutkan itu
kembali! Pelatih, tolong jangan\lbiarkan ia menyakitiku!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

That Pokémon was really scary.
Thank you for beating it up!

Can you take me home, please?
I’ve played enough for today."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. That Pokémon was really scary. Thank you for beating it up! Can you take me home, please? I’ve played enough for today.
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Pokémon itu benar-benar
menakutkan. Terima kasih sudah\lmengalahkannya! Bisakah kau

mengantarku pulang? Aku sudah cukup
bermain untuk hari ini.

entries.original:
"[black][player] decided to go with the
little girl!"
entries.translation_source: [black][player] decided to go with the little girl!
entries.translated:
[black][player]Pelatih [player] memutuskan
untuk pergi bersama gadis kecil\litu!

entries.original:
"Are you a strong Trainer or
something?

You must be if you fought that
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Are you a strong Trainer or something? You must be if you fought that Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Apakah kau Pelatih yang kuat atau
sesuatu? Pasti begitu karena kau\lmelawan Pokémon itu!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I wanna go home.
I’ve played enough for today."
entries.translation_source: Sniff\. I wanna go home. I’ve played enough for today.
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Aku ingin pulang. Aku sudah
cukup bermain untuk hari ini.

entries.original:
"That Pokémon before was really
scary!

Why is it so mean?
Is this its home?"
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon before was really scary! Why is it so mean? Is this its home?
entries.translated:
Pokémon sebelumnya benar-benar
menakutkan! Kenapa ia begitu jahat?\lApa ini rumahnya?

entries.original:
"We made it out!
Thank you, Trainer!

I know how to get home from here."
entries.translation_source: We made it out! Thank you, Trainer! I know how to get home from here.
entries.translated:
Kita berhasil keluar! Terima kasih,
Pelatih! Aku tahu jalan pulang dari\lsini.

entries.original:
"My parents put me in the corner
because I went into Rift Cave."
entries.translation_source: My parents put me in the corner because I went into Rift Cave.
entries.translated:
Orangtuaku menghukumku di sudut
karena aku masuk ke Rift Cave.

entries.original:
"There are stories of people never
returning from Rift Cave.

They say that whole groups who have
gone down there have never been\lseen again."
entries.translation_source: There are stories of people never returning from Rift Cave. They say that whole groups who have gone down there have never been seen again.
entries.translated:
Ada cerita tentang orang-orang yang
tidak pernah kembali dari Rift\lCave. Mereka bilang seluruh

kelompok yang pergi ke sana tidak
pernah terlihat lagi.

entries.original:
"I fear the worst.

Our daughter may wind up being
added to the list of people who’ve\lnever returned from Rift Cave\."
entries.translation_source: I fear the worst. Our daughter may wind up being added to the list of people who’ve never returned from Rift Cave\.
entries.translated:
Aku khawatir yang terburuk. Putri
kami mungkin akhirnya ditambahkan\lke daftar orang yang tidak pernah

kembali dari Rift Cave\.

entries.original:
"There are stories of people never
returning from Rift Cave.

They say that whole groups who have
gone down there have never been\lseen again.

It’s a good thing you saved our
daughter, Champion.

I shudder to think what could have
happened to her."
entries.translation_source: There are stories of people never returning from Rift Cave. They say that whole groups who have gone down there have never been seen again. It’s a good thing you saved our daughter, Champion. I shudder to think what could have happened to her.
entries.translated:
Ada cerita tentang orang-orang yang
tidak pernah kembali dari Rift\lCave. Mereka bilang seluruh

kelompok yang pergi ke sana tidak
pernah terlihat lagi. Untunglah kau\lmenyelamatkan putri kami, Champion.

Aku merinding memikirkan apa yang
bisa terjadi padanya.

entries.original: "[green]Gagyagyaah!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Gagyagyaah!
entries.translated: [green]Gagyagyaah!

entries.original:
"[black]Palkia began to warp the space
around it to increase it’s size!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Palkia began to warp the space around it to increase it’s size!
entries.translated:
[black]Palkia mulai melengkungkan ruang di
sekitarnya untuk memperbesar\lukurannya!

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] warped space to
disappear\."
entries.translation_source: [black][buffer1] warped space to disappear\.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] melengkungkan ruang untuk
menghilang\.

entries.original: "The Rogue Electivire"
entries.translation_source: The Rogue Electivire
entries.translated: The Rogue Electivire

entries.original: "Nerd"
entries.translation_source: Nerd
entries.translated: Nerd

entries.original:
"No\. Electivire\. please!
Why are you acting like this?"
entries.translation_source: No\. Electivire\. please! Why are you acting like this?
entries.translated:
Tidak\. Electivire\. kumohon! Kenapa
kau bersikap seperti ini?

entries.original: "[green]Vire!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Vire!
entries.translated: [green]Vire!

entries.original:
"Electivire\. why don’t you go
back in your Poké Ball?

Yes\. come on, now\. return!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire\. why don’t you go back in your Poké Ball? Yes\. come on, now\. return!
entries.translated:
Electivire\\. kenapa kamu tidak
kembali ke dalam Poké Ball-mu? Ya\\.\layo, sekarang\\. kembali!

entries.original:
"Oh\. come on, Electivire\.
don’t knock your ball away\."
entries.translation_source: Oh\. come on, Electivire\. don’t knock your ball away\.
entries.translated:
Oh\\. ayolah, Electivire\\. jangan
dorong bola kamu pergi\.

entries.original:
"Electivire\. that could’ve
seriously injured me!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire\. that could’ve seriously injured me!
entries.translated:
Electivire\\. itu bisa saja melukaiku
dengan serius!

entries.original:
"Help!

Somebody help me!

My Electivire’s gone rogue!"
entries.translation_source: Help! Somebody help me! My Electivire’s gone rogue!
entries.translated:
Tolong! Ada yang tolong aku!
Electivire-ku menjadi liar!

entries.original: "[black]Protect the nerd?"
entries.translation_source: [black]Protect the nerd?
entries.translated: [black]Lindungi si kutu buku?

entries.original:
"Thank you!
Thank you for protecting me!

Now, please, battle my Electivire
and bring it back to its senses!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you! Thank you for protecting me! Now, please, battle my Electivire and bring it back to its senses!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih! Terima kasih sudah
melindungiku! Sekarang, tolong,\llawan Electivire-ku dan buat dia

sadar kembali!

entries.original:
"Electivire!
Come back!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire! Come back!
entries.translated: Electivire! Kembalilah!

entries.original: "[blue]And he’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]And he’s gone\.
entries.translated: [blue]Dan dia pergi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Please\. you were kind enough to
protect me\. so please, chase after\lmy Electivire!

He’s the only friend I have\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Please\. you were kind enough to protect me\. so please, chase after my Electivire! He’s the only friend I have\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Tolong\\. kamu cukup baik untuk
melindungiku\\. jadi tolong, kejar\lElectivire-ku! Dia satu-satunya

teman yang kumiliki\.

entries.original:
"Electivire\. please\. just listen
to me\.

Return to your Poké Ball!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire\. please\. just listen to me\. Return to your Poké Ball!
entries.translated:
Electivire\\. tolong\\. dengarkan aku\\.
Kembali ke Poké Ball-mu!

entries.original:
"I owe you one for helping
my Electivire.

I can’t give you anything here, so
meet me in the [green]Epidimy Town\lPokémon Center[blue] if you want a\lreward for your help."
entries.translation_source: I owe you one for helping my Electivire. I can’t give you anything here, so meet me in the [green]Epidimy Town Pokémon Center[blue] if you want a reward for your help.
entries.translated:
Aku berhutang budi padamu karena
membantu Electivire-ku. Aku tidak\lbisa memberimu apa pun di sini,

jadi temui aku di [green]Pusat Pokémon
Kota Epidimy[blue] jika kamu ingin hadiah\latas bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"[red]Epidimy Town, you say\.

Then I must head there\. for the
sake of the Science Society\."
entries.translation_source: [red]Epidimy Town, you say\. Then I must head there\. for the sake of the Science Society\.
entries.translated:
[red]Kota Epidimy, katamu\\. Maka aku
harus pergi ke sana\\. demi\lPerkumpulan Ilmu Pengetahuan\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Sniff\.

My Electivire\.

This scientist came by and asked
to take a look at him, but when I\lhanded her his Poké Ball, she\ltook off!

Now my only friend is gone\."
entries.translation_source: [blue]Sniff\. My Electivire\. This scientist came by and asked to take a look at him, but when I handed her his Poké Ball, she took off! Now my only friend is gone\.
entries.translated:
[blue]Hiks\\. Electivire-ku\\. Ilmuwan ini
datang dan meminta untuk\lmelihatnya, tapi ketika aku

menyerahkan Poké Ball-nya padanya,
dia kabur! Sekarang satu-satunya\ltemanku hilang\.

entries.original:
"I know I promised I’d give you a
reward when you got here, but can\lyou wait just a little longer?

I want to wait until I’m reunited
with my Electivire for good.

If you bring him back, I’ll throw
in something extra."
entries.translation_source: I know I promised I’d give you a reward when you got here, but can you wait just a little longer? I want to wait until I’m reunited with my Electivire for good. If you bring him back, I’ll throw in something extra.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu aku berjanji akan
memberimu hadiah saat kamu sampai\ldi sini, tapi bisakah kamu menunggu

sebentar lagi? Aku ingin menunggu
sampai aku bersatu kembali dengan\lElectivire-ku untuk selamanya. Jika

kamu membawanya kembali, aku akan
memberi sesuatu tambahan.

entries.original:
"That’s a relief.

For a moment, I thought I’d never
see my friend again\."
entries.translation_source: That’s a relief. For a moment, I thought I’d never see my friend again\.
entries.translated:
Itu melegakan. Untuk sesaat, aku
pikir aku tidak akan pernah melihat\ltemanku lagi\.

entries.original:
"Now I’ll never see my friend
again\."
entries.translation_source: Now I’ll never see my friend again\.
entries.translated:
Sekarang aku tidak akan pernah
melihat temanku lagi\.

entries.original:
"Do I have any clue where
Electivire could be?

I heard that scientist say
something about heading to [green]Seaport\lCity[blue] to run experiments\.

But that’s all I can say."
entries.translation_source: Do I have any clue where Electivire could be? I heard that scientist say something about heading to [green]Seaport City[blue] to run experiments\. But that’s all I can say.
entries.translated:
Apakah aku punya petunjuk di mana
Electivire berada? Aku dengar\lilmuwan itu mengatakan sesuatu

tentang pergi ke [green]Kota Seaport[blue] untuk
melakukan eksperimen\\. Tapi hanya\litu yang bisa kukatakan.

entries.original:
"You say you saved my Electivire
from the scientist?

Well, then please bring him back
to me!"
entries.translation_source: You say you saved my Electivire from the scientist? Well, then please bring him back to me!
entries.translated:
Kamu bilang kamu menyelamatkan
Electivire-ku dari ilmuwan? Kalau\lbegitu, tolong bawa dia kembali

padaku!

entries.original:
"The door requires a passcode to
unlock."
entries.translation_source: The door requires a passcode to unlock.
entries.translated:
Pintu memerlukan kode sandi untuk
membuka.

entries.original:
"This looks like a great place to
write a secret passcode\."
entries.translation_source: This looks like a great place to write a secret passcode\.
entries.translated:
Ini tampak seperti tempat yang
bagus untuk menulis kode sandi\lrahasia\.

entries.original:
"There appear to be some numbers
scrawled on the back of the crate.

They read: [green][buffer1][blue]"
entries.translation_source: There appear to be some numbers scrawled on the back of the crate. They read: [green][buffer1][blue]
entries.translated:
Tampaknya ada beberapa angka yang
ditulis di bagian belakang peti.\lAngka-angka itu adalah: [green][buffer1][blue]

entries.original:
"The door requires a passcode to
unlock.

Enter the passcode?"
entries.translation_source: The door requires a passcode to unlock. Enter the passcode?
entries.translated:
Pintu ini memerlukan kode sandi
untuk dibuka. Masukkan kode sandi?

entries.original:
"The passcode was incorrect.
The door remains locked.

Maybe the passcode is written
somewhere close by?"
entries.translation_source: The passcode was incorrect. The door remains locked. Maybe the passcode is written somewhere close by?
entries.translated:
Kode sandi salah. Pintu tetap
terkunci. Mungkin kode sandi\lditulis di suatu tempat di dekat

sini?

entries.original: "The door is already open."
entries.translation_source: The door is already open.
entries.translated: Pintu sudah terbuka.

entries.original: "And now, one last injection\."
entries.translation_source: And now, one last injection\.
entries.translated:
Dan sekarang, satu suntikan
terakhir\.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 You’re the same Trainer that
stopped this Electivire before!

Heh\.

Heh, heh, heh, heh, hah!

You see, I wanted you to follow
me here.

I even let this Electivire’s
Trainer know where I was going!

For you see, now I can use you to
fight my experiments and aid me in\lmy research!

Heh, heh, hah, hah, hah!

You see, now?"
entries.translation_source: You\.\CC0820 You’re the same Trainer that stopped this Electivire before! Heh\. Heh, heh, heh, heh, hah! You see, I wanted you to follow me here. I even let this Electivire’s Trainer know where I was going! For you see, now I can use you to fight my experiments and aid me in my research! Heh, heh, hah, hah, hah! You see, now?
entries.translated:
Anda\.\CC0820 Anda adalah Pelatih yang sama
yang menghentikan Electivire ini\lsebelumnya! Heh\. Heh, heh, heh, heh,

hah! Anda lihat, saya ingin Anda
mengikuti saya ke sini. Saya bahkan\lmemberi tahu Pelatih Electivire ini

ke mana saya pergi! Karena, lihat,
sekarang saya bisa menggunakan Anda\luntuk melawan eksperimen saya dan

membantu penelitian saya! Heh, heh,
hah, hah, hah! Anda lihat,\lsekarang?

entries.original:
"Electivire!
Attack this Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire! Attack this Trainer!
entries.translated: Electivire! Serang Pelatih ini!

entries.original: "[green]Vire!"
entries.translation_source: [green]Vire!
entries.translated: [green]Vire!

entries.original: "[green]Vire\."
entries.translation_source: [green]Vire\.
entries.translated: [green]Vire\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh, urk\.

I am disappointed my experiment
could not hold up.

However\.

There is always a contingency plan!

Heh, heh, heh, hah, hah!"
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh, urk\. I am disappointed my experiment could not hold up. However\. There is always a contingency plan! Heh, heh, heh, hah, hah!
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, heh, urk\. Saya kecewa
eksperimen saya tidak bisa\lbertahan. Namun\. Selalu ada rencana

cadangan! Heh, heh, heh, hah, hah!

entries.original:
"Electivire!
It’s time for round two!

Can you feel it?

I’ve filled the air with the power
I harnessed!

The power of the Hidden Grottos!

Use it to attack this Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire! It’s time for round two! Can you feel it? I’ve filled the air with the power I harnessed! The power of the Hidden Grottos! Use it to attack this Trainer!
entries.translated:
Electivire! Saatnya untuk ronde
kedua! Bisakah kau merasakannya?\lAku telah memenuhi udara dengan

kekuatan yang aku kumpulkan!
Kekuatan dari Hidden Grottos!\lGunakan untuk menyerang Pelatih

ini!

entries.original:
"[black]Do you need an explanation of the
Dynamax phenomenon?"
entries.translation_source: [black]Do you need an explanation of the Dynamax phenomenon?
entries.translated:
[black]Apakah Anda perlu penjelasan
tentang fenomena Dynamax?

entries.original:
"[black]Dynamax is a unique phenomenon that
a Pokémon can only undergo in\lspecial areas, such as Hidden\lGrottos.

Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax,
but if a Pokémon holds a Mega\lStone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be\lable to.

To Dynamax a Pokémon, press \btn04
when you see the red Dynamax\lsymbol appear.

If you choose to Dynamax your
Pokémon, the effect will last\lfor three turns.

During this time period, each of
your Pokémon’s moves will be\lpowered up into special variants\lknown as [green]Max Moves[black].

These Max Moves are much more
powerful than regular attacks."
entries.translation_source: [black]Dynamax is a unique phenomenon that a Pokémon can only undergo in special areas, such as Hidden Grottos. Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax, but if a Pokémon holds a Mega Stone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be able to. To Dynamax a Pokémon, press \btn04 when you see the red Dynamax symbol appear. If you choose to Dynamax your Pokémon, the effect will last for three turns. During this time period, each of your Pokémon’s moves will be powered up into special variants known as [green]Max Moves[black]. These Max Moves are much more powerful than regular attacks.
entries.translated:
[black]Dynamax adalah fenomena unik yang
hanya dapat dialami oleh Pokémon di\larea khusus, seperti Hidden

Grottos. Hampir semua Pokémon bisa
Dynamax, tetapi jika Pokémon\lmemegang Mega Stone atau Z-Crystal,

ia tidak akan bisa. Untuk Dynamax
Pokémon, tekan \btn04 saat kamu melihat\lsimbol Dynamax merah muncul. Jika

kamu memilih untuk Dynamax
Pokémon-mu, efeknya akan\lberlangsung selama tiga giliran.

Selama periode ini, setiap gerakan
Pokémon-mu akan ditingkatkan\lmenjadi varian khusus yang dikenal

sebagai [green]Max Moves[black]. Max Moves ini
jauh lebih kuat daripada serangan\lbiasa.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, urk\.

It seems this is a failed
experiment.

Perhaps my formula was not as
potent as I thought\.

However\.

It’s time for my final contingency
plan!

Electivire!
Out of my way!"
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, urk\. It seems this is a failed experiment. Perhaps my formula was not as potent as I thought\. However\. It’s time for my final contingency plan! Electivire! Out of my way!
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, urk\. Tampaknya ini adalah
eksperimen yang gagal. Mungkin\lformulaku tidak sekuat yang kukira\.

Namun\. Saatnya untuk rencana
cadangan terakhirku! Electivire!\lMenyingkirlah!

entries.original:
"I’ll come at you using my very
first test subjects!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll come at you using my very first test subjects!
entries.translated:
Aku akan mendatangimu menggunakan
subjek uji pertamaku!

entries.original:
"Urk\.

The Science Society will be
extremely disappointed when they\llearn of my failed endeavors.

However\. I still managed to harness
the power of the Hidden Grottos, so\lthis may not be a complete loss\.

Goodbye, for now, Trainer.

One day in the future, I will show
you the true power of science!"
entries.translation_source: Urk\. The Science Society will be extremely disappointed when they learn of my failed endeavors. However\. I still managed to harness the power of the Hidden Grottos, so this may not be a complete loss\. Goodbye, for now, Trainer. One day in the future, I will show you the true power of science!
entries.translated:
Urk\. The Science Society akan sangat
kecewa ketika mereka tahu tentang\lusahaku yang gagal. Namun\. Aku masih

berhasil mengumpulkan kekuatan dari
Hidden Grottos, jadi ini mungkin\lbukan kerugian total\. Selamat

tinggal, untuk sekarang, Pelatih.
Suatu hari nanti, aku akan\lmenunjukkan kepadamu kekuatan

sejati sains!

entries.original:
"[black]The Electivire seems to want to go
with you back to Epidimy Town!

Take it there?"
entries.translation_source: [black]The Electivire seems to want to go with you back to Epidimy Town! Take it there?
entries.translated:
[black]Electivire tampaknya ingin pergi
denganmu kembali ke Epidimy Town!\lBawa ke sana?

entries.original:
"[black]The Electivire seems to want to go
with you back to Epidimy Town!

But it can’t go while there’s someone
following you\."
entries.translation_source: [black]The Electivire seems to want to go with you back to Epidimy Town! But it can’t go while there’s someone following you\.
entries.translated:
[black]Electivire tampaknya ingin pergi
denganmu kembali ke Epidimy Town!\lTapi ia tidak bisa pergi saat ada

seseorang yang mengikutimu\.

entries.original:
"My Electivire came back to me!

It must have been because of your
efforts!

Now, as promised, here are your
rewards.

They’re the least I can give you
after all the time you spent\lchasing down my Electivire."
entries.translation_source: My Electivire came back to me! It must have been because of your efforts! Now, as promised, here are your rewards. They’re the least I can give you after all the time you spent chasing down my Electivire.
entries.translated:
Electivire-ku kembali padaku! Pasti
karena usahamu! Sekarang, seperti\lyang dijanjikan, inilah hadiahmu.

Itu yang paling bisa kuberikan
setelah semua waktu yang kau\lhabiskan mengejar Electivire-ku.

entries.original: "Take this Egg, too."
entries.translation_source: Take this Egg, too.
entries.translated: Ambil juga Telur ini.

entries.original: "You received an Egg from the nerd!"
entries.translation_source: You received an Egg from the nerd!
entries.translated:
Kamu menerima Telur dari si kutu
buku!

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ll need to make
space in your Cube before I can\lgive you this Electirizer."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ll need to make space in your Cube before I can give you this Electirizer.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu perlu mengosongkan
ruang di Cube-mu sebelum aku bisa\lmemberimu Electirizer ini.

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ll need to make
space in your party before I can\lgive you your reward."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ll need to make space in your party before I can give you your reward.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu perlu mengosongkan
ruang di timmu sebelum aku bisa\lmemberikan hadiahmu.

entries.original:
"Use the [green]Electirizer[blue] on an [green]Electabuzz[blue]
to evolve it."
entries.translation_source: Use the [green]Electirizer[blue] on an [green]Electabuzz[blue] to evolve it.
entries.translated:
Gunakan [green]Electirizer[blue] pada [green]Electabuzz[blue]
untuk mengevolusikannya.

entries.original: "Swords of Justice"
entries.translation_source: Swords of Justice
entries.translated: Pedang Keadilan

entries.original:
"The Swords of Justice of the
Unova region\.

Why would they be here?

They’re not!

Not yet at least\.

In time, things may change\."
entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice of the Unova region\. Why would they be here? They’re not! Not yet at least\. In time, things may change\.
entries.translated:
Pedang Keadilan dari Wilayah Unova\.
Mengapa mereka ada di sini? Mereka\ltidak! Belum setidaknya\. Seiring

waktu, segalanya mungkin berubah\.

entries.original:
"The Swords of Justice of the Unova
region have appeared!

Why would they be here?

The great Portal Boom, that’s why!

Will you capture them and show
them to me?"
entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice of the Unova region have appeared! Why would they be here? The great Portal Boom, that’s why! Will you capture them and show them to me?
entries.translated:
Pedang Keadilan dari Wilayah Unova
telah muncul! Mengapa mereka ada di\lsini? Ledakan Portal yang hebat,

itulah alasannya! Maukah kau
menangkap mereka dan menunjukkan\lmereka padaku?

entries.original:
"The Swords of Justice are waiting
for a Trainer like the Champion\lto come and find them!

If you don’t find them soon,
someone else just might!"
entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice are waiting for a Trainer like the Champion to come and find them! If you don’t find them soon, someone else just might!
entries.translated:
Pedang Keadilan sedang menunggu
Pelatih seperti sang Juara untuk\ldatang dan menemukan mereka! Jika

kau tidak segera menemukannya,
orang lain mungkin akan\lmelakukannya!

entries.original:
"Ahaha, I knew I could count
on you!

Word has it the Pokémon have been
spotted around [green]Victory Road[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Ahaha, I knew I could count on you! Word has it the Pokémon have been spotted around [green]Victory Road[blue].
entries.translated:
Ahaha, aku tahu aku bisa
mengandalkanmu! Kabar beredar\lPokémon telah terlihat di sekitar

[green]Victory Road[blue].

entries.original:
"Capture the Swords of Justice and
bring them here!

Word has it they’ve been spotted
around [green]Victory Road[blue].

They’re quite apprehensive of
humans, so they may only feel\lsecure when they’re together.

If you accidentally defeat one,
don’t worry!

Like most legendary Pokémon, they
will reappear if you enter the\lHall of Fame again."
entries.translation_source: Capture the Swords of Justice and bring them here! Word has it they’ve been spotted around [green]Victory Road[blue]. They’re quite apprehensive of humans, so they may only feel secure when they’re together. If you accidentally defeat one, don’t worry! Like most legendary Pokémon, they will reappear if you enter the Hall of Fame again.
entries.translated:
Tangkap Pedang Keadilan dan bawa
mereka ke sini! Kabar beredar\lmereka telah terlihat di sekitar

[green]Victory Road[blue]. Mereka cukup waspada
terhadap manusia, jadi mereka\lmungkin hanya merasa aman saat

bersama. Jika kau tidak sengaja
mengalahkan satu, jangan khawatir!\lSeperti kebanyakan Pokémon

legendaris, mereka akan muncul
kembali jika kau memasuki Hall of\lFame lagi.

entries.original:
"Trainer!

You have done well capturing the
Swords of Justice.

Now, follow me and bring them to
[green]Route 17[blue].

I have a suspicion about them\."
entries.translation_source: Trainer! You have done well capturing the Swords of Justice. Now, follow me and bring them to [green]Route 17[blue]. I have a suspicion about them\.
entries.translated:
Pelatih! Kau telah berhasil
menangkap Pedang Keadilan.\lSekarang, ikuti aku dan bawa mereka

ke [green]Rute 17[blue]. Aku punya kecurigaan
tentang mereka\.

entries.original:
"Trainer!

Bring the Swords of Justice you
captured earlier.

I have a suspicion about this
rock face\."
entries.translation_source: Trainer! Bring the Swords of Justice you captured earlier. I have a suspicion about this rock face\.
entries.translated:
Pelatih! Bawa Pedang Keadilan yang
kau tangkap sebelumnya. Aku punya\lkecurigaan tentang dinding batu ini\.

entries.original:
"Trainer!

I believe this rock face before me
is somehow linked to the Swords of\lJustice.

Please allow them out of their
Poké Balls, so we can see if they\lreact to the wall."
entries.translation_source: Trainer! I believe this rock face before me is somehow linked to the Swords of Justice. Please allow them out of their Poké Balls, so we can see if they react to the wall.
entries.translated:
Pelatih! Aku percaya dinding batu
di depanku ini entah bagaimana\lterhubung dengan Pedang Keadilan.

Tolong keluarkan mereka dari Poké
Ball mereka, sehingga kita dapat\lmelihat apakah mereka bereaksi

terhadap dinding.

entries.original:
"[black]Your Pokémon are shaking in their
Poké Balls!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Your Pokémon are shaking in their Poké Balls!
entries.translated:
[black]Pokémon-mu gemetar di dalam Poké
Ball mereka!

entries.original:
"Ahaha!
My suspicions were confirmed!

Despite the Swords of Justice not
originating in Borrius, they still\lbear a strong connection with\lwhatever is hiding behind this\lrock face.

If I am correct, you’ll need these
in your fight against it."
entries.translation_source: Ahaha! My suspicions were confirmed! Despite the Swords of Justice not originating in Borrius, they still bear a strong connection with whatever is hiding behind this rock face. If I am correct, you’ll need these in your fight against it.
entries.translated:
Ahaha! Kecurigaanku terbukti!
Meskipun Pedang Keadilan tidak\lberasal dari Borrius, mereka masih

memiliki hubungan kuat dengan apa
pun yang bersembunyi di balik\ldinding batu ini. Jika aku benar,

kau akan membutuhkan ini dalam
pertarunganmu melawannya.

entries.original:
"May the swords be with you, young
Trainer."
entries.translation_source: May the swords be with you, young Trainer.
entries.translated:
Semoga pedang menyertaimu, Pelatih
muda.

entries.original:
"[black]Keldeo boosted its aura and
increased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [black]Keldeo boosted its aura and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Keldeo meningkatkan aurananya dan
memperbesar ukurannya!

entries.original: "The Terror Granbull"
entries.translation_source: The Terror Granbull
entries.translated: Granbull yang Mengerikan

entries.original: "Goon"
entries.translation_source: Goon
entries.translated: Goon

entries.original: "Goon A"
entries.translation_source: Goon A
entries.translated: Goon A

entries.original: "Goon B"
entries.translation_source: Goon B
entries.translated: Preman B

entries.original: "Officer"
entries.translation_source: Officer
entries.translated: Petugas

entries.original: "Gruff"
entries.translation_source: Gruff
entries.translated: Kasar

entries.original: "Hello, good citizen!"
entries.translation_source: Hello, good citizen!
entries.translated: Halo, warga yang baik!

entries.original:
"Oh, I remember you!

You’re that [buffer1] who assisted us in
the Dresco Town Gym!

For that, you can have these
five Revives."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I remember you! You’re that [buffer1] who assisted us in the Dresco Town Gym! For that, you can have these five Revives.
entries.translated:
Oh, saya ingat Anda! Anda adalah
[buffer1] yang membantu kami di Gim\lKota Dresco! Untuk itu, Anda dapat

memiliki lima Revive ini.

entries.original:
"Say, would you like to help out by
assisting the police again?"
entries.translation_source: Say, would you like to help out by assisting the police again?
entries.translated:
Katakan, apakah Anda ingin membantu
polisi lagi?

entries.original:
"Ah\. those Badges mean that you’re
probably strong enough\.

Would you be willing to lend a
hand to the local police force?"
entries.translation_source: Ah\. those Badges mean that you’re probably strong enough\. Would you be willing to lend a hand to the local police force?
entries.translated:
Ah\. Lencana-lencana itu berarti Anda
mungkin cukup kuat\. Apakah Anda\lbersedia membantu kepolisian

setempat?

entries.original:
"Ah, good, good.

Then, as you know, Borrius’ crime
problem mostly relates to the\lgangs that were confined together\lin [green]Antisis City[blue].

Recently, however, the gang that
used to dominate the most\lterritories there, the so-called\l\qoTerror Granbull\qc, vacated their\lold base.

On top of that, there’s been reports
that several members of the gang\lhave been congregating and causing\ltrouble in various locations.

With our police force spread so thin,
we need a strong Trainer such as\lyourself to help in rounding up\lthose goons."
entries.translation_source: Ah, good, good. Then, as you know, Borrius’ crime problem mostly relates to the gangs that were confined together in [green]Antisis City[blue]. Recently, however, the gang that used to dominate the most territories there, the so-called \qoTerror Granbull\qc, vacated their old base. On top of that, there’s been reports that several members of the gang have been congregating and causing trouble in various locations. With our police force spread so thin, we need a strong Trainer such as yourself to help in rounding up those goons.
entries.translated:
Ah, baik, baik. Lalu, seperti yang
Anda tahu, masalah kejahatan\lBorrius sebagian besar terkait

dengan geng-geng yang dikurung
bersama di [green]Kota Antisis[blue]. Baru-baru\lini, geng yang dulu mendominasi

sebagian besar wilayah di sana,
yang disebut \qoTerror Granbull\qc,\lmeninggalkan markas lama mereka.

Ditambah lagi, ada laporan bahwa
beberapa anggota geng berkumpul dan\lmenyebabkan masalah di berbagai

lokasi. Dengan kekuatan polisi kami
yang tersebar tipis, kami\lmembutuhkan Pelatih kuat seperti

Anda untuk membantu menangkap para
preman itu.

entries.original:
"Ah, thank you for your assistance.

When you are prepared, meet me on
the east side of [green]Route 10[blue], just up\lthe first set of stairs you see.

I recommend making sure your
Pokémon are healed up."
entries.translation_source: Ah, thank you for your assistance. When you are prepared, meet me on the east side of [green]Route 10[blue], just up the first set of stairs you see. I recommend making sure your Pokémon are healed up.
entries.translated:
Ah, terima kasih atas bantuan Anda.
Jika Anda sudah siap, temui saya di\lsisi timur [green]Rute 10[blue], tepat di atas

set tangga pertama yang Anda lihat.
Saya sarankan pastikan Pokémon Anda\lsudah dipulihkan.

entries.original:
"Our forces will be spread thin for
the foreseeable future.

If you would like to lend a hand,
it will always be appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Our forces will be spread thin for the foreseeable future. If you would like to lend a hand, it will always be appreciated.
entries.translated:
Pasukan kami akan tersebar tipis
dalam waktu dekat. Jika Anda ingin\lmembantu, itu akan selalu dihargai.

entries.original:
"Huh?
It’s some punk kid!

Man, who just walks up to a big gang
of people without protection, huh?

Let’s rough [buffer2] up and snatch
all [buffer1] cash!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? It’s some punk kid! Man, who just walks up to a big gang of people without protection, huh? Let’s rough [buffer2] up and snatch all [buffer1] cash!
entries.translated:
Hah? Itu anak punk! Wah, siapa yang
berani mendekati geng besar tanpa\lperlindungan, ya? Ayo kita habisi

[buffer2] dan rampas semua uang
[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"That’s right! There’s no one to blame
but yourself, punk!"
entries.translation_source: That’s right! There’s no one to blame but yourself, punk!
entries.translated:
Benar! Tidak ada yang bisa
disalahkan selain dirimu sendiri,\lpunk!

entries.original:
"Didn’t your mommy ever tell you not
to follow strangers anywhere?

Well, we’re about to show ya why\.
the hard way!

So c’mon then - lemme hear ya
squeal, ya brat!

Beg for mercy from the
[green]Terror Granbull[green]!"
entries.translation_source: Didn’t your mommy ever tell you not to follow strangers anywhere? Well, we’re about to show ya why\. the hard way! So c’mon then - lemme hear ya squeal, ya brat! Beg for mercy from the [green]Terror Granbull[green]!
entries.translated:
Apa ibumu tidak pernah bilang
jangan ikut orang asing ke mana\lpun? Baiklah, kami akan tunjukkan

kenapa\. dengan cara yang keras! Jadi
ayo - biarkan aku dengar eranganmu,\lbocah! Minta ampun pada [green]Terror

Granbull[green]!

entries.original:
"Hold it right there!

I’m arresting you, in the name of
the Fallshore City Police!"
entries.translation_source: Hold it right there! I’m arresting you, in the name of the Fallshore City Police!
entries.translated:
Berhenti di sana! Saya menangkap
Anda, atas nama Polisi Kota\lFallshore!

entries.original:
"Uh oh - it’s the cops!

Scatter, boys!"
entries.translation_source: Uh oh - it’s the cops! Scatter, boys!
entries.translated: Uh oh - itu polisi! Sebar, kawan!

entries.original:
"What!? Get back here, you cowardly
wusses!

You outnumber these jokers, easily!

Gah\. just you wait - you’ll be sorry
you ever got in our way!"
entries.translation_source: What!? Get back here, you cowardly wusses! You outnumber these jokers, easily! Gah\. just you wait - you’ll be sorry you ever got in our way!
entries.translated:
Apa!? Kembali ke sini, kalian
pengecut! Kalian lebih banyak dari\lpada orang-orang ini, mudah! Gah\.

tunggu saja - kalian akan menyesal
pernah menghalangi kami!

entries.original:
"Darn\. they got away\.

Still, all this water means that
there aren’t too many places to\lescape from us.

They can’t have gone that far.
Let’s split up and look for them."
entries.translation_source: Darn\. they got away\. Still, all this water means that there aren’t too many places to escape from us. They can’t have gone that far. Let’s split up and look for them.
entries.translated:
Sial\. mereka lolos\. Namun, semua air
ini berarti tidak banyak tempat\luntuk melarikan diri dari kita.

Mereka tidak mungkin pergi sejauh
itu. Mari kita berpisah dan mencari\lmereka.

entries.original:
"And that’s you finished, I’m afraid!
You’re under arrest!

Now don’t cause any trouble, and
just come along quietly."
entries.translation_source: And that’s you finished, I’m afraid! You’re under arrest! Now don’t cause any trouble, and just come along quietly.
entries.translated:
Dan itu berarti Anda selesai, saya
khawatir! Anda ditahan! Sekarang\ljangan buat masalah, dan ikut saja

dengan tenang.

entries.original:
"Good work, [player].

Thanks to your efforts, there’s one
less criminal on the loose.

Only [buffer1] are left now.

Keep searching, while I take this man
down to the station."
entries.translation_source: Good work, [player]. Thanks to your efforts, there’s one less criminal on the loose. Only [buffer1] are left now. Keep searching, while I take this man down to the station.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, [player]. Berkat usaha
Anda, satu penjahat berkurang.\lHanya [buffer1] yang tersisa

sekarang. Teruslah mencari,
sementara saya membawa orang ini ke\lkantor polisi.

entries.original:
"Great job, [player]!
That should be most of them now!

Only their leader remains at large,
so\.

Let’s regroup on [green]Route 10[blue] by the
stairs to determine his location."
entries.translation_source: Great job, [player]! That should be most of them now! Only their leader remains at large, so\. Let’s regroup on [green]Route 10[blue] by the stairs to determine his location.
entries.translated:
Kerja hebat, [player]! Itu
seharusnya sebagian besar dari\lmereka sekarang! Hanya pemimpin

mereka yang masih buron, jadi\. Mari
berkumpul kembali di [green]Rute 10[blue] dekat\ltangga untuk menentukan lokasinya.

entries.original:
"It’s you - you’re the little brat
from earlier!

You thought you were so tough with
that cop backin’ you up?

Without him, you’re just some
pathetic wimp!

And pathetic wimps ain’t good for
anythin’ but crying!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you - you’re the little brat from earlier! You thought you were so tough with that cop backin’ you up? Without him, you’re just some pathetic wimp! And pathetic wimps ain’t good for anythin’ but crying!
entries.translated:
Kau lagi - kau si bocah nakal dari
tadi! Kau pikir kau hebat dengan\lpolisi itu yang mendukungmu? Tanpa

dia, kau hanya seorang pengecut
yang menyedihkan! Dan pengecut yang\lmenyedihkan tidak berguna untuk apa

pun selain menangis!

entries.original:
"Ngh\. so the kid’s decided to play
detective, huh?

Fine! I’ll teach you no second-rate
brat can just go mess with the\lTerror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: Ngh\. so the kid’s decided to play detective, huh? Fine! I’ll teach you no second-rate brat can just go mess with the Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
Ngh\. jadi bocah ini memutuskan untuk
main detektif, ya? Baiklah! Aku\lakan mengajarimu bahwa tidak ada

bocah kelas dua yang bisa seenaknya
macam-macam dengan Terror Granbull!

entries.original:
"Gah! How’d this little snot find me
hiding here!?

Grr\. well then, I guess you don’t
leave me any choice!

I’m gonna teach a punk like you a
lesson in pain!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! How’d this little snot find me hiding here!? Grr\. well then, I guess you don’t leave me any choice! I’m gonna teach a punk like you a lesson in pain!
entries.translated:
Gah! Bagaimana bocah ingusan ini
menemukanku bersembunyi di sini!?\lGrr\. baiklah, kurasa kau tidak

memberiku pilihan lain! Aku akan
memberi pelajaran pada punk\lsepertimu tentang rasa sakit!

entries.original:
"Tch\. so this punk kid found me\.

Fine! Taste the terrible terror of
the Terror Granbull!

\.

That sounded way better in my head\."
entries.translation_source: Tch\. so this punk kid found me\. Fine! Taste the terrible terror of the Terror Granbull! \. That sounded way better in my head\.
entries.translated:
Tch\. jadi bocah punk ini menemukanku\.
Baiklah! Rasakan teror mengerikan\ldari Terror Granbull! \. Itu

terdengar lebih keren di kepalaku\.

entries.original:
"There you are, [player].

I must commend you on your valiant
efforts in rounding up those four\lcowardly goons.

As for the leader of the pack,
however, who remains at large\.

I haven’t seen him.

Has he returned to Antisis City,
perhaps?"
entries.translation_source: There you are, [player]. I must commend you on your valiant efforts in rounding up those four cowardly goons. As for the leader of the pack, however, who remains at large\. I haven’t seen him. Has he returned to Antisis City, perhaps?
entries.translated:
Itu kau, [player]. Aku harus memuji
usahamu yang gagah berani dalam\lmengumpulkan keempat preman

pengecut itu. Namun, soal pemimpin
kelompok itu, yang masih buron\. Aku\lbelum melihatnya. Mungkin dia

kembali ke Antisis City?

entries.original:
"Hahahaha! As if I would!

The mighty Gruff, leader of the
Terror Granbull, doesn’t just let a\lchance to beat down a do-gooder\lslip on by!"
entries.translation_source: Hahahaha! As if I would! The mighty Gruff, leader of the Terror Granbull, doesn’t just let a chance to beat down a do-gooder slip on by!
entries.translated:
Hahahaha! Seolah aku akan! Gruff
yang perkasa, pemimpin Terror\lGranbull, tidak akan membiarkan

kesempatan untuk mengalahkan
seorang pembela kebaikan begitu\lsaja lewat!

entries.original:
"Stop right there, criminal scum!

I’m taking you in for the various
felonies and disturbances you’ve\lcaused across Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Stop right there, criminal scum! I’m taking you in for the various felonies and disturbances you’ve caused across Borrius!
entries.translated:
Berhenti di situ, sampah kriminal!
Aku akan menangkapmu karena\lberbagai kejahatan dan gangguan

yang telah kau sebabkan di seluruh
Borrius!

entries.original:
"Hah! I’d love to see ya try!

As for you, kid\. \CC0818 sure, you didn’t
do too bad, beatin’ my goons the\lway ya did\.

But those cowards fled from an
easy beatin’ - it was no surprise\lya won over those saps.

But you’re gonna find I ain’t such
an easy target, capice?

I’ll be a real man, and see just
how good ya really are.

Get ready, ya wannabe hero, ’cos
Gruff only knows how to play rough!"
entries.translation_source: Hah! I’d love to see ya try! As for you, kid\. \CC0818 sure, you didn’t do too bad, beatin’ my goons the way ya did\. But those cowards fled from an easy beatin’ - it was no surprise ya won over those saps. But you’re gonna find I ain’t such an easy target, capice? I’ll be a real man, and see just how good ya really are. Get ready, ya wannabe hero, ’cos Gruff only knows how to play rough!
entries.translated:
Hah! Aku ingin melihat kau mencoba!
Adapun kau, nak\. \CC0818 tentu saja, kau\ltidak buruk, mengalahkan anak

buahku seperti yang kau lakukan\.
Tapi para pengecut itu lari dari\lkekalahan mudah - tidak

mengherankan kau mengalahkan
mereka. Tapi kau akan tahu bahwa\laku bukan target yang mudah,

mengerti? Aku akan menjadi pria
sejati, dan lihat seberapa hebat\ldirimu sebenarnya. Bersiaplah,

pahlawan palsu, karena Gruff hanya
tahu cara bermain kasar!

entries.original:
"Heh\. awright, I get it - ya got me,
fair and square!

But don’t go thinkin’ that I’m turning
myself in, ya hear?

I’m hoppin’ on a boat to East
Borrius, and me and the boys’ll\lmake a fresh start there!

Smell ya later, copper!

And next time, remember to
confiscate my bike!"
entries.translation_source: Heh\. awright, I get it - ya got me, fair and square! But don’t go thinkin’ that I’m turning myself in, ya hear? I’m hoppin’ on a boat to East Borrius, and me and the boys’ll make a fresh start there! Smell ya later, copper! And next time, remember to confiscate my bike!
entries.translated:
Heh\. baiklah, aku mengerti - kau
menangkapku, jujur dan adil! Tapi\ljangan berpikir aku akan

menyerahkan diri, dengar? Aku akan
naik kapal ke East Borrius, dan aku\lserta anak-anak akan memulai awal

yang baru di sana! Sampai jumpa,
polisi! Dan lain kali, ingatlah\luntuk menyita sepedaku!

entries.original:
"Gah\.! I can’t believe it never
occurred to me to do that\.

Sigh\. but still, that was fine work
there, [player].

I’ll radio my colleagues in Seaport
City, to intercept him at the port.

There’s nothing more we can do here,
so for now, please take this.

Consider it a reward for doing your
bit to help the community."
entries.translation_source: Gah\.! I can’t believe it never occurred to me to do that\. Sigh\. but still, that was fine work there, [player]. I’ll radio my colleagues in Seaport City, to intercept him at the port. There’s nothing more we can do here, so for now, please take this. Consider it a reward for doing your bit to help the community.
entries.translated:
Gah\.! Aku tidak percaya tidak pernah
terpikir olehku untuk melakukan itu\.\lHuh\. tapi tetap saja, kerja bagus di

sana, [player]. Aku akan
menghubungi rekan-rekanku di\lSeaport City, untuk mencegatnya di

pelabuhan. Tidak ada lagi yang bisa
kita lakukan di sini, jadi untuk\lsaat ini, tolong terima ini. Anggap

saja sebagai hadiah karena telah
membantu masyarakat.

entries.original:
"Maybe another time\.

I could ask for your help in
solving another case.

Until then, stay safe, and stay
vigilant."
entries.translation_source: Maybe another time\. I could ask for your help in solving another case. Until then, stay safe, and stay vigilant.
entries.translated:
Mungkin lain kali\. Aku bisa meminta
bantuanmu untuk memecahkan kasus\llain. Sampai saat itu, tetap aman,

dan tetap waspada.

entries.original: "Too Much TV"
entries.translation_source: Too Much TV
entries.translated: Terlalu Banyak TV

entries.original: "[black]Missions Completed: [green][buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: [black]Missions Completed: [green][buffer1]
entries.translated: [black]Misi Selesai: [green][buffer1]

entries.original:
"My\.\CC0820 my daughter\.

She’s fallen into a deep coma\.

It’s because she\.\CC0820 she watched
too much television!

If only there were someone out
there who could help her\.

You seem like a well-traveled
Trainer.

Perhaps you know someone who
could help?"
entries.translation_source: My\.\CC0820 my daughter\. She’s fallen into a deep coma\. It’s because she\.\CC0820 she watched too much television! If only there were someone out there who could help her\. You seem like a well-traveled Trainer. Perhaps you know someone who could help?
entries.translated:
Putri\.\CC0820 putriku\. Dia jatuh ke dalam
koma yang dalam\. Itu karena dia\.\CC0820 dia\lmenonton televisi terlalu banyak!

Andai saja ada seseorang di luar
sana yang bisa membantunya\. Anda\lsepertinya Pelatih yang sering

bepergian. Mungkin Anda kenal
seseorang yang bisa membantu?

entries.original:
"I knew I was right to ask you!
Oh, thank you!

Please find someone to restore my
daughter’s consciousness.

Perhaps a scientist of some sort?

I’m sure there’s some institute out
there that researches the brain\."
entries.translation_source: I knew I was right to ask you! Oh, thank you! Please find someone to restore my daughter’s consciousness. Perhaps a scientist of some sort? I’m sure there’s some institute out there that researches the brain\.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu aku benar untuk bertanya
padamu! Oh, terima kasih! Tolong\ltemukan seseorang untuk memulihkan

kesadaran putriku. Mungkin ilmuwan
semacam? Aku yakin ada suatu\linstitut di luar sana yang meneliti

otak\.

entries.original:
"If not you, this Trainer I
don’t even know, then who?"
entries.translation_source: If not you, this Trainer I don’t even know, then who?
entries.translated:
Jika bukan kamu, Pelatih yang
bahkan tidak kukenal, lalu siapa?

entries.original:
"Ah, Trainer, it’s you again!

The scientist you sent was able to
heal my daughter!

My gratitude knows no bounds.

This mischievous Pokémon emerged
from my daughter during the\lhealing process.

I want you to have it."
entries.translation_source: Ah, Trainer, it’s you again! The scientist you sent was able to heal my daughter! My gratitude knows no bounds. This mischievous Pokémon emerged from my daughter during the healing process. I want you to have it.
entries.translated:
Ah, Pelatih, kau lagi! Ilmuwan yang
kau kirim berhasil menyembuhkan\lputriku! Rasa terima kasihku tak

terbatas. Pokémon nakal ini muncul
dari putriku selama proses\lpenyembuhan. Aku ingin kau

memilikinya.

entries.original:
"But first you’ll need to make space
in your party for it."
entries.translation_source: But first you’ll need to make space in your party for it.
entries.translated:
Tapi pertama-tama kau perlu
menyediakan tempat di timmu\luntuknya.

entries.original:
"Because of you, not only is my
daughter back to normal, but she\ldoesn’t even remember the concept\lof a television!

It’s truly a miracle."
entries.translation_source: Because of you, not only is my daughter back to normal, but she doesn’t even remember the concept of a television! It’s truly a miracle.
entries.translated:
Karena dirimu, tidak hanya putriku
kembali normal, tapi dia bahkan\ltidak ingat konsep televisi!

Benar-benar keajaiban.

entries.original:
"[black]She’s in a dream-like state.

This is what happens when you
watch too much TV."
entries.translation_source: [black]She’s in a dream-like state. This is what happens when you watch too much TV.
entries.translated:
[black]Dia dalam keadaan seperti mimpi.
Inilah yang terjadi ketika kau\lmenonton TV terlalu banyak.

entries.original:
"Thank you for helping me get
better, Trainer!

I heard I was sick, but my Daddy
won’t tell me why."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for helping me get better, Trainer! I heard I was sick, but my Daddy won’t tell me why.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah membantu saya
sembuh, Trainer! Saya dengar saya\lsakit, tapi Ayahku tidak mau

memberitahu alasannya.

entries.original:
"Here at the Dream Research Lab,
we study the dreams of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Here at the Dream Research Lab, we study the dreams of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Di Laboratorium Penelitian Mimpi
ini, kami mempelajari mimpi\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"What did you say?

A child in Polder Town has fallen
into a coma due to watching too\lmuch television?

Then it must be worse than I
feared\.

I’ve been getting reports from all
across the region of children\lunable to divert their attention\lfrom that horrendous device.

In order to help this child, I must
have data on all of the children\lin Borrius locked into this\l\qotelevision\qc frenzy.

Trainer!

It’s up to you to get this data
for me.

By my count, there are [buffer1] children
total.

My scans indicate there are two in
snowy areas, one in a city on the\lcoast, and another in a somber and\lsad town.

You’ve found one, so that just
leaves [green][buffer2][blue] more.

When you encounter another, scan
them with your Super Cube and\lsend me the data."
entries.translation_source: What did you say? A child in Polder Town has fallen into a coma due to watching too much television? Then it must be worse than I feared\. I’ve been getting reports from all across the region of children unable to divert their attention from that horrendous device. In order to help this child, I must have data on all of the children in Borrius locked into this \qotelevision\qc frenzy. Trainer! It’s up to you to get this data for me. By my count, there are [buffer1] children total. My scans indicate there are two in snowy areas, one in a city on the coast, and another in a somber and sad town. You’ve found one, so that just leaves [green][buffer2][blue] more. When you encounter another, scan them with your Super Cube and send me the data.
entries.translated:
Apa yang kamu katakan? Seorang anak
di Polder Town koma karena terlalu\lbanyak menonton televisi? Maka itu

pasti lebih buruk dari yang saya
khawatirkan\. Saya sudah menerima\llaporan dari seluruh wilayah

tentang anak-anak yang tidak bisa
mengalihkan perhatian dari alat\lyang mengerikan itu. Untuk membantu

anak ini, saya harus memiliki data
tentang semua anak di Borrius yang\lterperangkap dalam \qotelevisi\qc.

Trainer! Terserah padamu untuk
mendapatkan data ini untukku.\lMenurut perhitungan saya, ada total

[buffer1] anak. Pemindaian saya
menunjukkan ada dua di daerah\lbersalju, satu di kota di pesisir,

dan satu lagi di kota yang muram
dan sedih. Kamu sudah menemukan\lsatu, jadi tinggal [green][buffer2][blue] lagi.

Saat kamu bertemu yang lain, pindai
mereka dengan Super Cube-mu dan\lkirimkan data itu padaku.

entries.original:
"You still have yet to gather data
on [green][buffer1][blue] of the children locked in a\l\qotelevision frenzy\qc.

My scans indicate there are two in
snowy areas, one in a city on the\lcoast, and another in a somber and\lsad town.

When you encounter one, scan them
with your Super Cube and send me\lthe data."
entries.translation_source: You still have yet to gather data on [green][buffer1][blue] of the children locked in a \qotelevision frenzy\qc. My scans indicate there are two in snowy areas, one in a city on the coast, and another in a somber and sad town. When you encounter one, scan them with your Super Cube and send me the data.
entries.translated:
Kamu masih belum mengumpulkan data
tentang [green][buffer1][blue] anak yang\lterperangkap dalam \qodemam

televisi\qc. Pemindaian saya
menunjukkan ada dua di daerah\lbersalju, satu di kota di pesisir,

dan satu lagi di kota yang muram
dan sedih. Saat kamu bertemu salah\lsatu, pindai mereka dengan Super

Cube-mu dan kirimkan data itu
padaku.

entries.original:
"It appears I have all the data I
need to cure this \qotelevision\lfrenzy\qc.

I will be back momentarily."
entries.translation_source: It appears I have all the data I need to cure this \qotelevision frenzy\qc. I will be back momentarily.
entries.translated:
Tampaknya saya memiliki semua data
yang saya butuhkan untuk\lmenyembuhkan \qodemam televisi\qc ini.

Saya akan kembali sebentar lagi.

entries.original:
"Thank you for waiting.

I have visited each home and cured
the children of their illnesses.

However, during the healing
process, a strange Pokémon\lemerged from each of their bodies.

As a result, they no longer
understand the concept of\lwatching television.

I believe these children will now
be able to lead productive lives."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for waiting. I have visited each home and cured the children of their illnesses. However, during the healing process, a strange Pokémon emerged from each of their bodies. As a result, they no longer understand the concept of watching television. I believe these children will now be able to lead productive lives.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih sudah menunggu. Saya
telah mengunjungi setiap rumah dan\lmenyembuhkan anak-anak dari

penyakit mereka. Namun, selama
proses penyembuhan, Pokémon aneh\lmuncul dari setiap tubuh mereka.

Akibatnya, mereka tidak lagi
memahami konsep menonton televisi.\lSaya yakin anak-anak ini sekarang

akan dapat menjalani kehidupan yang
produktif.

entries.original:
"All of the children have been cured
of the \qotelevision frenzy\qc.

You should return to Polder Town to
claim your reward."
entries.translation_source: All of the children have been cured of the \qotelevision frenzy\qc. You should return to Polder Town to claim your reward.
entries.translated:
Semua anak telah disembuhkan dari
\qodemam televisi\qc. Kamu harus\lkembali ke Polder Town untuk

mengambil hadiahmu.

entries.original:
"[black]The child was scanned using the
Cube.

Data was sent to the scientist at
the Dream Research Lab.

Children remaining: [green][buffer1][black]."
entries.translation_source: [black]The child was scanned using the Cube. Data was sent to the scientist at the Dream Research Lab. Children remaining: [green][buffer1][black].
entries.translated:
[black]Anak itu dipindai menggunakan Cube.
Data dikirim ke ilmuwan di\lLaboratorium Penelitian Mimpi. Anak

tersisa: [green][buffer1][black].
